# Brahmavaivarta-purāṇa 4

## Chapter 1

## \|\| 1.1 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam \|*  
*devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet \|\| 1 \|\|*

Shri-Krishna-janma-Khandam

1\. Offering salutation to Narayana and Nara the best of the humans, the goddess Sarasvati and Vyasa, one should thereafter recite the Jaya Purana.

## \|\| 1.2-9 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śrutaṃ prathamato brahmanbrahmakhaṇḍaṃ manoharam \|*  
*brahmaṇo vadanāṃbhojātparamādbhutameva ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tatastadvacanāttūrṇaṃ samāgatya tavāṃtikam \|*  
*śrutaṃ prakṛtikhaṇḍaṃ ca sudhākhaṃḍātparaṃ varam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tato gaṇapateḥ khaṃḍamakhaṃḍabhavakhaṃḍanam \|*  
*na me tṛptaṃ mano lolaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ śrotumicchati \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍaṃ ca janmādeḥ khaṃḍanaṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*pradīpaṃ sarvatattvānāṃ karmaghnaṃ haribhaktidam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sadyo vairāgyajananaṃ bhavaroganikṛṃtanam \|*  
*kāraṇaṃ muktibījānāṃ bhavābdhestāraṇaṃ param \|\| 6 \|\|*

*karmopabhogarogāṇāṃ khaṃḍane ca rasāyanam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃbhojaprāptisopāna kāraṇam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*jīvanaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jagatāṃ pāvanaṃ param \|*  
*vada vistārya māṃ bhaktaṃ śiṣyaṃ ca śaraṇāgatam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kena vā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇa ājagāma mahītalam \|*  
*sarvāṃśaireka eveśaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam \|\| 9 \|\|*

2-9. Narada said – О Brahman, I have seen listened to the astonishing story of Brahma-khanda from the mouth of Brahma, thereafter with his permission I went to him and also listened to the Prakriti-khanda which was nectar-like sweet and thereafter I listened to the Ganapati Khanda which removes the cycle of birth and death for humans. But my unstable mind has not been satisfied. I therefore, intend to listen to some special type of story relating to the birth of Krishna in the form of Krishna Janma-khanda. Therefore you-please narrate the same to me. It removes the cycle of birth and death among the humans and bestows salvation and the devotion of the gods. It is instrumental in developed attachment and also removes the disease of involvement in the worldly pleasures. It is the seed of redemption, is like a boat in the ocean of the universe, removes the ailments of several births after bearing the result of the same, serving at the form of the medicine. It serves as the step for the achievement of lotus-like feet of lord Krishna and is the purifier of the entire universe. I happen to be your pupil having taken refuge with you. Therefore, you narrate the same to me quite extensively. At whose request did lord Krishna appear or earth in all the arhshas.

## \|\| 1.10 \|\|

*yuge kutra kuto hetoḥ kutra vā''virbabhūva ha \|*  
*vasudevo'sya janakaḥ ko vā kā vā ca devakī \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In which yuga did he appear and for what reason and at which place on earth? Who was Vasudeva his father and Devaki his mother?

## \|\| 1.11 \|\|

*vada kasya kule janma māyayā suviḍaṃbanam \|*  
*kiṃ cakāra samāgatya kena rūpeṇa vā hariḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In whose rays was he born with this illusion? And what were the deeds performed by him in which form.

## \|\| 1.12 \|\|

*jagāma gokulaṃ kaṃsabhayena sūtikāgṛhāt \|*  
*kathaṃ kaṃsātkīṭatulyādbhayeśasya bhayaṃ mune \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. O sage, (it is leant) that being afraid of Kariisa, he disappeared from the labour room and was carried to Gokula but Kamsa happen to be like a small insect for him and he could appear in a dangerous form then was he afraid of Kamsa?

## \|\| 1.13 \|\|

*harirvā gopaveṣeṇa gokule kiṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*kuto gopāṅganāsārdhaṃ vijahāra jagatpatiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The lord of the universe, arriving in Goloka what type of deeds were performed by him in the form of a cowherds? Where did he perform the divine dance with the cowherdesses?

## \|\| 1.14-15 \|\|

*kā vā gopāṃganā ke vā gopālā bālarūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*kā vā yaśodā ko naṃdaḥ kiṃ vā puṇyaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kathaṃ rādhā puṇyavatī devī gokulavāsinī \|*  
*vraje vā vrajakanyā sā babhūva preyaso hareḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Who were the cowherdesses? Who was the child Gopala? Who were Nanda and Yashoda? What merit did they earn as a result of which the lord was born as their son? Why was the virtuous Radha, the dweller of the Goloka descended in Vraja and became the beloved of Krishna?

## \|\| 1.16 \|\|

*kathaṃ gopyo durārādhyaṃ saṃprāpurīśvaraṃ param \|*  
*kathaṃ tāśca parityajya jagāma mathurāṃ punaḥ \|\| 16\|\|*

16\. The auspicious story of the lord is quite inaccessible and serves as a boat to cross the ocean of the universe including the flatters of the deeds and removal of the pain. It serve as a burning wood for the sins and also destroys like fire many of the sins performed in the earlier births. It serves like nectar for the ear and relieves one of all the pain. О merciful one, you kindly enlighten a devotee like me who happens to be your pupil as well as.

## \|\| 1.17 \|\|

*bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ vidhāya jagāma saḥ \|*  
*kathayasva mahābhāga puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Because one earns merit by performing tapas, recitation of the name of the lord, performing great charity, visiting of the holy places on earth, listening to the recitation of the Vedas, fasting, vrata, adoration of the gods and performing of various yajnas\\ all these do not compare even one sixteenth part the listening to the glory of the lord.

## \|\| 1.18-20 \|\|

*sudurlabhāṃ harikathāṃ taraṇiṃ bhavasāgare \|*  
*niṣekabhoganigaḍakleśacchedana kartanīm \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pāpeṃdhanānāṃ dahane jvaladagniśikhāmiva \|*  
*puṃsāṃ śrutavatāṃ koṭijanmakilbiṣanāśinīm \|\| 19 \|\|*

*muktiṃ karṇasudhāramyāṃ śokasāgaranāśinīm \|*  
*mahyaṃ bhaktāya śiṣyāya jñānaṃ dehi kṛpānidhe \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. How could the cowherdesses achieve the lord who is difficult to get even with devotion, as their spouse. Why did the lord leave Goloka and went to Mathura?

## \|\| 1.21-22 \|\|

*tapojapamahādānātpṛthivyāṃ tīrthadarśanāt \|*  
*śrutipāṭhādanaśanādvratāddevārcanādapi \|\| 21 \|\|*

*dīkṣāyāḥ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*ṣoḍaśīṃ jñānadānasya kalāṃ nārhati tatphalam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. O Brahman, you have listened to auspicious words and also recited them; therefore, О virtuous one, you kindly tell me that the lord who had actually incarnated on earth to rid her of the burden of the evil people, what did he actually do.

## \|\| 1.23 \|\|

*pitrā'haṃ preṣito jñānādānāya tava sannidhim \|*  
*sudhāsamudraṃ saṃprāpya ko vā'nyatpātumicchati \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. My father has asked me to seek the divine knowledge from you. After reaching the ocean of nectar who will seek the ordinary water.

## \|\| 1.24 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*mayā jñāto'si dhanyastvaṃ puṇyarāśiḥ sumūrtimān \|*  
*karoṣi bhramaṇaṃ lokānpāvituṃ kulapāvana \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Shri Narayana said – О purifier of the race, you are quite graceful, meritorious and quite an intelligent one. I am do realise this for purifying the universe you move around here and there on earth.

## \|\| 1.25-26 \|\|

*janānāṃ hṛdayaṃ sadyaḥ suvyaktaṃ vacanena vai \|*  
*śiṣye kalatre kanyāyāṃ dauhitre bāṃdhave'pi ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

*putre pautre ca vacasi pratāpe cāpadi striyām \|*  
*vṛddhau vairiṇi vidyāyāṃ jñāyate hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. With the speaking of a few words, the mind of a person becomes clear. One know the mind through the pupil, the wife, the daughter, the son of the daughter brother, son, grandson, speaking, influenced wife, misery, elevation, enemy and learnings.

## \|\| 1.27 \|\|

*jīvanmukto'si pūtastvaṃ śuddhabhakto gadābhṛtaḥ \|*  
*punāsi pādarajasā sarvādhārāṃ vasundharām \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. You are free from birth and death, are quite spotless and are the devout follower of lord Vis nu, the holder of gada. You are purifying this earth with the dust of your feet.

## \|\| 1.28 \|\|

*punāsi lokāntsarvāṃśca svīyavigrahadarśanāt \|*  
*sumaṃgalāṃ harikathāṃ tena tvaṃ śrotumicchasi \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. You remove all the miseries the people by appearing before them. Because of this you are getting interested in listening to the story of the lord which provides prosperity.

## \|\| 1.29 \|\|

*yatra kṛṣṇakathāḥ saṃti tatraiva sarvadevatāḥ \|*  
*ṛṣayo munayaścaiva tīrthāni nikhilāni ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Whosoever listens to the story of lord Krishna or recites it all the gods, sages, ascetics and all the holy places reside there.

## \|\| 1.30-31 \|\|

*kathāḥ śrutvā kathāṃte te yāṃti santo nirāpadam \|*  
*bhavaṃti tāni tīrthāni yeṣu kṛṣṇakathāḥ śubhāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*sadyaḥ kṛṣṇakathāvaktā svasya puṃsāṃ śataṃ śatam \|*  
*samuddhṛtya śrutavatāṃ punāti nikhilaṃ kulam \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. After listening to the sacred story of the lord and after his completion, the noble people achieve the infallible place of the lord. Wherever the story of lord Krishna is recited the place is turned as the sacred one. The one who recites the story of lord Krishna he redeems a hundred generations.

## \|\| 1.32-33 \|\|

*praṣṭā tu praśnamātreṇa punāti kulamātmanaḥ \|*  
*śrotā śravaṇamātreṇa svakulaṃ sva svabāṃdhavān \|\| 32 \|\|*

*śatajanmatapastapto janmedaṃ bhārate labhet \|*  
*karoti saphalaṃ janma śrutvā harikathāmṛtam \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. The one who puts a question about the same purifies his race with the putting of the question and the listener purifies his entire race together with the brothers and other relatives. After performing tapas for a hundred births one is born in the land of Bharata to enable him to be successful in his births after listening to the story of the lord.

## \|\| 1.34-35 \|\|

*arcanaṃ vaṃdanaṃ mantrajapaḥ sevanameva ca \|*  
*smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ śaśvadguṇaśravaṇamīpsitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*nivedanaṃ tasya dāsyaṃ navadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam \|*  
*karoti janma suphalaṃ kṛtvaitāni ca nārada \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Performing the adoration of the lord and the reciting of his mantra, performing puja reciting of his name always, performing kirtana, listening to his virtues with complete surrender serving as a slave or performing the nine types of adoration of the lord. О Narada, performing all these acts, a person becomes successful in life.

## \|\| 1.36 \|\|

*na ca vighno bhavettasya paramāyurna naśyati \|*  
*na yāti tatpuraḥ kālo vainateyamivoragaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Such a person never has to face obstructions and his life span never gets waisted and the god of death gets terrified from him like the serpent getting testified from Garuda.

## \|\| 1.37 \|\|

*na jahāti samīpaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ tasya hariḥ svayam \|*  
*upatiṣṭhati tūrṇaṃ tamaṇimādikasiddhayaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The lord never leaves him alone and all the siddhis like anima and others, automatically reach him.

## \|\| 1.38 \|\|

*sudarśanaṃ bhramatyeva tasya pārśve divāniśam \|*  
*kṛṣṇājñayā ca rakṣārthaṃ ko vā kiṃ kartumīśvaraḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. At the command of the lord, his Sudarsana-cakra always hovers round his devotees and as such no one can do any harm toys.

## \|\| 1.39-40 \|\|

*na yāṃti tatsamīpaṃ ca svapne'pi yamakiṃkarāḥ \|*  
*jvaladagniṃ yathā dṛṣṭvā śalabhā na vrajaṃti tam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vyādhayo vipadaḥ śokā viprāśca na prayāṃti tam \|*  
*na yāti tatsamīpaṃ ca mṛtyurmṛtyubhayānmune \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. As the fire-flies do not approach the place were the fire bums in flame, similarly the messengers of Yama never approach such a person even in dream. О sage, the diseases, misfortune, grief, obstructions never approach, him and because of the fear of destruction even the death avoids him.

## \|\| 1.41 \|\|

*ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|*  
*sa ca sarvatra niḥśaṃkaḥ sukhī kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The sages, the ascetics, siddhas and the gods remain always pleased with him. Because of the grace of lord Krishna, he moves about fearlessly with comfort.

## \|\| 1.42 \|\|

*tava kṛṣṇakathāyāṃ ca ratirātyaṃtikī sadā \|*  
*janakasya svabhāvo hi janye tiṣṭhati niścitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. You have always been far attracted to the listening of story of lord Krishna. Truly the nature of the father is inherited by son.

## \|\| 1.43 \|\|

*vipreṃdra kā praśaṃseyaṃ janma te brahmamānase \|*  
*yatra yatra kule janma tanmatistādṛśī bhavet \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О Indra among the Brahmanas, how shall I praise you, you are mind-bom son of Brahma. The race from which one is born, he inherits the intelligence of similar type.

## \|\| 1.44-45 \|\|

*pitā vidhātā jagatāṃ kṛṣṇapādābjasevayā \|*  
*nityaṃ karoti yaḥ śaśvannavadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ratiḥ kṛṣṇakathāyāṃ ca yasyāśrupulakodgamaḥ \|*  
*mano nimagnaṃ tatraiva sa bhaktaḥ kathito budhaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Your father became the creator of the universe by the grace of lotus-like feet of lord Krishna and he always remains devoted his lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 1.45 \|\|

*ratiḥ kṛṣṇakathāyāṃ ca yasyāśrupulakodgamaḥ \|*  
*mano nimagnaṃ tatraiva sa bhaktaḥ kathito budhaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The intelligent people call only such a person as the true devotee of lord Krishna who remains attracted towards the listening to the story of lord Krishna with tears flowing from his eyes in emotion and he remains engrossed in the same position always.

## \|\| 1.46 \|\|

*putradārādikaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti śrīhareriti \|*  
*ātmanā manasā vācā sa bhaktaḥ kathito budhaiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. He treats with action, thought and behaviour, his son, wife and the entire family as having blessed by the lord. Such a person is considered to be a true devotee of the lord.

## \|\| 1.47 \|\|

*nirjane tīrthasaṃparke niḥsaṃgā ye mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*dhyāyaṃte caraṇāṃbhojaṃ śrīhareste ca vaiṣṇavāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The one who devote himself at the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna at the lonely places as well as the sacred places, he is called the true Vaishnava.

## \|\| 1.48 \|\|

*dayā'sti sarvajīveṣu sarvaṃ kṛṣṇama yaṃ jagat \|*  
*yo jānāti mahājñānī sa bhakto vaiṣṇavo mataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Those who are merciful on all the creatures, visualise the entire universe like Krishna himself. Such great intellectuals are known as a Vaishnava devotee of the lord.

## \|\| 1.49-50 \|\|

*śaśvadye nāma gāyaṃti guṇaṃ maṃtraṃ japaṃti ca \|*  
*kurvaṃti śravaṇaṃ gāthā vadaṃti te'tivaiṣṇavāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*labdhānīṣṭāni vastūni pradātuṃ haraye mudā \|*  
*tūrṇaṃ yasya mano hṛṣṭaṃ sa bhakto jñānināṃ varaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. One who recites the name of the lord besides his virtues, reciting of the mantras performing japam and listens to the sacred story of the lord, he. is indeed considered as great Vaishnava. The one who offers the things desired by him to the lord with pleasure, such a devotee is considered to be best of the intellectuals.

## \|\| 1.51 \|\|

*yanmano haripādābje svapne jñāne divāniśam \|*  
*pūrvakarmopabhogaṃ ca bahirbhuṅkte sa vaiṣṇavaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The one whose mind is always engrossed in the lotus-like feet of the lord throughout the day and night whether in sleeps or awake and who places the reward of the deeds performed by him in earlier births outwardly in an attached manner, he is called the tme Vaishnava.

## \|\| 1.52 \|\|

*guruvaktrādviṣṇumaṃtro yasya karṇe viśatyalam \|*  
*taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ pravadaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The one in whose ear the mantra of the lord enters through mouth of his preceptor, he is called the great Vaishnava.

## \|\| 1.53 \|\|

*pūrvāntsapta parāntsapta sapta mātāmahādikān \|*  
*sodarānuddharedbhaktaḥ svaprasūṃ ca prasūprasūm \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. He redeems the earlier as well as the future seven generations of his parents and the maternal parents beside the relatives, the mother and mother of the maternal grandmother.

## \|\| 1.54 \|\|

*kalatraṃ kanyakāṃ baṃdhuṃ śiṣyaṃ dauhitramātmanaḥ \|*  
*kiṃkarānkiṃkarīścaivamuddharedvaiṣṇavaḥ sadā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Such a Vaishnavas redeems his wife, the daughter, brothers, pupils, son of the daughter beside the male and female servants.

## \|\| 1.55 \|\|

*sadā vāṃchati tīrthāni vaiṣṇavasparśadarśane \|*  
*pāpidattāni pāpāni teṣāṃ naśyaṃti saṃgataḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. All the holy places remain anxious in order to have a look at the true Vaishnavas and with their contact all the sins of the sinners of those places get vanished.

## \|\| 1.56 \|\|

*godohanakṣaṇaṃ yāvadyatra tiṣṭhaṃti vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*tatra sarvāṇi tīrthāni saṃti tāvanmahītale \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. At which ever place a Vaishnava remains up to the time of the milking of the cows all the holy places reached that place.

## \|\| 1.57 \|\|

*dhruvaṃ tatra mṛtaḥ pāpī mukto yāti hareḥ padam \|*  
*tathaiva jñānagaṃgāyāmaṃte kṛṣṇasmṛtau yathā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The people who die at such places are redeemed instantaneously and proceed to the abode of the lord, in the same way as a person at the time of death recites the name of the lord Krishna or a person reciting the name of the Ganga, meets with his death and achieves the abode of the lord.

## \|\| 1.58 \|\|

*tulasīkānane goṣṭhe śrīkṛṣṇamaṃdire pare \|*  
*vṛṃdāraṇye haridvāre tīrtheṣvanyeṣu vā yathā \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. The forest of Tulasi plants, abodes of the cows, the temples of lord Krishna, Vmdavana, Haridvara and other sacred places are considered to be quite auspicious and whose dies at such places surely reaches the abode of the lord.

## \|\| 1.59-60 \|\|

*pāpāni pāpināṃ yāṃti tīrthasnānāvagāhanāt \|*  
*teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti vaiṣṇavasparśavāyunā \|\| 59 \|\|*

*na hi sthātuṃ śaknuvaṃti pāpānyeva kṛtāni ca \|*  
*jvaladagnau yathā kṣipraṃ śuṣkāṇi hi tṛṇāni ca \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. The sinners are relieved of the sins after taking a bath at the sacred places. Their sins vanish with the touching of the air with the bodies of the Vaish nava. The sins cannot sustain like the dry leaves, are sure to bum in the fire flames.

## \|\| 1.61 \|\|

*bhaktaṃ vartmani gacchaṃtaṃ ye ye paśyaṃti mānavāḥ \|*  
*saptajanmārjitāghāni teṣāṃ naśyaṃti niścitam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Such of the people who have a look at the devotees walking on the road, the sins accumulated by them in the past seven births get destroyed with the casting of the glance at the devotee of the lord.

## \|\| 1.62 \|\|

*ye niṃdaṃti hṛṣīkeśaṃ tadbhaktaṃ puṇyarūpiṇam \|*  
*śatajanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati niścitam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Such of the people who denounce the meritorious devotees of the lord, the merits earned by them during the past hundred births get destroyed.

## \|\| 1.63 \|\|

*te pacyaṃte mahāghore kuṃbhīpāke bhayānake \|*  
*bhakṣitāḥ kīṭasaṃghena yāvaccaṃdradivākarau \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Ultimately they fall into the terrific kumbhipaka hell and remain there till the time of the sun and the moon and the insects eat them up.

## \|\| 1.64 \|\|

*tasya darśanamātreṇa puṇyaṃ naśyati niścitam \|*  
*gaṃgāṃ snātvā raviṃ natvā tadā vidvānviśudhyati \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. All the merits disappear at the sight of such people, such a person is purified after bowing in reverence to the sun taking bath in the Ganga.

## \|\| 1.65-66 \|\|

*vaiṣṇavasparśamātreṇa mukto bhavati pātakī \|*  
*tasya pāpāni haṃtyeva svāṃtaḥstho madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathito vipra viṣṇuvaiṣṇavayorguṇaḥ \|*  
*adhunā śrīharerjanma nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. But the sinner is purified at the very sight of a Vaishnava because such a Vaishnava is always devoted to lord Madhusudana and all his sins get destroyed. О Brahman, a thus I have narrated to you the virtues of Vishnu and Vaishnavas now I am going to speak to you about the birth of lord Hari which you please listen.

## Chapter 2

## \|\| 2.1-2 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*yena vā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇa ājagāma mahītalam \|*  
*yaṃ yaṃ vidhāya bhūmau sa jagāma svālayaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*bhārāvataraṇopāyaṃ duṣṭānāṃ ca vadhodyamam \|*  
*sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi suvicārya vidhānataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – I shall narrate to you at whose prayer lord Krishna incarnated on earthy the deeds performed by him in the universe, the efforts made by him to relieve the earth of her burden, besides killing of the wicked people.

## \|\| 2.3 \|\|

*adhunā gopaveṣaṃ ca gokulāgamanaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*rādhā gopālikā yena nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The arrival of lord Krishna in the form of a cowherds in Goloka and the reason for incarnation Radha as a cowherds, is going to narrated by me, You please listen to it.

## \|\| 2.4 \|\|

*śaṃkhacūḍavadhaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ śrutam \|*  
*adhunā tatsuvistārya nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. I had briefly spoken to you about the killing of Samkhacuda, I am now narrating the same story in considerable details. You please listen to it.

## \|\| 2.5 \|\|

*śrīdāmnaḥ kalahaścaiva babhūva rādhayā saha \|*  
*śrīdāmā śaṃkhacūḍaśca śāpāttasyā babhūva ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Once the cowherd named Sridama quarrelled with Radha as a result of which the latter had to be born as Samkhacuda on earth.

## \|\| 2.6 \|\|

*rādhāṃ śaśāpa śrīdāmā yāhi yoniṃ ca mānavīm \|*  
*vraje vrajāṃganā bhūtvā vicarasva mahītale \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Sridama also pronounced a curse on Radha to be born as a human being and to remain Vraja as a female roaming about in that place.

## \|\| 2.7-8 \|\|

*bhītā śrīdāmaśāpātsā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ samuvāca ha \|*  
*gopīrūpā bhaviṣyāmi śrīdāmā māṃ śaśāpa ha \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kamupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi vada māṃ bhayabhaṃjana \|*  
*tvayā vinā kathamahaṃ dhariṣyāmi svajīvanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Thereafter with the curse of Sridama, Radha was afraid who spoke to Krishna, "O lord, I shall have to be born as a cowherds because of the curse of Sridama, you tell me the remedy for the same, because without you how can I be reborn."

## \|\| 2.9-11 \|\|

*kṣaṇamekaṃ yugaśataṃ kālanātha tvayā vinā \|*  
*cakṣurnimeṣavirahādbhavedaṃdhaṃ mano mama \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrābhaṃ kṣudhāpūrṇānanaṃ tava \|*  
*nātha cakṣuñcakorābhyāṃ pibāmyahamaharniśam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tvamātmā me manaḥ prāṇā dehamātraṃ vahāmyaham \|*  
*dṛṣṭiśaktiśca cakṣustvaṃ jīvanaṃ paramaṃ dhanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. O lord, without you a moment will be spent by me like yugas. Even separation from you of the twinkling of an eye disturbed me immensely. I actually consume the nectar-like the full moon of the winter season representing your glory, day and night like the partridge bird. You are toy soul and my life though I move about with this body. Therefore you happen to be my eye-sight, my eyes and the treasure of my life.

## \|\| 2.12 \|\|

*svapne jñāne tvayi manaḥ smarāmi tvatpadāṃbujam \|*  
*tava dāsyaṃ vinā nātha na jīvāmi kṣaṇaṃ vibho \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. I always adore you while sleeping or awake and always meditate upon your lotus-like feet. О lord, О virtuous one, I cannot remain alive even for a moment without serving you.

## \|\| 2.13-14 \|\|

*kṛṣṇastadvacanaṃ śrutvā bodhayāmāsa suṃdarīm \|*  
*vakṣasi preyasīṃ kṛtvā cakāra nirbhayāṃ ca tām \|\| 13 \|\|*

*mahītalaṃ gamiṣyāmi vārāhe ca varānane \|*  
*mayā sārdhaṃ bhūgamanaṃ janma te'pi nirūpitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. On listening to the words of Radha, lord Krishna to convince her. He embraced his beloved and reassured her variously saying, О beautiful faced one, in the Varaha-kalpa. I shall walk on the surface of the earth and you will also be born with me at that time.

## \|\| 2.15 \|\|

*vrajaṃ gatvā vraje devi vihariṣyāmi kānane \|*  
*mama prāṇādhikā tvaṃ ca bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О goddess, we shall be born in Vraja and roam about in the forest, you are dearer to me than my life therefore why do you get afraid when I am there.

## \|\| 2.16 \|\|

*tāmityuktvā haristatra virarāma jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*ato hetorjagannātho jagāma naṃdagokulam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Krishna, the lord of the universe; kept quiet after thus speaking. Because of this the lord of the universe went to Gokula.

## \|\| 2.17-18 \|\|

*kiṃ vā tasya bhayaṃ kaṃsādbhayāṃtakārakasya ca \|*  
*māyā bhayacchalenaiva jagāma rādhikāṃtikam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vijahāra tayā sārdhaṃ gopaveṣaṃ vidhāya saḥ \|*  
*saha gopāṃganābhiśca pratijñāpālanāya ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The lord who removes the fears of others, how could he be afraid of Kamsa? Displaying his illusory fear he went to Radha and for the fulfilment of this words the performed the divine dance with Radha and other cowherdesses.

## \|\| 2.19 \|\|

*brahmaṇā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samāgatya mahītalam \|*  
*bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtvā jagāma svālayaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. At the request of Brahma, lord Krishna incarnated on earth and relieved her of the burden and then went back too his abode.

## \|\| 2.20 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śrīdāmnaḥ kalahaścaiva kathaṃ vā rādhayā saha \|*  
*saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃvyasya kathayādhunā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Narada said – Earlier you had mentioned about the dispute of Radha and Shridama briefly but currently you speak out to me the same in detail.

## \|\| 2.21 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā rādhayā sārdhaṃ goloke śrīhariḥ svayam \|*  
*vijahāra mahāraṇye nirjane rāsamaṃḍale \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Narayana said – Once lord Krishna was roaming about in the secluded place in Rasamandala of Goloka.

## \|\| 2.22-23 \|\|

*rādhikāsukhasaṃbhogād bubudhe na svakaṃ param \|*  
*kṛtvā vihāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇastāmapṛṣṭvā vihāya ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*gopikāṃ virajāmanyāṃ śṛṅgārārthaṃ jagāma ha \|*  
*vṛṃdāraṇye ca virajā subhagā rādhikāsamā \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Engrossed in the love sport with Radha, he was filled with illusion; that is why after performing of the love-sport, he left Radha and was engaged in the same play with a cowherds named Viraja. She happened to be as beautiful as Radha herself and lived in Vmdavana.

## \|\| 2.24-25 \|\|

*tasyā vayasyāḥ suṃdaryo gopīnāṃ śatakoṭayaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā gopī dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ratnasiṃhāsanasthā sā dadarśa harimantike \|*  
*dadarśa śrīharistāṃ ca śaraccaṃdranibhānanām \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. She had a hundred crores of beautiful cowherdesses as female friends. She happened to be dearer to Krishna than his own life. She was seated on the gem-studded lion-throne and found lord Krishna approaching her, who looked at her face which was shining like the full moon of the winter season.

## \|\| 2.26-28 \|\|

*manoharāṃ sasmitāṃ ca paśyaṃtīṃ vakracakṣuṣā \|*  
*sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ prodbhinnanavayauvanām \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ bhūṣitāṃ śuklavāsasā \|*  
*pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgīṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ śrīharistūrṇaṃ vijahāra tayā saha \|*  
*puṣpatalpe mahāraṇye nirjane ratnamaṃḍape \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. She was smiling and casting side glance and was of tender age of sixteen, quite truthful, adorned in all the beautiful ornaments, wearing white garments. He was feeling emotion and passionate at the same time. Looking at her lord Krishna enjoyed conjugal pleasures with her on the flowery bed in the secluded orchard.

## \|\| 2.29-33 \|\|

*mūrcchāmavāpa virajā kṛṣṇaśṛṃgārakautukāt \|*  
*kṛtvā vakṣasi prāṇeśaṃ koṭikaṃdarpasannibham \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tayā saktaṃ śrīhariṃ ca ratnamaṃḍapasaṃsthitam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā ca rādhikālyaśca cakrustāṃ ca nivedanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā suṣvāpa ca cukopa ha \|*  
*bhṛśaṃ ruroda sā devī raktapaṃkajalocanā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tā uvāca mahādevī māṃ taṃ darśayituṃ kṣamāḥ \|*  
*yadi satyaṃ brūta yūyaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ pragacchata \|\| 32 \|\|*

*kariṣyāmi phalaṃ gopyāḥ kṛṣṇasya ca yathocitam \|*  
*ko rakṣitā'dya tasyāśca mayi śāstiṃ prakurvati \|\| 33 \|\|*

29-33. She enraged Krishna who appeared beautiful like crores of gods of love and enjoyed his company variously getting ultimately fainted. The lord however remained with her in the gem-studded mandapa. The female friends of Radhika looked at this performance of lord Krishna and reported the same to Radhika, On hearing the words of the female friends, Radhika was enraged and she started crying and her eyes were turned like the red lotus flowers. The great goddess then spoke to her female friends. In case you are telling me the truth then get along with me and show me the place, shall punish the cowherds together with lord Krishna appropriately. I shall see who protects them from my ray.

## \|\| 2.34-35 \|\|

*śīghramānayatālyaśca tayā sārddhaṃ hariṃ priyam \|*  
*aṃtarvaktraṃ sasmitaṃ ca viṣakuṃbhaṃ sudhāmukham \|\| 34 \|\|*

*madāśrayaṃ samāgaṃtuṃ yūyaṃ dāsaṃ na dāsyatha \|*  
*tameva maṃḍapaṃ ramyaṃ yāta saṃrakṣateśvaram \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. О friend, you bring before me the cowherds and Krishna here who happens to be wicked from with in but as a smiling race, filled with poison but coated with nectar. A few people will not be able to bring him here therefore let us move to the beautiful mandapa and protect him.

## \|\| 2.36-37 \|\|

*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā kāścidgopyo bhayānvitāḥ \|*  
*tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃpuṭāṃjalyo bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ \|*  
*tāmūcuḥ purataḥ sthitvā sarvā eva priyāṃ satīm \|\| 36 \|\|*

*. ālya ūcuḥ \|*  
*vayaṃ taṃ darśayiṣyāmo virajāsahitaṃ vibhum \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. On hearing the words of Radhika all the female friends get terrified thereafter all of them appeared before her with folded hands and meekly standing said to Radhika.

## \|\| 2.38-46 \|\|

*tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā rathamāruhya suṃdarī \|*  
*jagāma sārdhaṃ gopībhistriṣaṣṭiśatakoṭibhiḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ratneṃdrasāraracitaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham \|*  
*maṇīṃdrasāraracitaṃ kalaśānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*rājitaṃ citrarājībhirvaijayaṃtīvirājitam \|*  
*lakṣacakrasamāyuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*maṇisāravikāraiśca koṭistaṃbhaiḥ suśobhitam \|*  
*nānācitravicitraiśca sahitaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*siṃdūrākāramaṇibhirmadhyadeśe vibhūṣitaiḥ \|*  
*ratnakṛtrimasiṃhaiśca rathacakrordhvasaṃsthitaiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*caturlakṣaparimitaiścitraghaṃṭāsamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*citraputtaliśobhāḍhyairvicitraiśca virājitam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*ratimaṃdiralakṣaiśca ratnasāravinirmitaiḥ \|*  
*maṇisārakapāṭaiśca śobhitaiścitravājibhiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*maṇīṃdrasārakalaśaiḥ śekharojjvalitairyutam \|*  
*bhogadravyasamāyuktaṃ veṣadravyasamanvitam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*śobhitaṃ ratnaśayyābhī ratnapātraghaṭānvitam \|*  
*harinmaṇīnāṃ vedīnāṃ samūhena samanvitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

38-46. The female friends said – we will show you no doubt Viraja and lord Krishna, On listening to their words, the beautiful RSdha mounted the chariots with sixty three hundred million cowherdesses and departed from that place. The chariot was studded with the best of gems and was shining like crores of suns emitting the lustre. It was built with the best of jewels and had three crores of kalafas decorating it. It had lines of paintings and the banner and a lakh of wheels, it could move with great speed, looked quite charming and had crores of pillars studded with gems, various types of arts were displayed in the same. It was quite pleasant. It was studded with rubies and on the wheels there were artificial lions decorating. There were four lakhs of paintings including those of Chitraghanta and the other dolls, it had beautiful horses which looked like the paintings and the doors were studded with gems, besides several pleasure houses and the kalasas with shining peaks. There were several materials and cosmetics, the bed of gems, vases of jewels and the stools made of different types of gems and jewels.

## \|\| 2.47-49 \|\|

*kuṃkumābhamaṇīnāṃ ca sopānaiḥ koṭibhiryutam \|*  
*syamaṃtakaiḥ kaustubhaiśca rucakaiḥ pravaraistathā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*padmakṛtrimakoṭīnāṃ śatakaiśca suśobhitam \|*  
*citrakānanavāpībhi rviśiṣṭābhirvirājitam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*ratneṃdrasāraracitakalaśojjvalaśekharam \|*  
*śatayojanamūrdhvaṃ ca daśayojanavistṛtam \|\| 49 \|\|*

47-49. There were several steps studded with rubies and shining like saffron and other gems including the artificial lotuses, from the astonishing type of forests, steps-wells besides the pitches made of gem. It was a hundred yojanas in height and was ten yojanas in width.

## \|\| 2.50-53 \|\|

*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālākoṭivirājitam \|*  
*kuṃdānā karavīrāṇāṃ yūthikānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

*sucārucaṃpakānāṃ ca nāgeśānāṃ manoharaiḥ \|*  
*mallikānāṃ mālatīnāṃ mādhavīnāṃ sugaṃdhinām \|\| 51 \|\|*

*kadaṃbānāṃ ca mālānāṃ kadaṃbaiśca virājitam \|*  
*sahasradalapadmānāṃ mālābhiśca virājitam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*citrapuṣpodyānasaraḥ kānanaiśca vibhūṣitam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ syaṃdanānāṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ vāyuvahaṃ param \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. It had crores of garlands of Parijata flowers besides other flowers like Jasmine, Campa, Nagakesara, Mallika, Malatl and fragrant Madhavi besides kadamba. There were garlands of thousand pettaled lotus flowery, several orchards, stream, tanks and forest. It was the best of all the chariots and could move with the speed of the wind.

## \|\| 2.54-59 \|\|

*tatsūkṣmavastrasārāṇāṃ varairācchāditaṃ param \|*  
*ratnadarpaṇalakṣāṇāṃ śatakaiśca samanvitam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*śvetacāmarakoṭībhirvajrakoṭibhiranvitam \|*  
*candanāgarukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitaiḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ koṭitalpavirājitam \|*  
*koṭighaṃṭāsamāyuktaṃ patākākoṭibhiryutam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*ratnaśayyākoṭibhiśca citravajraparicchadaiḥ \|*  
*caṃdanāktaiścaṃpakānāṃ kuṃkumaiśca vicitritaiḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*puṣpopadhānasaṃyuktaiḥ śṛṃgārārhābhiranvitam \|*  
*adṛśyairaśrutairdravyaiḥ suṃdaraiśca vibhūṣitam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*evaṃbhūtādrathāttūrṇamavaruhya haripriyā \|*  
*jagāma sahasā devī taṃ ratnamaṃḍapaṃ mune \|\| 59 \|\|*

54-59. It was covered with the best of fine garments and had a hundred lakh mirrors of gems, a crores of fly-whisks with handles of precious stones. There were sandal-paste, agurii, kasturl and saffron besides crores of flowers of Parijata spread on the beds' besides crores of bells, banners beds made of gems and strings of pearls and flowers besides the pillows, it had several articles of cosmetics placed in abundance, some of which were never heard of even. О sage, thus descending quickly from the chariot, Radha the beloved of lord Krishna, at once reached the gem-studded mandapa.

## \|\| 2.60-62 \|\|

*dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśe dvārapālaṃ manoharam \|*  
*lakṣagopaiḥ parivṛtaṃ smerānanasaroruham \|\| 60 \|\|*

*gopaṃ śrīdāmanāmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapriyakiṃkaram \|*  
*tamuvāca ruṣā devī raktapaṃkajalocanā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*gaccha dūraṃ gaccha dūraṃ ratilaṃpaṭakiṃkara \|*  
*kīdṛśīṃ matparāṃ kāṃtāṃ drakṣyāmi tvatprabhoraham \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. She saw there a beautiful gate-keeper surrounded by a lakh of cowherds and had a smiling face. He happened to be Shridama, the best of the servants of Shri Krishna. He found Radha burning in anger and her eyes setting red like red-lotus flowers. She said to him, "O servant of a passionate lord, you remove yourself from this place to enable me to have a look at the beloved of your lord who is important then me."

## \|\| 2.63-64 \|\|

*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā niḥśaṃkaḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*tāmeva na dadau gaṃtuṃ vetrapāṇirmahābalaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*tūrṇaṃ ca rādhikālyaśca śrīdāmānaṃ sakiṃkaram \|*  
*balena prerayāmāsuḥ kopena sphuritādharāḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. On hearing the words of Radhika, holding a cane in his hand, he prevented Radhika from entering the pleasure orchard. He stood there fearlessly. Thereafter, the female friends of Radhika forcibly removed the servant of Krishna from that place. At that point of time the lips of all the cowherdesses were fluttering.

## \|\| 2.65-66 \|\|

*śrutvā kolāhalaṃ śabdaṃ gopikānāṃ hariḥ svayam \|*  
*jñātvā ca kopitāṃ rādhāmaṃtardhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 65 \|\|*

*virajā rādhikāśabdādaṃtardhānaṃ harerapi \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ bhayārtā sā jahau prāṇāṃśca yogataḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. On hearing the of the cowherdesses and finding Radha in great anger, the lord disappear from the scene. Viraja too listened, to the enrage words of Radha and finding Krishna having been disappeared ended her life with the application of yogic practices.

## \|\| 2.67-68 \|\|

*sadyastatra saridrūpaṃ taccharīraṃ babhūva ha \|*  
*vyāptaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ tayā golokameva ca \|\| 67 \|\|*

*koṭiyojanavistīrṇaṃ prasthe'tinimnameva ca \|*  
*dairghye daśaguṇaṃ cāru nānāratnākaraṃ param \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. Thereafter her body was converted into a stream which flowed around Goloka. It was the crores of yojanas and width quite deep and In length it was ten times more. It possesses various gems and was quite beautiful.

## Chapter 3

## \|\| 3.1 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*rādhā ratigṛhaṃ gatvā na dadarśa hariṃ mune \|*  
*virajāṃ ca saridūpāṃ dṛṣṭvā gehaṃ jagāma sā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shri Narayana said – О sage, on her entry into the pleasure chamber Radhika could not find the lord arid finding Viraja having been turned into the form of a stream she returned to her abode.

## \|\| 3.2-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇo virajāṃ dṛṣṭvā saridrūpāṃ priyāṃ satīm \|*  
*uccai ruroda virajātīre nīramanohare \|\| 2 \|\|*

*mamāṃtikaṃ samāgaccha preyasīnāṃ pare vare \|*  
*tvayā vinā'haṃ subhage kathaṃ jīvāmi suṃdari \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Thereafter lord Krishna finding that his beloved having been turned into a stream, he started crying seated on its bank and said, "O best of the beloved, you come to me immediately, О virtuous lady, О beautiful one, how shall I be able to remain alive without you"?

## \|\| 3.4-6 \|\|

*nadyadhiṣṭhātri devi tvaṃ bhava mūrtimatī satī \|*  
*mamāśiṣā rūpavatī suṃdarī yoṣitā varā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*pūrvarūpācca saubhāgyādidānīṃ subhagā bhava \|*  
*purātanaṃ śarīraṃ te saridūpamabhūtsati \|\| 5 \|\|*

*jalādutthāya cāgaccha vidhāya tanumuttamām \|*  
*aṣṭau siddhīrmayā dattāḥ surasuṃdari satvaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. You become the best of the streams on earth. О beautiful one, with my boon you become a beautiful damsel. As a matter of luck you be more beautiful then your original figure because your earlier body has been turned into the stream. Therefore with a beautiful body you emerge out of the water of the stream. О beautiful one, with that and in view I have bestowed upon you all the siddhis (success.

## \|\| 3.7 \|\|

*kṛṣṇājñayā ca virajā vidhāya tanumuttamām \|*  
*ājagāma hareragre sākṣādrādheva suṃdarī \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Thereafter with the permission of lord Krishna, Viraja emerged as Radha herself and stood before Krishna.

## \|\| 3.8 \|\|

*pītavastraparīdhānā smerānanasaroruhā \|*  
*paśyaṃtaṃ prāṇanāthaṃ ca paśyaṃtī vakracakṣuṣā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Wearing a yellow lower garment and a serene smile on her face, the lotus faced damsel stood before Krishna and started looking at him with side-glances.

## \|\| 3.9-14 \|\|

*nitaṃbaśroṇibhārārtā pīnonnatapayodharā \|*  
*māninī māninīnāṃ ca gajeṃdramaṃdagāminī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*suṃdarī sudarīṇāṃ ca dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām \|*  
*cārucaṃpakavarṇābhā pakvabiṃbādharā varā \|\| 10 \|\|*

82-83. Lakshmi the goddess of fortune rinses the feet of the lord with her hair and serves him with the utmost devotion. Sarasvati adore him offering prayers which have soothing effect on the ears like a nectary, are you not aware of such a lord.

## \|\| 3.84 \|\|

*bhītā ca prakṛtirmāyā sarveṣāṃ bījarūpiṇī \|*  
*satataṃ stauti yaṃ bhaktyā taṃ na jānāsi mānini \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Prakriti who happens to be the seed of all, always praise him with devotion. Proud damsel are you not fully aware of him.

## \|\| 3.85-92 \|\|

*stuvaṃti satataṃ vedā mahimnaḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām \|*

*śeṣaḥ sahasravadanaiḥ paramātmānamīśvaram \|*

*dharmaḥpātā ca sarveṣāṃ sākṣī ca jagatāṃ patiḥ \|*

*śvetadvīpanivāsī yaḥ pātā viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ vibhuḥ \|*

*surāsuramunīṃdrāśca manavo mānavā budhāḥ \|*  
*sevaṃte na hi paśyaṃti svapne'pi caraṇāṃbujam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*kṣipraṃ roṣaṃ parityajya bhaja pādāṃbujaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*bhrūbhaṃgalīlāmātreṇa sṛṣṭisaṃhartureva ca \|\| 92 \|\|*

85-92. All the Vedas recite the glory of the sixteenth, part of the lord but are unable to know about his reality. О damsel, are you not aware of him. О goddess, Brahma, the creator of the Vedas go on reciting his glory with all the four mouths and serve at his lotus-like feet. Shiva the lord of yogis with his five mouths always recites his glory and also serves at his lotus-like feet and with his mind filled with emotion he serves as his lotus-like feet. Shesha recited his glory with thousands of his moths with devotion and also served at his lotus-like feet. Dharma protects all besides being the witness of all he also serve at his feet being the lord of all. Vishnu the resident of Shveta-dvipa who is all-pervading happens to be an athsa of the lord and has taken to the eternal form. All the gods, demons, sages, ascetics, intellectuals and humans continuously serve at his lotus-like feet but are unable to visualise him even in dream, you must serve at the lotus-like feet of lord Hari shedding away your anger because he can reduce the earth to ashes with a simple side-glance.

## \|\| 3.93-94 \|\|

*nimeṣamātrādasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet \|*  
*yasyaikadivase'pyaṣṭāviṃśatīṃdrāḥ pataṃtyapi \|\| 93 \|\|*

*evamaṣṭottaraśatamāyuryasya jagadvidheḥ \|*

93-94. With the twinkling of an eye of the lord, Brahma vanishes and with the spending of single day of the lord twenty eight Indras disappear. О Radha, he is the one having the age of hundred and eight years, the entire universe and the goddesses are being controlled by the same lord.

## \|\| 3.95-96 \|\|

*śrīdāmno vacanaṃ śrutvā kevalaṃ kaṭumujjvalam \|*

*rāseśvarī bahirgatvā tamuvāca ha niṣṭhuram \|*  
*sphuradoṣṭhī muktakeśī raktāṃbhoruhalocanā \|\| 96 \|\|*

95-96. О Brahman, on hearing the words of Shridama which were quite harsh, Radha the beloved of lord was immensely enraged. At that point of time burning with rage her lips were uttering, the hair was dishevelled, the eyes became red like red lotus dower. She then came out and spoke very harsh-words.

## \|\| 3.97-98 \|\|

*rādhikovāca \|*  
*re re jālma mahāmṛḍha śṛṇu lampaṭakikara \|*

*tvadīśvaraśca śrīkṛṣṇo na hyasmākaṃ vrajādhama \|*

97-98. Radhika said – О degraded one, a food and servant of a thief, listen to me. You are well aware of everything I am not aware of your lord. О degraded one, lord Krishna happens to be your lord alone and not of we people. Therefore, you get lost from here I am quite well-aware that you always praise your father and denounce your mother.

## \|\| 3.99-101 \|\|

*yathā'surāśca tridaśā nityaṃ niṃdaṃti saṃtatam \|*

*gopa vrajāsurīṃ yoniṃ golokācca bahirbhava \|*  
*mayā'dya śapto mūḍhastvaṃ kastvāṃ rakṣitumīśvaraḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

*rāseśvarī tamityuktvā suṣvāpa virarāma ca \|*  
*vayasyāḥ sevayāmāsuścāmarai ratnamuṣṭibhiḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

99-101. О foolish one, as the demons always denounce the gods similarly you have always been denouncing me. You will therefore, become a demon. О cowherd, you will fall from Goloka and will be born as a demon on earth. О foolish one, I have pronounced a curse on you. I shall see who comes to your rescue, Thus sneaking Radha, the goddess of the divine dance kept quiet and when she went to sleep her female friends started moving the fly-whisks with the handles decorated with gems.

## \|\| 3.102 \|\|

*śrutvā ca vacanaṃ tasyāḥ kopena sphuritādharaḥ \|*  
*śaśāpa tāṃ ca śrīdāmā vraja yoniṃ ca mānuṣīm \|*  
*śrīdāmovāca \|*  
*mānuṣyā iva kopaste tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣī bhuvi \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. But on the other hand on hearing the words of Radha, the lips of Shridama also started uttering, he also cursed her to be born in a human race.

## \|\| 3.103-104 \|\|

*bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho mayā śaptā tvamaṃbike \|*  
*chāyayā kalayā vā'pi paraśaktyā kalaṃkinā \|\| 103 \|\|*

*mūḍhā rāpāṇapatnī tvāṃ vakṣyati jagatītale \|*  
*rāpāṇaḥ śrīhareraṃśo vaiśyo vṛṃdāvane vane \|\| 104 \|\|*

103-104. Shridama said – О mother your anger is like an ordinary human being Therefore, with my curse you will also be born as a human being on earth. There is no doubt about it. With the shadow of the eternal force you will appear on earth but the foolish people will call you as the wife of Rayana. Vaisya, who will be born of the Goloka of lord Krishna in Vmdavana.

## \|\| 3.105 \|\|

*bhaviṣyati mahāyogī rādhāśāpena garbhajaḥ \|*

105\. Because of the curse of Radha he would become a Mahdyogi in his mothers womb and shall be reborn as such. Thereafter you will achieve lord Krishna Gokula and shall roam about with him in the forest.

## \|\| 3.106 \|\|

*bhavitā te varṣaśataṃ vicchedo hariṇā saha \|*

106\. Thereafter you will be separated from the lord for a hundred years and thereafter getting united with him you would return to Goloka.

## \|\| 3.107 \|\|

*tāmityuktvā ca natvā ca sa jagāma hareḥ puraḥ \|*  
*gatvā praṇamya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śāpākhyānamuvāca ha \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Thus speaking to her and bowing before her Shridama went to the lord. He bowed in reverence to him and narrated to him the incident of the pronouncing of the curse.

## \|\| 3.108-111 \|\|

*ānupūrvyāttu tatsarvaṃ ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*uvāca taṃ rudaṃtaṃ ca gacchadhvaṃ dharaṇītalam \|\| 108 \|\|*

*na jetā te tribhuvane hyasureṃdro bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*kāle śaṃkaraśūlena dehaṃ tyaktvā mamāṃtikam \|\| 109 \|\|*

*āgamiṣyasi paṃcāśadyugāṃte tu mamāśiṣā \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā tamuvāca śucā'nvitaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

*tvadbhaktirahitaṃ māṃ ca kadācinna kariṣyasi \|*  
*ityuktvā śrīhariṃ natvā jagāma svāśramādbahiḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

108-111. Не started crying again and again. At that point of time the lord said to him. Now you proceed on to the earth. There will be no other demon in the three worlds to over-power you. You will be the king of the demons and in due course of time you will meet with your end with the striking of the trident of Shiva and come back to Goloka. I am going to bless you that you will remain there for fifty yugas. On hearing the won of lord Krishna, Shridama felt grief-stricken and spoke to him, I accept your command but you do not deprive me of your devotion on earth at any time. Thus speaking he bowed before the lord and came out of his ashrama.

## \|\| 3.112-113 \|\|

*paścājjagāma sā devī ruroda ca punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*kva yāsi vatsetyuccārya vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ satī \|\| 112 \|\|*

*śrīdāmā'pi ca tāṃ natvā ruroda premavihvalaḥ \|*  
*sa eva śaṃkhacūḍaśca babhūva tulasīpatiḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

112-113. Radha also started following him and started speaking while weeping bitterly. О son, where are you going? Thus speaking she lamented again and again. Shridama also bowed in reverence to her and cried aloud for a long time. Ultimately he became Samkhacuda and husband of Tulasi.

## \|\| 3.114 \|\|

*gate śrīdāmni sā devī jagāmeśvarasannidhim \|*  
*sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa hariḥ pratyuttaraṃ dadau \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. At the departure of Sridama, Radha also went to lord Krishna and narrated the entire story to him. The lord then spoke to her.

## \|\| 3.115 \|\|

*śokāturāṃ ca tāṃ kṛṣṇo bodhayāmāsa preyasīm \|*  
*śaṃkhacūḍaśca kālena saṃprāpa punarīśvaram \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Finding Radha engrossed in grief lord Krishna consoled her variously. In due course of time SamkhacOda again became the attendants of the lord.

## \|\| 3.116 \|\|

*rādhā jagāma dharaṇīṃ vārāhe hariṇā saha \|*  
*vṛṣabhānugṛhe janma lalābha gokule mune \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. O sage, Radha went to the earth at the time of Varaha incarnation of Vishnu and was born in Gokula in the house of Vrsabhanu.

## \|\| 3.117 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇākhyānamaṃgalam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ vāṃchitaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Thus I have narrated to you the entire story of lord Krishna which provides welfare in all the times and all the people desire to listen to it. What else do you want to listen from me?

## Chapter 4

## \|\| 4.1 \|\|

*. nārada uvāca \|*  
*kena vā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇo mahīṃ ca kena hetunā \|*  
*ājagāma jagannātho vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – О best of these well versed in the Vedas, at whose request lord Krishna who happens to be the lord of the universe appeared on earth in human form and what was the reason for it.

## \|\| 4.2 \|\|

*. nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*

## \|\| 4.3 \|\|

*suraiścāsurasaṃtaptairbhṛśamudvignamānasaiḥ \|*

3\. Having been terrified immensely by the demons, the goddess earth accompanied with the gods, reached the inaccessible court of Brahma.

## \|\| 4.4 \|\|

*dadarśa tasyāṃ deveśaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā \|*

4\. And found Brahma the lord of the gods there illumining; with divine lustre and surrounded by a Rsis, sages and siddhas delightfully.

## \|\| 4.5-6 \|\|

*apsarogaṇanṛtyaṃ ca paśyaṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā \|*  
*gaṃdharvāṇāṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śrutavaṃtaṃ manoharam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*japaṃtaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam \|*

5-6. Wearing a smile on his face, he was witnessing the dance of the apsaras, accompanied with the music by Gandharvas. He was reciting the two latter name of Krishna, his eyes were filled with tears because of his devotion and the entire body had become sensational.

## \|\| 4.7-9 \|\|

*bhaktyā sā tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ praṇamya caturānanam \|*  
*sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakre daityabhārādikaṃ mune \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sā'śrupūrṇā sapulakā tuṣṭāva ca ruroda ca \|*

*kathamāgamanaṃ bhadre vada bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*susthirā bhava kalyāṇi bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. О sage, the goddess PrthvI together with the gods bowed to the four faced Brahma and told him the story of his suffering at the hands of the demons. Thereafter, getting emotional her eyes was filled with tears and while crying she started offering prayer to Brahma. Looking at her Brahma the creator of the universe said, "O noble lady, why ace you crying and offering prayer at the same time"? How have you arrived here?

## \|\| 4.10-13 \|\|

*āśvāsya pṛthivīṃ brahmā devānpapraccha sādaram \|*  
*kathamāgamanaṃ devā yuṣmākaṃ mama sannidhim \|\| 10 \|\|*

*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā devā ūcuḥ prajāpatim \|*  
*bhārākrāṃtā ca vasudhā dasyugrastā vayaṃ prabho \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tvameva jagatāṃ sraṣṭā śīghraṃ no niṣkṛtiṃ kuru \|*  
*gatistvamasyā bho brahmannirvṛtiṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pīḍitā yena bhāreṇa pṛthivīyaṃ pitāmaha \|*  
*vayaṃ tenaiva duḥkhārtāstadbhāraharaṇaṃ kuru \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. Tell me at once. Surely you will meet with welfare, О prosperous one, why are you feeling panicky? You be composer.

## \|\| 4.14-16 \|\|

*devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tāṃ papraccha jagadvidhiḥ \|*  
*dūrīkṛtya bhayaṃ vatse sukhaṃ tiṣṭha mamāṃtikam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*keṣāṃ bhāramaśaktā tvaṃ soḍhuṃ paṃkajalocane \|*

*tasya sā vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca svapīḍanam \|*

14-16. Thus assuring the goddess of earth variously Brahma asked the gods respectfully, "0 gods, why have you arrived here"? You tell me the reason for it. On listening to the words of Brahma the gods spoke to Prajapati thus, О lord, the earth is suffering because of the weight of the demons and the people also suffering at the hands of the demons. You happen to be the creator of the universe and therefore you urgently search for a remedy for her. О Brahman, О grandsire, you are the only source for us; therefore you think of the ways and means to free ourselves from the torture of the demons since the goddess earth is suffering with the weight of the demons. He are also suffering at the hands of the demons therefore you kindly remove her burden.

## \|\| 4.17-18 \|\|

*kṣitiruvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi svakīyāṃ mānasīṃ vyathām \|*  
*vinā baṃdhuṃ saviśvāsaṃ nānyaṃ kathitumarhati \|\| 17 \|\|*

*strījātirabalā śaśvadrakṣaṇīyā svabaṃdhubhiḥ \|*  
*janakasvāmiputraiśca garhitā'nyaiśca niścitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Listening to the words of the gods, Brahma told them О goddess earth, you get relieved of the terror and be happy. I do something to relieve you of your misery. О lotus eyed one, I shall surely removed your burden and you will meet with prosperity. О noble lady, I shall surely move in the direction which brings welfare to you. On hearing the words of Brahma, the goddess earth narrated to him details of her sufferings with a smiling face.

## \|\| 4.19 \|\|

*tvayā pṛṣṭā jagattāta na lajjā kathituṃ mama \|*

19\. PrthvI said – О lord, no one can speak out his heart a trusted persons. Therefore I am rising to narrate detail of my Sufferings to you kindly listen to me, a female is considered to be helpless; therefore she is protected by the father, the husband and the son in all times. Her protection by anyone else has been denounced.

## \|\| 4.20 \|\|

*kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnā ye ye ca tadbhaktaniṃdakāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ mahāpātakināmaśaktā bhāravāhane \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. You are the father of the universe and are asking me. Therefore the people with the weight of whom I am suffering, I am going to tell you about them. Because I will not feel shy in narrating my tale to you.

## \|\| 4.21-22 \|\|

*svadharmācārahīnā ye nityakṛtyavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*śraddhāhīnāśca vedeṣu teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pitṛmātṛgurustrīṇāṃ poṣaṇaṃ putrapoṣyayoḥ \|*

21-22. Those who are deprived of the devotion of lord Krishna and those who denounce his devotees, I am unable to bear the load of such people.

## \|\| 4.23-24 \|\|

*ye mithyāvādinastāta dayāsatya vivarjitāḥ \|*

23-24. Those who do not follow their dharma, perform no good deeds, having no faith in the Vedas. I am troubled with the weight of such people. Such of the people feed do not feed or maintain their parents, teacher, wife, son and other dependants, I am unable to bear the load of such people.

## \|\| 4.25 \|\|

*kalyāṇasūktasāmāni harernāmaikamaṃgalam \|*  
*kurvaṃti vikrayaṃ ye vai teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О lord, such of the persons who speak falsehood, who are deprived of mercy and truth, denouncing the Vedas and the gods cannot be carried by me and I am suffering because of them. Those who betrays the friend are ungrateful give false evidence betray the faith of others, misappropriate the trust their load is unbearable by me.

## \|\| 4.26 \|\|

*jīvaghātī gurudrohī grāmayājī ca lubdhakaḥ \|*

26\. Those who sell away Kalyana-siikta of the Samaveda and also the name of the lord which provides welfare, they troubled me the most and I am unable to bear their load.

## \|\| 4.27 \|\|

*pūjāyajñopavāsādi vratāni vividhāni ca \|*

27\. Those who kill the creatures, betray the teacher, performed yajnas from village to village, the terrorists, those burning the dead bodies of the Siidras and consuming their food, I am unable but bear their load.

## \|\| 4.28-29 \|\|

28-29. Those who destroy the puja, yajna fasting and several other vratas feel suffering because all them.

## \|\| 4.30 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ madvyathāyā nivedanam \|*

30\. Such of the people who are envious of cows, Brahmana, gods, Vaishnavas and the devotees of the lord reciting its glory, I am unable to bear that load. О creator of the universe, I am unable to bear the atrocities of Samkhacuda and I suffer much more at the hands of other demons. I am unable to bear their weight.

## \|\| 4.31-32 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vasudhā ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ \|*

31-32. О lord, I have thus narrated to the details of my sufferings and in case I am your true devotee then you kindly think of some remedy for the same.

## \|\| 4.33-40 \|\|

*kālena bhāraharaṇaṃ kariṣyati madīśvaraḥ \|*  
*mantraṃ maṃgalakumbhaṃ ca śivaliṃgaṃ ca kuṃkumam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*madhukāṣṭhaṃ caṃdanaṃ ca kastūrīṃ tīrthamṛttikām \|*  
*khaṅgagaṃḍakakhaṃḍaṃ ca sphāṭikaṃ padmarāgakam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*iṃdranīlaṃ sūryamaṇiṃ rudrākṣaṃ kuśamūlakam \|*

*nirmālyaṃ caiva naivedyaṃ haridvarṇamaṇiṃ tathā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*graṃthiyuktaṃ yajñasūtraṃ darpaṇaṃ śvetacāmaram \|*  
*gorocanaṃ ca muktāṃ ca śuktiṃ māṇikyameva ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

*purāṇasaṃhitāṃ vahniṃ karpūraṃ paraśuṃ tathā \|*  
*rajataṃ kāṃcanaṃ caiva pravālaṃ ratnameva ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*kuśabījaṃ tīrthatoyaṃ gavyaṃ gomūtragomayam \|*  
*tvayi ye sthāpayiṣyaṃti mūḍhāścaitāni sundari \|\| 39 \|\|*

*pacyante kālasūtreṇa varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam \|\| 40 \|\|*

33-40. Thus speaking the goddess earth started crying before Brahma again and again. Listening to her cries Brahma said, О goddess earthy I shall try my best to remove your sufferings and simultaneously remove the demons from the earth. Because one meets with success only by making efforts.

## \|\| 4.41 \|\|

*brahmā pṛthvīṃ samāśvāsya devatābhistayā saha \|*  
*jagāma jagatāṃ dhātā kailāsaṃ śaṃkarālayam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The great lord will surely remove your suffering at an appropriate time. О beautiful one the person who will place mantra the pitcher of welfare, Shivalinga, vermilion, Jethimadhu, sandal, kastiiri, earth from the sacred places, soul, horn of Rhinoceros, crystal gems, rubies, sapphire, Suryamani, Rudraksa, Kusa-grass, Sdlagrdma, Samkha, Tulasi, image of the gods, water-conch burning lamp, adorable stone, bell, Shiva, naivedya, the gem, the yajhopavtta, mirror, fly-whisks, gorocana, jewels, ruby, Puranas, fire camphor, battle-axe, silver, gold, coral, gems, water of the sacred places, cows milk, curd, ghee, cowdung and sows urine, on the ground shall have to spend ten thousand years in the kdlasHtra hell and keep on suffering there.

## \|\| 4.42-46 \|\|

*gatvā tamāśramaṃ ramyaṃ dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ vidhiḥ \|*  
*vasaṃtamakṣayavaṭamūle svaḥsaritastaṭe \|\| 42 \|\|*

*vyāghracarmaparīdhānaṃ dakṣakanyāsthibhūṣaṇam \|*  
*triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ trilocanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*nānāsiddhaiḥ parivṛtaṃ yogīṃdragaṇasevitam \|*  
*parito'psarasāṃ nṛtyaṃ paśyaṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*gaṃdharvāṇāṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śrutavaṃtaṃ kutūhalāt \|*  
*paśyaṃtīṃ pārvatīṃ prītyā paśyaṃtaṃ vakracakṣuṣā \|\| 45 \|\|*

*japaṃtaṃ pañcavaktreṇa harernāmaikamaṅgalam \|*  
*maṃdākinīpadmabījamālayā pulakāṃkitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

42-46. Thus Brahma the creator of the universe assuring the goddess earth variously went to lord Shiva accompanied by other gods. They reached Kailasa.

## \|\| 4.47 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare brahmā tasthāvagre sa dhūrjaṭeḥ \|*  
*pṛthivyā surasaṃghaiśca sārddhaṃ praṇatakaṃdharaiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Reaching there Brahma spotted Shiva who was seated under the everlasting banyan tree grown on the bank of the Ganga of the heaven. He was rearing tiger’s skin and the ornaments of the bones of Sati, the daughter of Daksha. He was holding a trident. He had five faces, three eyes surrounded by several of siddhas and yogis, wearing a serene smile on the face and was witnessing the dance of apsaras accompanied with the music of Gandharvas. The goddess Parvati was lovingly at him and he also was looking at her with the side glance. With his five faces he was reciting the name of the lord which provides welfare. He was feeling joyful, wearing the garlands of lotus flowers from the Ganga.

## \|\| 4.48-49 \|\|

*uttasthau śaṃkaraḥ śīghraṃ bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā jagadgurum \|*  
*nanāma mūrdhnā saṃprītyā labdhavānāśiṣaṃ tataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*praṇemurdevatāḥ sarve śaṃkaraṃ caṃdraśekharam \|*  
*praṇanāma dharā bhaktyā cāśiṣaṃ yuyuje haraḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. At that very moment Brahma appeared before Shiva together with all the, gods and bowed in reverence to him.

## \|\| 4.50 \|\|

*vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa pārvatīśaṃ prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*śrutvā natamukhastūrṇaṃ śaṃkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. At the sight of Brahma, Shiva the teacher of the universe, with his mind filled with devotion at once got up to receive him and offered his salutation to him. Thereafter, he received his blessings as well. All the gods then started offering their salutation to Shiva, who blessed them variously.

## \|\| 4.51 \|\|

*bhaktāpāyaṃ samākarṇya pārvatīparameśvarau \|*  
*babhūvatustau duḥkhārtau bodhayāmāsa tau vidhiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Thereafter Brahma, the creator of the universe narrated the story of the earth to Shiva the lord of Parvati, hearing which Shiva bowed his head downwards beings the one who loved his devotees.

## \|\| 4.52 \|\|

*tato brahmā maheśaśca surasaṃghānvasuṃdharām \|*  
*gṛhaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa samāśvāsya prayatnataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Both Shiva and Parvati on hearing the sufferings of his devotees felt painful at heart. At this, Brahma tried to salute him.

## \|\| 4.53-63 \|\|

*tato deveśvaraistūrṇamāgatya dharmamaṃdiram \|*  
*saha tena samālocya prajagmurbhavanaṃ hareḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*vaikuṃṭhaṃ paramaṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param \|*  
*vāyunā dhāryamāṇaṃ ca brahmāṃḍādūrdhvamuttamam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca brahmalokātsanātanam \|*  
*varṇanīyaṃ na kavibhirvicitraṃ ratnanirmitam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*padmarāgairiṃdranīlai rājamārgairvibhūṣitam \|*  
*te manoyāyinaḥ sarve saṃprāpustaṃ manoharam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*hareraṃtaḥpuraṃ gatvā dadṛśuḥ śrīhariṃ surāḥ \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpuraśobhitam \|*  
*ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṃḍasthalavirājitam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*pītavastraparīdhānaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam \|*  
*śāṃtaṃ sarasvatīkāṃtaṃ lakṣmīdhṛtapadāṃbujam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*koṭikaṃdarpalīlābhaṃ smitavaktraṃ caturbhujam \|*  
*sunaṃdanaṃdakumudaiḥ pārṣadairupasevitam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*caṃdanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ suratnamukuṭojjvalam \|*  
*paramānaṃdarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahakārakam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*taṃ praṇemuḥ sureṃdrāśca bhaktyā brahmādayo mune \|*  
*tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā bhaktyā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*paramānaṃdabhārārtāḥ pulakāṃcitavigrahāḥ \|\| 63\|\|*

53-63. Thereafter Brahma and Shiva asked the goddess earth and the other gods to go to their respective abodes reassuring them.

## \|\| 4.64-65 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*namāmi kamalākāṃtaṃ śāṃtaṃ sarveṣṭamacyutam \|*  
*vayaṃ yasya kalābhedāḥ kalāṃśakalayā surāḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*manavaśca munīṃdrāśca mānuṣāśca carācarāḥ \|*  
*kalākalāṃśakalayā bhūtāstvatto niraṃjana \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. Both Brahma and Shiva went to the abode of Brahma and consulted him variously thereafter all of them combined went to Vaikuntha which is the great abode of Vishnu and is beyond the birth and death and is situated beyond the globe, floating in the air. This eternal abode of Vishnu is situated beyond a crore of yojanas from the earth. It is built in gems, is beyond the comprehension of the poets where the rubies and sapphires are freely used on the path ways. The gods who could move with the speed of the mind reached there in am instant and had a look at Lakshmi Narayana in the inner apartment, who was seated at ease on the gem-studded lion-throne, adorned with the gem-studded ornaments, gem-studded armlets, wristlets and anklets. Besides the neck ornaments of gems, he was wearing yellow lower garments the long garland of forest flower was quite peaceful lord of Sarasvati, served by Lakshmi at his feet possessing the lustre of crores of gods of love, having a smiling face, four armed and surrounded by his attendants like Sunanda, Nanda, Kumuda and several others. All his limbs were plastered with the sandal-pastes. He had the beautiful crown studded with gems on his head. He is blissful and the one who always had been merciful on his devotees. Such a type of lord Vishnu was seen by Brahma and other gods who offered their salutation to him, with devotion. All of them meekly stood their offering prayers. At that point of time all the gods were feeling blissful and their body was filled with emotion.

## \|\| 4.66-67 \|\|

*śaṃkara uvāca \|*  
*tvāmakṣayamakṣaraṃ vā vyaktamavyaktamīśvaram \|*  
*anādimādimānaṃdarūpiṇaṃ sarvarūpiṇam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*aṇimādikasiddhīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvakāraṇam \|*  
*siddhijñaṃ siddhidaṃ siddhirūpaṃ kaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Brahma said – О lord of Kamala, О peaceful one, I bow in reverence to lord Acyuta who happens to be the lord of all you happen to be your own lustre and all the gods also have emerged from your rays О spotless one all the sages, the ascetics and the humans appear on earth together with all the moveable and immovable creatures emerging from your rays.

## \|\| 4.68-73 \|\|

*dharma uvāca \|*  
*vede nirūpitaṃ vastu varṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*vede nirvacanīyaṃ yattannirvaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*yasya saṃbhāvanīyaṃ yadguṇarūpaṃ niraṃjanam \|*  
*tadatiriktaṃ stavanaṃ kimahaṃ staumi nirguṇam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*brahmādīnāmidaṃ stotraṃ ṣaṭślokoktaṃ mahāmune \|*  
*paṭhitvā mucyate durgādvāñchitaṃ ca labhennaraḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*devānāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā tānuvāca hariḥ svayam \|*  
*golokaṃ yāta yūyaṃ ca yāmi paścācchriyā saha \|\| 71 \|\|*

*naranārāyaṇau tau dvau śvetadvīpanivāsinau \|*  
*ete yāsyaṃti goloke tathā devī sarasvatī \|\| 72 \|\|*

*anaṃtā mama māyā ca kārttikeyo gaṇādhipaḥ \|*  
*sāvitrī vedamātā ca paścādyāsyaṃti niścitam \|\| 73 \|\|*

68-73. Shiva said – О lord, you are indestructible imperishable, all-pervading, visible and invisible, blissful and possessed all the siddhis like anima and others. Because of this, you are known to be the bestower of all the success and the form of success therefore which one of us could be competent enough to recite your glory.

## \|\| 4.74 \|\|

*tatrāhaṃ dvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇo gopībhī rādhayā saha \|*  
*atrāhaṃ kamalāyuktaḥ sunaṃdādibhirāvṛtaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Dharma said – The men with letters have described the one, who has been highlighted in the Vedas. But the one who was of the elements which are beyond the description of the Vedas who can offers prayer to him? Whatever sins are possible for anyone, they are considered to be the virtues, which appear in the form of their prayer. They are spotless and are visible as well as invisible, how can such a lord destroy. О great sage, whosoever recites the six verses composed by the gods in favour of the lord, such a person is relieved of all the miseries and always meets with the success. On hearing the prayer of the gods, Vishnu himself spoke to them. All of you should go to Goloka and shall also follow you with Lakshmi. Nara-Narayana the, dweller of Shveta-dvipa and Sarasvati will also follow you. My vast illusion, Karttikeya, Ganesha and Savitri, the mother of the Vedas will also follow us.

## \|\| 4.75 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaśca kṛṣṇo'haṃ śvetadvīpanivāsakṛt \|*  
*mamaivaitāḥ kalāḥ sarve devā brahmādayaḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. I reside in the Goloka having two armed in the form of Krishna with Radha and. other cowherdesses and at this place I reside with Kamala and other courtiers.

## \|\| 4.76-77 \|\|

*kalākalāṃśakalayā surāsuranarādayaḥ \|*  
*golokaṃ yāta yūyaṃ ca kāryasiddhirbhaviṣyati \|\| 76 \|\|*

*vayaṃ paścādgamiṣyāmaḥ sarveṣāmiṣṭasiddhaye \|*  
*ityuktvā vai sabhāmadhye virarāma hariḥ svayam \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. Narayana the dweller of the Shveta-dvipa and Krishna are one and the same. I happen to be Brahma and all the gods happen to be my rays.

## \|\| 4.78 \|\|

*praṇamya devatāḥ sarvā jagmurgolokamadbhutam \|*  
*vicitraṃ paramaṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. The gods, demons and human beings also represent my rays. All of you should go to Goloka and you will surely meet with success. Thereafter all of us will also reach there for the fulfilment of the desires of all. Thus speaking in the court the lord kept quiet.

## \|\| 4.79-82 \|\|

*ūrdhvaṃ vaikuṃṭhato gamyaṃ paṃcāśatkoṭiyojanam \|*  
*vāyunā dhāryamāṇaṃ ca nirmitaṃ svecchayā vibhoḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca devāste gamanotsukāḥ \|*  
*te manoyāyinaḥ sarve saṃprāpurvirajātaṭam \|\| 80 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā devāḥ sarittīraṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ manoharam \|\| 81 \|\|*

*muktāmāṇikyaparamamaṇiratnākarānvitam \|*  
*kṛṣṇaśubhraharidraktamaṇirājivirājitam \|\| 82 \|\|*

79-82. Thereafter all the gods bowed in reverence to him and proceeded to Goloka which is astonishing in nature beyond the birth and death and happens to be the eternal abode.

## \|\| 4.83 \|\|

*pravālāṃkuramudbhūtaṃ kutracitsumanoharam \|*  
*paramāmūlyasadratnākararājivibhūṣitam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. This abode of the lord is beyond fifty crore yojanas from Vaikuntha and is floating in the air and was created as per the desire of the all-pervading lord. All the gods then started with the intention of reaching Goloka which is beyond descriptions the gods who could move with the speed of the mind reached in an instant on the bank of the river, the gods were surprised since it was spotless like the crystal gems. It had mines of rubies, sapphire, gems, besides the various types of gems including those having black, white, green and red colour.

## \|\| 4.84 \|\|

*vidheradṛśyāmāścarya nidhiśreṣṭhākarānvitam \|*  
*padmarāgeṃdranīlānāmākaraṃ kutracinmune \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Because of the sprouting of the coral rods, the best of the mines of gems could be seen at several pieces.

## \|\| 4.85-87 \|\|

*kutracicca marakatākaraśreṇīsamanvitam \|*  
*syamaṃtakākaraṃ kutra kutracidrucakākaram \|\| 85 \|\|*

*amūlyapītavarṇābhaṃ maṇiśreṇyākarānvitam \|*  
*ratnākaraṃ kutracicca kutracitkaustubhākaram \|\| 86 \|\|*

*kutra nirvacanīyānāṃ maṇīnāmākaraṃ param \|*  
*kutracitkutracidramyavihārasthalamuttamam \|\| 87 \|\|*

85-87. О sage, it was quite surprising for Brahma to look at such a scene. There were several other mines were the rubies and sapphires, emerald gems were found and at some places there were the mines of Syamafttaka gems and the treasures of gold.

## \|\| 4.88-89 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tu paramāścaryaṃ jagmustatpāramīśvarāḥ \|*  
*dadṛśuḥ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ śataśṛṃgaṃ manoramam \|\| 88 \|\|*

*pārijātatarūṇāṃ ca vanarājivirājitam \|*  
*kalpavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ veṣṭitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

88-89. At places there were the valuable gems of yellow colour and at certain places the gems were available in heaps. At some places the kaustubha gems were found in abundance and at some places there were mines of gems which were beyond description. At some places, there were orchard for strolling.

## \|\| 4.90-92 \|\|

*koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca dairghyaṃ daśaguṇottaram \|*  
*śailaprasthaparimitaṃ paṃcāśatkoṭiyojanam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*prākārākāramasyaiva śikhare rāsamaṃḍalam \|*  
*daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ vartulākāramuttamam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*puṣpodyānasahasreṇa puṣpitena sugaṃdhinā \|*  
*saṃkulena madhughrāṇāṃ samūhena samanvitam \|\| 92 \|\|*

90-92. The gods were surprised at the sight end getting flabbergasted, the gods reached the other bank of the rivers where they found a graceful and charming mountain with hundred peaks which had the forest of Parijata trees besides kalpavrksas and the Kamadhenu cows.

## \|\| 4.93 \|\|

*surata dravyasaṃyuktai rājitaṃ ratimaṃdiraiḥ \|*  
*ratnamaṃḍapakoṭīnāṃ sahasreṇa samanvitam \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. It was a crores of yojanas in height and was ten times its width; its peak was spread over an area of fifty crores of yojanas that mountain was surrounding the entire Goloka like a boundary wall, at the peak of the mountain there was the Rasamandala which was spread over an area of ten yojanas and was circular in shape. It was abounded with orchards of thousands of fragrant flowers and with group of black-wasps.

## \|\| 4.94 \|\|

*ratnasopānayuktena sadratnakalaśena ca \|*  
*harinmaṇīnāṃ staṃbhena śobhitena ca śobhitam \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. It was filled with the articles required for the lover-sports and also had many of the decorated pleasure houses, it had a thousand crores of steps studded with gems and filled with the pitcher made with best of gems and the pillars studded with rubies and sapphires.

## \|\| 4.95-96 \|\|

*siṃdūravarṇamaṇibhiḥ paritaḥ khacitena ca \|*  
*indranīlairmadhyagatairmaṃḍitena manoharaiḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*ratnaprākārasaṃyuktamaṇibhedairvirājitam \|*  
*dvāraiḥ kapāṭasaṃyuktaiścaturbhiśca virājitam \|\| 96 \|\|*

95-96. The gems of vermilion colour were studded for the purpose of decoration, it had the pleasant boundary walls studded with beautiful gems and the doors were also studded with various types of gems.

## \|\| 4.97 \|\|

*rajjugraṃthisamāyuktarasālapallavānvitaiḥ \|*  
*paritaḥ kadalīstaṃbhasamūhaiśca samanvitam \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. It was filled with the trunks of banana trees. The trunks of banana tree tied with strings and the mango leaves were tied in strings adorning the place.

## \|\| 4.98-100 \|\|

*śukladhānyaparṇajālaphaladūvāṃrkurānvitam \|*  
*caṃdanāgarukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitam \|\| 98 \|\|*

*veṣṭitaṃ gopakanyānāṃ samūhaiḥ koṭiśo mune \|*  
*ratnālaṃkārasaṃyuktai ratnamālāvirājitaiḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūra ratnanūpurabhūṣitaiḥ \|*  
*ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṃḍasthalavirājitaiḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

98-100. О sage, the white paddy, the net of leaves, the fruits, the tender Ditrva-grass, the sandal-paste, aguru, kastiirL and the saffron, besides beverages were available in abundance there. Crores of cowherdesses were found there who were adorned with the gem-studded ornaments and their garlands of gems. They were wearing the armlets, anklets and wristlets of gems besides the pall of ear ornaments studded with gems.

## \|\| 4.101-103 \|\|

*ratnāṃgulīyalalitairhastāṃgulivirājitaiḥ \|*  
*ratnapāśakavṛndaiśca virājitapadāṃgulaiḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*bhūṣitai ratnabhūṣābhiḥ sadratnamukuṭojjvalaiḥ \|*  
*gajeṃdramuktālaṃkārairnāsikāmadhyarājitaiḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

*siṃdūrabiṃdunā sārddhamalakādhaḥsthalojjvalaiḥ \|*  
*cārucampakavarṇābhaiścaṃdanadravacarcitaiḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

101-103. They were wearing the rings of gems of all the fingers of the hands as well as the toes. They were adorned with all the ornaments including the crown on the head and the precious gems as the nose ornaments. They had the spot of vermilion decorating their foreheads and their hair-do was beautifully done. They had the lustre of the beautiful campaka flowers and their limbs were plastered with the sandal-paste.

## \|\| 4.104-113 \|\|

*pītavastraparīdhānairbiṃbādharamanoharaiḥ \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāṇāṃ prabhāṃ muṣṇanmukhojjvalaiḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

*śaratpraphullapadmānāṃ śobhāmoṣaṇalocanaiḥ \|*  
*kastūrīpātrikāyuktai rekhāktakajjalojjvalaiḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

*praphullamālatīmālājālaiḥkabaraśobhitaiḥ \|*  
*madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ samūhaiścāpi saṃkulaiḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

*cāruṇā gamanenaiva gajakhaṃjanagaṃjanaiḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

*vakrabhrūbhaṃgasaṃyogaślakṣṇasmitasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*pakvadāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktivirājitaiḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

*khageṃdracaṃcuśobhāḍhyanāsikonnatabhūṣitaiḥ \|*  
*gajeṃdragaṃḍayugmābhastanabhāranatairiva \|\| 109 \|\|*

*nitambakaṭhinaśroṇīpīnabhārabharānataiḥ \|*  
*kaṃdarpaśaraceṣṭābhirjarjarībhūtamānasai \|\| 110 \|\|*

*darpaṇaiḥ pūrṇacaṃdrāsyasauṃdaryadarśanotsukaiḥ \|*  
*rādhikācaraṇāṃbhojasevāsaktamanorathaiḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

*suṃdarīṇāṃ samūhaiśca rakṣitaṃ rādhikājñayā \|*  
*krīḍāsarovarāṇāṃ ca lakṣaiśca pariveṣṭitam \|\| 112 \|\|*

*śvetaraktairlohitaiśca veṣṭitaiḥ padmarājitaiḥ \|*  
*sukūjadbhirmadhughrāṇāṃ samūhaiḥ saṃkulaiḥ sadā \|\| 113 \|\|*

104-113. They were wearing the yellow garments and had the lips like the ripe wood-apples. Their faces were like the full moon of the winter season, the eyes resembling the full blown lotuses of the winter season, kasturl, collyrium applied to the eyes, had the garlands of fully blossomed jasmine flowers round their necks surrounded by the black-wasps which were greedy for the honey. Their walking resembled the royal elephant. They had the curved eyebrows and serene smile on the faces. Their teeth resembled the ripe pomegranate and the nose resembled that of the peak of Garuda, the beautiful breasts resembled the temples of the elephants which made them uneasy because of their weight, they had developed buttocks and till pelvic regions they shattered the mind because of the passionate advances and were anxious to look at the mirror to find there reflection in it. All these damsels were devoted at the lotus-like feet of Radhika and served her Rasamandala was quite well guarded by these damsels, which had lakhs of the streams for water sports, some of them had white, red and extremely red lotus flower were the birds were issuing sweets notes and the black-wasps, were producing hissing sound.

## \|\| 4.114-116 \|\|

*puṣpodyānasahasreṇa puṣpitena samanvitam \|*  
*koṭikuṃjakuṭīraiśca puṣpaśayyāsamanvitaiḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

*bhogadravyasakarpūratāṃbūlavastrasaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*ratnapradīpaiḥ paritaḥ śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

*vicitrapuṣpamālābhiḥ śobhitaiḥ śobhitaṃ mune \|*

114-116. There ware several of the blossoming orchards containing the beds of flowers and the Rasamandala was filled with crores of hermitages. The appropriate things like camphor, betel, cloth, lamps of gems, white fly whisks, mirrors and the garlands of different flowers were available in abundance there. О sage, looking at the Rasamandala the gods came out in the open.

## \|\| 4.117 \|\|

*tato vicakṣaṇaṃ ramyaṃ dadṛśuḥ suṃdaraṃ vanam \|*  
*vanaṃ vṛdāvanaṃ nāma rādhāmādhavayoḥ priyam \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. The gods also found Vmdavana which was the favourite sports of Radha and Madhava which was quite beautiful and charming.

## \|\| 4.118-122 \|\|

*krīḍāsthānaṃ tayoreva kalpavṛkṣacayānvitam \|*

*kutra helikadaṃbānāṃ kadaṃbaiḥ kamanīyakam \|*

*sugaṃdhikusumānāṃ ca gaṃdhena surabhīkṛtam \|*  
*āmrāṇāṃ nāgaraṃgāṇāṃ panasānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 121 \|\|*

*tālānāṃ nārikelānāṃ vṛṃdairvṛṃdārakaṃ vanam \|*  
*jaṃbūnāṃ badarīṇāṃ ca kharjūrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

118-122. They also had a look at the pleasure sports of Radhamadhava which had a number of kalpavrks a. At the bank of river Viraja, the cool breeze which was blowing slowly disturbs river water, the lotus flowers were decorated with kastUri which appeared in bundles, issuing fragrance and the cuckoos which were perched on the tender leaves of the lotus flowers were issuing sweet notes. At certain spots of kadamba trees served as the best sporting places. It had a number of Mandara, campaka trees besides the sandal-wood trees and the fragrance of the flowers pervaded everywhere. There were several trees of mangoes, jack-fruit, tala, coconut, silk fruits, silk-fruit, jujube and palm trees in large numbers.

## \|\| 4.123-125 \|\|

*gurvākāmrātakānāṃ ca jaṃbīrāṇāṃ ca nārada \|*  
*kadalīnāṃ śrīphalānāṃ dāḍimānāṃ manoharaiḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

*supakvaphalasaṃyuktaiḥ samūhaiśca virājitam \|*  
*pippalīnāṃ ca śālānāmaśvatthānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 124 \|\|*

*niṃbānāṃ śālmalīnāṃ ca tittiḍīnāṃ ca śobhanaiḥ \|*  
*anyeṣāṃ tarubhedānāṃ saṃkulaiḥ saṃkulaṃ sadā \|\| 125 \|\|*

123-125. О Narada, besides the above there were the trees of betel nuts, Myrobalan, lemon banana, wood-apple, pomegranate, blossoming with ripe fruits. Besides there were trees of long-pepper, the fig tree, neem tree, teak-wood trees, silk-cotton trees and tamarind trees.

## \|\| 4.126-130 \|\|

*paritaḥ kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛndairvṛndairvirājitam \|*
