*ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhayaṃ smerānanasaroruham \|\| 152 \|\|*

150-152. He was immensely pleased while looking at Ganesha and comfortably took his seat. At that point of time all the people present there had a glance of the face of lord Vishnu which could attract the entire universe, he was wearing kirita-crown, kundalas and clad in yellow garment. He was quite youthful, having dark complexion and his body was plastered with sandal-paste, kastiirl, aguru and saffron and he was adorned with gem-studded ornaments. He wore a smile over his face.

## \|\| 6.153 \|\|

*ratna siṃhāsanasthaṃ ca pārṣadaiḥ pariveṣṭitam \|*  
*vaṃditaṃ ca suraiḥ sarvaiḥ śivena pūjitaṃ stutam \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. He was seated on a gem-studded lion-throne and was surrounded by his courtiers. All the gods offered their salutations to him. Shiva also adored him performing puja.

## \|\| 6.154-156 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā pārvatī viṣṇuṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā \|*  
*mukhamācchāditaṃ cakre vāsasā vrīḍayā satī \|\| 154 \|\|*

*atīva sundaraṃ rūpaṃ darśaṃdarśaṃ punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*dadarśa mukhamācchādya nimeṣarahitā satī \|\| 155\|\|*

*paramādbhutaveṣaṃ ca sasmitā vakracakṣuṣā \|*  
*sukhasāgarasammagnā babhūva pulakāṃcitā \|\| 156 \|\|*

154-156. Looking at Vishnu, the mind and eyes of Parvati were filled with delight. At this Parvati felt shy and covered her face with a piece of cloth but she looked at the charming face of Vishnu again and again and covering her mouth with a piece of cloth, she then looked at Vishnu delightfully with a side-glance and wearing a smile on her face, she was engrossed in bliss and her hair of the body stood at end.

## \|\| 6.157-159 \|\|

*kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa pañcāsyaṃ śubhravarṇaṃ trilocanam \|*  
*triśūlaparighadharaṃ kandarpakoṭisundaram \|\| 157 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa śyāmaṃ tamekāsyaṃ ca dvilocanam \|*  
*caturbhujaṃ pītavastraṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam \|\| 158 \|\|*

*ekaṃ bahma mūrtibhedamabhedaṃ vā nirūpitam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā babhūva sā māyā sakāmā viṣṇu māyayā \|\| 159 \|\|*

157-159. In a moment she looked at Shiva having five faces and fair complexion, with three eyes, holding a trident, pattisa and looked more beautiful than the crores of the gods of love. Then in the next moment she had a look at Vishnu who was dark-complexioned having a single face, two eyes, four arms, clad in a pltambara and wearing a long garland of forest flower round his neck. Looking at him, she started thinking in her mind, "Brahma is one but he had created different types of figures". Thus thinking the passion in the mind Parvati was aroused.

## \|\| 6.160 \|\|

*madaṃśāśca trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|*  
*tābhyāmautkarṣapātācca śreṣṭhaḥ sattvaguṇātmakaḥ \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. She thought that in spite of the fact that Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, all the three of them had emerged from her amsha, in spite of that Vishnu happens to be the most superior and preserves sattvaguna in him.

## \|\| 6.161 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā taṃ pārvatī bhaktyā pulakāṃcitavigrahā \|*  
*manasā pūjayāmāsa paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. Looking at him Parvati felt emotional and she adored the lord with great devotion.

## \|\| 6.162 \|\|

*durgāṃtarābhiprāyaṃ ca bubudhe śaṃkaraḥ svayam \|*  
*sarvāṃtarātmā bhagavānaṃtaryāmī jagatpatiḥ \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. But feelings of Durga were well understood by Shiva himself, who was the lord of world and living in the heart of all creature.

## \|\| 6.163 \|\|

*durgāṃ nirjanamāhūya tāmuvāca haraḥ svayam \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ hitaṃ tathyamakhaṃḍitam \|\| 163 \|\|*

163\. Thereafter, Shiva called for Durga in a secluded place and spoke to her beneficial, truthful and uncontradictionable words.

## \|\| 6.164-167 \|\|

*. śrīśaṃkara uvāca \|*  
*nivedanaṃ madīyaṃ ca nibodhaṃ śailakanyake \|*  
*śṛṃgāraṃ dehi bhadraṃ te haraye paramātmane \|\| 164 \|\|*

*ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca brahmaikaṃ ca sanātanam \|*  
*vadaiko vedarahito viṣayānmūrtibhedakaḥ \|\| 165 \|\|*

*ekā prakṛtiḥ sarveṣāṃ mātā tvaṃ sarvarūpiṇī \|*  
*svayaṃbhūrasi vāṇī tva lakṣmīrnārāyaṇorasi \|\| 166 \|\|*

*mama vakṣasi durgā tvaṃ nibodhādhyātmakaṃ sati \|*  
*śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca sureśvarī \|\| 167 \|\|*

164-167. Shiva said – O daughter of the mountain, you listen to my request, you provide the conjugal pleasure to lord Vishnu, because myself, Brahma and Vishnu represent the everlasting Brahman. The god are without differentiation and the worldly pleasures create difference in the form. Prakriti happened to be the one for all. You happen to be mother in all the forms. You happen to be Sarasvati in the heart of Brahma, Lakshmi in the heart of Narayana and Durga in my heart. Therefore, О chaste lady, you listen to my divine words. On hearing the words of Shiva, Parvati the goddess of all them spoke.

## \|\| 6.168-169 \|\|

*. pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*dīnabaṃdho kṛpāsiṃdho tava māmakṛpā katham \|*  
*suciraṃ tapasā labdho nāthastvaṃ jagatāṃ mayā \|\| 168 \|\|*

*mādṛśīṃ kiṃkarī nātha na parityaktumarhasi \|*  
*ayogyamīdṛśaṃ vākyaṃ mā mā vada maheśvara \|\| 169 \|\|*

168-169. Parvati said – O Lord of the down-trodden, you are the ocean of mercy but why do you shower disgrace on me because I achieved you in the form of a husband after performing tapas for a long time. Therefore, О lord, you do not disown a slave like me. О Maheshvara, you never indulge in such in proper words with me.

## \|\| 6.170 \|\|

*tava vākyaṃ mahādeva kariṣyāmyeva pālanam \|*  
*dehāṃtare janma labdhvā bhajiṣyāmi hariṃ hara \|\| 170 \|\|*

170\. О Mahadeva, О Shiva, I shall obey your command but I shall serve Vishnu in an other birth taking a new form.

## \|\| 6.171-172 \|\|

*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā virarāma maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*uccairjahāsābhayadaḥ pārvatyai cābhayaṃ dadau \|\| 171 \|\|*

*tatpratijñāpālanāya pārvatī jāṃbavadgṛhe \|*  
*labhiṣyati janurdhātarnāmnā jāṃbavatī satī \|\| 172 \|\|*

171-172. On hearing this Maheshvara kept quite. Thereafter lord Shiva laughed aloud and provided protection to Parvati. О Brahman, in order to honour to the words of Shiva. Parvati would be born in the house of Jambavan in the name of chaste Jambavati.

## \|\| 6.173 \|\|

*. brahmovāca \|*  
*bhūmau katividhe bhūpe saṃsthite pārvatī katham \|*  
*lalābha bhārate janma niṃdite bhālluke gṛhe \|\| 173 \|\|*

173\. Brahma said – Why did, Parvati take a birth in a degraded race of bears, when there were many royal families on earth?

## \|\| 6.174-175 \|\|

*. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*rāmāvatāre tretāyāṃ devāṃśāśca yayurmahīm \|*  
*himālayāṃśo bhallūko jāṃbavānnāma kiṃkaraḥ \|\| 174 \|\|*

*rāmasya varadānena ciraṃjīvī śriyā yutaḥ \|*  
*koṭisiṃhabalādhānaṃ vidhatte ca mahābalaḥ \|\| 175 \|\|*

174-175. Lord Krishna said – In the Tretayuga, at the time of incarnation of Rama, all the gods as had to appear on earth in various forms. Out of them, from the amsha of Himalaya, my servant named, Jambavan was also born, he enjoyed long life because of the boon of Rama. He was quite virtuous, possessed great prowess and had a strength of crores of lions.

## \|\| 6.176 \|\|

*pituraṃśagṛhe durgā jagāmāṃśena bhūtalam \|*  
*pūrvaṃ pūrvasya vṛttāṃtaṃ kathitaṃ śṛṇu manmukhāt \|\| 176 \|\|*

176\. At that time Parvati having an Goloka of her father emerged on the earth. Now you listen to an earlier story in this connection for my mouth.

## \|\| 6.177 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ ca surāṇāṃ vai vaṃśā gacchaṃtu bhūtalam \|*  
*nṛpaputrā matsahāyā bhaviṣyaṃti raṇe vidhe \|\| 177 \|\|*

177\. The atnshas of all the gods would be born on earth and becoming princes participate in the war.

## \|\| 6.178 \|\|

*kamalākalayā sarvā bhavaṃtu nṛpakanyakāḥ \|*  
*manmahiṣyo bhaviṣyaṃti sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 178 \|\|*

178\. From the amsha of Kamla, all the princesses were to be born to become my wife numbering sixteen thousand.

## \|\| 6.179-180 \|\|

*dharmo'yamaṃśarūpeṇa pāṃḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ \|*  
*vāyoraṃśādbhīmasenaḥ sa vajrī hyarjunaḥ svayam \|\| 179 \|\|*

*nakulaḥ sahadevaśca svarvaidyāṃśasamudbhavau \|*  
*sṛryāṃśaḥ karṇavīraśca viduraḥ sa yamaḥ svayam \|\| 180 \|\|*

179-180. From his amsha Dharma would be born as Yudhisthira, Bhlmsena would be born of the amsha of Vayu, Arjuna would be born as the amsha of Indra, while Nakul and Sahadeva would be born from the amsha of Asvinlkumara. The valorous Kama would be born from the amsha of Surya and while Yama would appear in the form of Vidura.

## \|\| 6.181-183 \|\|

*duryodhanaḥ kaleraṃśaḥ samudrāṃśaśca śaṃtanuḥ \|*  
*aśvatthāmā śaṃkarāṃśo droṇo vahnyaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 181 \|\|*

*hutāśanāṃśo bhagavāndhṛṣṭadyumno mahābalaḥ \|*  
*caṃdrāṃśo'pyabhimanyuśca bhīṣmaścaiva vasūdbhavaḥ \|\| 182 \|\|*

*vasudevaḥ kaśyapāṃśo'pyadityaṃśā ca devakī \|*  
*vasvaṃśo naṃdagopaśca yaśodā vasukā minī \|\| 183 \|\|*

181-183. Duryodhana would be born of the amsha of Kali, Santanu would be born from the amsha of ocean, Asvatthama would be born from the amsa of Shiva while Drona would be born of the amsa of the god of fire. The great warrior Dhrst adyumna was born from the amsa of Hutasana while Abhimanyu was born of the amsa of the moon; Bhlsma was born of the amsa of Vasu while Vasudeva was born of the amsa of Kashyapa. Devaki was born of the amsa of Diti, the cowherd Nanda was born from the amsa of Vasu and his wife Yashoda was also born from the amsa of Vasu.

## \|\| 6.184 \|\|

*draupadī kamalāṃśā ca yajñakuṃḍasamudbhavā \|*  
*subhadrā śatarūpāṃśā devakīgarbhasaṃbhavā \|\| 184 \|\|*

184\. From the amsa of Kamala, Draupdl emerged out of the fire altar; from the womb of Devaki, Subhadra was born from the amsa of Satarupa.

## \|\| 6.185 \|\|

*devā gacchaṃtu pṛthivīmaṃśena bhārahārakāḥ \|*  
*kalayā devapatnyaśca gacchaṃtu pṛthivītalam \|\| 185 \|\|*

185\. Thus in order to rid the earth from her burden all the gods and goddesses appeared on earth with their respective arhsas.

## \|\| 6.186 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā bhagavānvirarāma ca nārada \|*  
*sarvaṃ vivaraṇaṃ śrutvā tatrovāsa prajāpatiḥ \|\| 186 \|\|*

186\. О Narada, thus speaking the lord kept quiet. On hearing these words, Brahma came back and took his seat.

## \|\| 6.187-188 \|\|

*kṛṣṇasya vāme vāgdevī dakṣiṇe kamalālayā \|*  
*purato devatāḥ sarvāḥ pārvatī cāpi nārada \|\| 187 \|\|*

*gopyo gopāśca parito rādhā vakṣaḥsthalasthitā \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare sā ca tamuvāca vrajeśvarī \|\| 188 \|\|*

187-188. Narada, Sarasvati was lodged to the left of lord Krishna while Lakshmi stood to the right, all the gods were facing him besides Parvati. Radhika was enshrined in the heart of cowherds and cowherdesses. In the meantime Vrajeshvari Radhika said to the lord.

## \|\| 6.189-190 \|\|

*. rādhikovāca \|*  
*śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi kiṃkarīvacanaṃ prabho \|*  
*prāṇā dahaṃti satatamāṃdolayati me manaḥ \|\| 189 \|\|*

*cakṣurnimīlanaṃ kartumaśaktā tava darśane \|*  
*tvayā vinā kathaṃ nātha yāsyāmi dharaṇītalam \|\| 190 \|\|*

189-190. Radhika said – O lord, you kindly listen to a small servant like me. О lord my life is burning all the time and the mind is unstable. I am unable to separate from you even when close my eyes or even winking there for a moment, how shall I be able to move on to the earth alone without you?

## \|\| 6.191 \|\|

*kiyatkālāṃtareṇaiva melanaṃ me tvayā saha \|*  
*prāṇeśvara brūhi satyaṃ bhaviṣyatyeva gokule \|\| 191 \|\|*

191\. О lord of my life, tell me truthfully the period after which both of us would unite in Gokula.

## \|\| 6.192-193 \|\|

*nimeṣaṃ ca yugaśataṃ bhavitā me tvayā vinā \|*  
*kaṃ drakṣyāmi kva yāsyāmi ko vā māṃ pālayiṣyati \|\| 192 \|\|*

*mātaraṃ pitaraṃ baṃdhuṃ bhrātaraṃ bhaginīṃ sutam \|*  
*tvayā vinā'haṃ prāṇeśa ciṃtayāmi na kaścana \|\| 193 \|\|*

192-193. Without you a moment is like a yuga for me. Whom shall I look at on earth. Where shall I go? О lord of my life, with you I never bother about my mother, my father, my relatives, my brothers, my sister and even the son.

## \|\| 6.194-196 \|\|

*karoṣi māyayā channā māṃ cenmāyeśa bhūtale \|*  
*vismṛtāṃ vibhavaṃ dattvā me satyaṃ śapathaṃ kuru \|\| 194 \|\|*

*anukṣaṇaṃ mama manomadhupo madhusūdana \|*  
*karotu bhramaṇaṃ nityaṃ samādhvīke padāṃbuje \|\| 195 \|\|*

*yatrayatra ca yasyāṃ vā yonau janma bhavatvidam \|*  
*tvaṃ svasya smaraṇaṃ dāsyaṃ mahyaṃ dāsyasi vāṃchitam \|\| 196 \|\|*

194-196. О lord of illusion, in case you want to send me to the earth with your illusion, then you give me a solemn promise, О Madhusudana, let the black-wasps of my mind always roam about around your lotus-like feet to extract the money. Wherever and whenever I am born in any form, you would always own me and provide me your slavehood. ф'ШКМ TlfMETSi M

## \|\| 6.197-198 \|\|

*kṛṣṇastvaṃ rādhikā'haṃ ca premasaubhāgyamāvayoḥ \|*  
*na vismarāmi bhūmau ca dehi mahyaṃ varaṃ param \|\| 197 \|\|*

*yathā tanvā saha prāṇāḥ śarīraṃ chāyayā saha \|*  
*tathā''vayorjanma yātu dehi mahyaṃ varaṃ vibho \|\| 198 \|\|*

197-198. Even after descending on earth you as Krishna and myself as Radhika should never separate of forget each other. You kindly bestow the boon on me. О all pervading one as the life follows the body and the shade also follows the same, therefore, both of us should be born together. This is the boon which I desire from you.

## \|\| 6.199 \|\|

*cakṣurnimeṣavicchedo bhavitā nāvayorbhuvi \|*  
*tatrāgatyāpi kutrāpi dehi mahyaṃ varaṃ prabho \|\| 199 \|\|*

199\. О lord on arriving the earth, there should be no separation between us even for a while. You kindly grant this boon to me.

## \|\| 6.200-201 \|\|

*mama prāṇaistava tanuḥ kena vā karuṇā hare \|*  
*ātmanā muralīpādau manasā vā vinirmitau \|\| 200 \|\|*

*striyaḥ katividhāḥ saṃti puruṣā vā puruṣṭuta \|*  
*nāsti kutrāpi kāṃtā vā kāṃtyā śaktyā ca mādṛśī \|\| 201 \|\|*

200-201. О Hari, your body should remain alive with my life. The flute should be made of my body and your feet should be made by my mind. There are several people in the universe who adore each other but there is no other damsel equal to me in glory and prowess on earth.

## \|\| 6.202 \|\|

*tava dehārdhabhāgena kena vā'haṃ vinirmitā \|*  
*ayamevāvayorbhedo nāstyatastvayi me manaḥ \|\| 202 \|\|*

202\. Thereafter, lord Krishna took her in his lap and rinsed her face with a piece cloth. He then spoke soft beneficial, and truthful words consoling her at the same time.

## \|\| 6.203 \|\|

*mamātmā mānasaṃ prāṇāstvayi saṃsthāpitā yathā \|*  
*tavātmamānasaprāṇā mayi vā saṃsthitāstathā \|\| 203 \|\|*

203\. Lord Krishna said – I am going to reveal before you the best of the divine yoga, which removes mental agony and is beyond the reach of the great yogis, you listen to me.

## \|\| 6.204 \|\|

*ato nimeṣavirahādātmanorviklavaṃ manaḥ \|*  
*pradagdhaṃ santataṃ prāṇā dahaṃti virahaśrutau \|\| 204 \|\|*

204\. О beautiful one, the entire universe has been divided between the one who takes the shelter and the place of shelter. In both of them, there could be no possibility of any difference from the one who takes refuge and the base of such refuge. The base of fruit is the flower and the base of the flower is the tender leaves, the base of the tender leaves or and the base of branches is the tree itself.

## \|\| 6.205 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sā devī tatraiva surasaṃsadi \|*  
*bhūyobhūyo rurodoccairdhṛtvā taccaraṇāṃbujam \|\| 205 \|\|*

205\. Who has created me from half of your body, there is therefore no difference between us and my mind always remains devoted to you.

## \|\| 6.206 \|\|

*kroḍe kṛtvā tu tāṃ kṛṣṇo mukhaṃ saṃmṛjya vāsasā \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ satyaṃ tathyaṃ hitaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 206 \|\|*

206\. My mind, my soul and my life always remain devoted to you, similarly your mind, life and soul should always remain devoted to me.

## \|\| 6.207 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ādhyātmikaṃ paraṃ yogaṃ śokacchedanakārakam \|*  
*śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yogīṃdrāṇāṃ ca durlabham \|\| 207 \|\|*

207\. Therefore even a moment's separation disturbs me. With the very hearing of the separation from you, me life gets disturbed.

## \|\| 6.208-209 \|\|

*ādhārādheyayoḥ sarvaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ paśya sundari \|*  
*ādhāravyatirekeṇa nāstyādheyasya saṃbhavaḥ \|\| 208 \|\|*

*phalādhāraṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca puṣpādhāraṃ ca pallavam \|*  
*skandhaśca pallavādhāraḥ skandhādhārastaruḥ svayam \|\| 209 \|\|*

208-209. Thus speaking, in the assembly of gods, Radhika fell on the feet of the lord and started crying aloud.

## \|\| 6.210-213 \|\|

*vṛkṣādhāro 'pyaṃkuraśca jīvaśaktisamanvitaḥ \|*  
*aṣṭirekāṃkurādhāraścāṣṭyādhāro vasundharā \|\| 210 \|\|*

*śeṣo vasundharādhāraḥ śeṣādhāro hi kacchapaḥ \|*  
*vāyuśca kacchapādhāro vāyvādhāro'hameva ca \|\| 211 \|\|*

*mamādhārasvarūpā tvaṃ tvayi tiṣṭhāmi sāṃpratam \|*  
*tvaṃ ca śaktisamūhā ca mūlaprakṛ tirīśvarī \|\| 212 \|\|*

*tvaṃ śarīrasvarūpā'si triguṇā''dhārarūpiṇī \|*  
*tavātmā'haṃ nirīhaśca ceṣṭāvāṃśca tvayā saha \|\| 213 \|\|*

210-213. Sprouting is the base of the tree which produces the life in the tree. The seeds is the base of sprouting and the base of the seed happens to the earth. The base of the earth is the Shesha and the base of Shesha is the tortoise, the base of tortoise is the wind and the base of wind is in me you happen to be my base, because I always remain in you. You happen to be the cluster of strength and also the great goddess known as Mula-Prakriti. You appear in human form and are also the base of all the three gunas. I happen to be your soul and coming in contact with you I get activity.

## \|\| 6.214 \|\|

*puruṣādvīryamutpannaṃ vīryātsantatireva ca \|*  
*tayorādhārarūpā ca kāminī prakṛteḥ kalā \|\| 214 \|\|*

214\. The semen emerges from the man and from the semen emerges the progeny and the woman happen to be the base of both of them representing Prakriti.

## \|\| 6.215 \|\|

*vinā dehena kvātmā ca kva śarīraṃ vinā''tmanā \|*  
*prādhānyaṃ ca tayordevi vinā tvā'dya kuto bhavaḥ \|\| 215 \|\|*

215\. There could be no soul without the body and without the soul there could be no body. О goddess though both of them have their own importance but the things of earth cannot move without both of them.

## \|\| 6.216-219 \|\|

*na kutrāpyāvayorbhedo rādhe saṃsārabījayoḥ \|*  
*yatrātmā tatra dehaṃ ca na bhedo vinayena kim \|\| 216 \|\|*

*yathā kṣīre ca dhāvalyaṃ dāhikā ca hutāśane \|*  
*bhūmau gandho jale śaityaṃ tathā tvayi mayi sthite \|\| 217 \|\|*

*dhāvalyadugdhayoraikyaṃ dāhikānalayoryathā \|*  
*bhūgandhajalaśaityānāṃ nāsti bhedastathā''vayoḥ \|\| 218 \|\|*

*mayā vinā tvaṃ nirjīvā cādṛśyo'haṃ tvayā vinā \|*  
*tvayā vinā bhavaṃ kartuṃ nālaṃ sundari niścitam \|\| 219 \|\|*

216-219. О Radha, in the form of seeds there is no difference between both of us wherever there is the soul there is the body. Both of them cannot be separated from each other as the whiteness which is integral part of the milk, the power of burning is an integral part of fire, coolness is the integral part of the water; similar is the case with both of us. As the whiteness cannot be separated from the milk, the power of burning cannot be separated from the fire, the earth cannot be separated from fragrance, coolness cannot be separated from water and are integral part of each other, similar is the case with both of us. О beautiful one, you remain in active in my absence and without you, I also remain invisible. It is also sure that without you, I cannot indulge in any activity of the universe.

## \|\| 6.220 \|\|

*vinā mṛdā ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ yathā nālaṃ kulālakaḥ \|*  
*vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāro'laṃkāraṃ kartumakṣamaḥ \|\| 220 \|\|*

220\. As a potter cannot make a pitcher without the clay and the goldsmith cannot make any ornament without the gold, similarly I become helpless without you.

## \|\| 6.221-223 \|\|

*svayamātmā yathā nityastathā tvaṃ prakṛtiḥ svayam \|*  
*sarvaśaktisamāyuktā sarvādhārā sanātanī \|\| 221 \|\|*

*mama prāṇasamā lakṣmīvāṇī ca sarvamaṃgalā \|*  
*brahmeśānantadha rmāśca tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā priyā \|\| 222 \|\|*

*samīpasthā ime sarve surā devyaśca rādhike \|*  
*ebhyo'pyadhikā no cetkathaṃ vakṣaḥ sthalasthitā \|\| 223 \|\|*

221-223. As the soul is eternal, similarly you as Prakriti are also eternal. You are the base of all the strength and are everlasting. Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Parvati, Brahma, Shiva, Sheshanaga and Dharma are all like my life but you are dearer to me then my life. О Radha, all these gods and goddesses live with me. Had you not been dearest to me than all of them, then how could you reside in my heart.

## \|\| 6.224 \|\|

*tyajāśrumokṣaṇaṃ rādhe bhrāṃtiṃ ca niṣphalāṃ sati \|*  
*vihāya śaṃkāṃ niḥśaṃkaṃ vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ vraja \|\| 224 \|\|*

224\. Therefore, О Radha, you stop shedding tears and get yourself relieved of the illusion. Therefore you go to the house of Vrsabhanu fearlessly.

## \|\| 6.225-227 \|\|

*kalāvatyāśca jaṭhare māsānāṃ nava sundari \|*

225-227. О beautiful one, reaching there you enter the womb of Kalavati and remain there for nine months, shedding your form you take to the form of Vishnu and then appear before the universe. At the time of birth you emerge from the womb of Kalavati in the form of an infant without robes and start crying.

## \|\| 6.228 \|\|

*ayonisaṃbhavā tvaṃ ca bhavitā gokule sati \|*

228\. О chaste lady, you appear in Gokula and having been born without any human contact. I shall also be born without human contact. It is not possible for both of us to remain in the womb.

## \|\| 6.229 \|\|

*bhūmisaṃspṛṣṭamātraṃ māṃ gokule prāpayiṣyati \|*

229\. As soon as I incarnate on earth my father will carry me to Gokula because of the fear of Kamsa I shall surely go to Gokula for your sake.

## \|\| 6.230 \|\|

*yaśodāmaṃdire māṃ ca sānandaṃ nandanaṃdanam \|*

230\. О virtuous one, you will meet me there in the house of Nanda where I shall the present in the form of the son of Nanda and you would also meet me there.

*smṛtiste bhavitā kāle vareṇa mama rādhike \|*

231\. О Radha, with my boon you will remember me at the proper time and I shall enjoy your company in the forest of Vrindavana.

## \|\| 6.232-233 \|\|

*triḥsaptaśatakoṭībhirgopībhirgokulaṃ vraja \|*

*saṃsthāpya saṃkhyārahitā gopīrgokula eva ca \|*

232-233. Therefore, О noble lady, you incarnate on earth with in Gokula with your thirty three female friends and twenty one hundred crores of cowherdesses. In Gokula you have an equal number of cowherds and you should assure them with your nectar like words in Gokula properly.

## \|\| 6.234 \|\|

*ahaṃ gopāla suhṛdaḥ saṃsthāpyātraiva rādhike \|*

234\. О Radhika, I myself shall move on to Mathura keeping all my cowherds friends in Gokula. In Mathura I shall meet my father Vasudeva in his abode.

## \|\| 6.235 \|\|

*vraje vrajantu krīḍārthaṃ mama saṃge priyātpriyāḥ \|*

235\. All my dear cowherd friends will move along with me and go to Vraja and should be born in the houses of crores of Gopas there.

*ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇo virarāma ca nārada \|*

236\. О Narada, thus speaking lord Krishna kept quiet. Thereafter all the gods and goddesses besides the cowherds and cowherdesses also stayed there.

## \|\| 6.237 \|\|

*brahmeśaśeṣadharmāśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ taṃ parātparam \|*

237\. Brahma, Shiva, Dharma, Parvati, Lakshmi and Sarasvati offered prayers to lord Krishna delightfully.

## \|\| 6.238 \|\|

*bhaktyā gopāśca gopyaśca virahajvarakātarāḥ \|*

238\. Feeling grieved because of separation all the cowherds and cowherdesses started offering prayers to lord Krishna with their minds filled with devotion.

## \|\| 6.239-240 \|\|

*prāṇādhikaṃ priyaṃ kāṃtaṃ rādhāpūrṇamanoratham \|*

*sāśrupūrṇātidīnāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ bhayākulām \|*  
*prabodhavacanaṃ śrutyamuvāca tāṃ hariḥ svayam \|\| 240 \|\|*

239-240. Radha also adored her husband who was dearer to her than her own life and could fulfil the desirous of all. Lord Krishna then spoke to Radha who was feeling panicky because of the separation with her eyes filled with tears. She looked quite meek and was upset because of fear. Lord Krishna assured her with truthful words.

## \|\| 6.241 \|\|

*. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*prāṇādhike mahādevi sthirā bhava bhayaṃ tyaja \|*  
*yathā tvaṃ ca tathā'haṃ ca kā ciṃtā te mayi sthite \|\| 241 \|\|*

241\. Lord Krishna said – O great goddess, you are dearer to me than my life; therefore you remain healthy, shedding all the fears. As you are so am I, therefore why should you feel afraid when I am there.

## \|\| 6.242-243 \|\|

*kiṃ tu te kathayiṣyāmi kiṃcidevāstyamaṃgalam \|*

*bhaviṣyatyeva mama ca mathurāgamanaṃ tataḥ \|\| 243 \|\|*

242-243. Off-course, I am telling you something which is unpleasant, "We shall be separated from each other for a hundred years". О beautiful one, which could happen because of the curse of Shridama. During that period I shall remain at Mathura.

## \|\| 6.244-250 \|\|

*tatra bhārāvataraṇaṃ pitrorbaṃdhanamocanam \|*  
*mālākārataṃtuvāyakubjikānāṃ ca mokṣaṇam \|\| 244 \|\|*

*ghātayitvā ca yavanaṃ mucukundasya mokṣaṇam \|*  
*dvārakāyāśca nirmāṇaṃ rājasūyasya darśanam \|\| 245 \|\|*

*udvāhaṃ rājakanyānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*daśādhikaśatasyāpi śatrūṇāṃ damanaṃ tathā \|\| 246 \|\|*

*mitropakaraṇaṃ caiva vārāṇasyāśca dāhanam \|*  
*harasya jṛṃbhaṇaṃ tatra bāṇasya bhujakṛṃtanam \|\| 247 \|\|*

*pārijātasya haraṇaṃ yadyatkarmāṇi tāni ca \|*  
*gamanaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ munisaṃghapradarśanam \|\| 248 \|\|*

*saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ ca baṃdhūnāṃ yajñasaṃpādanaṃ pituḥ \|*  
*śubhakṣaṇe punastatra tvayā sārddhaṃ pradarśanam \|*  
*kariṣyāmi ca tatraiva gopikānāṃ ca darśanam \|\| 249 \|\|*

*tubhyamādhyātmikaṃ dattvā punaḥ satyaṃ tvayā saha \|*  
*divāniśamavicchedo mayā sārddhamataḥ param \|\| 250 \|\|*

244-250. Living there I shall be relieving the earth of her burden and remove the fetters of my parents. I shall redeem the gardener, a tailor and hunch-back lady. Destroying a Yavana, redeeming Mucukunda and constructing the city of Dvaraka, I shall, thereafter, attend the RajasUya-yajna of Yudhisthra. Marrying sixteen thousand princesses I shall destroy a hundred and ten enemy. Restoring Sudama my friend to a graceful position, burning the city of Varanasi, supporting Shiva defeating Banasura, forcibly removing the tree of Parijata and accomplishing all other tasks, I shall go on pilgrimage with you Thereafter, we will meet the great sages talk wit) the relatives, completing the yajna of my father then I shall meet time you in an auspicious an\< all the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 6.251-253 \|\|

*bhaviṣyati tvayā sārddhaṃ punarāgamanaṃ vraje \|*

*nityaṃ saṃmīlana svapne bhaviṣyati tvayā saha \|*

Thereafter you will alway remain with me and shall never get separated, shall return to Vraja with you thereafter. О dea one, during the time of separation of a hundrei years from you, both of us will always meet ii the dream daily. Getting separated from you am reaching Dvaraka all the important tasks will b performed by me from the arhsa of Narayan; during all these hundred years. This is certain Thereafter, we shall again engage ourselves ii the divine dance at Vrindavana.

254-256. Thereafter, relieving the parents and th cowherdess of their grief and removing th burden of the earth, accompanied with you am the cowherdesses, I shall come back again to th Goloka. О Radha, the amsas of Narayana in m shall accompanied with Lakshmi and Sarasvati ti Vaikuntha and Vishnu and Dharma gettinj separated from my amsa shall revered to Shveta dvipa.

257\. Such of the gods and goddesses who had emerged from arhsas from the gods would also revert to their respective abodes. Thereafter we shall all remain in the Goloka.

## \|\| 6.258 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca śubhāśubham \|*

258\. О damsel, I have now narrated to you all the future pleasant the unpleasant happenings and whatever I have told you can never be otherwise.

## \|\| 6.259 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kṛtvā rādhāṃ svavakṣasi \|*

259\. Thus speaking lord Krishna embraced Radha and all the gods and their spouses were surprised at this.

## \|\| 6.260-261 \|\|

*uvāca śrīharirdevāndevīṃ ca samayocitam \|*

*gaccha pārvati kailāsaṃ sutābhyāṃ svāmi nā saha \|*

260-261. Thereafter Shri Hari spoke to the gods and goddesses, "You go to your respective place for the accomplishment for the future task." О Parvati, you go back to Kailasa with your husband and both the sons. Whatever have I spoken about the accomplishment of the tasks, it would surely happen.

## \|\| 6.262 \|\|

*bhavitā kalayā janma sarveṣāṃ ca vrajeśvari \|*  
*kṣudrāṇāṃ caiva mahatāṃ devaṃ laṃbodaraṃ vinā \|\| 262 \|\|*

262\. O goddess of Vraja, excepting Ganesha, all the gods and goddesses from their arhsas should appear on earth.

## \|\| 6.263-264 \|\|

*praṇamya śrīhariṃ devāḥ svālayaṃ prayayurmudā \|*  
*lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ bhaktyā praṇamya puruṣottamam \|\| 263 \|\|*

*hariṇā yojitaṃ karma kartuṃ vyagrā mahīṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*bhartrā nirūpitaṃ sthānaṃ devānāmapi durlabham \|\| 264 \|\|*

263-264. Thereafter all the gods delightfully bowed in reverence to lord Krishna and Sarasvati with devotion and went back to their respective abodes. Whatever tasks had been prescribed by the lord were to be established by them and for that purpose they emerged on the earth. Because the place prescribed by the lord was inaccessible even to the gods.

## \|\| 6.265-266 \|\|

*uvāca rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇo vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ vraja \|*

*ahaṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ vasudevālayaṃ priye \|*  
*paścātkaṃsabhaya vyājādgokulaṃ tava sannidhim \|\| 266 \|\|*

265-266. Then Shri Krishna spoke to Radha first of all you go to the house of Vrsabhanu, together with the cowherds and cowherdesses. О dear one, I am also appearing in the house of Vasudeva; thereafter I shall reach you in Gokula on the pretext on the fear from the Kamsa.

## \|\| 6.267 \|\|

*rādhā praṇamya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ raktapaṃkajalocanā \|*  
*bhṛśaṃ ruroda purataḥ premavicchedakātarā \|\| 267 \|\|*

267\. Thereafter Radha having the eyes like red lotus become anxious bitterly before him.

## \|\| 6.268-269 \|\|

*sthāyaṃsthāyaṃ kvacidyāṃtī gatvāgatvā punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*punaḥ punaḥ samāgatya darśaṃdarśaṃ harermukham \|\| 268 \|\|*

*papau cakṣuścakorābhyāṃ nimeṣarahitā satī \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrābhasudhāpūrṇaṃ prabhormukham \|\| 269 \|\|*

268-269. She walked slowly for some distance and again come back and stood before the lord. She enjoyed looking at the moon.

## \|\| 6.270 \|\|

*tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya saptadhā parameśvarī \|*  
*praṇamya saptadhā caiva punastasthau hareḥ puraḥ \|\| 270 \|\|*

270\. Thereafter the goddess Radhika went round the lord seven times and ultimately stood before Hari.

## \|\| 6.271 \|\|

*ājagmurgopikānāṃ ca triḥsaptaśatakoṭayaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma ca gopānāṃ samūhaḥ koṭisaṃkhyakaḥ \|\| 271 \|\|*

271\. At that point of time seventy three crores of cowherdesses and a crore of cowherds arrived here.

## \|\| 6.272-273 \|\|

*gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca samūhaiḥ saha rādhikā \|*  
*punaḥ praṇamya taṃ rādhā tatra tasthau ca nārada \|\| 272 \|\|*

*trayastriṃśadvayasyābhirgopībhiḥ saha suṃdarī \|*  
*gopānāṃ ca samūhaiśca praṇamya prayayau mahīm \|\| 273 \|\|*

272-273. О Narada, Radha again stood before the lord with the cowherds and cowherdesses and then stared at him. On the arrival on the thirty three female friends of Radhika, she bowed in reverence to the lord and then moved on accompanied with cowherd and cowherdesses.

## \|\| 6.274 \|\|

*hariṇā yojitaṃ sthānaṃ prajagmurnaṃdagokulam \|*  
*vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ rādhā gopīgopagṛhaṃ yayau \|\| 274 \|\|*

274\. They arrived in Gokula of Nanda. Radha appered in the house of Vrsabhanu and the cowherdesses appeared in the houses of other cowherds.

## \|\| 6.275 \|\|

*mahīṃ gatāyāṃ rādhāyāṃ gopībhiḥ saha gopakaiḥ \|*  
*babhūva śrīhariḥ sadyaḥ pṛthivīṃ gamanotsukaḥ \|\| 275 \|\|*

275\. Thus Radha descended on earth together with cowherds and cowherdesses. The cowherds also got ready to reach the houses of other cowherds.

## \|\| 6.276 \|\|

*saṃbhāṣya gopāngopīśca niyojya svīyakarmaṇi \|*  
*manoyāyī jagannātho jagāma mathurāṃ hariḥ \|\| 276 \|\|*

276\. Thus speaking to the cowherds and cowherdesses and deputing them variously, the lord of the universe incarnated in Mathura.

## \|\| 6.277 \|\|

*pūrvaṃ yadyadapatyaṃ ca devakīvasudevayoḥ \|*  
*babhūva sadyastatkaṃsaḥ putraṣaṭkaṃ jaghāna ha \|\| 277 \|\|*

277\. Kamsa had killed all the six children born of Devaki one by one.

## \|\| 6.278 \|\|

*śeṣāṃśaṃ saptamaṃ garbhaṃ māyayā''kṛṣya gokule \|*  
*nidhāya rohiṇīgarbhe jagāma cājñayā hareḥ \|\| 278 \|\|*

278\. At the command of the lord Yogamaya extracted the foetus from the womb of Devaki which happen to be that of Sheshanaga Ananta and carried the same to Gokula transplanting in the womb of Rohini.

## Chapter 7

## \|\| 7.1-3 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*tasyātirekaṃ kṛṣṇasya mahatpuṇyakaraṃ param \|*  
*vada janma mahābhāga janmamṛtyujarāpaham \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vasudevaḥ kasya putraḥ kasya kanyā ca devakī \|*  
*ko vasurdevakī kā vā vivāhaṃ cobhayorvada \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kathaṃ jaghāna kaṃsastatputraṣaṭkaṃ ca dāruṇaḥ \|*  
*kasmindine harerjanma śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narada said – O Lord, you kindly narrate to me the story relating to the birth of lord Krishna which is quite auspicious, the best and destroys the birth, the death and the old age who was the father of Vasudeva and who was the father of Devaki? Who was Devaki and Vasudeva in their earlier births? You kindly tell me how were they married? How did the terrible Kamsa kill their six sons and when was lord Krishna bom? I would like to listen to it in detail.

## \|\| 7.4-6 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*kaśyapo vasudevaśca devamātā ca devakī \|*  
*pūrvapuṇyaphalenaiva prāpatuḥ śrīhariṃ sutam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*devamīḍhānmāriṣāyāṃ vasudevo mahānabhūt \|*  
*yasyodbhave devasaṃgho vādayāmāsa duṃdubhim \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ānakaṃ ca mahāhṛṣṭāḥ śrīharerjanakaṃ ca tam \|*  
*saṃtaḥ purātanāstena vadaṃtyānakaduṃdubhim \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Shri Narayana said – Kashyapa appeared in the form of Vasudeve and Aditi, the mother of the gods was born as Devaki. They got the lord as their son because of the merits of their earlier births, Vasudeva was born from Devarrildha as father and Marisa as the mother. At the time of their births, the gods were rejoiced who rounded Dundubhis and beating of dmms besides playing on other musical instmment. That is why in the ancient time Vasudeva the son of the lord was also known as Anakadunbubhi.

## \|\| 7.7 \|\|

*āhukasya sutaḥ śrīmānyaduvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*devako jñānasiṃdhuśca tasya kanyā ca devakī \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. In the race ofYadus Shriman Deva happened to be the son of Anaka who was the ocean of knowledge. Devaki happened to be his daughter.

## \|\| 7.8 \|\|

*gargo yadukulācāryaḥ saṃbaṃdhaṃ vasunā saha \|*  
*devakyāḥ kārayāmāsa vidhivacca yathoditam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Garga the family priest of Yadus, married Devaki with Vasudeva, according to the scriptures.

## \|\| 7.9 \|\|

*mahāsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro vasudevaḥ śubhe kṣaṇe \|*  
*udvāhe devakīṃ tasmai devakaḥ pradadau kila \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. At the time of marriage, Vasudeva was decorated with coat of arms. At the time of marriage her father gave away his daughter Devaki to Vasudeva.

## \|\| 7.10-11 \|\|

*aśvānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi gajānāṃ ca śatāni ca \|*  
*sālaṃkṛtānāṃ dāsīnāṃ śatāni suṃdarāṇi ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

*nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*maṇiśreṣṭhāni vajrāṇi svarṇapātrāṇi nārada \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. О Narada, Devaka gave away in marriage to Vasudeva thousands of horses, hundreds of elephants, hundreds of ornaments, beautiful slave girls and several typed of beverages, besides the gems, diamonds, jewels and vases of gold.

## \|\| 7.12-16 \|\|

*sadratnabhūṣitāṃ kanyāṃ śatacaṃdrasamaprabhām \|*  
*trailokyamohinīṃ dhanyāṃ mānyāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ ca yoṣitām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*rūpādhārāṃ guṇādhārāṃ susmitāṃ vakralocanām \|*  
*navasaṃgamayogyāṃ ca prodbhinnanavayauvanām \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tāṃ gṛhītvā rathe kṛtvā prasthānasamaye tadā \|*  
*kaṃso hṛṣṭaḥ sahacaro bhaginyudvāhakarmaṇi \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tasyā rathasamīpasthe kaṃse gacchati tatkṣaṇe \|*  
*kaṃsaṃ saṃbodhya gagane vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kathaṃ hṛṣṭo'si rājeṃdra śṛṇu satyaṃ vaco hitam \|*  
*devakyā hyaṣṭamo garbho mṛtyuhetustavaiva hi \|\| 16 \|\|*

12-16. The girl who was adorned with all the ornaments had the lustre of hundreds of moons and could attract all the three worlds towards herself. She was quite graceful in the ladies and was the ocean of virtues, wearing a serene smile on her face and looking with side glances. She was best suited for love-sport and was quite youthful. After marriage she was made to sit in the chariot with Vasudeva. But when they were about to start, Kamsa also accompanied them delightfully, feeling joyful after the marriage of Devaki. When Kamsa was accompanying Devaki, at that very moment there was a divine voice from the sky, addressed to him "O best of the kings, why are your getting over-joyed? You listen to the truthful and beneficial words. The eighth child of Devaki would be the cause of your death."

## \|\| 7.17 \|\|

*śrutvaivaṃ devakīṃ kaṃsaḥ khaḍgahasto mahābalaḥ \|*  
*devavākyādbhayātkrodhātpāpiṣṭho haṃtumudyataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. On hearing this, the valorous Kamsa took out the divine word he felt panicky, getting enraged. The sinful person got ready for the killing of Devaki.

## \|\| 7.18 \|\|

*tāṃ haṃtumudyataṃ dṛṣṭvā vasudevaḥ supaṃḍitaḥ \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa nītijño nītiśāstraviśāradaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Vasudeva on the other hand finding Kamsa getting ready to kill Devaki, spoke to him appropriate words which were well-suited to the times and since Vasudeva was well-versed in the scriptures.

## \|\| 7.19 \|\|

*vasudeva uvāca \|*  
*rājanītiṃ na jānāsi śṛṇu me vacanaṃ hitam \|*  
*yaśaskaraṃ ca doṣaghnaṃ śāstroktaṃ samayocitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Vasudeva said – You are unaware of the royal practices. You listen to my words which are beneficial, glorious, remover of the sins and are strictly according to the scriptures.

## \|\| 7.20 \|\|

*asyā evāṣṭamo garbho mṛtyuścettava bhūmipa \|*  
*imāṃ ca hatvā duṣkīrtiṃ karoṣi tvaṃ naraḥ katham \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O king, in case Devaki's eight child is going to be the cause of your death then why to you indulge in undignified and sinful action of killing her and earning disgrace in the universe.

## \|\| 7.21 \|\|

*vadhe ca kṣudrajaṃtūnāṃ hiṃsakānāṃ ca paṃḍitaḥ \|*  
*kārṣāpaṇaṃ samutsṛjya mṛtyukāle pramucyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Because a killer when kills the insignificant creatures he gets relieved of the sin after giving away in charity, even a counter feet coin at the time of death.

## \|\| 7.22-23 \|\|

*ahiṃsakānāṃ kṣudrāṇāṃ vadhaḥ śataguṇaṃ dhruvam \|*  
*prāyaścittaṃ mṛtyukāle kathitaṃ padmayoninā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vadhe viśiṣṭajaṃtūnāṃ paśvādīnāṃ ca kāmataḥ \|*  
*tataḥ śataguṇaṃ pāpaṃ niścitaṃ manurabravīt \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. By killing the non-ferocious animals, one has to performed repentance, hundred times more then killing a terrific creatures. This has been ordained by Brahma. By killing special creatures and the animals and or by deliberately killing them, one earns hundred times more sins. This has been ordained by Manu.

## \|\| 7.24-31 \|\|

*narāṇāṃ mlecchajātīnāṃ vadhe śataguṇaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*mlecchānāṃ ca śatānāṃ ca yatpāpaṃ labhate vadhe \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sacchūdraikasya ca vadhe tatpāpaṃ labhate pumān \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sacchūdrāṇāṃ śatānāṃ ca yatpāpaṃ labhate vadhe \|*  
*tatpāpaṃ labhate nūnaṃ govadhaikena niścitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*gavāṃ daśaguṇaṃ pāpaṃ brāhmaṇasya vadhe bhavet \|*  
*viprahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ strīvadhe labhate naraḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*viśeṣato hi bhaginī poṣyā ca śaraṇāgatā \|*  
*strīhatyāśatapāpaṃ ca bhavedasyā vadhe nṛpa \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tapo japaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ tīrthadarśanam \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ homaṃ svargārthaṃ kurute budhaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ svapnatulyasamaṃ bhavam \|*  
*paśyaṃti satataṃ saṃto dharmaṃ kurvaṃti yatnataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*bhaginīṃ tyaja dharmiṣṭha svavaṃśāparabhāskara \|*  
*budhāḥ katividhāḥ saṃti sabhāyāṃ pṛcchatāṃ nṛpa \|\| 31 \|\|*

24-31. He earns hundred times more sins by killing a persons of mleccha race and the sin one earns by killing a mleccha, the same amount of sin is earned by him by killing a Shudra; the sin one earns by killing a Shudra. The sin one earns by killing a hundred Sodras is equal to killing of arrow. One earns ten times more sins by killing a cow; the sin earned by killing a Brahmana is equal to killing often cows. The sin of killing ten Brahmanas would be equal to killing of a women. The situation as further aggravated when the lady happens to be your own sister or the one who is dependent on you or the one who has taken refuge with you. О king, you are therefore sure to earn hundred times more the sins of killing a woman in case of killing Devaki. The intelligent persons performs tapas, recitation, gives away charity, performing of pUja, visiting holy places, offering food to Brahmana and performing of sacrifice for achieving heaven. The noble people consider the entire universe to be like the bubble of the water or like a dream, having no essence and illusory and therefore move on the righteous path. О religious minded one, You are the son of your race like the lotus. Therefore you free your sister, О king there are many types of intellectuals available in your court.

## \|\| 7.32-34 \|\|

*asyāścaivāṣṭamo garbho yadapatyaṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*baṃdho tubhyaṃ pradāsyāmi tena me kiṃ prayojanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*athavā yānyapatyāni bhavaṃti jñānināṃ vara \|*  
*tāni sarvāṇi dāsyāmi tvattaḥ ko me varaḥ priyaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*bhaginīṃ tyaja rājeṃdra kanyātulyāṃ priyāṃ tava \|*  
*miṣṭānnapānadānena vardhitā manujāṃ sadā \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. Whatever child is born from her womb on the eighth time I shall hand him over to you. He will be of no consequence to me. О best of the intellectuals, I shall hand over of the born to Devaki you because there is no one else dearer to me then you. О best of the kings you kindly leave alone your sister who is quite dearer to you like your own daughter. You have brought her up offering sweet food, bets and various types of eatables.

## \|\| 7.35 \|\|

*vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā tatyāja bhaginīṃ nṛpaḥ \|*  
*vasudevaḥ priyāṃ nītvā jagāma nijamaṃdire \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. On hearing the words of Vasudeva, the king left Devaki. Thereafter Vasudeva went to his abode together with Devaki.

## \|\| 7.36 \|\|

*kramādapatyaṣaṭkaṃ ca yadyadbhūtaṃ ca nārada \|*  
*dadau tasmai vasuḥ satyātsa jaghāna krameṇa tān \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. О Narada, One after the other six sons were born to Vasudeva but as per his words Vasudeva handed over each one of them to Kamsa who killed them one after the other.

## \|\| 7.37 \|\|

*devakyāḥ saptame garbhe kaṃso rakṣāṃ dadau bhiyā \|*  
*rohiṇījaṭhare māyā tamākṛṣya rarakṣa ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Thereafter Kamsa variously protected the seven conception of Devaki but Yogamaya with her illusion extracted the foetus from Devaki and transplanted it in the womb of Rohinl.

## \|\| 7.38 \|\|

*rakṣakāḥ kathayāmāsurgarbhasrāvo babhūva ha \|*  
*tasmādbabhūva bhagavānātmā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The gate-keeper informed Kamsa that Devaki had met with an abortion. A child was born from the womb of Rohinl who was given the name of Samkarsana.

## \|\| 7.39-43 \|\|

*tasyā evāṣṭamo garbho vāyupūrṇo babhūva ha \|*  
*gate ca navame māsi daśame samupasthite \|\| 39 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭiṃ dadau ca garbhe ca bhagavānsarvadarśanaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ rūpavatī devī sarvāsāṃ yoṣitāṃ varā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*babhūva darśanātsadyaḥ suṃdarī sā caturguṇā \|*  
*dadarśa devakīṃ kaṃsaḥ praphullavadanekṣaṇām \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tejasā prajvalaṃtīṃ ca māyāmiva diśo daśa \|*  
*jyotiṣāṃ saṃhatiṃ caiva yathā mūrtimatīmiva \|\| 42 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā tāmasureṃdraśca vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau \|*  
*asmādgarbhādapatyaṃ ca mṛtyubījaṃ mamaiva ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

39-43. Thereafter the eighth son of Devaki was born when her womb was filled with the wind. After the completion of nine months, there arrived the tenth month and the lord had to appear from that womb. Devaki herself was the best of all the beautiful ladies and with the very look of the lord she became four times more beautiful than before. At that point of time Devaki with the developed face and the eyes looked at Kamsa, she was illumining all the ten directions with the lustre of Yogamaya. She looked like the mass of lustre. Looking at Devaki, Kamsa the king of demons was totally surprised. He thought the child born of her womb would be the cause of his death.

## \|\| 7.44 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā kaṃsaśca dadau rakṣāṃ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca saptadvāraṃ rarakṣa ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Thus speaking Kamsa carefully kept a watch over Vasudeva and Devaki. He lodged them in an abode having seven gates.

## \|\| 7.45 \|\|

*pūrṇe ca daśame māse garbhaḥ pūrṇo babhūva ha \|*  
*babhūva sā calaspaṃdā jaḍarūpā ca nārada \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О Narada, after completion of the tenth month, the period of conception came to an end. She then walked slowly and became inactive.

## \|\| 7.46 \|\|

*garbhaṃ ca vāyunā pūrṇe nirlipto bhagavānajit \|*  
*hṛtpadmakośe devakyā adhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The conception was completed with the wind and the lord resided in the heart of Devaki.

## \|\| 7.47-51 \|\|

*sā viśvaṃbharagarbhā ca maṃdirābhyaṃtare satī \|*  
*uvāsa jaḍarūpā ca kleśayuktā babhūva ha \|\| 47 \|\|*

*uvāsa ca kṣaṇaṃ devī kṣaṇamutthāya tiṣṭhati \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ vrajati pādaikaṃ kṣaṇaṃ svapiti tatra vai \|\| 48 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā ca devakīṃ śīghraṃ vasudevo mahāmanāḥ \|*  
*prasūtisamayaṃ jñātvā sasmāra harimīśvaram \|\| 49 \|\|*

*ratnapradīpasaṃyukte maṃdire sumanohare \|*  
*sthāpayāmāsa khaḍgaṃ ca lohaṃ toyaṃ hutāśanam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*maṃtrajñaṃ ca naraṃ caiva baṃdhupatnīrbhayākulaḥ \|*  
*vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva trasto baṃdhūṃśca sādaram \|\| 51 \|\|*

47-51. At the time of the arrival of the lord of the universe in the womb of Devaki, she felt suffering with pain and became inactive. In a moment she used to sit and next moment she got up. In a moment she walked and in another moment she went to sleep. At the same time Vasudeva looked at Devaki and finding that the time of delivery had arrived, he started reciting the name of the lord of the universe, in that beautiful abode having the lamp of gems. He immediately brought the sword, iron, water and the fire, getting terrified. He summoned the people well-versed in mantras, the wives of his borthers, learned Brahman as and other relatives.

## \|\| 7.52-54 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare tasyā rātrerdvau praharau gatau \|*  
*vyāptaṃ ca gaganaṃ meghaiḥ kṣaṇadyutisamanvitaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*vavuśca vāyavaśceṣṭā yayurnidrāṃ ca rakṣakāḥ \|*  
*aceṣṭitāśca śayane mṛtā iva vicetanāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*etasminnaṃtare tatra cājagmustridaśeśvarāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭuvurdharmabrahmeśā garbhasthaṃ parameśvaram \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. In the meantime at the dead of night, the sky was over-cast with clouds. The pleasant wind started blowing and all the guards went to sleep as if they had lost their consciousness. They lay on the floor as if they were sleeping in bed. At the sametime Brahma, Shiva and Dharma arrived there and started offering prayers to the lord.

## \|\| 7.55 \|\|

*. devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*jagadyonirayonistvamanaṃto 'vyaya eva ca \|*  
*jyotiḥsvarūpo hyanaghaḥ saguṇo nirguṇo mahān \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The gods said – You are the place of birth of the universe but you are yourself without the place of birth; you are beyond measures, imperishable, the form of sight, sinless, having qualities, and without qualities, besides being the great lord,

## \|\| 7.56-59 \|\|

*bhaktānurodhātsākāro nirākāro niraṃkuśaḥ \|*  
*nirvyūho nikhilādhāro niḥśaṃko nirupadravaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*nirupādhiśca nirlipto nirīho nidhanāṃtakaḥ \|*  
*svātmārāmaḥ pūrṇakāmo'nimiṣo nitya eva ca \|\| 57 \|\|*

*svecchāmayaḥ sarvahetuḥ sarvaḥ sarvaguṇāśrayaḥ \|*  
*sukhado duḥkhado durgo durjanāṃtaka eva ca \|\| 58 \|\|*

*subhago durbhago vāggmī durārādhyo duratyayaḥ \|*  
*vedahetuśca vedāśca vedāṃgo vedavidvibhuḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

56-59. Being invisible you appear in definite form for the sake of your devotees, you are unconcerned, fnoving at will, the base of all without any doubt, without any trouble, without any attribute uninvolved, indifferent, death for the death, roaming in your soul, the one who fulfils the desires of all, eternal the one who moves at will, the cause of everyone the form of everyone, the abode of all the virtues, bestower of pleasures and the pain, quite deep, uninvolved, destroyer of the wicked people, fortunate and unfortunate, short spoken, difficult adore, inaccessible, the cause of the Vedas, the form of the Vedas and post-Vedic literature and well-versed in the Vedas being all pervading.

## \|\| 7.60 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā devāśca praṇemuśca muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*harṣāśrulocanāḥ sarve vavṛṣuḥ kusumāni ca \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Thus speaking the gods bowed before the lord again and again and with their eyes filled with tears, they showered the flower.

## \|\| 7.61-72 \|\|

*dvicatvāriṃśannāmāni prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ labhate vāṃchitaṃ phalam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*iti śrībrahmavaivarte brahmādikṛtaśrīkṛṣṇastotram \|*  
*. nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā devāste svālayaṃ yayuḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*babhūva jalavṛṣṭiśca niśceṣṭā mathurāpurī \|*  
*ghorāṃdhakāranibiḍā babhūva yāminī mune \|\| 63 \|\|*

*gate saptamuhūrte tu cāṣṭame samupasthite \|*  
*vedātiriktadurjñeye sarvotkṛṣṭe śubhe kṣaṇe \|\| 64 \|\|*

*śubhe grahe dṛṣṭiyukte'pyadṛṣṭe cāśubhagrahe \|*  
*ardharātre samutpanne rohiṇyāmaṣṭamītithau \|\| 65 \|\|*

*jayaṃtīyogasaṃyuktaṃ cārdhacaṃdrodaye mune \|*  
*dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ lagnaṃ bhītāḥ sūryādayastadā \|\| 66 \|\|*

*gagane kramamullaṃghya jagmurmīnaṃ śubhāvahāḥ \|*  
*suprasannā grahāḥ sarve babhūvustatra saṃsthitāḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*ekādaśāste prītyā ca muhūrtaṃ dhāturājñayā \|*  
*vavarṣuśca jaladharā vavurvātāḥ suśītalāḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*suprasannā ca pṛthivī prasannāśca diśo daśa \|*  
*ṛṣayo manavaścaiva yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*devā devyaśca muditā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ \|*  
*jagurgaṃdharvapatayo vidyādharyaśca nārada \|\| 70 \|\|*

*sukhena susruvurnadyo jajvaluścāgnayo mudā \|*  
*nedurduṃdubhayo nāke cānakāśca manoharāḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mahāvṛṣṭirbabhūva ha \|*  
*jagāma sūtikāgehaṃ nārīrūpaṃ vidhāya bhūḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

61-72. Narayana said – Thus praising the lord, the gods returned to their respective abodes. О sage, the entire city of Mathura seemed to have been at a stand-still because of heavy rain. It was pitch dark during the night. О sage, the period of seven muhUrtas was spent and the eight one arrive, when at the dead of the night, the best of the auspicious time arrived it was the time inaccessible by anyone accept the Vedas. At that point of time all the planets were having the auspicious sight, the unfavourable planets were not there as a matter of chance, Jayantl-yoga was accomplished. О sage, when the crescent arose, all the planets in the sky including the sun, looking at lagna. Reached the mina-lagna. All the planets arrived there getting delighted. At the command of the lord all the planets assembled in the eleventh house delightfully. It started raining and the cool wind started blowing, the goddess earth was quite happy together with all the ten directions, the sages, the Manuvmda, Yaksas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, the gods, the goddesses were all delighted. The apsaras started dancing while lord of the Gandharvas and the Vidyadharis started singing and playing on musical instruments. О Narada, all the rivers started flowing gleefully; the fire was ignited and the Dundubhis were sounded in the heaven with the other musical instrument. The rain of Parijata flowers started falling. The earth taking to the form of a female reached the labour room. The slogans of victory were shouted, the conches were blown and the name of Hari was recited.

## \|\| 7.73-80 \|\|

*jayaśabdaḥ śaṃkhaśabdo hariśabdo babhūva ha \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare tatra papāta devakī satī \|\| 73 \|\|*

*niḥsasāra ca vāyuśca devakījaṭharāttataḥ \|*  
*tatraiva bhagavānkṛṣṇo divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca \|\| 74 \|\|*

*hṛtpadmakośāddevakyā harirāvirbabhūva ha \|*  
*atīva kamanīyaṃ ca śarīraṃ sumanoharam \|\| 75 \|\|*

*dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sphuranmukuṭakuṇḍalam \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram \|\| 76\|\|*

*maṇiratneṃdrasārāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitam \|*  
*navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā \|\| 77 \|\|*

*caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitam \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaṃ biṃbādharamanoharam \|\| 78 \|\|*

*mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca sadrannamukuṭojjvalam \|*  
*tribhaṃgavakramadhyaṃ ca vanamālāvibhūṣitam \|\| 79 \|\|*

*śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ cāru kaustubhena virājitam \|*  
*kiśoravayasaṃ śāṃtaṃ kāntaṃ brahmeśayoḥ param \|\| 80 \|\|*

73-80. At that point of time Devaki fell down on the ground and the wind fell from her womb. Thereafter lord Krishna taking to the divine form appeared from the womb of Devaki. His body extremely beautiful and charming. He had two arms and was holding a flute in his hand, his ears, were adorned with makara-kundalas and he wore a serene smile over the face, bestowing his grace over the devotees. The gem-studded ornaments were adding to the beauty of his body and he was clad in yellow lower garments, having a complexion of new clouds. His body was plastered with sandal-paste, aguru, kastiirl and saffron. His face resembled to that of the face of full moon of winter season and his lips resembled the ripe wood apple which added to his charming beauty. He had a peacock feather adoring his head together with the gem-studded kirlta crown. The divine lustre of Shrihari was illumining the place. He stood in Tribhangl pose and wore long garland of forest flowers round his neck. The Shrivatsa mark appeared over his chest which was emitting lustre. In the chest, there appeared a golden line over which the kaustubha gems was shining and looked quite beautiful. He was of tender age and quite peaceful, lord Hari was dear to Brahma as well as Shiva.

## \|\| 7.81-82 \|\|

*dadarśa vasudevaśca devakīpurato mune \|*  
*tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau \|\| 81 \|\|*

*kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ \|*  
*sāśrupūrṇaḥ sapulako devakyā ca striyā saha \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. О sage, Vasudeva and Devaki looked at the lord and were surprised with the same. Vasudeva and Devaki started offering prayer to the lord with their eyes were filled with tears and the body felt emotional. They bowed in reverence to him and started offering prayer with folded hands.

## \|\| 7.83-87 \|\|

*. vasudeva uvāca \|*  
*tvāmatīṃdriyamavyaktamakṣaraṃ nirguṇaṃ vibhum \|*  
*dhyānāsādhyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 83 \|\|*

*svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ svecchārūpadharaṃ param \|*  
*nirliptaṃ paramaṃ brahma bījarūpaṃ sanātanam \|\| 84 \|\|*

*sthūlātsthūlataraṃ vyāptamatisūkṣmamadarśanam \|*  
*sthitaṃ sarvaśarīreṣu sākṣirūpamadṛśyakam \|\| 85 \|\|*

*śarīravaṃtaṃ saguṇamaśarīraṃ guṇotkaram \|*  
*prakṛtiṃ prakṛtīśaṃ ca prākṛtaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|\| 86 \|\|*

*sarveśaṃ sarvarūpaṃ ca sarvāṃtakaramavyayam \|*  
*sarvādhāraṃ nirādhāraṃ nirvyūhaṃ staumi kiṃ vibhum \|\| 87 \|\|*

83-87. Vasudeva said – You are beyond the organ of senses, invisible, beyond description, without qualities, pervading everywhere, beyond the reach of any one, the great soul, the great lord, moving at will, the form of all, the one who takes to any from at will, the great lord uninvolved eternal Brahman and the eternal form of the seed; you are harder then the hardest, pervading everywhere, smaller then the smallest, invisible one, dweller in all the bodies as a witness, invisible one, taking to human from, the treasure of virtues, the form of Prakriti and the lord of Prakriti beyond Prakriti and the form of all. What type of prayer can be offer to you?

## \|\| 7.88-91 \|\|

*anaṃtaḥ stavane'śakto'śaktā devī sarasvatī \|*  
*yaṃ vā stotumaśaktaśca paṃcavaktraḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

*caturmukho vedakartā yaṃ stotumakṣamaḥ sadā \|*  
*gaṇeśo na samarthaśca yogīṃdrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*ṛṣayo devatāścaiva munīṃdramanumānavāḥ \|*  
*svapne teṣāmadṛśyaṃ ca tvāmeva kiṃ stuvaṃti te \|\| 90 \|\|*

*śrutayaḥ stavane'śaktāḥ kiṃ stuvaṃti vipaścitaḥ \|*  
*vihāyaiva śarīraṃ ca bālo bhavitumarhasi \|\| 91 \|\|*

88-91. We are unable to offer prayer to you because even goddess Sarasvati, Shiva with five faces, Karttikeya with six faces are unable to do so. Even four faced Brahma and the creator of the Vedas is unable to recite your glory. Even lord Ganesha is unable to do so. You are the teacher of the teachers of yogis, Rsis, the gods, sages, Manus and the human being. You do not appear evening their dreams. Therefore removing this form you appear in the form of a child.

## \|\| 7.92-93 \|\|

*vasudevakṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*bhaktiṃ dāsyamavāpnoti śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃbuje \|\| 92 \|\|*

*viśiṣṭaputraṃ labhate haridāsaṃ guṇānvitam \|*  
*saṃkaṭaṃ nistarettūrṇaṃ śatrubhītyā pramucyate \|\| 93 \|\|*

92-93. Whosoever recites the stotra recited by Vasudeva, thrice a day, he achieves the slavehood and the devotion of the lotus-like feet of Krishna. He achieves great merit and the devotion of lord Hari besides the son. All his miseries are over, without any difficulty and he is relieved of the terror of all his enemies.

## \|\| 7.94 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmavaivarte vasudevakṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotram \|*  
*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā tamuvāca hariḥ svayam \|*  
*prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānbhaktānugrahakātaraḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Narayana said – On hearing the words of Vasudeva, lord Hari who bestows grace over his devotees then spoke to him.

## \|\| 7.95-97 \|\|

*. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tapasāṃ ca phalenaiva putro'haṃ tava sāṃpratam \|*  
*varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*purā tapasvināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sutapāstvaṃ prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*patnī te pṛśnināmnī ca tapasā''rādhitastvayā \|\| 96 \|\|*

*putro matsadṛśastatra dṛṣṭvā māṃ ca vṛto budhaḥ \|*  
*mayā datto varastubhyaṃ matsamo bhavitā sutaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

95-97. Shri Krishna said – I have become your son because of the result of your tapas. You will meet with all the welfare, there is no doubt about it. In earlier times you had been a great tapas and Prajapati named Sutapa. Prsni was the name of your wife, both of you adored me with your wife and having an audience with me you asked for a boon that you should get a son like me. I therefore bestowed a boon to you saying, "You will get a son like me.".

## \|\| 7.98 \|\|

*dattvā tubhyaṃ varaṃ tāta manasā''locya ciṃtitaḥ \|*  
*matsamo nāsti bhuvane putro'haṃ tena hetunā \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. O respectable one after bestowing the boon to you I thought in my mind that there is no one else comparable to me in the universe, therefore I became your son.

## \|\| 7.99-100 \|\|

*tapasāṃ ca prabhāveṇa tvameva kaśyapaḥ svayam \|*  
*sutapā devamāteyamaditiśca pativratā \|\| 99 \|\|*

*adhunā kaśyapāṃśastvaṃ vasudevaḥ pitā mama \|*  
*devakī devamāteyamaditeraṃśasaṃbhavā \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. Because as a result of the tapas you become Kashyapa and she became Sutapa, the mother of Aditi. Now you have appeared as Vasudeva from the amsa of Kashyapa becoming my father and Devaki has appeared from the amsa of Aditi, the goddes of the gods as my mother.

## \|\| 7.101 \|\|

*tvatto'dityāṃ vāmano'haṃ putrasteṃ'śena saṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*adhunā paripūrṇo'haṃ putraste tapasāṃ phalāt \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. From you, I was also born as Vamana as your son and because of the result of your tapas presently I have appeared again as your son.

## \|\| 7.102 \|\|

*māṃ vā tvaṃ putrabhāvena brahmabhāvena vā punaḥ \|*  
*māṃ prāpto'si mahāprājña jīvanmukto bhaviṣyasi \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. О virtuous one, you will be freed from the cycle of birth and death, by getting me as a son.

## \|\| 7.103 \|\|

*yaśodābhavanaṃ śīghraṃ māṃ gṛhītvā vrajaṃ vraja \|*  
*saṃsthāpya tatra māṃ tāta māyāmādāya sthāpaya \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. О respectable one, now you carry me to the abode of Yashoda immediately in Vraja. Keeping me there you bring Yogamaya here.

## \|\| 7.104-105 \|\|

*ityuktvā śrīharistatra bālarūpo babhūva ha \|*  
*nagnaṃ bhūmau śayānaṃ ca dadarśa śyāmalaṃ sutam \|\| 104 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā sa bālakaṃ tatra mohito viṣṇumāyayā \|*  
*kiṃ vā kūṭaṃ ca taṃdrāyāmapūrvaṃ sūtikāgṛham \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. Thus speaking the lord turned himself into the form of a child; finding the son of dark complexion sleeping over the floor and getting influenced with the illusion of lord Vishnu, Vasudeva spoke about the child who was the eternal Brahman, With his birth the labour-room was illumining.

## \|\| 7.106 \|\|

*ityuktvā vasudevaśca samālocya striyā saha \|*  
*gṛhītvā bālakaṃ kroḍe jagāma nandagokulam \|\| 106\|\|*

106\. Thus speaking after consulting his wife, he picked up the child in his lap he proceeded towards the city of Gokula.

## \|\| 7.107 \|\|

*gatvā nandavrajaṃ śīghraṃ viveśa sūtikāgṛham \|*  
*dadarśa śayanāviṣṭāṃ yaśodāṃ nidrayā'nvitām \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Reaching in Vraja of Nanda he immediately entered the labour-room and found Yashoda sleeping on the bed.

## \|\| 7.108-109 \|\|

*nidrānvitaṃ ca nandaṃ ca sarvaṃ tatra gṛhe sthitam \|*  
*dadarśa bālikāṃ nagnāṃ taptakāṃcanasannibhām \|\| 108 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyāṃ prasannāsyāṃ paśyantīṃ gṛhaśekharam \|*  
*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vasudevaśca vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. Finding Nanda in sleep and аЦ other members of the house also enjoying thft sl^ep, he looked at the girl who was without robes ,md was having the lustre of molten gold. She had a smiling face and was starting of at the ceiling. Looking at her, Vasudeva was immensely surprised.

## \|\| 7.110 \|\|

*saṃsthāpya tatra putraṃ ca kanyāmādāya satvaram \|*  
*jagāma mathurāṃ hṛṣṭaḥ svakāṃtāsūtikāgṛham \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Leaving the male child there he picked up the girl and proceeded towards, Mathura. Thereafter he reached the labour-room delightfully before his wife.

## \|\| 7.111 \|\|

*sthāpayāmāsa tatraiva mahāmāyāṃ ca bālikām \|*  
*rorūyamāṇāṃ tāmeva dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭā ca devakī \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. He then placed the girl who was indeed Mahamaya on the bed and she started crying aloud. Devaki felt delighted on looking at her.

## \|\| 7.112-113 \|\|

*rodanenaiva sā bālā bodhayāmāsa rakṣakān \|*  
*utthāya rakṣakāḥ śīghraṃ bālikāṃ jagṛhustadā \|\| 112 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā bālikāṃ te ca prajagmuḥ kaṃsasannidhim \|*  
*jagāma devakī paścādvasudevaśca śokataḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

112-113. The girl child woke up the guards with her cries. All the people got up at once and picked up the child. They took her to Karhsa and placed her before him. Thereafter, Vasudeva and Devaki followed them with painful hearts.

## \|\| 7.114 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā ca bālikāṃ kaṃso nātihṛṣṭo mahāmune \|*  
*rorūyamāṇāṃ kalyāṇīṃ taddayā na babhūva ha \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. О great sage, Kaiser could not be happy at the sight of the girl but at the same time he could not be compassionate on her when she was crying.

## \|\| 7.115-116 \|\|

*tāṃ gṛhītvā ca pāṣāṇe hantuṃ yāṃtaṃ sudāruṇam \|*  
*uvāca vasudevaśca devakī paramādaram \|\| 115 \|\|*

*bhobhoḥ kaṃsa nṛpaśreṣṭha nītiśāstraviśārada \|*  
*nibodha vākyaṃ satyaṃ ca nītiyuktaṃ manoramam \|\| 116 \|\|*

115-116. He was going to strike her on the stone slabs. Both Vasudeva and Devaki spoke to the terrible king at that time, "O best of the kings, О Kariisa, you are well aware of the scriptures you kindly listen to my truthful and appropriate words.".

## \|\| 7.117 \|\|

*hatvā''vayoḥ putraṣaṭkaṃ dayā te nāsti bāṃdhava \|*  
*adhunā cāṣṭame garbhe bālikāmabalāṃ mama \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. О brother, you never displayed compassion by killing six of our sons. Currently from the eight conception this daughter has been born.

## \|\| 7.118 \|\|

*hatvā tava kimaiśvaryaṃ bhaviṣyati mahītale \|*  
*strīmeva haṃtumabala kiṃ kṣamā raṇamūrdhani \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. What type of fortunes would you achieve on earth by killing her. Can the helpless woman be able to snatch your royal treasures?

## \|\| 7.119 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā taṃ vasurdevakī ca sabhātale \|*  
*ruroda puratastatra kaṃsasya ca durātmanaḥ \|*  
*kaṃsastayorvacaḥ śrutvā tāmuvāca durātmanā \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. Thus speaking both Vasudeva and Devaki started crying in the court of the wicked king Kamsa. The wicked Kamsa listened to the words of both of them then spoke.

## \|\| 7.120-123 \|\|

*. kaṃsa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu vākyaṃ madīyaṃ ca nibodha bodhayāmi te \|\| 120 \|\|*

*tṛṇena parvataṃ hantuṃ śakto dhātā ca daivataḥ \|*  
*kīṭena siṃhaśārdūlaṃ maśakena gajaṃ tathā \|\| 121 \|\|*

*śiśunā ca mahāvīraṃ mahāṃtaṃ kṣudrajantubhiḥ \|*  
*mūṣakena ca mārjāraṃ maṃḍūkena bhujaṃgamam \|\| 122 \|\|*

*evaṃ janyena janakaṃ bhakṣyeṇaiva ca bhakṣakam \|*  
*vahninā ca jalaṃ naṣṭuṃ vahniṃ śuṣkatṛṇena ca \|\| 123 \|\|*

120-123. Kamsa said – You listen to my words. I am going to make you understand, before you listen to me and accept them. The destiny can destroy a mountain with a small straw. Similarly it can get a powerful lion or a tiger killed through and an insect, a huge elephant could be got killed by it with a mosquito, a child could defeat a great warrior, a gigantic aquatic animal from a petty equatic animal, a cat could be killed by mouse and a frog could kill a serpent. It can get the father killed from the son, a huge devoured could be devoured by a petty devourer, fire from water, a dry straw could destroy the fire, it is surprising that a single Brahmana a Jahnu and drunk the water of the seven oceans.

## \|\| 7.124-128 \|\|

*pītāḥ sapta samudrāśca dvijenaikena jantunā \|*  
*dhāturgatirvicitrā tu durjñeyā bhuvanatraye \|\| 124 \|\|*

*daivena bālikā naṣṭuṃ māṃ samarthā bhaviṣyati \|*  
*bālikāṃ ca vadhiṣyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 125 \|\|*

*ityevamuktvā kaṃsaśca gṛhītvā bālikāṃ tadā \|*  
*haṃtumārabdhavānkaṃsastamuvāca vasustadā \|\| 126 \|\|*

*vṛthā hiṃsitavānrājandehi bālāṃ kṛpānidhe \|*  
*sa tacchrutvā vicārajñaḥ kaṃsastuṣṭo mahāmune \|\| 127 \|\|*

*saṃbodhayantaṃ tatraiva vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī \|*  
*he kaṃsa haṃsi kāṃ mūḍha na vijñāya harergatim \|\| 128 \|\|*

124-128. Therefore, the moves of the destiny are quite astonishing and beyond comprehension in the three worlds. As the move of destiny this girl child could also be able to kill me. Therefore I will surely kill her. There is no need of further thought in this case. Thus speaking Kamsa caught hold of the girl child and as he was about to kill her, Vasudeva said, "O king up to now you have uselessly resorted to killing. О compassionate one, you give this girl child to me." О great sage on hearing this Kamsa was delighted. At that point of time a divine voice from the sky addressed Kamsa, "O foolish Kamsa, whom are you going to kill without coming to know about the moves of the lord. The one who is going to kill you has already be born and who would appear at the appropriate time."

## \|\| 7.129-130 \|\|

*kutracittvannihantā'sti kāle vyakto bhaviṣyati \|*  
*śrutvaiva devavāṇīṃ ca tatyāja bālikāṃ nṛpaḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

*vasudevo devakī ca tāmādāya mudā'nvitau \|*  
*jagmatuḥ svagṛhaṃ tau ca kanyāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|\| 130 \|\|*

129-130. Listening to the divine voice the king spared the girl child. Both Vasudeva and Devaki delightfully carried her to their abode. Vasudeva on the other hand distributed riches among the Brahman as getting back the girl-child, who had been on the verge of death.

## \|\| 7.131-133 \|\|

*mṛtāmiva punaḥ prāpya brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dhanam \|*  
*sā parā bhaginī vipra kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

*ekānaṃśeti vikhyātā pārvatyaṃśasamudbhavā \|*  
*vasustāṃ dvārakāyāṃ tu rukmiṇyudvāhakarmaṇi \|\| 132 \|\|*

*dadau durvāsase bhaktyā śaṃkarāṃśāya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ nigaditaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇajanmānukīrtanam \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarātighnaṃ sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ mune \|\| 133 \|\|*

131-133. О Brahmana, that girl child happened to be the elder sister of K»sna who was born of the arhsha of Parvati. The girl was given in due course of time the name of Ekanamsa. Vasudeva gave away that girl in marriage to Durvasa who had appeared as the arhsha of Shiva at the time of the marriage of Rukmini. О sage, I have narrated to you the story relating to the birth of Krishna which relieves one of birth, death and old age and makes one earn great merit.

## Chapter 8

## \|\| 8.1 \|\|

*. nārada uvāca \|*  
*janmāṣṭamīvrataṃ brūhi vratānāṃ vratamuttamam \|*  
*phalaṃ jayaṃtīyogasya sāmānyenaiva sāṃpratam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – In all the vratas Janmastaml-vrata is considered to be the best of all. You kindly let me know the result of the combination of Jayanti with the same.

## \|\| 8.2 \|\|

*ko vā doṣo'pyakaraṇe bhojano vā mahāmune \|*  
*upavāsaphalaṃ kiṃ vā jayaṃtyāṃ ca susaṃmatam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О great sage, you kindly let me know the sin earned by not performing the vrata or by eating something on that day. What is the reward for fasting at the time of Jayanti.

## \|\| 8.3 \|\|

*vrataṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca saṃyamasya ca sāṃpratam \|*  
*upavāsapāraṇayoḥ suvicārya vada prabho \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О lord, your kindly enlighten me on the vrata, the method of adoration, the discipline the fasting and ending of the fast quite carefully.

## \|\| 8.4-5 \|\|

*. nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ saptamyāṃ saṃyataḥ pāraṇe tathā \|*  
*aruṇodayavelāyāṃ samutthāya pare'hani \|\| 4 \|\|*

*prātaḥkṛtya saṃvidhāya snātvā saṃkalpamācaret \|*  
*vratopavāsayorbrahmañchrīkṛṣṇaprītihetukam \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Narayana said – On the Seventh day of the moon one should consume the left over of the yajna and with a disciplined mind and on the next day, the eighth day of the moon, one should get up early in the morning and take a bath. Therefore he should take a vow for performing the vrata by fasting, he should take samkalpa, "I am performing the vrata and fasting for the pleasure of lord Krishna".

## \|\| 8.6 \|\|

*manvādidivase prāpte yatphalaṃ snānapūjanaiḥ \|*  
*phalaṃ bhādrapade'ṣṭamyāṃ bhavetkoṭiguṇaṃ dvija \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Brahamana, by performing the vrata on the eight day of the black fortnight, one gets the merit of crores of times more than one could ordinary get for performing ordinary vratas.

## \|\| 8.7 \|\|

*tasyāṃ tithau vārimātraṃ pitṝṇāṃ yaḥ prayacchati \|*  
*gayāśrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena śatābdaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. On that particular day whosoever offers simple water to the a man is equated with performing of the shraddha at Gaya for a hundred years. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 8.8-13 \|\|

*snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā nirmāya sūtikāgṛham \|*  
*lohakhaṃḍavahnijālairyuktaṃ rakṣakasaṃghakaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tatra dravyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ nābhicchedanakartanam \|*  
*dhātrīsvarūpāṃ nārīṃ ca yatnataḥ sthāpayedbudhaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pūjādravyāṇi cārūṇi sopacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*phalānyaṣṭau ca miṣṭāni dravyāṇyeva hi nārada \|\| 10 \|\|*

*jātīphalaṃ ca kaṃkolaṃ dāḍimaṃ śrīphalaṃ tathā \|*  
*nārikeraṃ ca jaṃbīraṃ kūṣmāṃḍaṃ ca suvāsasam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*arghyamācanīyaṃ ca snānīyaṃ śayanaṃ tathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāṃbūlamanulepanam \|*  
*dhūpadīpau bhūṣaṇaṃ vai copacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 13 \|\|*

8-13. After taking the bath and getting free from the daily routine, one should build up a labour-room in which the iron, the sword, fire, the attendant and various types of materials should be kept, besides the scissors, and a mid-wife. О Neared, after performing sixteen type of puja one should provide eight types of beautiful fruits, seeds, beverages, nutmeg, kamkola, pomegranate, wood apple. Coconut, lemon, melon, best of costumes, asana, clothes, water madhuparka, arghya, water for sipping, water for bathing, the bed, fragrance, flowers, naivedya, betel, fragrant paste, incense and ornament. These are the items meant for use in the sixteen type of adoration.

## \|\| 8.14-15 \|\|

*pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|*  
*ācamya cāsane sthitvā svastivācanapūrvakam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ghaṭasyāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya paṃca devatāḥ \|*  
*ghaṭe hyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Thereafter washing the feet, wearing clean costumes, one should be seated on the dsana, sipping the water at the same time. Thereafter reciting svastivacana, the pitcher should be consecrated adoring other gods at the same time.

## \|\| 8.16-19 \|\|

*vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca yaśodāṃ naṃdameva ca \|*  
*rohiṇīṃ baladevaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhīdevīṃ vasuṃdharām \|\| 16 \|\|*

*rohiṇīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ caiva aṣṭamīṃ sthānadevatām \|*  
*aśvatthāmnā saha baliṃ hanumaṃtaṃ vibhīṣaṇam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kṛpaṃ paraśurāmaṃ ca vedavyāsaṃ mṛkaṃḍakam \|*  
*sarvasyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā dhyānaṃ kuryāddharestadā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*puṣpakaṃ mastake nyasya punardhyāyedvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi nārada \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. Lord Krishna should be invoked in the pitcher water. Thereafter all the gods including Vasudeva, Devaki, Yashoda, Nanda, Rohini, Baladeva, goddess SasthI, earth goddes, a Brahmana lady, astaml, local god, Asvatthama, Bali, Hanuman, Vibhlsana, Krpacarya, Paras'urama, Vedavyasa and Markandeya should also be invoked. Placing the flowers on the head, the devotees should performed dhyanam.

## \|\| 8.20 \|\|

*brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ kumārāya mahātmane \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O Narada, I am going to enlighten you about the dhyanam which has been prescribed in the Samaveda. You listen to it. In the earlier time the same was told by Brahma to the great sage Kumara.

## \|\| 8.21 \|\|

*bālaṃ nīlāṃbujābhamatiśayaruciraṃ smeravaktrāṃbujaṃ taṃ brahmeśānaṃtadharmaiḥ katikatidivasaiḥ stūyamānaṃ paraṃ yat \|*  
*dhyānāsādhyamṛṣīndrairmunigaṇamanujaiḥ siddhasaṃghairasādhyaṃ yogīṃdrāṇāmaciṃtyamatiśayamatulaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ bhaje'ham \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. I adore Balamukunda who had the complexion of blue lotus flower and is extremely beautiful and who bears a serene smile always over his face. Brahma, Shiva, Shesha and Dharma always adore him, he cannot be achieved by dhyanam alone. And is also beyond the reach of the best of Rsis, sages, the siddhas and the human being. He is beyond the comprehension even of the great yogis. He happens to be best of all and is the witness of everyone.

## \|\| 8.22-23 \|\|

*dhyātvā puṣpaṃ ca dattvā ca tatsarvaṃ ca nivedayet \|*  
*evaṃ vratī vrataṃ kuryācchṛṇu maṃtrakramaṃ mune \|\| 22 \|\|*

*āsanaṃ sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ sadratnamaṇinirmitam \|*  
*vicitraṃ ca vicitreṇa gṛhyatāṃ śobhanaṃ hare \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. О sage, thus meditating upon, one should offer the flowers to him. Thus the devotee should perform the vrata. Now I am going to recite the mantra of same, you please listen to me. О lord Hari, you posses all the glory. You kindly accept the asana which is studded with the best of gems, jewels and decorated the flowers and creepers.

## \|\| 8.24 \|\|

*vasanaṃ vahniśaucaṃ ca nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*prataptasvarṇakhacitaṃ citritaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O Hari, I offer the costumes which are pure like the fire, created by Vishvakarma and are beautifully woven like the gold.

## \|\| 8.25 \|\|

*pādaprakṣālanārthaṃ ca svarṇapātrasthitaṃ jalam \|*  
*pavitraṃ nirmalaṃ cāru pādyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O Hari, you kindly accept the pure water contained in the vase of gold with the spotless water for the sake of cleaning of the feet.

## \|\| 8.26 \|\|

*madhusarpirdadhikṣīraṃ śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ param \|*  
*svarṇapātrasthitaṃ deyaṃ snānārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O Hari, I offer you the honey, the curd, milk and sugar combined in a vase for the purpose, you are taking the bath.

## \|\| 8.27 \|\|

*dūrvākṣataṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ svacchatoyasamanvitam \|*  
*caṃdanāgurukastūrīsahitaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О Hari, I offer DUrvd-grass, rice, white flower, sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl mixed in the water and arghya.

## \|\| 8.28 \|\|

*susvādu svacchatoyaṃ ca vāsitaṃ gaṃdhavastunā \|*  
*śuddhamācamanīyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О Parameshvara, I offer the tasteful and fragrant water for sipping.

## \|\| 8.29 \|\|

*gaṃdhadravyasamāyuktaṃ viṣṇo tailaṃ suvāsitam \|*  
*āmalakyā dravaṃ caiva snānīyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О Vishnu, you kindly accept the fragrant material besides the fragrant oil mixed with the juice of myrobalan for taking bath.

## \|\| 8.30 \|\|

*sadratnamaṇisāreṇa racitāṃ sumanoharām \|*  
*chāditāṃ sūkṣmavastreṇa śayyāṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О Hari, you kindly accept this bed which has been built with the best of gems and covered with fine silken cloth.

## \|\| 8.31 \|\|

*cūrṇaṃ ca vṛkṣabhedānāṃ mūlānāṃ dravasaṃyutam \|*  
*kastūrīdravasaṃyuktaṃ gandhaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О Hari, you accept this fragrance which is mixed with the powder of many trees and their roots besides kasturl.

## \|\| 8.32 \|\|

*puṣpaṃ sugaṃdhiyuktaṃ ca saṃyuktaṃ kuṃkumena ca \|*  
*supriyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sāṃprataṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О Hari, I offer you the fragrant flowers together with saffron which are liked by all the gods.

## \|\| 8.33 \|\|

*gṛhyatāṃ svastikoktaṃ ca miṣṭadravyasamanvitam \|*  
*supakvaphalasaṃyuktaṃ naivedyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О Hari, I offer you the sweets and the naivedya together with the beautiful ripe fruits.

## \|\| 8.34 \|\|

*laḍḍukaṃ modakaṃ caiva sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ guḍaṃ madhu \|*  
*navoddhṛtaṃ dadhi takraṃ naivedyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О Hari, I offer you the sweet balls, modakas, and ghee, milk raw-sugar (guda), honey, fresh curd and butter milk as naivedya.

## \|\| 8.35 \|\|

*śītalaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ kṣīrasvādusupakvakam \|*  
*tāṃbūlaṃ bhogasāraṃ ca karpūrādisamanvitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О great lord, I offer you the tasteful milk in which the sugar has been mixed and is quite cold. I also offer the betel with devotion which contains camphor and other fragrant materials.

## \|\| 8.36 \|\|

*bhaktyā niveditamidaṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara \|*  
*candanāguru kastūrīkuṃkumadravasaṃyutam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. О Parameshvara, you kindly accept the paste consisting of sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl, saffron for apparition on the body.

## \|\| 8.37 \|\|

*abīracūrṇaṃ ruciraṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara \|*  
*tarubhedarasotkarṣo gaṃdhayukto'gninā saha \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. O Hari, I offer the gum which has been extracted from various types of trees mixed with many fragrant material and is liked by all the gods as incense.

## \|\| 8.38 \|\|

*supriyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|*  
*ghorāṃdhakāranāśaikahetureva śubhāvahaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. I offer you the lamp which is the form of light and removes all the darkness from the world you kindly accept it.

## \|\| 8.39 \|\|

*supradīpo dīptikaro dīpo'yaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|*  
*pavitraṃ nirmalaṃ toyaṃ karpūrādisamāyutam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О Hari, you accept this water for drinking which is quite pure, spotless, sanctified by camphor and happens to be the life of all the creatures. You kindly accept it.

## \|\| 8.40-41 \|\|

*jīvanaṃ sarvabījānāṃ pānārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare \|*  
*nānāpuṣpasamāyuktaṃ grathitaṃ sūkṣmataṃtunā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śarīrabhūṣaṇavaraṃ mālyaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām \|*  
*dattvā deyāni dravyāṇi pūjopayogitāni ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. You kindly accept this garland of flowers which has been made from various flowers and has been sewed in the fine cord and serves as an ornament over the body. All other material be offered and all the materials collected for the lord should for adoration should also be offered to him.

## \|\| 8.42 \|\|

*vratasthānasthitaṃ dravyaṃ haraye deyameva ca \|*  
*phalāni tarubījāni svādūni suṃdarāṇi ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. О best of the lords, you kindly accept these fruits which are quite tasteful, beautiful and increase the progeny.

## \|\| 8.43 \|\|

*vaṃśavṛddhikarāṇyeva gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara \|*  
*āvāhitāṃśca devāṃśca pratyekaṃ pūjayedvratī \|\| 43 \|\|*
