43\. Similarly all the gods who are invoked should also be adored. All the gods should be adored with devotion and thereafter three hand-cups filled with flower should be offered.

## \|\| 8.44-46 \|\|

*tānpūjya bhaktibhāvena dadyātpuṣpāṃjalitrayam \|*  
*sunaṃdanaṃdakumudāngopāngopīśca rādhikām \|\| 44 \|\|*

*gaṇeśaṃ kārttikeyaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ ca śivaṃ śivām \|*  
*lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva dikpālāṃśca grahāṃstathā \|\| 45 \|\|*

*śeṣaṃ sudarśanaṃ caiva pārṣadapravarāṃstathā \|*  
*sampūjya sarvadevāṃśca praṇamya daṃḍavadbhuvi \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyaśca naivedyaṃ dattvā dadyācca dakṣiṇām \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. Thereafter the cowherds named Sunanda, Nanda, Kumuda and the cowherdesses named Radhika should also be adored together with Ganesha, Karttikeya, Brahma, Shiva, Parvati, Laks ml, Sarasvati, Dikpalas, nine planet and Shesha, Sudarsana and the attendants of the gods. One should offer reverence to them prostrating before them. Thereafter, Brahmana should be served with naivedya and daksina.

## \|\| 8.47 \|\|

*kathāṃ ca janmādhyāyoktāṃ śṛṇuyādbhakti bhāvataḥ \|*  
*tadā kuśāsane sthitvā kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vratī \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Thereafter one should listen to the story narrated in the chapter of birth. On that very night, the devotee should remain seated on the seat of kusha remaining awake for the night.

## \|\| 8.48 \|\|

*prabhāte cāhnikaṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya śrīhariṃ mudā \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca kārayeddharikīrtanam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Early in the morning getting free from the daily routine, one should adore the lord with a pleasant mind and serve food to the Brahmanas reciting the name of Hari.

## \|\| 8.49-50 \|\|

*. nārada uvāca \|*  
*vratakālavyavasthāṃ ca vedoktāṃ sarvasaṃmatām \|*  
*vedārthaṃ ca samālocya saṃhitāṃ ca purātanīm \|\| 49 \|\|*

*upavāse jāgaraṇe vrate kiṃ vā phalaṃ mune \|*  
*kiṃ vā pāpaṃ tatra bhuktvā vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Narada said – О sage, you are the best among those well versed in the Vedas. You kindly let me know the merit one achieves after performing the vrata as prescribed in the Vedas, remaining awake and by serving food to the Brahmanas. You kindly tell me the same.

## \|\| 8.51 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*aṣṭamī karkṣasaṃyuktā rātryarthe yadi dṛśyate \|*  
*sa eva mukhyakālaśca tatra jātaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Narayana said – At the dead of night, the eighth day of the moon, in the Rohini constellation is considered to be the time for the birth of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 8.52-53 \|\|

*jayaṃ puṇyaṃ ca kurute jayaṃtī tena saṃsmṛtā \|*  
*tatropoṣya vrataṃ kṛtvā kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*sarvāpavādaḥ kālo'yaṃ pradhānaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ \|*  
*iti vedavidāṃ vāṇī cetyuktā vedhasā purā \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. The one who performs vrata at that time, becomes victorious besides achieving merit. That is why it has been termed as Jayanti also, the intellectual should perform vrata keeping himself awake. This is the time without controversy and is agreed to by all. This is prescribed by those well versed in the Vedas. In the earlier times, it was so proclaimed by Brahma.

## \|\| 8.54 \|\|

*tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yaścopoṣya vrataṃ caret \|*  
*koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The one who keeps himself awake performing the vrata, he is relieved of all the sins earned by him during crores of births and achieves salvation. There is no doubt it.

## \|\| 8.55 \|\|

*varjanīyā prayatnena saptamīsahitāṣṭamī \|*  
*sā sarkṣāpi na kartavyā saptamīsahitāṣṭamī \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. When Saptami and Astaml are combined one should not perform the vrata during that time even when the Rohini constellation is there. Because lord Krishna the son of Devaki appeared in the unimpaired Rohini constellation.

## \|\| 8.56-58 \|\|

*aviddhāyāṃ kaṛkṣāyāṃ jāto devakinaṃdanaḥ \|*  
*vedavedāṃgaguptetiviśiṣṭaṃ maṃgalakṣaṇe \|\| 56 \|\|*

*vyatīte rohiṇīṛkṣe vratī kuryācca pāraṇām \|*  
*tithyaṃte ca hariṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā devārcanaṃ vratī \|\| 57 \|\|*

*pāraṇaṃ pāvanaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*upavāsāṃgabhūtaṃ ca phaladaṃ siddhikāraṇam \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. This particular knowledge is not available in the Vedas and the post-Vedic literature in spite of its being quite of welfare nature and is quite secret. One should break the fast after the Rohini constellation is over at the end of the Astaml-tithi. One should adore the lord with devotion and thereafter should break the fast which removes all the sins of the humans and is the part of the vrata and fasting it results in welfare and provides success.

## \|\| 8.59 \|\|

*sarveṣvevopavāseṣu divā pāraṇamiṣyate \|*  
*anyathā phalahāniḥ syātkṛte dhāraṇapāraṇe \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. In all types of fasting, one should end the fast during the day alone because if one does it otherwise, the merit of the vrata is lost.

## \|\| 8.60 \|\|

*na rātrau pāraṇaṃ kuryādṛte vai rohiṇīvratāt \|*  
*niśāyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryādvarjayitvā mahāniśām \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Except the Rohini vrata, the fast should not be broken during the night, even if someone breaks the fast in the night but he should never do it on Mahanisa (moonless night).

## \|\| 8.61 \|\|

*pūrvāhṇe pāraṇaṃ śastaṃ kṛtvā viprasurārcanam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ saṃmataṃ kuryādṛte vai rohiṇī vratam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. After adoring the Brahmanas and the gods, one should break the fast in the forenoon. The fast should be broken after consulting all except the vrata of Rohini.

## \|\| 8.62 \|\|

*budhasomasamāyuktā jayaṃtī yadi labhyate \|*  
*na kuryādgarbhavāsaṃ ca tatra kṛtvā vrataṃ vratī \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. When the Jayanti falls on Monday or Wednesday and if one performs vrata on that day he was never to be born again.

## \|\| 8.63-67 \|\|

*udaye cāṣṭamī kiṃcinnavamī sakalā yadi \|*  
*bhavedbudheṃdusaṃyuktā prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutā \|\| 63 \|\|*

*apivarṣaśatenāpi labhyate vā na labhyate \|*  
*vrataṃ tatra vratī kuryātpuṃsāṃ koṭiṃ samuddharet \|\| 64 \|\|*

*nṛṇāṃ vinā vratenāpi bhaktānāṃ hīnasaṃpadām \|*  
*kṛtenaivopavāsena prīto bhavati mādhavaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*bhaktyā nānopacāreṇa rātrau jāgaraṇena ca \|*  
*phalaṃ dadāti daityārirjayantīvratasaṃbhavam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*vittaśāṭhyamakurvāṇaḥ samyakphalamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*kurvāṇo vittaśāṭhyaṃ ca labhate sadṛśaṃ phalam \|\| 67 \|\|*

63-67. When Astaml is there at the time of day break and during rest of the period, the Navamt-tithis is there and Rohini Nakstra also is combined with Monday of Wednesday, such a type of combination is achieved after hundreds of years but the one who performs vrata during that period crores of his generations are redeemed. Such of the people who are poor can achieve all the merits by observing the fast alone and the lord get pleased with them. One should adore the lord with a mind filled with devotion remaining awake during the night and the lord bestows the reward of performing Jayantl-vrata to them. At that point of time, whosoever gives away in charity-without getting miser, he gets the best of the reward. The one who behaves miserly he achieves the reward only in fraction.

## \|\| 8.68 \|\|

*aṣṭamyāmatha rohiṇyāṃ na kuryātpāraṇaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*hanyātpurākṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ copavāsārjitaṃ phalam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. If an intellectual is unable to break the fast on the day of Astaml in Rohini constellation, he loses the merit of the fasting performed by him even in earlier births.

## \|\| 8.69 \|\|

*tithiraṣṭaguṇaṃ haṃti nakṣatraṃ ca caturguṇam \|*  
*tasmātprayatnataḥ kuryāttithibhāṃte ca pāraṇam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. The tithis destroy the merit to eight times and the constellation deprive a person of the merit four times. Therefore one should try to end the fast by the close of the tithis or the constellation.

## \|\| 8.70 \|\|

*mahāniśāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ tithibhāṃtaṃ yadā bhavet \|*  
*tṛtīye'hni muniśreṣṭha pāraṇaṃ kurute budhaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. О best of the sage, in the case the tithis end at Mahanisa beside the constellation, in that case the intellectual should break the fast on the third day.

## \|\| 8.71 \|\|

*ṣaṇmuhūrte vyatīte tu rātrāveva mahāniśā \|*  
*labhate brahmahatyāṃ ca tatra bhuktvā ca nārada \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. О Narada, after the passing of six muhUrtas, the time of Mahanisd arrives in the night. The one who takes food during that period earns the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 8.72 \|\|

*gomāṃsaviṇmūtrasamaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam \|*  
*puṃsāmabhakṣyaṃ śuddhānāmodanasya ca kā kathā \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The betel, fruits and water offered by him turn into the flesh of cow, refuse and the urine. At that point of time even the best of the food for the humans becomes unfit for consumption, then what to speak of the boiled rice.

## \|\| 8.73-74 \|\|

*triyāmāṃ rajanī prāhustyaktvādya ca catuṣṭayam \|*  
*nāḍīnāṃ tadubhe sandhye divasādyaṃtasaṃjñite \|\| 73 \|\|*

*janmāṣṭamyāṃ ca śuddhāyāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ vratam \|*  
*śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 74\|\|*

73-74. Leaving aside the four dandas of the beginning and the end, the period of night in between them is called Triyama, before and end of the night there are two sandhyas (day break and evening). Out of these, one is called the day break and the other the evening. By performing the auspicious Janmastml-vrata and remaining awake, a person is relieved of the sin of a hundred births. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 8.75-76 \|\|

*janmāṣṭamyāṃ ca śuddhāyāmupoṣya kevalaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya vrataṃ jāgaraṇaṃ vinā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*yadbālye yacca kaumāre yauvane yacca vārdhake \|*  
*saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. At the time of fasting during the auspicious Janmastaml, one achieves the merit of performing the Asvamedha sacrifice. Without remaining awake and by performing only the vrata, one is relieved of the sins performed by him during childhood, teen-age, young age, and old age. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 8.77-84 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇajanmadivase yaśca bhuktaṃ narādhamaḥ \|*  
*sa bhavenmātṛgāmī ca brahmahatyāśataṃ labhet \|\| 77 \|\|*

*koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam \|*  
*anarhaścāśuciḥ śaśvaddaive pitrye ca karmaṇi \|\| 78 \|\|*

*ante vasetkālasūtre yāvaccaṃdradivākarau \|*  
*kṛmibhiḥ śūlatulyaiśca tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiśca bhakṣitaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*pāpī tataḥ samutthāya bhārate janma cellabhet \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ ca kṛmirbhavet \|\| 80 \|\|*

*gṛdhrakoṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ \|*  
*śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni sṛgālaḥ sapta janma ca \|\| 81 \|\|*

*saptajanmasu sarpaśca kākaśca saptajanmasu \|*  
*tato bhavennaro mūko galatkuṣṭhī sadāturaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*tato bhavetpaśughnaśca vyālagrāhī tato bhavet \|*  
*tadaṃte ca bhaveddasyurdharmahīnaśca gṛdhrakaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*tato bhevatsa rajakastailakārastato bhavet \|*  
*tato bhaveddevalako brāhmaṇaśca sadā'śuciḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

77-84. Those who consume food during the birthday of Krishna earn the sin of enjoying the company of their mothers and besides earning the sin of Brahmahatya. Besides destroying the merits of crores of their earlier births, they are considered to be unfit for performing religious ceremony for the gods and the manes and have to remain in the kdlasUtra hell, till the sun and the moon last. The insect with sharp teeth bite them daily in hell. Thereafter getting redeemed they are reborn in the land of Bharata and serve as a cowherds for sixty thousands crores of years, a pig for hundred births, wild animal for hundred births, a jackal for seven births, a snake for seven births, a crow for seven births, and a deaf and dumb person suffering from leprosy. He always remains anxious thereafter. He is there born as an animal, a wild animal, a snake charmer, a thief, a vulture, a washerman and blacksmith and thereafter he is born as a temple priest.

## \|\| 8.85 \|\|

*upavāsāsamarthaścedekaṃ vipraṃ ca bhojayet \|*  
*tāvaddhanāni vā dadyādyadbhuktaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. If anyone is unable to perform the fasting, one should serve food to a Brahmana, besides giving him the money which should suffice for him to take food twice.

## \|\| 8.86 \|\|

*sahasrasaṃmitāṃ devīṃ japedvā prāṇasaṃyamān \|*  
*kuryāddvādaśasaṃkhyākānyathārthaṃ tadvrate naraḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Thereafter, he should recite the Gayatri-mantra a thousand times performing Pranayama, in this vrata one should recite the mantra twelve thousand times.

## \|\| 8.87 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa śrutaṃ yaddharmavaktrataḥ \|*  
*vratopavāsapūjānāṃ vidhānamakṛte ca yat \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. I had heard this from the mouth of Dharma and the same has been narrated by me to you and I have also told you the fault one earns for not observing the same.

## Chapter 9

## \|\| 9.1-2 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*saṃsthāpya gokule kṛṣṇaṃ yaśodāmaṃdiraṃ vasuḥ \|*  
*jagāma svagṛhaṃ nandaḥ kiṃ cakāra mahāṃ prabhuḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kiñcakāra haristatra kativarṣasthitiḥ prabhoḥ \|*  
*bālakrīḍanakaṃ tasya varṇaya kramaśo mune \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narada said – Vasudeva placed Krishna in the palace of Yashoda and returned to his abode. Thereafter, how were the festivities for the birth of Krishna performed and for how long? You kindly narrate to me the story about his childhood.

## \|\| 9.3 \|\|

*purā kṛtā yā pratijñā goloke rādhayā saha \|*  
*tatkṛtaṃ kena vidhinā pratijñāpālanaṃ hareḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. In the Goloka the lord had promised to Radha but then how could the lord fulfil that promise?

## \|\| 9.4 \|\|

*kīdṛgvṛndāvanaṃ nāma maṇḍalaṃ kiṃvidhaṃ vada \|*  
*rāsakrīḍāṃ jalakrīḍāṃ saṃvyasya varṇaya prabho \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O lord, the account of Vrindavana and the sight of the divine dance there, you kindly describe in detail, the Rasalila and the water-sports.

## \|\| 9.5-7 \|\|

*nandastapaḥ kiñcakāra yaśodā cātha rohiṇī \|*  
*hareḥ pūrvaṃ ca halinaḥ kutra janma babhūva ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

*pīyūṣakhaṃḍamākhyānamapūrvaṃ śrīhareḥ smṛtam \|*  
*viśeṣataḥ kavimukhānnavyaṃ nūnaṃ pade pade \|\| 6 \|\|*

*svarāsamaṇḍalakrīḍāṃ varṇaya svayameva ca \|*  
*parokṣavarṇanātkāvyaṃ praśastaṃ navyavarṇanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. What type of tapas had Nanda, Yashoda and Rohini performed? Where was Balabhadra born earlier to his becoming the brother of the lord Krishna. The divine story of Hari has been compared with the block of nectar. Particularly by listening to the story of lord Hari from the mouth of the poet, one is infested with devotion and it always appeals as new whenever one listens to it. Therefore, you kindly describe the divine dance performed by Krishna from your own mouth in the poetic narrations, one listen to the performance indirectly but wherever one listens to the experience, ones witnesses with his own eyes, it is considered to be the best.

## \|\| 9.8 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇāṃśo bhavānsākṣādyogīṃdrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|*  
*yo yasyāṃśaḥ sa ca janastasyaiva sukhataḥ sukhī \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Because of your being the arhsa of lord Krishna you happen to be the teacher of the yogis. The one who belongs to a particular arhsa, he remains happy with the same.

## \|\| 9.9 \|\|

*tvayaiva varṇitau pādau vilīnau tu yuvāṃ hareḥ \|*  
*sākṣādgolokanāthāṃśastvameva tatsamo mahān \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. You are described about the lotus-like feet of lord in which both of you had merged. Therefore you happen to be the clean arhsa of the lord of Goloka and yourself also as great he is.

## \|\| 9.10 \|\|

*. nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*brahmeśaśeṣavighneśāḥ kūrmo dharmo'hameva ca \|*  
*naraśca kārttikeyaśca śrīkṛṣṇāṃśā vayaṃ nava \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Narayana said – Brahma, Shiva, Shesha, Ganesha, Ktlrma, Dharma, myself, the Nara and Karttikeya happen to be the nine gods who emerged from the amsha of Krishna.

## \|\| 9.11 \|\|

*aho golokanāthasya mahimā kena varṇyate \|*  
*yaṃ svayaṃ no vijānīmo na vedāḥ kiṃ vipaścitaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Alas, who can describe the glory of the lord of Goloka. I am myself not quite aware of him nor do the Vedas know about him then, what to say of the other intellectuals?

## \|\| 9.12 \|\|

*sūkaro vāmanaḥ kalkirbauddhaḥ kapilamīnakau \|*  
*ete cāṃśāḥ kalāścānye saṃtyeva katidhā mune \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О sage, Varaha, Vamana, Kalki, Bauddha, Kapila and Matsya also were the amsa of the lord. Besides them, there are various other incarnations who happen to be the amsa of Krishna.

## \|\| 9.13-14 \|\|

*kūrmo nṛsiṃho rāmaśca śvetadvīpavirāḍvibhuḥ \|*  
*paripūrṇatamaḥ kṛṣṇo vaikuṇṭhe gokule svayam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vaikuṇṭhe kamalākāṃto rūpabhedāccaturbhujaḥ \|*  
*goloke gokule rādhākāṃto'yaṃ dvibhujaḥ svayam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. KGrma, Nrsimha, Rama and Virat of Shveta-dvipa are the amsa of lord Vishnu. Lord Krishna happen to be the great soul. He himself dwells in the Vaikuntha as well as the Goloka. In Vaikunt ha, he is known to be the husband of Kamala having four arms and in Goloka he appears in the form of Krishna having two arms only and is known as the husband of Radha.

## \|\| 9.15 \|\|

*asyaiva tejo nityaṃ ca citte kurvaṃti yoginaḥ \|*  
*bhaktāḥ pādāmbujaṃ tejaḥ kutastejasvinaṃ vinā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. All the yogis always meditate upon the same tejas. There could be no tejas without a Tejasvi.

## \|\| 9.16-17 \|\|

*śṛṇu vipra varṇayāmi yaśodānandayostapaḥ \|*  
*rohiṇyāśca yato hetordadṛśuste harermukham \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vasūnāṃ pravaro nando nāmnā droṇastapodhanaḥ \|*  
*tasya patnī dharā sādhvī yaśodā sā tapasvinī \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. О Brahmana, now I am going to highlight about the tapas of Yashoda, Nanda and Rohini as a result of which they could see the face of the lord (in the form of a son.) you listen to me. Nanda happened to be Drona who was the best of the Vasus and his chaste wife known as Dhara re-appeared on earth as Yashoda.

## \|\| 9.18-20 \|\|

*rohiṇī sarpamātā ca kadrūśca sarpakāriṇī \|*  
*eteṣāṃ janmacaritaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 18 \|\|*

*ekadā ca dharā droṇau parvate gandhamādane \|*  
*puṇyade bhārate varṣe gautamāśramasannidhau \|\| 19 \|\|*

*cakratuśca tapastatra varṣāṇāmayutaṃ mune \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇadarśanārthaṃ ca nirjane suprabhātaṭe \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. Rohini happened to be the mother of the serpents in earlier birth. Now I am going to narrate the life stories of all of them, which you please listen. О sage, once the chaste Dhara and Drona performed tapas over the Gandhamadana mountain in the ashrama of Gautama for ten thousand years. They continued tapas on the bank of the Suprabha river in a secluded place for achieving lord Krishna.

## \|\| 9.21 \|\|

*na dadarśa hariṃ droṇo dharā caiva tapasvinī \|*  
*kṛtvāgnikuṃḍaṃ vairāgyātpraveṣṭuṃ samupasthitau \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Thereafter both Drona and Dhara finding themselves unable to achieve audience, became unattached and prepared a fire alter to bum themselves in the same.

## \|\| 9.22-23 \|\|

*tau martukāmau dṛṣṭvā ca vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī \|*  
*drakṣyathaḥ śrīhariṃ pṛthvyāṃ gokule putrarūpiṇam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*janmāṃtare vasuśreṣṭha durdarśaṃ yogināṃ vibhum \|*  
*dhyānāsādhyaṃ ca viduṣāṃ brahmādīnāṃ ca vaṃditam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Finding them ready to bum themselves there was a divine voice from the sky saying. "O best of Vasus, you will have an audience with lord Krishna on earth in Gokula in the form of a son. Even the yogis are unable to have a look at him. He is beyond the comprehension of most of the intellectuals and is adored by Brahma even.".

## \|\| 9.24 \|\|

*śrutvaivaṃ taddharādroṇau jagmatuḥ svālayaṃ sukhāt \|*  
*labdhvā tu bhārate janma dṛṣṭaṃ tābhyāṃ harermukham \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. On hearing this both Dhara and Drona retreated to their respective abodes and in the next birth they had the lord as their son.

## \|\| 9.25 \|\|

*yaśodānaṃdayorevaṃ kathitaṃ caritaṃ tava \|*  
*sugopyaṃ tridaśānāṃ ca rohiṇīcaritaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thus the stories of Nanda and Yashoda have been narrated by me which are quite secret and beyond the gods. Now I am going to narrate the story of Rohini which you please listen.

## \|\| 9.26-27 \|\|

*ekadā devamātā ca puṣpotsavadine satī \|*  
*vijñāpanaṃ caradvārā cakāra kaśyapaṃ mune \|\| 26 \|\|*

*susnātā suṃdarī devī ratnālaṃkāra bhūṣitā \|*  
*cakāra veṣaṃ vividhaṃ dadarśa darpaṇe mukham \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. О sage, once during the menstrual period Aditi the mother of gods sent a message to Kashyapa, she clad herself in beautiful garments and adorned herself with best of gems-studded ornaments after taking bath. Then looking at the mirror, she decorated herself variously.

## \|\| 9.28-32 \|\|

*kastūrībiṃdunā sārddhaṃ siṃdūrabiṃdusaṃyutam \|*  
*ratnakuṃḍalaśobhāḍhyaṃ patrābharaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*gajamauktikasaṃyuktaṃ nāsāgraṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*vakrabhrūbhaṃginā yuktaṃ vicitrakajjalojjvalam \|*  
*pakvadāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktivirājitam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*pakvabiṃbādharauṣṭhaṃ ca sasmitaṃ suṃdaraṃ sadā \|*  
*atīva kamanīyaṃ ca munīṃdracittamohanam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*evaṃbhūtaṃ mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā suṃdarī svagṛhe sthitā \|*  
*paśyaṃtī patimārgaṃ ca kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā \|\| 32 \|\|*

28-32. Besides a spot of kasturl, she also adorned her forehead with the vermilion, her ears with gems-studded kundalas decorated herself variously and also wore the pearl in her nose. Her face resembled the full moon of winter season and her eyes resembled the lotus flower of winter season. She had curved eye-brows and collyrium was applied to her eyes. She had beautiful teeth resembling the seeds of pomegranate. Her face was quite illumining. Her lips resembled the ripe fruit of wood apple and with her serene smile, she could attract the minds of sages. Looking at her face in the mirror she was lodged in her abode and suffering from passion started anxiously looking towards the path from which her husband was to arrive.

## \|\| 9.33 \|\|

*śuśrāva vārtāmaditiḥ kaśyapaṃ kadrusaṃyutam \|*  
*ratnasārasamāraṃbhe tasyā vakṣasthale sthitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. In the meantime she came to know that Kashyapa was enjoying life with KadrQ placing his head on her breasts.

## \|\| 9.34-36 \|\|

*śrutvā cukopa sādhvī sā hatāśā ratikātarā \|*  
*na śaśāpa patiṃ premṇā śaśāpa sarpamātaram \|\| 34 \|\|*

*na devālayayogyā sā dharmiṣṭhā dharmanāśinī \|*  
*dūraṃ gacchatu svarlokādātmayoniṃ ca mānavīm \|\| 35 \|\|*

*śrutvaivaṃ sā caradvārā śaśāpa devamātaram \|*  
*sā caivaṃ mānavīṃ yoniṃ yātu martye jarāyutām \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. Thereafter she felt disgusted but in spite of her getting infested with passion, she did not pronounced a curse on her husband but she pronounced a curse of KadrQ. "This lady well-versed in the Dharma has not proved herself worthy of a temple and had indulged herself in the destruction of dharma, therefore, getting deprived of the heaven she would go to the earth and be born in the human race.” On hearing these words from the mouth of messengers KadrQ also pronounced a curse on Aditi the mother of the gods thus, "she also would be born on earth and suffer from old age in the human race."

## \|\| 9.37-38 \|\|

*kaśyapo bodhayāmāsa kadruṃ ca sarpamātaram \|*  
*kāle yāsyasi martyaṃ ca mayā saha śucismite \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tyaja bhītiṃ labha sukhaṃ drakṣyasi śrīharermukham \|*  
*evamuktvā kaśyapaśca jagāma cāditergṛham \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Thereafter Kashyapa tried to convince KadrQ, the mother of the serpents, "O lady with a serene smile, at the time you move on to the earth I shall also accompany you. Therefore shedding all the fears, you be happy." Because on earth, you will be able to witness the lord in the form of your son. Thus speaking Kashyapa went to the abode of Aditi.

## \|\| 9.39 \|\|

*vāṃchāṃ pūrṇāṃ ca tasyāśca cakāra bhagavānvibhuḥ \|*  
*ṛtau tatra maheṃdraśca babhūva ca surarṣabhaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Reaching there Kashyapa fulfilled the desire of Aditi as a result of which Mahendra was born out of her womb.

## \|\| 9.40 \|\|

*aditirdevakī caiva sarpamātā ca rohiṇī \|*  
*kaśyapo vasudevaśca śrīkṛṣṇajanako mahān \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The same Aditi appeared as Devaki on earth and KadrQ the mother of the serpents was known as Rohini. Kashyapa happened to be Vasudeva the father of Krishna.

## \|\| 9.41-42 \|\|

*rahasyaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca sarvaṃ nigaditaṃ mune \|*  
*adhunā baladevasya janmākhyānaṃ mune śṛṇu \|\| 41 \|\|*

*anaṃtasyāprameyasya sahasraśirasaḥ prabhoḥ \|*  
*rohiṇī vasudevasya bhāryāratnaṃ ca preyasī \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. O sage, I have revealed the entire secret of you. I am now going to narrate the story of the birth of Baladeva, which you please listen. He was Ananta, imperishable having thousands of snake-hoods and the incarnation of the lord. Rohini happened to the beloved of Vasudeva.

## \|\| 9.43 \|\|

*jagāma gokulaṃ sādhvī vasudevājñayā mune \|*  
*saṃkarṣaṇasya rakṣārthaṃ kaṃsabhītā palāyitā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О sage, with the permission of Vasudeva for the protection of Samkarsana from Karhsa, she went to Gokula.

## \|\| 9.44 \|\|

*devakyāḥ saptamaṃ garbhaṃ māyā kṛṣṇājñayā tadā \|*  
*rohiṇyā jaṭhare tatra sthāpayāmāsa gokule \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. At that point of ime at the command of lord Krishna, Yogamaya, extracted the foetus of Nanda from the womb of Devaki and transplanted it into the womb of Rohini.

## \|\| 9.45-46 \|\|

*saṃsthāpya ca tadā garbhaṃ kailāsaṃ sā jagāma ha \|*  
*dināṃtare katipaye rohiṇī naṃdamaṃdire \|\| 45 \|\|*

*suṣāva putraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ taptaraupyābhamīśvaram \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. After doing so the goddess went to Kailasa. With the passage of time Rohini gave birth to a son who happened to be the amsha of Krishna. He had the complexion of the molten silver and quite glorious. The lord himself had a serene smile on the face and possessed the divine lustre.

## \|\| 9.47 \|\|

*tasyaiva janmamātreṇa devā mumudire tadā \|*  
*svarge duṃdubhayo nedurānakā murajādayaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. With the birth of Baladeva, all the gods were delighted and big drums were beaten in the heaven besides other musical instrument were also played upon there.

## \|\| 9.48 \|\|

*jayaśabdaṃ śaṃkhaśabdaṃ cakrurdevā mudānvitāḥ \|*  
*naṃdo hṛṣṭo brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dadau \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Getting immensely pleased the gods shouted the slogan of victory, blowing on the conches at the same time. Nanda on the other hand getting delighted distributed enormous riches to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 9.49 \|\|

*ciccheda nāḍīṃ dhātrī ca snāpayāmāsa bālakam \|*  
*jayaśabdaṃ jagurgopyaḥ sarvābha raṇabhūṣitāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. With the severing of the cord by the mid-wife, the child was bathed, the cowherdesses adorned with all the ornaments started shouting the slogan of victory.

## \|\| 9.50-52 \|\|

*paraputrotsavaṃ naṃdaścakāra paramādarāt \|*  
*tadā yaśodā gopībhyo brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā \|\| 50 \|\|*

*dhanāni nānāvastūni tailaṃ siṃdūrameva ca \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa yaśodānaṃdayostapaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*janmākhyānaṃ ca halino rohiṇīcaritaṃ tathā \|*  
*adhunā te vāṃchanīyaṃ naṃdaputrotsavaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. Nanda gracefully celebrated the occasion of the birth of a son. Thereafter getting pleased, Yashoda distributed riches to the cowherdesses as well as the Brahmanas besides other articles like oil, vermilion etc. О son, I have thus narrated to you the story about the tapas of Nanda and Yashoda besides the birth of Balabhadra, and the story of Rohini. Now I am going to narrate to you about the festivities following the birth of Krishna in the house of Nanda. You listen it.

## \|\| 9.53-55 \|\|

*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham \|*  
*maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇacaritaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jīvanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*sarvāśubhavināśaṃ ca bhaktidāsyapradaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vasudevaśca saṃsthāpya naṃdamaṃdire \|\| 54 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā bālikāṃ hṛṣṭo jagāma nijamaṃdiram \|*  
*kathitaṃ caritaṃ tasyāḥ śrutaṃ saṃmukhato mune \|\| 55 \|\|*

53-55. The hearing of life-stories of Krishna bestows pleasure, salvation, knowledge of sattvas, removes the cycle of birth and death besides old age. They happen to be the life of Vaishnavas, remover of all the misfortunes and bestows the devotion of the lord. О sage, Vasudeva placing Krishna in the abode of Nanda and carrying the girl-child in her place, he returned to his abode with pleasure. I have recited the story in detail earlier and also about the girl-child.

## \|\| 9.56-57 \|\|

*adhunā gokule kṛṣṇacaritaṃ śṛṇu maṃgalam \|*  
*vasudeve gṛhaṃ yāte yaśodā naṃda eva ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

*maṃgale sūtikāgāre jayāgāre jayānvite \|*  
*dadarśa putraṃ bhūmisthaṃ navīnanīradaprabham \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. Presently you listen to the story of Krishna while, he stayed in Gokula. After the departure of Vasudeva, Nanda and Yashoda found in the pleasant labour-room which happened to be the home of victory, the child Krishna possessing the dark complexion placed on the ground.

## \|\| 9.58-59 \|\|

*atīva suṃdaraṃ nagnaṃ paśyaṃtaṃ gṛhaśekharam \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaṃ nīleṃdīvaralocanam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*rudaṃtaṃ ca hasaṃtaṃ c veṇusaṃsaktavigraham \|*  
*hastadvayaṃ suvinyastaṃ premavaṃtaṃ padāṃbujam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. He was quite beautiful and without robes and was looking at the kalasha placed at the top of the house. The lustre of his face put to shame, the lustre of the moon and both his eyes were life the blue lotus flower. Some times he cried and some times he laughed, the particles of dust were found over his limbs. Both his hand were placed over the ground and both his lotus-like feet looked like the mass of love.

## \|\| 9.60-62 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā naṃdaḥ striyā sārddhaṃ hariṃ hṛṣṭo babhūva ha \|*  
*dhātrī taṃ snāpayāmāsa śītatoyena bālakam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*ciccheda nāḍīṃ bālasya harṣādgopyo jayaṃ daduḥ \|*  
*ājagmurgopikāḥ sarvā bṛhacchroṇyaścalatkucāḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*bālikāśca vayasyaśca viprapatnyāśca sūtikām \|*  
*āśiṣaṃ yuyujuḥ sarvā dadṛśurbālakaṃ mudā \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. Looking at the lord, Nanda felt delighted with his wife. Thereafter, the mid-wife bathed the son with the warm water, the cord of the child was severed the delightful cowherdesses started shouting the slogans of victory. They had stiff pelvic region, moving breasts and all the cowherdesses assembled there. All the girls, the female friends and the wives of Brahmanas reached the labour-room and started looking at the child. They delightfully started blessing him.

## \|\| 9.63-65 \|\|

*kroḍe cakruḥ praśaṃsaṃtya ūṣustatra ca kāścana \|*  
*naṃdaḥ sacailaḥ snātaśca dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|\| 63 \|\|*

*pāraṃparyavidhiṃ tatra cakāra hṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*vādyāni vādayāmāsa baṃdibhyaśca dadau dhanam \|*  
*tato naṃdaśca sānaṃdaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dhanam \|\| 65 \|\|*

63-65. Some of the ladies earned the child in their lap and started kissing him. Many of the cowherdesses remained there. Nanda then took his bath and was clad in new garments and performed all the traditional rites with a pleasant mind, fed the Brahmanas, the scriptures of welfare were recited, the musical instrument were played upon and the beggars were distributed the riches. Thereafter Nanda with a delightful mind gave away riches in charity to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 9.66-69 \|\|

*sadratnāni pravālāni hīrakāṇi ca sādaram \|*  
*tilānāṃ parvatānsapta suvarṇaśatakaṃ mune \|\| 66 \|\|*

*raupyaṃ dhānyācalaṃ vastraṃ gosahasraṃ manoharam \|*  
*dadhi dugdhaṃ śarkarāṃ ca navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu \|\| 67 \|\|*

*miṣṭānnaṃ sallaḍḍukaughaṃ svādūni modakāni ca \|*  
*bhūmiṃ ca sarvasasyāḍhyāṃ vāyuvegāṃsturaṃgamān \|\| 68 \|\|*

*tāṃbūlāni ca tailāni dattvā hṛṣṭo babhūva ha \|*  
*rakṣituṃ sūtikāgāraṃ yojayāmāsa brāhmaṇān \|\| 69 \|\|*

66-69. О sage, he also distributed several precious gems besides the diamonds and coral. He gave away in charity seven mountain like heaps of sheshamum, hundred heaps of gold, mountains of paddy besides cloth a thousand of beautiful cows, curd, milk, sugar, batter, ghee, honey, sweets, best of sweet balls, tasteful modakas, irrigated land, steed which could move with the speed of wind betel and the oil. He also deputed Brahmanas for the protection of the labour-room.

## \|\| 9.70 \|\|

*tatra maṃtrajñamanujānsthavirāngopikāgaṇān \|*  
*vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa harernāmaikamaṃgalam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Thereafter deputing the Brahmanas well-versed in the mantras and the old cowherdesses, he arranged for the recitation of the name of Hari which bestows welfare.

## \|\| 9.71-72 \|\|

*bhaktyā ca brāhmaṇadvārā pūjayāmāsa devatāḥ \|*  
*gopālikāśca vṛddhāśca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

*ānandāḥ sumukhā gopāḥ pulakājitavigrahāḥ \|*  
*prahaṣṭamānasā brahmatnājamamaranandamandiram \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. He also arranged the adoration of the gods with deep devotion. Thereafter Nanda, arrived in the palace whose mind was filled with delight and be stood at the end, besides being blissful.

## \|\| 9.73 \|\|

*āśīrvādaṃ prayuñjānā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ \|*  
*jīghragāḥ puṣyahastāścāpyājagapurnandamandiram \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. The Brahmanas well-versed in the Vedas holding flowers in their hands started blessing the king who arrived there urgently.

## \|\| 9.74 \|\|

*nānāvidhāśca gaṇakā jyotiḥśāstraviśāradāḥ \|*  
*vāksiddhāḥ pustakakarā ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. The people well-versed in astrology, who had truthful speech, holding the books in their hands, also arrived in the abode of Nanda.

## \|\| 9.75 \|\|

*sasmitā viprapatnyaśca vayasyāḥ sthavirā varāḥ \|*  
*bālikā bālakayutā ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Many of the young maidens besides the old ladies, the wives of the Brahmanas, the boys and the girls also arrived there with smiling faces.

## \|\| 9.76 \|\|

*tebhyo'pi pradadau ratnaṃ dhanāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*varavastrāṇi raupyāṇi gosahasrāṇi sādaram \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Nanda on his part distributed several types of riches, gems, costumes and a thousand cows.

## \|\| 9.77-78 \|\|

*naṃdastebhyo namaskṛtya cakāra vinayaṃ mudā \|*  
*āśiṣaṃ yuyujuḥ sarve dadṛśurbālakaṃ param \|\| 77 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro babhūva vrajapuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*gaṇakaiḥ kārayāmāsa yadbhaviṣyaṃ śubhāśubham \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. Nanda expressed his humility while bowing in reverence to all of them, who blessed him variously looking at the newly born child. Thus Nanda the lord of vratas, collecting all the materials, celebrated the birth of the son and the astrologer highlighted the good and the bad effect of the planets according to the child horoscope.

## \|\| 9.79-81 \|\|

*evaṃ vavardha bālaśca śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī \|*  
*naṃdālaye halī caiva bhukta mātuḥ payodharam \|\| 79 \|\|*

*tadā ca rohiṇī hṛṣṭā tatra putrotsave mudā \|*  
*tailasiṃdūratāṃbūlaṃ dhanaṃ tābhyo dadau mune \|\| 80 \|\|*

*dattvāśiṣaśca śirasi tāśca te svālayaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*yaśodārohiṇīnaṃdāstasthurgehe mudānvitāḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

79-81. Thereafter, the child started growing in the abode of Nanda, like the moon of the bright fortnight. In the abode of Nanda, Balabhadra was sucking the breast of his mother, о sage, at that point of time, Rohim also participated in the festivities and also delightfully distributed oil, vermilion, betel and enormous riches to the ladies present there. All of them blessed the child over his head and went back to their respective abodes. Only Nanda, Yashoda, and Rohinl remained in the palace.

## Chapter 10

## \|\| 10.1-3 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*atha kaṃsaḥ sabhāmadhye svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ \|*  
*śuśrāva vācaṃ gagane sūnṛtāmaśarīriṇīm \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kiṃ karoṣi mahāmūḍha ciṃtāṃ svaśreyasaḥ kuru \|*  
*jātaḥ kālo dharaṇyāṃ te tiṣṭhopāye narādhipa \|\| 2 \|\|*

*naṃdāya tanayaṃ dattvā vasudevastavāṃtakam \|*  
*kanyāmādāya tubhyaṃ ca dattvā saṃmāyayā sthitaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narayana said – Thereafter, Kamsa heard the divine voice from the sky while he was seated over the golden lion throne, "O foolish one what are you doing; think of your well-being. I king your death has arrived on the earth and you think of the ways for your welfare, Vasudeva has changed his son with that of the daughter of Nanda for your destruction and brought her here clandestinely and handed her over to you.

## \|\| 10.4 \|\|

*māyāṃśā kanyakeyaṃ ca vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ \|*  
*tava haṃtā gokule ca varddhate naṃdamaṃdire \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. This girl was born of arhsa of Maya and the lord himself was born in the house of Vasudeva as his son. He will be the one who will kill you and is growing up in the house of Nanda in Gokula.

## \|\| 10.5-6 \|\|

*devakyāḥ saptamo garbho varddhate naṃdamaṃdire \|*  
*devakyāḥ saptamo garbho na susrāvāmṛtaṃ sutam \|\| 5\|\|*

*sthāpayāmāsa māyo taṃ rohiṇījaṭhare kila \|*  
*tatra jātaśca śeṣāṃśo baladevo mahābalaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. The seventh child of Devaki too is growing up in the house of Nanda, the seventh conception of Devaki was not aborted and that son is still alive. Yogamaya extracted foetus from the womb of Devaki and transplanted the same in the womb of Rohiiil and Baladeva was born out of that.

## \|\| 10.7-8 \|\|

*gokule tau ca vardhete kālau te naṃdamaṃdire \|*  
*śrutveti vacanaṃ rājā babhūvānamrakaṃdharaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ciṃtāmavāpa sahasā tatyājāhāramunmanāḥ \|*  
*pūtanāṃ ca samānīya prāṇebhyaḥ preyasīṃ satīm \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. "Both Krishna and Baladeva will be the cause of your death and are growing up in the house of Nanda." On hearing this divine voice, the king Kaiirsa started feeling panicky. He could not take his food and he summoned Putana, who was dearer to him than his life and spoke to her in his court which was attended to by many kings.

## \|\| 10.9-10 \|\|

*uvāca bhaginīṃ rājā sabhāmadhye ca nītivit \|*  
*.kaṃsa uvāca \|*  
*pūtane gokulaṃ gaccha kāryārthaṃ naṃdamaṃdiram \|\| 9 \|\|*

*iti śrībra0 ma0 pu0 śrīkṛ0nā0sa0 pūtanāmokṣo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Kamsa said – О Putana, you go to the palace of Nanda in Gokula for my sake and applying poison to your breasts you insert them in the mouth of the infant. О dear one, you move with the speed of the mind. You are well-versed in the illusion.

## \|\| 10.11-16 \|\|

*māyāmānuṣarūpaṃ ca vidhāya vraja yogini \|*  
*durvāsaso mahāmaṃtraṃ prāpya sarvatragāminī \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sarvarūpaṃ vidhātuṃ tvaṃ śaktāsi supratiṣṭhite \|*  
*ityuktvā tāṃ mahārājastasthau saṃsadi nārada \|\| 12 \|\|*

*jagāma pūtanā kaṃsaṃ praṇamya kāmacāriṇī \|*  
*taptakāṃcanavarṇābhā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*bibhratī kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam \|*  
*kastūrībiṃdunā yuktaṃ siṃdūraṃ dadhatī mudā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*maṃjīraraśanābhyāṃ ca kalaśabdaṃ prakurvatī \|*  
*saṃprāpya goṣṭhaṃ durdarśaṃ naṃdālayamanoharam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*parikhābhirgabhīrābhirdurlaṃghyābhiśca veṣṭitam \|*  
*racitaṃ prastarairdivyairnirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|\| 16 \|\|*

11-16. O Yogini, by means of your illusion you take to human form and go there. О well established one, you can move everywhere because of the mantra you received from Durvasa and are also competent to take to any form. О Narada, thus speaking the king Kamsa, kept quiet. Bowing in reverence to Kamsa, Putana started from the place. The glory of her limbs resembled the molten gold. She was adorned with various types of ornaments and the garland of jasmine flowers, wearing beautiful hair do over the head. She was having the beautiful spots of kasturl on her forehead, besides the vermilion creating sound with her anklets and waist-band, she went on to her path. Reaching Vraja, she looked at the beautiful palace of Nanda which was difficult to look at by others and was surrounded by quite deep and dark revines which were difficult to cross. It was constmcted by Vishvakarma with stones.

## \|\| 10.17-18 \|\|

*iṃdranīlairmarakataiḥ padmarāgaiśca bhūṣitam \|*  
*suvarṇakalaśairdivyaiścitritaiḥ śekharojjvalaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*prākārairgaganasparśaiścaturdvārasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*yuktaṃ lohakapāṭaiśca dvārapālasamanvitaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. It was decorated with sapphire, emerald lotus-like gems, had the divine' kalasas of gold and astonishing type of the sikharas. The boundary walls touching the sky and had four gates which had the doors of iron. The gale keepers were guarding the gates.

## \|\| 10.19-21 \|\|

*veṣṭitaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ sundarīgaṇaveṣṭitam \|*  
*muktāmāṇikyaparaśaiḥ pūrṇaratnādibhirdhanaiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*svarṇapātravaṭākīrṇaṃ gavāṃ koṭibhiranvitam \|*  
*bharaṇīyaiḥ kiṃkaraiśca gopalakṣaiḥ samanvitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dāsīnāṃ ca sahasraiśca karmavyagraiḥ samanvitam \|*  
*praviveśāśramaṃ sādhvī sasmitā sumanoharā \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. The beautiful palace was surrounded by the beautiful damsels and was filled with diamonds and gems besides other riches. There were enormous number of golden vases, crores of cows, lakhs of cowherds, serving as attendants who were fed there. There were thousands of slave girls who were engaged in different types of works. The chaste Putana entered in such a type of palace in a beautiful form, wearing the serene smile over her face.

## \|\| 10.22-24 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ praviśaṃtīṃ ca gopyo dṛṣṭvānumenire \|*  
*kiṃ vā padmālayā durgā kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgatā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*praṇemurgopikā gopāḥ papracchuḥ kuśalaṃ ca tām \|*  
*dadau siṃhāsanaṃ pādyaṃ vāsayāmāsa tatra vai \|\| 23 \|\|*

*papraccha kuśalaṃ sā ca gopānāṃ bālakasya ca \|*  
*uvāsa sasmitā sādhvī pādyaṃ jagrāha sādaram \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. Finding her entering in to the palace, the cowherdesses as if Lakshmi or Durga had arrived to have a look at child Krishna all the cowherd and cowherdesses bowed before her and enquired of her welfare. They offered her a lion throne as a seat and washed her feet. The chaste lady also enquired of the welfare from the cowherdesses. The beautiful damsel then sat there with a smile on her face and accepted the offerings made to her by the cowherds and cowherdesses quite delightfully.

## \|\| 10.25 \|\|

*tāmūcurgopikāḥ sarvāḥ kā tvamīśvari sāṃpratam \|*  
*vāsaste kutra kiṃ nāma kiṃ vātra karma no vada \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thereafter, the cowherdesses enquired of her, "O damsel who are you and where do you live. What is your name? What is the purpose of your arrival here? You tell us.".

## \|\| 10.26-28 \|\|

*tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā sāpyuvāca manoharam \|*  
*mathurāvasinī gopī sāṃprataṃ viprakāminī \|\| 26 \|\|*

*śrutaṃ vācikavaktreṇa tattvaṃ maṃgalasūcakam \|*  
*babhūva sthavire kāle naṃdaputro mahāniti \|\| 27 \|\|*

*śrutvāgatāhaṃ taṃ draṣṭumāśiṣaṃ kartumīpsitām \|*  
*putramānaya taṃ dṛṣṭvā yāmi kṛtvā tamāśiṣam \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. On hearing the words of the cowherdesses, she spoke in beautiful words, "I reside in Mathura and am a cowherds. Presently I am the wife of the Brahmana. I have heard from a messenger that Nanda and Yashoda have got a son in the old age. On hearing it, I have arrived here to blessed the child. You bring here the child, I shall revert to my abode after blessing the child.".

## \|\| 10.29 \|\|

*brāhmaṇīvacanaṃ śrutvā yaśodā hṛṣṭamānasā \|*  
*praṇamayya sutaṃ kroḍe dadau brāhmaṇayoṣitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. On hearing the words of the Brahmana lady the mind of Yashoda was delighted who bowed before her and gave the child to the Brahmana lady who carried him in her lap.

## \|\| 10.30 \|\|

*kṛtvā kroḍe tu taṃ sādhvī cucuṃba ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*stanaṃ dadau sukhāsīnā hariṃ puṇyavatī satī \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Carrying him in her lap, she kissed him again and again; thereafter the chaste Putana inserted his breast into the mouth of Krishna.

## \|\| 10.31-32 \|\|

*ahodbhuto'yaṃ bālasta sundaro gopasundari \|*  
*guṇairnārāyaṇasamo bāloyamityuvāca ha \|\| 31 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇo viṣastanaṃ pītvā jahāsa vakṣasi sthitaḥ \|*  
*tasyāḥ prāṇaiḥ saha papau viṣakṣīraṃ sudhāmiva \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. She said to Yashoda, "O beautiful cowherdess, this child of your is of astonishing beauty and equates Narayana is qualities. Lord Krishna sucking the breast of Ptitana coated with poison, sat on her breasts and started smiling, he sucked her milk poison, together with her life."

## \|\| 10.33-37 \|\|

*tatyāja bālakaṃ sādhvī prāṇāṃstyaktvā papāta ha \|*  
*vikṛtākāravadanā cottānavadanā mune \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sthūladehaṃ parityajya sṛkṣmadehaṃ viveśa sā \|*  
*āruroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ ratnasāravinirmitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*pārṣadapravarairdivyairveṣṭitaṃ sumanoharaiḥ \|*  
*śvetacāmaralakṣeṇa śobhitaṃ lakṣadarpaṇaiḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vahniśaucena vastreṇa sūkṣmeṇa bhūṣitaṃ varam \|*  
*nānācitravicitraiśca sadratnakalaśairyutam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*suṃdaraṃ śatacakraṃ ca valitaṃ ratnatejasā \|*  
*pārṣadāstāṃ rathe kṛtvā jagmurgolokamuttamam \|\| 37 \|\|*

33-37. О sage, the chaste lady shed away her life leaving the child there and she fell down on the ground. After the fall of her body her mouth look quite terrific. She fell down with her face on the earth and left her worldly body and entered the ethereal body. She mounted on a gem-studded chariot which was carefully built. The chariot was surrounded with the divine courtiers having beautiful banners in lakhs. It had a large number of mirrors, garments purified by fire was the best, having painting made of different types of gems and had a hundred wheels. It was illumining with the lustre of the gems. The courtiers carried her to excellent Goloka making Ptitana to ride over it.

## \|\| 10.38 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tamadbhutaṃ lokā gopikāścātivismitāḥ \|*  
*kaṃsaḥ śrutvā ca tatsarvaṃ vismitaśca babhūva ha \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Beholding the wonderful act, the cowherd and the cowherdesses felt surprised and hearing all this Kansha too became dazed.

## \|\| 10.39 \|\|

*yaśodā bālakaṃ nītvā kroḍe kṛtvā stanaṃ dadau \|*  
*maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa vipradvārā śiśormune \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О sage, Yashoda then picked up the child and took him in his lap and started feeding him with her breasts. They also performed the welfare ceremony through the Brahmanas for child.

## \|\| 10.40 \|\|

*dadāha dehaṃ tasyāśca naṃdaḥ sānaṃdarpūvakam \|*  
*caṃdanāgurukastūrīsamaṃ saṃprāpya saurabham \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thereafter, Nanda delightfully cremated the body of Putana using sandal-wood, aguru and kasturl besides others fragrant articles.

## \|\| 10.41 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*sā vā kā rākṣasīrūpā kathaṃ puṇyavatī satī \|*  
*kena puṇyena taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagāma kṛṣṇamaṃdiram \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Narada said – Who was that chaste lady in the form of Putana appearing as a demoness? By what merit she had an audience with the lord with and went to the abode Krishna?

## \|\| 10.42-43 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*baliyajñe vāmanasya dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ manoharam \|*  
*balikanyā ratnamālā putrasnehaṃ cakāra tam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*manasā mānasaṃ cakre putrasya sadṛśo mama \|*  
*pibedyadi stanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ karomi taṃ ca vakṣasi \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Narayana said – In the sacrifice of Bali his daughter named Ratnamala felt attracted towards Vamana and desired to have him as her son. She had thought in her mind that the son like him should be fed by her from her breasts. "Inserting the breast in to his mouth I shall make him sit over my breasts.".

## \|\| 10.44 \|\|

*haristanmānasaṃ jñātvā papau janmāṃtare stanam \|*  
*dadau mātṛgatiṃ tasyai kāmapūraḥ kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The lord understood her desire and therefore he sucked his^ breasts in the next birth. The compassionate lbrd who fulfils all the desires, gave her the position of a mother feeding himself from her breasts.

## \|\| 10.45 \|\|

*dattvā viṣastanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūtanā rākṣasī mune \|*  
*bhaktyā mātṛgatiṃ prāpa kaṃ bhajāma vinā harim \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О sage, the demoness Putana offered her breasts for sucking by Krishna with devotion and achieved the glory. Then why should I adore any other god accept the lord who granted salvation to Putana?

## \|\| 10.46 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra śrīkṛṣṇa guṇakīrtanam \|*  
*padepade sumadhuraṃ pravaraṃ kathayāmi te \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. О Brahmana, thus I have narrated the qualities of lord Krishna which are sweet at every step. Now I am going to narrate to you his qualities further which are no doubt the best in the world.

## Chapter 11

## \|\| 11.1 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā gokule sādhvī yaśodā naṃdagehinī \|*  
*gṛhakarmaṇi saṃsaktā kṛtvā bālaṃ svavakṣasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – Once Yashoda, the chaste wife of Nanda was engaged in some household work carrying the child in her lap.

## \|\| 11.2 \|\|

*vātyārūpaṃ tṛṇāvartamāgacchaṃtaṃ ca gokulam \|*  
*śrīharirmanasā jñātvā bhārayukto babhūva ha \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. At that very moment a demon named Trnavarta arrived there in the form of a storm in Gokula. Lord Krishna realising the arrival of the demon increased the weight of his body.

## \|\| 11.3 \|\|

*bhārākrāṃtā yaśodā ca tatyāja bālakaṃ tadā \|*  
*śayanaṃ kārayitvā ca jagāma yamunāṃ mune \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О sage, Yashoda finding herself unable to carry the weight of the child, placed him over the bed and herself went to the Yamuna.

## \|\| 11.4 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare ta vātyārūpadharo'suraḥ \|*  
*ādāya taṃ bhrāmayitvā gatvā ca śatayojanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. In the meantime the demon in the form of a storm carried the child moving him round and round.

## \|\| 11.5-7 \|\|

*babhaṃja vṛkṣaśākhāśca hyaṃdhībhūtaṃ ca gokulam \|*  
*cakāra sadyo māyāvī punastatra papāta ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

*asuro'pi harisparśājjagāma harimaṃdiram \|*  
*suṃdaraṃ rathamāruhya kṛtvā karmakṣayaṃ svakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pāṃḍyadeśodbhavo rājā śāpāddurvāsaso'suraḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇasparśādgolokaṃ sa jagāma ha \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. The demon uprooted the trees and broke the branches and then created the dust storm plunging the entire Gokula in darkness. The illusory demon created all this storm in a moment. He was then himself upset with the weight of lord Krishna and fell down on the ground. With the touch of lord Hari, the demon also achieved Vaikuntha; all his deeds were destroyed and mounted on the chariot, he reached in the Goloka. He was the king of the land and had turned into a demon with the curse of Durvasa. With the touch of lord Krishna, he reached Goloka.

## \|\| 11.8-9 \|\|

*vātyārūpe gate gopā gopyaśca bhayavihvalāḥ \|*  
*na dṛṣṭvā bālakaṃ tatra śayānaṃ śayane mune \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sarve nijaghnuḥ svaṃ vakṣasthalaṃ śokākulā bhayāt \|*  
*kecinmūrchāmavāpuśca ruruduścāpi kecana \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. О sage, after the departure of the demon, all the cowherds and cowherdesses were terror stricken. Finding the child missing from the bed all of them felt panicky and while crying they started beating the breasts. Some of them were fainted and some of them started crying.

## \|\| 11.10 \|\|

*anveṣaṇaṃ prakurvaṃto dadṛśurbālakaṃ vraje \|*  
*dhūlidhūsarasarvāṃgaṃ puṣpodyānāṃtarasthitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The people started searching for the child and they found him ultimately in the forest with his body covered with dust he was lying in an orchard of flowers.

## \|\| 11.11 \|\|

*iti śrībra0 ma0 śrīkṛṣṇaja0 nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde tṛṇāvartavadho nāmai kādaśo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. He was found at the bank of a tank with deep water. Getting panicky, he was crying looking towards the sky.

## \|\| 11.12 \|\|

*gṛhītvā bālakaṃ naṃdaḥ kṛtvā vakṣasi satvaram \|*  
*darśaṃ darśaṃ mukhaṃ tasya ruroda ca śucā'nvitaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Nanda at once picked up the child and carried him in his lap. Looking at the face of the child he, started crying aloud.

## \|\| 11.13-14 \|\|

*yaśodā rohiṇī śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ ruroda ca \|*  
*kṛtvā vakṣasi tadvaktraṃ cucuṃba ca muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa snāpayāmāsa bālakam \|*  
*stanaṃ dadau yaśodā ca prasannavadanekṣaṇā \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Thereafter, Yashoda and Rohini also started crying looking at the child. Carrying him in their lap they started kissing his face again and again. After performing the welfare ceremony the child was made to bathe. Thereafter expressing delight through face and eyes, Yashoda inserted her breast in to his mouth.

## \|\| 11.15 \|\|

*. nārada uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ śaśāpa durvāsāḥ pāṃḍyadeśodbhavaṃ nṛpam \|*  
*suvicārya vada brahmannitihāsaṃ purātanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Narada said – О Brahman, why did Durvasa pronounced a curse on the king of Pandya country? You kindly think over it care fully and narrate the old story.

## \|\| 11.16-17 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*pāṃḍyadeśādhipo rājā sahasrākṣaḥ pratāpavān \|*  
*strīsahasraṃ samādāya kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*manohare nirjane ca parvate gaṃdhamādane \|*  
*vijahāra nadītīre puṣpodyāne manorame \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Narayana said – Sahasraksa, the king of Pandya country was quite glorious, the king infatuated with passion accompanied with я-Viundred damsels was roaming about in ^ secluded place over Gandhamadana mountain, he enjoyed conjugal pleasured over the-'oank of the river, in the flower or chard located over the bank of the river.

## \|\| 11.18 \|\|

*nānāprakāraśṛgāraṃ viparītādikaṃ nṛpaḥ \|*  
*nakhadaṃtakṣatāṃgaṃ ca kāminīnāṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The king behaved pervertedly with the damsels injuring them with teeth and the nails while indulging in love-sports.

## \|\| 11.19 \|\|

*kṛtvā mūrtisahasraṃ ca yogīṃdro nṛpatīśvaraḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā sthalavihāraṃ ca jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The competent king taking to a thousand forms enjoyed the company of the damsel over the land as well as in water.

## \|\| 11.20-21 \|\|

*nāryo vivasanāḥ sarvā nagnāśca nṛpayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*vijahruśca puṣpabhadrānadītīre manohare \|\| 20 \|\|*

*etasminnaṃtare tatra samāyāto mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*śiṣyalakṣaiḥ parivṛto gacchanvai śaṃkaraṃ prati \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Thus all the damsels were engaged in water-sport with the king in the Puspabhadra river getting unrobed. In the meantime, Durvasa accompanied by a lakh of his pupils arrived there on his way to a abode of Shiva.

## \|\| 11.22 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā muniṃ mahāmatto nottasthau na nanāma ha \|*  
*vācā hastena rājā ca saṃbhāṣāṃ na cakāra ha \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The intoxicated king did not show due respect to the sage on his arrival. He did not get up to welcome him nor did the express anything by indication of hand or speech.

## \|\| 11.23-24 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā cukopa nṛpatiṃ śaśāpa sphuritādharaḥ \|*  
*asuro bhava pāpiṣṭha yogādbhraṣṭo bhuvaṃ vraja \|\| 23 \|\|*

*smṛtvā haripadāṃbhojaṃ jvaladagniṃ viveśa ha \|\| 32 \|\|*

*hāhākāraṃ surāḥ sarve vicakrurgagane sthitāḥ \|*

## Chapter 12

## \|\| 12.1 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā maṃdire nandapatnī sā''naṃdapūrvakam \|*  
*kṛtvā vakṣasi goviṃdaṃ kṣudhitaṃ ca stanaṃ dadau \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – Once Yashoda the wife of Nanda carried the child in her lap was feeding him with her breast milk.

## \|\| 12.2-4 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare gopya ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram \|*  
*sthavirāśca vayasyāśca bālikā bālakānvitāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2-4. In the meantime all the cowherds and the old ladies together with boys and girls arrived in the abode of Nanda. At that point of time Yashoda placed the child who was still hungry over the bed and delightfully with pleasure started giving away the oil, vermilion, betel, sweets, clothes and ornaments on the occasion of the birthday of Krishna.

## \|\| 12.5-7 \|\|

*etasminnantare kṛṣṇo ruroda kṣudhitastadā \|*

*papāta caraṇaṃ tasya pravīṇe śakaṭe mune \|*  
*viśvaṃbharapadāghātāttacca cūrṇaṃ babhūva ha \|\| 6 \|\|*

*babhaṃja śakaṭaṃ peturbhagnakāṣṭhāni tatra vai \|*

5-7. In the meantime hungry Krishna started crying. In the meantime Krishna the lord of illusion placed his foot with his illusion. His fort fell over the solid cart in the court-yard. With the blow of the foot of Krishna, the cart was shuttered into pieces which were scattered everywhere. The card, milk, ghee, butter and honey placed in the cart started flowing.

## \|\| 12.8-10 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ gopikāśca dudruvurbālakaṃ bhayāt \|*  
*dadṛśurbhagnaśakaṭamiṃdhanābhyaṃtare śiśum \|\| 8 \|\|*

*māyārakṣitasarvāṃgaṃ ruditaṃ kṣudhitaṃ kṣudhā \|*  
*stanaṃ dadau yaśodā taṃ ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ śucā \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Looking at the surprise, the cowherdesses went running to the child. They found that he had been broken the cart into wooden pieces. All the vases of cart had been broken resulting into the flow of milk. With the remaining pieces, of wood. Feeling panicky, Yashoda removed the child from there, whose all the limbs were intact with the influence of illusion. He was crying, simply because he was hungry. The grief-stricken Yashoda started crying and also fed the child with her breast.

## \|\| 12.11-13 \|\|

*papracchurbālakāngopā babhaṃja śakaṭaṃ katham \|*

*śrutvā tadvacanaṃ gopā gopyaśca jahasurmudā \|*

11-13. The cowherds enquired from the boys playing there. "How did this cart be broken"? We don't find any reason for it. All of a sudden how could this surprise happen." On hearing this boys said, "O cowherds, you listen to our talk, the cart was broken with the attack of Krishna by his feet." On hearing this, all the cowherds and cowherdesses started laughing delightfully, who could not believe the same, the people of Vraja said that it was all false.

14\. Thereafter the welfare ceremony of the child was performed by the Brahmanas. One of the Brahmanas placing his hand over the head of the child recited a kavacha.

*vadāmi tatte viprendra kavacaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam \|*

15-16. О best of the Brahmanas, I am going to enlighten you about the kavacha with protects all. Its knowledge was imparted in earlier times by Yogamaya to Brahma when lord Vishnu was sleeping in the oceanic waters over the serpent bed and was terrified by Madhu-kaitabha, he recited the prayer to Yoganindra.

## \|\| 12.17 \|\|

*yoganidrovāca \|*  
*dūrībhūtaṃ kuru bhayaṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ te harau sthite \|*

17\. Yoganidra said – О lord of the universe, О Brahman, be fearless shedding the fear why should you be afraid when I and the lord are there. Therefore, you live comfortably.

## \|\| 12.18 \|\|

*śrīhariḥ pātu te vaktraṃ mastakaṃ madhusūdanaḥ \|*

18\. Lord Hari should protect your face, Madhusfldana should protect your forehead, Shri Krishna protect both your eyes. And the husband of Radhika should protect your nose.

## \|\| 12.19 \|\|

*karṇayugmaṃ ca kaṇṭhaṃ ca kapālaṃ pātu mādhavaḥ \|*  
*kapolaṃ pātu govindaḥ keśāṃśca keśavaḥ svayam \|\| 19 \|\|*

## \|\| 12.20 \|\|

*adharoṣṭhaṃ hṛṣīkeśo daṃtapaṃktiṃ gadāgrajaḥ \|*  
*rāseśvaraśca rasanāṃ tālukaṃ vāmano vibhuḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The lower lip should be protect by Hrslkesa, the line of teeth should be protected by wielder of gada. The tongue should be protected by the lord of Rasa (dance) and the palate should be protected by Vamana the all-pervading one.

## \|\| 12.21-22 \|\|

*vakṣaḥ pātu mukundaśca jaṭharaṃ pātu daityahā \|*  
*janārdanaḥ pātu nābhiṃ pātu viṣṇuśca mehanam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*nitaṃbayugmaṃ guhyaṃ ca pātu te puruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*jānuyugme jānakīśaḥ pātu te sarvadā vibhuḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The chest should be protected by Mukunda and the belly should be protected by the killer of the Daityas, the navel should be protected by Janardana, while male organ should be protected by Vishnu. The pelvic region should be protected by Purusottma. The lord of JanakI should be protected the knees.

## \|\| 12.23 \|\|

*hastayugmaṃ nṛsiṃhaśca pātu sarvatra saṃkaṭe \|*

23\. Nrsiiiiha should protect both the hands during all the dangers. Varaha born out of lotus should protect the feet.

## \|\| 12.24-25 \|\|

*ūrdhvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ pātu hyadhastātkamalāpatiḥ \|*  
*pūrvasyāṃ pātu gopālaḥ pātu vahnau daśāsyahā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*vanamālī pātu yāmyāṃ vaikuṃṭhaḥ pātu nairṛtau \|*

24-25. The bust should be protected by Narayana, while the lower portion should be protected by lord of Kamala, the eastern direction should be protected by Gopala or the south-east should be protected by the killer of Ravana, the southern region should be protected by Vanamall, south-west should be protected by Vaikuntha while the western should be protected by Vasudeva.

## \|\| 12.26-27 \|\|

*pātu te saṃtatamajo vāyavyāṃ viṣṭaraśravāḥ \|*

*aiśānyāmīśvaraḥ pātu pātu sarvatra śatrujit \|*

26-27. North-west should be protected by Vist arasrava. The northern direction should be protected by the lustre of Kamlasana and north-east should be protected by Isvara who should conquers of the enemies. Raghava should protect in the water land and the sky.

## \|\| 12.28 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahmankavacaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*kṛṣṇena kṛpayā dattaṃ smṛtenaiva purā mayā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О Brahman, this is quite and astonishing kavacha the knowledge of which was bestowed on me by lord Krishna in earlier times.

*śuṃbhena saha saṃgrāme nirlakṣye ghoradāruṇe \|*

29\. Engaged in the terrific fight with Sumbha, goddess Durga on receiving this kavacha defeated the demon in no time.

## \|\| 12.30-31 \|\|

*kavacasya prabhāveṇa dharaṇyāṃ patito mṛtaḥ \|*

*mṛte śuṃbhe ca govindaḥ kṛpālurgaganasthitaḥ \|*  
*mālāṃ ca kavacaṃ dattvā golokaṃ sa jagāma ha \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. With the influence of this kavacha he fell on the ground after have been killed. In the earlier times Sumbha carried on the war for a hundred years remaining in the sky and after his death lord Govinda while remaining in the sky bestowed this kavacha together with the rosary. And he went to Goloka thereafter.

## \|\| 12.32 \|\|

*kalpāṃtarasya vṛttāṃtaṃ kṛpayā kathitaṃ mune \|*

32\. О sage, I have narrated to you this kavacha with which no one gets panicky at any time.

## \|\| 12.33 \|\|

*koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo naṣṭā mayā dṛṣṭāśca vedhasaḥ \|*

33\. In every kalpa with the company of the lord, I have seen crores of Brahmanas falling.

## \|\| 12.34 \|\|

*ityuktvā kavacaṃ dattvā sā'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*niḥśaṅko nābhikamale tasthau sa kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Thus speaking handing over the kavacha, the goddess disappeared. Thereafter Brahma continued to dwell on the lotus emerging from navel of Vishnu.

## \|\| 12.35-36 \|\|

*suvarṇaguṭikāyāṃ ca kṛtvedaṃ kavacaṃ param \|*

*viṣāgnijalaśatrubhyo bhayaṃ tasya na jāyate \|*  
*jale sthale cāṃtarikṣe nidrāyāṃ rakṣatīśvaraḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. This kavacha should be kept in gold and the intelligent people should it over the right arm and by doing so, one is relieved of the danger of poison, fire, water and enemies. The kavacha protect one in the waters on earth in the sky while sleeping or awake.

## \|\| 12.37 \|\|

*saṃgrāme vajrapāte ca vipattau prāṇasaṃkaṭe \|*

37\. During the time of war, fall of thunderbolt, evil times and danger of death, one becomes fearless with the reciting of this kavacha.

## \|\| 12.38 \|\|

38\. In the earlier times by reciting this kavacha around his neck, Shiva easily over-powered Tripurasura and kicked him.

## \|\| 12.39 \|\|

*baddhvedaṃ kavacaṃ kālī raktabījaṃ cakhāda sā \|*

39\. In the meantime holding this kavacha, the goddess swallowed Raktabija and the Shesha with a thousand heads bears the load of the universe like the seed of sheshamum.

## \|\| 12.40 \|\|

*āvāṃ sanatkumāraśca dharmasākṣī ca karmaṇām \|*  
*kavacasya prabhāveṇa sarvatra jayino vayam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Both of us (Nara-narayana), Sanatkumara, Dharma witness of the karmas are always victorious with the influence of this kavacha.

## \|\| 12.41 \|\|

*tasya nandaśiśoḥ kaṇṭhe cakāra kavacaṃ dvijaḥ \|*
