41\. Thereafter Nanda, tied that kavacha round the neck of Krishna. Thus lord Hari was adored with his own kavacha around his neck for protection.

## \|\| 12.42 \|\|

*prabhāvaḥ kathitaḥ sarvaḥ kavacasya harestathā \|*  
*anantasyācyutasyaiva prabhāvamatulaṃ mune \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. O sage, I have narrated to you the influence of the kavacha of lord Hari and I am also narrating to the astonishing influence of lord Acyuta.

## Chapter 13

## \|\| 13.1 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*aparaṃ kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu kiṃcinmahāmune \|*  
*vighnanighnaṃ pāpaharaṃ mahāpuṇyakaraṃ param \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – О best of the sages, you listen to the glory of lord Krishna which removes all the abstractions and the sins, besides being highly meritorious.

## \|\| 13.2-4 \|\|

*ekadā nandapatnī ca kṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ svavakṣasi \|*  
*svarṇasiṃhāsanasthā ca kṣudhitaṃ taṃ stanaṃ dadau \|\| 2 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tatra vipreṃdraikaḥ samāgataḥ \|*  
*vṛtaḥ śiṣyasamūhaiśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*prajapanparamaṃ brahma śuddhasphaṭikamālayā \|*  
*daṇḍī chatrī śuklavāsā dantapaṃktivirājitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Once Yashoda the wife of Nanda, seated on a golden lion-throne was feeding Krishna with her breasts. At that point of time a Brahmana arrived there surrounded with his pupils and illumining with the divine lustre he was holding rosary of crystal gems and was reciting the name of eternal Brahman. He carried with him a stuff and an umbrella. Besides being clad in white garment, his lines of teeth were looking quite charming.

## \|\| 13.5 \|\|

*jyotirgraṃtho mūrtimāṃśca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ \|*  
*paribibhrajjaṭājālaṃ taptakāṃcanasannibham \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He was well versed in astrology as well as the Vedas and post-Vedic literature. He was wearing over his head the matted locks of hair, looking like the molten gold.

## \|\| 13.6 \|\|

*śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyo gaurāṃgaḥ padmalocanaḥ \|*  
*yogīndro dhūrjaṭeḥ śiṣyaḥ śuddhabhakto gadābhṛtaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. His face resembled the full moon of the winter season. He had fair complexion and his eyes resembled the lotus flowers. The great yogi happened to be the pupil of Shiva, besides being the devotee of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 13.7-9 \|\|

*vyākhyāmudrākaraḥ śrīmāñchiṣyānadhyāpayanmudā \|*  
*vedavyākhyāṃ katividhāṃ prakurvanniva līlayā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ekībhūya caturvedāstejasā mūrtimāniva \|*  
*sākṣātsarasvatīkaṇṭhaḥ siddhāṃtaikaviśāradaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dhyānaikaniṣṭhaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapādāṃbhoje divāniśam \|*  
*jīvanmukto hi siddheśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. The great sage delight folly educated his pupil. His one hand was held in Vyakhydnamudrd, which was clearly visible. He used to recite the commentary on the Vedas variously with pleasure. Looking at him, it appeared that all the Vedas had appeared in him in person with all their glory. The goddess of Sarasvati was dwelling in his throat and he happened to be only expert in the interpretation of the scriptures with his mind always devoted at the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna. He was free from birth, lord of the siddhas and was all-knowledgeable.

## \|\| 13.10-11 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā sā samuttasthau yaśodā praṇanāma ca \|*  
*pādyaṃ gāṃ madhuparkaṃ ca svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ dadau \|\| 10 \|\|*

*bālakaṃ vaṃdayāmāsa munīndraṃ sasmitaṃ mudā \|*  
*muniśca manasā cakre praṇāmaśatakaṃ harim \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Looking at him Yashoda got up and bowed before him. Then she offered him arghya, the cows madhuparka and the gold besides offering him lion-throne for sitting. She also delightfully made her child to bow before the sage. The sage on his part bowed in reverence to lord Krishna a hundred times.

## \|\| 13.12 \|\|

*āśiṣaṃ pradadau prītyā vedamaṃtropayogikam \|*  
*praṇanāma ca śiṣyāṃśca te tāṃ yuyujurāśiṣam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Reciting the hymns of the Vedas the blessed him variously. Thereafter, Yashoda also bowed in reverence to his pupils who blesses her variously.

## \|\| 13.13-14 \|\|

*śiṣyānpādyādikaṃ bhaktyā pradadau ca pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*sāśiṣyāṃghrī ca prakṣālya samuvāsa sukhāsane \|\| 13 \|\|*

*samudyatā sā praṣṭuṃ ca puṭāñjaliyutā satī \|*  
*svakroḍe bālakaṃ kṛtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharā \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Yashoda entertained the pupils of the sage individually bowing before them offering pddya etc. Thereafter the sage together with his pupils washed their feet and occupied their respective seats. Thereafter the chaste Yashoda carrying the child in her lap with her mind filled with devotion got ready to ask something from sage.

## \|\| 13.15-27 \|\|

*svātmārāmaṃ maṃgalaṃ ca praṣṭuṃ yadyapi na kṣamā \|*  
*tathā'pi bhavato nāma śivaṃ pṛcchāmi sāṃpratam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*abalā buddhihīnāyā doṣaṃ kṣaṃtuṃ sadā'rhasi \|*  
*mūḍhasya satataṃ doṣaṃ kṣamāṃ kurvaṃti sādhavaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*aṃgirā vā'tha vā'trirvā marīcirgautamo'tha vā \|*  
*kratuḥ kiṃ vā pracetā vā pulastyaḥ pulaho'thavā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*durvāsāḥ kardamastvaṃ vā vaśiṣṭho garga eva vā \|*  
*jaigīṣavyo devalo vā kapilo vā svayaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanando vā sanātanaḥ \|*  
*voḍhuḥ paṃcaśikho vā tvamāsuriḥ saubhariḥ kimu \|\| 19 \|\|*

*viśvāmitro'tha vālmāko vāmadevo'tha kaśyapaḥ \|*  
*saṃvartaḥ kimutathyo vā kiṃ kaco vā bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*bhṛguḥ śukraśca cyavano naranārāyaṇo'thavā \|*  
*sakthinaḥ parāśaro vyāsaḥ śukadevo'tha jaiminiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanastathā \|*  
*āstīko vā jaratkārurṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṃḍakaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*paulastyastvamagastyo vā śaradvāngirireva ca \|*  
*śamīko'riṣṭanemiśca māṇḍavyaḥ paila eva ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

*pāṇinirvā kaṇādo vā śākalyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ \|*  
*aṣṭāvakro bhāgurirvā sumanturvatsa eva vā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*jābālo yājñavalkyaśca vaiśaṃpāyana eva ca \|*  
*yatirhaṃsī pippalādo maitreyaḥ karuṣastathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*upamanyurgauramukho'ruṇiraurvo'tha kakṣivān \|*  
*bharadvājo vedaśirā śaṃkukarṇo'tha śaunakaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*eteṣāṃ puṇyaślokānāṃ ko bhavānvada me prabho \|*  
*pratyuttarārhā nāhaṃ cettathā'pi vaktumarhasi \|\| 27 \|\|*

15-27. She said, "Though I am not competent enough to ask you about the welfare of my child, still I am going to enquire about your welfare. Therefore you forgive my short comings being a foolish lady before you. The noble people always forgive the sins of foolish people." The sages like Arigira, Atri, Marlci, Gautama, Kratu, Praceta, Pulastya, Pulaha, Durvasa, Kardama, Vasistha, Garg, Jaiglsavya, Devala or Svayam-Vibhu, Kapila, Sanatkumara, Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatana, Vodhu, Pancasikha, Asuri, Saubhari, Vishvamitra, Valmlki, Vamdeva, Kashyapa, Samvarta, Kaca, Brihaspti, Bhrigu, Sukra, Cyavana, Nara-narayana, Sakti, Parasara, Vyasa, Sukadeva, Jaimini, Markandeya, Lomasa, Kanva, Katyayana, Asttka, Jaratkaru, Rsyasmga, Vibhandaka, Paulastya, Agastya, Saradvan, Giri, Samlka, Aristanemi, Mandavya, Paila, Panini, Kanada, Sakalya, Sakatayana, Astavakra, Bhaguri, Sumantu, Vatsa, Jabala, Yajnavalkya, Vaisampayana, Yati, HansI, Pippalada, Maitreya, Karusa, Upamanyu, Gauramukha, Aruni, Aurva, Bharadvaja, Vedasira, Sankukarna or Shaunaka represent your glory alone. О lord, I am not competent enough to enter into discussion with you still I would request you kindly you suggest to me the name of the boy.

## \|\| 13.28 \|\|

*kiṃkaraḥ kiṃkarī vā'pi samarthā prabhumīśvaram \|*  
*yo yasya sevāniyataḥ sa kaṃ pṛcchati taṃ vinā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Only the male or female servants can put questions to the lord. The one who serves the lord daily, whom shall he ask for the removal of his doubt.

## \|\| 13.29-30 \|\|

*dhanyā'haṃ kṛtakṛtyāhaṃ saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mama \|*  
*tvatpādābjarajaḥsparśājjanmakoṭyaṃhasā kṣayaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tvatpādodakasaṃsparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā \|*  
*tavāgamanamātreṇa tīrthībhūto mamāśramaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. I am quite youthful and indebted to you. My life has met with success with the very touch of the dust of your lotus-like feet. The sins of crores of birth have disappeared. Because with the touch of the water from your feet even the earth gets purified and with your arrival here my abode has been purified and has been turned into a holy place.

## \|\| 13.31 \|\|

*yeye śrutāḥ śrutau brahmañcchrutisārā mahājanāḥ \|*  
*teṣāmeko mayā dṛṣṭaḥ pūrvapuṇyaphalodayāt \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О Brahman, such of the people who have been described as the best in the Vedas, you happen to be one of them and I could have an audience with you because of the merit earned by me in the earlier births.

## \|\| 13.32 \|\|

*śiṣyā vedā mūrtimaṃto grīṣma madhyāhnabhāskarāḥ \|*  
*gokulaṃ matkulaṃ sadyaḥ punaṃti pādareṇunā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Your glorious pupils are emitting lustre like the mid-day sun of the summer season. You have surely purified Gokula and my abode with the dust of your feet.

## \|\| 13.33 \|\|

*āśiṣaṃ kartumarhaṃti prasannamanasā śiśum \|*  
*pūrṇasvastyayanaṃ sadyo viprāśīrvacanaṃ dhruvam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The great ascetics like you would be competent to bless my child. Indeed the blessing of a Brahmana bestows welfare completely and immediately.

## \|\| 13.34-35 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā naṃdastrī bhaktyā tasthau muneḥ puraḥ \|*  
*naraṃ prasthāpayāmāsa naṃdamānayituṃ satī \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yaśodāvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa munipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*jahasuḥ śiṣyasaṃghāśca bhāsayaṃto diśo daśa \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Thus speaking Yashoda the wife of Nanda stood with a devoted mind before be ascetic and she sent a messengers to call for Nanda also at the spot. On hearing the words of Yashoda, the ascetic smiled and all the pupils also started laughing illumining all the directions.

## \|\| 13.36 \|\|

*hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītiyuktaṃ mahatpuṇyakaraṃ param \|*  
*tāmuvāca mudā yuktaḥ śuddhabuddhirmahāmuniḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Thereafter the sage of the pure wisdom delightfully spoke words to Yashoda, which bestowed welfare, were truthful, quite appropriate as well as meritorious.

## \|\| 13.37 \|\|

*śrīgarga uvāca \|*  
*sudhāmayaṃ te vacanaṃ laukikaṃ ca kulocitam \|*  
*yasya yatra kule janma sa eva tādṛśo bhavet \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Garga said – Your nectar like words are quite befitting to your race and the people. The race in which one is born, he gains the temperament of the same.

## \|\| 13.38-39 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ gopapadmānāṃ giribhānuśca bhāskaraḥ \|*  
*patnī padmāsamā tasya nāmnā padmāvatī satī \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ kanyā yaśodā tvaṃ yaśovarddhanakāriṇī \|*  
*ballavānāṃ ca pravaro labdho naṃdaśca vallabhaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. For the lotus-like race of the cowherds Giribhanu happened to be like the sun, his wife known as chaste Padmavati equated Lakshmi you happen to be their daughter and you have been given the name of Yashoda for the increase in their glory. You have accepted Nanda who is the best of the Vallabha race as your husband.

## \|\| 13.40-42 \|\|

*naṃdo yastvaṃ ca yā bhadre bālo yo yena vā gataḥ \|*  
*jānāmi nirjane sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi naṃdasannidhim \|\| 40 \|\|*

*gargo'haṃ yaduvaṃśānāṃ cirakālaṃ purohitaḥ \|*  
*prasthāpito'haṃ vasunā nānyasādhye ca karmaṇi \|\| 41 \|\|*

*etasminnantare naṃdaḥ śrutamātraṃ jagāma ha \|*  
*nanāma daṃḍavadbhūmau mūrdhnā taṃ munipuṃgavam \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. O noble lady, I know your true identity as well as that of Nanda and also the reason for which this child has arrived but I shall speak this out to Nanda in seclusion. I am the family priest of the people of Yadu race for a long time and am known by the name of Garga. I have been deputed by Vasudeva for an important task which cannot be established by anyone else. In the meantime on hearing the arrival of the sage, Nanda also arrived there and prostrated before the sage.

## \|\| 13.43-44 \|\|

*śiṣyānnanāma mūrdhnā ca te taṃ yuyujurāśiṣam \|*  
*samutthāyāsanāttūrṇa yaśodānaṃda eva ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā'bhyaṃtaraṃ ramyaṃ jagāma viduṣāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*gargo naṃdo yaśodā ca saputrā sā mudā'nvitā \|*  
*vākyaṃ gargastadovāca nigūḍhaṃ nirjane mune \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. He also bowed in reverence to his pupils. All of them blessed Nanda variously; thereafter Nanda and Yashoda got up from their seats and also took the sage Garga with them in the inner apartment. In that room only Garga, Nanda, Yashoda and their sons were present. At that point of time Garga revealed to them and important secret.

## \|\| 13.45-47 \|\|

*śrīgarga uvāca \|*  
*ayi naṃda pravakṣyāmi vacanaṃ te sukhāvaham \|*  
*prasthāpito'haṃ vasunā yena tacchrūyatāmiti \|\| 45 \|\|*

*vasunā sūtikāgāre śiśuḥ pratyarpaṇaṃ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*putro'yaṃ vasudevasya jyeṣṭhaśca tasya ca dhruvam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*kanyā te tena yā nītā mathurāṃ kaṃsabhīruṇā \|*  
*asyānnaprāśanāyāhaṃ nāmānukaraṇāya ca \|*  
*gūḍhena preṣitastena tasyodyogaṃ kuru dvija \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. Garga said – I shall speak to you some pleasant words. The purpose for which Vasudeva has sent me here,-you kindly listen to me. Afraid of the terror of Kamsa, Vasudeva had brought this child here and placed him in the labour room and carrying your daughter form here, he went to Mathura. Therefore Vasudeva happens to be the father of this child and the one who is elder to this child also is his son. He has sent me secretly to perform the Annapmsana and names giving ceremonies of the children secretly. Therefore, you kindly make arrangements for the same.

## \|\| 13.48-51 \|\|

*pūrṇabrahmasvarūpo'yaṃ śiśuste māyayā mahīm \|*  
*āgatya bhāraharaṇaṃ kartā dhātrā ca sevitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*golokanātho bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāpatiḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇo yo vaikuṃṭhe kamalākāṃta eva ca \|\| 49 \|\|*

*śvetadvīpanivāsī yaḥ pitā viṣṇuśca so'pyajaḥ \|*  
*kapilo'nye tadaṃśāśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|\| 50 \|\|*

*sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ rāśirmūrtimānāgataḥ kimu \|*  
*taṃ vasuṃ darśayitvā ca śiśurūpo babhūva ha \|\| 51 \|\|*

48-51. Your child is the form of eternal Brahman and has incarnated on earth for removing her burden. Brahma had adored him and happens to be the lord of Goloka. He is the husband of Radha. He also happens to be Narayana the dweller of Vaikuntha and the lord of Kamala. Vishnu who happens to be the dweller of the Shveta-dvipa is also his form alone. All the sages like Kapila, Nara-narayana and others are not separate from him. Evidently he has arrived here possessing the lustre of all. The same Krishna had appeared in his true from before Vasudeva and then turned himself into the form of a child.

## \|\| 13.52-53 \|\|

*sāṃprataṃ sūtikāgārādājagāma tavālayam \|*  
*ayonisaṃbhavaścāyamāvirbhūto mahītale \|\| 52 \|\|*

*vāyupūrṇaṃ mātṛgarbhe kṛtvā ca māyayā hariḥ \|*  
*āvirbhūya vasuṃ mūrtiṃ darśayitvā jagāma ha \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Currently he has arrived here in labour room of your abode. This child has been born without any human contact over the earth. Before birth with his illusion, he had filled the womb of his mother with the wind. After appearing before Vasudeva, he displayed his true form and then became a child again.

## \|\| 13.54-56 \|\|

*yugeyuge varṇabhedo nāmabhedo'sya ballava \|*  
*śuklaḥ pītastathā rakta idānīṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ \|\| 54\|\|*

*śuklavarṇaḥ satyayuge sutīvratejasā vṛtaḥ \|*  
*tretāyāṃ raktavarṇo'yaṃ pīto'yaṃ dvāpare vibhuḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kalau śrīmāṃstejasāṃ rāśireva ca \|*  
*paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma tena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

54-56. О Vallabha, the boy appeared with the different names and the different forms, combining him the complexion of whiteness, yellowness and redness. He has appeared as Krishna in the Satyayuga. Having been surrounded by the dazzling lustre he appeared with fair-complexion. In the Tretdyuga he appeared with red-complexion and Dvdpara he appeared with yellow-complexion in the Kaliyuga he appeared in dark-complexion in the Tretayuga he combined in him all the lustre as a complete Brahma; that is why he has been given of Krishna.

## \|\| 13.57 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vācakaḥ ko'yamṛkāro'naṃtavācakaḥ \|*  
*śivasya vācakaḥ ṣaśca nakāro dharmavācakaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. in the word Krishna appears form the form of Brahma, 4 stand for unlimited, It stand for Shiva and vi stands for dharma.

## \|\| 13.58 \|\|

*akāro viṣṇuvacanaḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ \|*  
*naranārāyaṇārthasya visargo vācakaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Even otherwise st: stands for Vishnu, the dweller of Shveta-dvipa and the voiceless aspiration (visarga) stands for Nara-narayana.

## \|\| 13.59 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ rāśiḥ sarvamūrtisvarūpakaḥ \|*  
*sarvādhāraḥ sarvabījastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. This happens to be the lustre of all the gods, the form of all the gods, the base of all and the seed of all. That is why he is called Krishna.

## \|\| 13.60-61 \|\|

*karmanirmūlavacanaḥ kṛṣirno dāsyavācakaḥ \|*  
*akāro dātṛvacanastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kṛṣirniśceṣṭavacano nakāro bhaktivācakaḥ \|*  
*akāraḥ prāptivacanastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. The other interpretation is that stands for the destruction of all the deeds and ^ stands for the devotion for the one who bestows the devotion or his slavehood. зт is used for the one who is the bestower. Therefore he has been given the name of Krishna. According to other interpretation stands for lifeless and 4 stands for his devotion while зт stands for the getting of the same. Therefore he has been called Krishna.

## \|\| 13.62 \|\|

*kṛṣirnirvāṇavacano nakāro mokṣavācakaḥ \|*  
*akāro dātṛvacanastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. In an other interpretation ^4. stands for redemption and vj stands for moksa while stands for the giver, earning him the name of Krishna.

## \|\| 13.63 \|\|

*nāmnāṃ bhagavato naṃda koṭīnāṃ smaraṇena yat \|*  
*tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ kṛṣṇeti smaraṇe naraḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The merit one gets by reciting the name of the crores of the gods, one get the same merit by simply reciting the name of Krishna.

## \|\| 13.64 \|\|

*yadvidhaṃ smaraṇātpuṇyaṃ vacanācchravaṇāttathā \|*  
*koṭijanmāṃhaso nāśo bhavedyatsmaraṇādikāt \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The merit one gets with the reciting of the name of Krishna, the same merit is achieved by collective recitation and listening to the same. With the reciting of the name of Krishna the sins of crores of births disappear.

## \|\| 13.65 \|\|

*viṣṇornāmnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam \|*  
*kṛṣṇeti suṃdaraṃ nāma maṃgalaṃ bhaktidāyakam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Of all the name of Vishnu, the name Krishna happens to be more purposeful and the eternal tattva. The name Krishna is quite beautiful, bestower of welfare and the devotion.

## \|\| 13.66-67 \|\|

*kakāroccāraṇādbhaktaḥ kaivalyaṃ mṛtyujanmaham \|*  
*ṛkārāddāsyamatulaṃ ṣakārādbhaktimīpsitām \|\| 66\|\|*

*nakārātsahavāsaṃ ca tatsamaṃ kālameva ca \|*  
*tatsārūpyaṃ visargācca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. With the reciting of the letter чг one achieves salvation devoid of birth and death. With sg one gets eternal slavehood, which ч one gets the devotion and with the recitation of ч one is combined with the lord and voiceless (visarga) stands for SarQpya salvation. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 13.68-69 \|\|

*kakāroccāraṇādeva vepaṃte yamakiṃkarāḥ \|*  
*ṛkārokterna tiṣṭhaṃti ṣakārātpātakāni ca \|\| 68 \|\|*

*nakāroccāraṇādrogā akārānmṛtyureva ca \|*  
*dhruvaṃ sarve palāyaṃte nāmoccāraṇabhīravaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. With the reciting of the letter чг the messengers of Yama they can never be stable and with the delighting of 4 their condition become precarious and with the reciting of ч all the ailments disappear, with the reciting of ^ all the ailment disappear and with the reciting of 3t death disappear. Because with the reciting of the name of the lord, the messengers of Yama run away getting frightened.

## \|\| 13.70-71 \|\|

*smṛtyuktiśravaṇodyogātkṛṣṇanāmno vrajeśvara \|*  
*rathaṃ gṛhītvā dhāvaṃti golokātkṛṣṇakiṃkarāḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*pṛthivyā rajasaḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ śaktā vipaścitaḥ \|*  
*nāmnaḥ prabhāvasaṃkhyānaṃ saṃto vaktuṃ na ca kṣamāḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. О lord of Vraja, with the reciting of the name of Krishna his messengers rush from Goloka mounted on the chariot; the intelligent people can perhaps count the particles of dust on earth but the glory and influence of the name of the lord us beyond counting.

## \|\| 13.72-73 \|\|

*purā śaṃkaravaktreṇa nāmno'sya mahimā śrutaḥ \|*  
*guṇānnāmaprabhāvaṃ ca kiṃcijjānāti madguruḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*brahmā'naṃtaśca dharmaśca surarṣimanumānavāḥ \|*  
*vedāḥ saṃto na jānaṃti mahimnaḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. In the earlier times, I had heard the glory of this name, from the mouth of lord Shiva, my teacher who is aware of the influence of this name to some extent. Brahma, Shesha, Dharma, gods, the sages, Manus, humans, the Vedas and noble people are not aware of even one-sixteenth of the glory of that name.

## \|\| 13.74 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathito naṃda mahimā ca sutasya ca \|*  
*yathāmati yathājñānaṃ guruvaktrādyathā śrutam \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. O Nanda, I have recited the glory of your son according to my intelligence whatever was heard by me from the mouth oi.ny teacher.

## \|\| 13.75-80 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ kaṃsadhvaṃsī ca viṣṭaraśravāḥ \|*  
*devakīnaṃdanaḥ śrīśo yaśodānaṃdano hariḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

*sanātano'cyuto'naṃtaḥ sarveśaḥ sarvarūpadhṛk \|*  
*sarvādhāraḥ sarvagatiḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*rādhābaṃdhū rādhikātmā rādhikājīvanaṃ svayam \|*  
*rādhāprāṇo rādhikeśo rādhikāramaṇaḥ svayam \|\| 77 \|\|*

*rādhikāsahacārī ca rādhāmānasapuraṇaḥ \|*  
*rādhādhano rādhikāṅgo rādhikāsaktamānasaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*rādhikāciktacoraśca rādhāprāṇādhika: prabhuḥ \|*  
*paripūrṇatamaṃ brahama govindo garaḍadhvajaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*nāmānyetāni kṛṣṇasya śrutāni manmukhāddhṛdi \|*  
*janmamṛtyuharāṇyeva rakṣa naṃda śubhekṣaṇa \|\| 80 \|\|*

75-80. Lord Krishna is also known with the names of Krishna, pltambara, KamsadhvarhsI, Vist arasravah, Devakinandana, Srisa, Yashoda-nandana, Hari, Sanatana, Acyuta, Ananta, Sarvesa, the one who takes to any form, the base of everyone, omnipresence, the cause of all, the cause, the beloved of Radha, the soul of Radha, the life of Radha, the one who enjoys company of Radha, the companion of Radha, the one who fulfils the desires of Radha , the treasure of Radha , limb of Radha the one whose mind is attracted towards Radha, the one who steals away the mind of Radha, one who protects the life of Radha, the great lord, the complete Brahman, Govinda, Garuda-dhvaja and Krishna which you have listened from my mouth. You keep them in mind. О virtues Nanda, these names steal away the life and death from a person.

## \|\| 13.81-85 \|\|

*kṛtaṃ nirūpaṇaṃ nāmnāṃ kaniṣṭhasya yathā śrutam \|*  
*jyeṣṭhasya halino nāmnaḥ saṃketaṃ śṛṇu manmukhāt \|\| 81 \|\|*

*garbhasaṃkarṣaṇādeva nāmnā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*nāstyaṃto'syaiva vedeṣu tenānaṃta iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*baladevo balodrekāddhalī ca haladhāraṇāt \|*  
*śitivāsā nīlavāsānmusalī musalāyudhāt \|\| 83 \|\|*

*revatyā saha saṃbhogādrevatīramaṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*rohiṇīgarbhavāsāttu rauhiṇeyo mahāmatiḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ jyeṣṭhaputrasya śrutaṃ nāma niveditam \|*  
*yāsyāmyahaṃ gṛhaṃ naṃda sukhaṃ tiṣṭha svamaṃdire \|\| 85 \|\|*

81-85. Thus I have narrated to you the names of your younger son; now I shall speak about the names of your elder son Haladhara from my mouth. Because of the extraction of the foetus from the womb he is known as Sarnkarsana, he is endless and that is why he is called Ananta in the Vedas. Because of his possessing great prowess, he is also know as Baladeva. Since he carries the plough, he is known as Haladhara. Because he is clad in blue garment, he is known as Nllambara, Because of his holding Musala he is called Musall. Because of his association with Revati, he is known as Revati-Ramana. He is called Rauhineya because of his remaining in the womb of Rohinl. Thus I have given the name of your elder son also according to what I had heard from my teacher. О Nanda, I shall now proceed on to my abode, you remain comfortably in your abode.

The demons and the sages which provides salvation to all, the latter т of Radha relieves one of the sins accumulated during crores of his births.

With the reciting of the name of Radha or listening to it, by narrating and reciting it, one is relieved of the net of illusion, the ailments, grief, death and even Yama gets terrified from him. 114-119. (These things will fonn part of Krishnallla) Yamalarjuna, the son of Kubera would be redeemed. Krishna will eat the butter, by stealing it. The stealing of the robes of cowherdesses, completing their vrata returning their robes to them, lord Krishna shall steal away their hearts and would attract them towards himself. Thereafter, he would engage himself in the divine dance with the ladies, in the spring season. On the full moon night, he will have the conjugal pleasure with the cowherdesses and fulfilling their desires he will enjoy the water-sport with them.

121-123. He would then proceed on to Mathura increasing the grief of the cowherdesses. He would come again to convince the cowherdesses and impart divine knowledge to them. He would protect AkrQra and his chariot. Thereafter mounted on the chariot and accompanied by the brother and the father besides the people of Vraja, he would cross the Yamuna and reach Mathura. In the water of the Yamuna he would display his divine from to AkrQra bestowing him the divine knowledge.

## \|\| 13.124-126 \|\|

Thereafter convincing both of you he would re-establish Ugrasena as the king of Mathura.

127\. He would relieve the woman of the grief by imparting the divine knowledge to them. The thread ceremony of both the brothers would them be performed by the family priest and they will also start the studies.

128-130. Thereafter, he would restore the dead son back to his teacher. Thereafter, cheating the royal guards he would kill the Yavana king and also provide salvation to Mucukunda playfully. He would to Dvaraka together with Yadavas and then enjoy love-sports with the ladies increasing their fortune and the son of grandsons.

131-132. He would earn a false blemish of stealing a diamond and then help the Pandavas. Relieving the earth of her burden he would attend the Rajashuya-yajna of Yudhisthira. Then he would steal away the Parijata tree from the heaven of Indra shattering his pride.

Remove the poverty of a Brahmana, restore the dead child of a Brahmana, subjugating the wicked people and shall proceed on the pilgrimage and shall meet you also.

## \|\| 13.136-140 \|\|

*kṛtvā ca rādhayā sārdhaṃ vrajamāgamitā punaḥ \|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ naṃda bhaviṣyaṃ vedanirṇayam \|*

136-140. Thereafter, he would visit Vraja with Radha again. He would then send to Dvaraka his prime Goloka. Thereafter, accomplishing all the tasks, he would return to Goloka together with Radha. Narayana too would proceed to Vaikuntha accompanied with you. Both Narayana and Dharnia would go to the abode of lord Vishnu in the ocean of milk. О Nanda, I have thus narrated to you all the happenings of the future as foretold in the Vedas. Now you listen to me, the purpose of my arrival here. On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of the month of Magha, the required ceremony should be performed for both the boys. It is Thursday with the Revati constellation. Besides the moon and the stars would be quite with quite favourable.

## \|\| 13.141-142 \|\|

141-142. Thereafter, the moon is placed in mxna-lagna with the full vision. The karana named vanija is also available on that day and the time therefore is quite auspicious. Such a muhurta is difficult to get. All the best and the useful, yoga are combined at that time. Therefore in consultation with the learned people you complete this ceremony delightfully.

144-150. In the meantime all the cowherds, cowherdesses, boy and girls arrived in the abode of Nanda in order to meet the sage Garga. They found Garga to be emitting lustre like the mid-day of the summer season, surrounded with his pupils and the divine lustre emerging from his face. He was removing the doubts of the siddhas who questioned him variously. With his yogic powers he could visualise the happenings of the past, present and future. The divine from of the lord for achieving whom the ascetics meditate upon for long the same lord was looked by him occupying the lap of Yashoda. The form of the lord which he could see with the dhyanam, provided to him by Shiva, the same lord who fulfilled the desires of all, was blissful, was seen by him delightfully with his mind filled with emotions and the hair standing on their ends. He was engrossed in the devotion of the lord. He was adoring the lord offering pfija to him mentally.

153-157. Thereafter, he arranged for curd, milk, ghee, guda, oil, honey, butter, butter-milk, sugar and the water from all available in streams. Thereafter, the best quality of rice brought in heaps like the mountains, besides the fried rice, seven mountains of salt, seven mountains of sugar, seven mountains of sweet balls. Made of the flour of wheat and barley, pindas, modakas and the mountains of svastika and other eatables.

## \|\| 13.158-161 \|\|

*kapardakānāmatyuccaiḥ śailānsapta ca nārada \|*  
*karpūrādikayuktānāṃ tāṃbūlānāṃ ca maṃdiram \|\| 158 \|\|*

*vistṛtaṃ dvārahīnaṃ ca vāsitodakasaṃyutam \|*  
*caṃdanāgurukastūrīkaṃkumena samanvitam \|\| 159 \|\|*

*nānāvidhāni ratnāni svarṇāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*muktāphalāni ramyāṇi pravālāni mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 160 \|\|*

*nānāvidhāni cārūṇi vāsāṃsi bhūṣaṇāni ca \|*  
*putrānnaprāśane nandaḥ kārayāmāsa kautukāt \|\| 161 \|\|*

158-161. О Narada, there were seven mountains of small conches. The betels were arranged with camphor and lodged in a house having no doors. There was a store of fragrant water, in which sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl and saffron were mixed. Various types of diamonds pearls, sapphire, beautiful clothes and ornaments were arranged by Nanda for the Annaprasana ceremony of his sons.

## \|\| 13.162-167 \|\|

*saṃskārayuktaṃ ruciraṃ candanadravacarcitam \|*  
*prāṅgaṇaṃ kadalīstambhai rasālanavapallavaiḥ \|\| 162 \|\|*

*grathitaiḥ sūkṣmavastreṇa veṣṭayāmāsa kautukāt \|*  
*yuktaṃ maṅgalakumbhaiśca phalapallavasaṃyutaiḥ \|\| 163 \|\|*

*candanā'gurukastūrīpuṣpamālāvirājitaiḥ \|*  
*mālyānāṃ varavastrāṇāṃ rāśibhiśca virājitam \|\| 164 \|\|*

*gavāṃ ca madhuparkāṇāmāsanānāṃ ca nārada \|*  
*phalānāṃ jalakumbhānāṃ samūhaiśca samanvitam \|\| 165 \|\|*

*nānāprakārairvādyaiśca durlabhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ \|*  
*ḍhakkānāṃ dundubhīnāṃ ca paṭahānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 166 \|\|*

*mṛdaṅgamurajādīnāmānakānāṃ samūhakaiḥ \|*  
*vaṃśīsannahanīkāṃsyaśarayantraiśca śabditam \|\| 167 \|\|*

162-167. The court-yard was cleared and beautifully decorated. The water mixed with sandal-paste was sprinkled there. The trunks of banana trees were arranged and the strings knitting the tender leaves of mango trees were made to decorate the place besides the banners of fine clothes were made to decorate the court-yard. The kalasas of welfare filled with water were consecrated at suitable spots, the fruits and tender leaves were placed over the necks of the kalasas beautifully decorating them with sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl and garlands of flowers. Several types of garlands and costumes were arranged in the court-yard. The cows, madhuparka, asana, fruits and pitchers of waters were also placed there. Various types of charming musical instrument including small drums, big drums, double-drums and others besides the flutes, were made to play.

## \|\| 13.168-169 \|\|

*vidyādharīṇāṃ nṛtyena bhṛṅgimābhramaṇena ca \|*  
*gaṃdharvanāyakānāṃ ca saṃgītairmūrcchanāyutaiḥ \|\| 168 \|\|*

*svarṇasiṃhāsanānāṃ ca rathānāṃ niḥsvanairyutam \|*  
*etasminnantare nandamuvāca vācako mudā \|\| 169 \|\|*

168-169. The Vidyadharls started dancing in various postures and the Gandharvas played in musical instruments seated on golden lion-thrones and the chariots. The abode of Nanda was looking quite graceful. At that point of time Nanda spoke to the messenger delightfully.

## \|\| 13.170-171 \|\|

*ājagmurballavendrāśca bāndhavā ballavāstathā \|*  
*aśvasthāśca gajasthāśca rathasthāśceti satvaram \|\| 170 \|\|*

*ājagmū rājaputrāśca ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ \|*  
*āgato giribhānuśca sastrīkaśca sakiṅkaraḥ \|\| 171 \|\|*

170-171. All your relatives and the cowherds have arrived. Some of them arrived mounted over the horses, elephants and the chariots, many of the princes arrived adorned with the gem-studded ornaments.

## \|\| 13.172-174 \|\|

*rathānāṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ gajānāṃ ca tathaiva ca \|*  
*turaṅgamāṇāṃ koṭiśca śibikānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 172 \|\|*

*ṛṣīndrāṇāṃ munīndrāṇāṃ viprāṇāṃ ca vipaścitām \|*  
*bandināṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ ca samūhaiśca samīpataḥ \|\| 173 \|\|*

*gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca saṃkhyā kartuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*paśyāgatya bahirbhūyetyuvāca prāṅgaṇe sthitaḥ \|\| 174 \|\|*

172-174. Giribhanu had also arrived with his wife and the servants, with the four lakhs of chariots, four lakhs of elephants, a crore of horses, a crores of palanquins had arrived together with a large number of ascetics, sages, men of learnings Brahmanas, bards and the beggars. Who could be competent enough to spell out the number of cowherds and cowherdesses. You come out of the court-yard and have a look for yourself. The messenger spoke all this standing in the court-yard.

## \|\| 13.175 \|\|

*śrutvaivaṃ tānupavrajya samānīya vrajeśvaraḥ \|*  
*prāṅgaṇe vāsayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa satvaram \|\| 175 \|\|*

175\. On hearing this Nanda the lord of the Vraja himself went to the place to welcome them and offered them suitable seats adoring them at the same time.

## \|\| 13.176 \|\|

*ṛṣyādikasamūhaṃ ca praṇamya śirasā bhuvi \|*  
*vastubhirbandhubhiḥ pūrṇaṃ babhūva nandagokulam \|\| 176 \|\|*

176\. He prostrated before the ascetics offering them the customary padyci and arghya.

## \|\| 13.177-178 \|\|

*vastubhirbandhubhiḥ pūrṇaṃ babhūva nandagokulam \|*  
*na ko'pi kasya śabdaṃ ca śrotuṃ śaktaśca tatra vai \|\| 177 \|\|*

*trimuhūrtaṃ kuberaśca śrīkṛṣṇaprītaye mudā \|*  
*cakāra svarṇavṛṣṭyā ca paripūrṇaṃ ca gokulam \|\| 178 \|\|*

177-178. At that point of time the city of Gokula of Nanda was very much over-crowded with the people and the stuffs that nobody could hear the words of others. Kubera, on the other hand showered the rain of gold in honour of the birth of lord Krishna with which the entire Gokula was filled.

## \|\| 13.179 \|\|

*kautukāpahnavaṃ cakrurbandhuvargāśca krīḍayā \|*  
*ānamrakandharāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā nandasya sampadam \|\| 179 \|\|*

179\. It was all surprising looking at the riches of Nanda. All his relatives were feeling complacent and they concealed their anxiety by indulging in various types of sports.

## \|\| 13.180-181 \|\|

*nandaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ pūto dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|*  
*candanāgurukastūrī kuṅkumenaiva bhūṣitaḥ \|\| 180 \|\|*

*uvāsa pādau prakṣālya svarṇapīṭhe manohare \|*  
*gargasya ca munīndrāṇāṃ gṛhītvā''jñāṃ vrajeśvaraḥ \|\| 181 \|\|*

180-181. Nanda on his part purified himself after performing the daily routine and was clad in two washed garment. The sandal-paste, aguru, kastUri and saffron we applied on his body. He then took his seat on the golden pedestal washing his feet with the permission of the sages.

## \|\| 13.182-184 \|\|

*saṃsmṛtya viṣṇumācāṃtaḥ svastivācanapūrvakam \|*  
*kṛtvā karma ca vedoktaṃ bhojayāmāsa bālakam \|\| 182 \|\|*

*gargavākyānusāreṇa bālakasya mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇeti maṅgalaṃ nāma rarakṣa ca śubhe kṣaṇe \|\| 183 \|\|*

*saghṛtaṃ bhojayitvā ca kṛtvā nāma jagatpateḥ \|*  
*vādyāni vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam \|\| 184 \|\|*

182-184. He sipped the water, reciting the name of the lord and after performing svastivacana and other Vedic rites, he fed the boy with food, according to the advise of Garga. The boy was given the name of Krishna in an auspicious time, after the names giving ceremony of the lord, he was served with food containing ghee. The musical instruments were sounded besides performing other welfare ceremonies.

## \|\| 13.185 \|\|

*nānāvidhāni svarṇāni dhanāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*bhakṣyadravyāṇi vāsāṃsi brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā \|\| 185 \|\|*

185\. Various types of charities were distributed by Nanda to the Brahmanas including gold, eatables and the costumes.

## \|\| 13.186 \|\|

*bandibhyo bhikṣukebhyaśca suvarṇaṃ vipulaṃ dadau \|*  
*bhārākrāntāśca te sarve na śaktā gantumeva ca \|\| 186 \|\|*

186\. The prisoners and the beggars were supplied with gold in abundance and they were unable to carry the weight for themselves.

## \|\| 13.187 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbandhuvargāṃśca bhikṣukāṃśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa paripūrṇaṃ manoharam \|\| 187 \|\|*

187\. The complete and the best of food including the sweets was served to Brahmanas, relatives and the beggars.

## \|\| 13.188 \|\|

*dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ caiva khādyatāṃ khādyatāmiti \|*  
*babhūva śabdo'tyuccaiśca satataṃ nandagokule \|\| 188 \|\|*

188\. At that point of time only words heard in Gokula were "give me" and "eat more". Therefore, there was a huge noise.

## \|\| 13.189-190 \|\|

*ratnāni paripūrṇāni vāsāṃsi bhūṣaṇāni ca \|*  
*pravālāni suvarṇāni maṇisārāṇi yāni ca \|\| 189 \|\|*

*cārūṇi svarṇapātrāṇi kṛtāni viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*gatvā gargāya vinayaṃ cakāra vrajapuṃgavaḥ \|\| 190 \|\|*

189-190. Nanda then delightfully gave away in charity large number of gems, costumes, ornaments, diamonds, gold, the best of the gems and the gold vases made by Vishvakarma.

## \|\| 13.191 \|\|

*śiṣyebhyaḥ svarṇabhārāṇi pradadau vinayānvitaḥ \|*  
*dvijebhyo'pyavaśiṣṭebhyaḥ paripūrṇāni nārada \|\| 191 \|\|*

191\. He also gave in abundance the gold to the pupils of the sages and the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 13.192-193 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*gṛhītvā śrīhariṃ gargo jagāma nibhṛtaṃ mudā \|*  
*tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā praṇamya ca tamīśvaram \|\| 192 \|\|*

*sāśrunetraḥ sapulako bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvovāca kṛṣṇapadāṃbuje \|\| 193 \|\|*

192-193. Narayana said – Garga then took Srihari in a secluded place and with his mind filled with devotion, he started offering prayers to him with the tears flowing from his eyes and hair on his body standing and ends. His mind was filled with devotion and adoring at the feet of Krishna he stood therewith folded hands.

## \|\| 13.194 \|\|

*garga uvāca \|*  
*he kṛṣṇa jagatāṃ nātha bhaktānāṃ bhayabhañjana \|*  
*prasanno bhava māmīśa dehi dāsyaṃ padāmbuje \|\| 194 \|\|*

194\. Garga said – О Krishna, О lord of the universe, О remover of the fear of the devotees, О lord, you kindly bestow the slavehood of your feet to me.

## \|\| 13.195 \|\|

*tvatpitrā me dhanaṃ dattaṃ tena me kiṃ prayojanam \|*  
*dehi me niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ bhaktānāmabhayaprada \|\| 195 \|\|*

195\. You bestow protection to your devotees. In case your father has offered some riches to me but the same is of no consequence to me, you kindly bestow your unfading devotion.

## \|\| 13.196 \|\|

*aṇimādikasiddhiṣu yogeṣu muktiṣu prabho \|*  
*jñānatattve'maratve vā kiñcinnāsti spṛhā mama \|\| 196 \|\|*

196\. O lord, the siddhis like anima, yogic practices, the salvation, the learnings and or becoming immortal are not at all desired by me.

## \|\| 13.197 \|\|

*indratve vā manutve vā svargalokaphale ciram \|*  
*nāsti me manaso vāñchā tvatpādasevanaṃ vinā \|\| 197 \|\|*

197\. without serving at your feet I consider the position of Indra, Manu or the heaven hardly to attract me.

## \|\| 13.198 \|\|

*sālokyaṃ sārṣṭisārūpye sāmīpyaikatvamīpsitam \|*  
*nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi te brahmaṃstvatpādasevanaṃ vinā \|\| 198 \|\|*

198\. О Brahman, without serving at your feet, I consider Salokya, Sarsti, Sarupya, Samlpya and Ekatva type of salvation to be of no consequence.

## \|\| 13.199 \|\|

*goloke vāpi pātāle vāse nāsti manorathaḥ \|*  
*kintu te caraṇāmbhoje santataṃ smṛtirastu me \|\| 199 \|\|*

199\. I have desired to dwell in the Goloka or in the nether world. My only desire is that I should always remain devoted at your feet.

## \|\| 13.200-201 \|\|

*tvanmantraṃ śaṅkarātprāpya katijanmaphalodayāt \|*  
*sarvajño'haṃ sarvadarśī sarvatra gatirastu me \|\| 200 \|\|*

*kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho dīnabandho padāmbuje \|*  
*rakṣa māmabhayaṃ dattvā mṛtyurme kiṃ kariṣyati \|\| 201 \|\|*

200-201. As a result of the tapas perfonned by me during many earlier births and.as a result of the merit of the some, I achieved your mantra from Shiva, as a result of which I have become all knowledgeable and can look at everything. Besides I can move any where I like. A ocean of mercy, О lord of the down-trodden, be merciful on me. Providing me all protection, give me a place under your feet. Because in that case I shall not be afraid of the death.

## \|\| 13.202 \|\|

*sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ sarvastvatpādāmbhojasevayā \|*  
*mṛtyuñjayo'ntakālaśca babhūva yogināṃ guruḥ \|\| 202 \|\|*

202\. By serving at your feet Shiva became the lord of all over coming death and the destroyer of Yama besides being the teacher of the yogis.

## \|\| 13.203 \|\|

*brahmā vidhātā jagatāṃ tvatpādāmbhojasevayā \|*  
*yasyaikadivase brahmanpatantīndrāścaturdaśa \|\| 203 \|\|*

203\. O Brahman, by serving at your feet Brahma became the creator of the universe whose one day equates with the life of fourteen Indras.

## \|\| 13.204 \|\|

*tvatpādasevayā dharmaḥ sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām \|*  
*pātā ca phaladātā ca jitvā kālaṃ sudurjayam \|\| 204 \|\|*

204\. By serving at your feet Dharma became the witness of all the deeds of the people besides being bestower of the results of all the deeds of the people.

## \|\| 13.205 \|\|

*sahasravadanaḥ śeṣo yatpādāmbujasevayā \|*  
*dhatte siddhārthavadviśvaṃ śivaḥ kaṇṭhe viṣaṃ yathā \|\| 205 \|\|*

205\. Because of his serving at your feet the thousand headed Shesha carried the earth like the seed of sheshamum and Shiva carries the poison in his throat.

## \|\| 13.206 \|\|

*sarvasaṃpadvidhātrī yā devīnāṃ ca parātparā \|*  
*karoti satataṃ lakṣmīḥ keśaistvatpādamārjanam \|\| 206 \|\|*

206\. Lakshmi who happens to be the best of the goddesses and creates all the riches, rinses, your feet with her hair.

## \|\| 13.207 \|\|

*prakṛtirbījarūpā sā sarveṣāṃ śaktirūpiṇī \|*  
*smāraṃsmāraṃ tvatpadābjaṃ babhūva tatparāvarā \|\| 207 \|\|*

207\. The one who is the form of seed of all, reflects the prowess, the same Prakriti always remains devoted at your feet.

## \|\| 13.208 \|\|

*pārvatī sarvarūpā sā sarveṣāṃ buddhirūpiṇī \|*  
*tvatpādasevayā kāntaṃ lalābha śivamīśvaram \|\| 208 \|\|*

208\. Parvati representing the intelligence of all the form of the universe achieved Shiva as her husband by serving at your feet.

## \|\| 13.209 \|\|

*vidyādhiṣṭhātrī devī yā jñānamātā sarasvatī \|*  
*pūjyā babhūva sarveṣāṃ saṃpūjya tvatpadāmbujam \|\| 209 \|\|*

209\. The goddess of learning and knowledge known as Sarasvati is being adored by the universe by the grace of your lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 13.210 \|\|

*sāvitrī vedajananī punāti bhuvanatrayam \|*  
*brahmaṇo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gatistvatpādasevayā \|\| 210 \|\|*

210\. Savitri, the mother of the Vedas and creator of Brahma and the Brahmanas was adored in the three worlds and became the most auspicious because of your grace.

## \|\| 13.211 \|\|

*kṣamā jagadvibhartuṃ ca ratnagarbhā vasundharā \|*  
*prasūtiḥ sarvasasyānāṃ tvatpādapadmasevayā \|\| 211 \|\|*

211\. The goddess Vasundhara, having the jewels and diamonds in her womb, was able to serve at your lotus-like feet besides being able to produce various types of cereals.

## \|\| 13.212 \|\|

*rādhā mamāṃśasaṃbhūtā tava tulyā ca tejasā \|*  
*sthitvā vakṣasi te pādaṃ sevate'nyasya kā kathā \|\| 212 \|\|*

212\. Radha who is born of your own amsha possessing the same lustre dwells, in your heart by serving at your feet, what to speak of others.

## \|\| 13.213 \|\|

*yathā śarvādayo devā devyaḥ padmādayo yathā \|*  
*sanāthaṃ kuru māmīśa īśvarasya samā kṛpā \|\| 213 \|\|*

213\. О lord, at you have graced the gods like Shiva and others and goddess like Laksm! and others, similarly you shower your grace on me because, the kindness of the lord spreads to everyone, equally.

## \|\| 13.214 \|\|

*na yāsyāmi gṛhaṃ nātha na gṛhṇāmi dhanaṃ tava \|*  
*kṛtvā māṃ rakṣa pādābjasevāyāṃ sevakaṃ ratam \|\| 214 \|\|*

214\. О lord, I shall neither go to my house nor shall I accept the riches offered to me. You kindly allow me to serve at your lotus-like feet always while protecting me.

## \|\| 13.215 \|\|

*iti stutvā sāśrunetraḥ papāta caraṇe hareḥ \|*  
*ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ bhaktyā pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ \|\| 215 \|\|*

215\. Thus offering prayers with tears in his eyes, the sage Garga fell at the feet of the lord and wept for a long time. At that point of time his body was filled with emotions and his hair stood and ends.

## \|\| 13.216 \|\|

*gargasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*uvāca taṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo mayi te bhaktirastviti \|\| 216 \|\|*

216\. On hearing the words of the sage Garga, the lord who is compassionate on his devotees smiled. Then lord Krishna said, "You be devoted to me always".

## \|\| 13.217 \|\|

*idaṃ gargakṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ smṛtiṃ ca labhate dhruvam \|\| 217 \|\|*

217\. Whosoever recites this stotra thrice a day, he achieves the deep devotion of Hari besides the slavehood of the lord.

## \|\| 13.218-219 \|\|

*janmamṛtyujarārogaśokamohādisaṃkaṭāt \|*  
*tīrṇo bhavati śrīkṛṣṇadāsasevanatatparaḥ \|\| 218 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇasya sahakālaṃ ca kṛṣṇasārddhaṃ ca modate \|*  
*kadācinna bhavettasya vicchedo hariṇā saha \|\| 219 \|\|*

218-219. Even a person who serves at the devotees of lord Kr§ria, he is freed from birth, death, old age, ailments, grief and illusion. He enjoys all the pleasures with lord Krishna till the lord remains of earth. He is never separated from the lord.

## \|\| 13.220-221 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*hariṃ muniḥ stavaṃ kṛtvā dadau nandāya taṃ mudā \|*  
*uvāca taṃ gṛhaṃ yāmi kurvājñāmiti ballava \|\| 220 \|\|*

*aho vicitraṃ saṃsāro mohajālena veṣṭitaḥ \|*  
*saṃmīlanaṃ ca viraho narāṇāṃ sindhuphenavat \|\| 221 \|\|*

220-221. Narayana said – The sage Garga after adoring Krishna handed him over to Nanda and said, "O cowherd, you permit me now to enable to proceed to my abode. Alas, how astonishing is this universe getting entangled in worldly attraction. In the universe, the meeting and separation of people is like the river and its water.".

## \|\| 13.222 \|\|

*gargasya vacanaṃ śrutvā ruroda nanda eva ca \|*  
*sadvicchedo hi sādhūnāṃ maraṇādatiricyate \|\| 222 \|\|*

222\. On hearing the words of Garga Nanda started crying because for noble people the separation from the sages is as painful as the death itself.

## \|\| 13.223-224 \|\|

*sarvaśiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ munīndraṃ gantumudyatam \|*  
*sarve nandādayo gopā rudantau gopikāstadā \|\| 223 \|\|*

*praṇemuḥ paramaprītyā cakrustaṃ vinayaṃ mune \|*  
*dattvā''śiṣaṃ muniśreṣṭho jagāma mathurāṃ mudā \|\| 224 \|\|*

223-224. Finding that the sage Garga was about to return with all his pupil, the cowherd Nanda besides other cowherdesses and cowherds, bowed in reverence to him. The sage after pronouncing his blessing on them delightfully, left the place and proceeded on to Mathura.

## \|\| 13.225 \|\|

*ṛṣayo munayaścaiva bandhuvargāśca ballavāḥ \|*  
*sarve jagmurdhanaiḥ pūrṇāḥ svālayaṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ \|\| 225 \|\|*

225\. All other sages, ascetics, relatives and Vallabhas, retreated to their respective abodes delightfully carrying enormous riches with them.

## \|\| 13.226 \|\|

*prajagmurbandinaḥ sarve paripūrṇamanorathāḥ \|*  
*miṣṭadravyāṃśukotkṛṣṭaturagasvarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 226 \|\|*

226\. Getting fully satisfied with the sweets, beverages, clothes, the base of horses, ornaments of gold, all the bards went back to their respective abodes.

## \|\| 13.227 \|\|

*ākaṇṭhapūrṇā bhuktyā ca bhikṣukā gantumakṣamā \|*  
*svarṇavastrabharodrekapariśrāntā mudā'nvitāḥ \|\| 227 \|\|*

227\. The beggars had taken food to their full and carrying gold, ornaments with them they were unable to move because of the weight carried by them.

## \|\| 13.228 \|\|

*sumandagāminaḥ kecitkecidbhūmau ca śerate \|*  
*kecidvartmani tiṣṭhantaścottiṣṭhantaśca kecana \|\| 228 \|\|*

228\. Some of the beggars delightfully moved on slowly, some of them started sleeping on the ground and some of them covering the distance of their journey by sitting or were standing occasionally.

## \|\| 13.229-230 \|\|

*kecidūṣuḥ pramuditā hasantastatra kecana \|*  
*kapardakānāṃ vastūnāṃ śeṣāṃścorvaritānbahūn \|\| 229 \|\|*

*kecittānādaduḥ sthitvā darśayantaśca kecana \|*
