## \|\| 14.53-54 \|\|

*rambhā ca mānavaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā svargaṃ jagāma ha \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vṛkṣārjunavibhañjanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*nalakūbaramokṣaśca rambhāyāśca mahāmune \|*  
*puṇyadaṃ kṛṣṇacaritaṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamaparaṃ kathayāmi te \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. Thus Rambha reverted to the heaven after leaving the human body. I have narrated to you the falling of the Arjuna tree. О great sage, the story of Nalakubara and Rambha bestows salvation and relieves one of the birth, death and old age, providing great merit to the listener. I have thus narrated to you a part of the story of lord Krishna now I am narrating the story to you further.

## Chapter 15

## \|\| 15.1 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā kṛṣṇasahito nando vṛndāvanaṃ yayau \|*  
*tatropavanabhāṇḍīre cārayāmāsa godhanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – Once Nanda, accompanied by Krishna went to Vrindavana. There was a garden named Bhandlra, where the cows were made to graze.

## \|\| 15.2-3 \|\|

*saraḥ susvādutoyaṃ ca pāyayāmāsa tatpapau \|*  
*uvāsa vṛkṣamūle ca bālaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

*etasminnantare kṛṣṇo māyāmānuṣavigrahaḥ \|*  
*cakāra māyayā'kasmānmeghācchannaṃ nabho mune \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. They made the cows to drink delicious water from the tank which they also drank. Thereafter embracing the child, Nanda sat under the shade of a tree. О sage, at the same time Krishna who had the illusory body covered the sky with clouds by means of illusion.

## \|\| 15.4-6 \|\|

*meghāvṛtaṃ nabho dṛṣṭvā śyāmalaṃ kānanāntaram \|*  
*jhaṃjhāvātaṃ mahāśabdaṃ vajraśabdaṃ ca dāruṇam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vṛṣṭidhārāmatisthūlāṃ kampamānāṃśca pādapān \|*  
*dṛṣṭvaivaṃ patitaskandhānnando bhayamavāpa ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kathaṃ yāsyāmi govatsānvihāya svāśramaṃ bata \|*  
*gṛhaṃ yadi na yāsyāmi bhavitā bālakasya kim \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. The sky was over-cast with clouds. There was all darkness in the garden and it started. Raining heavily with strong mind. The cloud started thundering. Their thundering resembled the fall of vajra. Torrential rain started and the trees started trembling together with their branches, this frightened Nanda he thought that how could be leave for his abode, leaving the cows and the calves there but if he did not return to his abode, what could happen to the child.

## \|\| 15.7 \|\|

*evaṃ nande pravadati ruroda śrīharistadā \|*  
*payobhiyā hariścaiva pituḥ kaṇṭhaṃ dadhāra saḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. When Nanda was so thinking Krishna started crying and stuck to the body of Nanda, his father in terror.

## \|\| 15.8 \|\|

*etasminnantare rādhā''jagāma kṛṣṇa sannidhim \|*  
*gamanaṃ kuvanī rājahaṃsakhañjanagañjanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In the meantime Radha came to Krishna and while walking she put the goose to shame.

## \|\| 15.9 \|\|

*śaratpārvaṇacandrābhāmuṣṭavaktramanoharā \|*  
*śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāmocanalocanā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. She had beautiful face stealing the lustre of the full moon of the winter season, and her eyes resembled the full moon or the lotus flower of the winter season blossoming at noon.

## \|\| 15.10 \|\|

*paritastārakāpakṣmavicitrakajjaloñjvalā \|*  
*khagenadracajcucāruprīśaṃsānāśakanāsikā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Both her eyes were decorated with collyrium. Her nose resembled the beak of Garuda and its beauty could put the glory of Lakshmi to shame,

## \|\| 15.11 \|\|

*tanmadhyasthalaśobhārha sthūlamuktāphalojjvalā \|*  
*kabarīveṣasaṃyuktā mālatīmālyaveṣṭitā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In the centre of the nose a pearl was hanging which was emitting lustre, her hair was decorated with the garlands of jasmine flowers.

## \|\| 15.12 \|\|

*grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaprabhāmuṣṭakakuṇḍalā \|*  
*pakvabimbaphalānāṃ ca śrīmuṣṭādharayugmakā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. He had two kundalas which resembled the lustre of the mid-day sun of the summer season. Her lips resembled the ripe wood apple.

## \|\| 15.13 \|\|

*muktāpaṅaktiprabhātaikadantapadaktisamujjvalā \|*  
*īṣatmaphullakundānāṃ suprabhānāśakasmitā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. And her line of teeth resembled the gems. She wore a smile over her face which put the glory of the bud to shame.

## \|\| 15.14 \|\|

*kastūrībindusaṃyukta sindūrabindubhūṣitā \|*  
*kapālaṃ mallikāyuktaṃ bibhratī śrīyutaṃ satī \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. She had a spot of KastUrl on her head together with that of vermilion. Her cheeks were decorated with jasmine flowers.

## \|\| 15.15 \|\|

*sucāruvartulākārakapolapulakānvitā \|*  
*maṇiratnendrasārāṇāṃ hāroraḥsthalabhūṣitā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. She felt emotional on her roundish cheeks. The breasts were decorated with the garland of best of gems.

## \|\| 15.16 \|\|

*sucāruśrīphalayugakaṭhinastanasaṃgatā \|*  
*patrāvalīśriyā yuktā dīptā sadratnatejasā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Her breasts were quite round and stiff decorated with leaves and were illumined with the gem.

## \|\| 15.17 \|\|

*sucāruvartulākāramudaraṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*vicitratrivalīyuktaṃ nimnanābhiṃ ca bibhratī \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Her belly was beautiful roundish, quite pleasant, astonishing and had three lines on it. The navel was quite deep.

## \|\| 15.18 \|\|

*sadralasāraracitamekhalājālabhūṣitā \|*  
*kāmāsrasārabhūbhaṅgayogīndaracittamohinī \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. There was a waist band decorating the waist which was studded with best of gems. Her curved eye-brows look like the weapons of the gods of love which could make the minds of even the sages to become unstable.

## \|\| 15.19-21 \|\|

*kaṭhinaśroṇiyugalaṃ dharaṇīdharaninditam \|*  
*sthalapadmaprabhāmuṣṭacaraṇaṃ dadhatī mudā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ratnabhūṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ yāvakadravasaṃyutam \|*  
*maṇīndraśobhāsaṃmuṣṭasālaktakapunarbhavam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sadratnasāraracitakvaṇanmañjīra rañjitam \|*  
*ratnakaṅkaṇakeyūracāruśaṅkhavibhūṣitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. The pelvic region was well developed and put the mountain to shame. She had the feet which were more beautiful then even the lotus flowers. Her feet wore the anklets and they were painted with the beautiful paint. Her nails of the feet quite beautiful and were shining immensely, the anklets were studded with the best of gems which created sound, she wore the armlets, anklets on the arms and the bangles of beautiful conch.

## \|\| 15.22-23 \|\|

*ratnāṅgulīyanikaravahniśuddhāṃśukojvalā \|*  
*cārucampakapuṣpāṇāṃ prabhā muṣṭakalevarā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sahasradalasaṃyuktakrīḍākamalamujjvalam \|*  
*śrīmukhaśrīdarśanārthaṃ bibhratī ratnadarpaṇam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. The fingers on his rings were emitting lustre like the fire. The beauty of her limbs surpassed the campaka flowers. In one of her hands, she was carrying a thousand petalled lotus which was best for the sport and in the other, she was carrying a mirror in order to look her reflection in the mirror.

## \|\| 15.24 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nirjane nando vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau \|*  
*candrakoṭiprabhāmuṣṭāṃ bhāsayantīṃ diśo daśa \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Nanda was extremely surprised on finding her there because she was illumining the entire universe with her lustre rendering the lustre of crores of moons to be of no consequence.

## \|\| 15.25 \|\|

*nanāma tāṃ sāśrunetro bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|*  
*jānāmi tvāṃ gargamukhātpadmādhikapriyāṃ hareḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. With his eyes filled with tears and the heart filled with devotion, he bowed before Radha and said to her, "I have heard about you from the mouth of Garga. You happen to be Lakshmi of lord Hari and are dearer then her.".

## \|\| 15.26 \|\|

*jānāmīmaṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ paraṃ nirguṇamacyutam \|*  
*tathāpi mohito'haṃ ca mānavo viṣṇumāyayā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. I know her also who happens to be better then Maha-Vishnu is formless but because of my being a human being, I have been influenced with the illusion of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 15.27 \|\|

*gṛhāṇa prāṇanāthaṃ ca gaccha bhadre yathāsukham \|*  
*paścāddāsyasi matputraṃ kṛtvā pūrṇamanoratham \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О chaste lady, you accept your lover and go with pleasure, after fulfilling the desire of my son you return him to me.

## \|\| 15.28 \|\|

*ityuktvā pradadau tasyai rudantaṃ bālakaṃ bhiyā \|*  
*jagrāha bālakaṃ rādhā jahāsa madhuraṃ sukhāt \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. On hearing the words of Nanda, Radha said to him, "I shall bestow you the unparalleled slavehood. At present you should remain devoted to the lotus-like feet of both of us and with a delighted mind you should always recite our names.".

## \|\| 15.29-30 \|\|

*uvāca nandaṃ sā yatnānna prakāśyaṃ rahasyakam \|*  
*ahaṃ dṛṣṭā tvayā nanda katijanmaphalodayāt \|\| 29 \|\|*

*prājñastvaṃ gargavacanātsarvaṃ jānāsi kāraṇam \|*  
*akathyamāvayorgopyaṃ caritaṃ gokule vraja \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Thereafter, he handed over the child to Radha who was crying. Receiving the child, Radha smiled sweety.

## \|\| 15.31 \|\|

*varaṃ vṛṇu vrajeśa tvaṃ yatte manasi vāñchitam \|*  
*dadāmi līlayā tubhyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. She spoke to Nanda, "You have met me as a result of the accumulated merits of many births. You keep this secret carefully which not be made public at any cost. You have been educated because of the words of Garga and you are therefore well-aware of all the reasons. You do not speak out the secret of both of us. Now you go to Gokula.

## \|\| 15.32-33 \|\|

*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tāmuvāca vrajeśvaraḥ \|*  
*yuvayoścaraṇe bhaktiṃ dehi nānyatra me spṛhā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yuvayoḥ sannidhau vāsaṃ dāsyasi tvaṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*āvābhyāṃ dehi jagatāmambike parameśvari \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. О lord of Vraja, you ask for a boon whatever you desire, I shall surely give you even if it be difficult to get from the Vedas.

## \|\| 15.34-35 \|\|

*śrutvā nandasya vacanamuvāca parameśvarī \|*  
*dāsyāmi dāsyamatulamidānīṃ bhaktirastu te \|\| 34 \|\|*

*āvayoścaraṇāmbhoje yuvayośca divāniśam \|*  
*praphullahṛdaye śaśvatsmṛtirastu sudurlabhā \|\| 35\|\|*

34-35. On hearing the words of Radhika, the lord of Vraja said, "Let me remain devoted at the feet of the both of you. I have no other desire. О great goddess, О mother of the universe you kindly grant as a boon to meet you in the Goloka”.

## \|\| 15.36 \|\|

*māyā yuvāṃ ca pracchannau na kariṣyati madvarāt \|*  
*goloke yāsyathānte ca vihāya mānavīṃ tanum \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Because of the boon pronounced by me, the illusion will not be able to over-power you. You will ultimately proceed to Goloka leaving your human body.

## \|\| 15.37 \|\|

*evamuktvā tu sānandaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ svavakṣasi \|*  
*dūraṃ nināya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bāhubhyāṃ ca yathepsitam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Thus speaking, with a delightful mind, she carried Krishna in her lap to a distant place.

## \|\| 15.38-44 \|\|

*kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ kāmācchleṣaṃśleṣaṃ cucumba ca \|*  
*pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgo sasmāra rāsamaṇḍalam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*etasminnantare rādhā māyāsadratnamaṇḍapam \|*  
*dadarśa ratnakalaśaśatena ca samanvitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*nānāvicitracitrāḍhyaṃ citrakānanaśobhitam \|*  
*sindūrākāramaṇibhiḥ stambhasaṃghairvirājitam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*candanāgurukastṛrīkuṅkumadravayuktayā \|*  
*saṃyuktaṃ mālatīmālāsamūhapuṣpaśayyayā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*nānābhogasamāyuktaṃ divyadarpaṇasaṃyutam \|*  
*maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyamālājālairvibhūṣitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*maṇīndrasāraracitakapāṭena samanvitam \|*  
*bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣitairvastraiḥ patākānikarairvaraiḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kuṅkumākāramaṇibhiḥ saptasopānasaṃyutam \|*  
*yuktaṃ ṣaṭpadasaṃyuktaiḥ puṣpodyānaṃ ca puṣpitaiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

38-44. Getting infested with passion, she started kissing him. At that point of time her entire body felt emotional and she remembered of Rasamandala. In the meantime Radha spotted a beautiful dancing mandapa which was built with the best of gems and decorated with the vases made of diamonds. Besides it had enough of sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl and saffron besides garlands of jasmine flower, the flower beds, different types of articles of pleasure and divine mirrors. There were garland of the best of gems, jewels, diamonds, etc. It had doors which were built with the best of diamonds, painting creepers with other floral designs and were adorned by fine clothes and banners. It had seven step made of precious gems of vermilion in shade, it had a flower orchard, full of flowers in which the black-wasps were creating hissing sound. Finding it there, she went inside it.

## \|\| 15.45 \|\|

*sā devī maṇḍapaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagāmābhyantaraṃ mudā \|*  
*dadarśa tatra tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisamanvitam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. She found there the betel with camphor, the vases of gems filled with pleasant cool water.

## \|\| 15.46-53 \|\|

*jalaṃ ca ratnakumbhasthaṃ svacchaṃ śītaṃ manoharam \|*  
*sudhāmadhubhyāṃ pūrṇāni ratnakumbhāni nārada \|\| 46 \|\|*

*puruṣaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca kiśora śyāmasundaram \|*  
*koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ candanena vibhūṣitam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*śayānaṃ puṣpaśayyāyāṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*pītavastraparīdhānaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ kvaṇanmadjīrarañjitam । sadratarasāranirmāṇakeyūravalayānvitam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitam \|*  
*kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaprabhāmuṣṭamukhojjvalam \|*  
*śaratpraphullakamalaprabhāmocanalocanam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*mālatīmālyasaṃśliṣṭaśikhipicchasuśobhitam \|*  
*trivaṃkacūḍāṃ bibhrantaṃ paśyantaṃ ratnamandiram \|\| 52 \|\|*

*kroḍaṃ bālakaśūnyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā taṃ navayauvanam \|*  
*sarvasmṛtisvarūpā sā tathāpi vismayaṃ yayau \|\| 53 \|\|*

46-53. О Narada, there were many vases filled with nectar and honey inside the orchard. A boy of tender age having dark-complexion was sleeping there. He had the lustre of crores of gods of love. His body was plastered with sandal-paste and was wearing a smile on his face. He was clad in yellow lower garment, had a smiling face and eyes, and was wearing the anklets made of the best of gem which were creating sweet sound. He had on his person the anklets and wristlets made of the best of gems besides the gem-studded kundalas in the ears. The kaustubha gem was adorning his chest and the lustre of his face could steal the shine of the full moon of the winter season and his eyes resembled the blossomed lotus flower of the winter season. He wore a long garland of flowers and had a peacock feather on his head. His hair was adorned with flowers and he was looking at Ratnamandapa. Finding the child carried by Radha missing from her lap and finding another youth lying on the bed, Radha was extremely surprised.

## \|\| 15.54 \|\|

*rūpaṃ rāseśvarī dṛṣṭvā mumoha sumanoharam \|*  
*kāmāccakṣuścakorābhyāṃ mukhacandraṃ papau mudā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Radha felt attracted towards him while looking at his beautiful form. With passion, she delightfully started looking at his face.

## \|\| 15.55-56 \|\|

*nimeṣarahitā rādhā navasaṃgamalālasā \|*  
*pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgī sasmitā madanāturā \|\| 55 \|\|*

*tāmuvāca haristatra smerānanasaroruhām \|*  
*navasaṃgamayogyāṃ ca paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. He in turn stared at her without winking his eyes. Radha was then infatuated with the desire of having union with him. The hair of her body stood at an ends and wearing a serene smile on her face she was infatuated with passion. Thereafter looking with a side.glance she found him suitable for fresh union. Thereafter Krishna spoke to the lotus faced Radha.

## \|\| 15.57 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*rādhe smarasi golokavṛttāntaṃ surasaṃsadi \|*  
*adya pūrṇaṃ kariṣyāmi svīkṛtaṃ yatpurā priye \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Krishna said – О dear one, О Radha, do you remember the incident that occurred in the assembly of gods in Goloka, whatever promise I had given you in earlier times, I am going to fulfil today.

## \|\| 15.58-61 \|\|

*tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā rādhe preyasī ca varānane \|*  
*yathā tvaṃ ca tathā'haṃ ca bhedo hi nāvayordhruvam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*yathā kṣīre ca dhāvalyaṃ yathā'gnau dāhikā sati \|*  
*yathā pṛthivyāṃ gandhaśca tathā'haṃ tvayi saṃtatam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*vinā mṛdā ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ vinā svarṇena kuṇḍalam \|*  
*kulālaḥ svarṇakāraśca nahi śaktaḥ kadācana \|\| 60 \|\|*

*tathā tvayā vinā sṛṣṭimahaṃ kartuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ \|*  
*sṛṣṭerādhārabhūtā tvaṃ bījarūpo'hamacyutaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

58-61. О Radha, О beautiful faced one, you are dearer to me than my life, I am completely like you and there is absolutely no difference between the two of us. As whiteness is an integral part of milk, the burning sensation is an integral part of the fire and fragrance is an integral part of earth, similarly, I am completely with you always. As the potter is unable to make a vase without the clay or the gold-smith is unable to make ornaments without gold, similarly I cannot indulge in the creation of the universe without you; you are the best of the universe whereas, I happen to be the seed known as Acyuta.

## \|\| 15.62 \|\|

*āgaccha śayane sādhvi kuru vakṣaḥsthale hi mām \|*  
*tvaṃ me śobhā svarūpā'si dehasya bhūṣaṇaṃ yathā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О chaste lady, you come over to the bed and embrace me. As ornament increases the beauty of the body, similarly you happen to be my grace.

## \|\| 15.63-65 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaṃ vadānta māṃ lokāstvayaiva rahitaṃ yadā \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca tadā te'pi tvayaiva sahitaṃ param \|\| 63 \|\|*

*tvaṃ ca śrīstvaṃ ca saṃpattistvamādhārasvarūpiṇī \|\| 64 \|\|*

*sarvaśaktisvarūpāsi sarvarūpo'hamakṣaraḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

63-65. Whenever I get separated from you, the people call me by the name of only Krishna and when I am united with you then people give me the name of Shri Krishna. You happen to be my Sri, you are my wealth and the base of everything, you possess the form of all the prowess, are eternal and are the form of everything.

## \|\| 15.66-67 \|\|

*yadā tejaḥsvarūpo'haṃ tejorūpā'si tvaṃ tadā \|*  
*na śarīrī yadāhaṃ ca tadā tvamaśarīriṇī \|\| 66 \|\|*

*sarvabījasvarūpo'haṃ sadā yogena sundari \|*  
*tvaṃ ca śaktisvarūpā ca sarvastrīrūpadhāriṇī \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. When I appear in the form of tejas, you also appear similarly. Whenever I appear without any form, you also act similarly. О beautiful one, I take to the form of the seed always in your company. You have the form of great prowess and also take to the form of all the women on earth.

## \|\| 15.68-71 \|\|

*mamāṅgāṃśasvarūpā tvaṃ mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*śaktyā buddhyā ca jñānena mayā tulyā varānane \|\| 68 \|\|*

*āvayorbhedabuddhiṃ ca yaḥ karoti narādhamaḥ \|*  
*tasya vāsaḥ kālasūtre yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 69 \|\|*

*pūrvānsapta parānsapta puruṣānpātayatyadhaḥ \|*  
*koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*ajñānādāvayornindāṃ ye kurvanti narādhamāḥ \|*  
*pacyante narake ghore yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 71 \|\|*

68-71. In relation to my limbs you happen to be the great goddess or MiilaPrakriti. О damsel, you possess prowess, intelligence and knowledge comparable to mine. Such of the wicked persons who consider both of us to be separate from each other, falls in the kdlasutra hell and remains there till the sun and the moon last. Such a conduct on his part makes his seven future and seven past generations to fall in the hell. His merits for crores of births surely get destroyed. Such of the wicked person, who because of ignorance, denounces us, he also falls in the hell and remains there till the sun and the moon last.

## \|\| 15.72-74 \|\|

*rāśabdaṃ kurvatastrasto dadāmi bhaktimuttamām \|*  
*dhāśabdaṃ kurvataḥ paścādyāmi śravaṇalobhataḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*ye sevante ca dattvā māmupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*yāvajīvanaparyantaṃ yā prītirjāyate mama \|\| 73 \|\|*

*sā prītirmama jāyeta rādhāśabdāttato'dhikā \|*  
*priyā na me tathā rādhe rādhāvaktā tato'dhikaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

72-74. The one who recites Ti I bestow the best of devotion on him and the one who recites the word «ft is followed by me because I am always desirous of hearing the word of Radha. Such of the people who adore me throughout their life with sixteen types of offering, I like them very much and from that liking emanates the word of Radha. О Radha, I love you as much as I love a person who recites the name of Radha.

## \|\| 15.75-76 \|\|

*brahmānantaḥ śivo dharmo naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|*  
*kapilaśca gaṇeśaśca kārttikeyaśca matpriyaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

*lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī prakṛtistathā \|*  
*mama priyāśca devāśca tāstathāpi na tatsamāḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. Brahma, Ananta, Shiva, Dharma, the sage Nara-narayana, Kapila and Ganesha are quite dear to me. Besides, Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Durga,Savitri, Prakriti and all other gods are also dear to me; but I do not like them as much as I like a person who recites the name of Radha.

## \|\| 15.77-79 \|\|

*te sarve prāṇatulyā me tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā satī \|*  
*bhinnasthānasthitāste ca tvaṃ ca vakṣaḥsthale sthitā \|\| 77 \|\|*

*yā me caturbhujā mūrtirbibhartti vakṣasi priyām \|*  
*so'haṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpastvāṃ vivahāmi svayaṃ sadā \|\| 78 \|\|*

*ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇastasthau talpe manorame \|*  
*uvāca rādhikā nāthaṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharā \|\| 79 \|\|*

77-79. They are like my life and therefore, О chaste Radha, you are also dearer to me than my life, all of them reside in separate places but you reside in my heart. My four-armed form is enshrined in the heart of my beloved, and I in the form of Krishna carry your weight. Thus speaking lord Krishna reclined on the bed of roses. Thereafter Radha lowering her head with devotion spoke to the lord.

## \|\| 15.80 \|\|

*rādhikovāca \|*  
*smarāmi sarvaṃ jānāmi vismarāmi kathaṃ vibho \|*  
*yattvaṃ vadasi sarvāhaṃ tvatpādābjaprasādataḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Radhika said – О virtuous one, I remember everything and how can I forget it? Whatever have you spoken, is true. Whatever I am, it is all due to the grace of your lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 15.81 \|\|

*īśvarasyāpriyāḥ kecitpriyāśca kutra kecana \|*  
*ye yathā māṃ na smaranti tathā teṣu tavākṛpā \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Some of the people are not liked by the lord and some of them are quite dear to him. The one who does not remember me is not held by you in grace.

## \|\| 15.82 \|\|

*tṛṇaṃ ca parvataṃ kartu samarthaḥ parvataṃ tṛṇam \|*  
*tathāpi yogyāyogye ca saṃpattau ca samā kṛpā \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. You are competent enough to raise a mountain from a straw and reduce a mountain to a straw. In spite of that you bestow your grace on all in spite of one's being competent or incompetent in either pleasure or in pain.

## \|\| 15.83 \|\|

*tiṣṭhatyahaṃ śayānastvaṃ kathābhiryatkṣaṇaṃ gatam \|*  
*tatkṣaṇaṃ ca yugasamaṃ nāhaṃ prāpayituṃ kṣamā \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. I am standing here and you are sleeping. Whatever time we have spent in talking, has passed like a yuga, which cannot be brought back by me.

## \|\| 15.84 \|\|

*vakṣaḥsthale ca śirasi dehi te caraṇāmbujam \|*  
*dunoti manmanaḥ sadyastvadīyavirahānalāt \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Therefore, you place your lotus-like feet on my breasts. My heart is burning because of separation from you.

## \|\| 15.85-86 \|\|

*puraḥ papāta me dṛṣṭistvadīyacaraṇāmbuje \|*  
*nītā mayā nahi kleśāddraṣṭumanyatkalevaram \|\| 85 \|\|*

*pratyekamaṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva dattā śānte mukhāmbuje \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā mukhāravindaṃ ca nānyaṃ gantuṃ ca sā kṣamā \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. Whenever I look at your lotus-like feet, I do not feel interested in looking at any other part of your body. I have fixed my gaze at your lotus-like feet after having looked at all your limbs. My eye is unable to go anywhere after looking at your lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 15.87 \|\|

*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa puruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*tāmuvāca hitaṃ tathyaṃ śrutismṛtinirūpitam \|\| 87\|\|*

87\. On hearing the words of Radhika, Shri Krishna the best of the persons, smiled a little and he spoke to her beneficial, truthful and appropriate words.

## \|\| 15.88 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*na khaṇḍanīyaṃ tattatra mayā pūrvaṃ nirūpitam \|*  
*tiṣṭha bhadre kṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ kariṣyāmi tava priye \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. Shri Krishna – О noble lady, О dear one, whatever I had spoken earlier should never be contradicted. You wait for a while; I shall do good to you.

## \|\| 15.89-91 \|\|

*tvanmanorathapūrṇasya svayaṃ kālaḥ samāgataḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*yasya yallikhitaṃ pūrvaṃ yatra kāle nirūpitam tadeva khaṇḍituṃ rādhe kṣamo nāhaṃ ca ko vidhiḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*vidhātuśca vidhātā'haṃ yeṣāṃ yallekhanaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*brahmādīnāṃ ca kṣudrāṇāṃ na tatkhaṇḍyaṃ kadācana \|\| 91 \|\|*

89-91. The time for the fulfilling of your desire has arrived. О Radha, whatever has already been spoken earlier about this, cannot be contradicted, therefore how could destiny venture to do so? I am creator of the creator; therefore whatever has been told by me, cannot be contradicted even by the poor Brahma.

## \|\| 15.92-94 \|\|

*etasminnantare brahmā''jagāma purato hareḥ \|*  
*mālākamaṇḍalukara īṣatsmeracaturmukhaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*gatvā nanāma taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratuṣṭāva yathāgamam \|*  
*sāśrunetrapulakito bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*stutvā natvā jagaddhātā jagāma harisannidhim \|*  
*punarnatvā prabhuṃ bhaktyā jagāma rādhikāntikam \|\| 94 \|\|*

92-94. In the meantime Brahma also arrived there before the lord, holding a rosary and a kamandalu in his hands. He wore a serene smile on all the four faces. He bowed in reverence to lord Krishna and offered prayer to him according to agama. Brahma, the creator of the universe, felt emotional and tears started flowing from his eyes. He bowed in reverence to him and offered his prayer with salutations. Thereafter offering his salutation again to lord Krishna he went to Radhika.

## \|\| 15.95-96 \|\|

*mūrdhnā nanāma bhaktyā ca mātustaccaraṇāmbuje \|*  
*cakāra saṃbhrameṇaiva jaṭājālena veṣṭitam \|\| 95 \|\|*

*kamaṇḍalujalenaiva śīghraṃ prakṣālitaṃ mudā \|*  
*yathāgamaṃ pratuṣṭāva puṭāñjaliyutaḥ punaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

95-96. He offered his salutation to her also bowing his heads at her lotus-like feet. He washed her feet with the water from his kamandalu and then rinsed them with the matted locks of hair of his heads. Thereafter he started adoring her.

## \|\| 15.97-101 \|\|

*.brahmovāca \|*  
*sudurlabhaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhārate ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*sudurlabhaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhārate ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ purā mayā \|*  
*bhāskare puṣkare tīrthe kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

*ājagāma varaṃ dātuṃ varadātā hariḥ svayam \|*  
*varaṃ vṛṇīṣvetyukte ca svābhīṣṭaṃ ca vṛtaṃ mudā \|\| 99 \|\|*

*rādhikācaraṇāmbhojaṃ sarveṣāmapi durlabham \|*  
*he guṇātīta me śīghramadhunaiva pradarśaya \|\| 100 \|\|*

*mayetyukto harirayamuvāca māṃ tapasvinam \|*  
*darśayiṣyāmi kāle ca vatsedānīṃ kṣameti ca \|\| 101 \|\|*

97-101. Не said, О mother, by the grace of lord Krishna, I have been able to have a look at your lotus-like feet which are beyond the reach of all. I had performed tapas in the earlier times at the holy place of Puskara, in the sun shine, to please of Shri Krishna, for sixty thousand years. Thereafter, the lord himself came to pronounce a boon on me. He said, "You ask for a boon." At these words of the lord, I asked for a boon that I should be able to look at the lotus-like feet of Radhika which is beyond the reach of all. О virtuous one, you kindly let me have a look at her lotus-like feet. At these words of mine, the lord spoke to an ascetic like me thus: "O son, I shall make you look at the feet of Radhika at an appropriate time. You please excuse me at the moment,

## \|\| 15.102 \|\|

*nahīśvarājñā viphalā tena dṛṣṭaṃ padāmbujam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ vāñchitaṃ mātargoloke bhārate'dhunā \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. The command of the lord never becomes infructuous therefore I have been able to look at your lotus-like feet today. О mother, you are adored in the Goloka as well as in the land of Bharata equally well.

## \|\| 15.103 \|\|

*sarvā devyaḥ prakṛtyaṃśā janyāḥ prākṛtikā dhruvam \|*  
*tvaṃ kṛṣṇāṅgārdhasaṃbhūtā tulyā kṛṣṇena sarvataḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. The other goddess forms are a part of Prakriti and as such they appear in a natural way, but you happen to be the better half of lord Krishna and having been born out of his body, you are like him alone.

## \|\| 15.104 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇastvamayaṃ rādhā tvaṃ rādhā vā hariḥ svayam \|*  
*nahi vedeṣu me dṛṣṭa iti kena nirūpitam \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. You are lord Krishna and he happens to be Radha or otherwise you are Radha and he happens to be Krishna. Even the Vedas cannot decide on the point. No one has concluded on the subject.

## \|\| 15.105 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍādbahirūrdhvaṃ ca goloko'sti yathāmbike \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhaścāpyajanyaśca tvamajanyā tathāmbike \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. О mother, as the Goloka is beyond the universe and is above all, similarly Vaikuntha also is inaccessible and you are also beyond birth.

## \|\| 15.106-107 \|\|

*yathā samastabrahmāṇḍe śrīkṛṣṇāṃśāṃśajīvinaḥ \|*  
*tathā śaktisvarūpā tvaṃ teṣu sarveṣu saṃsthitā \|\| 106 \|\|*

*puruṣāśca hareraṃśāstvadaṃśā nikhilāḥ striyaḥ \|*  
*ātmanā deharūpā tvamasyādhārastvameva hi \|\| 107 \|\|*

106-107. As the amsa of Krishna, you pervade the entire universe and the creatures living therein. Similarly, you happen to be the strength of the creatures and reside in them in the same form. All the people happen to be the amsa of lord Hari and all the females happen to be your amsa; you have a definite form and happen to be the base of all the ladies.

## \|\| 15.108-109 \|\|

*asyānu prāṇaistvaṃ mātastvatprāṇairayamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*kimaho nirmitaḥ kena hetunā śilpakāriṇā \|\| 108 \|\|*

*nityo'yaṃ ca tathā kṛṣṇastvaṃ ca nityā tathā'mbike \|*  
*asyāṃśā tvaṃ tvadaṃśo vā'pyayaṃ kena nirūpitaḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. O mother, you live because of their lives and because of your life lord Krishna is alive. Alas, which one of the architects had created one or the other! О mother, lord Krishna is eternal and so are you. You happen to be his amsa and he happens to be you amsa; who can decide on the point.

## \|\| 15.110-111 \|\|

*ahaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ devānāṃ janakaḥ svayam \|*  
*taṃ paṭhitvā gurumukhādbhavantyeva budhā janāḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

*guṇānāṃ vāstavānāṃ te śatāṃśaṃ vaktumakṣamaḥ \|*  
*vedo vā paṇḍito vā'nyaḥ ko vā tvāṃ stotumīśvaraḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

110-111. I am the creator of the universe as well as the Vedas. By learning the Vedas from the mouth of the teacher, the people become learned but even such people of wisdom are not aware of even the hundredth part of your glory.

## \|\| 15.112-114 \|\|

*stavānāṃ janakaṃ jñānaṃ buddhirjñānāmbikā sadā \|*  
*tvaṃ buddherjananī mātaḥ ko vā tvāṃ stotumīśvaraḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

*yadvastu dṛṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ taddhi vaktuṃ budhaḥ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*yadadṛṣṭāśrute vastu tannirvaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

*ahaṃ maheśo'naṃtaśca stotuṃ tvāṃ ko'pi na kṣamaḥ \|*  
*sarasvatī ca vedāśca kṣamaḥ kaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

112-114. Who else, including the Vedas and the learned people, could be able to recite your glory because prayers emanate for knowledge and knowledge is created by intelligence. О mother, you are the creator of intelligence; therefore who else will be able to sing your glory? The things which are witnessed by all the intellectuals are unable to describe it. But the same which is beyond the vision of one and all and is unheard of, who can describe the same. Myself, Shiva and Ananta are unable to recite your glory. Your glory is beyond the reach of the Vedas and Sarasvati. Who else can recite your glory?

## \|\| 15.115 \|\|

*yathāgamaṃ yathoktaṃ ca na māṃ ninditumarhasi \|*  
*īśvarāṇāmīśvarasya yogyāyogye samā kṛpā \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Following the agama whatever has been spoken by me, you please don't denounce me for the same. The great soul happens to be the lord of all and he is equally graceful towards the competent and incompetent people.

## \|\| 15.116 \|\|

*janasya pratipālyasya kṣaṇe doṣaḥ kṣaṇe guṇaḥ \|*  
*jananī janako yo vā sarvaṃ kṣamati snehataḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. The parents visualise the short-comings of the sons and daughters whom they bring up, at every step but they forgive them out of affection.

## \|\| 15.117 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā tasthau ca puratastayoḥ \|*  
*praṇamya caraṇāmbhoje sarveṣāṃ vandyamīpsitam \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Thus speaking the creator of the universe bowed at the feet of Radha and Krishna which are desired by and adored by all. Thereafter he stood before them.

## \|\| 15.118-119 \|\|

*brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*rādhāmādhavayoḥ pāde bhaktirdāsyaṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 118 \|\|*

*karmanirmūlanaṃ kṛtvā mṛtyuṃ jitvā sudurjayam \|\| 119 \|\|*

118-119. The one who recites this stotra recited by Brahma, thrice a day, achieves devotion at the lotus-like feet of Radhamadhava besides achieving their slavehood. Uprooting all his deeds he overcomes the terrific death and crossing all the lokas he reaches Goloka.

## \|\| 15.120-126 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca ha rādhikā \|*  
*varaṃ vṛṇu vidhātastvaṃ yatte manasi vartate \|\| 120 \|\|*

*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tāmuvāca jagadvidhiḥ \|*  
*varaṃ ca yuvayoḥ pādapadmabhaktiṃ ca dehi me \|\| 121 \|\|*

*ityukte vidhinā rādhā tūrṇamomityuvāca ha \|*  
*punarnanāma tāṃ bhaktyā vidhātā jagatāṃ patiḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

*tadā brahmā tayormadhye prajvālya ca hutāśanam \|*  
*hariṃ saṃsmṛtya havanaṃ cakāra vidhinā vidhiḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

*utthāya śayanātkṛṣṇa uvāsa vahnisannidhau \|*  
*brahmaṇoktena vidhinā cakāra havanaṃ svayam \|\| 124 \|\|*

*praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ tāṃ janakaḥ svayam \|*  
*kautukaṃ kārayāmāsa saptadhā ca pradakṣiṇām \|\| 125 \|\|*

*punaḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ rādhāṃ kārayitvā hutāśanam \|*  
*praṇamayya tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vāsayāmāsa taṃ vidhiḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

120-126. Narayana said – On hearing the words of Brahma, Radhika said to him, "0 creator of the universe, you ask for a boon." On hearing the words of Radhika the creator of the universe said, "You kindly bestow the devotion of both your lotus-like feet on me." At these words of Brahma, Radhika at once agreed to the same. Thereafter Brahma, the lord of the universe, bowed in reverence to Radhika. He ignited fire in between the two and reciting the name of the lord, performed homa there. Lord Krishna himself got up from the bed and came to the fire-altar and performed the homa as desired by Brahma. Thereafter Brahma made Radha bow in reverence to Krishna. Thereafter, he himself performing the duty of a father gave away her hand in marriage to Krishna after making them circle round the fire seven times. Thereafter Radha again took a round of the god of fire and bowing before him she was seated besides Krishna.

## \|\| 15.127-130 \|\|

*tasyā hastaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ grāhayāmāsa taṃ vidhiḥ \|*  
*vedoktasaptamantrāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa mādhavam \|\| 127 \|\|*

*saṃsthāpya rādhikāhastaṃ harervakṣasi vedavit \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇahastaṃ rādhāyāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe prajāpatiḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

*sthāpayāmāsa mantrāṃstrīnpāṭhayāmāsa rādhikām \|*  
*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāṃ jānuvilambitām \|\| 129 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇasya gale brahmā rādhādvārā dadau mudā \|*  
*praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ ca kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

127-130. Thereafter Shri Krishna held the hand of Radha in his hand and seven hymns of the Veda were recited by Hari. Thereafter Brahma placed the hand of Radha in the hand of Krishna and placed the hand of Krishna on the shoulders of Radha. Thereafter Radha was made to recite seven hymns of the Vedas. Thereafter Brahma made Radha to place the garland of Parijata flowers falling up to the knees, around the neck of lord Krishna, who bowed in reverence at the same time.

## \|\| 15.131-136 \|\|

*rādhāgale haridvārā dadau mālāṃ manoharām \|*  
*punaśca vāsayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

*tadvāmapārśve rādhāṃ ca sasmitāṃ kṛṣṇacetasam \|*  
*puṭāñjaliṃ kārayitvā mādhavaṃ rādhikāṃ vidhiḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

*pāṭhayāmāsa vedoktānpañca mantrāṃśca nārada \|*  
*praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samarpya rādhikāṃ vidhiḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

*kanyakāṃ ca yathā tāto bhaktyā tasthau hareḥ puraḥ \|*  
*etasminnantare devāḥ sānandapulakodgamāḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

*dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsuścānakaṃ murajādikam \|\| 135 \|\|*

*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha \|*  
*jagurgandharvapravarā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ \|\| 136 \|\|*

131-136. Thereafter lord Krishna placed a beautiful garland of flowers around the neck of Radha. Then Radha was made to sit to the left of Krishna. Radha was smiling serenely reciting the name of Krishna in her mind. Brahma then made both of them recite five hymns from the Vedas and then bowing before them he handed Radha over to Krishna in the same way a father hands over his daughter. He then stood before the lord. At that point of time the delightful gods playing on the big-drums and small-drums, poured a rain of flowers on them. The best of the Gandharvas started singing and the apsaras started dancing.

## \|\| 15.137-139 \|\|

*tuṣṭāva śrīhariṃ brahmā tamuvāca ha sasmitaḥ \|*  
*yuvayoścaraṇāmbhoje bhaktiṃ me dehi dakṣiṇām \|\| 137 \|\|*

*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca hariḥ svayam \|*  
*madīyacaraṇāmbhoje sudṛḍhā bhaktirastu te \|\| 138 \|\|*

*svasthānaṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*mayā niyojitaṃ karma kuru vatsa mamājñayā \|\| 139 \|\|*

137-139. Brahma then adored Radha and Madhava. Wearing a serene smile on his face, he then said to both of them, "Let me remain devoted to the lotus-like feet of both of you. This is the form of daksind which I accept from you." On hearing the words of Brahma, the lord himself said to him, "You will always remain immensely devoted at my lotus-like feet." Now you go back to your abode and meet with the welfare. О son, you perform your duty and whatever is entrusted by me to you.

## \|\| 15.140-141 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā vidhātā jagatāṃ mune \|*  
*praṇamya rādhāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca jagāma svālayaṃ mudā \|\| 140 \|\|*

*gate brahmaṇi sā devī sasmitā vakracakṣuṣā \|*  
*sā dadarśa harervaktraṃ cacchāda vrīḍayā mukham \|\| 141 \|\|*

140-141. Narayana said – О sage, on hearing the words of Shri Krishna, Brahma, the creator of the universe, bowed in reverence to Radha and Krishna and went back to his abode. After the departure of Brahma, the goddess Radha looked at the lord with a side glance and covered her face which shyness.

## \|\| 15.142-143 \|\|

*pulakāṅkitasarvāṃgī kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā \|*  
*praṇamya śrīhariṃ bhaktyā jagāma śayanaṃ hareḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

*candanāgurupaṅkaṃ ca kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam \|*  
*lalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā dadau kṛṣṇasya vakṣasi \|\| 143 \|\|*

142-143. She was feeling emotional at that point of time and was suffering from the pain of passion. Thereafter she bowed in deep reverence to the lord and went to his bed. She decorated his head beside the chest with sandal-paste, kastUri, aguru and saffron.

## \|\| 15.144 \|\|

*sudhāpūrṇaṃ ratnapātraṃ madhupūrṇaṃ manoharam \|*  
*pradadau haraye bhaktyā bubhuje jagatīpatiḥ \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. She then offered nectar and honey in the gem-cups which were consumed by the lord,

## \|\| 15.145 \|\|

*tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam \|*  
*dadau kṛṣṇāya sā rādhā sādaraṃ bubhuje hariḥ \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. Radha then offered fragrant betel to the lord comprising of the camphor in it which was eaten by him.

## \|\| 15.146 \|\|

*cakhāda sasmitā rādhā haridattaṃ sudhārasam \|*  
*tāmbūlaṃ tena dattaṃ ca bubhuje purato hareḥ \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. Thereafter, Radha consumed the nectar offered by the lord to her smilingly and also chewed the betel offered by him.

## \|\| 15.147 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaścarvitatāmbūlaṃ rādhikāyai mudā dadau \|*  
*cakhāda parayā bhaktyā papau tanmukhapaṅkajam \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. Then Krishna offered to Radha the betel which had been chewed by him which was consumed by Radha with devotion. She then started looking at his lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 15.148 \|\|

*rādhācarvitatāmbūlaṃ yayāce madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*jahāsa na dadau rādhā kṣametyuktaṃ tayā mudā \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Then lord MadhusOdana desired to have a betel chewed by Radha but she declined the same saying, "You kindly excuse me" and she never gave it to him.

## \|\| 15.149 \|\|

*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravamuttamam \|*  
*yaḥ kāmo dhyāyate nityaṃ yasyaikacaraṇāmbujam \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. Thereafter, Madhava himself applied on the body of Radha the sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl and saffron.

## \|\| 15.150 \|\|

*yaḥ kāmo dhyāyate nityaṃ yasyaikacaraṇāmbujam \|*  
*babhūva tasya sa vaśo rādhāsaṃtoṣakāraṇāt \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. The one at whose lotus-like feet, the god of love who always adores, the same lord was over-powered by the love of Radha.

## \|\| 15.151 \|\|

*yadbhṛtyabhṛtyairmadano jitaḥ sarvakṣaṇaṃ mune \|*  
*svecchāmayo hi bhagavāñjitastena kutūhalāt \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. О sage, the one whose servant of the servants over-powers the gods of love, the same lord willingly and playfully was over-powered by Radha.

## \|\| 15.152 \|\|

*kare dhṛtvā ca tāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sthāpayāmāsa vakṣasi \|*  
*cakāra śithilaṃ vastraṃ cumbanaṃ ca caturvidham \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. Thereafter, lord Krishna embraced Radha holding her with his hands and loosening her garments, kissing her at the same time.

## \|\| 15.153 \|\|

*babhūva ratiyuddhena vicchinnā kṣudraghaṇṭikā \|*  
*cumbanenauṣṭharāgaśca hyāśleṣeṇa ca patrakam \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. In the battle of sexual pleasure the small bells studded in the waist-band of Radha were broken and her lips became red because of the kissing and the decoration of the chest was disturbed with the embraces.

## \|\| 15.154 \|\|

*śṛṃgāreṇaiva kabarī sindūratilakaṃ mune \|*
