*dhanuḥpramāṇaśatakamūrdhvamagniśikhopamam \|\| 180 \|\|*

*śatahastapramāṇaṃ ca prastāraṃ vartulākṛtim \|*  
*śobhitaṃ ratnakalpaiśca tadabhyantaramuttamam \|\| 181 \|\|*

176-181. They were all set up for the love-sport of RSdha and Madhava. There were thirty beautiful gardens. Thereafter there was an attractive beautiful spot quite secluded under the shade of the banyan tree, with a lake and an orchard of campaka flowers on the bank beside the forest of jasmine flowers. Beside that, for the love-sports a gem-studded mandapa was also erected which had four pedestals at four ends. It was exceedingly beautiful.

## \|\| 17.182 \|\|

*vahiśuddhāṃśudairvasairmālājālavicitritaiḥ \|*  
*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālyopadhānasaṃyutaiḥ \|\| 182 \|\|*

182\. It was decorated with the best of gems and painted with hundreds of brushes. There were nine pairs of door leaves which were studded with gems and contained different types of paintings. Its walls and ceilings were also studded with gems and precious gems. Every door had a Ratnamandapa attached to it. Three crores of artificial kalasas were adding to its grandeur. It had seven steps studded in precious stones, the top of the mandapa having kalasas made of gems which were illumining the entire area. It was decorated with banners, toranas and wide fly-whisks. Innumerable mirrors of precious stones were available there as a result of which the mandapa looked illumining from the front side. It was a hundred bows in height and was shining like the burning flames. It was circular in shape and was spread over an area of a hundred feet. There were beds of diamonds in the inner portion of the same.

## \|\| 17.183-184 \|\|

*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiḥ surabhīkṛtam \|*  
*navaśṛṅgārayogyaiśca kāmavarddhanakāribhiḥ \|\| 183 \|\|*

*mālatīcampakānāṃ ca puṣparājibhiranvitam \|*  
*sakarpūraiśca tāmbūlaiḥ sadratnapātrasaṃsthitaiḥ \|\| 184 \|\|*

183-184. The beds were covered with the best of bed-sheets purified by fire. Getting decorated with the garlands, they looked quite fine; they had pillows made of the garlands of Pdrijata flowers.

## \|\| 17.185 \|\|

*vajrasāreṇa khacitairmuktājālavilambibhiḥ \|*  
*ratnasāraghaṭākīrṇaṃ ratnapīṭhaiḥ susaṃyutam \|\| 185 \|\|*

185\. The building was scented with sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl and saffron. The garlands of jasmine and campaka flowers were placed there. For increase in fresh love, the betels with camphor were placed in the boxes of gems.

## \|\| 17.186-187 \|\|

*ratnasiṃhāsanairyuktaṃ ratnacitreṇa citritaiḥ \|*  
*kṣaritaiścandrakāntaiśca susiktaṃ jalabindubhiḥ \|\| 186 \|\|*

*śītavāsitatoyena saṃyuktaṃ bhogavastubhiḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā ratigṛhaṃ ramyaṃ nagaraṃ ca punaryayau \|\| 187 \|\|*

186-187. There were several pedestals made of gems in which the diamonds had been studded and the strings of beads were hanging round them. It was filled with the pitchers of gems.

## \|\| 17.188 \|\|

*yāni yeṣāṃ mandirāṇi tannāmāni lilekha saḥ \|*  
*mudā yukto viśvakarmā śiṣyairyakṣagaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 188 \|\|*

188\. It was decorated with the paintings drawn in gems over the gem-studded lion-thrones. It was decorated with jasmine flowers and the fragrant water besides other cosmetics were available here in abundance. Thus Vishvakarma after constructing the pleasure house went back to the city.

## \|\| 17.189-191 \|\|

*nidreśaṃ nidritaṃ natvā prayayau svālayaṃ mune \|*  
*sarvatraivaṃ sukṛtināṃ samastaṃ bhagavatkṛpā \|\| 189 \|\|*

*nehāścaryaṃ ca nagaraṃ babhūveśecchayā bhuvi \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamaṅgalam \|\| 190 \|\|*

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāma kānanasyāsya bhārate \|*  
*vyutpattirasya saṃjñā vā tattvaṃ vada sutattvavit \|\| 191 \|\|*

189-191. Whatever houses were allotted to the people, their name plates were fixed on each one of them. In this job his own pupils and the yaksas helped him.

## \|\| 17.192 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣirnārāyaṇo mudā \|*  
*prahasyovāca nikhilaṃ tattvameva purātanam \|\| 192 \|\|*

192\. О sage, at that point of time, Shri Krishna, the lord of sleep bowed in reverence to the lord when he was fast asleep and left the place. Thus all the pleasures were presented to the noble people in this manner. This is all due to the great lord and it is not surprising because this astonishing type of the city was built with the will of the lord. Thus I have narrated the life story of the lord which provides welfare and destroys the sins providing all the pleasures. What else do you want to listen to from me?

## \|\| 17.193-194 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā kedāranṛpatiḥ saptadvīpapatiḥ svayam \|*  
*āsītsatyayuge brahmansatyadharmarataḥ sadā \|\| 193 \|\|*

*sa reme saha nārībhiḥ putrapautragaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*putrāniva prajāḥ sarvāḥ pālayāmāsa dhārmikaḥ \|\| 194 \|\|*

193-194. Suta said – On hearing the word of Narada, the sage Narayana laughed gracefully and he started narrating an ancient story to Narada.

## \|\| 17.195 \|\|

*kṛtvā kratuśataṃ rājā lebhe nendratvamīpsitam \|*  
*kṛtvā nānāvidhaṃ puṇyaṃ phalakāṅkṣī na ca svayam \|\| 195 \|\|*

195\. Narayana said – О Brahman, in the earlier times there was a king named Kedara in Satyayuga who happened to be the king of all the seven continents and always followed the path of dharma. He was leading the comfortable life of a house-holder together with his wives, sons and grandsons. The religious king looked after the people as good as his own sons.

## \|\| 17.196 \|\|

*nityaṃ naimittikaṃ sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaprītipūrvakam \|*  
*kedāratulyo rājendro na bhūto bhavitā punaḥ \|\| 196 \|\|*

196\. The king completed a hundred yajha but did not accept the title of Indra. Though he earned merits by performing various good deeds he never aspired for the reward.

## \|\| 17.197 \|\|

*putreṣu rājyaṃ saṃnyasya priyāṃ trailokyamohinīm \|*  
*jaigīṣavyopadeśena jagāma tapase vanam \|\| 197 \|\|*

197\. He always performed many religious functions in order to please Krishna. Indeed there had been no king like him in the past nor shall be any in future also.

## \|\| 17.198-202 \|\|

*hareraikāntiko bhakto dhyāyate saṃtataṃ harim \|*  
*śaśvatsudarśanaṃ cakramasti yatsannidhau mune \|\| 198 \|\|*

*ciraṃ taptvā muniśreṣṭho golokaṃ ca jagāma saḥ \|*  
*kedāraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ ca tannāmnā ca babhūva ha \|\| 199 \|\|*

*tatrādyāpi mṛtaḥ prāṇī sadyo mukto bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*kamalāṃśā tasya kanyā nāmnā vṛndā tapasvinī \|\| 200 \|\|*

*na vavre sā varaṃ kaṃcidyogaśāstraviśāradā \|*  
*datto durvāsasā tasyai harermantraḥ sudurlabhaḥ \|\| 201 \|\|*

*sā viraktā gṛhaṃ tyaktvā jagāma tapase vanam \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe sunirjane \|\| 202 \|\|*

198-202. At the advice of the sage Jaigisavya, the king disowning his kingdom, the wife who could attract the three worlds, entrusting their care to his sons, went to the forest for performing tapas.

## \|\| 17.203-204 \|\|

*āvirbabhūva śrīkṛṣṇastatpuro bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānvaraṃ vṛṇvityuvāca saḥ \|\| 203 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā sā rādhikā kāntaṃ śānte sundaravigraham \|*  
*mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa sā sadyaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā \|\| 204 \|\|*

203-204. The king who was immensely devoted to Krishna always meditated upon him. О sage, the Sudarsana-cakra of Kjsna always attended on him for the sake of his protection. The king after performing tapas for a long time ultimately went to Goloka. A sacred place known by the name of Kedara emerged thereafter. It happens to be the place where even the dead person always achieves salvation. He had a daughter named Vrinda who was born out of the athsha of Lakshmi and happened to be a great ascetic. She was well-versed in the yogic practices and therefore did not accept anyone as her husband. Thereafter Durvasd initiated her with the inaccessible mantra of the lord which made her detached. After returning home, she again went back to the forest for performing tapas. She performed severe austerities for sixty thousand years.

## \|\| 17.205-206 \|\|

*sā ca śīghraṃ varaṃ vavre patistvaṃ me bhaveti ca \|*  
*omityuktvā ca rahasi ciraṃ reme tayā saha \|\| 205 \|\|*

*sā jagāma ca golokaṃ kṛṣṇena saha kautukāt \|*  
*rādhā samā sā saubhāgyādgopīśreṣṭhā babhūva ha \|\| 206 \|\|*

205-206. Thereafter lord Krishna himself appeared before her. The lord spoke to him delightfully saying, "You ask for a boon." But at the sight of the peaceful lord of Radhika, she was infatuated with passion and fainted.

## \|\| 17.207 \|\|

*vṛndā yatra tapastepe tattu vṛndāvanaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*vṛndayā'tra kṛtā krīḍā tena vā munipuṃgava \|\| 207 \|\|*

207\. On regaining consciousness she quickly uttered, "You be my husband". Lord Krishna accepted it and enjoyed her company in seclusion for a long time. Thereafter Vrinda went back to lord Krishna to Goloka and became the fortunate cowherdess like Radhika.

## \|\| 17.208 \|\|

*athā'nyaṃ cetihāsaṃ ca śṛṇuṣva vatsa puṇyadam \|*  
*yena vṛndāvanaṃ nāma nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 208 \|\|*

208\. The place where Vrinda performed the tapas, later on came to be known as Vrindavana. О sage, the place were Vrinda enjoyed the love-sports, known as Vrindavana.

## \|\| 17.209 \|\|

*kuśadhvajasya kanye dve dharmaśāstraviśārade \|*  
*tulasīvedavatyau ca virakte bhavakarmaṇi \|\| 209 \|\|*

209\. О son, there is another auspicious story about the origin of the name of Vrindavana which I am going to tell you and you please listen to it.

## \|\| 17.210-211 \|\|

*tapastaptvā vedavatī prāpa nārāyaṇaṃ param \|*  
*sītā janakakanyā sā sarvatra parikīrtitā \|\| 210 \|\|*

*tulasī ca tapastaptvā vāñchāṃ kṛtvā hariṃ prati \|*  
*daivāddurvāsasaḥ śāpātprāpya śaṅkhāsuraṃ prati \|\| 211 \|\|*

210-211. Kusadhvaja had two daughters named Tulasi and Vedavati who were well-versed in the scriptures but were quite detached from the worldly affairs. Out of these two Vedavati accepted Narayana as her husband. She is known as Sita, the daughter of Janaka everywhere, Tulasi on the other hand becoming desirous of the lord, performed great tapas but because of the curse from Durvasa, she had to accept 3amkhasura as her husband.

## \|\| 17.212-213 \|\|

*paścātsaṃprāpya kamalākāntaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam \|*  
*sā caiva hariśāpena vṛkṣarūpā sureśvarī \|\| 212 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ śāpena ca hariḥ śālagrāmo babhūva ha \|*  
*tathā tasthau ca satataṃ śilāvakṣasi suṃdarī \|\| 213 \|\|*

212-213. Thereafter, she achieved the pleasant lord of Lakshmi as her husband. The same goddess was turned into a tree with the curse of the lord and with her curse the lord took to the form of tfdlagrama. But the beautiful damsel started living in the heart of the lord as a Tulasi.

## \|\| 17.214-215 \|\|

*vistīrṇaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tulasīcaritaṃ ca te \|*  
*tasyāśca tapasaḥ sthānaṃ tadidaṃ ca tapodhana \|\| 214 \|\|*

*tasyāśca tapasaḥ sthānaṃ tadidaṃ ca tapodhana \|*  
*tena vṛndāvanaṃ nāma pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 215 \|\|*

214-215. О sage, I had already spoken about the story of Tulasi and I have discussed here as a passing reference. О great sage, she also performed the tapas in Vrindavana which earned the same name for the place.

## \|\| 17.216 \|\|

*atha vā te pravakṣyāmi paraṃ hetvantaraṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*yena vṛndāvanaṃ nāma puṇyakṣetrasya bhārate \|\| 216 \|\|*

216\. Besides the above, I am going to speak out another reason for the place getting the name of Vrindavana.

## \|\| 17.217 \|\|

*rādhāṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca vṛndānāma śrutau śrutam \|*  
*tasyāḥ krīḍāvanaṃ ramyaṃ tena vṛndāvanaṃ smṛtam \|\| 217 \|\|*

217\. In all the sixteen names of Radhika, she has a name also known as Vmda which has been described in the Vedas. This is the same place for her sports. That is why the place is named as Vrindavana.

## \|\| 17.218 \|\|

*goloke prītaye tasyāḥ kṛṣṇena nirmitaṃ purā \|*  
*krīḍārthaṃ bhuvi tannāmnā vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ smṛtam \|\| 218 \|\|*

218\. Lord Krishna himself has grown the Vrindavana for the pleasure of Radha. It was a place for performing the human plays of the lord; that is why the place is called Vrindavana.

## \|\| 17.219 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kāni ṣoḍaśa nāmāni rādhikāyā jagadguro \|*  
*tāni me vada śiṣyāya śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 219 \|\|*

219\. Narada said – О teacher of the universe, which are the sixteen names of Radha. You kindly tell me about them, since I feel anxious to know about them.

## \|\| 17.220 \|\|

*śrutaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ ca sāmavede nirūpitam \|*  
*tathā'pi śrotumicchāmi tvatto nāmāni ṣoḍaśa \|\| 220 \|\|*

220\. Though her thousand names have been described in the Samaveda I would like to know the sixteen names of Radha from your mouth.

## \|\| 17.221 \|\|

*abhyaṃtarāṇi teṣāṃ vā tadanyānyeva me vibho \|*  
*aho puṇyasvarūpāṇi bhaktānāṃ vāñchitāni ca \|\| 221 \|\|*

221\. О virtuous one, have these sixteen names been included in the thousand names or are they different from them. You kindly tell me because these names are quite meritorious and quite auspicious for the devotees,

## \|\| 17.222 \|\|

*nāmāni teṣāṃ vyutpattiṃ sarveṣāṃ durlabhāni ca \|*  
*pāvanāni jaganmāturjagatāmapi kāraṇam \|\| 222 \|\|*

222\. You also kindly tel! me about the genesis of the names of each one of them because these names happen to be the cause of the universe.

## \|\| 17.223-225 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*rādhā rāseśvarī rāsavāsinī rasikeśvarī \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā kṛṣṇapriyā kṛṣṇasvarūpiṇī \|\| 223 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇavāmāṃgasaṃbhūtā paramānandarūpiṇī \|*  
*kṛṣṇā vṛndāvanī vṛndā vṛndāvanavinodinī \|\| 224 \|\|*

*candrāvatī candrakāntā śatacandranibhānanā \|*  
*nāmānyetāni sārāṇi teṣāmabhyantarāṇi ca \|\| 225 \|\|*

223-225. Narayana said – The sixteen names of Radha are Radha, Raseshvari, Rasavasini, RasikeshvarT, Krishnapranadhika, Krishnapriya, Krishnasvampini, Krishnavamangasambhuta, Paramanandampini, Krishna, VrindavanI, Vmda, Vrindavanavinodini, Chandravati, Chandrakanta and Satachandrani-bhanana. These sixteen names form part of the thousand names of Radha.

## \|\| 17.226 \|\|

*rādhetyevaṃ ca saṃsiddhā rākāro dānavācakaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ nirvāṇadātrī yā sā rādhā parikīrtitā \|\| 226 \|\|*

226\. In the word Radha, the letter .. stands for salvation and … stands for the giving away in charity. Thus the one who gives away moksa in charity is known as Radha.

## \|\| 17.227 \|\|

*rā ca rāse ca bhavanāddhā eva dhāraṇādaho \|*  
*hareralidganādārāttana rādhā prakīrtitā \|\| 227 \|\|*

227\. Besides ti stands for the dance and ЧТ stands for the one who holds it. Therefore she is known as Radha because she embraced Hari.

## \|\| 17.228 \|\|

*rāseśvarasya patnīyaṃ tena rāseśvarī smṛtā \|*  
*rāse ca vāso yasyāśca tena sā rāsavāsinī \|\| 228 \|\|*

228\. Because she happens to be the wife of the lord of dance, therefore she is called Raseshvari. Since she is completely engrossed in the divine dance, therefore she is known as RasavasinL

## \|\| 17.229 \|\|

*sarvāsāṃ rasikānāṃ ca devīnāmīśvarī parā \|*  
*pravadanti purā santastena tāṃ rasikeśvarīm \|\| 229 \|\|*

229\. The saints say her as Rasikesavarl because she is foremost of all the goddess of taste.

## \|\| 17.230 \|\|

*prāṇādhikā preyasī sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā sā ca kṛṣṇena parikīrtitā \|\| 230 \|\|*

230\. Since she is dearer to lord Krishna than even his life, therefore she is given the name of Krishnapranadhika by lord himself.

## \|\| 17.231 \|\|

*kṛṣṇasyātipriyā kāntā kṛṣṇo vā'syāḥ priyaḥ sadā \|*  
*sarvairdevagaṇairuktā tena kṛṣṇapriyā smṛtā \|\| 231 \|\|*

231\. She was beloved wife of lord Krishna and Krishna was always beloved to her, therefore, all the deities called her Krishnapriya.

## \|\| 17.232-233 \|\|

*kṛṣṇarūpaṃ sannidhātuṃ yā śaktā cāvalīlayā \|*  
*sarvāṃśaiḥ kṛṣṇasadṛśī tena kṛṣṇasvarūpiṇī \|\| 232 \|\|*

*vāmāṅgārdhena kṛṣṇasya yā saṃbhūtā parā satī \|*  
*kṛṣṇavāmāṅgasaṃbhūtā tena kṛṣṇena kīrtitā \|\| 233 \|\|*

232-233. Since she, at times, takes to the form of Krishna playfully therefore she is known as Krishnasvarupinl. She is the chaste, beloved of Krishna and emerged out of the left side of the lord, therefore she is called Krishnavamanga-sambhQtS.

## \|\| 17.234 \|\|

*paramānandarāśiśca svayaṃ mūrtimatī satī \|*  
*śrutibhiḥ kīrtitā tena paramānandarūpiṇī \|\| 234 \|\|*

234\. The chaste Radha happens to be the heap of bliss, therefore, she is given the name in the Vedas Paramanandarupinl.

## \|\| 17.235 \|\|

*kṛṣirmokṣārthavacano na evotkṛṣṭavācakaḥ \|*  
*ākāro dātṛvacanastena kṛṣṇā prakīrtitā \|\| 235 \|\|*

235\. The word stands for the moksa and vr stands for the excellent and за giver the meaning as giver of moksa, therefore she is known as Krishna.

## \|\| 17.236 \|\|

*asti vṛndāvanaṃ yasyāstena vṛndāvanī smṛtā \|*  
*vṛndāvanasyādhidevī tena vā'tha prakīrtitā \|\| 236 \|\|*

236\. Since she belongs to Vrindavana therefore she is known as Vrindavanl. Or otherwise she is known by that name since she is the goddess of Vrindavana.

## \|\| 17.237 \|\|

*saṃghaḥ sakhīnāṃ vṛndaḥ syādakāro'pyastivācakaḥ \|*  
*sakhivṛndo'sti yasyāśca sā vṛndā parikīrtitā \|\| 237 \|\|*

237\. The group of the female friends is also known as Vmda and зт stands for strength and prowess. Since she has the group of female friends, therefore she is called Vmda.

## \|\| 17.238 \|\|

*vṛndāvane vinodaśca so'syā hyasti ca tatra vai \|*  
*vedā vadanti tāṃ tena vṛndāvanavinodinīm \|\| 238 \|\|*

238\. Since she enjoys enough of pleasure in Vrindavana, therefore the Vedas know her by the name of Vrindavanavinodinl.

## \|\| 17.239-240 \|\|

*nakhacandrāvalīvakracandro'sti yatra saṃtatam \|*  
*tena candrāvalī sā ca kṛṣṇena parikīrtitā \|\| 239 \|\|*

*candratulyā kāntirasti sadā yasyā divāniśam \|*  
*sā candrakāntā harṣeṇa hariṇā parikīrtitā \|\| 240 \|\|*

239-240. Since she has the face which emits the rays of the moon always therefore she has been given the name of Chandravati; since her face always emits the glory of the moon therefore, she is known by the name of Chandrakanta.

## \|\| 17.241 \|\|

*śaraccandraprabhā yasyāścānane'sti divāniśam \|*  
*muninā kīrtitā tena śaraccandraprabhānanā \|\| 241 \|\|*

241\. Since the glory of the full moon of the winter season always emerged from her face, therefore, she is known as Satachandranibhanana.

## \|\| 17.242-244 \|\|

*idaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmoktamarthavyākhyānasaṃyutam \|*  
*nārāyaṇena yaddattaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipaṅkaje \|\| 242 \|\|*

*brahmaṇā ca purā dattaṃ dharmāya janakāya me \|*  
*dharmeṇa kṛpayā dattaṃ mahyamādityaparvaṇi \|\| 243 \|\|*

*puṣkare ca mahātīrthe puṇyāhe devasaṃsadi \|*  
*rādhāprabhāvaprastāve suprasannena cetasā \|\| 244 \|\|*

242-244. Thus I have spoken out the details about her and all the sixteen names which were narrated by lord Narayana himself to Brahma who was seated on the lotus and Brahma in return narrated the same to my father. The same details were narrated by dharma in Puskara region at the time of a solar eclipse during an auspicious time, in the assembly of gods about the glory of Radha. Thereafter getting delighted the same knowledge was imparted to me.

## \|\| 17.245-247 \|\|

*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tubhyaṃ dattaṃ mayā mune \|*  
*nindakāyāvaiṣṇavāya na dātavyaṃ mahāmune \|\| 245 \|\|*

*yāvajjīvamidaṃ stotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*rādhāmādhavayoḥ pādapadme bhaktirbhavediha \|\| 246 \|\|*

*ante labhettayordāsyaṃ śaśvatsahacaro bhavet \|*  
*aṇimādikasiddhiṃ ca saṃprāpya nityavigraham \|\| 247 \|\|*

245-247. Now I have recited this immensely auspicious stotra to you, the knowledge of which should never be imparted to a non-believer, the one who denounces dharma or an non-Vaishnava. О sage, the one who recites this stotra thrice a day, achieves the lotus-like feet of Radhamadhava with devotion during this birth itself. Ultimately he. achieves the slavehood of the feet of the lord and becomes his companion for all times to come. He achieves the eternal body together with the siddhis like anima and others.

## \|\| 17.248-251 \|\|

*vratadānopavāsaiśca sarvairniyamapūrvakaiḥ \|*  
*caturṇāṃ caiva vedānāṃ pāṭhaiḥ sarvārthasaṃyutaiḥ \|\| 248 \|\|*

*sarveṣāṃ yajñatīrthānāṃ karaṇairvidhibodhitaiḥ \|*  
*pradakṣiṇena bhūmeśca kṛtsnāyā eva saptadhā \|\| 249 \|\|*

*śaraṇāgatarakṣāyāmajñānāṃ jñānadānataḥ \|*  
*devānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca darśanenāpi yatphalam \|\| 250 \|\|*

*tadeva stotrapāṭhasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm \|*  
*stotrasyāsya prabhāveṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|\| 251 \|\|*

248-251. The merits one earns by performing all the vratas, giving away in charities, performing vratas, reciting the Vedas with their meanings, performing all the yajnas in a proper manner, taking a round of the entire earth, protection of the people who come to take refuge, imparting knowledge to those who are without it and getting an audience with the gods or the Vais nava, the same merit cannot be compared with the one-sixteenth part of the merit one earns by reciting this stotra. With the recitation of this stotra a person is relieved of his birth and death.

## \|\| 17.252-254 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*saṃprāptaṃ paramāścaryaṃ stotraṃ sarvasudurlabham \|*  
*kavacaṃ cāpi devyāśca saṃsāravijayaṃ prabho \|\| 252 \|\|*

*kṛtaṃ stotraṃ suyatnena prāptaṃ tadapi durlabham \|*  
*śrutvā kṛṣṇakathāṃ citrāṃ tvatpādābjaprasādataḥ \|\| 253 \|\|*

*adhunā śrotumicchāmi yadrahasyaṃ ca tadvada \|*  
*prātaśca nagaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kimūcurballavā mune \|\| 254 \|\|*

252-254. Narada said – О lord, you have bestowed the knowledge of the extremely inaccessible stotra to me and I have also received the kavacha of Radha which bestows victory in the universe. I have also attained the knowledge of the inaccessible stotra composed by the yajha. By the grace of your lotus-like feet, I have listened to the astonishing type of story of lord Krishna; now you kindly enlighten me about the secret and the reaction of the cowherds after looking at the city.

## \|\| 17.255 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*gatāyāṃ tatra yāminyāṃ gate ca viśvakarmaṇi \|*  
*aruṇodayavelāyāṃ janāḥ sarve jajāgaruḥ \|\| 255 \|\|*

255\. Narayana said – When the night was over, Vishvakarma left the place at day-break and all the people woke up.

## \|\| 17.256 \|\|

*utthāya dṛṣṭvā nagaraṃ sarvebhyo'pi vilakṣaṇam \|*  
*kimāścaryaṃ kimāścaryamityūcurvrajavāsinaḥ \|\| 256 \|\|*

256\. Soon after waking up, they were surprised to find the astonishing construction of the city and all the people said, "This is simply astonishing."

## \|\| 17.257 \|\|

*kāścidgopānkecidūcuḥ kuta etadabhūdidam \|*  
*na jāne kena rūpeṇa ko bhūmau prabhavediti \|\| 257 \|\|*

257\. Some of the people said to the cowherds, "How could it happen, who knows, who appeared on the ground and in what form.".

## \|\| 17.258-259 \|\|

*bubudhe manasā nando gargavākyamanusmaran \|*  
*śrīharericchayā sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram \|\| 258 \|\|*

*brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ yasya bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā \|*  
*āvirbhūtaṃ tirobhūtaṃ tasyāsādhyaṃ ca kiṃ kutaḥ \|\| 259 \|\|*

258-259. Recollecting the words of Garga, Narada understood everything that it had all happened by the will of the lord. Because this moveable and immovable universe is created with his will and with his simple frowning everything from Brahma to a straw is made and unmade. What could be beyond his competence?

## \|\| 17.260 \|\|

*vivareṣveva yallomnāṃ brahmāṇḍānyakhilāni ca \|*  
*īśasya tanmahāviṣṇoḥ kimasādhyaṃ hareraho \|\| 260 \|\|*

260\. The lord, in the hair-pits of whose body, the eternal globes are lodged what could be beyond the competence of such a Maha-Vishnu.

## \|\| 17.261 \|\|

*brahmānanteśadharmāśca dhyāyante yatpadāmbujam \|*  
*kimasādhyaṃ tadīśasya māyāmānuṣarūpiṇaḥ \|\| 261 \|\|*

261\. The gods like Brahma, Ananta, Shiva and Dharma always adore at his lotus-like feet. What is beyond the competence of such an illusory lord.

## \|\| 17.262-263 \|\|

*bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ tannagaraṃ darśaṃdarśaṃ gṛhaṃgṛham \|*  
*pāṭhaṃpāṭhaṃ ca nāmāni sarvebhyo nilayaṃ dadau \|\| 262 \|\|*

*kṛtvā śubhakṣaṇaṃ nando vṛṣabhānaśca kautukī \|*  
*cakāra sagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ mudā''śramaniveśanam \|\| 263 \|\|*

262-263. Nanda went round each and every place in the city and distributed the houses to all looking at the name plates fixed on each one of them. Both Nanda and Vrsabhanu delightfully entered their respective houses at an auspicious time together with their families and servants.

## \|\| 17.264-265 \|\|

*sarve vṛndāvanasthāśca prasannavadanekṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*mudā praveśanaṃ cakruḥ svasvamāśramamuttamam \|\| 264 \|\|*

*sarve mumudire gopāḥ svesve sthāne manohare \|*  
*bālakā bālikāścaiva cikrīḍuśca praharṣitāḥ \|\| 265 \|\|*

264-265. Their faces and eyes were delighted while staying in Vrindavana. Thereafter, all the gopas entered their respective abodes gleefully. All the people felt happy in the beautiful houses given to them. The boys and girls started rejoicing, playing at the same time.

## \|\| 17.266 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇo baladevaśca śiśubhiḥ saha kautukāt \|*  
*krīḍāṃ cakāra tatraiva sthānesthāne manohare \|\| 266 \|\|*

266\. Lord Krishna and Baladeva also playfully engaged themselves in sport together with other boys there at charming places.

## \|\| 17.267 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ nirmāṇaṃ nagarasya ca \|*  
*abalānāṃ vane rāsamaṇḍalasya ca nārada \|\| 267 \|\|*

267\. Thus, О Narada, I have narrated to you the details about the construction of the city and the Rasamandala for the cowherdesses in the forest.

## Chapter 18

## \|\| 18.1 \|\|

*. śaunaka uvāca \|*  
*aho kimadbhutaṃ sūta rahasyaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*śrutaṃ kṛṣṇasya caritaṃ sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ param \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shaunaka said – О Suta, this is an astonishing type of story of lord Krishna which is quite secret and provides welfare besides salvation.

## \|\| 18.2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*śrutvā nagaranirmāṇaṃ nārado munisattamaḥ \|*  
*papraccha kṛṣṇacaritamaparaṃ sumanoharam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Suta said – Hearing about the construction of the city, Narada the best of the sages, enquired about the other story about lord Krishna.

## \|\| 18.3 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇākhyānacaritaṃ pīyūṣamṛṣisattama \|*  
*jñānasiṃdho nigada māṃ śiṣyaṃ ca śaraṇāgatam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Narada said – О best of the sages, О ocean of knowledge, I have arrived to take refuge under Woman your feet and as your pupil also, therefore, you kindly continue to narrate the nectar-like story of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 18.4 \|\|

*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā mudā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*uvāca paramīśasya caritaṃ paramādbhutam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. On hearing the words of Narada, Narayana himself started narrating the astonishing annal of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 18.5 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ balena saha mādhavaḥ \|*  
*jagāma śrīmadhuvanaṃ yamunātīranīrajam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Narayana said – Once Madhava accompanied by Baladeva and other boys went to Madhuvana on the bank of Yamuna which was created as an island on its bank.

## \|\| 18.6-7 \|\|

*vicerurgosahasraiśca cikrīḍurbālakāstadā \|*  
*viśrāntāstṛṭparītāśca kṣudhā ca paripīḍitāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tamūcurgopaśiśavaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parayā mudā \|*  
*kṣudasmānbādhate kṛṣṇa kiṃ kurmo brūhi kiṃkarān \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. All the boys started roaming about in that place together with thousands of cows. After getting tired they felt hungry and thirsty and all of them spoke to Krishna, "O Krishna we are feeling extremely hungry; we are your attendants, tell us what should be done?"

## \|\| 18.8 \|\|

*śiśūnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tānuvāca dayānidhiḥ \|*  
*hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vacanaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. On hearing the words of the boys, Krishna with a delightful face being the ocean of mercy, spoke to them the truthful words.

## \|\| 18.9-11 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bālā gacchata viprāṇāṃ yajñasthānaṃ sukhāvaham \|*  
*annaṃ yācata tāñchīghraṃ brāhmaṇāṃśca kratūnmukhān \|\| 9 \|\|*

*viprā āṃgirasāḥ sarve svāśrame śrīvanāntike \|*  
*yajñaṃ kurvanti viprāśca śrutismṛtiviśāradāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*niḥspṛhā vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve māṃ yajanti mumukṣavaḥ \|*  
*māyayā māṃ na jānanti māyāmānuṣarūpiṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. Shri Krishna said – О boys, you go to the place of yajna of the Brahmanas and ask them for food from them when they might be engaged in performing the yajna. The sages like Angira and other Brahmanas well-versed in the scriptures are engaged in the performing of the yajna. They are all Vaishnava and are performing the yajna for achieving salvation, but they are unable to realise about me, because of the illusion.

## \|\| 18.12 \|\|

*na ceddadati yuṣmabhyamannaṃ viprāḥ kratūnmukhāḥ \|*  
*tatkāntā yācata kṣipraṃ dayāyuktāḥ śiśūnprati \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. In case the Brahmanas do not give away food to you being engaged in the performing of the yajna, then you can go to their wives, who are always compassionate on children.

## \|\| 18.13 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā yayurbālakapuṃgavāḥ \|*  
*purato brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tasthurānamrakaṃdharāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. On hearing the words of Krishna, all the boys reached there and bowing in reverence to the Brahmanas stood there.

## \|\| 18.14 \|\|

*ityūcurbālakāḥ śīghramannaṃ datta dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*na śuśruvurdvijāḥ kecitkecicchrutvā sthitāḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The boys said – О best of the Brahmanas, you give us food at once. But many of them did not hear those words while others stood there attentively in spite of listening to them.

## \|\| 18.15 \|\|

*te yayū randhanāgāraṃ brāhmaṇyo yatra pācikāḥ \|*  
*gatvā bālā viprabhāryāḥ praṇemurnatakandharāḥ \|\| 15\|\|*

15\. Thereafter the boys went to the kitchen where the Brahmana women were cooking the food and bowed in reverence to them.

## \|\| 18.16 \|\|

*natvocurbālakāḥ sarve viprabhāryāḥ pativratāḥ \|*  
*annaṃ datta mātaro'smānkṣudhārtānbālakānapi \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Offering their salutations to the chaste Brahmana women, the boys said, "O mothers, we are suffering from hunger and therefore give us food.".

## \|\| 18.17 \|\|

*bālānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tāṃśca manoharān \|*  
*papracchuḥ sādaraṃ sādhvyaḥ smerānanasaroruhāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. On hearing the words of the boys, they looked at them who were quite charming, smiling with lotus-like faces. The chaste ladies then asked them respectfully.

## \|\| 18.18-19 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇre śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe viprapatnīmokṣa ṇaprastāvonāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇīnāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā tā ūcuste mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*snigdhā hasantaḥ sphītāśca sarve gopālabālakāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. The Brahmatia women said – "O intelligent boys, who are you? Who has sent you? What are your names? We shall serve you food with several other delicious dishes." On hearing the words of the ladies, all the boys laughed with delight and said.

## \|\| 18.20-22 \|\|

*bālā ūcuḥ \|*  
*preṣitā rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ vayaṃ kṣutpīḍitā bhṛśam \|*  
*dattānnaṃ mātaro'smabhyaṃ kṣipraṃ yāmastadantikam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ito vidūre bhāṇḍīre vanābhyantarameva ca \|*  
*vaṭamūle madhuvane vasantau rāmakeśavau \|\| 21 \|\|*

*viśrāntau kṣudhitau tau ca yācete'nnaṃ ca mātaraḥ \|*  
*kimu deyamadeyaṃ vā śīghraṃ vadata no'dhunā \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. The boys said – "O mothers, we have been sent here by Rama and Krishna, we are extremely hungry. You give us food. We have to return to them immediately. Both Baladeva and Krishna are seated under the shade of a banyan tree in Madhuvana located in Bhandlra forest, a little distance away from this place. О mothers, they are quite peaceful, besides being hungry and thirsty and are demanding food. Do you want to give us or not; you tell us frankly.".

## \|\| 18.23 \|\|

*gopānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā hṛṣṭānandāśrulocanāḥ \|*  
*pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgāstatpādābjamanorathāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. On hearing the words of the cowherds, the eyes of the ladies were filled with joy and their hair on the body stood on end because they were desirous of having a look at the lotus-like feet of the lord.

## \|\| 18.24-25 \|\|

*nānāvyañjanasaṃyuktaṃ śālyannaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ svādu dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu \|\| 24 \|\|*

*raupye kāṃsye rājate ca pātre kṛtvā mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*tāḥ sarvā viprapatnyaśca prayayuḥ kṛṣṇasannidhim \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. They arranged food in plates of gold and silver besides the flowers and delightfully carried the same to them. The food contained boiled rice, milk mixed with rice, tasteful curd, milk, ghee and honey which they carried to lord Krishna.

## \|\| 18.26 \|\|

*nānāmanorathaṃ kṛtvā manasā gamanotsukāḥ \|*  
*pativratāstā dhanyāśca śrīkṛṣṇadarśanotsukāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Such of the chaste ladies are quite graceful who go for an audience with Krishna preserving many desires in their mind.

## \|\| 18.27-28 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dadṛśurgatvā rāmaṃ ca saha bālakam \|*  
*vaṭamūle vasantaṃ tamuḍumadhye yathoḍupam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*śyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam \|*  
*sundaraṃ sasmitaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Reaching there, they found Krishna and Balarama seated there with other boys under the shade of the banyan tree. They looked as if the moon was surrounded by the stars, he had a dark-complexion, was of tender age, wore a yellow silken garment, had a smiling face; was peaceful and shining being the lord of Radha.

## \|\| 18.29 \|\|

*śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam \|*  
*ratnakuṇḍalayugmābhyāṃ gaṇḍasthalavirājitam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. He had the face resembling the full moon of the winter season and was adorned with the gem-studded ornaments, a pair of kundalas was adorning his ears.

## \|\| 18.30-32 \|\|

*ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpurabhūṣitam \|*  
*ājānulambitāṃ śubhrāṃ bibhrataṃ ratnamālikām \|\| 30 \|\|*

*mālatīmālayā kaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalavirājitam \|*  
*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumāñcitavigraham \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sunakhaṃ sukapolaṃ ca pakva bimbādharaṃ varam \|*  
*pakvadāḍimabījābhaṃ bibhrataṃ dantamuttamam \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. He had on his person the gem-studded annlets, wristlets and anklets and he wore a long garland of forest flowers falling up to the knees. He was wearing the garland of jasmine flowers on his neck and the chest. His body was plastered with sandal-paste, aguru, kastUrl and saffron; his nose and cheeks were quite beautiful. The lips resembled the ripe wood-apples and the line of teeth resembled the ripe seeds of the pomegranate.

## \|\| 18.33-35 \|\|

*śikhipicchasamāyuktaṃ baddhacūḍaṃ parātparam \|*  
*kadambapuṣpayugmābhyāṃ karṇamūle virājitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*dhyānāsādhyaṃ yogināṃ ca bhaktānugrahakātaram \|*  
*brahmeśadharmaśeṣendraiḥ stūyamānaṃ munīśvaraiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvaivamīśvaraṃ bhaktyā praṇemurdvijayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*svānāṃ jñānānurūpaṃ ca tuṣṭuvurmadhusūdanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. He had a peacock feather placed on his head and the flowers of kadamba adorned his ears. Lord Krishna who happens to be beyond the reach of the yogis but he always remains anxious to shower his grace on his devotees. Brahma, Shiva, Dharma, Shesha, Indra and the sages always offer prayers to him. Looking at such a type of lord, the wives of the Brahmanas bowed to him in reverence.

## \|\| 18.36-37 \|\|

*viprapatnya ūcuḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ dhāma nirīho nirahaṃkṛtiḥ \|*  
*nirguṇaśca nirākāraḥ sākāraḥ saguṇaḥ svayam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sākṣirūpaśca nirliptaḥ paramātmā nirākṛtiḥ \|*  
*prakṛtiḥ puruṣastvaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ ca tayoḥ param \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. The Brahmana women said – О lord, you are Brahman, the eternal abode, without desires, pride, qualities, formless and with form, without qualities, witness of all, uninvolved, the great soul, formless besides being Prakriti and Purusa. You happen to be the cause of both of them.

## \|\| 18.38 \|\|

*sṛṣṭisthityantaviṣaye ye ca devāstrayaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*te tvadaṃśāḥ sarvabījā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Though Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are known to create, preserve and destroy the universe, they also happen to be your own amsha.

## \|\| 18.39 \|\|

*yasya lomnāṃ ca vivare cākhilaṃ viśvamīśvara \|*  
*mahāvirāṇmahāviṣṇustvaṃ tasya janako vibho \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О lord, you are the Virat form of Maha-Vishnu in whose hair-pits of the body all the globes are lodged.

## \|\| 18.40 \|\|

*tejastvaṃ cāpi tejasvī jñānaṃ jñānī ca tatparaḥ \|*  
*vede'nirvacanīyastvaṃ kastvāṃ stotumiheśvaraḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. You possess lustre, knowledge and are the form of knowledge. It has been described in the Vedas that you are the one, who is beyond description, who can be competent enough to recite your glory?

## \|\| 18.41-42 \|\|

*mahadādisṛṣṭisūtraṃ pañcatanmātrameva ca \|*  
*bījaṃ tvaṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ sarvaśaktisvarūpakaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*sarvaśaktīśvaraḥ sarvaḥ sarvaśaktyāśrayaḥ sadā \|*  
*tvamanīhaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ sarvānandaḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. You are mahat and the form of the globe, pancatanmatras, the seed of all the tejas, a form of all the tejas, the lord of all the tejas and the abode of all the tejas. You are beyond desires, self-illumining, blissful and eternal. Being formless, you also possess several forms. You are beyond the organ of senses though you are well aware of the subject of each one of them.

## \|\| 18.43-45 \|\|

*aho'pyākārahīnastvaṃ sarvavigrahavānapi \|*  
*sarveṃdriyāṇāṃ viṣayaṃ jānāsi nendriyī bhavān \|\| 43 \|\|*

*sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā yatstotre yannirūpaṇe \|*  
*jaḍībhūto maheśaśca śeṣo dharmo vidhiḥ svayam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*pārvatī kamalā rādhā sāvitrī vedasūrapi \|*  
*vedaśca jaḍatāṃ yāti ke vā śaktā vipaścitaḥ \|\| 45\|\|*

43-45. The one, by describing whose glory and highlighting whose tattvas even Sarasvati becomes dumb-folded, besides Shiva, Shesha, Dharma and even Brahma, besides Parvati, Laks ml, Radha, Savitri, the creation of the Vedas; therefore who can offer prayers to you.

## \|\| 18.46 \|\|

*vayaṃ kiṃ stavanaṃ kurmaḥ striyaḥ prāṇeśvareśvara \|*  
*prasanno bhava no deva dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. О lord of our lives, we are only women; what can we offer you as a prayer? О lord of the drown-trodden, О lord, be happy and graceful to us.

## \|\| 18.47 \|\|

*iti petuśca tā viprapatnyastaccaraṇāmbuje \|*  
*abhayaṃ pradadau tābhyaḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Thus speaking all the ladies fell at the feet of the lord. Thereafter the delightful lord assured them all protection.

## \|\| 18.48 \|\|

*viprapatnīkṛtaṃ stotraṃ pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*sa gatiṃ viprapatnīnāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The one who recites this stotra of the wives of the Brahmanas at the time of performing pitja, achieves high place. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 18.49 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*tāḥ padāmbhojapatitā dṛṣṭvā śrīmadhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*varaṃ vṛṇuta kalyāṇaṃ bhavitā cetyuvāca ha \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Narayana said – Finding the ladies falling at his feet Madhusudana said – "You ask for a boon." You will meet with all the welfare.

## \|\| 18.50 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā viprapantyo mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*tamūcurvacanaṃ bhaktyā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. On hearing the words of Shri Krishna, the wives of the Brahmanas delightfully stood there with their mind filled with devotion and said to Krishna.

## \|\| 18.51 \|\|

*dvijapatnya ūcuḥ \|*  
*varaṃ kṛṣṇa na gṛhṇīmo naḥ spṛhā tvatpadāmbuje \|*  
*dehi svaṃ dāsyamasmabhyaṃ dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ sudurlabhām \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The wives of the Brahmanas said – Krishna, we are not interested in a boon, we are the followers of your lotus-like feet; therefore you kindly grant us the inaccessible slavehood of your feet.

## \|\| 18.52 \|\|

*paśyāmo'nukṣaṇaṃ vaktrasarojaṃ tava keśava \|*  
*anugrahaṃ kuru vibho na yāsyāmo gṛhaṃ punaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О Keshava, we should always look at your lotus-like face. О virtuous one, be compassionate on us, we do not intend to go back to our abodes, feprfte: ящт: ch€unftfa:l

## \|\| 18.53 \|\|

*dvijapatnīvacaḥ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ \|*  
*omityuktvā trilokeśastasthau bālakasaṃsadi \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The compassionate Krishna, the lord of the three worlds, listened to the words of the Brahmana wives and said, "All right". He then sat there in the company of the boys.

## \|\| 18.54-57 \|\|

*pradattaṃ viprapatnībhirmiṣṭamannaṃ sudhopamam \|*  
*bālakānbhojayitvā tu svayaṃ ca bubhuje vibhuḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tatra śātakumbhaṃ rathaṃ param \|*  
*dadṛśurviprapatnyaśca patantaṃ gaganādaho \|\| 55 \|\|*

*ratnadarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ ratnasāraparicchadam \|*  
*ratnastambhairnibaddhaṃ ca sadratnakalaśojjvalam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*śvetacāmarasaṃyuktaṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitam \|*  
*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitam \|\| 57 \|\|*

54-57. Lord Krishna then made the boys to consume the sweet and delicious food and himself also did so. In the meantime the wives of the Brahmana found that an astonishing type of chariot was descending from the sky. It had the mirrors of gems and diamonds. It had the gem-studded pillars, shining with beautiful kalasas, the white fly-whisks, the best of the silken costumes and it was decorated with the garlands of Pdrijata flowers.

## \|\| 18.58-60 \|\|

*śatacakrasamāyuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam \|*  
*veṣṭitaṃ pārṣadairdivyairvanamālāvibhūṣitaiḥ \|\| 58\|\|*

*pītavastraparīdhānai ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitaiḥ \|*  
*navayauvanasaṃpannaiḥ śyāmalaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*dvibhujairmuralīhastairgopaveṣadharairvaraiḥ \|*  
*śikhipicchaguñjamālābaddhavakrimacūḍakaiḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

58-60. It had a hundred wheels and could move with the speed of the mind. The beautiful chariot was surrounded by the attendants wearing a long garland of lotus flowers, clad in a yellow lower garment and adorned with gem-studded ornaments. They were all young having a dark-complexion, quite pleasant to look at, having two arms, holding a flute in the hand and appearing in the best of the costumes of cowherds. Their hair was well-arranged on the head with a peacock feather appearing at the top.

## \|\| 18.61 \|\|

*avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ te praṇamya hareḥ padam \|*  
*rathamārohaṇaṃ kartumūcurbrāhmaṇakāminīḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The attendants descended from the chariot and bowed at the feet of the lord and asked the Brahmana women to mount on the chariot.

## \|\| 18.62 \|\|

*viprabhāryā hariṃ natvā jagmurgolokamīpsitam \|*  
*babhūvurgopikāḥ sadyastyaktvā mānuṣavigrahān \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The Brahmana women bowing at the feet of lord Krishna went to the Goloka and shedding their human bodies, they were turned into the forms of cowherds in the Goloka.

## \|\| 18.63 \|\|

*hariśchāyāṃ vinirmāya tāsāṃ ca viṣṇumāyayā \|*  
*prasthāpayāmāsa gṛhānbrāhmaṇānāṃ svayaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Thereafter the lord created the shadow Brahmana women and sent them back to their abodes in place of the original ones.

## \|\| 18.64 \|\|

*viprāśca bhāryā uddiśya paramodvignamānasāḥ \|*  
*anveṣaṇaṃ prakurvanto dadṛśuḥ pathi kāminīḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The Brahmanas getting annoyed were searching for them in their abodes. In the meantime, they came across the shadow Brahmana women on the path.

## \|\| 18.65 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvocurbrāhmaṇāḥ sarve tāste ca vinayānvitāḥ \|*  
*pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgāḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇāḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. All the Brahmanas felt emotional by looking at them and their faces blossomed like the lotus flowers. They spoke to the Brahmana women quite meekly.

## \|\| 18.66-67 \|\|

*brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*aho'tidhanyā yūyaṃ ca dṛṣṭo yuṣmābhirīśvaraḥ \|*  
*asmākaṃ jīvanaṃ vyarthaṃ vedapāṭho'pyanarthakaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*vede purāṇe sarvatra vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ \|*  
*harervibhūtayaḥ sarvāḥ sarveṣāṃ janako hariḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. The Brahmana said – "All of you are quite graceful because you have had an audience with the lord. The lives of us people are of no consequence, besides the reciting of the Vedas. It has been ordained in the Vedas and the Puranas by the intellectuals that the entire universe is the Icjas of the lord.

## \|\| 18.68 \|\|

*tapo japo vrataṃ jñānaṃ vedā dhyayanamarcanam \|*  
*tīrthasnānamanaśanaṃ sarveṣāṃ phalado hariḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. It is the lord alone, who bestows the reward of the tapas, recitation, performing of vrata, knowledge, recitation of the Vedas, performing of puja, visiting of the sacred places and the performing of vratas besides fasting.

## \|\| 18.69 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sevito yena kiṃ tasya tapasāṃ phalaiḥ \|*  
*prāptaḥ kalpataruryena kiṃ tasyānyena śākhinā \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Whosoever has adored lord Krishna, would not be in need of the reward for performing his tapas. When one gets the kalpavrksa, then he no more requires the ordinary trees.

## \|\| 18.70-71 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇo hṛdaye yasya tasya kiṃ karmabhiḥ kṛtaiḥ \|*  
*kiṃ vā na sāgarasyaiva pauruṣaṃ kūpalaṅghane \|\| 70 \|\|*

*ityevamuktvā viprāśca gṛhītvā kāminīvarāḥ \|*  
*ājagmuḥ svagṛhaṃ hṛṣṭāstābhiḥ sārdhaṃ ca remire \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. The one, in whose heart lord Krishna dwells, does not need to perform any deeds. The one, who has drunk the ocean, the digging of a well is of no consequence for him." Thus speaking, the Brahmanas returned to their respective abodes together with all the damsels and enjoyed their company.

## \|\| 18.72-73 \|\|

*tāsāṃ tato'dhikaṃ prema krīḍāsu sarvakarmasu \|*  
*dākṣiṇyaṃ māyayā śaktyā brāhmaṇānāmatarkitam \|\| 72 \|\|*

*atha nārāyaṇaḥ so'yaṃ balena śiśubhiḥ saha \|*  
*jagāma svālayaṃ tūrṇaṃ pūrṇabrahma sanātanaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. By enjoying their company, the Brahmanas were much more delighted as compared to their earlier enjoyment. But the truth about the excess of the same, the Brahmanas could not realise. Thereafter, lord Krishna, accompanied by Balabhadra and other cowherds returned to their respective abodes.

## \|\| 18.74 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ harermāhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*purā śrutaṃ dharmavaktrātkiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Thus I have narrated to you the best of the glory of the lord which I had heard in earlier times from the mouth of Dharma. What else do you want to listen to?

## \|\| 18.75 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*ṛṣīndra kena puṇyena babhūva viprayoṣitām \|*  
*munīndrayogasiddhānāṃ durlabhā gatirīśvarī \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Narada said – О best of the sages, with the influence of whose merit, the Brahmana women achieved that stage which is inaccessible to the sages, yogis and siddhas.

## \|\| 18.76 \|\|

*imāḥ kā vā puṇyavatyaḥ purā tasthurmahītalam \|*  
*ājagmuḥ kena doṣeṇa vada saṃdehabhañjanam \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. What were the virtuous women in their earlier births and for what crime did they reach the earth? You kindly remove this doubt of mine.

## \|\| 18.77 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*saptarṣīṇāṃ ramaṇyaśca rūpeṇāpratimāḥ parāḥ \|*  
*guṇavatyaḥ suśīlāśca dharmiṣṭhāśca pativratāḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Narayana said – These women happened to be the spouses of Saptarsis and were quite beautiful, virtuous, meek, religious-minded and chaste.

## \|\| 18.78-79 \|\|

*navīnayauvanāḥ sarvāḥ pīnaśroṇi payodharāḥ \|*  
*divyavastraparīdhānā ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*taptakāñcanavarṇābhāḥ smerānanasaroruhāḥ \|*  
*munīnāṃ mohituṃ śaktā mānasaṃ vakracakṣuṣā \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. All of them were youthful with stiff breasts and developed pelvic region, clad in divine garments and adorned with gem-studded ornaments, having the complexion of molten gold, their faces resembled the full-blown lotus flowers and looked with side-glances, attracting the minds of even the great sages.

## \|\| 18.80 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tāsāṃ stanaśroṇimukhāni sundarāṇi ca \|*  
*analaścakame tāśca madanānalapīḍitaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Looking at their beautiful breasts, the pelvic region and the face, the god of fire was infatuated with passion and desired for them.

## \|\| 18.81 \|\|

*agnisthānasthitānāṃ ca śikhayā suratonmukhaḥ \|*  
*spṛṣṭvā cāṅgāni tāsāṃ ca babhūva hṛtacetanaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Then the god of fire touched limb of beautiful women who were at the place of fire with the flames and fainted as a result thereof.

## \|\| 18.82 \|\|

*pativratā na jānanti patipādābjamānasāḥ \|*  
*agniraṅgāni tāsāṃ ca darśaṃdarśaṃ mumoha ca \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The damsels who were devoted to their husbands could not know the trick. On the other hand the god of fire was infatuated with passion at the sight of their bodies.

## \|\| 18.83 \|\|

*vahneśca mānasaṃ jñātvā bhagavānaṅgirā muniḥ \|*  
*śaśāpa taṃ cetyuvāca sarvabhakṣo bhaveti ha \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Realising the mind of the god of fire, the sage Angira pronounced a curse on him saying, "You should consume everything thereafter.".

## \|\| 18.84 \|\|

*vahniḥ sacetano bhūtvā tuṣṭāva munipuṃgavam \|*  
*vrīḍayā namravadanaścakampe brahmatejasā \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Regaining consciousness the god of fire prayed to the sage variously with his head cast down with shame and started trembling for fear of his eternal lustre.

## \|\| 18.85-86 \|\|

*kruddho munivaraḥ spṛṣṭāḥ kāminyaśca śaśāpa ha \|*  
*yāta yūyaṃ pāpayuktā mānuṣīṃ yonimeva ca \|\| 85 \|\|*

*bhārate brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gṛhe labhata janma vai \|*  
*kariṣyanti vivāhaṃ ca yuṣmākaṃ kulajā dvijāḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. The angry sage pronounced a curse on the damsels who were touched by Agni, that they should be born as humans in the house of Brahmanas. They were to be married to Brahmanas of a high race.

## \|\| 18.87 \|\|

*śrutvā vākyaṃ munestāśca ruruduḥ premavihvalāḥ \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyutāḥ sarvā ūcustaṃ viduṣāṃ varam \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. On hearing the words of the sage the damsels started crying and with folded hands they spoke to the foremost of the learned persons.

## \|\| 18.88 \|\|

*munipatnya ūcuḥ \|*  
*na tyajāsmānmuniśreṣṭha niṣpāpāśca pativratāḥ \|*  
*ajānantyaḥ paraspṛṣṭā na ca nastyaktumarhasi \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. The wives of the sages said – "O best of the sages, you have disowned us though we are sinless and chaste. We have been touched without our knowledge and as such you need not disown us.

## \|\| 18.89 \|\|

*bhaktānāṃ kiṃkarīṇāṃ ca na daṇḍaṃ kartumarhasi \|*  
*yuṣmākaṃ caraṇāmbhojaṃ kadā drakṣyāmahe vayam \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. It is not proper for you to punish your devotees like this. When shall we again look at your lotus-like feet?

## \|\| 18.90 \|\|

*khaḍagacchedāñrapātātsarvapraharaṇānyune \|*  
*dāruṇaḥ kāntavicchedaḥ sādhvīnauṃ duḥsahaḥ sadā\|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. О sage, the disowning of a chaste lady by her husband is like cutting her into pieces with a sword or the falling of vajra or attacking with various weapons.

## \|\| 18.91 \|\|

*brahmiṣṭhānāṃ guṇavatāṃ parānkāntānmahāmunīn \|*  
*evaṃbhūtānkathaṃ tyaktvā yāsyāmaḥ pṛthivītalam \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. О virtuous sage, engrossed in Brahman, separating us from such a chaste husband like you, how shall we roam about on earth?

## \|\| 18.92 \|\|

*yāsyāmo yadi vipreśa kadā'trāgamanaṃ vada \|*  
*ajñānasparśadoṣaśca na syānno vidhibodhitaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. On hearing the words of the damsels, the sage looked at their lotus-like faces and with his mind infatuated with love, he started crying.

## \|\| 18.93 \|\|

*ahalyayā punaḥ prāptaḥ svāmīndrasya pradharṣaṇāt \|*  
*sā saṃbhogātpunaḥ śuddhā sparśanādvarjitā vayam \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. О best of Brahmanas, in case we move on to the earth then when shall it be possible for us to return here. It is almost established that we shall not earn the sin of an act done by us unknowingly.

## \|\| 18.94 \|\|

*vicāraṃ kuru dharmiṣṭha vedavedāṅgapāraga \|*  
*viśvakartuśca putrastvaṃ sarvavedavidāṃ vara \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Ahalya, after getting involved with Indra, was owned again by Gautama. She was purified even after enjoying sex with Indra but we on the other hand shall be disowned simply for the reason of being touched.

## \|\| 18.95 \|\|

*anyeṣāṃ ca bhayātkāntā vrajanti śaraṇaṃ patim \|*  
*svakāntabhayasaṃvignāḥ śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajanti tāḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. О religious one, being well-versed in the Vedas and post-Vedic literature, you just think over it. О best of the those well-versed in the Vedas, you happen to be the son of the creator of the universe.

## \|\| 18.96 \|\|

*abhayaṃ dehi dharmiṣṭha bhayayuktābhya eva ca \|*  
*putre śiṣye kalatre ca ko daṇḍaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Getting afraid of others a woman goes to her husband; where shall she take refuge?

## \|\| 18.97 \|\|

*durbalaḥ sabalo vāpi svavastūnāmapīśvaraḥ \|*  
*svadravyavikrayaṃ kartuṃ na cānyo rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. О religious one, you provide protection to us who are getting fearful. Everyone is competent enough to punish his son, pupils and the wife.

## \|\| 18.98 \|\|

*kāminīnāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā dayālurmunipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*premṇā ruroda tāsāṃ ca nirīkṣya mukhapaṅkajam \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. The owner of a commodity whether he is weak or strong, can sell it and no one else can protect it.".

## \|\| 18.99 \|\|

*vedavedāṅgapārajño jñānināṃ yogināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*patnīvicchedaviṣaye mūrcchāṃ prāpa tathāpi saḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Though he was well-versed in Vedic and post-Vedic literature, the best of the intellectuals and the yogis, he lost his senses, getting separated from his wives.

## \|\| 18.100 \|\|

*sarve babhūvuḥ śokārtā virahodvignamānasāḥ \|*  
*nirīkṣya tāsāṃ vaktrāṇi tasthuḥ puttalikā yathā \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. All the people were disturbed and felt gloomy, because of the separation; all of them were dumb found like puppets, looking at them.

## \|\| 18.101 \|\|

*kṛtvā vilāpaṃ suciraṃ sarvavedavidāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*bhrātṛbhiśca sahālocya tā uvāca śucā''turaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. Angira, the sage, who was well-versed in the Vedic and post-Vedic literature, started lamenting. Thereafter he consulted his brothers and feeling grief-stricken, he spoke to the damsels.

## \|\| 18.102 \|\|

*aṅgirā uvāca \|*  
*yūyaṃ śṛṇuta vakṣyāmi vacanaṃ satyameva ca \|*  
*svakarmabhogināṃ bhogamākarmācca śrutau śrutam \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Angira said – I am going to tell you the truth which you please listen to. I have heard from the Vedas that one has to face the result of the deeds performed by him.

## \|\| 18.103 \|\|

*gato bhogaśca yuṣmākamasmābhiḥ saha niścitam \|*  
*gate bhoge punarbhogo na hi vede nirūpitaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Actually the time for your association with me has come to an end. This is certain. After the end of the pleasure one does not have to enjoy the same. This has been ordained in the Vedas.

## \|\| 18.104 \|\|

*śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma bhārate kṛtibhiḥ saha \|*  
*nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma janmakoṭiśatairapi \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. In the land of Bharata all the good or bad deeds are performed by the people and unless their rewards are faced, they do not get destroyed even after the lapse of hundreds of births.

## \|\| 18.105 \|\|

*parabhuktāṃ ca kāntāṃ ca yo bhuṅkte sa narādhamaḥ \|*  
*sa pacyate kālasūtre yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 105\|\|*

105\. The one who enjoys the wife of others, is considered to be a degraded one. He falls into the kalasutra hell till the age of the sun and the moon.

## \|\| 18.106 \|\|

*na sā daive na sā paitrye pākārhā pāpasaṃyutā \|*  
*tasyā āliṃgane bhartā bhraṣṭaśrīstejasā hataḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Such a woman is prevented from cooking food for the gods or the manes. Her husband even achieves a degraded position embracing her.

## \|\| 18.107 \|\|

*devatāḥ pitarastasya havyadāne ca tarpaṇe \|*  
*sukhino na bhavantyevamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. The gods and manes do not feel happy by the offerings made by her. This has been ordained by Brahma.

## \|\| 18.108 \|\|

*tasmādyatnena bhāryāyā rakṣaṇaṃ kurute sudhīḥ \|*  
*anyathā pāpabhāgbhartā niścitaṃ narakaṃ vrajet \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. Therefore the intellectuals protect their wives with great efforts, otherwise the husband would become degraded and fall into the hell.

## \|\| 18.109 \|\|

*padepade sāvadhānaḥ kāntāṃ rakṣati paṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*na vratī na sthalī yoṣā doṣāṇāṃ ca karaṇḍikā \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. An intelligent person getting alert protects his wife at every step because a damsel attracts many blames unmindful of vratas or places.

## \|\| 18.110 \|\|

*kalatraṃ pākapātraṃ ca sadā rakṣitumarhati \|*  
*parasparśādaśuddhāṃ ca śuddhāṃ svasparśane sadā \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Therefore, one should always protect the women and the cooking vases, because they get polluted with the touch of others and by the touch of her husband she always remains pure.

## \|\| 18.111 \|\|

*svakāntaṃ ca parityajya paraṃ gacchati yā'dhamā \|*  
*kumbhīpākaṃ sā prayāti yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. In case a degraded woman who disregarding her own husband, visits some other men, she falls into the kumbhlpaka hell up to the life of the sun and the moon.

## \|\| 18.112 \|\|

*tāmeva yamadūtāśca saṃsthāpya narakāntare \|*  
*uttiṣṭhati vidūrāccetkurvanti daṇḍatāḍanām \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. The messengers of Yama then throw her in another hell and if she wants to come out of it, she is punished with the strikes of rods.

## \|\| 18.113 \|\|

*sarpapramāṇāḥ kīṭāśca tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāḥ sudāruṇāḥ \|*  
*daśanti puṃścalīṃ tatra satataṃ ca divāniśam \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. The terrific insects of the size of snakes and having terrific fangs bite the degraded women continuously day and night.

## \|\| 18.114 \|\|

*vikṛtākāraśabdaṃ ca karoti śāśvataṃ bhiyā \|*  
*na mamāra prahāreṇa sūkṣmadehavidhāriṇī \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. Such a woman cries in pain but she does not die by the stroke because of her having an astral body.

## \|\| 18.115-116 \|\|

*muhūrtārdhaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā loke'tra yaśasā hatā \|*  
*patitā paraloke ca gatimetādṛśīṃ labhet \|\| 115 \|\|*

*paraspṛṣṭā ca vai nārī yā spṛhāṃ kurute param \|*  
*sā'pi duṣṭā parityājyā cetyāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

115-116. For a moment's pleasure on earth, she destroys her grace and also receives hostile treatment after death. The women who have been touched by some other person or desires for someone else, are also to be disowned; this had been ordained by Brahma.

## \|\| 18.117 \|\|

*tasmānnārī parairyatnādadṛṣṭā kṛtibhiḥ kṛtā \|*  
*asūryaṃpaśyā yā dārāḥ śuddhāstāśca pativratāḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Therefore the intellectuals have ordained that the women should be protected from the evil eye of others. Such of the women are considered to be quite chaste, who look at the sun through a curtain.

## \|\| 18.118 \|\|

*svacchandagāminī yā ca svatantrā sūkarīsamā \|*  
*antarduṣṭā sadā saiva niścitaṃ paragāminī \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. The one, who roams about at will independently, is born as a female pig. The wicked women who enjoy the company of others are indeed degraded in all respects.

## \|\| 18.119 \|\|

*svāmisādhyā ca yā nārī kuladharmabhiyā sthitā \|*  
*kāntena sārddhaṃ sā kāntā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti niścitam \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. The one who remains under the control of her husband because of the fear of the family tradition, indeed goes to Vaikuntha with her husband.

## \|\| 18.120 \|\|

*yāta yūyaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ mānuṣīṃ yonimīpsitām \|*  
*kṛṣṇadarśanamātreṇa golokaṃ yāsyatha dhruvam \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. All of you should go to the earth and be born in human race. Getting an audience with Shri Krishna, you would get purified and achieve Goloka.

## \|\| 18.121 \|\|

*hariṇā nirmitāśchāyā yuṣmākaṃ yogamāyayā \|*  
*tā vipramandire sthitvā cāgamiṣyanti no dhruvam \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. Lord Krishna would create your shadow body with the illusion of Yogamaya and would send them to your respective homes. Thereafter, you would all reach my place.

## \|\| 18.122 \|\|

*punaraṃśena naḥ patnyo bhaviṣyatha na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*yuṣmākaṃ mama śāpaśca babhūva ca varādhikaḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Then again you would become my spouses; there is no doubt about it. This curse of mine would indeed be the more beneficial to you than a boon.

## \|\| 18.123 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sa munirvirarāma śucā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*tā āgatya mahīṃ śāpādbabhūvurviprayoṣitaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. I have narrated to you the best of the stories of lord Krishna which includes the achieving of salvation by the virtuous women.

## \|\| 18.124 \|\|

*dattvā'nnaṃ haraye bhaktyā prajagmurharimandiram \|*  
*babhūva niścitaṃ tāsāṃ śāpaśca saṃpado'dhikaḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. О best of the Brahmanas, the story of Krishna appears to be new at every step which does not fully satisfy the listeners. Who could be satisfied with the welfare?

## \|\| 18.125 \|\|

*nindyā nīcā ca saṃpattirvipattirmahato varā \|*  
*aho sadyaḥ satāṃ kopaścopakārāya kalpate \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. Whatever had been heard by me from the mouth of my teacher, the same has been related by me. Now what else do you want to listen to from me? You tell me what is desired by you.

## \|\| 18.126 \|\|

*vinā vipattermahimā kutaḥ kasya bhavedbhuvi \|*  
*bhūtāḥ kāntaparityāgānmuktā brāhmaṇayoṣitaḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. Thus speaking, the sage got infatuated with grief and the damsels reached the earth, where they became the wives of the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 18.127 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamuttamam \|*  
*aho puṇyavatīnāṃ ca mokṣākhyānaṃ manoharam \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. Narada said – О compassionate one, О teacher of the universe, you kindly narrate to me the story of Shri Krishna, whatever had been heard by you from your teacher.

## \|\| 18.128 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇākhyānaṃ viprendra nūtnaṃ nūtnaṃ padepade \|*  
*na hi tṛptiḥ śrutavatāṃ kena śreyasi tṛpyate \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. After serving the food to the lord, all of them reached Goloka and they were relieved of the curse. Thus they were benefited by the curse pronounced by the sage.

## \|\| 18.129 \|\|

*yāvadramyaṃ tatkathitaṃ yacchrutaṃ guruvaktrataḥ \|*  
*vada māṃ vāñchitaṃ yatte kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. It is a curse to own the riches of a degraded person and it is a boon to have the curse of a noble person. The anger of the wise people bestows welfare in one way or the other.

## \|\| 18.130 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*yadyacchrutaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ guruvaktrātkṛpānidhe \|*  
*maṅgalaṃ kṛṣṇacaritaṃ tanme brūhi jagadguro \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. Without coming face to face with the danger on earth who can achieve greatness? After having been disowned by the husband, the wives of the Brahmanas achieved salvation.

## \|\| 18.131 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*śrutvā devarṣivacanamṛṣirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*aparaṃ kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ pravaktumupacakrame \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. Suta said – On listening to the words of Narada, the great sage, the sage Narayana started narrating the sto.ry of lord Krishna which bestows great merit.

## Chapter 19

## \|\| 19.1 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ baladevaṃ vinā hariḥ \|*  
*jagāma yamunātīraṃ yatra kāliyamandiram \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – Once Krishna, without Baladeva, went to the bank of Yamuna together with other cowherd boys where the serpent Kaliya used to live.

## \|\| 19.2-4 \|\|

*paripakvaphalaṃ bhuktvā yamunātīraje vane \|*  
*svecchāmayastṛṭparītaḥ papau ca nirmalaṃ jalam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*gokulaṃ cārayāmāsa śiśubhiḥ saha kānane \|*  
*vijahāra ca taiḥ sārddhaṃ sthāpayāmāsa gokulam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*krīḍānimagnacitto'yaṃ bālakāśca mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*bhuktvā navatṛṇaṃ gāvo viṣatoyaṃ papurmune \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Consuming the ripe fruits from the bank of Yamuna, lord Krishna drank the clean water of the river. Krishna together with the cowherds grazed the cows there and after collecting them at one place he started playing. With their minds fully devoted to the sports, all the cowherds kept on playing delightfully. О sage, the cows grazing the forest grass on the bank of the river Yamuna also drank the water of the Yamuna which had been mixed with the snake poison.

## \|\| 19.5-7 \|\|

*viṣāktaṃ ca jalaṃ pītvā dāruṇāntakaceṣṭayā \|*  
*jvālābhiḥ kālakūṭānāṃ sadyaḥ prāṇāṃśca tatyajuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā mṛtaṃ gosamūhaṃ gopāścintākulā bhiyā \|*  
*viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve tamūcumardhusūdanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*jñātvā sarvaṃ jagannātho jīvayāmāsa gokulam \|*  
*uttasthustatkṣaṇaṃ gāvo dadṛśuḥ śrīharermukham \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. The cows drank the poisonous water as a move of destiny, as a result of which all of them lost their lives. All the cowherd boys felt disturbed finding their cows dead and all of them started looking at the face of Hari.

## \|\| 19.8 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaḥ kadambamāruhya yamunānīratīrajam \|*  
*papāta sarpabhavane nāgamadhye narākṛtiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In the meantime, Krishna climbed a tree in human form on the bank of the Yamuna and jumped into the abode of the sages.

## \|\| 19.9 \|\|

*śatahastapramāṇaṃ ca jalotthānaṃ babhūva ha \|*  
*bālā harṣaṃ viṣādaṃ ca menire tatra nārada \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. О Narada, at that point of time, the water of Yamuna was raised to a hundred feet. Looking at this, the boys felt delighted and at the same time also felt gloomy.

## \|\| 19.10 \|\|

*sarpo narākṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā kāliyaḥ krodhavihvalaḥ \|*  
*jagrāha śrīhariṃ tūrṇaṃ taptalohaṃ yathā naraḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Finding a human there, the Kaliya serpent was extremely annoyed. He at once swallowed Krishna, who was like a burning rod of iron.

## \|\| 19.11-12 \|\|

*dagdhakaṇṭhodaro nāgaścodvigno brahmatejasā \|*  
*prāṇā yāntyevamuktvā ca cakārodvamanaṃ punaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*bhagnadanto raktamukhaḥ kṛṣṇavajrāṅgacarvaṇāt \|*  
*raktavaktrasya bhagavānuttasthau mastakopari \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. But with the divine tejas of the lord Krishna, the throat and the belly of the serpent started burning. In panic he uttered that his life was going to depart from his body. Thus speaking, he vomited out Krishna and all the teeth of the serpent were broken and blood started oozing out of the mouth. Lord Krishna stood on the hood of the serpent who vomited blood.

## \|\| 19.13 \|\|

*nāgo viśvaṃbharākrāntaḥ sa prāṇāṃstyaktumudyataḥ \|*  
*cakāra raktodvamanaṃ papāta mūrcchito mune \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The weight of lord Krishna was unbearable for the serpent and his life was about to depart from his body. Vomiting blood, he fainted and fell down.

## \|\| 19.14-16 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā taṃ mūrchitaṃ nāgā ruruduḥ premavihvalāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kecitpalāyitā bhītāḥ kecitpraviviśurbilam \|*  
*maraṇābhimukhaṃ kāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā surasā satī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*nāginībhiḥ saha premṇā ruroda purato hareḥ \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyutā tūrṇaṃ praṇamya śrīhariṃ bhiyā \|*  
*dhṛtvā pādāravinde ca tamuvāca bhiyā''kulā \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Finding him fainted all the serpents started crying infatuated with the love for Kaliya serpent. Some of them fled in panic while others entered the holes. The chaste Surasa finding her husband to be facing death, came forward with all the female servants and started crying before the lord. She bowed before him with folded hands and holding his feet she said.

## \|\| 19.17 \|\|

*surasovāca \|*  
*he jagatkānta me kāntaṃ dehi mānaṃ ca mānada \|*  
*patiḥ prāṇādhikaḥ strīṇāṃ nāsti bandhuśca tatparaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Surasa said – О lord of the universe, you are graceful and therefore bestow your grace on me, returning my husband to me. For the women, the husband is dearer to them than their lives; therefore there is nothing before them, except their husbands.

## \|\| 19.18 \|\|

*sakalabhuvananātha prāṇanāthaṃ madīyaṃ na kuru vadhamananta premasindho subandho \|*  
*akhilabhuvanabandho rādhikāpremasindho patimiha kuru dānaṃ me vidhāturvidhātaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O lord you are beyond measure, the ocean of love and are the lord of the universe; therefore you return my husband to me. You are the friend of the entire universe, you are the ocean of love for Radhika and happen to be Brahma for Brahma. Therefore you return my husband to me.

## \|\| 19.19 \|\|

*triyanavidhiśeṣāḥ ṣaṇamukhaścā''syasaṃdhaiḥ stavanaviṣayajāṅyātstotumīśā na vāṇī \|*  
*na khalu nikhilavedāḥ stotumanye'pi devāḥ stavanaviṣayaśaktāḥ santi santastavaiva\|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Shiva, Brahma, Shesha and Karttikeya always become dumb-found in an attempt to adore you. Even Sarasvati is unable to recite your glory. All the Vedas and the gods are unable to recite your glory. Only your devotees are competent enough to offer prayers to you.

## \|\| 19.20 \|\|

*kumatirahamadhijñā yoṣitāṃ kvādhamā vāh kva bhuvanagatirīśaścakcuṣo gocaro me \|*  
*vidhihariharareṣaiḥ stūyamānaśca yastva matanumanujamīśaṃ stotupicchāmi taṃ tvam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. I am a foolish woman and that too a female serpent and you happen to be the lord of the universe and are invisible Parameshvara. Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and Shesha always praise you. Such a formless person appearing in human form is quite surprising.

## \|\| 19.21-22 \|\|

*stavanaviṣayabhītā pārvatī kasya padmā śrutigaṇajanayitrī stotumīśā na yaṃ tvām \|*  
*kalikaluṣanimagnā vedavedāṅgaśāstra śravaṇaviṣayamūḍhā stotumicchāmi kiṃ tvām \|\| 21 \|\|*

*śayāno ratnaparyaṅke ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāṅgo rādhāvakṣasi saṃsthitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Parvati, Lakshmi, Sarasvati, the creator of the Vedas are hesitant to offer prayers to you, then how can I be able to do so? A foolish woman like me is trying to adore the same lord having no knowledge of the Vedic scriptures. This is beyond understanding; you sleep at the bed of gems, adorned with all the gem-studded ornament. Radha adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments always resides in your heart.

## \|\| 19.23 \|\|

*candanokṣitasarvāṅgaḥ smerānanasaroruhaḥ \|*  
*prodyatpremarasāmbhodhau nimagnaḥ satataṃ sukhāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. All your limbs are plastered with sandal-paste. You wear a smile on your face and you always remain engrossed in the ocean of love.

## \|\| 19.24-28 \|\|

*mallikāmālatīmālājālaiḥ śobhitaśekharaḥ \|*  
*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ gandhāmoditamānasaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*puṃskokilakaladhvānairbhramaradhvanisaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*kusumeṣu vikāreṇa pulakāṅkitavigrahaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*priyāpradattatāmbūlaṃ bhuktavānyaḥ sadā mudā \|*  
*vedā aśaktā yaṃ stotuṃ jaḍībhūtā vicakṣaṇāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca kiṃ staumi nāgavallabhā \|*  
*vande'haṃ tvatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmeśaśeṣasevitam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*lakṣmīsarasvatīdurgā jāhnavī vedamātṛbhiḥ \|*  
*sevitaṃ siddhasaṃghaiśca munīndrairmanubhiḥ sadā \|\| 28 \|\|*

24-28. The garlands of jasmine flowers decorate your head; your mind feels pleasant with the fragrance of the Parijata flowers. The sweet voice of cuckoo and hissing sound of the black-wasps infatuate love in your body which remains filled with emotions. You always delightfully consume the betel offered to you by your beloved. You are the one who is beyond the praise of the Vedas and many intellectuals become dumb-found by reciting your glory. How can I, an ordinary female serpent, offer prayer to you. In fact I am only trying to at your lotus-like feet which are served by Brahma, Shiva, Shesha, Lakshmi, Durga, Gangs, Sarasvati, the siddhas, sages and Manu.

## \|\| 19.29 \|\|

*niṣkāraṇāyākhilakāraṇāya sarveśvarāyāpi parātparāya \|*  
*svayaṃprakāśāya parāvarāya parāvarāṇāmadhipāya te namaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. You happen to be devoid of cause, the cause of all, the lord of all, beyond everyone, self-illumining, the best and the lord of the best. I bow in reverence at your feet.

## \|\| 19.30 \|\|

*he kṛṣṇa he kṛṣṇa surāsureśa brahmeśa śeṣeśa prajāpatīśa \|*  
*munīśa manvīśa carācareśa siddhīśa siddheśa gaṇeśa pāhi \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О Krishna, you happen to be the lord of the demons and the gods; you are the lord of Brahma, lord of Shesha, lord of Prajapati and sages besides Manu, moveable and immovable, siddhis, siddhas and lord of the ganas. You kindly bestow your protection on us.

## \|\| 19.31 \|\|

*dharmeśa dharmīśa śubhāśubheśa vedeśa vedeṣvanirūpitaśca \|*  
*sarveśa sarvātmaka sarvabandho jīvīśa jīveśvara pāhi matprabhum \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. You are the lord of dharma, the religious minded people, good and bad and the Vedas. Even the Vedas are unable to project you properly. О lord of all, you happen to be the soul of all, the friend of all, the lord of all the creatures, therefore you protect my husband.

## \|\| 19.32 \|\|

*ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharā \|*  
*vidhṛtya caraṇāmbhojaṃ tasthau nāgeśavallabhā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thus offering prayers to the lord she bowed in reverence to him. She then fell at the lotus-like feet of the lord.

## \|\| 19.33 \|\|

*nāgapatnīkṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpātpramuktastu yātyante śrīhareḥ padam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Whosoever recites the stotra composed by the spouse of Naga thrice a day, is relieved of all the sins and achieves the abode of the lord ultimately.

## \|\| 19.34 \|\|

*iha loke harerbhaktimante dāsyaṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*labhate pārṣado bhūtvā sālokyādicatuṣṭayam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He achieves the devotion of the lord on earth and ultimately achieves the inaccessible slavehood of the lord, besides the four types of salvation like Salokya, etc.

## \|\| 19.35 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*nāgapatnīvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānsarvanandanaḥ \|*  
*prahṛṣṭotphullanayanaḥ kimuvāca hariḥ svayam \|\| 35\|\|*

35\. Narada said – On listening to the words of the wife of the serpent, lord Krishna felt delighted and what did he speak to her, you kindly reveal this secret to me.

## \|\| 19.36 \|\|

*kathayasva mahābhāga rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*sūta uvāca \|*  
*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānsarvadarśanaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Suta said – On hearing the words of Narada, Narayana the creator of the universe, spoke in sweet words.

## \|\| 19.37 \|\|

*uvāca paramātmānaṃ madhuvṛndaṃ padepade \|*  
*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*nāgapatnīvacaḥ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇastamuvāca ha \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Narayana said – On bearing the words of the spouse of Naga, lord Krishna said to her, who was standing there with folded hands feeling panicky at the same time and had fallen on his feet.

## \|\| 19.38 \|\|

*puṭāñjaliyutāṃ pāde patitāṃ bhayavihvalām \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha nāgeśe varaṃ vṛṇu bhayaṃ tyaja \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Shri Krishna said – О goddess of the serpents, you get up. Don't be afraid and ask for a boon. О mother, with my boon you will remain ever young and eternal.

## \|\| 19.39 \|\|

*gṛhāṇa kāntaṃ he mātarmadvarādajarāmaram \|*  
*kālindīhradamutsṛjya svakīyaṃ bhavanaṃ vraja \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Leaving the kunda of Yamuna you go to your abode. О daughter, you move from this place with pleasure together with your husband and the family.

## \|\| 19.40 \|\|

*bhartrā sagoṣṭhyā sārddhaṃ ca gaccha vatse sukhī bhava \|*  
*adya prabhṛti nāgeśi bhūtā kanyā ca tvaṃ mama \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О Naga damsel, from today onwards, you will be my daughter and this male serpent who is dearer to you than your life, would become my son-in-law. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 19.41-43 \|\|

*tvatprāṇādhika evāyaṃ jāmātā ca na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*matpādapadmacihnena garuḍastvatpatiṃ śubhe \|\| 41 \|\|*

*kṛtvā ca stavanaṃ bhaktyā praṇamiṣyati matpadam \|*  
*tyaja tvaṃ garuḍādbhītiṃ śīghraṃ ramaṇakaṃ vraja \|\| 42 \|\|*

*hradānnirgaccha vatse tvaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā prasannavadanekṣaṇā \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. О pleasant one, because of the imprints of my foot on the head of the Naga, Garuda shall be no more inimical to him. But shall adore my feet offering prayers; therefore don’t be afraid of Garuda and move on to the island of Ramanaka. О daughter, getting out of this kunda you ask for a desired boon. On hearing the words of lord Krishna, her face and eyes felt delighted and with tears in her eyes and the mind filled with devotion, she said.

## \|\| 19.44 \|\|

*uvāca sāśrunetrā sā bhaktinamrātmakandharā \|*  
*surasovāca \|*  
*varaṃ dāsyasi cedānīṃ varadeśvara me'pi ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Surasa said – О lord, in case you intend to bestow a boon on me than you extend the infallible and deep devotion of your lotus-like feet to me.

## \|\| 19.45 \|\|

*tvatpādābje dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ niścalāṃ dātumarhasi \|*  
*manmanastvatpadātmbhoje bhramatu bhramaro yathā \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. My mind should always roam around your lotus-like feet like black-wasps and I should always remain devoted to you and should never forget you.

## \|\| 19.46 \|\|

*tava smṛtarvismṛtirna kadā'pi na bhaviṣyati \|*  
*svakānte mama saubhāgyaṃ kānto'yaṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. I should become fortunate with my husband who should become an intellectual. О lord, this is my wish and prayer which may kindly be fulfilled by you.

## \|\| 19.47 \|\|

*ityevaṃ prārthanīyaṃ ca paripūrṇaṃ kuru prabho \|*  
*ityevamuktvā sarpastrī pratasthau purato hareḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Thus speaking, the spouse of the Naga stood before the lord. Then she looked at the face of the lord Krishna which was shining like the full moon.

## \|\| 19.48-49 \|\|

*śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ dadarśa śrīharermukham \|*  
*locanābhyāṃ papau vaktraṃ nimeṣarahitaṃ satī \|\| 48 \|\|*

*sarvāṅgapulakodbhinnā sānaṃdāśrupariplutā \|*  
*sundaraṃ bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā putrasnehaṃ prakurvatī \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. The chaste lady continued to stare at the beauty of the face of Krishna without winking even for a moment. She felt emotional and the tears started flowing from her eyes. Finding the lord in the form of a beautiful boy, she developed a maternal affection in her mind and overwhelmed with devotion she again spoke.

## \|\| 19.50 \|\|

*uvāca punarevedaṃ bhaktyudrekapariplutā \|*  
*na yāsyāmi ramaṇakaṃ tatra nāsti prayojanam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. "I shall not go to Ramanaka; the place will be of no use for me. Let my husband be the lord of the serpents but you kindly allow me to be your slave-girl.

## \|\| 19.51 \|\|

*sarpaḥ karotu saṃsāraṃ kuru māṃ nijakiṅkarīm \|*  
*na vāñchā mama he kṛṣṇa sālokyādicatuṣṭaye \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. О Krishna, I am not interested in the four types of salvation like Salokya and others because they do not weigh one-sixteenth part of the devotion at your feet.

## \|\| 19.52 \|\|

*tvatpadāmbhojasevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|*  
*vinā tvatpādasevāṃ ca yo vāñchati varāntaram \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Having been born in the sacred land of Bharata, the one who instead of being desirous of getting devotion of your feet desires for something else, he remains deprived."

## \|\| 19.53 \|\|

*bhārate durlabhaṃ janma labdhvā'sau vañcitaḥ svayam \|*  
*nāgapatnyā vacaḥ śrutvā smerānanasaroruhaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. On hearing the words of the wife of Naga, the face of lord Krishna blossomed with a smile. He felt delighted and said, "Be it so". Thus speaking he agreed to her words.

## \|\| 19.54-55 \|\|

*prasannamānasaḥ śrīmānomityevamuvāca ha \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare divyaḥ sadratnasāranirmitaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*ājagāma rathastūrṇamuddīptastejasā mune \|*  
*pārṣadapravarairyukto vastramālāparicchadaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. О sage, in the meantime a divine chariot reached there which was decorated with the best of the gems and was illumining with lustre. It had several attendants and was decorated with banners of fine clothes and garlands of flowers, having a hundred wheels; it moved with the speed of the wind or that of the minds. It looked quite pleasant.

## \|\| 19.56 \|\|

*śatacakro vāyuvego manoyāyī manoharaḥ \|*  
*avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ śyāmalāḥ śyāma kiṅkarāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Several of the dark-complexioned attendants descended from the chariot and bowing at the feet of lord Krishna took away the wife of the Naga with them and they went to Goloka.

## \|\| 19.57 \|\|

*praṇamya kṛṣṇaṃ tāṃ nītvā jagmurgolokamuttamam \|*  
*hariśchāyāṃ vinirmāya dadau sarpāya tejasā \|\| 57\|\|*

57\. The gods created a shadow Naga woman in her place and substituted her as the wife of the serpent Kaliya. Having been infatuated with the illusion of the lord, the serpent could understand nothing.

## \|\| 19.58 \|\|

*sa ca kiṃcinna bubudhe mohito viṣṇumāyayā \|*  
*avaruhya sarpamūrdhnaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Thereafter, lord Krishna the ocean of mercy, compassionately placed his hand on the hood of the serpent.

## \|\| 19.59 \|\|

*dadau hastaṃ ca kṛpayā śīghraṃ kāliyamastake \|*  
*saṃprāpya cetanāṃ sadyo dadarśa purato harim \|\| 59 \|\|*
