59\. With the placing of the hand by Krishna on the head of the serpent, he regained consciousness, he looked with folded hands and tears filled his eyes who looked towards the lord and also looked at the chaste Surasa.

## \|\| 19.60-61 \|\|

*puṭāñjaliyutāṃ sāśrupūrṇāṃ ca surasāṃ satīm \|*  
*praṇanāma hariṃ sadyo ruroda premavihvalaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*bhaktyudrekātsāśrunetrāṃ pulakāṅkitavigrahām \|*  
*tūṣṇīṃbhūtāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā samuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*yadīśvarasya satataṃ yogyāyogye samā kṛpā \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. He at once bowed before the lord and started crying infatuated with the devotion for Krishna. With his mind filled with devotion, the eyes filled with tears, the body getting emotional, he looked at Surasa. Finding him keeping quiet Krishna said. The grace of the lord is showered equally on the competent and incompetent people.

## \|\| 19.62 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*varaṃ vṛṇu tvaṃ kālīya yaste manasi vartate \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Shri Krishna said – О Kaliya, you ask for a boon. О son, you are dearer to me than my life and therefore shed fear for life and be comfortable.

## \|\| 19.63 \|\|

*tvaṃ me prāṇādhiko vatsa sukhaṃ tiṣṭha bhayaṃ tyaja \|*  
*tasyāhamanugṛhṇāṇi yo'tibhakto mamāṃśajaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Because the one who is born out of my amsa and is immensely devoted to me, I am especially kind to him. After suppressing him I bestow my grace on him.

## \|\| 19.64 \|\|

*kiṃcittaddamanaṃ kṛtvā tvatprasādaṃ karomyaham \|*  
*tvadvaṃśajātānsarpāṃśca hanti yo mānavādhamaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The inferior person who would kill the snakes of that line, he earns the sin equal to Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 19.65 \|\|

*brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavitā tasya niścitam \|*  
*matpādapadmacihne yaḥ karoti daṇḍatāḍanam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Whosoever will strike the imprint of my foot on your hood, he would earn double the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 19.66 \|\|

*dviguṇaṃ brahmahatyāyā bhavitā tasya kilbiṣam \|*  
*lakṣmīryāsyati tadgehācchāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The goddess of riches shall disappear from his house pronouncing a curse on him; besides his race, age and glory will be on the decline.

## \|\| 19.67 \|\|

*vaṃśāyuryaśasā hānirbhavitā tasya niścitam \|*  
*dhruvaṃ varṣaśataṃ kālasūtre yāsyati madgirā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. According to my words he will have to face the sufferings in the kalasUtra hell for a hundred years, the insect of your size would bite him always.

## \|\| 19.68 \|\|

*tvatpramāṇāḥ kīṭasaṃghā daṃśiṣyanti ca saṃtatam \|*  
*bhogānte janma labdhvā ca tanmṛtyustasya daṃśanāt \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. After remaining in the hell, he would be born on earth and would die of a snake bite. All his generations would always be afraid of the snakes.

## \|\| 19.69-73 \|\|

*tasya vaṃśodbhavānāṃ ca tvadvaṃśādbhavitā bhayam \|*  
*ye ca tvadvaṃśajāndṛṣṭvā supadāṅkaṃ madīyakam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*praṇamiṣyanti bhaktyā te mucyante sarvapātakāt \|*  
*gaccha śīghraṃ ramaṇakaṃ tyaja bhītiṃ khagādhipāt \|\| 70 \|\|*

*matpadāṅkaṃ mūrdhni dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ bhaktyā praṇamiṣyati \|*  
*tava tvadvaṃśajānāṃ ca garuḍānna bhayaṃ kvacit \|\| 71 \|\|*

*sarveṣāṃ jñātisarpāṇāṃ varo'dya bhava madvarāt \|*  
*varaṃ kiṃ paramaṃ vatsa vāñchitaṃ varayādhunā \|\| 72 \|\|*

*bhayaṃ tyaktvā kathaya māṃ tvadīyaṃ duḥkhabhañjanam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā kāliyaḥ kampito bhiyā \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā tamuvāca bhujaṅgamaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

69-73. Looking at your progeny with my foot imprinted on the hood, whosoever would bow with devotion, he would be relieved of all the sins. Therefore, you immediately move to Ramanaka and don't be afraid of Garuda, the king of the birds. He would adore you with devotion finding the imprint of my foot on your hood; therefore you yourself and your progeny would never be afraid of Garuda. With the bestowing of the boon by me today, you consider yourself to be the best of all the snakes. О son, you tell me what more boon is needed by you? You consider myself to be the reliever of your miseries and speak out to me without fear. On hearing the words of Krishna, the serpent Kaliya trembling with fear spoke with folded hands.

## \|\| 19.74-78 \|\|

*kāliya uvāca \|*  
*vare'nyasminmama vibho vāñchā nāsti varaprada \|\| 74 \|\|*

*bhaktiṃ smṛtiṃ tvatpadābje dehi janmani janmani \|*  
*janma brahmakule vā'pi tiryagyoniṣu vā samam \|\| 75 \|\|*

*tadbhavetsaphalaṃ yatra smṛtistvaccaraṇāmbuje \|*  
*tanniṣphalaḥ svargavāso nāsti cettvatpadasmṛtiḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*tvatpādadhyānayuktasya yattatsthānaṃ ca tatparam \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ vā koṭikalpaṃ vā puruṣāyuḥ kṣayo'stu vā \|\| 77 \|\|*

*yadi tvatsevayā yāti saphalo niṣkalo'thavā \|*  
*teṣāṃ cāyurvyayo nāsti ye tvatpādābjasevakāḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

74-78. Kaliya said – О lord, besotwer of boons, I am not desirous of any other boon for me but in spite of that if you want to bestow any boon on me, you bestow the devotion of your lotus-like feet; this is my desire. Because one is born in the race of a Brahmana or as a bird, an animal or all of the them. Only that person is successful who always remains at your lotus-like feet. In case one is averse to the devotion of your feet, then even the stay in the heaven is of no consequence. The place one achieves by adoring at your feet is the real place and the best of all, whether it is for a moment or for crores of kalpas. When life is spent in adoration at your feet it becomes successful; otherwise it is of no consequence or is useless. Those who serve at your lotus-like feet, their age is never spent and they are relieved of the birth, death, ailment, grief, pain and fear.

## \|\| 19.79-80 \|\|

*na santi janmamaraṇarogaśokārtibhītayaḥ \|*  
*indratve vā'maratve vā brahmatve cātidurlabhe \|\| 79 \|\|*

*vāñchā nāstyeva bhaktānāṃ tvatpādasevanaṃ vinā \|*  
*sujīrṇapaṭakhaṇḍasya samaṃ nūtanameva ca \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. Without serving at your feet, your devotees never aspire for the place of Indra, etemalship and the inaccessible place of Brahma. What to speak of anything else, your devotees look at the four types of salvation like Salokya and others like the tom garments.

## \|\| 19.81-84 \|\|

*paśyanti bhaktāḥ kiṃ cānyatsālokyādicatuṣṭayam \|*  
*saṃprāptastvanmanurbrahmannanaṃtādyāvadeva hi \|\| 81 \|\|*

*tāvattvadbhāvanenaiva tvadvarṇo'hamanugrahāt \|*  
*māṃ ca bhaktamapakvaṃ vā vijñāya garuḍaḥ svayam \|\| 82 \|\|*

*deśād dūraṃ ca nyakkāraṃ cakāra dṛḍhabhaktimān \|*  
*bhavatā ca dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ dattvā me varadeśvara \|\| 83 \|\|*

*sa ca uktaśca bhakto'haṃ na māṃ tyaktuṃ kṣamo'dhunā \|*  
*tvatpādapadmacihnāktaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīmastakaṃ mama \|\| 84 \|\|*

81-84. О Brahman, after receiving your mantra from Ananta, I always remained devoted to you. This is the reason why I have earned your grace today. At that point of time Garuda thinking of me to be an immature devotee had denounced me and drove me out but, О bestower of the boon, you have bestowed your deep devotion on me and proved that I am as good a devotee of yours as a Garuda has been. Therefore, it would not be proper for you to disown me. Because of the imprint of your foot on my head and looking at its grace, Garuda would treat me as virtuous in spite of the fact that I have no virtues with me at all. Therefore you need not disown me.

## \|\| 19.85 \|\|

*sadoṣaṃ guṇayuktaṃ māṃ so'dhunā tyaktumakṣamaḥ \|*  
*mamārādhyāśca nāgeṃdrā na tadvadhyo'hamīśvara \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. TIIiq II Now Garuda will not trouble me taking me to be your devotee. О lord, they will not kill me any further. I am not afraid of anyone else except Ananta my teacher.

## \|\| 19.86 \|\|

*bhayaṃ na kebhyaḥ sarvatra tamanaṃtaṃ guruṃ vinā \|*  
*yaṃ devendrāśca devāśca munayo manavo narāḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Indra, the gods, the sages, Manu, the humans are not in a position to visualise you even in a dream, but the same lord is standing before me personified.

## \|\| 19.87-88 \|\|

*svapne dhyānena paśyaṃti cakṣuṣorgocaraḥ sa me \|*  
*bhaktānurodhātsākāraḥ kutaste vigraho vibho \|\| 87 \|\|*

*saguṇatvaṃ ca sākāro nirākāraśca nirguṇaḥ \|*  
*svecchāmayaḥ sarvadhāma sarvabījaṃ sanātanam \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. О virtuous one, you have no body, but you appear in a definite form at the request of the devotee. You are full of qualities, having the definite form and at the same time you are without qualities and formless, you move at will, the abode of all, the seed of all, eternal, the lord of all, the witness of all, the soul of all and you take to all the forms.

## \|\| 19.89-91 \|\|

*sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ sākṣī sarvātmā sarvarūpadhṛk \|*  
*brahmeśaśeṣadharmendrā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*stotuṃ yamīśaṃ te jāḍyāḥ sarpaḥ stoṣyati taṃ vibhum \|*  
*he nātha karuṇāsiṃdho dīnabaṃdho kṣamādhamam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*khalasvabhāvādajñānātkṛṣṇa tvaṃ carvito mayā \|*  
*nāstralakṣyo yathākāśo na dṛśyāṃto na laṃghyakaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

89-91. Even Brahma, Shiva, Shesha, Dharma, Indra and the intellectuals well-versed in the Vedic and post-Vedic literature stand dumb-found while offering prayers, then now an insignificant serpent like me could adore you. О ocean of mercy, you forgive a down-graded person like me. О Krishna, because of my wicked nature and ignorance, I chewed you earlier. But as a weapon cannot be aimed at the sky, the end of which is not visible, nor can it be crossed, touched or covered, similar is the case with your lustre.

## \|\| 19.92 \|\|

*na spṛśyo hi na cāvaryastathā tejastvameva ca \|*  
*ityevamuktvā nāgendraḥ papāta caraṇāmbuje \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Thus speaking the king of the serpents fell at the lotus-like feet of the lord. The lord was pleased with him and spoke, "Be it so". Thus he bestowed all the boons on him.

## \|\| 19.93-95 \|\|

*omityuktvā haristuṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ tasmai varaṃ dadau \|*  
*nāgarājakṛtaṃ stotraṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet \|\| 93 \|\|*

*tadvaṃśyānāṃ ca tasyaiva nāgebhyo na bhayaṃ bhavet \|*  
*sa nāgaśayyāṃ kṛtvaiva svaptuṃ śaktaḥ sadā bhuvi \|\| 94 \|\|*

*viṣapīyūṣayorbhedo nāstyeva tasya bhakṣaṇe \|*  
*nāgagraste nāgaghāte prāṇānte viṣabhojanāt \|\| 95\|\|*

93-95. The one who recites the stotra composed by the serpents getting up early in the morning, there is no end to his progeny and is never afraid of the serpents. He can sleep on a bed of snakes. The consuming of poison or nectar will be of no consequence for him. One is relieved of all ailments including the bite of snakes, having been attacked by snakes and consuming the poisonous food leading to death, with the reciting of this stotra.

## \|\| 19.96-98 \|\|

*stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa sustho bhavati mānavaḥ \|*  
*bhūrje kṛtvā stotramidaṃ kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe kare \|\| 96 \|\|*

*bibharti yo bhaktiyukto nāgebhyo'pi na tadbhayam \|*  
*yatra gehe stotramidaṃ nāgastatra na tiṣṭhati \|\| 97 \|\|*

*viṣāgnivajrabhītiśca na bhavettatra niścitam \|*  
*iha loke harerbhaktiṃ smṛtiṃ ca satataṃ labhet \|*  
*ante ca svakulaṃ pūtvā dāsyaṃ ca labhate dhruvam \|\| 98 \|\|*

96-98. Writing this stotra on the bark leaves, whosoever ties it around the neck or the right arm with devotion, is freed from the danger of the serpent and the one in whose house this stotra is kept, the serpents cannot remain there. Besides the place is relieved of the dangers of poison, fire and vajra. Such a person always remains devoted to the lord on earth and ultimately in due course of time, purifying his race, he achieves the slavehood of the lord.

## \|\| 19.99 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*nāgendrāya varaṃ dattvā punastaṃ jagadīśvaraḥ \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Narayana said – О lord of the universe, lord Krishna after bestowing the boon on the serpent, spoke to him some sweet words which were beneficial to him for the future.

## \|\| 19.100-101 \|\|

*gaccha tvaṃ ca ramaṇakaṃ yathendranagaraṃ param \|*  
*sārddhaṃ svagoṣṭhyā nāgendra yamunājalavartmanā \|\| 100 \|\|*

*śrutvā nāgo harerājñāṃ ruroda premavihvalaḥ \|*  
*kadā drakṣyāmi tvatpādapadmaṃ nāthetyuvāca ha \|\| 101 \|\|*

100-101. Shri Krishna said – О lord of the Nagas, by moving in the waters of the Yamuna, you together with your wife and the entire family proceed towards the Ramanaka island which is more beautiful than the place of Indra. At this command of the lord the serpent started crying filled with affection and said, "O lord when shall I be able to have a look at your lotus-like feet?".

## \|\| 19.102 \|\|

*praṇamya śatakṛtvaśca striyā goṣṭhyā saheśvaram \|*  
*jagāma jalamārgeṇa nāgendro virahāturaḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Getting disturbed due to the impending separation from the lord he bowed in reverence to him a hundred times and moved together with his wife and family through the waters of the Yamuna.

## \|\| 19.103 \|\|

*yamunā hradatoyaṃ ca babhūvāmṛtakalpakam \|*  
*prasannā jantavaḥ sarve babhūvustena nārada \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Thereafter, the water of the kunda in the Yamuna was turned like nectar which delighted all the birds and animals.

## \|\| 19.104 \|\|

*gatvā dadarśa bhavanaṃ yathendranagaraṃ param \|*  
*ājñayā ca kṛpāsindhornirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. Reaching Ramanaka, he found a palace as huge as the palace of Indra which was constructed by Vishvakarma at the command of the lord.

## \|\| 19.105 \|\|

*tatra tasthau ca nāgendraḥ striyā putragaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*niḥśaṅko harṣayuktaśca haribhāvana tatparaḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. In the company of his wife and other family members, he fearlessly and gleefully continued to stay there.

## \|\| 19.106 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamadbhutam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ paraṃ kiṃ śrotumicchasi \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Thus I have narrated to you the astonishing story of the lord which provides pleasure, salvation and is quite purposeful. What else do you want to listen to from me?

## \|\| 19.107 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*maharṣervacanaṃ śrutvā nārado harṣavihvalaḥ \|*  
*ṛṣiṃ papraccha saṃdehaṃ sarvasaṃdehabhañjanam \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Suta said – On hearing the words of the sage, the mind of Narada was filled with emotion. Thereafter, he again asked the sage who could remove the doubts of all, for the removal of his doubt.

## \|\| 19.108 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ vihāya kālīyaḥ svapūrvabhavanaṃ param \|*  
*jagāma yamunātīraṃ tanme brūhi jagadguro \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. Narada said – О teacher of the universe, why had the serpent Kaliya moved to the kunda in Yamuna leaving his earlier abode. You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 19.109-111 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu nārada vakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam \|*  
*yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrānme malaye sūryaparvaṇi \|\| 109 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇākhyānaprasaṅgena suprabhā paścime taṭe \|*  
*papraccha dharmaṃ pulahaḥ kathitaṃ munisaṃsadi \|\| 110 \|\|*

*idamākhyānamāścaryamuvāca taṃ kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*tatra śrutaṃ mayā vipra nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 111 \|\|*

109-111. Narayana said – I am narrating to you an ancient historical story, which was narrated at Malaya mountain on the left bank of Suprabha river by Dharma which leads to lord Krishna. You listen to it. In the assembly of the sages, the sage Pulaha enquired from Dharma and Dharma, the compassionate one, told him the astonishing story. I heard the same from him which I am going to repeat to you.

## \|\| 19.112-114 \|\|

*śeṣājñayā nāgagaṇā pratisaṃvatsaraṃ bhiyā \|*  
*kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu kurvanti garuḍārcanam \|\| 112 \|\|*

*puṣpairdhūpaiśca dīpaiśca naivedyairbalibhirmudā \|*  
*puṣkare ca mahātīrthe susnātā bhaktisaṃyutāḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

*tasya pūjāṃ ca kālīyo na cakārātyahaṃkṛtaḥ \|*  
*nāgapūjopakaraṇaṃ balādbhakṣitumudyataḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

112-114. At the command of the serpent Shesha all the Nagas getting terrified used to adore Garuda on the full moon day of Kartika, every year. Once Kaliya after having his bath with devotion at the great sacred place of Puskara, getting arrogant, did not adore Garuda and was about to consume the material meant for the adoration of Garuda.

## \|\| 19.115 \|\|

*cakrurnivāraṇaṃ nāgā nītimūcurmadoddhatam \|*  
*na śaktā vāraṇe te cetyāvirbhūtaḥ khageśvaraḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. The Nagas prevented him from doing so and spoke to the arrogant one, "We people are unable to prevent you". At that very moment Garuda, the king of the birds, arrived there.

## \|\| 19.116-117 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā khageśvaraṃ nāgāḥ kālīyaprāṇarakṣayā \|*  
*prāṇaśaktyā ca yuyudhuryāvatsūryodayaṃ mune \|\| 116 \|\|*

*pakṣīndratejasā sarve samudvignāḥ palāyitāḥ \|*  
*anantaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ sarveṣāmabhayapradam \|\| 117 \|\|*

116-117. Finding him there all the Nagas fought with Garuda in order to protect the life of Kaliya, which continued till day-break. At last, all of them felt dispirited and upset with the prowess of Garuda fled from the place. All of them reached to take refuge under Ananta who provides protection to all.

## \|\| 19.118 \|\|

*palāyanaparāndṛṣṭvā nāgāṃśca karuṇānidhiḥ \|*  
*tatra tasthau ca niḥśaṅkaḥ kālīyastaṃ dadarśa ha \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. After the disappearing of all the Nagas from the place, Kaliya, the compassionate one stood there fearlessly and started staring at Garuda.

## \|\| 19.119 \|\|

*smṛtvā haripadāmbhojaṃ kālīyo yuyudhe mune \|*  
*muhūrta ca tayoryuddhaṃ babhūvātīva dāruṇam \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. О sage, then he started fighting with Garuda reciting the name of Krishna in his mind. The fierce battle continued for a muhUrta.

## \|\| 19.120-121 \|\|

*parājitaśca nāgenadrastejasā garuḍasya ca \|*  
*bhiyā palāyanaṃ kṛtvā jagāma yamunā hradam \|\| 120 \|\|*

*na taṃ saubhariśāpena khagendro gantumīśvaraḥ \|*  
*tatra tasthau bhiyā nāgo jagpuḥ paścācca tadganah \|\| 121 \|\|*

120-121. Thereafter the serpent Kaliya was defeated by the prowess of Garuda and in panic, he rushed to the kunda in Yamuna, where Garuda could not reach because of the curse of the sage Saubhari. Naga then continued to stay there feeling panicky and subsequently all his servants also reached there.

## \|\| 19.122 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ tu saubhareḥ śāpo babhūva garuḍāya vai \|*  
*kathaṃ na śakto gantuṃ taṃ hradamīśvaravāhanaḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Narada said – How did the sage Saubhari pronounce a curse on Garuda and why had Garuda, the vehicle of lord Vishnu, no access to that place.

## \|\| 19.123-126 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ tatra saubhariḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

*tapastaptvā mahāsiddho dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbujam \|*  
*samīpe dhyāyamānasya kūle ca yamunā jale \|\| 124 \|\|*

*gaṇena sārdhaṃ niḥśaṃkaḥ karoti bhramaṇaṃ mudā \|*  
*pucchamutphālya bahudhā paritaḥ paramecchayā \|\| 125 \|\|*

*muniṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya yātyāyāti mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*sakulaṃ sumahātmānaṃ darśaṃdarśaṃ khagādhipaḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

123-126. Narayana said – The sage Saubhari performed tapas for a divine thousand years and became Mahasiddha and was always devoted to the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna close to the place of the meditating sage. Garuda the lord of the birds also used to come and play there fearlessly. With great devotion in his mind Garuda used to take rounds of the sage delightfully daily.

## \|\| 19.127 \|\|

*jagrāha cañcunā mīnaṃ munīndrasya samīpataḥ \|*  
*gacchantaṃ taṃ mīnamukhaṃ dadarśa kopacakṣuṣā \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. The sage belonged to the pure race and looking at him Garuda the king of the birds caught hold of a fish in his presence. Pressing the fish with the feet by Garuda, the sage looked at him with contempt. Garuda felt trembling at the sight of the sage and the fish was dropped into the water.

## \|\| 19.128 \|\|

*prakopito munerdṛṣṭyā mīnastoye papāta ha \|*  
*tamuvāca munīndraśca punarādātumudyatam \|*  
*mīnaśca garuḍatrāsāttasthau munisamīpataḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. Garuda intended to catch it again but the fish getting terrified again went close the sage. Looking at this the sage spoke.

## \|\| 19.129 \|\|

*saubhariruvāca \|*  
*gaccha dūraṃ gaccha dūraṃ khagendra matsamīpataḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. Saubhari said – "O king of the birds, you get away from here and move to another place. How could you be competent to catch the aquatic animal in my presence.

## \|\| 19.130 \|\|

*kā yogyatā matpuraste grahītuṃ jīvamulbaṇam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇavāhanaṃ jñātvā cātmānaṃ bahu manyase \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. Do you think too much about yourself being the vehicle of Vishnu. Lord Krishna is competent enough to create crores of birds like you.

## \|\| 19.131 \|\|

*tvadvidhānkoṭiśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sraṣṭuṃ śaktaśca vāhakān \|*  
*karomi bhasmasāttūrṇaṃ tvāṃ ca bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. I can reduce you to ashes only with a side-glance. You are no doubt the vehicle of Vishnu but we are not your slaves.

## \|\| 19.132 \|\|

*vāhanaṃ ca tvamīśasya na vayaṃ tava kiṃkarāḥ \|*  
*adya prabhṛti pakṣīndra yadyāgacchasi me hradam \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. О king of the birds, in case you come to my кипфа here again, you will surely be reduced to ashes.".

## \|\| 19.133 \|\|

*madīyaśāpāttūrṇaṃ ca bhasmasādbhavitā dhruvam \|*  
*munīndrasya vacaḥ śrutvā pracacāla khageśvaraḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. Hearing the words of the sage, Garuda was upset. Resembling the name of Krishna in his heart, he bowed before the sage in reverence and left the place.

## \|\| 19.134 \|\|

*smāraṃsmāraṃ kṛṣṇapādaṃ taṃ praṇamya jagāma ha \|*  
*adyaprabhṛti viprendra patagendrasya saṃtatam \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. O best of the Brahmanas, even today with the mere mention of the name of that kunda, the body of Garuda shivers in panic.

## \|\| 19.135 \|\|

*hradasya śrutimātreṇa kampo bhavati niścitam \|*  
*itihāsaśca kathito yaḥ śruto dharmavaktrataḥ \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. I have narrated to you the event of history which I had heard from the mouth of Dharma; now you listen to the secret about the story of the lord which is pleasant to hear and bestows welfare.

## \|\| 19.136-139 \|\|

*sarahasyaṃ śrutisukhaṃ prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu maṅgalam \|*  
*vijñāya suciraṃ bālā nottasthau tajjalāddhariḥ \|\| 136 \|\|*

*cakrurviṣādaṃ mohācca ruruduryamunātaṭe \|*  
*svavakṣoghātanaṃ cakruḥ kecidbālāḥ śucā''kulāḥ \|\| 137 \|\|*

*kecinnipatya bhūmau ca mūrcchāṃ prāpuhariṃ vinā \|*  
*hradaṃ praveṣṭuṃ kecicca viraheṇa samanvitāḥ \|\| 138 \|\|*

*kecidgopālabālāśca cakruśca tannivāraṇam \|*  
*kṛtvā vilāpaṃ kecicca prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyatāḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

136-139. The boys standing at the bank of river Yamuna thought that "much time has elapsed but lord Krishna has not come out of the waters." Therefore they felt disturbed and started crying. Some of the boys overcome with grief started beating their breast; some of them fainted with the separation from the lord and fell down on the ground. Some of them got ready to jump into the same kunda in separation from Krishna but some of the boys forcibly prevented them from doing so. Some of them started lamenting and some of them got ready to end their lives who were prevented from doing so, by the intelligent persons.

## \|\| 19.140 \|\|

*teṣāṃ kecijjñānavanto rakṣāṃ cakruḥ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*kecidūcuśca hāheti kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kecana \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. Some of them cried in terror reciting the name of Krishna. Some of them rushed to Nanda who conveyed the news to him.

## \|\| 19.141 \|\|

*kecidvaktuṃ pravṛttiṃ ca prayayurnandasannidhim \|*  
*kecitsaṃmīlitāstatra śokamohabhayāturāḥ \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. Some of them were influenced with grief, love and fear and said, "What should we do now"? Hari has disappeared.

## \|\| 19.142 \|\|

*ityūcuḥ kiṃ kariṣyāmaḥ kuto'smākaṃ gato hariḥ \|*  
*he nandasūno he kṛṣṇa prāṇebhyo'pyadhikapriya \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. О Nanda, listen, О Krishna, you are dearer to us than our lives, О brother, you appear before us without delay, otherwise life is departing out of our body.

## \|\| 19.143 \|\|

*he bandho darśanaṃ dehītyūcuḥ prāṇāḥ prayānti hi \|*  
*etasminnantare kecidbālakā nandasannidhim \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. In the meantime some of the boys reached Nanda who were crying and getting unstable.

## \|\| 19.144-145 \|\|

*saṃprāpuratilolāśca rudantaḥ śokavihvalāḥ \|*  
*pravṛttimūcustaṃ śīghraṃ yaśodāṃ mūlato balam \|\| 144 \|\|*

*gopāngopālikāścaiva raktapaṅkajalocanāḥ \|*  
*śrutvā vārtāṃ ca te sarve śīghraṃ jagmuḥ śucā'nvitāḥ \|\| 145 \|\|*

144-145. They narrated the entire event to Yashoda and Balabhadra who was seated beside her and also to other cowherds and cowherdesses having red eyes. On hearing this, all were upset with grief and arrived at the bank of Yamuna. They all started crying.

## \|\| 19.146-147 \|\|

*kalindanandinītīraṃ rurudurbālakairyutāḥ \|*  
*gatvā saṃmīlitāḥ sarve ruruduḥ śokamūrcchitāḥ \|\| 146 \|\|*

*hradaṃ viśantīmambāṃ tāṃ keciccakrurnivāraṇam \|*  
*gopā gopālikāścaiva jaghnuraṅgāni śokataḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

146-147. All the people collecting there started crying ar 1 fainted. The mother Yashoda was about to jump into the kunda who was prevented from doing so by the people present there. Some of the cowherdesses overcome with grief started beating their limbs, while others started lamenting and some of them fainted.

## \|\| 19.148 \|\|

*kecidvilalapustatra mūrcchāṃ prāpuśca kecana \|*  
*hradaṃ viśantīṃ tāṃ rādhāṃ vārayāmāsa kācana \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Some of the cowherdesses prevented Radha from entering in that kunda but at the bank of the river, Radha got fainted and fell like a log.

## \|\| 19.149 \|\|

*mūrcchāṃ ca prāpa sā śokānmṛteva ca sarittaṭe \|*  
*vilapyātibhṛśaṃ nando mūrcchāṃ prāpa punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. On the other hand, Nanda while lamenting fainted again and again. He regained consciousness and fainted again.

## \|\| 19.150-151 \|\|

*bhūyo'pi rodanaṃ kṛtvā bhūyo mūrcchāmavāpa ha \|*  
*vilapantaṃ bhṛśaṃ nandaṃ yaśodāṃ śokakarśitām \|\| 150 \|\|*

*gopāśca gopikāścaiva rādhikāmatimūrcchitām \|*  
*rudato bālakānsarvānbālikāśca śucā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*sarvāṃśca bodhayāmāsa balaśca jñānināṃ varaḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

150-151. Thus lamenting Nanda and Yashoda besides the grief-stricken cowherds and cowherdesses and the unconscious Radhika, started crying. Thereafter brilliant Balarama tried to console all the grief-stricken cowherdesses.

## \|\| 19.152-154 \|\|

*śrībaladeva uvāca \|*  
*gopā gopālikā bālāḥ sarve śṛṇuta madvacaḥ \|*  
*he nanda jñānināṃ śreṣṭha gargavākyasmṛtiṃ kuru \|\| 152 \|\|*

*jagadbibhartuḥ śeṣasya saṃhartuḥ śaṃkarasya ca \|*  
*vidhātuḥ saṃvidhātuśca bhuvi kasmātparājayaḥ \|\| 153 \|\|*

*paramāṇuḥ paro vyūhaḥ sthūlātsthūlaḥ parātparaḥ \|*  
*vidyamāno'pyavidṛśyaḥ saṃyogo yogināmapi \|\| 154 \|\|*

152-154. Baladeva said – О cowherds, cowherdesses and the boys, all of you should listen to my words. О best of the intellectuals, О Nanda, the best of the intellectuals, you kindly remember the words of the sage Garga. The one who happens to be the support of the serpent Shesha, is the killer of the one who happens to be the destroyer of the universe and Vidhata for Brahma, who can defeat him on earth. He happens to be smaller than the smallest and bigger than the biggest. He is more solid than the best of the solid things and is beyond everyone, he remains invisible as well as visible and is adored by the yogis.

## \|\| 19.155-156 \|\|

*diśāṃ nāsti samāhāraḥ spṛśyo nākāśa eva ca \|*  
*api sarveśvaro bādhya ityūcuḥ śrutayaḥ sphuṭam \|\| 155 \|\|*

*nātmā dṛśyo nāstralakṣyo na vadhyo na hi dṛśyakaḥ \|*  
*nāgnigrasto na hiṃsyaścāpīdamādhyātmikā viduḥ \|\| 156 \|\|*

155-156. As the directions cannot be collected, the sky cannot be touched, similarly the great lord cannot be controlled by anyone. This has been clearly ordained by the Shrutis. The soul is not visible and is beyond the aim of weapons. He cannot be killed nor can he be seen. The fire is unable to bum him and he cannot be killed. This is what has been ordained by those engaged in spiritual thinking.

## \|\| 19.157 \|\|

*vigraho'syaiva kṛṣṇasya bhaktadhyānārthameva ca \|*  
*jyotiḥsvarūpasya vibhornādyantamadhyamātmanaḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

157\. The body of Krishna which is visible is meant for his devotees. The all-pervading lord having lustre has no beginning, end or middle.

## \|\| 19.158 \|\|

*jalaplute ca brahmāṇḍe jalaśāyī janārdanaḥ \|*  
*yannābhipadmajo brahmā tasyeśasya hrade vipat \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. At the time when the entire globe is submerged in water, at that point of time, lord Janardana reclines in the waters and Brahma seated on a lotus emerge out of his navel. How can such a great lord face any difficulty inside a small kundal.

## \|\| 19.159 \|\|

*maśakaścetkṣamo grastuṃ brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ pitaḥ \|*  
*na tathā'pi tadīśaṃ taṃ grastuṃ sarpaḥ kṣamo bhavet \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. О father, not only this, in case a mosquito could swallow the entire globe in spite of that a serpent would not be able to swallow Krishna.

## \|\| 19.160 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamādhyātmikamanuttamam \|*  
*nigūḍhaṃ yogināṃ sāraṃ saṃśayacchedakāraṇam \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. Whatever has been stated by me, is the best of spiritualistic talk which is beyond the reach of the yogis, it is quite deep and idealistic and removes the doubts.".

## \|\| 19.161 \|\|

*baladevavacaḥ śrutvā gargavākyamanusmaran \|*  
*tatyāja śokaṃ nandaśca vrajaśca vrajayoṣitaḥ \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. On hearing the words of Baladeva and recalling the words of the sage of Gargacarya. Nanda and all the ladies of the Vraja were freed from grief.

## \|\| 19.162 \|\|

*prabodhaṃ menire sarve na yaśodā na rādhikā \|*  
*bandhuvicchedaviṣaye prabodhe na sthitaṃ manaḥ \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. All of them agreed with him but Radha and Yashoda could not be satisfied because the mind does not rest in piece in separation from the near and dear ones.

## \|\| 19.163 \|\|

*etasminnantare kṛṣṇamutpatantaṃ jalānmune \|*  
*dadṛśustaṃ suprasannā vrajāśca vrajayoṣitaḥ \|\| 163 \|\|*

163\. О sage, in the meantime the humans of Vraja delightfully found Krishna emerging out of the water.

## \|\| 19.164 \|\|

*śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*asigdhavastramasiigdhamaluptacandanāñjanam \|\| 164 \|\|*

164\. His face resembling the full moon of the winter season, wore a smile on his face, his clothes were dry and so was his body. The sandal-paste of the forehead and the collyrium of the eyes were undisturbed.

## \|\| 19.165-166 \|\|

*sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|*  
*mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca vaṃśīvadanamacyutam \|\| 165 \|\|*

*yaśodā bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā vakṣasi sasmitā \|*  
*cucumba vadanāmbhojaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā \|\| 166 \|\|*

165-166. He was adorned with all the ornaments, had a divine lustre, a peacock feather was adorning his head and the fruit was touching his lips. Finding the boy quite hail and hearty, Yashoda smiled and embraced him and her face and eyes were beaming with delight. She then started kissing the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 19.167 \|\|

*kroḍe cakāra nandaśca balaśca rohiṇī mudā \|*  
*nimeṣarahitāḥ sarve dadṛśuḥ śrīmukhaṃ hareḥ \|\| 167 \|\|*

167\. Thereafter Nanda, Balarama and Rohini too took him in their lap and all of them started staring at Hari without winking even for a moment.

## \|\| 19.168 \|\|

*premāndhā bālakāḥ sarve cakrurāliṅganaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*papuścakṣuścakoraiśca mukhacandraṃ ca gopikāḥ \|\| 168 \|\|*

168\. Thereafter all the boys embraced Krishna with devotion and the cowherdesses started staring at the facial beauty of Krishna.

## \|\| 19.169-170 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra sahasā kānanāṃtaram \|*  
*dāvāgnirveṣṭayāmāsa taiḥ sarvaiḥ saha gokulam \|\| 169 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā śailapramāṇāgniṃ paritaḥ kānanāntare \|*  
*praṇāśaṃ menire sarve bhayamāpuśca saṃkaṭe \|\| 170 \|\|*

169-170. At that point of time suddenly the forest was surruunded by a terrific fire, the flame of which were raised like a mountain. The danger terrified everyone who thought their end to be nearing.

## \|\| 19.171 \|\|

*praṇāśaṃ menire sarve bhayamāpuśca saṃkaṭe \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve saṃpuṭāñjalayo vrajāḥ \|*  
*bālā gopyaśca saṃtrastā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ \|\| 171 \|\|*

171\. Then all the people of Vraja, the cowherdesses and cowherds folded their hands with devotion and started offering prayers to Krishna.

## \|\| 19.172 \|\|

*bālā ūcuḥ \|*  
*yathā saṃrakṣitaṃ brahmansarvāpatsveva naḥ kulam \|*  
*tathā rakṣāṃ kuru punardāvāgnermadhusūdana \|\| 172 \|\|*

172\. The boys said – О Brahman, О Madhusudana, the way you have always protected us from dangers together with our kiths and kins, similarly you protect us from the forest fire.

## \|\| 19.173-177 \|\|

*tvamiṣṭadevatā'smākaṃ tvameva kuladevatā \|*  
*sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃhartā jagatāṃ ca jagatpate \|\| 173 \|\|*

*vahnirvā varuṇo vā'pi candro vā sūrya eva ca \|*  
*yamaḥ kuberaḥ pavana īśānādyāśca devatāḥ \|\| 174 \|\|*

*brahmeśaśeṣadharmendrā munīndrā manavaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*mānavāśca tathā daityā yakṣarākṣasakiṃnarāḥ \|\| 175 \|\|*

*ye ye carācarāścaiva sarve tava vibhūtayaḥ \|*  
*āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca tathecchayā \|\| 176 \|\|*

*abhayaṃ dehi goviṃda vahnisaṃharaṇaṃ kuru \|*  
*vayaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmo rakṣa naḥ śaraṇāgatān \|\| 177 \|\|*

173-177. You happen to be our supreme god and the family god. О lord of the universe, you are the creator of the universe, its protector and the destroyer. The fire, Varuna, the Moon, the Sun, Yama, Kubera, wind-god, Isana and other gods besides Brahma, Vinsu, Shiva, Dharma, sages, Manu, humans, demons, Yaksas, Raksasas and Kinnaras besides all the movable and immovable creatures are only your amshas. They all appear and disappear according to your command. О Govinda, you protect us and save us from this fire. All of us have come to take refuge with you. You protect us since we have taken refuge under you.

## \|\| 19.178 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā te sarve tasthurdhyātvā padāmbujam \|*  
*dūrībhūtastu dāvāgniḥ śrīkṛṣṇāmṛtadṛṣṭitaḥ \|\| 178 \|\|*

178\. Thus speaking the people started meditating upon the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna. At the very nectar-like sight of Krishna the forest fire disappeared.

## \|\| 19.179-180 \|\|

*dūrībhūte ca dāvāgnau nanṛtuste mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*sarvāpadaḥ praṇaśyanti harismaraṇamātrataḥ \|\| 179 \|\|*

*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*vahnito na bhavettasya bhayaṃ janmani janmani \|\| 180 \|\|*

179-180. After the forest fire was extinguished, all of them started rejoicing and dancing. All the dangers disappeared after the reciting of the name of the lord. Whosoever recites this auspicious stotra in the early morning, never meets with any danger from the fire in his life.

## \|\| 19.181 \|\|

*śatrugraste ca dāvāgnau vipattau prāṇasaṅkaṭe \|*  
*stotrametatpaṭhitvā tu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 181 \|\|*

181\. He is never surrounded by the enemies or the forest fire or any dangers which all disappear with the reciting of the stotra.

## \|\| 19.182 \|\|

*śatrusainyaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti sarvatra vijayī bhavet \|*  
*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|\| 182 \|\|*

182\. With the reciting of this stotra, the enemy army is destroyed and one becomes victorious. He achieves the devotion of lord Krishna during this birth and ultimately achieves the slavehood of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 19.183 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*dāvāgnimokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā taiḥ sārddhaṃ śṛṇu nārada \|*  
*jagāma śrīharirgehaṃ kuberabhavanopamam \|\| 183 \|\|*

183\. Narayana said – О Narada saving them from the forest fire, Shri Krishna went back to his abode which was like the palace of Kubera.

## \|\| 19.184 \|\|

*brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ nandaḥ paripūrṇaṃ dadau mudā \|*  
*bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa jñātivargāṃśca bāndhavān \|\| 184 \|\|*

184\. The delightful Nanda distributed enough of charity to the Brahmanas and also served food to his relatives.

## \|\| 19.185 \|\|

*nānāvidhaṃ maṅgalaṃ ca harernāmānukīrtanam \|*  
*vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa vipradvārā mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 185 \|\|*

185\. He performed various welfare ceremonies and other religious functions including the reciting of the Vedas by the Brahmanas for the welfare of Krishna.

## \|\| 19.186 \|\|

*evaṃ mumudire sarve vṛndāraṇye gṛhegṛhe \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojadhyānaikatānamānasāḥ \|\| 186 \|\|*

186\. Thus all the people of Vrindavana started meditating upon the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna with a devoted mind.

## \|\| 19.187 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamaṅgalam \|*  
*kalikilbiṣakāṣṭhānāṃ dahane dahanopamam \|\| 187 \|\|*

187\. I have thus narrated to you the pleasant story of the lord which bums the sins like the fire burning the wood.

## Chapter 20

## \|\| 20.1 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā bālakaiḥ sārddhaṃ balena saha mādhavaḥ \|*  
*bhuktvā pītvā'nuliptaśca vṛndāraṇyaṃ jagāma ha \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – Once Madhava accompanied by Balabhadra and the boys while finishing their meals and decorating their heads with sandal-paste, went to Vrindavana.

## \|\| 20.2 \|\|

*krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavānkautukena ca taiḥ saha \|*  
*krīḍāni magnacittānāṃ dūraṃ tadgokulaṃ yayau \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The lord played with them for long. When all of them were engrossed in the sports, the cows and calves strayed away.

## \|\| 20.3 \|\|

*tasya prabhāvaṃ vijñātuṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ patiḥ \|*  
*cakāra nihnutiṃ gāśca vatsāṃśca bālakānapi \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. At that point of time Brahma, the lord of creation thought of testing the competence of lord Krishna. He therefore stole away the cows, the calves and the cowherds and hid them somewhere.

## \|\| 20.4 \|\|

*vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvakārakaḥ \|*  
*punaścakāra tatsarvaṃ yogīndro yogamāyayā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Understanding his move, Hari who is all knowledgeable and is the creator of the universe, created the cows, calves and the cowherds with the influence of Yogamaya.

## \|\| 20.5 \|\|

*jagāma śrīharirgehaṃ kālayitvā ca gokulam \|*  
*balena bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ krīḍākautukamānasaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Thereafter lord Krishna who is well-versed in the divine play returned to his abode with the cows, Balabhadra and the cowherds.

## \|\| 20.6 \|\|

*evaṃ cakāra bhagavānvarṣamekaṃ ca pratyaham \|*  
*yamunāgamanaṃ gobhirbalena saha bālakaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Thus this process continued for one year. Daily he used to go to the bank of Yamuna with Balabhadra and cows and daily returned in the evening.

## \|\| 20.7 \|\|

*brahmā prabhāvaṃ vijñāya lajjānamrātmakandharaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma hareḥsthānaṃ bhāṇḍīravaṭamūlake \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Understanding this influence of the lord, Brahma felt ashamed and went to the lord in the Bhandlra forest, who was resting under the shade of a tree.

## \|\| 20.8 \|\|

*dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ tatraiva gopālagaṇaveṣṭitam \|*  
*yathā pārvaṇacandraṃ ca vibhāntaṃ svagaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. He found Krishna there surrounded by the cowherds like the moon surrounded by the constellation, which illumine.

## \|\| 20.9-11 \|\|

*ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca hasantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā \|*  
*pītavastraparīdhānaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitam \|*  
*ratnakuṇḍalayugmābhyāṃ svakapolasthalojjvalam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāmamanoharam \|*  
*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumārcitavigraham \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. Lord Krishna was seated on a gem-studded lion-throne comfortably and wore a serene smile on his face; he was clad in a yellow lower garment and his body was emitting divine lustre; he was wearing armlets, wristlets and anklets made of gems. His ears were adorned with a pair of kundalas. He was playful and could steal the mind of others. His limbs were plastered with sandal-paste, aguru, kastUrl and saffron.

## \|\| 20.12 \|\|

*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvibhūṣitam \|*  
*navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ prodbhinnanavayauvanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The garlands of forest flowers adorned his body and his body had the complexion of new clouds with the youthfulness emerging out of the same.

## \|\| 20.13 \|\|

*mālatīmālyasaṃyuktaṃ mayūrapicchacūḍakam \|*  
*svāṅgasaundaryadīptyā ca kṛtabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. He had a crown of peacock feathers and the garlands of jasmine flowers were decorated in it. With the lustre of his limbs, the ornaments were shining.

## \|\| 20.14 \|\|

*śaratpārvaṇacandrasya prabhāmuṣṭāsyasundaram \|*  
*pakvabimbādharauṣṭhaṃ ca khagendracañcunāsikam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. His face resembled the beauty of the full moon of the winter season. His lips resembled the ripe wood-apple and the nose resembled the beak of Garuda.

## \|\| 20.15-18 \|\|

*śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ prabhāmocanalocanam \|*  
*muktāpaṅktivinindyaikadantapaṅktimanoharam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam \|*  
*śāntaṃ ca rādhikākāntaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ param \|\| 16 \|\|*

*evaṃbhūtaṃ prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāmātivismitaḥ \|*  
*darśaṃdarśamīśvaraṃ taṃ praṇanāma punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yaddṛṣṭaṃ hṛdayāmbhoje tadrūpaṃ bahireva ca \|*  
*yā mūrtiḥ purato dṛṣṭā sā paścātparitastataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. His eyes resembled the beauty of the mid-day lotus flower of the summer season and his teeth resembled the beautiful jewels. The kaustubha gem adorned his chest. Having a look at the peaceful Krishna the lord of Radha, Brahma was extremely surprised and he bowed in reverence to him. He started looking at him and bowed in reverence again and again. The form in which Brahma had visualised the lord in his heart, the same figure was found by him before him. The figure which was present in the front, the same was at the back and on both sides.

## \|\| 20.19 \|\|

*tatra vṛndāvane sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasamaṃ mune \|*  
*dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ tatra tasthau jagadguruḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Oh sage! in Vmdavana he found everything like Krishna and meditating upon his fonn, Brahma sat out there.

## \|\| 20.20-23 \|\|

*gāvo vatsāśca bālāśca latāgulmāśca vīrudhaḥ \|*  
*sarvaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ brahmā śyāmarūpaṃ dadarśa ha \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvaivaṃ paramāścaryaṃ punardhyānaṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*dadarśa trijagadbrahmā nānyatkṛṣṇaṃ vinā mune \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kva ca vṛkṣaḥ kva vā śailaḥ kva mahī kva ca sāgarāḥ \|*  
*kva devāḥ kva ca gandharvā munīndrāḥ kva ca mānavāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kva cātmā kva jagadbījaṃ kva svargaḥ kvāyameva ca \|*  
*sarvaṃ ca svadṛśā brahmā dadarśa māyayā hareḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

20-23. He visualised Krishna to be present in all the cows, the calves, the boys, the creepers, the trees and in the entire Vmdavana. Witnessing such a scene surprised Brahma who again meditated upon him. О sage, at that point of time Brahma could see nothing in the three worlds except lord Krishna; there were no trees, no mountains, no earth, no oceans, no gods, Gandharvas, sages, humans, soul, seeds of the universe, heaven and he himself. He was non-plussed. With the illusion of the lord, he found everything like himself.

## \|\| 20.24 \|\|

*kva kṛṣṇo jagatāṃ nāthaḥ kva vā māyāvibhūtayaḥ \|*  
*sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃcinnirvaktumakṣamaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Not only this he could not find lord Krishna himself nor his creation; now everything was alike. There was no creation and everything was like Krishna himself. Finding this Brahma was taken aback and was unable to speak.

## \|\| 20.25 \|\|

*kiṃ staumi kiṃ karomīti manasaivaṃ pragṛhya ca \|*  
*tatra sthitvā jagaddhātā japaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He then started thinking within himself, "Whom should I adore now? What should I do?" Thereafter the creator of the universe staying there got ready to perform japam.

## \|\| 20.26 \|\|

*sukhaṃ yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā babhūva saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ \|*  
*pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro'tidīnavat \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. He sat comfortably in yogasana, folded his hands, getting emotional, his eyes were filled with tears and became quite meek and humble.

## \|\| 20.27 \|\|

*iḍāṃ suṣumnāṃ madhyāṃ ca piṅgalāṃ nalinīṃ dhurām \|*  
*nāḍīṣaṭkaṃ ca yogena nibaddhya ca prayatnataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. He controlled by meditation the three veins, named ida, susumna, madhyd, pingala, nalinl and dhura.

## \|\| 20.28-31 \|\|

*mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūraṃ manoharam \|*  
*viśuddhaṃ paramājñākhyaṃ ṣaṭcakraṃ ca nibaddhya ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*laṅghanaṃ kārayitvā ca tatṣaṭcakraṃ kramādvidhiḥ \|*  
*brahmarandhraṃ samānīya vāyubandhaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 29 \|\|*

*nibadhya vāyuṃ madhyāṃ tāmānīya hṛdayāmbujam \|*  
*taṃ vāyuṃ bhrāmayitvā ca yojayāmāsa madhyayā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*evaṃ kṛtvā tu niṣpando yo datto hariṇā purā \|*  
*jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ tasyaiva ca daśākṣaram \|\| 31 \|\|*

28-31. He than controlled the cakras in muladhara, svadhisthana, manipura, manohara, visuddha and paramajna. He then crossed the saf-cakra and established the air in Brahmarandhra. Establishing the air, he then again arrived close to madhyd vein turning that wind, the Vidhata linked the madhyd vein and while doing this, he became stable and started reciting the ten-letter mantra given to him by Hari in earlier times.

## \|\| 20.32-34 \|\|

*muhūrtaṃ ca japaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ padāmbujam \|*  
*dadarśa hṛdayāmbhoje sarvatejomayaṃ mune \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tattejaso'ntare rūpamatīva sumanoharam \|*  
*dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ bhūṣitaṃ pītavāsasā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*śrutimūlasthalanyastajvalanmakarakuṇḍalam । īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānuyarahakārakam \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. О sage, after meditating upon the lotus-like feet of Krishna for a muhiirta, he visualised the glorious form of the lord in his heart in the lustre. He had a beautiful form having two arms holding a flute in his hand, wearing pitdmbara, adorned with all the ornaments and the kundalas in the ears. Hari was having a smile on his face and looked anxious to bestow his grace on his devotees.

## \|\| 20.35-36 \|\|

*yaddṛṣṭaṃ brahmarandhre ca hṛdi tadbahireva ca \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā ca paramāścaryaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|\| 35 \|\|*

*yatstotraṃ ca purā dattaṃ hariṇaikārṇave mune \|*  
*tamīśaṃ tena vidhinā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. The form he could visualise in Brahmarandhra, the same form could be seen by him in his heart. Witnessing such a surprise, he started praying to the lord. О sage, the knowledge of the stotra that was imparted to Brahma in earlier times, the same was recited by him with devotion quite humbly.

## \|\| 20.37-41 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|*  
*sarvānirvacanīyaṃ taṃ namāmi śivarūpiṇam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*navīnajaladākāraṃ śyāmasundaravigraham \|*  
*sthitaṃ jantuṣu sarveṣu nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpiṇam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ jagadvyāpijagatparam \|*  
*sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ bījarūpaṃ sanātanam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*sarvādhāraṃ sarvavaraṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitam \|*  
*sarvārādhyaṃ sarvaguruṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*sarvamaṃtrasvarūpaṃ ca sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ varam \|*  
*śaktiyuktamayuktaṃ ca staumi svecchāmayaṃ vibhum \|\| 41 \|\|*

37-41. Brahma said – I bow in reverence to the form of everything, the lord of everyone, cause of all the causes, beyond description and form of welfare. The one who is like the fresh cloud, dark-complexioned, who remains uninvolved in spite of his remaining in all the creatures, who is witness of all, the one who roams in the soul, is all successful, pervades the whole world, remains aloof from the world, the form of all, the seed of all, eternal, the best of all, the base of all, all powerful, adored by all, teacher of all, the cause of all the welfares, the form of all the mantras, bestower of all the riches and prowess. He is endowed with all the riches and is also without them. I adore the lord who is all pervading and moves at will.

## \|\| 20.42-45 \|\|

*śaktīśaṃ śaktibījaṃ ca śaktirūpadharaṃ varam \|*  
*saṃsārasāgare ghore śaktinaukāsamanvitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*kṛpāluṃ karṇadhāraṃ ca namāmi bhaktavatsalam \|*  
*ātmasvarūpamekāṃtaṃ liptaṃ nirliptameva ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma staumi svecchāsvarūpiṇam \|*  
*sarvendriyādidevaṃ tamindriyālayameva ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*sarvendriyasvarūpaṃ ca virāḍrūpaṃ namāmyaham \|*  
*vedaṃ ca vedajanakaṃ sarvavedāṅgarūpiṇam \|\| 45 \|\|*

42-45. Не is extremely powerful, the seed of prowess, the form of prowess, is like the boat of strength in the ocean of the universe, is quite merciful, beloved of the devotees and the great sailor. I adore him offering prayers, the one who is the form of self, secluded, uninvolved, as well as involved, is Brahman having all the qualities and even without them, the one who moves at will, I adore him. The one, who is the supreme god of all the organs of senses, the abode of all the organs of senses, the form of all the organs of senses and the one who happens to possess Virat form, I adore him. The one, who is the form of the Vedas, the creator of the Vedas, the form of post-Vedic literature and the mantras, I adore such a Parameshvara.

## \|\| 20.46-49 \|\|

*sarvamantasvarūpaṃ ca namāmi parameśvaram \|*  
*sārātsārataraṃ dravyamapūrvamanirūpiṇam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*svatantramasvatantraṃ ca yaśodānandanaṃ bhaje \|*  
*santaṃ sarvaśarīreṣu tamadṛṣṭamanūhakam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*dhyānāsādhyaṃ vidyamānaṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ guruṃ bhaje \|*  
*rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rāsollāsasamutsukam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*gopībhiḥ sevyamānaṃ ca taṃ dhareśaṃ namāmyaham \|*  
*satāṃ sadaiva santaṃ tamasantamasatāmapi \|\| 49 \|\|*

46-49. He is the gist of all the essence, incomplete, inexplicable, independent and dependent, son of Yashoda, is adored by me. The one who resides in all the bodies, is invisible, beyond controversy, inaccessible even by deep meditation, the teacher of the intellectuals and the yogis. I adore him. He is the one who resides in the Rasamandala, is bliss of the divine dance and is always anxious for the same. He is the one who is served by the cowherdesses and is the lord of the earth, I adore him. The one who is the truth for the noble people and falsehood for the wicked people, the lord of the yogis, achievable by yogic practices and the one who is adored by Shiva, I adore him.

## \|\| 20.50-53 \|\|

*yogīśaṃ yogasādhyaṃ ca namāmi śivasevitam \|*  
*mantrabījaṃ mantrarājaṃ mantradaṃ phaladaṃ phalam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*mantrasiddhisvarūpaṃ taṃ namāmi ca parātparam \|*  
*sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca sukhadaṃ duḥkhadaṃ puṇyameva ca \|\| 51 \|\|*

*puṇyapradaṃ ca śubhadaṃ śubhabījaṃ namāmyaham \|*  
*ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā gāśca sa bālakān \|\| 52\|\|*

*nipatya daṇḍavadbhūmau ruroda praṇanāma ca \|*  
*dadarśa cakṣurunmīlya vidhātā jagatāṃ mune \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. The one who is the seed of mantras, the lord of the mantras, the bestower of the mantras and their reward besides being the form of the reward; the one who grants success in the mantras and is beyond everyone, I adore him. The one who is the form of pleasure and pain, bestower of suspiciousness and the one who is the seed of welfare and bestows welfare, I bow before him. Thus the creator of the universe adored lord Krishna and returned the cowherd boys to him. He then prostrated before him on the ground and started crying. Thereafter, О sage, he then opened his eyes and found Krishna there.

## \|\| 20.54-55 \|\|

*brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante śrīhareḥ padam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*labhate dāsyamatulaṃ sthānamīśvarasannidhau \|*  
*labdhvā ca kṛṣṇasānnidhyaṃ pārṣadapravaro bhavet \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. The one who recites the stotra composed by Brahma with devotion every day, enjoying all the pleasures of the world ultimately proceeds to the abode of Hari, where he achieves the inaccessible slavehood of the lord. He than attains closeness of the lord and becomes his attendant.

## \|\| 20.56 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*gate jagatkāraṇe ca brahmalokaṃ ca brahmaṇi \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇo bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ jagāma svālayaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Narayana said -After the departure of Brahma, the creator of the universe, Shri Krishna returned to his place together with the cowherd boys.

## \|\| 20.57 \|\|

*gāvo vatsāśca bālāśca jagmurvarṣāntare gṛham \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇamāyayā sarve menire te dināntaram \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Though the cows, the calves and the boys returned to their home after one year, with the illusion of the lord they thought it to be a single day.

## \|\| 20.58-59 \|\|

*gopā gopālikā kiṃcittatkartuṃ na kṣamāstadā \|*  
*yoginaḥ kṛtrimaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ nūtnaṃ vā purātanam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ śubham \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakālasukhāvaham \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. At that point of time the cowherds and cowherdesses could not guess anything. For a yogi everything is artificial and there is nothing old or new for him. Thus I have narrated to you the story of lord Krishna which bestows welfare, pleasure, salvation, is auspicious and is always blissful.

## Chapter 21

## \|\| 21.1-3 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā''nandayuktaśca nando gopavraje mune \|*  
*dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsa śakrayāgakṛtodyamaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ guḍaṃ madhu \|*  
*etānyādāya śakrasya pūjāṃ kurvantviti bruvan \|\| 2 \|\|*

*yeye santyatra nagare gopā gopyaśca bālakāḥ \|*  
*bālikāśca dvijā bhūyo vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca bhaktitaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narayana said – О sage, once Nanda delightfully made an announcement in the city at the time of performing of Indrayaga, that all the cowherds, cowherdesses, boys, girls, Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras living in Vraja, should bring with devotion, curd, milk, ghee, butter milk, butter, guda and honey besides other materials for the adoration of Indra.

## \|\| 21.4-5 \|\|

*ityevaṃ śrāvayāmāsa svayameva mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*yaṣṭimāropayāmāsa ramyasthāne suvistṛte \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dadau tatra kṣaumavastraṃ mālājālaṃ manoharam \|*  
*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravameva ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Thus making an announcement, he installed a flag-post delightfully in a vast area and it was decorated with silken garments and beautiful garlands of flowers. The face was decorated with sandal-paste, aguru, kastUrl and saffron.

## \|\| 21.6-7 \|\|

*snātaḥ kṛtāhniko bhaktyā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|*  
*uvāsa svarṇapīṭhe ca prakṣālitapadāmbujaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*nānāprakārapātraiśca brāhmaṇaiśca purohitaiḥ \|*  
*gopālairgopikābhiśca bālābhiḥ saha bālakaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. After taking a bath and completing other daily routines Nanda clad himself in two new garments, washing his lotus-like feet, got himself seated on the golden seat. At that point of time many Brahmanas holding different types of vases, the priests, cowherds, cowherdesses, the boys and the girls also arrived there.

## \|\| 21.8 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatrājagmurnagaravāsinaḥ \|*  
*mahāsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhārā nānopāyanasaṃyutāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In the meantime all the people of the city arrived there carrying the materials with them together with various types of presents.

## \|\| 21.9 \|\|

*ājagmurmunayaḥ sarve jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|*  
*śāntāḥ śiṣyagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The sages well-versed in the Vedic and post-Vedic literature, shining with their divine lustre, having a divine vision also arrived there with their pupils.

## \|\| 21.10-13 \|\|

*gargaśca gālavaścaiva śākalyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ \|*  
*gautamaḥ karuṣaḥ kaṇvo vātsyaḥ kātyāyanastathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*saubharirvāmadevaśca yājñavalkyaśca pāṇiniḥ \|*  
*ṛṣyaśṛṅgo gauramukho bharadvājaśca vāmanaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ śṛṅgī sumanturjaiminiḥ kacaḥ \|*  
*parāśaraśca maitreyo vaiśampāyana eva ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇāśca katividhā bhikṣukā bandinastathā \|*  
*bhūpā vaiśyāśca śūdrāśca samājagmurmahotsave \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. He sages like Garga, Galava, Sakalya, Sakat ayana, Gautama, Karusa, Kanva, Vatsya, KStyayana, Saubhari, Vamadeva, Yajnavalkya, Panini, Rsyashrnga, Gauramukha, Bharadvaja, Vamana, Krishna-dvaipayana, Srngi, Sumantu, Jaimini, Kaca, Parasara, Maitreya, Vaisampayana, together with many Brahmanas, beggars, bards, kings, Vaisyas and Shudras also arrive to attend the function.

## \|\| 21.14 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā munīndrānnandaśca brāhmaṇānbhūmipāṃstathā \|*  
*svarṇapīṭhātsamuttasthau vrajāścottasthureva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Looking at the sages, the Brahmanas and the kings, Nanda got up from the golden pedestal and with him all the people of Vraja also stood up.

## \|\| 21.15 \|\|

*praṇamya vāsayāmāsa munīndrānviprabhūmipān \|*  
*teṣāmanumatiṃ prāpya tatrovāsa punarmudā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Bowing in reverence to the sages, Brahmanas and the kings, he made them seated appropriately and with their permission he also took his seat.

## \|\| 21.16-17 \|\|

*pākaṃ ca yaṣṭinikaṭe kartumājñāṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*pākaprājñaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ śatamānīya sādaram \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tatra ratnapradīpāśca jajvaluḥ paritastathā \|*  
*andhībhūtaṃ ca dhūpena sthānaṃ tatsurabhīkṛtam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. He then commanded a hundred Brahmanas, the Brahmanas well-versed in cooking, "You start cooking besides the flag-post." The place was illuminated with burning lamps of diamonds. With the burning of incense, the place was plunged into darkness with its smoke and also filled with fragrance.

## \|\| 21.18 \|\|

*nānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi mālyāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*naivedyaṃ ca bahuvidhamapūrvaṃ sumanoharam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О Narada, the place was filled with various types of flowers, several types of divine eatables, sheshamum balls and many other sweets.

## \|\| 21.19-22 \|\|

*tilalaḍḍukapūrṇaṃ ca maṇḍakānāṃ sahasrakam \|*  
*svastikaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ ca yaṣṭisthānaṃ ca nārada \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kalaśānāṃ sahasraṃ ca pūrṇaṃ śarkarayā mune \|*  
*yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ laḍḍukairmadhurairvaraiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ghṛtapakvairviprakṛtaiḥ pūrṇāni kalaśāni ca \|*  
*vṛkṣapakvāni ramyāṇi cārurambhāphalāni ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

*phalāni paripakvāni kāladeśodbhavāni ca \|*  
*kṣīrāṇāṃ kumbhalakṣāṇi dadhnāṃ tāvanti nārada \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. О sage, there were thousands of pitchers filled with sugar. The sweet balls were made of the flour of wheat and barley, which were fried by the Brahmanas in ghee. There were several pitchers filled with them. О Narada, the beautiful bananas which were ripened in the trees themselves and a large quantity of fruits of the season, a lakh of pitchers filled with milk and an equal number of pitchers filled with curd were also lying there.

## \|\| 21.23 \|\|

*madhūnāṃ kumbhaśatakaṃ sarpiṣkumbha sahasrakam \|*  
*kalaśānāṃ trilakṣāṇi takrapūrṇāni niścitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. There were a hundred pitchers of honey, a thousand pitchers of ghee and three lakh pitchers of butter-milk placed there.

## \|\| 21.24 \|\|

*ghaṭānāṃ pañcalakṣāṇi guḍapūrṇāni niścitam \|*  
*tilatailena pūrṇaṃ ca kalaśānāṃ sahasrakam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. There were five lakhs of vases filled with guda and a thousand vases filled with sheshamum oil were available there.

## \|\| 21.25 \|\|

*vṛṣendrāśca bahuvidhā bhogārhadravyavāhakāḥ \|*  
*nānāvidhāni pātrāṇi sauvarṇarājatāni ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The consumable articles were transported by bulls and various types of vases of gold and silver were also placed there.

## \|\| 21.26 \|\|

*svarṇapīṭhāni ca brahmannājagmuryaṣṭisannidhim \|*  
*vastrāṇi varaṇārhāṇi cārūṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О Brahman, by the side of that flag-post, there were pedestals of gold, beautiful costumes for wearing besides beautiful ornaments.

## \|\| 21.27 \|\|

*nānāvidhāni vādyāni cārūṇi madhurāṇi ca \|*  
*vādakāḥ svarayantrāṇi vādayāmāsurutsave \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. During the festivities, those who played on musical instruments were doing so in a sweet tone issuing various types of tunes.

## \|\| 21.28 \|\|

*chāgalānāṃ sahasrāṇi mahiṣāṇāṃ śatāni ca \|*  
*meṣakāṇāṃ ca lakṣāṇi hyānayāmāsa tatra vai \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thousands of he-goats, a hundred he-buffaloes and a lakh of sheep were also brought there.

## \|\| 21.29 \|\|

*śatānyeva gaṇḍakānāmājagmuryaṣṭisaṃnidhim \|*  
*prekṣitāni ca sarvāṇi rakṣitāni ca rakṣakaiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Hundreds of rhinoceros arrived near the flag-post and several articles were put on show there, well-guarded.

## \|\| 21.30 \|\|

*bālakānāṃ bālikānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛkṣayoṣitām \|*  
*yūnāṃ ca yuvatīnāṃ ca saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Who could count the number of boys, girls, trees, creepers and young boys and young girls?

## \|\| 21.31 \|\|

*gāyakānāṃ ca saṃgītaṃ nartakānāṃ ca nartanam \|*  
*śrutvā dṛṣṭvā janāḥ sarve mumuhuḥ sumahotsave \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. In the beautiful function all the people were engrossed in the music and dance festivities.

## \|\| 21.32-34 \|\|

*raṃbhorvaśī menakā ca ghṛtācī mohinī ratiḥ \|*  
*prabhāvatī bhānumatī vipracittistilottamā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*candraprabhā suprabhā ca ratnamālā madālasā \|*  
*reṇukā ramaṇī brahmannetā ājagmurutsave \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tāsāṃ nṛtyena gītena stanāsyaśroṇidarśanāt \|*  
*rūpeṇa vakradṛṣṭyā ca mūrcchāṃ prāpuśca mānavāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. О Brahman, in that function Radha, UrvasI, Menaka, GhrtacI, Mohini, Rati, Prabhavati, Bhanumatl, Vipracitti, Tilottama, Chandraprabha, Suprabha, Ratnamala, Madalasa and beautiful Renuka also arrived. By looking at the dance and music, the breasts, faces and the pelvic region of the damsels and their overall beauty, besides the side-glances, the people got fainted.

## \|\| 21.35-36 \|\|

*etasminnantare śīghramājagāma hariḥ svayam \|*  
*gopālabālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ balena balaśālinā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā taṃ ca janāḥ sarve saṃbhrāntā harṣavihvalāḥ \|*  
*uttasthurārādbhītāśca pulakāṅkitavigrahāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. In the meantime Gopala accompanied by valorous Balabhadra arrived there himself. On their arrival and looking at them all the people felt delighted and suddenly got up. Their hair-stood on end and they felt panicky from a distance.

## \|\| 21.37-38 \|\|

*krīḍāsthānātsamāyāntaṃ śāntaṃ sundaravigraham \|*  
*vinodamuralīveṇuśṛṅgaśabdasamanvitam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*sadratnasārabhūṣābhirbhūṣitaṃ kaustubhena ca \|*  
*candanāgurupaṅkena carcitaṃ śyāmavigraham \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Shri Krishna was returning from the playground, his peaceful appearance was quite charming. The sweet sound of the flute was accompanied by the sound of vina, horn and other musical instruments played at the same time. He was adored with the best of ornaments studded with gems together with the kaustubha gem. His dark-complexioned body was plastered with sandal-paste and aguru.

## \|\| 21.39 \|\|

*śaranmadhyāhnapadmāsyaṃ paśyantaṃ ratnadarpaṇe \|*  
*cārucandanacandreṇa kastūrībindunā saha \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Не was looking at the mirror of diamonds, his face which resembled the glory of the mid-day lotus of the winter season. A spot of kastiiri decorated his forehead on which the sandal-paste was also applied and it looked like the moon.

## \|\| 21.40-43 \|\|

*śaśāṅkena yathā''kāśaṃ bhālamadhyavirājitam \|*  
*mālatīmālayā śyāmakaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalojjvalam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*bakapaṅktyā yathā''kāśaṃ śāradīyaṃ sunirmalam \|*  
*cāruṇā pītavastreṇa śobhitaṃ śyāmavigraham \|\| 41 \|\|*

*vibhāntaṃ vidyutā śaśvannavaniṃ nīradaṃ yathā \|*  
*kundaprasūnairguñjābhirbaddhavakrimacūḍakam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*yathendradhanuṣā bhāti vibhātaṃ bhagaṇairnabhaḥ \|*  
*ratnakuṇḍaladīptyā ca smitavaktrasuśobhitam \|\| 43 \|\|*

40-43. With this on his forehead he seemed as if he was decorated with the moon shining in the sky. He had a dark-complexioned throat, the chest was decorated with the garland of jasmine flowers and was shinning like a line of sky-larks flying in the sky in the winter season. He was clad in pitambara which added to the beauty of the dark-complexioned body. It appeared as if lightning appeared from the clouds. He wore a crown on his head which was tilted towards one side, with the peacock feather and the garland of fragrant flowers were decorating it. It appeared as if the rainbow was decorated with the constellation in the sky. His smiling face had the gem-studded kundalas decorating the ears which emitted lustre like the blossomed lotus flower of the summer season.

## \|\| 21.44-47 \|\|

*śaratpraphullapadmaṃ ca dyumaṇeḥ kiraṇairyathā \|*  
*viprakṣattriyavaiśyāśca munayo ballavā mune \|\| 44 \|\|*

*praṇamya vāsayāmāsū ratnasiṃhāsane śubhe \|*  
*uvāsa ratnapīṭhe sa teṣāṃ madhye jagatpatiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*yathā babhau śaraccandro jyotiṣāmantare ca khe \|*  
*śrutvā tamūcuste sarve jagatāmīśvaraṃ param \|\| 46 \|\|*

*svecchāmayaṃ guṇātītaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā mahotsavaṃ śīghramuvāca pitaraṃ hariḥ \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ durlabhāṃ nītiṃ nītiśāstraviśāradaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

44-47. О sage, thus looking at him, all the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and cowherds bowed in reverence to him and made him sit on the gem-studded lion-throne. While thus seated on the gem-studded lion-throne, the lord of the universe, looked as if the full moon of the winter season was surrounded by stars. Thus visualising the entire situation all the people said, "O lord of the universe you are beyond qualities, illustrious and eternal." Looking at the festivities Shri Krishna well-versed in the scriptures, at once spoke to his father the words which were inaccessible to all.

## \|\| 21.48-50 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhobho ballavarājeṃdra kiṃ karoṣīha suvrata \|*  
*ārādhyaḥ kaśca kā pūjā kiṃ phalaṃ pūjane bhavet \|\| 48 \|\|*

*phalena sādhanaṃ kiṃ vā kaḥ sakhyaḥ sādhanena ca \|*  
*deve ruṣṭe bhavetkiṃ vā pūjāyāḥ pratibandhake \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tuṣṭo devaḥ kiṃ dadāti phalamatra paratrakam \|*  
*kāciddadātyatra phalaṃ paratreha na kācana \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. Shri Krishna said – О lord of the Vallabas and best of the devotees, what is all this you are doing? "Who is your family god?" What is the form of this puja? After performing this ptija what reward shall accrue the reform? And with that reward which one of the tasks would be established? By performing it which one of the desires would be fulfilled? In case this puja is not performed what shall be the reaction of the gods and what harm can come to us? And in case he is pleased what type of reward of the world or heaven could be bestowed by the gods on us.

## \|\| 21.51 \|\|

*kācicca nobhayatrāpi cobhayatrāpi kācana \|*  
*avedavihitā pūjā sarvahānikaraṇḍikā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Some of the adoration provide us reward for this world only and not beyond the life. Some of the adorations provide no benefit to the performer either in this world or the next, while some of the adorations provide benefit for the present world as well as the future one.

## \|\| 21.52 \|\|

*pūjeyamadhunā vā te kimu vā puruṣakramāt \|*  
*dṛṣṭo devastvayā kasminpūjeyaṃ cānusāriṇī \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Such of the adoration which is not prescribed in the Vedas, is bound to cause harm. Is this adoration of modem or ancient origin?

## \|\| 21.53 \|\|

*sākṣātkhādati devaste sākṣātkiṃ vā na khādati \|*  
*sākṣādbhuṅkte ca yo devaḥ supraśastaṃ tadarcanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Where have you visualised the god who is being adored? Does your god consume food in visible and invisible form? Such of the god who appears in visible form, his adoration is blissful.

## \|\| 21.54 \|\|

*sākṣātkhādati naivedyaṃ viprarūpī janārdanaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇe parituṣṭe ca saṃtuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. It has been prescribed in the Vedas that the Brahmanas are like the gods for us. О father, the adoration of the Brahmana is more purposeful than adoring any other gods.

## \|\| 21.55 \|\|

*kiṃ tasya devapūjāyāṃ yo niyukto dvijārcane \|*  
*pūjitā brāhmaṇā yena pūjitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The Brahmanas in the form of Janardana consumes the offerings. When the Brahmana is satisfied all the gods get satisfied.

## \|\| 21.56 \|\|

*devāya dattvā naivedyaṃ dvijāya na prayacchati \|*  
*bhasmībhūtaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pūjanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The one, who engages himself in the adoration of the Brahmana, for him the adoration of the gods is of no consequence. The one who has adored the Brahmanas had adored all the gods.

## \|\| 21.57 \|\|

*viprāya devanaivedyadānāddhruvamanantakam \|*  
*tuṣṭo devo varaṃ dattvā prayāti ca svamandiram \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. After offering the food to the gods if the Brahmana shall not be served with the same, in that case the entire offering is reduced to ashes and the entire adoration becomes of no consequence.

## \|\| 21.58 \|\|

*dattvā devāya naivedyaṃ mūḍho bhuṅkte svayaṃ yadi \|*  
*dattāpahārī devasvaṃ bhuktvā ca narakaṃ vrajet \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. By offering food to the Brahmanas, one achieves merit without measure and the gods getting pleased dwell in his home.

## \|\| 21.59 \|\|

*devadattaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ naivedyaṃ ca vinā hareḥ \|*  
*praśastaṃ sarvadeveṣu viṣṇunaivedyabhojanam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. In case a foolish one offers food to the gods without offering the same to the Brahmanas or consumes himself, then he is termed as one who had stolen the riches of the gods and thereafter he has to fall into hell. Therefore except the food offered to the lord one should not accept the same offered food to the gods. The same would not be eaten by anyone else which is offered to the gods. The food offered to Vishnu can be consumed by everyone.

## \|\| 21.60-61 \|\|

*annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ ca kramamidaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*na dattvā vastu devāya dattaṃ viprāya cetsudhīḥ \|*  
*bhuktvā vipramukhe devāstuṣṭāḥ svargaṃ prayānti ca \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. The one, who does not offer food to Vishnu, the food and the water so consumed are like refuse and urine. This system has to be followed by everyone but more particularly by the Brahmanas. If an intelligent person without offering the food to the gods offers it to the Brahmanas, then with the food so consumed by the Brahmanas, the gods are pleased and retire to heaven.

## \|\| 21.62 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena viprāṇāmarcanaṃ kuru \|*  
*praśastaphaladātṝṇāmiha loke paratra ca \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Therefore, making all the efforts one should adore the Brahmanas because by serving them, one would be benefited in this as well as in the future life.

## \|\| 21.63 \|\|

*japastapaśca pūjā vā yajñadānaṃ mahotsavam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ sāraṃ vipratuṣṭiśca dakṣiṇā \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The performing of japam, tapas, puja, yajna, charities, festivities would end at the serving of Brahmanas to their satisfaction.

## \|\| 21.64 \|\|

*dakṣiṇānāṃ śarīreṣu tiṣṭhanti sarvadevatāḥ \|*  
*pādeṣu sarvatīrthāni puṇyāni pādadhūliṣu \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. All the gods reside in the body of a Brahmana and all the holy places dwell in his feet. With the dust of his feet all the merits are achieved.

## \|\| 21.65 \|\|

*pādodake ca viprāṇāṃ tīrthatoyāni santi ca \|*  
*tatsparśātsarvatīrtheṣu snānajanyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The water with which the feet of the Brahmanas are washed, all the holy places reside there. With the very touch of it, one achieves the merits of taking baths in all the holy places.

## \|\| 21.66 \|\|

*naśyaṃti bhakṣaṇādrogā bhaktibhāvena ballava \|*  
*saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. О Ballava, if one consumes with devotion the water of the Brahmanas, all his ailments disappear and he is relieved of all the sins committed by him during the past seven births. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 21.67 \|\|

*pāpaṃ pañcavidhaṃ kṛtvā yo vipraṃ praṇamedvraje \|*  
*sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvapāpātpramucyate \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The one who bows before the Brahmana after committing five types of sins, is relieved of all of them like his taking baths in the holy places.

## \|\| 21.68 \|\|

*brāhmaṇasparśamātreṇa mukto bhavati pātakī \|*  
*darśanānmucyate pāpāditi vede nirūpitam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. With the very touch of the Brahmana a sinner is relieved of all the sins and by looking at him, all the sins disappear. This has been ordained in the Vedas.

## \|\| 21.69-72 \|\|

*aprājño vā'tha prājño vā brāhmaṇo viṣṇuvigrahaḥ \|*  
*priyāḥ prāṇādhikā viṣṇorye viprā harisevinaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*dvijānāṃ haribhaktānāṃ prabhāvo durlabhaḥ śrutau \|*  
*yeṣāṃ pādābjarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā \|\| 70 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ ca pādacihnaṃ yattīrthaṃ tatparikīrtitam \|*  
*teṣāṃ ca sparśamātreṇa tīrthapāpaṃ praṇaśyati \|\| 71 \|\|*

*āliṅganātsadālāpātteṣāmucchiṣṭabhojanāt \|*  
*darśanātsparśanāccaiva sarvapāpātpramucyate \|\| 72 \|\|*

69-72. All the well-read as well as the foolish Brahmanas represent the body of lord Vishnu. Such of the Brahmanas who adore lord Vishnu are dearer to the lord than his own life. The influence of the Brahmanas who are devoted to the lord, has been commanded in the Vedas. With the fall of dust from the feet of the Brahmanas, even the sin committed in the holy places vanish. Their embrace, sweet conversation, audience with them and their touch, relieves the people of all the sins.

## \|\| 21.73 \|\|

*bhramaṇe sarvatīrthānāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ snānato bhavet \|*  
*haridāsasya viprasya tatpuṇyaṃ darśanāllabhet \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. The merit one gets by visiting all the holy places and taking baths in them, the same merit is achieved with the mere look of the Brahmana who is devoted to lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 21.74 \|\|

*ye viprā haraye dattvā nityamannaṃ ca bhuñjate \|*  
*ucchiṣṭabhojanātteṣāṃ harerdāsyaṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Such of the Brahmanas who always consume food first offering to the lord and by consuming such food a person achieves the slavehood of the lord.

## \|\| 21.75 \|\|

*na dattvā haraye bhaktyā bhuñjate cedbhramādapi \|*  
*purīṣasadṛśaṃ vastu jalaṃ mūtrasamaṃ bhavet \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. If anyone consumes the food by mistake without offering first to the lord, it becomes like refuse and the water becomes like wine.

## \|\| 21.76 \|\|

*śūdraśceddharibhaktaśca naivedyabhojanotsukaḥ \|*  
*adhikāro na śūdrāṇāṃ harerapyarcane tathā \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. A true devotee of Hari always remains anxious to consume the food after offering the same to the lord. He offers uncooked food to the lord and then consumes the food cooked by him.

## \|\| 21.77 \|\|

*viparaṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ śālagrāmaśilācani \|*  
*adhikāro na śūdrāṇāṃ hararapycane tathā \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. As the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaisyas and Shudras have no right to adore Shalagrama, similarly the Shudras have no right for adoring Hari.

## \|\| 21.78 \|\|

*dravyāṇyetāni gopendra viprebhyaścenna dāsyati \|*  
*bhasmībhūtāni sarvāṇi bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. О lord of the cowherds, in case all these articles are not given to the Brahmana, then they will be reduced to ashes. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 21.79 \|\|

*annaṃ ca sarvajīvebhyaḥ puṇyārthaṃ dātumarhati \|*  
*dattvā viśiṣṭajīvebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ phalamāpnuyāt \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. The food can be given to all the people for earning merits but by offering the same to specific personalities, one achieves special merit.

## \|\| 21.80 \|\|

*ato dattvā mānuṣebhyo labhate'ṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam \|*  
*tato viśiṣṭaśadrabhyo datvā taddviguṇaṃ phalam \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Therefore by offering food to the humans one gets eight times the merits and by offering the same to a special type of Shudras, one gets double the merit.

## \|\| 21.81 \|\|

*datavā'nana vaiśyajātibhyastataścāṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam \|*  
*śūdrāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ vaiśyebhyo'naṃ pradāya ca \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. By offering food to the Vaishyas, one gets eight time more merits. One gets double the merit by giving food to the Shudras as compared to the Vaisyas.

## \|\| 21.82-84 \|\|

*dattvā'nnaṃ kṣatriyebhyo'pi vaiśyānāṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*kaṣatriyāṇāṃ śataguṇaṃ vidrebhyo'naṃ pradāya ca \|\| 82 \|\|*

*viprāṇāṃ ca śataguṇaṃ śāstrajñe brāhmaṇe phalam \|*  
*śāstrajñānāṃ śataguṇaṃ bhakte vipre labheddhruvam \|*  
*sa cānnaṃ haraye dattvā bhuṅkte bhaktyā ca sādaram \|\| 83 \|\|*

*viṣṇave viprabhaktāya dattvā dātuśca yatphalam \|*  
*tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ bhaktabrāhmaṇabhojane \|\| 84 \|\|*

82-84. One earns double the merit, if in case the food is served to the Kshatriyas in place of the Vaisyas. One gets a hundred times more merit by offering food to the Brahmanas as compared to the food given to the Kshatriyas. In case the food is given to a Brahmana, well-versed in the scriptures, one achieves a hundred times more merit than serving food to an ordinary Brahmana. By serving food to a Brahmana who is devoted to the lord, one achieves a hundred times more merits than giving food to the Brahmanas well-versed in the scriptures. Offering food to Hari one should consume it gracefully. By giving away riches in charity to a Brahmana devoted to Vishnu and the merit one earns by that, the same is achieved by offering food to a Brahmana devoted to the lord.

## \|\| 21.85 \|\|

*bhakte tuṣṭe haristuṣṭo harau tuṣṭe ca devatāḥ \|*  
*bhavanti siddhāḥ śākhāśca yathā mūlaniṣecanāt \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. When the devotee of the lord is pleased, lord Hari himself is pleased, as with the watering of the trees at the roots, the new branches are sprouted.

## \|\| 21.86 \|\|

*dravyāṇyetāni devāya yadyekasmai prayacchati \|*  
*sarve devāśca ruṣṭāśceddevaiḥ kaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. In case the eatables are offered to one single god only then the others get annoyed and what shall the lone god do in the presence of all other gods.

## \|\| 21.87 \|\|

*athavā'rddhaṃ ca vastūnāṃ dehi govardhanāya ca \|*  
*gā vardhayati nityaṃ yastena govardhanaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Therefore, you offer half of the eatable material collected now to mountain Govardhana. The mountain is called Govardhana because it increases the flock of cows.

## \|\| 21.88 \|\|

*govardhanasamastāta puṇyavānna mahītale \|*  
*nityaṃ dadāti gobhyo yo navīnāni tṛṇāni ca \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. О father, there is no one more meritorious than Govardhana on earth, because the same provides fresh grass to the cows daily.

## \|\| 21.89-91 \|\|

*tīrthasthāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ viprabhojane \|*  
*sarvavratopavāseṣu sarveṣveva tapaḥsu ca \|\| 89 \|\|*

*yatpuṇyaṃ ca mahādāne yatpuṇyaṃ harisevane \|*  
*bhuvaḥ paryaṭane yattu sarvavākyeṣu yadbhavet \|\| 90 \|\|*

*yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣāyāṃ ca labhennaraḥ \|*  
*tatpuṇyaṃ labhate prājño gobhyo dattvā tṛṇāni ca \|\| 91 \|\|*

89-91. Visit to the holy places, feeding the Brahmanas, performing all the vratas and fasting, service to the lord, going round the earth, being truthful and performing all the yajnas, the person gets great merit but the same merit is achieved by offering green grass to the cows.

## \|\| 21.92 \|\|

*bhuktavantīṃ tṛṇaṃ yaśca gāṃ vārayati kāmataḥ \|*  
*brahmahatyā bhavettasya prāyaścittādviśudhyati \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. The one who deliberately prevents a cow from grazing, earns the sin of Brahmahatya and can be purified after repentance,

## \|\| 21.93 \|\|

*sarve devā gavā maṅge tīrthāni tatpadeṣu ca \|*  
*tadguhyeṣu svayaṃ lakṣmīstiṣṭhatyeva sadā pitaḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. О father, all the gods dwell in all the limbs of the cow, while all the sacred places dwell in her hoofs. Lakshmi herself dwells in her body.

## \|\| 21.94-96 \|\|

*goṣpadāktamṛdā yo hi tilakaṃ kurute naraḥ \|*  
*tīrthasnāto bhavetsadyo jayastasya padepade \|\| 94 \|\|*

*gāvastiṣṭhaṃti yatraiva tattīrthaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*prāṇāṃstyaktā narastatra sadyo mukto bhaveddhruvam \|\| 95 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāmaṅgaṃ yo hanti mānavādhamaḥ \|*  
*brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

94-96. The one who applied tilakam on his head from the dust of the hoofs of the cow, earns the merit of having a bath in all the sacred places and faces victory at every step. The place where the cows are kept, becomes like the sacred place and in case one meets his end at that place, he gets redeemed at once. The one who strikes a blow on the limbs of the Brahmanas and the cows, such a wicked person earns the sin of Brahmahatya. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 21.97 \|\|

*nārāyaṇāṃśānviprāṃśca gāśca ye ghnanti mānavāḥ \|*  
*kālasūtraṃ ca te yānti yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. Such of the degraded people who kill the Brahmanas and the cows who are the ariisa of Narayana, have to fall in kalasutra hell and remain there up to the life of the sun and the moon.

## \|\| 21.98 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇo virarāma ca nārada \|*  
*ānandayukto nandaśca tamuvāca smitānanaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*
