98\. О Narada, thus speaking lord Krishna kept quiet. Thereafter Nanda with a delightful mind said to him, wearing a serene smile on his face.

## \|\| 21.99 \|\|

*nanda uvāca \|*  
*paurvāparīyaṃ pūjeti mahendrasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*suvṛṣṭisādhanī sādhyaṃ sarvasasyamanoharam \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Narada said – We are performing this traditional pUja for lord Indra. It is for the cause of good rain and abundance of harvest.

## \|\| 21.100 \|\|

*sasyāni prāṇināṃ prāṇāḥ sasyājjīvanti jīvinaḥ \|*  
*pūjayanti vrajasthāśca mahendraṃ puruṣakramāt \|*  
*mahotsavaṃ vatsarānte nirvighnāya śivāya ca \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. The cereals are the life of the people which keep the people alive. The people of Vraja have been performing this puja traditionally for Indra. This functioh is performed at the end of the year for the removal of obstruction and the welfare of all.

## \|\| 21.101 \|\|

*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā balena saha mādhavaḥ \|*  
*uccairjahāsa sa punaruvāca pitaraṃ mudā \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. On hearing these words, Krishna together with Balabhadra laughed aloud and joyfully spoke to their father.

## \|\| 21.102-103 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*aho śrutaṃ vicitraṃ te vacanaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*upahāsyaṃ lokaśāstraṃ vedeṣveva vigarhitam \|\| 102 \|\|*

*nirūpaṇaṃ nāsti kutra śakrādvṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate \|*  
*apūrvaṃ nītivacanaṃ śrutamadya mukhāttava \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. Shri Krishna said – We have listened to your most astonishing and surprising talk, which could be denounced by the people, the scriptures and the Vedas and are nothing short of a joke. It is nowhere prescribed that it rains because of Indra. We have only come to know from your mouth today these unprecedented words.

## \|\| 21.104 \|\|

*śruṇu nītiṃ śrutimatāṃ he tāta nānayaṃ vadeḥ \|*  
*vacanaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ santo jānanti sarvata \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. О father, don't indulge in such improper things. You listen to the same council of the intellectuals, the people who are well aware of the words of the Samaveda.

## \|\| 21.105 \|\|

*praśnaṃ kuruṣva mantrāṃśca vividhānapi saṃsadi \|*  
*bruvantu paramārthaṃ ca kimindrādvṛṣṭireva ca \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. You kindly consult your courtiers in the assembly and other intellectuals, whether it is Indra alone who causes the rain.

## \|\| 21.106 \|\|

*sūryāddhi jāyate toyaṃ toyātsasyāni śākhinaḥ \|*  
*tebhyo'nnāni phalānyeva tebhyo jīvanti jīvinaḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. The water is collected by the rays of the sun and from the water, the cereals, the creepers and the trees grow. The cereals and the fruits grow from the same source which provides life to the people.

## \|\| 21.107-108 \|\|

*sūryagrastaṃ ca nīraṃ ca kāle tasmātsamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*sūryo meghādayaḥ sarve vidhātrā te nirūpitāḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

*yatrābde yo jaladharo gajaśca sāgaro mataḥ \|*  
*sasyādhipo nṛpo mantrī vidhātrā te nirūpitāḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

107-108. The water which is dried up by the sun with its rays, the same causes the rain during the rainy season. The sun and the clouds are the creations of the lord. Such of the clouds which are considered as the elephants the ocean, those who have been declared as the lords of the cereals and the minister; they are all created by the lord.

## \|\| 21.109 \|\|

*jalādikānāṃ sasyānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ ca nirūpitam \|*  
*abde'bde'styeva tatsarvaṃ kalpe kalpe yugeyuge \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. The quantity of greenery, the grass is decided every year besides the water. According to the same decision the process is repeated every year since time immemorial.

## \|\| 21.110-111 \|\|

*hastī samudrādādāya kareṇa jalamīpsitam \|*  
*dadyādghanāya taddadyādvātena prerito ghanaḥ \|\| 110\|\|*

*sthānesthāne pṛthivyāṃ ca kālekāle yathocitam \|*  
*īśecchayā''virbhūtaṃ ca na bhavetpratibandhakam \|\| 111 \|\|*

110-111. The sun extracting the water from the ocean hands it over to the clouds and the clouds with the help of the wind drops the rains appropriately on the earth at different times. The water is created with the will of the lord and no obstruction can be created in the process.

## \|\| 21.112 \|\|

*bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca mahatkṣudraṃ ca madhyamam \|*  
*dhātrā nirūpitaṃ karma kena tāta nivāryate \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. О father, the present, past and future, degraded, mediocre and the high ranking people are created by Brahma, who can negate it.

## \|\| 21.113-114 \|\|

*jagaccarācaraṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ teneśvarājñayā \|*  
*ādau vinirmitaṃ bhakṣyaṃ paścājjīva iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

*abhyāsātsa svabhāvo hi svabhāvātkarma eva ca \|*  
*jāyate karmaṇāṃ bhogo jīvināṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

113-114. He has created this movable and immovable universe at the command of the lord. First of all the arrangement for the food is made and then the jlva appears. With the repetition of the process, the arrangement is called nature. One performs everything by nature and by performing the deeds, people have to face pleasure and pain.

## \|\| 21.115-116 \|\|

*yātanājanmamaraṇarogaśokabhayāni ca \|*  
*samutpattirvipadvidyā kavitā vā yaśo'yaśaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

*puṇyaṃ ca svargavāsaśca pāpaṃ narakasaṃsthitiḥ \|*  
*bhuktirmuktirharerdāsyaṃ karmaṇā ghaṭate nṛṇām \|\| 116 \|\|*

115-116. The pain, birth and death, ailment, grief, fear, riches, danger, learnings, poetry, glory, denouncement, merit, living in heaven, sin, living in hell, devotion, deliberation, rage and the slavehood of the lord are achieved by the people according to their karmas.

## \|\| 21.117 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ janako hīśaścābhyāsaḥ śīlakarmaṇām \|*  
*dhātuśca phaladātā ca sarvaṃ tasyecchayā bhavet \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. The lord is the creator of all. The humble nature and the reward for the deeds performed are given by the lord. Whatever happens, happens due to the will of the lord.

## \|\| 21.118 \|\|

*vinirmito virāḍyena tattvāni prakṛtirjagat \|*  
*kūrmaśca śeṣadharaṇī cābrahmastamba eva ca \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. He created Virat, all the tattvas, Prakriti, globe, tortoise, Shesha, Prthivi and the creatures right from Brahma to the straw.

## \|\| 21.119 \|\|

*yasyājñayā marutkūrmaṃ dhakte śeṣaṃ bibharti saḥ \|*  
*śeṣo vasundharāṃ mūrdhnā sā ca sarvaṃ carācaram \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. At the command of the lord the wind supports the tortoise, the tortoise supports Shesha and Shesha carries the earth on his head and the earth carries all the moveable and immovable creatures.

## \|\| 21.120 \|\|

*yasyājñayā sadā vāti jagatprāṇo jagattraye \|*  
*tapati bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhūgolaṃ suprabhākaraḥ \|\| 120\|\|*

120\. At his command, the wind which is the life of the universe, blows in all the three worlds, the sun with sharp rays bums while moving around.

## \|\| 21.121 \|\|

*dahatyagniḥ saṃcarate mṛtyuśca sarvajantuṣu \|*  
*utpattiḥ śākhināṃ kāle puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. The fire bums, the death overpowers all the creatures; the trees are grown and blossom timely.

## \|\| 21.122 \|\|

*svesve sthāne samudrāśca tūrṇaṃ majjantyadho'dhunā \|*  
*tamīśaṃ bhaja bhaktyā ca śakraḥ kiṃ kartumīśvaraḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. By his command the ocean remains lodged at the proper place and goes down quickly, therefore, the same lord should be adored with devotion. What can Indra do?

## \|\| 21.123 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍaṃ ca katividhamāvirbhūtaṃ tirohitam \|*  
*vidhayaśca katividhā yasya bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. With whose frowning, several of the globes playfully come into being and disappear and several of the Brahma emerge and then disappeared.

## \|\| 21.124 \|\|

*mṛtyormṛtyuḥ kālakālo vidhāturvidhireva sa. \|*  
*bhaja taṃ śaraṇaṃ tāta sa te rakṣāṃ kariṣyati \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. He happens to be the death for the death and death for the god of death and happens to be Brahma for Brahma. О father, let us take refuge with him, he will surely protect you.

## \|\| 21.125-126 \|\|

*aho'ṣṭāviṃśadindrāṇāṃ patane yadaharniśam \|*  
*vidhātureva jagatāmaṣṭottaraśatādhikaḥ \|\| 125 \|\|*

*nimeṣādyasya patanaṃ nirguṇasyātmanaḥ prabhoḥ \|*  
*evaṃbhūte tiṣṭhatīśe śakrapūjā viḍambanam \|\| 126 \|\|*

125-126. Alas, with the fall of twenty eight Indras whose one day is counted and the fall of a hundred and eight Brahmas the creator of the universe, equate with the winking of his eyes and as such the adoration of Indra in preference to such a lord would just be a fallacy.

## \|\| 21.127 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇo virarāma ca nārada \|*  
*praśaśaṃsuśca munayo bhagavantaṃ sabhāsadaḥ \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. О Narada, thus speaking lord Krishna kept quiet, the sages and all other courtiers highly appreciated the words of lord Krishna and praised him.

## \|\| 21.128-129 \|\|

*nandaḥ sapulako hṛṣṭaḥ sabhāyāṃ sāśrulocanaḥ \|*  
*ānandayuktā manujā yadi putraiḥ parā jitāḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇājñāṃ samājñāya cakāra svastivācanam \|*  
*krameṇa varaṇaṃ tatra sarveṣāṃ ca cakāra ha \|\| 129 \|\|*

128-129. Narada also felt delighted and the hair on his body stood on end, while the tears started flowing from his eyes. When the father gets defeated at the hands of his own son, one achieves a peculiar delight. Nanda accepting the command of lord Krishna recited svastivacana invoking all the gods.

## \|\| 21.130 \|\|

*parvatasyamunīṃdrāṇāṃ cakāra pūjanaṃ tadā \|*  
*budhānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gavāṃ vahneśca sādaram \|\| 130\|\|*

130\. He then adored the mountains and the sages and distributed to the learned Brahmanas the cows and also consecrated fire.

## \|\| 21.131 \|\|

*tatra pūjāsamāptau ca kratau ca sumahotsave \|*  
*nānāprakāravādyānāṃ babhūva śabda ulbaṇaḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. In the festivities of the yajna when the puja came to an end, thundering sounds were heard from all sides.

## \|\| 21.132 \|\|

*jayaśabdaḥ śaṅkhaśabdo hariśabdo babhūva ha \|*  
*vedamaṅgalakāṇḍaṃ ca \|papāṭha munipuṅgavaḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. The sounds of victory echoed in the sky besides the blowing of conches and reciting of the name of Hari. Garga the best of the sages recited the Vedas.

## \|\| 21.133 \|\|

*bandināṃ pravaro ḍiṇḍī kaṃsasya sacivaḥ priyaḥ \|*  
*uccaiḥ papāṭha purato maṅgalaṃ maṅgalāṣṭakam \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. Dindl who was the best of the bards and was very close to Kamsa started reciting the verses of welfare in loud voice.

## \|\| 21.134 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaḥ śailāntikaṃ gatcā bhinnāṃ mūrtiṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*vastu khādāmi śailo'smi varaṃ vṛṇvityuvāca ha \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. Shri Krishna went to the Govardhana mountain and taking to another form, he said, "I am the mount Govardhana and am consuming the stuff offered to me. You ask from me.".

## \|\| 21.135 \|\|

*uvāca nandaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paśya śaulaṃ pitaḥ puraḥ \|*  
*varaṃ prārthaya bhadraṃ te bhavitā cetyuvāca ha \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. At that point of time, Shri Krishna said to Nanda, "O father, you look at the mountain in the front and ask for a boon from him which could bestow welfare on you.

## \|\| 21.136 \|\|

*harerdāsyaṃ harerbhaktiṃ varaṃ vavre sa ballavaḥ \|*  
*dravyaṃ bhuktvā varaṃ dattvā so'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 136 \|\|*

136\. Then Nanda, the chief of the Ballava, prayed to him, "You bestow on me the slavehood of the lord and his devotion." Consuming the eatables and pronouncing a boon that form disappears.

## \|\| 21.137 \|\|

*munīndrānbrāhmaṇāṃścaiva bhojayitvā ca gopapāḥ \|*  
*bandibhyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca munibhyaśca dhanaṃ dadau \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. Nanda, the protector of the cows, served the Brahmanas and the bards with food. He also offered riches to the sages and the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 21.138 \|\|

*munibhyo brāhmaṇebhyo'pi dattvā nando mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*rāmakṛṣṇau puraskṛtya sagaṇaḥ svālayaṃ yayau \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. After distributing the riches among the Brahmanas and the sages, Nanda felt delighted and placing Balarama and Krishna ahead of the cowherds, they moved on to their abodes.

## \|\| 21.139 \|\|

*raupyaṃ vastraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca varamaśvaṃ maṇiṃ tathā \|*  
*bhakṣyaṃ dravyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ baṃdine ḍiṃḍine dadau \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. They also provided the bards with gold, silver, garments, beautiful horses and several other eatables.

## \|\| 21.140-141 \|\|

*stutvā natvā rāmakṛṣṇau munayo brāhmaṇā yayuḥ \|*  
*yayurapsarasaḥ sarvā gandharvāḥ kiṃnarāstathā \|\| 140\|\|*

*rājāno ballavāḥ sarve cāhūtā ye mahotsave \|*  
*sarve praṇamya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ yayuḥ sādarapūrvakam \|\| 141 \|\|*

140-141. All the sages and the Brahmanas retired to their respective abodes after bowing in reverence to Balarama and Krishna. All the apsaras, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Ballavas who had arrived to participate in the function, returned to their respective abodes bowing before lord Krishna.

## \|\| 21.142-143 \|\|

*etasminnantare śakraḥ kopaprasphuritādharaḥ \|*  
*makhabhaṃge bahuvidhāṃ niṃdāṃ śrutvā sureśvaraḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

*marudbhirvāridaiḥ sārdhaṃ rathamāruhya satvaram \|*  
*jagāma naṃdanagaraṃ vṛndāraṇyaṃ manoharam \|\| 143 \|\|*

142-143. In the meantime Indra finding the yajna having been disturbed and hearing about his denouncement, was immensely enraged. His lips started fluttering. He, accompanied by the winds and the clouds mounted on the chariot arrived in the city of Nanda located in Vrindavana.

## \|\| 21.144 \|\|

*sarve devā yayuḥ paścādyuddhaśāstraviśāradāḥ \|*  
*śastrāstrapāṇayaḥ kopādrathamāruhya nārada \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. O Narada, thereafter the gods who were well-versed in the warfare also held the weapons in their hands getting enraged and mounting on the chariot, they also went away.

## \|\| 21.145 \|\|

*vāyuśabdairmeghaśabdaiḥ sainyaśabdairbhayānakaiḥ \|*  
*cakampe nagaraṃ sarvaṃ nando bhayamavāpa ha \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. The thundering of the clouds, the blowing of the winds and the sound was created by the terrific movement of the soldiers. The entire populace of the city was frightened together with Nanda.

## \|\| 21.146 \|\|

*bhāryāṃ saṃbodhya svagaṇamuvāca śokakātaraḥ \|*  
*rahaḥ sthalaṃ samānīya nītiśāstraviśāradaḥ \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. Nanda who was well-versed in polity, summoned his wife and attendants in seclusion and spoke to them getting dejected.

## \|\| 21.147 \|\|

*nanda uvāca \|*  
*he yaśode samāgaccha vacanaṃ śṛṇu rohiṇi \|*  
*rāmakṛṣṇau samādāya vraja dūraṃ vrajātpriye \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. Nanda said – "O Yashoda, О Rohini, come here and listen to my words. О dear one, you move from here to a distant place from Vraja.

## \|\| 21.148 \|\|

*bālakā bālikā nāryo yāntu dūraṃ bhayākulāḥ \|*  
*balavantaśca gopālāstiṣṭhaṃtu matsamīpataḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Let the boys and girls besides the ladies also move at some distant place and only the strong people should remain here.

## \|\| 21.149 \|\|

*paścācca nirgamiṣyāmo vayaṃ ca prāṇasaṃkaṭāt \|*  
*ityuktvā ballavaśreṣṭhaḥ sasmāra śrīhariṃ bhiyā \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. We shall leave this place only when we are faced with death." Thus speaking Nanda the best of the Ballavas started reciting the name of Hari in panic.

## \|\| 21.150 \|\|

*puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|*  
*kāṇvaśākhoktastotreṇa tuṣṭāva ha śacīpatim \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. With folded hands bowing his head he started praising Indra with stotra prescribed in the Kanva-sakha.

## \|\| 21.151-157 \|\|

*nanda uvāca \|*  
*indraḥ surapatiḥ śakro ditijaḥ pavanāgrajaḥ \|\| 151\|\|*

*sahasrākṣo bhagāṅgaśca kaśyapāṅgaja eva ca \|*  
*biḍaujāśca sunāsīro marutvānpākaśāsanaḥ \|\| 152 \|\|*

*jayantajanakaḥ śrīmāñchacīśo daityasūdanaḥ \|*  
*vajrahastaḥ kāmasakho gautamīvratanāśanaḥ \|\| 153 \|\|*

*vṛtrahā vāsavaścaiva dadhīcidehabhikṣukaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇuśca vāmanabhrātā puruhūtaḥ purandaraḥ \|\| 154 \|\|*

*divaspatiḥ śatamakhaḥ sutrāmā gotrabhidvibhuḥ \|*  
*lekharṣabho balārātirjambhabhedī surāśrayaḥ \|\| 155 \|\|*

*saṃkrandano duścyavanasturāṣāṇmeghavāhanaḥ \|*  
*ākhaṇḍalo harihayo namuciprāṇanāśanaḥ \|\| 156 \|\|*

*vṛddhaśravā vṛṣaścaiva daityadarpaniṣūdanaḥ \|*  
*ṣaṭcatvāriṃśannāmāni pāpaghnāni viniścitam \|\| 157 \|\|*

151-157. Nanda said – О Indra, Surapati, Sakra, Ditija, Pavanagraja, Sahasraksa, Bhaganga, Kashyapangaja, Vidouja, Sunaslra, Marutvan, Pakasasana, Jayanta-janaka, Shriman, Shachisha, Daityastidana, Vajrahasta, Kamasakha, destroyer of the vrata of GautamI, killer of Vrtraha, Vasava, desirous of the body of Dadhici, Jisnu, brother of Vamana, Puruhuta, Purandara, Divaspati, Satamakha, Sutrama, Gotrabhid, Vibhu, Lekharsabha, Balarati, JambhabhedI, Surasraya, Sarhkrandana, Duscyavana, Turasat, Meghavahana, Akhandala, Harihaya, killer of Namuci, Vaddhasrava, Vrsa and the destroyer of the pride of the demons. These forty-six names of Indra surely remove the sins.

## \|\| 21.158 \|\|

*stotrametatkauthumoktaṃ nityaṃ yadi paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*mahāvipattau śakrastaṃ vajrahastaśca rakṣati \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. Whosoever recites this stotra contained in the Kauthumi-sakha, Indra protects him holding a vajra during all the dangers.

## \|\| 21.159 \|\|

*ativṛṣṭiśilāvṛṣṭivajrapātācca dāruṇāt \|*  
*kadācinna bhayaṃ tasya rakṣitā vāsavaḥ svayam \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. Since Indra himself becomes the protector, one is not afraid of the excess of rains, hail-storm and the falling of vajra.

## \|\| 21.160 \|\|

*yatra gehe stotramidaṃ yaśca jānāti puṇyavān \|*  
*na tatra vajrapatanaṃ śilāvṛṣṭiśca nārada \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. О Narada, the house in which this auspicious stotra of Indra is recited the same is protected from the falling of vajra as well as the hail-storm.

## \|\| 21.161-162 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*stotraṃ naṃdamukhācchrutvā cukopa madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*uvāca pitaraṃ nītiṃ prajvalanbrahmatejasā \|\| 161 \|\|*

*kaṃ stauṣi bhīro ko vendrastyaja bhītiṃ mamāntike \|*  
*kṣaṇārddhe bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣamo'hamavalīlayā \|\| 162 \|\|*

161-162. On hearing the stotra from the mouth of Nanda, Madhusudana felt enraged. Illumining with the divine lustre, he spoke to his father the most appropriate words, "O coward, to whom are you offering this prayer. Who is Indra? You shed away all the fears in my presence. I can reduce him to dust in a moment.

## \|\| 21.163 \|\|

*gāśca vatsāṃśca bālāṃśca yoṣito hi bhayāturāḥ \|*  
*govardhanasya kuhare saṃsthāpya tiṣṭha nirbhayam \|\| 163 \|\|*

163\. Placing the cows, the calves, the boys and the women in the caves of Govardhana, you become free from fear.

## \|\| 21.164 \|\|

*bālasya vacanaṃ śrutvā taccakāra mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*harirdadhāra śailaṃ taṃ vāmahastena daṇḍavat \|\| 164 \|\|*

164\. On hearing the words of the boy, Nanda did so with pleasure and lord Krishna then lifted up that mountain like a rod upwards.

## \|\| 21.165-166 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra dīpto'pi ratnatejasā \|*  
*andhībhūtaśca sahasā babhūva rajasā''vṛtaḥ \|\| 165 \|\|*

*savāto meghanikaraścacchāda gaganaṃ mune \|*  
*vṛndāvane babhūvātivṛṣṭireva nirantaram \|\| 166 \|\|*

165-166. О sage, in the meantime the entire place in spite of having been illuminated with the gems, was covered with darkness due to the dust. The clouds accompanied by the wind covered the entire sky and torrential rains started falling in Vrindavana.

## \|\| 21.167 \|\|

*śilāvṛṣṭirvajravṛṣṭirulkāpātaḥ sudāruṇaḥ \|*  
*samastaṃ parvatasparśātpatitaṃ dūratastataḥ \|\| 167 \|\|*

167\. There were hail-storms, rain of vajras and the falling of comets were also seen but strangely enough all these, while touching Govardhana were thrown apart at a distance.

## \|\| 21.168 \|\|

*viphalastatsamārambho yathā'nīśodyamo mune \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā moghaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ sadyaḥ śakraścukopa ha \|\| 168 \|\|*

168\. О sage, thus the entire exercise of Indra became infructuous like the effort of an ordinary person. Finding his efforts becoming unsuccessful, Indra was enraged.

## \|\| 21.169 \|\|

*jagrāhāmoghakuliśaṃ dadhīcyasthivinirmitam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā taṃ vajrahastaṃ ca jahāsa madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 169 \|\|*

169\. He picked up the infallible vajra made of the bones of Dadhlci in his hands. Finding vajra in the hands of Indra Madhusudana started laughing.

## \|\| 21.170-171 \|\|

*sahastaṃ stambhayāmāsa vajramevātidāruṇam \|*  
*sahāmaragaṇaṃ moghaṃ cakārastaṃbhanaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 170 \|\|*

*sarve tasthurniścalāste bhittau puttalikā yathā \|*  
*hariṇā jṛmbhitaḥ śakraḥ sadyastaṃdrāmavāpa ha \|\| 171 \|\|*

170-171. He made the hands of Indra together with the vajra motionless. He made the hand of Indra holding the vajra motionless. Not only this, the lord also made the clouds to be static together with the gods which made them look like puppets studded in a wall. They at once became motionless. With the rendering of the gods immensely motionless Indra was over-powered by swoon.

## \|\| 21.172-174 \|\|

*dadarśa sarvaṃ tandrāyāṃ tatra kṛṣṇamayaṃ jagat \|*  
*dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam \|\| 172 \|\|*

*pītavastraparīdhānaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā'dbhutatamaṃ tatra sadyo mūrcchāmavāpa ha \|\| 173 \|\|*

*candanokṣitasarvāṅgayetatsarva carācaram \|*  
*dṛṣaṭvā'ddhatatamaṃ tatra sadyo mūrkāmavāpa ha\|\| 174 \|\|*

172-174. In his swoon, Indra witnessed the entire universe in the form of Krishna alone. He held flutes in all the hands and was adorned with all the ornaments, clad in pltambara, seated on a gem-studded lion-throne, wearing a serene smile on his face, anxious to bestow grace on his devotees and all whose limbs of the body were plastered with sandal-paste. With the sight of this astonishing scene, Indra got fainted.

## \|\| 21.175 \|\|

*jajāpa mantraṃ tatraiva pradattaṃ guruṇā purā \|*  
*sahasradalapadmasthaṃ dadarśa jyotirulbaṇam \|\| 175 \|\|*

175\. He then started reciting the mantra given to him by his teacher. At that point of time, he found a block of lustre on the thousand pettailed lotus.

## \|\| 21.176-178 \|\|

*tatrāntare divyarūpamatīva sumanoharam \|*  
*navīnajaladotkarṣaṃ śyāmasundaravigraham \|\| 176 \|\|*

*sadratnasāranirmāṇajvalanmakarakuṇḍalam \|*  
*jvalanmaṇīndramakarakirīṭojjvala śekharam \|\| 177 \|\|*

*jvalatā kaustubheṃdreṇa kaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalojjvalam \|*  
*maṇikeyūravalayamaṇimañjīraraṅñitam antarbahiḥ \|*  
*samaṃ dṛṣṭā tuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|\| 178 \|\|*

176-178. In the meantime he found the great lord having the charming and divine body, the complexion of the new clouds, having the beautiful form, wearing the gem-studded kundalas, a mukuta adorning his head, with the kaustubha gem decorating his chest and the neck, wearing the armlets, anklets and wristlets who projected the same form inside as well as outside. He then started adorning the lord.

## \|\| 21.179-180 \|\|

*indra uvāca \|*  
*akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*guṇātītaṃ nirākāraṃ svecchāmayamanaṃtakam \|\| 179 \|\|*

*bhaktadhyānāya sevāyai nānārūpadharaṃ varam \|*  
*śuklaraktapītaśyāmaṃ yugānukramaṇena ca \|\| 180\|\|*

179-180. Indra said – You are indestructible, the eternal Brahman, form of lustre, eternal, devoid of qualities, formless, having your own will, beyond measure, taking to many forms for the sake of your devotees and appear in different complexions like white, red and yellow and dark according to the exigencies of the lord.

## \|\| 21.181-182 \|\|

*śuklatejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca satye satyasvarūpiṇam \|*  
*tretāyāṃ kuṃkumākāraṃ jvalaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 181 \|\|*

*dvāpare pītavarṇaṃ ca śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā \|*  
*kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kalau kṛṣṇaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ prabhum \|\| 182 \|\|*

181-182. In Satyayuga, your lustre appears in white complexion and stands for truth; in the Tretayuga, the divine lustre illumines in the saffron complexion; in Dvapara you have a yellow complexion and are adorned with pltambara while in Kaliyuga you have the dark complexion having the name of Krishna. In all these forms you happen to be the only great soul.

## \|\| 21.183 \|\|

*navadhārādharotkṛṣṭaśyāmamundravigraham \|*  
*nandaikanandanaṃ vande yaśodānandanaṃ prabhum \|\| 183 \|\|*

183\. Your form has the complexion of new clouds which is dark and beautiful. I bow in reverence to the lord who happens to be the son of Nanda of Yashoda.

## \|\| 21.184-188 \|\|

*gopikācetanaharaṃ rādhāprāṇādhikaṃ param \|*  
*vinodamuralīśabdaṃ kurvantaṃ kautukena ca \|\| 184 \|\|*

*rūpeṇāpratimenaiva ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|*  
*kandarpakoṭisaundaryaṃ bibhrataṃ śāntamīśvaram \|\| 185\|\|*

*krīḍantaṃ rādhayā sārdhaṃ vṛndāraṇye ca kutracit \|*  
*kutracinnirjane'raṇye rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam \|\| 186 \|\|*

*jalakrīḍāṃ prakurvantaṃ rādhayā saha kutracit \|*  
*rādhikākabarībhāraṃ kurvantaṃ kutracidvane \|\| 187 \|\|*

*kutracidrādhikāpāde dattavantamalaktakam \|*  
*sadā carvitatāmbūlaṃ gṛhṇantaṃ kutracinmudā \|\| 188 \|\|*

184-188. You are the one who steals away the hearts of the cowherdesses and are dearer to Radha than her life. Playfully you hold the flute in your hands, the sound of which echoes everywhere. Your beauty is beyond description, you are clad in the gem-studded ornaments, you are more beautiful then the crores of gods of love, are peaceful, the great lord and indulge in divine plays in Vrindavana. You rest you your head on the breasts of Radha in a secluded place in Vrindavana, while sometimes you indulge in water-sports with her. Sometimes you comb the hair of Radha and sometimes you apply paint on the feet of Radha, while sometimes you chew the betel already used by Radha, delightfully.

## \|\| 21.189 \|\|

*paśyantaṃ kutracidrādhāṃ paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā \|*  
*dattavantaṃ ca rādhāyai kṛtvā mālāṃ ca kutracit \|\| 189 \|\|*

189\. Sometimes you look at Radha who stares at you with side-glances and sometimes you hand over the garlands of flowers made by you, yourself.

## \|\| 21.190 \|\|

*kutracidrādhayā sārdhaṃ gacchantaṃ rāsamaṃḍalam \|*  
*rādhādattāṃ gale mālāṃ dhṛtavantaṃ ca kutracit \|\| 190\|\|*

190\. Sometimes you visit Rasamaydala with Radha and sometimes you adorn your neck with the flower garland provided to you by Radha.

## \|\| 21.191 \|\|

*sārdhaṃ gopālikābhiśca viharantaṃ ca kutracit \|*  
*rādhāṃ gṛhītvā gacchantaṃ vihāya tāṃ ca kutracit \|\| 191 \|\|*

191\. Sometimes, you roam about in Vrindavana with the cowherdesses and sometimes you move about with Radha while at times you move alone.

## \|\| 21.192 \|\|

*viprapatnīdattamannaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca kutracit \|*  
*bhuktavantaṃ tālaphalaṃ bālakaiḥ saha kutracit \|\| 192 \|\|*

192\. At places you consume the food provided by the wives of the Brahmanas and sometimes you consume the tala fruits supplied to you by the boys.

## \|\| 21.193 \|\|

*vastraṃ gopālikānāṃ ca harantaṃ kutracinmudā \|*  
*gavāṃ gaṇaṃ vyāharantaṃ kutracidbālakaiḥ saha \|\| 193 \|\|*

193\. Sometimes you steal away the costumes of the cowherdesses and sometimes you call for the cows and cowherds.

## \|\| 21.194-195 \|\|

*kālīyamūrdhni pādābjaṃ dattavantaṃ ca kutracit \|*  
*vinodamuralīśabdaṃ kurvantaṃ kutracinmudā \|\| 194 \|\|*

*gāyantaṃ ramyasaṅgītaṃ kutracidbālakaiḥ saha \|*  
*stutvā śakraḥ stavendreṇa praṇanāma hariṃ bhiyā \|\| 195 \|\|*

194-195. At times you place your feet on the hood of serpent Kaliya and sometimes you play on the flute with pleasure. Sometimes you sing beautiful song in the company of the cowherd boys. Thus offering prayer to Krishna, Indra bowed in reverence to him.

## \|\| 21.196-198 \|\|

*purā dattena guruṇā raṇe vṛtrāsureṇa ca \|*  
*kṛṣṇena dattaṃ kṛpayā brahmaṇe ca tapasyate \|\| 196 \|\|*

*ekādaśākṣaro mantraḥ kavacaṃ sarvalakṣaṇam \|*  
*dattametatkumārāya puṣkare brahmaṇā purā \|\| 197 \|\|*

*kumāro'ṅgirase dattaṃ gurave'ṅgirasā mune \|\| 198 \|\|*

196-198. In earlier times Brihaspati had given this stotra to Indra at the time of war with Vrtrasura. First of all lord Krishna compassionately gave it to Brahma who had performed this eleven-letter mantra together with the kavacha and the stotra. Thereafter, Brahma gave it to Kumara in Puskara region and Kumara in turn gave it to Angira, while Angira gave it to Brihaspati.

## \|\| 21.199-200 \|\|

*idamindrakṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet sa hi prāpya dṛḍhāṃ bhaktimante dāsyaṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 199 \|\|*

*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokebhyo mucyate naraḥ \|*  
*na hi paśyati svapne'pi yamadūtaṃ yamālayam \|\| 200 \|\|*

199-200. Therefore whosoever regularly recites this stotra composed by Indra, achieves the deep devotion and slavehood of-the lord undoubtedly. Such a person is freed from the birth, death, old age, disease and grief. He does not have to witness the messengers of Yama or the hell even in dream.

## \|\| 21.201 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*indrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prasannaḥ śrīniketanaḥ \|*  
*prītyā tasmai varaṃ dattvā sthāpayāmāsa parvatam \|\| 201 \|\|*

201\. Narayana said – On listening to the words of Indra, the lord of Lakshmi felt delighted and blessing Indra he re-established the mountain.

## \|\| 21.202 \|\|

*praṇamya ca hariṃ śakraḥ prayayau svagaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*gahvarasthā janāḥ sarve prajagmurgahvarādgṛham \|\| 202 \|\|*

202\. Indra then bowing before Krishna returned to his abode with his attendants. Thereafter all the people came out of the caves of the mountain and went back to their homes.

## \|\| 21.203-204 \|\|

*te sarve menire kṛṣṇaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ vibhum \|*  
*puraskṛtya vrajasthāṃśca prayayau svālayaṃ hariḥ \|\| 203 \|\|*

*tuṣṭāva naṃdaḥ putraṃ taṃ pūrṇabrahma sanātanam \|*  
*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo bhaktipūrṇāśrulocanaḥ \|\| 204 \|\|*

203-204. All of them took Krishna to be the complete Brahman, the lord also returned to his abode together with all the people of Vraja. Nanda felt overwhelmed with delight and his mind was filled with devotion. The tears started emerging out of his eyes. With his heart filled with delight, he adored his son who was eternal Brahman.

## \|\| 21.205 \|\|

*nanda uvāca \|*  
*namo brahmaṇyadevāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca \|*  
*jagaddhitāya kṛṣṇāya govindāya namonamaḥ \|\| 205 \|\|*

205\. Nanda said – О bestower of welfare, the well-wisher of the cows and Brahmanas and the one who wished well of the entire universe, I bow in reverence to such a Krishna also known as Govinda.

## \|\| 21.206 \|\|

*namo brahmaṇyadevāya brahmaṇe paramātmane \|*  
*anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍadhāmadhāmne namo'stu te \|\| 206 \|\|*

206\. You are the one who always delights the Brahmanas, the form of Brahman, the eternal great soul, the abode of crores of Brahmanas. I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 21.207 \|\|

*namo matsyādirūpāṇāṃ jīvarūpāyasākṣiṇe \|*  
*nirliptāya nirguṇāya nirākārāya te namaḥ \|\| 207 \|\|*

207\. О son, you are the life of the Adityas, are without any qualities, formless, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 21.208 \|\|

*atisūkṣmasvarūpāya sthūlātsthūlatamāya ca \|*  
*sarveśvarāya sarvāya tejorūpa namo'stu te \|\| 208 \|\|*

208\. You are smaller than the smallest and harder than the hardest, the lord of all, the form of all, lustre of all, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 21.209-215 \|\|

*atipratyakṣarūpāya dhyānāsādhyāya yoginām \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ vandyāya nityarūpiṇe \|\| 209 \|\|*

*dhāmne caturṇṇāṃ varṇānāṃ yugeṣveva caturṣu ca \|*  
*śuklaraktapītaśyāmābhidhānaguṇaśāline \|\| 210 \|\|*

*yogine yogarūpāya gurave yogināmapi \|*  
*siddheśvarāya siddhāya siddhānāṃ gurave namaḥ \|\| 211 \|\|*

*yaṃ stotumakṣamo brahmā viṣṇuryaṃ stotumakṣamaḥ \|*  
*yaṃ stotumakṣamo rudraḥ śeṣo yaṃ stotumakṣamaḥ \|\| 212 \|\|*

*yaṃ stotumakṣamo dharmo yaṃ stotumakṣamo raviḥ \|*  
*yaṃ stotumakṣamo lambodaraścāpi ṣaḍānanaḥ \|\| 213 \|\|*

*yaṃ stotumakṣamāḥ sarve munayaḥ sanakādayaḥ \|*  
*kapilo na kṣamaḥ stotuṃ siddhendrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 214 \|\|*

*na śaktau stavanaṃ kartuṃ naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|*  
*anye jaḍadhiyaḥ ke vā stotuṃ śaktāḥ parātparam \|\| 215 \|\|*

209-215. You are invisible, the one who is difficult to be achieved by the yogis even after great tapas\\ you are adorned by Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, are eternal, adored by people of all the varnas in all the four yugas, spotless, red, yellow and dark-complexioned, possess qualities; you are the form of yogis, the form of the form of the yoga, the teacher of the yogis, lord of the siddhas, form of the siddhas, besides being the teacher of the siddhas, I bow in reverence to you. You are the one who is beyond the prayers of Brahma and Vishnu and even Shiva, Shesha, Dharma, Surya, Ganesha, Karttikeya and Sanaka; besides other sages are unable to offer prayer to him. You are the one and even Nara-narayana cannot offer their prayers to you. The one who is beyond everyone, then how can a person having no wisdom offer prayer to you.

## \|\| 21.216 \|\|

*vedā na śaktā no vāṇī na ca lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī \|*  
*na rādhā stavane śaktā kiṃ stuvanti vipaścitaḥ \|\| 216 \|\|*

216\. The one who even the Vedas, speech, Lakshmi, Sarasvati and Radha are unable to offer prayers, then who else can venture to offer prayers to you.

## \|\| 21.217-219 \|\|

*kṣamasva nikhilaṃ brahmannaparādhaṃ kṣaṇekṣaṇe \|*  
*rakṣa māṃ karuṇā sindho dīnabandho bhavārṇave \|\| 217 \|\|*

*purā tīrthe tapastaptvā putraḥ prāptaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*svakīyacaraṇāmbhoje bhaktiṃ dāsyaṃ ca dehi me \|\| 218 \|\|*

*brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā sālokyādikameva vā \|*  
*tvatpadāmbhojadāsyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 219 \|\|*

217-219. O Brahman, I am feeling sinful at every moment; therefore you kindly forgive me. О ocean of mercy, well-wisher of the down-trodden, you kindly protect me in the ocean of the universe. In the earlier time, I had performed great tapas and after visiting holy places, I achieved you as a son. You kindly bestow the devotion of your lotus-like feet and your slavehood.

## \|\| 21.220 \|\|

*indratvaṃ vā suratvaṃ vā saṃprāptiṃ siddhisvargayoḥ \|*  
*rājatvaṃ cirajīvitvaṃ sudhiyo gaṇayanti kim \|\| 220 \|\|*

220\. The Brahmanhood, etemalship and the salvations like Salokya do not weigh even one-sixteenth part of the pleasure of achieving your slavehood. Then the place of Indra, the god-hood, the siddhis, heaven, the kingship and long life shall be of no consequence.

## \|\| 21.221 \|\|

*etadyatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ brahmatvādikamīśvara \|*  
*bhaktasaṅgakṣaṇārddhasya nopamā te kimarhati \|\| 221 \|\|*

221\. Whatever has been spoken by me about Brahman does not compare to the pleasure one achieves by keeping the company of your devotees even for a moment.

## \|\| 21.222 \|\|

*tvadbhakto yastvatsadṛśaḥ kastvāṃ tarkitumīśvaraḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇārddhālāpamātreṇa pāraṃ kartuṃ sa ceśvaraḥ \|\| 222 \|\|*

222\. Because your devotees are always like you. Then who can measure your glory? By talking to your devotees even for half of a moment, it makes one to cross over the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 21.223 \|\|

*bhaktasaṅgādbhavatyeva bhaktiṃ kartumanekadhā \|*  
*tvadbhaktajaladālāpajalasekena varddhate \|\| 223 \|\|*

223\. Keeping the company of your devotees, the devotion always sprouts, in the form of the clouds like your devotees and the conversation with them seems like the pouring of rain and with the supply of that water, the devotion in one's mind sprouts.

## \|\| 21.224 \|\|

*abhaktālāpatāpāttu śuṣkatāṃ yāti tatkṣaṇam \|*  
*tvadguṇasmṛtisekācca varddhate tatkṣaṇe sphuṭam \|\| 224 \|\|*

224\. Such of the people who are not devoted to the lord, sprouting dries away while talking to them and with the watering of the same reciting the glory of the lord and his devotees, they go on increasing.

## \|\| 21.225 \|\|

*tvadbhaktyaṅkuramudbhūtaṃ sphītaṃ mānasajaṃ param \|*  
*na naśyaṃ varddhanīyaṃ ca nityaṃnityaṃ kṣaṇekṣaṇe \|\| 225 \|\|*

225\. When the devotion in one's mind appears and grows up, then it never vanishes, it always continues to increase every moment and every day.

## \|\| 21.226 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃprāpya brahmatvaṃ bhaktasya jīvanāya ca \|*  
*dadātyeva phalaṃ tasmai haridāsyamanuttamam \|\| 226 \|\|*

226\. Thereafter such a devotee achieves the highest stage of Brahman and for his welfare, the eternal slavehood is bestowed on him.

## \|\| 21.227 \|\|

*saṃprāpya durlabhaṃ dāsyaṃ yadi dāso babhūva ha \|*  
*suniścayena tenaiva jitaṃ sarvaṃ bhayādikam \|\| 227 \|\|*

227\. When some one becomes the slave of the lord, achieving the inaccessible slavehood, he is freed from all the fetters.

## \|\| 21.228 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā bhaktyā ca nandastasthau hareḥ puraḥ \|*  
*prasannavadanaḥ kṛṣṇo dadau tasmai tadīpsitam \|\| 228 \|\|*

228\. With his mind filled with devotion Nanda spoke all this and thereafter he stood before the lord. Thereafter lord Krishna wearing a smile on his face bestows the desired boon to him.

## \|\| 21.229 \|\|

*evaṃ nandakṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*sudṛḍhāṃ bhaktimāpnoti sadyo dāsyaṃ labheddhareḥ \|\| 229 \|\|*

229\. Thus whosoever recites with devotion the stotra recited by Nanda, with deep devotion achieves the slavehood of the lord.

## \|\| 21.230-234 \|\|

*tapastaptvā yadā droṇastīrthe ca dharayā saha \|*  
*stotraṃ tasmai purā dattaṃ brahmaṇā tatsudurlabham \|\| 230 \|\|*

*hareḥ ṣaḍakṣaro mantraḥ kavacaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam \|*  
*iha saubhariṇā dattaṃ tasmai tuṣṭena puṣkare \|\| 231 \|\|*

*tadeva kavacaṃ stotraṃ sa ca mantraḥ sudurlabhaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇoṃ'śena muninā nandāya ca tapasyate \|\| 232 \|\|*

*mantraḥ stotraṃ ca kavacamiṣṭadevo gurustathā \|*  
*yā yasya vidyā prācīnā na tāṃ tyajati niścitam \|\| 233 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ stotraṃ śrīkṛṣṇākhyānamadbhutam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ bhavabandhavimocanam \|\| 234 \|\|*

230-234. In the earlier times Drona was performing tapas with Dhara in Puskara region and this inaccessible stotra was bestowed by Brahma to them. In this world, the sage Saubhari with an extremely delightful mind gave to Brahma the six letter mantra of Hari together with the base of kavacha. The same kavacha, the same stotra and the same inaccessible mantra was given by Garga to Nanda who was engaged in tapas. In earlier times the one who achieved whichever mantra, stotra, kavacha, the family god, teacher and the learnings, the same person never parted. Thus the story of Krishna as well as his stotra has been spelt out which bestow pleasure, salvation, essence of all and relieves one of the worldly bondages.

## Chapter 22

## \|\| 22.1-2 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā rādhikānātho balena saha bālakaiḥ \|*  
*jagāma tattālavanaṃ paripakvaphalānvitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vṛkṣāṇāṃ rakṣitā daityaḥ khara rūpī ca dhenukaḥ \|*  
*koṭisiṃhasamabalo devānāṃ darpanāśanaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Once Krishna, the lord of Radhika accompanied by Balabhadra and other boys went to the tala forest which was filled with ripe fruits. Dhenukasura in the form of a donkey used to guard the forest trees. It possessed the strength of crores of lions and could reduce the pride of the gods to ashes.

## \|\| 22.3-4 \|\|

*śarīraṃ parvatasamaṃ kūpatulye ca locane \|*  
*īṣāpaṃktisamā dantāstuṇḍaṃ parvatagahvaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śatahastaparimitā jihvā lolā bhayānakā \|*  
*kāsārasadṛśī nābhiḥ śabdastasya bhayānakaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. It had a mountain like body and both the eyes resembled well. His teeth resembled the plough-shaft and the mouth looked like a mountain cave, his wavering and terrific tongue was a hundred feet in length and his navel looked like a pond. He uttered a terrific sound. dTdcH сП

## \|\| 22.5 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tālavanaṃ bālā harṣamāpuraninditāḥ \|*  
*kautukātkṛṣṇamūcuste smerānanasaroruhāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The boys were delighted at the sight of the tala forest and a smile appeared on their faces, playfully they spoke to Krishna.

## \|\| 22.6-7 \|\|

*bālā ūcuḥ \|*  
*he kṛṣṇa karuṇāsindho dīna bandho jagatpate \|*  
*mahābala balabhrātaḥ samastabalināṃ vara \|\| 6 \|\|*

*avadhānaṃ kuru vibho kṣaṇārddhaṃ no nivedane \|*  
*kṣudhitānāṃ śiśūnāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsala \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The boys said – О Krishna, the ocean of mercy and brother of the down-trodden, the lord of the universe, possessor of great strength, brother of Balabhadra and the best of the boys. О virtuous one, you kindly pay attention to our request for a moment. You love your devotees, all the children are suffering from hunger.

## \|\| 22.8-9 \|\|

*svādūni sundarāṇyeva paśya tālaphalāni ca \|*  
*bhaṅktuṃ cālayituṃ vṛkṣānpātituṃ ca phalāni ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nānāvarṇāni puṣpāṇi pakvāni durlabhāni ca \|*  
*ājñāṃ karoṣi cetkṛṣṇa ceṣṭāṃ karttu vayaṃ kṣamāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. You look at the delicious tala fruits in the forest. We intend to pluck the fruit and make the flowers of various colours to fall on to the earth by shaking the trees together with the ripe fruits. О Krishna, if you permit us we can make an attempt.

## \|\| 22.10-11 \|\|

*kiṃ tvatra daityo balavānkhararūpī ca dhenukaḥ \|*  
*ajitastridaśaiḥ sarvairmahābalaparākramaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*durnivāryaśca sarveṣāṃ kaṃsasya sacivo mahān \|*  
*hiṃsakaḥ sarvajantūnāṃ vanānāmasti rakṣitā \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. But the valorous demon Dhenuka in the form of a donkey is guarding the forest. He is invincible from the gods, is immensely valorous and beyond control. He happens to be the chief minister of (Kaihsa and kills all the creatures.

## \|\| 22.12-13 \|\|

*suvicārya jagatkānta vada no vadatāṃ vara \|*  
*yuktaṃ kāryamayuktaṃ vā kartavyamatha vā na vā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bālakānāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ bālānvacanaṃ tatsukhāvaham \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. О lord of the universe, О best of the speakers, you only think over or request carefully and tell us whether our effort would be proper or improper. Whether we should make an attempt or not. On hearing the words of the boys, lord Madhusudana spoke to them in quite sweet and pleasant words.

## \|\| 22.14 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ vo daityādbhayaṃ bālā yūyaṃ matsahacāriṇaḥ \|*  
*vṛkṣānbhaṅktvā cālayitvā phalāni khādatābhayam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Shri Krishna said – О boys, when you always live with me then why should you be afraid of a demon; you go shake the tress and breaking them eat the fruit.

## \|\| 22.15 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇājñāṃ samādāya bālakā balaśālinaḥ \|*  
*utpeturvṛkṣaśikharaṃ kṣudhitāśca phalārthinaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Getting the permission from Shri Krishna, the valorous boys because of being hungry climbed the trees for plucking the fruits.

## \|\| 22.16 \|\|

*nānāprakāravarṇāni svādūni sundarāṇi ca \|*  
*phalāni pātayāmāsuḥ paripakvāni nārada \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О Narada, they started dropping many of the delicious, beautiful and ripe fruits and dropping them on the ground.

## \|\| 22.17-19 \|\|

*kecidbabhañjurvṛkṣāśca cālayāmāsureva ca \|*  
*kecitkolāhalaṃ cakurnanṛtustatra kecana \|\| 17 \|\|*

*avaruhya tarubhyaśca bālakā balaśālinaḥ \|*  
*phalānyādāya gacchanto dadṛśurdaityapuṅgavam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*mahābalaṃ mahākāyaṃ ghoraṃ gardabharūpiṇam \|*  
*āgacchantaṃ mahāvegātkurvantaṃ śabdamulbaṇam \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. The boys broke the trees and shook them badly. Some of them started making a noise while others started dancing. When the valorous boys got down from the trees and were about to move with the fruit they found the valorous demon in the form of a donkey with a gigantic and terrific body creating a terrific sound rushing towards the boys.

## \|\| 22.20 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā ruruduḥ sarve phalāni tatyajurbhiyā \|*  
*kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti śabdaṃ ca pracakrurbahudhā bhṛśam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. At the sight of the demon, all the boys started crying being terror-stricken uttering the name of Krishna again and again.

## \|\| 22.21 \|\|

*asmānrakṣa samāgaccha he kṛṣṇa karuṇānidhe \|*  
*he saṅkarṣaṇa no rakṣa prāṇā no yānti dānavāt \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. They said, О Krishna, О ocean of mercy, you arrive here and save us. О Samkarsana you protect us other-wise this demon will kill us.

## \|\| 22.22 \|\|

*iti śrībahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyanāradasaṃvāde dhenukavadhonāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О Krishna, О Hari, О Murari, О Govinda, О Damodara, brother of the down-trodden, lord of all the cowherdesses, the lord of the cowherds, beyond measure, Narayana, you protect us in the ocean of universe.

## \|\| 22.23 \|\|

*bhaye'bhaye vātha śubhe'śubhe vā sukheṣu duḥkheṣu ca dīnanātha \|*  
*tvayā vinā'nyaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhavārṇave na no'sti he mādhava rakṣa rakṣa \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О lord of the down-trodden, О Madhava, there is no one else to take care of us a the time of fear and without fear, at the good and bad times or in pleasure and pain. There is no one else who could provide protection to us. Therefore you protect us from the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 22.24 \|\|

*jayajaya guṇasindho kṛṣṇa bhaktaikabandho bahutarabhayayuktānbālakānrakṣa rakṣa \|*  
*jahi danujakulānāmīśamasmāka mantaṃ surakulabaladarpaṃ vardhayemaṃ nihatya \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О ocean of the virtues, О Krishna, you are the only well-wisher of the devotees. We all the boys are getting terrified and therefore you protect us. He happens to be the lord of the race of demons by killing him you can increase the prestige of the gods.

## \|\| 22.25 \|\|

*bālānāṃ viklavaṃ dṛṣā balena saha mādhavaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma śiśusthānaṃ bhayahā bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Finding the boys upset, the lord Krishna who is the remover of the danger, the one who showers grace on his devotees, accompanied by Balabhadra, reached near the boys.

## \|\| 22.26 \|\|

*bhayaṃ nāsti bhayaṃ nāstītyuktvā dudrāva satvaram \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyo nirbhayaṃ dattavāñchiśūn \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Wearing a smile on their faces both of them rushed to the boys and delightfully reassured them.

## \|\| 22.27 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ bālā nanṛturvijahurbhayam \|*  
*harismṛtiścābhayadā sarvamaṅgaladāyikā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Finding Krishna and Balabhadra there all the boys became fearless and they started dancing because the reciting of the name of the lord provides protection and complete welfare.

## \|\| 22.28 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇo dānavaṃ dṛṣṭvā grasantaṃ purataḥ śiśūn \|*  
*balaṃ saṃbodhya balinamuvāca madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Shri Krishna finding the demon denouncing the boys, Madhusudana spoke to mighty Balabhadra.

## \|\| 22.29 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*dānavo baliputro'yaṃ nāmnā sāhasiko balī \|*  
*gardabho brahmaśāpena śapto durvāsasā purā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Shri Krishna said – He happens to be the son of immensely valorous demon Bali who was cursed in earlier times by Durvasa. With that curse he was turned into a donkey.

## \|\| 22.30 \|\|

*pāpiṣṭho mama vadhyo'yaṃ mahābalaparākamaḥ \|*  
*ahamenaṃ vadhiṣyāmi tvaṃ rakṣa bālakānbala \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О Balabhadra, he is extremely sinful and possesses great strength also. Therefore he has to be killed by me. I shall kill him. You better protect these boys.

## \|\| 22.31 \|\|

*ādāya bālakānsarvāndūraṃ gacchetyuvāca ha \|*  
*tāngṛhītvā balaḥ śīghraṃ jagāma tvarayājñayā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Accompanied with the boys you move to a distant place. Thereafter Balabhadra at the command of Krishna moved with the boys to a distant place.

## \|\| 22.32-33 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ dānavendro mahābalaparākramaḥ \|*  
*jagrāsa līlayā kopājjvaladagniśikhopamam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*babhūvātidāhayukto martukāmo'titejasā \|*  
*ujjagrāsa punardaityo vibhuṃ tejasvinaṃ bhiyā \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. But after swallowing Krishna, the inside of the body of the demon started burning because of the immense lustre of the lord; getting terrified the demon vomited out the illustrious lord.

## \|\| 22.34-36 \|\|

*ujjhitaṃ santamīśaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā daityo mumoca ha \|*  
*atīva sundaraṃ śāntaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇadarśanamātreṇa babhūvāsya purā smṛtiḥ \|*  
*ātmānaṃ bubudhe kṛṣṇaṃ jagatāṃ kāraṇaṃ param \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tejaḥsvarūpamīśaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva dānavaḥ \|*  
*yathāgamaṃ yathājanma guṇātītaṃ śruteḥ param \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. He looked at the lord when he was emerging out of his body being extremely beautiful, peaceful and having divine lustre. At the sight of Krishna, he was reminded of the events of his earlier birth. He then recognised himself as well as the one who happens to be the cause of the universe. Looking at the illustrious lord he started offering prayer to him.

## \|\| 22.37 \|\|

*dānava uvāca \|*  
*vāmano'si tvamaṃśena matpituryajñabhikṣukaḥ \|*  
*rājyahartā ca śrīhartā sutalasthaladāyakaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The demon said – With your amsa you appeared in the form of Vamana who became a beggar in the yajna of my fathers; you happen to be the usurper of his kingdom and glory and had bestowed the kingship of the underworld to my father.

## \|\| 22.38 \|\|

*balirbhaktivaśo vīraḥ sarveśo bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*śīghraṃ tvaṃ hindhi māṃ pāpaṃ śāpādgardabharūpiṇam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. You are devoted to Bali, are quite valorous, the lord of everyone, while your devotees are loved by you; therefore you kindly relieve a sinful person like me from this form of a donkey.

## \|\| 22.39 \|\|

*munerdurvāsasaḥ śāpādīdṛśaṃ janma kutsitam \|*  
*mṛtyuruktaśca muninā tvatto mama jagatpate \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О lord of the universe, I had achieved this form because of the curse of Durvasa who had also foretold my about death at your hands.

## \|\| 22.40 \|\|

*ṣoḍaśāreṇa cakreṇa sutīkṣṇenātitejasā \|*  
*jahi māṃ jagatāṃ nātha sadbhaktiṃ kuru mokṣada \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О lord of the universe, О giver of the salvation, you shoot the extremely sharp cakra or sixteen arrows for killing me and provide me the salvation.

## \|\| 22.41 \|\|

*tvamaṃśena varāhaśca samuddhartuṃ vasundharām \|*  
*vedānāṃ rakṣitā nātha hiraṇyākṣaniṣūdanaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. О lord, you had also appeared from your amsa as an incarnation of Varaha and redeemed this earth, saved the Vedas and killed Hiranyaksa.

## \|\| 22.42 \|\|

*tvaṃ nṛsiṃhaḥ svayaṃ pūrṇo hiraṇyakaśiporvadhe \|*  
*prahrādānugrahārthāya devānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. You are complete Paramatma and killing Hiranyaksipu bestowed your grace on Prahlada and took to the form of Nrsimha for the protection of the gods.

## \|\| 22.43 \|\|

*tvaṃ ca vedoddhārakartā mīnāṃśena dayānidhe \|*  
*nṛpasya jñānadānāya rakṣāyai suraviprayoḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O ocean of mercy, you appeared from your athsa in the from of a fish and protected the Vedas and providing knowledge to the king saved the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 22.44 \|\|

*śeṣādhāraśca kūrmastvamaṃśena sṛṣṭihetave \|*  
*viśvādhāraśca viśvastvamaṃśenāpi sahasradhṛk \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. You also appeared in the form of a tortoise from your amsha and also appeared in the from of Shesha and carried the load of the entire universe over your head.

## \|\| 22.45 \|\|

*rāmo dāśarathistvaṃ ca jānakyuddhārahetave \|*  
*daśakandharahantā ca sindhau setuvidhāyakaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. For the redemption of JanakI you were born as Rama, the son of Dasaratha. Constructing a bridge on the ocean, you killed Ravana having ten faces.

## \|\| 22.46 \|\|

*kalayā paraśurāmaśca jamadagnisuto mahān \|*  
*triḥsaptakṛtvo bhūpānāṃ nihantā jagatīpate \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. О lord of the universe, with your rays you appeared as Parashurama the son of Jamadagni, relieved the earth of the Kshatriya kings.

## \|\| 22.47 \|\|

*aṃśena kapilastvaṃ ca siddhānāṃ ca gurorguruḥ \|*  
*mātṛjñānapradātā ca yogaśāstravidhāyakaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Kapila was born from your athsa who happened to be the teacher of siddhas and was the propounder of Yogashastra bestowing the divine knowledge to his mother.

## \|\| 22.48 \|\|

*aṃśena jñānināṃ śreṣṭho naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|*  
*tvaṃ ca dharmasuto bhūtvā lokavistārakārakaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Nara-narayana the best of the sages was also born of your amsha. In the form of Dharamputra you expanded the universe.

## \|\| 22.49 \|\|

*adhunā kṛṣṇarūpastvaṃ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam \|*  
*sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ bījarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Presently you have yourself appeared in the from of Krishna and you happen to be the seed of all the eternal incarnations.

## \|\| 22.50-52 \|\|

*yaśodājīvano nityo nandaikānandavardhanaḥ \|*  
*prāṇādhidevo gopīnāṃ rādhāprāṇādhikapriyaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*vasudevasutaḥ śānto devakīduḥkhabhañjanaḥ \|*  
*ayonisaṃbhavaḥ śrīmānpṛthivībhārahārakaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*pūtanāyai mātṛgatiṃ pradātā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*bakakeśipralambānāṃ mamāpi mokṣakārakaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. You are the life of Yashoda, eternal increase the delight of Nanda the lord of the lives of the cowherdesses and are dearer to Radha than her life you are the son of Vasudeva, peaceful, remover of the pain of Devaki, born without human contact, possessor of all the riches, remover of the burden of the earth, providing the graceful place to Putana like a mother. You are merciful and are the one who provided salvation to skylark, KesT, Pralamba and myself.

## \|\| 22.53 \|\|

*svecchāmaya guṇātīta bhaktānāṃ bhayabhañjana \|*  
*prasīda rādhikānātha prasīda kuru mokṣaṇam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. You move at will, are beyond qualities, remover or the fear or the devotees, О lord of Radhika, be pleased with me and grant me redemption.

## \|\| 22.54 \|\|

*he nātha gārdabhīyoneḥ samuddhara bhavārṇavāt \|*  
*mūrkhastvadbhaktaputro'haṃ māmuddhartuṃ tvamarhasi \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. О lord, you kindly provide salvation to me from the ocean of the universe and the form of a donkey. I happen to be the foolish son of your devotee. You provide redemption to me.

## \|\| 22.55 \|\|

*vedā brahmādayo yaṃ ca munīndrāḥ stotumakṣamāḥ \|*  
*kiṃ staumi taṃ guṇātītaṃ purā daityo'dhunā kharaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The one whose glory cannot be recited by the Vedas, Brahma and other gods and the sages how can a person like me offer prayer to such a lord, who was earlier a demon and now a donkey.

## \|\| 22.56 \|\|

*evaṃ kuru kṛpāsindho yena me na bhavejjanuḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā pādāravindaṃ te kaḥ punarbhavanaṃ vrajet \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. О ocean of mercy, now move in such a way by which I shall not have to be born on earth, who would desire to return to his come after looking at your feet?

## \|\| 22.57 \|\|

*brahmā stotā kharaḥ stotā nopahāsitumarhasi \|*  
*sadīśvarasya vijñasya yogyāyogye samā kṛpā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The one who is adored by Brahma, the same lord is being adored by a mere donkey, which is quite laughable because the lord bestows this grace equally on all.

## \|\| 22.58-61 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā daityendrastasthau ca purato hareḥ \|*  
*prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānatituṣṭo babhūva ha \|\| 58 \|\|*

*idaṃ daityakṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*sālokyasārṣṭisāmīpyaṃ līlayā labhate hareḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*iha loke harerbhaktimante dāsyaṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*vidyāṃ śriyaṃ sukavitāṃ putrapautrānyaśo labhet \|\| 60 \|\|*

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śrutvā'numene daityendrastavanaṃ karuṇānidhiḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ karomi saṃhāramīdṛśaṃ bhaktamityaho \|\| 61 \|\|*

58-61. Thus speaking the demon stood before the lord, his face was looking quite graceful and satisfied. The one who recites this stotra composed by the demon he achieves the place of Hari the fortunes and his closeness without much effort. He achieves the devotion of lord during this world and ultimately he attains the inaccessible place of Hari besides learnings, riches, the best of poetry, sons and grandsons beside the glory. Narayana said – the merciful lord on hearing the prayer of the Daitya Krishna started thinking in his mind as to how to kill such devotee of mine.

## \|\| 22.62 \|\|

*anumanya smṛtiṃ tasya saṃjahāra hariḥ svayam \|*  
*na hi yukto vadhaḥ stoturdurvakturvidhirīśvarāt \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Thereafter the demon desirous of his immediate death, having lost his wisdom, was filled with anger and his lips started fluttering in rage. Me then spoke to lord Hari.

## \|\| 22.63 \|\|

*dānavo māyayā viṣṇorvisasmāra punaḥ svakam \|*  
*duruktistatkaṇṭhadeśe hyadhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Deity a said – О son of a human, devoid of wisdom you indeed intend to die at my hands. I can dispatched you to the place of Yama today.

## \|\| 22.64 \|\|

*uvāca śrīhariṃ daityaḥ kopātprasphuritādharaḥ \|*  
*mune sadyo martukāmo daivagrasto vicetanaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. О boy, having reached in my tala forest, you want to escape alive. You will not be able to return home nor would you be able to meet your relatives. Kariisa, Jarasandha and Naraka could not be equated with me. Even the gods tremble in fear with the hearing of my name who is there like me on the earth.

## \|\| 22.65 \|\|

*daitya uvāca \|*  
*dhruvaṃ tvaṃ martukāmo'si durbuddhe mānavārbhaka \|*  
*adya prasthāpayiṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ yamamandiram \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Shiva the destroyer of the universe cannot destroy me. Even Brahma, Vishnu and the god of death are not in a position to cause any harm to me.

## \|\| 22.66-67 \|\|

*āyāsi jīvanākāṅkṣī mama tālavanaṃ śiśo \|*  
*na yāsyasi punargehaṃ bāndhavaṃ na hi drakṣyasi \|\| 66 \|\|*

*na kaṃso na jarāsandho narako na samo mama \|*  
*devāḥ kampanti me nityaṃ ke cānye matsamā bhuvi \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Thus thinking the lord himself made his memory to vanish because the one who offers prayer cannot be killed and only the one, who uttered harsh words, is killed by the lord, This has been provided in the scriptures.

## \|\| 22.68 \|\|

*nahi saṃhārakartā ca māṃ saṃhartuṃ kṣamaḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*na ca brahmā na viṣṇuśca na mṛtyuḥ kāla eva ca \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Influenced by the illusion of lord Vishnu the demon forgot about himself and harsh words dwelt in his throat.

## \|\| 22.69-72 \|\|

*mama tālatarūnbhaṅktvā pātayitvā phalāni ca \|*  
*ahaṃkaroṣi sahasā kimaho kasya tejasā \|\| 69 \|\|*

*kastvaṃ vada baṭo satyaṃ kamanīyo'tisundaraḥ \|*  
*durlabhaṃ jīvanaṃ dātuṃ mahyaṃ kathamihāgataḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*ityuktvā mastake kṛtvā prerayitvā tu taṃ balī \|*  
*dūrataḥ pātayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ maraṇonmukhaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

*pātayitvā ca taṃ bhūmau viṣāṇābhyāṃ jaghāna saḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇāṅgasparśamātreṇa tadviṣāṇe babhañjatuḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

69-72. Breaking my tala trees and dropping the fruits, on what basis are you feeling so proud. О son, tell me truthfully who are you? You are quite charming and beautiful. Why have you arrived here to offer your life to me? Thus speaking the valorous demon who was standing at the death’s door, lifted Kq§na on his head and threw him at a distance, by making him fall on the ground. He them struck him with his horns. But with the touch of the body of Krishna his horns were broken.

## \|\| 22.73 \|\|

*daityo bhagnaviṣāṇaśca tamīśaṃ kopayanmune \|*  
*jagrāsa carvaṇaṃ kartuṃ bhagnadanto babhūva ha \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. О sage, after the breaking of the horns, the demon was annoyed and he caught hold of Krishna in order to chew him. But while doing so all his teeth were broken.

## \|\| 22.74 \|\|

*tejasā dagdhavaktraśca tamujjagrāha tatkṣaṇe \|*  
*jajvāla vyathitaḥ kopāddadāra khurato mahīm \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. With the lustre of Krishna his mouth was burnt out and he swallowed him at once. He than started burning with anger and went on digging earth with his hoofs.

## \|\| 22.75 \|\|

*cūrṇayitvā tu lāṃgūlaṃ śabdaṃ kṛtvā bhayānakam \|*  
*sa jagāma śiśusthānaṃ dudruvurbālakā bhiyā \|\| 75\|\|*

75\. Moving his tail, creating deafening sound he rushed towards the boys who started running away.

## \|\| 22.76 \|\|

*balaṃ ca prerayāmāsa mastakena mahābalī \|*  
*balo muṣṭiṃ dadau tasmai mūrcchāmāpa tato'suraḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Thereafter Balabhadra pushed the powerful demon aside and struck him with a fist result of which the demon was fainted.

## \|\| 22.77-78 \|\|

*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya jagāma harisannidhim \|*  
*balamuṣṭyā ca vyathitaḥ punarmūrcchāmavāpa saḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

*punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau vyathākulaḥ \|*  
*utsasarja bṛhalleḍaṃ mūtraṃ ca bhayamāpa ha \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. Regaining consciousness in a moment, he went towards the lord and was again fainted with the blow of the fist by Balabhadra. On regaining consciousness he felt painful, but still he got up and in fear he started dropping urine and refuse.

## \|\| 22.79 \|\|

*kṣaṇātsaṃdhikṣaṇaṃ prāpya mahābalaparākramaḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā śirasi govindaṃ cūrṇayāmāsa dānavaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. After resting for a while, the valorous and highly strong demon lifted Govinda on his head and started roaming about.

## \|\| 22.80 \|\|

*pātayāmāsa bhūmau taṃ cūrṇayitvā punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*utpāṭya tālavṛkṣaṃ taṃ tāḍayāmāsa mādhavaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Moving him in a circular manner again and again, he then dropped him on the ground. Thereafter Madhava uprooted a tala tree and threw it at him.

## \|\| 22.81 \|\|

*yathā khaḍgaprahāreṇa dānavasya bhavedvyathā \|*  
*tathā babhūva daityasya tālavṛkṣasya tāḍanāt \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. The pain he had suffered after having been struck at the head, the same amount of pain was felt by him with the striking of the tala tree at him.

## \|\| 22.82 \|\|

*govardhanam samutpāsya ghātayāmāsa taṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*papāta vegacchailerastasyopari mahāmune \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The lord than lifted up the Govardhana mountain and threw it at him. О great sage, the king of the mountain fell on the demon with great force.

## \|\| 22.83 \|\|

*parvatasya prahāreṇa mūrcchāmāpa mahābalaḥ \|*  
*babhūva jarjarāṅgaśca rudhiraṃ ca samudvaman \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. With the striking of the mountain, the valorous demon was fainted and all. his limbs were wounded. He vomited blood.

## \|\| 22.84 \|\|

*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau ruṣā'suraḥ \|*  
*gṛhītvā parvataśreṣṭhaṃ prerayāmāsa mādhavam \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. After regaining consciousness in a moment, the demon got up at once and lifting up the mountain he threw it at Madhava.

## \|\| 22.85 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā śailamutpatantaṃ vegena madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*jagrāha dakṣiṇakare yathekṣudaṇḍavatprabhuḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. MadhusOdana on the other hand finding the mountain approaching him with great force hold it with right hand like the sugar-cane.

## \|\| 22.86 \|\|

*pūrvasthāne parvataṃ taṃ sthāpayāmāsa kautukāt \|*  
*gṛhītvā daityakarṇāgraṃ pātayāmāsa dūrataḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Thereafter he placed the mountain at its original place moulding the ear of the demon in his hand, the lord threw him away at a distance.

## \|\| 22.87 \|\|

*utpatya ca mahāvegāccakāra veṣṭanaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*pṛthivīṃ gharṣayāmāsa tīkṣṇāgreṇa khureṇa ca \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. The demon took a high jump and than surrounded the lord and thereafter he started digging the earth with the hoofs.

## \|\| 22.88 \|\|

*pragṛhya śrīhariṃ vegātkṛtvā mūrdhni mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*utpapāta manoyāyī līlayā lakṣayojanam \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. The great asura held the lord with great force, raised him on his head and he went up in the sky up to a lakh of yojanas with the speed of a mind.

## \|\| 22.89 \|\|

*praharaṃ ca tayoryuddhaṃ nirlakṣe ca babhūva ha \|*  
*tato gṛhītvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ papāta dharaṇītale \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. They fought in first space for a prahara. Thereafter Krishna was held by him tightly and he descended on earth.

## \|\| 22.90 \|\|

*punarmuhūrtaṃ yuddhaṃ ca babhūva bhūtale tayoḥ \|*  
*mudā hariḥ praśaśaṃsa prahasya dānaveśvaram \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Thereafter both of them fought for a muhiirta on the ground. Thereafter lord Krishna smilingly praised the demon delightfully.

## \|\| 22.91 \|\|

*madbhaktasya baleḥ putraṃ dhanyaṃ tajjīvanaṃ param \|*  
*svastyastu te dānavendra vatsa nirvāṇatāṃ vraja \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. He said, О best of the demons, you happen to be the son of Bali, who has been a great devotee of mine. Your life is graceful. Therefore we should meet with welfare and redemption.

## \|\| 22.92 \|\|

*maddarśanaṃ svastibījaṃ paraṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam \|*  
*sarvādhikaṃ sarvaparaṃ labha sthānaṃ manoharam \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. And audience with me results in the seed of welfare and the salvation. You achieved the best of the places; with good deeds beyond all of them.

## \|\| 22.93-94 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sasmāra cakramuttamam \|*  
*sūryakoṭisamaṃ dīptyā jagrāha tatsudarśanam \|\| 93 \|\|*

*cikṣepa bhrāmayitvā ca ṣoḍaśāramanuttamam \|*  
*ciccheda līlayā'vadhyaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. The lord while thus speaking remembered the Sudarsana-cakra which was like the crores of suns and illumining. He held that cakra having sixteenth spokes which was illumining like crores of suns. Holding the cakra in his hand he moved it in a circular manner and shot it at the demons. With the striking of cakra, the head of demon was severed who couldn't be killed by Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

## \|\| 22.95 \|\|

*papāta mastakaṃ bhūmau dānavasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*tejaḥsamūha uttasthau śatasūryasamaprabhaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. The head of the demon fell down on the ground and looked like the lustre of hundreds of suns.

## \|\| 22.96 \|\|

*vilokya harilokaṃ saṃśliṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇapadāmbuje \|*  
*saṃprāpya paramaṃ mokṣamaho dānavapuṅgavaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. The lustre merging from the demons head, finding the lustre in the feet of the lord rushed towards it and merged in the same. Thus the great Danava achieved salvation.

## \|\| 22.97 \|\|

*gaganasthāḥ surāḥ sarve munayaśca bhṛśaṃ mudā \|*  
*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ cakruste tatra varṣaṇam \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. At that point of time the gods remaining in the sky beside the sages felt delighted and showered Parijdta flowers.

## \|\| 22.98-99 \|\|

*nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ \|*  
*jagurgandharvanikarā stuṣṭuvurmunayo mudā \|\| 98 \|\|*

*stutvā jagmuḥ surāḥ sarve munayo harṣavihvalāḥ \|*  
*dhenukasya vadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrājagmuśca bālakāḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

98-99. The dundhubhis were sounded in the heaven and the apsaras started dancing, the Gandharvas started singing and the sages offered prayer.

## \|\| 22.100 \|\|

*balaśca balināṃ śreṣṭhastuṣṭāva puruṣottamam \|*  
*tuṣṭuvurbālakāḥ sarve nanṛtuśca mudā'nvitāḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. Balarama the best of the valorous people, also started praising the lord and all the boys started dancing in delight.

## \|\| 22.101 \|\|

*dattvā kṛṣṇabalābhyāṃ ca prapakvāni phalāni ca \|*  
*sarvāṇi bhakṣayāmāsurbālāḥ prahaṣṭamānasāḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. The happy boys offered to Balarama and Krishna, the sweet and delicious fruits and consumed them also.

## \|\| 22.102 \|\|

*bhuktvā pītvā hariḥ śīghraṃ balena bālakaiḥ saha \|*  
*jagāma svālayaṃ brahmannihatya dānaveśvaram \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. О Brahma, killing the Danava and consuming the fruits Shri Krishna and Balarama together with the boys went back to their abodes.

## Chapter 23

## \|\| 23.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kena pāpena balijo gardabhatvamavāpa ha \|*  
*durvāsāḥ kena doṣeṇa śaśāpa dānaveśvaram \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – For what sin the son of Bali was turned into a donkey and for what reason Durvasa pronounced a curse on the king of the demons.

## \|\| 23.2 \|\|

*kena puṇyena vā nātha balinaḥ śrīhareḥ padam \|*  
*sahasaikatvamuktiṃ ca saṃprāpa dānavādhipaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О lord, the son of Bali who happened to be the best of those in the giver of charities, by what merit achieved the place of lord Krishna, known as Aikyamoksa.

## \|\| 23.3 \|\|

*mune sarvaṃ suvistārya vada saṃdehabhañjana \|*  
*aho kavimukhe kāvyaṃ nūtnaṃnūtnaṃ padepade \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О sage, О remover of the doubts, you kindly speak out to me everything in detail. The poetry in the mouth of a poet looks like new at every step.

## \|\| 23.4 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam \|*  
*purā śrutaṃ dharmavaktrātparvate gandhamādane \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said – О son in this connection I will narrated to you and ancient and historical story which was told to me at Gandhamadana mountain by Brahma himself.

## \|\| 23.5 \|\|

*pādmakalpe ca vṛttāntaṃ vicitraṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*nārāyaṇakathopetaṃ karṇapīyūṣamuttamam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. This auspicious and charming story relates to the Padma-kalpa. The one should listens to the story of Narayana with his own ears which like the nectar.

## \|\| 23.6 \|\|

*yatra kalpe kathā ceyaṃ tatra tvamupabarhaṇaḥ \|*  
*ākalpajīvī saśrīkaḥ sundaraḥ sthirayauvanaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The kalpa to which the story relates, during that time you happened to be a Gandharva named Upabarhana. You had the age of a kalpa. You were endowed with all the riches, quite beautiful and youthful.

## \|\| 23.7-9 \|\|

*paṃcāśatkāminīnāṃ ca patiḥ śṛṅgāratatparaḥ \|*  
*vareṇa brahmaṇastvaṃ ca sukaṇṭho gāyaneśvaraḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*anukṣaṇaṃ papustāste sundaraṃ mukhapaṅkajam \|*  
*nimeṣarahitāḥ sarvāḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tāsāṃ prāṇaiśca ghaṭito vidhinā tvamiva śrutam \|*  
*divāniśaṃ sahacarā na jīvanti tvayā vinā \|*  
*\|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Being the husband of fifty damsels, you were always engaged in love-sports. With the boon of Brahma you had achieved a beautiful throat and you happened to be the king. All the passionate damsels stared at you with position. The destiny had endowed you with many virtues and no one could equation earth. They always accompanied you and could never separate from you even for a mount.

## \|\| 23.10-11 \|\|

*puṣpodyāne ca rahasi sthāne sthāne manorame \|*  
*gahareṣu ca śailānāṃ kandareṣu nadīṣu ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kānaneṣu ca ramyeṣu śmaśāne jantuvarjite \|*  
*yathāmanorathaṃ tāśca krīḍāṃ cakrustvayā saha \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. They enjoyed your love-sports in secluded orchards, charming places, mountain caves, ravines, the rivers, beautiful wild cremation grounds having no creatures.

## \|\| 23.12 \|\|

*tadā daivādvidheḥ śāpādbhūtvā dāsīsuto bhavān \|*  
*adhunā brahmaṇaḥ putro vaiṣṇavocchiṣṭabhojanāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. At that point of time with the curse of Brahma, you had to be born as the son of a maid-servant and with influence of your serving the best of the food to the Brahmanas. Currently you happen to be the son of Brahma.

## \|\| 23.13 \|\|

*asaṃkhyakalpajīvī ca vaiṣṇavapravaro mahān \|*  
*jñānadṛṣṭyā sarvadarśī priya śiṣyaśca dhūrjaṭeḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Presently you happen to be the loving pupil of lord Shiva and will live for innumerable kalpas, becoming great, the best of Vaishnavas, you can have the universal vision, because of your eternal knowledge.

## \|\| 23.14 \|\|
