*dṛṣṭvā tayośca śṛṅgāraṃ muniḥ kāmī babhūva ha \|*  
*jitendriyo'satsaṃsargāddoṣaḥ sāṃsargiko bhavet \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – О sage you, listen to the deep rooted story of the life of Durvasa. It is surprising. It projects as to how such an ascetic who had controlled all his senses fell to the company of a female. Witnessing the love-sport of both of them the self-controlled sage was infatuated, with love, because by keeping the company of a sinful person, some of his deficiencies are transported to another person.

## \|\| 24.3-4 \|\|

*sahasā tasya hṛdaye babhūva surate spṛhā \|*  
*tapastaptvā tatra dadhyau kāminīṃ madanāturaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tena pathā yāti munīśvaraḥ \|*  
*prārthayantyā patiṃ santamaurvaśca sutayā saha \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Suddenly the desire of enjoying the conjugal pleasures and the company of a damsel arose in his mind. After finishing his tapas, the passionate sage thought of a damsel. In the meantime, the sage Aurva was passing by that side, accompanied with his daughter who was desirous of getting a husband for herself.

## \|\| 24.5 \|\|

*ūrūdbhavo brahmaṇaśca purā kalpe tapasyataḥ \|*  
*ūrdhvaretāśca yogīndra orvastena iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In the earlier times since the sage was born in the region of Urn he was given the name of Aurva who was perfectly self-controlled and a great yogi.

## \|\| 24.6 \|\|

*tasya jānūdbhavā kanyā kandalī nāma viśrutā \|*  
*durvāsasaṃ prārthayantī nānyaṃ manasi rocate \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Since she was born out of his thigh, she was given the name of Kandall who was attracted towards Durvasa and desired no one else.

## \|\| 24.7-9 \|\|

*sasuto hi muniśreṣṭho munerdurvāsasaḥ puraḥ \|*  
*tasthau mahāprasannaśca jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*munīndro'pi munīndraṃ taṃ puro dṛṣṭvā sasaṃbhramaḥ \|*  
*prajavena samuttasthau nanāma ca mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*aurvo durvāsasaṃ tatra samāśliṣya mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*uvāca munaye sarvaṃ kanyakāyā manoratham \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Aurva the best of the sages who was extremely delightful and possessed the lustre of the fire flame came to Durvasa with his daughter and stood before the sage. The sage Durvasa finding the best of the sages before him was upset in his mind. But he delightfully got up and bowed in reverence to him. Aurva embraced Durvasa and delightfully conveyed to him the desire of his daughter.

## \|\| 24.10 \|\|

*aurva uvāca \|*  
*vikhyātā kandalī nāma mama kanyā manoharā \|*  
*prauḍhā tvāmeva dhyāyantī śrutvā vācikavaktrataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Aurva said – My daughter named Kandall listening to your glory from your messengers always adored you and she is adult at the moment.

## \|\| 24.11 \|\|

*ayonisambhavā kanyā trailokyaṃ mohituṃ kṣamā \|*  
*sarvarūpaguṇādhārā doṣeṇaikena saṃyutā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The girl is born without any human touch and can attract all the three worlds. She possesses all the qualities but has one shorting coming also.

## \|\| 24.12 \|\|

*atīva kalahāviṣṭā kopena kaṭubhāṣiṇī \|*  
*nānāguṇayutaṃ dravyaṃ na tyajedekadoṣataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. She is quite quarrelsome and speaks foul word in anger but if someone has all the virtues the same person cannot be discarded just for a single short coming.

## \|\| 24.13-15 \|\|

*aurvasya vacanaṃ śrutvā harṣaśokānvito muniḥ \|*  
*dadarśa kanyāṃ purato guṇarūpasamanvitām \|\| 13 \|\|*

*śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām \|\| 14 \|\|*

*navayauvanasaṃyuktāṃ paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā \|*  
*ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitām \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. On listening to the words of sage Aurva, Durvasa felt delighted and was also greedy. He found the most beautiful girl full of all the virtues before him. Her face resembled the full moon of the winter season, the eyes resembled the fully blown lotus flowers of the winter season. She wore a smile on her face and her pelvic region and breasts were quite solid. She was quite youthful and was looking at the sage with side-glance. She was adorned with the gem-studded ornaments and was clad in the costumes purified by fire.

## \|\| 24.16 \|\|

*munirmumoha tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ \|*  
*uvāca taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The sage Durvasa was infatuated with passion with the looked at the girl. He spoke to the sage Aurva.

## \|\| 24.17-18 \|\|

*durvāsā uvāca \|*  
*nārīrūpaṃ tribhuvane muktimārganirodhakam \|*  
*vyavadhānaṃ tapasyāyāḥ satataṃ mohakāraṇam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kārāgāre ca saṃsāre durvahaṃ nigaḍaṃ param \|*  
*acchedyaṃ jñānakhaḍgaiśca mahadbhiḥ śaṃkarādibhiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Durvasa said – In three worlds the beauty of a female is an obstruction towards the achieving of the salvation; it creates obstruction in the tapas and is the cause of illusion always. She happens to fee a grave fetter in the prison of the universe which cannot be transported easily. Even the gods like Shiva and many sages could not it cut-off with the sword of their knowledge.

## \|\| 24.19 \|\|

*saṅgicchāyātiriktaṃ ca karmabhogātparātparam \|*  
*indriyādindriyādhārādvidyāyāśca materapi \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The women happen to be good companion, who always follows like a shadow, she is karmabhoga, the base of the organ of senses and can be controlled with learning and intelligence.

## \|\| 24.20 \|\|

*ādehaṃ saṅginī chāyā bhogāntaṃ bhoga eva ca \|*  
*dehendriyāṇi jīvāntaṃ vidyā caivāvaśīlinam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The shadow remains with a person till the life, the pleasures are enjoy by the person till they are not finished but the body and the organs of senses have to continue till life. The learnings keeps the company of a person till they are used.

## \|\| 24.21-22 \|\|

*matiścaivāvaśīlāntā sukhī janmanijanmani \|*  
*yāvajjīvī ca sustrīko na tāvajjanmakhaṇḍanam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*yāvacca jīvino janma tāvadbhogaḥ sukhāvahaḥ \|*  
*paraṃ munīndra sarvasmāddharipādābjasevanam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The same position is held with the intelligence but the best of the women keep company of their husbands for many lives, A person having a virtuous wife, enjoys the life through out. Till such time a person is born, the pleasures are treated to be pleasant by him. The devotion at the lotus-like feet of the lord always provides pleasure.

## \|\| 24.23-24 \|\|

*dhyāyataḥ kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ mama vighno babhūva ha \|*  
*na jāne karmadoṣeṇa kena vā pūrvajanmanaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*puṃścalyā saha śṛṅgāraṃ dṛṣṭvā daityasya manmanaḥ \|*  
*babhūva kāmasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ dhātrā ca tatphalam \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. I was meditating upon the lotus-like feet of the lord when this obstruction was created. I know not by which part of my actions, I had to face this situation. Witnessing the conjugal pleasures of the demon with the loose woman, my mind was infatuated with passion and Brahma has rewarded me accordingly.

## \|\| 24.25-26 \|\|

*kiṃ tvahaṃ tava kanyāyāḥ kaṭūktiśatakaṃ mune \|*  
*dhruvaṃ kṣamāṃ kariṣyāmi dāsyāmi ca tataḥ phalam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sarvato'pi parā nindā strīkaṭūktisahiṣṇutā \|*  
*atīva ninditaḥ satsu strījito bhuvanatraye \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. O sage, I shall surely forgive your daughter for her harsh words for sometime and thereafter I shall punish her for the same. At is really disgraceful for a man to bear the harsh words of the wife. This is denounced by all in the three worlds.

## \|\| 24.27 \|\|

*tavājñāṃ mastake kṛtvā grahīṣyāmi sutāṃ tava \|*  
*upetāṃ kāminīṃ tyaktvā kālasūtraṃ vrajennaraḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. I except your command and also your daughter because refuse the company of a damsel, who is offered to a person drives him the kalasutra hell.

## \|\| 24.28 \|\|

*rahasyupasthitāṃ kāmātpuṃścalīṃ cejjitendriyaḥ \|*  
*parityajeddharmabhayādadharmānnarakaṃ vrajet \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Even if a passionate loose women approaches a person who has controlled his senses and in case he disregards her only keeping in view his dharma but by thus conducting himself he has to go to the hell.

## \|\| 24.29 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā durvāsā virarāma muneḥ puraḥ \|*  
*munirvedoktavidhinā dadau tasmai sutāṃ mune \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Thus speaking before the sage, Durvasa kept quiet. О sage, Aurva than gave away his girl in marriage to Durvasa.

## \|\| 24.30-31 \|\|

*svastītyuvāca durvāsā muniśca yautukaṃ dadau \|*  
*kanyāsamarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mohāccaiva ruroda ha \|\| 30 \|\|*

*mūrcchāmavāpa sa muniḥ svakanyāvirahāturaḥ \|*  
*apatyabhedaśokaughaḥ svātmārāmaṃ na muñcati \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Durvasa on his part accepted the, girl speaking the words svasti. The sage also gave the dowry. After marrying the girl to Durvasa, the sage started weeping and was fainted with the separation of his daughter because the separation from ones own daughter is always painful to all.

## \|\| 24.32 \|\|

*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya bodhayāmāsa kanyakām \|*  
*mūrcchitāṃ tātavicchedādrudantīṃ śokasaṃyutām \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Regaining consciousness in a moment he started advising the girl who was also crying getting separated from her father.

## \|\| 24.33 \|\|

*aurva uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu vatse pravakṣyāmi nītisāraṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*hitaṃ satyaṃ ca vedoktaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Aurva said – О daughter, I am explaining to you the inaccessible tattva of politics which would be beneficial, truthful and is provided by the Vedas and would result in pleasure.

## \|\| 24.34 \|\|

*svakāntaśca paro bandhuriha loke paratra ca \|*  
*na hi kāntātparaḥ preyān kulastrīṇāṃ paro guruḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. In this universe, as well as in future life the husband happens to be the best of relatives. For the ladies of high families there could be none else dearer to them than the husband. The husband is the best of teacher for them.

## \|\| 24.35-36 \|\|

*devapūjā vrataṃ dānaṃ tapaścānaśanaṃ japaḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu dīkṣā sarvamakheṣu ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*prādakṣiṇyaṃ pṛthivyāśca brāhmaṇātithisevanam \|*  
*sarvāṇi patisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. The adoration, performing of vrata, charities, fasting, japam, bathing at the holy places, performing of all the yajnas, going round the universe, serving the Brahmanas and the guests do not compare even one sixteenth part of serving the husband.

## \|\| 24.37 \|\|

*kimetaiḥ patibhaktāyā abhaktāyāśca bhārate \|*  
*yadā duḥkhī sukhārambhe sākāṅkṣaḥ prathamo bhavet \|*  
*patisevā paro dharmaḥ sarvaśāstreṣu paṭhyate \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. In the land of Bharata, the one, who is devoted to the husband and the one who is otherwise, all are of no consequence, when at the beginning of the pleasure, the husband feels painful. All the shastras spell out that serving the husband is extremely religious. One should treat according to ones wisdom, her husband even greater than lord Narayana.

## \|\| 24.38-42 \|\|

*svaprajñānena satataṃ kāntaṃ nārāyaṇādhikam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā taccaraṇatmbhojasevāṃ nityaṃ kariṣyati \|\| 38 \|\|*

*parihāsena kopena bhrameṇāvajñayā mune \|*  
*kaṭūktiṃ svāminaḥ sākṣātparokṣānna kariṣyati \|\| 39 \|\|*

*striyā vāgyoniduṣṭāyāḥ kāmato bhārate bhuvi \|*  
*prāyaścittaṃ śrutau nāsti narakaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śatam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*sarvadharmaparītā yā kaṭūktiṃ kurute patim \|*  
*śatajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tasyā naśyati niścitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*dattvā kanyāṃ bodhayitvā jagāma munipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*svātmārāmaḥ svāśrame ca tasthau strīsahito mudā \|\| 42 \|\|*

38-42. One should always serve at his lotus-like feet, О sage, one should not speak harsh words to the husband even in joke as by mistake. In the land of Bharata, a lady who utters harsh words to her husband or follows an evil path, no remedy has been provided in the Vedas for her purification. She has to remain in the hell up to the life of Brahma. A women getting all the religious ceremonies performed, but speaks harsh words to her husband, all the good deeds performed in her hundred births are destroyed, Thus Aurva best of the sages after tendering good advise to his daughter left the place. The sage Durvasa thereafter started living his asrama delightfully. At the developing of the desire for conjugal pleasures, the sage got a damsel.

## \|\| 24.43-45 \|\|

*sambhogecchāvṛte citte kāmī saṃprāpa kāminīm \|*  
*aho sukṛtināṃ kāmo vāñchāmātreṇa sidhyati \|\| 43 \|\|*

*śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ kṛtvā muniśreṣṭho mahāmune \|*  
*śubhe kṣaṇe gṛhītvā tāṃ suṣvāpa nirjane priyām \|\| 44 \|\|*

*nārīrasānabhijñaḥ syādājanma munipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*tathā'pi suratau vijñaḥ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. It is surprising that the task of the noble people gets established with the mere wish. О great sage, thereafter Durvasa, the best of the sages prepared the bed for conjugal pleasures in the secluded place and enjoyed the company of his wife there. The sage Durvasa had never tasted the company of the women throughout his life still being well-versed in the art of making love, he was surprising by competent in the same. He enjoyed the company of his wife variously.

## \|\| 24.46 \|\|

*nānāprakāraṃ śṛṅgāraṃ cakāra vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*navasaṃgamamātreṇa mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa kandalī \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. With the first experience of the conjugal pleasure Kandall fainted. Since the sage himself was engrossed in the conjugal pleasure he also lost the sense about the day and night for eight days.

## \|\| 24.47 \|\|

*mūrcchāṃ prāpa muniśreṣṭho bubudhe na divāniśam \|*  
*evaṃ pratidinaṃ tatra cakāra suratiṃ mune \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Thus he daily enjoyed the company of his wife. Thus a clever person was united with the clever women.

## \|\| 24.48-50 \|\|

*vidagdhāyā vidagdhena babhūva saṃgamaḥ samaḥ \|*  
*saṃbabhūva gṛhāsaktastapastyaktvā munīśvaraḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*karoti kalahe nityaṃ kandalī svāminā saha \|*  
*munīndro bodhayāmāsa nītivākyena kāminīm \|*  
*sā tanna bubudhe kiṃcitkaroti kalahe spṛhām \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tātapradattajñānena sā na śāntā babhūva ha \|*  
*na hīyate prabodhena svabhāvo duratikramaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. Now the sage Durvasa discarded performing of tapas and was attracted towards his household affairs. Kandall on the other hand started quarrelling with her husband daily, but the sage used to speak to tell her the appropriate words, she however never cared for his words and always quarrelled with him. Even the knowledge imparted by her on father was of no use to her. Because one cannot ever-come the nature which cannot be changed with any amount of advise.

## \|\| 24.51-53 \|\|

*nityaṃ kaṭūktiṃ kāntaṃ sā karoti hetunā vinā \|*  
*jagatprakampitaṃ yena tayā kopātsa kampitaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*tayā kṛtāṃ kaṭūktiṃ ca kṣamāsaṃsthāṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa tāṃ nityaṃ sadyo mohāddayānidhiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*kaṭūktiśatakaṃ pūrṇaṃ tatkālena babhūva ha \|*  
*kṣamāṃ cakāra kṛpayā kaṭūktiṃ ca śatādhikām \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. She used to speak bitter words to her husband without any rhyme or reason shaking the entire universe. Thus he started trembling with the anger of his wife. The merciful sage used to bear all the harsh words of his wife and always started tried to convince her by with sweet words. Thus all her harsh words were ended but the sage tolerated more than hundred harsh words of his wife.

## \|\| 24.54 \|\|

*patnīkaṭūktyā niyataṃ pradagdhaṃ mānasaṃ muneḥ \|*  
*tasyāḥ kaṭūktikāriṇyāḥ karma pūrṇaṃ babhūva ha \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Thus the sage always tolerated her harsh words and all his sins for uttering harsh words were completed.

## \|\| 24.55-56 \|\|

*svātmārāmo dayāluśca kopaṃ tyaktuṃ na sa kṣamaḥ \|*  
*śaśāpa kāminīṃ mohādbhasmarāśirbhaveti ca \|\| 55 \|\|*

*muneriṅgitamātreṇa bhasmasātsā babhūva ha \|*  
*evamatyucchritānāṃ ca na kalyāṇaṃ jagattraye \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. Durvasa in spite of his being compassionate could not control his anger. He therefore, pronounced a curse on his wife, let you be reduced to a heap of dust. With the slightest indication of the sage, she was reduce to ashes. Such undisciplined women cannot meet with welfare in the three worlds.

## \|\| 24.57 \|\|

*śarīre bhasmasādbhūte pratibiṃbaḥ sa cātmanaḥ \|*  
*jīvastatrāntarikṣastho hyuvāca vinayātprabhum \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. After the burning of the body, the reflection of the soul stood in the sky and spoke to the lord.

## \|\| 24.58-60 \|\|

*jīva uvāca \|*  
*he nātha sarvadarśī tvaṃ satataṃ jñānacakṣuṣā \|*  
*sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajñaḥ kimahaṃ bodhayāmi te \|\| 58 \|\|*

*saduktirvā kaṭūktirvā kopaḥ saṃtāpa eva ca \|*  
*lobho mohaśca kāmaśca kṣutpipāsādikaṃ ca yat \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sthaulyaṃ kārśyaṃ ca nāśaśca dṛśyādṛśyaṃ samudbhavam \|*  
*sarvaṃ śarīradharmaṃ ca na jīvasya na cātmanaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

58-60. The soul said – О lord, everything is visible to you with your divine sight. Being all-knowledgeable, you know everything. Listening to the best of the words. The harsh words, anger, repentance, greed, illusion, passion, hunger, thirst, hardness, weakness, destruction, visible, invisible and taking birth are related to the human body. They are neither related with the gunas nor with the soul.

## \|\| 24.61-62 \|\|

*sattvaṃ rajastama iti śarīraṃ triguṇātmakam \|*  
*tacca nānāprakāraṃ ca nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 61 \|\|*

*kiñcitsattvātiriktaṃ ca kiñcideva rajodhikam \|*  
*tamotiriktaṃ kiñcicca na samaṃ kutracinmune \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. Having been composed of the three tattvas namely, sattva, rajas, tamas, this body is known as Trigunatmaka. This is also of various types. Listen I am access in others the rajoguna is an access while щ others, the tamoguna is found in access. Nowhere the body has all the gunas alike.

## \|\| 24.63 \|\|

*sattvodayācca muktīcchā karmecchā ca rajoguṇāt \|*  
*tamoguṇājjīvahiṃsā kopo'haṃkāra eva ca \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Because of the presence of the sattva in the body, the jlva aspires for salvation; with the increase of rajoguna, one aspires for performing actions and with the increase tamoguna, one resorts to killing with anger and pride.

## \|\| 24.64-65 \|\|

*kopātkaṭūktirniyataṃ kaṭūktyā śatrutā bhavet \|*  
*tayā cāpriyatā sadyaḥ śatruḥ kaḥ kasya bhūtale \|\| 64 \|\|*

*ko vā priyo'priyaḥ kaḥ kiṃ kiṃ mitraṃ ko ripurbhavet \|*  
*iṃdriyāṇi ca bījāni sarvatra śatrumitrayoḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. The harsh words emanate from the anger and the enmity emerges from harsh words and because of enmity one becomes an enemy in no time. Otherwise who is the enemy of whom on earth? Who is liked and disliked? Who is the friend and who is the foe? All the organ of senses are responsible for friendship and enmities.

## \|\| 24.66 \|\|

*prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartuḥ prāṇādhikā priyā \|*  
*babhūva śatrutā sadyo duruktyā ca kṣaṇāddvayoḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The husband is dearer to a wife more than her life and so is the case with the husband. In spite of that because of my foul words an enmity was created between us in no time.

## \|\| 24.67 \|\|

*yadgataṃ tadgataṃ sarvaṃ kāmadoṣeṇa vai prabho \|*  
*kṣamāparādhaṃ nikhilaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadādhunā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. O lord, whatever has happened because of passion, better forgive it no you kindly forgive me and tell me what is to be done by me now.

## \|\| 24.68 \|\|

*kiṃ karomi kva yāmīti bhavitā kutra janma me \|*  
*tava nānyasya jāyā'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi jagattraye \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. "Where should I go and where shall L be bom?" I shall not accept anyone else as a husband in the three worlds.

## \|\| 24.69 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā jīvaśca maunībhūto babhūva ha \|*  
*mūrcchāmavāpa sa muniḥ śokena hṛtacetanaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Thus speaking, the soul kept quiet and the sage fell on earth loosing his consciousness.

## \|\| 24.70 \|\|

*svātmārāmo mahājñānī jahāra cetanāmaho \|*  
*strīvicchedo vidagdhānāṃ sarvaśokātparātparaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. It is really surprising that the sage who had been the great intellect so lost his senses. Indeed, for the virtuous people the separation of the wife happens to be the greatest of all the griefs.

## \|\| 24.71-73 \|\|

*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ \|*  
*tatra yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā cakāra vāyudhāraṇam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tatra jagāma brāhmaṇo'rbhakaḥ \|*  
*daṇḍī chatrī raktavāsā bibhratti lakamuttmam \|\| 72 \|\|*

*sasmitaḥ śyāmavarṇaśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā \|*  
*vayasā'tiśiśuḥ śānto jñānī vedavidāṃ varaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

71-73. In a moment after regaining consciousness he got ready to end his life. He than sat in yogasana and obstructed his breathing. In the meantime a Brahmana boy arrived there holding a danda and an umbrella, clad in red garments with the tilaka adorning his forehead, wearing a smile on his face, possessing dark complexion and illumining with divine lustre. The child was peaceful, quite learned and best of those well-versed in the Veda.

## \|\| 24.74 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā taṃ saṃbhrameṇaiva durvāsāḥ praṇanāma ha \|*

74\. Durvasa bowed in reverence to him and made him sit over a seat and than adored him with devotion.

## \|\| 24.75 \|\|

*uvāca brāhmaṇavaṭurdattvā tasmai sadāśiṣam \|*

75\. That Brahmana ascetic started conversation with the sage. With the audience of the child and receiving his blessing, the grief of the sage disappeared.

## \|\| 24.76 \|\|

*śiśurūpaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā tamuvāca vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*

76\. Remaining in the form of a child in a moment, he who was well-versed in the scriptures and polity, spoke to the sage nectar-like words which were quite appropriate for the occasion.

## \|\| 24.77-78 \|\|

*śiśuruvāca \|*

77-78. The child said – О all knowledgeable Brahmana, you are well-aware of everything because of the grace of your teacher, in spite of that you feel disheartened because of the grief. Therefore, I asked you what is the inner secret of it. The Brahmanas are meant for performing tapas and by performing tapas one can exercise control over all the three worlds. Presently what are you doing discarding your dharmaP

## \|\| 24.79-80 \|\|

*kā kasya patnī kaḥ kāntaḥ kasyā vā bhuvanatraye \|*

79-80. In the three worlds who is the wife of whom and who is the husband of whom. All the people moved with the illusion of lord Hari, Kandall happened to be your false wife, that is why she left you in a moment. The truth never disappear and the falsehood never remains for long.

## \|\| 24.81 \|\|

*ekānaṃśā ca bhaginī vasudevasutā hareḥ \|*

81\. Ekanamsa the daughter of Vasudeva and sister of Krishna has been born out of the atnsha of Parvati. She is quite docile and has long life.

## \|\| 24.82 \|\|

*kalpe kalpe sundarī sā tava patnī bhaviṣyati \|*

82\. The same beautiful girl shall always remain your wife in all the kalpas. Therefore you engage yourself in tapas for sometime delightfully.

## \|\| 24.83-84 \|\|

*kandalī kadalījātirbhaviṣyati mahītale \|*

*kalpāntare śāntarūpā tava patnī bhaviṣya ti \|*

83-84. Kandall would be born on earth in the race of Kadall. In due course of time, she would become auspicious, bestower of noble results, pleasant and bestower of the progeny. She would be inaccessible and a peaceful lady and shall become your wife. The one who gets his organs of senses beyond control, he has to be subjugated; this has been ordained in the Vedas.

## \|\| 24.85 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā śīghraṃ ca viprarūpī janārdanaḥ \|*  
*dattvā jñānaṃ ca viprāya so'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. This speaking and bestowing knowledge to the Brahmana, Hari in the form of the Brahmana boy disappeared from the scene.

## \|\| 24.86 \|\|

*muniḥ sarvabhramaṃ tyaktvā tapasyāyāṃ mano dadhe \|*

86\. The sage getting relieved of all the doubts devoted himself to the performing of tapas and Kandall was born on earth in the race of Kadall.

## \|\| 24.87 \|\|

*daityastālavanaṃ gatvā babhūva gardabhākṛtiḥ \|*

87\. О sage, the demon arrived in the tala forest and was turned into a donkey and Tilottama in due course of time was born as Usha the daughter of Banasura.

## \|\| 24.88-89 \|\|

*daityendro viṣṇucakreṇa prāṇāṃstyaktvā suvāñchitam \|*

*kāle tilottamā bhūtvā jagāma svālayaṃ punaḥ \|*

88-89. The demon was killed with the cakra of Vishnu and achieved the eternal abode of lord Krishna which is beyond the reach of ever the sages. In due course of time she was born and was embraced by Aniruddha, the grandson of Krishna and ultimately she achieved her eternal abode as Tilottama.

## \|\| 24.90 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*padepade sundaraṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Thus I have spoken to you the best of the stories of lord Krishna which is charming at every step. What else do you want to listen from me.

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*

8-9. Bowing at the feet of his father-in-law, started wailing with grief. Me than narrated the entire episode to the sage from beginning to end. On hearing it, the sage Aurva fell on the ground unconscious. In spite of his being so learned a sage, he lay there fainted like a dead person.

11-12. On regaining consciousness found the grief and terror-stricken son-in-law who was standing bowing before him and crying with his eyes filled with tears which had turned red like the red lotus flower. At that point of time the spge Aurva was trembling in anger and his lips we were fluttering.

*aurva uvāca \|*

13\. Aurva said – О Brahman, you are born of the race of Atri and are the grandson of Brahma; you have for a petty fault pronounced such a great punishment of my daughter.

## \|\| 25.14 \|\|

*tvajjanma śaṃkarāṃśena śiṣyastasya jagadguroḥ \|*

## \|\| 25.15 \|\|

*anasūyā mahāsādhvī kamalāṃśā tava prasūḥ \|*

15\. Anasuya who was born out of the athsa of Lakshmi happens to be your mother. I do not know for what reason you have this type of wisdom.

## \|\| 25.16-17 \|\|

*guṇavāñjanako yasya mātā guṇavatī satī \|*

16-17. The one whose father is virtuous and the mother is an immensely chaste lady full of all the virtues, their sons can be so heartless it has been provided in the Vedas. 1 had wedded my daughter who was dearer to me than my life and had all the virtues except one blemish.

## \|\| 25.18-19 \|\|

*vāgduṣṭāyāśca daṇḍo hi parityāgaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ \|*

18-19. Even in the Vedas it has been provided to disown a wife who is foul spoken. In case you had disowned man and she could have been brought up the father but in spite of that your reduced my daughter to ashes. Therefore you have to meet with great humiliation. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 25.19-20 \|\|

*madapatyaṃ svalpadoṣe yato bhasmīkṛtaṃ tvayā \|*

*mahatāṃ kṣudrajantūnāṃ sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ sadā \|*  
*sraṣṭā pātā ca śāstā ca bhagavānkaruṇānidhiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. All the creatures of the world are created, maintain and destroyer while the lord who is all merciful.

## \|\| 25.21 \|\|

*ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho vilapya ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*

21\. Tfius Speaking the sage started wailing again and again uttering the name of his daughter he went back to his abode.

## \|\| 25.22 \|\|

*gate munīndre durvāsā vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ punaḥ \|*

22\. After the departure of the sage Aurva, Durvasa lamented again and again. Getting deprived of the divine knowledge, his grief went on increasing.

## \|\| 25.23 \|\|

*śokānalo hi kālena vicchinno jñānabhasmanā \|*

24\. Recollecting his wife again and again, he lamented continuously. He somehow got himself composed again and devoted himself towards tapas.

## \|\| 25.25 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ muneḥ śāpasya kāraṇam \|*

25\. Thus I have narrated to you the cause of the curse of the sage quite elaborate by. In due course of time Durvasa had to fgce unbearable humiliation.

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*

27-28. Narayana said – О sage, the king Ambarisa was born in solar race. He devoted his mind always at the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna. He never cared much about his merit earned by performing the good deeds.

*dhyāyate'harniśaṃ dharmī svante jñāne hariṃ mudā \|*

30\. He has been performing Ekadasi-vrata, adoring lord Krishna and performing all the connected rites.

## \|\| 25.31-32 \|\|

*sutīkṣṇaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ ca hareścakraṃ sudarśanam \|*

*brahmādibhiḥ stūyamānaṃ pūjitaṃ ca surāsuraiḥ \|*

31-32. The Sudarsana-cakra of Krishna having sixteen spokes was as illustrious as lord Hari himself, having the lustre of crores of sons and was adored by Brahma and otter gods. The lord entmsted the protection of king Ambarisa to Sudarsana-cakra which always hovered round him.

## \|\| 25.33-36 \|\|

*ekādaśīvrataṃ kṛtvā dvādaśīdivase sati \|*

*dattvā dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ suvarṇarajatādikam \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca bhojanārthamuvāsa ha \|\| 34 \|\|*

*etasminnantare viprastapasvī kṣudhito mune \|*  
*daṇḍī chatrī śuklavāsā bibhrattilakamuttamam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*jaṭilo'tikṛśastrastaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ \|*  
*tatrājagāma bhagavāndurvāsā nṛpateḥ puraḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

33-36. Once the king after performing the Ekadasi-vrata performed the usual puja on the next day and distributed gold and silver to the Brahmanas as serving them with food. While all the Brahmanas were taking food in the meantime the sage Durvasa also arrived there who was quite hungry holding a danda and an umbrella, clad in white garments, with his forehead fainted with tilakam and wearing the matted locks of hair on the head. He was quite lean and thin but terror stricken. His throat, lips and palate had dried up.

## \|\| 25.37-38 \|\|

*sa ca dṛṣṭvā munīndraṃ tamutthāya ca praṇamya ca \|*

*tasmai dattvā ''śiṣaṃ vipraḥ samuvāsa sukhāsane \|*  
*papraccha rājā taṃ prītaḥ kā''jñā te vada kāmitam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. О sage, the king finding the sage having arrived in his abode got up and welcomed him and after washing his feet with the water contained in the golden pitcher, he seated him on the golden lion-throne. The sage Durvasa also blessed him variously and took his seat. The king than asked lovingly to the sage, "What is your command for me? You Spell out your desire.".

## \|\| 25.39 \|\|

*nṛpendravacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca mahāmuniḥ \|*

39\. On hearing this, the sage said, О king I am suffering from hunger and you serve me with proper food.

## \|\| 25.40-43 \|\|

*kiṃtvaghamarṣaṇamantraṃ tu japtvā''yāmyacireṇa vai \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ pratīkṣatāṃ rājannityuktvā ca gato muniḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*gate vipre tu rājarṣiścintāṃ prāpa duratyayām \|*  
*vilokya vigataprāyāṃ dvādaśīṃ bhayasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tatra samāyāntaṃ guruṃ mudā \|*  
*natvā nivedya sarvaṃ tu nṛpatiḥ samuvāca ha \|\| 42 \|\|*

*nāyāti muniśārdūlaḥ prayāti dvādaśī tithiḥ \|*  
*saṃkaṭe'sminvidheyaṃ ca vivicya vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*śīghraṃ vada muniśreṣṭha bhadrābhadraṃ ca māmiti \|\| 43 \|\|*

40-43. I am just coming reciting the Aghamarsana mantra. Therefore you should wait for me for a moment. Thus speaking the sage left the place. After the departure of the Brahmana, the king felt extremely worried, the Dvadashi-tithi was coming to an end and as such he was afraid. In the meantime his teacher arrived there. The king bowed in reverence to him and told him everything and asked, О sage, the sage Durvasa has not returned so far and the Dvadashi-tithi is coming to end. What could be done in such a difficult time. You kindly think over it and let me know about the future course of action,

## \|\| 25.44 \|\|

*śrutvā nṛpoktiṃ tvaritamuvāca munipuṃgavaḥ \|*

44\. Listening to the words of the king, the best of the sages spoke to the king, the beneficial and truthful words which were according to the provision of the Vedas and were beneficial in results.

## \|\| 25.45 \|\|

*vaśiṣṭha uvāca \|*

45\. Vasistha said – In case the fast is broken on the thirteenth day of the moon, after the lapse of the twelfth days, the merit of the fasting is lost and the one who performs the vrata also has to face destruction.

## \|\| 25.46-49 \|\|

*brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavettasya śrutau śrutam \|*  
*bhakṣyadravyaṃ surātulyamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*na bhojayitvā mūḍhaścedatithiṃ samupasthitam \|*  
*sa trastaḥ kṣudhito bhuṅkte kumbhīpāke vrajeddhuvam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*śatavarṣaṃ tatra tiṣṭhannaraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet \|*  
*vyādhiyukto daridraśca bhavejjanmani janmani \|\| 48 \|\|*

*ato'tisūkṣmaṃ kiṃ brūmo'dhunā parama saṃkaṭe \|*  
*rakṣāṃ kuru dvayordharmaṃ samālokya vadāmi te \|\| 49 \|\|*

46-49. Besides he earns the sin of Brahmahatya. This has been ordained in the Vedas, the eatables become like wine. In case he consumes food without offering the same to the guest, who had already arrived and he has to fall in the kumbhipaka hell. Where he has to dwell for a hundred years and than has to be born as a cdndala, suffering from all ailment and poverty. Therefore at this time of danger what type of secret talk can I reveal to you. You are to protect the dharma of both. Keeping this in view I tell you.

## \|\| 25.50-51 \|\|

*upavāsaphalaṃ rakṣa kṛṣṇasya caraṇodakam \|*  
*bhuktvā śīghramapo rājaṃstadbhakṣaṇamabhakṣaṇam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*ityuktvā brahmaṇaḥ putro virarāma mahāmune \|*  
*bubhuje tajjalaṃ kiṃcitkṛṣṇapādāmbujaṃ smaran \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. By sipping the water of the lord Krishna’s feet you save the merit of fasting. О king, you therefore consume the water, the sipping of the water of the feet of lord Krishna cannot be treated as the good. О great sage, thus speaking Vasist ha, the son of Brahma kept quiet and the king with his mind, at the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna, sipped the water of the feet of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 25.52-53 \|\|

*etasminnantare brahmannājagāma munīśvaraḥ \|*  
*ciccheda kopātsarvajñaḥ svajaṭāṃ nṛpateḥ puraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tataḥ samutthitaḥ śīghraṃ puruṣo'gniśikhopamaḥ \|*  
*khaḍga hasto mahābhīmo rājendraṃ hantumudyataḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. О Brahman, in the meantime the sage Durvasa arrived there. The all knowing sage got enraged and he plucked a lock of hair, out of which an illustrious person having the lustre of the fire flame appeared, he was terrible to look at and was holding a sword in his hand. He got ready to kill the king Ambarisa.

## \|\| 25.54 \|\|

*hareścakraṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā sūryakoṭisamaprabham \|*  
*ciccheda kṛtyāpuruṣaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ chettumudyatam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. At the sight of the terrific person, the Sudarsana-cakra of lord Krishna got activated and it cut-off the head of the terrific person created by Durvasa and got ready to kill Durvasa also.

## \|\| 25.55 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā sudarśanaṃ vipro dudrāva bhayavihvalaḥ \|*  
*dvijaḥ paścāttaṃ dadarśa jvaladagniśikhopamam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. At the sight of Sudarsana-cakra, the sage Durvasa felt terrified and fled from the place followed by the Sudarsana-cakra illumining like the burning flames.

## \|\| 25.56-57 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍakramaṇaṃ kṛtvā nirviṇṇo'ti bhayākulaḥ \|*  
*taṃ ca matvā jagannāthaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 56 \|\|*

*trāhitrāhītyevamuktvā viveśa brahmaṇaḥ sabhām \|*  
*utthāya brahmā viprendraṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ mune \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. He was completely upset and went round the globe. Feeling tired he went to the abode of Brahma and took refuge with him. He uttered, "O sage, save me." Thus speaking he entered the court of Brahma. Brahma got up from a seat and enquired about his welfare.

## \|\| 25.58 \|\|

*sarvaṃ sa kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ mūlato vidhim \|*  
*śrutvā brahmā niśaśvāsa tamuvāca bhayākulaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Durvasa narrated to him the entire episode from beginning to end. On hearing this Brahma took a deep sigh and getting upset with fear, spoke to him.

## \|\| 25.59 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*haridāsaṃ vatsa śaptuṃ gato'si kasya tejasā \|*  
*rakṣitā yasya bhagavāṃstaṃ ko hantā jagattraye \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Brahma said – О son, on what base did you venture to pronounce a curse on a devotee of lord Vishnu? One who is protected by the lord, no one can cause harm to him in the three worlds.

## \|\| 25.60 \|\|

*kṣudrāṇāṃ mahatāṃ caiva bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca \|*  
*rarakṣa saṃtataṃ cakraṃ śrīharirbhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The devotees are the beloved of lord Hari and for the protection of his devotees, the ca/cra (disc) has been deputed.

## \|\| 25.61 \|\|

*yo mūḍho vaiṣṇavaṃ dveṣṭi viṣṇuprāṇasamaṃ dvija \|*  
*tasya saṃhārakartāraṃ saṃhartumīśvaro hariḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. О Brahmana, the one who feels envious of the devotees of lord Vishnu who are dearer to him like his own life are the one who tries to harm them is destroyed by lord Hari.

## \|\| 25.62 \|\|

*śīghraṃ sthānāntaraṃ gaccha vatsa trāṇaṃ na vā'dhunā \|*  
*anyathā tvāṃ mayā sārdhaṃ haniṣyati sudarśanam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О son, therefore you leave this place and go to some distant place because you cannot be saved here. Otherwise this Sudarsana-cakra will kill me also along with you.

## \|\| 25.63 \|\|

*kiṃ brahmalokaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ dagdhuṃ śaktaṃ kṣaṇena yat \|*  
*tejasā viṣṇutulyaṃ yatkenānyena nivāryate \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The Sudarsana-cakra which can destroy the Brahmaloka and the globe in a moment and the one which is as illumining as Vishnu himself, who can prevent it.

## \|\| 25.64-65 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā tato dudrāva brāhmaṇaḥ \|*  
*trasto jagāma kailāsaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ bhiyā \|\| 64 \|\|*

*kṛpānidhāna māṃ rakṣetyuvāca śaṃkaraṃ bhiyā \|*  
*na praccha kuśalaṃ sarvajño brāhmaṇaṃ śivaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. On hearing the words of Brahma sage Durvasa getting terrified, left the place and arrived at Kailasa and said to Shiva, "O merciful one, you protect me." The all-knowledgeable Shiva did not enquire from Durvasa about his welfare.

## \|\| 25.66 \|\|

*uvāca dīnadīneśaḥ saṃhartā jagatāṃ kṣaṇāt \|*  
*sthiro bhava dvijaśreṣṭha madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Lord Shiva who happens to be the protector of the down-trodden and the people in misery and can destroy all the lokas in a moment, said to Durvasa, "O best of Brahmana, be stable and listen to my words."

## \|\| 25.67 \|\|

*śaṃkara uvāca \|*  
*pautrastvaṃ jagatāṃ dhāturatreśca tanayo mune \|*  
*vedajñātā'si sarvajña mūrkhatulyaṃ tu karma te \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Shiva said – You happen to be the grandson of Brahma and the son of sage Atri. You are all-knowledgeable, well-versed in the Vedas but your actions are like fools.

## \|\| 25.68 \|\|

*vedeṣu ca purāṇeṣu setihāseṣu sarvataḥ \|*  
*nirūpito yaḥ sarveśastaṃ na jānāsi mūḍhavat \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The one who has been described as the lord of all in the Vedas, Puranas and historical Annals you are not aware of him like a fool.

## \|\| 25.69-70 \|\|

*ahaṃ brahmā ca indraśca ādityā vasavastathā \|*  
*dharmendrau ca surāḥ sarve munīndrā manavastathā \|\| 69 \|\|*

*āvirbhūtāstirobhūtā yasya bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā \|*  
*tasya prāṇādhikaṃ bhaktaṃ haṃsi tvaṃ kasya tejasā \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. With the playfully frowning of whom, myself Brahma, Indra, Adityas, Vasus, Dharmendra all the gods, the sages, the Manus are born and destroyed; his devotees are dearer to him than all the creatures on earth. By whose lustre you were going to kill the king?

## \|\| 25.71 \|\|

*ahaṃ brahmā ca kamalā durgā vāṇī ca rādhikā \|*  
*na hi bhaktātparāḥ premṇā bhaktāśca sarvataḥ priyāḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Even myself Brahma, Lakshmi, Durga, Sarasvati and Radhika are not equated by word with his devotees. He likes his devotees the best of all.

## \|\| 25.72-73 \|\|

*kṣudrāṃśca mahato bhaktāñchaśvadrakṣati yatnataḥ \|*  
*sarvāntarātmā bhagavāṃścakreṇa duḥsahena ca \|\| 72 \|\|*

*niyujya cakraṃ durvāryaṃ svātmatulyaṃ ca tejasā \|*  
*tathā'pi na pratītiśca svayaṃ gacchati rakṣitum \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. Therefore, the lord who happens to be the soul of all protects his devotees with the cakra making much efforts. He does not depend even the terrible cakra which has been deputed for the protection of his devotees and on the other hand, he himself goes for their protection.

## \|\| 25.74 \|\|

*svakīyaguṇa nāmnāṃ ca śravaṇādatisaṃbhramaḥ \|*  
*bhaktasaṅge bhramatyeva chāyeva satataṃ hariḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Listening to his qualities and the name, the lord at once follows his devotee like the shadow and moves after him.

## \|\| 25.75 \|\|

*kāntā prāṇādhikā śaśvanna hi ko'pi tato'dhikaḥ \|*  
*bhaktāndveṣṭi svayaṃ sā cettūrṇaṃ tyajati tāṃ prabhuḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Their spouses are dearer to him than their lives. No one is beyond him but they also feel envious of the devotees. In that case the lord disowns him as well.

## \|\| 25.76 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ ca priyā viprāḥ svaśarīrādapi dvija \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyaḥ priyā bhaktāḥ prāṇebhyaśca harerapi \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. О sage, the Brahmanas are dear or to the lord than his own body but the devotees are dearer to him than the Brahmanas; they are dearer to him than his life.

## \|\| 25.77 \|\|

*īśvarasya priyaḥ ko vā'priyaḥ ko vā jagattraye \|*  
*yaḥ śiṣṭastaṃ bhajecchaśvaddhyāyate satataṃ sadā \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Who is dear to the lord in the three worlds and who is otherwise but the noble people are always adored by him.

## \|\| 25.78 \|\|

*mahati pralaye brahmanbrahmaṇḍaughe jalaplute \|*  
*na tatra nāśo bhaktānāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca bhaviṣyati \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. О Brahmana, at the time of great dissolution when everything submerges in the water even than his devotees are never destroyed.

## \|\| 25.79 \|\|

*bhaja brāhmaṇa govindaṃ smara tasya padāmbujam \|*  
*sarvāpado vinaśyanti śrīhareḥ smaraṇādapi \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. О Brahman, you recite the prayer of Govinda and devote your mind at his lotus-like feet. All the dangers disappear with the reciting of the name of the lord.

## \|\| 25.80 \|\|

*vraja śīghraṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaḥ śaraṇaṃ tava \|*  
*dāsyatyevābhayaṃ tubhyaṃ karuṇāsāgaro vibhuḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. You at once proceed to Vaikuntha and you can take refuge there the all merciful lord will surely provide you protection.

## \|\| 25.81 \|\|

*etasminnantare vyāptaṃ kailāsaṃ cakratejasā \|*  
*yathā ca sūryakiraṇaiḥ supradīptaṃ mahītalam \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. In the meantime the entire mount Kailasa was filled with the tejas of Sudarsana-cakra like the rays of the sun.

## \|\| 25.82-84 \|\|

*dagdhā jvālākarālaiśca sarve kailāsavāsinaḥ \|*  
*trāhi trāhītyevamuktvā śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā cakraṃ durviṣahaṃ śaṃkaraḥ karuṇānidhiḥ \|*  
*pārvatyā saha saṃprītyā brāhmaṇāyāśiṣaṃ dadau \|\| 83 \|\|*

*tejaḥ satyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ yadi ceccirasaṃcitam \|*  
*kṛtāparādho bhītaśca dvijo bhavatu vijvaraḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

82-84. All the people of Kailasa felt the burning heat of Sudarsana-cakra and praising for protection arrived to take refuge with Shiva. Finding that unbearable cakra, the compassionate Shiva together with Parvati blessed Brahmana variously and pronounced a boon on him. "In case her tejas is true and the tapas earned by her since long is also true then the Brahmana, in spite of his performing a sin should be freed from the suffering from the same.".

## \|\| 25.85-86 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*yatprabhormama puṇyeṣu brāhmaṇaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ \|*  
*mamāśiṣā mahābhītyā śīghraṃ bhavatu vijvaraḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*ityevamuktvā kṛpayā virarāma śivā śivaḥ \|*  
*muniḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. Parvati said – "This Brahmana has arrived to take refuge at the feet of my lord. Let him be relieved of all the danger with my blessing." Parvati after speaking these words kept: quiet with Shiva and the sage bowing in reverence to Shiva, the lord of the gods; proceeded towards Vaikuntha for taking refuge.

## \|\| 25.87 \|\|

*gatvā vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ manoyāyī munīśvaraḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā sudarśanaṃ paścādviveśāntaḥpuraṃ hareḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. The sage Durvasa who could move with the speed of mind, reached Vaikuntha and finding the Sudarsana-cakra following him, he entered the inner apartment.

## \|\| 25.88-92 \|\|

*dadarśa śrīhariṃ vipro ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam \|*  
*śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ param \|\| 88 \|\|*

*śyāmaṃ caturbhujaṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ manoharam \|*  
*ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyaṃ ratnamālāvibhūṣitam \|\| 89 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram \|*  
*sadratnasāraracitaṃ kirīṭojjvalaśekharam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*pārṣadapravarendraiśca sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*padmāsevitapādābja sarasvatyā stutaṃ puraḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

*sunandanandakumudapracaṇḍādibhirāvṛtam \|*  
*guṇānuvādaṃ gāyantaṃ tanaḥ paśyantamīṣsitam \|\| 92 \|\|*

88-92. He found lord Hari seated on a gem-studded lion throne holding samkha, cakra, padma and gada, clad in yellow lower garment, having a dark-complexion, four arms, peaceful, lord of Lakshmi, quite pleasant, adorned with gem-studded ornaments and the garland of gems and wearing serene smile on the face. The one who bestowed his grace on his devotees, having his head adorned with the kirita crown and being served by two chowry, bearer, holding white fly-whisks. Lakshmi was serving at his lotus-like feet while Sarasvati was praising him. He was surrounded by Sunanda, Nanda, Kumuda, Prachanda and other attendants surrounded him. He was looking at his devotees who were engaged in devotion for the lord.

## \|\| 25.93 \|\|

*evaṃbhūtaṃ prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā daṇḍavatpraṇanāma ca \|*  
*tuṣṭāva sāmavedoktastotreṇa parameśvaram \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. Finding such a lord there Durvasa bowed in reverence to him and catered prayer to the lord With the stotra, contained in the Samaveda.

## \|\| 25.94-95 \|\|

*durvāsā uvāca \|*  
*trāhi māṃ kamalākānta trāhi māṃ karuṇānidhe \|*  
*dīnabandho'tidīneśa karuṇāsāgara prabho \|\| 94 \|\|*

*vedavedāṅgasaṃsraṣṭurvidhātuśca svayaṃ vidhe \|*  
*mṛtyormṛtyuḥ kālakāla trāhi māṃ saṃkaṭārṇave \|\| 95 \|\|*

94-95. Durvasa said – O Lord of Lakshmi, you save me, О ocean of mercy, you protect me; you are lord of the down-trodden and those who are in great misery. You are ocean of compassion and the lord, you are the creator of the Vedas and post-Vedic literature, beside your day being the universe and the preserver of the universe as well. You are death for the death and Kala for the Kala, you protect me from the ocean of miseries.

## \|\| 25.96-97 \|\|

*saṃhārakartuḥ saṃhāraḥ sarveśaḥ sarvakāraṇaḥ \|*  
*mahāviṣṇutarorbījaṃ rakṣa māṃ bhavasāgare \|\| 96 \|\|*

*śaraṇāgataśokārtabhayatrāṇaparāyaṇa \|*  
*bhagavannava māṃ bhītaṃ nārāyaṇa namo'stu te \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. You are the killer of those who indulge in killings. You are the lord and the cause of all, you are the seed of victory of Maha-Vishnu and you protect me from the ocean of the universe. О lord, you relieve me I have come to take refuge with you suffering from danger. You always protect those who take refuge in you. You protect me since I am in danger. О Narayana, I bow you again and again.

## \|\| 25.98-100 \|\|

*vedeṣvādyaṃ ca yadvastu vedāḥ stotuṃ na ca kṣamāḥ \|*  
*sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā kiṃ stuvanti vipaścitaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

*śeṣaḥ sahasravaktreṇa yaṃ stotuṃ jaḍatāṃ vrajet \|*  
*pañcavaktro jaḍībhūto jaḍībhūtaścaturmukhaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*śrutayaḥ smṛtikartāro vāṇī cetstotumakṣamā \|*  
*ko'haṃ vipraśca vedajñaḥ śiṣyaḥ kiṃ staumi mānada \|\| 100 \|\|*

98-100. The one who has been declared to be all sovereign in the Vedas and the glory of whom is beyond the recitation of the Vedas and Sarasvati also stands there like a dumb person, than how can ether intellectuals, praise him. Shesha with all the thousand hoods finds himself non-pulsed while offering prayer to you. Even the five-faced Shiva becomes motionless and the four-faced Brahma has to keep quiet, the Shrutis and smrtis and Sarasvatr are not competent enough to praise you. How can an ordinary person like me offered prayer to your О lord, I am well-versed in the Vedas and also the pupil of those who are well-versed in the Vedas, still I don’t have the competence to offer prayer to you.

## \|\| 25.101-102 \|\|

*manūnāṃ ca mahendrāṇāmaṣṭāviṃśatime gate \|*  
*divāniśaṃ yasya vidheraṣṭottaraśatāyuṣaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*tasya pāto bhavedyasya cakṣurunmīlanena ca \|*  
*tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca kiṃ staumi pāhi māṃ prabho \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. The one whose one day is counted with the age of twenty-eight Manus and Mahendra, the same creator remain alive for hundred and eight years. But even when they also fall only than you wink for a while. Thus the lord who is beyond description, how can I praise him. О lord, you protect me.

## \|\| 25.103 \|\|

*ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā papāta caraṇāmbuje \|*  
*nayanāmbujanīreṇa siṣeca bhayavihvalaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Thus praising the lord, Durvasa fell on his lotus-like feet and overwhelmed with fear, he started wetting his feet with his tears.

## \|\| 25.104 \|\|

*durvāsasā kṛtaṃ stotraṃ hareśca paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*puṇyadaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ jaganmaṅgalanāmakam \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. The stotra composed by Durvasa as prescribed in Samaveda is quite auspicious and create prosperity even in deserted places.

## \|\| 25.105 \|\|

*yaḥ paṭhetsaṃkaṭagrasto bhaktiyuktaśca saṃyataḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇastaṃ kṛpayā śīghramāgatya rakṣati \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. The one who recites the same at the time of danger and practices it the lord Narayana arrived to protect him gracefully.

## \|\| 25.106-107 \|\|

*rājadvāre śmaśāne ca kārāgāre bhayākule \|*  
*śatrugraste dasyubhītau hiṃsrajantusamanvite \|\| 106 \|\|*

*veṣṭite rājasainyena magne pote mahārṇave \|*  
*stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

106-107. In the royal court cremation ground, the prison in danger, getting surrounded by the enemies, while facing the wild animals, getting surrounded by the royal array and while at the time of the sinking of the ship in the great ocean whosoever recited this stotra he gets relieved of the danger. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 25.108 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*muneśca stavanaṃ śrutvā bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*prahasyovāca madhuraṃ pīyūṣavṛṣṭivanmudā \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. Narayana said – Listening to the prayer of the sage, the lord who bestowed his grace on the devotees smiled for a moment and spoke nectar-like words in sweet voice.

## \|\| 25.109 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati vareṇa me \|*  
*kiṃ tu me vacanaṃ nityaṃ śṛṇu satyaṃ sukhāvaham \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. The lord said – Get up О sage, you will meet with welfare vith my boon. But you listen to my truthful and pleasant words.

## \|\| 25.110 \|\|

*anyeṣāṃ ca bhavejjñānaṃ śrutvā śāstraṃ satāṃ mukhāt \|*  
*svamūrtimanti śāstrāṇi bhavetsantaścaranti hi \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. By listening to the scriptures from the mouth of the noble people even the lay-men achieve knowledge. The scripture travel in the form of the noble people everywhere.

## \|\| 25.111 \|\|

*karma vedaviruddhaṃ ca sarveṣāmatigarhitam \|*  
*karoti vidvāṃścejjñātvā sa ca jīvanmṛtādhikaḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. When an intellectual having all the wisdom acts against the Vedas, he can be termed as dead even when he be still alive.

## \|\| 25.112 \|\|

*purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu cetihāseṣu brāhmaṇa \|*  
*vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca mahimā śrutaḥ sarvaiśca sarvataḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. О Brahmana, in the Puranas, Vedas and the historical treatises, the glory of Vaishnavas has been highlighted which has been heard by one and all variously.

## \|\| 25.113 \|\|

*ahaṃ prāṇā vaiṣṇavānāṃ mama prāṇāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*tāneva dveṣṭi yo mūḍho mamāsūnāṃ ca hiṃsakaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. I am the life of Vaishnavas and Vaishnavas happen to be my life. Therefore whosoever is envious of them, the foot indulges in her time me with the same.

## \|\| 25.114-116 \|\|

*putrānpautrānkalatrāṃśca rājyaṃ lakṣmīṃ vihāya ca \|*  
*dhyāyante satataṃ ye māṃ ko me tebhyaḥ paraḥ priyaḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

*parā bhaktānna me prāṇā na ca lakṣmīrna śaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*na bhāratī na ca brahmā na durgā na gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

*na brāhmaṇā na vedāśca na vedajananī parā \|*  
*na gopī na ca gopālā na rādhā praṇataḥ priyāḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

114-116. The one who devotes his mind towards me disregarding his sons, grandsons, spouses, kingdom and riches no one is dearer to me than such a person. There is no one greater on earth for me than my devotees and in comparison to them Lakshmi, Shiva, Sarasvati, Brahma, Durga, Ganesha, Brahmanas, Vedas, Savitri, Cowherd Cowherdesses and all others of no consequence.

## \|\| 25.117 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ sāraṃ ca vāstavam \|*  
*na praśaṃsāparaṃ teṣāṃ te ca prāṇādhikāḥ priyāḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Thus I have spoken to you truthfully, which is the gist in reality. I have not exaggerated anything for praising my devotees, who are dearer to me than my life.

## \|\| 25.118-119 \|\|

*māṃ dviṣanti ca ye mūḍhā jñānahīnāśca vañcitāḥ \|*  
*ātmānaṃ ye na jānanti te yānti nirayaṃ ciram \|\| 118 \|\|*

*ye dviṣanti ca madbhaktānprāṇānāmadhikaṃ priyān \|*  
*teṣāṃ śāstā tvahaṃ tūrṇaṃ paratra nirayaṃ ciram \|\| 119 \|\|*

118-119. Such of the foolish and unwise people who are envious of me and are not aware of themselves, they have to fall in the hell for a long-time and those who are envious of my devotees, who are dearer to me than my life, I at once punish them and beyond life they have to suffer in the hell for long.

## \|\| 25.120 \|\|

*prabhāvo'haṃ ca sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ paripālakaḥ \|*  
*na ca vyāpī svatantro'haṃ bhaktādhīno divāniśam \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. I am the cause of everyone and the lord besides being the preserver of all but still I am not independent. I am always influenced by my devotees.

## \|\| 25.121 \|\|

*goloke vā'tha vaikuṇṭhe dvibhujaṃ ca caturbhujam \|*  
*rūpamātramidaṃ śaśvatprāṇā me bhaktasannidhau \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. In the Goloka, I appear in two-armed and in Vaikuntha, I appear as four-armed one. I have only symbolical appearance in Goloka and Vaikuntha but actually I always remain with ray devotees.

## \|\| 25.122 \|\|

*yaduktaṃ bhaktadattaṃ ca bhakṣaṇīyaṃ ca tanmama \|*  
*abhakṣyaṃ dravyamanyena dattaṃ cedamṛtopamam \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. I consume everything whatever is offered to me by my devotees but even if the nectar is offered by a non-believer to me, it is not acceptable to me.

## \|\| 25.123-124 \|\|

*aṃbarīṣaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ nirīhaṃ tamahiṃsakam \|*  
*kathaṃ haṃsi dayāśīlaṃ sarvaprāṇihite ratam \|\| 123 \|\|*

*dayāṃ kurvaṃti ye santaḥ satataṃ sarvajantuṣu \|*  
*tāndviṣanti ca ye mūḍhāsteṣāṃ hantā'hameva ca \|\| 124 \|\|*

123-124. The king Ambarlsa happens to be the best of the kings who is unattached, believes in Ahimsa, quite compassionate one and loves all the creatures. Why do you intend to kill such a noble person? The noble people who are compassionate to the creatures and such of the people who are envious of them, I destroy them.

## \|\| 25.125 \|\|

*bhaktānāṃ hiṃsakaṃ śatrumahaṃ rakṣitumakṣamaḥ \|*  
*ambarīṣālayaṃ gaccha sa tvāṃ rakṣitumīśvaraḥ \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. I am completely helpless in protecting those who are inimical to my devotees. Therefore, you approach Ambarlsa who will surely protect you.

## \|\| 25.126 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*idaṃ vākyaṃ ca tacchrutvā brāhmaṇo bhayavihvalaḥ \|*  
*viṣaṇṇamānasastasthau smarankṛṣṇapadāmbujam \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. Narayana said – On listening to the words of the lord, the Brahmanas was upset and with the disturbed mind he got upreciting the name of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 25.127 \|\|

*etasminnantare brahmā bhavānyā saha śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*dharmaścendrādayo devā ājagmurmunipuṅgavāḥ \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. In the meantime Brahma, Shiva with Parvati, Dhrama, the moon besides the sages also arrived there.

## \|\| 25.128 \|\|

*praṇamya tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. Overwhelming with the devotion of the lord, they bowed in reverence and started praising him.

## \|\| 25.129 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*svātmasvarūpa nirlipta bhaktānugrahakātara \|*  
*bhaktāparādhajanakaṃ rakṣa brāhmaṇapuṅgavam \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. Brahma said – О self illumining lord, you are uninvolved and always show mercy on your devotees, therefore you kindly protect this Brahmana, who has committed a sin against your devotees.

## \|\| 25.130 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca \|*  
*dīnabandho jagannātha nāyaṃ vipro jagadbahiḥ \|*  
*kṛtāparādhaṃ dīnaṃ ca pāhīmaṃ śaraṇāgatam \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. Shiva said – О compassionate on the down-trodden, you are the lord of the universe and this Brahmana, does not remain out of it. Therefore you protect this sinful and meek Brahmana, who has come to take refuge in you.

## \|\| 25.131 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*bhakta evāṃbarīṣaste na dvijā na surā vayam \|*  
*sarveṣāmīśvarastvaṃ ca rakṣa vipraṃ kṛtāgasam \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. Parvati said – Ambarisa happens to be your devotee. The Brahmanas, the gods all of us are also your devotees; you happen to be the lord of all therefore you protect the sinful Brahmana.

## \|\| 25.132 \|\|

*dharma uvāca \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ janakastvaṃ ca pātā daṇḍakṛdīśvaraḥ \|*  
*śiśuhetoḥ śiśuṃ hanti pitetyevaṃ kutaḥ prabho \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. Dharma said – О lord, you happen to be the creator of all, preserver and the one who punishes everyone. But where has it been provided that the father would kill one child for the sake of other.

## \|\| 25.133 \|\|

*iṃdra uvāca \|*  
*kṛpayā samatā śaśvatsarveṣu jīviṣu prabho \|*  
*aparādhaphalaṃ bhūtamadhunā pātumarhasi \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. Indra said – О lord, you are compassionate always to all the creatures. He has already suffered for his sin. You kindly protect him now.

## \|\| 25.134 \|\|

*rudra uvāca \|*  
*śāntiṃ kartuṃ samucitamucitaṃ sāṃprataṃ kuru \|*  
*kṛtakuṇṭhasya mūlasya pālanaṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. Rudra said – whatever will be done by you to make him peaceful it would be quite appropriate; now you save this handicapped fool.

## \|\| 25.135 \|\|

*dikpāla uvāca \|*  
*kṛtāparādhaṃ vipraṃ ca chettumarhasi na śrutau \|*  
*aparādhaśamaṃ kṛtvā sadā pāti sadīśvaraḥ \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. Dikpala said – It is unheard in the Vedas that a sinful Brahmana should be killed. The lord always maintains the people after forgiving for them their sins.

## \|\| 25.136 \|\|

*grahā ūcuḥ \|*  
*yo dveṣṭi vaiṣṇavaṃ mūḍhastaṃ ruṣṭā sarvadevatāḥ \|*  
*pīḍāṃ kurmo vayaṃ śaśvatpaścāttvaṃ pātumarhasi \|\| 136 \|\|*

136\. The planets said – The one who is envious of the Vaishnavas, the gods also get annoyed with the fool. We people always punish him variously and thereafter protect him.

## \|\| 25.137 \|\|

*munaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*nātha vipre parābhūte sarve jīvanmṛtā vayam \|*  
*daṇḍaṃ vidhātumekasya bhavellajjā svajātiṣu \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. The sages said – О lord, at the humiliation of this Brahmana we people feel like dead while still alive. By finding one getting humiliated, the others of the same race feel ashamed.

## \|\| 25.138 \|\|

*atriruvāca \|*  
*tvayaiva dattaḥ putro me krodhī tvatsevakaḥ sadā \|*  
*na kaṃ bibheti trailokye tejasvī tejasā tava \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. Atri said – You had bestowed a son like this, who is full of anger but always serves at your feet. Because of his illumining with your tejas, he does not care for anyone in the three worlds.

## \|\| 25.139 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*kṣamāparādhaṃ bhagavan brāhmaṇaṃ śaraṇāgatam \|*  
*stuvanti deva viprāśca na vipraṃ hantumarhasi \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. Lakshmi said – О lord, you forgive the Brahmana who has come to take refuge with you, all the gods and the Brahmanas are praying you. You please don’t commit the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 25.140 \|\|

*sarasvatyuvāca \|*  
*bodhayiṣyāmi devānāṃ janakaṃ kāmadaṃ śrutim \|*  
*bhagavansvāmī sarveṣāṃ sarvāṃśca pātumarhasi \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. Sarasvati said – О lord, you are the creator of the Vedas and fulfil the desires of all; I shall speak to you about a Shruti according to which you happen to be his protector and therefore you should protect him.

## \|\| 25.141 \|\|

*pārṣadā ūcuḥ \|*  
*bhavataḥ smṛtimātreṇa sarveṣāṃ sarvamaṅgalam \|*  
*bhavetsarvāpado yānti pāhīmaṃ śaraṇāgatam \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. The creator said – With the reciting of your name everyone meets prosperity and all the misfortunes disappear; therefore you please protect this person who has come to take refuge with you.

## \|\| 25.142 \|\|

*nartakā ūcuḥ \|*  
*dāridryabhaṃjana vayaṃ bhikṣukāstava saṃtatam \|*  
*bhikṣāṃ naḥ sāṃprataṃ dehi paritrāṇaṃ dvijasya ca \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. Nartaka said – O Lord of the removal of poverty, we had always been begging from you. Therefore you bestow the alms in the form of the protection of this Brahmana.

## \|\| 25.143 \|\|

*eteṣāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā prabhuḥ śaraṇavatsalaḥ \|*  
*prahasyovāca vacanaṃ sarvasantoṣakāraṇam \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. On hearing the words of all the gods, the lord smiled and spoke the words satisfying everyone.

## \|\| 25.144 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*sarve śṛṇuta madvākyaṃ nītiyuktaṃ sukhāvaham \|*  
*viprarakṣāṃ kariṣyāmi yuṣmākamājñayā dhruvam \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. The lord said – All of you should listen to my appropriate words which will bestow pleasure. At your command now I protect the Brahmana.

## \|\| 25.145 \|\|

*kiṃ tvayaṃ yātu vaikuṇṭhādambarīṣālayaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*karotu pāraṇaṃ tatra rājñaḥ suprītaye muniḥ \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. But this Brahmana should go from Vaikuntha to the house of Ambarlsa and he should pray to the king for his pleasure.

## \|\| 25.146 \|\|

*viprastasyātithirbhūtvā nirdoṣaṃ śaptumudyataḥ \|*  
*sudarśanaṃ tu taṃ rakṣyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hantumudyatam \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. This Brahmana being the guest of the king was about to pronounce a curse on him without any rhyme or reason. Because of that this Sudarsana-cakra got activated for the killing of this Brahmana.

## \|\| 25.147 \|\|

*pūrṇaṃ varṣamayaṃ bhīto bhramatyeva bhuvaṃ mudā \|*  
*upavāsī sa rājendraḥ sastrīkaśca śucā'nvitaḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. The terrified Brahmana has been roaming around the world for a year and since than the king Ambarlsa is fasting with his wife.

## \|\| 25.148 \|\|

*tato'hamupavāsī ca bhaktopavāsakāraṇāt \|*  
*stanāndhaṃ bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhuṅkte jananī yathā \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Because of the fasting of my devotees, I am also fasting. As the mother finding her infant fasting she herself does not take the food, I am facing the same situation.

## \|\| 25.149 \|\|

*mamāśiṣā muniśreṣṭhaḥ sadyo bhavatu vijvaraḥ \|*  
*pathi tatrāsya hiṃsāṃ ca maccakraṃ na kariṣyati \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. With my blessing, the great sage will be pleased and on the way, my cakra will not harm him.

## \|\| 25.150 \|\|

*ahamevādya niścintaḥ sukhaṃ bhokṣyāmi niścitam \|*  
*bhaktadattaṃ ca yadvastu prītyā kṛtvā sudhopamam \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. Whatever is given to me by the devotees with devotion, I accept it like nectar and consume it with pleasure.

## \|\| 25.151 \|\|

*lakṣmīdattaṃ ca yaddravyaṃ na cāhaṃ bhoktumīśvaraḥ \|*  
*vinā bhaktapradānena na tṛptiṃ dātumīśvaraḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. Unless a devotee of mine offers me something, I do not consume anything offered to me even by Lakshmi and Lakshmi is also unable to offer me anything unless it is given by the devotees.

## \|\| 25.152 \|\|

*he munīndra mahāprājña gaccha vatsa nṛpālayam \|*  
*sarve devāśca devyaśca gacchantu munayo gṛham \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. О best of the sages, O people of great wisdom, O son, you go to the king’s palace and all other gods and the goddesses should go back to their respective abodes.

## \|\| 25.153 \|\|

*ityuktvā śrīharistūrṇaṃ yayau svāntaḥpuraṃ mudā \|*  
*yayuḥ sarve mudā yuktāḥ praṇamya jagadīśvaram \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. Thus speaking lord Hari went back to his abode and all the people bowing at the feet of the lord went back to their respective homes.

## \|\| 25.154 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaśca manoyāyī jagāma nṛpamandiram \|*  
*sudarśanaṃ ca taccakraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. The Brahmana who could move with the speed of the mind, at once reached the house of the king followed by the cakra illumining like crores of suns.

## \|\| 25.155-156 \|\|

*upoṣya vatsaraṃ rājā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ \|*  
*siṃhāsanasthaḥ purato dadarśa munipuṅgavam \|\| 155 \|\|*

*utthāya saṃbhramātsadyaḥ praṇamya sādaraṃ mudā \|*  
*bhojayitvā tu miṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bubhuje svayam \|\| 156 \|\|*

155-156. Because of his fasting for one year, the throat, lips and palate of the king had dried up, seated on his throne he found the sage approaching him. The king suddenly got up and delightfully bowed before the Brahmana, served him food and thereafter he himself took food.

## \|\| 25.157-158 \|\|

*bhuktvā tuṣṭo dvijaśreṣṭho yuyuje paramāśiṣam \|*  
*jagāma svālayaṃ tūrṇaṃ praśaśaṃsa punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

*uvāca pathi viprendro manasā vismayākulaḥ \|*  
*māhātmyaṃ durlabhamaho vaiṣṇavānāmiti dvijaḥ \|\| 158 \|\|*

157-158. Getting satisfied with the food, he blessed him immensely praising the king. Thereafter, he than left for his abode; the Brahmana was surprised in his mind saying the glory of the Vaishnavas is beyond our reach.

## Chapter 26

## \|\| 26.1-2 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*dvādaśīlaṅghane doṣaḥ śrutastvanmukhato mune \|*  
*parābhavo muneścaiva nṛpatrāṇaṃ hareraho \|\| 1 \|\|*

*adhunā śrotumicchāmi sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ ca me \|*  
*ekādaśīvratasyāsya vidhānaṃ vada niścitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narada said – О sage, I have heard from you the blemish one earns by the elapse of Dvadashi. Which enshrines the defeat of the sage and the rescue of the king. Presently I would like to listen about your desire. You kindly spell out to me the details of performing of Ekadashi-vrata.

## \|\| 26.3 \|\|

*aho śrutau śrutaṃ kiṃcinmatabhedānna niścitam \|*  
*śrutīnāṃ kāraṇamukhācchrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Whatever had been provided in the Vedas cannot be taken for granted because of controversies; therefore I intend to listen the same from your mouth who happens to be the cause of shrutis.

## \|\| 26.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekādaśīvratamidaṃ devānāmapi durlabham \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaprītijanakaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tapasvinām \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said – The Ekadashi-vrata beyond the reach of gods, it represents the love of Shri Krishna and the tapas of the tapasvis.

## \|\| 26.5-9 \|\|

*devānāṃ ca yathā kṛṣṇo devīnāṃ prakṛtiryathā \|*  
*āśramāṇāṃ yathā vipro vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā śivaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yathā gaṇeśaḥ pūjyānāṃ yathā vāṇī vipaścitām \|*  
*śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedāstīrthānāṃ jāhnavī yathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*taijasānāṃ yathā svarṇaṃ prāṇināṃ vaiṣṇavo yathā \|*  
*dhanānāṃ ca yathā vidyā saṅgināṃ ca yathā priyā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*pramathānāṃ yathā rudraḥ śreyasāṃ ca yathā matiḥ \|*  
*ātmā yathendriyāṇāṃ ca cañcalānāṃ yathā manaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*gurustrīṇāṃ yathā mātā bandhūnāṃ ca yathā patiḥ \|*  
*baliṣṭhānāṃ yathā daivaṃ kālaḥ kalayatāṃ yathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

5-9. As is Shri Krishna among the gods, Prakriti among the goddesses, Brahmana among the varnas, Shiva among the Vaishnavas, Ganesha among the adorables, speech among the intellectuals, Vedas among the holy scriptures, the gold among the glittering elements, Vaishnava among the creatures, Vidya among the treasures, the wife among the companions, Rudra among the ganas, intelligence among the welfares, soul among the organs of senses, the mind among the unstable things, mother among the teachers, the husband among the relatives, the destiny among the powerful beings, the gods of death among those who could never be averted.

## \|\| 26.10-18 \|\|

*suśīlaṃ caiva mitrāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ rugyathā mune \|*  
*yathā kīrtiḥ kīrtimatāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca yathā gṛham \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yathā khalo hiṃsakānāṃ duṣṭānāṃ caiva puṃścalī \|*  
*tejasvināṃ graheśaśca sahiṣṇūnāṃ yathā kṣitiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*yathā'mṛtaṃ bhakṣaṇānāṃ dāhakānāṃ yathā'nalaḥ \|*  
*yathā śrīrdhanadātṝṇāṃ satīnāṃ ca yathā satī \|\| 12 \|\|*

*prajeśānāṃ yathā brahmā saritāṃ sāgaro yathā \|*  
*yathā sāma śrutīnāṃ ca gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca yathā'śvatthaḥ puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī yathā \|*  
*yathā mārgo hi māsānāmṛtūnāṃ ca yathā madhuḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ādityānāṃ yathā sūryo rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaro yathā \|*  
*yathā bhīṣmo vasūnāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ yathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*devarṣīṇāṃ yathā tvaṃ ca brahmarṣīṇāṃ yathā bhṛguḥ \|*  
*nṛpāṇāṃ ca yathā rāmaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo yathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*yathā sanatkumāraśca yogināṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ śarabho yathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yathā himādriḥ śailānāṃ maṇīnāṃ kaustubho yathā \|*  
*sarasvatī nadīnāṃ ca yathā puṇyasvarūpiṇī \|\| 18 \|\|*

10-18. The good nature among the friend, the disease among the enemies, the glory among the glorious people, the house among the householders, the wicked persons among the killers, the wicked women among the wicked persons, the sun among those containing lustre, the earth among those who tolerate everything, the nectar among the eatables, the fire among the things which burn, Lakshmi among the bestowers of riches, Parvati among the chaste-ladies, Brahma among the Prajapatis, the ocean among the rivers, Samaveda among the Vedas, Gayatri among the chandas, the plpala tree among the trees, Tulasi among the flowers, Margaslrsa among the months, spring among the seasons, Surya among the Adityas, Shiva among the Rudras, Bhlsma among the Vasus, Bharata among the varsas, Narada among the divine ascetic, Bhrigu among the Brahmarsis, Rama among the king, Kapila among the siddhas, Sanatkumara among the yogis, Airavata among the elephants, Sarabha among the animals, Himalaya among the mountains, kaustubha among the gems, Sarasvati among the rivers.

## \|\| 26.19-21 \|\|

*gandharvāṇāṃ citraratho yathā śreṣṭhaśca nārada \|*  
*yathā kubero yakṣāṇāṃ sumālī rakṣasāṃ yathā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*yathā śreṣṭhā ca nārīṇāṃ śatarūpā varā parā \|*  
*manūnāṃ ca yathā śreṣṭhaḥ svayaṃ svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sundarīṇāṃ yathā rambhā yathā māyā ca māyinām \|*  
*ekādaśīvratamidaṃ vratānāṃ ca varaṃ tathā \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. Chitraratha among the Gandharvas, Kubera among the Yaksas, Sumall among the Raksasas, the beautiful SatarQpa among the women, Svayambhuva Manu among the Manus, Rambha among the beautiful damsels, Bhagavati among the goddesses of illusion, similarly the Ekadasi-vrata is best of all the vratas.

## \|\| 26.22 \|\|

*kartavyaṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ nityameva ca \|*  
*yatīnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. This vrata should be performed by all the four varnas alike. It should particular be performed by the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 26.23 \|\|

*satyaṃ sarvāṇi pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca \|*  
*santyevaudanamāśritya śrīkṛṣṇavratavāsare \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. All the sire like Brahmahatya and others reside in the cooked rice during the Ekadashi-vrata.

## \|\| 26.24 \|\|

*bhuktvaitāni ca pāpāni yo bhuṅkte tatra mandadhīḥ \|*  
*ihātipātakī so'pi yātyante narakaṃ dhruvam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Therefore, the one who consumes the cooked rice on that day, he contributes to all the sins. Becoming a great sinner on the earth, he ultimately falls the hell.

## \|\| 26.25 \|\|

*ekādaśīpramāṇāni yugasaṃkhyākṛtāni ca \|*  
*kumbhīpāke mahāghore sthitvā caṇḍālatāṃ vrajet \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. For eleven yugas he has to remain in the kumbhlpaka hell and thereafter he is born as a Chandala.

## \|\| 26.26 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmavavarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde ekādaśīvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. He suffers with leprosy for seven births and thereafter he is relieved of the sins. This has been ordained by Brahma.

## \|\| 26.27 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahmanyo doṣastatra bhojane \|*  
*dvādaśīlaṅghane doṣo mayoktaśca śrutaḥ purā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О Brahman, I have narrated to you about the sin one earns by consuming food on Ekadashi day and the sin one earns by crossing the Dvadashi day and has already been explained by me which you have already listened.

## \|\| 26.28 \|\|

*daśamīlaṅghane doṣaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te \|*  
*purā śruto dharmavaktrādvedasāroddhṛto'pi ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Now I am going to tell you the sin one earns by crossing the tenth day (Dasaml-tithi). I had been enlightened on this by Dharma in earlier times which had been the essence of the Vedas.

## \|\| 26.29 \|\|

*daśamīṃ yaḥ kalāmātrāṃ mūḍho'jñānena laṅghayet \|*  
*yāti śrīstadgṛhāttūrṇaṃ śāpaṃ dattvā tu dāruṇam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The foolish person who crosses the tenth day even by fraction, the goddess Lakshmi deserts his house leaving him.

## \|\| 26.30 \|\|

*iha tadvaṃśahāniśca yaśohānirbhaveddhruvam \|*  
*ante manvantaraśatamandhakūpe vaseddvija \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. His progeny is put to harm in this birth together with his glory. Ultimately falls into the andhakiipa hell for a hundred manvantaras.

## \|\| 26.31 \|\|

*daśamyekādaśī vāpi dvādaśī yatra vāsare \|*  
*tatra bhuktvā paradine upoṣya vratamācaret \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The day on which the Dashaml, Ekadashi and Dvadashi fall, one should take his food on that day and fast during the next day.

## \|\| 26.32-34 \|\|

*dvādaśyāṃ ca vrataṃ kṛtvā trayodaśyāṃ ca pāraṇam \|*  
*dvādaśīlaṅghane doṣo vratināṃ tanna vidyate \|\| 32 \|\|*

*saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yatra prabhāte kiṃcideva sā \|*  
*tatropoṣyā dvitīyā ca parā cedyadi vardhate \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭidaṇḍātmikā yatra prabhāte ca tithitrayam \|*  
*kurvanti gṛhiṇaḥ pūrvaṃ caiva yatyādayastathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. While performing vrata of Dvadashi one should break it on Trayodasl day. In that case, one does not earn the sin of crossing the Dvadashi-tithi. In spite of there being Ekadashi on one day and on the next day if there is little of Dvadashi in the early morning, than the second day the fast should be continued. In case the tithi is extended to sixty dandas and in the early morning there is the on conglomeration of three tithis, in that case, a house-holder should perform vrata on the earlier day and not the у at is.

## \|\| 26.35-36 \|\|

*paratrānaśanaṃ kṛtvā nityakṛtyaṃ samācaret \|*  
*vrate jāgaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvatraivācaredbudhaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tatpūrvadivase nityaṃ vrate kṛtvā pare'hani \|*  
*ekādaśyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ pāraṇaṃ tu samācaret \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. The fast should be observed on the next day carrying on other daily routine. In case the Ekadashi, falls on two consecutive days, one should perform the vrata and the night awakening on the first night itself after performing vrata on the first day one should break his fast on the neat day after the elapse of Ekadashi-tithi.

## \|\| 26.37 \|\|

*vaiṣṇavānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca vidhavānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*sarvāḥ samā upoṣyāstā bhikṣūṇāṃ brahmacāriṇām \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The Vaishnavas, the yatis, the widows, the beggars and Brahmacaris should all performed the Ekadashi-vrata.

## \|\| 26.38 \|\|

*śuklāmeva tu kurvanti gṛhiṇo vaiṣṇavetarāḥ \|*  
*na kṛṣṇālaṅghane doṣasteṣāṃ vedeṣu nārada \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The people other than the Vaishnavas should performed Ekadashi-rata of the bright fortnight and while doing so they do not earn the sin of crossing the Shte/a.s7-tithi according to the Vedas.

## \|\| 26.39 \|\|

*śayanībodhinīmadhye yā kṛṣṇaikādaśī bhavet \|*  
*saivopoṣyā gṛhasthena nānyā kṛṣṇā kadācana \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The Krishna-Janma Ekadashi falling between Harishayani and Haribodhini Ekadashi should be observed by the householder who should keep the fast on that day and not on other Ekadashi days falling in the black fortnight.

## \|\| 26.40 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathito brahmannirṇayo'yaṃ śrutau śrutaḥ \|*  
*vratasyāsya vidhānaṃ ca nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О Brahman, thus I have spoken to you everything about the Ekadashi-vrata which has been prescribed in the Vedas, now I narrate to you the details of its performance.

## \|\| 26.41 \|\|

*kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ pūrvāhṇe na ca bhuṅkte punarjalam \|*  
*ekākī kuśaśayyāyāṃ naktaṃ śayanamācaret \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. On the tenth day in the early morning, after coming havisya food, one should not take even water the second time. One should sleep on the mat of kusha during the night alone.

## \|\| 26.42-44 \|\|

*brāhme muhūrte cotthāya prātaḥkṛtyaṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*nityakṛtyaṃ vidhāyātha tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret \|\| 42 \|\|*

*vratopavāsaṃ saṃkalpya śrīkṛṣṇaprītipūrvakam \|*  
*kṛtvā sandhyāṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca vidhāyāhnikamācaret \|\| 43 \|\|*

*nityapūjāṃ dine kṛtvā vratadravyaṃ samāharet \|*  
*kṛtvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ pradṛṣṭaṃ vidhibodhitam \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Thereafter getting up in the early morning in the Brahmamuhwrta, he should purify himself from all the daily routines like taking of bath, etc. Thereafter one should take a vow before lord Krishna for the observing of the fast. Then performing sandhya, one should complete all the daily routines and the adorations. Performing the ptija he should collect the material required for performing the vrata including the sixteen types of material prescribed in the scriptures.

## \|\| 26.45-46 \|\|

*āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ puṣpānulepanam \|*  
*dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca bhūṣaṇam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*gandhaṃ snānīyatāmbūle madhuparkaṃ punarjalam \|*  
*etānyāhṛtya divase vrataṃ naktaṃ samācaret \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. The sixteen types of materials include asana, the clothes, padya, arghya, flowers, sandal-paste, incense, lamp, naivedya, yajnopavlta, ornaments, fragrance, water for bathing, betel, madhuparka and the water for sipping. Collecting all these materials during the day one should perform the vrata during the night.

## \|\| 26.47 \|\|

*upaviśyāsane pūto dhṛtvā dhauteyavāsasī \|*  
*ācamya śrīhariṃ natvā svastivācanamācaret \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Getting seated Over a pure seat he should clad himself into new garments. After sipping he should bow in reverence to lord Hari and then utter svastivacana.

## \|\| 26.48 \|\|

*āropya maṅgalaghaṭaṃ dhānyādhāre śubhe kṣaṇe \|*  
*phalaśākhācaṃdanāktaṃ vedoktaṃ munibhirmudā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. He should concentrate the welfare pitcher on the fried paddy and the neck of the pitcher should be adorned with mango leaves and some fruits. The kalasas should then be painted with sandal-paste and one should perform the adoration as prescribed in the Vedas by the seers.

## \|\| 26.49-50 \|\|

*devaṣaṭkaṃ samāvāhya pṛthagdhānyaiḥ samācaret \|*  
*pūjāṃ pañcopacāraiśca prakṛṣṭaiśca vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*gaṇeśvaraṃ dinakaraṃ vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām \|*  
*saṃpūjyaitānpraṇamyātha vrataṃ kuryāddhariṃ smaran \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Thereafter he should invoke six gods on the six bundles of the paddy and then should adore them with best of the five-fold material. The six gods are Ganesha, Surya, Agni, Vishnu, Shiva and Parvati. One should recite the name of Hari after adoring them all and then start the vrata.

## \|\| 26.51-52 \|\|

*nārādhya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca yadi karma samācaret \|*  
*nityaṃ naimittikaṃ cāpi tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 51 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vratāṅgabhūtameva ca \|*  
*kaṇvaśākhoktamiṣṭaṃ ca vrataṃ śṛṇu mahāmune \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. In case anyone observes the vrata without performing the daily pUjd and other connected details, his entire effort becomes infructuous. Thus О great sage, I have explained to you the details about the performing of the vrata which have been prescribed in the Kanvashakha. Now you listen about the desired vrata.

## \|\| 26.53-54 \|\|

*sāmavedoktadhyānena dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam \|*  
*puṣpaṃ ca śirasi nyasya punardhyānaṃ samācaret \|\| 53\|\|*

*dhyānaṃ śṛṇu nigūḍhaṃ ca sarveṣāmapi vāñchitam \|*  
*na prakāśyamabhaktāya bhaktaprāṇādhikaṃ param \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. One should meditate upon lord Krishna according to the hymns prescribed in Samaveda, placing flowers on his head and than concentrate his mind. You listen to me about the extremely deep dhyanam which is desired by all. It should not be revealed to non-believers, but it is dearer to the devotees than their lives.

## \|\| 26.55 \|\|

*navīnanīrado yadvacchyāmasundaravigraham \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇacandrābhāvinindyāsyamanuttamam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The body of Shri Krishna has the complexion of the new clouds and is quite beautiful. His face is like the full-moon of the winter season and the best of all.

## \|\| 26.56 \|\|

*śaratsūryodayābjānāṃ prabhāmocanalocanam \|*  
*svāṃgasauṃdaryaśobhābhī ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. His eyes resembled the blossomed lotus flower of the winter season. His body was adorned with various types of ornaments studded with gems, which add to the beauty of his body.

## \|\| 26.57 \|\|

*gopīlocanakoṇaiśca prasannairatisūcakaiḥ \|*
