*śaśvannirīkṣyamāṇaṃ tatprāṇairiva vinirmitam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The eyes of the delightful cowherdesses always looked at him with side-glances continuously, as if the body of the lord was created out of the lives of the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 26.58 \|\|

*rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rāsollāsasamutsukam \|*  
*rādhāvaktraśaraccandrasudhāpānacakorakam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. He is enshrined in the middle of the Rasamandala and is quite anxious to perform the divine dance and he is looking at the lotus-like face of Radha which resembles the full moon of the winter season, like the partridge bird.

## \|\| 26.59-61 \|\|

*kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam \|*  
*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sadratnasāranirmāṇaṃ kirīṭojjvalaśekharam \|*  
*vinodamuralīnyastahastaṃ pūjyaṃ surāsuraiḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ brahmādīnāṃ ca vanditam \|*  
*kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ yastamīśvaramahaṃ bhaje \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. His chest is adorned with kaustubha-gem and the garland of Parijata flowers; his forehead is adorned with the kirlta-mukuta studded with the best of gems. He playfully holds the flute in his hand and is adored by the gods and demons alike. He is difficult to achieve even with deep meditation. The gods like Brahma and others adore him. He happens to be the cause of all the causes. I adore the lord.

## \|\| 26.62 \|\|

*dhyātvā'nena tamāvāhya copahārāṇi ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*dattvā saṃpūjayedbhaktyā mantrairebhiśca nārada \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О Narada, thus meditating upon the lord, he should invoke him and should adore him reciting mantras with devotion.

## \|\| 26.63 \|\|

*āsanaṃ svarṇanirmāṇaṃ ratnasāraparicchadam \|*  
*nānācitra vicitrāḍhyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. О Parmeshvara, you kindly accept the asana which is made of gold studded with the best of gems and decorated with paintings.

## \|\| 26.64-65 \|\|

*vahniprakṣālitaṃ vastraṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*mūlyānirvacanīyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ rādhikāpate \|\| 64 \|\|*

*pādaprakṣālanārhaṃ ca suvarṇapātrasaṃsthitam \|*  
*suvāsitaṃ śītalaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ karuṇānidhe \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. О lord of Radhika, you kindly accept the costumes prepared by Vishvakarma, which are invaluable and are pure like fire. О merciful one, for washing your feet, you accept this cool water contained in the golden pitcher.

## \|\| 26.66 \|\|

*idamarghyaṃ pavitraṃ ca śaṅkhatoyasamanvitam \|*  
*puṣpadūrvācandanāktaṃ gṛhyatāṃ bhaktavatsala \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. О beloved of the devotees, you kindly accept this auspicious arghya contained in the base of shamkha (conch).

## \|\| 26.67 \|\|

*suvāsitaṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ candanāgurusaṃyutam \|*  
*sadyaste prītijanakaṃ gṛhyatāṃ sarvakāraṇa \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. О cause of everything, you kindly accept the sandal-paste and aguru besides the white flowers.

## \|\| 26.68 \|\|

*candanāgurukasūrīkuṅkumośīramutmam \|*  
*sarveṣsitamidaṃ kṛṣṇa gṛhyatāmanulepanam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. О lord Krishna, you accept this paste made of sandal, aguru, kasturi and saffron besides khasa, which is desired by all.

## \|\| 26.69 \|\|

*raso vṛkṣaviśeṣasya nānādravyasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*sugandhiyuktaḥ sukhado dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. You kindly accept the incense which has been created out of the juice of a special tree, mixed with various materials, fragrance and is quite pleasant.

## \|\| 26.70-71 \|\|

*divāniśaṃ supradīpto ratnasāravinirmitaḥ \|*  
*punardhvāntanāśabījaṃ dīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 70 \|\|*

*nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi svādūni surabhīṇi ca \|*  
*coṣyādīni pavitrāṇi svātmārāma pragṛhyatām \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. You kindle this lamp of gems which bums throughout the day and night and is the cause for removing all the darkness. О lord, who roams in the soul, you kindly accept all the delicious eatables which are quite tasteful and are scented.

## \|\| 26.72 \|\|

*sāvitrīgranthisayuktaṃ svarṇatantuvinirmitam \|*  
*gṛhyatāṃ devadeveśa racitaṃ cāru kāruṇā \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. О lord of the gods, you kindly accept this yajnopavha which has been sanctified with the knot of Gayatri mantra and is made of the gold by excellent artisans.

## \|\| 26.73 \|\|

*amūlyaratnaracitaṃ sarvā vayavabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*tviṣā jājvalyamānaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ nandanandana \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. О son of Nanda, you accept these costly ornaments of gold studded with the best of gems which are illumining and can adore all the limbs of the body.

## \|\| 26.74 \|\|

*pradhāno varṇanīyaśca sarvamaṅgalakarmaṇi \|*  
*pragṛhyatāṃ dīnabandho gandho'yaṃ maṅgalapradaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. O merciful for the down-trodden, you accept this fragrance which is the best of all the auspicious ones, praise-worthy and bestows welfare.

## \|\| 26.75 \|\|

*dhātrī śrīphalapatrotthaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ manoharam \|*  
*vāñchitaṃ sarvalokānāṃ bhagavanpratigṛhyatām \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. cufksn у4\<я1ч\> м1 О lord, you kindly accept this Vishnu-oil which has been prepared from the myrobalan and the leaves of the wood apples and is quite pleasant and desired by all.

## \|\| 26.76 \|\|

*vāñchanīyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam \|*  
*mayā niveditaṃ nātha tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. O lord, you kindly accept this betel which has been scented with camphor and is liked by all which is offered by me.

## \|\| 26.77 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ prītijanakaṃ sumiṣṭaṃ madhuraṃ madhu \|*  
*sadratnasārapātrasthaṃ gopīkānta pragṛhyatām \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. О lord of the cowherdesses, you kindly accept this honey which increases love, is quite sweet and is contained in several vases of gems.

## \|\| 26.78 \|\|

*nirmalaṃ jāhnavītoyaṃ supavitraṃ suvāsitam \|*  
*punarācamanīyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ madhusūdana \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. О lord Madhusiidana, you kindly accept this extremely purified water for sipping which contains fragrance and the water of the Ganga.

## \|\| 26.79-80 \|\|

*iti ṣoḍaśopacārāndattvā bhakto mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*mantreṇānena puṣpāṇi mālyaṃ dattvā prayatnataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*nānāprakārapuṣpaiśca grathitaṃ śuklatantunā \|*  
*pravaraṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca mālyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ prabho \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. Thus the devotee should perform the sixteen-fold adoration and should offer the garland of flowers. О lord Krishna, you kindly accept the garland of white flowers which have been entwined in a white cord.

## \|\| 26.81 \|\|

*iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyānmūlamantreṇa ca vratī \|*  
*kuryāttatstavanaṃ bhaktyā puṭāñjaliyutaḥ sudhīḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Thus a wise devotee should offer the flowers filled in the hand-cups and adore the lord offering prayers.

## \|\| 26.82 \|\|

*bhakta uvāca \|*  
*he kṛṣṇa rādhikānātha karuṇāsāgara prabho \|*  
*saṃsārasāgare ghore māmuddhara bhayānake \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The devotee said – О Krishna, О lord of Radhika, О lord, you are the ocean of mercy and protect me from the terrible ocean or the universe, helping me to cross it.

## \|\| 26.83 \|\|

*śatajanmakṛtāyāsādudvignasya mama prabho \|*  
*svakarmapāśanigaḍairbaddhasya mokṣaṇaṃ kuru \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. О lord, I am upset because of my suffering for hundreds of births and I am bound in the fetters of the sins emanating from my own deeds. You kindly redeem me.

## \|\| 26.84 \|\|

*praṇataṃ pādapadme te paśya māṃ śaraṇāgatam \|*  
*bhavapāśabhayādbhītaṃ pāhi tvaṃ śaraṇāgatam \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. I am falling at your feet, you look at a person like me who has taken refuge with you. I am entangled with the human bondages of the universe and I have come to take refuge with you. You kindly protect me.

## \|\| 26.85 \|\|

*bhaktihīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ vidhihīnaṃ ca vedataḥ \|*  
*vastumantravihīnaṃ yattatsaṃpūrṇaṃ kuru prabho \|\| 85\|\|*

85\. О lord, I am devoid of devotion, am actionless, devoid of the Vedic knowledge, the riches and the mantras', therefore, you kindly make me complete.

## \|\| 26.86 \|\|

*vedoktavihitā'jñānātsvāṅgahīne ca karmaṇi \|*  
*tvannāmoccāraṇenaiva sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaveddhare \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. О lord Hari, unaware of the provisions of the Vedas I have performed the adoration which may be having some short-comings in performance or the reciting of names, which should be overlooked by you.

## \|\| 26.87 \|\|

*iti stutvā taṃ praṇamya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām \|*  
*mahotsavaṃ vidhāyātha kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vratī \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Thus reciting the prayers to the lord and bowing before him one should offer daksina to the Brahmanas and the performer should remain awake during the night with rejoicing.

## \|\| 26.88 \|\|

*kṛtvā vratopavāsaṃ ca yadi nidrāṃ niṣevate \|*  
*punareva jalaṃ bhuṅkte vratārdhaphalabhāgbhavet \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. In case anyone goes to sleep while performing the vrata or drinks water then half of its merit is lost.

## \|\| 26.89 \|\|

*yatnena ca haviṣyānnaṃ sakṛdeva samācaret \|*  
*mantreṇānena viprendra śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇaṃ smaran \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. О best of the Brahmana, reciting the name of the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna, one should take the food left over from the yajna.

## \|\| 26.90 \|\|

*annaṃ hi prāṇināṃ prāṇā brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā \|*  
*dehi me viṣṇurūpaṃ tvaṃ vratopavāsayoḥ phalam \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. О food, you are the form of Vishnu and were created by Brahma in the form of life; therefore you bestow on me the reward for my performing the vrata and fasting.

## \|\| 26.91 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā bhārate vratamuttamam \|*  
*pūrvānsapta parānsapta svātmānamuddhareddhruvam \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Thus one should perform the vrata with devotion on the land of Bharata and one who does so, redeems seven earlier and seven coming generations.

## \|\| 26.92 \|\|

*mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ caiva śvaśrūṃ ca śvaśuraṃ sutām \|*  
*jāmātaraṃ tathā bhṛtyamuddharenniścitaṃ naraḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. The person who performs the vrata redeems his mother, brother, mother-in-law, father-in-law. daughter and even the servants.

## \|\| 26.93 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra śrīkṛṣṇacaritavratam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāramaparaṃ kathayāmi te \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. О Brahmana, I have narrated to you the story of lord Krishna which is quite pleasant, provides welfare and salvation; now you listen to another story.

## Chapter 27

## \|\| 27.1-3 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*gopīnāṃ vastraharaṇaṃ varadānaṃ manīṣitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*hemante prathame māsi gopikāḥ kāmamohitāḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ bhaktyā ca yāvanmāsaṃ susaṃyutāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*snātvā sūryasutātīre pārvatīṃ vālukāmayīm \|*  
*kṛtvā'vāhya ca mantreṇa pūjāṃ kurvanti nityaśaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narayana Said – О Narada, you listen, I am again narrating the life story of Krishna in which he stole away the costumes of the cowherdesses and also bestowed the desired boon to them. During the first month of the spring season, the cowherdesses infatuated with passion took the havisya food only once and controlling themselves they performed the vrata with devotion for a month. They went to the river Yamuna, taking a bath in it and making an image of Parvati in sand, invoked her with the mantras and performed her pitja.

## \|\| 27.4-9 \|\|

*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiśca manoharaiḥ \|*  
*nānāprakārapuṣpaiśca mālyairbahuvidhairapi \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairvastrairnānāphalairmune \|*  
*maṇimuktāpravālaiśca vādyairnānāvidhairapi \|\| 5 \|\|*

*he devi jagatāṃ mātaḥ sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇi \|*  
*nandagopasutaṃ kāntamasmabhyaṃ dehi suvrate \|\| 6 \|\|*

*mantreṇānena deveśīṃ parihāraṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*tataḥ kṛtvā tu saṃkalpaṃ pūjayan mūlamantrataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*mantrastu sāmavedokto'yātayāmaḥ sabījakaḥ \|*  
*oṃ śrīdurgāyai sarvavighnavināśinyai nama iti \|\| 8 \|\|*

*puṣpaṃ mālyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā śubham \|*  
*mantreṇānena tadbhaktyā daduḥ sarvā mudānvitāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

4-9. O sage, they offered the sandal-paste, a gum, kasturl, saffron, various types of flowers and flower garlands, incense, lamp, eatables, several types of fruits, gems and jewels and with the sound of musical instrument they used to recite. "O goddess, we are performing the best of the vrata', you are the mother of the universe besides being its creator, preserver and the destroyer, therefore you bestow on us Krishna the son of Nanda as our husband. Reciting this mantra making the image of goddess Parvati in sand, taking a vow and recited the basic mantra. The mantra that has been prescribed in the Samaveda is like this … Reciting this mantra the cowherdesses offered to the goddess flower garlands, eatables, incense, lamps and all other materials with devotion.

## \|\| 27.10-11 \|\|

*pravālamālayā bhaktyā cemaṃ mantraṃ sahasradhā \|*  
*japaṃ kṛtvā ca stutvā ca praṇemuḥ śirasā bhuvi \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye sarvakāmaprade śive \|*  
*dehi me vāñchitaṃ devi namaste śaṃkarapriye \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Thereafter holding the coral rosary in their hands they recited this mantra a hundred times and bowing their heads on the ground, they prayed in reverence to her thus, "O beloved of Shiva, О Shiva, you bestow all the welfare on the people and fulfil all the wishes. О goddess, I bow in reverence to you, let our wish be fulfilled.".

## \|\| 27.12 \|\|

*ityuktvā ca namaskāraṃ kṛtvā dattvā ca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*naivedyāni ca sarvāṇi brāhmaṇebhyo yayurgṛham \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thus speaking and bowing in reverence they offered eatables to the BrShmanas besides giving away daksina to them.

## \|\| 27.13 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*stavarājaṃ śṛṇu mune tuṣṭuvuryena pārvatīm \|*  
*bhaktyā gopāṅganāḥ sarvāḥ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradām \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Narayana said – О sage, now you listen to the great stotra reciting which the cowherdesses adored Parvati for the fulfilment of their desires.

## \|\| 27.14-15 \|\|

*jagatyekārṇave ghore rudrasūryavivarjite \|*  
*añjanākāratoyena saṃplute ca carācare \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dattaṃ purā brahmaṇe ca hariṇā jalaśāyinā \|*  
*tasmai dattvā sarvamidaṃ nidrāṃ bheje jagatpatiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. When the entire universe was submerged in water in the earlier times leaving no trace of the sun, the moon and the water had completely submerged all the moveable and immovable of the earth. Thereafter Vishnu reclining in the water imparted knowledge of the stotra to Brahma. After bestowing the knowledge of this stotra, Vishnu the lord of the universe was over-powered by yoganidra.

## \|\| 27.16 \|\|

*nābhipadme jagatsraṣṭā madhunā kaiṭabhena ca \|*  
*pīḍitaḥ parituṣṭāva mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thereafter, Brahma who had emerged, seated on the lotus flowers, the stalk of which emerged from the navel of Vishnu, was paralysed by Madhu and Kaitabha. At that point of time Brahma adored the goddess Miila-Prakriti.

## \|\| 27.17-19 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*durge śive'bhaye māye nārāyaṇi sanātani \|*  
*jaye me maṅgalaṃ dehi namaste sarvamaṅgale \|\| 17 \|\|*

*daityanāśārthavacano dakāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|*  
*ukāro vighnanāśārthaṃ vācako vedasaṃmataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*repho rogaghnavacano gaśca pāpaghnavācakaḥ \|*  
*bhayaśatrughnavacanaścākāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Brahma said – О Durga, О Shiva, you are fearless, Maya, NarayanI and eternal Jaya, you provide welfare to me. You bestow welfare on all. I bow in reverence to you, the word ^ of Durga for the destruction of the demons; 'З stands for the removal of the obstruction, this is the meaning derived according to the Vedas. T in the word Durga stands for removal of the diseases and т stands for destruction of the sins and зп stands for destruction of the enemies.

## \|\| 27.20 \|\|

*smṛtyukti smaraṇādyasyā ete naśyanti niścitam \|*  
*ato durgā hareḥ śaktirhariṇā parikīrtitā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. With the reciting of the name of Durga the daityas and all other obstructions disappear. This is the reason why Durga has been termed as the true sakti of the lord by Hari himself.

## \|\| 27.21 \|\|

*vipattivācako durgaścākāro nāśavācakaḥ \|*  
*durgaṃ naśyati yā nityaṃ sā durgā parikīrtitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Otherwise the word stands for misfortune and 3tt stands for the destruction of the same. Therefore the one who always destroys misfortune is called Durga.

## \|\| 27.22-24 \|\|

*durgo daityendravacano'pyākāro nāśavācakaḥ \|*  
*taṃ nanāśa purā tena budhairdurgā prakīrtitā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*śaśca kalyāṇavacana ikārotkṛṣṭavācakaḥ \|*  
*samūhavācakaścaiva vākāro dātṛvācakaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śreyaḥsaṅghotkṛṣṭadātrī śivā tena prakīrtitā \|*  
*śivarāśirmūrttimatī śivā tena prakīrtitā \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. In another interpretation of Daityendra, stands for the demons and зтт stands for their destroyer. Since the goddess had destroyed demons in earlier times that is why the intellectual called her as Durga. In the word Shiva, … stands for the best and .. stands for the combination and … stands for the giver. Therefore the one who provides welfare to all, she is called Shiva, she happens to be the treasure of the welfare, that is why she is called Shiva.

## \|\| 27.25 \|\|

*śivo hi mokṣavacanaścākāro dātṛvācakaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ nirvāṇadātrī yā sā śivā parikīrtitā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. In another interpretation, the word fire has been used for moksa or redemption and зтт stands for the one who provides the same, therefore the word Shiva also means the one who provides salvation.

## \|\| 27.26 \|\|

*abhayo bhayanāśoktaścākāro dātṛvācakaḥ \|*  
*pradadātyabhayaṃ sadyaḥ sā'bhayā parikīrtitā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The word Abhaya stands for removing of danger and зп stands for the one who provides the same. Since she provides protection from all the dangers she is known as Abhaya.

## \|\| 27.27 \|\|

*rājyaśrīvacano māśca yāśca prāpaṇavācakaḥ \|*  
*tāṃ prāpayati yā sadyaḥ sā māyā parikīrtitā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. In the interpretation of Raja-Lakshmi, … stands for riches and m stands for the one who bestows the same; therefore the one who bestows all the riches is called Maya.

## \|\| 27.28 \|\|

*māśca mokṣārthavacano yāśca prāpaṇavācakaḥ \|*  
*taṃ prāpayati yā nityaṃ sā māyā parikīrtitā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Otherwise in the meaning of moksa nr stands for moksa and … stands for the giver. Therefore she is known as Maya because she bestows redemption from the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 27.29-30 \|\|

*nārāyaṇārdhāṅgabhūtā tena tulyā ca tejasā \|*  
*sadā tasya śarīrasthā tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*nirguṇasya ca nityasya vācakaśca sanātanaḥ \|*  
*sadā nityā nirguṇā yā kīrtitā sā sanātanī \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Since she is born out of half the body of Narayana and because of her remaining in the body of Narayana she is also called NarayanI. The word Sanatana is used for the eternal principle or the one who is without qualities. Therefore since she always remains without qualities she is also called Sanatanl.

## \|\| 27.31-32 \|\|

*jayaḥ kalyāṇavacano yākāro dātṛvācakaḥ \|*  
*jayaṃ dadāti yā nityaṃ sā jayā parikīrtitā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sarva maṅgalaśabdaśca saṃpūṇaiśvaryavācakaḥ \|*  
*ākāro dātṛvacanastaddātrī sarvamaṅgalā \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. The word Jaya stands for welfare and зп stands for the giver. Since she provides victory to everyone, she is given the name of Jaya. The word Sarvamangala stands for all the fortunes and зп stands for the giver. Therefore the one who bestows all the fortunes is called Sarvamangala.

## \|\| 27.33-34 \|\|

*nāmāṣṭakamidaṃ sāraṃ nāmārthasahasaṃyutam \|*  
*nārāyaṇena yaddattaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipaṅkaje \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tasmai dattvā nidritaśca babhūva jagatāṃ patiḥ \|*  
*madhukaiṭabhau durgāṃ tau brahmāṇaṃ hantumudyatau \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. These eight names of the goddess represent the essence of this stotra which provides the meaning of her name as well. Narayana had bestowed the knowledge of this stotra to Brahma who was seated on the lotus emerging from the navel of Vishnu. After bestowing the knowledge to Brahma, lord Vishnu was over-powered by sleep. Thereafter two demons named Madhu and Kaitabha intended to kill Brahma.

## \|\| 27.35 \|\|

*stotreṇānena sa brahmā stutiṃ natvā cakāra ha \|*  
*sākṣātstutā tadā durgā brahmaṇe kavacaṃ dadau \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Thereafter, Brahma adored Durga reciting this stotra and bowed in reverence to her. After the offering of prayer to Durga, she herself appeared on the scene and provided a kavacha to Brahma.

## \|\| 27.36 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇakavacaṃ divyaṃ sarvarakṣaṇanāmakam \|*  
*dattvā tasmai mahāmāyā sā'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Bestowing the knowledge of Sarvamangala, (all protector), kavacha to Brahma, Mahamaya disappeared.

## \|\| 27.37-39 \|\|

*stotraṃ kurvanti nidrāṃ ca saṃrakṣya kavacena vai \|*  
*nidrānugrahataḥ sadyaḥ stotrasyaiva prabhāvataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tatrājagāma bhagavānvṛṣarūpī janārdanaḥ \|*  
*śaktyā ca durgayā sārdhaṃ śaṃkarasya jayāya ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sarathaṃ śaṃkaraṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā ca nirbhayaṃ dadau \|*  
*atyūrdhvaṃ prāpayāmāsa jayā tasmai jayaṃ dadau \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. By protecting himself with kavacha, Brahma started reciting the prayer. With the influence of the stotra, the goddess of sleep taking to the form of a bull accompanied by Durga and lord Janardana arrived there for the victory of Shiva. The lord carried Shiva together with his chariot on his head and relieving him of all the dangers, raised him up. The goddess Jaya bestowed victory to him.

## \|\| 27.40 \|\|

*stotrasyaiva prabhāveṇa saṃprāpya kavacaṃ vidhiḥ \|*  
*varaṃ ca kavacaṃ prāpya nirbhayaṃ prāpa niścitam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. With the influence of this stotra Brahma received kavacha and by receiving kavacha and the boon, he became fearless.

## \|\| 27.41 \|\|

*brahmā dadau maheśāya stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ varam \|*  
*tripurasya ca saṃgrāme sarathe patite harau \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. During the battle with Tripurasura, when Shiva fell down with his chariot, Brahma bestowed this kavacha to Shiva.

## \|\| 27.42 \|\|

*brahmāstraṃ ca gṛhītvā sa sanidraṃ śrīhariṃ smaran \|*  
*stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ prāpya jaghāna tripuraṃ haraḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. After receiving this kavacha, stotra from Brahma, Shiva recited the name of Hari who was engrossed in sleep. Shiva then killed the demon Tripurasura.

## \|\| 27.43 \|\|

*stotreṇānena tāṃ durgāṃ kṛtvā gopālikā stutim \|*  
*lebhire śrīhariṃ kāntaṃ stotrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The cowherdesses adored Durga, reciting this stotra and with the influence of the goddess they achieved the lord as their husband.

## \|\| 27.44-45 \|\|

*gopakanyā kṛtaṃ stotraṃ sarvamaṅgalanāmakam \|*  
*vāṃchitārthapradaṃ sadyaḥ sarvavighnavināśanam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca mānavaḥ \|*  
*śaivo vā vaiṣṇavo vā'pi śākto durgātpramucyate \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Thus this stotra is called Sarvamangala composed by the cowherdesses fulfils the desires, removes all the obstructions and by reciting it thrice a day with devotion by all including all the Vaishnavas, Saivas and Saktas, one is relieved of all the dangers.

## \|\| 27.46-50 \|\|

*rājadvāre śmaśāne ca dāvāgnau prāṇasaṃkaṭe \|*  
*hiṃsrajantubhayagrasto magnaḥ pote mahārṇave \|\| 46 \|\|*

*śatrugraste ca saṃgrāme kārāgāre vipadgate \|*  
*guruśāpe brahmaśāpe bandhubhede ca dustare \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sthānabhraṣṭe dhanabhraṣṭe jātibhraṣṭe śucā'nvite \|*  
*patibhede putrabhede khalasarpaviṣānvite \|\| 48 \|\|*

*stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa sadyo mucyeta nirbhayaḥ \|*  
*vāṃchitaṃ labhate sadyaḥ sarvaiśvaryamanuttamam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*iha loke harerbhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ ca satataṃ smṛtim \|*  
*ante dāsyaṃ ca labhate pārvatyāśca prasādataḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

46-50. By reciting this stotra one achieves success and freedom in the royal court, cremation ground, forest fire, in danger from the wild animals, getting terrified from the terrific creatures, at the time of sinking of a ship in the great ocean, getting surrounded by the enemies in the battle-field, in the prison, at the time of misfortune, during the curse of the teacher, curse of the Brahmanas, separation from the close relatives, falling from the position, becoming pauper, falling from the caste, having been plunged in grief, during separation from husband or the son, when in pain, having been bitten by the wicked serpent, whosoever recites this stotra he is relieved of all the dangers and is also freed from the same. One achieves the riches according to the best of his desires.

## \|\| 27.51 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmavaivarte gopakanyākṛtaṃ sarvamaṃgalāstotram \|*  
*anena stavarājena tuṣṭuvurnityamīśvarīm \|*  
*praṇemuḥ parayā bhaktyā yāvanmāsaṃ vrajāṅganāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. With the grace of Parvati, he achieves the infallible devotion of the lord in this world. If he recites his name regularly he ultimately achieves his slavehood. The cowherdesses of Vraja reciting this stotra adored Durga with utmost devotion bowing in reverence to her for one month regularly.

## \|\| 27.52 \|\|

*evaṃ pūrṇe ca māse ca samāptidivase tathā \|*  
*snātuṃ prajagmurgopyaśca vastrāṇyādhāya tattaṭe \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. After the completion of the month on the last day, the cowherdesses went to the bank of Yamuna and keeping their costumes on the banks they entered the river water.

## \|\| 27.53-57 \|\|

*nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi ratnamūlyāni nārada \|*  
*pītalohitaśuklāni cārūṇi miśritāni ca \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tīrāvṛtānyasaṃkhyāni taiśca tīraṃ suśobhanam \|*  
*candanāgurukastūrī vāyunā surabhīkṛtam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*naivedyaiśca bahuvidhaiḥ kāladeśodbhavaiḥ phalaiḥ \|*  
*dhūpaiḥ pradīpaiḥ sindūraiḥ kuṅkumaiśca virājitam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*jale krīḍonmukhā gopyo babhūvuḥ kautukena ca \|*  
*nagnāḥ krīḍābhirāsaktāḥ śrīkṛṣṇārpitamānasāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaśca vastrāṇi dravyāṇi vividhāni ca \|*  
*vāsāṃsyādāya vastūni cakhāda śiśubhiḥ saha \|\| 57 \|\|*

53-57. О Narada, all the costumes which were as costly as the gems with red, blue, white and mixed colours were lying on the bank of the Yamuna. They were numberless. The bank of the Yamuna looked quite charming with the presence of those costumes. The entire bank was filled with the fragrance of sandal, aguru, kasturl and a fragrant wind was blowing. Various types of eatables, fruits, available during the season, the incense, vermilion and saffron were adding to the beauty of the river Yamuna. After their entry into the water, the cowherdesses were about to start the water-sports. In the meantime Krishna arrived there and saw the various types of costumes lying on the bank of the Yamuna. He therefore reached over the river bank with all the cowherds. They took charge df all the costumes and started consuming all the eatables lying there.

## \|\| 27.58 \|\|

*gatvā dūraṃ ca gopālāstasthuḥ sarve mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*vastrāṇi puṃjīkṛtyādāvūcuḥ skandhe'tilolupāḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. All the cowherds delightfully went to a distant place. All the naughty boys made a bundle of the clothes and placing it over the shoulders, they started talking.

## \|\| 27.59-60 \|\|

*śrīdāmā ca sudāmā ca vasudāmā tathaiva ca \|*  
*subalaśca supārśvaśca śubhāṅgaḥ sundarastathā \|\| 59 \|\|*

*candrabhāno vīrabhānaḥ sūryabhānastathaiva ca \|*  
*vasubhāno ratnabhāno gopālā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. The cowherds like Shridama, Sudama, Vasudama, Subala, Suparsva, Subhanga, Sundara, Chandrabhana, Virabhana, Suryabhana and Vasubhana besides Ratnabhana happened to be the twelve main cowherds.

## \|\| 27.61 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇo baladevaśca pradhānāśca caturdaśa \|*  
*gopā harervayasyāśca koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo mune \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Adding Krishna and Balabhadra to the number they are counted as fourteen. О sage, otherwise there were crores of cowherds who were friendly with Krishna.

## \|\| 27.62-63 \|\|

*vastrāṇyādāya te sarve tasthurekatra dūrataḥ \|*  
*śataśaḥ puñjikāstatra sthāpayāmāsurunmukhāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*kiṃcidvastraṃ samādāya kṛtvā ca puñjikāṃ mudā \|*  
*samāruhya kadambāgramuvāca gopikā hariḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. Carrying the costumes of the cowherdesses they moved at a distance and they made hundreds of bundles of those costumes. Thereafter lord Krishna carried some of the bundles with him and climbed over a kadamba tree and said to the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 27.64 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhobho gopālikāḥ sarvā vinaṣṭā vratakarmaṇi \|*  
*kṛtvā vidhānaṃ madvākyaṃ śrutvā krīḍata manmathāt \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Shri Krishna said – "O cowherdesses, you have been unsuccessful in the performing of this vrata." You first listen to my words and then observe all the prescribed rites. Only after that you can play with the god of love.

## \|\| 27.65 \|\|

*saṃkalpite vratārhe ca māse maṅgalakarmaṇi \|*  
*yūyaṃ nagnāḥ kathaṃ toye vratāṅgahānikārikāḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The month in which the vrata has been performed, the welfare ceremonies have been performed, in the same month all of you after getting unrobed have entered the water. Why did you do so? By doing this you are desecrating your vrata and creating harm for yourself.

## \|\| 27.66-67 \|\|

*paridheyāni vāsāṃsi puṣpamālyāni yāni ca \|*  
*vratārhāṇi ca vastūni kena nītāni vo'dhunā \|\| 66 \|\|*

*vrate tu nagnā yā snāti tāṃ ruṣṭo varuṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*varuṇānucarāścakrurvāsovastūpanirhṛtim \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Who has carried away your costumes, the flower garlands and the things required in the vrata? If a woman takes her bath after unrobing herself during the vrata, lord Varuna gets annoyed with her. The attendants of Varuna have carried away your costumes.

## \|\| 27.68-70 \|\|

*kathaṃ yāsyatha nagnāśca na vratasyā bhaviṣyati \|*  
*vratārādhyā kathaṃ sā ca vastūni kiṃ na rakṣati \|\| 68 \|\|*

*cintāṃ kuruta tāṃ pūjyāṃ tuṣṭāva balirīśvarīm \|*  
*yuṣmākamīdṛśī devī na śaktā vasturakṣaṇe \|\| 69 \|\|*

*kathaṃ vrataphalaṃ sā vā dātuṃ śaktā sureśvarī \|*  
*phalaṃ pradātuṃ yā śaktā sā śaktā sarvakarmaṇi \|\| 70 \|\|*

68-70. Now how will you return without robes on and what shall happen to your vrata? Could the goddess who is adored by you not protect your costumes and other things? You now remember your great goddess who is quite adorable. You please her with your prayer. Is your goddess unable to protect your belongings? If it is not like that then how could she bestow the reward of vrata on you? The one who is competent to bestow the reward of vrata, can also be competent enough to perform all the deeds.

## \|\| 27.71-72 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā cintāmāpurvrajastriyaḥ \|*  
*dadṛśuryamunātīraṃ vastravastuvihīnakam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*cakrurviṣādaṃ toye ca nagnāstā rurudurbhṛśam \|*  
*kva gatāni ca vastrāṇi vastūnītyūcuratra naḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. On hearing the words of Krishna all this cowherdesses felt deeply concerned; they found that their costumes which they had placed on the bank of the Yamuna were missing together with other things which they had placed there. Standing in the water without robes on they were filled with grief and started crying and said, "How could our costumes and other things have disappeared from the river bank?"

## \|\| 27.73 \|\|

*kṛtvā viṣādaṃ tatraiva tamūcurgopakanyakāḥ \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyutāḥ sarvā bhaktyā vinayapūrvakam \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Getting upset all the cowherdesses prayed to Krishna with devotion folding their hands.

## \|\| 27.74-76 \|\|

*gopālikā ūcuḥ \|*  
*paridheyāni vastrāṇi kiṃkarīṇāṃ sadīśvara \|*  
*nibodhayātmānameva sparśaṃ kartuṃ tvamarhasi \|\| 74 \|\|*

*vratārhāṇi ca vastūni devasvāni ca sāmpratam \|*  
*adattāni mocitāni grahītuṃ vedavidvada \|\| 75 \|\|*

*dehi dhautāni dhṛtvā ca kariṣyāmo vrataṃ vayam \|*  
*vastunā'nyena govinda vastūnāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ kuru \|\| 76 \|\|*

74-76. The cowherdesses said – О supreme lord, you happen to be the lord of the slaves like us therefore you consider our costume which are to be worn by us as your own. You have every right to touch them but the things which we have got to be offered during the vrata are dedicated to the adorable goddess and without offering the same to her, it would not be proper to carry them back. О best of those well-versed in the Vedas, you return our costumes wearing which we shall perform our vrata. О Govinda, you consume all other things for yourself.".

## \|\| 27.77 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra śrīdāmā vastrapuñjikām \|*  
*darśayitvā ca tāḥ sarvā dūraṃ dudrāva tatpuraḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. In the meantime Shridama arrived there with the bundle of clothes and showing the same to them, he fled away from the place.

## \|\| 27.78 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā savastraṃ gopālaṃ sarvāsāmīśvarī parā \|*  
*sarvā vayasyāścāvavāca kopayuktā jalaplutā \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Finding that the cowherd was carrying their costumes Radhika, the adorable of all the cowherdesses, while remaining in the water felt annoyed and addressing the cowherdesses she said.

## \|\| 27.79-83 \|\|

*śrīrādhikovāca \|*  
*he suśīle śaśikale he candramukhi mādhavi \|*  
*kadambamāle he kunti yamune sarvamaṅgale \|\| 79 \|\|*

*he padmamukhi sāvitri pārijāte ca jāhnavi \|*  
*sudhāmukhi śubhe padme he gauri he svayaṃprabhe \|\| 80 \|\|*

*kālike kamale durge he sarasvati bhārati \|*  
*apūrṇe rati he gaṃge cāmbike sati sundari \|\| 81 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇapriye madhumati campe candananandini \|*  
*yūyaṃ sarvāḥ samutthāya baddhvā''nayata ballavam \|\| 82 \|\|*

*sarvā rādhājñayā tūrṇaṃ samutthāya jalātkrudhā \|*  
*prajagmurgopikā nagnā yonimācchādya pāṇinā \|\| 83 \|\|*

79-83. Radhika said – О Sushila, Shashikala, Chandramukhi, Madhavi, Kadambamali, Kunti, Yamuna, Sarvamangala, Padmamukhi, Savitri, Parijata, Jahnavi, Sudhamukhi, Subha, Padmi, Gauri, Svyamprabha, Kalika, Kamala, Durga, Sarasvati, Bharti, Apurva, Rati, Ganga, Ambika, Sundari, Krishnapriya, Madhumati, Champa, Chandananandini, all of you should get up and capture the cowherds. At the command of Radhika, all the cowherdesses emerged from the water and covering their pelvic region with hands they rushed towards the cowherds.

## \|\| 27.84 \|\|

*etāsāṃ sahacāriṇyo gopyastūrṇaṃ sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*prajagmustena rūpeṇa kopādāraktalocanāḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Thousands of their attendant cowherdesses also came out of the water and started running after them in the same way.

## \|\| 27.85 \|\|

*vegena dudruvuḥ sarvāḥ śrīdāmānaṃ ca bālikāḥ \|*  
*vegena ca pradhāvantaṃ bibhrataṃ vastrapuṃjikām \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. All the damsels started running after Shridama who was running carrying the bundle of clothes with him.

## \|\| 27.86-87 \|\|

*jagāma śīghraṃ śrīdāmā yatra gopāḥ sahāṃśukāḥ \|*  
*javena dudruvurgopyastatpaścādbalasaṃyutāḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*vastracorāṃśca gopāṃśca veṣṭayāmāsurāśu tāḥ \|*  
*bhiyā pradudruvurbālā yatra kṛṣṇaḥ sahāṃśukaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. In the meantime Shridama arrived at the place were all the cowherds were seated together with the costumes. All the cowherdesses rushed to the place forcibly and surrounded the cowherds who had stolen the costumes, but all the cowherds getting terrified rushed to the place of Krishna, where he was carrying all the saris with him.

## \|\| 27.88-89 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇasahitānbālānvarayāmāsurāśu ca \|*  
*gopikānāṃ bhiyā gopā dadurvastrāṇi mādhavam \|\| 88 \|\|*

*mādhavaḥ sthāpayāmāsa skandhe skandhe tarostathā \|*  
*kadambavṛkṣaḥ śuśubhe vastrairnānāvidhairapi \|\| 89 \|\|*

88-89. The cowherdesses reaching there surrounded the boys as well as Krishna. Terrified of the cowherdesses, the boys gave away all the clothes to Madhava and Madhava placed all the clothes on the trunk of the tree. With the placing of various types of costumes on the kadamba tree, it looked quite fine.

## \|\| 27.90 \|\|

*vastrāṇāṃ puṃjikāḥ sarvāḥ skandheṣu vinidhāya ca \|*  
*uvāca gopikāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ parihāsaparaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Thus placing all the bundles of clothes, on the trunk of the trees, Shri Krishna started rejoicing and spoke the following words.

## \|\| 27.91-92 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bho bho gopālikā nagnā idānīṃ kiṃ kariṣyatha \|*  
*vastrayāñcāṃ prakartuṃ ca kurutāśu puṭāñjalim \|\| 91 \|\|*

*gatvā vadata yuṣmākamīśvarīmatha rādhikām \|*  
*karotu śīghraṃ vastrāṇāṃ yāñcāṃ kṛtvā puṭāñjalim \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. Shri Krishna said – О cowherdesses, now you tell me what you will do without robes, you beg for the costumes immediately with folded hands and tell Radhika your chief also to do so.

## \|\| 27.93-94 \|\|

*anyathā'haṃ na dāsyāmi yuṣmabhyamaṃśukāni ca \|*  
*yuṣmākamīśvarī rādhā kiṃ kariṣyati me'dhunā \|\| 93 \|\|*

*vratārādhyā ca yā devī sā vā me kiṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ brūta yūyaṃ ca rādhikām \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. Otherwise I shall not give you any clothes; what harm can Radhika, your goddess, do to me? Even otherwise what shall the goddess who is adored by you during the vrata, bring to me? All of you should go and tell this to Radhika.

## \|\| 27.95 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā tāḥ sarvā gopakanyakāḥ \|*  
*vīkṣya locanakoṇena prajagmū rādhikāntikam \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. On hearing the words of Krishna, all the cowherdesses casting their side-glances at Krishna went to Radhika their goddess.

## \|\| 27.96 \|\|

*cakrurnivedanaṃ gatvā yaduvāca hariḥ svayam \|*  
*śrutvā jahāsa sā rādhā babhūva kāmapīḍitā \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Reaching there they narrated to her whatever had been spoken by Krishna, hearing which Radhika started smiling and abounded with desire.

## \|\| 27.97 \|\|

*śrutvā tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ pulakāñcitavigrahā \|*  
*na jagāma hareḥ sthānaṃ vrīḍayā sasmitā satī \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. On hearing the words of the cowherdesses, her hair stood on end and she continued smiling but because of shyness, she could not go to the lord.

## \|\| 27.98 \|\|

*jale yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbujam \|*  
*brahmeśānantadharmāṇāṃ vandyamīpsitadaṃ param \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Thereafter, remaining in the water, she recited the name of the lord Krishna seated in yogasana and meditated upon the lotus-like feet of Krishna which are also adored by Brahma, Shiva, Ananta, Garga and others.

## \|\| 27.99 \|\|

*smāraṃsmāraṃ padāmbhojaṃ sā'śrusaṃpūrṇalocanā \|*  
*bhāvātirekātprāṇeśaṃ tuṣṭāva nirguṇaṃ param \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. With her eyes filled with tears, she devoted her mind to the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna again and again. Thereafter getting emotional and overwhelmed, she offered prayer to the lord.

## \|\| 27.100 \|\|

*. rādhikovāca \|*  
*golokanātha gopīśa madīśa prāṇavallabha \|*  
*he dīnabandho dīneśa sarveśvara namo'stu te \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. Radhika said – О lord of the Goloka, lord of the cowherdesses, my lord and lord of my life, О merciful to the down-trodden, lord of the down-trodden, the lord of all, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.101 \|\|

*gopeśa gosamūheśa yaśodānandavardhana \|*  
*nandātmaja sadānanda nityānanda namo'stu te \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. О lord of the cowherds, lord of the herd of cows, you are the one who increases the pleasure of Yashoda, the son of Nanda. You are Sadananda, Nityananda, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.102 \|\|

*śatamanyormanyubhagna brahmadarpavināśaka \|*  
*kālīyadamana prāṇanātha kṛṣṇa namo'stu te \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. You are the one, who made the anger of Indra to be infructuous. Subjugator of Kaliya, О lord of my life, О Krishna I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.103 \|\|

*śivānanteśa brahmeśa brāhmaṇeśa parātpara \|*  
*brahmasvarūpa brahmajña brahmabīja namo'stu te \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. You are the lord of Shiva, Ananta, Brahmanas, beyond everything, the form of Brahman, the knower of Brahman and the seed of Brahman, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.104 \|\|

*carācaratarorbīja guṇātīta guṇātmaka \|*  
*guṇabīja guṇādhāra guṇeśvara namo'stu te \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. You are the seed of the tree of movable and immovable beyond gunas, gunatmaka, the seed of the gunas, the base of the gunas, lord of the gunas, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.105 \|\|

*aṇimādikasiddhīśa siddheḥ siddhisvarūpaka \|*  
*tapastapasviṃstapasā bījarūpa namo'stu te \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. You are the lord of siddhis including anima, you are the form of success, the form of siddhis, the seed of tapas, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.106-108 \|\|

*yadanirvacanīyaṃ ca vastu nirvacanīyakam \|*  
*tatsvarūpa tayorbījaṃ sarvabīja namo'stu te \|\| 106 \|\|*

*ahaṃ sarasvatī lakṣmīrdurgā gaṅgā śrutiprasūḥ \|*  
*yasya pādārcanānnityaṃ pūjyā tasmai namonamaḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

*sparśane yasya bhṛtyānāṃ dhyānena ca divāniśam \|*  
*pavitrāṇi ca tīrthāni tasmai bhagavate namaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

106-108. You are beyond description, the form of inexplicable one, the seed of both, the seed of all, I bow in reverence to you. I myself, Sarasvati, Lakshmi, Durga, have become eternal by adoring at your feet always, I bow in reverence to you. By adoring whose devotees and by touching them even the sacred places are purified, I bow in reverence to such a lord.

## \|\| 27.109 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sā devī jale saṃnyasya vigraham \|*  
*manaḥ prāṇāṃśca śrīkṛṣṇe tasthau sthāṇusamā satī \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. Thus speaking and remaining in the water she completely devoted her mind and remained there motionless.

## \|\| 27.110 \|\|

*rādhākṛtaṃ hareḥ stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*haribhaktiṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca labhedrādhāgatiṃ dhruvam \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Whosoever recites the stotra composed by Radha thrice a day he achieves the devotion of the lord besides his slavehood and also achieves the place of Radha.

## \|\| 27.111 \|\|

*vipattau yaḥ paṭhedbhaktyā sadyaḥ saṃpattimāpnuyāt \|*  
*cirakālagataṃ dravyaṃ hṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca labhyate \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. Whosoever recites this stotra at the time of danger, he achieves all the fortunes and also gets back the riches which he had lost for long.

## \|\| 27.112 \|\|

*vastuvṛddhirbhavettasya prasannaṃ mānasaṃ param \|*  
*cintāgrastaḥ paṭhedbhaktyā parāṃ nirvṛtimāpnuyāt \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. There is an increase in his relatives and he always remains delightful. A person who is engrossed in many types of worries, gets relieved of the same by reciting this stotra.

## \|\| 27.113-114 \|\|

*patibhede putrabhede mitrabhede ca saṃkaṭe \|*  
*māsaṃ bhaktyā yadi paṭhetsadyaḥ saṃdarśanaṃ labhet \|\| 113 \|\|*

*bhaktyā kumārī stotraṃ ca śṛṇuyādvatsaraṃ yadi \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇasadṛśaṃ kāntaṃ guṇavantaṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 114 \|\|*

113-114. The one who is separated from the husband c= the son or the friend and during the time oi danger whosoever recites this stotra for a month, he is relieved of the entire grief. If a maid recites this stotra with devotion for a year without inteiruption, she achieves a husband whose qualities equates lord Krishna.

## \|\| 27.115-118 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmavaivarte śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe rādhākṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇa stotram \|*  
*jalasthā rādhikā dhyātvā śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbujam \|*  
*stutvaivaṃ cakṣurunmīlya dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamayaṃ jagat \|\| 115 \|\|*

*dadarśa yamunātīraṃ vastradravyamayaṃ mune \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tandrā'thavā svapnamiti mene ca rādhikā \|\| 116 \|\|*

*yatra sthāne yadādhāre yaddravyaṃ saṃsthitaṃ purā \|*  
*vastraiśca sahitaṃ sarvaṃ tatprāpurgopakanyakāḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

*jalādutthāya tāḥ sarvā vrataṃ kṛtvā manīṣitam \|*  
*saṃprāpya ca varaṃ devyastā sarvāḥ svālayaṃ yayuḥ \|\| 118 \|\|*

115-118. Radhika adored at the lotus-like feet of Krishna while remaining in water as a result of which when she opened her eyes she found Krishna everywhere. The bank of Yamuna was found by her filled with all the costumes. At the sight of the same, Radhika realised than she was dreaming. Whatever things were placed on the bank of the river were all received by the cowherdesses together with their costumes. Thereafter all the cowherdesses coming out of the water performed their vrata appropriately pleasing the goddess and receiving boons from her.

## \|\| 27.119 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*vratasya kiṃ vidhānaṃ ca kiṃ nāma kiṃ phalaṃ prabho \|*  
*kāni dravyāṇi deyāni kā deyā tatra dakṣiṇā \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. Narada said – О lord, how is that vrata performed? What is its name and the reward? What are the things required for the same and what is the type of daksina to be offered for it?

## \|\| 27.120 \|\|

*vratānte kiṃ rahasyaṃ ca babhūva sumanoharam \|*  
*vyāsaṃ kṛtvā mahābhāga vada nārāyaṇīṃ kathām \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. О virtuous one, at the end of the vrata what was the pleasant secret revealed? You kindly speak out the story of Narayana in detail.

## \|\| 27.121 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*kathāṃ kathitumārebhe kavīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. Sflta said – On hearing the words of Narada, Narayana the best of the sages, who happens to be the teacher of all the teachers and the poet smiled and started speaking.

## \|\| 27.122 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sarvaṃ vratavidhānaṃ ca matto vatsa niśāmaya \|*  
*khyātaṃ gaurīvrataṃ nāma mārge māsi kṛtaṃ striyā \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Narayana said – О son, you listen to me in detail, the method of performing the vrata is called Gmn-vrata. This vrata was performed by the ladies in the month of Agahana.

## \|\| 27.123 \|\|

*puṃsāṃ ca dharmakāmārthamokṣadaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktidam \|*  
*deśabhede prasiddhaṃ ca vrataṃ paurvāparaṃ smṛtam \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. It also bestows dharma, artha, kama and moks a besides the devotion of lord Krishna to the people. It is popular in many regions of the country. It continues from the ancient traditions.

## \|\| 27.124-125 \|\|

*kāmadaṃ kāmukānāṃ ca phalaṃ kāntanimittakam \|*  
*upoṣya pūrvadivase vastraṃ prakṣālya saṃyatā \|\| 124 \|\|*

*prātaśca mārgasaṃkrāntyāṃ bhaktyā gatvā sarittaṭam \|*  
*dhṛtvā dhaute ca snātvā ca nānādravyeṇa kanyakā \|\| 125 \|\|*

124-125. It fulfils the desires of all and one achieves the reward relating to the wife or the women. The maid should perform this vrata by controlling her mind and washing her clothes and the next day on the first day of Agahana she should go to the bank of the river with devotion and take a bath wearing two clothes.

## \|\| 27.126-127 \|\|

*devaṣaṭkaṃ ca saṃpūjya kṛtvā cāvāhanaṃ ghaṭe \|*  
*gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śivam \|\| 126 \|\|*

*durgāṃ paṃcopacāraiśca saṃpūjya vratamārabhet \|*  
*ghaṭādhaḥ piṇḍikāṃ kṛtvā caturasrāṃ suvistṛtām \|*  
*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiśca susaṃskṛtām \|\| 127 \|\|*

126-127. Thereafter, the six gods like Ganesha, Stirya, Agni, Vishnu, Shiva and Durga should be invoked and five-fold adorations for them should be performed. Thereafter starting the vrata a pedestal should be made over which the pitcher should be consecrated. It should be decorated with sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl and saffron, delightfully.

## \|\| 27.128 \|\|

*nirmāya bālukānāṃ ca durgāṃ daśabhujāṃ parām \|*  
*dhṛtvā kapāle sindūraṃ tadadhaścandanendukam \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. Thereafter an image of ten-armed Durga should be made in sand and the vermilion should be applied on the head and the lower part of the body should be plastered with sandal-paste and camphor.

## \|\| 27.129 \|\|

*tāṃ dhyātvā''vāhayeddevīṃ tato bhūtvā puṭāñjaliḥ \|*  
*imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhitvā''dau tataḥ pūjāṃ samārabhet \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. Thereafter the goddess should be invoked with great devotion and with folded hands, the following s/otra should be recited saying,

## \|\| 27.130 \|\|

*he gauri śaṃkarārdhāṅgi yathā tvaṃ śaṃkarapriyā \|*  
*tathā māṃ kuru kalyāṇi kāntakāntāṃ sudurlabhām \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. It means "O Gauri, better half of lord Shiva, О KalyanI, as you are beloved of lord Shiva, you also make me the beloved of my husband."

## \|\| 27.131 \|\|

*imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhitvā tu dhyāyeddevīṃ jagatprasūm \|*  
*dhyānaṃ tatsāmavedoktaṃ nigūḍhaṃ sarvakāmadam \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. Reciting this mantra, one should meditate upon the goddess who is the mother of the universe. О Narada, this dhyanam which fulfils all the desires has been prescribed in the Samaveda.

## \|\| 27.132 \|\|

*śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi munīndrāṇāṃ ca durlabham \|*  
*dhyāyantyanena siddhāśca durgāṃ durgatināśinīm \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. О Narada, this dhyanam which is beyond the reach of the sages is being spoken by me. You listen to it. The siddhas also meditate upon Durga who is the destroyer of all the misfortunes.

## \|\| 27.133-140 \|\|

*śivāṃ śivapriyāṃ śaivāṃ śivavakṣaḥsthalasthitām \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ supratiṣṭhāṃ sulocanām \|\| 133 \|\|*

*navayauvanasaṃpannāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*ratnakaṅkaṇakeyūraratnanūpurabhūṣitām \|\| 134 \|\|*

*ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitām \|*  
*mālatī mālyasaṃsaktakabarabhramarānvitām \|\| 135 \|\|*

*sindūratilakaṃ cārukastūrībindunā saha \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukāṃ ratnakirīṭāṃ sumanoharām \|\| 136 \|\|*

*maṇīndrasārasaṃsaktaralamālāsamujjvalām \|*  
*pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālānulambitām \|\| 137 \|\|*

*supīnakaṭhinaśroṇīṃ bibhratīṃ ca stanānatām \|*  
*navayauvanabhāraughādīṣannamrāṃ manoharām \|\| 138 \|\|*

*brahmādibhiḥ stūyamānāṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhām \|*  
*pakvabimbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca cārucampakasannibhām \|\| 139 \|\|*

*muktāpaṅktivinindyaikadantarājivirājitām \|*  
*muktikāmapradāṃ devīṃ śaraccandramukhīṃ bhaje \|\| 140 \|\|*

133-140. The goddess Durga is the form of welfare known as Shiva, beloved of Shiva, Saiva, the one who resides in the heart of Shiva wearing a serene smile on her face is glorious, having beautiful eyes, youthful, adorned with the gem-studded ornament including armlets, wristlets and anklets, besides a pair of knndalas of gems in the ears, the garlands of fragrant jasmine flower adorn the neck with the garlands of jasmine flowers. Her head is adorned with a spot of kasturl and vermilion. She is clad in the best of costumes purified by fire and wearing a kirita-crown on the head, she is wearing the garland of best of gems besides the long garland of forest flowers. Her pelvic region is quite solid and developed. She carries heavy, developed breasts, looks quite youthful and is adorned by the gods like Brahma and others. She has the lustre like crores of suns and her lips resemble the ripe wood-apples; she has the complexion of beautiful campaka flowers and has the line of teeth resembling the jewels; she provides salvation and fulfils all the desires. She has the face like the full moon of the winter season, I adore goddess Parvati.

## \|\| 27.141 \|\|

*dhyātvaivaṃ mastake puṣpaṃ vinyasya ca vratī mudā \|*  
*puṣpaṃ gṛhītvā bhaktyā ca punardhyātvā ca pūjayet \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. Thus meditating upon the goddess, a devotee should place the flower on her head and again taking flower should adore her with devotion.

## \|\| 27.142 \|\|

*dattvā ṣoḍaśopacārānprahṛṣṭaṃ tatra nityaśaḥ \|*  
*pūrvoktenaiva mantreṇa mudā bhaktyā vrate vratī \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. With the above mantra of the vrata, the devotee should make six types of offerings.

## \|\| 27.143 \|\|

*pūrvoktenaiva stotreṇa stutvā ca praṇamettadā \|*  
*kṛtvā praṇāmaṃ bhaktyā ca saṃyataḥ śṛṇuyātkathām \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. Thereafter reciting the above stotra one should bow before her and concentrating her mind one should listen to the glory of the vrata of Gauri.

## \|\| 27.144-145 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*vrataṃ vratavidhānaṃ ca phalaṃ ca stotramadbhutam \|*  
*adhunā śrotumicchāmi gaurīvratakathāṃ śubhām \|\| 144 \|\|*

*vrataṃ kena kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ bhūmau kena prakāśitam \|*  
*etatsarvaṃ suvistārya vada saṃdehabhañjana \|\| 145 \|\|*

144-145. Narada said – I have listened to the glory of the vrata and the method of performing it; now I intend to listen to Gauri vrata. О remover of the doubts, who performed this vrata for the first time and who popularised it on earth, you kindly tell me in detail.

## \|\| 27.146-147 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*kuśadhvajasya hi sutā nāmnā vedavatī satī \|*  
*tayā kṛtaṃ vratamidaṃ mahātīrthe ca puṣkare \|\| 146 \|\|*

*samāptidivase sākṣādbabhūva jagadambikā \|*  
*yoginīlakṣasaṃyuktā sūryakoṭisamaprabhā \|\| 147 \|\|*

146-147. Narayana said – Kusadhvaja had a daughter named Vedavati. She performed this vrata for the first time at Puskara. At the completion of this vrata, the goddess Jagadambika appeared before her, having the lustre of crores of suns, with a lakh of yoginis and gave an audience to her.

## \|\| 27.148 \|\|

*śātakumbhavinirmāṇarathasthā parameśvarī \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā tāmuvāca susaṃyutām \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. She was riding on a chariot of gold, wearing a smile on her face. She then spoke to the self-disciplined Vedavati.

## \|\| 27.149 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*he vedavati bhadraṃ te varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam \|*  
*tava vratena tuṣṭā'haṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi vāñchitam \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. Parvati said – "O Vedavati, you will meet with welfare. Ask for a boon. I am pleased with your vrata and as such I shall bestow the boon desired by you.".

## \|\| 27.150 \|\|

*pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ hṛṣṭamānasām \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyutā sādhvī praṇamyovāca nārada \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. О Narada, on hearing the words of Parvati and finding her place, the chaste Vedavati bowed in reverence to her and said.

## \|\| 27.151 \|\|

*vedavatyuvāca \|*  
*devi nārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ mahyaṃ dehi manīṣitam \|*  
*vare'nyasminspṛhā nāsti dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ ca tatpade \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. Vedavati said – О goddess, you bestow Narayana as my husband who is desired by me. I am not interested in any other boon. You kindly bestow upon me the deep devotion of his lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 27.152 \|\|

*śrutvā vedavatīvākyaṃ prahasya jagadambikā \|*  
*avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ tāmuvāca haripriyām \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. On hearing the words of Vedavati, Jagadambika descended from her chariot smilingly and spoke to the beloved of Hari.

## \|\| 27.153-155 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*jñātaṃ sarvaṃ jaganmātastvaṃ ca lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ satī \|*  
*bhārataṃ pādarajasā pūtaṃ kartuṃ samāgatā \|\| 153 \|\|*

*tvatpādarajasā sādhvi sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā \|*  
*nikhilāni ca tīrthāni pūtāni parameśvarī \|\| 154 \|\|*

*vrataṃ te lokaśikṣārthaṃ tapaścara tapasvini \|*  
*nārāyaṇasya kāntā tvaṃ priyā janmani janmani \|\| 155 \|\|*

153-155. Parvati said – О mother of the universe, I have known everything about you. You are the chaste Lakshmi incarnate on earth and have arrived here to purify the land of Bharata with the dust of your feet. О recluse one, the earth Will get immediately purified with the touch of your lotus-like feet, О great goddess, all the sacred places have also been purified. Your this vrata is meant for educating the universe. О ascetic, you perform tapas. In every birth you will always be the beloved of Narayana and his wife as well.

## \|\| 27.156-157 \|\|

*bhārāvataraṇe viṣṇurvasudhāmāgamiṣyati \|*  
*rāmo dāśarathiḥ pūrṇaḥ kartuṃ dasyuvinigraham \|\| 156 \|\|*

*brahmaśāpācca cyutayormokṣaṇāya ca bhaktayoḥ \|*  
*ayodhyāyāṃ ca tretāyāmāvirbhāvo harerapi \|\| 157 \|\|*

156-157. Lord Vishnu will incarnate on earth in order to reduce her burden, in order to subjugate the demons, the Puma-Brahma would incarnate as Rama, the son of Dasharatha. His two attendants named as Jaya and Vijaya have fallen from Vaikuntha with the curse of the Brahmanas. In order to redeem them the lord would be born in Tretayuga in Ayodhya.

## \|\| 27.158-159 \|\|

*tvameva mithilāṃ gaccha vidhāya śiśuvigraham \|*  
*tvāmimāṃ prāpya janako'pyayonisaṃbhavāṃ sutām \|\| 158 \|\|*

*pālayiṣyati yatnena sītā tvaṃ ca bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*gatvā rāmo'pi mithilāṃ tvadvivāhaṃ kariṣyati \|\| 159 \|\|*

158-159. Taking to the form of an infant, you go to Mithila where king Janaka would adopt you as his daughter reborn without human contact and will bring you up with considerable care. You will be given the name of Sita. Rama would come to Mithila and marry you.

## \|\| 27.160-164 \|\|

*nārāyaṇasya kāntā tvaṃ kalpe kalpe bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*ityuktvā tāṃ samāliṅgya pārvatī svālayaṃ yayau \|\| 160 \|\|*

*gatvā sā mithilāṃ sādhvī śiśurūpaṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*lāṅgalasya ca rekhāyāṃ sukhāttasthau ca māyayā \|\| 161 \|\|*

*vilokya janakastāṃ ca nagnāṃ mudritalocanām \|*  
*taptakāñcanavarṇāṃ ca rudantīṃ tejasā'nvitām \|\| 162 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ca gṛhītvā ca kṛtvā vakṣasi nārada \|*  
*gacchantaṃ prati tatraiva vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī \|\| 163 \|\|*

*ayonisaṃbhavāṃ kanyāṃ kamalāṃ grahaṇaṃ kuru \|*  
*nārāyaṇaste jāmātā bhavitetyeva me vacaḥ \|\| 164 \|\|*

160-164. "In each and every kalpa you would always be the beloved wife of the lord." Thus speaking Parvati left for her abode embracing Lakshmi. The ascetic Vedavati turned herself in to the form of an infant and went to the earth and comfortably hid herself in the ploughed field. The king, Janaka, saw that an infant devoid of robes was lying on earth closing her eyes, The lustre of her limbs resembled that of the molten gold and the illustrious girl was found crying. Finding her so crying Janaka picked her up and carried her in his lap. When he was about to move from that place, there was a divine voice from the sky, "This infant girl is the form of Lakshmi and born without human contact. You accept her. In due course of time Narayana would himself be your son-in-law." This is what has to be spoken by me.

## \|\| 27.165-166 \|\|

*śrutvā tadā devavāṇīṃ gṛhītvā kanyakāmṛṣiḥ \|*  
*gatvā dadau svakāntāyai pālanāya mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 165 \|\|*

*sā labdhayauvanā prāpa rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ satī \|*  
*vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa kāntaṃ trijagatāṃ patim \|\| 166 \|\|*

165-166. The king Janaka then carried the child delightfully and handed her over to his wife for bringing her up. In due course of time when she was grown up the chaste Sita with the influence of this vrata, achieved Rama the son of Dasaratha as her husband,

## \|\| 27.167-168 \|\|

*prakāśitaṃ vaśiṣṭhena pṛthivyāṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ \|*  
*rādhā kṛtvā vratamidaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prāṇavallabham \|\| 167 \|\|*

*gopāṅganāśca taṃ prāpurvratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitā vipra kathā gaurīvratasya ca \|\| 168 \|\|*

167-168. The sage Vasistha popularised this vrata on earth with great devotion. Radhika after performing this vrata achieved lord Krishna and her beloved and the cowherdesses also achieved Krishna after performing this vrata. О Brahmana, I have thus narrated to you the details about Gauri vrata.

## \|\| 27.169 \|\|

*bhārate ca vratamidaṃ yā karoti kumārikā \|*  
*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|\| 169 \|\|*

169\. If any maid in the land of Bharata performed this vrata she achieved the husband equivalent to the glory of lord Krishna. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 27.170 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*evaṃ vrataṃ ca cakrustā yāvanmāsaṃ ca gopikāḥ \|*  
*pūrvastotreṇa tāṃ devīṃ tuṣṭuvuśca dinedine \|\| 170 \|\|*

170\. Narayana said – Thus the cowherdesses performed the vrata for one complete month. They used to recite the above in praise of the goddess, daily.

## \|\| 27.171-172 \|\|

*samāptidivase gopyo vrataṃ kṛtvā mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*kaṇvaśākhoktastotreṇa tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvarīm \|\| 171 \|\|*

*yena stotreṇa tāṃ stutvā sītā satyaparāyaṇā \|*  
*sadyaḥ saṃprāpa kāntaṃ ca rāmaṃ rājīvalocanam \|\| 172 \|\|*

171-172. At the completion of the vrata, the cowherdesses performed the vrata according to the method prescribed in the kanva-sakha and offered prayers to her, as a result of which the truthful Sita achieved the lotus eyed Rama as her husband. The same stotra has been given as follows.

## \|\| 27.173 \|\|

*jānakyuvāca \|*  
*śaktisvarūpe sarveṣāṃ sarvādhāre guṇāśraye \|*  
*sadā śaṃkarayukte ca patiṃ dehi namo'stu te \|\| 173 \|\|*

173\. Janaki said – О Shiva, you possess the prowess of all and you happen to be the base of all, you are the treasure of all the virtues and always enjoy the pleasure of the company of the lord Shiva. I bow in reverence to you, you bestow a husband on me.

## \|\| 27.174 \|\|

*sṛṣṭisthityaṃtarūpeṇa sṛṣṭisthityantarūpiṇī \|*  
*sṛṣṭisthityantabījānāṃ bījarūpe namo'stu te \|\| 174 \|\|*

174\. You are the one who creates, maintains and destroys the universe; you represent the seeds for creation, the preservation and the destruction, They represent your form. I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.175 \|\|

*he gauri patimarmajñe pativrataparāyaṇe \|*  
*pativrate patirate patiṃ dehi namostu te \|\| 175 \|\|*

175\. You are well-aware of the essence of the husband, you are devoted to your husband you are quite chaste, always attracted towards your husband; provide me a husband, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.176 \|\|

*sarvamaṃgalamāṅgalye sarvamaṃgalasaṃyute \|*  
*sarvamaṃgalabīje ca namaste sarvamaṃgale \|\| 176 \|\|*

176\. You are bestower of all the prosperity and are filled with all the welfare, you are the seed of all the welfare; therefore, О Sarvamangala, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.177 \|\|

*sarvapriye sarvabīje sarvāśubhavināśini \|*  
*sarveśe sarvajanake namaste śaṃkarapriye \|\| 177 \|\|*

177\. О beloved of lord Shiva, you are loved by all, you are the seed of all, you remove all the misfortunes, you are all and the mother of all, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.178 \|\|

*paramātmasvarūpe ca nityarūpe sanātani \|*  
*sākāre ca nirākāre sarvarūpe namo'stu te \|\| 178 \|\|*

178\. You are the form of great soul and eternal, you are visible as well as invisible, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.179 \|\|

*kṣuttṛṣṇecchā dayā śraddhā nidrā tandrā smṛtiḥ kṣamā \|*  
*etāstava kalāḥ sarvā nārāyaṇi namo'stu te \|\| 179 \|\|*

179\. Hunger, greed, desires, mercy, faith, sleep, drowsiness, memory and forgiveness are all your rays. О NarayanI, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.180 \|\|

*lajjā medhā tuṣṭipuṣṭī śāntisaṃpattivṛddhayaḥ \|*  
*etāstava kalāḥ sarvāḥ sarvarūpe namo'stu te \|\| 180 \|\|*

180\. Shyness, intelligence, satisfaction, support, peace, wealth and wisdom are all your rays. О form of all, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.181 \|\|

*dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasvarūpe ca tayorbījaphalaprade \|*  
*sarvānirvacanīye ca mahāmāye namo'stu te \|\| 181 \|\|*

181\. You have the form of visible and invisible. You bestow the seed as well as the fruit. No one can make you speechless, О virtuous one, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.182 \|\|

*śive śaṃkarasaubhāgyayukte saubhāgyadāyini \|*  
*hariṃ kāntaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ dehi devi namo'stu te \|\| 182 \|\|*

182\. О Shiva, you possess the fortunes relating to Shiva and also bestow the fortune on others; О goddess, you bestow lord Krishna as my husband, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 27.183 \|\|

*stotreṇānena yāḥ stutvā samāptidivase śivām \|*  
*namanti parayā bhaktyā tā labhante hariṃ patim \|\| 183 \|\|*

183\. On the day of completion of the vrata whosoever recites this stotra with great devotion and bows before the goddess Parvati, she surely gets lord Hari as her husband.

## \|\| 27.184 \|\|

*iha kāntasukhaṃ bhuktvā patiṃ prāpya parātparam \|*  
*divyaṃ syandanamāruhya yātyante kṛṣṇasannidhim \|\| 184 \|\|*

184\. Achieving the husband who is beyond all, she enjoys all the worldly pleasures with her husband in this world and ultimately, mounted over the divine chariot, she reaches the abode of Krishna.

## \|\| 27.185-188 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmavaivarte sītākṛtaṃ pārvatīstotram \|*  
*samāptidivase rādhā gopībhiḥ saha saṃyutā \|*  
*devīṃ praṇamya stutvā ca vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 185 \|\|*

*gosahasraṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ suvarṇaśatakaṃ mudā \|*  
*viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā svagṛhaṃ gantumudyatā \|\| 186\|\|*

*brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca bhojayāmāsa sādaram \|*  
*vādyāni vādayāmāsa bhikṣukāya dhanaṃ dadau \|\| 187 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tatra durgā durgārtināśinī \|*  
*āvirbabhūva gaganājjvalantī brahmatejasā \|\| 188 \|\|*

185-188. On the day of the completion of the vrata, Radhika offered this prayer with the cowherdesses and bowing in reverence to the goddess completed her vrata. She gave away a thousand cows to the Brahmanas, with a hundred golden cows to the Brahinana and a hundred golden coins. After giving away daksina to the Brahmanas, she was about to leave for her abode. She served food to a thousand Brahmanas gracefully and many types of musical instrument were played upon. The riches were distributed among the beggars. In the meantime Durga, the remover of all the misfortunes illumining with the divine lustre, appeared in the sky.

## \|\| 27.189 \|\|

*īṣaddhāsyaprasanāsyā yoginīśatasaṃyutā \|*  
*siṃhasthā ca daśabhujā ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā \|\| 189 \|\|*

189\. She wore a serene smile on her face and was accompanied by hundred yoginis. She was mounted over a lion, had ten arms and was adorned with the gem-studded ornaments.

## \|\| 27.190 \|\|

*śātakumbhamayādivyādralasāraparicchadāt । avaruhya rathātūrṇamāliṅgayorasi rādhikām \|\| 190 \|\|*

190\. She descended from the gem-studded chariot and embraced Radhika.

## \|\| 27.191 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā gopāṅganā devīṃ praṇemuśca mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*āśiṣaṃ yuyuje durgā vāñchāsiddhirbhaviṣyati \|\| 191 \|\|*

191\. On witnessing the goddess, the cowherdesses were overjoyed who bowed in reverence to her. Thereafter the goddess Durga blessed them saying, "The desires of all of you shall be fulfilled.

## \|\| 27.192 \|\|

*gopikābhyo varaṃ dattvā tāḥ saṃbhāṣya ca sādaram \|*  
*uvāca rādhikāṃ durgā smerānanasaroruhā \|\| 192 \|\|*

192\. Pronouncing the boon on the cowherdesses and talking to them gracefully, the goddess Durga with the smiling face spoke to Radhika.

## \|\| 27.193-195 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*rādhe sarveśvaraprāṇādadhike jagadambike \|*  
*vrataṃ te lokaśikṣārthaṃ māyāmānuṣarūpiṇi \|\| 193 \|\|*

*golokanāthaṃ golokaṃ śrīśailaṃ girijātaṭam \|*  
*śrīrāsamaṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ vṛndāvanamanoharam \|\| 194 \|\|*

*caritaṃ raticorasya strīṇāṃ mānasahārakam \|*  
*viduṣaḥ kāmaśāstrāṇāṃ kiṃsvitsmarasi sundari \|\| 195 \|\|*

193-195. Parvati said – О Radha, you are dearer to the lord of the universe more his own life. You have performed this vrata in order to educate the people. You have appeared in human form due to your illusion. О beautiful one, do you remember the life story of lord Krishna who is the lord of the Goloka, Srishaila, the banks of river Viraja, the Rasamandala and charming Vmdavana? He is well-versed in the art of making love and steals away the hearts of the women and is the one who indulges in love sports.

## \|\| 27.196 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇārdhāṅgasaṃbhūtā kṛṣṇatulyā ca tejasā \|*  
*tavāṃśakalayā devyaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 196 \|\|*

196\. You have been born out of half the body of Krishna and you are equal to him in lustre. All the goddesses have been created out of your amsha. Then you are a chaste woman.

## \|\| 27.197 \|\|

*bhavatī ca hareḥ prāṇā bhavatyāśca hariḥ svayam \|*  
*vede nāsti dvayorbhedaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 197 \|\|*

197\. You are the life of the lord and Hari himself happens to be your life. Even the Vedas project you as the one and do not speak of any difference between two. Then how could you be termed as a human being?

## \|\| 27.198 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi brahmā taptvā tapaḥ purā \|*  
*na te dadarśa pādābjaṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 198 \|\|*

198\. In earlier times Brahma meditated for a thousand years but could not have a glance at your lotus-like feet, than how could you be tenned as the human being?

## \|\| 27.199 \|\|

*kṛṣṇājñayā ca tvaṃ devi gopīrūpaṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*āgatā'si mahīṃ śānte kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 199 \|\|*

199\. О goddess, О peaceful one, you have taken to the form of a cowherdess at the command of lord Krishna and have arrived here on earth, than how could you be termed as a human being?

## \|\| 27.200-202 \|\|

*suyajño hi nṛpaśreṣṭho manuvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*tvatto jagāma golokaṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 200 \|\|*

*triḥsaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ cakāra pṛthivīṃ bhṛguḥ \|*  
*tava mantreṇa kavacātkathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 201 \|\|*

*śaṃkarātprāpya tvanmantraṃ siddhaṃ kṛtvā ca puṣkare \|*  
*jaghāna kārtavīryaṃ ca kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 202 \|\|*

200-202. Bom in the race of Manu, Suyasha, the best of the kings went to Goloka with your grace; therefore how could you be termed as a human being? Paras'urama rid the earth of the Kshatriyas twenty-one times with the influence of your mantra and kavacha; therefore how could you be a human being? He, receiving your mantra from Shiva, meditated upon it in the Puskara region and killed Kartavirya. Then how could you be a human being?

## \|\| 27.203 \|\|

*babhañja darpāddantaṃ ca gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*tvatto nāma bhayaṃ cakre kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 203 \|\|*

203\. In arrogance Parashurama broke a tusk of Ganesha. He was only afraid of you, than how could you be termed as a human being?

## \|\| 27.204 \|\|

*mayyuddhatāyāṃ kopena bhasmasātkartumīśvaraḥ \|*  
*rarakṣāgatya matprītyā kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 204 \|\|*

204\. When I was about to reduce him to ashes in anger then, О goddess, you protected him lovingly. Then how could you be termed as a human being?

## \|\| 27.205 \|\|

*kalpe kalpe tava patiḥ kṛṣṇo janmani janmani \|*  
*vrataṃ lokahitārthāya jaganmātastvayā kṛtam \|\| 205 \|\|*

205\. Lord Krishna will always be your husband, in all your future births, you are the mother of the universe and this vrata has been performed by you for the welfare of the universe?

## \|\| 27.206 \|\|

*aho śrīdāmaśāpena bhārāvataraṇena ca \|*  
*bhūmau tavādhiṣṭhānaṃ ca kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 206 \|\|*

206\. You have incarnated on earth to relieve her of her burden due to the curse of Shridama. Then how could you be termed as a human being?

## \|\| 27.207 \|\|

*ayonisaṃbhavā tvaṃ ca janmamṛtyujarāpahā \|*  
*kalāvatīsutā puṇyā kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī \|\| 207 \|\|*

207\. You are the daughter of Kalavati born without any human contact. You are meritorious and are the remover of the birth, death and old age then; how could you be termed as human being?

## \|\| 27.208-209 \|\|

*triṣu māseṣvatīteṣu madhumāse manohare \|*  
*nirjane nirmale rātrau suyogye rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 208 \|\|*

*sarvābhirgopikābhiśca sārdhaṃ vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*harṣeṇa hariṇā sārdhaṃ krīḍā te bhavitā sati \|\| 209 \|\|*

208-209. After three months, in the month of Caitra, at night in the beautiful Rasamandala of Vrindavana you will enjoy the divine dance with the lord and other cowherdesses.

## \|\| 27.210 \|\|

*vidhātrā likhitā krīḍā kalpe kalpe mahītale \|*  
*tava śrīhariṇā sārdhaṃ kena rādhe nivāryate \|\| 210 \|\|*

210\. O Radha, in every kalpa, Brahma has ordained your union with lord Hari; then how could any one stop it?

## \|\| 27.211 \|\|

*yathā saubhāgyayuktā'haṃ harasya śrīharipriye \|*  
*tathā saubhāgyayuktā tvaṃ bhava kṛṣṇasya sundari \|\| 211 \|\|*

211\. O beloved of lord Hari, beautiful one as I happen to be the spouse of the fortunate lord Shiva, similarly you are also the fortunate spouse of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 27.212 \|\|

*yathā kṣīreṣu dhāvalyaṃ yathā vahnau ca dāhikā \|*  
*bhuvi gandho jale śaityaṃ tathā kṛṣṇe sthitistava \|\| 212 \|\|*

212\. As the whiteness in milk, the burning sensation in fire, the fragrance in earth and coolness in water always remain, similarly you always remain in the heart of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 27.213 \|\|

*devī vā mānuṣī vā'pi gāndharvī rākṣasī tathā \|*  
*tvattaḥ parā ca saubhāgyā na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati \|\| 213 \|\|*

213\. There is no one more fortunate than you, among the goddesses, the women, the Gandharva damsels as well as the demonesses nor shall there be anyone in future.

## \|\| 27.214 \|\|

*parātparo guṇātīto brahmādīnāṃ ca vanditaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ kṛṣṇastavādhīno madvareṇa bhaviṣyati \|\| 214 \|\|*

214\. With the boon pronounced by me, the lord who is beyond everyone, beyond the qualities, the one adored by Brahma and other gods, the same lord Krishna would always be at your command.

## \|\| 27.215-216 \|\|

*brahmānantaśivārādhyo bhavitā tvadvaśaḥ sati \|*  
*dhyānāsādhyo durārādhyaḥ sarveṣāmapi yoginām \|\| 215 \|\|*

*tvaṃ ca bhāgyavatī rādhe strījātiṣu na te parā \|*  
*kṛṣṇena sārdhaṃ paścāttvaṃ golokaṃ ca gamiṣyasi \|\| 216 \|\|*

215-216. Brahma, Ananta, Shiva and even lord Krishna will be over-powered by you, who are beyond the conception of the yogis and whose devotion is quite difficult to achieve. Therefore, О Radha, no one else is more fortunate than you in all the universe. At last you will achieve Goloka together with Krishna.

## \|\| 27.217 \|\|

*ityuktvā pārvatī sadyastatraivāntardadhe mune \|*  
*sārdhaṃ gopālikābhiśca rādhikā gantumudyatā \|\| 217 \|\|*

217\. О sage, thus speaking Parvati disappeared from the scene at once. Thereafter Radhika also got ready to return to her abode with the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 27.218-224 \|\|

*etasminnantare kṛṣṇo jagāma rādhikāpuraḥ \|*  
*rādhā dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram \|\| 218 \|\|*

*pītavastraparīdhānaṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitam \|*  
*ājānumālatīmālāvanamālāvibhūṣitam \|\| 219 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram \|*  
*candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam \|\| 220 \|\|*

*śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ sadratnamukuṭojjvalam \|*  
*pakvadāḍimabījābhadaśanaṃ sumanoharam \|\| 221 \|\|*

*vinodamuralīhastanyastalīlāsaroruham \|*  
*koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāmamanoharam \|\| 222 \|\|*

*guṇātītaṃ stūyamānaṃ brahmānantaśivādibhiḥ \|*  
*brahmasvarūpaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ śrutibhiścānirūpitam \|\| 223 \|\|*

*avyaktamakṣarāvyaktaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*māṅgalyaṃ maṅgalādhāraṃ maṅgalaṃ maṅgalapradam \|\| 224 \|\|*

218-224. In the meantime lord Krishna appeared before Radhika. Radhika looked at Krishna who was of tender age having beautiful dark complexion, clad in pitambara, adorned with all the ornaments, wearing the garland of jasmine flowers, falling up to the knees, together with the long garland of forest flowers. His eyes resembled the lotus flower of winter season and he was having the face which resembled the full moon of the winter season. He had a gem-studded crown on his head. His teeth resembled the seeds of pomegranate. He was quite charming and held a flute in his hand playfully, together with a blue lotus flower. He was beautiful like crores of the gods of love besides being charming and beyond qualities. Brahma, Ananta, Shiva and other gods adored him. He is the form of Brahman, well-wishers of the Brahmanas, well-versed in the Shrutis, unmanifest, indestructible, manifest, form of lustre, eternal, bestower of grace, the base of welfare, the form of welfare and the bestower of welfare.

## \|\| 27.225 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tadadbhutaṃ rūpaṃ saṃbhramātpraṇanāma tam \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchitā rādhā kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā \|\| 225 \|\|*

225\. Finding Krishna in such an astonishing form, Radha felt nervous and she bowed before him. At the sight of Krishna, Radha was filled with passion and fainted.

## \|\| 27.226 \|\|

*darśaṃdarśaṃ mukhāmbhojaṃ sasmitā vakralocanā \|*  
*mukhasyācchādanaṃ cakre vrīḍayā ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 226 \|\|*

226\. Looking at the charming face of her beloved, he started smiling and in shyness she started covering her face with cloth again and again.

## \|\| 27.227 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā haristāmuvāca prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*gopālikāsamūhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 227 \|\|*

227\. Lord Hari wearing a smile on his face and with charming eyes, then stood before Radha and the group of cowherdesses and spoke to her.

## \|\| 27.228 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*prāṇādhike rādhike tvaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu manīṣitam \|*  
*bho bho gopālikā sarvā varaṃ vṛṇuta vāñchitam \|\| 228 \|\|*

228\. Shri Krishna said – О lady of my life, О Radha, you asked for a desired boon. О cowherdesses, you also spell out your desire.

## \|\| 27.229 \|\|

*kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā varaṃ vavre ca rādhikā \|*  
*gopālikāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca sarvasaṃkalpapādapāt \|\| 229 \|\|*

229\. On hearing the words of lord Krishna, Radha and all the cowherdesses felt delighted and all of them begged for their boon from Krishna who was like kalpavrksa.

## \|\| 27.230 \|\|

*rādhikovāca \|*  
*tvatpādābje manmanoliḥ satataṃ bhramatu prabho \|*  
*pātuṃ bhaktirasaṃ padme madhupaśca yathā madhu \|\| 230 \|\|*

230\. Radhika said – О lord, my mind like a black-wasp always hovers around your lotus-like feet, in order to extract the juice of devotion.

## \|\| 27.231 \|\|

*madīya prāṇanāthastvaṃ bhava janmani janmani \|*  
*tvadīyacaraṇāmbhoje dehi bhaktiṃ sudurlabhām \|\| 231 \|\|*

231\. In every birth you should be my lord and you provide us the infallible devotion of your lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 27.232 \|\|

*tava smṛtau guṇe cittaṃ svapne jñāne divāniśam \|*  
*bhavennimagnaṃ satatametanmama manīṣitam \|\| 232 \|\|*

232\. My mind, while sleeping or awake, during day and night should always recite the glory of your virtues, this is what is desired by me.

## \|\| 27.233 \|\|

*gopālikā ūcuḥ \|*  
*yathā rādhāṃ tathā naśca prāṇabandho divāniśam \|*  
*bhaviṣyasi prāṇanāthaḥ pāsyasi pratijanmani \|\| 233 \|\|*

233\. The cowherdesses said – О lord of our lives, as you are the lord of Radha in all the births and her protector, similarly you should be the same to us also.

## \|\| 27.234 \|\|

*āsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā tathā'stvevamuvāca ha \|*  
*prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānyaśodānandavardhanaḥ \|\| 234 \|\|*

234\. On hearing their words, the lord the son of Yashoda, with the smiling face said, "Be it so." Saying this he accepted their prayer.

## \|\| 27.235-236 \|\|

*krīḍāpadmaṃ rādhikāyai sahasradalasaṃyutam \|*  
*lalitāṃ mālatīmālāṃ dadau prītyā jagatpatiḥ \|\| 235 \|\|*

*mālāsamūhaṃ puṣpāṇi gopībhyo gopikāpatiḥ \|*  
*prahasya paramaprītyā pradadāvityuvāca ha \|\| 236\|\|*

235-236. Thereafter, the lord of the universe lovingly handed over a thousand petaled lotus flower to Radhika and a garland of jasmine flowers to Lalita. Thereafter Krishna, the lord of the cowherdesses, smilingly gave away to other cowherdesses flowers and garlands of flowers with utmost devotion.

## \|\| 27.237 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*triṣu māseṣvatīteṣu yūyaṃ krīḍāṃ mayā saha \|*  
*rāsamaṇḍalaramye ca vṛndāraṇye kariṣyatha \|\| 237 \|\|*

237\. Krishna said – After the expiry of three months, you will enjoy my company in the charming Rasaman4ala of Vrindavana.

## \|\| 27.238-239 \|\|

*yathā'haṃ ca tathā yūyaṃ nāhaṃ bhedaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ \|*  
*prāṇo'haṃ caiva yuṣmākaṃ yūyaṃ prāṇā mama prabhoḥ \|\| 238 \|\|*

*vrataṃ vo lokarakṣārthaṃ na hi svārthamidaṃ priyāḥ \|*  
*sahāgatāśca golokādgamanaṃ ca mayā saha \|\| 239 \|\|*

238-239. Whatever I am, you are also like me. There is no difference between us. I happen to be your life and you happen to be my life, О dear ones, this vrata had not been performed by you with a selfish motif but is meant for the welfare of the universe. You have arrived here from the Goloka and you have to return to that place with me.

## \|\| 27.240 \|\|

*gacchata svālayaṃ śīghraṃ vo'haṃ janmani janmani \|*  
*prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasyo yūyaṃ me nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 240 \|\|*

240\. Now you rapidly go back to your abodes. I shall belong to you in every birth. You will be dearer to me than my life. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 27.241 \|\|

*ityuktvā śrīharistatra tasthau sūryasutātaṭe \|*  
*tasthurgopālikāḥ sarvā vīkṣya kṛṣṇaṃ punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 241 \|\|*

241\. Thus speaking lord Krishna sat on the bank of the river Y amuna and the cowherdesses also got themselves seated around him.

## \|\| 27.242 \|\|

*sarvāḥ prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ sasmitā vakralocanāḥ \|*  
*prītyā cakṣuścakorābhyāṃ mukhacandraṃ papurhareḥ \|\| 242 \|\|*

242\. All the cowberdesses were smiling delightfully and started extracting nectar from the lotus-like face of the lord, with the eyes, looking at him with side glances again and again like the partridge bird.

## \|\| 27.243 \|\|

*tāḥ śīghraṃ prayayurgehaṃ jayaṃ dattvā punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*hariśca śiśubhiḥ sārddhaṃ prasannaḥ svālayaṃ yayau \|\| 243 \|\|*

243\. Thereafter, shouting the slogan of the victory of the lord, the cowherdesses returned to their abodes and the lord, also getting pleased with the cowherds, returned to his abode.

## \|\| 27.244 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamaṅgalam \|*  
*gopīnāṃ vastraharaṇaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham \|\| 244 \|\|*

244\. Thus I have narrated to you the charming life story of the lord in the context of the stealing of the costumes of the cowherdesses.

## Chapter 28

## \|\| 28.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*triṣu māseṣvatīteṣu tāsāṃ ca hariṇā saha \|*  
*vada kena prakāreṇa babhūva tanusaṃgamaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – You kindly tell me how the cowherdesses could have a union with Krishna after three months.

## \|\| 28.2 \|\|
