*vṛndāvanaṃ kiṃprakāraṃ kiṃvidhaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*harirekastāśca bahvyaḥ kena krīḍā babhūva ha \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. What is the type of Vrindavana and what is the form of Rasamandalal Krishna was one and the cowherdesses were many; then how could the divine dance be possible?

## \|\| 28.3 \|\|

*kutūhalaṃ bhavati me idaṃ śrotuṃ navaṃ navam \|*  
*kathayasva mahābhāga puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O virtuous one, it is quite auspicious to recite or listen to your name. I am getting anxious to listen to the subject. You tell me.

## \|\| 28.4 \|\|

*kathā purāṇasārāṇāṃ rāsayātrā hareraho \|*  
*harilīlāḥ pṛthivyāṃ tu sarvāḥ pratimanoharāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The divine dance of lord is the tattvas of the Puranas and all the divine places of Hari on earth are quite interesting.

## \|\| 28.5 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*prahasya suprasannāsyaḥ pravaktumupacakrame \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Suta said – On hearing the words of Narada, the sage Narayana delightfully spoke with a smile on his face.

## \|\| 28.6-8 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā śrīharirnaktaṃ vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau \|*  
*śubhe śuklatrayodaśyāṃ pūrṇe candrodaye mune \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yūthikāmālatīkundamādhavīpuṣpavāyunā \|*  
*vāsitaṃ kalanādena madhubhrāṇāṃ manoharam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*navapallavasaṃyuktaṃ puṃskokilarutaśrutam \|*  
*navalakṣarāsavāsasaṃyuktaṃ sumanoharam \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Narayana said – О sage, once lord Krishna went to Vmdavana on the thirteenth day of the bright fort-night of the month of Caitra. At that point of time Vmdavana was filled with the fragrance of jasmine, kunda and flowers of several creepers. The black-wasps were issuing a hissing sound which was quite charming. The trees had fresh leaves, the sweet voice of cuckoos was echoing in the forest. Since Vmdavana had a lakh of dancing halls, it looked very charming.

## \|\| 28.9 \|\|

*candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena suvāsitam \|*  
*karpūrānvitatāmbūlabhogadravyasamanvitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. There were enough stocks of sandal-paste, aguru, kastiirl, saffron, betels with camphor and other cosmetics for pleasure.

## \|\| 28.10 \|\|

*prasūnaiścampakānāṃ ca kastūrīcandanānvitaiḥ \|*  
*ratiyogyairviracitairnānātalpaiḥ suśobhitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. There were enough of beautiful beds scented with kastiirl, sandal-paste, campaka flowers, which could be used for making love-sport.

## \|\| 28.11-12 \|\|

*dīptaṃ ratnapradīpaiśca dhūpena surabhīkṛtam \|*  
*nānāpuṣpaiśca racitaṃ mālājālairvirājitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*parito vartulākāraṃ tatraiva rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena susaṃskṛtam \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The place was illumined with the burning lamps of gems and there were heaps of garlands of different flowers. The Rdsamandala was made in a circular manner and the sandal-paste, aguru, kastiirl and saffron were applied there suitably.

## \|\| 28.13-14 \|\|

*puṣpodyānaiḥ puṣpitaiśca yuktakrīḍāsarovaraiḥ \|*  
*haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇairjalakukkuṭakūjitaiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*krīḍanīyaiḥ sundaraiśca surataśramahāribhiḥ \|*  
*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśatoyapūrṇaiḥ sunirmalaiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. There were enough of flower orchards and lakes for water-sports, which were infested with the birds like geese, ducks, water-fouls which were issuing sweet notes; the water was spotless like the crystal gems, having enough of waves. The place was best for the sports, was quite beautiful and could remove the fatigue after the love-sports.

## \|\| 28.15 \|\|

*dadhipūrṇaśukladhānyajalairnirmañchanīkṛtam \|*  
*rambhāstambhasamūhena sundareṇa suśobhitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Curd rice and the fried rice were scattered every where. The place was decorated with the trunks of banana trees.

## \|\| 28.16-17 \|\|

*āmrapallavayuktena sūtrabandhena cāruṇā \|*  
*bhūṣitaṃ maṃgalaghaṭaiḥ sindūracandanānvitaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*mālatīmālyasaṃyuranārikelaphalānvitaḥ \|*  
*sa rāsamaṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭā jahāsa madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The leaves of the mango trees were tied in with cotton strings, which were used for decoration. Besides, the pitchers for welfares were decorated with vermilion and sandal-paste and were suitably placed there. These welfares pitchers were further adorned with coconuts and the garlands of jasmine flowers. Lord Madhusudana smiled at the sight of Rdsamandala.

## \|\| 28.18 \|\|

*cakāra tatra kutukādvinodamuralīravam \|*  
*gopīnāṃ kāmukīnāṃ ca kāmavardhanakāraṇam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. He playfully played on the flute there, which increased the passion of the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 28.19 \|\|

*tacchrutvā rādhikā sadyo mumoha madanāturā \|*  
*babhūva sthāṇuvaddehā dhyānaikatānamānasā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On hearing it the passion of Radhika was increased and she lost all her senses. Her body became lifeless and her mind was totally devoted to the lord.

## \|\| 28.20-21 \|\|

*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya punaḥ śuśrāva sā dhvanim \|*  
*uvāsa sā samuttasthau samudvignā punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tyaktvā cāvaśyakaṃ karma niḥsasāra drutaṃ gṛhāt \|*  
*yayau tadanusāreṇa prasamīkṣya caturdiśam \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. After regaining consciousness in a moment, she heard the same tune of the flute. She got up at once. Now she felt hysterical again and again. Leaving aside all her jobs, she moved out of her house. Looking on all sides she started following the direction of the tune of the flute and proceeded on.

## \|\| 28.22 \|\|

*dhyāyantī caraṇāmbhojaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*tejasā ca dyotayantī sadratnasārabhūṣataiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Devoting her mind to the feet of lord Krishna, she was moving on. She was illumining all the directions with the lustre of her gem-studded ornaments.

## \|\| 28.23 \|\|

*bahirbabhūvustāstrastā vareṇa hṛtacetanāḥ \|*  
*kuladharmaṃ parityajya niśaṃkāḥ kāmamohitāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Her friends also lost their senses on hearing the tune of the flute. Getting infested with passion all the cowherdesses discarding all the family traditions moved on.

## \|\| 28.24 \|\|

*trayastriṃśadvayasyāśca tāḥ suśīlādayaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*rādhikāyāḥ priyatamā gopīnāṃ pravarā yayuḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Out of all the cowherdesses, friendly to Radha, the thirty three names are well known. Out of them Suslla was quite prominent who was following her.

## \|\| 28.25 \|\|

*tāsāṃ paścādyayurgopyastāsāṃ saṃkhyā nibodha me \|*  
*samā veṣeṇa vayasā rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The number of cowherdesses who followed them is being mentioned by me. You listen to it. All of them were clad in similar costumes and were of the same age, beauty and virtues.

## \|\| 28.26-27 \|\|

*yayuḥ suśīlāsaṃgena sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*yayuścandramukhī paścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ekādaśasahasrāṇi mādhavyālyaśca niryayuḥ \|*  
*jagmuḥ kadambamālālyaḥ sa sahasrāṇi trayodaśa \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Sixteen thousand cowherdesses were following Suslla. ChandramukhI was also followed by sixteen thousand cowherdesses. Madhavi was followed by eleven thousand cowherdesses. Kadambamala was followed by ten thousand cowherdesses.

## \|\| 28.28 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde rāsakrīḍāprastāvo nāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Kuntl was followed by ten thousand cowherdesses. Yamuna was followed by fourteen thousand cowherdesses.

## \|\| 28.29 \|\|

*jāhnavīsahacāriṇyaḥ sahasrāṇi yayurnava \|*  
*yayurnavasahasrāṇi padmamukhyālya eva ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Jahnavl had nine thousand cowherdesses with her and ChandramukhI had also an equal number of them with her.

## \|\| 28.30 \|\|

*sāvitryālyaḥ paṃcadaśa sahasrāṇi yayurvrajāt \|*  
*pārijātāvayasyāśca sahasrāṇi yayurdaśa \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Savitri was followed by fifteen thousand cowherdesses. Parijata was followed by ten thousand cowherdesses.

## \|\| 28.31 \|\|

*svayaṃprabhānugāḥ sapta sahasrāṇi yayurvrajāt \|*  
*yayuḥ sudhāmukhīgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Svayamprabha was followed by seven thousand cowherdesses. SudhamukhI had fourteen thousand cowherdesses with her.

## \|\| 28.32 \|\|

*śubhānugā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa \|*  
*padmānugā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Subha had fourteen thousand cowherdesses with her and Padma was accompanied by an equal number of cowherdesses.

## \|\| 28.33 \|\|

*gaurī padmā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa \|*  
*yayuḥ sarvamaṅgalālyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Gauripadma had also fourteen thousand cowherdesses with her while Sarvamangala was accompanied by sixteen thousand of them.

## \|\| 28.34 \|\|

*kālikālyo yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*niryayuḥ kamalālyaśca sahasrāṇi trayodaśa \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Kalika too had sixteen thousand cowherdesses while Kamala had thirteen thousand of them.

## \|\| 28.35 \|\|

*durgānugā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*yayuḥ sarasvatīpaścātsahasrāṇi trayodaśa \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Sixteen thousand cowherdesses followed Durga while Sarasvati had thirteen thousand of them.

## \|\| 28.36-37 \|\|

*prajagmurbhāratīpaścātsahasrāṇi daśa vrajāt \|*  
*aparṇāsahacāriṇyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa \|\| 36 \|\|*

*ratipaścādvayasyāśca sahasrāṇi yayurdaśa \|*  
*gaṅgāvayasyāḥ prayayuḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Bharati had ten thousand cowherdesses, while Aparna had fourteen thousand cowherdesses with her. Rati had ten thousand of cowherdesses with her while Ganga had fourteen thousand of them.

## \|\| 28.38 \|\|

*prajagmurambikāpaścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*satīpaścādyayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi trayodaśa \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Ambika was followed by sixteen thousand cowherdesses and Sati was followed by thirteen cowherdesses.

## \|\| 28.39 \|\|

*nandinīsahacāriṇyaḥ sahasrāṇi yayurdaśa \|*  
*prayayuḥ sundarīpaścātsahasrāṇi trayodaśa \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Nandini was followed by ten thousand cowherdesses and Sundarl was followed by thirteen thousand of them.

## \|\| 28.40 \|\|

*yayuḥ kṛṣṇapriyāpaścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*yayurmadhumatīpaścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Krishnapriya had sixteen thousand cowherdesses while Madhumatl also had an equal number of them with her.

*yayuścampānugā gopyaḥ sahasrāṇi trayodaśa \|*

*krīḍārambhe ca madhye ca viratau karma yoṣitām \|\| 114 \|\|*

*prītyarthamapi kartavyaṃ cakāreśastato'dhikam \|*  
*gopīkaṅkaṇarekhābhiḥ pādālaktakacihnitaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

*śuśubhe kṛṣṇadehaśca yathā'drirgairikeṇa ca \|*  
*evaṃbhūte pūrṇarāsasaṃbhūte rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 116 \|\|*

*samājagmuḥ surāḥ sarve sakalatrāśca sānugāḥ \|*  
*suvarṇasyandanasthāśca kautukātsvagaṇāvṛtāḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

114-117. Lord Krishna enjoyed love-sports as is prescribed in the Kamashastra. Whatever types of make-up was requited in the beginning, in the middle or the end of the love-sport by the cowherdesses, the lord used much more than that. With the scratches of the armlets of the cowherdesses and the paint of the feet, the body of lord Krishna looked quite beautiful like the charm of the mountain of red orchard. Thus with the completion of the divine dance all the gods together with their attendants end families reached the Rasamantfala with curiosity. They were mounted over the chariots of gold and were surrounded by their attendants.

## \|\| 28.118-119 \|\|

*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgāḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ \|*  
*ṛṣayo munayaścaiva siddhāśca pitarastathā \|\| 118 \|\|*

*vidyādharāśca gandharvā yakṣarākṣasakinnarāḥ \|*  
*sastrīkāśca samājagmurdadṛśuśca mudā'nvitāḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

118-119. They were filled with passion and their hairs stood at ends. All the ascetics the sages, the siddha, the manes, Vidyadhara, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Kinnaras also arrived there delightfully.

## \|\| 28.120-123 \|\|

*divyasyandanamāruhya śātakaumbhavinirmitam \|*  
*suśobhitaṃ ca maṇinā ratnasāraparicchadam \|\| 120 \|\|*

*vahniśuddhāṃśukenaiva veṣṭitaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*śvetacāmarayuktaṃ ca sadratnadarpaṇāmbujam \|\| 121 \|\|*

*śatacakraṃ citrayuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam \|*  
*sadratnasāranirmāṇakalaśojjvalaśekharam \|\| 122 \|\|*

*samājagāma bhagavānpārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*vāmapārśve mahākālo dakṣiṇe nandikeśvaraḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

120-123. Lord Shiva accompanied by Parvati also arrived there mounted over the chariot of gold. The chariot was inlaid with diamonds and the gems, it was covered with beautiful cloth and had white fly-whisks and had the stops of gems. It had a hundred wheels which were beautifully painted. It moved with the speed of the mind, the top of the chariot was decorated with the pitcher made of gems which were illumining. Mahakala was lodged to the left of Shiva while Nandikeshvara appeared to his right.

## \|\| 28.124 \|\|

*purataḥ kārtikeyaśca svayaṃ devo gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*piṅgalākṣādayaḥ sarve pārṣadāḥ paritastayoḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. Karttikeya and Ganesha were lodged in the front, Pingalaksa and other attendant were lodged towards the feet.

## \|\| 28.125 \|\|

*kṣetrapālādayaḥ sarve tathā'ṣṭau bhairaveśvarāḥ \|*  
*vakṣaḥsthalasthitā durgā sasmitā vakralocanā \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. All the ksetrapalas and eight bhairavas were also there, Durga with a smiling face, casting a side-glance was lodged at the chest of Shiva.

## \|\| 28.126 \|\|

*bhāratyā saha brahmā ca śātakaumbharathasthitaḥ \|*  
*vāme saptarṣayastasya dakṣiṇe sanakādayaḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. Brahma the creator of the universe also arrived there with a Bharati mounted over a golden chariot, the Saptarsis were lodged to his left while Sanaka and other sages were lodged to the right.

## \|\| 28.127 \|\|

*suvarṇasyandanasthaśca dharmaḥ sākṣī ca karmaṇām \|*  
*vakṣasthalasthitā tasya mūrtiḥ smerānanā satī \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. Dharma the witness of all the deeds, was also mounted over a golden chariot. A smiling image of Sati was implanted on his chest.

## \|\| 28.128-129 \|\|

*paśyantī pūrṇarāsaṃ ca sakāmā vakralocanā \|*  
*paritaḥ pārṣadāḥ sarve jvalanto brahmatejasā \|\| 128 \|\|*

*śacyā saha mahendraśca rohiṇyā ca kalānidhiḥ \|*  
*svāhā sārddhaṃ svayaṃ vahniḥ sūryaśca saṃjñayā saha \|\| 129 \|\|*

128-129. She was casting a side-glance on her lord, getting infested with passion. Dharma was surrounded by the attendants who emitted divine lustre. Similarly Indra accompanied by his spouse, the moon accompanied by Rohini. Agni accompanied by Svaha and Surya accompanied by Sanjna were also present there.

## \|\| 28.130 \|\|

*samājagāma kāmaśca ratiṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi \|*  
*sarve grahāśca dikpālā ājagmuḥ sakalatrakāḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. Kamadeva with Rati and Dikpalas and all the stars together with their spouses also arrived there.

## \|\| 28.131 \|\|

*ākāśasthāśca dadṛśuḥ sarāsaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*kecicca mumuhustatra mūrcchāmāpuśca kecana \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. All of them were witnessing the divine dance of Rasamandala remaining in the sky. Some of them were Infested with passion while others were fainted.

## \|\| 28.132 \|\|

*muhūrtaṃ ca surāḥ sarve sasmitāśca mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*candanadravavṛṣṭiṃ ca puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca cikṣipuḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. For a period of two ghadls, all the gods kept on smiling delightfully and started raining, flowers and sandal-paste.

## \|\| 28.133 \|\|

*kastūrīyuktamālyānāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ cakrurmunīśvarāḥ \|*  
*rāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā devapatnyaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. The sages, dropped the rain of the garland of flowers, scented with kastiiri. Looking at the divine dance in Rasamandal all the spouses of the gods were infested with passion.

## \|\| 28.134 \|\|

*sthale ratirasaṃ kṛtvā jagāma yamunājalam \|*  
*rādhayā saha kṛṣṇaśca pūrṇabrahma sanātanaḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. Thereafter Puma-Brahman and eternal Krishna after enjoying the love-sport with Radha on the ground entered the water of the Yamuna.

## \|\| 28.135 \|\|

*gopībhiḥ saha jagmuśca māyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇarūpikāḥ \|*  
*prapīḍitāḥ kāmabāṇaiḥ krīḍāṃ cakrurjale mudā \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. The illusion of lord Krishna accompanied the cowherdesses. All of them getting infested with passion started enjoying the water-sport with Krishna.

## \|\| 28.136 \|\|

*jalaṃ dadau rādhikāyai sakāmo mādhavaḥ svayam \|*  
*dadau sā ca mādhavāya kāmārtāyāñjalitrayam \|\| 136 \|\|*

136\. The passionate Madhava himself offered water to Radhika who in turn offered water thrice to Madhava in her hand-cups.

## \|\| 28.137 \|\|

*vastraṃ jagrāha tasyāśca sā ca nagnā babhūva ha \|*  
*mālāṃ ciccheda kabarīṃ cakāra śithilāṃ hariḥ \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. Thereafter the lord unrobed Radhika broke her garland and unmade the locks of her hair.

## \|\| 28.138 \|\|

*sindūrapakṣakaṃ luptaṃ veṣaṃ ca jalatāḍanaiḥ \|*  
*bhrūvicitramoṣṭharāgaṃ luptaṃ kajjalalocanam \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. He splashed so much of water over Radhika that her entire make-up was washed out. The eye-brows looked surprising, the paintings of the lips and the collyrium of the eyes were also washed out.

## \|\| 28.139 \|\|

*tāṃ ca nagnāṃ samāśliṣya nimamajja jale hariḥ \|*  
*prakṛtyā'bhyantare krīḍāṃ sutasthau ca tayā saha \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. The lord embraced the unrobed Radhika and went beneath the water and enjoying the water sport again emerged over-the water.

## \|\| 28.140-141 \|\|

*tāṃ ca nagnāṃ darśayitvā gopikāṃ krīḍayā natām \|*  
*sasmitāṃ prerayāmāsa dūrato yamunājale \|\| 140 \|\|*

*sā vegena samutthāya balājjagrāha mādhavam \|*  
*gṛhītvā muralīṃ kopātprerayāmāsa dūrataḥ \|\| 141 \|\|*

140-141. Radhika who was bending because of love-sport and was smiling getting unrobed, was dragged by Krishna an the water and displaying her reflection in the water of Yamuna, he took her out of it. The Radhika also caught hold of Krishna forcefully with a jump and snatching away his flute, she dragged him in anger for a long distance.

## \|\| 28.142-143 \|\|

*gṛhītvā pītavasanaṃ taṃ cakāra digambaram \|*  
*vanamālāṃ ca ciccheda dadau toyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

*hariṃ punaḥ samākṛṣya preṣayāmāsa pāthasi \|*  
*gabhīre srotasi mune nimamajja jagatpatiḥ \|\| 143 \|\|*

142-143. She also unrobed him taking away his pltambara and also broke away the vanamala. She then started splashing water over him again and again. Thereafter Radhika dragged Hari in the deep water who was drowned there.

## \|\| 28.144 \|\|

*utthāya mādhavaḥ śīghraṃ tāṃ gṛhītvā prahasya ca \|*  
*kṛtvā vakṣasi nagnāṃ ca cucumba ca punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. Thereafter Madhava got up at once and caught hold of Radhika and smilingly embraced her implanting kisses on her again and again.

## \|\| 28.145 \|\|

*evaṃ tā mūrtayaḥ sarvā gopībhiḥ saha kautukāt \|*  
*krīḍāṃ vicakruryamunātīranīre manohare \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. Similarly, all the images of lord Krishna behaved similarly with all other cowherdesses in the waters of Yamuna.

## \|\| 28.146 \|\|

*tīraṃ gatvā tayā sārdhaṃ harirnagnaśca magnayā \|*  
*sā taṃ yayāce vasanaṃ sa ca tāṃ sasmitāṃ satīm \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. Thereafter, the unrobed Krishna and Radha reached the bank of the Yamuna. Radha then begged for her costumes from Krishna smilingly.

## \|\| 28.147 \|\|

*rādhikāyai dadau vastraṃ ramyāṃ mālāṃ ca mādhavaḥ \|*  
*pradadau haraye vastraṃ vaṃśī rāseśvarī tathā \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. Thereafter Madhava returned to Radhika all her costumes and the beautiful garments, who intum returned the robes of Krishna together with the flute.

## \|\| 28.148-149 \|\|

*candanāgurukastūrīṃ sarvāṅge kuṅkumānvitām \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya parayā bhaktyā dadau śroṇisthitasya ca \|\| 148 \|\|*

*nirmāya cūḍāṃ lalitāṃ kāminīṃ cittamohinīm \|*  
*śobhanairmālatīmālyaiścakāra veṣṭanaṃ punaḥ \|\| 149 \|\|*

148-149. She than painted the body of Krishna with sandal-paste, aguru, saffron and kasturl. Thereafter Radha decorated the hair of lord Krishna who influences the cowherdesses and tied the garland of jasmine flowers on his head.

## \|\| 28.150 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāyāśca kabarīṃ sumanoharām \|*  
*kṛtvā kuṇḍalasaṃskāraṃ nirmame patrakāvalīm \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. Thereafter lord Krishna also arranged a beautiful hair-do for Radha and painted her cheeks with tree leaves.

## \|\| 28.151 \|\|

*dadau lalāṭe sindūraṃ kastūrībindubhiḥ saha \|*  
*tadadhaścandanenduṃ ca susūkṣmaṃ sumanoharam \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. He decorated her forehead with the spot of kasturl and vermilion and under the same, a small spot of sandal-paste was also painted.

## \|\| 28.152 \|\|

*nakhāṅgaṃ stanayorūrvorurasyeva ghanaṃ mudā \|*  
*dattvā tāṃ vāsayāmāsa vahniśuddhāṃśukena vai \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. He then made the marks with his nails on the breasts and this and clad her in sanctified garments.

## \|\| 28.153 \|\|

*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumānāṃ draveṇa saḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā vakṣasi saṃlipya cucumba ca muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. Applying the sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl and saffron over her body. He embraced her implanting kisses again and again.

## \|\| 28.154 \|\|

*punarāśleṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dadau mālāṃ gale punaḥ \|*  
*bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāṃ kṛtvā mañjīracaraṇe dadau \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. Again embracing her, he if adorned her neck with a necklace and other ornaments on the body besides anklets on the feet.

## \|\| 28.155 \|\|

*alaktakaṃ caraṇayornakheṣu ca dadau punaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ gopāśca gopīnāṃ vidadhau ca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. Her nails and feet were again painted with red-core. Similarly the reflections of the lord also decorated the cowherdesses separately.

## \|\| 28.156 \|\|

*punaḥ prajagmustā mattāḥ sundaraṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*pūrṇenducandrikāyuktaṃ ratiyogyaṃ sunirjanam \|\| 156 \|\|*

156\. Thereafter, the intoxicated cowherdesses reached the Rasamandala which was filled with the rays of the moon and was located at a secluded place.

## \|\| 28.157 \|\|

*mādhavīketakīkundamālatīnāṃ manoharaiḥ \|*  
*campayūthīmallikānāṃ puṣpaiśca surabhīkṛtam \|\| 157 \|\|*

157\. The fragrance of madhavi, ketaki, kunda, malatl, campaka and jasmine flowers was spread over the entire Rasamandala.

## \|\| 28.158 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā ca sphuṭitaṃ puṣpaṃ cayanaṃ kartumīśvarī \|*  
*gopīrniyojayāmāsa kautukena ca rādhikā \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. Finding the beautiful flowers there Radhika deputed some of the cowherdesses for collecting the flowers.

## \|\| 28.159 \|\|

*kāścinniyojayāmāsa mālānirmāṇakarmaṇi \|*  
*kāścittāmbūlasajjeṣu kāściñcandanagharṣaṇe \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. Some of them were asked to make the garments and some of them were asked to make the betels while others were asked to make the sandal-paste.

## \|\| 28.160 \|\|

*mālā candanatāmbūlaṃ gopīdattaṃ ca sundarī \|*  
*dadau kṛṣṇāya saṃprītyā sasmitā vakralocanā \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. Radhika looked with side-glances and wearing smile on her face, she offered the sandal-paste and betels to Krishna lovingly which were handed over to her by the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 28.161 \|\|

*kāścinniyojanaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇasaṅgītakarmaṇi \|*  
*mṛdaṅgamurajādīnāṃ vādaneṣu ca kāścana \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. Some of the cowherdesses started playing on musical instruments together with Krishna and some were engaged in musical drum.

## \|\| 28.162 \|\|

*evaṃ rāse ratiṃ kṛtvā līlayā hariṇā saha \|*  
*vijahāra ca sarvatra nirjaneṣu manoharam \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. Thus Radhika enjoying the company of Krishna in the Rdsamandala and the love-sports roamed about in the beautiful secluded places with Krishna.

## \|\| 28.163-171 \|\|

*puṣpodyāneṣu ramyeṣu sarasāṃ ca taṭeṣu ca \|*  
*kandare kandare ramye nadeṣu ca nadīṣu ca \|\| 163 \|\|*

*atīva nirjanasthāne śmaśāne girigahvare \|*  
*vāñchiteṣu ca nārīṇāṃ trayastriṃśadvaneṣu ca \|\| 164 \|\|*

*bhāṇḍīre śrīvane ramye kadambakānane tathā \|*  
*tulasīkānane kundavane campakakānane \|\| 165 \|\|*

*nimbāraṇye madhuvane jambīrakānane tathā \|*  
*nālikeravane pūgavane ca kadalīvane \|\| 166 \|\|*

*badarīkānane bilvavane nāriṅgakānane \|*  
*aśvatthakānane vaṃśavane dāḍimakānane \|\| 167 \|\|*

*mandārakānane tālavane cūtavane tathā \|*  
*ketakīkānane'śokavane kharjūrakānane \|\| 168 \|\|*

*āmrātakavane jambūgahane śālakānane \|*  
*kaṭake kānane padmavane jātivane mune \|\| 169 \|\|*

*nyagrodhagahane ghore tathā śrīkhaṇḍakānane \|*  
*prahṛṣṭakesaravane sarvato'pi vilakṣaṇe \|\| 170 \|\|*

*evaṃ reme kautukena kāmāttriṃśaddivāniśam \|*  
*tathā'pi mānasaṃ pūrṇaṃ na ca kiṃcidbabhūva ha \|\| 171 \|\|*

163-171. She roamed about with Krishna in beautiful flower orchards, the banks of the lakes, mountain caves, charming rivers and rivulets, completely deserted places, cremation grounds, the caves of the mountains and the thirty three forests which are desire to be visited by the ladies. These include Bhandlra-vana, Shri-vana, the beautiful kadamba-v ana, Tulasi-vana, Nimbaranya, Madhu-vana, citron-forest, coconut-forest, betel-nut-forest, banana-forest, jujubi-forest, wood-apple-forest orange forest, Asvattha forest, bamboo forest, pomegranate forest, Mandara forest, tala forest, mango forest, asoka forest, palm forest, mango-forest, hog-plum-forest, silk-fruity forest, teak-wood forest, thorny forest, lotus forest, jasmine forest, thick forest, Shrikhanda forest and the most surprising and developed saffron forest. They roamed about in these, forests for thirty days and nights but their mind was still not satisfied.

## \|\| 28.172 \|\|

*na kāminīnāṃ kāmaśca śṛṅgāreṇa nivartate \|*  
*adhikaṃ vardhate śaśvadyathā'gnirghṛtadhārayā \|\| 172 \|\|*

172\. The mind of the passionate damsels is never satisfied with the love-sports but they become more and more desirous for the same as the ghee in flames the fire.

## \|\| 28.173-174 \|\|

*jagmurdevāḥ svagehaṃ ca devyaśca munayastathā \|*  
*te sarve praśaśaṃsuśca vismayaṃ ca yayurmudā \|\| 173 \|\|*

*gehe gehe nṛpendrāṇāṃ lebhire janma bhārate \|*  
*dagdhāḥ kāmāgnināṃ'śena devyaḥ śṛṅgāralālasāḥ \|\| 174 \|\|*

173-174. All the gods and goddesses and the sages were quite surprised with the divine dance and praising if they left for their abodes. Many of the passionate goddesses took the birth on earth in royal families with the hope of enjoying the lave sports.

## Chapter 29

## \|\| 29.1 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*atha gopāṅganāḥ sarvāḥ kāmamattatayā mune \|*  
*atiprauḍhāśca māninyo neśvaraṃ menire patim \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – О sage, getting intoxicated with passion all the cowherdesses who were quite adult and arrogant never considered Krishna as the husband and kissed as the lord.

## \|\| 29.2-3 \|\|

*kāścidūcuraho kṛṣṇa sasmitā vakralocanāḥ \|*  
*mālatīpuṣpamuttolya dehi me mālikāmiti \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kāścidūcuraye kṛṣṇa svakroḍe'smāṃśca kurviti \|*  
*gṛhītvāśrīhareḥ skandhamāruroha ca kācana \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Some of them casting the side-glances smilingly said to Krishna, You give me the garland made by the jasmine flower. Some of them said, О Krishna you carry no in your lap. Some of them climbed on his shoulders.

## \|\| 29.4 \|\|

*uvāca kāciddarpeṇa pramattā prāṇavallabham \|*  
*svakīyapītavasanaṃ paridhāraya māmiti \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. An intoxicated cowherdess spoke to her beloved Krishna, You let me wear your lower yellow garment.

## \|\| 29.5-11 \|\|

*uvāca kācidīśaṃ taṃ sindūraṃ dehi māmiti \|*  
*uvāca kācitprāṇeśaṃ śīghramāgatya sāmpratam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kṛtvā kuntalasaṃskāraṃ kuru me kabarīmiti \|*  
*kāścitsaṃprerayāmāsuḥ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ ballavāya ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*svāṃgaveṣavidhāyinyo bhūṣārthaṃ śrutimūlayoḥ \|*  
*uvāca kācitkāmena paraṃ saṃketapūrvakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*paśyantī tanmukhāmbhojaṃ sasmitā maithunāya ca \|*  
*kācijjagrāha muralīṃ balādākṛṣya mādhavam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*jahāra pītavasanaṃ kṛtvā nagnaṃ ca kāminī \|*  
*kāminyaḥ kāścidityūcurmāninyo madhusūdanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*alaktakadravaṃ dehi pādayornakhareṣu ca \|*  
*uvāca kācitpremṇā taṃ gaṇḍayoḥ stanayormama \|\| 10 \|\|*

*nānācitravicitrāḍhyāṃ karu patrāvalīmiti \|*  
*kṛtvā'numānaṃ manasā dṛṣṭvā tāsāṃ pramattatām \|\| 11 \|\|*

5-11. Some one said to the lord, You apply vermilion over my forehead. Some one went rapidly to her beloved and said, "You arrange ray hair after combing it." Covering the unrobed body some one of them sent sandal-paste for adoring the ears of the lord. A cowherdess smilingly filled with passion, approached Krishna, desirous of union with him looked at his lotus-like face and spoke sweet words. One of the damsels dragged Madhava forcibly and snatched away his flute. Some one stole away his pltambara unrobing him. One of the arrogant damsel said to Madhusudana, "You paint the nails of my feet." Some one spoke to him, "You paint my breasts and cheeks with different figures." Madhava then realising the state of mind in which the cowherdesses were placed disappeared from the scene.

## \|\| 29.12-17 \|\|

*mādhavo rādhayā sārddhamantardhānaṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*atīva nirjane sthāne mudā svecchāmayo vibhuḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kalāmānaprakāraṃ ca śṛṃgāraṃ ca cakāra ha \|*  
*parvate parvate ramye dvīpedvīpe sunirjane \|\| 13 \|\|*

*taṭe taṭe nadīnāṃ ca sarvajantuvivarjite \|*  
*śrīgoṣṭhe ratnaśaile ca velāgaṅgātaṭe'pi ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kālinde ca pulinde ca mandire gandhamādane \|*  
*manohare kundavane kāverītīranīraje \|\| 15 \|\|*

*puṣpabhadrāpulinaje puṣpodyāne supuṣpite \|*  
*sarvatra ramaṇaṃ kṛtvā rādhāveṣaṃ vidhāya ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

*jagāma malayadroṇīṃ ramyāṃ candanavāyunā \|*  
*śayyāṃ puṣpamayīṃ kṛtvā tatra reme tayā saha \|\| 17 \|\|*

12-17. Thereafter, the lord who always moves at will moved with Radha and enjoyed her company in a secluded place. Both of them visited different mountains, charming deserted is land, the pleasant banks of the river sacred mountains, mountains of gems, the banks of Ganga and Yamuna the temples, Gandhamadana mountain, the pleasant kunda forest, the lotus forest on the bank of the Kaverl river and the flower orchards located over the Puspabhadra river. He than decorated the body of Radha and reached the valley of Malayacala where the wind bearing the fragrant of sandal-wood was blowing. He made the flower bed and was united with Radha.

*atīva sukhasaṃbhogānmūrcchāṃ saṃprāpya rādhikā \|*

*tasyāḥ kapāle siṃdūratilakaṃ sundaraṃ dadau \|*

*sālaktakāṃśca nakharāṃścitritānpādapadmayoḥ \|*

*madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ padmasthānaṃ supadmajam \|*

*tatra snātvā jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha tayā saha \|*

## \|\| 29.30-33 \|\|

*tato gacchaṃstayā sārddhaṃ dadarśa purato vaṭam \|*

30-33. Thereafter he moved on accompanied by Radha and while so moving they came across a banyan tree which was quite a gigantic one and fairly tall. Its leaf provided shade in an area of a yojana. Thereafter Govinda, sat down near the jasmine forest. The fragrant breeze was blowing there. Shri Krishna spent a let of time with Radha at that place narrating to her some ancient story and repealing other secrets. At that point of time the sage Astavakra appeared before them.

## \|\| 29.34-36 \|\|

*āgacchantaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanekṣaṇam \|*

*mukhato'gnimudgirantaṃ taporāśimivotthitam \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. The sage was coming towards them. His face and the eyes were filled with pleasure. Instead of devoting his mind to the lord, he was disturbed in his meditation. Now he was witnessing the beauty before him. H

## \|\| 29.37-39 \|\|

*aho kiṃ vā brahmatejo mūrtimantamiha svayam \|*

37-39. It looked as if the divine lustre as itself had incarnated on earth. He had grown beard and moustaches on his face and the hair of the body and the nails had also grown. He was quite illustrious and peaceful. Getting panicky, bowing in devotion he stood before them with folded hands. Radha started laughing looking at the sage but Hari stopped her and enlightened her about the influence of the sage. The sage than bowed in reverence to Govinda and offered prayers to him. He recited they stotra for lord Krishna which was given to him by lord Shiva in earlier times.

## \|\| 29.40 \|\|

*aṣṭāvakra uvāca \|*  
*guṇātīta guṇādhāra guṇabīja guṇātmaka \|*

40\. Astavakra said – О lord, you are beyond qualities, the base of qualities, the cause of qualities, the form of qualities, the lord of qualities, the seed of the virtuous People and the abode of qualities. Therefore, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 29.41 \|\|

*siddhisvarūpa siddhyeśa siddhibīja parātpara \|*  
*siddhisiddhiguṇādhīśa siddhānāṃ gurave namaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. You are the form of success, the amsha of success, the cause of success, beyond everything, the great siddha of the siddhis the lord of the virtues and the teacher of the siddhas. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 29.42 \|\|

*he vedabīja vedajña vedinvedavidāṃ vara \|*  
*vedājñātādyarūpeśa vedājñeśa namo'stu te \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. О seed of the Vedas, you are well-versed in the Vedas, the possessor of the Vedas, the best among those well-versed in the Vedas, unknown in the Vedas, you have an eternal form, the lord of those well-versed in the Vedas. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 29.43 \|\|

*brahmānanteśa śeṣendra dharmādīnāmadhīśvara \|*  
*sarva sarveśa śarveśa bījarūpa namo'stu te \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. You are the lord of Brahma, Ananta, Shesha, Indra and Dharma, the form of everyone, the lord of everyone and the lord of all. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 29.44 \|\|

*prakṛte prākṛta prajña prakṛtīśa parātpara \|*  
*saṃsāravṛkṣa tadbīja phalarūpa namo'stu te \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. You are the form of Prakriti, the eminent intellectual, lord of Prakriti, beyond everything, seed of the tree of the universe besides being its fruit. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 29.45 \|\|

*sṛṣṭisthityantabījeśa sṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇa \|*  
*mahāvirāṭtarorbīja rādhikeśa namo'stu te \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. you are the seed of creation, preservation and destruction, you represent the creation of the universe, its preservation and cause of its destruction. You are the seed for the tree of Mahavirat and lord of Radhika. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 29.46-47 \|\|

*aho yasya trayaḥ skandhā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|*  
*śākhāpraśākhā vedādyāstapāṃsi kusumāni ca \|\| 46 \|\|*

*saṃsāraviphalā eva prakṛtyaṃkurameva ca \|*  
*tadādhāra nirādhāra sarvādhāra namo'stu te \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva happen to be the three branches of the tree of Mahavirat. The Vedas and others Vedic literature are the tender branches, the tapas represent the flowers. Therefore, the universe happens to be the form of special fruit in which Prakriti is the sprouting leaves and you happen to be the root of the same. You are without base but still you happen to be the base of all. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 29.48 \|\|

*tejorūpa nirākāra pratyakṣānūhameva ca \|*  
*sarvākārātipratyakṣa svecchāmaya namo'stu te \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Yon are the form of the lustre, the invisible one, beyond the evidence of existence, the form of Virat, quite visible and you move at will. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 29.49 \|\|

*ityuktvā sa muniśreṣṭho nipatya caraṇāmbuje \|*

49\. Thus speaking the best of the sages, fell at the feet of the lord and then departed for his heavenly abode in presence of both of them.

## \|\| 29.50-51 \|\|

*papāta tatra taddehaḥ pādapadmasamīpataḥ \|*

*saptatālapramāṇaṃ tu cotthāya ca papāta ha \|*

50-51. His body fell close to the feet of the lord and a divine illuminating lustre emerged out of his body which was as. high as the seven tala trees and it again fell down. The same lustre circumambulated around lord Krishna and thereafter it merged into his feet.

## \|\| 29.52-53 \|\|

*aṣṭāvakrakṛtaṃ stotraṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet \|*

*prāṇādhiko mumukṣūṇāṃ stotrarājaśca nārada \|*

52-53. Whosoever will recite the stotra composed by Astavakra he will achieve redemption. There is no doubt about it. This is the best of the stotras and is dearer to the devotees than their lives. Its knowledge was imparted in earlier times in Vaikuntha by lord Hari to Shiva.

*. nārada uvāca \|*

## \|\| 30.2-3 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā mṛtaṃ muniṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃskāraṃ kartumudyataḥ \|*

2-3. Narayana said – Finding the sage dead before him Shri Krishna got ready to cremate his body. Carrying his body on his chest, Krishna started crying aloud like and ordinary person. He held that body in his arms tightly, as a result of which the ashes emerged from the body.

## \|\| 30.4-5 \|\|

*raktamāṃsāsthihīnaṃ taccharīraṃ ca mahātmanaḥ \|*

4-5. The body of the sage was devoid of the blood flesh and bones. О great sage, sage Astavakra performed tapas for sixty thousand years while fasting, as a result of which all his blood, flesh and bones were burnt out by the fire of the stomach. He neglecting the out-world knowledge always devoted his mind at the lotus-like feet of the lord.

## \|\| 30.6-12 \|\|

*citāṃ candanakāṣṭhena nirmāya madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā'gnikāryaṃ tatraiva sthāpayāmāsa śokataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dadau citāyāmagniṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ dattvā śavopari \|*

*taddehe bhasmasādbhūte nedurdundubhayo divi \|*

*avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ pārṣadapravarā hareḥ \|*

*dhṛtavantaṃ sūkṣmadehaṃ praṇamayya munīśvaram \|*

6-12. Thereafter lord Madhusudana made a pier of sandal-wood and cremated his body. Expressing his grief Madhusudana placed the body of the sage on the pier and after that the wood was also placed over the body. Thereafter the pier was lit. When the pair went in flames, the lord fainted for a while. When the body of the sage was burnt out, the musical instruments and the big drums were sounded in the heaven. At the same time the flowers were rained from the sky. At that point of time a beautiful chariot arrived from Goloka which was inlaid with-the best of gems and could move with the speed of mind and was decorated with the garlands of flowers and other costumes. It had a number of attendant who resembled the form of lord Krishna. The attendant of the lord, immediately descended from the chariot who resembled the form of Krishna. All of them bowed in reverence to Krishna and Radhika and also the sage who was in ethereal form. Thereafter the sage was made to board the chariot and was than carried to Goloka.

## \|\| 30.13 \|\|

*gate munīndre golokaṃ vṛndāvanavinodinī \|*

13\. After the departure of Astavakra, the great sage to Goloka, Radhika the goddess of VmdSvana felt surprised and asked the lord of the universe.

Thereafter the auspicious soul was mounted over the chariot and went to Goloka and with the influence of that you could not help crying. О lord you had welcomed him with your eyes filled with tears; therefore, you tell me the entire story in detail.

## \|\| 30.18 \|\|

*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ kathāṃ kathitumārebhe yugāntaragatāmapi \|\| 18 \|\|*

*aṣṭāvakro munīndro'pi vikhyāto bhuvanatraye \|*

20\. The sage Astavakra was well-known in the three worlds. О mother of the universe, his (glory was spread over the three worlds.

## \|\| 30.21 \|\|

*kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vimanaskā haripriyā \|*

## \|\| 30.22-23 \|\|

*rādhikovāca \|*

*sa vitṛpto bhavati kiṃ goṣpadodakapānataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vedānāṃ vedavaktṝṇāṃ vidhāturjanakasya ca \|*

22-23. Radhika said – "The thirsty person who could not quench his thirst with the ocean of nectar could he be satisfied with the water stored in the place measuring the hoof of a cow. You happen to be the creator of the Vedas and post-Vedic literature and you happen to be the lord of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. Therefore who else could be superior to you.".

## \|\| 30.24 \|\|

*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇo babhūva ha \|*

24\. On hearing the words of Radhika, Krishna felt delighted and therefore revealing the astonishing and inaccessible secret to her he spoke.

## \|\| 30.25 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*

25\. Shri Krishna said – О any beloved, you listen to me I will narrate to you an ancient story, with the hearing or reciting or which all the sins vanish.

## \|\| 30.26 \|\|

*mahāviṣṇornābhipadmādbabhūva jagatāṃ vidhiḥ \|*

26\. After the submerging of the three worlds in the water Brahma who happens to be my own amsha emerged from the navel of Mahavishpu from my rays.

## \|\| 30.27 \|\|

27\. In the earlier times he had four mind born sons who were devoted to Narayana and illumined with the divine lustre.

## \|\| 30.28 \|\|

*śiśavaḥ pañcavarṣīyā nagnā ajñānino yathā \|*

28\. They were intellectuals and always remained like the five-year-old children roaming about naked devoid of the knowledge of Brahman but were well-versed in Brahmatattva. They were known as Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatana and Sanatkumara.

*sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ \|*

29-31. Brahma said to them, "O sons you engage yourself in the creation of the universe." But all of them disregarding the words of their father went for performing tapas. After the departure of his sons, Brahma felt sad because if the sons do not listen to his father, it becomes quite painful to the father.

## \|\| 30.32 \|\|

32\. Thereafter, with his divine knowledge he created several sons out of his limbs, who were well-versed in tapas. and well-versed in the Vedic and post-Vedic literature, illumining with the divine lustre.

## \|\| 30.33-36 \|\|

*atriḥ pulastyaḥ pulaho marīcirbhṛguraṅgirāḥ \|*

*tadastu ca kathā bahvī munivaṃśānukīrtanī \|*  
*cārvī puṇyasvarūpā ca prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu sundari \|\| 36 \|\|*

33-36. These included Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, Marichi, Bhrigu, Angira, Kratu, Vasistha, Vodhu, Kapila, Asuri, Kavi, Sanku, Pancasikha and Praceta. All of them got ready to increase the universe, remaining with their wives, all the sages produced many children and grand children. The story relating to the tradition of the race of sages is quite lengthy and bestows merit. Therefore, it should be left out; now we shall talk on the subject relating to the present context.

## \|\| 30.37 \|\|

*pracetasaḥ sutaḥ śrīmānasito munipuṅgavaḥ \|*  
*sakalatrastapastepe divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Praceta had two sons named Sriman and Asita who happened to be the best of the sages, as it performed tapas for a divine thousand years with his wife.

## \|\| 30.38-39 \|\|

*na babhūva sutastasya prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ \|*  
*taṃ samboddhuṃ babhūvātha satyā vāgaśarīriṇī \|\| 38 \|\|*

*kathaṃ tyajasi prāṇāṃstvaṃ gaccha śaṅkarasannidhim \|*  
*siddhaṃ kuru gṛhītvā ca mantraṃ śaṅkaravaktrataḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. But could not get a son. Then they were getting ready to end their lives. At that point of time a divine voice was heard saying, О sage why are you ending your life? You go to Shiva and receive a mantra from him, which should be recited by you.

## \|\| 30.40 \|\|

*mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ te sadyaḥ sākṣādbhaviṣyati \|*  
*vareṇābhīṣṭadevyāśca putraste bhavitā dhuvam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The great goddess of the mantra would surely appear before you and with the boon of the same goddess, you would surely beget a son.

## \|\| 30.41-42 \|\|

*śrutvaitaccaritaṃ vipro jagāma śivasannidhim \|*  
*yogināmapyagamyaṃ ca śivalokaṃ nirāmayam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*sakalatro yathā yogī tuṣṭāva yogināṃ gurum \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Hearing this the sage went to Shiva who is beyond the reach of the yogis. The sage arrived at Shivaloka with his wife and with his mind filled with devotion, bowing in reverence to him, offered prayer to Shiva who happens to be the lord of the yogis.

## \|\| 30.43 \|\|

*asita uvāca \|*  
*jagadguro namastubhyaṃ śivāya śivadāya ca \|*  
*yogīndrāṇāṃ ca yogīndra gurūṇāṃ gurave namaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Asita said – О teacher of the universe, I offer my salutation to you. You are the form of welfare and bestow welfare, you are best among the yogis and happen to be the teacher of the teachers. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 30.44 \|\|

*mṛtyomṛrtyusvarūpeṇa mṛtyusaṃsārakhaṇḍana \|*  
*mṛtyorīśa mṛtyubīja mṛtyuñjaya namo'stu te \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Taking to the form of death, you even destroy the death. You are the lord of death, the cause of death and are the one who has over-powered death. I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 30.45 \|\|

*kālarūpaṃ kalayatāṃ kālakāleśa kāraṇa \|*  
*kālādatīta kālasya kālakāla namo'stu te \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О great lord, you are the form of Kala and the aim of those who count the time. You happen to be the death for the Kala, the lord and the cause of the death. You are the death for the Kala, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 30.46 \|\|

*guṇātīta guṇādhāra guṇabīja guṇātmaka \|*  
*guṇīśa guṇināṃ bīja guṇināṃ gurave namaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. You are beyond the qualities, the base of qualities, the cause of qualities, the lord of qualities, the seed of the virtuous people, you are the teacher of virtuous people. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 30.47 \|\|

*brahmasvarūpa brahmajña brahmabhāve ca tatpara \|*  
*brahmabījasvarūpeṇa brahmabīja namostu te \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. You are the form of Brahman, well-versed in the Brahman, thinker of Brahman and the form of Brahman as well as the seed of the Vedas, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 30.48 \|\|

*iti stutvā śivaṃ natvā purastasthau munīśvaraḥ \|*  
*dīnavatsāśrunetraśca pulakāṃ citavigrahaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. After offering the prayer to Shiva, he stood before him like a helpless person and started dropping tears from his eyes. His entire body was filled with sensation.

## \|\| 30.49 \|\|

*asitena kṛtaṃ stotraṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*varṣamekaṃ haviṣyāśī śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The one who recites the stotra of Shiva composed by Asita regularly for a year and also consumer havisya food with devotion, he achieves a Vaishnava and intelligent son having long life.

## \|\| 30.50-51 \|\|

*sa labhedvai ṣṇavaṃ putraṃ jñāninaṃ cirajīvinam \|*  
*bhavedanāḍhyo duḥkhī ca mūko bhavati paṇḍitaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*abhāryo labhate bhāryāṃ suśīlāṃ ca pativra tām \|*  
*iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante śivasannidhim \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. The pauper achieves riches the dumb person becomes intelligent and the person without a wife achieves a chaste wife. He after enjoying all the riches in the universe ultimately reaches the abode of Shiva.

## \|\| 30.52 \|\|

*idaṃ stotraṃ purā dattaṃ brahmaṇā ca pracetase \|*  
*pracetasā svaputrāyāsitāya dattamuttamam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. In the earlier times this stotra was handed down by Brahma to Praceta who intum handed it down to his son Asita.

## \|\| 30.53 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*samākarṇya muneḥ stotraṃ bhagavāñchaṃkaraḥ svayam \|*  
*uvāca brahmaṇaḥ putraṃ svabhaktaṃ bhaktava tsalaḥ \|\| 53\|\|*

53\. Krishna said – On hearing the stotra from the sage, lord Shiva who is always graceful to his devotees, said to the son of Brahma.

## \|\| 30.54 \|\|

*śaṃkara uvāca \|*  
*sthiro bhava muniśreṣṭha jānāmi tava vāñchitam \|*  
*putraste bhavitā satyaṃ madaṃśena ca matsamaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Shiva said – О best of the sages, be patient. I am well-aware of your desire. You will achieve a son from my amsa, who will equate me. This is true.

## \|\| 30.55-60 \|\|

*dāsyāmi mantramatulaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca sudurlabham \|*  
*ityuktvā ca dadau mantraṃ tavaiva ṣoḍaśākṣaram \|\| 55 \|\|*

*stotraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca kavacaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*saṃsāravijayaṃ nāma puraścaraṇapūrvakam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*varaṃ dātumiṣṭadevī pratyakṣā bhaviteti ca \|*  
*ityuktvā virato rudraḥ sa taṃ natvā jagāma ha \|\| 57 \|\|*

*jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ so'sitaḥ śatavatsaram \|*  
*sākṣādbhūtvā varastasmai tvayā dattaḥ purā sati \|\| 58 \|\|*

*putraste bhavitā satyaṃ mahājñānī suteti ca \|*  
*varaṃ dattvā tvamagamo golokaṃ mama sannidhim \|\| 59 \|\|*

*kālena ca sutastasya śivāṃśena babhūva ha \|*  
*brahmiṣṭho devalo nāmnā kandarpasamasundaraḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

55-60. I will bestow a beautiful mantra to you which is beyond the reach of all the people. Thus speaking Shiva bestowed on the sage your sixteen letter mantra, stotra method of adoration and the method of its completion. He also bestowed on him, the kavacha which made the devotees victorious on the universe and said to the Brahmanas. The goddess will appear before you for bestowing the boons on you. Thus speaking Rudra kept quiet and the Brahman bowing in reverence to him left the place. Thereafter the sage Asita recited the mantra, for a hundred years. Thereafter you appeared before hire in earlier times and granted him a boon saying, "You will beget a most illustrious son. This is the truth." Thus pronouncing the boon on the Brahmana, you returned, to Goloka and joined me.

## \|\| 30.61 \|\|

*suyajñanṛpateḥ kanyāṃ ratnamālāvatīṃ mudā \|*  
*tāṃ sundarīṃ vivāhena jagṛhe sarvamo hinīm \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. In due course of time Asita had a son named Devala from the amsa of Shiva who was denoted to Brahman and was as beautiful as the god of love. He was married to the daughter of Suyajna named Ratnamalavati who was quite charming and beautiful.

## \|\| 30.62 \|\|

*sthāne sthāne ca rahasi śatavarṣaṃ tayā saha \|*  
*sa reme nipuṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ strīṇāṃ ramaṇakarmaṇi \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The sage Devala who was well-versed in the art of making love, enjoyed the company with Ratnamalavati for a hundred years roaming about in several secluded places.

## \|\| 30.63-64 \|\|

*kālāntare sa virato babhūva munipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*sukhaṃ sarvaṃ parityajya dharmiṣṭhaḥ śrīhariṃ smaran \|\| 63 \|\|*

*utthāya rātrau śayanādviraktaśca tapodhanaḥ \|*  
*sa yayau tapase kānte gandhamādanaparvate \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. In due course of time a sense of detachment developed in the mind of Devala, after which he is discarded everything and devoted his mind to lord Hari once during the night he got up from the bad and went to a cave in the Gandhamadana mountain for performing tapas.

## \|\| 30.65 \|\|

*nidrāṃ tyaktvā ca tatkāntā na dṛṣṭvā svāminaṃ satī \|*  
*vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ śokātpradagdhā virahāgninā \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. When his wife woke up he found her husband missing and burning with the pangs of separation, she started lamenting filled with grief.

## \|\| 30.66-67 \|\|

*uttiṣṭhantī nirviśantī rurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*taptapātre yathā dhānyaṃ babhūva tanmanastadā \|\| 66 \|\|*

*āhāraṃ ca parityajya prāṇāṃstatyāja sundarī \|*  
*cakāra tatsutastasyāḥ karma nirharaṇādikam \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Sometimes she got up and sometimes she fell down. Thus Ratnamalavati started crying aloud again and again, her mind was facing the same condition as the paddy faces while it is poured in the burning vase. The beautiful damsel stopped taking food and ultimately she met with her end. After her death her son cremated her, performing all the last rites.

## \|\| 30.68-69 \|\|

*tapaścakāra sa munirgandhamādanagahvare \|*  
*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca mama bhakto jitendriyaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*taṃ dadarśa ha daivena rambhā śṛṃgāralokupā \|*  
*atīvasundaraṃ śāntaṃ kandarpamiva sundaram \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. The sage who was self-controlled and was my devotee performed tapas in the cave at Gandhamadana mountain for a thousand divine years. As a move of destiny in the meantime, the extremely passionate Rambha looked at the sage who was quite beautiful, peaceful and was as charming as the god of love.

## \|\| 30.70 \|\|

*sā ca taṃ kathayāmāsa nirjane samupasthitā \|*  
*vidhāya veṣaṃ yatnena trailokyacittamohinī \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Rambha who could attract, three worlds to herself appeared in the secluded place before the sage and said.

## \|\| 30.71 \|\|

*rambhovāca \|*  
*nibodha sādho madvākyaṃ kāminīnāṃ manoharam \|*  
*tyaktvā kaṭhoraṃ rahasi bhaja māṃ sukhadāyikām \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Rambha said – О ascetic, you listen to the charming words of damsel like me. Discarding this hard tapas. you enjoy my company with pleasure in the secluded place.

## \|\| 30.72 \|\|

*tvaṃ vareṣu varaḥ pṛthvyāṃ varārohā svayaṃvarā \|*  
*vidagdhāyā vidagdhasya durlabho nava saṃgamaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Because you are the best among the best and I happen to be the best of the apsaras and quite beautiful. It is really difficult for a competent person to have a union with a competent damsel.

## \|\| 30.73 \|\|

*yajñaṃ kurvanti bhūpālā bhārate svargahetukam \|*  
*svargabhoganimittaṃ ca bhogasārā vayaṃ mune \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. О sage, the kings of the land of Bharata performed yajnas for achieving the heaven, the pleasures of the heaven are available on earth.

## \|\| 30.74 \|\|

*stanayoryugmamūrvorme sundaraṃ mukhapaṃkajam \|*  
*hāsyabhrūbhaṃgasahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā ko na labhetsukham \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Who will not achieve pleasure by enjoying my breasts, the thighs, the beautiful face like the lotus flower and the smile on my face.

## \|\| 30.75 \|\|

*strīrasaḥ sukhasāraśca munīnāmabhivāñchitaḥ \|*  
*rasikāsukhasaṃbhogo nirjane cātidurlabhaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Because out of all the pleasures, the pleasure of the company of a damsel is desired even by the great sages. It is very difficult to get the pleasure of enjoying the company of a beautiful damsel in a lonely place.

## \|\| 30.76 \|\|

*devo vā mānavo vā'pi gandharvo vā'tha rākṣasaḥ \|*  
*srīsukheṣvapyavijñeyo rambhāyā rativañcitaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The gods, the humans, Gandharvas and the demons getting deprived of the love sports of Rambha should be treated like those who are unaware of the pleasure of the company of the ladies.

## \|\| 30.77 \|\|

*rahasyupasthitāṃ kāntāṃ na bhajedyo jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*gātralomapramāṇābdaṃ kumbhīpāke vaseddhruvam \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Such of the self-controlled person who does not enjoy the company of the damsel who appears before him in a secluded place, he falls into the kumbhipaka hell and has to remain their till the number of years equivalent to the number hair oil ones body.

## \|\| 30.78 \|\|

*satyaṃ tasyāśca vadhabhāktacchāpena praṇa śyati \|*  
*vidhātā mohinīśāpādapūjyo bhuvanatraye \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. He earns the sin of killing the damsel and is also destroyed with the same sin. Brahma became unadorable because of the curse of Mohini.

## \|\| 30.79 \|\|

*yena tyaktopasthitā taṃ yathā paśyati puṃścalī \|*  
*svāmiputrasvabandhūnāṃ na tathā ghātakaṃ ruṣā \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. The one who disowns a loose women, she looks at him with such a great anger with which she never looks at her husband, son father and the her other relatives.

## \|\| 30.80 \|\|

*paraṃ priyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ jāraṃ jānāti puṃścalī \|*  
*yadi tena parityaktā taṃ hantuṃ sā tu dakṣiṇā \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. The loose women is considered by men to be more loveable. Therefore, if anyone disowns a loose woman he appears like killing himself.

## \|\| 30.81 \|\|

*puṃścalī hiṃsrajantubhyo navaghātibhya eva ca \|*  
*duṣṭā śaśvaddayāhīnā durantā pratijanmani \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. The loose women becomes more dangerous than the wild animal who attacks in rage and she always become heartless and at is the cause of the miseries.

## \|\| 30.82 \|\|

*tyaja dhyānaṃ muniśreṣṭha bhuṃkṣvedaṃ tapasaḥ phalam \|*  
*rahasyupasthitāṃ māṃ ca gṛhītvā suciraṃ sukham \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. O best of the sages you disown your tapas and enjoy my company for long in the secluded places, earning the reward of your tapas.

## \|\| 30.83 \|\|

*sa rambhāvacanaṃ śrutvā tāmuvāca bhayākulaḥ \|*  
*hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. On hearing the words of Rambha, the sage felt panicky and he spoke the words which were beneficial, truthful, appropriate and could result in achieving pleasure.

## \|\| 30.84 \|\|

*devala uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rambhe pravakṣyāmi vedasāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*kuladharmocitaṃ satyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvinām \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Devala said – О Rambha listen to me, I am going to tell you the essence of the Vedas which is truthful and is appropriate to the one who is born in the race of Brahmanas.

## \|\| 30.85 \|\|

*dharmo'yaṃ yuktakāle ca svayoṣiti rato dvijaḥ \|*  
*sarvatra pūjitaḥ śaśvadiha loke paratra ca \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. It has been prescribed that a Brahmanas should enjoy the company of his wife at the appropriate time. Such a Brahmana is adored in this as well as in this future birth.

## \|\| 30.86 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyo yo rataḥ parayoṣiti \|*  
*yāti tasyāpūjitasya ruṣṭā lakṣmīrgṛhādapi \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Such of the Brahmana or Kshatriya or Vaisya who always indulges in the worldly pleasure with his wife, he becomes unadorable and the goddess of riches getting annoyed, leaves this place.

## \|\| 30.87 \|\|

*ihātinindyaḥ sarvatra nādhikārī svakarmasu \|*  
*paratraivāndhakūpe ca yāvadvarṣaśataṃ vaset \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. He is denounced in this world getting discarded from his race and is not considered suitable for performing any good deeds. After his death, he falls into the andhakupa hell where he has to stay for a hundred years.

## \|\| 30.88 \|\|

*grāhyā copasthitā strī ca gṛhiṇā na tapasvinā \|*  
*tyāge doṣaḥ kāminīnāṃ śāpabhākpāpabhāggṛhī \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. Therefore it could be proper for a house holder to except a women who approaches him but no for an ascetic. Only a house-holder earns a sin by disregarding the damsels. It is he, who gets entitled for a curse or a sin.

## \|\| 30.89 \|\|

*brahmā jagadvidhātā'pi na viraktaḥ kalatravān \|*  
*tyāge doṣastatkadācinnāsmākaṃ tyaktayoṣitām \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Lord Brahma the creator of the universe also has a wife and has not become an ascetic. Therefore the ascetic who has already disowned the damsel can earn no sin by discarding a loose women.

## \|\| 30.90 \|\|

*svabhāryāṃ ca parityajya yo gṛhṇāti parastriyam \|*  
*yaśodhanāyuṣāṃ hānirbhavejjīvanmṛtasya ca \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. The one who accepts another damsel by disowning his own wife, he is treated as dead while still being alive. All his glory, fortune and age are destroyed.

## \|\| 30.91 \|\|

*bhuvi nāsti yaśo yasya jīvanaṃ tasya niṣphalam \|*  
*susaṃpadā kiṃ rājyena sukhena ca tapasvinaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. The one who does not achieve glory on earth, his life is of no consequence. The ascetic remain unconcerned with the riches, the kingdom and other worldly pleasure.

## \|\| 30.92 \|\|

*niṣkāmena ca vṛddhena mayā kiṃ te prayojanam \|*  
*suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ mātaryuvānaṃ paśya sundari \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. О mother, what purpose would be served by your accepting an ascetic person like me. О beautiful one, you search for some others youthful person who should be beautiful.

## \|\| 30.93 \|\|

*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopāpsarasāṃ varā \|*  
*uvāca bhūyo vākyaṃ taṃ trastā prasphuritādharā \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. On hearing the words of the sage, the apsara was enraged. Her lips started fluttering and getting panicky, she spoke to Devala.

## \|\| 30.94 \|\|

*rambhovāca \|*  
*cārucampakavarṇābhaḥ kandarpasamasundaraḥ \|*  
*tapaḥprabhāvātsaśrīkaḥ suveṣaḥ saṃmataḥ striyāḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Rambha said – You have a complexion like beautiful moon and the flowers, you are beautiful like the god of love, as a result of tapas you have attained great glory and your physique has attracted a damsel.

## \|\| 30.95 \|\|

*tvayā vinā'nyaṃ kaṃ yāmi ko vāsti tvatparaḥ pumān \|*  
*puṃścalī tvāṃ parityajya kā jīvati smarā turā \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Whom shall I approach after leaving you, who else is a better person like you? which one of the loose women getting infested with passion can remain alive disowning you.

## \|\| 30.96 \|\|

*śīghraṃ māṃ bhaja viprendra dagdhāṃ kāmāgninā sadā \|*  
*kāmo naśyati māṃ tvatto yathā rambhāṃ mataṃgajaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Therefore, О best of the Brahmanas, I am burning with passion and you enjoy my company. I am getting destroyed by your neglect as the trunk of the banana tree gets destroyed when trampled upon by the intoxicated elephant.

## \|\| 30.97 \|\|

*na cecchāpaṃ pradāsyāmi vada vedavidāṃ vara \|*  
*māṃ vā dāruṇaśāpaṃ vā satvaraṃ grahaṇaṃ kuru \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. О best of those well-versed in the Vedas in case you do not agreed to my words I am sure to pronounce a curse on you. Now you accept a terrific curse which is going to pronounced by me.

## \|\| 30.98 \|\|

*dagdhāḥ prāṇā manodagdhaṃ svātmā vā iti saṃtatam \|*  
*navaśṛṅgārapīyūṣapānanirvāṇatāṃ vrajet \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. My mind, my life and my soul are burning at the moment. They are desirous of enjoying the nectar of new found love, which can only pacify me.

## \|\| 30.99 \|\|

*svāntarduḥkhena duḥkhārto yo yaṃ śapati niścitam \|*  
*taṃ śāpaṃ khaṇḍituṃ śakto na vidhātā jagatpatiḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. The one who pronoimces a curse whose soul is hurt, the curse of such a person cannot be negativated even by Brahma the lord of the universe.

## \|\| 30.100-102 \|\|

*dvijo rambhāvacaḥ śrutvā babhūva dhyānatatparaḥ \|*  
*novāca kiṃcinmaunasthaḥ sā taṃ kopācchaśāpa ha \|\| 100 \|\|*

*he vakracitta te vipra sarvāvayavavakrimam \|*  
*śarīramañjanākāraṃ rūpayauvanavarjitam \|\| 101 \|\|*

*atīvavikṛtākāraṃ triṣu lokeṣu garhitam \|*  
*purātanaṃ tapo naṣṭaṃ sadyo bhavatu niścitam \|\| 102 \|\|*

100-102. On hearing the words of Rambha, the Brahmana started performing tapas and uttered no words. At this, Rambha was en raged a and she pronounced a curse on the sage saying, "O Brahmana, having a wicked mind your body will get deformed and all your limbs will have to face deformity. Your body will become black like collyrium and you will be deprived of youthfulness. Your form should become completely deformed which, should be denounced by everyone. And the tapas performed by you till now should become fruitless."

## \|\| 30.103 \|\|

*ityuktvā puṃścalī kāmātkāmalokaṃ jagāma ha \|*  
*acireṇa munīndraśca na dadarśa hareḥ padam \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Thus speaking the loose women getting infested with passion left for the abode of the god of love. Thereafter the sage could not achieve an audience with the lord.

## \|\| 30.104-105 \|\|

*padāravindavirahātsamudvigno babhūva ha \|*  
*svāṅgaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā vikṛtaṃ pūrvapuṇyavivarjitam \|\| 104 \|\|*

*kṛtvā'gnikuṇḍaṃ śokena prāṇāṃstya ktuṃ samudyataḥ \|*  
*mayā dṛṣṭo varo datto divyajñānena bodhitaḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. With the separation of his mind from the lotus-like feet of the lord, the sage was upset. With the loss of all tapas and the merits, he was filled with grief and finding all his limbs deformed, he tried to enter into the fire altar, with the intention putting an end to his life-In the meantime, I saw the sage, blessed him and bestowed the divine knowledge on him.

## \|\| 30.106-108 \|\|

*āśvāsaśca kṛtaḥ prītyā tataḥ śānto babhūva ha \|*

*tapo'vasāne madbhakto mayā yuktaḥ kṛtaḥ priye \|\| 108 \|\|*

106-108. I assured him lovingly as a result of which, the sage became peaceful. Finding that all the eight limbs of his body had been deformed. 1 playfully gave him the name of Astavakra. Thereafter at my advice, he went to Malayacala and he performed tapas for sixty thousand years. О dear one, at the end of the tapas I release my devotees.

## \|\| 30.109-112 \|\|

*sarvasminpralaye naṣṭe na madbhaktaḥ praṇaśyati \|*

*tyaktāhārasyāntaraṃ ca bhasmapūrṇaṃ tato muneḥ \|*  
*āgataṃ malayadroṇīṃ munihetormayā priye \|\| 110\|\|*

*aṣṭāvakrācca madbhakto na bhūto na bhaviṣyati \|*

*niṣkalaḥ puṃścalī śāpādbrahmā'pūjyo yathā purā \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ gūḍhaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 112 \|\|*

109-112. At the time of dissolution when every thing is destroyed my devotee remain unaffected. He performed tapas without consuming anything for a long time. The fire of his stomach consumed everything within the body and the sage reducing the same to the ashes. О dear, I had arrived in the valley of Malaya mountain for the sake of this sage, There has been no other devotees of mine great or than Astavakra nor shall there be anyone in future. The great grandson of Brahma had beei -such a great ascetic, but with the curse of that loose women, he was deprived of everything as Brahma became unadorable in the earlier times. Thus I have narrated to your the entire secret story of the sage which was quite pleasant and bestows merit. What else do you want to listen from me.

Because of the hard tapas his body was shattered. When his body was covered with white-ants, the compassionate lord Brahma arrived there in the secluded place, where he was performing tapas in order to bestow a boon or him.

*kamaṇḍalujalasparśādutthāya nṛpatiḥ svayam \|*

39-40. The one who is always attracted towards whom is entangled in him. О dear one, you look at me I am moving to Kamaloka infatuated with passion. О virtuous one, you speak out the words which may pen et rate his heart.

## \|\| 31.41-44 \|\|

*munimohanabījaṃ ca taṃ mohaṃ kuru mohini \|*

41-44. Protecting yourself do not allow the grace of the women to be shattered in the three worlds. О dear, one should reveals her heart to the same one, after ensuring that the same person is really loved by her, otherwise there-is always possibility of your being laughed at, which results into death. On hearing the words of Rambha, Mohini felt ashamed while walking with the smile on her face and spoke to her, the secret of her mind which had placed her in that condition.

*mohinyuvāca \|*

45-46. Mohini said – О Rambha since the time I bad have seen Brahma in a secluded place. I am burning with passion since than. I have not taken food since than because I don’t have any inclination for the same.

*jānāmi nāhamudayaṃ yāminīśadineśayoḥ \|*

## \|\| 31.53 \|\|

53\. Rambha said – О noble lady, if it is like so, then listen to me fearlessly, I am speak to you about your welfare. I shall removed all your sufferings.

*kṛtvā veṣamapūrvaṃ ca pūrvamārādhya manmatham \|*

## \|\| 31.55 \|\|

*jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakam \|*

## \|\| 31.56-57 \|\|

*bhaja kāmaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā puṣkare vraja mohini \|*

*ityuktvā tāmapsarasāṃ pravarā kāmamantikam \|*

56-57. О Mohini, you go to the Puskara region and serve the god of love. He is quite compassionate and the lord of the women and would surely appear before you without delay. Thus speaking to Mohini, Rambha the best of the apsaras went to the god of love for her satisfaction and Mohini went to the Puskara region.

## \|\| 31.58 \|\|

*puṣkare ca tapaḥ kṛtvā kāmaṃ saṃprāpya mohinī \|*

58\. Reaching there Mohini performed tapas and achieved the god of love. Accompanied with him, she went to Brahmaloka which is free from all the ailments.

## \|\| 31.59-63 \|\|

*dadarśa nirjanasthaṃ ca mohinī kamalodbhavam \|*

*kṣaṇaṃ nanarta suciraṃ sugānena kṣaṇaṃ jagau \|*

*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo mumoha sāśrulocanaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā mugdhaṃ caturvaktraṃ mohinī hṛṣṭamānasā \|*

*svāṅgaṃ saṃdarśayāmāsa smerabhrūbhaṅgapūrvakam \|*

59-63. Finding Brahma in a secluded place Mohini tried to entice Brahma. She would at time dance and at times she started singing. Than she started reciting the songs which could attract the minds of my devotees. Brahma the creator of the universe was influenced with the singing of Mohini and his entire body felt emotional. His eyes were filled with tears. Finding Brahma to have been filled with passion, Mohini was delighted. She than displayed her intentions quite play fully. She displayed her side-glances, smiles and her limbs. The one having lest his senses would never care for the shame in the world.

## \|\| 31.64 \|\|

*vijñāya brahmā tadbhāvaṃ natavaktro babhūva ha \|*  
*pradāya tasyā dānaṃ ca virataḥ śrīhariṃ smaran \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. When realising the intentions of Mohini, Brahma cast his glance down-wards, after giving her the reward, he started reciting the name of the lord detracting his mind from her.

## \|\| 31.65 \|\|

*vijñāya brahmaṇo bhāvaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā \|*

65\. Realising about the intention of Brahma, the throat, lips and palate of Mohini were dried up. Finding her efforts becoming useless, he started offering prayer to the best of the god of love for the fulfilment of her desires.

## \|\| 31.66-67 \|\|

*mohinyuvāca \|*  
*sarvendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ viṣṇoraṃśaṃ ca mānasam \|*

66-67. Mohini said – You are the best among the organ of senses and happen to be the arhsha of Vis nu, the seeds emerge because of your deeds and the universe emerged out of them I offer my salutations to you. The lord himself is the soul and Shiva happens to be the creator of the universe add you are born out of him. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 31.68 \|\|

*sṛṣṭiḥ sarvaśarīreṣu dṛṣṭiśca yogināmapi \|*

68\. You are manifest in all the bodies and also happen to be the sight of the yogis, you are the solution of the universe, difficult in adoration and difficult to get, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 31.69 \|\|

*sarvājita jagajjetarjīva jīvamanohara \|*

## \|\| 31.70-71 \|\|

*śaśvadyoṣidadhiṣṭhāna yoṣitprāṇādhikapriya \|*

70-71. You are always adored by the ladies and are dearer to them than their lives. You are the one who bestows the love of the husband, the base of all the beauties, the source of all the qualities, the courtier of the fragrant breeze, friend of the spring season, I offer my adoration to you.

## \|\| 31.72 \|\|

*śaśvadyonikṛtādhāra strīsaṃdarśanavardhana \|*

72\. You are always dependent on the pelvic region and increase the beauty of the women always and pacify those who are separated from each other, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 31.73 \|\|

*akṛpā yeṣu te'narthāsteṣāṃ jñānavināśanam \|*

73\. Such of the people who could not enjoy your grace, their lives become useless and they loose intelligence. Your form is quite visible in your devotees. О ocean of mercy, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 31.74 \|\|

*tapasvināṃ ca tapasāṃ vighnabījāvalīlayā \|*  
*manaḥ sakāmaṃ muktānāṃ kartuṃ śakta namo'stu te \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. You are the form of seed in creating obstruction in the tapas of the ascetics; you can influence the mind of the unconcerned person play fully, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 31.75 \|\|

*tapaḥsādhyāścārādhyāśca sadaivaṃ pāñcabhautikāḥ \|*

75\. You can be adored by performing tapas with this Pancabhautika body and you get pleased also you are the base of the five organs of senses and have the five arrows of love, I offer my salutations to you.

## \|\| 31.76-77 \|\|

*mohinītyevamuktvā tu manasā sā vidheḥ puraḥ \|*

*uktaṃ mādhyaṃdine kānte stotrametanmanoharam \|*  
*purā durvāsasā dattaṃ mohinyai gandhamādane \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. After thus speaking Mohini felt unconcerned and reaching before Brahma, she stood there casting her eyes down-wards. О lord she recited this stotra prescribed in Madhyandina-shakha at Gandhamadana mountain.

## \|\| 31.78 \|\|

*stotrametanmahāpuṇyaṃ kāmī bhaktyā yadā paṭhet \|*

78\. If a passionate person recites the stotra. with devotion he achieves his aim without fail and surely becomes spotless.

## \|\| 31.79 \|\|

*ceṣṭāṃ na kurute kāmaḥ kadācidapi taṃ priyam \|*

79\. Even the passion does not trouble the beloved. He always remains hail and hearty, healthy, possessing all the riches and the glory resembling the god of love. He also gets a wife, who could attract all the three worlds.

## Chapter 32

## \|\| 32.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*mohinīstavanenaiva kāmastuṣṭo babhūva ha \|*

1-2. Lord Krishna said – The god of love was pleased with the prayer of MohinT and he himself arrived there, remaining in the space, he placed an arrow on the bow and sanctifying it with auspicious mantras he shot the arrows at Brahma. With the shooting of the arrow of the god of love, the mind of Brahma became unstable and passion was aroused in him.

## \|\| 32.3-5 \|\|

*kṣaṇaṃ nirīkṣaṇaṃ cakre mohinyāsye punaḥpunaḥ \|*

*he kāma yauvanonmatta mūḍhaiśvaryeṇa garvita \|*  
*bhavitā darpabhaṅgaste gurorme helanāditi \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Не looked at the face of Mohini for a moment and than he started looking at her again and again. Thereafter Brahma achieved the great knowledge reciting the name of Hari and then he became unconcerned, e could realise with the divine sights the entire play of the god of love. Thereafter getting upset Brahma pronounced a curse on the god of love also since he happened to be his own son. "You have been intoxicated of your youth, О foolish one, you have become proud of your wealthy your pride will be shattered because of disregarding me who happens to be your own teacher.

## \|\| 32.6 \|\|

*hatodyamo jagāmāśu manmatho madhunā saha \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ śāpabhītaśca śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Becoming unsuccessful in his efforts, the god of love left the place at once accompanied by the spring season. Terrified from the curse of Brahma, his throat, lips and palate were dried up.

## \|\| 32.7 \|\|

*ityuvāca jagaddhātā mohinīṃ madanāturām \|*

## \|\| 32.8 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*mātarmohini gaccha tvaṃ niṣphalaṃ karma cātra te \|*

8\. Brahma said – О mother Mohini, you will not be successful with me. Therefore, you leave this place. I have understood your mind. I am not suitable for this purpose.

## \|\| 32.9 \|\|

*vede jugupsitaṃ karma tadeva kartumakṣamaḥ \|*

9\. I am myself the creator of the Vedas and organised the whole universe Therefore, I am unable to indulge in a deed which has been denounced in the Vedas,

## \|\| 32.10-14 \|\|

*akīrtiṃ vedavaktuśca nindyaṃ ca kimataḥ param \|*

*śrutau śrutamiti tyājyā sarvadaiva tapasvinām \|*

*niṣṭhurā navaghātibhyaḥ sarvāpadbījarūpiṇī \|*

*paradrohādyathā saṃpatkulaṭāprema tatsamam \|*  
*sarvebhyo hiṃsrajantubhyo vipadbījā sadaiva hi \|\| 14 \|\|*

10-14. What more degrading could it be for the me who is well-versed in the Vedas, passionate woman who presents herself with the evil intent ion has to be disowned by even a passionate person and the ascetics should always get rid of her. This had been ordained in the Vedas. Particularly the loose-women have to be disowned by everyone. The proximity of the loose women results in the destruction of wife, riches, life, age and glory. She happens to be worse than the killers and is the seed for misfortune. The love of the wicked women, the lustre of the lightening, the line drawn on the water, friendship, with the intention of greed and the riches achieved by betraying others, are all short lived, the wicked women result in greater misery as compared to the wild animals.

## \|\| 32.15 \|\|

*yo viśvasettāṃ saṃmūḍho vipattasya padepade \|*

15\. The one who believes them has to face the misfortune at every step, you are quite beautiful and graceful also and you always keep your self aloof from the passionate people.

## \|\| 32.16 \|\|

*yūnāṃ saṃpatsvarūpā ca viṣatulyā tapasvinām \|*

## \|\| 32.17 \|\|

*tavaiva karma yogyaṃ ca yuvānaṃ paśya sundari \|*

17\. О beautiful one, therefore you search for another youthful person for your purpose. You are quite intelligent among the women and therefore search for an intelligent men.

## \|\| 32.18-19 \|\|

*vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet \|*

*asvatantraḥ parādhīnaḥ kā ratiḥ puṃścalīṣu me \|*

18-19. The union of a passionate lady with a passionate man is always useful. I have already reached the old age and am pretty old and ascetic, a Vaishnava Brahmana and am not independent. How could my mind get attracted towards a loose women? Therefore, О daughter, leaving a father like me, you leave this place.

## \|\| 32.20-21 \|\|

*nātrā'haṃ ca jagatsraṣṭā tasmāttava pitā sadā \|*  
*manmathaṃ caṃdramitraṃ ca jayantaṃ nalakūbaram \|\| 20 \|\|*

*svarvaidyau caṃdratanayaṃ ditiputrāṃśca suṃdarān \|*

20-21. I am the creator of the universe by name and from that point view I am your father as well. You can go to Chandramitra, Kamadeva, Jayanta, Nalakubara, Asvinlkumara, Budha and the beautiful sons of Diti. They are well-versed in the art of making love.

## \|\| 32.22-24 \|\|

*yā māṃ yāsi hi tāṃstyaktvā sā vidagdhā ca kāmukī \|*

*strī cetprayāti puruṣaṃ viparītaṃ viḍambanam \|*

*svayaṃ prārthayate svāmī na tu svāminameva ca \|*

22-24. when you have come to me disregarding such people, how could you be termed as an intelligent passionate women. It is the man who always desired a union with a woman. In case a women goes to a man, it is just like moving in apposite direction. Of all the gems, the gem-like women is considered to be the best. The husband himself requests the wife and not the other way. Such of the ladies who themselves approach the men are denounced.

## \|\| 32.25 \|\|

*bhaveddūraṃ svalpamūlyaṃ ratnaṃ svayamupasthitam \|*

25\. If a gem appears itself then its value decreases. The men always approach the women and the women never approaches, the men.

## \|\| 32.26-27 \|\|

*lokācāreṣu vedeṣu na strī yāti parapriyam \|*

*sa pūjyo na bhavetpūjyo yadratiḥ paravastuṣu \|*  
*kaḥ kasya śatrurabale niśāmaya jagattraye \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Neither has it been provided in the Vedas nor in the prevalent traditions in which the women approaches the men. The one who holds in high esteem his own wife is always adorable but the one who is infatuated with passion towards others wives, is not adorable. О helpless lady, who is the enemy of whom in the three worlds.

## \|\| 32.28-29 \|\|

*svendriyāḥ śatravaḥ sarve śatrutā yannimittataḥ \|*

28-29. Your own organ of senses are your enemies because of which the enmity develops. In case, one behaves as per the provisions of the Vedas, he finds the entire universe friendly to him. In case one, acts against the Vedas even the friend turn inimical to him and the one who moves according to the Vedas, the lord is always pleased with him.

30\. By pleasing the lord, the entire universe gets pleased and in case he becomes annoyed the entire universe becomes inimical. Where are the wicked women and where are the chaste ones?

*svakīyācaraṇātsarvaṃ bhave bhavati karmaṇaḥ \|*

## \|\| 32.32-33 \|\|

*duḥśīlā puṃścalī nindyā suśīlā ca pativratā \|*

32-33. The wicked woman always has a loose character and is denounced by all and the noble lady is always treated to be chaste. Even the chaste women are of three types. There is no differentiation among the loose women. Such of the women who herself goes to another person, she happens to be the black spot among the women.

## \|\| 32.34-35 \|\|

*bhave ratyai svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā veṣaṃ kṛtvā prayāti tam \|*

*vaktuṃ samudyatā sā ca kopaprasphuritādharā \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Such a women goes to another person decorating herself, then in spite of her being of high caste, she cannot be held in high esteem. She can be considered as an ordinary woman. Thus speaking Brahma the creator of the universe kept quiet and the apsara whose lips were fluttering in rage spoke in anger.

## \|\| 32.36-39 \|\|

*mohinyuvāca \|*

*tvayā nibodhitā nītirmano me na sthiraṃ bhavet \|*

*tvadvaktradṛṣṭimātreṇa sarve jārāśca vismṛtāḥ \|*

36-39. Mohini said – О creator of the universe, I have come to know your entire life story presently. Whatever regulations have been spelt out by you can not provide solace to my mind. Ever since I cast a glance on you, my mind felt attracted towards you. With the sight of your face all my earlier friends have been forgotten. This body of mine has started burning with passion. When I was going to end my life Rambha prevented me from doing so and she advised me accordingly. Thereafter, I came to you with the help of the god of love.

## \|\| 32.40 \|\|

*samadhustava śāpena sa jagāma hatodyamaḥ \|*

40\. Getting terrified with the curse pronounced by him on you, he also left the place becoming unsuccessful. Though you have denounced me but I am unable to leave the place.

## \|\| 32.41 \|\|

*sarvāṅgeṣveva me jāḍyaṃ babhūva sāṃprataṃ vibho \|*

41\. О virtuous one, all my limbs are presently becoming numb. О ocean of mercy be compassionate on me. It would not be proper for you to kill me.

## \|\| 32.42 \|\|

*tavāśleṣaṇamātreṇa vijvarā'haṃ suniścitam \|*

42\. This is certain that I shall feel satisfied only by embracing you. Because of the deeds you are the creator of the worlds and I happen to be a wicked women.

*kaścicchacyāśca jaṭharaṃ tava putrāśca kecana \|*  
*kecitkṛtvā harerbhaktiṃ karmaṇā tasya pārṣadāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

## \|\| 32.48 \|\|

*kecidbhavanti kṛmayo viṣṭhāyāṃ daivadoṣataḥ \|*

## \|\| 32.49 \|\|

*kecitprayānti narakaṃ viṇmūtre tatra pacyate \|*
