50-51. Some people become the gods, humans and petty creatures because of the influence of their deeds-some of the people become the best of the Brahmanas on earth. Some of them become the kings, Vaishyas, Shudras and Mlecchas. Some of the people becomes intellectuals by their deeds and some of them become all knowledgeable because of their deeds.

## \|\| 32.52 \|\|

*kecinmūrkhāḥ kecidandhāḥ svāṅgahīnāśca kecana \|*

## \|\| 32.53-54 \|\|

*kecitpaṭhanti sarvārthaṃ jānanti guruvaktrataḥ \|*

## \|\| 32.55 \|\|

*kācidveśyā tadāhāraṃ bhuṅkte kṛtvā'ṅga vikrayam \|*

## \|\| 32.56-57 \|\|

*śrutvā rahasyaṃ tatsarvaṃ prahasyovāca taṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*satyaṃ sāraṃ hitaṃ vākyaṃ jagatāṃ ca sukhāvaham \|\| 48 \|\|*

43-48. She said, "How could I pronounce a curse on the loveable Brahma who happens to be the creator of the universe?" Aflter the departure of Mohinl the apsara of the heaven, the sages felt immediately grieved and the creator of the universe started trembling. His head was lowered thereafter the sages who always bestows welfare, spoke of the remedy to him, you take refuge with the lord of the Vaikuntha. Thus speaking, all of them left for their respective abodes. Thereafter Brahma went to take refuge with my second figure which is peaceful is the lord of Lakstnl, having dark complexion and known as Narayana. Brahma reached there with faded faces and bowed in reverence to the four armed Vishnu who took his seat besides him. At that point of time his throat, lips and palate had dried up. He than revealed the cause of his arrival to lord Vishnu who is blissful on the down-trodden, the ocean of mercy, the one who redeems all from the miseries. On hearing the words of Brahma, Narayana smiled for a moment and spoke to him the truthful, beneficial words which were the essence of all and provided welfare.

49-53. Narayana said – You yourself are well-versed in the Vedas and happen to be the teacher of all the intelligent teacher but whatever you have done is unheard of in the universe. The woman are the amsa of Prakriti and are the form of seed of the universe. With the insult of a woman Prakriti is insulted. This is not Bharatavarsa alone but happens to be the absolutely sacred place. In this playground of Brahmaloka what was the need of your controlling the senses. In case, in the land of Bharata, accidentally if a damsel reaches a person with the intention of physical unity, infatuated with love even the self controlled persons are not required to disowned her because by doing so he falls into the hell ultimately.

## \|\| 33.54-57 \|\|

*bhavedeva hi duḥkhārtā śāpaṃ dadyācca taṃ dhruvam \|*

54-57. Getting infested with pain such a woman would surely pronounce a curse on the man. The one who disowning his own wife passionately owns some other damsel he is considered to be a degraded person. There is no doubt bout it. He dragged his ten past and ten future generations into the hell. Similarly the women who leaving her own husband passionately goes to another person, she also throws her ten past and ten future generations in the hell but a person who enjoys the company of a whore earns no blemish. Only a damsel of high family earns a blemish. In case a damsel of high family by making efforts attracts someone to her. She surely falls into the hell named andhakiipa and remains there till the life of the sun and the moon.

67-71. Thereafter the hundred faced Brahma was also mode to take his seat beside the two Brahmas who had already arrived. At that very moment another lord of the universe having a thousand faces known as Brahma also arrived before Vishnu. He also adored lord Vishnu bowing his head. He also offered prayer to him reciting the stotras which were unheard of earlier. And all of them were seated, lord Hari enquired about the welfare of the gods and the Brahmas of different globes, finding other Brahmas there, the pride of the four faced Brahma who considered himself to be like other Brahmas was shattered. The lord projected the Brahmas of the other globes.

Then the lord gracefully made him realise that the number of globes equates with the number of the hair on his body and there are the same number of Brahmas, who remain present there always. Thereafter, all the Brahmas bowing before lord Narayana left for their abodes.

Thereafter, the four faced Brahma considered himself to be the lord of a tiny kingdom, his face was lowered in shame thereafter lord Vishnu asked Brahma, "Tell me, what is all this you have seen like a dream?" Listening to the words of Narayana, Brahma said, "With the grace of your illusion I have witness the past, present and future." Thus speaking Brahma felt ashamed in the assembly and thereafter realising the agony of his mind, the lord spoke to him about the method for the release from the curse.

He held, a trident, the paftisha and the best of Khatvdnga in his hand. He carried a musical instrument made of the best of gems. He delight-fully descended from the vehicle and bowing his head with devotion, he offered his salutation to Krishna the lord of Kamala and took his seat to his left.

She was brought on earth by Bhaglratha earning her the name of Bhaglrathi.

*payaḥphenanibhā śaśvadativegavatī sadā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*ākarāmūlyaratnānāṃ maṇīndrāṇāṃ ca saṃtatam \|*  
*nāgakanyāśca yattīre krīḍanti sthirayauvanāḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*svayaṃ devī ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ veṣṭayitvā ca saṃtatam \|*  
*sahasrayojanā prasthe dairghye ca lakṣayojanā \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. The flow of Ganga reaches the nether world which earns her the name of Bhogavati. Her water remains spotless like the milk and always flows with great speed, she always serves as an abode for the diamonds and gems as well as the sages and the female serpent girls always play over her bank. The Ganga herself has surrounded Vaikuntha from all sides which is a lakhs of yojanas in length and a thousand yojanas in width.

## \|\| 34.44 \|\|

*asyā vināśaḥ pralaye nāstyeva duhiturmama \|*  
*nānāratnākaraṃ divyaṃ tattīraṃ sumanoharam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. This daughter of mine never gets destroyed even at the time of dissolution of the world. Her banks are always charming, divine and the store-houses for the gems.

## \|\| 34.45 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ jāhnavījanma puṇyadam \|*  
*brahmaṇaśca pratīkāro mohinīśāpatā śṛṇu \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Thus I have narrated to you the story of the birth of the Ganga. Now you listen to me the method by which Brahma was relieved of the curse of Mohinl.

## Chapter 35

## \|\| 35.1 \|\|

*. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇaśca brahmāṇamuvāca kṛpayā punaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā gaṅgāṃ ca sarve tāṃ mama māyāṃ ca menire \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Krishna said – Narayana compassionately again started speaking to Brahma and all those present there looking at the Ganga took to be for my illusion.

## \|\| 35.2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*uttiṣṭha gaccha bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati caturmukha \|*  
*atra snātvā'bhiśaparastvaṃ pūto bhava mamā''jñayā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Narayana said – О four-faced Brahma get up and go to your abode You will surely meet with welfare. Taking a bath in the river Ganga you will be relieved of the curse with my command.

## \|\| 35.3-4 \|\|

*tvaṃ cetsatyaṃ svayaṃ pūtaḥ sparśaṃ vāñchanti tāni te \|*  
*vaiṣṇaveśasya tīrthāni sarvāṇi satataṃ mune \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tathāpi śāpamuktastvamatra prakṛtihelanāt \|*  
*ahaṃkāraśca sarveṣāṃ pāpabījamamaṅgalam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sage in case you feet truthful and are puce at heart, All these sacred places including yourself are desirous of the touch of Vishnu but since you have defied the nature you have earned a sin. You will therefore be relieved of a sin. The arrogance is the seed of all the sins and misfortunes.

## \|\| 35.5 \|\|

*śīghraṃ tvaṃ gaccha golokaṃ mamālayaṃ parātparam \|*  
*prakṛtyaṃśāṃ maṅgaladāṃ tatra prāpsyasi bhāratīm \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. You immediately move on to my infallible place of Goloka. Reaching there you will achieve Sarasvati who is the form of Prakriti and always bestows welfare.

## \|\| 35.6 \|\|

*prakṛtiṃ bhaja kalyāṇa sṛṣṭibījasvarūpiṇīm \|*  
*aho kalpāntaparyantaṃ tapastaptaṃ tvayā'dhunā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О virtuous one, you own Prakriti, who happens to be the seed of the universe. You have performed tapas, for a kalpa.

## \|\| 35.7 \|\|

*tava mantraṃ na gṛhṇanti ke'pi veśyā'bhiśāpataḥ \|*  
*yadanyadevapūjāyāṃ tava pūjā bhaviṣyati \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Because of the curse of the wicked women no body would recite your mantra but you will be adored together with the other gods.

## \|\| 35.8 \|\|

*tvameva jagatāṃ dhātā svātmārāmaśca yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*sarvarūpī ca pūjaḥ ca sarvadeheṣu sarvataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Since you are the creator of the universe and always remain engrossed in your own soul, you are the form of all and are adorable by all.

## \|\| 35.9 \|\|

*tadā mamājñayā brahmā snātvā ca jāhnavījale \|*  
*śīghraṃ jagāma golokaṃ māṃ praṇamya jagadguruḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Thereafter Brahma the teacher of the universe took bath in the Ganga at my command and left for Goloka.

## \|\| 35.10 \|\|

*te devā munayaḥ sarve prajagmuḥ svālayaṃ mudā \|*  
*sunirmalaṃ mama yaśo gāyantaśca punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Thereafter all the gods, the sages reciting my spotless glory again and again left for their respective abodes.

## \|\| 35.11 \|\|

*vidhirāgatya golokaṃ saṃprāpya bhāratīṃ satīm \|*  
*sarvavidyādhidevīṃ tāṃ madvaktrābjavinirmitām \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. On reaching Goloka Brahma achieved Sarasvati who happens to be the goddess of all the matter and had. emerged out of my lotus-like face.

## \|\| 35.12 \|\|

*vāgīśvarīṃ ca saṃprāpya brahmā pramuditaḥ svayam \|*  
*kāmāstrāṇāṃ ca vyāpāramanumene svayaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Achieving Sarasvati Brahma felt delighted, Brahma then himself permitted the god of love to short the arrows on him.

## \|\| 35.13 \|\|

*tata āgatya māṃ natvā prāpya trailokyamohinīm \|*  
*krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavānsthānesthāne'tinirjane \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Soon thereafter Brahma returned to my place and bowed before me. Owning Sarasvati who could attract the three worlds, Brahma took her to the secluded places and enjoyed her company.

## \|\| 35.14-15 \|\|

*ratiṃ cirataraṃ kṛtvā virarāma svayaṃ vidhiḥ \|*  
*vāgīśvarīmuvācedaṃ tvaṃ vai brahmā ca karmaṇā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kācitsvakarmaṇā sādhvī pūjyā ca sthirayauvanā \|*  
*tavaiva karmayogaṃ ca yuvānaṃ paśya sundari \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. After enjoying the love-sport with her for long, ‘the mind of Brahma felt detached and he spoke to Sarasvati, "You represent the Brahman by your action." A women becomes chaste by her deeds, beside being adorable and possessing the everlasting youth. О beautiful one, you better select some one else who should be quite young for your purpose.

## \|\| 35.16-17 \|\|

*vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet \|*  
*jarāturo'haṃ vṛddhaśca tapasvī vaiṣṇavo dvijaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*asvatantraḥ parādhīnaḥ kā ratiḥ puṃścalīṣu me \|*  
*ājagāma brahmalokaṃ punareva nijālayam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Because a competent women can feel happy with a competent man. Because of my old age I am unstable, old, ascetic, Vaishnava, Brahmana and am governed by others. How could I be attached to a loose women? I have returned again to my own abode which is Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 35.18 \|\|

*dadṛśubrarhmalokasthāstāṃ devīṃ kautukānvitāḥ \|*  
*atīva sundarīṃ ramyāṃ śubhravarṇāṃ ca sasmitām \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The people of Brahmaloka looked at the goddess with great interest who was quite beautiful, charming having fair complexion and wore a serene smile on her face.

## \|\| 35.19-20 \|\|

*śaracchītāṃśuvadanāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām \|*  
*pakvabimbaprabhāmuṣṭadīptauṣṭhādharapallavām \|\| 19 \|\|*

*yuktāpaṭuktivininyaikadantapaduktimanoharām \|*  
*ratrakeyūravalayaralanūpuraśobhitām \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Her face resembled the moon of the winter season, the eyes resembled the lotus flowers of the winter season; the shining lips resembled the ripe wood apples, the lines of teeth resembled the jewels. The goddess was adorned with armlets, wristlets and the anklets made of gems.

## \|\| 35.21 \|\|

*ratnakuṇḍalayugmena karṇamūlavirājitām \|*  
*ratnendrasārahāreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalām \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The gem-studded ear-ornaments adorned her ears and the garland of gems was shining on her breasts.

## \|\| 35.22 \|\|

*vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ sūkṣmaṃ bibhratīṃ navayauvanām \|*  
*atīva kamanīyāṃ ca pīnaśroṇipayodharām \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. She was clad in fine clothes sanctified by fire and was quite youthful and attractive. She had solid breasts.

## \|\| 35.23-25 \|\|

*vīṇāpustakahastāṃ ca vyākhyāmudrākarāṃ varām \|*  
*te ca nirmañchanaṃ kṛtvā cakruḥ paramamaṅgalam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*purīṃ praveśayāmāsurbrahmāṇaṃ bhāratīṃ mudā \|*  
*brahmā tayā saha krīḍāṃ cakāra sa divāniśam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*atīva sukhasaṃbhoge nimagnaḥ satataṃ mudā \|*  
*gūḍhe sarvapurāṇeṣu kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 25\|\|*

23-25. She held vlna in both the hands, while the other hands were in vyakhyana-mudra. The people of Brahmaloka welcomed the goddess sacrificing various valuable on her. Thereafter both Brahma and Bharati entered Goloka. Thereafter both Brahma and Bharati were engaged in love-sports, they then delightfully engaged themselves in the love-sport This is the secret of various Puranas; what else do you want to listen from me.?

## \|\| 35.26 \|\|

*.śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*prāṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya parameśvarī \|*  
*bhūyo'pi paripapraccha kautukānmānasaṃ purā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Narayana said – On hearing the words of her beloved, Radha curiously again asked the lord.

## \|\| 35.27-28 \|\|

*śrīrādhikovāca \|*  
*brahmā kathaṃ na jagrāha veśyāṃ svayamupasthitām \|*  
*na karmakṣetre rahasi phaladātā ca karmaṇām \|\| 27 \|\|*

*upasthitāyāstyāge ca mahāndoṣo hi yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*jñātvā devo vidhātā sa kathaṃ tatyāja mohinīm \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Radhika said – "O lord, you tell me why did Brahma not accept the apsara of the heaven who herself arrived before him in a secluded place. The reason was not known in the land of Bharata. It is really sinful not to accept a damsel who herself arrives to seek ones company. Brahma being well aware of this how could he disappoint Mohini?"

## \|\| 35.29 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*pādmakalpasya vṛttāntamuvāca parameśvarīm \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Narayana said – On hearing the words of Radhika Madhusudana smiled and he narrated to her the story of Padma-kalpa.

## \|\| 35.30 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu kānte pravakṣyāmi purāvṛttāntamīpsitam \|*  
*akathyaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca mahatāmabhininditam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Shri Krishna said – О my beloved listen to me, I am going to tell you an extremely secret and untold story which delights the noble people.

## \|\| 35.31 \|\|

*ekadā ca prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ vidhātā prerito mayā \|*  
*sasarja manasā putrāñjvalato brahmatejasā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Once I inspired Brahma for the creation of the universe. Thereafter the illumining mind born sons were created by him.

## \|\| 35.32-34 \|\|

*sanakaṃ ca sanandaṃ ca sanātanamanuttamam \|*  
*sanatkumāraṃ voḍhuṃ ca kaviṃ pañcaśikhaṃ vibhum \|\| 32 \|\|*

*asitaṃ kapilaṃ siddhaṃ siddhānmama kulodbhavān \|*  
*tānnagnānpañcavarṣīyānpitā sraṣṭuṃ jagāda ha \|\| 33 \|\|*

*prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ prerakaṃ ca janakaṃ te'vamanya ca \|*  
*prajagmustapase tūrṇaṃ mamārcanaparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. They were known as Sanaka, Sananda, the best Sanatana, Sanatkumara, Vodhu Kavi, Pancasikha, Asita, Kapila and siddha, the five siddhas who always remain or the ago of five years and were born out of my amsa were asked by Brahma to engage themselves in the creation of the universe. Those sons of Brahma always engaged themselves in my devotion. Disregarding the command of their father, the proceeed on for performing tap as.

## \|\| 35.35 \|\|

*tadā ruṣṭo jagaddhātā punaḥ putrānvinirmame \|*  
*rudrānekādaśa varānrudato bhīmavigrahān \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Therefore, getting disgusted Brahma created another set of sons. They happened to be the possessing terrific bodies and were eleven in number. Since they were always crying, they came to be known as Rudras.

## \|\| 35.36-38 \|\|

*tasminprayujya tarasā punaḥ putrānvinirmame \|*  
*yogī yogena māṃ dhyātvā svātmārāmaḥ svavigrahe \|\| 36 \|\|*

*vasiṣṭhaṃ pulahaṃ caiva kratumaṅgirasaṃ tathā \|*  
*bhṛgumatriṃ pulastyaṃ ca dakṣaṃ kardamameva ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

*marīciṃ ca vinirmāya prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ niyujya ca \|*  
*prahṛṣṭamānasaḥ putraṃ kanyaikā ca sasarja ha \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. Entmsting the creation of the universe to the Rudras, Brahma started meditating upon me. With this yogic powers and with his mind devoted in me, Brahma created more sons who have been known as Vasistha, Pulaha, Kratu, Angira, Bhrigu, Atri, Pulastya, Daksha, Kardama and Marlci and entrusted them with the task of creation of the universe. Thereafter Brahma delightfully created another son and a daughter.

## \|\| 35.39 \|\|

*kṛṣṇasya kāminaḥ putraḥ kāmadevo babhūva ha \|*  
*kanyā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Kamadeva happen to be the son of Shri Krishna and was filled with love, the girl who was created was of sixteen years’ age and was adorned with all the ornaments.

## \|\| 35.40 \|\|

*uvāca putraṃ sa vidhiḥ sudīptaṃ purataḥ sthitam \|*  
*durnivāryaṃ matkalāṃśaṃ svātmārāmaṃ manoharam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The son who was standing before him and was born out of my amsa was quite pleasant to look at beside being illustrious.

## \|\| 35.41 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*strīpuṃsoḥ krīḍanārthāya mudā tvaṃ ca vinirmitaḥ \|*  
*hṛṣṭiyogena sarveṣāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ kariṣyasi \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Brahma said – I have created both of you and you incite the men and a women to indulge in the love sport between. By means of yogic practices you reside in the hearts of all.

## \|\| 35.42-43 \|\|

*saṃmohanaṃ samudvegaṃ bījastaṃbhitakāraṇam \|*  
*unmattabījaṃ jvaladaṃ śaśvaccetanahārakam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*pragṛhyaitānmayā dattānsarvānsaṃmohanaṃ kuru \|*  
*durnivāryo mama varādbhava vatsa bhaveṣu ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. You accept my arrows by which you can influence others besides charming them with force, disturbing the seed, making them hysterical, creating burning sensation, removing of senses and disturbing them because of my been you can move everywhere in the universe without any obstruction.

## \|\| 35.44-45 \|\|

*bāṇāndattvaivamuktvā ca prahṛṣṭaśca jagadvidhiḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvovāca duhitaraṃ varaṃ dātuṃ samudyataḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*etasminnantare kāmo manasā''locya mantraṇām \|*  
*kartuṃ śastraparīkṣāṃ ca bāṇāṃścikṣepa brahmaṇi \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. The lord of the universe handing over the arrows to kama, felt extremely delighted and looking at the daughter he thought of bestowing a boon on her. In the meantime ката in order to test the weapons provided to him by his own father, shot an arrow at Brahma.

## \|\| 35.46 \|\|

*maṃtrapūtaiśca bāṇaiśca durvāryaiḥ smaraṇena ca \|*  
*atividdho mahāyogī mūrcchito hatacetanaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. With the shooting of the arrow at Brahma, the creator of the universe who happens to be the lord of mantras was wounded and he lost his senses.

## \|\| 35.47-48 \|\|

*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya dadarśāgre ca kanyakām \|*  
*tāṃ saṃbhoktuṃ manaścakre sā dudrāva bhiyā satī \|\| 47 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā paścācca pitaraṃ dhāvantaṃ hatacetanam \|*  
*jagāma śaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ ca tapasvinām \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. On regaining his consciousness he found the girl there and became desirous of enjoying her company. The chaste girl fled from the scene in terror. Finding her father following her she felt terrified and ran for shelter towards his ascetic brothers.

## \|\| 35.49 \|\|

*te tāṃ samīpe saṃsthāpya tamūcuḥ pitaraṃ krudhā \|*  
*hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vedoktaṃ nītisāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Keeping the giri with them, the ascetics looked at; Brahma, their own father with great anger and they spoke to him the words which were according to the Vedas, quite appropriate and the best.

## \|\| 35.50 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*aho kimetajjanaka karma te'tivigarhitam \|*  
*nīcānāṃ caritaṃ yattatkaroṣi tvaṃ jagadvidhe \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The sages said – It pain us a lot that you have indulged in such an action which is to be denounced by all. О creator of universe, you have indulged in the actions which are practiced by the degraded people.

## \|\| 35.51 \|\|

*paśyanti satataṃ santaḥ prasūmiva parastriyam \|*  
*ye te sarvatra pūjyāśca paratreha jitendriyāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The noble people always look at the other women like their own mother and always control their senses. Such people are adored every where in the universe.

## \|\| 35.52 \|\|

*tvaṃ svayaṃ vedakartā ca kanyāṃ saṃbhoktumicchasi \|*  
*kanyā ca mātṛvargeṣu praviṣṭā ca śrutau śrutā \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. You are yourself the creator of the universe and you intend to enjoy the company of your own daughter. The daughter comes in the category of mothers which has been defined in the Vedas.

## \|\| 35.53-56 \|\|

*guroḥ patnī rājapatnī viprapatnī ca yā satī \|*  
*patnī ca bhrātṛsutayormitrapatnī ca tatprasūḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*prasūḥ pitrostathā bhrātuḥ patnī śvaśrūḥ svakanyakāḥ \|*  
*jananī tatsapatnī ca bhaginī surabhī tathā \|\| 54 \|\|*

*svābhīṣṭasurapatnī ca dhātrikā'nnapradāyikā \|*  
*garbhadhātrī svanāmnā ca bhayāttrātuśca kāminī \|\| 55 \|\|*

*etā vedapraṇītāśca sarveṣāṃ mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*etāsvapi ca sarvāsu nyūnatā nāsti kāsu ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

53-56. The wife of the teacher, the wife of the king, wife of the Brahmana, the wives of the brothers and the sons, the wife of the friends and their mothers, the wives of the parents, the mother in-law, one’s own daughter, the mother, co-wife, the sisters the cow, the wife of the family gods, mid-wife, the one who provides food, the one who keeps in the womb, the one who removes the danger, are all considered to be like mothers. This has been ordained in the Vedas, they are all equal in respect and no one is of lesser in importance.

## \|\| 35.57 \|\|

*kanyādātā'nnadātā ca jñānadātā'bhayapradaḥ \|*  
*janmado mantrado jyeṣṭhabhrātā ca pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Similarly the one who gives away the daughter, the one who gives away food, the one who gives away knowledge, the one who gives away protection, the one who gives birth, the one who gives mantra and the elder brother are considered to be like father.

## \|\| 35.58 \|\|

*etā vahanti ye mūḍhā ya etāñjanakānapi \|*  
*pacyante narake te ca yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Such of the foolish people who misbehave with the mother and the father as defined above they fall into the hell and remain there till the age of Brahma.

## \|\| 35.59 \|\|

*tānandhakūpe saṃsthāpya dūrato yamakiṅkarāḥ \|*  
*kurvanti tāḍanaṃ śaśvatpurīṣaṃ pāyayanti ca \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The messengers of Yama carry them and through them in the andhakupa hell and always torture them were they have to consume refuge.

## \|\| 35.60 \|\|

*tvameva viśvakartā ca śāstā vai śamanasya ca \|*  
*vayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ tena gṛhṇāsi kanyakām \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. You are the creator of the universe and also administer even the god of death and you create the three worlds. Are you going to catch hold of this girl because of the position you will going.

## \|\| 35.61 \|\|

*asmākaṃ purato dūraṃ gaccha kāmārtamānasa \|*  
*na kurmo bhasmasātkartuṃ śaktāśca janakaṃ vayam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. O father, your mind is infested with passion and you therefore disappear from the sight of sight of we people at a long distance. Though we are competent enough to reduce you to ashes but we still do not so taking you to be our father.

## \|\| 35.62 \|\|

*gurordoṣasahasrāṇi kṣantumarhanti paṇḍitāḥ \|*  
*sarvaghnaṃ taṃ vinighnanti nītijñāḥ svaguruṃ vinā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Because the noble people forgive a thousand sins of the teacher. The people who are well-versed in polity destroyed the person who kill every-one, accept the teacher.

## \|\| 35.63 \|\|

*gṛhṇanti yadi sarvasvaṃ śapantaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ gurum \|*  
*sādhavastaṃ na nindanti praṇamanti svabhaktitaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. In case a teacher takes away every-thing and than pronouncing a curse, even such a heartless teacher is not denounced by the noble people and adore him with great devotion.

## \|\| 35.64 \|\|

*ye dviṣanti ca nindati gurumiṣṭaṃ surātparam \|*  
*pacyante te'ndhakūpe ca yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The one becomes the jealous of the teacher, who indeed in the better than the gods and denounce him they fall in the andhakupa hell and stay there till the life of the sun and the moon.

## \|\| 35.65 \|\|

*purīṣaṃ bhuñjate nityaṃ kṣubhitā yamatāḍanaiḥ \|*  
*sarpapramāṇakīṭaiśca daṃśitāśca divāniśam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. After having been tortured by the messengers of Yama they consumed the refuge and are bitten by the snakes through out the day and night.

## \|\| 35.66 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā munayaḥ praṇemustatpadāmbujam \|*  
*sarvaṃ bhavati daivena praśāntamanasā dhruvam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. -Thus speaking the sages offered their salutation at the feet of Brahma, everything is possible according to the moves of destiny.

## \|\| 35.67 \|\|

*unmukhā munayaḥ sarve babhūvuśca svakarmaṇi \|*  
*brahmā śarīraṃ saṃtyaktuṃ vrīḍayā ca samudyataḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. All the sages than engaged themselves in their respective assignment and Brahma feeling ashamed thought of ending his life.

## \|\| 35.68 \|\|

*yogena bhittvā ṣaṭcakraṃ sarvānprāṇānniruddhya ca \|*  
*brahmarandhraṃ samānīya tatyāja svena vartmanā \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. He stopped his Pranavayu (wind of life) and broke the Satcakra with the yogic practices and pushing it through the Brahmarandhra, his soul was about to leave his body.

## \|\| 35.69-70 \|\|

*manasā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā namaskāraṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*na me manaḥ paradravye bhavitā stokamīśvara \|\| 69 \|\|*

*prāṇatyāgātparaṃ duḥkhamayaśaśca yaśasvinām \|*  
*babhūva hṛdi kṛtvaikaṃ brahmā līnaśca brahmaṇi \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. At that point of time he remembers the name of lord Hari and offered his salutation to him saying, О lord my mind should not get attracted even slightly towards the riches of others. For the graceful people, the denouncement is verse than death. Completely devoting his mind towards the lord he merged into the Brahman.

## \|\| 35.71 \|\|

*kanyā tātaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā vilapya ca bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ \|*  
*yogena dehaṃ tatyāja sā pralīnā ca brahmaṇi \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Finding her father dead, the daughter felt extremely grieved and lamented for long. Thereafter she ending her life by yogic practices merged into the body of Brahman.

## \|\| 35.72 \|\|

*mṛtaṃ tātaṃ ca bhaginīṃ dṛṣṭvā ca munipuṃgavāḥ \|*  
*sasmaruḥ śrīhariṃ kopātsvātmārāmaṃ vilapya ca \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The best of sages also thinking of their father and the sister who had met with their end, lamented for long in anger and started reciting the name of Hari.

## \|\| 35.73 \|\|

*nārāyaṇo madaṃśaśca kṛpayā''gatya satvaram \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ jīvayāmāsa brahmajñānātsutāṃ ca tām \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Thereafter, Narayana who happens to be my arirsa arrived there at once and with the application of his divine knowledge he brought back to life Brahma and his daughter.

## \|\| 35.74 \|\|

*brahmā puro hariṃ dṛṣṭvā varaṃ vavre sma vāñchitam \|*  
*bhaktiṃ tvaccaraṇe śaśvanniścalāmanapāyinīm \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Brahma on finding Hari standing before him asked for a desired boon, "My mind should remain devoted at your feet always. And I should have and everlasting and deep devotion at your feet.".

## \|\| 35.75 \|\|

*brahmāṇaṃ virasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tamuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*prabodhavacanaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ manoharam \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Finding Brahma disturbed in his brain, the compassionate lord spoke to him to enlighten him with the words which were truthful, appropriate and pleasant.

## \|\| 35.76 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu brahmanpravakṣye'haṃ mukhamuttolya sāṃpratam \|*  
*tyaja lajjāṃ jagannātha hṛdayajvararūpiṇīm \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Narayana said – О Brahman, О lord of the universe, you shed away the shame and the burning of their heart. Raise up your head and listen to me whatever I am speaking to you.

## \|\| 35.77 \|\|

*satkīrtirapakīrtirvā supratiṣṭhāpyupadravaḥ \|*  
*kṣudrāṇāṃ caiva mahatāṃ bhavatyeva svakarmaṇā \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Credit or discredit, reputation or denouncement, one gets according to his own deeds either he is a great or insignificant.

## \|\| 35.78 \|\|

*sarveṣāmapi sarvebhyaḥ svakarma balavattaram \|*  
*tasmātsantaḥ prakurvanti nityaṃ satkarma saṃtatam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. One's own deeds are always powerful for a person. By availing of the reward of the one's deeds, one consumes them.

## \|\| 35.79 \|\|

*kecitkurvanti nirmūlaṃ sarveṣāmapi karmaṇām \|*  
*kṛtaṃ karma paraṃ bhuktvā haripādābjacetasaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Some one has to face the result of his own deed by devoting his mind at the lotus-like feet of the lord.

## \|\| 35.80 \|\|

*kukarmaṇaścāpakīrtistato lajjā bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*sukarmaṇaḥ supratiṣṭhā sarvatra nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. One gets denouncement by indulging in misdeeds which results in shame. With the noble deeds, one attains glory and nobility.

## \|\| 35.81-82 \|\|

*kālena rajasā deho balaṃ rūpaṃ śubhāśubham \|*  
*kīrtiryā triguṇā caiva mohaścāpayaśo vidhe \|\| 81 \|\|*

*ṛṇavraṇāpavādāśca jantūnāṃ yānti kālataḥ \|*  
*mahatāṃ tau ca pūrvoktau netaraśca kadācana \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. О Brahman, the body attains old age because of the time. Besides the strength, beauty, good and bad deeds, the three types of glory, illusion and denouncement, indebtedness, wounds and black spot are earned by people according to their deeds but the noble people are free from all these.

## \|\| 35.83 \|\|

*sadā'pakīrtirvasati parastrīṣu ca vastuṣu \|*  
*tasmātte naiva gṛhṇanti santaḥ svakleśakāraṇe \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. The blemish resides in the riches of others as well as the wives of others. Therefore the noble people do not aspire for the same because they are always troublesome.

## \|\| 35.84-85 \|\|

*smara māmantare brāhme madīyaṃ viṣayaṃ kuru \|*  
*ataste na mano lolaṃ bhavitā paravastuṣu \|\| 84 \|\|*

*yoṣidrūpā ca me māyā sarveṣāṃ mohakāriṇī \|*  
*līlayā kurute mohaṃ svātmārāmasya saṃtatam \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. Therefore reciting my name in your mind you devote yourself to me. In that case the mind is not attracted towards other things, my illusion in the form of damsels influenced everyone, my illusion also attracts playfully the noble people.

## \|\| 35.86-87 \|\|

*nānāmudrāśraye deśe rāgiṇo saṃtataṃ ratiḥ \|*  
*stanābhidhe māṃsapiṇḍe'dhare lālālaye'śucau \|\| 86 \|\|*

*śroṇivaktrastanaṃ tāsāṃ kāmadevālayaṃ sadā \|*  
*tasmātte na hi paśyanti santo hi dharmabhīravaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. The passionate people depending upon the beauty of their limbs always feel attracted towards them. As for example their breasts, the developed part of the body and those which are impure, lips and other parts of the body are always the source of attraction for them. Therefore the such of the people who are devoted to religion never look at the buttocks, the face, the breasts and the pelvic region of the woman.

## \|\| 35.88 \|\|

*ko dharmaḥ kiṃ yaśasteṣāṃ kā pratiṣṭhā ca kiṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*kiṃ buddhirvidyā dānaṃ ca parastrīṣu ca yanmanaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. The one whose mind is engrossed in the ladies, his dharma, glory, tapas, intelligance, knowledge and charities become infructuous.

## \|\| 35.89 \|\|

*ihāpyapayaśo duḥkhaṃ narakeṣu paratra ca \|*  
*vāsaḥ prahārasteṣāṃ ca tāḍanaiḥ kṛmibhakṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. He has to face miseries in this world and have fall into the hell after death where many types of insects bite him.

## \|\| 35.90 \|\|

*duḥkhabījaṃ sukhaṃ matvā mūḍhāśca daivadoṣataḥ \|*  
*parastrīsevanaṃ prītyā kurvanti saṃtataṃ mudā \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. The foolish people as a move of destiny get attracted towards the wives of others delightfully taking it to be a real pleasure.

## \|\| 35.91 \|\|

*uttamā matpadāmbhojaṃ satkarma madhyamāḥ sadā \|*  
*smaranti śaśvadadhamāḥ parastrīsevanaṃ mudā \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. But the best of the people always devote their mind at my feet performing good deeds and the degraded people delightfully enjoy the company of the wives of others.

## \|\| 35.92 \|\|

*vipattiḥ saṃtataṃ tasya paravastuṣu yanmanaḥ \|*  
*viśeṣataḥ parastrīṣu suvarṇeṣu ca bhūmiṣu \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. The one who feels attracted towards the wives of others, the gold of other and the land of others, he has always to face the miseries.

## \|\| 35.93-94 \|\|

*daivātparastriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā viramedyo hariṃ smaran \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā parasuvarṇaṃ ca hastaprakṣālanācchuciḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*satataṃ naiva saṃsaktāḥ santaḥ svastrīṣu kāmataḥ \|*  
*yakṣmavyādhijñānahānilokanindābhayena ca \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. The one who on coming across anthers wife recites the name of Hari in his mind and by coming across the riches of others he neglects them such a person is sanctified, the people suffering from ailments, people without knowledge and some of the people afraid of public denouncement never indulge themselves in approaching the wives of others.

## \|\| 35.95-96 \|\|

*tapasvinastapasyāyāṃ śāstracintāsu paṇḍitāḥ \|*  
*yogino yogacintāsu vedārtheṣu ca vaidikāḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*sādhyaśca patisevāsu gṛhasthā gṛhakarmasu \|*  
*viṣayeṣu viṣayiṇo madbhaktā mama sevane \|\| 96 \|\|*

95-96. The ascetics engage themselves in performing tapas, the learned people engage themselves in the study of scriptures, the yogis engage themselves in yogic practices, the Vedic people spend their time in the study of the Vedas, the auspicious serving the husbands attend to the household affairs, the passionate people engage themselves in the evil deeds and the devotees always remain devoted to me.

## \|\| 35.97 \|\|

*ete niyuktā eteṣu sabhāsu ca praśaṃsitāḥ \|*  
*vedoktācaraṇenaiva tadviruddhena ninditāḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. Those, who are engaged in such type of works follow the path of the Vedas and are praised in the assembly of intellectuals, such of the people who act against the Vedas are always denounced,

## \|\| 35.98-99 \|\|

*sarve nityaṃ praśaṃsanti śaśvatsanmārgagāminam \|*  
*hālikā api nindanti kuvartmagāminaṃ vidhe \|\| 98 \|\|*

*bhavitā na parastrīṣu paravastuṣu te manaḥ \|*  
*adyaprabhṛti jīvantaṃ niviṣṭaṃ madvareṇa ca \|\| 99 \|\|*

98-99. О Brahman, the one who follows the right path is praised by everyone and those who follow the wrong path are denounced even by those ploughing the fields.

## \|\| 35.100 \|\|

*madīyaviṣaye bāhye mayā dattaṃ kuru priyam \|*  
*antarā matpadāmbhojacintāṃ vighnavināśinīm \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. Because of the boon pronounced by me your mind will never feel attracted at the wives of others besides others riches. You follow the discourse given by me out-worldly and in-worldly you devote your mind towards my lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 35.101 \|\|

*kanyā bhavatu me brahmankāmadevasya kāminī \|*  
*ratirnāma parityājyā ratyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. О Brahman, your daughter would become the wife of Kamadeva and will be known by the name of Rati. She would be known as the goddess of love. You disown her.

## \|\| 35.102 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā brahmāṇamāśvāsya kamalāpatiḥ \|*  
*jagāma nityaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vṛndāvanavinodanaḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Thus speaking assuring Brahma and Radha Krishna moved on to Vaikuntha.

## Chapter 36

## \|\| 36.1 \|\|

*. śrīrādhikovāca \|*  
*etena niyamenaiva brahmā tatyāja mohinīm \|*  
*kathaṃ sa kulaṭāśāpādapūjyaḥ saṃbabhūva ha \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Radhika said – Because of this, Brahma disowned Mohinl. It is true but how could Brahma become unadorable because of the curse of the wicked women.

## \|\| 36.2 \|\|

*kathaṃ tasya darpabhaṅgaṃ cakāra kamalāpatiḥ \|*  
*kathayasva sarvabījaṃ sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ svayam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Bow could lord Vishnu who happens to be the cause of everything and the lord himself shatter the pride of Brahma?

## \|\| 36.3 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*rāseśvarīvacaḥ śrutvā prahasya rasikeśvaraḥ \|*  
*nigūḍhamitihāsaṃ ca tāṃ vaktumupacakrame \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Narayana said – On hearing the words of Radhika, Krishna smiled and started narrating the ancient history.

## \|\| 36.4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*brahmā ciraṃ tapastaptvā matto labdhvā varaṃ varam \|*  
*sṛṣṭa nānāvidhāṃ kṛtvā vidhātā sa vabhūva ha \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Shri Krishna said – Having been blessed by me Brahma performed tapas for a long time and engaged himself in creation of the universe.

## \|\| 36.5 \|\|

*tapasāṃ phaladātā ca sarveṣāṃ śāstikṛtprabhuḥ \|*  
*ātmānamīśvaraṃ jñātvā mahāgarvo babhūva ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Brahma on the other hand, who happens to be the bestower of the reward for all the tapas and who regulates the universe thinking himself to be the great lord was filled with pride.

## \|\| 36.6-7 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu garvaparyantamunnatiḥ \|*  
*iti matvā brahmaṇaśca darpabhaṅgaḥ kṛto mayā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ bhaveddarpo brahmāṇḍeṣu parātparaḥ \|*  
*vijñāya sarvaṃ sarvātmā teṣāṃ śāstā'hameva ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The progress is seen in all the globes till one is not infested with pride. Realising this, I shattered the pride of all those who are filled with immense pride in the globes.

## \|\| 36.8-9 \|\|

*prathame brahmaṇo garvo mayā cūrṇīkṛtaḥ śrutaḥ \|*  
*śaṅkarasya ca pārvatyāścandrasya ca ravestathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vahnerdurvāsasaścaiva tathā dhanvantareḥ priye \|*  
*krameṇa darpabhaṅgaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. О dear one, first of all I shattered the pride of Brahma, which I have already narrated to you. Now I am going to tell you about the story of the shattering of pride of Shiva, Parvati, the sun, the moon, the god of fire, Durvasa and Dhanvantari.

## \|\| 36.10 \|\|

*kṣudrāṇāṃ mahatāṃ caiva yeṣāṃ garvo bhavetpriye \|*  
*evaṃvidhamahaṃ teṣāṃ cūrṇībhūtaṃ karomi ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О dear one, whenever all the people irrespective of being big or small are filled with pride, I surely shatter their pride.

## \|\| 36.11 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā \|*  
*papraccha rādhā yatnena saṃtrastā bhayavihvalā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Narayana said – On hearing the words of Shri Krishna, the lips, throat and palate of Radhika were dried up, she was upset with fear and she asked him in panic.

## \|\| 36.12 \|\|

*. śrīrādhikovāca \|*  
*kasya kena prabhāveṇa mahādarpo babhūva ha \|*  
*tvayā kena prabhāveṇa tasya bhaṅgaḥ kṛtaḥ purā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Radhika said – Who was influenced with pride because of whom? How did you shatter their pride?

## \|\| 36.13 \|\|

*kathayasva prāṇanātha sarveṣāṃ darpabhañjana \|*  
*darpado bhayadaḥ prāṇadānaikakāraṇeśvara \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О lord of my life, you are the one who shatter the pride of all. You fill the people with pride, you provide fearlessness to the people besides while restoring life and are their sole lord. You tell me the truth.

## \|\| 36.14 \|\|

*. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yena bhūtaṃ garvacūrṇaṃ śrutaṃ trijagatāṃ vidheḥ \|*  
*anyeṣāṃ śrūyatāṃ rādhe vyāsena kathayāmi te \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Shri Krishna said – О Radha, you are already listen, to the story by means of which the pride of Brahma was shattered. How I am going to tell you the story about the shattering of the pride of others.

## \|\| 36.15-16 \|\|

*svayaṃ śivo madaṃśaśca saṃhartā jagatāṃ ca yaḥ \|*  
*tejasā matsamaḥ pūrṇo jñānena ca guṇena ca \|\| 15\|\|*

*dhyāyanti yogino yaṃ sa yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|*  
*jñānānandasvarūpo'yaṃ tasyākhyānaṃ śṛṇu priye \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Lord Shiva happens to be my own amsa and is the destroyer of the three worlds, he is equal to me in lustre, qualities and intelligence, the ascetics meditate upon him. He is the teacher of all the yogis and is blissful besides being the store of knowledge. О dear one, you listen to the story about him.

## \|\| 36.17-18 \|\|

*yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tapastaptvā divāniśam \|*  
*bhūtvā ca matkalāpūrṇo babhūva matsamo vibhuḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tapasā tejasā śaśvattejorāśirbabhūva ha \|*  
*sūryakoṭiprabhāvaśca bhaktānāṃ kalpapādapaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. After performing tapas for sixty thousand yugas through out the day and nights he achieved all my rays and becoming complete in all respects, he pervaded the universe. As a result of the performing of the continuously tapas and gaining the lustre, he became the store of lustre. His influence, exceeded, the three crores of suns. He is kalpavrksa for his devotees.

## \|\| 36.19 \|\|

*dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ ca yogīndrāstattejo bahukālataḥ \|*  
*tadantare ca paśyanti svarūpamatisundaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The ascetics after performing great tapas and meditating upon him for a long time, visualise his beautiful form.

## \|\| 36.20-22 \|\|

*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam \|*  
*triśūlapaṭṭiśakaraṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ varam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*japantaṃ svātmanā''tmānaṃ śvetābjabījamālayā \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ candracūḍaṃ parātparam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*svarṇākāraṃ jaṭābhāraṃ dadhataṃ śirasā mudā \|*  
*śāntaṃ kāntaṃ trijagatāṃ bhaktānu'grahakātaram \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. He has a complexion of crystal, five faces and three eyes. He holds a trident and a pattisa in his hands and is clad in tiger skin. He is adorned with the garland of white lotus flowers and recites his own mantras. He always wears a serene smile on his face, the eternal Shiva has a crescent on his head serving as a crown on the matted locks of hair. He is peaceful in appearance and is always compassionate on his devotees.

## \|\| 36.23 \|\|

*atha svamīśvaraṃ matvā pradātā sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*dadāti sarvaṃ sarvebhyo vāñchitaṃ kalpapādapaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Considering himself to be supreme lord and the bestower of all the riches he fulfils the desires of all like a kalpa tree.

## \|\| 36.24 \|\|

*yo yaṃ vāñchati taṃ tasmai varaṃ dattvā vareśvaraḥ \|*  
*babhūva garvasaṃyuktaḥ svātmārāmaḥ svalīlayā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Whenever things are desired by anyone he bestows the same on him. Thus Shiva who always roamed about in his own soul was once filled with pride.

## \|\| 36.25-26 \|\|

*ekadā ca vṛko daityastapastepe śivasya ca \|*  
*kedāre ca kaṭhoreṇa varṣamekaṃ divāniśam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nityaṃ yāti tatsamīpaṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*varaṃ dātuṃ yathā'bhīṣṭaṃ na jagrāhāsuro varam \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. With this illusion, the demon with his mind filled with devotion asked for a boon, "The person on whose head I place my hand, he should be reduce to ashes.".

## \|\| 36.27 \|\|

*varṣānte śaṅkaraḥ śaśvattasthau tatpurataḥ svayam \|*  
*varado bhaktipāśena kṣaṇaṃ gantuṃ na sa kṣamaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. When Shiva moved from that place after pronouncing the boon on the demon, he followed Shiva. Lord Shiva who has already over-come the death felt panicky of the death and started running about.

## \|\| 36.28 \|\|

*sarvaiśvaryaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ haraḥ padam \|*  
*daityaḥ kiṃcinna gṛhṇāti paritaḥ śūlapāṇinaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Once a demon named Vrka went to the Kedara region of Shiva and performed severed tapas there. The compassionate lord Shiva always visited that demon in order to bestow a boon on him but the demon did not accept any boon.

## \|\| 36.29 \|\|

*dhyāyamānaṃ tatpadābjaṃ dṛṣṭvā trasto maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*ayācitāraṃ niśceṣṭaṃ ruroda premavihvalaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. At the end of the year Shiva started remaining present before him always. Lord Shiva having bound with the fetters of devotion of the demon, could not leave that place even for a moment.

## \|\| 36.30 \|\|

*atīva rodanāttasya dhyānabhaṅgo babhūva ha \|*  
*dadarśa purataḥ sākṣāddātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Shiva offered him all the fortunes, the siddhis, the devotion, salvation and the highest stage of the lord, but the demon did not accept them.

## \|\| 36.31 \|\|

*yanmāyayā varaṃ vavre daityendro bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*hastaṃ dadhe ca yanmūrdhni sa bhasma bhaviteti ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. He only continued devoting his mind at his lotus-like feet. Then suddenly finding that the body of the demon become motionless, Shiva felt panicky and overwhelmed with love started crying.

## \|\| 36.32 \|\|

*omityuktvā prayāntaṃ taṃ dudrāva daityapuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*mṛtyuñjayo mṛtyubhayāddudrāva trāsavihvalaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. With the crying of Shiva, the meditation of the demon was disturbed. He then found lord Shiva, the bestower of toll the riches standing before him.

## \|\| 36.33 \|\|

*papāta ḍamarustasya vyāghracarma manoharam \|*  
*digambaro daśadiśo bheje dānavabhītaye \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. His damaru and the pleasant tiger-skin fell down, getting terrified from the demon. He roamed about from the fear of the demon unrobed and in terror rushed in all the directions.

## \|\| 36.34 \|\|

*na hanti taṃ ca kṛpayā bhaktaṃ ca bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*duṣṭānusāraṃ sādhuśca na karoti kadācana \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. In spite of that the compassionate Shiva did not want to kill him because the noble people do not get cruel even to the wicked people.

## \|\| 36.35-36 \|\|

*sādhavo ghnanti ghnantaṃ ca bhṛtyaṃ putraṃ priyāṃ vinā \|*  
*prabodhituṃ na śaktaśca svātmānaṃ kṛpayā samam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*śivaḥ svamṛtyuṃ matvā ca bhītaśca nirahaṃkṛtaḥ \|*  
*smāraṃsmāraṃ ca māṃ bhadre māmeva śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. The noble people kill only the people who intend to kill them but the servants, son and the beloved are never killed by them. Shiva could not understand well the demon because he treated the demon to be his own son. Finding his death nearing him, Shiva was extremely terrified and devoid of all the pride. О dear one, reciting my name again and again, he arrived to take refuge with me.

## \|\| 36.37 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā svāśramamāyāntaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukam \|*  
*he hare rakṣa rakṣeti japantaṃ bhayavihvalam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. I found him arriving in my abode. His throat, lips and palate had dried up. He was crying, "O lord Hari save me." Thus uttering these words again and again, he felt upset.

## \|\| 36.38-39 \|\|

*saṃsthāpya tatsamīpe ca sa daityo bodhito mayā \|*  
*pṛṣṭaśca sarvavṛttāntamuvāca māṃ krameṇa ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tadā mamājñayā tūrṇaṃ vañcito māyayā'suraḥ \|*  
*dattvā svamūrdhni hastaṃ ca sadyo bhasma babhūva ha \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Making the demon to remain by the side of Shiva I addressed him and he narrated to me, the entire story. Thereafter, with the influence of my illusion the demon placed his hand on his own head and was reduced to ashes.

## \|\| 36.40 \|\|

*tadā siddhāḥ surendrāśca munīndrā manavo mudā \|*  
*tuṣṭuvurmāṃ subhaktyā ca lajjayā lajjitaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. At that point of time all the siddhas, Indra, the sages, Manus and even Shiva feeling ashamed, started eulogising me.

## \|\| 36.41 \|\|

*babhūva cūrṇastadgarvo jagāma bodhito mayā \|*  
*varaṃ dadāti varadastato bodhyo hyahaṃ śivaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. His pride was shattered thereafter I enlightened him and he left the place. I myself fulfil the effects of pronouncing a boon.

## \|\| 36.42-43 \|\|

*atha garvānvito rudro hantuṃ tripuramulbaṇam \|*  
*matvā manasi saṃhartā sarveṣāṃ jagatāmiti \|\| 42 \|\|*

*ko'yaṃ pataṅgavaddaitya iti matvā yayau raṇam \|*  
*vihāya śūlaṃ maddattaṃ madīyakavacaṃ param \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Thereafter, Shiva with his mind filled with pride went to kill Tripurasura. He believed in his mind that he was the only one who could destroy all the three worlds then how could the great demon who was like a fire fly before him, face lord Shiva? He than went to the battle-field while going to the battle-field, he left the trident and the kavacha given by me at his place.

## \|\| 36.44 \|\|

*ciraṃ babhūva samaraṃ varṣamekaṃ divāniśam \|*  
*na ko'pi jetuṃ kaṃ śakto dvau samau samare tadā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. He continued fighting with Tripurasura for one year through out the day and night but no one could be victorious. In the battle-field, both of them appeared to be equals.

## \|\| 36.45 \|\|

*pṛthivyāṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā daityendro māyayā priye \|*  
*atyūrdhvaṃ ca samuttasthau pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О dear, the demon while fighting on earth by his illusion rose higher in the space around fifty crores of yojanas.

## \|\| 36.46 \|\|

*uttasthau śaṃkarastūrṇaṃ hantuṃ daityaṃ jagatprabhuḥ \|*  
*babhūva tatra yuddhaṃ ca māsamekaṃ nirāśraye \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Shiva the lord of the universe also raised himself to fight with the demon. In the space they went on fighting for a month.

## \|\| 36.47 \|\|

*astrāṇi cāpaṃ ciccheda śaṅkarasyāsuro balī \|*  
*rathaṃ babhañja daityendraścāpamastrāṇi śaṅkarāt \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The valorous demon shattered the weapon and the bow of Shiva broke his chariot and destroyed his all other weapons.

## \|\| 36.48 \|\|

*jaghāna muṣṭinā rudro dānavendraṃ prakopataḥ \|*  
*vajramuṣṭiprahāreṇa sadyo mūrcchāmavāpa saḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The enraged Shiva administered a powerful fist on the chest of the demon. With the blow of the fist by Shiva, the demon at once fainted.

## \|\| 36.49 \|\|

*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya kopāddānavapuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*śivaṃ śayānamuttolya pātayāmāsa bhūtale \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Regaining consciousness in a moment, the demon picked up Shiva, while he was asleep and threw him on the ground.

## \|\| 36.50 \|\|

*sarathe pātite rudre devā devarṣayo bhiyā \|*  
*tuṣṭuvurmāṃ paritrāhi kṛṣṇetyuktvā punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. When Shiva together with his chariot was so badly defeated all the gods felt panicky. Thus Shiva started offering prayers to me again and again.

## \|\| 36.51-54 \|\|

*haraḥ sasmāra māmeva nirbhayo bhayakāraṇam \|*  
*tuṣṭāva bhaktyā stotreṇa mayā dattena saṃkaṭe \|\| 51 \|\|*

*tadā'haṃ kalayā śīghraṃ vṛṣarūpaṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*śayānaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dhṛtvā viṣāṇābhyāmurukramam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*dadau tasmai svakavacaṃ svaśūlamarimardanam \|*  
*prāpya taddānavasthānamatyūrdhvaṃ ca nirāśrayam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*mayā dattena śūlena jaghāna tripuraṃ haraḥ \|*  
*māmeva darpahantāraṃ tuṣṭāva vrīḍitaḥ punaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

51-54. Finding the danger ahead Shiva meekly uttered my name again and again. At the time of danger he recited the stotra given by me to him with devotion. Than I, taking to the form of a bull lifted up Shiva over my horn. I then gave him my kavacha and the trident which always destroyed the enemies. With the use of that trident he attracted Tripura who had been present in the sky without any base and destroyed him with the attack of my trident. Thereafter lord Shiva having his pride shattered praised me again and again.

## \|\| 36.55-56 \|\|

*sadyaḥ papāta daityendraścūrṇībhūtaśca bhūtale \|*  
*devatā munayaḥ sarve tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṅkaraṃ mudā \|\| 55 \|\|*

*tatyāja śaṅakaro darpaṃ vighnabījaṃ tato vibhuḥ \|*  
*jñānānandasvarūpaśca nirliptaḥ sarvakarmasu \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. The demon was than reduced to ashes and fell down on the ground. At the sight of the killing of the demon, the gods, the sages and Shiva started prising me. Thereafter Shiva realising that the pride had been the cause of all the trouble got rid of it. He devoted his mind to the blissful knowledge and indulged in all the deeds in an unattached manner.

## \|\| 36.57 \|\|

*tato'haṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa vahāmi tena taṃ priyam \|*  
*mama priyatamo nāsti trailokyeṣu śivātparaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Since than I started carrying Shiva over my back as his vehicle because no one else in the three worlds is dearer to me than Shiva.

## \|\| 36.58-61 \|\|

*manaḥsvarūpo brahmā me jñānarūpo maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*buddhirbhagavatī durgā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 58 \|\|*

*nidrādayaḥ śaktayo yāstāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ \|*  
*vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā sā svayaṃ ca sarasvatī \|\| 59 \|\|*

*mama kalyāṇādhidevo harṣarūpo gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*paramārthaḥ svayaṃ dharmo mama bhakto hutāśanaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*sarvaiśvaryādhidevī me sarvagolokavāsinaḥ \|*  
*prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī tvaṃ sadā prāṇāghikā mama \|\| 61 \|\|*

58-61. Brahma represents my mind Shiva intelligence and MQla-Prakriti also known as Durga represents wisdom. All other shaktis including sleep they represent the form of Prakriti and Sarasvati happens to be the goddess of my speech. Ganesha who bestows all the welfares is the form of my pleasure. Dharma stands for the welfare of all and Agni is fully devoted to me. All these residing in Goloka are the gods of my fortune. You happen to be the great goddess of my life and are dearer to me than my life.

## \|\| 36.62 \|\|

*gopāṅganāstava kalā ata eva mama priyāḥ \|*  
*mallomakūpajā gopāḥ sarve golokavāsinaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. All the cowherdesses happen to be your rays and are therefore quite dear to me. All the cowherds residing in Goloka have emerged from my hair-pits.

## \|\| 36.63 \|\|

*tejaḥsvarūpaḥ sūryaśca prāṇā me vāyavaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*jalādhidevo varuṇaḥ pṛthivī me malodbhavā \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Thus the sun is the form of my lustre, the wind-god represent breathing Varuna stands for the lord of waters and the earth had emerged out of my refuse.

## \|\| 36.64 \|\|

*mama śūnyo mahākāśo madano mānasodbhavaḥ \|*  
*indrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve matkalāṃśāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The space void for me. The god of love was created out of my mind and all the gods including Indra emerged out of my rays.

## \|\| 36.65 \|\|

*etāni sṛṣṭibījāni mahadādīni caiva hi \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ bījarūpo'haṃ svayamātmā nirāśrayaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. All the tattvas which form the part of the seed in the universe, I happen to be the base of all of them and the soul of all.

## \|\| 36.66-67 \|\|

*jīvo me pratibimbaśca karmabhogādhikārakaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ sākṣī nirīhaśca na bhogī sarvakarmasu \|\| 66 \|\|*

*bhaktadhyānārthadeho'yaṃ mama svecchāmayasya ca \|*  
*prakṛtiḥ puruṣo'haṃ ca eka eva parātparaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. The Jiva happens to be my reflection, who has to face the result of his deeds, I am unattached and the witness of all but I never have to face the reward of any action. This body which has been self-created by me is meant for the adoration of my devotees. I happen to be Prakriti Purusa and the only great lord.

## \|\| 36.68 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe śivadarpavimocanam \|*  
*sṛṣṭibījaṃ ca śṛṇu me pārvatīdarpamocanam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. O Radha, thus I have narrated to you the story of out the shattering of the pride of Shiva. Now you listen to the story relating to the shattering of the pride of Parvati who happens to be the seed of all the creation.

## \|\| 36.69 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ityuktavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*papraccha rādhikā devī nigūḍhamabhivāñchitam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Narayana said – After listening from Shri Krishna, Radhika asked him a secret question.

## \|\| 36.70 \|\|

*śrīrādhikovāca \|*  
*bhagavansarvatattvajña sarvabīja sanātana \|*  
*vada me vāñchitaṃ praśnaṃ sarvasaṃdehabhañjanam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Radhika said – О virtuous one, you are well-aware of all the tattvas and the seed of all, you are the eternal one and are competent enough to remove all the doubts. You give me an appropriate reply to my question.

## \|\| 36.71 \|\|

*sarvajñānādhidevaśca śaṃkaraḥ sarvatattvavit \|*  
*mṛtyuṃjayaḥ kālakālo bhagavāṃstvatsamo mahān \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Shiva happens to be the lord of all the knowledge, well-versed in all the tattvas conqueror of the death, the death for all the times and is as great as you are.

## \|\| 36.72-73 \|\|

*kathaṃ vibhūtigātraśca pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ \|*  
*digambaro jaṭādhārī nāgasaṃghātabhūṣaṇaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*vṛṣeṇāṭati devendro vihāya varavāhanam \|*  
*na bibharti kathaṃ ratnasāranirmāṇabhūṣaṇam \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. But why does he apply ashes on his body why does he have five faces, three eyes remains without robes, wearing matted locks of hair on the head, using the serpents as his ornament why does he move on the bull leaving all other vehicles, why does he not adorn himself with gem-studded ornament.

## \|\| 36.74 \|\|

*vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ tyaktvā dhatte śārdūlacarmakam \|*  
*dhatte dhattūrakusumaṃ pārijātaṃ vihāya ca \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Leaving aside the costumes sanctified by fire, why does he clad himself in tiger skin. Leaving aside the Parijata flowers, why does he use the thorn apple flowers.

## \|\| 36.75 \|\|

*nāsti ratnakirīṭecchā jaṭāyāṃ prītiruttamā \|*  
*divyalokaṃ parityajya śmaśāneṣu spṛhā vibhoḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Instead of the gem-studded kirita-crown why does he adorn his head with matted locks of hair. Why does Shiva intend to dwell in the cremation grounds, instead of living in the divine places.

## \|\| 36.76 \|\|

*candanāgurukastūrīsugayikusumāni ca \|*  
*tyaktvā spṛhā bilvapatra bilvakāṣṭhānuleṣane \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Leaving aside the sandal-paste, aguru, kastUrl and fragrant flowers, why does he prefer the leaves of wood-apple and also its fruit.

## \|\| 36.77 \|\|

*etadveditumicchāmi vyāsena kathaya prabho \|*  
*śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ nātha varddhate me manaḥspṛhā \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. I would like to have a clarification on all these points. You kindly let me know. О lord, I am getting a ixious to know about them.

## \|\| 36.78 \|\|

*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*kathāṃ kathitumārebhe kṛtvā rādhāṃ svavakṣasi \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. On hearing the words of Radhika, lord MadhusQdana smiled for a moment and taking her in his embrace he said.

## \|\| 36.79 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tapaḥ kṛtvā maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*virarāma pūrṇatamo dhyātvā māṃ manasā mudā \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. §rl Krishna said – In the ancient times lord Maheshvara after performing tapas for sixty thousand yugas, felt blissful and devoting his mind in me became disinterested in the universe.

## \|\| 36.80-81 \|\|

*etasminnantare māṃ ca dadarśa purataḥ sthitam \|*  
*atīva kamanīyāṅgaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram \|\| 80 \|\|*

*ahonirvacanīyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā rūpamanuttamam \|*  
*na babhūva vitṛṣṇaśca locanābhyāṃ trilocanaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

80-81. In the meantime, he found me standing before him having beautiful limits, tender age and dark complexion. Everything was beyond description. At the sight of my form, the eyes of three-eyed Shiva were never satisfied.

## \|\| 36.82 \|\|

*paśyannimeṣarahita iti matvā svamānase \|*  
*bhaktyudrekānmahābhakto ruroda premavihvalaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. He, the great devotee continued staring at me and overwhelmed with my devotion, he started lamentation.

## \|\| 36.83 \|\|

*sahasravadano'nanto bhāgyavāṃśca caturmukhaḥ \|*  
*bahubhirlocanairdṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva bahubhirmukhaiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. He thought that serpent Ananta with thousand hoods and Brahma having four faces were more fortunate than myself, who could look at the lord with many eyes and offered prayers with many mouthy.

## \|\| 36.84 \|\|

*paśyāmi kiṃ vā kiṃ staumi saṃprāpya nāthamīdṛśam \|*  
*āsyaikena locanābhyāṃ caturddhā sa punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. On finding such a lord of mine, how should I look at him and how should I adore him because I have a single mouth and only two eves. He repeated this sentence four times.

## \|\| 36.85-86 \|\|

*sva mānase kurvatīdaṃ śaṃkare ca tapasvini \|*  
*tadbabhūva caturvaktraṃ pūrveṇa saha pañcamam \|\| 85 \|\|*

*ekaikavaktraṃ śuśubhe locanaiśca tribhistribhiḥ \|*  
*babhūva tena tannāma pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. Having thus thought in his mind by Shiva, four more faces were added to his body making total of five of them. Each and every face than bad three eyes as a result of which he was known as five-faced and three eyed.

## \|\| 36.87 \|\|

*stavanādadhikaprītiḥ śivasya darśane mama \|*  
*tenādhikāni tasyaivaṃ babhūvurlocanāni ca \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. In preference to the prayer of Shiva he was more interested in staring at me with more eyes as a result of which more ryes appeared on his faces.

## \|\| 36.88 \|\|

*cakṣūṃṣi guṇarūpāṇi tasya brahmasvarūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*sattvaṃ rajastama iti tasya hetuṃ niśāmaya \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. The eyes of Shiva having the form of Brahman, present sattva, rajas and tamas. I am going to speak out the reason for the same. You please listen to me.

## \|\| 36.89 \|\|

*sattvāṃśena dṛśā śaṃbhuḥ paśyanpāti ca sāttvikān \|*  
*rājasena rājasikāṃstāmasena ca tāmasān \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Lord Shiva looks at the sattvika people with his sattvika eyes, the raj as l people with his rajas eyes and tdmasl people with tamas eyes. He protects them all.

## \|\| 36.90 \|\|

*cṣuṣastāmasatyaścāllalāṭasthāddharasya ca \|*  
*saṃhārakāle saṃharaturagnirāvibhavetkudhā \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. At the time of dissolution, the destructive fire emerges from the wrathful third eye of the forehead of destroyer Shiva.

## \|\| 36.91 \|\|

*koṭitālapramāṇaśca sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ \|*  
*lelihāno dīrghaśikhastrailokyaṃ dagdhumīśvaraḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. The flames of that fire rise as high as the height of crores of tala trees placed one on the other, has the lustre of crores of suns and have innumerable flames which reduce to ashes everything in the universe.

## \|\| 36.92 \|\|

*vibhūtigātraḥ sa vibhuḥ satīsaṃskārabhasmanā \|*  
*dhatte tasyā asthimālāṃ premabhāvena bhasma ca \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Shiva applied the dust produced by the burning of the body of Sati. That is why, he is known by the name of the one who applied ashes on his body. Because of his love for Sati, he adorned himself with the garland of her bones had also applied the ashes on his body.

## \|\| 36.93-94 \|\|

*svātmārāmo yadyapīśastathā'pi pūrṇamabdakam \|*  
*satīśavaṃ gṛhītvā ca bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ ruroda ha \|\| 93 \|\|*

*pratyaṅgaṃ cāpi tasyāśca papāta yatra yatra ha \|*  
*siddhapīṭhastatra tatra babhūva mantrasiddhikṛt \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. Though Shiva is all knowledgeable, still he carried the dead body of Sati on his shoulder for full one year and roamed about everywhere in all the four comers, while crying. Wherever the limb of Sati fell, a siddha-pltha was created there where the success in mantras is achieved.

## \|\| 36.95 \|\|

*tadā śavāvaśeṣaṃ ca kṛtvā vakṣasi śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*papāta mūrcchito bhūtvā siddhikṣetre ca rādhike \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. О Radhike, thereafter, embracing the bones of the body of Sati, Shiva fell down at the place of accomplishment and was fainted.

## \|\| 36.96 \|\|

*tadā gatvā maheśaṃ taṃ kṛtvā kroḍe prabodhya ca \|*  
*adadāṃ divyatattvaṃ ca tasmai śokaharaṃ param \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. At that point of time I went to that place and carrying Shiva in my lap and bestowed him the divine knowledge which relieved him of the grief.

## \|\| 36.97 \|\|

*tadā śivaśca saṃtuṣṭaḥ svaṃ lokaṃ ca jagāma ha \|*  
*mūrtyantareṇa kālena tāṃ saṃprāpa priyāṃ satīm \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. Thereafter, getting satisfied, Shiva left for his abode and after sometime Shiva regained Sati in another form.

## \|\| 36.98 \|\|

*divyasragdhāriyogena necchā nitye pare vibhoḥ \|*  
*jaṭāṃ tapasyākālīnāṃ dhatte'dyāpi vivekataḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Shiva remains without robes because he always remain engrossed in yogic practices, the eternal lord is devoid of all the desires The matted locks of hair on his head relate to the period when he performed tapas which he maintains even to this day because of his eternal awareness.

## \|\| 36.99 \|\|

*na cecchā keśasaṃskāre svāṅgaveṣeṇa yoginaḥ \|*  
*samatā candane paṅke loṣṭe ratne maṇīśvare \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. The ascetics have no desire to clad themselves in beautiful garments or to arrange the heed-dress. An ascetic finds no difference between the sandal-paste and mud or a ball of earth; even the gems are treated by him like the dust.

## \|\| 36.100 \|\|

*garuḍadveṣiṇo nāgāḥ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*bibharti kṛpayā svāṅge tāneva śaraṇāgatān \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. The Nagas getting terrified from Garuda took refuge with lord Shiva and with his mind filled with Compassion, he adorned all his limbs with the snakes.

## \|\| 36.101 \|\|

*vāhanaṃ vṛṣarūpo'hamanyastaṃ voḍhumakṣamaḥ \|*  
*tripurasya vadhe pūrvaṃ matkalāṃśasamudbhavaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. I myself carry him in the form of a bull because no one else is competent enough to transport him. In the earlier times duririg the killing of Tripurasura, a bull was created with my amsa.

## \|\| 36.102 \|\|

*pārijātādikaṃ puṣpasugandhi candanādikam \|*  
*mayi saṃnyasya teṣvevaṃ prītirnāsti kadācana \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. He has already offered Parijata and other flowers besides the sandal-paste and fragrant articles to me, therefore he never feels attracted towards them.

## \|\| 36.103 \|\|

*dhattūre tatsadā prītirbilvapatrānulepane \|*  
*gandhahīne sugandhe ca yogīṣṭe vyāghracarmaṇi \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. The flowers of thorn-apple, the leaves of wood apple tree and its fruits and the paste of the wood-apple besides the flowers having no fragrance, the skin of tiger is always like by the yogis. Therefore, he always remains attracted towards them.

## \|\| 36.104 \|\|

*divyaloke divyatalpe janatāyāṃ na tanmanaḥ \|*  
*śmaśāne'tīvarahasi dhyāyate māmaharniśam \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. He does not feel happy in the divine places, divine beds and the places filled with crowds. Therefore he prefer to reside in lonely places including the cremation grounds and is always engaged in reciting my name.

## \|\| 36.105 \|\|

*ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ samaṃ ca manyate śivaḥ \|*  
*mamānirvacanīye'tra rūpe tanmagnamānasam \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. He considered everyone right for Brahma to the blade of grass as equal. He only devotes his mind towards me.

## \|\| 36.106 \|\|

*brahmaṇaḥ patanenāpi śūlapāṇeḥ kṣaṇo bhavet \|*  
*tasyāyuṣaḥ pramāṇaṃ ca nāhaṃ jānāmi kā śrutiḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. After the fall of Brahma only a moment of Shiva passes. I am not aware of his age in the measure then how can the Shrutis know about it.

## \|\| 36.107-109 \|\|

*jñānaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaḥ śūlaṃ dhatte mattejasā samam \|*  
*vinā mayā na kaścittaṃ śaṃkaraṃ jetumīśvaraḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

*śaṃkaraḥ paramātmā me prāṇebhyo'pi paraḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*tryambake manmanaḥ śaśvanna priyo me bhavātparaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍanikaraṃ channaṃ mayā manmāyayā sadā \|*  
*sa kampati haraṃ śaśvanna ca taṃ mohituṃ kṣamaḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

107-109. Shiva who has ever-powered death carry the trident that emerged from my lustre and also the intelligence. Ho one else except me would be in a position to conquer Shiva. Shiva is the lord supreme and is dearer to me than my own life. I always devote my mind to Shiva in the form of Tryambaka. No one else is dearer to me than Shiva, my illusion pervades the entire universe, but she get panicky at the sight of Shiva. She is unable to over-power him.

## \|\| 36.110 \|\|

*na saṃvasāmi goloke vaikuṇṭhe tava vakṣasi \|*  
*sadā śivasya hṛdaye nibaddhaḥ premapāśataḥ \|\| 110\|\|*

110\. I never reside in Goloka, Vaikuntha or your heart. On the other hand I am over-powered by the fetters of love of Shiva and I always reside in his heart.

## \|\| 36.111-114 \|\|

*svarasiddhaṃ sutānena pañcavaktreṇa śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*śaśvadgāyati madgāthāṃ tenāhaṃ tatsamīpataḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

*sraṣṭuṃ śakto hi naṣṭuṃ ca bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā'pi yaḥ \|*  
*brahmāṇḍanikaraṃ yogānna yogī śaṃkarātparaḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

*divyajñānena yaḥ sraṣṭuṃ naṣṭuṃ bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā \|*  
*mṛtyuṃ kālādikaṃ bhakto na jñānī śaṃkarātparaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

*mama bhaktiṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca muktiṃ ca sarvasaṃpadaḥ \|*  
*sarvasiddhiṃ dātumīśo na dātā śaṃkarātparaḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

111-114. Shiva always sings my praise in divine tunes from his five mouths therefore I always remain close to him. The one is in a position to reduce the entire universe to ashes with mere frowning and as such no ascetic could ever be compared with Shiva. The one who is in a position to playfully destroy and recreate the universe with the application of his divine knowledge. There is no one else more knowledgeable than Shiva. Shiva is competent enough to bestow my devotion, my slavehood, salvation, all the fortunes and the siddhis and as such there is no one greater than him in the performing of the charities.

## \|\| 36.115 \|\|

*pañcavaktreṇa mannāma yo hi gāyatyaharniśam \|*  
*madrūpaṃ dhyāyate śaśvanna bhaktaḥ śaṃkarātparaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Не engages himself always reciting my glory with all his five faces; therefore there is no other devotee in the world better than him.

## \|\| 36.116 \|\|

*ahaṃ sudarśanaṃ śaṃbhustejasā ca vayaṃ samāḥ \|*  
*brahmā sraṣṭā ca yogena nāsmābhistejasā samaḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. Myself, Sudarsana-cakra and Shiva are equal in glory. Even Brahma the creator of the universe cannot equate us in yogic practices as well as the glory.

## \|\| 36.117 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarve śaṃkarasya yaśo'malam \|*  
*tathā'pyasya darpabhaṅgaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Thus I have narrated to you the spotless glory of Shiva and the story about the shattering of his pride. What else do you want to listen from me.

## Chapter 37

## \|\| 37.1 \|\|

*śrīrādhikovāca \|*  
*evaṃbhūtasya ca vibhoḥ sarveśasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*na śastaṃ kathamucchiṣṭaṃ brūhi saṃdehabhañjana \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Radhika said – О remover of the doubts, why is the 'left over' of Shiva not considered to be praise-worthy; you kindly tell me.

## \|\| 37.2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu devi pravakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam \|*  
*pāpendhanānāṃ dahane jvaladāgniśikhopamam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Shri Krishna said – О goddess, you listen to me I narrate to you an ancient story which serves as a fire wood for burning the sins of the past births.

## \|\| 37.3 \|\|

*sanatkumāro vaikuṇṭhamekadā ca jagāma ha \|*  
*dadarśa bhuktavantaṃ ca nāthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dvijaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Once Sanatkumara arrived in Vaikuntha. Narayana found the arrival of the Brahmana after he had finished his food.

## \|\| 37.4 \|\|

*tuṣṭāva gūḍhaiḥ stotraiśca praṇamya bhaktito mudā \|*  
*avaśeṣaṃ dadau tasmai saṃtuṣṭo bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. He l awed in reverence to him with devotion and offered prayers with deep devotion. The lord who loves his devotees was pleased and he offered the 'left over' to him.

## \|\| 37.5 \|\|

*prāptamātreṇa tatraiva bhuktaṃ tenaiva kiṃcana \|*  
*kiṃcidrarakṣa baṃdhūnāṃ bhakṣaṇāya ca durlabham \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The Brahmana after receiving the 'left over' at once consumed a part of it and the remaining part was kept by him to be distributed to his relatives.

## \|\| 37.6 \|\|

*siddhāśrame ca yaddattaṃ gurave śūlapāṇine \|*  
*bhaktyudrekācca tatsarvaṃ bhuktaṃ ca prāptimātrataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Thereafter, arriving in Siddhdsrama he gave away the left over to lord Shiva who having been filled with devotion consumed the whole of it.

## \|\| 37.7 \|\|

*bhuktvā sudurlabhaṃ vastu nanarta premavihvalaḥ \|*  
*pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. After consuming the 'left-over' which was beyond the reach of everyone, he was overwhelmed with joy and started dancing. He felt totally blissful in his body and his eyes were filled with tears; he felt extremely delighted. Не started uttering the name of Hari from all his five mouths in different tunes and in sweet voice praising him in various ways.

## \|\| 37.8 \|\|

*gāyanmama guṇānbhaktyā sukaṇṭhaḥ paṃcavaktrataḥ \|*  
*rāgabhedaikatānena tālamānena suṃdaram \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Since he was totally engrossed in the dhyanam of Hari, the daman1, the conch and tigers skin fell down. He also fell down fainted and started crying.

## \|\| 37.9 \|\|

*papāta ḍamarurhastācchṛṅgaṃ ca vyāghracarma ca \|*  
*svayaṃ nipatya paścācca rudanmūrcchāmavāpa ha \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He was in deep meditation with the thousand pettaled lotus of his heart completely devoted to the lord Hari.

## \|\| 37.10 \|\|

*atīva kamanīyaṃ tadrūpaṃ dhyātvaikamānamaḥ \|*  
*sahasradalamadhyasthaṃ māṃ paśyanhṛtsaroruhe \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In the meantime Durga, the destroyer of the evil times, with smiling face and eyes arrived immediately there.

## \|\| 37.11 \|\|

*etasminnantare devī durgā durgārtināśinī \|*  
*mudā''jagāma śīghraṃ tatprasannavadanekṣaṇā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Finding Shiva crying and in unconsqious condition falling here and there, Durga laughed and questioned Sanatkumara about the condition of Shiva.

## \|\| 37.12 \|\|

*rudantaṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nipatantaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*prahasya vārtāṃ papraccha kumāraṃ śūlapāṇinaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Sanatkumara with folded hands narrated the entire episode to Durga, hearing which she was enraged and her lips started fluttering. When Shiva found that Durga was about to pronounce a curse, he got up and convinced her variously praising with folded hands.

## \|\| 37.13-14 \|\|

*sarvaṃ tāṃ kathayāmāsa kumāraḥ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ \|*  
*śrutvā cukopa sā devī śivaṃ prasphuritādharā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tāṃ śaptumudyatāṃ devīmutthāya ca trilocanaḥ \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ tuṣṭāva saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Listening to the pleasant stotra, Parvati did not pronounce a curse on Shiva but she desire that left-over should not be consumed even by the intellectuals.

## \|\| 37.15 \|\|

*śrutvā manoharaṃ stotraṃ na śaśāpa śivaṃ śivā \|*  
*duṣṭaṃ cakre taducchiṣṭamabhakṣyaṃ viduṣāmapi \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. But the illustrious and fortunate people would not have the effect of the same. Shiva who happens to be the destroyer of the universe felt upset with the curse of Parvati and started trembling.

## \|\| 37.16 \|\|

*na lokānāṃ prabhāvaśca tapaḥsaubhāgyatejasām \|*  
*brahmāṇḍe sarvasaṃhartā cakaṃpe pārvatībhaye \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thereafter Parvati the mother of the universe and one who is the creator of all the virtues whose eyes had become red like red lotus spoke in anger the words which were the essence of the tradition.

## \|\| 37.17 \|\|

*uvāca taṃ jaganmātā nītisāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*gaṇaprasūḥ sakopā ca raktapaṅkajalocanā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. This is the influence of the tapas and not of the tejas of the people. The one who destroy the old universe, he is being terrified by Parvati, the daughter of mountain.

## \|\| 37.18 \|\|

*aho tapaḥprabhāvaśca tejasaśca na jīvinām \|*  
*sa brahmāṇḍasya saṃhartā cakampe śailakanyakā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Parvati said – You happen to be the preserver of the universe beside being the protector. You are especially so with me. Besides you happen to be the reciter of the four Vedas besides being their creator and you are yourself all virtuous.

## \|\| 37.19 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*tvaṃ poṣṭā jagatāṃ pātā mamaiva ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*vaktā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ janakaśca svayaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. You bestow salvation to your devotees besides all the riches. In case you indulge in improper way then who could save the dharmal.

## \|\| 37.20 \|\|

*muktipradātā bhaktānāṃ dātā ca sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*tvaṃ cetkaroṣi durnītiṃ ko vā dharmaṃ ca pāti vai \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. I always maintain and feed by you. I am also your slave. Because of my own misdeeds I have been deprived of consuming the 'left over' of Vis nu.

## \|\| 37.21 \|\|

*sadā te paripālyā'haṃ poṣyā bhaktyā ca kiṃkarī \|*  
*vaṃcitā karmadoṣeṇa haranirmālyabhakṣaṇe \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Certain things get purified with gold, some of them by air and some of them by washing and some of them got purified by offering them to Vishnu. The food offer to Vishnu is revered by all the gods, the manes and the guests who feel satisfied with the same. This has been prescribed in the Vedas.

## \|\| 37.22-23 \|\|

*kiṃcicchuddhaṃ hiraṇyena kiṃcidvastu ca vāyunā \|*  
*kiṃcitprakṣālanenaiva sarvaṃ viṣṇornivedanāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

*viṣṇorniveditānnena yaṣṭavyāḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|*  
*pitaro'tithayaścaivamiti vedeṣu niścitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. The one who discarding the food which is unfit for conception and consumed the naivedya of Vishnu he is considered to be the best of the attendants of Vishnu.

## \|\| 37.24 \|\|

*anivedyamabhakṣyaṃ ca naivedyamudare hareḥ \|*  
*tyaktvā karoti yo bhaktyā pārṣadapravaro bhavet \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The nectar does not compare even one-sixteenth part of the food offered to lord Vishnu Such food is the best of all and difficult to get besides being the essence of all the eatables.

## \|\| 37.25 \|\|

*amṛtaṃ sarvavastūnāmiṣṭasāraṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*viṣṇorniveditānnasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The nectar helps in driving the untimely death and pleases the fools but the naivedya of Vishnu turns one who consumes it like Vishnu himself. This is quite astonishing.

## \|\| 37.26 \|\|

*hantyakālikamṛtyuṃ tadamṛtaṃ mūḍharaṃjanam \|*  
*naivedyaṃ ca harereva haritulyaṃ karotyaho \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The one who consumes the naivedya of Vishnu because of his own sweet will, he achieves the reward of performing tapas for sixty thousand years.

## \|\| 37.27 \|\|

*yadṛcchayā taṃ naivedyaṃ yo bhuṅkte sādhusaṃgataḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇāṃ prāpnoti tapasaḥ phalam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Such of the devotee who always with their mind filled with devotion, offer food to the lord and consume the 'left-over', such persons in spite of their performing tapas compare themselves with the lord in lustre.

## \|\| 37.28 \|\|

*yo nivedya hariṃ bhuṅkte bhaktyā bhaktaśca nityaśaḥ \|*  
*kiṃ vā tapasyāṃ kartā ca sa harestejasā samaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. In the earlier times in Puskara-ksetra I had heard all this from your mouth in the assembly of the sages. I do not happen to be the creator of the Vedas nor could I be competent enough to speak on the subject.

## \|\| 37.29 \|\|

*śrutaṃ purā tvanmukhataḥ puṣkare munisaṃsadi \|*  
*ahaṃ vedavidhātā na kimahaṃ vaktumīśvarī \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О lord, I have achieved you as my husband after performing tapas for long time; then why was I deprived of consuming the naivedya of Vis nu.

## \|\| 37.30 \|\|

*suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā mayā labdhastvamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*tvayā viṣṇoḥ prasādena vaṃcitā'haṃ kathaṃ prabho \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О lord Shiva, you have presently deprived me from consuming the naivedya of Shiva, therefore you will have to receive the reward for the same from me just now. From today onwards, whosoever will consume your naivedya, will be born as a dog in the land of Bharata.

## \|\| 37.31-32 \|\|

*yato na dattaṃ naivadyaṃ viṣṇormahyaṃ tvayā'dhunā \|*  
*ato matto gṛhāṇaitatphalameva maheśvara \|\| 31 \|\|*

*adyaprabhṛti ye lokā naivedyaṃ bhuñjate tava \|*  
*te janmaikaṃ sārameyā bhaviṣyantyeva bhārate \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Thus speaking, the mother Parvati started crying before Shiva. She at once looked at the throat of Shiva as a result of which he came to be known as Nllakantha or blue throated. Shiva then embraced gracefully Parvati and relieved her anguish by praising her.

## \|\| 37.33-34 \|\|

*ityuktvā pārvatī mātā ruroda purato vibhoḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭiḥ papāta tatkaṇṭhe nīlakaṇṭho babhūva ha \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tadā śivaḥ śivāṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā vakṣasi sādaram \|*  
*tanmānabhaṅgaṃ stotreṇa vinayena cakāra ha \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. He wiped out the tears from her eyes again and again and by praising her gently he removed her anguish and spoke appropriate words to her.

## \|\| 37.35 \|\|

*kareṇa cakṣuṣornīraṃ saṃmṛjya ca punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa vividhairnītivākyairmanoharaiḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Getting pleased the goddess spoke to the lord, Unless I consume the naivedya of Vishnu I shall end my life. I maintain this body to maintain your fortune. Now how can I maintain the body without the grace.

## \|\| 37.36-37 \|\|

*parituṣṭā ca sā devī bhartāraṃ samuvāca ha \|*  
*kalevaraṃ ca tyakṣyāmi naivedyena vinā hareḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde haranirmālyaśāpaprasaṅgo nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Your naivedya which removes the, birth, death and old age was incomplete and since you have disowned it, it has become impure. Therefore in your very presence, I am ending my life.

## \|\| 37.38 \|\|

*apūrvaṃ tava naivedyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam \|*  
*kṛtaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca yattasmātpaśya dehaṃ tyajāmi ca \|\| 38 \|\|*
