*sarve nivedanaṃ cakrurbrahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ patim \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shri Krishna said – All the gods deliberated on the matter considerably and then arrived at the abode of Brahma. All of them then submitted themselves before he creator of the universe.

## \|\| 41.2-3 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*tava sṛṣṭau jagatsraṣṭā ratnādhāro himālayaḥ \|*  
*sa cetprāpsyati mokṣaṃ ca ratnagarbhā kuto mahī \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sutāṃ śūlabhṛte dattvā bhaktyā śaileśvaraḥ svayam \|*  
*nārāyaṇasya sārūpyaṃ saṃprāpsyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. The gods said – О creator of the universe, in your universe, Himalaya happens to be the abode of the gems and diamonds. In case he attains moksa then the title of the earth as Ratnagarbha (having gems in her womb) would become infructuous. Himalaya, after giving away his daughter in marriage to Shiva the holder of the trident with devotion sure to achieve the Sarupya moksa of Narayana. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 41.4 \|\|

*tvaṃ tasya nindanaṃ kṛtvā vimatiṃ pratipādaya \|*  
*tvayā vinā kṣamo nānyo gaccha śailagṛhe prabho \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О lord, therefore you go to the abode of Himalaya and denuding Shiva pollute his mind. No one else except you can perform this task.

## \|\| 41.5 \|\|

*devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tānuvāca vidhiḥ svayam \|*  
*vacanaṃ nītisāraṃ ca karṇapīyūṣamuttamam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. On hearing the words of the gods, Brahma himself spoke out the words which were sweet like nectar for the ears and were the best in polity.

## \|\| 41.6 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*nāhaṃ karta kṣamo vatsāḥ śivanindā sudaṣkarām \|*  
*saṃpaddhināśarūpāṃ ca vipado bījarūpiṇīm \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Brahma said – О my children, I am unable to denounce Shiva which is extremely difficult and results in the destruction of all the riches and could create all round miseries.

## \|\| 41.7 \|\|

*bhūteśaṃ prasthāpayata svātmanindāṃ karoti saḥ \|*  
*paranindā vināśāya svanindā yaśase param \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. You send Bhtitanatha to him with the player that he should denounce himself in the abode of Himalaya. By denouncing others one earns destruction and by denouncing himself one earns great glory.

## \|\| 41.8 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā taṃ praṇamya surāḥ priye \|*  
*śīghraṃ yayuste kailāsaṃ gatvā ca tuṣṭuvuḥ śivam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О dear, on hearing the words of Brahma all the gods left his place after offering their salutations to him. They then reached Kailasa and they started praising him.

## \|\| 41.9-10 \|\|

*sarve nivedanaṃ cakruḥ śaṃkaraṃ karuṇālayam \|*  
*sa yayau śailamūlaṃ ca tānāśvāsya prahasya ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

*devā mumudire sarve śīghraṃ gatvā svamandiram \|*  
*iṣṭasiddhirmude śaśvadasiddhirduḥkhavardhinī \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Thereafter, the gods told everything to Shiva the ocean of mercy, hearing which he laughed aloud. He assured the gods and reached the abode of Himalaya himself. All the gods felt immensely delighted at this and reaching their own abodes they started rejoicing there because the success in one's mission is always delightful and getting unsuccessful in one's mission is always painful.

## \|\| 41.11 \|\|

*atha śailaḥ sabhāmadhye samuvāsa mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*bandhuvargaiḥ parivṛtaḥ pārvatīsahitaḥ svayam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Himalaya the king of mountains was seated in his court surrounded by his wife and Parvati.

## \|\| 41.12-13 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra viprarūpī śivaḥ svayam \|*  
*samājagāma sahasā prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*daṇḍī chatrī dīrghavāsā bibhrattilakamuttamam \|*  
*kare sphaṭikamālāṃ ca śālagrāmaṃ gale dadhat \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. In the meantime Shiva himself arrived there suddenly in the form of a Brahmana. His face and eyes were delightful and he was holding a staff and a cakra. in his hands. He was clad in a long costume and his forehead was plastered with the best of tilakam. He hold a rosary of crystal beads in his hand and an image of Shalagrdma was hanging around him neck.

## \|\| 41.14-16 \|\|

*taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā samuttasthau sagaṇaśca himālayaḥ \|*  
*nanāma daṇḍavadbhūmau bhaktyā'tithimapūrvakam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*nanāma pārvatī bhaktyā prāṇeśaṃ viprarūpiṇam \|*  
*āśiṣaṃ yuyuje vipraḥ sarveṣāṃ prītipūrvakam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*śailadattāsane śīghramuvāsa brāhmaṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*madhuparkādikaṃ sarvaṃ jagrāha prītipūrvakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Finding him there, Himalaya got up with his attendants and with his mind filled with devotion, he bowed in reverence to him, welcoming him at the same time. He then prostrated on the ground and finding the lord of her life in the form of a Brahmana, Parvati also offered her salutation to him. The Brahmana lovingly bless everyone and occupied the seat offered by the king of mountains and was seated in Sukhasana. He accepted madhuparka and other eatables offered by the king of the mountains.

## \|\| 41.17 \|\|

*papraccha kuśalaṃ śailo brāhmaṇaṃ ko bhavāniti \|*  
*uvāca sarvaṃ viprendro girīndraṃ sādareṇa ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Himavan asked the Brahmana about his welfare saying, "You kindly let me know your introduction". On hearing this the Brahmana spoke to the king of the mountains everything respectfully.

## \|\| 41.18 \|\|

*. brāhmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ghāṭikāṃ vṛttimāśritya bhramāmi dharaṇītale \|*  
*manoyāyī sarvagāmī sarvajño'haṃ gurorvarāt \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Brahmana said – I roam over the universe and perform the marriage of the boys and girls. My mind is very sharp. With the boon of my feet I can reach everywhere and I know everything.

## \|\| 41.19 \|\|

*mayā jñātaṃ śaṃkarāya sutāṃ dātuṃ tvamicchasi \|*  
*imāṃ padmāsamāṃ divyāmajñātakulaśīline \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. I have come to know that you intend to marry your daughter who is like Lakshmi to Shiva, whose family or caste is unknown.

## \|\| 41.20-23 \|\|

*nirāśrayāyāsaṅgayārūpāya nirguṇāya ca \|*  
*śmaśānagāmine sarvabhūtanāthāya yogine \|\| 20 \|\|*

*digvāsase'higātrāya vibhūtibhūṣaṇāya ca \|*  
*vyālagrāhisvarūpāya kālavyāpādanāya ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ajñātamṛtyave'jñāyānāthāyābandhave bhave \|*  
*taptasvarṇajaṭābhāradhāriṇe nirdhanāya ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*ajñātavayase'tīva vṛddhāya cāvikāriṇe \|*  
*sarvāśrayāya bhramiṇe nāgahārāya bhikṣave \|\| 23 \|\|*

20-23. He knows about and is deprived of beauty and the companion. He is without qualities and resides in the cremation grounds. He is lord of all the Bhutas (goblins), he always remains without robes and the serpents are coiled around his body. He applies ashes on his body and roams about like a snake charmer. He is the destroyer of Kala, who has overcome death. He is without wisdom and an orphan having no relatives in the universe. He has matted locks of hair having the completion of molten gold. He is a pauper and his age is unknown being pretty old, without blemish and the refuge of everyone. He always remains wandering adorning his body with the ornaments of serpents.

## \|\| 41.24 \|\|

*nibodha jñānināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kulodbhavam \|*  
*sa te pātrānurūpaśca pārvatīdātṛkarmaṇi \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. This is his only introduction and you are going to marry your daughter to such a person. Narayana is the best among the intellectuals and belongs to the noble race. You better understand his importance. He is the only suitable person to whom Parvati should be given in marriage by you.

## \|\| 41.25-26 \|\|

*mahājanaḥ smeramukhaḥ śrutimātrādbhaviṣyati \|*  
*lakṣaśailādhipastvaṃ ca na tasyaiko'sti bāndhavaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*bāndhavānmenakāṃ praśnaṃ kuru śīghraṃ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*sarvānpṛccha ca yatnena he bandho pārvatīṃ vinā \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. The people will laugh at the news that Parvati was going to marry Shiva. You are the lord of lakhs of the mountains but Shiva does not have a single relative for himself. Therefore, you consult all your relatives and your wife Mena about this. О friend, I shall speak only this that you should consult everyone on the subject but do not consult Parvati about it.

## \|\| 41.27-28 \|\|

*rogiṇe nauṣadhaṃ śaśvatkupathyaṃ rocate sadā \|*  
*ityuktvā brāhmaṇaḥ śīghraṃ snātvā bhuktvā mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*jagāma svālayaṃ śānto vṛndāvanavinodini \|*  
*brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā menovāca himālayam \|*  
*śokena sāśrunayanā hṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Because an ailing person does not like the medicine, he only intends to indulge in eating according to his will. Thus speaking the Brahmana delightfully took his bath and food with Himalaya and left the place peacefully. О Radha, you enjoy the love-sport in Vrindavana. On hearing the words of Brahmana, was filled with agony. Her eyes were filled with tears and she said to Himalaya.

## \|\| 41.29 \|\|

*menakovāca \|*  
*śṛṇu śailendra madvākyaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Menakaa said – О lord of the mountains, you listen to my words which would be beneficial at the end. You consult all the best of the mountains. I shall never give away my daughter in marriage to Shiva.

## \|\| 41.30 \|\|

*pṛccha śailavarānasmai na dāsyāmi sutāmaham \|*  
*tyakṣyāmi sarvānviṣayānbhakṣyāmi viṣameva ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Look here I shall discard everything and can consumption also and can also live in a dense forest binding Parvati around my neck.

## \|\| 41.31 \|\|

*gale baddhvā'mbikāṃ paśya yāsyāmi ghorakānanam \|*  
*gṛhītvā pārvatīṃ menā gatvā kopālayaṃ ruṣā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Thus speaking Mena holding the hand of Parvati went to the chamber in anger. She discarding food started crying and slept on the floor.

## \|\| 41.32 \|\|

*tyaktvā''hāraṃ rudantī ca cakāra śayanaṃ bhuvi \|*  
*etasminnantare tatra vasiṣṭho bhrātṛbhiḥ saha \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. In the meantime, Vasistha accompanied with his brothers and Arundhatl arrived there.

## \|\| 41.33 \|\|

*ājagāma punastaiśca yuktā paścādarundhatī \|*  
*praṇamya śailastānsarvānsvarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ dadau \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Himavan after offering his salutation to them gave them golden seats and adored them making sixteen types of offering.

## \|\| 41.34 \|\|

*dattvā ṣoḍaśopacārānpūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*ṛṣayaśca sabhāmadhye sukhamūṣuḥ sukhāsane \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. All the sages were comfortably seated in the assembly and Arundhatl went to the place where Parvati and Mena were lodged.

## \|\| 41.35 \|\|

*jagāmārundhatī tūrṇaṃ yatra menā ca pārvatī \|*  
*gatvā dadarśa menāṃ ca śayānāṃ śokamūrcchitām \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Reaching there she found that Mena was drowned on the ocean of grief lying on the ground. The chaste Arundhatl than spoke sweet words to Mena which were also beneficial to her.

## \|\| 41.36 \|\|

*uvāca madhuraṃ sādhvī sāvadhānāṃ hitaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*arundhatyuvāca \|*  
*uttiṣṭha menake sādhvi tvadgṛhe'hamarundhatī \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Arundhatl said – О chaste lady, Mena get up. I am Arundhatl who has arrived in your home. I happen to be the mind born daughter of the manes. You consider myself to be the daughter-in-law of Brahma.

## \|\| 41.37 \|\|

*pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā māṃ jānīhi vidhervadhūm \|*  
*arundhatyāḥ svaraṃ śrutvā śīghramutthāya menakā \|*  
*uvāca śirasā natvā tāṃ padmāmiva tejasā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. On hearing the words of Arundhatl, Mena at once got up and she bowed in reverence to Arundhatl who was having the divine lustre.

## \|\| 41.38 \|\|

*menakovāca \|*  
*aho'dya kimidaṃ puṇyamasmākaṃ puṇyajanmanām \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Menaka said – what is the great merit that has emerged today as a result of which the daughter-in-law of Brahma has arrived in my abode who happens to be the wife of Vasistha.

## \|\| 41.39-40 \|\|

*vadhūrjagadvidheḥ patnī vasiṣṭhasya mamālaye \|*  
*saṃbhrameṇedamevokte gṛhaṃ te'haṃ ca kiṃkarī \|\| 39 \|\|*

*īśvarī jagatāṃ sraṣṭurāgatā bahupuṇyataḥ \|*  
*pādyaṃ dattvā svarṇapīṭhe vāsayāmāsa tāṃ satīm \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. О goddess, I am your slave-girl. You treat this house as your home. Because of our great merit we have been fortunate enough to meet the goddess of the Universe. She spoke this quickly. Thereafter she offered to the chaste lady, the padya and arghya, also gave her the golden seat over which she was seated. She was served the sweet food and thereafter she also tools the food with her daughter.

## \|\| 41.41 \|\|

*bhojayāmāsa miṣṭānnaṃ bubhuje kanyayā saha \|*  
*śivasya hetornītiṃ ca bodhayāmāsa menakām \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Shiva the lord of the yogis would never be desirous of the marriage, he would accept your daughter in marriage only at the request of Brahmanas. After the completion, of the tapas of your daughter, he had given such a promise. Because of this, Shiva the lord of the yogis would surely accept the proposal of the marriage. At this words of the sages, Himalaya smiled and feeling panicky he humbly spoke to them.

## \|\| 41.42 \|\|

*arundhatī prasaṅgena saṃbandhayojanāni ca \|*  
*atha śailamṛṣīndrāśca nītisāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*bodhayāmāsuḥ saṃbandhayojanāni prasaṅgataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Arundhatl then tried to convince Mena about the qualities of Shiva and also insisted that the marriage should be performed.

## \|\| 41.43 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*śailendra śrūyatāṃ vākyamasmākaṃ śubhakārakam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Himalaya said – Shiva does not possess any riches like a king nor does he have any source of pleasure. He has no house no riches and no relatives.

## \|\| 41.44 \|\|

*śivāya pārvatīṃ dehi saṃhartuḥ śvaśuro bhava \|*  
*ayācitāraṃ deveśaṃ bodhayāśu prayatnataḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. On the other hand the sages also spoke to Himavan with the best of the words which were quite appropriate, beneficial and pleasing about the marriage of Shiva and Parvati.

## \|\| 41.45-47 \|\|

*tava śaṅkāvināśāya brahmasaṃbandhakarmaṇi \|*  
*necchako dārasaṃyoge śaṃkaro yogināṃ varaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*vidheḥ prārthanayā deva tava kanyāṃ grahīṣyati \|*  
*duhituste tapasyānte pratijñānaṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*hetudvayena yogīndro vivāhaṃ ca kariṣyati \|*  
*ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya ca himālayaḥ \|*  
*uvāca kiṃcidbhītaśca paraṃ vinayapūrvakam \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. The sages said – О lord of the mountains listen to our beneficial words, you give away in marriage your daughter Parvati to Shiva and become the father-in-law of the destroyer of all.

## \|\| 41.48 \|\|

*himālaya uvāca \|*  
*śivasya rājasāmagrīṃ na hi paśyāmi kāṃcana \|*  
*kiṃcidāśramamaiśvaryaṃ kiṃ vā svajanabāndhavam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. You should try to convince Shiva making considerable efforts and starts preparation for the marriage. Soon the doubt about the performing of marriage with Shiva and Parvati would be removed.

## \|\| 41.49 \|\|

*na kanyāmatinirliptayogine dātumarhati \|*  
*yūyaṃ vidhātuḥ putrāśca satyaṃ vadata niścitam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. He is a pauper and remain uninvolved and giving away the daughter to an ascetic like him would not be proper. You people are the sons of Brahma therefore you be graceful to tender me some sane and definite advice.

## \|\| 41.50-51 \|\|

*nānurūpāya putrāya pitā kanyā dadāti cet \|*  
*kālāllobhādbhayānmohācchatābdaṃ narakaṃ vrajet \|\| 50 \|\|*

*na hi dāsyāmyahaṃ kanyāmicchayā śūlapāṇine \|*  
*yadvidhānaṃ bhavedyogyamṛṣayastadvidhīyatām \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. In case a father because of passion, greed, danger and love gives away in marriage his daughter to an unsuitable person, he has to fall in the hell for long. Therefore I shall not gave away my daughter in marriage to Shiva of my own sweet will О sages, you move according to the best possible way.

## \|\| 41.52 \|\|

*himālayavacaḥ śrutvā vasiṣṭho vidhinandanaḥ \|*  
*vedavedāṅgavijñātā vedoktaṃ vaktumudyataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. On listening to the words of Himavan, the sage Vasistha who was well-versed in the Vedas and post-Vedic literature spoke to Himavan the words which were completely according to the provision of the Vedas.

## \|\| 41.53 \|\|

*vasiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*vacanaṃ vividhaṃ śaila laukike vaidike tathā \|*  
*sarvaṃ jānāti śāstrajño nirmalajñānacakṣuṣā \|\| 53\|\|*

53\. Vasistha said – О lord of the mountains there are three types of words defined in the Vedas, the person who is well-versed in the scriptures is fully aware of the truth, by his divine sight.

## \|\| 41.54 \|\|

*asatyamahitaṃ paścātsāmprataṃ śrutisundaram \|*  
*subuddhaṃ śatrurvadati na hitaṃ ca kadācana \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The first category of words are those which should be pleasing to all the ears and could be understood quickly. But later on could be false and are found to be harmful. Such words are spoken only by enemies and they do not bestow welfare at all.

## \|\| 41.55 \|\|

*āpātaprītijanakaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|*  
*dayālurdharmaśīlaśca bodhayatyeva bāndhavam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The second type of words are those which appeared to be painful in the beginning but they result in delight. Such words are spoken by highly religious people who are quite compassionate. Such words are spoken only to one's close relatives and brothers.

## \|\| 41.56 \|\|

*śrutimātrātsudhātulyaṃ sarvakāle sukhāvaham \|*  
*satyasāraṃ hitakaraṃ vacasāṃ śreṣṭhamīpsitam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The third type of words are those which serve like nectar in the ears as soon as one hear them and they look quite sweet. Such words are pleasant for all times, such words are truthful, beneficial, the best and desired by all.

## \|\| 41.57 \|\|

*evaṃ ca trividhaṃ śaila nītiśāstranirūpitam \|*  
*kathyatāṃ triṣu madhye kiṃ vadāmi vākyamīpsitam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. О lord of the mountains thus three types of words have been described in the scriptures, which one of the words of these three categorise desired by you. I would like to speak about the same.

## \|\| 41.58 \|\|

*bāhyasaṃpadvihīnaśca śaṃkarastridaśeśvaraḥ \|*  
*tattvajñānasamudreṣu sannimagnaikamānasaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. О lord of the mountains, lord Shiva is free from the outward show because his mind is always engrossed in the ocean of the tattvas.

## \|\| 41.59 \|\|

*āpātabhramasaṃpattirvidyucchrīriva nāśinī \|*  
*sadānandasyeśvarasya svātmārāmasya kā spṛhā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The wealth and the riches are by nature unstable and perishable like the lightening, therefore there would be no desire with Shiva who is blissful and remains engrossed in his own soul.

## \|\| 41.60 \|\|

*gṛhī dadāti svasutāṃ rājyasaṃpattiśāline \|*  
*kanyāṃ vidveṣiṇe dattvā kanyāghātī bhavetpitā \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The householder gives away his daughter in marriage to a wealthy person. A father who gives away his daughter in marriage to a person who is envious of the ladies, he is termed as the killer of the daughter.

## \|\| 41.61 \|\|

*ko vadecchaṃkaro duḥkhī kubero yasya kiṃkaraḥ \|*  
*bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ naṣṭuṃ kṣamo hi yaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. who says that Shiva is a pauper or is filled with grief The one who has the attendants like Kubera and the one with whose simple frowning the universe could be created or destroyed.

## \|\| 41.62 \|\|

*nirguṇaḥ paramātmā ca ya īśaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*sarveśaḥ sa ca nirlipto liptaśca sarvajantuṣu \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. the same lord who is devoid of gunas is the eternal soul, the lord of all, beyond Prakriti is uninvolved and pervades in all the creatures.

## \|\| 41.63 \|\|

*sa ekaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāre sa sarvaḥ sṛṣṭikarmaṇi \|*  
*nirākāraśca sākāro vibhuḥ svecchāmayaḥ svayam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. He is not alone in the act of the destruction of the universe. He can also create the universe, he is formless as well as with form. He pervades everywhere, he is the one who moves at will.

## \|\| 41.64-65 \|\|

*ya īśastrividhāṃ mūrtiṃ vidhatte sṛṣṭikarmaṇi \|*  
*sṛṣṭisthityantajananīṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivābhidhām \|\| 64 \|\|*

*brahmā ca brahmalokastho viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodavāsakṛt \|*  
*śivaḥ kailāsavāsī ca sarvāḥ kṛṣṇavibhūtayaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. Taking to the Trimiirti form merging in him Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva at one place, in one form, he performs the task of creation, preservation and destruction of the universe. Brahma resides in the Brahmaloka, Vishnu resides in the ocean of the milk and Shiva has Kailasa as his abode. All the three are the vibhiitis of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 41.66 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇaśca dvidhābhūto dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ \|*  
*caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Lord Krishna has two forms, the first one has two arms and the second one has four arms. In his four-armed form, he resides in Vaikuntna and in his two-armed form he resides in Goloka.

## \|\| 41.67 \|\|

*tasya devasya teṃ'śāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|*  
*keciddevāḥ kalāstasya kalāṃśāścaiva kecana \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are the amshas of Krishna. Same of the gods happen to be his rays and while the other is only the part of his rays.

## \|\| 41.68 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaḥ sṛṣṭyunmukhaścāpi prakṛtiṃ tatra nirmame \|*  
*nirmāya tāṃ ca tadyonau vīryādhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. It is lord Krishna who had created Prakfti with the sole purpose of the creation of the universe and for the purpose of creation, the seed was implanted in her womb.

## \|\| 41.69 \|\|

*tato ḍimbhaḥ samudbhūtastanmadhye ca mahāvirāṭ \|*  
*mahāviṣṇuḥ sa vijñeyo śrīkṛṣṇaṣoḍaśāṃśakaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Out of that womb an egg was born, out of which Mahavirat appeared. He is also known as Maha-Vishnu who happens to be the sixteenth Goloka of Shri Krishna.

## \|\| 41.70 \|\|

*nābhipadmodbhavo brahmā tasyaiva jalaśāyinaḥ \|*  
*bhālodbhavastasya sraṣṭuḥ śaṃkaraścandraśekharaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. The four faced Brahma emerged out of the navel of Maha-Vishnu who was reclining on the serpent bed in the ocean. Lord Shiva appeared from the forehead of Brahma.

## \|\| 41.71 \|\|

*mahāviṣṇurvāmapārśvātsaṃbhūto viṣṇureva ca \|*  
*sarve prākṛtikāḥ śaila brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Vishnu appeared from the left side of Mahavis nu. О king of the mountains, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are all the forms of Prakritika.

## \|\| 41.72 \|\|

*dhatte caturvidhāṃ mūrtiṃ prakṛtiḥ kṛṣṇasaṃbhavā \|*  
*aṃśena līlayā sṛṣṭyai kalayā bahudhā tayā \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Prakriti was born out of Shri Krishna taking herself to four forms. For performing in the universe play fully they took to many forms by their rays and amshas.

## \|\| 41.73-76 \|\|

*kṛṣṇavāmāṃgasaṃbhūtā rādhā rāseśvarī svayam \|*  
*mukhodbhavā svayaṃ vāṇī rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|\| 73 \|\|*

*vakṣaḥsthalodbhavā lakṣmīḥ sarvasaṃpatsvarūpiṇī \|*  
*śivā tejaḥsu devānāmāvirbhāvaṃ cakāra sā \|\| 74 \|\|*

*nihatya dānavānsarvāndevebhyaśca śriyaṃ dadau \|*  
*prāpya kalpāṃtare janma jaṭhare dakṣayoṣitaḥ \|\| 75\|\|*

*nāmnā satī śivaṃ prāpa dakṣastasmai dadau ca tām \|*  
*yogena dehaṃ tatyāja śrutvā sā bhartṛniṃdanam \|\| 76 \|\|*

73-76. Raseshvari Radha appeared from the left side of Shri Krishna and from her mouth Sarasvati, the goddess of all the Ragas emerged. Lakshmi representing all the riches emerged from her breasts. She displayed her Shiva form with the lustre of all the gods for the killing of the demon. Thereafter, she bestowed the Raja-Lakshmi on the gods. After the change of kalpa, she was born out of the womb of the wife of Daksha and was known by the name of Sati who married to Shiva. Daksha himself gave her away in marriage but listening to the denouncement of her husband, Sati ended her life.

## \|\| 41.77-78 \|\|

*pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā menakā tava gehinī \|*  
*lalābha tasyā jaṭhare janma sā jagadaṃbikā \|\| 77 \|\|*

*śivā śivasya patnīyaṃ śaila janmanijanmani \|*  
*kalpe kalpe buddhirūpā jñānināṃ jananī parā \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. Your wife Mena happens to be the mind-bom daughter of the manes. Jagadambika was born out of the womb of Mena, О lord of the mountains, Shiva happens to be the wife of Shiva in all the kalpas. She represents the wisdom of the best of the intellectuals.

## \|\| 41.79 \|\|

*jātismarā ca sarvajñā siddhidā siddharūpiṇī \|*  
*asyā asthi citābhasma bhaktyā dhatte śivaḥ svayam \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. She bestows success and is all Knowledgeable. She remembers the events of all her previous births, Shiva adorns himself with the garland of her bones and applies the ashes of her fire, on his body.

## \|\| 41.80 \|\|

*dehi tvaṃ svecchayā kanyāṃ dehi bhadra śivāya ca \|*  
*athavā sā svayaṃ kāṃtasthānaṃ yāsyati drakṣyati \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. О form of welfare, you give away your daughter willingly to Shiva. Otherwise she is sure to proceed to the abode of her lord and you will keep on watching the sight.

## \|\| 41.81 \|\|

*prāktanādyasya yā kāṃtā sā taṃ prāpnoti vallabham \|*  
*prajāpaternibaṃdhaṃ ca na ko'pi khaṃḍituṃ kṣamaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Whichever husband, a women had in her previous birth, the same husband is achieved by her in the present birth. No one can change this order of Brahma.

## \|\| 41.82-83 \|\|

*vivāhe notsukaḥ śaṃbhuḥ svātmārāmaśca tattvavit \|*  
*tuṣṭuvustaṃ surāḥ sarve tārakākhyena pīḍitāḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*devānāṃ pīḍanaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇā prārthito vibhuḥ \|*  
*kṛpayā svīcakārāśu kṛpālurdevasaṃsadi \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. Shiva is well-aware of tattvas who moves in his own way therefore he is not quite anxious for the marriage. All the gods who were terrified by Tarakasura prayed to Shiva. Realising the pain of the gods, Brahma prayed to Shiva. The compassionate Shiva agreed to have her gracefully as his wife.

## \|\| 41.84-85 \|\|

*kṛtvā pratijñāṃ yogīṃdro dṛṣṭvā kleśamasaṃkhyakam \|*  
*duhituste tapaḥsthānamājagāma dvijātmakaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*tāmāśvāsya varaṃ dattvā jagāma nijamaṃdiram \|*  
*tacchrutvaivāyayuḥ sarve surāḥ śakrādayo mudā \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. Promising to marry her. Shiva the lord of the yogis himself witnessed the severe, tapas performed by your daughter and he himself went there in the form of a Brahmana boy. He assured her and also granted a born to her and thereafter he left for the place. On hearing the news the gods like Indra and others were filled with delight.

## \|\| 41.86-87 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānbrahmā dharmaśca sāṃpratam \|*  
*ṛṣayo munayaḥ sarve gaṃdharvā yakṣarākṣasāḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*tatra sarve mudā yuktaiḥ samālocanakartṛbhiḥ \|*  
*prasthāpitā vayaṃ śīghramanṛṇā sā aruṃdhatī \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. Thereafter lord Narayana, Brahma, Dharma and all the gods, Sages, Gandharvas, Yaksas and Raksasas met at a particular place and all of them discussed on the subject. All of them had speedily sent me here. The goddess Arundhatl had already performed his job.

## \|\| 41.88 \|\|

*tava prabodhane prītirvarddhate mahatī sadā \|*  
*saṃprāptaṃ śubhakāryaṃ ca sarvakālasukhāvaham \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. I feel delighted in talking to you, Shiva who is bestower of pleasure in all the time proposed to be marriage in your presence.

## \|\| 41.89 \|\|

*śivāṃ śivāya śaileṃdra svecchayā cenna dāsyasi \|*  
*bhavitā vā vivāhaśca bhavitavyabalena ca \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. О lord of the mountains in case you do not give away Parvati in marriage to Shiva willingly than the marriage would be performed as the move of destiny.

## \|\| 41.90-92 \|\|

*āgamiṣyati devo yo nārāyaṇasahāyavān \|*  
*ratnasārarathe kṛtvā devānāṃ pravaraṃ varam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*yogīṃdrāṇāṃ vareṇyaṃ taṃ jñānināṃ ca gurorgurum \|*  
*ādimadhyāṃtarahitamavikāramajaṃ param \|\| 91 \|\|*

*varaṃ dadau śivāyai sa śivaśca tapasaḥ sthale \|*  
*na hīśvarapratijñātaṃ durlabhaṃ viphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 92 \|\|*

90-92. Lord Shiva would be mounted over she chariot studded with best of gems. He is the best of the yogis the teacher of the intellectuals free from the beginning, middle or end is without blemish and is without birth. Accompanied by Narayana the best of the gods he would arrived here, the same Shiva has already granted a boon to Parvati, while she was performing tapas. The infallible words of the lord cannot be otherwise.

## \|\| 41.93 \|\|

*brahmādistaṃbaparyataṃ sarvaṃ naśvaramasthiram \|*  
*aho pratijñā durlaṅghyā sādhūnāmavināśinī \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. Everything right from Brahma to the blade of grass is perishable and unstable but the words of infallible ascetics cannot be otherwise.

## \|\| 41.94 \|\|

*eko maheṃdraḥ śailānāṃ pakṣāṃściccheda līlayā \|*  
*pavano līlayā meroḥ śṛṃgabhaṃgaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. All the wings of the mountains were cut off by Indra in a moment playfully; playing with the wind the peaks of mountains were shattered.

## \|\| 41.95 \|\|

*ke vā śaileṣu yoddhāraḥ suraiḥ saha himālaya \|*  
*patiṣyaṃti samudreṣu pavanaiḥ preritāḥ kṣaṇāt \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Therefore О Himalaya, which one of the mountains with you is competent enough to wage a war against the gods. With the force of the wind all the mountains will fall into the ocean in no time.

## \|\| 41.96 \|\|

*ekārthe yadi śailendra sarvasaṃpadvinaśyati \|*  
*sarvānrakṣati taddattvā vinā ca śaraṇāgatam \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. О king of the mountains, in case by giving away one thing, one can save the destruction of others, one should protect the rest by giving away one. This rule is not applicable for the one who comes to take refuge with you.

## \|\| 41.97 \|\|

*śaraṇāgatarakṣārthaṃ prāṇāṃśca dātumarhati \|*  
*putradāradhanaṃ sarvāniti nītivido viduḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. It would be quite appropriate to give away even the life for the protection of the one who has taken refuge. Then what to speak of the son, the wife and riches besides other things? This has been ordained by people who are well-versed in the scriptures.

## \|\| 41.98 \|\|

*dattvā viprāya svasutāmanaraṇyo nṛpeśvara \|*  
*brahmaśāpādvimuktaśca rarakṣa sarvasaṃpadam \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. The king Anaranya was freed from the curse of a Brahmana by giving away his daughter to him in marriage By doing this, he was able to protect all his riches.

## \|\| 41.99 \|\|

*tamāśu bodhayāmāsurnītiśāstravido janāḥ \|*  
*brahmaśāpanimagnaṃ ca brahmaṇyamatikātaram \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. He was well-wishers of Brahmanas but facing the curse from them, Anaranya was advised by those well-versed in the scriptures is duty at that time. By following the same he was freed from the danger.

## \|\| 41.100 \|\|

*tvameva śailarājeṃdra sutāṃ dattvā śivāya ca \|*  
*rakṣa sarvānbaṃdhuvargānvaśe kuru surānapi \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. О lord of the mountains, similarly you also save all your relatives and friends by giving away your daughter to Shiva and get control on the gods.

## \|\| 41.101 \|\|

*vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya parvateśvaraḥ \|*  
*papraccha nṛpavṛttāṃtaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. On hearing the words of Vasistha, Himalaya, the king of the mountains laughed aloud and with a painful heart he enquired about the story of Anaranya.

## \|\| 41.102 \|\|

*himālaya uvāca \|*  
*kasya vaṃśodbhavo brahmannanaraṇyo nṛpeśvaraḥ \|*  
*sutāṃ dattvā sa ca kathamarakṣatsarvasaṃpadam \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Himalaya said – О Brahmana, in which race was the king Anaranya born and how did he get himself relieved of the danger by giving away his daughter to the Brahmana and saved all his fortunes.

## \|\| 41.103 \|\|

*vasiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*manuvaṃśodbhavo rājā so'naraṇyo nṛpeśvaraḥ \|*  
*ciṃrajīvī dharmaśīlo vaiṣṇavo vijiteṃdriyaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Vasistha said – The king Anaranya was born in the race of Manu. He had long life, was quite a religious one, was a Vaishnava and had controlled all his senses.

## \|\| 41.104 \|\|

*svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaputro'tidhārmikaḥ \|*  
*rājyaṃ cakāra dharmeṇa yugānāmekasaptatim \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. The name of the Manu happens to be Svayambhuva who had been the son of Brahma and was quite a religiously minded king. He mled quite religiously by the period of seventy one yagas.

## \|\| 41.105 \|\|

*tato jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ sahitaḥ śatarūpayā \|*  
*saṃprāpya dāsyaṃ sānnidhyaṃ harerdāso babhūva ha \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. Thereafter he went to Vaikuntha with his daughter named Satampa. There he achieved the slavehood of Hari and became his attendant,

## \|\| 41.106 \|\|

*manurbabhūva tatpaścātsvayaṃ svārociṣo mahān \|*  
*svārociṣe gate śaila babhūva manuruttamaḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. О lord of the mountain, thereafter the great Svarocis Manu was there. Thereafter Uttama Manu appeared,

## \|\| 41.107 \|\|

*uttame nirgate dharmī tāmaso manureva ca \|*  
*tato manurbabhūvātra raivato jñānināṃ varaḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Thereafter the Tamas Manu who was the form of Dharma appeared and he was succeeded by Raivata Manu.

## \|\| 41.108-110 \|\|

*cākṣuṣaśca tato jñeyaḥ śrāddhadevaśca saptamaḥ \|*  
*sāvarṇiraṣṭamo jñeyaḥ śrīsūryatanayo mahān \|\| 108 \|\|*

*caitravaṃśodbhavo rājā purā''sītsuratho bhuvi \|*  
*navamo dakṣasāvarṇirbrahmasāvarṇiko daśa \|\| 109 \|\|*

*ekādaśo manuśreṣṭho dharmasāvarṇirucyate \|*  
*tataśca rudrasāvarṇirviṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ \|\| 110\|\|*

108-110. Thereafter the sixth one was Caksusa the seventh was Sraddhadeva and the eighth one was the great Savarani who was the son of Surya, who had in earlier birth born as the king Suratha in the family of Caitra. The ninth Manu was Daksha Savarani and the tenth was Brahma Savarani. The eleventh one was Dharma Savarani and the twelfth was Rudra Savarani who happened to be a great devotee of Vishnu and had controlled all his senses.

## \|\| 41.111-112 \|\|

*tatparo devasāvarṇiriṃdrasāvarṇikastataḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitā baṃdho manavaśca caturdaśa \|\| 111 \|\|*

*eteṣu samatīteṣu babhūva brahmaṇo dinam \|*  
*indrasāvarṇivṛttātaṃ sarvaṃ matto niśāmaya \|\| 112 \|\|*

111-112. Thereafter, Deva Savarani was born and after him the fourteenth the Manu was Indra Savarani. О brother, thus I have narrated to you the names of all the fourteenth Manus, after the passing of whom a day of Brahma is counted. Now you listen to the story of Indra Savarani.

## \|\| 41.113-115 \|\|

*manūnāṃ pravaro dharmī śuddhabhakto gadābhṛtaḥ \|*  
*cakāra rājyaṃ dharmeṇa yugānāmekasaptatim \|\| 113 \|\|*

*rājyaṃ dattvā sureṃdrāya jagāma tapase vanam \|*  
*suradreṃsya sutaḥ śrīmāñchrīniketurmahābalaḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

*tasya putro mahāyogī purīṣatarureva ca \|*  
*tasya putro'titejasvī gokāmukha iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

113-115. Indra Savarani happened to be the best of the Manus, was quite a religious one and was a great devotee of Vishnu the holder of Gada. He ruled the earth for a period of seventy one yugas quite religiously. Thereafter, entrusting the care of his kingdom to Surendra his son he himself went to die forest for tapas. Surendra had a valorous son named Shriniketu who had a son named Purlsatam who was a great yogi. Purlsataru had an illustrious son known by the name of Gokamukha.

## \|\| 41.116-117 \|\|

*vṛddhaśravāḥ sutastasya tatputro bhānureva ca \|*  
*puṇḍarīkaḥ sutastasya tatputro jihvalastathā \|\| 116 \|\|*

*jihvalasya sutaḥ śṛṅgī tatputro bhīma eva ca \|*  
*tatputro'pi yaśaścandro yaśasā ca śaśī jitaḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

116-117. He had a son named Vrddhasrava and Vrddhashrava had a son named Bhanu, Bhanu had a son named Pundrlka, while Pundrlka had the son named Jihvala, Jihvala had the son named Smgl and Smgl had the son named Bhlma, Bhlma had a son named Yashaschandra, who with his glory conquered even the glory of moon.

## \|\| 41.118-119 \|\|

*tatkīrtiṃ nirmalāṃ santo gāyanti saṃtataṃ surāḥ \|*  
*tasya putro vareṇyaśca purāraṇyaśca tatsutaḥ \|\| 118 \|\|*

*tatputro dhārmikaḥ śrīmāndharāraṇyaśca eva ca \|*  
*tatputro maṃgalāraṇyastapasvī jñānināṃ varaḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

118-119. His spotless glory was always recited by the gods and the sages. He had a son named Varenya. Varenya had the son named Puraranya who had a son named Dhararanya who was a quite a religious one. He had son named Mangalaranya who was a great ascetic and a great intellectual.

## \|\| 41.120-121 \|\|

*aputrako nṛpaśreṣṭhastapase puṣkaraṃ gataḥ \|*  
*suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā varaṃ labdhvā maheśvarāt \|\| 120\|\|*

*saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavaṃ putramanaraṇyaṃ jiteṃdriyam \|*  
*dattvā tasmai ca rājyaṃ ca jagāma tapase vanam \|\| 121 \|\|*

120-121. Mangalaranya, the best of the kings was issueless. He, therefore, performed great tapas in Puskara region. He performed tapas for a long time and than achieved a boon, as a result of which he was bestowed with a son, who had controlled all his desires and was known by the name of Anaranya he entrusting the kingship to his son went to the forest for performing tapas.

## \|\| 41.122 \|\|

*anaraṇyo nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ saptadvīpamahīpatiḥ \|*  
*cakāra yajñaśatakaṃ bhṛguṇā ca purodhasā \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Anaranya the best of the king ruled the seven continents and he appointed Bhrigu as his family priest and performed an hundred yajnas.

## \|\| 41.123 \|\|

*tucchaṃ matvāśu śakratvaṃ na lebhe naśvaraṃ sudhīḥ \|*  
*līlayā ca jitaḥ śakro līlayā ca jito baliḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. The king who was full of wisdom did not accept the position of Indra taking it to be quite perishable. He actually conquered Bali and Indra quite playfully.

## \|\| 41.124-127 \|\|

*jitāśca dānaveṃdrā vai jvalatā svena tejasā \|*  
*babhūvuḥ śataputrāśca rājñastasya himālaya \|\| 124 \|\|*

*kanyaikā suṃdarī ramyā padmā padmālayāsamā \|*  
*sā kanyā yauvanasthā ca babhūva pitṛmaṃdire \|\| 125 \|\|*

*cāraṃ prasthāpayamāsa varāya nṛpatīśvaraḥ \|*  
*ekadā pippalādaśca gaṃtuṃ svāśramamutsukaḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

*tapaḥsthāne nirjane ca gandharvaṃ sa dadarśa ha \|*  
*strīṣu nirmagnacittaṃ ca śṛṅgārarasasāgare \|\| 127 \|\|*

124-127. With the great luster he possessed the king of demons was also defeated. О Himalaya the king had a hundred sons and a beautiful daughter named Padma who resembled Lakshmi in beauty. Remaining in the house of her father she became youthful Thereafter the king sent the messengers to all sides. Once the great ascetic named PippalSda was anxious to go to his asrama. In that secluded place he came across to Gandharva who was enjoying the love-sport in the company of the damsels.

## \|\| 41.128-130 \|\|

*kāmādatīva mattaṃ ca na jānantaṃ divāniśam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā taṃ muniśārdūlaḥ sakāmaśca babhūva ha \|\| 128 \|\|*

*tataḥ subhagnacittaḥ sañcintayandārasaṃgraham \|*  
*ekadā puṣpabhadrāyāṃ snātuṃ gacchanmunīśvaraḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

*dadarśa padmāṃ yuvatī padmāmiva manoramām \|*  
*keyaṃ kasyeti papraccha samīpasthāñjanānmuniḥ \|\| 130\|\|*

128-130. Having been drowned in passion, the Gandharva was intoxicated and lost the sense about the day or the night. The sage witnessing the sight was filled with passion. From that day onwards, he remained upset and started thinking about his marriage. Once the sage Pippalada was moving towards the bank of Puspabhadra river for taking a bath. He spotted the princess Padma on his way, who was quite youthful and looked like KamalS in beauty. He enquired about her from the people there as to who was she and who was her father.

## \|\| 41.131-133 \|\|

*janā nivedanaṃ cakruḥ padmā'naraṇyakanyakā \|*  
*muniḥ snātvā'bhīṣṭadevaṃ saṃpūjya rādhikeśvaram \|\| 131 \|\|*

*jagāma kāmī bhikṣārthamanaraṇyasabhājire \|*  
*rājā śīghraṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma bhayākulaḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

*madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*kāmātsarvaṃ gṛhītvā ca yayāce kanyakāṃ muniḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

131-133. The people told him that she happened to be Padma, daughter of Anaranya. Thereafter taking his bath and adoring lord Krishna, the passionate. Sage went to the palace of Anaranya for receiving charity. Finding the sage there, the king felt panicky and he bowed in reverence to him offering madhuparka and performing piijd for him. The sage accepted all his offering delightfully and than demanded the hand of his daughter.

## \|\| 41.134-136 \|\|

*maunī babhūva nṛpatiḥ kiṃcinnirvaktumakṣamaḥ \|*  
*muniḥ punaryayāce taṃ kanyā dehīti me nṛpa \|\| 134 \|\|*

*athavā bhasmasātsarvaṃ kariṣyāmi kṣaṇena ca \|*  
*sarve babhūvurācchannā gaṇāśca tejasā muneḥ \|\| 135 \|\|*

*ruroda rājā sagaṇo dṛṣṭvā vṛddhaṃ jarāturam \|*  
*mahiṣyo ruruduḥ sarvā iti karttavyamakṣamāḥ \|\| 136 \|\|*

134-136. The king kept quiet. He was unable to speak out anything. The sage again put up his demand, "O king give me the hand of your daughter otherwise I shall reduce all your riches to ashes by pronouncing a curse. At that point of time with the lustre of the sage, all the courtiers of the kings were immensely influenced. Finding the body of the sage badly affected with old age, the king started crying with all his attendants and courtiers. All the queens also started crying. No one could think as to what could be done in those circumstances.

## \|\| 41.137-140 \|\|

*mūrcchāṃ prāpa mahārājñī kanyāmātā śucākulā \|*  
*paṇḍito nītiśāstrajño bodhayāmāsa bhūmipam \|\| 137 \|\|*

*mahiṣīṃ ca nṛpasutānkanyakānītimuttamām \|*  
*adya vāpi dinānte vā dātavyā kanyakā nṛpa \|\| 138 \|\|*

*parāya viprādanyasmai kasmai vā dātumarhasi \|*  
*satpātraṃ brāhmaṇādanyaṃ na paśyāmi jagattraye \|\| 139 \|\|*

*sutāṃ dattvā ca munaye rakṣasva sarvasaṃpadam \|*  
*rājakanyānimittena sarvasaṃpatpraṇaśyati \|\| 140\|\|*

137-140. The chief queen who happened to be the mother of the daughter got filled with grief and was fainted. Those well-versed in polity and the scriptures advised the king "O king, you have to give away in marriage the girl today or any other day. Do you think it proper to give away your daughter to some-one else besides the ascetic? I do not find anyone more suitable in the three worlds beside this Brahmana who could be given your daughter in marriage, you save all your riches by giving away the daughter to the sage. The entire kingdom would be destroyed for the sake of the princess.

## \|\| 41.141-142 \|\|

*sarvaṃ rakṣati tattyaktvā vinā taṃ śaraṇāgatam \|*  
*rājā prājñavacaḥ śrutvā vilapya ca muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 141 \|\|*

*kanyāṃ sālaṃkṛtāṃ kṛtvā munīndrāya dadau kila \|*  
*kāntāṃ gṛhītvā sa munirmuditaḥ svālayaṃ yayau \|\| 142 \|\|*

141-142. One should disown everyone else except the one who takes refuge to save everything. The king listened to the intellectuals and while lamenting again and again adorning his daughter with all the ornaments, gave her away in marriage, to the sage. The sage also accompanied with his wife delightfully returned to his abode.

## \|\| 41.143 \|\|

*rājā sarvānparityajya jagāma tapase śucā \|*  
*bhartuśca duhituḥ śokātprāṇāṃstatyāja sundarī \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. The king also, with this mind filled with grief, left the kingdom for performing tapas. His beautiful wife getting separated from the daughter and husband ended her life.

## \|\| 41.144-145 \|\|

*putrāḥ pautrāśca bhṛtyāśca mūrcchāṃ prāpurnṛpaṃ vinā \|*  
*anaraṇyastapastaptvā cintayanrādhikeśvaram \|\| 144 \|\|*

*golokanāthaṃ saṃsevya golokaṃ ca jagāma ha \|*  
*babhūva kīrtimānrājā jyeṣṭhaputro nṛpasya ca \|*  
*putravatpālayāmāsa prajāḥ sarvā mahītale \|\| 145 \|\|*

144-145. In the absence of the king his sons, grandson and the attendants were fainted. The king Anaranya reciting the name of Shri Krishna went to Goloka after performing tapas. Thereafter the eldest son of the king succeeded him and he treated all the people in his kingdom like his own sons.

## Chapter 42

## \|\| 42.1-4 \|\|

*vasiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*athānaraṇyasya kanyā siṣeve bhaktito munim \|*  
*karmaṇā manasā vācā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaṃ yathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ekadā svarṇadīṃ snātuṃ gacchaṃtīṃ sasmitāṃ satīm \|*  
*dadarśa pathi dharmaśca māyayā nṛpaliṃgakaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*cāruratnarathasthaśca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*navīnayauvanaśrīmānkāmadevasamaprabhaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sundarīṃ ramyāmuvāca māyayā vibhuḥ \|*  
*vijñātumantastattvaṃ ca tasyāśca muniyoṣitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Vasistha said – The daughter of king Anaranya served the sage physically, mentally and by speech with utmost devotion like Lakshmi served Narayana. Once while she was going to, the bank of Ganga smilingly, for taking a bath, Dharma taking to the form of a beautiful king appeared before her in order to test her devotion. He started talking like a passionate person who was mounted over a gem-studded chariot, was adorned with gem-studded ornaments, was quite youthful and was as beautiful as the god of love. In order to test the inner feeling of the wife of the sage, Dharma spoke to her.

## \|\| 42.5-6 \|\|

*dharma uvāca \|*  
*ayi sundari lakṣmīva rājayogye manohare \|*  
*atīva yauvanasthe ca kāmini sthirayauvane \|\| 5 \|\|*

*jarāturasya vṛddhasya samīpe tvaṃ na rājase \|*  
*candanāgurusaṃliptā rājase rājavakṣasi \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Dharma said – О beautiful one, you are as attractive as Lakshmi herself. О damsel, you are in youthful age and this youthful life is meant for the enjoyment of a king. Therefore, do you not feel disgraced by living with the sage who is pretty old. Getting your body plastered with sandal-paste and aguru you should adorn the lap of a king.

## \|\| 42.7 \|\|

*vipraṃ tapaḥsu nirataṃ satyajñaṃ maraṇonmukham \|*  
*vihāya paśya rājendraṃ ratiśūraṃ smarāturam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. What is the use of that old Brahmana who is nearing death, is truthful and is always engaged in performing tapas. You disown him and look at me. I am a king. I am well-versed in the love-sport and presently I have been infested with passion.

## \|\| 42.8 \|\|

*prāpnoti sundaraṃ puṇyātsaundaryaṃ pūrvajanmataḥ \|*  
*saphalaṃ tadbhavetsarvaṃ rasikāliṃganena ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. A beautiful damsel achieves a beautiful person because of the good deeds of her earlier birth. She gets all her desires fulfilled with the embrace of a charming person.

## \|\| 42.9-10 \|\|

*sahasrasundarīkāntaṃ kāmaśāstra viśāradam \|*  
*kiṃkaraṃ kuru māṃ kānte parityakṣyāmi tā api \|\| 9 \|\|*

*nirjale nirjane ramye śaileśaile nadenade \|*  
*puṣpodyāne puṣpite ca sugandhipuṣpavāyunā \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. О dear one, I am well-versed in the scriptures on love, possess thousands of beautiful damsels. I shall disown all of them. О damsel you make me your slave.

## \|\| 42.11-12 \|\|

*malaye candanāraṇye cārucandanavāyunā \|*  
*vihariṣyāmi kāmena kāminyā ca tvayā saha \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kāmajvareṇa dagdhāyāḥ śāṃtiṃ kartumahaṃ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*viharasva mayā sārddhaṃ janmedaṃ saphalaṃ kuru \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Accompanied with a charming damsel like you I shall roam about in the lonely places having no water, charming places, the mountains, the banks of the rivers and rivulets, flower orchards where the breeze is filled with the fragrance of flowers, besides the beautiful sandal-wood trees of the Malaya mountain. I am competent enough to subside the flame of passion arising in your body. You come along with me and enjoy my company making your present birth a success.

## \|\| 42.13 \|\|

*ityevamuktavaṃtaṃ taṃ svarathādavaruhya ca \|*  
*grahītumutsukaṃ hastaṃ tamuvāca pativratā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus speaking he descended from the chariot and he tried to catch hold of the hand of the princes:. At this, the chaste-lady spoke to him denouncing him at the same time.

## \|\| 42.14-15 \|\|

*padmovāca \|*  
*dūraṃ gaccha gaccha dūraṃ pāpiṣṭha bhūmipādhama \|*  
*māṃ cetpaśyasi kāmena sadyo bhasma bhaviṣyasi \|\| 14 \|\|*

*pippalādaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ tapasā pūtavigraham \|*  
*vihāya tvāṃ bhajiṣyāmi strījitaṃ ratilaṃpaṭam \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Padma said – О degraded king you are extremely sinful therefore move away. In case you cast a voluptuous eye on me, you would surely be reduced to ashes. Pippalada is a sage who has, purified his body by great tapas. Leaving him, shall I enjoy company of a wicked person who has been defeated by the damsels.

## \|\| 42.16-17 \|\|

*strījitasparśamātreṇa sarvapuṇyaṃ praṇaśyati \|*  
*na bhūmau pātakī pāpātpāpināṃ strījitātparaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*māṃ mātaraṃ ca strībhāvaṃ kṛtvā yena bravīṣi ca \|*  
*bhaviṣyati kṣayastena kālena mama śāpataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. You should realise it that with the touch of a person who is controlled by the women, one gets destroyed, there is no other greater sinner on earth like the one who is defeated by the ladies. Therefore you consider myself as your mother and should not speak like this, otherwise with the pronouncing of a curse by me, you would vanish.

## \|\| 42.18 \|\|

*śrutvā dharmaḥ satīśāpaṃ nṛpamūrtiṃ vihāya ca \|*  
*dhṛtvā svamūrtiṃ deveśaḥ kaṃpamāna uvāca tām \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. On hearing about the curse of a chaste women, Dharma at once shed away the form of a king and took to a real form and with a trembling voice, he spoke to Padma.

## \|\| 42.19 \|\|

*dharma uvāca \|*  
*mātarjānīhi māṃ dharmaṃ dharmajñānāṃ gurorgurum \|*  
*parastrīmātṛbuddhiṃ ca kurvantaṃ saṃtataṃ sati \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Dharma said – О mother, take me to be Dharma, who is the teacher of all the teachers. О chaste lady I always look at the others wives like mothers.

## \|\| 42.20-21 \|\|

*ahaṃ tavāṃtarvijñātumāgatastava sannidhim \|*  
*yuṣmākaṃ ca mano jāne tathāpi daivabodhitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kṛtaṃ me damanaṃ sādhvi na viruddhaṃ yathocitam \|*  
*śāstiḥ samutpathasthānāmīśvareṇa vinirmitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. I had come to you in order to test your mind in spite of the fact that I know fully well about the mind of the chaste lady. But still moved by the destiny I arrived here to test your chastity, О chaste lady you have done well by denouncing me. It is not Improper, it is quite appropriate to put a person moving on the wrong path in the right direction.

## \|\| 42.22 \|\|

*dharmaṃ svadharmaṃ vijñātuṃ kālaṃ kalayituṃ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*vidhātāraṃ saṃvidhātuṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. I bow in reverence to lord Krishna, who makes even Dharma to follow the Dharma and makes even the god of death to account for everything and is competent enough to create the creator of the worlds.

## \|\| 42.23-24 \|\|

*saṃhartuṃ yaḥ kṣamaḥ kāle saṃhartāraṃ bhavaṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*sraṣṭāraṃ līlayā sraṣṭuṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śatruṃ vidhātuṃ mitraṃ ca suprītiṃ kalahaṃ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*sraṣṭuṃ naṣṭam tadevaṃ ca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. He is the one who destroys at the appropriate time, creates the creator at the appropriate time. I how in reverence to lord Krishna. The one who can make the enemy as the friend and the friend as the enemy. He is the one who is competent enough to destroy the entire universe, I bow in reverence to lord Krishna.

## \|\| 42.25 \|\|

*śāpaṃ pradātuṃ sarvāśca sukhaduḥkhavarānkṣamaḥ \|*  
*saṃpadaṃ vipadaṃ yo hi tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The one who is competent enough of pronounce curse on everyone bestows pleasure and pain, boons, riches and even the miseries, I bow in reverence to the same Krishna.

## \|\| 42.26-27 \|\|

*prakṛtirnirmitā yena mahāviṣṇuśca nirmitaḥ \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yena śuklīkṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ jalaṃ śītaṃ kṛtaṃ purā \|*  
*dāhīkṛto hutāśaśca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. The one who has created Prakriti, Maha-Vishnu, Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and other gods I how in reverence to him. The one who in earlier times bestowed whiteness to the milk, coolness to the water, burning to Agni, I bow in reverence to the same Kpsna.

## \|\| 42.28 \|\|

*atitejaḥ samutthāya tejorūpāya mūrttaye \|*  
*guṇaśreṣṭhanirguṇāya tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The one who is extremely illustrious and the form of tejas, I bow in reverence too the Krishna who happens to be full of qualities and even without qualities.

## \|\| 42.29 \|\|

*sarvasmai sarvabījāya sarveṣāmantarātmane \|*  
*sarvabaṃdhusvarūpāya tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The one who is form of all, the-seed of all, the soul of all, the friend of all, I bow in reverence to the same Krishna.

## \|\| 42.30 \|\|

*ityuktvā puratastasyāstasthau dharmo jagadguruḥ \|*  
*sā sādhvī taṃ ca vijñāya sahasovāca parvata \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О mountain, thus speaking Dharma the teacher of all, stood before the princess and the chaste lady also recognising him spoke.

## \|\| 42.31-33 \|\|

*padmovāca \|*  
*tvameva dharmaḥ sarveṣāṃ sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām \|*  
*sarvāṃtareṣu sarvātmā sarvajñaḥ sarvatattvavit \|\| 31 \|\|*

*kathaṃ mano me vijñātuṃ viḍaṃbayasi kiṃkarīm \|*  
*yatkṛtaṃ tvatkṛte brahmannaparādho babhūva me \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tvaṃ ca śapto mayā'jñānātstrīsvabhāvātkrudhā vibho \|*  
*kā vyavasthā bhavettasya cintayāmīti sāṃpratam \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. PadmS said – You are Dharma for all, witness of all the actions, you are the inner soul of everyone, all knowledgeable and are well-versed in all the tattvas than why did you create the situation to know the mind of and insignificant slave girl like me? It is sinful, whatever I have spoken to you. О virtuous one, I spoke all that in anger, foolishness and because of the nature of women and cursed you also. Therefore, I am bow thinking about the curse.

## \|\| 42.34-42 \|\|

*ākāśo'sau diśaḥ sarvā yadi naśyanti vāyavaḥ \|*  
*tathāpi sādhvīśāpastu na naśyati kadācana \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tvaṃ ca naṣṭo bhavasi cetsṛṣṭināśo bhavettadā \|*  
*iti kartavyatāmūḍhā tathāpi tvāṃ vadāmyaham \|\| 35 \|\|*

*satye pūrṇaścatuṣpādaiḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā śaśī \|*  
*virājase devarāja sarvakālaṃ divāniśam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*pādakṣayaśca tretāyāṃ bhagavanbhavitā tava \|*  
*pādau parau dvāpare ca tṛtīyaśca kalau vibho \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kaliśeṣe śeṣapādastavācchanno bhaviṣyati \|*  
*punaḥ satye samāyāte paripūrṇo bhaviṣyasi \|\| 38 \|\|*

*satye sarvavyāpakastvaṃ tadanyeṣu ca kutracit \|*  
*yatra sthānaṃ tavādhāro vadāmi śrūyatāṃ vibho \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vaiṣṇaveṣu ca sarveṣu yatiṣu brahmacāriṣu \|*  
*pativratāsu prājñeṣu vānaprastheṣu bhikṣuṣu \|\| 40 \|\|*

*nṛpeṣu dharmaśīleṣu satsu sadvaiśyajātiṣu \|*  
*dvijaseviṣu śūdreṣu satsaṃsargasthiteṣu ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

*eṣu tvaṃ satataṃ pūrṇo dharmarāja virājase \|*  
*yugeyuge tadādhārā yatra puṇyatamā janāḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

34-42. The sky, all the directions and the wind could be destroyed but the curse of a chaste lady could never be destroyed. And with your destruction, the entire universe would vanish. Thus thinking I am standing here thoughtlessly. In spite of that I tell you that О king of the gods in the Satyayuga, the moon will shine with the full rays having four feet and you will illumine during the day and night. But, О lord in the Tretayuga, you will be deprived of one foot. О virtuous one, during the Dvapara you will have two feet only and during Kaliyuga your three feet could be destroyed. During the time of Kali, you will have the lustre of one feet only which would the multiplied by four times during Satyayuga, О virtuous one, during the Satyayuga you would remain all-pervading but in other yugas you would pervade partially. Now I am going to spell out the place of your abode. You will remain fully present with the Vaishnavas recluses, Brahmacarls, the chaste woken, intelligent people, Vanaprasthas, yogis, the religious rulers the noble people, the noble Vaisyas the Shudras who serve with devotion, the BrShmanas, Ks atriya and Vaisyas. You will be fully present with all of them, in every yuga wherever the noble souls will reside they would become your bases.

## \|\| 42.43-44 \|\|

*aśvatthavaṭabilveṣu tulasīcaṃdaneṣu ca \|*  
*dīkṣāparīkṣāśapathagoṣṭhagoṣpadabhūmiṣu \|\| 43 \|\|*

*vivāheṣu ca puṣpeṣu vidyamāno'si śākhiṣu \|*  
*devālayeṣu tīrtheṣu satāṃ śaśvadgṛheṣu ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. You will remain present in the trees like plpala, banyan, wood-apple, Tulasi and sandal-wood. You will always remain present on these trees while receiving Dlksa, at the time of test, taking oaths cowsheds and the land for the cows, in the appropriate flowers and in trees of the gods, you will always remain present. You will also be present only in the temples, sacred places, houses of the noble people which would become your abode.

## \|\| 42.45-47 \|\|

*vedavedāṃgaśravaṇe jaleṣu ca sabhāsu ca \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaguṇanāmokta śrutigītasthaleṣu ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

*vratapūjātaponyāyayajñasākṣisthaleṣu ca \|*  
*gavāṃ gṛheṣu goṣveva vidyamāno hi paśyasi \|\| 46 \|\|*

*kṛśatā tena bhavitā dharma teṣu sthaleṣu ca \|*  
*etadanyeṣu kṛśatā yadagamyaṃ ca tacchṛṇu \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. At the time of the reciting or listening of the Vedas and the post Vedic literature, in the courts, the places were the name of Shrl Krishna and his glory are recited, while performing vratas, tapas, administering of justice, performing of yajnas and at the time of standing witness besides the abodes of cows, you would always remain present, О Dharma, In these places you would appear with full rays without any short-coming and in the places other than these, your deficiency would be visible. Now you listen to me about the places which cannot be visited by you.

## \|\| 42.48-57 \|\|

*puṃścalīṣu ca sarvāsu gṛheṣu naraghātinām \|*  
*naraghātiṣu nīceṣu mūrkheṣu ca khaleṣu ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

*devatāguruvipreṣṭapālyānāṃ dhanahāriṣu \|*  
*asannareṣu dhūrteṣu caureṣu ratibhūmiṣu \|\| 49 \|\|*

*durodarasurāpānakalahānāṃ sthaleṣu ca \|*  
*śālagrāmasādhutīrthapurāṇarahiteṣu ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

*dasyusneheṣu vādeṣu tālacchāyāsu garviṣu \|*  
*asijīvimaṣījīvidevalagrāmayājiṣu \|\| 51 \|\|*

*vṛṣavāhasvarṇakārajīvahiṃsopajīviṣu \|*  
*bhartṛniṃditanārīṣu strījiteṣu ca puṃsu ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

*dīkṣāsaṃdhyāviṣṇubhaktivihīneṣu dvijeṣu ca \|*  
*svāṃgakanyāvikrayiṣu svayoṣidvikrayeṣvatha \|\| 53 \|\|*

*śālagrāmasuragraṃthabhūmivikrayiṣu prabho \|*  
*mitradohikṛtaghneṣu satyaviśvāsaghātiṣu \|\| 54 \|\|*

*śaraṇāgatadīneṣu cāśritaghneṣu nṛṣvapi \|*  
*śaśvanmithyoktiśīleṣu tathā sīmāpahāriṣu \|\| 55 \|\|*

*kāmātkrodhāttathā lobhānmithyāsākṣipravādiṣu \|*  
*puṇyakarmavihīneṣu puṇyakarmavirodhiṣu \|\| 56 \|\|*

*sthātumeteṣu nindyeṣu nādhikārastava prabho \|*  
*mamāpi vacanaṃ satyaṃ babhūva tatkṣaṇaṃ tava \|\| 57 \|\|*

48-57. You will not be accessible to the loose-women, in the houses of the killers of human beings, the degraded people, those who steals the riches of the gods, the teacher, Brahmanas, the family gods and dependable people, those people having no character, the cheats, thieves, pleasure houses, gambling dens, the places of drinking and quarrelling. The places which are deprived of ascetics, sacred scriptures and Puranas, the places of robbers, the places of controversies, the shade of tala trees, the arrogant people, those who earn by the use of sword, while those who live with the use of ink, with the temple priests, those who performed yajnas in every village, those who plough the fields, the places of gold-smiths, those who live on the killing of animals, the places of women who denounce their husbands the man who sells away his wife or Shalagrama or image of the gods or the sacred books or sacred lands those who betray the faith of their friends, who are ungrateful, who betray the truthful person, those who kill the poor and those who arrive to take refuge with them. Those who always utter falsehood, those who cross the limits or those who give false evidence because of passion, anger and grief, the places inhabited by the persons deprived of merits and those who oppose the performing of merits, you will hot be entitled to stay in such places. О lord in case such an arrangement is made, my words would be truthful.

59-65. Dharma said – О lady you are quite graceful, you are devoted to your husband, you will always meet with welfare, you have protected me and therefore I shall grant a boon to you. You accept it. О girl, your husband would become youthful, would be well-versed in love-sport, beautiful, virtuous and will have and ever-lasting youth. О chaste lady by achieving all the riches and fortunes you would also remain ever young. О daughter, your husband would live longer than Markandeya would possessed more riches than Kubera, would have more fortunes than Indra, would be more devoted to Vishnu and would be a siddha greater than Kapila. Your husband would always enjoy fortunes through out his life. О chaste lady, you would achieve the palaces far greater than the palaces of Kubera, you would achieve ten sons who would be more virtuous and enjoy longer life than your virtuous husband. There is no doubt about it. О mountain king, thus speaking is lord Dharma kept quiet.

66\. Padma than went round him and offered her salutation to him and then left for her abode. Dharma also reverted to his abode pronouncing boon on her.

70-75. О lord of Maha-Lakshmi, after a week an auspicious time would come when the moon would reach in Lagnesa and accompanied with his son Budha. All the moon and the stars would be quite favourable and auspicious it could be Monday of Margaslrsa month. This lagna is without any blemish, all the planets favourably-look at the king and there would be no unkind planet. It would be the best time and would bestower of progeny, would provide long life to the husband, deprive of widowhood, would bestow pleasure in all the births, would never make the husband and wife to separate. This would thus be the best of the combination. At that point of time you give away four daughter who happens to be the MiilaPrakriti, Isvarl, is the form of the tejas of all the gods, adored by all the gods, mother of the universe while Mahadeva who happens to be the father of the universe and become graceful.

76\. In the earlier kalpa for the protection of the gods MiilaPrakriti had emerged out of the lustre of the gods illumining all the ten directions.

## \|\| 42.77-78 \|\|

*asyāḥ svatejasā daityāḥ keciddagdhāḥ palāyitāḥ \|*

77-78. О lord of the mountains, many of the demons were reduce to ashes with her lustre and many of them fled away in panic. Some of them were reduce to ashes over on earth and some of them fled away to neither world. Some of them fainted and some of them took refuge with, the goddess keeping a straw in their teeth.

*keciccikṣipurastrāṇi stambhitā api kecana \|*

## \|\| 42.80-82 \|\|

*niḥśatravo babhūvuste surā asyāḥ prasādataḥ \|*

*dakṣaśca vidhivaddevīṃ pradadau śūlapāṇaye \|*

80-82. By her grace the gods were rid of the enemies. The same JagadambU alter the change of kalpa, at the command of lord Krishna was born as the daughter of Daksha. Daksha, on his part gave away the daughter in marriage to Shiva the holder of trident. О mountain, thereafter in the yajna of my father there was an assembly of gods, there developed a great row between Shiva and Daksha, as a result of which Shiva offering his salutation to Brahma left this place.

## \|\| 42.83-85 \|\|

*dakṣaśca sagaṇo ruṣṭaḥ prayayau svālayaṃ tadā \|*  
*kopātsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro dakṣo yajñaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 83 \|\|*

*na dadau yajñabhāgaṃ ca mātsaryācchūlapāṇaye \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā satī prakupitā janakaṃ raktalocanā \|\| 84 \|\|*

*nirbhartsya ca bahutaraṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā \|*

83-85. Daksha also getting annoyed left the place with his attendants and reached his abode thereafter Daksha in anger collected the material for yajna and organise a great yajna. Out of jealousy, Daks a did not invite Shiva in the yajna Finding this Sati developed a great rage against her father. Her eyes became red and with a painful heart she went to the place of her fathers yajna and from there she went to her mother.

## \|\| 42.86-90 \|\|

*bhaviṣyaṃ kathayāmāsa trikālajñā parātparā \|*

*palāyanaṃ ca devānāṃ yajñasthānādgirīśvaram \|*  
*munīnāmṛtvijāṃ caiva parvatānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 87 \|\|*

*jayaṃ śaṃkarasainyānāṃ svātmano mṛtyumeva ca \|*  
*śokātparyaṭanaṃ bharturvirahāturacetasā \|\| 88 \|\|*

*nirmāṇaṃ netrarasaḥ prabodhaṃ ca janārdanāt \|*  
*mūrtibhedātpunaḥ prāptiṃ vihāraṃ tasya tatsamam \|\| 89 \|\|*

*aparaṃ bhavitavyaṃ ca sarvamuktvā jagāma sā \|*

86-90. Thereafter the all knowledgeable and the best of all the goddesses Sati spoke to her mother all the happening of the future in which the destruction of the yajna the insult of her father and the running away of all the gods towards Himalaya the fleeing of the sages and the performers of the yajna, besides the mountains, the victory of the garias of Shiva, her own death and the wandering of Shiva infested with the grief of the separation of his wife-in all the directions forming of a lake with the tears flowing from the eyes of Shiva the consoling of Shiva by Janardana and his composing himself, her own rebirth in the abode of Himalaya and marriage with Shiva. Thus she narrated everything to her mother. Thereafter, Sati with a painful heart left the place in spite of being dissuaded to do so by her sisters.

## \|\| 42.91-97 \|\|

*babhūvādarśanā yogātsarvāsāṃ siddhiyoginī \|*  
*gatvā sā jāhnavītīraṃ smṛtvā saṃpūjya śaṃkaram \|\| 91 \|\|*

*smṛtvā taccaraṇāmbhojaṃ dehaṃ tatyāja sundarī \|*  
*gandhamādanadroṇīsthaṃ śarīraṃ praviveśa ha \|\| 92 \|\|*

*saṃjahāra purā yena daityānāmakhilaṃ kulam \|*  
*hāhākāraṃ pracakruśca surāḥ sarve'tivismitāḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*jagmuḥ śaṃkarasenāśca deśayajñaṃ vinaśya ca \|*  
*parābhavaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kṛtvā śokāturāḥ parāḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*satvaraṃ sarvavṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsurīśvaram \|*  
*śrutvā pravṛttiṃ saṃhartā sarvarudragaṇairvṛtaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*mūrcchā saṃprāpa śokena jñānānandaḥ parātyaraḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya samutthāya trilocanaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

*jagāma svarṇadītīraṃ yatra devīkalevaram \|\| 97 \|\|*

91-97. She was a Siddhayoginl and with the application of the yogic practices, she disappeared from the sight of everyone, she went to the bank of the Ganga and devoting her mind at the feet of Shiva and adoring him, she concentrated her mind at the feet of Shiva and then ended her life. After shedding the body of Sati she entered in the cave of Gandhamadana mountain and entered the divine form in the cave, She in fact entered the same divine form by which she had killed the demons in earlier times, All the gods were completely surprised at the sight and started crying in panic. The army of Shiva arrived in the abode of Daksha and destroyed the yajna of Daksha. Getting filled with grief, they rushed back to Shiva and conveyed the news to him. On hearing this, Shiva went to the bank of the Ganga and found the body of Parvati lying there.

## Chapter 43

## \|\| 43.1-3 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*atha durgāṃ mahādevassatīmūrtiṃ manoharām \|*  
*amlānapadmavaktrāṃ tāṃ śayānāṃ jāhnavītaṭe \|\| 1 \|\|*

*dadhatīmakṣamālāṃ ca prataptakāñcanaprabhām \|*  
*tejasā prajvalantīṃ ca dadhānāṃ śuklavāsasam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā satīśarīraṃ ca pradagdho virahāgninā \|*  
*tattvarāśirmūrtimāṃśca mūrcchāṃ prāpa tathāpi ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narayana said – on looking at the body of Parvati Mahadeva which looked as sleeping, the lustre of whose face was still illumining and had not faded out. She was clad in white garment, holding a rosary in her hand, was illumining with the divine lustre and the charming rays of her body which looked like the molten gold were spreading everywhere. At the sight of the image Shiva's mind started burning with separation. Though he happened to be well-versed in all the tattvas, still he fainted and fell down on the ground.

## \|\| 43.4 \|\|

*kalatraśoko balavānsvātmārāmaṃ parātparam \|*  
*bādhate vedabījaṃ taṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Shiva who had been valorous, felt painful with the separation of his wife. He is the one who always roams about is the best among the best, the seed of the Vedas, the teacher of the yogic practices, he also felt painful with the death of Sati.

## \|\| 43.5 \|\|

*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya tāmuvāca trilocanaḥ \|*  
*nirīkṣya vadanāmbhojaṃ sthāṇuḥ sthāṇurivāparaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After regaining consciousness, immovable Shiva looked like the fallen trunk of the tree. Looking at the lotus-like face of Sati he spoke.

## \|\| 43.6 \|\|

*sāśrunetro'tidīnaśca dīnānāṃ śaraṇapradaḥ \|*  
*dīnadainyāpahārī ca vilalāpa paraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. At that point of time his eyes were filled with tears. Though he happens to be the refuge of down-trodden and removes the miseries of the miserable people, still his condition became miserable and he started lamenting.

## \|\| 43.7 \|\|

*śaṃkara uvāca \|*  
*uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha subhage sati prāṇeśvari priye \|*  
*śaṅkaro'haṃ tava svāmī paśya māṃ nikaṭāgatam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Shiva said – О beautiful one, О chaste lady of my life, get up I happen to be Shiva, your husband. You look at me since I have come to you.

## \|\| 43.8 \|\|

*śivaṃ śivapradaṃ sarvasaṃpadrūpaṃ ca siddhidam \|*  
*sarvātmānaṃ ca sarveśaṃ śavatulyaṃ tvayā vinā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Though I possess the form of welfare, bestow welfare and the form of all the riches, bestow success, the soul all and the lord of all but in spite of that I happen to be like a dead body without you.

## \|\| 43.9 \|\|

*śakto'haṃ ca tvayā sārddhaṃ sarvaśaktisvarūpayā \|*  
*śaktihīnaḥ śavasamo niśceṣṭaḥ sarvakarmasu \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. You possess all the prowess, I become competent only when you are with me. Without you I loose my sakti and become still in all the performance.

## \|\| 43.10 \|\|

*yaśca śaktiṃ na jānāti jñānahīnaśca nindati \|*  
*taṃ tyaktumucitaṃ vijñe kathaṃ māṃ tyajasi priye \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О dear, you possess the special knowledge, the one who is not aware of the importance of sakti, such a person devoid of knowledge and denounce her. It is not proper for you to leave me. But why are you disowning me?

## \|\| 43.11 \|\|

*svayaṃ brahmā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ sādhyabhūtā vayaṃ tava \|*  
*sasmitaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ ca vada kiṃcitsudhopamam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Myself Brahma and Vishnu adore you always. Now you speak smilingly nectar-like words casting side glances.

## \|\| 43.12-13 \|\|

*madhurābhāsadṛṣṭyā ca māṃ dagdhaṃ secanaṃ kuru \|*  
*māṃ dṛṣṭvā dūrataḥ śīghraṃ snigdhaṃ vadasi sasmitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kathamadyāpi ruṣṭeva vilapantaṃ na bhāṣase \|*

12-13. You supply water to the like the rain water who has been burnt out by your separation, you always smiled at me looking from a distance and talked to me lovingly, why are you so much annoyed with me and are not talking to me when I am so lamenting. О lady of my life, get up why don't you look at me.

## \|\| 43.14-15 \|\|

*parityajya ca naḥ prāṇāngantuṃ nārhasi sundari \|*  
*jagadambe samuttiṣṭha prāṇādhāre parātpare \|\| 14 \|\|*

*pativrate samuttiṣṭha kathaṃ māṃ nādya sevase \|*  
*kathaṃ karoṣi vijñāya vratabhaṅgaṃ śrutiprasūḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. О beautiful one it is not proper for you to leave me after death like this. О best lady of my life you are beyond everyone, О mother of the universe, get up. О chaste damsel, why don't you serve me today? You are the mother of the Vedas. What is all this being done by you breaking the vratdl.

## \|\| 43.16-17 \|\|

*ityuktvā mṛtadehaṃ ca priyāyā virahāturaḥ \|*

16-17. Thus speaking Shiva infested with the separation of Sati, lifted up the body of his beloved and embraced her, kissing at again and again. He placed his lips over her lips and the chest over her breasts. Thus he embraced her again and again while lamenting.

## \|\| 43.18-19 \|\|

*punaḥ sa cetanāṃ prāpya vegādutthāya śokataḥ \|*

*saptadvīpasaptasindhuṃ lokālokaṃ ca kāñcanam \|*

18-19. After regaining consciousness, he got up with force infatuated with grief. Inspire of his being the teacher of the intellectuals, he started wandering like an intoxicated person. Carrying the body of Sati, he wandered in the seven islands, seven oceans various countries and mountains. He started wandering in the fallacy.

## \|\| 43.20 \|\|

*śataśṛṅgagireḥ pārśve jambudvīpe ca bhārate \|*

20\. While so wandering he went at Satasrngagiri in Bharata in Jambudvipa, Aksayavata, in the deserted land on the bank of Ganga.

## \|\| 43.21-23 \|\|

*rurodoccaiḥ svayaṃ kṛtvā sati sādhvītyudīrya ca \|*  
*trinetranetranīreṇa saṃbabhūva sarovaram \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tannetraṃ ca saro nāma munīnāṃ tapasaḥ sthalam \|*

21-23. Не started crying, "О Sati, О chaste women". Thus crying he started shouting loudly. At that point of time the tears flowing from the eyes of Shiva were turned into a lake which was given the name of Netrasara. In due course of time it became the place for performing tapas by the sages. This auspicious and holy place was spread over an area of two yojanas. О mountain, while taking a bath in that sacred place, the humans do not have to be reborn. Having a dip into that water all the sins of the people disappear.

## \|\| 43.24 \|\|

*tyaktvā tāṃ mānavīṃ mūrtiṃ narā yānti hareḥ padam \|*

24\. Discarding the human body, the people achieve the place of Vispu. Then stopping crying he again started wandering on the earth.

## \|\| 43.25-27 \|\|

*pūrṇamabdaṃ mahāyogī virahāturamānasaḥ \|*  
*satīgalitapratyaṅgairaṃgaiśca parvateśvara \|\| 25 \|\|*

*babhūva siddhapīṭhānāṃ samūho vāñchitapradaḥ \|*

25-27. Shiva the great yogi was badly infested with separation and for a full one year he kept on wandering. Thereafter, Shiva cremating the remaining parts of the body of Sati, prepared a garland of her bones and wore it around his neck. The ashes of the body of Sati were applied by Shiva on his body.

## \|\| 43.28-33 \|\|
