*samūṣurīśasadasi lakṣmīkānta praṇamya te \|*  
*śrīhariḥ śaṅkaramaho kṛtvā vakṣasi mūrcchitam \|*  
*rudantaṃ bodhayāmāsa jñānīśo jñānināṃ gurum \|\| 33 \|\|*

28-33. Then reciting the name of Sati the lady of his life, Shiva again fainted. The one who was always roaming in his own soul, even forgot Brahman. Thus the one who fulfilled the desires of others became lifeless with the grief of the separation of Sati and was seated tmder the banyan tree. He was lying there unconsciousness and finding him in that condition, all the gods were surprised. All of them than went to Shiva Lord Narayana also accompanied with his attendants reached at the place. His feet were adorned by Kamala with the ornaments of gems. He was wearing a pltdmbara had four arms, wore a smile on his face, was delightful and adorned with long garland of forest flowers. Dharma accompanied by gods and the sages arrived there and bowed in reverence to the lord of Lakshmi. All of them were seated in an assembly there. Thereafter lord Hari took Shiva in his lap, who happen to be the teacher of the intellectuals and was crying. He than started consoling him.

## \|\| 43.34 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*svātmārāma nibodhedaṃ madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The lord said – О lord, you are the one who roams about in his own soul, you listen to my words which are beneficial, divine, essence of the Vedas and destroy the grief.

## \|\| 43.35-37 \|\|

*hitamadhyātmasāraṃ ca duḥkhaśokanikṛntanam \|*  
*sarvādhyātmavidyamānabījaṃ jñānanidhiṃ vidhim \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tathāpi bodhayāmi tvāṃ sarvajñaṃ vedhaso vidhim \|*  
*budhaṃ bodhayituṃ śakto'budho'pi prāṇasaṃkaṭe \|\| 36 \|\|*

*vyavahāro'sti lokeṣu sarvaḥ sarvaparasparam \|*  
*māyāśritā guṇāḥ sarve hetavaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. Though you yourself happen to be the seed of the divine knowledge, possess supreme knowledge, are all knowledgeable and happen to be the creator of the creators, still I am imparting you the divine knowledge. When the life is in danger, even and unwise parson can render advise to a learned person. This is the tradition that the people try to convince one and other at appropriate time. All the virtues are controlled by May2 which result into the pleasure and the pain for the humans. Therefore the powerful illusion of Vishnu causes more pain to the virtuous person.

## \|\| 43.38-39 \|\|

*viṣṇumāyā balavatī guṇayuktaṃ prabādhate \|*  
*duḥkhaṃ śokaṃ bhayaṃ śaṃbho durdine bhavatīśvara \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tatrātīte kutastāni sudine ca samāgate \|*  
*harṣa aiśvaryadarpaśca saṃtataṃ tatra varddhate \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. О Sambhu, О Isvara, during the bad times one has to face pain, grief and fear. When the bad time is over and the good time arrives everything could be achieved. During that time the pleasure and fortunes go on increasing. Therefore the intellectuals considered it to be like a dream.

## \|\| 43.40 \|\|

*sarvāṇyetāni gaṇyante svapnānīva vipaścitaḥ \|*  
*jñānaṃ labha mahādeva jñānabīja sanātana \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О Mahadeva, you receive the knowledge. You are the seed of the knowledge and are eternal. Regain your consciousness. You will meet with welfare. You will surely get back Sati.

## \|\| 43.41-42 \|\|

*cetanāṃ kuru bhadraṃ te satīṃ prāpsyasi niścitam \|*  
*tattoyaṃ śītatā nityaṃ nāgniṃ muñcati dāhikā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tejaḥ sūryaṃ mahīṃ gandho tathā tvāṃ ca satī śiva \|*  
*śailetyevaṃ samākarṇya hariṃ kiṃciduvāca ha \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. O Shiva as the coolness never leaves the waters the power of burning never leaves the fire, the lustre never leaves the sun, the fragrance never leaves the earth, similarly Sati cannot be separated from you. О mountain, on hearing this Shiva opened his eyes and looking at Hari he spoke. Whatever he spoke to him, you listen from me.

## \|\| 43.43-44 \|\|

*netrāṇyunmīlanaṃ kṛtvā trinetraḥ śrūyatāmiti \|*  
*trinetra uvāca \|*  
*kastvaṃ tejaḥsvarūpo'si ka ime tava sannidhau \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kinnāma bhavataścaiṣāṃ kāni nāmāni kā satī \|*  
*ko'haṃ ko me bhavānbrūte kiṃkarāḥ kuta āgatāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. Shiva said – О form of lustre, who are you? Who are all the people surrounding you? What is Sati? Who am I? Who are you all talking with me where are these attendants going? You please tell me.

## \|\| 43.45-48 \|\|

*kva yāsyasi kva yāsyāmi kva gacchanta ime vada \|*  
*harirityevamākarṇya ruroda sagaṇo gire \|\| 45 \|\|*

*netranīraistrinetraṃ taṃ rudantaṃ prasiṣeca saḥ \|*  
*haritrinetrayornetranīrapātena tatra vai \|\| 46 \|\|*

*babhūva sarasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tīrthaṃ bhuvanapāvanam \|*  
*bhārate'stagireḥ paścāttatrākṣayavaṭāṃtike \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sthalaṃ babhūva tapasāṃ muktibījaṃ tapasvinām \|*  
*athovāca punaḥ śīghramādhyātmaṃ ca haraṃ hariḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

45-48. O mountain, on hearing this Hari started robbing with his attendants. He made Shiva to bathe with his tears. With the combination of the tears of Shiva and Narayana, a pleasant lake was formed which was known by the name of Bhuvanapavana-Tlrtha. It is located in the land of Bharata, beyond the Astacala-mountain, close to the Aksayata tree which is a sacred place and provides salvation to the ascetics for performing tapas there. Thereafter Hari spoke in the presence of the gods and the chaste sages to Shiva, the words which were quite divine in nature.

## \|\| 43.49-52 \|\|

*śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ munīnāmūrdhvaretasām \|*  
*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu śaṃkara vakṣyāmi jñānānaṃda sanātana \|\| 49 \|\|*

*jñānaṃ jñānanidhe śokādvismṛto'si parātpara \|*  
*sudinaṃ durdinaṃ śaśvadbhavatyeva bhave bhave \|\| 50 \|\|*

*sarveṣāṃ prākṛtānāṃ ca te bīje sukhaduḥkhayoḥ \|*  
*sukhādbhavati harṣaśca darpaḥ śauryapramattatā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*rāga aiśvaryakāmaśca vidveṣaśca nirantaram \|*  
*duḥkhācchokātsamudvegādbhayaṃ nityaṃ pravartate \|\| 52 \|\|*

49-52. The lord said – О Shiva you are knowledgeable and blissful beside being eternal. You listen to me whatever I speak. О ocean of knowledge, you and the one who is beyond everything, you have forgotten the divine knowledge and are infested in grief. The good and bad days come and go during every one is life, they happen to be the cause of pleasure and pain for the people. One gets delighted with his pleasure and arrogance, prowess and pride, love and the desire for possession, jealousy, always appear on earth. One gets only feels because of the pain, grief and anger.

## \|\| 43.53 \|\|

*hatānyetāni sarvāṇi hate bīje maheśvara \|*  
*sudinaṃ durdinaṃ caiva sarvakarmodbhavaṃ bhava \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. О Maheshvara, with the destruction of the seed all these get automatically destroyed. О Shiva the good days and bad days are achieved because of the past deeds.

## \|\| 43.54 \|\|

*tatkarma tapasā sādhyaṃ karmaṇā ca śubhāśubham \|*  
*tapaḥ svabhāvasādhyaṃ ca svabhāvo'bhyāsato bhavet \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The actions are successful by tapas and one gets the good and bad reward because of his own actions. The tapas can be attained by nature and the nature is the result of the constant practice.

## \|\| 43.55-57 \|\|

*saṃsargasādhyo 'dhyāsaśca saṃsargaḥ puṇyato bhavet \|*  
*puṇyabījaṃ manaścaiva pāpabījaṃ ca caṃcalam \|\| 55\|\|*

*manaḥ śaṃbho mamāṃśaśca sarveṃdriyapuraḥsaram \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ janako'haṃ ca cittvaṃ brahmā patistvayam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*brahraikaṃ mūrtibhedastu guṇabhedena saṃtatam \|*  
*tadbrahma vividhaṃ vastu saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ śiva \|\| 57 \|\|*

55-57. The practice is achieved by noble company and while coming across with noble people, one achieves the merits. The unstable mind is the cause of merit or the sin. О Sambhu, the mind as well as all the organ of senses or my amshas, you are the creator of all and you happen to be the supreme knowledge and Brahma is the lord of intelligence. The eternal Brahman and the great soul are one. Because of the difference in qualities, they achieved different forms. The Brahmatattva happens to be the one but appears in various forms. О Shiva, it is with qualities and without qualities as well.

## \|\| 43.58 \|\|

*māyāśrito yaḥ saguṇo māyā'tītaśca nirguṇaḥ \|*  
*svecchāmayaśca bhagavānicchayā vikaroti ca \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. The one who takes shelter under the illusion is called Saguna and the one who is devoid of illusion is called Nirguna. The lord always moves at will he appears of his own will in various form.

## \|\| 43.59-64 \|\|

*icchāśaktiśca prakṛtirnityā sarvaprasūḥ sadā \|*  
*kecidekaṃ vadaṃtyeva brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*kecidvadanti dvividhaṃ brahma prakṛtipūrvakam \|*  
*śṛṇu ye ca vadantyekaṃ māyāpuruṣayoḥ param \|\| 60 \|\|*

*tasmādbhavati tau dvau ca tadbrahma sarvakāraṇam \|*  
*atha caikaṃ paraṃ brahma dvividhaṃ bhavatīcchayā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*icchāśaktiśca prakṛtiḥ sarvaśaktiprasūḥ \|sadā \|*  
*tatrāśaktaśca saguṇaḥ sarvādhāraḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*sarveśvaraḥ sarvasākṣī sarvatrāsti phalapradaḥ \|*  
*śarīraṃ dvividhaṃ śaṃbho nityaṃ prākṛtameva ca \|\| 63 \|\|*

*nityaṃ vināśarahitaṃ naśvaraṃ prākṛtaṃ sadā \|*  
*ahaṃ tvaṃ cāpi bhagavānnāvayornityavigrahaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

59-64. His will-power is given the name of Prakriti which is eternal and is the creator of all. All the people describe the eternal Brahman in the form of lustre, but some other intellectuals taking him to be associated with Prakriti call him Dvividha. Those who call him one, you listen to their argument. Brahma, Maya and Jlvatama is beyond both. Both of them (Maya and Jlvatama) emerged from the Brahman. Therefore Brahman happens to be the cause of all, the same Brahman in spite of his being one, by his own will is divided into two. His will power is described as Prakriti who happens to be the mother of all the shaktis. Because of the combination of all, the same great soul is described as Saguna. Indeed it happens to be the foundation of all, being eternal, the lord of all, the witness of all and the one who bestows the reward to all. О Sambhu, the body also is of two types, one is eternal and other is Prakrta.

## \|\| 43.65-66 \|\|

*āvayoraṃśabhūtā ye prākṛtā naṣṭavigrahāḥ \|*  
*rudrādayastvadaṃśāśca madaṃśā viṣṇurūpiṇaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*mamāpyevaṃ dvidhā rūpaṃ dvibhujaṃ ca caturbhujam \|*  
*caturbhujo'haṃ vaikuṇṭhe padmayā pārṣadaiḥ saha \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. The eternal body never perishes but the Prakrta body is perishable. О lord, the bodies of both of us are eternal. Such of the creatures who are our amshas or born out of the Trigunatmikd Prakriti and therefore they are called Prakrta. The Prakrta body is always perishable. Rudra and all other happen to be your amshas and those who are in the form of Vishnu happen to be my amsha.

## \|\| 43.67-69 \|\|

*goloke dvibhujo'haṃ ca gopībhiḥ saha rādhayā \|*  
*dvividhaṃ ye vadantyevaṃ dvau pradhānau tu tanmate \|\| 67 \|\|*

*puruṣaśca sadā nityo nityā prakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*sadā tau dvau ca saṃśliṣṭau sarveṣāṃ pitarau śiva \|\| 68 \|\|*

*saśarīrau niḥśarīrau svecchayā sarvarūpiṇau \|*  
*prādhānyaṃ ca yathā puṃsaḥ prakṛteśca sadā tathā \|\| 69 \|\|*

67-69. I have two forms one having two arms and other having four arms. In my four-aimed form I live in Vaikuntha with Lakshmi and other courtiers. In my two-armed form I am known by the name of Krishna and reside in Goloka together with the cowherdesses and Radha. Such of the people who consider Brahma Dvividha, there are two main tattvas according to their opinion which include eternal Purusa and eternal Prakri) Isvari. О Shiva, both of them are united together and they happen to be the parents of all.

## \|\| 43.70-72 \|\|

*satīmicchasi cecchambho prakṛteḥ stavanaṃ kuru \|*  
*yatstotraṃ ca tvayā dattaṃ purā durvāsase mudā \|\| 70 \|\|*

*taddivyaṃ kaṇvaśākhoktaṃ bhaja tena jagatprasūm \|*  
*śokanāśo bhavatu te śivaṃ śiva mamāśiṣā \|\| 71 \|\|*

*dūraṃ viplavahetuśca yātu strīvirahajvaraḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktvā lakṣmīśo virarāma girīśvaram \|\| 72 \|\|*

70-72. Both of them take to definite form or remain formless according to their will, both of them have the form of all. As the Purusa has the eternal importance, similarly the Prakriti also enjoys the same position О Shiva, if you intend to achieve Sati then adore Prakriti. In the earlier times, whatever stotra you had delightfully given to Durvasa, it is indeed divine and has been described in the Kanvasakha. You adore the mother of the universe with that stotra. О Shiva with my blessings you will get rid of the grief.

## \|\| 43.73-74 \|\|

*stavanaṃ kartumārebhe prakṛteśca maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*snātvā natvā ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ brahmāṇaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*maheśvara uvāca \|*  
*oṃ namaḥ prakṛtyai mantraḥ \|*  
*brāhmi brahmasvarūpe tvaṃ māṃ prasīda sanātani \|*  
*paramātmasvarūpe ca paramānandarūpiṇi \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. Your welfare would increase and you will be deprived of the ocean of the grief caused by the separation of your wife from you very soon. О king of the mountains, thus speaking lord Vishnu, the husband of Kamala, kept quiet and lord Shiva started adoring Prakriti at the same time. He took his bath and with his mind filled with devotion and overwhelmed he bowed in reverence to Krishna and Brahma.

## \|\| 43.75 \|\|

*bhadre bhadraprade durge durgaghne durganāśini \|*  
*potasvarūpe jīrṇe tvaṃ māṃ prasīda bhavārṇave \|\| 75\|\|*

75\. Maheshvara said – I bow in reverence to Prakriti. О Brahmi, you are the from of Brahman and are eternal, be pleased with me. You are the form of great soul and extremely blissful. О Durga, you are the form of welfare, provide welfare and are the destroyer of the demons Durga, besides removing all the dangers. You happen to be the boat for crossing the ocean of the universe. Be pleased with me.

## \|\| 43.76 \|\|

*sarvasvarūpe sarveśi sarvabījasvarūpiṇi \|*  
*sarvādhāre sarvavidye māṃ prasīda jayaprade \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. O form of all, the goddess of all, the form of all the seeds, the foundation of all, the knowledge of all and bestower of victory be pleased with me.

## \|\| 43.77-79 \|\|

*sarvamaṅgalarūpe ca sarvamaṅgaladāyini \|*  
*samastamaṅgalādhāre prasīda sarvamaṅgale \|\| 77 \|\|*

*nidre tandre kṣame śraddhe tuṣṭipuṣṭisvarūpiṇi \|*  
*lajje medhe buddhirūpe prasīda bhaktavatsale \|\| 78 \|\|*

*vedasvarūpe vedānāṃ kāraṇe vedadāyini \|*  
*sarvavedāṅgarūpe ca vedamātaḥ prasīda me \|\| 79 \|\|*

77-79. О Sarvamangala, you are the form of welfare, bestow welfare and are the base of all the welfares, be pleased with me. О grace of the devotees, you are sleep drowsiness, you are forgiveness, faith, satisfaction, the preserver, shyness, illustrious and the form of intelligence, be places with me. You are the creator of the Vedas, the form of Vedas, the cause of the Vedas, bestower of the Vedas and the form of all the Vedic literature, be pleased with me.

## \|\| 43.80-81 \|\|

*daye jaye mahāmāye prasīda jagadambike \|*  
*kṣānte śānte ca sarvānte kṣutpipāsāsvarūpiṇi \|\| 80 \|\|*

*lakṣmīrnārāyaṇakroḍe sraṣṭurvakṣasi bhārati \|*  
*mama kroḍe mahāmāye viṣṇumāye prasīda me \|\| 81 \|\|*

80-81. О mother of the universe, you are merciful, victory, Mahamaya, patience, peace, the destroyer of all and the form of hunger and thirst. You be pleased with me. О Illusion of Vishnu, you are Lakshmi in the lap of Narayana, Bharati with Brahma and Mahamaya in my lap. Be pleased with me.

## \|\| 43.82-83 \|\|

*kalākāṣṭhāsvarūpe ca divārātrisvarūpiṇi \|*  
*pariṇāmaprade devi prasīda dīnavatsale \|\| 82 \|\|*

*kāraṇe sarvaśaktīnāṃ kṛṣṇasyorasi rādhike \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhike bhadre prasīda kṛṣṇapūjite \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. О lover of the down-trodden, you are the form of all the directions day and night and bestow the reward for the deeds performed by people, you be happy with me. You are the cause of all the saktis, you are Radha in the heart of Shri Krishna and dearer to him than his own life. You are adored by Krishna. О virtuous one, be pleased with me.

## \|\| 43.84-86 \|\|

*yaśaḥsvarūpe yaśasāṃ kāraṇe ca yaśaḥprade \|*  
*sarvadevīsvarūpe ca nārīrūpavidhāyini \|\| 84 \|\|*

*samastakāminīrūpe kalāṃśena prasīda me \|*  
*sarvasaṃpatsvarūpe ca sarvasaṃpatprade śubhe \|\| 85 \|\|*

*prasīda paramānande kāraṇe sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*yaśasvināṃ pūjite ca prasīda yaśasāṃ nidhe \|\| 86 \|\|*

84-86. You are the form of glory, the cause of glory, bestower of glory and the form of all the goddesses. You created the form of women and with your rays you take to the form of damsels. Be pleased with me. You are the form of all the treasures, bestower of all the riches, quite auspicious, extremely blissful and bestower of all the riches and also are the cause for the same. You are adored by all the women you are the treasure of all the glories, be happy with me.

## \|\| 43.87 \|\|

*ādhāre sarvajagatāṃ ratnādhāre vasundhare \|*  
*carācarasvarūpe ca prasīda mama mā ciram \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. You are the base of the entire earth and the diamonds, known as Vasundhara. You have the form of moveable and immovable. You be pleased with me without delay.

## \|\| 43.88 \|\|

*yogasvarūpe yogīśe yogade yogakāraṇe \|*  
*yogādhiṣṭhātri devīśe prasīda siddhayogini \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. O Siddhayoginl, you are the form of yoga, the goddess of yoga, the bestower of yoga, the cause of all the yoga and the great goddess of yoga besides being the great goddess of all the goddesses. By pleased with me.

## \|\| 43.89 \|\|

*sarvasiddhisvarūpe ca sarvasiddhipradāyini \|*  
*kāraṇe sarva siddhīnāṃ siddheśvari prasīda me \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. O Siddheshvari, you are the form of all success, bestow success, you are the cause of all the success, be happy with me.

## \|\| 43.90 \|\|

*vyākhyānaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ matabhede maheśvari \|*  
*jñāne yaduktaṃ tatsarvaṃ kṣamasva parameśvari \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. О Maheshvari, you happen to be the commentary of all the religious scriptures. You are Parmeshvari in the form of knowledge. In case I have spoken anything undesirable, I beg to be forgiven to the same.

## \|\| 43.91 \|\|

*kecidvadanti prakṛteḥ prādhānyaṃ puruṣasya ca \|*  
*kecittatra matadvaidhe vyākhyābhedaṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Some people consider Prakriti to be the biggest force and some of them describe Purusa to be like that. Some of the intellectuals consider that the two theory emerged from the difference in the descriptive details.

## \|\| 43.92-93 \|\|

*mahāviṣṇornābhideśe sthitaṃ taṃ kamalodbhavam \|*  
*madhukaiṭabhau mahādaityau līlayā haṃtumudyatau \|\| 92 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā stutiṃ prakurvantaṃ brahmāṇaṃ rakṣituṃ purā \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa govindaṃ vināśahetave tayoḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

92-93. In the earlier times Brahma who was seated on the lotus which had emerged out of the navel of Vishnu and the demon named Madhu and Kait abha got ready to kill him. At that point of time Brahma adored you seeking protection from the demon and in order to save Brahma you woke up Narayana from his sleep.

## \|\| 43.94-95 \|\|

*nārāyaṇastvadbhaktyā ca jaghāna tau mahāsurau \|*  
*sarveśvarastvayā sārddhamanīśo'yaṃ tvayā vinā \|\| 94 \|\|*

*purā tripurasaṃgrāme gaganātpatite mayi \|*  
*tvayā ca viṣṇunā sārddhaṃ rakṣito'haṃ sureśvari \|\| 95 \|\|*

94-95. Thereafter, Narayana with the help of your shakti killed both the demons. With your co-operation he is known as the lord of all and without you he feels helpless. О greet goddess, protect me.

## \|\| 43.96 \|\|

*adhunā rakṣa māmīśe pradagdhaṃ virahāgninā \|*  
*svātmadarśanapuṇyena krīṇīhi parameśvari \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. О Isvarl presently I am burning in the the A separation from you. You protect me. и Parmeshvari you purchase me by paying the price of appearing before me.

## \|\| 43.97-99 \|\|

*ityuktvā virataḥ śaṃbhurdadarśa gaganasthitām \|*  
*ratnasārarathasthāṃ tāṃ devīṃ śatabhujāṃ mudā \|\| 97 \|\|*

*taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ jagatāṃ mātaraṃ satīm \|\| 98 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ virahāsaktaḥ punastuṣṭāva satvaram \|*  
*duḥkhaṃ nivedayāmāsa prarudanvirahodbhavam \|\| 99 \|\|*

97-99. After thus speaking Shiva kept quiet. He than looked towards the sky and found the goddess Prakriti present there. She was mounted on a chariot of gems, having hundred arms, with a delightful face, having the lustre of the molten gold, adorned with the gem-studded ornaments wearing a serene smile on the delightful face. She was mother of the universe in the form of Sati. Shiva who was suffering because of the separation again started offering prayer to her while sobbing and spoke to her the about pain of his separation.

## \|\| 43.100 \|\|

*darśayāmāsāsthimālāṃ svāṃgasthaṃ bhasmabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*kṛtvā bahu parīhāraṃ toṣayāmāsa suṃdarīm \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. He displayed the garland of bones worn by him and also the ashes applied by him on his body and satisfied the beautiful Sati.

## \|\| 43.101 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaśca brahmā ca dharmaḥ śeṣaḥ surarṣayaḥ \|*  
*śivaṃ rakṣeśvarītyuktvā tuṣṭuvuste sanātanīm \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. At that point of time Narayana, Dharma, Brahma, Shesha, the gods and the sages spoke, "O Ishvari protect Shiva". Thus speaking they offered prayer to the goddess.

## \|\| 43.102 \|\|

*babhūva parituṣṭā sā teṣāṃ stotreṇa tatkṣaṇam \|*  
*uvāca kṛpayā śaṃbhuṃ prāṇeśaṃ prāṇavallabhā \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. With the reciting of the stotra, by all of them, she was at once pleased and she spoke to Shiva who was dearer to her than her life.

## \|\| 43.103-104 \|\|

*prakṛtiruvāca \|*  
*sthiro bhava mahādeva prāṇādhika mama prabho \|*  
*bhavānātmā ca yogīśaḥ svāmī janmani janmani \|\| 103 \|\|*

*ahaṃ śailendrakāminyāṃ labdhvā janma maheśvara \|*  
*tava patnī bhaviṣyāmi muñca tvaṃ virahajvaram \|\| 104 \|\|*

103-104. Prakriti said – О Mahadeva, you keep patience. О lord you are dearer to me than my life. О Yoglsvara, you are my soul and my lord in every birth. О Maheshvara, I would be born from the womb of Mena the wife of Himalaya the king of the mountains and shall become your wife. Therefore you shed away the grief of my separation.

## \|\| 43.105 \|\|

*ityuktvā śivamāśvāsya cāṃtardhānaṃ cakāra sā \|*  
*surā jagmustamāśvāsya lajjānamrātmakandharam \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. Thus speaking assuring Shiva, the goddess disappeared. Thereafter, the gods bowing in shame before Shiva assured him variously and left for their respective abodes.

## \|\| 43.106 \|\|

*harṣāntarātmā giriśaḥ kailāsaṃ tu jagāma ha \|*  
*nanarta sagaṇastūrṇaṃ saṃtyajya virahajvaram \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Shiva than left for the Kailasa mountain and freeing himself from the flames of separation, he started dancing with his ganas.

## \|\| 43.107 \|\|

*idaṃ śivakṛtaṃ stotraṃ prakṛtyā yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*na bhavetkāminībhedastasya janmani janmani \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Whosoever recites this stotra of Prakriti, composed by Shiva, would never have to face separation from his wife in any birth.

## \|\| 43.108 \|\|

*ihaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā sa yāti śivamandiram \|*  
*dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. After enjoying all the worldly pleasures during the present life he would achieve the abode of Shiva and enjoys dharma, artha, kama and moksa, there is no doubt about it.

*. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*

*saṃskāraṃ kārayāmāsuḥ pārvatīṃ parvatastriyaḥ \|*

11\. She wives of the king of mountain initiated Parvati who after taking bath was clad in two divine garment.

## \|\| 44.12 \|\|

*kārayitvā suveṣāṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāma \|*

*daduścālaktakaṃ cāru pādāṃguliṣu pādayoḥ \|*

## \|\| 44.15 \|\|

## \|\| 44.17 \|\|

*prāṅgaṇaṃ kārayāmāsa rambhāstambhaiḥ samanvitam \|*

17\. The court-yard was decorated with the trunk of banana trees over which the silken cords were coiled together with the leaves of mango trees.

## \|\| 44.18-20 \|\|

*phalapallavasaṃyuktaiḥ kalaśairjalasaṃyutaiḥ \|*

*mālatīmālyasaṃyuktaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ sumanoharam \|*

18-20. The court-yard was decorated with fruits, tree leaves, pitchers filled with water, sandal-paste, aguru, kasturi and beautiful flowers beside the garland of jasmine flowers. Finding the gods having arrived there Himalaya bowed in reverence to them and he commanded his attendants to provide gem-studded thrones to all of them. Lord Narayana reached there together with all his attendants.

## \|\| 44.21-23 \|\|

*vinatānandanāttūrṇamavaruhya caturbhujaḥ \|*

*ratnamuṣṭinibaddhaiśca sevitaḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*ṛṣiśreṣṭhaiḥ suraśreṣṭhaiḥ stūyamānaśca saṃsadi \|\| 22 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyo bhaktānugrahakātaraḥ \|*  
*uvāsa ca tadabhyāśe brahmā devagaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. Не descended from the back of Garuda the son of Vinata and the four armed Narayana got himself seated on the gem-studded lion throne. The four-anned attendants of lord Vishnu adorned with gem-studded ornaments holding the fly-whisks with gem-studded handed were moving the fly-whisk over Vishnu. The assembly consisted her the best of sages, the best of gods, who were adoring Vishnu. Lord Vishnu had delightful face, wearing the serene smile and looked like getting anxious to shower his grace on the devotees. Brahma the creator of the universe accompanied by other gods took his seat besides Vishnu.

## \|\| 44.24-25 \|\|

*ṛṣayo munayaścaiva samūṣurmaṅgale sthale \|*  
*etasminnantare śambhuravaruhya rathādaho \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ratnāsane samuttiṣṭhandadarśa parvatālayam \|*  
*samājagmuḥ śivaṃ draṣṭuṃ śailendranagarastriyaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. All the sages and ascetics also took their seats at the place of welfare. In the meantime descended from his chariot looked at the king of the mountain while taking his seat on the gem-studded lion throne. Thereafter the damsels of the Sailendra Nagara arrived there.

## \|\| 44.26-28 \|\|

*vṛddhā bālā yuvatyaśca vastrābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ \|*  
*kāścitkajjalahastāśca vastrahastāśca kāścana \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kāścitsindūrahastāśca kāścitkaṃkatihākarāḥ \|*  
*veṣārdhabhūṣitāḥ kāścitkāścinnaivārdhabhūṣitāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kāścinnirbhūṣitāḥ kāścitsarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ \|*  
*sarvā āgatya saṃtasthuḥ sasmitā parvatālaye \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. They included the old women, small girls damsels, who were all clad in the best of costumes and adorned with ornaments. Some of them carried collyrium in their hand, some of them costumes, some of them vermilion, some of the comb some of them were fully decorated while others were not decorated at all. Some of them arrived there without adorning themselves with the ornaments. All of them entered the abode of the palaces of the king of mountains smilingly.

## \|\| 44.29 \|\|

*ṛṣikanyā devakanyā nāgakanyā manoharāḥ \|*

29\. The daughters of the sages, the gods, the Nagas, Gandharvas, mountains and other kings also arrived there.

## \|\| 44.30-33 \|\|

*sarvā apsaraso divyā rambhādyā samupasthitāḥ \|*  
*menā kanyāgaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ varam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*cārucampakavarṇābhamekavaktraṃ trilocanam \|*

*candanāgurukastūrīcārukuṅkumabhūṣitam \|*  
*mālatīmālyasaṃyuktaṃ sadratnamukuṭojjvalam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vahniśaucenātulena cātisūkṣmeṇa cāruṇā \|*

30-33. Rambha and other divine apsaras also reached there. Accompanied by the girls, Mena also looked at the bride-groom who had the beauty of charming flowers, single face, three eyes, wearing a smile on his delightful face, adorned with beautiful, gem-studded ornaments, with his body plastered in sandal-paste, aguru, kasturi and saffron. He had the garland of jasmine flowers and wore a gem-studded beautiful crown on his head which was illumining. He was clad in extremely beautiful costumes which were sanctified by fire, were quite fine, charming and priceless.

## \|\| 44.34 \|\|

*ratnadarpaṇahastaṃ ca kajjalojjvalalocanam \|*

34\. He was holding a mirror in his hand and the collyrium was applied to both his eyes. He looked quite graceful with the lustre emitting from his body.

## \|\| 44.35-36 \|\|

*atīva taruṇaṃ ramyairbhūṣitāṅgaiśca bhūṣitam \|*  
*bibhrantaṃ rūpamatulaṃ paraṃ nārāyaṇājñayā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*yogasvarūpaṃ yogeśaṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum \|*  
*svecchāmayaṃ guṇātītaṃ brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. He was looking quite young and the ornaments adorning his limbs looked quite graceful. He had taken to the beautiful form at the command of Narayana. Shiva happens to be the form of yoga, lord If yogis teacher of yogis, independent, devoid of gunas and representing the eternal flames of Brahman.

## \|\| 44.37-39 \|\|

*guṇabhedādrūpabhedaṃ dhatte'nantamarūpakam \|*

*sarvādhāraṃ sarvabījaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvajīvanam \|*  
*sākṣirūpaṃ nirīhaṃ ca paramānandamakṣaram \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ādyantamadhyarahitaṃ sarvādyaṃ sarvarūpakam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā jāmātaraṃ menā jahau śokaṃ mudānvitā \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. Because of the difference in gunas he takes to many forms but in spite of that he is without any form. He is the one who comes to the rescue of the people, drowning in the ocean of the universe and happen to be the cause of the creation, preservation and the destruction of the universe. He is the base of all, the seed of all, the lord of all, the life of all, the witness of all, unattached, blissful, eternal free from beginning, middle or end, the form of the beginning of everything. Finding such a son-in-law Mena's grief disappeared.

## \|\| 44.40 \|\|

*praśaśaṃsuryuvatyaśca dhanyā dhanyā satīti tāḥ \|*

40\. The damsels cried repeatedly, "O Parvati you are really graceful". Thus they started praising her, some of them said that Durga is quite fortunate.

## \|\| 44.41 \|\|

*kāmena kāścitkāminyo maunībhūtāśca stambhitāḥ \|*  
*na dṛṣṭo vara ityevamasmābhirjñānagocare \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Some of the damsels getting infested with passion were totally surprised and kept quiet and some of them uttered "We have never come across such a bride-groom in our lives.

## \|\| 44.42-43 \|\|

*kāścinnimeṣarahitā mūrcchāmāpuśca kāścana \|*  
*nininduḥ svapatiṃ kāścitsvecchāṃ cakruśca kāścana \|\| 42 \|\|*

*kāścidbhāvena ruruduḥ pulakāñcitavigrahāḥ \|*  
*jagurgandharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Some of them continued to stare at him without winking their eyes, while some of them got fainted. Some of them started denouncing their own husbands while some of the an became desirous of him. Some of them getting over-powered with emotions were overwhelmed and started sobbing. The Gandharvas were singing and the apsaras were dancing.

## \|\| 44.44-49 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā śaṃkararūpaṃ ca prahṛṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|*  
*nānāprakāravādyāni cārūṇi madhurāṇi ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*vādakā vādayāmāsurnānāśilpena tatra vai \|*  
*etasminnantare durgā śailāntaḥpuracārikā \|\| 45 \|\|*

*bahiścakāra sadratnāsanasthāṃ ratnavedikām \|*  
*kastūrībindubhiḥ sāndrasindūrabindubhūṣitām \|\| 46 \|\|*

*cārucandanacandrābhāṃ namrabhālasthalojjvalām \|*  
*ratnendrasārahāreṇa vakṣaḥsthalavibhūṣitām \|\| 47 \|\|*

*trinetradattanetrāṃ tāmanyavāritalocanām \|*  
*atīṣaddhāsyayuktāsyāṃ sakaṭākṣāṃ manoharām \|\| 48 \|\|*

*ralkeyūravalayaratrakaṅkaṇapaṇḍitām \|*  
*ralrapāśakasaṃsaktāṃ kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitām \|\| 49 \|\|*

44-49. All the gods felt delighted at the beauty of lord Shiva, The persons playing on musical instruments displayed different tunes and played on beautiful and sweet musical instrument. In the meantime, the maid-servant of the inner apartment of the palace of Himalaya brought Durga outside, who was fully clad in the divine garments She was seated on the gem-studded lion-throne. Her face was decorated with kasturl vermilion and the spots of different types. Her face was plastered with sandal-paste and was emitting the lustre of the moon and she looked quite beautiful. A garland of gems adorned her breasts. She was looking at the three eyed Shiva with side-glances. She never cast her side glance at anybody else accept Shiva. Her face was wearing a serene smile while looking with side-glances she seemed quite graceful. She was adorned with an armlets and wristlets of gems and the waist-band, having the small bells producing sweet sound.

## \|\| 44.50 \|\|

*amūlyātulyacitrāḍhyavastrayugma suśobhitām \|*  
*sadratnakuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca cārugaṇḍasthalojjvalām \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. She was clad in two beautiful garments, having no comparison, her cheeks were shining with the lustre of gems studded in the her ear-rings.

## \|\| 44.51 \|\|

*maṇisāraprabhāmuṣṭadantarājivirājitām \|*  
*ratnadarpaṇahastāṃ ca krīḍāpadmaṃ vighūrṇatīm \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Her teeth resembled the lustre of gems. She held a mirror of gems in her hand and in the other one she was carrying a lotus which was being rotated by her playfully.

## \|\| 44.52 \|\|

*candana guru kasturi kunkume nadgacarcitam \|*  
*muditā dadṛśuḥ sarve jagadādyāṃ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. All her limbs were plastered with sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl and saffron.

## \|\| 44.53 \|\|

*trinetro netrakoṇena tāṃ dadarśa mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*sarvāṃ satyākṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā vijahau virahajvaram \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Delighted Shiva also looked at Parvati with a side-glance. The complete figure of Parvati resembled the figure of Sati. At the sight of Parvati, Shiva was completely freed from the fever of separation of Sati.

## \|\| 44.54 \|\|

*śivaḥ sarvaṃ visasmāra durgāsanyastamānasaḥ \|*  
*pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgo harṣāśruyuktalocanaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. His mind was fully attracted at Durga and he forget everything. He felt emotional in his body and his eyes started drooping the tears of pleasure.

## \|\| 44.55-56 \|\|

*etasminnantare śailaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sapurohitaḥ \|*  
*taṃ varaṃ varayāmāsa vastracaṃdanabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*bhaktyā pādyādibhirmālyairdivyagaṃdhamanoharaiḥ \|*  
*tataḥ śīghraṃ vedamaṃtraiḥ saṃpradānaṃ cakāra tām \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. In the meantime. Himalaya accompanied by his family priest offered to Shiva the costumes, sandal-paste and ornaments accepting him as the bride groom. With his mind filled with demotion he offered padya and other types of adoration's besides the garland of divine flowers issuing divine fragrance. Thereafter with the reciting of the Vedic hymns he handed on the hand of her daughter to Shiva.

## \|\| 44.57-62 \|\|

*yautukāni dadau tasmai ratnāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*cāruratnavikāraṇi pātrāṇi sundarāṇi ca \|\| 57 \|\|*

*gavāṃ lakṣaṃ gajeṃdrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi ca rādhike \|*  
*ratnakaṃbalayuktāni sāṃkuśāni mudānvitaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*triṃśallakṣaṃ hayānāṃ ca sajjitānāmakātaraḥ \|*  
*dāsīnāmanuraktānāṃ lakṣaṃ sadratnabhūṣitam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*śataṃ dvijabaṭūnāṃ ca pārvatībhrātṛkalpakam \|*  
*rathānāṃ ca śataṃ ramyaṃ ratnendrasāranirmitam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*pārvatīṃ vastusahitāṃ svastītyuccārya śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*jagrāhānaṃdamanasā yatnācchailasamarpitām \|\| 61 \|\|*

*himālayaḥ sutāṃ dattvā parihāraṃ cakāra tam \|*  
*mādhyaṃdinoktastātreṇa tuṣṭāva saṃpuṭāṃjaliḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

57-62. О Radhika, Himalaya with his mind filled with delight and large-heatedly, gave away in dowry a large number of gems of various types, vases built with various types of diamonds, a lakh of cows, a thousand elephants with goads studded with gems, three lakhs of caparisoned horses, a lakh of female slaves adorned with ornaments of gems, a hundred Brahmana boys who were dearer to Parvati like her own brothers and a hundred chariots which were inlaid with the best of gems. The king of the mountains offered his daughter making great efforts to Shiva who accepted the same uttering the words Svasti, with his delightful mind. After giving away the girl in charity Himalaya offered his prayer to Shiva. He recited the stotra which is prescribed in the MSdhyandina-sakha.

## \|\| 44.63 \|\|

*himālaya uvāca \|*  
*prasīda dakṣayajñaghna narakārṇavatāraka \|*  
*sarvātmarūpa sarveśa paramānaṃdavigraha \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Himalaya said – О destroyer of the yajna of Daksha, О protector of the people falling in the ocean of hell, you are the form of everyone, the lord of everyone and having a blissful body. Be pleased with me.

## \|\| 44.64 \|\|

*guṇārṇava guṇātīta guṇayukta gaṇeśvara \|*  
*guṇabīja mahābhāga prasīda guṇināṃ vara \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. You are the ocean of virtues, beyond the gun as, filled with gunas, the lord of gunas because of your qualities, you are the best among the virtuous people. О great lord be happy with me.

## \|\| 44.65 \|\|

*yogādhāra yogarūpa yogajña yogakāraṇa \|*  
*yogīśa yogināṃ bīja prasīda yogināṃ guro \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. You are the best of yoga, the form of yoga, knower of the yoga, the cause of yoga the lord of the yogas, cause of the yogis and the teacher of the yogis be pleased with me.

## \|\| 44.66 \|\|

*pralayapralayādyaikabhavapralayakāraṇa \|*  
*pralayānte sṛṣṭibīja prasīda paripālaka \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. You are the form of dissolution, you are the sole cause of dissolution. After the dissolution you happen to be the seed of the recreation of the universe and preserve that universe completely, be pleased with me.

## \|\| 44.67 \|\|

*saṃhārakāle ghore ca sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇa \|*  
*durnivārya durārādhya cāśutoṣa prasīda me \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. You have the form of terrific destruction and are the cause of the total destruction, the horrible one, difficult in adoration but can be pleased in no time. Be pleased with me.

## \|\| 44.68 \|\|

*kālasvarūpa kāleśa kāle ca phaladāyaka \|*  
*kālabījaikakālaghna prasīda kālapālaka \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. You are the form of Kala, the lord of Kala, provide the reward at the appropriate time, the only cause of Kala, destroyer of Kala and preserver of KSla, be pleased with me.

## \|\| 44.69 \|\|

*śivasvarūpa śivada śivabīja śivāśraya \|*  
*śivabhūta śivaprāṇa prasīda paramāśraya \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. You are the form of welfare, bestower of welfare, the seed of welfare, refuge of welfare, the form of welfare and the life and the abode of refuge for everyone. Be pleased with me.

## \|\| 44.70 \|\|

*ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā virarāma himālayaḥ \|*  
*praśaśaṃsuḥ surāḥ sarve munayaśca girīśvaram \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Thus adoring Shiva, Himalaya kept quiet. Thereafter all the gods and the sages who had assembled there praised Shiva.

## \|\| 44.71 \|\|

*himālayakṛtaṃ stotraṃ saṃyato yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*pradadāti śivastasmai vāñchitaṃ rādhike dhruvam \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. О Radhika such of the persons, who with devoted mind recite the stotra composed by Himalaya, Shiva surely fulfils all his desires.

## Chapter 45

## \|\| 45.1-2 \|\|

*. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*atha vedavidhānena saṃsthāpya vahnimīśvaraḥ \|*  
*yajñaṃ cakāra tatraiva vāme saṃsthāpya pārvatīm \|\| 1 \|\|*

*nivṛtte vidhivadyajñe viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadau \|*  
*śivaḥ śatasuvarṇāni vṛṃdāvanavinodini \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Shri Krishna said – Thereafter Shiva made PSrvati to sit to his left side and performed the yajna according to the Vedic rites. О damsel of the pleasure of Vrindavana, after the completion of the yajna Shiva gave away to the Brahmanas a hundred gold coins in daksina.

## \|\| 45.3 \|\|

*atha pradīpamānīya śaileṃdranagarastriyaḥ \|*  
*nirvartya maṃgalaṃ karma gṛhaṃ saṃprāpya daṃpatī \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Thereafter the wives of the lord of mountains performed the welfare ceremonies took the newly wedded couple in the inner apartment.

## \|\| 45.4-6 \|\|

*kṛtvā jayadhvaniṃ prītyā śubhanirmañchanādikam \|*  
*sasmitāḥ sakaṭākṣāśca pulakāṃcitavigrahāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vāsagehaṃ saṃpraviśya dadṛśuḥ kāminīgaṇāḥ \|*  
*śaṃkaraṃ rūpaveṣāḍhyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumāṃcitavigraham \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ manoharam \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. All of them recited the slogan of victory of Shiva and sprinkling divine water on the couple smilingly looked at Shiva with side-glances. All of them became emotional at that time. After getting into the palace, all the damsels looked at the face of Shiva who was looking with side glances. He looked quite graceful.

## \|\| 45.7-11 \|\|

*apūrvasūkṣmaveṣāḍhyaṃ siṃdūrabiṃdubhūṣitam \|*  
*cārucaṃpakavarṇābhaṃ sarvāvayavasuṃdaram \|\| 7 \|\|*

*navīnayauvanasthaṃ ca munīndracittamohanam \|*  
*sarasvatīṃ ca lakṣmīṃ ca sāvitrīṃ jāhnavīṃ ratim \|\| 8 \|\|*

*aditiṃ ca śacīṃ caiva lopāmudrāmaruṃdhatīm \|*  
*ahalyāṃ tulasīṃ svāhāṃ rohiṇīṃ ca vasuṃdharām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śatarūpāṃ ca saṃjñāṃ ca satīstrīṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*devakanyā nāgakanyā munikanyā manoharāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yā yāḥ sthitāstatra tāsāṃ saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*tābhī ratnāsane datte tatrovāsa śivo mudā \|*  
*tamūcuḥ kramaśo devyo madhuroktiṃ sudhāmiva \|\| 11 \|\|*

7-11. His costumes and ornaments were quite fine; he was decorated with the spots of vermilion; his fair complexion was putting to shame the lustre of the campaka flowers he appeared youthful from all his limbs and could attract even the minds of the ascetics. The sixteen chaste damsels including Sarasvati, Lakshmi, Savitri, Ganga, Rati, Aditi, IndranI, Lopamudra, Arundhatl, Ahalaya, Tulasi, Svaha, Rohini, Vasundhara, SatarOpa and Sanjna were present there. Besides them several daughters, of gods, Nagas and the ascetics also reached there, who could count the number of damsels present there at that time? Shiva took his seat on the gem-studded lion-throne delightfully and all the goddesses started offering prayer to Shiva.

## \|\| 45.12 \|\|

*sarasvatyuvāca \|*  
*prāptā satī mahādevādhunā prāṇadhikā mudā \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā priyāsyaṃ caṃdrābhaṃ saṃtāpaṃ tyaja kāmuka \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Savitri said – О Mahadeva we have got back Sati who is dearer to you than your life delightfully at this time. Therefore О passionate one, you relieve the suffering of your mind while looking at the beauty of your beloved.

## \|\| 45.13 \|\|

*kālaṃ gamaya kāleśa sadā saṃśleṣapūrvakam \|*  
*viśleṣaste na bhavitā sarvakālaṃ mamāśiṣā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О lord of the death, you spend your time in union with her and with my blessing you will never be separated from her at any time.

## \|\| 45.14 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*lajjāṃ vihāya deveśa satīṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|*  
*tiṣṭha saṃprati kā lajjā prāṇā yāṃti yayā vinā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Lakshmi said – О lord of the gods, now shedding away shyness you embrace Sati. She is the one without whom, one feels deprived of his life, why should one feel shy in getting her.

## \|\| 45.15 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*bhojayitvā satīṃ śaṃbho śīghraṃ bhojaya mā khidaḥ \|*  
*tadācamya sakarpūraṃ tāṃbūlaṃ dehi bhaktitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Savitri said – О Shiva you make Sati to take her food first and than you take your food. Don't worry; thereafter sipping йсатапа you chew betel with camphor with great devotion.

## \|\| 45.16 \|\|

*jāhnavyuvāca \|*  
*svarṇakaṃkatikāṃ dhṛtvā keśānmārjaya yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*kāminyāḥ svāmisaubhāgyaṃ sukhaṃ nātaḥ paraṃ bhavet \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Jahnavl said – using the comb of gold you arrange the hair of Sati; there is no other pleasure greater than looking at the face of charming Sati.

## \|\| 45.17-19 \|\|

*ratiruvāca \|*  
*gṛhītvā pārvatīṃ deva subhagāmatidurlabhām \|*  
*kathaṃ mama prāṇanātho niḥsvārtha bhasmasātkṛtaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*jīvayasi vibho kāmaṃ kāmavyāpāramātmani \|*  
*kuru dūraṃ ca saṃtāpaṃ mama viśleṣahetukam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*dampatīvirahakleśaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā dayānidhe \|*  
*tathāpi mama kāṃtaśca kopena bhasmasātkṛtaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Rati said – "O god why did you burn out kama my husband without any reason? О virtuous one, for your own purpose you revive kama back to life and remove my mental agony. О ocean of mercy, you are well-aware of the pain of separation of a couple. You had reduced to ashes my husband in anger."

## \|\| 45.20 \|\|

*ityuktvā kāmabhasmātha dadau sā granthibaṃdhitam \|*  
*ruroda purataḥ śaṃbhornāthanāthetyudīrya ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thus speaking she handed over the bundle of the ashes of kama before him and spoke to Shiva. "O lord" Thus speaking she started crying,

## \|\| 45.21 \|\|

*haristadrodanaṃ śrutvā karuṇāmayasāgaraḥ \|*  
*brahmā dharmādidevāśca yayurvāsagṛhaṃ śivam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. On hearing her cries Vishnu, the ocean of mercy and Brahma beside other gods reached the palace and stood besides Shiva.

## \|\| 45.22 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ dharmaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca surānapi \|*  
*javena pīṭhādutthāya svājñāṃ kurvityuvāca ha \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Finding Shiva, Brahma and Dharma there besides other gods present before him. Shiva got up with force and said, "Give me the command."

## \|\| 45.23-24 \|\|

*śaṃkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā tamuvāca hariḥ svayam \|*  
*kāmaṃ jīvaya he rudretyuktvā śīghraṃ jagāma saḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ūcurdevyo bahutaraṃ vākyaṃ vinayapūrvakam \|*  
*krudhā dṛṣṭvā śūlabhṛto bhasmato nirgataḥ smaraḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. On hearing the words of Shiva lord Vishnu himself said, "O Rudra revive kama back to life". Thus speaking he left that place The damsels present there also made several types of prayers to Shiva in this regard. Thereafter Shiva looked at the bundle of ashes gracefully and with the nectar-like sight of Shiva, Kamadeva emerged from the bundle of ashes.

## \|\| 45.25 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā kāmaṃ ratistaṃ ca praṇanāma maheśvaram \|*  
*tadrūpaṃ ca tadākāraṃ sasmitaṃ sadhanuḥśaram \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Finding kama having been revived she bowed in reverence to her husband as well as Maheshvara. At that point of time Kamadeva had the same beauty which he had possessed earlier and he wore a serene smile on his face, holding the bow and arrow in his hand.

## \|\| 45.26 \|\|

*praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ kāmaḥ stutiṃ kṛtvā yathāgamam \|*  
*bahirgatvā hariṃ devānpraṇamya samuvāca ha \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. He offered his prayer to lord Shiva according to the scriptures. Than he came out and bowed in reverence to other gods.

## \|\| 45.27 \|\|

*kāmaṃ saṃbhāṣya devāśca yuyujuśca tamāśiṣam \|*  
*kāle rakṣā vināśaśca niṣedhaḥ kena vāryate \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The gods talked to him and then blessed him. Who can prevent the destruction or the protection as destined.

## \|\| 45.28 \|\|

*atha śailaḥ surānsarvānnārāyaṇapurogamān \|*  
*bhojayāmāsa bhaktyā ca śāyayāmāsa yatnataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thereafter, Himalaya served food to all the gods including Narayana with great devotion and offered them the beds to sleep.

## \|\| 45.29 \|\|

*atha śaṃbhurvāsagṛhe vāme saṃsthāpya pārvatīm \|*  
*miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa tayā saha mudānvitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. In the pleasure house Shiva made Parvati to be seated on his left and he took food with sweets in her company.

## \|\| 45.30 \|\|

*bhuktavaṃtaṃ śivaṃ tatra devamātā'ditiḥ svayam \|*  
*uvāca sasmitaṃ rādhe saṃprītyā sarasaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О Radha at that point of time Aditi the mother of gods talked to Shiva and Parvati in sweet words who had already taken their food.

## \|\| 45.31 \|\|

*aditiruvāca \|*  
*bhojanāṃte śaci śaṃbhoḥ śaucārthaṃ jalamarpaya \|*  
*dehi śīghraṃ mama prītyā daṃpatyoḥ prītipūrvakam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Aditi said – О Indrani serve water to Shiva for washing his hands and rinsing his mouth. Because of my affection for the newly wedded couple, you presently supply water to them.

## \|\| 45.32 \|\|

*śacyuvāca \|*  
*kṛtvā vilāpaṃ yaddhetoḥ śavaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|*  
*yo babhrāma bhuvaṃ mohātkālena prāpa tāṃ satīm \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Sac! said – The purpose for which you had lamented embracing the body of Sati and had wandered in the entire universe, you have achieved back the same Sati.

## \|\| 45.33 \|\|

*aruṃdhatyuvāca \|*  
*mayā dattā satī tubhyaṃ menā dātumanīpsitā \|*  
*vividhaṃ bodhayitvemāṃ ratiṃ ca kartumarhasi \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Arundhatl said – Mena was not prepared to give away Parvati in marriage. I tried to convince her variously and have got you Sati, now you should enjoy the conjugal pleasures with her.

## \|\| 45.34 \|\|

*ahalyovāca \|*  
*vṛddhāvasthāṃ parityajya hyatīva taruṇo'dhunā \|*  
*tena menā tu mene tvāṃ sutāmarpitumīśvara \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Ahalaya said – О lord, now disowning the old age, you have taken to the youthful form. Therefore Mena had agreed to give her daughter to you.

## \|\| 45.35 \|\|

*tulasyuvāca \|*  
*satī tvayā parityaktā kāmo dagdhaḥ purākṛtaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ tadā vasiṣṭhaśca prabho prasthāpito'dhunā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Tulasi said – О lord, you had disowned Sati earlier and also reduced to ashes, kama then why did you send again Vasistha here.

## \|\| 45.36 \|\|

*svāhovāca \|*  
*sthiro bhava mahādeva strīṇāṃ vacasi sāṃpratam \|*  
*vivāhe vyavahāro'sti purastrīṇāṃ pragalbhatā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Svaha said – О Mahadeva whatever is being told by the damsels at present you please listen to me attentively, it is quite common for the ladies to indulge in such loose talk.

## \|\| 45.37 \|\|

*rohiṇyuvāca \|*  
*kāmaṃ pūraya pārvatyāḥ kāmaśāstraviśārada \|*  
*kuru pāraṃ svayaṃ kāmī kāmināṃ kāmasāgaram \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Vasundhara said – О Shiva, a hungry or a passionate person cannot be satisfied without the articles of pleasures. You satisfy the damsel in anyway you like.

## \|\| 45.38 \|\|

*vasuṃdharovāca \|*  
*bhogadravyaṃ vinā bhogī na hi tuṣṭaḥ kṣudhāturaḥ \|*  
*yena tuṣṭirbhavecchaṃbho tatkartumucitaṃ striyā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Sanjna said – О all knowledgeable Shiva you are well-aware of the sentiments of the passionate damsels. But Sati is unaware of enjoying the love-sports with her husband.

## \|\| 45.39 \|\|

*saṃjñovāca \|*  
*jānāsi bhāvaṃ sarvajña kāmārtānāṃ ca yoṣitām \|*  
*na ca svasvāminaṃ śaṃbho satī jānāti saṃgatam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. SatarQpa said – In secluded chamber placing the betel and the comfortable bed, both Parvati and Shiva should be sent delightfully.

## \|\| 45.40 \|\|

*śatarūpovāca \|*  
*tūrṇaṃ prasthāpaya prītyā pārvatyā saha śaṃkaram \|*  
*ratnapradīpaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ talpaṃ nirmāya nirjane \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Shri Krishna said – On listening to the pleasant and jovial words of the damsels, Shiva who happens to be the teacher of the yogis himself said.

## \|\| 45.41 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*strīṇāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tā uvāca śivaḥ svayam \|*  
*nirvikārī ca bhagavānyogīṃdrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Shiva said – О goddesses you should not talk to me like that because all of you are pretty chaste and the mothers of the universe; than why do you become so talkative with the son.

## \|\| 45.42 \|\|

*śaṃkara uvāca \|*  
*devyo mā vadatoktiṃ ca hyevaṃbhūtāṃ mamāṃtike \|*  
*jagatāṃ mātaraḥ sādhvyaḥ putre capalatā katham \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Rohini said – О well-versed in the scriptures on love, fulfils the desire of Parvati. Becoming yourself passionate you cross over the ocean of passion by means of the damsel Parvati.

## \|\| 45.43 \|\|

*śaṃkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā lajjitāḥ surayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*babhūvuḥ saṃbhramāttūṣṇīṃ citraputtalikā yathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. On hearing the words of Shiva all the damsels of the gods felt ashamed and getting upset kept quiet.

## \|\| 45.44 \|\|

*bhuktvā miṣṭāni bhagavānācamya ca mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*sakarpūraṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ bubhuje bhāryayā saha \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Thereafter lord Shiva delightfully consumed the sweets rinsed his mouth and started chewing the betel with camphor.

## \|\| 45.45-47 \|\|

*. iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śaṃkaravivāho nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*ratnapradīpaśatakairjvaladbhi rjvalitaṃ śriyā \|*  
*ratnapātraghaṭākīrṇaṃ muktāmāṇikyabhūṣitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*ratnadarpaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ maṃḍitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*caṃdanāgurusaṃyuktaṃ puṣpaśayyāsamanvitam \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. He was then seated on the gem-studded lion throne provided to him by Mena and started looking at the bed-room which was illumining like hundreds of burning lamps. It had enough of vases of gems and pitchers filled with water, the mirrors studded with various types of gems and diamonds besides the white fly-whisks. It had enough of sandal-paste, aguru and flower spread on the beds.

## \|\| 45.48 \|\|

*nānācitravicitrāḍhayaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*ratnasāreṇa khacitaṃ racitaṃ hīrakairvaraiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The house was constructed by Vishvakarma himself in which several types of paintings were decorated. It was built in the best of gems and was inlaid with precious gems.

## \|\| 45.49 \|\|

*kutracitsuranirmāṇavaikuṃṭhasumanoharam \|*  
*vṛṃdāvanaṃ kuṃjavanaṃ kutracidrāsamaṃḍalam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. In that house the abodes of the gods, charming Vaikuntha, Vrindavana, Kunjavana and Rasamandala had been painted.

## \|\| 45.50 \|\|

*kailāsaṃ ca kutracana kutracidiṃdramaṃdiram \|*  
*dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ mahādevaḥ parituṣṭo babhūva ha \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. At places Kailasa, the abode of Indra and several other astonishing scene were painted, looking at which Shiva was immensely pleased.

## \|\| 45.51 \|\|

*atha prabhātakālaśca babhūva prāṇavallabhe \|*  
*nānāprakāravādyāni vādayāṃcakrire janāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. О lady of my life, at the time of down various types of musical instrument were played upon.

## \|\| 45.52 \|\|

*sarve surāḥ samuttasthuḥ sajjībhūtāḥ sasaṃbhramāḥ \|*  
*svavāhanānsamāruhya kailāsaṃ gantumudyatāḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Than all the gods abruptly got up and decorating themselves with best of costumes and ornaments, mounted over their vehicles and got ready to depart for Kailasa.

## \|\| 45.53 \|\|

*vāsagehaṃ samāgatya dharmo nārāyaṇājñayā \|*  
*uvāca śaṃkaraṃ yogī yogīśaṃ samayocitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. At that point of time with the command of Narayana, Yogis and Dharma, went to the dwelling place and addressing Shiva spoke to him.

## \|\| 45.54 \|\|

*dharma uvāca \|*  
*uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te bhavatu pramathādhipa \|*  
*pārvatyā saha māheṃdre yātrāṃ kuru hariṃ smaran \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Dharma said – "O lord of the Pramathas you meet with welfare. Get up and reciting the name of Hari you move on with Parvati for a journey.".

## \|\| 45.55 \|\|

*itthaṃ dharmavacaḥ śrutvā pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*yātrāṃ cakāra māheṃdre vṛṃdāvanavinodini \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. О beloved of Vrindavana, on hearing the words of Dharma, Shiva started his journey with Parvati in Mahendra-yoga.

## \|\| 45.56 \|\|

*yātrāṃ kurvati deveśe pārvatyā saha śaṃkare \|*  
*uccai ruditvā sā menā tamuvāca kṛpānidhim \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. When Parvati started on her journey with Shiva. Mena while sobbing spoke to compassionate Shiva.

## \|\| 45.57-58 \|\|

*menovāca \|*  
*kṛpānidhe kṛpāṃ kṛtvā madvatsāṃ pālayiṣyasi \|*  
*sahasradoṣānbhagavānāśutoṣaḥ kṣamiṣyasi \|\| 57 \|\|*

*tvatpadāṃbujabhaktaiṣā madvatsā janma janmani \|*  
*svapne jñāne smṛtirnāsti mahādevaprabhuṃ vinā \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. Mena said – О merciful one, kindly maintain my daughter carefully, you are the lord who is easily pleased; therefore you forgive her for her follies. This daughter of mine is devoted at your feet for many births. Except Mahadeva as her lord, she does not think of anyone else even in dream.

## \|\| 45.59 \|\|

*tvadbhaktiśrutimātreṇa harṣāśrupulakānvitā \|*  
*tvanniṃdayā bhavenmaunā mṛtyuṃjaya mṛtā iva \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Hearing about your devotion she becomes overwhelmed and the tears start flowing from her eyes. О conqueror of the death at your denouncement, she keeps mum like a dead person.

## \|\| 45.60-66 \|\|

*ityuktā menakā śīghraṃ tatrāgatya himālayaḥ \|*  
*uccai ruroda ca tadā vatsāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kva yāsi vatsetyuccārya śūnyaṃ kṛtvā himālayam \|*  
*smāraṃsmāraṃ tadgaṇaughaṃ vidārya manmanaḥ sphuṭam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*ityevamuktvā śailendraḥ samarpya ca śivāṃ śive \|*  
*sa śailaḥ sahaputraśca rurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānadhyātmavidyayā svayam \|*  
*sarvānprabodhayāmāsa kṛpayā sa kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*nanāma pārvatī bhaktyā mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum \|*  
*māyayā ca mahāmāyā rurodoccairmurhumuhuḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*pārvatīrodanenaiva ruruduḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ \|*

28-35. Gautama said – О Indra, disgrace to you. You are the son of Kashyapa, the best of the gods, who was quite intelligent and you are the great grandson of Brahma the creator of the universe, then how could you. achieve such a nasty mind. This is quite astonishing you are the one who is well-versed in the Vedas and are quite intelligent but in your actions you are passionate for the Yorti. Therefore a hundred yon is would develop over your body and for full one year the smell of the yoni would emerge from your body. Thereafter with the adoration of Surya the yoni would be turned into the form of the eyes. О foolish one the reason for which you have desecrated the chastity of my beloved. Therefore with my curse and the anger of your teacher you will be deprived of all your riches. О foolish one because of your being my pupil I have not taken life out of you. О foolish one, because of the consideration of my own. teacher I am not ending your life because he happens to be quite an illustrious one and is intimately related to me. In order to avoid any misunderstanding between us I am leaving you alive. Therefore, О son Devendra, get up and go back to your house. *śakro mahāmunerasthnāṃ vajraṃ kṛtvā sudāruṇam \|*
