52\. Brahmahatyd because of the curse of Brahma could not reach there. Therefore, she was perched over a tree branch standing at the bank of lake MSnasarovara.

## \|\| 47.53-54 \|\|

*brahmahatyā śunāsīraṃ dudrāva hatacetanam \|*  
*raktavastraparīdhānā vṛtrastrīveṣadhāriṇī \|\| 53 \|\|*

*saptatālapramāṇā sā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā \|*  
*īṣāpramāṇadaśanā mahābhītaṃ cakāra tam \|\| 54\|\|*

53-54. At that point of time king Nahusa was made the lord of the three worlds, Nahusa was quite powerful and the gods were quite weak. Therefore after establishing himself over the thrown of Indra, Nahusa demanded that IndranI, the spouse of Indra should be made to serve him.

## \|\| 47.55-56 \|\|

*dhāvaṃtaṃ paridhāvaṃtī baliṣṭhā hatacetanam \|*  
*khaḍgahastā dayāhīnā vegena paridhāvati \|\| 55 \|\|*

*iṃdro dṛṣṭvā ca tāṃ ghorāṃ smāraṃsmāraṃ guroḥ padam \|*  
*viveśa mānasasaro mṛṇālasūkṣmasūtrataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. Thereafter Indra the destroyer of the demons, made vajra of the bone of the Dadhlci and killed Vrtra who was like a thorn for the gods.

## \|\| 47.57 \|\|

*tatra gaṃtuṃ na śaktā sā brahmaṇaḥ śāpakāraṇāt \|*  
*sā tasthau vaṭaśākhāyāṃ sarasastaṭasannidhau \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. But Indra, who was not quite conscious attracted the sin of Brahmahatya. The Brahmahatyd was clad in red garments and looked like an old woman. Her height equated with seven tala trees and her throat, lips and palate had dried up her teeth resembled plough-shafts. She terrified Indra very much.

## \|\| 47.58 \|\|

*athātra nahuṣo bhūpastrilokeśo babhūva ha \|*  
*sa yayāce śacīṃ devānbaliṣṭho durbalānapi \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. When Indra was so running away he was followed by her. Brahmahatyd was quite strong and Indra lost his senses. Her nature was quite cruel and holding a sword in her hand, she rushed towards Indra. Finding the terrific Brahmahatyd following him, he remembered the feet of his teacher and through the lotus stalk, he took to a tiny form and reached Manasarovara.

## \|\| 47.59 \|\|

*śacī śrutvā mahābhītā tārakāṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|*  
*tārā nirbhartsya svapatiṃ bhṛtyapatnīṃ rarakṣa ca \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. On hearing this Shachi felt terrified and she went to take refuge with goddess Tara. Tara on her part, denounced her husband very badly and than protected Sachi.

## \|\| 47.60 \|\|

*śacīmāśvāsya svagururjagāma tatsaro mudā \|*  
*ājuhāva śunāsīraṃ kātaraṃ hatacetanam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The teacher assured Shachi and went to Manasarovara and started calling Indra who was panic-stricken and quite dejected.

## \|\| 47.61 \|\|

*bṛhaspatiruvāca \|*  
*uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha he vatsa bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite \|*  
*tvadīśvaraṃ svareṇaiva niśāmaya bhayaṃ tyaja \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Brihaspati said – О son, get up. Why should you be afraid when I am there, you recognise me from my voice that I am your teacher don’t be afraid and come out.

## \|\| 47.62-65 \|\|

*svaraṃ bṛhaspaterjñātvā sarvasiddhīśvaro hariḥ \|*  
*sūkṣmarūpaṃ parityajya svarūpaṃ ca dadhāra saḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*utthāya sadyaḥ saṃbhrāto guruṃ taṃ sūryavarcasam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā nanāma saṃprītyā saṃprītaṃ tyaktakopakam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*padāṃbuje nipatitaṃ rudaṃtaṃ bhayavihvalam \|*  
*nidhāya vakṣasi premṇā ruroda premavihvalaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*rudaṃtaṃ vākpatiṃ tuṣṭaṃ tuṣṭāva tridaśeśvaraḥ \|*  
*puṭāṃjaliḥ pulakito bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

62-65. Recognising the voice of Brihaspati, Indra the lord of all the siddhis, discarded his tiny form and to taking to his original form met his teacher who was illumining like the sun. He had been quite happy discarding all the anger. He bowed in reverence to him with devotion and falling on his feet, he started crying. Getting filled with love the teacher picked up Indra and lovingly embraced him and he himself started crying. Finding Brihaspati having been fully satisfied and weeping, Indra was fully satisfied and overwhelmed. His head was bowed down in reverence and with folded hands he started praising him.

## \|\| 47.66 \|\|

*indra uvāca \|*  
*kṣamasva bhagavandoṣaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe \|*  
*bhṛtyāparādhaṃ satataṃ na gṛhṇāti sadīśvaraḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Indra said – О ocean of mercy, you forgive me for my sins, be compassionate on me, the noble lords do not mind about the sins of their servants.

## \|\| 47.67 \|\|

*svabhāryāsu svaśiṣyeṣu svabhṛtyeṣu suteṣu ca \|*  
*durbalaḥ sabalo vā'pi ko daṃḍaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Which one of the person would be incompetent to punish his own sons, wife, pupil and servant even if he is quite weak having no strength.

## \|\| 47.68-69 \|\|

*triṣu koṭiṣu deveṣu devako'hamapaṃḍitaḥ \|*  
*tvatprasādātsuraśreṣṭha kṛpayā varddhitastvayā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*saṃhartumīśastvaṃ sarvamahaṃ ko vāpi kīṭavat \|*  
*svayaṃ vidhātuḥ pautraśca punaḥ sraṣṭuṃ svayaṃ kṣamaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. Of all the three crores of the gods, I am the only one who is extremely foolish, but О best of the gods, for your own pleasure, you have always sought for my glory, you will be competent enough to destroy all. Who am I like a small insect, you are yourself the grandson of Brahma are quite competent enough to create the universe. After having been so eulogised by Indra, Brihaspati his teacher was fully satisfied and expressing his pleasure through his face and eyes, he spoke to Indra lovingly.

## \|\| 47.70 \|\|

*iti tasya stavaṃ śrutvā parituṣṭo guruḥ svayam \|*  
*uvāca vacanaṃ prītyā prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Brihaspati said – О virtuous one, be composed and receive the ever-lasting riches. О son, Indra you will receive four times more, the wealth, return to Amaravati and rule on the city.

## \|\| 47.71 \|\|

*gururuvāca \|*  
*sthiro bhava mahābhāga niścalāṃ kamalāṃ labha \|*  
*saṃprāpya paramaiśvaryaṃ pūrvasmācca caturguṇam \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. By my grace all your enemies would be destroyed. You go at once and meet the chaste Shachi.

## \|\| 47.72 \|\|

*gacchāmarāvatīṃ vatsa rājyaṃ kuru puraṃdara \|*  
*hataśatrurmatprasādādgatvā paśya śacīṃ satīm \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Thus speaking, as soon as the both the teacher and the pupil were about the leave that place. Brahmahatya in terrific form appeared before them. Indra felt terrified and took refuge with his teacher. At that point of time Brihaspati feeling panicky recited the name of Madhusudana. In the meantime there was a divine voice from the sky which carried deep meaning in few words. Brihaspati heard it.

## \|\| 47.73-75 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sa guruḥ saśiṣyo gaṃtumudyataḥ \|*  
*dadarśa purato ghorāṃ brahmahatyāṃ suduḥsahām \|\| 73 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā śakro mahābhītastaṃ guruṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|*  
*bṛhaspatirmahābhītaḥ sasmāra madhusūdanam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*etasminnaṃtare tatra vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī \|*  
*svalpākṣarā ca bahvarthā tāṃ śuśrāva bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

73-75. It said, "You save your pupil by giving him the Radha-kavacha which destroys all the evils.

## \|\| 47.76 \|\|

*saṃsāravijayaṃ nāma sarvāśubhavināśanam \|*  
*rādhike vacanaṃ śrutvā śiṣyaṃ rakṣādhuneti ca \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Thereafter, the teacher to whom the pupil was immensely dear gave to Indra, your kavacha and destroyed the Brahmahatya with a humkara.

## \|\| 47.77 \|\|

*tadā tvatkavacaṃ dattvā śiṣyāya śiṣyavatsalaḥ \|*  
*cakāra bhasmasāttāṃ ca huṃkāreṇaiva līlayā \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Thereafter accompanied with the pupil, Brihaspati went to Amaravati and found that the city had been destroyed by the enemy.

## \|\| 47.78 \|\|

*tadā śiṣyaṃ gṛhītvā ca gatvā tāmamarāvatīm \|*  
*dadarśa cchinnabhagnāṃ ca śatruṇā vacanādguroḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. On hearing about the arrival of her husband, Sac! was delighted. She bowed in reverence to the teacher and else her husband.

## \|\| 47.79 \|\|

*bharturāgamanaṃ śrutvā śacī saṃhṛṣṭamānasā \|*  
*praṇamya ca guruṃ bhaktyā svakāṃtaṃ praṇanāma sā \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Thereafter hearing about the arrival of Indra, all the gods, the sages and the ascetics felt delighted and were overwhelmed. They all reached before Indra. Indra was entrusted with the task of rebuilding of Amaravati to Vishvakarma the best of the architects. The architect spent a hundred year in rebuilding the city of Amaravati, it was inlaid with various types of gems, diamonds and precious stones and looked quite charming and beautiful but Indra. was not satisfied with it. On the other hand Vishvakarma could not return to his abode, without his permission Therefore with a disturbed mind he went to take refuge with Brahma.

## \|\| 47.80-83 \|\|

*śrutvā''gamanamiṃdrasya samājagmuḥ surāḥ priye \|*  
*ṛṣayo munayaścaiva harṣagadgadamānasāḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*yojayāmāsa satkāraṃ nirmātumamarāvatīm \|*  
*pūrṇamabdaśataṃ śilpī nirmame tvamarāvatīm \|\| 81 \|\|*

*nānāratnavicitrāḍhyāṃ maṇiratneṃdranirmitām \|*  
*manoharāṃ nirupamāṃ na hi tuṣṭo yayā hariḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*viśvakarmā gṛhaṃ gaṃtuṃ na śaśāka vinā''jñayā \|*  
*paramodvignacittaśca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 83 \|\|*

80-83. Realising the cause of his arrival Brahma himself said to him, "Because of your own actions, you have been stopped here and with the destruction of those deeds you would be relieved of your assignment from this place tomorrow." On hearing the words of Brahma, Vishvakarma at once returned to Amaravati and Brahma went to Vaikuntha. There, he bowed in reverence to his parents and told them about the difficulty of Vishvakarma.

## \|\| 47.84-85 \|\|

*vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ tamuvāca vidhiḥ svayam \|*  
*tava karmakṣayādeva tāvacchvo bhaviteti ca \|\| 84 \|\|*

*śrutvā tadvacanaṃ kāruḥ śīghraṃ prāpāmarāvatīm \|*  
*brahmā jagāma vaikuṇṭhe praṇamyovāca mātaram \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. Lord Vishnu assured Brahma and sent him back to his abode. He himself took to the form of a Brahmana boy and reached Amaravati. He was holding a Danda and Chatra. He was clad in white garments and his forehead was painted with tilakam he was dwarfish in outlook and white teeth. He wore a serene smile on his face which was quite charming He was in the form of a small boy but he possessed the divine intelligence. He himself was Brahma for Brahma and bestower of all the riches.

## \|\| 47.86-88 \|\|

*harirbrahmāṇamāśvāsya prasthāpya svagṛhaṃ ca tam \|*  
*viprarūpaṃ samāsthāya cājagāmāmarāvatīm \|\| 86 \|\|*

*daṇḍī chattrī śuklavāsā bibhrattilakamujjvalam \|*  
*atikharvaḥ śukladaṃtaḥ sasmitaḥ sumanoharaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*vayasā'tiśiśurbuddhyā jñānavṛddhyā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ vidhāturdhātā ca dātā ca sarvasaṃpadām \|\| 88 \|\|*

86-88. Reaching at the gate of the palace of Indra, he told the gate-keeper, "You inform Indra that a Brahmana boy has arrived to meet him." On hearing the words of the boy, the gate-keeper informed Indra and Indra at once met the Brahmana boy.

## \|\| 47.89-90 \|\|

*iṃdradvāre samuttiṣṭhandvārapālamuvāca ha \|*  
*brūhīdaṃ brahmaṇo dvāre śīghraṃ tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dvāri jñānaṃ cakāra tam \|*  
*sa ca śīghraṃ samāgamya dadarśa brāhmaṇārbhakam \|\| 90 \|\|*

89-90. The boy and girls surrounded him joyfully from all sides but he was smiling quite nicely and he was quite illustrious in his form. Indra bowed in reverence to Hari who had arrived in the form of a boy with great devotion. The lord on his part blessed him variously. Indra adored him, offering him madhuparka and other eatables. Thereafter he questioned the boy, "What brings you here.".

## \|\| 47.91-93 \|\|

*bālakānāṃ bālikānāṃ samūhaiḥ pariveṣṭitam \|*  
*hasadbhiśca mahotsāhātsasmitaṃ tejasā'nvitam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*praṇanāma harirbhaktyā taṃ hariṃ śiśurūpiṇam \|*  
*āśiṣaṃ yuyuje prītyā taṃ harirbhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā śakraḥ pūjāṃ cakāra tam \|*  
*papracchāgamanaṃ kasmādvadeti viprabālakam \|\| 93 \|\|*

91-93. On hearing the words of Indra, the Brahmana boy who happened to be like teacher Brihaspati spoke in a deep voice like the cloud.

## \|\| 47.94 \|\|

*iṃdrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca dvijārbhakaḥ \|*  
*megha gambhīrayā vācā bṛhaspatigurorguruḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Brahmana said – О Hari, I have come to meet you after coming to know about the construction of this astonishing city and to ask you some important questions.

## \|\| 47.95 \|\|

*brāhmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*samāgato'haṃ tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ praṣṭuṃ vacanamīpsitam \|*  
*citraṃ nagaranirmāṇaṃ samākarṇyādbhutaṃ hare \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. What is the time schedule fixed for the construction of this city or otherwise for how long Vishvakarma would be engaged in the construction work.

## \|\| 47.96 \|\|

*kativarṣaṃ ca nirmāṇe bhavānsaṃkalpito yathā \|*  
*katicittāṃ viśvakarmā nirmāṇaṃ vā kariṣyati \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. No Indra has so far resorted to this type of construction. No other Vishvakarma would be competent enough to carry out such a type of construction.

## \|\| 47.97 \|\|

*evaṃbhūtaṃ ca nirmāṇaṃ na kenaiṃdreṇa nirmitam \|*  
*naivaṃvidhaṃ sunirmāṇe viśvakarmā paraḥ kṣamaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. On hearing the words of the boy, Indra getting arrogant because of the immense riches, laughed and enquired from the boy again.

## \|\| 47.98 \|\|

*bālakasya vacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa sa sureśvaraḥ \|*  
*saṃpanmadātimattaśca punaḥ papraccha bālakam \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. "O boy how many of the Indras have you seen so far or heard about them and how many type of Vishvakarmas have been heard or seen by you. You kindly let me know in detail. On hearing the words of Indra, the Brahmana boy smiled and spoke the words which were sweet like nectar and were pleasant to listen.

## \|\| 47.99-100 \|\|

*katīṃdrāṇāṃ samūhaśca tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto'thavā \|*  
*viśvakarmā katividhastaṃ me brūhi śiśo'dhunā \|\| 99 \|\|*

*śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya viprabālakaḥ \|*  
*tamuvāca śrutisukhaṃ pīyūṣasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. Brahmana said – I am well-aware of your father who happens to be Prajapati Kashyapa. I also know your father who was the great ascetic and was Known by the name of Marichi.

## \|\| 47.101 \|\|

*brāhmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*jānāmi kaśyapaṃ tāta tava tātaṃ prajāpatim \|*  
*muniṃ marīcināmānaṃ tatrālaṃ ca taponidhim \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. I am also well-acquainted with Brahma, the lord of the gods who emerged out of the lotus, that was born from the navel of Vishnu. I have also acquaintance with Maha-Vishnu who is the protector of Sattvaguna.

## \|\| 47.102 \|\|

*nābhipadmodbhavaṃ viṣṇoḥ stutvā taṃ vidhimīśvaram \|*  
*rakṣitāraṃ ca taṃ viṣṇuṃ paraṃ sattvaguṇānvitam \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. I am also well-aware of the deluge of the ocean at the time of dissolution which looked quite terrible and was without any creatures. О Indra definitely the universe is of various types and the kalpas are also different while the Brahmandas are innumerable. In these Brahmandas several Brahmas, Vishnus, Maheshvaras and Indras have emerged, who can count their numbers but I am aware of all of them.

## \|\| 47.103-104 \|\|

*ekārṇavaṃ ca pralayaṃ sattvaśūnyaṃ bhayānakam \|*  
*sṛṣṭiṃ katividhāṃ śakra kalpaṃ katividhaṃ dhruvam \|\| 103 \|\|*

*brahmāṃḍaṃ ca katividhaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān \|*  
*brahmāṇḍeṣu katividhānindrānko gantumīśvaraḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

103-104. О best of the gods even if one is able to count the particles of dust on earth in spite of that the number of Indras cannot be counted. This is the opinion of the intellectuals.

## \|\| 47.105 \|\|

*yadi saṃkhyā'sti reṇūnāṃ dharāyāṃ ca surādhipa \|*  
*tathāpi saṃkhyā śakrāṇāṃ nāstyeveti vidurbudhāḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. The life and sovereignty of Indra is limited to four yugas. After the fall of twenty eight Indras, a day of Brahma is counted.

## \|\| 47.106 \|\|

*śakrasyāyuścādhikāro yugānāmekasaptatiḥ \|*  
*aṣṭāviṃśatiśakrāṇāṃ patane'harniśaṃ vidheḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Thus Brahma lives for hundred and eight years. The number of Brahmas also cannot be counted, what to speak of the numbers of Indras.

## \|\| 47.107 \|\|

*vidheraṣṭottaraśatamāyureva pramāṇataḥ \|*  
*sureṃdrāṇāṃ ca kā saṃkhyā nāsti saṃkhyā vidherapi \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. When the number of Brahmandas cannot be counted then how.culd one count a number of Brahmas, Vishnus and Shiva. An the hair-pits of Maha-Vishnu, the position of Brahmandas in the spotless water is the same, as a boat which floats on the waters of the river. Thus as the number of hair-pits on the body of Maha-Vishnu are innumerable, similarly the Brahmandas are also believed to be innumerable.

## \|\| 47.108-109 \|\|

*brahmāṃḍasaṃkhyā yatra kva brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|*  
*mahāviṣṇorlomakūpodbhave toye sunirmale \|\| 108 \|\|*

*brahmāṃḍe'sti yathā naukā bhavatoye ca kṛtrimā \|*  
*evaṃ lomnaḥ pramāṇena brahmāṃḍāḥ saṃtyasaṃkhyakāḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. In each one of the Brahmandas, many of the gods like you reside. In the meantime Hari looked at a large number of ants was spread over the length of a thousand bows looking at them the Brahmana boy laughed aloud but did not speak out anything, keeping quiet he looked serious. Realising about the joke of the Brahmana boy and listening to his words, Indra was immensely surprised. His throat, lips and palate dried up. Thereafter he questioned the Brahmana boy.

## \|\| 47.110-112 \|\|

*brahmāṃḍe ca katividhāḥ surāḥ saṃtyeva tvatsamāḥ \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare tatra dadarśa puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

*pipīlikāsamūhaṃ ca vyāyataṃ dhanuṣāṃ śatam \|*  
*kramaśastānsaṃnirīkṣya jahāsoccairdvijārbhakaḥ \|\| 111\|\|*

*novāca kiṃcinmaunī ca gaṃbhīraḥ sagaṇo yathā \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā hāsyaṃ vipravaṭorgāthāṃ śrutvā'tivismitaḥ \|*  
*papraccha ca punarvipraṃ śuṣkakaṃṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

110-112. Indra said – О Brahmana boy, why are laughing; you tell me the reason for it at once.

## \|\| 47.113 \|\|

*iṃdra uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ hasasi vipreṃdraṃ māṃ śīghraṃ kāraṇaṃ vada \|*  
*tvaṃ vā ko māyayā cchannaḥ śiśurūpī guṇārṇavaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. Otherwise tell me influenced by the illusion and possessing all the virtues who are you in the form of a boy?

## \|\| 47.114 \|\|

*iṃdrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca dvijārbhakaḥ \|*  
*ādhyātmikaṃ nītisāraṃ jñānabījaṃ paraṃ varam \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. On hearing the words of Indra, the Brahmana boy spoke out divine knowledge which was the form of seed for everything.

## \|\| 47.115 \|\|

*brāhmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*dṛṣṭaḥ pipīlikāsaṃgho heturasya nigūḍhakaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Brahmana said – Are you looking at the group of the ants, the reason for the same is quite deep. You don't ask me about the reason for your foolishness and grief.

## \|\| 47.116-117 \|\|

*mā māṃ pṛccha śokabījaṃ tavānyajñānakāraṇam \|*  
*sāṃsārikāṇāṃ saṃsāravṛkṣamūlanikṛṃtanam \|\| 116 \|\|*

*ajñānatamasicchannaṃ jñānadīpamanuttamam \|*  
*nigūḍhaṃ sarvavedeṣu siddhānāmapi durlabham \|\| 117 \|\|*

116-117. This is the destroyer of the roots of the tree? of the universe, surrounded by several creatures. It is covered with the darkness of foolishness. The best of the light is available in the Vedas which is beyond the reached of the siddhas, yogis and destroys the arrogance of the people.

## \|\| 47.118 \|\|

*yogināṃ prāṇatulyaṃ ca mūḍhāhaṃkārabhaṃjanam \|*  
*ityuktvā tatra saṃtasthau sasmito dvijapuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*punaḥ papraccha śakrastaṃ śuṣkakaṃṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. Thus speaking the boy who kept on smiling became mum. Than Indra whose throat, lips and palate had dried up again said to the boys.

## \|\| 47.119-120 \|\|

*śakra uvāca \|*  
*brūhi viprabaṭo śīghraṃ jñānadīpaṃ purātanam \|*  
*na jānāmi śiśuḥ kastvaṃ jñānarāśiḥ svamūrtimān \|\| 119 \|\|*

*iṃdrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā viprarūpī janārdanaḥ \|*  
*jñānaṃ bhāṣitumārebhe yogīṃdrāṇāṃ sudurlabham \|\| 120 \|\|*

119-120. Indra said – "0 Brahmana boy you enlighten me about the ancient light of the knowledge. You are the ocean of knowledge and are illustrious one. Who are you in the form of a boy, I am unable to know about you." On hearing the words of Indra the boy who was else than Janardana himself, imparted the divine knowledge to Indra which was beyond the reached of even the great yogis.

## \|\| 47.121-122 \|\|

*brāhmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sṛṣṭaḥ pipīlikāsaṃgha ekaikaḥ kramaśo mayā \|\| 121\|\|*

*sarve svakarmaṇā śakra śakrībhūtāḥ surālaye \|*  
*adhunā karmaṇā sarve kramaśo bhūtajanmanām \|\| 122 \|\|*

121-122. Brahmana said – О Indra, I have created the entire group of the ants, one by one, all these ants had been established, on a throne of Indra one by one. All of them after having been born in various yugas have currently been born as ants.

## \|\| 47.123 \|\|

*atītakāle saṃprāptā bhūtajātiṃ pipīlikām \|*  
*karmaṇā jīvino yāṃti vaikuṃṭhaṃ ca nirāmayam \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. The people achieved Vaikuntha by means of their actions and by means their karmas alone they achiever Brahmaloka and Shivaloka.

## \|\| 47.124 \|\|

*karmaṇā brahmalokaṃ ca śivalokaṃ ca karmaṇā \|*  
*svargaṃ svargasamāsthānaṃ pātālaṃ ca svakarmaṇā \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. By means of their own karmas they achieve the heaven and the nether-world which is also like heaven. By means of actions, they fall into the hell.

## \|\| 47.125-126 \|\|

*karmaṇā narakaṃ ghoraṃ svātmaduḥkhaikakāraṇam \|*  
*karmaṇā sūkarīgarbhaṃ karmaṇā kṣudrajīvanam \|\| 125 \|\|*

*karmaṇā paśupatnīnāṃ karmaṇā pakṣiyoṣitām \|*  
*karmaṇā kīṭayoniṃ ca vṛkṣatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā \|\| 126 \|\|*

125-126. With the same actions, the people are born from the womb of a pig and by the same actions they are born as degraded ones. By actions alone one achieves the womb of animals, the birds, the insects, besides the trees and becomes a lord or a slave.

## \|\| 47.127 \|\|

*svakarmaṇā sukhī duḥkhī sevyaḥ sevaka eva ca \|*  
*karmaṇā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca daivaṃ cāpi svakarmaṇā \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. By actions alone one is born as a Brahmana and a god or the position of Brahma.

## \|\| 47.128 \|\|

*svakarmaṇā ca pretatvaṃ brahmatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā \|*  
*karmaṇā vyādhiyuktaśca karmaṇevātisundaraḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. By ones' own action, one is mounted in a palanquin and with the same process, one becomes a great king. By actions alone one achieves the ailment or the beauty.

## \|\| 47.129 \|\|

*karmaṇā svāṅgahīnaśca svāṅgavṛddhaśca karmaṇā \|*  
*vidhātā karmasūtreṇa phaladātā ca jīvinām \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. By actions alone one is born without limbs or deformed or with excess of limbs, with the actions alone Brahma provides reward for the actions.

## \|\| 47.130-131 \|\|

*karma svabhāvasādhyaṃ ca svabhāvo'bhyāsajīvakaḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamādhyātmikaparaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

*sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ sāraṃ narakārṇavatārakam \|*  
*saṃsāraḥ svapnavatsarvaṃ devendra sacarācaram \|\| 131\|\|*

130-131. The actions are performed by nature and by practice. Thus I have narrated to you everything divine which bestows pleasures, merit and is the form of tattva besides relieving one of the ocean of hell. О Devendra, the entire universe irrespective of the moveable and immovable creatures is perishable.

## \|\| 47.132-133 \|\|

*mṛtyuśca mastakasthāyī sarveṣāṃ kālayogataḥ \|*  
*jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ jīvināṃ ca śubhāśubham \|\| 132 \|\|*

*śakra śaśvadbhramatyeva nāviṣṭastatra paṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktvā vipraśca tatra tasthau ca sasmitaḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

132-133. In this universe with the combination of time, the death hovers around the head of everyone. Everything of the creatures irrespective of good and bad are like the water bubbles. О Indra, the intellectuals always roam about in this world but never get attracted towards anyone. Thus speaking the Brahmana boy kept on sitting there.

## \|\| 47.134-139 \|\|

*vismitāstraidaśādhyakṣo nātmānaṃ bahu manyate \|*  
*etasminnantare śīghramājagāma munīśvaraḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

*ativṛddho mahāyogī jñānena vayasā mahān \|*  
*kṛṣṇājinī jaṭādhārī bibhrattilakamujjvalam \|\| 135 \|\|*

*vakṣaḥsthale romacakraṃ bibharti mastake kaṭam \|*  
*sthitaṃ sarvaṃ madhyadeśe kiṃcidutpāṭitaṃ sphuṭam \|\| 136 \|\|*

*samāgatya dvayormadhye tasthau sthāṇuvadeva saḥ \|*  
*mahendro brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 137 \|\|*

*madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*papraccha kuśalaṃ vipraṃ cakāra vinayaṃ punaḥ \|\| 138 \|\|*

*tuṣṭāvātithibhāvena mudā sādarapūrvakam \|*  
*viprārbhakastena sārddhaṃ saṃbhāṣāṃ ca cakāra saḥ \|*  
*svavāñchitaṃ paraṃ prāha sarvaṃ vinayapūrvakam \|\| 139 \|\|*

134-139. On hearing this Indra was immensely surprised; he stopped thinking so much of himself. In the meantime a great sage arrived there and was quite old was a great yogi and was immensely filled with knowledge. He was clad in black deer skin, had the matted lock of hair on the head, had applied bright tilakam on the forehead. He had a cakra of hair on the chest and carried a mat on his head. All his hair of the body was intact accept that a few of the hair had been pulled out. He came and stood in between the Brahmana boy and Indra like a log of wood. Finding the Brahmana there, Indra bowed in reverence to him and with his mind filled with devotion, offered him madhuparka, adoring him at the same time. Thereafter he meekly asked the Brahmana about his welfare and pleased him with his delightful welcome. Thereafter the Brahmana boy talked to him meekly to express him the feeling of his mind.

## \|\| 47.140-142 \|\|

*bālaka uvāca \|*  
*kutastvamāgato vipra kinnāma tava vā vada \|*  
*ko vā'trāgamane heturnivāsaḥ kena hetunā \|\| 140 \|\|*

*kaṭaṃ kathaṃ mastake te lomacakraṃ ca vakṣasi \|*  
*atyunnataṃ madhyadeśe kiṃcidutpāṭitaṃ mune \|\| 141\|\|*

*māṃ cetkṛpā'sti te vipra sarvaṃ saṃvyasya kathyatām \|*  
*atyadbhutamidaṃ sarvaṃ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 142 \|\|*

140-142. The boy said – "O Brahmana, where from have you arrive? What is your name and the purpose of your arrival here? Where do you live? Why are you carrying a mat over your head? О sage what does the cakra of hair on your chest represent? It is quite vast but in the middle of it some hair has been pulled out? О Brahman, in base you will be graceful to me than you tell me in detail. I am getting anxious to know about this astonishing reality."

## \|\| 47.143 \|\|

*sa śiśorvacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*sarvaṃ svakīyavṛttāntaṃ śakrasya purato mudā \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. On hearing the words of the boy, the great sage revealed before Indra delightfully, his story.

## \|\| 47.144 \|\|

*muniruvāca \|*  
*alpāyuṣā mayā vipra kutrāpi na kṛtā gṛhāḥ \|*  
*na vivāhaścopajīvyaṃ bhikṣopajīvinā'dhunā \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. The sage said – О Brahmana, my life is going to end shortly. Therefore, I have not built up any house anywhere. I am not married nor I have arranged for my living. Now a days, I live on charities of others.

## \|\| 47.145 \|\|

*lomaśeti ca mannāma heturviprasya darśanam \|*  
*varṣaṇātapaśāntyarthaṃ mastakasthaṃ kaṭaṃ mama \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. My name is Lomasa, I have arrived here to have an audience with the Brahmana. I have placed the mat on my head, in order to protect myself from the rain and the sun-shine.

## \|\| 47.146 \|\|

*vakṣasthalasthitaṃ romacakraṃ tatkāraṇaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*sāṃsārikāṇāṃ bhayadaṃ vivekajananaṃ param \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. The circle of hair over my chest has a reason behind it, which would be fearful for the people of the universe but enlightens the intellectuals.

## \|\| 47.147 \|\|

*āyuḥsaṃkhyāpramāṇaṃ me lomacakraṃ ca vakṣasi \|*  
*śakraikapatanaṃ vipra lomaikotpāṭanaṃ mama \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. This cakra of my chest is indicative of my age. О Brahmana with the fall of an Indra a hair from my chest is pulled out.

## \|\| 47.148 \|\|

*utpāditāni lomāni tena madhye sthitāni ca \|*  
*brahmaṇo dviparārdhe ca mama mṛtyurnirūpitaḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Similarly many of the hair from the cakra have been pulled out. In spite of that, many of them still remain, with the completion of the second half of Brahma's life, my death has been destined.

## \|\| 47.149 \|\|

*asaṃkhyavidhayo brahmanmariṣyanti mṛtā api \|*  
*kalatreṇa ca putreṇa gṛheṇa kiṃ prayojanam \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. Innumerable Brahmas have met with their end and would also die in future, I am the least concerned, with the men and women or a houses.

## \|\| 47.150 \|\|

*brahmaṇaḥ patane cakṣurnimeṣaśca harerbhavet \|*  
*tatpādapadmamatulaṃ cintayāmi niraṃtaram \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. With the fall of Brahma Vishnu, winks but once. Therefore I always devote my mind at his foots like feet.

## \|\| 47.151 \|\|

*durlabhaṃ śrīharerdāsyaṃ bhaktirmuktirgarīyasī \|*  
*svapnavatsarvamaiśvaryaṃ tadbhaktivyavadhāyakam \|\| 151\|\|*

151\. The slavehood of the feet of lord Hari is difficult to get which is greater than the devotion and the salvation. The entire fortunes are like a dream and obstruct in achieving the devotion of the lord.

## \|\| 47.152 \|\|

*idaṃ madguruṇā dattaṃ śaṃbhunā jñānamuttamam \|*  
*vinā bhaktiṃ na gṛhṇāmi sālokyādicatuṣṭayam \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. This is the best of the knowledge which was bestowed on me by Shiva who happens to be my teacher because of which without his devotion I am not interested in achieving Salokya and other types of salvation.

## \|\| 47.153 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sa munirjagāma śivasannidhim \|*  
*śiśurūpī haristatraivāntardhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. Thus speaking the sage went to the abode of Shiva and Shiva in the form of Vishnu also disappeared from the place.

## \|\| 47.154-155 \|\|

*indrastu svapnavaddṛṣṭvā babhūva tatra vismitaḥ \|*  
*tṛṣṇāmātraṃ ca saṃpattau nāstyeva parameśvare \|\| 154 \|\|*

*viśvakarmāṇamānīya priyamuktvā śatakratuḥ \|*  
*dattvā ratnāni saṃpūjya taṃ prasthāpitavāngṛham \|\| 155 \|\|*

154-155. Indra looked at the whole scene like a dream and was immensely surprised now he had no desire left for the property. He immediately called for Vishvakarma and talking to him lovingly, presented to him innumerable gems beside honouring him and sent him back to his abode.

## \|\| 47.156 \|\|

*sarvaṃ vinyasya putre ca śaraṇaṃ gantumudyataḥ \|*  
*śacīṃ rājyaśriyaṃ tyaktvā vivekī kṣayakāmukaḥ \|\| 156 \|\|*

156\. He than thought of giving everything to his son and to take refuge with the lord his intelligence woke up and disowning Shachi and Raja-Lakshmi, he became desirous of the reduction of his fate.

## \|\| 47.157 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā vivekinaṃ kāntaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā \|*  
*śacī jagāma śokārtā saṃtrastā śaraṇaṃ guroḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

157\. On the other hand, Indrani found that her husband was expressing his pain of the heart and had taken the shelter of intelligence, she was upset with grief and getting afraid went to the teacher to take refuge with him.

## \|\| 47.158 \|\|

*sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ kṛtvā samānīya bṛhaspatim \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa śakraṃ taṃ nītisāreṇa kāminī \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. She narrated the entire story and brought him to her abode. She somehow enlightened Indra on polity.

## \|\| 47.159 \|\|

*guroḥ śāstraviśeṣaṃ ca dampatīrasasaṃyutam \|*  
*vidhāya ca svayaṃ prītyā pāṭhayāmāsa taṃ mudā \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. The sage Brihaspati taught them the scriptures on the love for the couples which was himself composed by him.

## \|\| 47.160 \|\|

*muniḥ śāstraviśeṣaṃ ca bodhayāmāsa vākpatiḥ \|*  
*sa cakāra tadā rājyaṃ vṛndāvana vinodini \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. Brihaspati communicated the gist of the scriptures quite carefully to Indra. О cowherdess of VmdSvana, thereafter Indra started ruling as before.

## \|\| 47.161 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śakradarpavimocanam \|*  
*sākṣāddṛṣṭo darpabhaṅgo nandayajñe sureśvari \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. О great goddess now I have narrated to you the about the shattering of the pride of Indra you have yourself witnessed the waves in which the pride of Indra was shattered in the yajha of Nanda.

## Chapter 48

## \|\| 48.1 \|\|

*śrīrādhikovāca \|*  
*kathito bhavatā mahyaṃ darpabhaṅgaḥ śruto hareḥ \|*  
*darpabhaṅagaṃ raveścāpi śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Radhika said – You have narrated to me the episodes relating to the shattering of the pride of Indra but now I would like to listen to the episode relating to the shattering of the pride of Sflrya.

## \|\| 48.2-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadaivodayaṃ kṛtvā ravirastaṃ jagāma ha \|*  
*mālī sumālī daityendrau dīptiṃ kartuṃ samudyatau \|\| 2 \|\|*

*mahāsaṃpanmadonmattau śaṃkarasya vareṇa ca \|*  
*tayośca prabhayā rātrirna bhavediti sundari \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Shri Krishna said – Once the sun was set after rising but the two demons Mall and Sumall started illuminating the earth like the sun-shine. Both the demons with the boons of Shiva had become quite powerful and were intoxicated. Because of the lustre emerging from their bodies, The night's ceased to exist.

## \|\| 48.4 \|\|

*ruṣṭaḥ sūryaḥ svaśūlena tau jaghānāvalīlayā \|*  
*patitau sūryaśūlena mūrcchitau dharaṇītale \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. At this the sun was immensely enraged and he attacked both of them with a trident. Having been wounded with the trident of the sun, both of them fainted and fall down on earth.

## \|\| 48.5 \|\|

*bhaktāpāyaṃ ca vijñāya śaṃkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*āgatya jīvayāmāsa mahājñānena tau vibhuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Shiva finding the destruction of their devotees, arrived there and with the application of his divine knowledge, he revived them back to their lives.

## \|\| 48.6-7 \|\|

*tau ca natvā śivaṃ bhaktyā jagmaturnijamandiram \|*  
*dudrāva ca mahādevaḥ sūryaṃ hantuṃ ruṣā jvalan \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā saṃhārakartāraṃ jighāṃsantaṃ haraṃ raviḥ \|*  
*bhiyā palāyamānaśca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Both of them bowed in reverence to Shiva and went back to their respective, abodes. In the meantime Shiva getting immensely annoyed started following. Surya in order to destroy him. Surya realised that Shiva, the destroyer of the universe himself intends to destroy him. The panic-stricken Surya rushed to Brahma and took refuge with him.

## \|\| 48.8 \|\|

*dudrāva ca mahādevo brahmaṇo nilayaṃ ruṣā \|*  
*śūlamatyarthamudyamya kālakālo vidhervidhiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Thereafter, Shiva carrying the trident attacked the place of Brahma. Shiva happens to be the death for the death and is also Brahma for Brahma.

## \|\| 48.9 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā brahmā haraṃ ruṣṭaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|*  
*caturvaktreṇa vedoktastotreṇa jagatāṃ patiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Finding lord Shiva having been annoyed he started offering prayer by vedic hymns to him from his four mouths.

## \|\| 48.10 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*prasīda dakṣayajñaghna sūryaṃ maccharaṇāgatam \|*  
*tvayaiva sṛṣṭaṃ sṛṣṭeśca samārambhe jagadguro \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Brahma said – О teacher of the universe, you are the destroyer of the yajna of Daksha and creator of the entire universe, therefore, you be pleased with Surya who has taken refuge with me.

## \|\| 48.11 \|\|

*āśutoṣa mahābhāga prasīda bhaktavatsala \|*  
*kṛpayā ca kṛpāsindho rakṣa rakṣa divāniśam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. You are graceful on devotees, О virtuous one, you get pleased easily and are the ocean of mercy be pleased with us and protect Surya.

## \|\| 48.12 \|\|

*brahmasvarūpa bhagavansṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇa \|*  
*svayaṃ raviṃ ca nirmāya svayaṃ saṃhartumicchasi \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. O lord, you are the form of Brahman and are responsible for the preservation and destruction. The sun had been created by you and now you yourself intend to destroy it.

## \|\| 48.13 \|\|

*svayaṃ brahmā svayaṃ śeṣo dharmaḥ sūryo hutāśanaḥ \|*  
*indracaṃdrādayo devāstvatto bhītāḥ parātpara \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You are yourself Brahma, Shesha, Dharma, Surya and Agni. You are the one who is beyond everything, the moon and all other gods are afraid of you.

## \|\| 48.14-15 \|\|

*ṛṣayo munayaścaiva tvāṃ niṣevya tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*tapasāṃ phaladātā tvaṃ tapastvaṃ tapasāṃ phalam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ityevamuktvā brahmā taṃ sūryamānīya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*prītyā samarpayāmāsa śaṅkare dīnavatsale \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The ascetics and recluses, earn the title of Tapodhanas after serving you. You are the bestower of the reward of tapas, the form of tapas and also are the form of the reward of tapas. Thus speaking Brahma carried Surya and placed him at the feet of Shiva with great devotion.

## \|\| 48.16 \|\|

*śaṃbhustamāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā vidhiṃ natvā jagadvidhiḥ \|*  
*prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānālayaṃ prayayau mudā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thereafter, Shiva the creator of the universe pronounced his blessing to Sflrya and with a delightful mind bowing at the feet of Brahma reverted to his abode.

## \|\| 48.17 \|\|

*iti dhātṛkṛtaṃ stotraṃ saṃkaṭe yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*bhayātpramucyate bhīto baddho mucyeta bandhanāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The one who recites this stotra composed by Brahma for Shiva at the time of danger, he is relieved of all the dangers and is relieved of all fetters.

## \|\| 48.18 \|\|

*rājadvāre śmaśāne ca magnapote mahārṇave \|*  
*stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Whosoever recites this stotra in the royal courts cremation grounds after breaking of the ship in the ocean, he is surely relieved of all the dangers and meets with success.

## Chapter 49

## \|\| 49.1-2 \|\|

*. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sūryaḥ praṇamya brahmāṇaṃ mudāyuktastadājñayā \|*  
*cakāra vinayaṃ prītyā tejasvī triguṇātmakaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*atha vahnerupākhyānaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya \|*  
*gopanīyaṃ purāṇeṣu karṇapīyūṣamuttamam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Shri Krishna said – Surya who happens to be Trigundtmaka and the illustrious one bowed in reverence to Brahma and at his command shedding his pride started behaving in a docile manner. Now you listen to the story of Agni quite carefully. This story is quite secretive in the Puranas and serve as a nectar and is the best for the ears.

## \|\| 49.3-4 \|\|

*trailokyaṃ bhasmasātkartumekadā'gniḥ samudyataḥ \|*  
*śatatālapramāṇāntāṃ śikhāṃ kṛtvā bhayānakīm \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kṣubhitaḥ kupitaścaiva bhṛgoḥ śāpasya kāraṇāt \|*  
*svaṃ ca tejasvinaṃ matvā tucchaṃ matvā'nyamātmanaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Once Agni, the god of fire got ready to reduce the three lokas to ashes. At that point of time his flame were rising to the height of hundred tala trees. He had been enraged getting upset with the curse of Bhrigu. Thinking himself to be an extremely illustrious one he thought others to be of no consequence.

## \|\| 49.5 \|\|

*etasminnantare viṣṇurājagāmāvalīlayā \|*  
*vahnestāṃ dāhikīṃ śaktiṃ tāṃ jahāra puraḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In the meantime, Vishnu arrived there and standing before him Agni took away the power of Agni to burn.

## \|\| 49.6 \|\|

*māyayā śiśurūpī ca tamuvāca janārdanaḥ \|*  
*sasmito vinayaṃ kṛtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Having the form of a boy by his illution, lord Janardana told him smilingly and gently with devotion.

## \|\| 49.7 \|\|

*śiśuruvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ ruṣṭo'si bhagavanbhavānmāṃ kāraṇaṃ vada \|*  
*trailokyaṃ bhasmasātkartumudyato'si nirarthakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The boy said – О lord, why are you annoyed you tell me the reason for it? Why have you got ready to bum the three worlds for nothing.

## \|\| 49.8 \|\|

*tvameva bhṛguṇā śapto bhṛgośca damanaṃ kuru \|*  
*ekāparādhāttrailokyaṃ bhasmīkartuṃ na cārhasi \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Bhrigu has pronounced a curse on you, therefore you can suppress Bhrigu, how far is it justified to destroy all the three worlds for the fault of one person?

## \|\| 49.9 \|\|

*viśvaṃ ca brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaṃ tasya pātā svayaṃ hariḥ \|*  
*saṃhartā bhagavānrudra evameva kramo bhavet \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Brahma has created this world and Vishnu is the preserver of the same, the responsibility for destruction of the universe rests with Shiva this is the order prescribed since the time immemorial.

## \|\| 49.10 \|\|

*tatkathaṃ bhasmasātkartumīśvare śaṃkare sthite \|*  
*rakṣitāraṃ hariṃ jitvā saṃhāraṃ kuru satvaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

## Chapter 51

## \|\| 51.1-2 \|\|

1-2. Shri Krishna said – Lord Dhanvantari himself is a great personality and represents the amsa of Narayana. In earlier times, he emerged from the churning of the ocean. He was well-versed in all the Vedas beside the mantras and the tantras. He happened to be the pupil of Garuda and the small pupil of Shiva.

## \|\| 51.3-6 \|\|

*śiṣyāṇāṃ ca sahasreṇa gataḥ kailāsamīśvari \|*

At the sight of this, the proud pupils of Dhanvantari started laughing, he with the use of the terrific mantra made the serpent Taksaka motionless and deprived it of the poison. He took out the gem-studded in its hoods and holding it in his hand he moved it round and round and then threw it far away.

*nāgalakṣasamāyuktaṃ siddhamantreṇa mantritam \|*  
*prerayāmāsa kopena kālāntakasamaprabham \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Finding her sakti having been rendered infructuous, the goddess started burning in rage. She than took in her hand, the indestructible Nagapasha having in lakh of Nagas and muttering the mantras she sanctified the same which was quite illustrious and she shot it in anger.

## \|\| 51.39 \|\|

*dhanvatarirnāgapāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sasmito mudā \|*  
*sasmāra garuḍaṃ tūrṇamājagāma khageśvaraḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Dhanvantari finding the Nagapasa there, smiled for a while and remembered Garuda who arrived there at once.

## \|\| 51.40 \|\|

*sarpāstramāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā garuḍo harivāhanaḥ \|*  
*vidhāya cañcunā śīghraṃ bubhuje kṣudhitaściram \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Finding the weapon of serpent shot by mantra Garuda who was quite himgry for a long time cut into the pieces all the snakes and ate them up.

## \|\| 51.41-44 \|\|

*nāgāstraṃ niṣphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā koparaktekṣaṇā bhṛśam \|*  
*jagrāha bhasmamuṣṭiṃ ca śivadattāṃ purā priye \|\| 41 \|\|*

*bhasmamuṣṭiṃ mantrapūtāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca preritāṃ yathā \|*  
*pakṣavātena cikṣepa śiṣyaṃ paścānnidhāya ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

*nirastāṃ bhasmamuṣṭiṃ ca dṛṣṭvā devī cukopa ha \|*  
*jagrāha śūlamavyarthaṃ hantuṃ dhanvantariṃ svayam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*śivadattaṃ ca śūlaṃ ca śatasūryasamaprabham \|*  
*avyarthaśūlaṃ lokeṣu pralayāgnisamaprabham \|\| 44 \|\|*

41-44. О dear, when the Nagapasha was found infructous the eyes of goddess Manasa became red. She took out a handful of ashes which were given to her by Shiva in earlier times. She threw away the ashes given to her by Shiva after muttering the mantras. Garuda finding the ashes having been thrown over at by Dhanvantari he covered him with the spread of his wings and shattered the entire ashes. At the sight of this the goddess Manasa started burning in rage. She then took up the infallible trident given to her by Shiva, in her hand for the purpose of killing Dhanvantari. The infallible trident had the lustre of hundreds of suns and was illumining like the fire of the dissolution.

## \|\| 51.45 \|\|

*atha brahmā tathā śaṃbhurājagāma raṇājiram \|*  
*dhanvaṃtareśca rakṣārthaṃ śamanārthaṃ khagasya ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Thereafter for the protection of Dhanvantari and in pacifying Garuda Brahma and Shiva also arrived in the battle-field.

## \|\| 51.46 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā śaṃbhuṃ jagadgaurī vidhiṃ ca jagatāṃ patim \|*  
*bhaktyā nanāma tāveva niḥśaṅkā śūladhāriṇī \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Manias was standing fearlessly holding the trident in her hand and finding Brahma and Shiva there, she bowed in reverence to both of them.

## \|\| 51.47 \|\|

*dhanvantariśca garuḍaḥ praṇanāma sureśvarau \|*  
*tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā tau ca cakraturāśiṣam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Dhanvantari and Garuda on the other hand also offered their salutation to them and with their mind filled with devotion offered prayers to them. Both of them showered their blessing on them.

## \|\| 51.48 \|\|

*uvāca brahmā madhuraṃ hitaṃ dhanvatariṃ mudā \|*  
*pūjārthaṃ manasāyāśca lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. For the welfare of the people and for the adoration of goddess Manasa Brahma spoke very sweet and beneficial words to Dhanvantari.

## \|\| 51.49 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*dhanvaṃtare mahābhāga sarvaśāstraviśārada \|*  
*raṇaṃ te manasā sārddhaṃ na hi sāmyaṃ ca me matam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Brahma said – О virtuous one, О Dhanvantari, you are well-verged in all the scriptures. According to our opinion, it is not proper for you to fight with goddess Manasa.

## \|\| 51.50-52 \|\|

*śivadattena śūlena durnivāryeṇa sarvataḥ \|*  
*trailokyaṃ bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣameyaṃ tridaśeśvarī \|\| 50 \|\|*

*dhyāne kauthumaśākhoktaṃ kṛtvā bhaktyā samāhitaḥ \|*  
*dattvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ devyāśca kuru pūjanam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*āstikoktena stotreṇa stavanaṃ kartumarhasi \|*  
*parituṣṭā ca manasā varaṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyati \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. She is the great goddess and can destroy the three worlds with the use of the trident given to her by Shiva, with a devoted mind you adore her according to the method prescribed in the Kauthuma-shakha ' which sixteen types of offerings. You should adore her by reciting the stotra composed by AstJka. The goddess Manasa would pronounce a boon on you after getting pleased with your devotion.

## \|\| 51.53 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā cakārānumatiṃ śivaḥ \|*  
*vainateyaśca saṃprītyā bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Listening to the words of Brahma, Shiva also supported him and tried to convince Dhanvantari speaking loving words.

## \|\| 51.54 \|\|

*eṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā snātvā śuciralaṃkṛtaḥ \|*  
*vidhiṃ purohitaṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. On listening to the words of all of them, Dhanvantari took his bath and getting purified, making Brahma to serve as a priest, he started adoring goddess Manasa.

## \|\| 51.55 \|\|

*dhanvantariruvāca \|*  
*ihāgaccha jagadgauri gṛhāṇa mama pūjanam \|*  
*pūjyā tvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu purā kaśyapakanyake \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Dhanvantari said – О Jagadgauri, you arrive here and accept my adoration. О daughter of Kashyapa, you are already adored in all the three worlds.

## \|\| 51.56 \|\|

*tvayā jitaṃ jagatsarvaṃ devi viṣṇusvarūpayā \|*  
*tena te'straprayogaśca na kṛto raṇabhūmiṣu \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. О goddess, you have won the entire universe with the form of Vishnu, that is why you have not used the weapon in the battle-field.

## \|\| 51.57 \|\|

*ityuktyā saṃyato bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ \|*  
*gṛhītvā śuklakusumaṃ dhyānaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Thus sneaking with apt attention and. the mind filled with devotion, bowing before her, he offered white flowers to her and started meditating.

## \|\| 51.58-60 \|\|

*cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ sarvāṅgasumanoharām \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śobhitāṃ sūkṣmavāsasā \|\| 58 \|\|*

*sucārukabarīśobhāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*sarvābhayapradāṃ devīṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sarvavidyāpradāṃ śāntāṃ sarvavidyāviśāradām \|*  
*nāgendravāhinīṃ devīṃ bhaje nāgeśvarīṃ parām \|\| 60 \|\|*

58-60. She had the complexion of white campaka flowers having all the beautiful limbs, wearing a smile on the face, clad in fine garments, having the beautiful tuft of hair, adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments, She provides protection to all, having divine form, being compassionate on the devotees, bestower of the knowledge, having the peaceful mind possessing all the knowledge, using the Nagas as the vehicle the mistress of the Nagas. I adore you.

## \|\| 51.61 \|\|

*dhyātvaivaṃ kusumaṃ dattvā nānādravyasamanvitam \|*  
*dattvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ pūjayāmāsa tāṃ priye \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. О dear one, Dhanvantari adored goddess Manasa offering flowers and besides sixteen types of articles.

## \|\| 51.62 \|\|

*stotraṃ cakāra yatnācca pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Thereafter getting filled with emotions he bowed in reverence to her with folded hands and offered prayers to her.

## \|\| 51.63 \|\|

*dhanvatariruvāca \|*  
*namaḥ siddhisvarūpāyai siddhidāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*namaḥ kaśyapakanyāyai varadāyai namo namaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Dhanvantari said – О offer my salutation to goddess Manasa who is the form of success and bestows success, I offer my Salutation to her again and again. I offer my salutation to the daughter of Kashyapa, she bestows the boon, I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 51.64 \|\|

*namaḥ śaṃkarakanyāyai śaṃkarāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*namaste nāgavāhinyai nāgeśvaryai namo namaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. I bow in reverence to the daughter of Shiva, the form of Shiva and the one who uses Nagas as the vehicle, I bow in reverence to the goddess of the Nagas.

## \|\| 51.65 \|\|

*nama āstīkajanani jananyai jagatāṃ mama \|*  
*namo jagatkāraṇāyai jaratkārustriyai namaḥ \|\| 65\|\|*

65\. I bow in reverence to the mother of Astlka and the mother of the universe. You are the cause of the universe, I offer my salutation to you. You are the wife of Jaratkaru, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 51.66 \|\|

*namo nāgabhaginyai ca yoginyai ca namo namaḥ \|*  
*namaściraṃ tapasvinyai sukhadāyai namo namaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. You are the sister of Nagas, I offer my salutation to you. О yoginl, I offer my salutation to you again and again. I offer my salutation to the one who performed tapas for a long time. I offer my salutation to the one who provides all the pleasures.

## \|\| 51.67 \|\|

*namastapasyārūpāyai phaladāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*suśīlāyai ca sādhvyai ca śāntāyai ca namo namaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. I offer my salutation to the one who is the form of tapas and provides the result of the same. I offer my salutation to her again and again. The one who is immensely noble, chaste and peaceful, I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 51.68 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā bhaktyā ca praṇanāma prayatnataḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭā devī varaṃ dattvā satvaraṃ svālayaṃ yayau \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Thus speaking he bowed in reverence to her with his mind filled with devotion. The goddess on her part was pleased with him and pronouncing a boon on him went back to her abode.

## \|\| 51.69-70 \|\|

*brahmarudravainateyāḥ samājagmurnijālayam \|*  
*dhanvaṃtariśca bhagavāñjagāma nijamandiram \|\| 69 \|\|*

*jagmurnāgāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca phaṇārājivirājitāḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ stavarājaṃ mayā tava \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. Thereafter Brahma, Shiva and Garuda also went back to their respective abodes. The lord Dhanvantari also left for his abode. The Nagas having the hoods also delightfully went back to their abodes. Thus I have narrated to you the best of the stories.

## \|\| 51.71 \|\|

*vidhinā mātaraṃ bhaktimāstīkaśca cakāra ha \|*  
*tadā tuṣṭā jagadgaurī putraṃ taṃ munipuṃgavam \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The sage Astlka adored his mother with devotion. Thereafter, JagadGauri was pleased with her son.

## \|\| 51.72 \|\|

*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*vaṃśajānāṃ nāgabhayaṃ nāsti tasya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Who ever recites this stotra which is quite an auspicious one, with devotions all the people of his race are freed from the danger of the serpent. There is no doubt about it.

## Chapter 52

## \|\| 52.1-2 \|\|

*. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ darpabhaṅgaśca kathitaśca śrutastvayā \|*  
*kṣudrāṇāṃ mahatāṃ caiva kṛta eva na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*adhunā ca samuttiṣṭha gaccha vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|*  
*gopikā virahārtāśca śīghraṃ paśyāmi sundari \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Shri Krishna said – О beautiful one, I have described about the shattering of the pride of all the big and small people which has been listened by you. There is no doubt about it. now get up go to Vmdavana and I have to meet the cowherdesses who are suffering from separation.

## \|\| 52.3 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā māninī rasikeśvarī \|*  
*uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ naya māṃ na śaktā gaṃtumīśvara \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Narayana said – On hearing the words of Shri Kfsna, the proud Radha spoke to him, "O Lord I am unable to walk, therefore you carry me.".

## \|\| 52.4-7 \|\|

*rādhikā vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*māmāruhetyevamuktvā so'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 4 \|\|*

*sā manoyāyinī rādhā kṛtvā ca rodanaṃ kṣaṇam \|*  
*itastatastamanveṣya vṛndāraṇyaṃ jagāma sā \|\| 5\|\|*

*viveśa candanavanaṃ rudantī śokakātarā \|*  
*dadarśa gopikāstatra śokārtā bhayavihvalāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tāmrāsyā pūrṇanayanā bhramantī sarvakānanam \|*  
*nātha nātheti kurvantīrnirāhārā ruṣā'nvitāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. Listening to the words of Radhika lord MadhusQdana smiled and said, "You climb on me." Thus speaking the lord disappeared from the place. Finding this Radha lamented for a while. Thereafter searching for him here and there, she went to Vmdavana. Entering in the forest of sandal-wood she went on crying and got disgusted. She then looked at the cowherdesses who were filled with grief, upset with fear, having red faces and unstable eyes. She went on roaming from one forest, to the others crying uttering the name of lord. She did not eat anything and was quite angry.

## \|\| 52.8 \|\|

*tā dṛṣṭvā rādhikā sā ca premavicchedakātarā \|*  
*kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ malayabhramaṇādikam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Feeling disgusted in separation from love, she narrated the story of her roaming about over the Malaya mountain.

## \|\| 52.9-10 \|\|

*tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ ca sā rādhā ruroda virahāturā \|*  
*hā nāthanāthetyuccārya vilapya ca muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vinindya kṛṣṇaṃ kopena tarjayāmāsa ca kṣaṇam \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ śarīramutsraṣṭuṃ kopātsarvāḥ samudyatāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Thereafter, Radhika who was upset because of her separation, started crying with others saying, "O lord". She went on lamenting again and again denouncing Krishna. An anger she started beating her breasts and in a moment she got ready to end her life.

## \|\| 52.11 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare kṛṣṇastatra candanakānane \|*  
*svātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa rādhikāṃ gopikāgaṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In the meantime lord Kisna appeared before Radhika and all the cowherdesses in the forest of sandal-wood.

## \|\| 52.12 \|\|

*rādhā gopāṅganābhiśca dṛṣṭvā prāṇeśvaraṃ mudā \|*  
*sasmitā ca pradudrāva pulakāñcitavigrahā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Finding her lord present there together with the cowherdesses, Radhika felt delighted; her body was filled with emotions. Displaying a serene smile on the face, she rushed towards him.

## \|\| 52.13-14 \|\|

*tūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samāśliṣya jahāra muralīṃ ruṣā \|*  
*mālāṃ ca pītavasanaṃ bhagnaṃ kṛtvā ca māninī \|\| 13 \|\|*

*punaḥ saṃdhārayāmāsa vastraṃ mālāṃ manoharām \|*  
*vinodamuralīṃ tuṣṭā vṛndāvanavinodinī \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. She at once embraced Krishna and snatching away his flute, the rosary and pitambara, she unrobed him. After getting satisfied Radha, who enjoyed in the Vrindavana, returned to Krishna his robes, rosary and the flute.

## \|\| 52.15 \|\|

*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ cakāra tam \|*  
*muhurmuhurmukhaṃ vīkṣya cucumba paramādaram \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. She than pasted the paste of sandal-wood, aguru, kastiirl and saffron on his body and started kissing his face again and again, looking at the same.

## \|\| 52.16 \|\|

*kṣaṇaṃ saṃtarjayāmāsa kṣaṇaṃ stotraṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tasmai mudā dadau \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. In a moment she denounced him in an another moment she praised him. Still in another moment she offered fragrant betel with camphor to him.

## \|\| 52.17-19 \|\|

*atha gopāṅganāḥ sarvā ruruduḥ premavihvalāḥ \|*  
*sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakruḥ svaduḥkhaṃ virahodbhavam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dehatyāgaṃ ca snānaṃ ca svāhārasya visarjanam \|*  
*vanevane'harniśaṃ ca śaśvadbhramaṇameva ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ taṃ bhartsayāmāsuḥ stotraṃ cakruḥ kṣaṇaṃ mudā \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ dadurbhūṣaṇaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ tasmai ca candanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Thereafter infatuated with love, all the cowherdesses narrated their mental agony because of the separation. In the next moment the cowherdesses started denouncing him and in another moment getting pleased they started praising him. In a moment they adorned him with all the ornaments and in an other-moment they applied the sandal-paste on his body.

## \|\| 52.20 \|\|

*kāścidūcuḥ prāṇacoraṃ paśya rakṣeti saṃtatam \|*  
*evaṃ punarna karttavya maneneti ca kāścana \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Someone of them said, "Look he is the chief and our lives, you keep a guard on him always he should not disappear now.".

## \|\| 52.21 \|\|

*kāścidūcurimaṃ madhye yūyaṃ kuruta satvaram \|*  
*nibaddhaṃ premapāśena hṛdaye ceti kāścana \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Someone said, "All of you should surround him from all sides". Someone said, "Binding him with the fetters of love you keep him in your heart."

## \|\| 52.22 \|\|

*kāścidūcurayaṃ nāsti pratītirna kadācana \|*  
*yatnāccetanacoraṃ ca paśya paśyeti kāścana \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Someone said, "Never believe in him further." Some said, "He is the chief of the mind, therefore look at him again and again.".

## \|\| 52.23 \|\|

*kāścidūcurniṣṭhuro'yaṃ naraghātīti kopataḥ \|*  
*na punarvadate māṃ ca kāścaneti ca nārada \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Someone said, "Getting angry he is heartless and killer of the humans". Someone said, "He is net talking to me".

## \|\| 52.24 \|\|

*nirjanāni ca ramyāṇi yāni yāni vanāni ca \|*  
*bhrameyurgopikāstāni kṛṣṇena saha kautukāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. All the cowherds and cowherdesses should roamed about in all the charming places with Krishna play fully.

## \|\| 52.25 \|\|

*evaṃ taṃ gopikāḥ sarvā madhye kṛtvā sadīśvaram \|*  
*yayurvanāntare yatra suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|\| 25\|\|*

25\. Thus thinking all the cowherdesses surrounded lord Krishna from all the sides in charming Rasamandala and proceeded to that place.

## \|\| 52.26 \|\|

*rāsaṃ gatvā svarṇapīṭhe tasthau sa rasikeśvaraḥ \|*  
*niśi bhāti yathā''kāśe candrastārāgaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Reaching there, lord Krishna was seated on the lion-throne and appeared like the moon surrounded by the stars in the sky.

## \|\| 52.27 \|\|

*nānāmūrtīrvidhāyātra saha tābhirjanārdanaḥ \|*  
*cakāra ca punaḥ krīḍāṃ kāmukīnāṃ manoharām \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Thereafter Janardana multiplied himself into many forms and enjoyed the love-sport with the cowherdess which are liked by the passionate damsels.

## \|\| 52.28-29 \|\|

*svayaṃ rādhāṃ kare dhṛtvā pūrvoktaṃ ratimandiram \|*  
*viśvakarmavinirmāṇamāruroha smarāturaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ suvāsitam \|*  
*tatra campakatalpe sa suṣvāpa ca tayā saha \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Thereafter, passionate Krishna holding the hand of Radha reached in the pleasure-chamber which was built by Vishvakarma and had the fragrance of sandal-paste, aguru, kastiirl and saffron. He then enjoyed the company of Radha on the bed of campaka flowers.

## \|\| 52.30 \|\|

*nānāprakāraśṛṅgāraṃ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ \|*  
*cakāra kāmī krīḍāṃ ca kāminyā saha kautukī \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Krishna was well-versed in the love-sports and the Scriptures on love and he enjoyed the conjugal pleasures in many ways.

## \|\| 52.31 \|\|

*babhūva suratistatra suciraṃ ca tayormune \|*  
*ratiniṣṭhā tayo ramyā viratirnāsti tatkṣaṇam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О sage, thus both of them were engaged in each other companies for a long time. At that point of time their attraction towards the conjugal-pleasures could not be subsided.

## \|\| 52.32 \|\|

*evaṃ tau tasthatustatra rādhākṛṣṇau rasotsukau \|*  
*tasthustā gopikābhiśca suratau kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thus Krishna was always anxious for love-sport and he in many forms enjoyed the company of the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 52.33 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*ādau rādhāṃ samuccārya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*nimittamasya māṃ bhaktaṃ vada bhaktajanapriya \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Narada said – О loveable by the devotees, why do the people recite the name of Radha first and than of Krishna. What is the reason behind it. You kindly tell me. Who happens to be a true devotee of the lord.

## \|\| 52.34-35 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*nimittamasya trividhaṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya \|*  
*jaganmātā ca prakṛtiḥ puruṣaśca jagatpitā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*garīyasī trijagatāṃ mātā śataguṇaiḥ pituḥ \|*  
*rādhākṛṣṇeti gaurīśetyevaṃ śabdaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Shri Kysna said – I am going to speak out three reasons to you. you listen to them. First of all Prakriti happens to be the mother of the universe and Purusa is the father of the universe. In all the three worlds the glory of the mother is hundred times more than that of the father, that is why the terms of Radha, Krishna and Gaurisa, is used in the Vedas.

## \|\| 52.36-41 \|\|

*kṛṣṇarādheśagaurīti loke na ca kadā śrutaḥ \|*  
*prasīda rohiṇīcandra gṛhāṇārghyamidaṃ mama \|\| 36 \|\|*

*gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ saṃjñayā saha bhāskara \|*  
*prasīda kamalākānta gṛhāṇa mama pūjanam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*iti dṛṣṭaṃ sāmavede kauthume munisattama \|*  
*rāśabdoccāraṇādeva sphīto bhavati mādhavaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*dhāśabdoccārataḥ paścāddhāvatyeva sasaṃbhramaḥ \|*  
*ādau puruṣamuccārya paścātprakṛtimuccaret \|\| 39 \|\|*

*sa bhavenmātṛghātī ca vedātikramaṇe mune \|*  
*trailokye bhārataṃ dhanyaṃ karmakṣetraṃ ca puṇyadam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tato vṛndāvanaṃ puṇyaṃ rādhāpādābjareṇunā \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ ca vedhasā \|*  
*rādhikā caraṇāmbhojapādareṇūpalabdhaye \|\| 41 \|\|*

36-41. Even in the universe no body recited the name of Krishna RSdha and IsaGauri is never heard. Even for others the terms Rohinlchandra and Surya with Sanjna is. never heard of. you accept this meaning of mind and be happy. О lord of Kamala, you accent my adoration and be happy. This is what has been recited. Therefore О best of the sages, in Kauthuml-sakha of the Samaveda, it has been prescribed like this. With the reciting of the word TT Madhava gets ready and with the reciting of 41 he runs after following her. О sage, the one who recites the name of Purusa first and Prakriti later on, he desecrates the Vedas and is considered to be the killer of the mother. Thus the auspicious land of Bharata is considered to be the land of action and bestows great merit. Out of the land of Bharata, Vmdavana is considered to be more auspicious because the dust of the feet of Radha had fallen there. To achieve the dust of the feet of Radha, Brahma had performed tapas for sixty thousand years.

## Chapter 53

## \|\| 53.1 \|\|

*. nārada uvāca \|*  
*samatīte pūrṇarāse kiṃ cakāra jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*rahasyaṃ kiṃ babhūvātha tadbhavānvaktumarhati \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – After completion of Rdsallla, what else the lord of the universe do? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 53.2 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*rāsaṃ nivartya rāse ca rāseśvaryā samanvitaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ rāseśvarastasmādyamunāpulinaṃ yayau \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Shri Narayana said – After performing the divine dance in the Rasamandala Shri Krishna together with the goddess Radha went to the bank of the Yamuna.

## \|\| 53.3 \|\|

*tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā nirmalaṃ nirmale jale \|*  
*sārddhaṃ gopāṅganābhiśca jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Taking bath in the spot less clean water of the Yamuna and drinking the water, he performed the water sport together with all the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 53.4-6 \|\|

*tato jagāma bhagavānbhāṇḍīraṃ rādhayā saha \|*  
*gopāṅganāśca svagṛhānprayayurvirahāturāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*krīḍāṃ cakāra rahasi bhāṇḍīre mālatīvane \|*  
*mālatīpuṣpaśayyāyāṃ ramyāyāṃ ramaṇotsukaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kṛtvā krīḍāṃ ca tatraiva vāsantīkānanaṃ yayau \|*  
*reme tatraiva rāseśo vasante sumanohare \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Thereafter Shri Kfsna accompanied with Radha went to the Bhandlra forest and the cowherdesses suffering from the pangs of separation, went to their respective abodes. In the forest of BhSndlra in the orchard of the jasmine flowers Shri Krishna and Radha enjoyed the company of each other on the charming bed and thereafter they went to the Vasanti orchard. Lord Krishna presently enjoyed the company of Radha in that forest.

## \|\| 53.7-8 \|\|

*tatraiva ramaṇaṃ kṛtvā yayau candanakānanam \|*  
*candanokṣitasarvāṃgo gṛhītvā candanokṣitam \|\| 7\|\|*

*ramye candanatalpe ca snigdhe candanapallave \|*  
*pūrṇacandre samudite vijahāra tayā saha \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Radha, whose body was plastered with the sandal-paste, Shri Krishna went to the sandal-wood forest, he enjoyed the company of Radha on the bed of the tender leaves of the sandal-wood trees in the spotless rays of the moon.

## \|\| 53.9-11 \|\|

*kṛtvā vihāraṃ tatraiva yayau campakakānanam \|*  
*ramye campakatalpe ca cakāra ratimīśvarī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ratiṃ nirvartya tatraiva yayau padmavanaṃ prabhuḥ \|*  
*padmapatrasamākīrṇe talpe'tisumanohare \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sārdhaṃ tatra padmamukhyā śītena padmavāyunā \|*  
*cakāra sukhasaṃbhogaṃ yayau nidrāṃ tayā saha \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. After their performance in that place Shri Krishna went with Radha to the forest of jasmine flowers. Both of them enjoyed each others company on the charming bed of the jasmine flowers. Getting relieved of the love-sport they then went to the forest of lotus flowers. There they enjoyed on the bed of lotus flowers from which the fragrance of these flowers was issuing carried by the cool breeze. Thus Krishna enjoyed the company of the lotus faced Radha in that place and he went to sleep there.

## \|\| 53.12 \|\|

*vihāya nidrāṃ nidreśo dadarśa nidritāṃ priyām \|*  
*śayānāṃ padmatalpe ca sukhasaṃbhogamātrataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thereafter Shri Krishna, the lord of the sleep, rose up from the sleep and started staring at the beloved Radha who was comfortably sleeping on the bed of lotus flowers.

## \|\| 53.13-15 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ ca gharmāktaṃ śaraccandraviniṃditam \|*  
*atisaṃluptasindūraṃ luptaṃ kajjalamulbaṇam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*saṃluptādhararāgaṃ ca saṃluptagaṇḍapatrakam \|*  
*visrastakabarībhāraṃ netrotpalavimudritam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ratnakuṇḍalayugmenāmūlyena pariśobhitam \|*  
*rājitaṃ mauktikenaiva gajarājodbhavena ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. He looked at the lotus-like face of Radha which put to shame the moon of the winter season. She had developed the drops of sweating on the face in which the spots of vermilion had disappeared. Similarly the collyrium of the eyes, the paint of the lips and the printings on the cheeks had disappeared the knots of hair on the head had disarranged and the eyes were shut like the blue lotus flowers, her face was adorned with the invaluable two kundalas and Gajamukta.

## \|\| 53.16 \|\|

*premṇā svasūkṣmavastreṇa vahniśuddhena mādhavaḥ \|*  
*cakāra mārjanaṃ bhaktyā tadvaktraṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thereafter Madhava, who is always graceful on his devotees, rinsed her face with the fine garment lovingly which was sanctified by Agni.

## \|\| 53.17-18 \|\|

*keśasaṃmārjanaṃ kṛtvā nirmāya kabarīṃ hariḥ \|*  
*mādhavīmālatīmālājālena pariśobhitām \|\| 17 \|\|*

*ratnapaṭṭasūtrabaddhāṃ vāmavaktrāṃ manoharām \|*  
*atīva vartulākārāṃ kundapuṣpasuśobhitām \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The lord than combed her hair and decorated her head with jasmine flowers making a beautiful knot, binding it with the string of gems, she was seated turning her face towards the left and looked quite charming. Her head was decorated with beautiful circular lotus flower.

## \|\| 53.19 \|\|

*dadau sindūratilakamadhaścandanamujjvalam \|*  
*kastūrībindunā sārddhaṃ paritaḥ pariśobhitām \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He applied a tilakam of vermilion on her forehead and a spot of kastUri was also made under it together with another spot of the sandal-paste, decorating the same from all the sides.

## \|\| 53.20-21 \|\|

*cakāra patrakaṃ gaṇḍayugme citravicitritam \|*  
*pradadau kajjalaṃ bhaktyā netrotpalasamujjvalam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*cakārādhararāgaṃ ca rādhāyāścānurāgataḥ \|*  
*karṇabhūṣaṇayugmaṃ ca cakārātīva nirmalam \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. He than painted beautiful leaves on the cheeks and applied collyrium with devotion on the eyes resembling the blue lotus flowers. Thereafter lovingly her lips were also painted and her ears were adorned with beautiful ear ornaments.

## \|\| 53.22-23 \|\|

*amūlyaratnahāraṃ ca stanabhāra yugojjvalam \|*

*vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ divyamamūlyaṃ viśvaratnataḥ \|*

22-23. He then adorned her with invaluable garlands of gems which were falling on her breasts. He adorned her neck with a garland of invaluable diamonds, he also adorned her with several types of ornaments. She was clad in beautiful costumes sanctified by fire on which the kasturi and saffron were sprinkled.

## \|\| 53.24 \|\|

*pradadau pādayugale ratnamañjīrarañjitam \|*  
*cakārālaktakaṃ bhaktyā pāduṅgulinakheṣu ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Her pair of feet were adorned with gem-studded anklets and the toes were painted red, with devotion.

## \|\| 53.25 \|\|

*cakāra sevāṃ sevyāyāḥ sevyastrijagatāṃ satām \|*  
*aho sevakasaṃbhaktyā śvetena cāmareṇa ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thus lord Krishna who in adored by the entire universe, served Radha, like a servant with utmost devotion and also moved the white fly-whisk.

## \|\| 53.26-27 \|\|

*sarvabhāvavidāṃ śreṣṭho bodhajñaḥ kāmaśāstravit \|*  
*kāminīṃ bodhayāmāsa vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi \|\| 26 \|\|*

*premṇā ca pradadau tasyai sadratnadarpaṇaṃ śubham \|*  
*suveṣadarśanārthaṃ ca mukhacandraṃ ca mārjitum \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Thereafter, lord Krishna who is well-versed in the scriptures of love and also is well-aware of the feeling connected therewith being best of the intellectuals woke up his beloved and embraced her. Thereafter, he presented to her a beautiful mirror of gems to unable her to look at her reflection in the mirror.

## \|\| 53.28-29 \|\|

*nānāpuṣpairviracitāmamlānāṃ candanokṣitām \|*  
*gaṇḍe saubhāgyayuktāyāḥ saubhāgyena dadau hariḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*kastūrīkuṅkamāktaṃ ca sugandhicandanaṃ tataḥ \|*

28-29. The immensely virtuous goddess Radha was adorned by Shri Krishna with many of the garlands of flowers soaked in sandal-paste, beside the undecaying flowers. Getting filled with love Shri Krishna applied on the entire body of Radha, the paste of kasturi, saffron and sandal-paste.

## \|\| 53.30-31 \|\|

*pārijātasya kusumaṃ dattaṃ rahasi brahmaṇā \|*

*kamalaṃ nirmalaṃ divyaṃ sahasradalamujjvalam \|*

30-31. О Narada, the Parijata flower which was given to him by Brahma was place by Krishna on the head of Radha. Than he placed the lotus of thousand petals which was spotless and divine issuing lustre and was given to Krishna by Shiva in a lonely place.

## \|\| 53.32 \|\|

*atisāraṃ maṇīndrāṇāṃ maṇiratnaṃ ca kaustubham \|*

## \|\| 53.33 \|\|

*āsavaṃ ratnapātrasthaṃ dasradattaṃ ca nirjane \|*

33\. Не then gave the divine beverage which increased pass ion and was given by the divine physician Ashvinlkumara to Krishna in a lonely place. He handed over the beverage for her drinking in the vase of gems to Radha.

## \|\| 53.34 \|\|

*mālatīmādhavīkundamandāracampakādikam \|*

34\. He than placed jasmine, Madhavi, Kunda, Mandara and campaka flowers in different vases and handed them over to Radha for her pleasure.

## \|\| 53.35-38 \|\|

*sudurlabhaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisusaṃskṛtam \|*  
*bhakṣaṇaṃ kārayāmāsa samayajñaśca tāṃ priyām \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sudurlabhaṃ ca viśveṣu vākpateḥ parinirmitam \|*  
*anuttamamamūlyaṃ ca varuṇena rahaḥsthale \|\| 36 \|\|*

*atisūkṣmamanupamaṃ dattaṃ bhaktyā virājitam \|*  
*vāsayāmāsa vasanaṃ kṛtvā nagnāṃ ca kautukāt \|\| 37 \|\|*

*devarājena dattaṃ ca gajarājendramauktikam \|*

35-38. Thereafter Krishna who is well aware of exigencies of the times gave away to Radha a betel with camphor which was difficult to get in the universe. Thereafter unrobing her she was clad in beautiful garments which ware prepared by Brihaspati and were invaluable and extremely charming, these handed over to the Krishna by Varuna in seclusion with great devotion. Indra had given Gajendra-mukta which serves as a nose ornament, was also given by Krishna to Radha.

## \|\| 53.39-41 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra suśīlādyāśca gopikāḥ \|*

*ṣaṣṭisatkoṭigopībhiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ \|*  
*āyayuḥ pādacihnena priyasya vahataḥ priyām \|\| 40 \|\|*

*kāściccaṃdanahastāśca kāściccāmaravāhikāḥ \|*  
*kāścitkastūrihastāśca mālāhastāśca kāścana \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. In the meantime the sixty extremely dear cowherdesses of Radha accompanied With sixty thousand cowherdesses delightfully reached there following the foot steps of Krishna and Radha. Some of them held sandal-paste, some fly-whisks, some kasturi and others held the garlands.

## \|\| 53.42 \|\|

*kāścitsiṃdūrahastāśca kāścitkaṃkatikākarāḥ \|*  
*kāścidalaktakakarā vastrahastāśca kāścana \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Some of them held the vermilion, some of them held the lotuses and the combs, some of them held the paint for the feet, some of them carried the costumes.

## \|\| 53.43-47 \|\|

*kāściddarpaṇahastāśca puṣpapātradharā varāḥ \|*  
*kāścitkrīḍāpadmahastā mālāhastāśca kāścana \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kāścidāsavahastāśca kāścidbhūṣaṇavāhikāḥ \|*  
*karatālakarāḥ kāścinmṛdaṃgavāhikāḥ parāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*svarayaṃtrakarāḥ kāścidvīṇāhastāśca kāścana \|*  
*ṣaṭtriṃśadrāgarāgiṇyo gopikārūpadhārikāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*golokādāgatāyāśca bhārataṃ rādhayā saha \|*  
*kāścijjaguśca nanṛtustatrāgatya ca kāścana \|\| 46 \|\|*

*kāściccakruśca sevāṃ ca rādhāyāḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*kāściccakruśca devyāśca pādasaṃvāhanaṃ mudā \|\| 47 \|\|*

43-47. Some of them held the mirrors, some of them held the lotus for playing and some of the held the garlands. Some of them held the flower vases. Some of them held the beverages and some of them carried ornaments. Some of them carried karatalas in their hands, some carried double drums, some carried musical instruments and the vlnas. Thus thirty six types of Raga-Raginis assembled there in the form of cowherdesses. They had arrived in the land of Bharata with Radha. On reaching before Radha some of them started singing, some of them started dancing, some of the them started moving the fly-whisks and some off them started delightfully pressing her feet.

## \|\| 53.48-54 \|\|

*kāciddadau ca tāmbūlaṃ bhakṣaṇārthe mahāmune \|*  
*evaṃ kautukayuktaśca puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|\| 48 \|\|*

*pratasthau gopikāsārddhaṃ rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitaḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ papau ca mādhvīkaṃ priyayā saha mādhavaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ cakhāda tāmbūlaṃ kṣaṇaṃ nidrāṃ yayau mudā \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ cakāra śṛṅgāraṃ ratnanirmitamandire \|\| 50 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ jalavihāraṃ ca cakāra yamunājale \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitā vatsa rāsakrīḍā hareraho \|\| 51 \|\|*

*svecchāmayasyātmanaśca paripūrṇatamasya ca \|*  
*nirguṇasya svatantrasya parasya prakṛteḥ prabhoḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇarāsakrīḍāvarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*uktaṃ kiśoracaritaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 54 \|\|*

48-54. О great sage, some others offered betels for her consumption. Thus in the sacred place of Vrindavana of lord Krishna occupying the heart of Radha together with the cowherdesses, was drinking beverages in a moment, in another moment he started chewing betel and in another moment he went to sleep delightfully, in another moment he enjoyed the love-sport with Radha in the palaces made of gems and in another moment, he started enjoying water sport with Radha in the waters of Yamuna. О son, thus I have narrated to you the Rasallla of the lord who moves according to this own will, is complete in all respects is without qualities and independent, beyond Prakriti, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. I have narrated to you the life story of lord Krishna, his childhood plays and other events. What else do you want to listen from me.

## Chapter 54

## \|\| 54.1-2 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ rahasyaṃ babhūva munisattama \|*  
*kathaṃ jagāma bhagavānmathurāṃ nandamandirāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

*nando dadhāra prāṇāṃśca vicchedena hareḥ katham \|*  
*gopāṅganā yaśodā vā kṛṣṇaikatānamānasāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narada said – О best of the sages what did Krishna do thereafter why did he go to Mathura leaving the abode of Nanda? How did Nanda, the cowherdess Yashoda behave in the absence of Krishna? How could they remain alive without him?

## \|\| 54.3 \|\|

*cakṣurnimeṣavicchedādyā rādhā na hi jīvati \|*  
*kathaṃ dadhāra sā devī prāṇānprāṇeśvaraṃ vinā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The goddess Radhika who could not remain alive with the separation from Krishna even for the sinking of the eyes, how could she remain alive after the departure of his beloved.

## \|\| 54.4 \|\|

*yeye tatsaṅgino gopāḥ śayanāsanabhogataḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ visasmaruste ca tādṛśaṃ bāṃdhavaṃ vraje \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. How could the cowherds who always ate the food and slept with Krishna spend the time with out him besides enjoying other pleasure, how could they forget him.

## \|\| 54.5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇo mathurāṃ gatvā kiṃ kiṃ karma cakāra saḥ \|*  
*svargārohaṇaparyantaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Then arriving at Mathura what did Krishna do. You kindly let me know all the events relating to the Krishna up to the time of his departure for the heaven.

## \|\| 54.6-10 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*kaṃsaścakāra yajñaṃ ca samāhūto dhanurmakham \|*  
*jagāma tatra bhagavāṃstena rājñā nimantritaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*rājā prasthāpayāmāsa cākrūraṃ bhagavatpriyam \|*  
*akrūraḥ prerito rājñā gatvā ca nandamandiram \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca gṛhītvā sa sagaṇaṃ mathurāṃ gataḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇaḥ śrīmathurāṃ gatvā jaghāna nṛpatiṃ mune \|\| 8 \|\|*

*jaghāna rajakaṃ caiva cāṇūraṃ muṣṭikaṃ gajam \|*  
*cakāra pitroruddhāraṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca bāndhavaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kubjayā saha śṛṅgāraṃ kṛtvā ca kautukena ca \|*  
*taṃ ca prasthāpayāmāsa golokaṃ gopikāpatiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

6-10. Shri Narayana said – In the city of Mathura, the king Kamsa performed a yajha of bow in which Krishna was invited. Krishna arrived in Mathura at the invitation of the king. In order to invite him the king deputed Akriira as a messenger. At the instance of the king Akrnra went to Nandagamva in the house of Nanda and accompanied with Krishna and other cowherds he went back to Mathura. О sage, reaching Mathura, Krishna killed the king, killing washarman, Canura, Mustika, Kuvalayaplda, he freed his parents from the prison. Krishna the lord of the Gopis enjoyed the company of Kubja and sent her to Goloka.

## \|\| 54.11 \|\|

*cakāra kṛpayā viṣṇurmālākārasya mokṣaṇam \|*  
*kṛpayā coddhavadvārā bodhayāmāsa gopikāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. With the grace, lord Krishna have been given the salvation to the gardener and the cowherdesses have been addressed by Uddhava.

## \|\| 54.12 \|\|

*tadopanīto bhagavānavantīnagaraṃ yayau \|*  
*cakāra vidyāgrahaṇaṃ muneḥ sāṃdīpanerguroḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thereafter the thread ceremony of Krishna was performed. He then went to the ashrama of the sage Sandlpani at Avanti for getting education.

## \|\| 54.13-14 \|\|

*tato jitvā jarāsandhaṃ nihatya yavaneśvaram \|*  
*ugrasenaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ cakāra vidhipūrvakam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*gatvā samudranikaṭaṃ nirmāya dvārakāṃ purīm \|*  
*jahāra rukmiṇīṃ devīṃ jitvā nṛpatisaṃghakam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. On return from that place he defeated Jarasandha and killing Kalayavana, Ugrasena was properly crowned as the king. There-after he built the city of Dvaraka within the ocean and becoming victorious on the group of kings, he abducted Rukmini and married her.

## \|\| 54.15-16 \|\|

*kāliṃdīṃ lakṣmaṇāṃ śaibyāṃ satyāṃ jāṃbavatīṃ satīm \|*  
*mitraviṃdāṃ nāgnajitīṃ samudvāhaṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*nihatya narakaṃ bhūpaṃ raṇena dāruṇena ca \|*

15-16. Thus he married also Kalindl, Laksmana, Saivya, Satya, Sati, Jambavati, Mitravinda and Nagnajitl. Thereafter lord Krishna killed Narakasura in the battle-field and abducted the sixteen thousand damsels kept by him in captivity and marrying them he enjoyed their company.

## \|\| 54.17-18 \|\|

*jahāra pārijātaṃ ca jitvā śakraṃ ca līlayā \|*

17-18. Thereafter he won Indra quite easily and winning Chandrasekhara cut of the hands of Banasura. He freed his grandson from the captivity of Banasura and returned to Dvaraka and he appeared before all the people in their respective houses.

## \|\| 54.19-20 \|\|

*yoge ca vasudevasya tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ \|*

*pūrṇe ca śatavarṣe ca sudāmnaḥ śāpamokṣaṇe \|*  
*punaryayau tayā sārddhaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. He than met in the yajna of Vasudeva, his beloved Radhika who had arrived there to attend they yajna. After freeing Sudama from the curse after a hundred years he again visited the auspicious Vrindavana together with Radha.

## \|\| 54.21-30 \|\|

*punaścaturdaśābdaṃ ca tayā sārdhaṃ jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*cakāra rāsaṃ rāse ca puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pūrṇamekādaśābdaṃ ca nivṛtya nandamaṃdire \|*
