*cakāra bhāraharaṇaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthuvikramaḥ \|*  
*paṃcaviṃśativarṣe ca śatavarṣādhikaṃ mune \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tiṣṭhañjagāma golokaṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca purātanaḥ \|*  
*yaśodāyai ca nandāya vṛṣabhānāya dhīmate \|\| 24 \|\|*

*rādhāmātre kalāvatyai dadau sāmīpyamokṣaṇam \|*  
*kṛṣṇena sārddhaṃ gopī ca rādhikā ca kutūhalāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nibadhya dharmasetuṃ ca vedoktaṃ ca yuge yuge \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ samāsena mahāmune \|\| 26 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ ramyaṃ caturvargaphalapradam \|*  
*brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ naśvarameva ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

*bhaja taṃ paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ nandanandanam \|*  
*svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 28 \|\|*

*paramavyayamavyaktaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|*  
*satya nityaṃ svataṃtraṃ ca sarveśaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|\| 29 \|\|*

*nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca nirākāraṃ nirañjanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

21-30. Thereafter in the sacred land of Bharata Shri Krishna the lord of the universe performed Rasallla in Rasamandala of Vrindavana for fourteen years. He stayed in the house of Nanda for eleven years. Thus lord Krishna remained on earth for a thousand hundred years, living in Mathura and Dvaraka. During this period the lord rid the earth of her weight. О sage the eternal lord Krishna spent hundred and twenty five years on earth and thereafter he left for heaven, he bestowed Yashoda Nanda, the intelligent Vrs abhahu, Kalavati the mother of Radha, the Samlpya type of salvation. О great sage, the cowherdesses Radhika on the other hand accompanying Krishna reached Goloka for performing Dharma in every yuga. Thus I have narrated to you the story of lord Krishna in brief which bestows dharma, artha and moksa. Considering all to be perishable right from Brahma to the blade of grass, one should recite the name of the blissful son of Nanda who moves at will is the eternal Brahman, great soul, the lord imperishable, invisible, who bestows his grace on his devotees and takes to a definite form, is truthful, eternal, independent, the lord of all, beyond Prakriti is without qualities, unattached, invisible and without blemish.

*saptasāgarasaṃyuktā saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā \|*

6-9. The earth with seven oceans, seven islands and innumerable forests and mountains, the nether world, seven lokas, Brahmaloka and seven heavens comprise of the universe because of his fear. Brahma creates the three Bhuvnas at the time of creation which are eternal. Because of his fear such innumerable globes are enshrined in the hair-pits of Mahavirat who happens to be his amsha and always meditates upon him. Under his influence the compassionate Vishnu protects the universe.

## \|\| 55.10-13 \|\|

*kālāgnirudro yadbhītaḥ kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ \|*

Afraid of him Mahadeva who has conquered the death getting disinterested with six gunas and attractions always meditate upon him. Getting afraid of him the fire bums, because of him the sun emits heat. Because of him Indra pours the rain through the clouds, because of him the fear of death pervades the universe. Because of him Dharmaraja controls the sinners, because of him the earth carries the moveable and immovable lokas, because of him Prakriti at the time of creation creates Mahada and other elements.

14-16. О son, who can be aware of his secret meaning. О son, he happens to be the one whose influence is unknown to Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. How can I be aware of his movements being a person devoid of wisdom. Lord Krishna the son of Nanda leaving Vrindavana, why did he go to Mathura, why did he disown the cowherdesses, Radha who was dearer to him than his life, Yashoda, Nanda and other relatives?

17-18. The lord always shatters the pride of all, bestows the pride and provides everything on everyone. Because of the curse of Sudama he shattered the pride of Radha and all other people achieved Brahma as desired by them. Thus Brahma also entered into some controversy.

*prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevyaśca priyāyāḥ prāṇato'pi ca \|*

19-24. Thereafter the all-pervading Maha-Vishnu shattered the pride of Brahma. Similarly the pride of Vishnu, Shesha, Shiva, Dharma, Yama, Samba, Sun, Moon, Garuda, Agni, Brihaspati, Durvasa, gate-keeper named Jaya and Vijaya, the gods, the demons, yours, Kamadeva, Indra, Laks mana, Arjuna, Banasura, Bhrigu, mountain Sumeru, the ocean, the wind, Varuna, Sarasvati, Durga, Kamala, PrthvI, Savitri, Ganga, Manasa and Radhika the great goddess, who had been dearer to the lord than his own life was shattered. Then what to speak of others?

25\. But he, while shattering the pride of all, became compassionate on them because he happens to be the creator of the entire universe, the destroyer and the one who preserves besides being the creator of the entire creation.

## \|\| 55.26-27 \|\|

26-27. Even Shiva is unable to recite his glory with all his five mouths. Brahma the creator of the universe also cannot recite his glory with all his four mouths. Besides the all-pervading Vishnu who is also known by the name of Janardana is unable to recite his glory.

*mahāvirāṇna śakto'pi yaṃ stotuṃ parameśvaram \|*

## \|\| 55.29-30 \|\|

29-30. О Narada, even Sarasvati becomes motionless while offering prayer to him in his presence. Even the Vedas are unable to recite his glory. О Brahman, I have thus narrated to you the glory of Shri Krishna who happens to be Nirguna and the great soul. What else do you want to listen from me?

## Chapter 56

## \|\| 56.1 \|\|

*kathaṃ kṛṣṇo mahāviṣṇordarpabhaṅga cakāra saḥ \|*

2\. I would like to listen to the way Shri Krishna shattered the pride of Maha-Vishnu and others. You kindly tell me this in detail.

3\. The life story of lord Krishna is quite sweet but it is always pleasant to listen to the story from the mouth of a good poet which becomes immensely sweeter (thus by listening to the story of lord Krishna from your mouth, it would add to the sweetness further).

## \|\| 56.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca mahāviṣṇorahaṃkāro babhūva sahaseti ca \|*

4\. Narayana said – Once Maha-Vishnu was inflated with pride suddenly that the entire universe was lodged in his hair-pits and therefore he was the supreme lord.

## \|\| 56.5-6 \|\|

*saṃhārabhairavī bhutvā taṃ sa jagrāsa līlayā \|*

5-6. Thereafter lord Krishna took to the form of Samhara-bhairava and started swallowing him. When only the head was left Maha-Vishnu started offering prayers devotedly to the lord. Finding

## \|\| 56.7-8 \|\|

*brahmaṇaḥ sahasā brahmanniti darpo babhuva ha \|*  
*ahaṃ trijagatāṃ dhātā kartā'hamīśvaraḥ svayam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*matparaḥ pūjito nāsti matparaśca jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ manasā kṛtvā bahudarpo babhūva ha \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. О Brahman, similarly Brahma also was once so inflated with pride that he was the sole creator of the universe and as such the supreme lord. He thought that there was none else who could be more adorable than him, nor was there anyone else who had so completely controlled his sense organs. Having thus resolved in his mind, he was filled with pride.

## \|\| 56.9-14 \|\|

*taṃ brahāṇāṃ samūhaṃ ca darśayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam \|*

*śatavaktraṃ ca pratyekaṃ brahmāṇḍaughaṃ ca līlayā \|*  
*tyaktukāmaṃ svadehaṃ ca vrīḍayā natakaṃdharam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*punaḥ prasādaṃ kṛpayā taṃ cakāra kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*kālena mohinīdvārā tamapūjyaṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*svakanyāṃ darśayitvā taṃ sakāmaṃ ca cakāra ha \|*  
*punastaddarpabhaṅgaṃ ca śivadvārā cakāra saḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tatyāja lajjayā dehaṃ punardehaṃ dadhāra saḥ \|*

*jñānaṃ dadau mahājñānī jñānānandaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*

9-14. Thereafter lord Krishna displayed the forms in which there were creatures with five faces, four faces, six faces and many of them having a hundred faces. He displayed the Brahmanda together with Brahma playfully as a result of which Brahma felt ashamed and he lowered his head in shame and got ready to end his life. Thereafter the lord who is the ocean of mercy bestowed his grace on him. At the appropriate time he made him unadorable and as a result of the curse of Mohini, he made him passionate by displaying his own daughter before him and thereafter he got his pride shattered through Shiva. Getting ashamed he thought of ending his life and took to another body. Thereafter the great intellectual and eternal who is also the form of intellectuals and an eternal lord took to the form of a Brahmana and appeared before Brahma and made him adorable again bestowing the divine knowledge on him. Similarly lord Vishnu also was once inflated with pride and thought, "I alone.maintain the entire universe and as such I happen to be the supreme lord.".

## \|\| 56.15-20 \|\|

*tamātmavismṛtaṃ kṛṣṇaścakāra rāmajanmani \|*  
*ahaṃ viśvaṃ bibharmīti śeṣo darpī babhūva ha \|\| 15 \|\|*

*taddarpaṃ garuḍadvārā cūrṇībhūtaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*

*na pūjitaśca śeṣeṇa svadarpeṇa purā mune \|*  
*garuḍena jitaṃ kodhāttamanantaṃ manasvinam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*cakāra mokṣaṇaṃ tasya śrīkṛṣṇaśca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*

*taṃ kṛtvā māyayā mohaṃ kārayāmāsa strīyutam \|*  
*punarjahāra tatpatnīṃ dakṣakanyāṃ mahāsatīm \|\| 19 \|\|*

*varṣa śuśoca taddehaṃ kroḍe kṛtvā ca śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*nānāsthānaṃ ca babhrāma rudañchokānmuhurmuhuḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

15-20. Thereafter at the time of the incarnation of Rama he shattered his pride by making him forget himself and his pride was shattered. Shesha also once was filled with pride feeling, "I carry the entire universe on my head and there was no one else comparable to me." Finding this the lord got his pride shattered through Garuda. О sage, once all the serpents adored Garuda the vehicle of Krishna, but serpent Shesha refused to do so, swollen with pride. At this Garuda was enraged and subjugated Ananta; thereafter all merciful Krishna got him released. Lord Shiva even was not prepared to marry because of the pride in him. Lord Krishna influenced him with his illusion and got him married; thereafter his wife named Mahasati the daughter of Daksha was kidnapped (because she ultimately burnt his body in the fire-altar of Daksha). Thereafter lord Shiva carrying the dead body of Sati in his lap suffered from the pain and grief for many years. He cried again and again because of his grief and roamed about in several places.

## \|\| 56.21-26 \|\|

*janmāntare punaḥ prāpya tāṃ satīṃ pārvatīṃ mudā \|*

*punaścā''ṅgīrasadvārā smārayāmāsa satvaram \|*  
*ekadā sarathaḥ śambhuḥ preritastripure purā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*hatvā daityaṃ śivadvārā tripurāriṃ cakāra tam \|*

*svayaṃ kalpatarurbhūtvā pratijñāṃ ca cakāra saḥ \|*

*iti labdhvā varaṃ rudrādgacchantaṃ śaṃkaraṃ vibhum \|*  
*hastaṃ dātuṃ ca taṃ mūrdhni prādhāvatsatvaraṃ purā \|\| 26 \|\|*

21-26. Thereafter, getting back Sati in the form of Parvati, he was fully delighted but because of the curse of Daksha he forgot all his divine knowledge. Durvasa, the son of Angira, helped him in restoring the divine knowledge to Shiva. Similarly in the earlier times, lord Krishna sent Shiva mounted on a chariot for the killing of Tripurasura. Though the compassionate Shiva could bestow all the books on everyone and himself being kalpavrksa took a vow thereafter, Vrkasura adored lord Shiva and achieved a boon from Shiva, who said, "Your desire will be fulfilled." Thus with the boon of Rudra, the demon before leaving that place intended to place his hand on Shiva's head.

## \|\| 56.27 \|\|

*atīva bhītaḥ śaṃbhuśca jagāma śaraṇaṃ harim \|*

27\. Finding this, Shiva felt panicky and went to take refuge with the lord. Thereafter, the lord reduced to ashes that demon for the sake of Shiva.

## \|\| 56.28 \|\|

*śivaṃ yuddhaṃ ca kurvantaṃ bāṇayuddhe purā vibhuḥ \|*  
*līlayā jṛmbhaṇāstreṇa jaḍībhūtaṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. In the earlier times, while fighting with Banasura, Shiva was playfully made motionless by the lord Krishna.

## \|\| 56.29 \|\|

*samāgataṃ dakṣayajñe śaṃbhuṃ dambhena līlayā \|*  
*vārayāmāsa bhagavānhastaṃ dattvā ca tadgale \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Again in the yajna of Daksha, the lord removed Shiva from the place by holding him by the neck.

## \|\| 56.30 \|\|

*kedārakanyakādvārā śapto dharmo'tidaivataḥ \|*  
*babhūvātikṛśo bhītaḥ kuhvāmeva yathā śaśī \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Similarly Dharma attracted a great curse from the daughter of Kedara, as a result of which he became very weak like the moon of the dark fortnight.

## \|\| 56.31-34 \|\|

*tadā tasyāśca śāpānte satye pūrṇo babhuva ha \|*  
*tripādbabhūva tretāyāṃ dvāparaṃ ca dvipāditi \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ekapācca kalau so'pi kalerante punaḥ kṣayaḥ \|*  
*ṣoḍaśāṃśo'tikliṣṭaśca sasmāra canaṇaṃ vibhoḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tadā satyayugārambhe paripūrṇo'bhavatpunaḥ \|*  
*punaryugānurodhena krameṇa ca punaḥ kṣayaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*yamo māṇḍavaśāpena śūdrayonimavāpa ha \|*  
*tadā punaḥ śatābdānte punaḥ śuddho babhūva ha \|\| 34 \|\|*

31-34. After the end of the curse, in Satyayuga he became complete and healthy. In Tretayuga he had three feet only, in the Dvapara only two and in the age of Kali he had only one foot left and thereafter he completely disappears. Thus Dharma getting present in sixteen parts was immensely upset and started adoring at the feet of the lord. He was complete in the Satyayuga in all respects. Similarly he went on increasing and decreasing according to the yugas; as a result of the curse of the sage Mandava even Yama had to be born in the house of Shudra and could be purified only after a hundred years.

## \|\| 56.35 \|\|

*sāmbo vimātṛśāpena galatkuṣṭhī babhūva saḥ \|*  
*tadā sūryavrataṃ kṛtvā punaḥ śuddho babhūva saḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Samba attracted leprosy because of the curse of his step-mother. He after performing the vrata of Surya was purified again.

## \|\| 56.36 \|\|

*candro darpamadenaiva jahāra ca guroḥ priyām \|*  
*babhūva darpabhaṅgo'sya yakṣmagrasto babhūva saḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Infatuated with pride Chandrama abducted Tara, the wife of Brihaspati as a result, he attracted the disease of consumption and his pride was shattered.

## \|\| 56.37-38 \|\|

*sūryo darpāttejasaśca hantuṃ śaṃkarakiṃkaram \|*  
*sumālītyabhidhaṃ daityaṃ jagāmā''śu giriṃ prati \|\| 37 \|\|*

*aharniśaṃ dīptikaraṃ kurvantaṃ viṣayaṃ raveḥ \|*  
*sūryeṇa bhīto daityaśca śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Because of the pride of his lustre, Surya went after Sumall a devotee of Shiva in order to kill him. The sun was performing the duty of illumining the universe day and night. Getting terrified by the sun, the demon took refuge with Shiva.

## \|\| 56.39-41 \|\|

*sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkaraśca jagrāha śūlameva ca \|*  
*bhīto dudrāva sūryaśca dṛṣṭvā taṃ śūlinaṃ mune \|\| 39 \|\|*

*jaghāna kāśyāṃ śūlena śūlīkāśīśvaro ravim \|*  
*mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpya śūlena darpaṃbhaṅgo babhūva ha \|\| 40 \|\|*

*sāndrāndhakāraḥ sahasā jagrāha pṛthivītalam \|*  
*āśutoṣo mahādevo jīvayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. О sage, finding Surya there Shiva took up his trident to strike at Surya, as a result of which he was terrified and while running he left Kasl. Then Shiva the lord of Kasl attacked Surya with his trident, as a result of which he fainted and fell down on the ground. And thus his pride was shattered. Thereafter the entire universe was plunged in to darkness. Finding this, Shiva who gets pleased in no time revived the sun back to life.

## \|\| 56.42-44 \|\|

*tuṣṭāva śaṃkaraṃ sūryo lajjito'pi bhayena ca \|*  
*kṛtvā tamāśiṣaṃ tuṣṭo yayau gehaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*vibhurgarutmato darpaṃ babhañja līlayā purā \|*  
*niḥśvāsaiḥ preritasyāpi śivasya vṛṣabhasya ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*āgacchantaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā śivaṃ purā \|*  
*draṣṭuṃ samāgataṃ bhaktyā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Getting ashamed and terrified, Surya then adored Shiva. The all merciful Shiva delightfully pronounced his blessing on Surya and left for his abode. In earlier times the lord shattered the pride of Garuda in no time, with the breathing of Nandi who was serving as a mount to Shiva. Garuda flew away at the time when Shiva was intending to meet Narayana mounted on the back of Nandi.

## \|\| 56.45 \|\|

*vahnirdapīṃ bhṛgoḥ śāpātsarvabhakṣo babhūva ha \|*  
*guroḥ svabhāryāhiraṇāddarpaścūrṇo babhūva ha \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Similarly the pride of Agni was shattered because of the curse of sage Bhrigu and he became the consumer of everything; the pride of Brihaspati was shattered with the abduction of his wife Tara.

## \|\| 56.46 \|\|

*durvāsaso darpabhaṅgo babhūva hyambarīṣataḥ \|*  
*sudarśanena cakreṇa viṣṇordurviṣaheṇa ca \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The pride of Durvasa was shattered because of the unbearable Sudarsana-cakra when he wanted to kill Ambarlsa a devotee of Vishnu.

## \|\| 56.47 \|\|

*jayasya vijayasyāpi darpabhaṅgaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhātpatitasyāpi brahmaśāpacchalena ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The lord threw away his attendants Jaya and Vijaya from Vaikuntha with the curse of the Brahmana sage Sanatkumara and shattered their pride.

## \|\| 56.48 \|\|

*nṛsiṃheṇa hataḥ so'pi hiraṇyakaśipuryathā \|*  
*sūkareṇa hiraṇyākṣo līlayā ca rasātale \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. In due course of time both Jaya and Vijaya were born as the demons named Hiranyakas'ipu and Hiranyaksa. Out of these too Hiranyakas'ipu was killed by lord Nrsimha and similarly Hiranyaksa was killed by Vishnu in the form of Varaha incarnation who rescued the earth from the deep water.

## \|\| 56.49-51 \|\|

*rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇaśca nihatau rāmabāṇataḥ \|*  
*janmāntare ca laṅkāyāṃ brahmaṇā prārthitasya ca \|\| 49 \|\|*

*śiśupālo hi nihataḥ kṛṣṇabāṇena līlayā \|*  
*dantavakraśca sahasā paripūrṇe'tra janmani \|\| 50 \|\|*

*surāṇāṃ darpabhaṅgaṃ ca daityadvārā cakāra ha \|*  
*asurāṇāṃ suradvārā virodhena parasparam \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. In due course of time both of them were born as Ravana and Kumbhakarna and were killed in Lanka by the arrows of Rama. Brahma had already prayed for their killing in earlier times. Then in the third birth they were born as Sisupala and Dantavakra who achieved heaven after having been killed at the hands of Shri Krishna. Thus lord Krishna created differences between the gods and the demons, shattered their pride in one way or the other.

## \|\| 56.52-53 \|\|

*vidhidvārā darpabhaṅgaṃ bhavataśca cakāra saḥ \|*  
*bhavānāsīnnāradaśca purā putraḥ prajāpateḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*gandharvaśca pituḥ śāpācchūdrīputrastataḥ kramāt \|*  
*tataḥ punarnāradaśca prasādādadhunā vibhoḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. The lord has also shattered your pride through Brahma because in the earlier times you happened to be Narada the son of Prajapati. With the curse of your father you became a Gandharva, son of a Siidra woman and in due course.of time you were reborn as Narada.

## \|\| 56.54-55 \|\|

*mama sādhyaṃ viśvamiti kāmadarpo babhūva ha \|*  
*taṃ pramataṃ haradvārā bhasmasācca cakāra saḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*punaḥ kṛtvā prasādaṃ taṃ jīvayāmāsa līlayā \|*  
*aikāntikaṃ ca tadbhaktaṃ sa ca nāstraṃ karoti hi \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Once the god of love was also inflated with pride thinking that the entire universe was controlled by him. Then the lord got the god of love reduced to ashes through Shiva and getting pleased, brought him back to life, since that time the god of love never tries to influence the devotees of the lord.

## \|\| 56.56 \|\|

*cakāra darpabhaṅgaṃ ca darpiṇo lakṣmaṇasya ca \|*  
*raṇe śaṃkaraśūlena rāvaṇapreritena ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Lord also shattered the pride of Laksmana in the battle-field when he had to face the trident of Shiva which was shot by Ravana.

## \|\| 56.57 \|\|

*punastaṃ jīvayāmāsa rāmasya stavanena ca \|*  
*svayaṃ vismṛtaviṣṇośca brahmaśāpena nārada \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. О Narada, Rama offered prayer who himself had incarnated on earth and had forgotten his tme form because of the curse of Brahma. Laks mana was revived back to life.

## \|\| 56.58-59 \|\|

*cakāra darpabhaṅgaṃ ca kārtavīryārjunasya ca \|*  
*jāmadagnyasya śastreṇāmoghena parśunā purā \|\| 58 \|\|*

*vipraputrasya maraṇe haraṇe kṛṣṇayoṣitām \|*  
*karṇena sārdhaṃ samare pārthadarpaṃ babhañja saḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. In the earlier times the lord shattered the pride of Kartaviryarjuna of the use of the battle-axe by Parashurama. The pride of Arjuna was also shattered with the death of the Brahmana boy, the abduction of the wives of Krishna and at the time of the battle between Kama and Arjuna.

## \|\| 56.60 \|\|

*bāṇasya coṣāharaṇe ciccheda ca bhujānvibhuḥ \|*  
*bhṛgośca dakṣayajñe ca darpabhaṅgaṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. At the time of abduction of Osa, the lord himself cut off the arms of BanSsura and shattered his pride. The pride of Bhrigu was shattered in the yajna of Daksha.

## \|\| 56.61 \|\|

*parśurāmasya rāmasya vivāho pathi gacchataḥ \|*  
*babhañja darpaṃ samare rāmadvārā purā vibhuḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. In the marriage of Rama when Parashurama met him on the way, his pride was shattered by him.

## \|\| 56.62 \|\|

*sumeroḥ śṛṅgabhṛṅgaṃ ca vāyudvārā cakāra saḥ \|*  
*samudrāṇāṃ darpabhaṅgaṃ cakārāgastyabhakṣaṇāt \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The pride of the Sumeru mountain was shattered with the breaking of its peaks by the wind. The pride of the ocean was shattered when Agastya drank its water.

## \|\| 56.63 \|\|

*akāle sṛṣṭiharaṇe tatputramaraṇe purā \|*  
*kopayuktasya vāyośca darpabhaṅgaṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. In the earlier times the pride of enraged wind was shattered by the lord when he wanted to untimely destroy the universe by killing the sun.

## \|\| 56.64-65 \|\|

*uṣāharaṇayātrāyāṃ dvārakāgamane hareḥ \|*  
*bāṇasya ca gavāṃ hetovaṃruṇaṃ ca śaśāpa saḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*kalahe gaṅgayā vāṇyā nārāyaṇāgrataḥ \|*  
*sarasvatīṃ ca tatyāja tasyā darpaṃ babhañja saḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. At the time of journey on the abduction of Us a, the lord left Dvaraka but by pronouncing a curse on Varuna who was abducting the cows of Banasura, his pride was shattered. At the time of quarrel between Ganga and Sarasvati in the presence of Vishnu he shattered the pride of Sarasvati by disowning her.

## \|\| 56.66-67 \|\|

*darpayuktāṃ ca durgāṃ ca tyaktvā śaṃbhurhimālaye \|*  
*kāmaṃ ca bhasmasātkṛtvā tapase ca yayau vibhuḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*lajjāmavāpa sā devī tasyā darpaṃ babhañja saḥ \|*  
*sā yayau tapase viṣṇoḥ prāptihetoḥ śivasya ca \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Shiva disowned the proud Durga, while living in Himalaya and reduced the god of love to ashes and he himself went for performing tapas. Thereafter, the goddess felt very much ashamed, after her pride was shattered she started adoring lord Vishnu for getting back Shiva as her husband. For this purpose she went to the forest for performing tapas.

## \|\| 56.68 \|\|

*bhārate suciraṃ taptvā devī vīṣṇorvareṇa ca \|*  
*cakāra svāminaṃ śaṃbhuṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. While performing tapas in Bharata for a long time, she achieved the eternal lord Shiva as her husband with the blessing of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 56.69 \|\|

*mahāsaubhāgyayuktā sā babhūva śaṃkarapriyā \|*  
*viśveṣu sarvadevīṣu pūjyā vandyā stutā suraiḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. The goddess became quite fortunate and the beloved of Shiva, besides being adorable by all the gods and the goddesses of the universe.

## \|\| 56.70-71 \|\|

*darpayuktā mahālakṣmīrbabhūva sā mahāmune \|*  
*parābhūtā purā devī jayena vijayena ca \|\| 70 \|\|*

*praviśantīṃ vibhordvāraṃ dattavā bhaktāya vāñchitam \|*  
*nivāritā sā dvārācca tena dauvārikeṇa vai \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. О great sage, in the earlier times, Maha-Lakshmi also was once filled with pride. Then he made Jaya and Vijaya to insult her, as a result of which her pride was shattered. She, after bestowing the boon on her devotees, was entering the door when the gate-keepers stopped her.

## \|\| 56.72 \|\|

*yadātmanastiraskāraṃ sābhimānā mahāsatī \|*  
*smṛtvā hareḥ pādapadmaṃ dehaṃ tyaktuṃ samudyatā \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The extremely proud and chaste Maha-Lakshmi was enraged because her insult was about to end her life, devoting her mind at the lotus-like feet of the lord.

## \|\| 56.73-75 \|\|

*tadā brahmā maheśaśca viṣṇurdharmaśca bhāskaraḥ \|*  
*candraśca kāmadevaśca vaiśvānaro dhaneśvaraḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*ṛṣayo munayaścaiva manavo vighnanāśakāḥ \|*  
*mahendro varuṇaścaiva jagatprāṇo hutāśanaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*samāyayūrudantaste padmāyāḥ purataḥ purā \|*  
*tuṣṭuvuśca mahālakṣmīṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm \|\| 75 \|\|*

73-75. At that point of time all the gods like Brahma, Shiva, Vishnu, Dharma, Surya, Moon, Kamadeva, Vaishvanara, Kubera, the sages, the ascetic, Vinayaka, the Manus, Mahendra, Varuna, Vayu and Agni arrived before Lakshmi while crying. They started eulogising the Mula-Prakriti and Isvarl known as Maha-Lakshmi.

## \|\| 56.75 \|\|

*samāyayūrudantaste padmāyāḥ purataḥ purā \|*  
*tuṣṭuvuśca mahālakṣmīṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The gods said – You forgive us О mother, О Bhagavati you are beyond everyone and have the form of spotless and sattva. You are beyond anger, forgive us.

## \|\| 56.77 \|\|

*upame sarvasādhvīnāṃ devīnāṃ devapūjite \|*  
*tvayā vinā jagatsarva mṛtatulyaṃ ca niṣphalam \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. You are the best of all the chaste goddesses, adored by all the gods, without you the entire universe is like death and infructuous.

## \|\| 56.78 \|\|

*sarvasaṃpatsvarupā tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvarūpiṇī \|*  
*rāseśvaryadhidevī tvaṃ tvatkalāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. You represent the fortunes of all, you happen to be the form of all, you are Raseshvari and the great goddess. All the women on earth represent was rays.

## \|\| 56.79 \|\|

*kailāse pārvatī tvaṃ ca kṣīrode sindhukanyakā \|*  
*svarge ca svargalakṣmīstvaṃ martyalakṣmīśca bhūtale \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. You are Prakriti in Kailasa, Sindhuputrl, Maha-Lakshmi in the ocean of milk, SvargaLakshmi in the heaven and Martya-Lakshmi on earth.

## \|\| 56.80 \|\|

*vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīrdevadevī sarasvatī \|*  
*gaṅgā ca tulasī tvaṃ ca vṛndā vṛndāvane vane \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Similarly in Vaikuntha you are Maha-Lakshmi, Sarasvati, goddess of the gods, Ganga, Tulasi and Savitri of Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 56.81 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī tvaṃ goloke rādhikā svayam \|*  
*rāse rāseśvarī tvaṃ ca vṛndā vṛndāvane vane \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. In the Goloka you are the great goddess Radha who is dearer to Krishna than his life, Raseshvari at the time of divine dance and Vmda in Vrindavana.

## \|\| 56.82 \|\|

*kṛṣṇapriyā tvaṃ bhāṇḍīre candrā candanakānane \|*  
*virajā campakavane śataśṛṅge ca sundarī \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. You are Krishnapriya in the Bhandlra forest, Chandra in the forest of sandal-wood, Viraja in the forest of campaka flowers and Sundarl in the mountain of a hundred peaks.

## \|\| 56.83 \|\|

*padmāvatī padmavane mālatī mālatīvane \|*  
*kṛndadantī kundavane suśīlā ketakīvane \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. You are Padmavati of Padma forest, Malatl of the Malatl forest, Kundadanti in the forest of lotus flower and Sus'Ila in the forest of Ketakl flowers.

## \|\| 56.84 \|\|

*kadambamālā tvaṃ devī kadambakānane'pi ca \|*  
*rājalakṣmī rājagehe gṛhalakṣmīrgṛhe gṛhe \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. You are Kadambamala in the kadamba forest, Raja-Lakshmi in the royal houses, GrhaLakshmi in every house.

## \|\| 56.85 \|\|

*ityuktavā devatāḥ sarve munayo manavastathā \|*  
*rurudurnamravadanāḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukāḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Thus speaking all the gods, the sages and Manu bowed in reverence to her and started crying with their throats, lips and palates having been dried up.

## \|\| 56.86 \|\|

*iti lakṣmīstavaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadevaiḥ kṛtaṃ śubham \|*  
*yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya sa vai sarvaṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Thus whosoever recites this Lakshmi stotra composed by gods early in the morning, surely gets everything.

## \|\| 56.87-90 \|\|

*abhāryolabhate bhāryāṃ vinītāṃ ca sutāṃ satīm \|*  
*suśīlāṃ sunadarīṃ ramyāmatisupriyavādinīm \|\| 87 \|\|*

*putrapautravatīṃ śuddhāṃ kulajāṃ komalāṃ varām \|*  
*aputro labhate putraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cirajīvinam \|\| 88 \|\|*

*paramaiśvaryayuktaṃ ca vidyāvantaṃ yaśasvinam \|*  
*bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīrlabhate śriyam \|\| 89 \|\|*

*hatabandhurlabhedbandhuṃ dhanabhraṣṭo dhanaṃ labhet \|*  
*kīrtiṃhīno labhetkīrtiṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca labheddhruvam \|\| 90 \|\|*

87-90. One who is deprived of a wife gets a very chaste, noble and charming wife having a sweet tongue besides grandsons and all the riches. He gets a damsel of high family with tender limbs. The one having no son gets a Vaishnava son having a long life, possessing all the riches and the one who is well educated. The people who are deprived of their kingdom would get it back and regain the lost riches and the lost relatives. The pauper would receive enough of riches with glory.

## \|\| 56.91 \|\|

*sarvamaṅgaladaṃ stotraṃ śokasaṃtāpanāśanam \|*  
*harṣānandakaraṃ śaśvaddharmamokṣasuhṛtpradam \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Thus this stotra is quite beneficial, bestows welfare, destroys grief and always bestows dharma, artha, кйта and moksa besides good friends.

## Chapter 57

## \|\| 57.1 \|\|

*atha saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca devānāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā tyaktavā ca rodanaṃ satī \|*  
*uvāca suprasannā tāṃsteṣāṃ stotreṇa nārada \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – О Narada adoring the gods, the chaste Lakshmi stopped crying who was pleased with their prayer.

## \|\| 57.2 \|\|

*mahālakṣmīruvāca tyajāmi dehaṃ na krodhānna vairāgyoṇa sāṃpratam \|*  
*idaṃ hṛdi samālocya devāstacch\_ūyatāmiti \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Maha-Lakshmi said – О gods, I am not ending my life because of detachment on anger. Therefore whatever has been resolved by me in my mind, I am going to tell you. You please listen to it.

## \|\| 57.3-4 \|\|

*yasminsadīśe mahati sarvasāmyo ca nirguṇe \|*  
*sarvātmani sadānande samatā tṛṇaśailayoḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā lakṣmīrlakṣaṃ sraṣṭumalaṃ ca yaḥ \|*  
*bhṛtye striyāṃ yatsamatā kiṃ kārya tasca sevayā \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The supreme lord is great and is alive for all. He is without qualities, is the soul of all, blissful and for him there is hardly any difference between a blade of grass and a mountain. Therefore the one who could by his simple frowning create lakhs of Lakshmis and treat equally the wives of others as well as the servants, what is the use of serving him?

## \|\| 57.5-6 \|\|

*tatpatnīnāṃ pradhānā'haṃ nīrastā dvāriṇā'dhunā \|*  
*tadbhṛtyabhṛtyabhṛtyena paripūrṇena nepsitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tyakṣyāmi jīvanamahamasaubhāgyā ca svāmini \|*  
*vahnau ca kāmanāṃ kṛtvā yathā bhadraṃ bhavetpurā \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. I am the foremost of all his wives, in spite of that the gate-keepers stopped me like him who happens to be the servant of the servants. I am no more attracted towards Krishna. Having been deprived of the fortune of my husband, I am desirous of the fire flames and intend to end my life in them. I can by doing so achieve the welfare which I did earlier.

## \|\| 57.7-8 \|\|

*yā strī bharturasaubhāgyā sā'saubhāgyā ca sarvataḥ \|*  
*śayane'bhojane tasyā na sukhaṃ jīvanaṃ vṛthā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yasyā nāsti priyaprema tasyā janma nirarthakam \|*  
*tartki putre dhane rupe saṃpattau yauvane'thavā \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The woman who is deprived of the fortune of her husband, becomes unfortunate from all sides. She does not enjoy any pleasure in sleep and taking food and her life becomes useless. The one who cannot achieve love for her husband, her life is of no consequence. Therefore, the sun, riches, beauty, wealth and youthfulness are of no consequence to her.

## \|\| 57.9 \|\|

*yadbhaktirnāsti kānte ca sarvapriyatame pare \|*

9\. The one who is not devoted lovingly towards her husband, becomes impure, devoid of dharma and is prevented from performing all the duties.

## \|\| 57.10-11 \|\|

*patirbandhurgatirbhartā daivataṃ gurureva ca \|*

10-11. Because the husband happens to be the true relative, the movement, the preserver, the god and the teacher and as such he happens to be the supreme lord. There is no other teacher better than the husband. О gods, the parents, the sun and brother can endow with the riches with difficulties but even to the foolish wives, their husbands provide them everything.

14-15. Such of the women who is the best of all and becomes envious and her husband like Vishnu who happens to be her teacher. She has to fall in the kumbhlpaka hell for a period of fourteen Indras. The woman who is not devoted to her husband, all her vratas, fasting, performing of charities, good deeds and the tapas performed for a long time, are reduced to ashes.

## \|\| 57.16 \|\|

## \|\| 57.18-19 \|\|

18-19. Therefore, it is incumbent on the women to serve their husband. The serving of husband is a great tapas. The serving of the husband is the great dharma and the serving of the husband is like the adoration of the gods, the serving of the husband is quite truthful and is the form of the holy places as well as the performing of the charities. Therefore, the husband of the woman is equated with gods. He has the form of the gods and has the auspicious form.

## \|\| 57.20-21 \|\|

*sarvapuṇyasvarupaśca patirupī janārdanaḥ \|*

20-21. He is immensely chaste and happens to be lord Krishna in the form of husband. Therefore, such of the women who consume the food taken by her husband and sip the water of his feet, the gods are always anxious to have an audience with such women. With the touch of such women all the holy places are relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 57.31-32 \|\|

*bhakte kalatre bandhau ca sarvatra samatā mama \|*

31-32. I have a feeling of equality for my devotees, the wife of other relatives but the main thing is that my devotee is greater than my wife therefore the invincible gate-keepers who happen to be my great devotees and are your own sons, you kindly forgive their fault and also mine.

## \|\| 57.33-35 \|\|

33-35. A devotee of mine filled with my devotion never gets panicky from the valorous warriors or even the demons. By consuming the wine of the devotion, my devotees get intoxicated and they are protected always with my Sudarsana-cakra. Thus speaking the lord of the universe held Laks ml and embraced her. Thereafter he called for the gate-keepers and said to them, 'O sons, don't be afraid. Remain comfortable. You cannot be afraid of any one till I am there. Who else can rule on my devotees? Therefore, О sons, you be established nicely in your position.

## \|\| 57.36 \|\|

Thereafter Ganga was filled with pride thinking that she was the only source for providing salvation to the people. The lord of the universe shattered her pride through the king Jahnu.

4-5. О sage, in the earlier times, the lord shattered the pride of Manasa through Durga. Once Radha denounced Krishna very badly finding him seated with Viraja and filled with pride she entered the dancing hall and she had them beaten by the gate-keepers and the cowherdesses with canes.

6-12. Thereafter Narada made Sudama who happens to be. his devotee, fo pronounce a curse on Radha. As a move of destiny getting her pride suddenly shattered, Radha had to be born on earth leaving the Goloka. She was born from the womb of Kalavati the wife of Vrsabhanu. Lord Krishna also at her request went to the abode of Nanda on the pretext of the fear from the Kamsa. That is why I have been given the name of Nanda-nandana. In order to fulfil the provisions of the curse of Sudama Krishna who happens to be the lord of the universe again went to Mathura. This has been told to me by Brahma who was born out of lotus. О Narada, immediately after birth why did he move from to Gokula to Mathura; no one could ever know about his intentions. I have thus spoken to you everything. Now you listen to me further. You listen from me the way Krishna the one who delighted the mind of Nanda went to Mathura, the way Yashoda and Nanda felt painful at heart, how the cowherds and cowherdesses of Vmdavana together with the cows started roaming about in the forest. By roaming about in the forest they became wild and only the forest dwellers could speak out smoothing about them.

Sometimes they lost their senses and sometimes they regained the same, sometimes they separated themselves from all and sometimes they started offering prayers. Sometimes they took deep sighs and in other moments they were engrossed in the devotion of the lord, sometimes they lay on bed and sometimes they got up from the same.

1-3. Shri Narayana said – I have narrated to you about the shattering of the pride of all; now you listen to the story of the shattering of the pride of Indra in detail. Finding her teacher who was always engrossed in Brahman, Indra did not welcome him, having been filled with pride he did not get up from the gem-studded lion-throne. Brihaspati felt immensely enraged at his insult and left the place. In spite of the fact that the immensely chaste teacher felt envious at that time still he did not pronounce a curse out of love for him.

О Narada, in case someone does not pronounce a curse on a great sinner because his love for him or because of dharma but in spite of that the sinner has to reap the reward for the same and dharma destroys him completely. A religious person whenever he pronounces a curse on a sinful person, the sinner surely gets destroyed but the religious person is deprived of his dharma. Because of that sin Indra attached Brahmahatya and terrified with the same he left his kingdom and went to a lake and started residing in the lotus stalk in a tiny form.

Once she spotted Sack She had beautiful limbs and was without any children. She was quite charming, youthful and adorned with the gem-studded ornaments. She had a beautiful line of teeth. Finding the chaste lady there, - Rajendra Nahusa's mind was filled with passion and he fainted because of his young age. As Radha adorned the chest of Krishna in Goloka or Lakshmi adorns the lap of Vishnu together with Sarasvati or BrahmanI adores the lap of Brahma or Mahasatl adores the lap of Dharma, Lakshmi in the lap of Ananta, in the nether world, Pusti in the lap of Ganesha, Devsena in the lap of Karttikeya, VarunanI in the lap of Varuna, Svaha in the lap of the fire god, Rati in the lap of Kamadeva, Sanjna in the lap of Surya, the wife of Vayu in the lap of the wind-god, Rohini in the lap of the moon, Devamata Aditi your mother in-law in the lap of Kashyapa, Mena mind born daughter of manes in the lap of Himalaya, Lopamudra in the lap of Agastya, Tara in the lap of Brihaspati, DevahutI in the lap of Kardama, Arundhatl in the lap of Vasistha, Satariipa in the lap of Manu, Damayanti in the lap of Nala, similarly О beautiful one, you the virtuous one accept me.

## \|\| 59.26 \|\|

Similarly we can move to Nandakavana, Pus pabhadra river, the mountain known by the name of hundred peaks, the banks of Godavari, where the pleasant cool breeze always blows or the river Campavati and its banks, the attractive campaka forest, cremation grounds, the terrific cremation grounds, the pleasant and lonely forests, the deserted caves of the mountains, the mountains, the forest, islands and the places which are difficult of access, the rivers and rivulets devoid of all the acquit animals, the sea-shores because at such places a competent person can really enjoy the company of a competent woman which is quite rewarding. We shall enjoy the bed of flowers soaked in sandal-paste. You enjoy all your conjugal pleasures with me. О goddess, with the boon of Brahma, I am free from old age or death.

When I was on earth then for enjoying the love-sports with me, UrvasI, herself came to me, but I discouraged her.

36-51. I have never been desirous of others' wives but on finding you today, my mind has been disturbed. Therefore I am prepared to discard all other women, clad in the best of gem-studded ornaments for your sake or I shall keep them as your slaves. О beautiful damsel, I shall garland you with the precious garland of gems by defeating Varuna with Brahmastra. By becoming victorious on the god of fire, I shall bestow on you the two divine garments. Therefore, О goddess you provide an opportunity for a slave like me to serve you. О beautiful one, after achieving victory on the gods I shall adorn you with the makara-kundalas worn by Aditi, which are made of the best of gems. By getting victorious on the moon I shall snatch away the inaccessible armlets of Rohini and give them to you or otherwise Chandrama who is suffering from consumption and happens to be my ancestor, would give me the precious ornaments even without my fighting with him. О auspicious one, I shall beg from Shiva who is always pleased with the prayers and is the lord of the devotees, is quite a compassionate one, is kalpataru\\ for providing the anklets of Parvati which creates a beautiful sound and I shall give them to you. О dear one, the couple of wristlets of Ganga which are studded with the best of gems are difficult to get. I shall get them for you today itself by waging a war. О gracious one, I shall snatch away the beautiful ornaments of Sanjna, the wife of Surya which is made of the best of gems and shall give them to you. I shall get you the spotless mirror of Rati, the wife of Kamadeva, by winning the god of love. O beautiful one, after adoring lord Vishnu I shall seek for the decaying lotus of Lakshmi and give it to you. Thus I shall also by performing tapas take away the rings of Savitri from Brahma. I shall also give to you the vina of Sarasvati who always sings, playing on the vina. Performing the vrata for Narayana I shall also give to you the ornaments of the toes of the wife of Kubera. Thus speaking Nahusa fell at the lotus-like feet of Indrani.

53-57. Shachi said – О son, О great lord, О father, the remover of fear, you listen to whatever I am going to speak. The king saves everyone from the fears, being the preserver he happens to be the father of everyone. Presently Mahendra has been dethroned and you have taken over as the king of heaven. The king happens to be the father of the people, their protector and surely everything for them. The wife of the teacher, the wife of the king, wives of the gods, wife of the son, sister of the mother, sister of the father, wife of the pupils, wife of the servant, wife of the maternal uncle, co-wife, wife of the brothef, the mother-in-law, the sister, the daughter and the family goddess have been defined to be the sixteen mothers in the scriptures. You are a human being and I happen to be the wife of the god, therefore I also happen to be like your mother.

О son, in case you intend to enjoy the company of the mother then go to Aditi because, О son, there is a provision for repentance for every sin but the one who enjoys the company of his mother, no repentance has been prescribed for him. Such a person has to fall in the kitmbhipdka hell. Thereafter for seven births he suffers from leprosy and also the mlecchas. Therefore no remedy has been prescribed for him; this has been ordained by Brahma.

The poets enjoy the creation of poetry, the Vaishnavas enjoy the achieving of the slavehood of Vishnu and the devotion of the lord. The Vaishnavas are never interested in any type of salvation except their devotion of lord Vishnu.
