Therefore О damsel, you come to my house and reaching there, adorn my beautiful bed which is quite charming, is placed in seclusion and is the best for the performance of the love-sport,

## \|\| 59.96 \|\|

*tyaja dvaidhaṃ ca manaso niścitaṃ varavarṇiri \|*  
*varānane mayā sārdhaṃ modasva varamandire \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. O passionate damsel, you be firm in your mind and take a decision. О beautiful faced one, you enjoy pleasure with me in the best of the palaces.

## \|\| 59.97 \|\|

*amūlyaratnamālāṃ ca maṇirājavirājitām \|*  
*bhikṣāṃ kṛtvā ca dāsyāmi lakṣmīvakṣasi śobhitām \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. I shall beg for the garment of gems which adorn the breasts of goddess Lakshmi and offer the same to you.

## \|\| 59.98-103 \|\|

*maṇiṃ cānantaśirasaḥ sarveṣāmatidurlabham \|*  
*duṣprāpyaṃ triṣulokeṣu tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi sundari \|\| 98 \|\|*

*maṇiratnaṃ kaustubhaṃ ca yo nārāyaṇavakṣasi \|*  
*bhikṣāṃ kṛtvā tu dāsyāmi kṛtvā nārāyaṇavratam \|\| 99 \|\|*

*candraśekharamauleśca yadardhaṃ candrabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*jarāmṛtyuvyādhiharaṃ śaktaṃ krīḍākaraṃ varam \|\| 100 \|\|*

*atīva viśvaduṣprāpyaṃ viśvavandyaṃ ca sundaram \|*  
*viśvanāthavrataṃ kṛtvā tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam \|\| 101 \|\|*

*dāsyāmi te śrīsūryasya maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ syamantakam \|*  
*bhaktyā sūryavrataṃ kṛtvā triṣu lokeṣu durlabham \|\| 102 \|\|*

*aṣṭau bhārānsuvarṇaṃ ca yaśca nityaṃ prasūyate \|*  
*jarāsṛtyuharaṃ cava paraṃ krīḍākaraṃ priye \|\| 103 \|\|*

98-103. O beautiful one, the precious gem which illumines the hood of lord Ananta, can be snatched away by me which is difficult to get in the three worlds and shall be brought by me and presented to you. I shall snatch away the kaustubha gem adorning the chest of Narayana and give it to you. I shall get for you the crescent adorning the head of Shiva which destroys old age, death and ailments, besides being quite competent, quite playful and inaccessible in the universe. I shall surely get it for you after performing tapas. О dear one, I shall get the precious gems from SUrya after adoring him with devotion which is difficult to get in the three worlds and bestows gold eight times a day and is beyond old age, death and makes one enjoy the best of love-sport.

## \|\| 59.104 \|\|

*amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ pātraratnaṃ manoharam \|*  
*saṃtataṃ madhṛpūrṇaṃ ca dāsyāmi madanasya ca \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. The vase of gem of the god of love which always remains filled with honey and represents the precious gems, shall surely be brought and presented to you. afijriuafcqfui h4jpi g ttemn

## \|\| 59.105-107 \|\|

*amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ suryatulyaṃ ca tejasā \|*  
*nānacitravicitrāḍhyaṃ nirmāṇamīśvarecchayā \|\| 105 \|\|*

*nirmalaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ saṇirājavirājitam \|*  
*hastalakṣaparimitaṃ caturasraṃ ca sundari \|\| 106 \|\|*

*padmāpadmāsanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ preṣṭhaṃ tasyā sudurlabham \|*  
*dhruvaṃ tumyaṃ pradāsyāmi kṛtvā padmālayāvratam \|\| 107 \|\|*

105-107. О beautiful one, I shall get you the invaluable gem-studded lotus seat of Lakshmi which illumines like the sun rays and which is painted variously and was built at the command of the lord, is spotless, circular, inlaid with lines of diamonds, is spread over an area of a lakh of hands, square in shape and is best of all, loved by Lakshmi, the most difficult to get. The same will be presented by me to you.

## \|\| 59.108 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā nahuṣaḥ kṛtvā vartmaniraudhanam \|*  
*punaḥ papāta caraṇe mahendrāṇyā muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. Thus speaking, Nahusa stood there obstructing the forward movement of Shachi and started falling on her feet again and again.

## \|\| 59.109 \|\|

*nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā \|*  
*tamuvāca mahendrāṇī smāraṃ smāraṃ guruṃ harim \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. Listening to the words of Nahusa, the throat, lips and palate of Shachi dried up but remembering in her mind the lord and the teacher, she said to him.

## \|\| 59.110 \|\|

*śacyuvāca acetanasya mūḍhasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ \|*  
*śroṣyāmyadya katividhāṃ kathāṃ kāmāturasya ca \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Shachi thought in her mind-This foolish fellow getting passionate has lost his senses and has become unmindful of good and bad deeds. For how long shall I have to listen to further?

## \|\| 59.111 \|\|

*madhumattaḥ surāsattaḥ kāmamatto dicetanaḥ \|*  
*mṛtyuṃ na gaṇacetkāmī kāmena hṛtamānasaḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. The one who is intoxicated with honey or drinks, getting infatuated with passion, unconscious and the one who is over-powered with voluptuous ideas, does not care for his death.

## \|\| 59.112-114 \|\|

*tyaja māmadha he matta mātṛtulyāṃ rajakvalām \|*  
*ṛtoḥ prathāmo divaso hyadya he nṛpa me dhruvam \|\| 112 \|\|*

*prathame divase strī ca cāṇḍālī sā rajasvalā \|*  
*dvitīye divase mlecchā tṛtīye rajakī tathā \|\| 113 \|\|*

*śuddhā bhartuścaturye'hni na śuddhā daivapai yayauḥ \|*  
*asacchūdrāsamā sā ca taddine ca paraṃ prati \|\| 114 \|\|*

112-114. Thus thinking in her mind she spoke to the king, "O intoxicated one, I am like your mother and am in period, therefore you leave me. О king this is the first day of my menses and as such a woman in such a condition is treated as a cmdala. On the second day she is treated like a mleccha woman and on the third day like a washer woman and only with fourth day she becomes fit for her husband and not for the performing of the adoration of gods or the manes. But even on that day she remains like an unclean Shudra woman.

## \|\| 59.115 \|\|

*prathame divase kāntāṃ yo hi gacchedrajasvalām \|*  
*brahmahatyācaturthāśaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Therefore, the person who cohabits with a woman in period on the first day, he earns one-fourth sin of Brahmahatya. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 59.116-118 \|\|

*sa pumānna ri karmārhoṃ daive pitrye ca karmaṇi \|*  
*adhamaḥ sa ca sarveṣāṃ ninditaśca yaśaskaraḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

*dvitīye divase nārīṃ yo vrajecca rajasvalām \|*  
*kāmataḥ paripūrṇāñca gohatyāṃ labhate dhruvam \|\| 117 \|\|*

*ājīvanaṃ nādhikārī pitṛviprasurārcane \|*  
*amanuṣyo'yaśasyaḥ syādityāṅgirasabhāṣitam \|\| 118 \|\|*

116-118. Such a person becomes unfit for performing the adoration of the gods and the manes and becomes entitled to the denouncement and earns a bad name. On the second day of the menses of a women, who enjoys her company he surely earns the sin of Gohatya, he becomes unfit for adoring the Brahmana, the manes and the gods for the whole life. He earns bad name and in human indignities, this has been ordained by Brihaspati.

## \|\| 59.119 \|\|

*dṛtīye divase jāyāṃ yo hi gacchedrajasvalām \|*  
*sa mūḍho bhrūṇahatyāṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayāḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. The one who enjoys the company of a damsel on the third day of the menstruation he earns the sin of killing foetus; there is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 59.120-122 \|\|

*pūrvavatpatitaḥ so'pi na cārhaḥ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*asacchūdrā caturthe'hni na gacchettāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*yadi māṃ mātaraṃ mūḍha grahīṣyasi balena ca \|\| 120 \|\|*

*ṛtāvatīte divase gamanaṃ ca kariṣyasi \|*  
*śacyāśca vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya nahuṣastayā \|\| 121 \|\|*

*uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaḥ śakrakāntāṃ ca suvratām \|*  
*devapatnī sadā śuddhā tannyūnaṃ mānavaṃ prati \|\| 122 \|\|*

120-122. Having so fallen like the earlier cases he also becomes unfit to performing the auspicious deeds. The intelligent person should not cohabits with a women who is considered to be an untouchable even on the fourth day of menstruation. О foolish one, even if you intend to enjoy my company who is like your mother, then you can do so only after the period of menstruation. On hearing the words of chaste Sack Nahusa laughed and with peaceful and sweet words he spoke to her. The wife of a god is always pure but for a human being it is not so.

## \|\| 59.123-126 \|\|

*śayane bhojane devī nāśuddhā mānavaṃ prati \|*  
*rajasvalāyāḥ saṃbhoge karmakṣetre ca bhārate \|\| 123 \|\|*

*tvayoktaṃ ca bhavetpā paṃ nātra du (sva)rge ca sundari \|*  
*karmakṣetre'pi tatkarma yadvedoktaṃ śubhāśubham \|\| 124 \|\|*

*na bhavedvaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jvalatāṃ brahmatejasā \|*  
*yathā pradīpte vahnau ca śuṣkāṇi ca tṛṇāni ca \|\| 125 \|\|*

*bhavanti bhasmībhūtāni tathā pāpāni vaiṣṇape \|*  
*vahnisūryabrāhmaṇebhyastejayānvaiṣṇapaḥ sadā \|\| 126 \|\|*

123-126. At time of sleeping as well as taking food, for a human being the wife of god can never be impure. О beautiful one, the sin you have highlighted about cohabiting with a woman in menstruation is applicable only into the sacred land of Bharata and not to heaven. The results of the good or bad deeds performed in the auspicious land of Bharata getting illumined with the lustre of Brahma are not applicable to the Vaishnavas because as the blade of grass is reduced to ashes in the flaming fire, so all sins are reduced to ashes, with a Vaishnava. This is because the Vaishnavas are more illustrious as compared to Agni, Stirya and the Brahmanas..

## \|\| 59.127 \|\|

*rakṣito viṣṇucakreṇa svatantro mattakuṃjaraḥ \|*  
*na vicāro na bhogaśca paiṣmavānāṃ svakarmaṇām \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. They are quite independent, because they are protected by the Sudarsana-cakra of Vishnu as was done in the case of the intoxicated elephant. The Vaishnavas do not have to reap the reward of their actions nor do they have to think of any actions.

## \|\| 59.128 \|\|

*nikhitaṃ sāmni kauthumyāṃ kuru praśnaṃ bṛhaspatīm \|*  
*asmāṃśca sarve jānanti candravaṃśyāṃśca vaiṣṇavān \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. All these things are enshrined in the kauthuml-sakha of Sdmaveda. You can consult your teacher Brihaspati in this regard. We are the Vais navas of the lunar race and are well-known the world over.

## \|\| 59.129-130 \|\|

*devamanyaṃ na sevante candravaṃśyā hariṃ vinā \|*  
*sadvaṃśaprabhavo yo hi brahmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo'thavā \|\| 129 \|\|*

*viṣṇumantraṃ na gṛṇhāti vañcito devamāyayā \|*  
*ko vā mantraśca ke devā na hi śāstā yamo mama \|\| 130 \|\|*

129-130. The Kshatriyas of the lunar race except the lord do not adore any other gods and goddesses. Having been born in the high Brahmana or Ks atriyas race, the people having been deprived of the illusion of Vishnu, do not receive Vishnu-mantra. But for me there is neither any mantra nor a god. Even Yama cannot exercise his control on me.

## \|\| 59.131 \|\|

*sarvāñchāstuṃ samartho'haṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivānvinā \|*  
*śayyāṃ kṛru guhaṃ gatvā śīghraṃ yāsyāmi te gṛham \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. I myself alone, except Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva can govern the universe. Therefore, reaching your home, you adorn the bed. I shall reach there in no time.

## \|\| 59.132-133 \|\|

*ṛtupāpaṃ mayi bhavettava kiṃ gaccha śobhane \|*  
*ityuktvā nahuṣo rājā praphullavadanekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

*ratnayānaṃ samāruhya yayau nandanakānanam \|*  
*na yayau sā śacī gehaṃ prajagāma gurorgṛham \|\| 133 \|\|*

132-133. "О beautiful one, I shall earn the sin of cohabiting with a woman in period. You don't have to lose anything. Therefore you go home." Thus speaking and with a delightful mind king Nahusa mounted on a gem-studded vehicle, proceeded to Nandana-vana and Saci instead of. going to her place, went to her teacher.

## \|\| 59.134-136 \|\|

*gatva kūśāsanasyaṃ ca dadarśa ca bṛhaspatim \|*  
*tārāsevitapādābjaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 134 \|\|*

*japamālākaraṃ śaśvajjapantaṃ kṛṣṇamīpsitam \|*  
*paramaṃ paramānandaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 135 \|\|*

*nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca svatantraṃ prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma bhaktānugrahavigraham \|\| 136 \|\|*

134-136. Reaching there she found Brihaspati seated on the seat of kusa-grass and Тйга was serving at his lotus-like feet. He was illumining with the divine lustre. Tara holding a rosary in her hand was reciting the name of lord Krishna who is the supreme lord, all blissful, the soul of all, the great lord, without qualities, unattached, beyond Prakriti, moves at will, eternal Parabrahma, bestower of grace on his devotees and takes to human form for their sake.

## \|\| 59.137-138 \|\|

*tamānandāśrunetraṃ ca nanāma śinakā bhuvi \|*  
*rudatī sāśrunetrā kā majjantī bhaktisāgare \|\| 137 \|\|*

*śokārṇave nimajjantī hṛdayena vidūyatā \|*  
*tuṣṭāva bhītā svaguruṃ brahmiṣṭhaṃ ca kṛpānidhim \|\| 138 \|\|*

137-138. She then looked at her teacher whose eyes were filled with blissful tears. Saci found the teacher getting drowned in the ocean of devotion. She bowed before him placing her head on the ground. Saci was drowning in the ocean of grief and feeling painful at heart, getting terrified, she started praising, the teacher who was all merciful and was engrossed in the adoration of Brahman.

## \|\| 59.139 \|\|

*śacyuvāca rakṣa rakṣa mahābhāga māṃ bhītāṃ śaraṇāgatām \|*  
*tvamīśvaraḥ svadāsīṃ ca nimagnāṃ śokasāgare \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. Saci said – О virtuous one, you are free from fear, you save your slave who is terrified and drowned in the ocean of grief and has arrived to take refuse with you, you save her. You are an all competent one.

## \|\| 59.140 \|\|

*anīśvaraśceśvaro vā baravānvā sudurbalaḥ \|*  
*svaśiṣyabhāryāṃ putrāṃśca śāsituṃ ca sadā kṣamaḥ \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. You are competent to control the lord or the demon, the valorous or the weak, you are competent enough to control the wife and the sons of your pupils.

## \|\| 59.141 \|\|

*dūrībhūtaḥ svarājyācca svaśiṣyaśca kṛtastvayā \|*  
*śāntirbabhūva doṣasya cādhunā'nugrahaṃ kuru \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. Your pupil Indra has been deprived of his kingdom because of the sin committed by him; therefore you be merciful now.

## \|\| 59.142 \|\|

*anāthāṃ sarvaśūnyāṃ māṃ śunyāṃ tāmamarāvatīm \|*  
*saṃpacchūnyamāśramaṃ me paśya rakṣa kṛṇānidhe \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. O ocean of mercy, I am helpless and an orphan, you take care of the city of Amaravati which is devoid of the gods, the riches, besides my abode.

## \|\| 59.143 \|\|

*dasyugrastāṃ ca māṃ rakṣa deśaṃ kiṃkaramānaya \|*  
*dattavā caraṇareṇūṃstaṃ śubhāśīrvacanaṃ kuru \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. I am presently being terrified by the robbers. You kindly protect me and bring back Indra who happens to be your slave and grace him with the dust of your feet and pronounce your blessings on him.

## \|\| 59.144-146 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ ca suruṇāṃ ca janmadātā paro guruḥ \|*  
*pituḥ śataguṇā mātā pūjyā vandyā garīyasī \|\| 144 \|\|*

*vidyādātā mantradātā jñānado haribhaktidaḥ \|*  
*pūjyo vandyaśca sevyaśca mātuḥ śataguṇo guruḥ \|\| 145 \|\|*

*mantrādyudgiraṇenaiva gururityucyate budhaiḥ \|*  
*anyo vandyo gururayamanyaścāropito guruḥ \|\| 146 \|\|*

144-146. Of all the teachers, the father happens to be the greatest of teachers, but the mother is hundred times more adorable as a teacher than the father who is all glorious, the teacher who bestows knowledge on someone is hundred times greater than the mother, the bestower of the mantras, the knowledge and the devotion of the gods, is more adorable than anyone else. The teacher with the reciting of the mantras makes them enter into the ears of the pupil which earns him the title of Guru. The other gurus are also adorable, while some of the teachers are only imaginary.

## \|\| 59.147-148 \|\|

*ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā \|*  
*cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

*adīkṣitasya mūrkhasya niṣkṛtirnāsti ni ścitam \|*  
*sarvakarmasvanarhasya narake tatpaśoḥ sthitiḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

147-148. I adore the teacher who has removed the darkness of ignorance from the eyes of his pupil, who has applied the collyrium of his knowledge in the eyes of his pupils. I bow in reverence to the greatness of such a teacher. The one who has not received DTksa there does not seem to be any rescue for him. He is unfit for all the deeds, such an animal only falls into hell.

## \|\| 59.149-150 \|\|

*janmadātā'nnadātā ca mātā'nye guravāstathā \|*  
*pāraṃ kartuṃ na śaktāste ghorasaṃsārasāgare \|\| 149 \|\|*

*vidyāmantrajñānadātā nipuṇaḥ pārakarmaṇi \|*  
*sa śaktaḥ śiṣyamuddhartumīśvaraśceśvarātparaḥ \|\| 150 \|\|*

149-150. The father who gives birth, the giver of food and the teacher of other kinds do not help in crossing the ocean of the universe on the teacher who bestows knowledge, mantra or education, can help one in crossing the ocean of the universe. The pupils are surely redeemed by them. He is like the lord and the lord is even greater than him.

## \|\| 59.151-152 \|\|

*gururviṣṇurgururbrahmā gururdevo maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*gururdharmo guruḥ śeṣaḥ sarvātmā nirguṇo guruḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

*sarvatīrthāśrayaścaiva karvadevāśrayo guruḥ \|*  
*sarvavedasvarupaśca gururūpī hariḥ svayam \|\| 152 \|\|*

151-152. Similarly Vishnu is the teacher, Brahma is the teacher, Maheshvara is the teacher, Dharma is the teacher, Shesha is the teacher and the from of all the teacher, is without qualities. He is the refuge of all the holy places, the refuge of all the gods and is the from of all the Vedas, therefore they like the lord himself.

## \|\| 59.153-154 \|\|

*abhīṣṭadeve ruṣṭe ca guruḥśakto hi rakṣitum \|*  
*gurau ruṣṭe'bhīṣṭadevo na hi śaktaśca rakṣitum \|\| 153 \|\|*

*sarve grahāśca yaṃ ruṣṭā yaṃ ruṣṭā devabrāhmaṇāḥ \|*  
*tvameva ruṣṭo bhavasi gurureva hi devatāḥ \|\| 154 \|\|*

153-154. When the family god is annoyed, it is only the teacher who can save one from his wrath, but when the teacher is annoys the family gods cannot protect the person. The one who annoys all the planets, the gods and the Brahmanas, the teacher also gets annoyed on them. And the teacher himself is a god.

## \|\| 59.155 \|\|

*na gurośca priyaścā''tmā na gurośca priyaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*dhanaṃ priyaṃ ca na gurorna ca bhāryā priyā tathā \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. No one is dearer on earth as compared to guru, neither the son, nor the riches or the wife.

## \|\| 59.156 \|\|

*na gurośca priyo dharmo na gurośca priyaṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*na gurośca priyaṃ satyaṃ na puṇyaṃ ca guroḥ param \|\| 156 \|\|*

156\. Dharma is also not dearer than the teacher, neither tapas nor satya and there is no other merit greater than the teacher.

## \|\| 59.157-158 \|\|

*guroḥ paro na śāstā ca na hi bandhurguroḥ paraḥ \|*  
*devo rājā ca śāstā ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca sadā guruḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

*yāvacchakto dātumannaṃ tāvacchāstā tadannadaḥ \|*  
*guruḥ śāstā ca śiṣyāṇāṃ pratijanmani janmani \|\| 158 \|\|*

157-158. There is no better ruler than the teacher, no better well-wisher than the teacher. For the teacher is always the god, the king and the ruler. The one who gives away food enjoys himself till such time as he provides the food, but a teacher rules on his people during many births.

## \|\| 59.159 \|\|

*mantro vidyā gururdevaḥ pūrvalabdho yathā patiḥ \|*  
*pratijanmani bandhena sarveṣāmupari sthitaḥ \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. Like the husband, the mantra and knowledge, the teacher also is achieved by the performing of the good deeds of earlier births. Having been bound with the fetters of the Karma the teachers are placed in the highest position in every birth.

## \|\| 59.160 \|\|

*pitā guruśca vandyaśca yatra janmani janmadaḥ \|*  
*guravo'nye tathā mātā guruśca pratijanmani \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. The father gives birth during this birth only and he is adored in the same births as a teacher also, the mothers as the teacher is also be considered like that but the teacher is adorable in all the births.

## \|\| 59.161 \|\|

*viprāṇāṃ tvaṃ variṣṭhaśca gariṣṭhaśca tapastinām \|*  
*brahmiṣṭhau brahmavidbrahmavidbrahman dharmiṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmiṇām \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. O Brahman, you are the best of the Brahmanas, the most illustrious one among the ascetics, the one completely devoted to Brahma, possessing knowledge of Brahma, the best of all the religious people.

## \|\| 59.162 \|\|

*tuṣṭo bhava muniśreṣṭha māṃ ca śakraṃ ca saṃpratam \|*  
*tvayi tuṣṭe sadā tuṣṭā bhavanti grahadevatāḥ \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. Therefore, О best of the sages, you be pleased with me and Indra presently because if you are pleased with me all the gods will be pleased.

## \|\| 59.163 \|\|

*ityuktvā kā śacī brahmanpunaruccau ruroda ha \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tadrodanaṃ tārā rurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ \|\| 163 \|\|*

163\. О Brahman, thus speaking Sac! again started crying aloud. On finding her crying Tara too followed her.

## \|\| 59.164 \|\|

*papāta caraṇe tārā ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*aparādhaṃ kṣametyuktvā gurustuṣṭo'pyuvāca tām \|\| 164 \|\|*

164\. Thereafter, Tara falling at the feet of the teacher started crying and said, "You kindly forgive the sin". Thereafter the teacher was pleased and said to them.

## \|\| 59.165 \|\|

*gururuvāca uttiṣṭha tāre śacyāśca sarva bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*sadyaḥ prāpsyati bhartāraṃ mahendraṃ ca madāśiṣā \|\| 165 \|\|*

165\. The teacher said – О Tara you get up, Sac! will surely meet with welfare. With my blessing she would surely achieve Indra.

## \|\| 59.166-168 \|\|

*ityuktvā sa gurustatra virarāma ca nārada \|*  
*papāta caraṇe tārā punareva ruroda ca \|\| 166 \|\|*

*guhītvā ca śacīṃ tārā saṃsthāpya ca svavakṣaki \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa vividhamādhyātmikamanuttamam \|\| 167 \|\|*

*śacīkṛtaṃ gurustotraṃ pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*guruścābhīṣṭadevaśca saṃtuṣṭaḥ pratijanmani \|\| 168 \|\|*

166-168. О Narada, thus speaking the teacher kept quiet but Tara again fell on his feet and started crying. Thereafter, Tara embracing Shachi, imparted her various types of divine knowledge. The one who recites the Guru-stotra composed by Shachi regularly at the time of adoration, all his teachers get pleased with him in every birth.

## \|\| 59.169-170 \|\|

*grahadevadvijāstaṃ ca parituṣṭāśca saṃtatam \|*  
*rājāno bāndhavāścaiva saṃtuṣṭāḥ sarvataḥ sadā \|\| 169 \|\|*

*gurubhaktiṃ viṣṇubhaktiṃ vāñchitaṃ labhate dhruvam \|*  
*sadā harṣo bhavettasya na ca śokaḥ kadācana \|\| 170 \|\|*

169-170. The planets, the gods and Brahmanas always remain pleased with him. He always pleases his relatives and kings. He surely achieves the devotion of the teacher and Vishnu obtaining all success; he is always delightful and is deprived of grief.

## \|\| 59.171-172 \|\|

*putrārtho labhate putraṃ bhāryārtho labhate priyam \|*  
*susvarupāṃ guṇavatīṃ satīṃ putravatīṃ dhruvam \|\| 171 \|\|*

*rogārtoṃ mucyate rogādbaddho mucyota bandhanāt \|*  
*aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkhobhavati paṇḍitaḥ \|\| 172 \|\|*

171-172. The one desirous of getting a son, gets a son; the one desirous of getting a wife, gets a beautiful, virtuous, chaste wife who bears his sons. The one suffering from ailment is relieved of the same and the person in fetters is freed from them. The person having no glory becomes glorious and a foolish person becomes an intellectual.

## \|\| 59.173-176 \|\|

*kadācidbandhuvicchedo na bhavettasya niścitam \|*  
*nityaṃ tadvardhate dharmoṃ vipulaṃ nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ \|\| 173 \|\|*

*labhate paramaiśvaryaṃ putrapautradhanānvitam \|*  
*iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuktvā prāpyate śrīhareḥ padam \|\| 174 \|\|*

*na bhavettatpunarjanma haridāsyaṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*viṣṇubhaktinamābdhau ca nimagnaśca bhaveddhruvam \|\| 175 \|\|*

*śāśvatpibati śāntiśca viṣṇubhaktirasāmṛtam \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokasaṃtāpanāśanam \|\| 176 \|\|*

173-176. He never has to suffer from the separation of his relatives, this is certain. There is always an increase of dharma and he always enjoys spotless glory. He achieves all the fortunes including sons and grandsons, enjoying all the pleasures in this world; he ultimately achieves the place of the lord. Achieving the slavehood of lord Hari there, he is never reborn and he is always influenced by the devotion of lord Hari. He always consumes the nectar of the devotion of the lord Vishnu getting peaceful and becoming free from birth, death, old age, ailment, grief and mental agony,

## Chapter 60

## \|\| 60.1 \|\|

*atha ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śācostotraṃ samākarṇya parituṣṭo bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaḥ kāntāmindrasya nārada \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shri Narayana said – О Narada, after listening to the prayer of Shachi, Brihaspati was immensely pleased; thereafter quite peacefully he spoke sweet these words to her.

## \|\| 60.2 \|\|

*bṛhaspatiruvāca tyaja vatse bhayaṃ sarva bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite \|*  
*yathā kacasya patnī me tathā tvamapi śobhane \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Brihaspati said – О daughter, you be free from all danger, you will face no danger as long as I am alive. О beautiful one, as I have my daughter-in-law, the son of Kaca you are like her.

## \|\| 60.3-4 \|\|

*yathā putraśtathā śiṣyo na bhedaḥ putraśiṣyayoḥ \|*  
*tarpaṇe pitṛdāne ca pālane paritoṣaṇo \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yathā'gnidātā putraśca tathā śiṣyaśca niścitam \|*  
*itīdaṃ kaṇvaśākhāyāmuvāca kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Because as the son serves the food, Pindadana and maintains the parents, similarly the pupil also does so. Therefore there is no difference between a son and a pupil. As the son performs the last rites, similarly the pupil also does so. This is certain and this has been prescribed by Brahma in Kanva-sakha.

## \|\| 60.5-7 \|\|

*pitā mātā gururbhāryā śiśuścānāthabāndhavāḥ \|*  
*ete puṃsāṃ nityapoṣyā ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yaścaitāṃśca na puṣṇāti bhasmāntaṃ tasya sūtakam \|*  
*daive pitrye na karmārhaḥ mo'pītyāha maheśvaraḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kurute naraburddhi ca mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum \|*  
*ayaśastasya sarvatra vidhna eva pade pade \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Brahma has ordained that the father, the mother, the teacher, the wife, the children and orphan relatives are to be served by the people. The one who does not take care of them has to remain infested with impurity, right from birth to cremation and is not considered fit to perform the adoration of gods or the manes; this has been prescribed by lord Shiva. The one who illiterates his parents and the teacher, earns a bad name and has to face obstruction at every step.

## \|\| 60.8 \|\|

*saṃpanmatto yaḥ karoti svagurośca parābhavam \|*  
*acinātsarvanāśāśca bhavettasya suniścitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Getting intoxicated with riches if he insults his teacher, he surely meets with his destruction. This is certain.

## \|\| 60.9-10 \|\|

*māṃ ca dṛṣṭavā sabhāmadhye nottasathau pākaśāsanaḥ \|*  
*tatphalaṃ bhujyate sākṣātsadyaḥ paśya ca sāṃpratam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ahaṃ karomi mokṣaṃ ca tava rakṣāṃ suniścitam \|*  
*śāsituṃ rakṣituṃ śaktaḥ sa eva surucyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. After finding my arrival at his court, Indra did not get up to welcome me from his lion-throne and presently he had to suffer for the same. I will surely protect you and also redeem Indra because the one who can rule and protect everyone of his pupils, only he is called the true teacher.

## \|\| 60.11 \|\|

*na paśyati satītvaṃ ca hṛcchuddhāyāśca yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*yanmānase vikalpaśca tasya dharmaśca naśyati \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The one who becomes careless about his wife, who is spotlessly chaste and only thinks of his own selfish ends, several types of desires therefore arise in his mind and ultimately his dharma is destroyed.

## \|\| 60.12 \|\|

*bhaviṣyati prabhāvaste durgāyāśca samaḥ sati \|*  
*lakṣmīsamā pratiṣṭhā ca yaśastadyaśasā samam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Your fortune would be like that of Radhika and like her you would achieve love, glory, affection. You and I would always be devoted to Indra.

## \|\| 60.13 \|\|

*saubhāgyaṃ rādhikātulyaṃ tatsamaṃ premabhartari \|*  
*tattulyaṃ gauravaṃ mānyaṃ prītiḥ prādhānyamīśvare \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You will be desirable by Indra like Rohini, would be adorable like Sarasvati and would always be spotless like Savitri.

## \|\| 60.14 \|\|

*rohiṇyāśca samāpekṣā pūjyā ca bhāratīsamā \|*  
*śuddhā nirupamā śaśvatsāvitrīsadṛśī sadā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. In the meantime a messenger arrived from the house of Nahusa and feeling panicky, he spoke before Brihaspati. The messenger said – "O goddess, get up, Nahusa is waiting for you in a charming and lonely place in Nandana-vana for love-sport and you immediately move on to that place."

## \|\| 60.15-16 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra āgato nahṛṣāccaraḥ \|*  
*uvāca vacanaṃ bhīto vākpatergoṃcare tataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*dūta uvāca uttiṣṭha devi śīghraṃ tvaṃ gacchasva nahuṣaṃ prati \|*  
*krīḍāṃ kartu ca rahasi ramye nandanakānane \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. On hearing the words of the messenger, Brihaspati was enraged. His body started shaking and the eyes turned red the blood.

## \|\| 60.17 \|\|

*dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutavā tamuvāca bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*kampitāvayavaḥ kopādraktapaṅkajalocanaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Brihaspati said – You go and inform Nahusa, "in case you intend to enjoy the conjugal pleasure with Shachi, then you come at night mounted on an unprecedented vehicle. Or otherwise you come in a palanquin carried by Saptarsis clad in beautiful costumes."

## \|\| 60.18-19 \|\|

*gururuvāca nahuṣaṃ vada gatvā tvaṃ śacīṃ ce dbhoktumicchasi \|*  
*apūrva yānamāruhya niśāyāmāgamiṣyasi \|\| 18 \|\|*

*saptarṣīṇāṃ ca skandhe ca datvā svaśivikāṃ śubhām \|*  
*tāmāruhya suveṣaśca gamanaṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. On hearing the words of Brihaspati, the messengers went back and informed the king accordingly. Listening to the words of the messenger, Nahusa laughed and said to the messenger.

## \|\| 60.20 \|\|

*vākpatervacanaṃ śrutvā gatvovāca nṛpaṃ tadā \|*  
*dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasyovāca kiṃkaram \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. "O messenger, you move at once and bring the Saptarsis here at once I shall make suitable arrangements with them."

## \|\| 60.21 \|\|

*gaccha gaccha tvaran gaccha saptarṣīñchīghramānaya \|*  
*upāyaṃ ca kariṣyāmi taiḥ sārdhaṃ sāprataṃ cara \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. On hearing the words of the king, the messengers went to Saptarsis and repeated the words of Nahusa to them.

## \|\| 60.22 \|\|

*nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā gatvā dūtastadantisam \|*  
*uvāca sarvāṃstatraiva yathoktaṃ nahuṣeṇa ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. On hearing the words of the messengers, all the Saptarsis arrived at the palace of the king delightfully who bowed in reverence to them.

## \|\| 60.23 \|\|

*dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā yayuḥ saptarṣayo mudā \|*  
*rājā dṛṣṭvā ca tānsarvānnanāmovāca sādaram \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Nahusa said – All of you are the sons of Brahma, possessing the eternal lustre and are attached to your devotees like Brahma himself.

## \|\| 60.24 \|\|

*nahuṣa uvāca yūyaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ putrā jvalanto brahmatejasā \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ madṛśāḥ sarve satataṃ bhaktavatsalāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Because of your devotion to Narayana you are spotless and are the form of sattva, free from attachment, pride and arrogance. You equate yourself with Narayana in lustre and glory, you are also like him in virtues, compassion, love and granting the boons,

## \|\| 60.25-26 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaparāḥ śaśvacchuddhasattavasvarūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*mohamātsaryahīnāśca darpāhaṃkāravarjitāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇasamāḥ sarve tejasā yaśasā sadā \|*  
*guṇena kṛpayā premṇā varadānena niścitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Thus speaking the king meekly prayed to them and started crying. Finding the king filled with grief, the ascetics said. Saptarsis said – О son, you ask for a boon; whatever is desired by you we are sure to bestow on you. There is nothing beyond our competence,

## \|\| 60.27-28 \|\|

*ityuktavā praṇato rājā tuṣṭāva ca ruroda ca \|*  
*dṛṣṭavā te kātaraṃ bhūpamūcuḥ parahitaiṣiṇaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ varaṃ pṛṇīṣva he vatsa yatte manasi vāñchitam \|*  
*sarvaṃ dātuṃ vayaṃ śaktā nāsārdhya naśca kiṃcana \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The position of Indra, Manu, long life, the lordship of seven islands, becoming eternal and achieving of everlasting pleasure, all the success of all the fortunes which are beyond the reach of anyone else or salvation or the devotion to Hari or whatever is beyond the reach of anyone else can be bestowed by us.

## \|\| 60.29-30 \|\|

*indratvaṃ vā manutvaṃ vā cirāyurvā tataḥ param \|*  
*saptaddhīpeśvaratvaṃ cāpyatīva suciraṃ sukham \|\| 29 \|\|*

*athāpi sarvasiddhitvaṃ sarvaiśvarya sudurlabham \|*  
*muktiṃ vā haribhaktiṃ vā tapasā yā sudurlabhā \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. O son, in which one of these things are you interested you tell us just now with pleasure, we shall bestow everything delightfully and thereafter leave for performing tapas.

## \|\| 60.31 \|\|

*kimīpsitaṃ te he vatsa brūhi naḥ sāṃprataṃ mudā \|*  
*sarva tumyaṃ pradāyaiva yāsyāmastapase mudā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The time spent without the adoration of Krishna is equated with lakhs of yugas and the day which is spent without his adoration is considered to be a bad day.

## \|\| 60.32 \|\|

*yugalakṣasamaṃ yacca kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇārcanaṃ vinā \|*  
*taddinaṃ durdinaṃ yattaddhyānasevanavarjitam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The one who desires for something else than serving him is considered to be like inviting his total destruction and the consumption of poison.

## \|\| 60.33-36 \|\|

*vinā tatsevanaṃ yo hi viṣayānyaṃ ca vāñchati \|*  
*viṣamatti praṇāśāya vihāyāmṛtamīpsitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*brahmā śivaśca dharmaśca viṣṇuścāpi mahānvirāṭ \|*  
*gaṇeśaśca dineśaśca śaṣeśca sanakādayaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*ete yaccaraṇambhojaṃ dhyāyante'harniśaṃ mudā \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ tanniratā vayam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrṛtvā tānuvāca nṛpeśvaraḥ \|*  
*sa lajjito namravaktra māyāmohitamānasaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

33-36. All the gods like Brahma, Shiva, Dharma, Vis nu, Mahavirat, Ganesha, Surya, Shesha, Sanaka and other sages always meditate upon his lotus-like feet. The same feet relieve of birth, death, old age and ailment. We always meditate upon the same. On hearing the words of the Saptarsis, Nahusa who was influenced by illusion spoke in shame casting his head downwards.

## \|\| 60.37-38 \|\|

*nahaṣa uvāca sarva dātuṃ samarthāśca yūyaṃ ca bhaktavatsalāḥ \|*  
*adhunā dehi (datta) me tūrṇaṃ śacīdānamabhīpsitam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*saptarṣivāhanaṃ kāntaṃ śacīcchati mahāsatī \|*  
*etadeva mama varaṃ niṣpannaṃ kurutācinam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Nahusa said – "You are competent enough to bestow everything and are graceful to the devotees. Therefore, you kindly bestow the boon of granting Sac! to me at the moment. The chaste Sac! desires that her beloved should be carried by Saptarsis in a vehicle. I only desire this much of the boon, you kindly bestow on me your grace accordingly.".

## \|\| 60.39-40 \|\|

*nahuṣasya vacaḥ śrutvā munayaśca parasparam \|*  
*matyuccairjahasuḥ sarve kautukena ca nārada \|\| 39 \|\|*

*rājānaṃ mohitaṃ matvā veṣṭitaṃ viṣṇumāyayā \|*  
*cakruḥ pratijñāṃ taṃ voḍhuṃ kṛpayā dīnavatsalāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. О Narada, on hearing the words of Nahusa, all the ascetics playfully laughed aloud. Finding that the king had been influenced by the illusion of Vishnu, the Rsis who were graceful on the down-trodden people agreed to carry the palanquin of the king Nahusa.

## \|\| 60.41-43 \|\|

*cakruḥ skanadhe tacchivikāṃ muktāmāṇikyabhūṣitām \|*  
*rājā yayau suveṣaśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā cātivilambaṃ ca bhartsayāmāsa tānnṛpaḥ \|*  
*krudhā śāśāpa durvāsāścāgragāmī ca vartmani \|\| 42 \|\|*

*mahānajaganaro bhūtvā pata vai mūḍhamānasa \|*  
*darśanāddharmaputrasya tava mokṣo bhaviṣyati \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. Thereafter the palanquin which was inlaid with several gems was carried on their shoulders. King Nahusa adorned himself with all the gem-studded ornament and the best of costumes was seated in the palanquin. Finding that the sages were moving quite slowly, the king admonished them for their low speed. The sage Durvasa who was leading them all was enraged and he pronounced a curse on the king saying, "O foolish minded king, you fall down becoming a huge python." You will be relieved of the curse only at an audience with Yudhisthira. О great king, thereafter, you will proceed to Vaikuntha mounted on a gem-studded plane and would enjoy all the pleasures, because the actions never remain infructuous.

## \|\| 60.44-46 \|\|

*ratnayānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ gatvā vaikuṇṭhasevanam \|*  
*kariṣyasi mahārāja na karma niṣphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarve prahasya munisattamāḥ \|*  
*rājā papāta tacchāpātsarpoṃ bhūtvā mahāmune \|\| 45 \|\|*

*śacī cagāma ttacchrṛtvā guruṃ natvā'marāvatīm \|*  
*yayau bṛhaspatiḥ śīghraṃ yatrendraḥ padmatantuṣu \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. О great sage, thus speaking all the sages left the place similarly and with the curse pronounced on the king he was turned into a snake. On hearing this Sac! bowed in reverence to her teacher and went back to the city of Amaravati. Brihaspati also reached there quickly, the place where Indra was hiding himself in the lotus stalk.

## \|\| 60.47 \|\|

*gatvā sanovarāmyāśamājuhāva sureśvaram \|*  
*atiprasannavadanaḥ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The merciful Brihaspati with a delightful mind went into the lake and started calling Indra.

## \|\| 60.48-50 \|\|

*bṛhaspatiruvāca ayivatsatvamāgāccha bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite \|*  
*tyaja bhītimihāgaccha gurustehaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*svagurośca svaraṃ śrutvā mahendro hṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*rūpaṃ vihāya sūkṣmaṃ ca svarūpeṇa samāyayau \|\| 49 \|\|*

*papāta daṇḍavanmūrdhnā bhaktyā caraṇayorguroḥ \|*  
*taṃ rudantaṃ mahābhītaṃ mudorasi cakāra saḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. Brihaspati said – О son, you come near me because, as long as I am there, you can never be afraid, be fearless and come to me, I am Brihaspati your teacher calling for you. Recognising the voice of his teacher Mahendra at once was filled with delight and shedding away his tiny form, took to his natural form. On reaching before the teacher he prostrated before him. Brihaspati on his part lifted up the terrified and crying Indra and embraced him lovingly.

## \|\| 60.51-52 \|\|

*kārayitvā somayāgaṃ pragayaścittāthaṃmeva ca \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsa taṃ guruḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*pradadau paramaiśvaryaṃ pūrvasmācca caturaguṇam \|*  
*āgatya sarvadevāśca cakruḥ sevāṃ mudā'nvitā \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Thereafter he had the soma-yajha performed by Indra for his repentance and then enthroned him on the gem-studded lion-throne. He was bestowed on him four times more the fortune and all the gods returned to serve him.

## \|\| 60.53 \|\|

*pradadau paramaiśvarya pūrvasmācca caturguṇam \|*  
*āgatya sarvadevāśca cakuḥ sevāṃ mudā'nvitā \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Sac! getting back Indra the lord of gods went to her place and delightfully started enjoying the conjugal pleasures on a bed of roses.

## \|\| 60.54 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa mahendradarpabhañjanam \|*  
*śacīsatītvarakṣā ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. О son, thus I have narrated to you the story relating to the shattering of the pride of Mahendra and the protection of the chastity of Sac!. What else do you want to listen to from me?

## \|\| 60.55 \|\|

*nārada uvāca somayāgavidhānaṃ ca brūhi māṃ munisattama \|*  
*kathaṃ taṃ kārayāmāsa guruśca kiṃ phalaṃ param \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Narada said – О best of the sages, you kindly tell me the method of performing Soma-yajna. How does the teacher get the yajna performed and what is the result of the same?

## \|\| 60.56-58 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca brahmahatyāpraśamanaṃ somayāgaphalaṃ mune \|*  
*varṣa somalatāpānaṃ yajamānaḥ karoti ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

*varṣamekaṃ phalaṃ bhuṅakte varṣamekaṃ jalaṃ mudā \|*  
*traivārṣikaṃ vratamidaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yasya traivāṣikaṃ dhānyaṃ nihitaṃ bhūtavṛddhaye \|*  
*adhikaṃ vā'pi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. Narayana said – О sage, the main object of perfonning the Soma-yajna is to relieve one of the curses of the Brahmahatya. According to the procedure laid down in the scriptures, the performer has to consume Somalata for a year. He takes fruit for one year and for one year he has to live on the water alone. It destroys all the sins and can be completed in three years. The one who keeps a stock of eatables for three years, for increase in the welfare of the people for three years and stores the food stuffs for more than that period, he alone gets entitled to the drinking of Soma.

## \|\| 60.59 \|\|

*mahārājaśca depo vā yāgaṃ kartumalaṃ mune \|*  
*na sarvamādhyo yajño'yaṃ bahvanno bahudakṣiṇaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. О sage, only the great king or the god can perform this yajna and none else because one has to distribute enough of riches and food stuffs as daksina for this yajna.

## Chapter 61

## \|\| 61.1 \|\|

*athaikaṣaṣṭi,mo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca iti te kathitaṃ kiṃcidindrasya darpabhañjanam \|*  
*aparaṃ śrūyatāṃ brahmansāvadhānaṃ nigūḍhakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shri Narayana said – О Brahman, I have spoken to you about the shattering of the pride of Indra to some extent. Now you listen to the second incident about him quite carefully.

## \|\| 61.2-5 \|\|

*samudramathanaṃ kṛtvā pītvā'mṛtarasaṃ purā \|*  
*nirjitya daityasaṃghāṃśca bahudarpo babhūva ha \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tadā kṛṣṇo balidvārā śakradarpa babhañja ha \|*  
*bhraṣṭaśriyo babhūvuste devā indrapurogamāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tadā bṛhaspateḥ stautrādaditeśca vratena te \|*

## \|\| 62.17 \|\|

*daśavāpīpradānena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*tato'dhikaṃ ca labhate puṇyaṃ kanyāpradānataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The merit one earns by donating ten step-wells the same merit is achieved by giving away a daughter in marriage.

## \|\| 62.18 \|\|

*daśakanyāpradānena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*tato'dhikaṃ ca labhate yajñaikena narādhipa \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О king, the merit one gets by giving away in marriage ten girls, he receives greater merits than that by performing a yajna.

## \|\| 62.19 \|\|

*śatayajñena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate puṇyakṛjjanaḥ \|*  
*tato'dhikaṃ ca labhate putrāsyadarśanena ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The merit one earns by perfonning a hundred yajnas he achieves a greater merit by looking at the face of his son.

## \|\| 62.20 \|\|

*darśane śataputrāṇāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*tatpuṇyaṃ labhate nūnaṃ puṇyavānsatyabālanāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The merit one gets by looking at the face of a hundred sons, he gets merits greater than that by being truthful.

## \|\| 62.21 \|\|

*na hi satyātparo dharmo nānṛtātpātakaṃ param \|*  
*na hi gahghāsamaṃ tīryaṃ ma devaḥ keśavātparaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Because there is no other dharma greater than being truthful and there is no other sin greater than being untruthful. There is no sacred place comparable to the Ganga and there is no other god greater than lord Krishna.

## \|\| 62.22 \|\|

*nāsti dharmātparo bandhurnāsti dharmātparaṃ dhanam \|*  
*dharmātpriyaḥ paraḥ ko vā spadharmaṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. There is no other relative greater than the dharma and no other riches are greater than dharma. Nothing is dearer in the universe than dharma. Therefore making all efforts you protect your dharma.

## \|\| 62.23 \|\|

*svadharme rakṣite tāta śaśvatsarvatra maṅgalam \|*  
*yaśasyaṃ supratiṣṭhā ca pratāpaḥ pūjanaṃ param \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О father, by protecting one's own dharma one always achieves welfare, glory, good name, praise and honour.

## \|\| 62.24-26 \|\|

*yaturdaśābdaṃ dharmeṇa tyaktvā gṛhasukhaṃ mraman \|*  
*vanavāsaṃ kariṣyāmi satyasya pālanāya te \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kṛtvā satyaṃ ca śapathamicchayā'nicchayā'thavā \|*  
*na kṛryātpālanaṃ yo hi bhasmāntaṃ tasya sūtakam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kumbhīpāke sa pacati yāvaccandradivākarau \|*  
*tato mūko bhavetkuṣaṭhī mānavaḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. Therefore in order to protect the truthfulness of your words, I, performing the dharma, disown the household pleasures and move for roaming about in the forest for fourteen years. I shall conduct my self as a forest-dweller. The one who willingly or unwillingly, by taking an oath for truth fullness, does not follow it he invites impurities which are carried with him as long as the sun and the moon last. Thereafter, he is born as a dumb person suffering from leprosy for seven births.

## \|\| 62.27-28 \|\|

*ityovamuktvā śrīrāmo vidhāya kalkalaṃ jaṭām \|*  
*prayayau ca mahāraṇye sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

*putraśokānmahārājāstatyāja svatanuṃ mune \|*  
*pālanāya pituḥ satyaṃ rāmo babhrāmakānana \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Thus speaking Rama, clad in the bark garment, wearing matted locks of hair, accompanied by Laksmana he moved on to the forest. О sage, the king on the other hand, lost his life in the grief from the separation of his son, Rama. Rama, on the other hand, in order to uphold the truthfulness, started wandering in the forest.

## \|\| 62.29-30 \|\|

*kālāntare mahāraṇye bhaginī rāvaṇasya ca \|*  
*bhramantī kānane ghore bhartrā sārdhaṃ sugautukāt \|\| 29 \|\|*

*dadarśa rāmaṃ kulaṭā kāmārtā rākṣasī tadā \|*  
*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgī sūrcchamāpa smareṇa ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. After sometime in the great forest, Surpanakha, the sister of Ravana, was wandering in the forest with her husband. The wicked demoness finding Rama there, was infatuated with passion and her body was overwhelmed with passion and she fainted.

## \|\| 62.31 \|\|

*śrīrāmanikaṭaṃ gatvā sasmitovāca kāmukī \|*  
*śasvadhauvanasaṃyuktā'tiprauḍhā kāmadurmadā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Therefore Surpanakha who was intoxicated, youthful and well-versed in the love-sport wearing a smile on her face, went to Shri Rama and said.

## \|\| 62.32 \|\|

*śūrpaṇakhovāca herāma he dhanaśyāma rūpadhāma suṇānvita \|*  
*māyānuraktāṃ vanitāṃ māṃ gṛhāṇa sunirjane \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Surpanakha said – О Rama you have the dark complexion and possess all the virtues; you kindly accept me in this secluded place, since I am infatuated with your love.

## \|\| 62.33 \|\|

*śrutvā śūrpaṇakhāvākyaṃ dharmaṃ saṃsmṛtya dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*uvāca sadhureṃ vākyaṃ śāvabhītaśca nārada \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О Narada, the extremely religious Rama getting terrified because of the curse and keeping in mind the dharma, spoke very sweet words.

## \|\| 62.34 \|\|

*śrīrāma uvāca ambamātaḥ sabhāryo'hamabhāryaṃ gaccha me'nujam \|*  
*duḥkhaṃ priyo'nyāṃ prabhajeditaraṃ ca sukhālayam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Shri Rama said – О mother, I am here with my wife therefore you go to my younger brother who doesn't have a wife at the moment. If a husband gets attracted towards another woman in the presence of his wife it becomes quite painful; therefore you go to Laksmana who happens to be the other person.

## \|\| 62.35 \|\|

*rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prayayau lakṣmaṇaṃ mudā \|*  
*dadarśa lakṣamaṇaṃ śāntaṃ kāntaṃ ca lakṣaṇānvitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Listening to the words of Rama, she went to Laksmana and glanced at him, who was quite peaceful, beautiful and having all the auspicious symbols.

## \|\| 62.36 \|\|

*māṃ bhajasva mahābhāgetyuvāca ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*lakṣmaṇāstadvacaḥ śrutvā tāmuvāca kutūhalāt \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. She requested him again and again, saying "O virtuous one, you use me." Laksmana on the other hand on listening to her words spoke to her.

## \|\| 62.37-38 \|\|

*lakṣmaṇa uvāca vihāya rāmaṃ sarveśaṃ he mūḍhe dāsamicchasi \|*  
*sītādāsī ca matpatnī sītādāso'hameva ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

*bhava sītāsapatnī tvaṃ gaccha rāmaṃ madīśvaram \|*  
*tava putro bhaviṣyāmi sītāyāścayathā sati \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Laksmana said – "O foolish one, why do you want to live with a servant like me, leaving aside Rama who is the lord of all. I am the slave of Sita. My wife also is the slave of Sita; therefore, you go to Rama who is my lord and become a co-wife of Sita. О chaste lady, the since I happen to be like the son of Sita and I happen to be your son as well and shall remain like that.".

## \|\| 62.39 \|\|

*lakṣmaṇāsya vacaḥ śrutvā kāmena hṛtamānasā \|*  
*uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ mūḍhā śuṣkakaṇṭheṣṭhatālukā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. On hearing the words of Laksmana the passionate Surpanakha was hurt in her mind and her throat, lips and palate were dried up. The foolish demoness then told Laksmana.

## \|\| 62.40-42 \|\|

*śūrpaṇakhovāca yadī tyajasi māṃ mūḍha kāmātsvayamupasthitām \|*  
*yuvayośca vipattiśca bhaviṣya ti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*brahmā ca mohinīṃ tyaktavā viśve'pūjye babhūva saḥ \|*  
*rambhāśāpena dakṣaśca chāgamasto babhūva saḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*svarvaidyaścorvaśīśāpādyajñabhāgavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*rūpahīnaḥ kṛberaśca menāśāpena lakṣmaṇa \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. Surpanakha said – О foolish one, I have arrived here of my own will. In case you disown me in spite of that, you will have to face a great misery. These is no doubt about it. Brahma became unadorable in the universe because of his neglecting Mohinl. Daksha had to carry the head of a goat on his body because of the curse of Rambha. Because of the curse of Urvashi, the Ashvinlkumaras were deprived of their share in the yajnas. О Laksmana, because of the curse of Mena, Kubera became ugly.

## \|\| 62.43 \|\|

*kāmo ghṛtācīśāpena babhūva bhasmasācchivāt \|*  
*balirmadālasāśāpādbhraṣṭarājyo babhūva ha \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Because of the curse of GhrtacI, Kamadeva was reduced to ashes by Shiva; because of the curse of Madalasa, Bali had to be dethroned.

## \|\| 62.44 \|\|

*śāpena mikṣakeśyāśca hṛtabhāryo bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*mama śāpāttathā rāmo hṛtabhāryo bhaviṣyati \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Because of the curse of MishrakesT, Tara the wife of Brihaspati was kidnapped. Similarly with my curse, the wife of Rama would be abducted.

## \|\| 62.45 \|\|

*kāmāturāṃ yauvanasthāṃ bhāryā svayamupasthitām \|*  
*na tyajeddharmabhītaśca śrutaṃ mādhyaṃdine purā \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Because in the earlier times in Madhyandini-shakha of the Vedas, it has been heard that if a passionate and youthful wife herself comes to a person she should never be disappointed.

## \|\| 62.46-51 \|\|

*iha tyaktvā pibadgrastaḥ paratra narakaṃ vrajet \|*  
*śrutvā śūrpaṇakhāvākyamardhayandreṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*ciccheda nāsikāṃ tasyāḥ kṣuradhāreṇa līlayā \|*  
*tasyā bhrātā ca yuyudhe balavānkharadūṣaṇaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sasainyo lakṣmaṇāstreṇa sa jagāma yamālayam \|*  
*caturdaśasahasraṃ ca rākṣasānkharadūṣaṇam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*mṛtāndṛṣṭvā śūrpaṇakhā bhartsayāmāsa rāvaṇam \|*  
*sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ kṛtvā jagāma puṣkaraṃ tadā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*brahmaṇaśca varaṃ prāpa kṛtvā ca duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*uvāca tādṛśīṃ dṛṣṭvā nirāhārāṃ tapasvinīm \|\| 50 \|\|*

*sarvajñastanmano matvā kṛpāsindhuśca nārada \|\| 51 \|\|*

46-51. By doing so one meets with misery in the present word and achieves hell in the other world. On hearing the words of Surpanakha Laks mana took out a dagger and with a sharp edged crescent arrow, he severed her nose. Thereafter her valorous brother Khara, Dusana arrived there and fought with Rama but were dispatched to the heavenly abode with the use of weapon by Laks mana. Finding Khara, Dusana having been killed, together with fourteen thousand demons, Surpanakha went to Lanka and denounced Ravana and narrated the entire story to him. Thereafter, she retired to Puskara-ksetra. By performing great tapas there she got a boon from Brahma. О Narada, finding that a female ascetic was performing tapas after fasting completely, Brahma the ocean of mercy understood her desire and said.

## \|\| 62.52-53 \|\|

*brahmovāca aprāpya rāmaṃ dṛṣprāpaṃ karoṣi duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmīśvaraṃ prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*janmāntare ca bhartāraṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ varānane \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Brahma said – You are performing severe tapas to achieve Rama who is self-disciplined or Laks mana who is the incarnation of dharma as your husband. Both of them are beyond Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, Prakriti and are inaccessible. Therefore, О beautiful one, you will get them as your husband in the next birth.

## \|\| 62.54 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā brahma ca jagāma svālayaṃ mudā \|*  
*dehaṃ tatyāja sā vahno sā ca kubjā babhūva ha \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Thus speaking Brahma delightfully went back to his abode. The demoness then entered the fire and ended her life. During the next birth, she was born as hunch back.

## \|\| 62.55 \|\|

*atha śūrpaṇakhā vākyātkopātkampitavigrahaḥ \|*  
*jahāra māyayā sītāṃ māyāvī rākṣaseśvaraḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. On the other hand listening to the words of Surpanakha, the great demon Ravana was filled with illusion and was immensely enraged. He started trembling. He kidnapped Sita deceitfully.

## \|\| 62.56 \|\|

*sītāṃ na dṛṣṭvā rāmaśca mūrcchāṃ prāpa ciraṃ mune \|*  
*cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa bhrātā ca''dhyātmikena ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. О sage, finding Sita missing, Rama fainted for a long time. His younger brother Laksmana brought him back to his senses after making many efforts.

## \|\| 62.57-58 \|\|

*tato babhrāma gahanaṃ śailaṃ ca kaṃdaraṃ nadam \|*  
*aharniśaṃ ca śokārto munīnāmāśramaṃ mune \|\| 57 \|\|*

*ciramanveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā na dṛṣṭvā jānakīṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*cakāra mitratāṃ rāmaḥ sugrīveṇa svayaṃ prabhuḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. О sage, thereafter both of them started searching for Sita throughout day and night in thick forest, mountains caves, rivers and various other places like the abodes of the ascetics. Both of them were filled with grief but being unsuccessful in their efforts, they made friends with Sugriva.

## \|\| 62.59 \|\|

*nihatya vālinaṃ bāṇairdadau rājyaṃ ca līlayā \|*  
*sugrīvāya ca mitrāya svīkārapālanāya vai \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. In order to upkeep his word Shri Rama killed Bali with his arrow and enthroned Sugriva as the king of Kiskindha.

## \|\| 62.60-62 \|\|

*dūtānprasthāpayāmāsa sarvatra vānareśvāḥ \|*  
*tasthau sugrīvabhavane śrīrāmaśca salakṣmaṇaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*hanūmate varaṃ dattavā ramyaṃ ratnāṅgulīyakam \|*  
*sītāyai śubhasaṃdeśaṃ prāṇadhāraṇakāraṇam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*taṃ ca prasthāpayāmāsa dakṣiṇāṃ diśamuttamām \|*  
*suprītyā''liṅganaṃ dattvā pādareṇūnsudurlabhān \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. Thereafter Sugriva the king of the monkeys also fulfilled his word for the searching of Sita and sent his messengers everywhere. Rama and Laksmana continued to stay with Sugriva. Blessing Hanuman Rama gave away his beautiful ring studded with gems to Hanuman and also gave him a message for Sita by means of which she could maintain her life. Thereafter, he embraced Hanuman lovingly and giving her the inaccessible dust of his feet, sent him towards the southern direction.

## \|\| 62.63 \|\|

*hanumānpayayau laṅkāṃ sītānveṣaṇahetave \|*  
*rāmādadhītasaṃdeśo yayau rudrakalodbhavaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Hanuman who was born of the amsha of Rudra receiving the message from Rama travelled to Lanka in search of Sita.

## \|\| 62.64-67 \|\|

*aśokakānane sītāṃ dadarśa śokakarśitām \|*  
*nirāhārāmatikṛśāṃ kuhvāṃ candrakalāmiva \|\| 64 \|\|*

*satataṃ rāma rāmeti japantīṃ bhaktibūrvakam \|*  
*bibhratīṃ ca jaṭābhāraṃ taptakāñcanasaṃnibhām \|\| 65 \|\|*

*dhyāyamānāṃ padābjaṃ ca śrīrāmasya dipāniśam \|*  
*śuddhāśayāṃ suśīlāṃ ca suvratāṃ ca pativratām \|\| 66 \|\|*

*mahālakṣmīlakṣmayuktāṃ prajvalantīṃ svatejasā \|*  
*puṇyadāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhuvanapāvatīm \|\| 67 \|\|*

64-67. On reaching Lanka he found JanakI in Asokavatika who had become quite lean and thin because of grief, remaining without food and was quite lean like the moon rays on a moonless night. She was reciting the name of Rama in her mind filled with devotion. She was carrying the locks of hair on her head and had the complexion of molten gold. She was always devoted to the name of Rama throughout day and night. She had a spotless mind was quite noble, performing the best of vratas, quite chaste, possessing the symptoms of Maha-Lakshmi. She was illumining with her own lustre and was the one who could provide all the merits of the holy places and could purify the entire universe.

## \|\| 62.68-72 \|\|

*praṇamya mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā rudatīṃ vāyunandanaḥ \|*  
*ratnāṅgulīyaṃ rāmasya dadau tasyai mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*ruroda dharmī tāṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛtvā taccaraṇāmbujam \|*  
*uvāca rāmasaṃdeśaṃ sītājīvanarakṣaṇam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*hanumānuvāca pāresamudraṃ śrīrāmaḥ saṃnaddhaśca salakṣmaṇaḥ \|*  
*babhūva rāmamitraṃ ca sugrīvo balavānkapiḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*rāmaśca vālinaṃ hatvā rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ dadau \|*  
*sugrīvāya ca mitrāya tadbhāryaṃ vālinā hṛtām \|\| 71 \|\|*

*sugrīvaśca tavoddhāraṃ svīcakāra ca dharmataḥ \|*  
*vānarāśca yayuḥ sarve tavānveṣaṇakāraṇāt \|\| 72 \|\|*

68-72. Bowing in reverence to the mother, Hanuman found her weeping. Then he handed over the finger ring of Rama to her and holding her feet Hanuman started crying. Thereafter he conveyed the message of Rama to her which could save Sita's life. Hanuman said – Both Rama and Laks mana are getting ready beyond the ocean. The valorous monkeys have made friends with Rama. Lord Rama after killing Bali, has enthroned Sugriva, his friend, as the king of the monkeys and has also restored his wife to him. Sugriva has taken a vow to free you. All the monkeys have proceeded to all the directions in search of you.

## \|\| 62.73-74 \|\|

*prāpya maṅgalavārtāṃ ca matto rājīvalocanaḥ \|*  
*gambhīraṃ sāgaraṃ baddhvā so'cireṇā''gamiṣyati \|\| 73 \|\|*

*nihatya rāvaṇaṃ pāpaṃ saputraṃ ca sabāndhavam \|*  
*kariṣyatyacireṇaiva he mātastava mokṣaṇam \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. О mother, getting news from me about your presence here, the lotus eyed Rama would bridge the deep ocean and arrive here. Killing the wicked Ravana with his friends or relatives would free you from the bondage.

## \|\| 62.75 \|\|

*adya ratnamayīṃ laṅkāṃ niḥśaṅkastvataprasādataḥ \|*  
*bhasmībhūtāṃ kariṣyāmi mātaḥ paśya ca sasmitam \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. By your grace, I am going to reduce the city of Lanka, made in gems, to ashes, you will find it delightful.

## \|\| 62.76-77 \|\|

*markaṭīḍimbhatulyāṃ ca laṅkāṃ paśyāmi suvrate \|*  
*mūtratulyaṃ samudraṃ ca śarāvamiva bhūtalam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*pipīlikāsaṃghamiva sasainyaṃ rāvaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*saṃhartuṃ ca samarthoṃ'haṃ muhūrtārdhena līlayā \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. О performer of the noble vratas, I look at Lanka like the child of a monkey. Similarly I consider the ocean like urine, the entire earth like a cup, Ravana with his demon army like a heap of ants. In half a MuhQrta I shall destroy them all playfully.

## \|\| 62.78 \|\|

*rāmapratijñārakṣārthaṃ na haniṣyāmi sāṃpratam \|*  
*svasthā bhava mahābhāge tyaja bhītiṃ madīśvari \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Because of the words of Rama I shall not indulge into whole-sale killing at the moment. О virtuous one, О mistress, you be cheerful discarding all fear.

## \|\| 62.79 \|\|

*pānarasya vacaḥ śrutvā rurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*uvāca vacanaṃ bhītā rāmapativratā \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. On hearing the words of the monkey, Janaki started weeping again and again and feeling panicky, the chaste Sita, the wife of Rama, spoke to Hanuman.

## \|\| 62.80 \|\|

*sītovāca aye jīvati me rāmo macchokārṇavadāruṇāt \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Sita said - In the ocean of my grief Rama is still alive.

## \|\| 62.81 \|\|

*api me kuśalī nāthaḥ kausalyānandanaḥ prabhu \|*  
*kīdṛśaśca kṛśāṅgaśca jānakījīvano'dhunā \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Is my lord, the son of Kaushalya, hail and hearty? How could Rama be at the moment? He must have grown weak.

## \|\| 62.82 \|\|

*kimāhāraśca kiṃ bhuṅkte mama praṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ \|*  
*api pāre samudrasya satyaṃ sītāpatiḥ svayam \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Rama who is dearer to me than my life what type of food does he consume? Is it a fact that Rama the husband of Sita is residing beyond the ocean?

## \|\| 62.83 \|\|

*api satyaṃ ka saṃnaddho na śokena hataḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*api smarati māṃ pāpāṃ svāmino duḥkharūpiṇīm \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Is it a fact that my lord has firmly resolved to arrive here? Is my lord not infested with grief, does he remember a sinful person like me who has been the cause for his grief.

## \|\| 62.84-85 \|\|

*madarthe kati duḥkhaṃ vā saṃprāpa sa madīśvaraḥ \|*  
*hāro nā''rorpitaḥ kaṇṭhe purā vyavahito ratau \|\| 84 \|\|*

*adhunaivā''vayormadhye samudraḥ śatayojanaḥ \|*  
*api drakṣyāmi taṃ rāmaṃ karuṇāsāgaraṃ prabhum \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. My lord had to suffer immensely for my sake. In the earlier times, he, at the time of enjoying conjugal pleasures did not use the garland taking them to be obstructions between the two bodies but at the present moment the obstruction is in the form of a hundred yojanas wide ocean. Shall it be possible for me to have an audience with the ocean of mercy.

## \|\| 62.86 \|\|

*kāntaṃ śāntaṃ nitāntaṃ ca dharmiṣṭhaṃ dharmakarmaṇi \|*  
*api sevāṃ kariṣyāmi pādapadme punaḥ prabhoḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Who is beautiful, peaceful, quite religious and the chaste lord? Shall it be possible for me to serve at the lotus-like feet of lord Rama.

## \|\| 62.87-89 \|\|

*patisevāvihīnāyā mūḍhāyā jīvanaṃ dṛthā \|*  
*api me dharmaputraśca satyaṃ jīvati lakṣmaṇaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*macchokasāgare magno bhagnadarpo mayā vinā \|*  
*vīrāṇāṃ pravaro dharmī devakalpaśca devaraḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

*api satyaṃ sasaṃnnaddho satprabhoranujaḥ sadā \|*  
*api drakṣyāmi satyaṃ taṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam \|*  
*prāṇānāmadhikaṃ premṇā dhanyaṃ puṇyasvarūpiṇam \|\| 89 \|\|*

87-89. The life of a foolish woman who is deprived of the service of her husband, is of no consequence. Is my dharmaputra Laksmana perfectly all right? My husband always remains drowned in the ocean of grief, whose pride is shattered at the moment. My Devara is the best of the warriors, quite chaste and god-like. Does the younger brother of my lord have a firm resolve? Can I have a look at Laksmana who is dearer to me than my life, is quite graceful, the form of merit and the form of dharma.

## \|\| 62.90 \|\|

*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dattvā pratyuttaraṃ śubham \|*  
*bhasmībhūtāṃ ca tāṃ laṅkāṃ cakāra līlayā mune \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. О sage, on hearing the words of Janaki, Hanuman spoke the words which were filled with welfare and assured her that he could reduce Lanka to ashes without much effort.

## \|\| 62.91 \|\|

*punaḥ prabodhaṃ tasyai ca dattavā vāyusutaḥ kapiḥ \|*  
*prayayau līlayā vegādyatra rājīvalocanaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Thereafter, Hanuman the son of wind-god, reassured Janaki again and quite easily went back to the lord having lotus-like eyes.

## \|\| 62.92 \|\|

*sarvaṃ tatkathāyāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ mātureva ca \|*  
*sītāmaṅgalavṛttāntaṃ śrutvā rāmo ruroda ca \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. On reaching there he conveyed the entire news about JanakI to him. On listening to the news of welfare about Sita, Rama became emotional.

## \|\| 62.93 \|\|

*rutodoccairlakṣmaṇaśca sugrīvaścāpi nārada \|*  
*vānarā ruruduḥ sarve sahabalaparākramāḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. О Narada, at that point of time, Laksmana and Sugriva also became emotional and started crying. Thereafter all the valorous monkeys also followed them.

## \|\| 62.94 \|\|

*nibadhya setuṃ laṅkāṃ ca prayayau raghunandanaḥ \|*  
*sasainyaḥ sānujaḥ śīghraṃ saṃnaddhaścāpi nārada \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. О son, thus I have spoken to you about the life story of Shri Rama which is quite pleasant, the form of tattvas, bestows salvation and serves as a boat for the crossing of the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 62.95-98 \|\|

*nihatya rāvaṇaṃ rāmo raṇaṃ kṛtvā sabāndhavam \|*  
*cakāra mokṣaṇaṃ brahman sitāyaśca śubhekṣaṇe \|\| 95 \|\|*

*kṛtvā puṣpakayānena sītāṃ satyaparāyaṇām \|*  
*ayodhyāṃ prayayau śīghraṃ krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

*krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavān sītāṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi \|*  
*vijahau virahajvālāṃ sītā rāmaśca tatkṣaṇam \|\| 97 \|\|*

*saptadvīpeśvaro rāmo babhūva pṛthivītale \|*  
*babhūva nikhilā pṛthvī ādhivyādhivivarjitā \|\| 98 \|\|*

95-98. О Narada, Rama, then got ready with the army and his younger brother. They constructed a bridge on the ocean and then left for Lanka.

## \|\| 62.99 \|\|

*babhūvatū rāmaputrau dhārmikau ca kuśīlavau \|*  
*tayośca putraiḥ pautreśca sūryavaṃśodbhavā nṛpāḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. О Brahman, Rama, after waging a war killed Ravana with all his relatives and relieved JanakI of all the dangers and freed her. Thereafter, the truthful Rama was made to board on the Pus paka-plane. Rama reached Ayodhya playfully. Rama embraced Sita there and enjoyed love-sport with her as a result of which the pain of separation between both of them disappeared. Shri Rama became the lord of the seven continents of the earth and the entire earth was freed from mental agonies and diseases.

## \|\| 62.100 \|\|

*iti te kathitaṃ vatsa śrīrāmacaritaṃ śubham \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ pārapotaṃ bhavārṇave \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. Lord Rama had two sons named Lava and Kusa. The solar race was further spread with their sons and grandsons.

## Chapter 63

## \|\| 63.1-2 \|\|

*atha triṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha kaṃso vicintyaivaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥsvapnameva ca \|*  
*samudvigno mahābhīto nirāhāro nirutsukaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*putraṃ mitraṃ bandhugaṇaṃ bāndhavaṃ ca purohitam \|*  
*samānīya sabhāmadhye tānuvāca suduḥkhitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Thereafter Kamsa thinking of a bad dream, felt immensely agitated and frightened and leaving eating food, was filled with grief. He summoned his sons, friends, brothers, relatives and the family priest in his court and started narrating his bad dream to them.

## \|\| 63.3 \|\|

*kaṃsa uvāca mayā dṛṣṭo niśīthe yo duḥsvapno hi bhayapradaḥ \|*  
*nibodhata budhāḥ sarve bāndhavāśca purohitāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Kamsa said – I witnessed an extremely bad dream at the dead of night. All the intellectuals, relatives and family priests but listen to me.

## \|\| 63.4-5 \|\|

*bibhratī raktapuṣpāṇāṃ mālāṃ sā raktacandanam \|*  
*raktāmbanaṃ khaḍgatīkṣṇaṃ kharparaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram \|\| 4 \|\|*

*prakṛtyāṭṭāṭṭahāsaṃ ca lolajihvā bhayaṃkarī \|*  
*atīva vṛddhā kṛṣṇāṅgī nagare mama nṛtyati \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. I found in my dream that in my city an old woman with black body was dancing. She was adorned with a garland of red flowers with the red sandal-paste applied on her body. She was clad in red garments and was laughing aloud. She held a sharp sword in her hand and a terrific skull-cup; her moving tongue was protruding and looked quite horrible.

## \|\| 63.6 \|\|

*muktakeśī chinnanāsā kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇāmbārapriyā \|*  
*vidhavā sā mahāśūdrī māmāliṅgitumicchati \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Similarly there was another black woman who was clad in black garments who appeared like a Mahashudra woman. Her dried hair was dishevelled and the nose was cut off. She wanted to embrace me.

## \|\| 63.7-8 \|\|

*malinaṃ cailakhaṇḍaṃ ca bibhratī rūkṣamūrdhajān \|*  
*dadhatī cūrṇatilakaṃ kapolai mama vakṣasi \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇavarṇāni pakvāni cchinnabhinnāni satyaka \|*  
*patanti kṛtvā śabdāṃśca śaśvattālaphalāni ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. She was clad in dirty garments had dried up hair and applied tilakam of the ashes. О Satyaka, I found that the ripe fruits of tala, having black colours were falling on my cheeks, one after the other continuously creating a sound.

## \|\| 63.9-10 \|\|

*kucailo vikṛtākāro mleccho hi rūkṣamūrdhajaḥ \|*  
*dadāti mahyaṃ bhūṣāyāṃ chinnabhinnakapardakān \|\| 9 \|\|*

*mahāruṣṭā ca divyā strī patiputravatī satī \|*  
*babhañja pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca sā'bhiśapya punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. A deformed mleccha worn "in adorned with dirty garments, having dry hair was offering broken small-shells for the making of ornaments. A chaste lady having her son alive, in great anger pronounced a curse again and again on me and broke a pitcher filled with water.

## \|\| 63.11 \|\|

*amlānāmoṃḍūmālāṃ ca raktacandanacarcitām \|*  
*dadāti maṅyaṃ vipraśca mahāruṣṭo'tiśapya ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. I also saw that a Brahmana filled with anger was pronouncing a curse on me, was offering me his undecayed garland which was soaked in the red sandal-paste.

## \|\| 63.12 \|\|

*kṣaṇamaṅgāravṛṣṭiśca bhasmavṛṣṭiḥ kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇam \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ raktavṛṣṭirbhavecca nagare mama \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. I also found that in every bit of my kingdom there was a rain of burning flames, ashes and blood.

## \|\| 63.13 \|\|

*vānaraṃ vāyasaṃ śvānaṃ bhallūkaṃ sūkaraṃ kharam \|*  
*paśyāmi vikaṭākāraṃ śabdaṃ kurvantamulbaṇam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. I found that a monkey of terrific size, the crows, the dogs, the bears, the pigs and the donkeys were creating a terrific noise.

## \|\| 63.14 \|\|

*paśyāmi śuṣkakāṣṭhānāṃ rāśimamlānakajjalam \|*  
*aruṇodayavelāyāṃ kapīṃścinnanakhāni ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The dry-wood had been collected the blackness of which could not be removed.

## \|\| 63.15-16 \|\|

*pītavastraparidhānā śuklacandanacarcitā \|*  
*bibhratī mālatīmālāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*krīḍākamalahastā sā sindūrabinduśobhitā \|*  
*kṛtvā'bhiśāpaṃ māṃ ruṣaṭā yāti manmandirātsatī \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. At the time of the sun-rise, I found the monkeys and the nails. A chaste woman came out of my palace. She was clad in pltambara and had applied the white sandal-paste and other cosmetics, adorned with garland of jasmine flowers and gem-studded ornaments. She was holding a lotus flower playfully and her forehead was painted with the spots of vermilion. The chaste lady getting annoyed with me pronounced a curse on me and left my palace.

## \|\| 63.17 \|\|

*pāśahastāṃśca puruṣānmuktakeśānbhayaṃkarān \|*  
*atirūkṣāṃśca paśyāmi viśāto nagaraṃ mama \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. I found some people with dishevelled hair entering in my kingdom holding nooses in their hands. They looked quite terrific and dry.

## \|\| 63.18-19 \|\|

*nagnanārī suktakeśī nṛtyantī ca gṛhe gṛhe \|*  
*atīva vikṛtākārāṃ paśyāmi sasmitāṃ sadā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*chinnanāsā ca vidhavā mahāśūdrī digambarā \|*  
*sā tailābhyaṅgitaṃ māṃ ca karotyatibhayaṃkarī \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. I found unrobed women dancing in each and every house having dishevelled hair and terrific form. Then there was an unrobed widow, who belonged to the Shudra caste and whose nose was cut-off, looked quite terrific and was applying oil on my body.

## \|\| 63.20 \|\|

*nirvāṇāṅgārayuktāśca bhasmabūrṇā digambarā \|*  
*atiprabhātasamaye citrāḥ paśyāmi sasmitāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. I found all these astonishing types of women in the early morning who were carrying fire flames. They had no clothes on their bodies and had applied ashes on their entire bodies. They were smiling.

## \|\| 63.21 \|\|

*paśyāmi ca vivāhaṃ ca nṛtyagītamanoharam \|*  
*raktavastraparīdhānānpuriṣānraktamīrdhajān \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In the dream I witnessed a marriage function which looked quite pleasant but I witnessed some people who were clad in red clothes, having red hair on the body.

## \|\| 63.22 \|\|

*raktaṃ vamantaṃ puruṣaṃ nṛtyantaṃ nagnamulbaṇam \|*  
*dhāvantaṃ ca śayānaṃ ca paśyāmi sasmitaṃ sadā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. I found a naked person who looked quite frightening, who vomited blood sometimes and danced sometimes. Sometimes he was found running and sometimes he slept while at the other times he smiled.

## \|\| 63.23-24 \|\|

*rāhugrastaṃ ca gagane maṇḍalaṃ candrasūryayauḥ \|*  
*ekakāleca paśyāmi sarvagrāsaṃ ca bāndhavāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ulkāpātaṃ dhūmaketuṃ bhūkampaṃ rāṣṭraviplavam \|*  
*jhañjhāvātaṃ mahotpātaṃ paśyāmi ca purohita \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. O brother, I found that both sun and the moon had risen in the sky at one and the same time. О family priest, in my dream I witnessed the falling of a comet, earth-quakes, national calamities, great storms and terrific disturbances.

## \|\| 63.25 \|\|

*vāyunā ghūrṇamānāṃśca cchinnaskandhānmahīruhān \|*  
*patitānparvatāścaiva paśyāmi pṛthivītale \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The trees were shaking, because of the force of the wind their branches were being broken and the mountain peaks were found falling on the earth.

## \|\| 63.26 \|\|

*puruṣaṃ chinnaśirasaṃ rṛtyantaṃ nagnamucchritam \|*  
*muṇḍamālākaraṃ ghoraṃ paśyāmi ca gṛhe gṛhe \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. In every house a tall and naked male figure was found dancing, having no head. That terrific person held a garland of human skulls in his hands.

## \|\| 63.27 \|\|

*dagthaṃ sarvāśramaṃ bhakmapūrṇamaṅgārasaṃkulam \|*  
*hāhākāraṃ ca kurvantaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāmi sarvataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. All the houses were filled with dust after having been burnt to ashes and all the people were crying in panic all round.

## \|\| 63.28 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā rājā sa virarāma sabhātale \|*  
*dṛṣadvā (śrṛtvā) svaptaṃ bāndhavāśca na tamuktvāniśaśvasuḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О Narada, after thus speaking the king Kamsa kept quiet. Listening to that dream all the brothers and relatives of the king started heaving deep sighs.

## \|\| 63.29-30 \|\|

*jahāra cetanāṃ sadyaḥ satyakaśca purohitaḥ \|*  
*matvā vināśaṃ kaṃsasya yajamānasya nārada \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ruroda nārīvargaśca pitā mātā ca śokataḥ \|*  
*mene vināśakālaṃ ca sadyaḥ svayamupasthitam \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. The family priest Satyaka realising the total destruction of Kamsa approaching fainted, all the wives and parents of Kamsa started crying in grief; they came to realise that the time of destruction was fast approaching.

## Chapter 64

## \|\| 64.1 \|\|

*atha catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca sarva kṛtvā parāmarśaṃ satyakaśca purohitaḥ \|*  
*buddhimāñchukraśiṣyaśca tamuvāca hitaṃ mune \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – О sage, Satyaka the family priest of Kamsa, who was quite intelligent and a pupil of Sukracarya took into consideration all that had been spoken by the king. He then spoke to him beneficial words.

## \|\| 64.2 \|\|

*satyaka uvāca bhayaṃ tyaja mahābhāga bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite \|*  
*kuru yāgaṃ maheśasya marvāriṣṭavināśanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Satyaka said – О virtuous one, be fearless, why should you be afraid when I am there. You perform the yajna of Shiva which removes all the obstructions.

## \|\| 64.3 \|\|

*yāgo dhanurmakho nāma bahvanno bahudakṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*duḥśapnānāṃ nāśakaraḥ śatrubhītivināśakaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The yajna is called after Dhanurmakha and after its performance, one has to give away as daksina food and riches, which removes the bad dreams and destroys all dangers from the enemy.

## \|\| 64.4 \|\|

*ādhyātmikamādhidaivamādhibhautikamutkaṭam \|*  
*eṣāṃ trividhotpātānāṃ khaṇḍano bhūtivardhaṃnaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. While performing this yajna one is relieved of the dangers like Adhyatmika, Adhidaivika and Adhibhautika disturbances besides removing all obstructions. It also bestows on one enough of fortune.

## \|\| 64.5 \|\|

*yāge samāpte śaṃbhuśca jarāmṛtyuharaṃ varam \|*  
*dadāti sākṣādbhavati dātā ca sarvasaṃpadām \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. At the end of the yajna lord Shiva himself appears in person and removing old age and death, bestows the desired boon. Thereafter the performer of the yajna is filled with all the riches.

## \|\| 64.6 \|\|

*cakāremaṃ ca yāgaṃ ca purā bāṇo mahābalaḥ \|*  
*nandī paraśurāmaśca bhallaśca balināṃ varaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In earlier times the valorous Banasura, Nandi, Parashurama and Bhalla the best of the warriors had performed this yajna.

## \|\| 64.7-8 \|\|

*purā dadau dhanuridaṃ śivo nandīśvarāya ca \|*  
*yāgena bhūtvā siddhaḥ sa dadau bāṇāya dhārmikaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kṛtvā yāgaṃ mahāsiddho dadau rāmāya puṣkare \|*  
*tubhyaṃ dadau paraśurāmaḥ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. In earlier times Shiva had given this bow to Nandlshvara who met with success in the yajna. The religious-minded Nandlsvara handed over the bow to Banasura. By achieving success through the yajna В ana handed over the bow at Puskara region to Parashurama and the compassionate Parashurama had given the same to you.

## \|\| 64.9 \|\|

*sahasrahastaparimitaṃ dairdhye'tikaṭhinaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*daśahastapraśastaṃ ca śaṃkarecchāvinirmitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O king, the bow is a thousand hands in length, it is quite hard and ten hands in width. It moves according to the will of Shiva.

## \|\| 64.10 \|\|

*paśupateḥ paśupataṃ yuktayānena durvaham \|*  
*sarve bhaṅktuṃ na śaktāśca devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vinā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. This Pasupata weapon of Shiva is difficult to be moved. No one else can break it except Narayana himself.

## \|\| 64.11 \|\|

*yāge ca dhanuṣaḥ pūjāṃ śaṃkarasya tu śaṃkare \|*  
*kuru śīghraṃ śubhārthaṃ ca sarvānkuru nimantraṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. You adore this bow in the welfare yajna of Shiva and extend invitation to all.

## \|\| 64.12 \|\|

*asminyāge dhanurbhaṅgo bhavedyadi narādhipa \|*  
*vināśo yajamānasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О king in case the bow is broken in the yajna the performer of the yajna has to meet with his end. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 64.13 \|\|

*bhagne dhanuṣi yāgaśca bhagno bhavati niścitam \|*  
*phalaṃ dadāti ko vā'tra cāniṣpanne ca karmaṇi \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. And with the breaking of the bow the yajna is surely desecrated. When the yajna is not completed then the question of reaping its reward would not arise.

## \|\| 64.14-15 \|\|

*brahmā ca dhanuṣo mūle madhye nārāyaṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*agre cograpratāpaśca mahādevo mahāmate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dhanurhi trivikāraṃ ca sadratnakhacitaṃ varam \|*  
*grīṣmamadhyāṅnamārtaṃṇḍaprabhāpracchannakāraṇ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. О intelligent one, Brahma resides at the base of the bow, Narayana in the middle and lord Shiva resides in the ground. First of all it is inlaid with gems and issues lustre like the sun or the mid-day sun of the summer season.

## \|\| 64.16-17 \|\|

*aśaktaśca namayitumanantaśca mahābalaḥ \|*  
*suryaśca kārtikeyaśca kā kathā'nyasya bhūmipa \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tripurāriḥ purā'nena jaghāna tripuraṃ mudā \|*  
*nirbhayaṃ kuru svacchandaṃ maṅgalārha mahotsavam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. In the earlier times Shiva had killed Tripurasura with this bow. Therefore, you arrange for the success of this yajna fearlessly.

## \|\| 64.18 \|\|

*matyakasya vacaḥ śrutvā candravaṃśavivardhanaḥ \|*  
*uvāca kaṃsaḥ sarvārthe satataṃ ca hitaiṣiṇam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. On hearing the words of Satyaka, Kamsa, the king of the solar race, spoke to the family priest who was his great well-wisher.

## \|\| 64.19 \|\|

*kaṃsa uvāca vasudevagṛhe jajñe madvadhī kuranāśanaḥ \|*  
*svacchandaṃ nandagehe ca vardhate nandanandanaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Kamsa said – My killer and the destroyer of my race, Krishna, has been born in the house of Vasudeva and is presently living in the house of Nanda.

## \|\| 64.20 \|\|

*madvandhuvargāñchūrāṃśca mantriṇaḥ suviśāradān \|*  
*bhaginīṃ pūtanāṃ pūtāṃ jaghāna bālako balī \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. That valorous boy has killed my valorous relatives and quite competent courtiers besides sister Ptitana.

## \|\| 64.21 \|\|

*govardhanaṃ dadhārrakakareṇa balavardhanaḥ \|*  
*mahendrasya ca śūrasya cakāra ca parābhavam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He is competent enough to increase his strength at will and could raise up the mountain Govarddhana on a single hand and also defeated the immensely powerful Mahendra.

## \|\| 64.22 \|\|

*brahmāṇaṃ darśayāmāsa brahmarūpaṃ carācaram \|*  
*nivahaṃ bāravatsānāṃ cakāra kṛtrimaṃ mudā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He also displayed his divine form to Brahma and also created illusory cowherds and cowherdesses besides the calves.

## \|\| 64.23 \|\|

*tameva balinaṃ hantuṃ mantraṇāṃ kuru satyaka \|*  
*mama śatrurvinā tena nāstiha dharaṇītale \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Therefore, О Satyaka, you somehow manage the killing of the same valorous boy because in the entire universe, except that boy there is no one else who could be inimical to me.

## \|\| 64.24-26 \|\|

*nahi svarge na pātāle triṣu lokeṣu niścitam \|*  
*santi santaśca rājānaḥ sarvatra mama bāndhavāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*mahātapasvī brahmā ca tapasvīṃ śaṃkaraḥ svayām \|*  
*viṣṇuḥ sarvatra sarvātmā samadarśo sanātanaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nandaputraṃ nihatyāhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pūjitaḥ \|*  
*mārvabhaumo bhaviṣyāmi saptadvīpeśvaro mahān \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. In heaven, Patala and earth there is no other enemy for me. This is certain. All the best of the kings everywhere in the world are friendly to me. Brahma is an ascetic and similar is the case with Shiva while Vishnu is all-pervading and eternal, therefore, simply with the killing of Krishna the son of Nanda, I would be adored the world over. I shall then become the lord of the seven continents and a great king.

## \|\| 64.27 \|\|

*svarge nihatya śakraṃ ca durbalaṃ daityanirjitam \|*  
*bhaviṣyāmi mahendraśca tatra nirjitya bhāskaram \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. By defeating the daityas and the gods in the heaven, I shall kill the weak Indra and defeating the sun I shall achieve the place of Mahendra.

## \|\| 64.28 \|\|

*yakṣmagrastaṃ ca candraṃ ca mamaiva pūrvapūruṣam \|*  
*vāyuṃ kuberaṃ varuṇaṃ yamaṃ jeṣyāmi niścitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. My ancestors who are suffering from consumption besides the wind, Kubera, Varuna and Yama would surely be defeated by me.

## \|\| 64.29 \|\|

*gaccha nandavrajaṃ śīghraṃ nandaṃ ca nandanandanam \|*
