*tadbhrātaraṃ ca balinaṃ balamānaya saṃpratam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Therefore you go to the city of Vraja ruled by Nanda. Go to the Nanda and bring Krishna here as well as his brother Baladeva expeditiously.

## \|\| 64.30 \|\|

*kaṃsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca sa satyakaḥ \|*  
*hitaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ paraṃ sāmayikaṃ tathā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. On hearing the words of Kamsa, Satyaka spoke beneficial words which were quite appropriate and could bestow prosperity.

## \|\| 64.31 \|\|

*satyaka uvāca akrūramuddhavaṃ vā'pi vasudevamathāpi vā \|*  
*prasthāpaya mahābhāga nandavrajamabhīpsitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Satyaka said – О virtuous one, in Vraja of Nanda, you kindly depute Akriira, Uddhava and Vasudeva.

## \|\| 64.32 \|\|

*satyakasya vacaḥ śrutvā vasantaṃ tatra saṃsadi \|*  
*svarṇasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca vasudevamuvāca saḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. On hearing the words of Satyaka, Kamsa spoke to Vasudeva who was seated on a lion-throne in the court.

## \|\| 64.33-34 \|\|

*kaṃma uvāca tattavajño nītiśāstrāṇāṃ tvamupāyaviśāradaḥ \|*  
*vraja nandavrajaṃ bandho vasudeva mutālayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*vṛṣabhānaṃ ca nandaṃ ca balaṃ ca nandanandanam \|*  
*śīghramānaya yajñe'tra sarvaṃ gokulavāsinam \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. Kamsa said – О brother Vasudeva, you are well-versed in polity and are quite competent in the making of devices. Therefore, you go to the place of your son in' Vraja of Nanda, informing them about the festivities of yajna. You bring with you Vrsabhanu, Nanda, Balabhadra, Krishna and all the residents of Gokula here.

## \|\| 64.35 \|\|

*gṛhītvā patrikāṃ dūtā gacchantu ca caturdiśm \|*  
*nṛpānmunigaṇānsarvānkartuṃ vijñāpanaṃ mudā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The messengers carrying the messages of the king moved to other kings and the sages on all directions.

## \|\| 64.36 \|\|

*nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ \|*  
*uvāca vacanaṃ brahman hṛdayena vidūṣatā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. О Brahman, on hearing the words of the king the throat, lips and palate of Vasudeva were dried up and he spoke with a painful heart.

## \|\| 64.37-38 \|\|

*vasudeva uvāca niyuktamatra rājendra gamanaṃ mama sāṃpratam \|*  
*vijñāpituṃ nandavrajaṃ nandaṃ vā nandanandanam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*yadyāyāto nandaputro yāgo te ca mahotsave \|*  
*avaśyaṃ tadvirodhaśca bhaviṣyati tvayā saha \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Vasudeva said – О king, you have entrusted the duty of my going to Vraja and to invite Nanda and his son, but in case the son of Nanda arrives here at the time of the festivities, your yajna here is bound to face some controversies,

## \|\| 64.39-40 \|\|

*tamahaṃ ca samānīya kārayiṣyāmi saṃyutam \|*  
*iti me na hi bhadraṃ ca vidhnastasya tavāpi ca \|\| 39 \|\|*

*pitrā''noto mṛtaḥ kṛṣṇa iti sarvo vadiṣyati \|*  
*vasudevaḥ sutadvārā jaghāna nṛpameva ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Then should I bring him for waging a war? It will not be proper for me and it would be a sort of obstruction there. The people would say that Krishna was killed when he was brought here by his father himself or otherwise Vasudeva got the king killed through his son.

## \|\| 64.41 \|\|

*dvayorekatarasyāpi sadyo mṛtyurbhaviṣyati \|*  
*patiṣyanti ca śūrāśca nāsti yuddhaṃ nirāmiṣam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Either one of you would be surely killed at the spot and no one knows the number of warriors which would be killed further because the war can never be peaceful.

## \|\| 64.42 \|\|

*vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā raktapaṅkacalocanaḥ \|*  
*khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā taṃ hantuṃ prayayau nṛpatīśvaraḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. On hearing the words of Vasudeva, the eyes of the great king Kamsa became red with anger. He holding a sword in his hand rushed to kill Vasudeva.

## \|\| 64.43-44 \|\|

*hāheti kṛtvā putraṃ ca vārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam \|*  
*ugraseno mahārājamatīva balavānmune \|\| 43 \|\|*

*svapīṭhādvasudevaśca kopāviṣṭo gṛhaṃ yayau \|*  
*akrūraṃ prerayāmāsa gantuṃ nandavrajaṃ nṛpaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. At this slight, Ugrasena cried in panic and dissuaded Kamsa from doing so. Vasudeva also left for his abode in anger. Thereafter the king Kamsa deputed Akrura to Vraja for getting the son of Nanda to Mathura.

## \|\| 64.45 \|\|

*dūtānprasthāpayāmāsa śīghraṃ pratidiśaṃ tathā \|*  
*āyayurmunayaḥ sarve nṛpaśca saparicchadā \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The messengers were dispatched in all the directions and all the kings and the sages arrived there together with their companions.

## \|\| 64.46-54 \|\|

*dikpālāśca surāḥ sarve brāhmaṇāśca tapasvinaḥ \|*  
*sanakaśca sanandaśca voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā \|\| 46 \|\|*

*sanatkumāro bhagavānprajvalanbrahmatejasā \|*  
*kapilaścāsuriḥ pailaḥ sumantuśca sanātanaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*pulahaśca pulastyaśca bhṛsuśca kraturaṅgirāḥ \|*  
*marīciḥ kaśyapaścaiva dakṣo'triścyavanastathā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*bharadvājaśca vyāsaśca gautamaśca parāśaraḥ \|*  
*pracetāśca vasiṣṭhaśca saṃvartaśca bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kātyāyano yājñavalkyo'pyuttaṅkaḥ saubharistathā \|*  
*parvato devalaścaiva jaigīṣavyaśca jaiminiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*viśvāmitraśca sutapāḥ pippalaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ \|*  
*jābālirjāṅgaliścaiva piśaliśca śilālikaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*āstaukaśca jagatkārustathā kalyāṇamitrakaḥ \|*  
*durvāsā vāmadevaśca ṛṣyaśrṛṅgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*pathiḥ kaviḥ kaṇādaśca gauśikaḥ pāṇinistathā \|*  
*kautso'dyamarṣaṇaścaiva vālmīkirlomaharṣaṇaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*mārkaṇaḍeyo mṛkaṇḍuśca parśurāmaśca sāṃkṛtiḥ \|*  
*agastyaśca tathā vāntastathā'nye munayo mune \|\| 54 \|\|*

46-54. All the Dikpalas, the gods, the Tapasvis Brahmanas like Sanaka, Sanandana, Vodhu, Pancansikha, Sanatkumara, illumining with divine lustre, then Kapila, Asuri, Paila, Sumanta, Sanatana, Pulaha, Pulastya, Brhgu, Kratu, Angira, Marichi, Kashyapa, Daksha, Atri, Cyavana, Bhardvaja, Vyasa, Gautama, Parasara, Praceta, Vasistha, Samvarta, Brihaspati, Katyayana, Yajnavalkya, Uttanga, Saubhari, Parvata, Devala, Jaiglsavya, Jaimini, Vishvamitra, Sutapa, Pippalada Sakatayana, Jabali, Jangali, Apisali, Silalika, Astlka, Jaratkaru, Kalyanamitra, Durvasa, Vamadeva, Srngl, Vibhandaka, Pathi, Kavi, Kanada, Kaus'ika, Panini, Kautsa, Aghamarsana, Valmlki, Lomaharsana, Markandeya, Mrkandu, Parashurama, Samkrti, Agastya, Vanta and several other sages arrived there.

## \|\| 64.55-58 \|\|

*saśiṣyāśca saputrāśca brāhmaṇāśca tapasvinaḥ \|*  
*jarāsaṃdho dantavakro dāmbhiko draviḍādhipaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*śiśupālo bhīṣmakaśca bhagadattaśca mudgalaḥ \|*  
*dhārtarāṣṭro dhūmakeśo dhūmraketuśca śambaraḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*śalyaḥ satrājitaḥ śaṅkurnṛpāścānye mahābalāḥ \|*  
*bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kṛpācāryo hyaśvatthāmā mahābalāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*bhūriśravāśca śālvaśca kaikeyaḥ kauśalastathā \|*  
*sarvānsaṃbhāṣayāmāsa mahārājo yathocitam satyako yajñadivase cakāra ca śubhakṣaṇam \|\| 58 \|\|*

55-58. О sage, accompanied by the sons and the pupils of the Tapasvls, Brahmanas besides Jarasandha, Dantavakra, Dambhika, Dravideshvara, Sis'upala, Bhlsmaka, Bhagadatta, Mudgala, Duryodhana, Dhiimakesa, Dhumraketu, Sambara, Salya, Satrajita, Sanku and several other valorous kings including Bhis ma, Drona, Krpacarya, the valorous Asvatthama, Bhurisrava, Salva, Kaikeya and Kausala. The great king Kamsa talked to each one of them appropriately and Satyaka started the yajna in an auspicious time.

## Chapter 65

## \|\| 65.1 \|\|

*atha pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyama uvāca kaṃsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā so'krūro dharmiṇāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*uvāca cauddhavaṃ śāntaṃ śāntaḥ prahṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – On hearing the words of Kamsa, Akrura who was the best of the religious people, quite peaceful and who always remained happy in his heart, calmly said to Uddhava.

## \|\| 65.3-4 \|\|

*koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ mama svayamupasthitam \|*  
*babhūva me samutpannaṃ yadyatkarma śubhāśubham \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ciccheda bandhanigaḍaṃ mama baddhasya karmaṇā \|*  
*kārāgārāśca saṃsārānmukto yāmi hareḥpadam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Akrura said – "Today, our night has been turned into a dawn. The day is quite auspicious. The teacher, the Brahmanas and the gods are indeed happy with me, the merit I had earned during the crores of last births has appeared before me. Akrura who was held in bondage because of his actions, the same have been destroyed today. Getting relieved of the prison of the universe, I am proceeding to the abode of Hari.

## \|\| 65.5 \|\|

*suhṛdartho kṛto'haṃ ca kaṃsena viduṣā ruṣā \|*  
*vareṇa tulyo devasya krodho mama babhūva ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The intelligent Kamsa has made me to seek for a friend. Therefore, the anger of the king has turned into a boon for me.

## \|\| 65.6 \|\|

*vrajarāja samāhartuṃ vrajaṃ yāsyāmi sāṃpratam \|*  
*drakṣyāmi paramaṃ pūjyaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. I shall immediately move to Vraja in order to bring Shri Krishna here. Krishna who happens to be the bestower of enjoyment of pleasures and moks a will meet me there.

## \|\| 65.7-8 \|\|

*navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ nīlendīvaranocanam \|*  
*pītavastrasamāyuktakaṭideśavirājitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dhūlidhūsaritāṅgaṃ ca kiṃvā candanacarcitam \|*  
*athāva navanītāktamaṅgaṃ drakṣyāmi sasmitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. He has a complexion of new clouds, the eyes like blue lotus flowers he is clad in pltambara on his entire body, would be covered with dust or applied with the sandal-paste. He would otherwise have the butter rubbed on his limbs and would be smiling; I shall look at him in this form.

## \|\| 65.9 \|\|

*kiṃvā vinodamuralīṃ vādayantaṃ manoharam \|*  
*kiṃvā gavāṃ samūhaṃ ca cārajantamitastataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Or playfully he would be playing on the flute and would be running after the cows grazing here and there.

## \|\| 65.10 \|\|

*kiṃvā vasantaṃ gacchantaṃ śayānaṃ vā suniścitam \|*  
*nidreśaṃ kīdṛśaṃ cādya sudṛṣṭvā ca śubhe kṣaṇo \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Otherwise either seated or walking, either sleeping or awake, I would be in a position to look at the lord. After looking at him in the auspicious moment I shall achieve great pleasure.

## \|\| 65.11 \|\|

*yatpādapadmaṃ dhyāyante brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*  
*na hi jānāti yasyāntamananto'nantavigrahaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and all the gods meditate upon his lotus-like feet and the serpent Ananta having the vast body is unable to know about his end.

## \|\| 65.12 \|\|

*yatprabhāvaṃ na jānanti devāḥ santaśca saṃtatam \|*  
*sya stotre jaḍībhūtā bhītā devī sarasvatī \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The influence of whom is unknown to the gods and the ascetics, the one whose glory is beyond the recitation of Sarasvati and while doing so she becomes dumb.

## \|\| 65.13-14 \|\|

*dāsīniyuktā yaddāsyo mahālakṣamīśca lakṣītā \|*  
*gaṅmā yasya padāmbhojānniḥsṛtā sattava rūmiṇī \|\| 13 \|\|*

*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharā tribhuvanātparā \|*  
*darśanasparśanābhyāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ pātakanāśinī \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. For serving whom Maha-Lakshmi is deputed like a slave girl and the auspicious Ganga emerged out of his feet which removes birth, death, old age and ailment, is the best in the three worlds and destroys the sins of others to just have a glance at her.

## \|\| 65.15 \|\|

*dhyāyate yatpadāmbhojaṃ durgā durgavināśinī \|*  
*trelokyajananī devī mulaprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. At whose lotus-like feet Durga meditated who happens to be the destroyer of all the misfortunes, is the mother of the three lokas, is the great goddess besides being Mula-Prakriti.

## \|\| 65.16-20 \|\|

*lomnāṃ kūpeṣu viśvāni mahāviṣṇośca yasya ca \|*  
*asaṃkhyāni vicitrāṇi sthūlātsthūlatarasya ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sa ca yatṣoḍaśāṃśaśca yasya sarveśvarasya ca \|*  
*taṃ draṣṭuṃ yāmi he bandho māyāmānuṣarūpiṇam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sarva sarvāntarātmānaṃ sarvajñaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*brahmajyotiḥsvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham \|\| 18 \|\|*

*nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca nirānandaṃ nirāśrayam \|*  
*paramaṃ paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ nandanandanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*svecchāmayaṃ sarvaparaṃ sarvabījaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*vadanti yoginaḥ śaśvaddhyāyante'harniśaṃ śiśum \|\| 20 \|\|*

16-20. Lord Vishnu in whose hair-pits, innumerable globes are enshrined and who happens to be harder than the hardest and who happens to be the sixteenth Goloka of lord Krishna. О brother, I am going to have a look at him; he has an illusory form, is the inner soul of all, all knowledgeable beyond Prakriti, the form of eternal light, who takes to a definite form in order to grace his devotees, is beyond qualities, unattached, devoid of bliss, devoid of shelter, the great lord, all blissful, bestower of bliss, the one who delights Nanda, who moves at will, is beyond everyone, the cause of all and is believed to be eternal. All the ascetics' meditate upon his child-like form throughout the day and night.

## \|\| 65.21-22 \|\|

*manvantarasahasraṃ ca nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ \|*  
*padme pādmastapastepe purā pādmaṃ tu yatkṛte \|\| 21 \|\|*

*punaḥ kuru tapasyāṃ ca tadā drakṣyasi māmiti \|*  
*sakṛcchabdaṃ ca śuśrāva na dadarśa tathā'pi tam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. In the initial Padmakalpa, Brahma who emerged from the lotus, performed tapas seated on a lotus for a thousand manvantaras in which because of his remaining without food, his belly shrank. He then heard the words, "Perform the tapas again and you will find me". But in spite of performing such a long tapas he was unable to have an audience with the lord.

## \|\| 65.23 \|\|

*tāvatkālaṃ punastaptvā varaṃ prāpa dadarśa tam \|*  
*īdṛśaṃ parameśaṃ ca drakṣyāmyadya tamuddhava \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О Uddhava, in the meantime he performed tapas again and then he had an audience with the lord who also bestowed on him a boon. I would be able to have an audience with such a great lord.

## \|\| 65.24 \|\|

*purā śaṃbhustapastepe yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|*  
*jyotirmaṇḍalamadhye ca goloke taṃ dadarśa saḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. In the earlier times Shiva had performed tapas up to the length of the sage of Brahma and then he could look at the lord in the Jyotirmandala in Goloka.

## \|\| 65.25-26 \|\|

*sarvatattavaṃ sarvasiddhaṃ mamatatvaṃ paraṃ varam \|*  
*saṃprāpa tatpadāmbhoje bhaktiṃ ca nirmalāṃ parām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*cakārā'tmasamaṃ taṃ ca yo bhakto(ktaṃ)bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*īdṛśaṃ parameśaṃ ca drakṣyāmyadya tamuddhava \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. He then achieved the best of his devotion besides the knowledge of all the tattvas, all the success and the best of the tattvas. The lord who is graceful to his devotees, made Shiva like him. О Uddhava, I shall have an opportunity to meet with such a lord today.

## \|\| 65.27-28 \|\|

*sahasraśakrapātāntaṃ nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ \|*  
*yasyānantastapastepe bhaktyā ca paramātmanaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tadā cā''tmasamaṃ jñānaṃdadau tasmai ya īśvāḥ \|*  
*īdṛśaṃ parameśaṃ ca drakṣyāo \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. О Uddhava, Ananta had adored the lord for the life of a thousand Indras with devotion, remaining without food and only after that he could achieve the lord who bestowed all the knowledge on him. I am going to meet such a great lord today.

## \|\| 65.29-32 \|\|

*sahasraśakrapātāntaṃ dharmastepe ca yattapaḥ \|*  
*tadā babhūva sākṣī sa dharmiṇāṃ sarvakarmiṇām \|\| 29 \|\|*

*śāstā ca phaladātā ca yatprasādānnṛṇāmiha \|*  
*sarveśamīdṛśamaho drakṣyāo \|\| 30 \|\|*

*aṣṭāviṃśatirindrāṇāṃ patane yaddivāniśam \|*  
*evaṃ krameṇa māsābdaiḥ śatābdaṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*aho yasya nimeṣeṇa brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet \|*  
*īdṛśaṃ paramātmānaṃ drakṣyāo \|\| 32 \|\|*

29-32. Dharma also meditated upon him up to the life of a thousand Indras and as a result of the same he became the witness of the deeds of all and by the grace of the same he became the ruler on the humans and the bestower of the reward for their deeds. О Uddhava, I shall have a chance of meeting with such a great lord today, whose one day and night is counted after the destruction of twenty-eight Indras. In this order with the passage of months and years, Brahma lives for a hundred years and after the spending of the age of Brahma, whose one second is counted. I am going to meet with such a great lord.

## \|\| 65.33-35 \|\|

*nāsti bhūrajasā saṃkhyā yathaiva brahmaṇāṃ tathā \|*  
*tathaiva bandho viśvānāṃ tadādhāro mahāvirāṭ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*viśave viśve ca pratyekaṃ brahma viṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*  
*munayo manavaḥ middhā mānavādyāścarācarāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yatṣoḍaśāṃśaḥ sa virāṭ sṛṣṭo naṣṭaśca līlayā \|*  
*īdṛśaṃ sarvaśāstāraṃ drakṣyāo \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. О brother, as the particles of dust on earth are beyond counting, -similarly the number of Brahmandas also is beyond counting the base of which happens to be Mahavirat. In every globe there are separate Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and other gods besides the sages, the ascetics, siddhas, human beings and other movable and immovable creatures. The one whose sixteenth Goloka is Virat, who is playfully born and is destroyed such a great lord who is a ruler will be met my me today.

## \|\| 65.36 \|\|

*ityovamuktvā'krūraśca pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ \|*  
*mūrcchāṃ prāpa sāśrunetrodadhyo taccaraṇāmbujam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Thus speaking Akrnra felt overwhelmed and his eyes started shedding tears of joy. He fainted at that time. He then started adoring the lotus-like feet of the lord.

## \|\| 65.37-38 \|\|

*babhūva bhaktipūrṇaśca smāraṃ smāraṃ padāmbujam \|*  
*kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ vā'pi kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*uddhavaśca tamāśliṣya praśaśaṃka punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*sa ca śīghraṃ yayau gehamakūro'pi svamandiram \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Remembering the lotus-like feet of the lord Krishna again and again with devotion, he circumambulated lord Krishna. Thereafter Uddhava embraced Akriira again and again and praised him. Thereafter, he immediately left for his abode and Akriira also went back to his abode.

## Chapter 66

## \|\| 66.1 \|\|

*atha ṣaṭuṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha rāseśvarīyukto rāse rāseśvaraḥ svayam \|*  
*sa ca reme tayā sārdhaṃmatīva ramaṇotsukaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – Lord Krishna, the foremost among those performing Rasa getting anxious for a union with Radha, spent pleasant time with her in Rdsamandala.

## \|\| 66.2 \|\|

*sukhasaṃbhogamātreṇa yayau nidrāṃ ca rādhikā \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ samutvāya dīnovāca priyaṃ dine \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. After the union with Krishna, Radhika felt sleepy she then had a dream after which she rose up and sat down. She then meekly submitted herself to lord Krishna her beloved.

## \|\| 66.3 \|\|

*rādhikovāca aho svāminnihā''gaccha tvāṃ karomi svavakṣasi \|*  
*pariṇāme vidhātā me na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Radhika said – О lord, you come here. Let me embrace you because I am not aware of what the destiny would do to me after this.

## \|\| 66.4 \|\|

*ityuktvā kā mahābhāgā priyaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|*  
*duḥsvapnaṃ kathāyāmāsa hṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Thus speaking, the immensely virtuous Radha embraced her beloved and started speaking about the bad dream, she had witnessed.

## \|\| 66.5 \|\|

*rādhikovāca ratnasiṃhāsane'haṃ ca ratnacchatraṃ ca bibhratī \|*  
*tadātapatraṃ jagrāha ruṣaṭo vipraśca me prabho \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Radhika said – О lord, I was seated on the gem-studded lion-throne under an umbrella of gems. At that very moment a Brahmana getting annoyed with me, snatched away the umbrella from my hands.

## \|\| 66.6 \|\|

*sāgare kajjalākāre mahāghore ca dustare \|*  
*gabhīre prerayāmāsa māmeva durbalāṃ sa ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He forcefully drove a weak person like me in the terrific, insurmountable and deep ocean which looked like an ocean of collyrium.

## \|\| 66.7-8 \|\|

*tatra srotasi śokārtā bhramāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*mahormīṇāṃ ca vegena vyākulā nakrasaṃkule \|\| 7 \|\|*

*trāhi trāhīti he nātha tvāṃ vadāmi punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*tvāṃ na dṛṣṭvā mahābhītā karomi prārthanāṃ suram \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Getting panicky I started looking in the ocean again and again which was infested with crocodiles and the high waves which made me upset. "O lord, you protect me. I repeated these words again and again; I was terrified at finding you nowhere and then started offering prayer to the god.

## \|\| 66.9-10 \|\|

*kṛṣṇa tatra nimajjantī paśyāmi candramaṇ̈ḍalam \|*  
*nipatantaṃ ca gaganācchatakhaṇḍaṃ ca bhūtale \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kṣaṇāntare ca paśyāmi gaganātsūryaṃmaṇḍalam \|*  
*babhūva ca catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ nipatya dharaṇītale \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. О Krishna while I was drowning in the ocean I found that the moon was reduced to a hundred particles and even the sky was falling on earth.

## \|\| 66.11 \|\|

*ekakāle ca gagane maṇḍalaṃ candrasūryayoḥ \|*  
*atīva kajjalākāraṃ sarvaṃ grastaṃ ca rāhuṇā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In the second moment I found the solar disc which fell from the sky on the earth was reduced to four pieces. Thereafter, I found that both the sun and the moon had risen in the sky and were eclipsed by Rahu who was completely black.

## \|\| 66.12 \|\|

*kṣaṇāntare ca paśyāmi brahmaṇo dīptimāniti \|*  
*satkroḍasthaṃ sudhākumbhaṃ babhañja ca ruṣeti ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The next moment, I found that an illustrious Brahmana snatched away the pitcher of nectar from me and broke it in anger.

## \|\| 66.13 \|\|

*kṣaṇāntare ca paśyāmi mahāruṣṭaṃ ca brāhmaṇam \|*  
*gṛhītvā ca vrajantaṃ ca cakṣuṣoḥ puruṣaṃ mama \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Again I found that the angry Brahmana was dragging away my beloved from me.

## \|\| 66.14-15 \|\|

*krīḍākamaladaṇḍaṃ ca hastāddhvastaṃ mama prabho \|*  
*sahasā khaṇḍaśaṇḍaṃ ca babhūva saha hetunā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*hastādṣvastaśca sahasā sadratnasāradarpaṇaḥ \|*  
*nirmalaḥ kajjalākāraḥ khaṇḍakaṇḍo babhūva ha \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. О lord suddenly the lotus stalk held in my hands fell down on the ground and was reduced to pieces. The spotless mirror which was made of the best of gems was suddenly broken into pieces, falling from hands. The mirror which was quite spotless was rendered black after the fall, like the collyrium.

## \|\| 66.16 \|\|

*hāro me ratnamārāṇāṃ chinno bhūtvā ca vakṣasaḥ \|*  
*atīva marinaṃ padmaṃ papāta dharaṇītale \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The garland of gems worn by me on the breasts was broken and shattered. The lotus also faded out and fell down on the ground.

## \|\| 66.17 \|\|

*saudhaputtalikāḥ sarvā nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca \|*  
*āsphoṭayanti gāyanti rudanti ya kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. All the puppets of my mansion were dancing and laughing. In a moment they clapped their hands and in another moment they started singing and then crying.

## \|\| 66.18 \|\|

*kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bṛhaccakraṃ khe bhramantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*nipatantaṃ cotpatantaṃ paśyāmi ca bhayaṃkaram \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. A cakra of black colour was roaming in the sky, sometimes it fell down on earth and was again raised up.

## \|\| 66.19-22 \|\|

*prāṇādhidevaḥ puruṣo niḥsṛtyāmyantarānmama \|*  
*rādhe vidāyaṃ dehīti tato yāmītyuvāca ha \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇavarṇā ca pratimā māmāśliṣyati cumbati \|*  
*kṛṣṇavastraparīdhānā ceti paśyāmi sāṃpratam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*itīdaṃ viparītaṃ ca dṛṣṭāvā ca prāṇāvallabha \|*  
*nṛtyanti takṣiṇāṅgāni prāṇā āndolayanti me \|\| 21 \|\|*

*rudanti śokātkarṣanti samudvignaṃ ca mānasam \|*  
*kimidaṃ kimidaṃ nātha vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. Getting out my great lord who is dearer to me than my life he was saying. "O Radha you send me off. I am going. An image of black colour clad in black costumes embraced me. This is what I have witnessed in the dream. О lord of my life thus witnessing the opposite type of dream, my right limbs are fluttering. I am feeling restless and am crying because of the onset of grief. My mind is extremely disturbed. О lord, you happen to be the best of the gods, therefore you tell me immediately as to what does it means.".

## \|\| 66.23-24 \|\|

*ityuktvā rādhikā devī śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā \|*  
*papāta tatpadāmbhoje bhītā sa śokaviṅvalā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śrutvā svapnaṃ jagannātho devīṃ kṛtvā svavakṣami \|*  
*ādhyātmikena yogena vodhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Thus speaking Radhika, whose throat, lips and palate had dried up, getting frightened and filled with grief, fell at the feet of lord Krishna. Thereafter, lord Krishna who-is the lord of the universe, listening to the dream of Radhika embraced her and with the application of his divine yogic powers, he enlightened her.

## \|\| 66.25 \|\|

*ttayāca śokaṃ sa devī jñānaṃ saṃprāpya nirmalam \|*  
*śāntaṃ ca bhagavaṃtaṃ ca kṛtvā kāntaṃ svavakṣasi \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thereafter, when Radha was imparted with the spotless divine knowledge, she was relieved of her grief and then embraced the lord gracefully.

## Chapter 67

## \|\| 67.1-2 \|\|

*athā saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca virahavyākulāṃ dṛṣṭvā māminīṃ kāmamohanaḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā vakṣasi tāṃ kṛṣṇo yayau krīḍāsarovaram \|\| 1 \|\|*

*rājarājeśvarī rādhā kṛṣṇavakṣasi rājate \|*  
*saudāminīva jalade nadīne gagane mune \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Krishna the lord of passion, finding his beloved becoming conscious due to the idea of separation from him, embraced her and moved towards the lake of water-sport. О sage, at that point of time, the great goddess Radha appearing in the lap of Krishna as the clouds appear in the sky and the lightning appearing in the clouds.

## \|\| 67.3-5 \|\|

*reme sa ramayā sārdhaṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*dvayordvayoryathā svarṇaṃmaṇyormārakato maṇiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ratnanirmāṇaparyaṅke ratnendrasāranirmite \|*  
*natnapradīpe jvalati ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ratnabhūṣābhūṣitayā rāsaratnaśca kautukāt \|*  
*rasaratnākare ramye nimagno rasikeśvaraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. All merciful Krishna gracefully enjoyed the company of Radha, Shri Krishna looked in both of them as an emerald in a heap of gems. There was a bed made of the best of the gems and a lamp made of gems was burning. All the ascetics of the divine dance were made of the gems including the ornaments. Lord Krishna was then adorned with the gem-studded ornaments and in the company of Radha, who was also adorned with gem-studded ornament were engrossed in the ocean of love-sport.

## \|\| 67.6 \|\|

*rāse rāseśvarī rādhā rāmeśvaramuvāca sā \|*  
*suratau viratau satyāṃ virate na manorathe \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Getting disinterested in the love-sport without getting her mind detached from the same, Radha the goddess of the divine dance, spoke to Krishna the lord of the divine dance.

## \|\| 67.7 \|\|

*rādhikovāca praphullā'haṃ tvayā nātha mṛtā mlānā ca tvāṃ vinā \|*  
*yathā mahauṣadhigaṇaḥ prabhāte bhāti bhāskare \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Radhika said – О lord, I always remain delighted with you and without you I feel like a dead person and get faded, like the bunch of great medicinal plants blossoms in the morning and getting faded with the sunshine.

## \|\| 67.8-9 \|\|

*naktaṃ dīpaśikhevāhaṃ tvayā sārdhaṃ tvayā vinā \|*  
*dine dine yathā kṣīṇā kṛṣṇapakṣe vidhoḥ kalā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tava vakṣasi me dīptiḥ pūrṇaṃcandraprabhāsamā \|*  
*sadyo mṛtā tvayā tyaktā kuhvāṃ candrakalā yathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. I shine with you like the light of the lamp at the night. Without you my lustre goes on decreasing like the lustre of the moon in the black fortnight. I always illumined like the full moon placing my head on your chest and getting deprived of you. I get destroyed at once like the moon rays in the moonless night.

## \|\| 67.10 \|\|

*jvaladagniśikhevāhaṃ ghṛtāhutyā tvayā saha \|*  
*tvayā vinā'haṃ nirvāṇā śiśire padminī yathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. With you I remain like the flames of fire in which ghee is poured and without you I get faded like the lotus flower in the winter season.

## \|\| 67.11 \|\|

*cintājvarajarāgrastā mattastvayi gate'pyaham \|*  
*astaṃgate ravau candre dhvāndagrastā dharā yathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. When you leave me get myself drowned in the worries as the sun or the moon cover the earth with darkness after they set.

## \|\| 67.12 \|\|

*bhraṣṭo veṣastvāṃ vinā me rupayauvanacetanam \|*  
*tārāvalī paribhraṣṭā sūryasūtodaye yathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Without you my costumes, beauty, youthfulness, consciousness get destroyed in the same way as the stars get destroyed at dawn.

## \|\| 67.13 \|\|

*tvamevā''tmā ca sarveṣāṃ mama nātho viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tanuryathā''tmanā tyaktā tathā'haṃ ca tvayā vinā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You are the soul of all but you happen to be the only lord of mind. Without you I remain like the body without the soul.

## \|\| 67.14 \|\|

*pañcaprāṇātmakastvaṃ me mṛtā'haṃ ca tvayā vinā \|*  
*dṛṣṭeśca golakau jadvaddṛṣṭiḥ puttalikāṃ vinā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. You are my five pranas and as such without you I feel like a dead person, like the eyes which become useless without the eye-balls.

## \|\| 67.15 \|\|

*sthalaṃ yathā citrayuktaṃ tvayā sārdhamahaṃ tathā \|*  
*asaṃskṛtā tvayā hīnā tṛṇācchannā yathā mahī \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. With you I glitter like a painted surface and without you I look like the earth grown with wild vegetation.

## \|\| 67.16-17 \|\|

*tvayā sārdhamahaṃ kṛṣṇa citrayukteva mṛnmayī \|*  
*tvāṃ vinā jaladhautā'haṃ virūpā mṛnmayīva ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

*gopāṅganānāṃ śobhā ca tvayā rāseśvareṇa ca \|*  
*hāre svarṇavikāre ca śvetena maṇinā saha \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. О Krishna, I remain with you like the painted image of gold and without you, I look like an image of clay filled with dust and water. You are the lord of the divine dance and as such all the cowherdesses appear before you as the crystal gems appear in the garland of gold.

## \|\| 67.18 \|\|

*vrajarāja tvayā sārdha rājante rājarājayaḥ \|*  
*yathā candreṇa nabhasi tārārājirvirājate \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О lord of Vraja, the group of kings illumine with you as the constellation surround the moon in the sky.

## \|\| 67.19 \|\|

*tvayā śobhā yaśodāyā nandasya nandanandana \|*  
*yathā śākhāphalaskandhaistarurājirvirājate \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О son of Nanda, as the fruits and branches decorate the trees similarly you decorate or glorify Yashoda and Nanda.

## \|\| 67.20 \|\|

*tvayā kārdha gokuleśa sobhā gokulavāsinām \|*  
*yathā sarvā lokarājī rājendreṇa virājate \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О lord of Gokula, with you the people of Gokula appear so graceful as the great king is surrounded by his people.

## \|\| 67.21 \|\|

*rāmasyāpi ca rāseśa tvayā śobhā manoharā \|*  
*rājate devarājena yathā svarge'marāvatī \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. О great king, with you the divine dance also looks pleasant as the city of Amaravati looks glorious in the heaven of Devaraja Indra.

## \|\| 67.22 \|\|

*vṛndāvanasya vṛkṣāṇāṃ tvaṃ ca śobhā patirgatiḥ \|*  
*anyoṣāṃ ca vanānāṃ ca balavānkesarī yathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. You are the lustre of the trees of Vrindavana, their lord and the sun, as the lion is considered to be quite glorious in the forest among the wild animals.

## \|\| 67.23 \|\|

*tvayā vinā yaśodā ya nimagnā śokasāgare \|*  
*aprāpya vatsaṃ murabhiḥ krośantī vyākulā yathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Without you, the mother Yashoda is engrossed in grief like the cow who cries without her calf.

## \|\| 67.24 \|\|

*āndolayanti nandasya prāṇā dagdhaṃ ca mānasam \|*  
*tvayā vinā taptapātre yathā dhānyasamūhakaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Without you Nanda feels restless and his mind is reduced to ashes as the paddy gets fried in the heated vase.

## \|\| 67.25 \|\|

*ityuktvā paramapremṇā sā patantī hareḥ pade \|*  
*punarādhyātmikenaiva bodhayāmāsa tāṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thus speaking Radhika infatuated with love held the feet of Krishna. Thereafter lord Krishna again enlightened her with spiritual knowledge.

## \|\| 67.26 \|\|

*ādhyātmiko mahāyogī mohasaṃchedakāraṇam \|*  
*yathā parśuśca vṛkṣāṇāṃ tīkṣṇadhāraśca nārada \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О Narada, the spiritual knowledge removes the illusion in the same way as a sharp edged axe cuts the trees.

## \|\| 67.27-28 \|\|

*nārada uvāca ādhyātmikaṃ mahāyogaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara \|*  
*śokacchedaṃ ca lokānāṃ śrotuṃ kautuhalaṃ mama \|\| 27 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇa uvāca ādhyātmiko mahāyogo na jñāto yogināmavi \|*  
*sa ca nānāprakāraśca sarvaṃ vetti hariḥ svayam \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Narada said – О best of those well-versed in the Vedas, you enlighten us on the spiritual Mahayoga which destroys the grief of the people. I am quite anxious to hear about it. Narayana said – Even the yogis are not quite aware of the spiritual Mahayoga which is of various kinds and is known to lord Hari completely.

## \|\| 67.29 \|\|

*kiṃcidādhyātmikaṃ caiva gonoke rādhikeśvaraḥ \|*  
*suprītaḥ kathāyāmāsa tripurāriṃ yathā mune \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О sage, Shri Krishna the lord of Radha, had narrated a few parts of the divine Mahayoga to Shiva getting extremely delighted.

## \|\| 67.30 \|\|

*sahasrendranipātāntaṃ tapaḥ kurvantamīśvaram \|*  
*śreṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ ca tapasvinām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Shiva performed tapas up to a thousand Indras. He happened to be the best of Vaishnavas and quite senior and the best among the mendicants.

## \|\| 67.31-32 \|\|

*puṣkare duṣkaraṃ taptvā pādme pādmaṃ ca padmajaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā taṃ sādaraṃ kṛṣṇa uvāca kiṃcidevatam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*śatendrapātaparyantaṃ kaṭhoreṇa kṛśodaram \|*  
*niśceṣṭamasthisāraṃ ca kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. In the Padmakalpa Brahma performed severe austerities in the Puskara-ksetra. Finding him there, lord Krishna revealed a little of the Mahayoga to Brahma. Brahma performed tapas for a period of a hundred Indras, when he was reduced to only a skeleton. Thereafter the compassionate lord gracefully spoke to him.

## \|\| 67.33-35 \|\|

*siṃhakṣetre purā dharmaṃ mattātaṃ dharmiṇāṃ varam \|*  
*caturdaśendrāvacchinnaṃ tapastaptvā kṛśodaram \|\| 33 \|\|*

*papāṭhā''yātmikaṃ kiṃcitkṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*kicicchatendrāvacchinnaṃ māṃ tapantamuvāca saḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kiṃcitsanatkumāraṃ ca tapantaṃ suciraṃ param \|*  
*sutapantamanantaṃ ca kiṃciccovāca nārada \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. In the earlier times my father who was quite a religious one, performed tapas in the Simhaks etra which prolonged to fourteen Indras and was rendered quite weak. Therefter, the lord becoming merciful bestowed the knowledge of the spiritual Mahayoga. Thereafter, the same knowledge was imparted to Sanatkumara who performed tapas for a hundred Indras. He was also imparted with a bit of the knowledge. Thereafter, О Narada, after performing severe tapas for a long time, the same knowledge, in part, was given to Ananta.

## \|\| 67.36-37 \|\|

*ciraṃ tapantaṃ kapilaṃ himaśaile tapasvinam \|*  
*puṣkare bhāskare kiṃcittapantaṃ duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*uvāca kiṃcitprahlādaṃ kiṃciddurvāsasaṃ bhṛgum \|*  
*evaṃ nigūḍhaṃ bhaktaṃ ca kṛpyā bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Thereafter Kapila performed severe tapas for a long time on Himalaya and to Bhaskara, who performed hard tapas in the Puskara region, the part of the same divine knowledge was imparted to them. Thereafter the lord who is graceful on his devotees, parted with no part of the same knowledge to Prahlada, Durvasa, Bhrigu and Nigudha.

## \|\| 67.38 \|\|

*krīḍākanovare ramye yaduvāca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*śokārtāṃ rādhikāṃ tacca kathāyāmi niśāmaya \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Thereafter lord Krishna had imparted knowledge of the same to Radhika on the charming bank of the lake of the water sport. I am going to speak out the same to you which you please listen to.

## \|\| 67.39 \|\|

*virasaṃ rasikāṃ dṛṣṭvā vāsayitvā ca vakṣasi \|*  
*uvācā''dhyātmikaṃ kiṃcidyoginīṃ yogināṃ guruḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Finding his beloved quite sad, the lord, who happens to be the teacher of the yogis, embraced her and started narrating to him the spiritual yoga.

## \|\| 67.40 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca jātismare smarā''tmānaṃ kathaṃ vismarasi priye \|*  
*sarvaṃ golokavṛttāntaṃ sudāmnaḥ śāpameva ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Shri Krishna said – О beloved, you remember the happening of the past birth, you recollect the past happening. Why do you forgot yourself? You remember the curse of Sudama pronounced by him in the Goloka.

## \|\| 67.41 \|\|

*śāpātkiṃciddinaṃ dīne tvadvicchedo mayā saha \|*  
*bhaviṣyati mahābhāge melanaṃ punarāvayoḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O goddess of humility, we shall be separated from each other for sometime because of the curse of Sudama. О virtuous one, we shall meet again.

## \|\| 67.42 \|\|

*punareva gamiṣyāmi golokaṃ taṃ nijālayam \|*  
*gatvā gopāṅganābhiśca gopairgolokavāsibhiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. We shall again visit Goloka and enjoy the company of the cowherds and cowherdesses there.

## \|\| 67.43 \|\|

*adhunā''dhyātmikaṃ kiṃcittavāṃ vadāmi niśāmaya \|*  
*śokadhnaṃ harṣadaṃ sāraṃ sukhadaṃ mānasasya ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Listen, presently I am going to speak about the spiritual yoga to you which removes grief, bestows pleasure, is the form of tattva and provides solace to the mind.

## \|\| 67.44 \|\|

*ahaṃ sarvāntarātmā ca nirliptaḥ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*vidyamānaśca sarveṣu sarvatrādṛṣṭa eva ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. I happen to be the inner soul of everyone, am involved in all the actions, omnipresent and pervade everywhere in invisible form.

## \|\| 67.45 \|\|

*vāyuścarati sarvatra yathaiva sarvavastuṣu \|*  
*na ca liptastathaivāhaṃ sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. As the wind pervades everywhere but is not involved similar is my case. I am the witness of all the deeds.

## \|\| 67.46 \|\|

*jīvo matpratibimbaśca sarvatra sarvajīviṣu \|*  
*bhoktā śubhāśubhānāṃ ca kartā ca karmaṇāṃ sadā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. I am present in all the bodies in the form of Jiva (soul) which happens to be my reflection. The Jiva has to face the reward of good and bad deeds and is also the creator of actions.

## \|\| 67.47-48 \|\|

*yathā calaghaṭeṣveva maṇḍalaṃ candramuryayoḥ \|*  
*bhagneṣu teṣu saṃśliṣṭastayoreva tathā mayi \|\| 47 \|\|*

*jīvaḥ śliṣṭastathā kāle mṛteṣu jīviṣu priye \|*  
*āvāṃ ca vidyamānau ca satataṃ sarvajantuṣu \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. As the pitchers filled with water get the reflection of the sun and the moon, but when the pitcher is broken, the reflection of the sun and the moon disappear. Similarly, the soul merges in me. The soul disappears from the body at the appropriate time. Both of us always remain in all the creatures.

## \|\| 67.49-58 \|\|

*ādhāraścāhamādheyaṃ kārya ca kāraṇaṃ vinā \|*  
*aye sarvāṇi dravyāṇi naśvarāṇi ca sundari \|\| 49 \|\|*

*āvirbhāvādhikāḥ kutra kutracinnyūnameva ca \|*  
*mamāṃśāḥ ke'pi devāśca keciddevāḥkalāstathā \|\| 50 \|\|*

*kecitkalāḥ kalāṃśāṃśāstadaṃśāṃśāśca kecana \|*  
*madaṃśā prakṛtiḥ sūkṣmā sāca mūrtyāca pañcadhā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*sarasvatī ca kamalā durgā tvaṃ cāpi vedasūḥ \|*  
*sarve devāḥ prākṛtikā yāvanto mūrtidhāriṇaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*ahamātmā nityadehī bhaktadhyānānurodhataḥ \|*  
*ye ye prakṛtikā rādhe te naṣṭāḥ prākṛte laye \|\| 53 \|\|*

*ahamevā''samevāgre paścādapyahameva ca \|*  
*yathā'haṃ ca tathā tvaṃ ca yathā dhāvalyadugdhayoḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*bhedaḥ kadā'pi na bhavenniścitaṃ ca tathā''vayoḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ mahānvirāṭ suṣaṭau viśvāni yasya lomasu \|\| 55 \|\|*

*aṃśastvaṃ tatra mahatī svāṃśena tasya kāminī \|*  
*āhaṃ kṣudravirāṭ sṛṣṭau viśvaṃ yannābhipadmataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*ayaṃ viṣṇorlomakūpe vāso me cāṃśataḥ sati \|*  
*tasya strī tvaṃ ca bṛhatī svāśane subhagā tathā \|\| 57 \|\|*

*tasya viśve ca pratyekaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivā aṃśāścānye cāpi ca matkalāḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

49-58. О beautiful one, I am the base and the universe is lodged on the base. Without the base the structure cannot remain in the same way as no task can be established without a reason. О beloved, all things are perishable whether they are produced in large numbers or in small numbers. Some of the gods happen to be my amsha but some of the gods represent my rays, some of them are the part of my rays and some of them are the aritsas of my amsha. Prakriti also happens to be my amsha which has the form of atom and which can take to five forms. Sarasvatx, Lakshmi, Durga, yourself and Savitri represent the five forms of Prakriti. All the gods having invisible or visible forms are also the forms of Prakriti. I happen to be the soul of all and with the demand of my devotees I take to various forms. О Radha, all the things of nature which are born or destroyed in due course of time, I myself alone remain present at the beginning and at the end of the creation. As the sun-shine cannot be separated from the sun rays, the whiteness cannot be separated from the milk, similarly both of us cannot be separated from each other. There is absolutely no difference between both of us; this is certain. In the universe I happen to be Mahavirat in whose hair-pits, innumerable globes are enshrined. At that time from your own athsha, you become Mahati the wife of Mahavirat. In the universe, I remain as a junior Virat, out of the navel of whom the universe emerged. О chaste lady, in the hair-pits of Vishnu, my amsha always resides. At that point of time you appear as Brihatl the wife of Vishnu. In every globe, we find Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and other gods. All the three Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva happen to be my arhshas and the rest are my rays.

## \|\| 67.59-60 \|\|

*matkalāṃśāṃśakalayā sarve devi carācarāḥ \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe tvaṃ mahālakṣmīrahaṃ tatra caturbhujaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sa ca viśvādbahiścordhvaṃ yathā goloka eva ca \|*  
*sarasvatī tvaṃ satye ca sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. O goddess, then the whole movable and immovable universe happens to be particle Goloka. You reside in Vaikuntha as Maha-Lakshmi, where I reside as Vishnu having four arms. Like Goloka it is lodged above Brahmanda where you happen to be Sarasvati. In the Satyaloka you happen to be the beloved Savitri of Brahma.

## \|\| 67.61-62 \|\|

*śivaloke śivā tvraṃ ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*vināśya durgaṃ durgā ca sarvadurgatināśinī \|\| 61 \|\|*

*sa eva dakṣakanyā ca sā eva śailakanyakā \|*  
*kailāse pārvatī tena saubhāgyā śivavakṣasi \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. In the abode of Shiva you become Shiva. You are Ishvari and the MtilaPrakriti. You are the one who destroyed the demon named Durga and destroyed all the evil forces. Therefore, you are given the name of Durga. The same Durga happened to be the Sati, the daughter of Daksha and then became the daughter of Himavan. This is the reason why the virtuous Parvati always remains in the heart of Shiva the lord of Kailasa.

## \|\| 67.63-64 \|\|

*svāṃśena tvaṃ sindhukanyā kṣīrode viṣṇuvakṣasi \|*  
*ahaṃ svāśena sṛṣṭau ca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*tvaṃ ca lakṣmī śivā dhātrī sāvitrī ca pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*goloke ca svayaṃ rādhā rāse rāseśvarī sadā \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. In the ocean of milk, you happen to be the beloved of Vishnu in the form of Sindhukanya (Lakshmi) who emerged out of your amsa. At the time of creation, I remain present with Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva – and you represent Lakshmi, Parvati, Sarasvati, Savitri, separately. In the Goloka you appear as Radha and in the divine dance you are known as Raseshvari

## \|\| 67.65-66 \|\|

*vṛndā dṛndāvane ramye virajā virajātaṭe \|*  
*sā tvaṃ sudāmaśāpena bhārataṃ puṇyamāgatā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*pūtaṃ kartuṃ bhārataṃ ca vṛndāraṇyaṃ ca sundari \|*  
*tvatkalāṃśāṃśakalayā viśveṣu sarvayoṣitaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. In the plesant Vrindavana you are known as Vrinda and on the bank of Viraja river you appear as the cowherdess Viraja. You were cursed by Sudama at that very place as a result of which you arrived in Bharata. О beautiful one, in order to purify Bharata and Vrindavana you are present here and all the women of the world appear from your amsa.

## \|\| 67.67-68 \|\|

*yāyoṣitsā ca bhavatī yaḥ pumānso'hameva ca \|*  
*ahaṃ ca kalayā vahnistvaṃ svāhā dāhikā priyā \|\| 67 \|\|*

*tvayā saha samartho'haṃ nālaṃ dagdhuṃ ca tvāṃ vinā \|*  
*ahaṃ dīptimatāṃ sūryaḥ kalayā tvaṃ prabhākarī \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. You happen to be the form of all the women in the universe. With my amsa, I become the fire and you with your amsa appear as the power of burning as Svaha the beloved of Agni. I am in a position to bum and destroy only when you are with me, but without you I feel helpless. By my own rays I shine as the sun in the sky and you happen to be my lustre.

## \|\| 67.69-72 \|\|

*saṃjñā tvaṃ ca tvayā bhāmi tvāṃ vinā'haṃ na dīptimān \|*  
*ahaṃ ca kalayā candrastvaṃ ca śobhā ca rohiṇī \|\| 69 \|\|*

*manoharastvayā sārdhaṃ tvāṃ na ca sundaraḥ \|*  
*ahamindraśca kalayā svargalakṣmīśca tvaṃ śacī \|\| 70 \|\|*

*tvayā sārdhaṃ devarājo hataśrīśca tvayā vinā \|*  
*ahaṃdharmaśca kalayā tvaṃ ca mūrtiśca dharmiṇī \|\| 71 \|\|*

*nāhaṃ śakto dharmakṛtyo tvāṃ ca dharmakriyāṃ vinā \|*  
*ahaṃ yajñaśca kalayā tvaṃ ca svāṃśena dakṣiṇā \|\| 72 \|\|*

69-72. You happen to be Sanjna the beloved of Stirya and I shine only when you are with me and without you I cannot shine from my rays. I become the moon and you accordingly become Rohinl. By your remaining with me, I am always pleasant and without you I don't have the lustre by my own rays. I conduct myself as Indra and you happen to be Shachi the Lakshmi of the heaven with you I happen to be the lord of the gods and without you I happen to be lustrless. By my rays, I happen to be Dharma and you happen to be Dharmini, the spouse of Dharma. I perform all the function of Dharma with you and without you I feel helpless. I am the form of yajna and from my rays and with your amsa you appear as daksind the spouse of yajna.

## \|\| 67.73-74 \|\|

*tvayā sārdhaṃ ca phalado'pyakamarthastvayā vinā \|*  
*kalayā pidṛloko'haṃ svāṃśena tvaṃ svadhā satī \|\| 73 \|\|*

*tvayā'laṃ kavyadāne ca sadā nālaṃ tvayā vinā \|*  
*ahaṃ pumāṃstvaṃ prakṛtirna sraṣṭā'haṃ tvayā vinā \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. With you I bestow the reward and without you I am helpless. With my own rays I represent the abode of manes and from your amsa you conduct yourself as chaste Svadha. With you on my side I am in a position to accept the offering of pindlas and without you I am helpless. If I am Purusa you happen to be Prakriti and as such I am unable to create the universe without you.

## \|\| 67.75-80 \|\|

*tvaṃ ca saṃvatsvarūpā'hamīśvaraśca tvayā saha \|*  
*lakṣmīyuktastvayā lakṣmayā niḥ śrīkaśca tvayā dinā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*yathā nālaṃ kulālaśca ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ mṛdā vinā \|*  
*ahaṃ śeṣaśca kalayā svāṃśena tvaṃ vasuṃdharā \|\| 76 \|\|*

*tvāṃ sasyaratnādhārāṃ ca bibharmi mūrdhni sundari \|*  
*tvaṃ ca kāntiśca śāntiśca bhūtirmūrtimatī satī \|\| 77 \|\|*

*tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kṣamā lajjā kṣudhā tṛṣṇā parā dayā \|*  
*nidrā śraddhā ca tandrā ca mūrcchā ca saṃnatiḥ kriyā \|\| 78 \|\|*

*mūrtirūpā bhaktirūpā dehināṃ deharūpiṇī \|*  
*mamā''dhārā sadā tvaṃ ca tavā'tmā'haṃ parasparam \|\| 79 \|\|*

*yathā tvaṃ ca tathā'haṃ ca samau prakṛtipūruṣau \|*  
*na hi sṛṣṭirbhaveddevi dvayorekataraṃ vinā \|\| 80 \|\|*

75-80. You represent all the riches and therefore with you remaining on my side, I become the lord. With your remaining with me I am known as the lord of Lakshmi and without you I am devoid of all my glory as the potter is unable to make a vase without the clay. Similarly without you, the universe cannot be created. With my rays I happen to be Shesha and from your amsa you happen to be the goddess earth. О beautiful one, being the place of all the cereals and the gems I hold you always over my head. You are the lustre, peace, fortune, absolutely chaste, satisfaction, growth, forgiveness, shyness, hunger, lust, compassion, sleep, faith, drowsiness, unconsciousness, adoration, the form of all, the form of devotion and the bodies of all, those who possess the body. You are always my base and I happen to be your soul. Therefore, as you are, so am I. Both Prakriti and Purusa have the same form. О goddess, the universe cannot survive without either of them.

## \|\| 67.81-82 \|\|

*ityuktvā paramātmā ca rādhāṃ prāṇādhikāṃ priyām \|*  
*kṛtvā vakṣasi suprīto bodhayāmāsa nārada \|\| 81 \|\|*

*sa ca kīḍāniyuktaśca babhūva ratnamandire \|*  
*tathā ca rādhāyā sārdhaṃ kāmukyā saha kāmukaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. О Narada, thus speaking lord Krishna embraced his beloved Radha and getting filled with passion, he took the passionate Radha in to the house of gems and enjoyed her company there.

## Chapter 68

## \|\| 68.1 \|\|

*athāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca kṛtvā krīḍāṃ samutthāya puṣpatalpātpurātanaḥ \|*  
*nidritāṃ prāṇasadṛśīṃ bodhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – After performing the love-sport, the eternal lord Krishna got up from the bed of roses and woke up his beloved also.

## \|\| 68.2 \|\|

*vastrāñcalena saṃskṛtya kṛtvā tannirmalaṃ mukham \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaṃ śāntāṃ ca madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. He cleaned her mouth a the piece of cloth. Thereafter Madhusudana spoke to Radha peaceful and sweet words.

## \|\| 68.3-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ayi tiṣṭhakṣaṇaṃ rādhe rāseśvari śucismite \|*  
*vraja bṛndāvanaṃ vā'pi vrajaṃ vraja vrajeśvari \|\| 3 \|\|*

*rāsādhiṣṭhātṛtevi tvaṃ rāsaṃ rāse kuru kṣaṇam \|*  
*grāme grāme yathā santi sarvatra grāmadevatāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*priyāralinivahaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṣaṇaṃ candanakānanam \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ vā campakavanaṃ ghaccha vā tiṣṭha sundari \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ gṛhaṃ ca yāsyāmi viśiṣṭaṃ kāryamasti me \|*  
*vidāyaṃ dehi me prītyā kṣaṇaṃ māṃ prāṇavallabhe \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. Shri Krishna said – О goddess of divine dance, О goddess who cuts pleasant jokes, you wait here for a moment in the dancing hall, thereafter you can move to Vrindavana or Vraja. You are the great goddess of the divine dance therefore moving to the Rasamandala to perform the divine dance for a moment as the god of the village remains in every village, similarly you first go with cowherdesses to the Chandana-vana and then for a moment you move on to the Campavana and stay there. О beautiful one, for a moment I shall go to my abode where I have to attend to an important work. Therefore, О lady of my life, you leave me gladly for a moment.

## \|\| 68.7 \|\|

*prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī tvaṃ prāṇāśca tvayi santi me \|*  
*prāṇī vihāya praṇāṃśca kutra sthātuṃ kṣamaḥ priye \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Because you happen to be the goddess of my life and my life always remains with you, О dear one, where can a person live without the life.

## \|\| 68.8-10 \|\|

*tvayi me mānasaṃ śaśvattavaṃ me saṃsāravāsanā \|*  
*tvatto mama priyā nāsti tvameva śaṃkarātpriyā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*prāṇā me śaṃkaraḥ satyaṃ tvaṃ ca prāṇādhikā sati \|*  
*ityuktvā tāṃ samāśliṣya bhagavān gantusudyataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*akrūrāgamanaṃ jñātvā sarvajñaḥ sarvasādhanaḥ \|*  
*ātmā pātā ca sarveṣāṃ sarvopakārakārakaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. My mind always remains attracted towards you, you are my worldly pleasure and no one is dearer to me than you. You are dearer than Shiva. О chaste lady, this is true that Shiva happens to be my life but you happen to be dearer to me than my life. Thus speaking lord Krishna who is all knowledgeable, all competent, soul of all, the protector and is the lord who does good to everyone embracing Radhika got ready to leave.

## \|\| 68.11 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tameva gacchantamutsukaṃ bhinnamānasam \|*  
*uvāca rādhikā devī hṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Goddess Radhika, finding the lord getting ready to go, spoke with a sad mind.

## \|\| 68.12-13 \|\|

*rādhikovāca he nātha ramaṇapreṣṭha śreṣṭhaśca preyasāṃ mama \|*  
*he kṛṣṇa he ramānātha vrajeśa mā draja vrajam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*adhunā tvāṃ prāṇanātha paśyāmi bhinnamānasam \|*  
*gate tvayi mama prema gataṃ saubhāgyameva ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Radhika said – О lord, О my dear husband, you are the best among those who are loved by me, О lord Krishna, you do not go to Vraja. О lord of my life presently I find that your mind is disturbed, therefore in case you leave at the moment, my fortune and love would also depart.

## \|\| 68.14 \|\|

*kva yāsi māṃ vinikṣipya gambhīre śokasāgare \|*  
*virahavyākulāṃ dīnāṃ tvayyeva śaraṇāgatām \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Therefore throwing me in the vast and deep ocean of grief, where are you going? I am getting upset because of separation. I am quite humble and I take refuge in you.

## \|\| 68.15 \|\|

*na yāsyāmi punargehaṃ yāsyāmi kānanāntaram \|*  
*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti gāyaṃ gāyaṃ divāniśam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In case you leave then I will not go back to my house. I shall go to some forest, reciting the name of Krishna.

## \|\| 68.16 \|\|

*na yāsyāmyathavā'raṇyaṃ yāsyāmi kāmasāgare \|*  
*tatra tvatkāmanāṃ kṛtvā tyakṣyāmi ca kalevaram \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Otherwise I shall not go to the forest but I shall drown myself in the ocean of love and getting desirous of you I shall end my life.

## \|\| 68.17 \|\|

*yathā''kāśo yathā''tmā ca yathā candro thā raviḥ \|*  
*tathā tvaṃ yāsi matpārśve nibaddho vasanāñcale \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. As the light the soul, the moon and the sun remain together similarly how could you leave when you are entangled with me with the comer of my costumes?

## \|\| 68.18 \|\|

*adhunā yāsi nairāśyaṃ kṛtvā me dīnavatsala \|*  
*na yuktaṃ hi parityaktuṃ dīnāṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatām \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О lord of the down-trodden, in case you leave at the moment disappointing me then it would not be proper for you to leave a humble person like me who has taken refuge in you.

## \|\| 68.19 \|\|

*yatpādapadmaṃ dhayāyante brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*  
*tvāṃ māyayā gopaveṣaṃ kathaṃ jānāmi matsarī \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The one whose feet are adored always by Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, he is taking to the form of a cowherd because of his illusion, how can I really know about you who is envious of you.

## \|\| 68.20 \|\|

*kṛtaṃ yaddeva durnītamaparādhasahasrakam \|*  
*yaduktaṃ patibhāvena cābhimānena tatkṣama \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О lord I have committed innumerable sins improperly and whatever I had spoken to you taking you as my husband in arrogance. You kindly forgive me.

## \|\| 68.21-23 \|\|

*cūrṇobhūtaśca madgarvo dūrībhūto manorathaḥ \|*  
*vijñātumātmasaubhāgyaṃ kimanyatkathayāmi te \|\| 21 \|\|*

*jñātvā gargamukhacchrutvā mohitā tava māyayā \|*  
*tvāṃ ca vaktuṃ na śaknomi premṇā vā bhaktipāśataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*yāsi cenmāṃ parityajya sakalaṅko bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*tvatputrapautrā naśyanti brahmamopānalena ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. My pride has been shattered and the goal has been left behind, what more can I speak in order to know about my fortune? In spite of knowing about the truth, about you from the mouth of Garga, I am still infatuated with the illusion, therefore getting over-powered with love and devotion, I am unable to speak out anything but in case you are going, leaving me alone then you will earn a blemish and all your sons, and grandsons would be destroyed in the fire of the anger.

## \|\| 68.24 \|\|

*kṣaṇaṃ yugaśataṃ manye tvāṃ vinā prāṇavallabham \|*  
*kathaṃ śatābdaṃ tvāṃ tyaktvā bibharmi jīvanaṃ prabhī \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. You are the lord of my life and without you even a moment is spent by me like a yuga. Therefore, О lord how can I remain alive getting separated from you for a hundred years.

## \|\| 68.25 \|\|

*ityuktvā rādhikā mopātpapāta dharaṇītale \|*  
*mūrcchaṃ saṃprāpa sahasā jahāra cetanāṃ mune \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О sage thus speaking Radhika fell down on the ground in anger and fainted losing consciousness.

## \|\| 68.26 \|\|

*kuṣṇastāṃ mūrcchitāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*cetanāṃ kārayitvā ca vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Thereafter the all merciful Krishna finding her fainted, brought her back to senses and embraced her.

## \|\| 68.27 \|\|

*bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ yogaiḥśokavikhaṇḍanaiḥ \|*  
*tathā'pi śokaṃ tyaktuṃ ca na śaśāka śucismitā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. In spite of the face that he had bestowed the divine knowledge of the yogic practices on her which could remove the grief but in spite of that Radhika, who always had a smiling face could not be relieved of the grief.

## \|\| 68.28 \|\|

*sāmānyavastuviśleṣīnṛṇāṃ śokāya kevalam \|*  
*dehātmanośca vicchedaḥ kva sukhāya prakalpate \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. When the separation from ordinary things creates grief for a person then how could the separation from the body and the soul be pleasant.

## \|\| 68.29 \|\|

*na yayau tatra divase vrajarājo vrajaṃ pati \|*  
*krīḍāsarovarābhyāśaṃ prayayau rādhāyā saha \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The lord of Vraja could not go to Vraja on that day. He took Radha to the lake of the love-sport.

## \|\| 68.30 \|\|

*tatra gatvā punaḥ krīḍāṃ cakāra ca tayā saha \|*  
*vijahau krihajvālāṃ rāse rāseśvarī mudā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Reaching there he again had the divine play with Radha as a result of which the burning sensation of the mind of the goddess of the divine dance was subsided.

## \|\| 68.31 \|\|

*rādhā sā svāminā sārdhaṃ puṣpacandanacarcitā \|*  
*puṣpacandanatalpe ca tasthau rahasi nārada \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Thereafter, G Narada, getting decorated with flowers and sandal-paste, Radha enjoyed the company of her husband Krishna on the bed of roses.

## Chapter 69

## \|\| 69.1 \|\|

*athaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ rahasyaṃ rādhākeśavayorvada \|*  
*nigūḍhatatvāmaspaṣṭaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – Thereafter what is the extremely secret and secret tattva of Radha and Krishna and what was their other tattva you kindly tell me.

## \|\| 69.2-3 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*gopanīyaṃ ca vedeṣu purāṇeṣu purāvidām \|\| 2 \|\|*

*punaḥ sakāmo bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ svecchāmayo vibhuḥ \|*  
*reme sa ramayā sārdhaṃ vidagdhaśca vidagdhayā \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Narayana said – О Narada, I will speak to you the extremely secretive tattva which the ancient people describe as quite secret in the Vedas and other scriptures. You please listen to me. Thereafter, the passionate, moving at will, all-pervading and clever lord Krishna enjoyed the love-sport with beautiful Radha.

## \|\| 69.4-7 \|\|

*catuḥṣaṣṭikalāśaktyā yathā kāntā kalāvatī \|*  
*kāmaśāstreṣu nipuṇā vidagdhā rasikeśvarī \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śṛṅgāralīlānipuṇā śaśvatkāmā ca kāmukī \|*  
*sundarī sundarīṣveva śaśvatsusthirayauvanā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*pitaṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā mānyā ca māninī \|*  
*śaṃbhoḥ śiṣyā jñānayutā śatakalpāntajīvinī \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vedavedāṅganipuṇā yoganītiviśāradā \|*  
*nānārūpadharā sādhvī prasiddhā siddhayoginī \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. Radha was completely like the figure of her mother Kalavati. Kalavati had the strength of sixty-four arts, quite attractive, well-versed in the sports of love, extremely intelligent, passionate, well-versed in passionate advances, always filled with passionate desires, completely passionate, most beautiful of woman, having quite stable youth-fullness and was the mind-bom daughter of the manes, was quite fortunate, arrogant, the pupil of Shiva, possessed all knowledge, who lived for a hundred kalpas, well-versed in the Vedas and post-Vedic literature, well-versed in yogic practices and polity, the one who could change to many forms, quite chaste and was the well-known Siddhayogini.

## \|\| 69.8-11 \|\|

*tatkanyā rādhikā devī mātṛtulyā ca kāmukī \|*  
*cakāra nānābhāvaṃ sā suśīlā svāminaṃ prati \|\| 8 \|\|*

*catuḥṣaṣṭikalāmānaṃ śrṛṅgāraṃ ca cakāra saḥ \|*  
*tyā viśiṣṭayā sākaṃ rāse rāmarasotsukaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tāṃ nakhāgrakṣataśroṇīṃ nakhakṣatapayodharām \|*  
*luptacandanasiṃdūrāṃ kabarīśithilāṃ satīm \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sukhasaṃbhogamagnāṃ ca nagnāṃ ca śokamūrcchitām \|*  
*pulakāñcitasarpāṅgīṃ nidrādevī samāyayau \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. Her daughter named Radhika was also like her mother and quite passionate. The noble Radhikfl displayed several types of dispositions in the divine dance for lord Krishna who was always anxious to perform for the sake of his beloved and particularly Radha who was quite dear to him, enjoyed sixty-four types of asanas, by which the pelvic region and the breasts were injured with the nails, the painting of the sandal-wood paste and the vermilion was shattered and the hair-do was disarranged. She enjoyed everlasting pleasure by getting unrobed and fainted with grief. Her entire body was filled with emotions and she was overwhelmed. She went to sleep in the same position.

## \|\| 69.12 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nidritāṃ kṛṣṇaḥkṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*ruroda māyayā māyī mayeśo lokaśikṣayā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thereafter, finding her enjoying the sleep, the compassionate lord Krishna who is the lord of illusion also, just for educating people getting filled with illusion cried aloud.

## \|\| 69.13 \|\|

*kṛtvā vakṣasi rādhāṃ ca cucumba ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*snātāṃ ca netrasalilaiḥ prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevatām \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Embracing the great goddess Radha he kissed her again and again. She was bathed with the waters of his tears.

## \|\| 69.14 \|\|

*prāṇādhikāṃ priyatamāṃ dhārayāmāsa vāsasī \|*  
*vahniśuddhe'tisūkṣme cāmūlye viśvamudurlabhe \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Krishna then clad his beloved with the garments sanctified by fire which were quite fine and were invaluable besides being difficult to get in the universe.

## \|\| 69.15-18 \|\|

*kabarīṃ ca dadau kuṅkumacandanam \|*  
*tadgātre ca gale hāramamūlyaṃ ratnanirmitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sindūraṃ ca dadau tasyāḥ sīmantādhaḥsthale'male \|*  
*dāḍimīkusumākāraṃ yuktaṃ candanabindubhi \|\| 16 \|\|*

*cakāra padmakaṃ gaṇḍe nānācitravicitrakam \|*  
*dadau tatpādapadme ca ratnamañjīrarañjitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pādāṅgulinakhāge ca sundarālaktakaṃ dadau \|*  
*nānāsuveṣojjvalitāṃ tāṃ nidrākulitāṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. He made a knot of her hair, plastered her body with saffron and sandal-paste, adorned her neck with garlands of invaluable gems and applied vermilion on the head at the point of the parting of the hair; her cheeks were decorated with various types of flowers like lotus and others and her feet were adorned with the gem-studded anklets, beautiful red paint was applied over her feet and the toes. Thus the lord decorated his beloved when she was fast asleep by applying various types of cosmetics.

## \|\| 69.19-22 \|\|

*punaścakāra mohena gāḍhāliṅganamīpsitam \|*  
*punaśca cumbanaṃ kṛtvā niveśya ca svavakṣasi \|\| 19 \|\|*

*suṣvāpa jagatāṃ svāmī kāntāvirahakātaraḥ \|*  
*etasminnantare kāne brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*śivaśeṣādibhirdevairmunīndraiḥ sārdhamāyayau \|*  
*āgatya natvā sirasā tuṣṭāva saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sāmavedoktastotreṇa paripūrṇatamaṃ vibhum \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. Thereafter infatuated with love, he embraced her and implanted kisses on her repeatedly, he then laid her against his chest and then went to sleep himself. In the meantime the grandsire Brahma, Shiva, Shesha and the gods arrived there together with the sages. They saluted before him bowing their heads and with folded hands started offering prayers as prescribed in the Samaveda.

## \|\| 69.23-25 \|\|

*brahmovāca jaya jaya jagadīśa vanditacaraṇa nirguṇa nirākāra svecchāmaya bhaktānugraha nityavigraha \|\| 23 \|\|*

*gopaveṣa māyayā māyeśa suveṣa suśīla śānta sarvakānta dānta nitāntajñānānanda parātparatara prakṛteḥ para sarvāntarātmarūpa nirlipta sākṣisvarūpa vyaktāvyakta nirañjana bhārāvatāraṇa karuṇārṇava śokasetāpagrasana jarāmṛtyubhayādiharaṇa śaraṇapañjara bhaktānugrahakāraka bhaktavatsala bhaktasaṃcitadhana oṃ namo'stu te \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sarpādhiṣṭhātṛdevāyetyuktvā vai prīṇanāya ca \|*  
*punaḥpunaḥruvācedaṃ mūrcchitaśca babhūva ha \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. Brahma said – О lord of the universe, victory to you, all of us adore your sacred feet. You are beyond the gunas like sattva, rajas and tamas you are formless, moving at will, graceful to the devotees, having the eternal form, taking to the form of a cowherd by illusion, lord of the illusion, clad in the best of garments, having the best nature, peaceful, loveable by all, can subjugate all, possessing eternal knowledge, quite blissful, beyond everything, beyond Prakriti, residing in the heart of everyone, unattached witness of the deeds of all the people; you are formless as well as with form, spotless, remover of the burden of earth, ocean of mercy, destroyer of the grief and sufferings of the people, destroyer of old age, death and fear, serving as a sage for those who take refuge in you, graceful and compassionate to the devotees and are the immense treasure of the devotees, we bow in reverence to you. You are the great god of all, we bow in reverence to you. Whatever was spoken by Brahma again and again to please the god, was spoken with utmost devotion, after which he fainted.

## \|\| 69.26 \|\|

*iti brahmakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ \|*  
*tatsarpābhīṣṭasiddhiśca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Whosoever recited the stotra composed by Brahma or listens to it with an attentive mind, all his desires get fulfilled, there is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 69.27 \|\|

*aputro labhate putraṃ priyāhīno labhetpriyām \|*  
*nirdhano labhate satyaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ dhanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. A man without son gets a son, without a wife, gets a wife and a pauper receives immense riches surely.

## \|\| 69.28 \|\|

*iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cānte dāsyaṃ labheddhareḥ \|*  
*acalāṃ bhaktimāpnoti mukterapi sudurlabhām \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Enjoying all the pleasures in this world, he achieves the slavehood of the lord ultimately and, achieves his everlasting abode.

## \|\| 69.29 \|\|

*stutvā ca jagatāṃ dhātā praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*śanaiḥ śanaiḥ samutthāya bhaktyā punaruvāca ha \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. He was thus eulogised by Brahma who prostrated before him again and again with his mind filled with devotion.

## \|\| 69.30-31 \|\|

*brahmovāca uttiṣṭha devadeveśa paramānandakāraṇa \|*  
*nandanandana sānanda nityānanda namo'stu te \|\| 30 \|\|*

*vraja nandālayaṃ nātha tyaja vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|*  
*smara sṛdāmaśāpaṃ ca śatavarṣanibandhanam \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Brahma said – О lord of the gods, О blissful one, the delight of Nanda, you are filled with bliss, are all blissful, I bow in reverence to you. О lord, leaving Vrindavana you go to the abode of Nanda. You remember the curse of Sudama in which you have to remain separated from your beloved for a hundred years.

## \|\| 69.32-34 \|\|

*bhaktaśāpānṛrodhena śatavarṣa priyāṃ tyaja \|*  
*punarenāṃ ca saṃprāpya golokaṃ ca gamiṣyasi \|\| 32 \|\|*

*gatvā pitṛgṛhaṃ deva paśyākūraṃ samāgatam \|*  
*pitṛvyamatithiṃ mānyaṃ dhanyaṃ vaiṣṇavamīśvara \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tena sārdhaṃ madhupurīṃ bhagavān gaccha saṃpratam \|*  
*kuru śaṃbhordhanurbhaṅgaṃ bhagnaṃ vairigaṇaṃ hare \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. Because of the curse of your devotees, you have to get separated from your beloved for a hundred years. You will get back again and go to Goloka but О lord, presently you go and reach the abode of your father and meet Akrara who happens to be your uncle and has arrived here. He is quite adorable, graceful and a great Vais nava. О lord, you go to Mathura accompanied by him. О Hari, reaching there you break the bow of Shiva and destroy the enemies.

## \|\| 69.35 \|\|

*hana kaṃsaṃ durātmānaṃ tātaṃ bodhaya mātaram \|*  
*nirmāṇaṃ dvārakāyāśca bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhuvaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. You free yourself from your parents from the bondage, killing the wicked Karnsa. Thereafter you build the city of Dvaraka and relieve the earth of her burden.

## \|\| 69.36 \|\|

*daha vārāṇasīṃ śaṃbhoḥ śakrasya sadanaṃ vibho \|*  
*śivasya jṛmbhaṇaṃ yuddhe bāṇasya bhujakṛntanam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. O virtuous one, destroying the city of KasI of lord Shiva you have to destroy the abode of Indra also, engaging Shiva in a trance, you destroy the arms of Banasura.

## \|\| 69.37 \|\|

*rukmiṇīharaṇaṃ nātha ghātanaṃ narakasya ca \|*  
*ṣoḍaśānāṃ sahasraṃ ca strīṇāṃ pāṇigrahaṃ kuru \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. О lord, kidnapping Rukmini, you kill Narakasura and marry the sixty thousand girls there.

## \|\| 69.38 \|\|

*tyaja priyāṃ prāṇasamāṃ vrajeśvara vrajaṃ vraja \|*  
*uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te yāvadrādhā na jāgrati \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О lord of Vraja, disowning your beloved who is dearer to you than your life, you proceed to Vraja. Till such time as Radha does not wake up, you get up at once. You will meet with welfare.

## \|\| 69.39 \|\|

*tyevamuktvā brahmā ca sendrairdevagaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*jagāma brahmalokaṃ ca śeṣaśca śaṃkarastathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Thus speaking Indra together with the gods like Brahma went back to Brahmaloka. The serpent Shesha and Shiva also retired to their respective abodes.

## \|\| 69.40-41 \|\|

*puṣpacandanavṛṣṭiṃ ca kuṣṇasyopari devatāḥ \|*  
*cakruḥ prītyā ca bhaktyā ca vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī \|\| 40 \|\|*

*badha kaṃsaṃ vathārha ca svapitrormokṣaṇaṃ kuru \|*  
*kṣayaṃ kurubhuvo bhāraṃ nāradetyevameva ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Thereafter filled with devotion the god showered the flowers soaked with sandal-paste on the lord and they heard a divine voice from the sky which said, "Karnsa is fit for killing. By killing him relieve your parents of bondage and then relieve the earth of her burden.".

## \|\| 69.42 \|\|

*ityevaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ \|*  
*rādhā bhagavatīṃ tyaktvā samuttasthau śanaiḥ śanaiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Hearing all these words, for the welfare of the people, lord Krishna leaving aside Radha got up slowly.

## \|\| 69.43 \|\|

*yayau hariḥ kiyaddūraṃ nirīkṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ tasthau candanānāṃ vane vāsasamīpataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Looking at Radha again and again the lord went up to a distance and he stopped for a moment in his abode in the Chandana-vana.

## \|\| 69.44-45 \|\|

*vihāya rādhā nindrāṃ sā samuttasthau svatalpataḥ \|*  
*na nirīkṣya harīṃ śāntaṃ kāntaṃ ca prāṇavallabham \|\| 44 \|\|*

*hā nātha ramaṇa preṣṭha prāṇeśa prāṇavallabha \|*  
*prāṇacora priyatama kva gato'sītyuvāca ha \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Radha on the other hand woke up and get up from her bed. She was peaceful, beautiful but finding her lord missing who was beautiful and peaceful, she said, "O lord, the extremely dear one, О lord of my life, the chief of my life, О beloved one, where have you gone.

## \|\| 69.46-47 \|\|

*kṣaṇamanveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā babhrāma mālatīvanam \|*  
*uvāsa kṣaṇamuttasthau kṣaṇaṃ suṣvāpa bhūtale \|\| 46 \|\|*

*ruroda kṣaṇamatyuccairvilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*āgacchā''gaccha he nāthetyevasuktvā punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. After searching for him for a moment she went to the Malatl-vana. She rested there for a while and again got up and then slept on the floor. She started crying in a moment saying, "O lord." Repeating these words again and again, she started lamenting loudly.

## \|\| 69.48 \|\|

*mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa saṃtāpātsaṃptatā virahānalaiḥ \|*  
*bhūtale ca tṛṇācchanne papāta ca yathā mṛtā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Burning with the fire of separation she fainted and she lay there on the grassy land like a dead person.

## \|\| 69.49 \|\|

*āyayustatra gopyaśca brahmañchatasahasraśaḥ \|*  
*kāściccāmarahastāśca gṛhītvā candanadravam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. О Brahman, at that point of time a lakh of cowherdesses arrived there to serve her, some of whom were carrying in their hands the fly-whisks and sandal-paste.

## \|\| 69.50 \|\|

*tāsāṃ madhye priyā līlā kṛtvā rādhāṃ svavakṣasi \|*  
*mṛtāmiva priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda premavihvalā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Lila has been the most favourable of the cowherdesses of Radha who picked her up and embraced her. Finding her friend like a dead person, she was upset and started crying.

## \|\| 69.51 \|\|

*sajalaṃ paṅkajadalaṃ paṅkopari nidhāya ca \|*  
*sthāpayāmāsa tāṃ rādhāṃ niśceṣṭāṃ ca mṛtāmiva \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. She spread the lotus leaves on the ground and then she placed the body of Radha on the same who was sleeping without any movement.

## \|\| 69.52-57 \|\|

*gopībhiḥ sevitāṃ tatra ruciraiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*candanadravayuktāṃ ca snigdhavastrānvitāṃ satīm \|\| 52 \|\|*

*dadarśa kṛṣṇastatraitya tāmeva prāṇavallabhām \|*  
*nivāritaśca gopībhirbaliṣṭhābhiśca nārada \|\| 53 \|\|*

*yathā nītaḥ sāparādho daṇḍatho rājabhaṭādibhiḥ \|*  
*cakāra rādhāṃ kroḍe ca samāgatya kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa bodhayāmāsa bodhanaiḥ \|*  
*saṃprāpya cetanāṃ devī dadarśa prāṇavallābhām \|\| 55 \|\|*

*babhūva susthirā devī tatyāja virahajvaram \|*  
*cakāra kāntaṃ sā kāntā gātrāliṅganamīpsitam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*nānāprakāraśṛṅgāraṃ cakāra madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*uvāsa ratnatalpe ca rādhāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|\| 57 \|\|*

52-57. The cowherdesses holding beautiful white fly-whisks started serving her and applying sandal-paste on her body and then clad her in a thick garment. In the meantime, lord Krishna also arrived there and found Radha there who was dearer to him than his life. О Narada, at that point. of time the strong and powerful cowherdesses were preventing the entry of Krishna towards the place of Radha like the soldiers of the king. But the compassionate Krishna, reaching there lifted Radha and took her in his lap and enlightened her With various types of divine knowledge. On regaining consciousness, Radha looked at the lord of her life and getting composed, she shed away the pain of separation. Thereafter, the beautiful Radha embraced her beloved and Madhusudana on his part carried Radha to the bed of gems and enjoyed the love-sport with her.

## \|\| 69.58 \|\|

*rādhāsakhī ratnamālā vidagdhā sarvapūjitā \|*  
*uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ nītisāramanuttamam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Thereafter Ratnamala, the dearest friend of Radha, spoke to Krishna in sweet tone the words which were very appropriate.

## \|\| 69.59-60 \|\|

*ratnamārovāca śṛṇu kṛṣṇa pravakṣyāmi pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|*  
*hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāraṃ daṃpatyoḥ prītikāraṇam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*saṃmataṃ kāmaśāstreṣu nītau vedapurāṇayoḥ \|*  
*laukikavyavarāreṣu praśasyaṃ suyaśaskaram \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. Ratnamala said – О Krishna, you listen to me, I am going to talk to you that which would be quite pleasant, beneficial, truthful and the tattva of polity besides being the cause of immense love of a couple. It is strictly according to the scriptures on love, polity, Vedas, Puranas and human behaviour. These words also bestow great reputation.

## \|\| 69.61 \|\|

*nārīṇāṃ ca priyā mātā priyo bhrātā ca vandhuṣu \|*  
*tataḥ priyaśca putraśca putrādeva priyaḥ patiḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Of all the women the mother is extremely lovable of all the relatives, the brothers is lovable and the son is more lovable than him. A husband is more lovable than the son.

## \|\| 69.62 \|\|

*śataputrātpriyaḥ svāmī sādhvīnāṃ sādhusaṃmataḥ \|*  
*rasikānāṃ vidagdhānāṃ na hi bhartuḥ paraḥ priyaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The chaste lady loves her husband more than a hundred sons. This is well-known. The passionate woman and the one who is well versed in the art of making love is devoted to her husband the most and no one can equal the husband.

## \|\| 69.63 \|\|

*yadi bhartā vidagdhaśca vidagdhānāṃ sukhāvahaḥ \|*  
*anyathā viṣatulyaśca viṣamaścetkhalaḥ khalu \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. In case the husband is also well-versed in the art of making love, in spite of that for the ladies he is quite pleasant and in case a husband is wicked and foolish, he is treated like poison and is always troublesome.

## \|\| 69.64 \|\|

*saṃsāre cānṛte vatsa daṃpatyoḥ prītireva ca \|*  
*parasparaṃ ca samatā priyasaubhāgyamīpsitam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. О Krishna, the love of a couple is considered to be quite important in the universe. The equality of a couple is the biggest fortune and is also desirable.

## \|\| 69.65 \|\|

*daṃpatyoḥ samatā nāsti yatra-yatra hi mantire \|*  
*alakṣmīstatra tatraiva viphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tayoḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The household in which the couple is not treated with equality, poverty dwells there and the life of both of them becomes of no consequence.

## \|\| 69.66 \|\|

*susvāmināṃ vibhedaśca paraṃ duḥkhaṃ ca yoṣitām \|*  
*śokasaṃtāpabījaṃ ca jīvitaṃ maraṇādhikam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. It is extremely painful for the woman to get separated from a meritorious husband. This separation could be the seed of grief and lamenting. And they have to suffer from it throughout the life.

## \|\| 69.67 \|\|

*svapne jāgaraṇe cāpi patiḥ prāṇāśca yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*patireva guruḥ strīṇāmiha loke paratra ca \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Whether sleeping or awake, the husband happens to be the life of the women. He is also considered to be their teacher in this as well as in the future life.

## \|\| 69.68 \|\|

*asmāttavayi gate nāthe mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa rādhikā \|*  
*papāta sahasā bhūmau tṛṇācchanne ca bhūtale \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. It is because of this that Radhika fainted after your departure and fell down suddenly on the grassy land.

## \|\| 69.69 \|\|

*mayā dattaṃ mukhe'syāśca śītalaṃ jalamuttamam \|*  
*tadā śvāso babhūvāsyāścetanaṃ bālyameva ca \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. I poured the cool and best water over her after which she regained consciousness and she started breathing again and again she regained her glow.

## \|\| 69.70-71 \|\|

*kṣaṇaṃ vadati he nātha he kṛṣṇeti kṣaṇaṃ sakhī \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ roditi saṃtaptā mūrcchāṃ prāpnoti tatkṣaṇam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*rādhikāyāḥ śarīraṃ ca saṃtaptaṃ virahānalaiḥ \|*  
*dagdhalohayaṣṭisamamaspṛśyamanalopamam \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. Another cowherdesses spoke again, "O lord, О Krishna," she then started crying in a moment and in a moment she fell down and fainted. As the iron rod becomes untouchable having been burnt in fire similarly the body of Radha became untouchable with the fire of separation.

## \|\| 69.72-73 \|\|

*svapne jāganaṇe rātrau divase ca gṛhe vane \|*  
*jale sthale cāntarikṣe'bhyudaye candrasūryayoḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*nāsti bhedaśca rādhāyā mṛtatulyā jaḍākṛtiḥ \|*  
*śaśvatpaśyati sthānasthā sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jagat \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. While sleeping or awake, during day or night in the house or in the forest on land or in water, in the sun and the moon shining in the sky, Radha became motioniess like a dead person. She was unable to distinguish anything. Lying on the ground she thought everything in the from of Vishnu.

## \|\| 69.74-77 \|\|

*snigdhapaṅke paṅkajānāṃ sajalāni dalāni ca \|*  
*nipatya tatkṛte talpe suṣvāpa virahāturā \|\| 74 \|\|*

*sevitā sā priyālībhiḥ saṃtataṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*candanadravasaṃsiktā snigdhavastrasamanvitā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*rādhāṅgasparśamātreṇa paṅkaḥ saṃprāpa śuṣkatām \|*  
*snigdhāni padmapatrāṇi babhūvurbhasmasātkṣaṇam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*candanaṃ śuṣkatāṃ prāpa varṇaścampakasaṃnibhaḥ \|*  
*babhuva kajjalākāraḥ keśasya varṇato hare \|\| 77 \|\|*

74-77. О Krishna, О well-versed in polity, you think on the matter carefully in your mind and do something by which the life of a damsel could be saved.

## \|\| 69.78-79 \|\|

*sindūrabindū ruciraḥ śyāmatāṃ prāpa tatkṣaṇam \|*  
*veṣo vilāso līlā ca krīḍā tyaktā babhūva ha \|\| 78 \|\|*

*ratnamālā tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā gatvā kṛṣṇāntikaṃ tadā \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ rādhāhitakaraṃ param \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. Collecting the petals of lotus flowers, a bed was made for her on the wet land Radha suffering from the pain of separation slept on that bed, the sandal-paste was applied on the thick garments and her female friends started serving her by moving the fly-whisks of white colour but with the touch of the limbs of Radha, the mud dried up and the leaves of the lotus flower were also bum out. О Hari, the sandal-paste was dried up and the complexion of the body was turned into the colour of black hair.

## \|\| 69.80 \|\|

*ratnamālovāca he kṛṣṇa kamalākānta tvadviyogena matsakhī \|*  
*prāṇāṃstyakṣyati śīghraṃ sā yadi nā''yāsyasi dhruvam \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. The spot of vermilion was turned into black. The costumes, the divine dance and the divine people were discarded. Ratnamala finding Radha in such a condition went to Krishna and spoke sweet words which were quite beneficial for Radha.

## \|\| 69.81 \|\|

*vicārya manasā kṛṣṇa yattatsamṛcitaṃ kuru \|*  
*na bhavetkāminīhatyā yena nītiviśārada \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Ratnamala said – О Krishna, О lord of Kamala, in separation from you, my friend would surely meet the end of her life. In case you do not arrive, she is sure to die.

## \|\| 69.82 \|\|

*ratnamālāvācaḥ śrutvā prahasyovāca mādhavaḥ \|*  
*hitaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇamasukhāvaham \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Hearing the words of Ratnamala, the lord smiled and spoke to her the words which were truthful, О gist of polity and could be quite pleasant.

## \|\| 69.83 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca īśo yadyapi śakto'haṃ niṣekaṃ khaṇḍituṃ priye \|*  
*tathā'pi na kṣamo ratne niyaternaṃ karomyaham \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Lord Krishna said – О P.atnamala, since I am the lord on to myself I am quite competent to remove the cause of her suffering but I am not competent enough to shatter the twin of the destiny.

## \|\| 69.84 \|\|
