*paurāṇikeṣu sūto'haṃ nītimatsvaṅgirā muniḥ \|*  
*viṣṇuvrataṃ vratānāṃ ca balānāṃ daivameva ca \|\| 82 \|\|*

*oṣadhīnāmahaṃ dūrvā tṛṇānāṃ kuśameva ca \|*  
*dharmakarmasu satyaṃ ca snehapātreṣu putrakaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*ahaṃ vyādhiśca śatrūṇāṃ jvaro vyādhiṣvahaṃ tathā \|*  
*madbhaktiṣvapi maddāsyaṃ vareṣu ca varaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*āśramāṇāṃ gṛhastho'haṃ saṃnyāsī ca vivekinām \|*  
*sudarśanaṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ kuśalaṃ ca śubhāśiṣām \|\| 85 \|\|*

*mi (i) ṣṭavākyaṃ prītideṣu dāneṣu cā''tmadānakam \|\| 86 \|\|*

*saṃcayeṣu dharmakarma karmaṇāṃ ca madarcanam \|*  
*kaṭhoreṣu tapaścāhaṃ phaleṣu mokṣa eva ca \|\| 87 \|\|*

*aṣṭasiddhiṣu prākāmyamahaṃ kāśīpurīṣu ca \|*

81-100. Rajashya among the yajnas, daksina among the spouses of yajna and Parashurama among those well-versed in the use of weapons who had been the son of Jamadagni. I am Suta among the composers of the Puranas, sage Angira among the those well-versed in polity, Vishnuvrata among the vratas, Daivabala among the forces, Diirva among the ausdhl, kusha among the straws, truthfulness among the religious people, the son among those who are bestowed with affection, ailment among the enemies, fever among the ailments, my slavehood of all the types of adoration which best of all and the Grhastha (household) among all the ashramas, Samnyasis among the prudent, Sudarshana among the weapons, welfare among the blessing, great knowledge among the fortunes, Vairagya (unattachment) among all the pleasures, sweet words among those which increase love, self realisation among the charities, the noble deed of all the things which are to be collected, tapas among all the hard labours, moksa among the fruits, prakamya among the siddhas, Kasi among the Purls (towns), KancI among the cities, inhabited by the Vaishnavas. I am Mahavirat among all the solid foundations. I happen to be the atom of all the tiny things in the world Asvinlkumara of all the physicians, Rasayana among the Osadhis, Dhanvantari among those well-versed in the mantras, grief among those which consume a person, Meghamallara among the Ragas and Kamoda among the beloved’s, Sridama among the courtiers, Uddhava among my relatives, cow among the animals, sandal among the forest trees, the holy places among all the tlrthas and Vaishnava among the devotees who always recite my mantras. There is no one dearer to me than my own devotees; In the trees I happen to be the sprouting leaves and I happen to be the form of all the things. I pervade in all the creatures who also dwell in me. As the fruit remains in a tree and the tree in the fruit, similarly I am the cause of everything. There is no other greater cause than myself; I am the lord of everything, I have no lord. I am myself the cause of all the deeds. This is what has been ordained by the intellectuals, the sinners are influenced by my illusion and are unaware of me because they are influenced by the destiny indulging in sinful ways and evil advice. I am the soul of all the creatures and their lord. Wherever I stay, the hunger, thirst and all other saktis remain there and when I leave that place all those also disappear as the attendants of the king disappear with the king. Therefore, О lord of Vraja, О Nanda, О father, you go to Vraja with this knowledge and impart the same to Radha and Yashoda. Thereafter Nanda the lord of Vraja together with his attendants left for Vraja and reaching there he narrated the words of Krishna to all the ladies.

## \|\| 73.101-103 \|\|

*te ca sarve jahaḥ śokaṃ mahājñānena nārada \|*  
*kṛṣṇo yadyapi nirlipto māyeśo māyayā rataḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*yaśodayā preritaśca punarāgatya mādhavam \|*  
*tuṣṭāva paramānandaṃ nandaśca nandanandanam \|\| 102 \|\|*

*sāmavedoktastotreṇa kṛtena brahmaṇā purā \|*  
*putrasya purataḥ sthitvā ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

101-103. О Narada, with the imparting of the great knowledge they also were relieved of the grief and though lord is uninvolved and the lord of illusion but still he loves someone under the influence of the illusion. Yashoda inspired Nanda who go to Mathura again. Reaching there, they eulogised all blissful Madhava by reciting the stotra composed by Brahma and prescribed in Samaveda. Both of them started crying standing before their son.

## Chapter 74

## \|\| 74.1-3 \|\|

*atha catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paramānandaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*paramātmā ca paramo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*bhuvo bhārāvataraṇo nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*parātpanastu bhagavānbrahmeśaśeṣavanditaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tuṣṭo nandastavaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*āgacchantaṃ gokulācca virahajvarakātaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narayana said – Lord Krishna who is blissful, complete in all respects the lord, the great soul, extremely devoted to his devotees, who appears on earth to rid of her burden, who is formless, beyond Prakriti, beyond all and Brahma, adored by Shiva, Shesha and is the lord of the universe, was pleased with the prayer of Nanda and spoke to him delightfully who was suffering from the pain of separation, getting upset and had arrived from Gokula.

## \|\| 74.4-7 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca gaccha nandavrajaṃ nanda tyaja śokaṃ bhramaṃ bhuvi \|*  
*śṛṇu satyaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ śokagranthinikṛntanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vāyuśca bhūmirākāśo jalaṃ tejaśca pañcamam \|*  
*uktaḥ śrutigaṇairetaiḥ pañcabhūtaiśca nityaśaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sarvaiṣāṃ dehināṃ tāta dehaśca pāñcabhautikaḥ \|*  
*mithyābhramaḥ kṛtrimaśca svapnavanmāyayā'nvitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dehaṃ gṛhṇanti sarvaiṣāṃ pañcabhūtāni nityaśaḥ \|*  
*māyāsaṃketarūpaṃ tadabhijñānaṃ bhramātmakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. Krishna said – You go to Vraja and get yourself relieved of the grief and illusion on the earth. I am speaking to you the truthful and the best of the knowledge which removes the knot of grief. Listen to me attentively, there are five mahabhutas on earth known as the wind, the earth, the sky, the water and the tejas. О father, the shrutis testify that the bodies of all the creatures on earth comprise of these five mahabhutas, that is why this7 body is called РйпсаЬЬаиИка. It comprises of false illusion, artificiality and is full of illusion like the dream. At the time of death the entire body pahcabhiita merges in them. Its indication, its form and identity are filled with illusion.

## \|\| 74.8-9 \|\|

*ko vā kasya sunastāta kā strī kasya patistu vā \|*  
*karmaṇā bhramaṇaṃ śaśvatsarveṣāṃ bhūrijanmani \|\| 8 \|\|*

*karmaṇā jāyante jantuḥ karmaṇaiva pralīyate \|*  
*sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ karmaṇā ca prapadyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Therefore, О fathers, who is the son of whom, who is the wife of whom and who is the husband of whom Jlva wanders in various forms for several births in various ways. Because the Jlva takes new birth because of his deeds and because of the karma it also merges into the great soul and it achieves pleasure, pain, fear and grief because of the past deeds. Someone is born in the heaven because of his deeds, someone is born in the house of Brahma, someone is born in the house of Brahmanas or Kshatriyas. Someone is born in the house of Vaisyas and someone is the born in the house of Shudras.

## \|\| 74.10 \|\|

*keṣāṃ vā janma svargeṣu keṣāṃ vā brahmaṇo gṛhe \|*  
*keṣāṃ vipreṣu kṣatreṣu keṣāṃ vā baiśyaśūdrayoḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Similarly, it sometimes is born in the house of some degraded person, sometimes as an insect of the refuse, sometimes as an animal or bird and sometimes as a petty creature.

## \|\| 74.11-12 \|\|

*atinīceṣu keṣāṃ vā keṣāṃ kṛmiṣu viṭsu ca \|*  
*paśupakṣiṣu keṣāṃ vā keṣāṃ vā kṣudrajantuṣu \|\| 11 \|\|*

*punaḥ punarbhramantyeva sarve tāta svakarmaṇā \|*  
*karoti karma nirmūlaṃ madbhakto matpiyaḥ sadā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Therefore, О father, all the people are born in their respective yonis again and again wandering here and there. But my devotee always remains engrossed in the uprooting of all the actions.

## \|\| 74.13-14 \|\|

*satyaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśceti caturyugam \|*  
*pañcaviṃśatsahasrāṇāṃ yugānte nidhanaṃ manoḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*manoḥ samaṃ mahendrasya paramāyurvinirmitam \|*  
*caturdaśendravicchittau brahmaṇo dinamucyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. There are four yugas known as Satya, Treta, Dvapara, Kaliyuga. Thus after the completion of twenty five thousand yugas. Manu, meets it with his end and the life of Indra has been equated with Manu, after the death of fourteen Indras continuously a day of Brahma is counted.

## \|\| 74.15-16 \|\|

*evaṃ parimitā rātriḥ kālavidbharvinirmitā \|*  
*evaṃ parimitā māsā varṣaṃ ca pariniścitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*brahmaṇaśca varṣaśataṃ paramāyurvinirmitam \|*  
*nimeṣamātraṃ kālo'yaṃ brahmaṇo nidhane mama \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. His night is of similar duration. This has been pronounced by those well-versed in the calculation of time. Thus they have the month and the year. The age of Brahma has been calculated to be hundred years and after the death of Brahma, a single moment of mine is counted.

## \|\| 74.17-18 \|\|

*brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ viśve vinirmitam \|*  
*satyo'haṃ paramātmā ca bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*manmantropāsakaḥ satyo dehaṃ tyaktvā dharāsu ca \|*  
*yāsyatyeva hi golokaṃ chitvā karma purātanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Similarly, all the things right from Brahma to the blade of grass are perishable. I alone am the trnth who take to human form to bestow grace on the great soul and the devotees. He who adores me reciting my mantra on earth, he, after death, destroying his past deeds, proceeds to Goloka.

## \|\| 74.19-20 \|\|

*asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pāte na bhavettasya pātanam \|*  
*gṛhṇati nityaṃ svaṃ dehaṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham \|\| 19 \|\|*

*na nanda mama bhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit \|*  
*nityaṃ sudarśanaṃ taṃ ca parirakṣati marvataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. He does not fall from Goloka even after the fall of innumerable BrahmSs, he achieves the eternal body which is devoid of death. О Nanda, my devotees never meet with any misfortune at any time. Apart from that my Sudarshana-cakra always protects them.

## \|\| 74.21-24 \|\|

*matto hi balavānbhaktaścintito'haṃ na cintitaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ svāmī ca tasyaiva na me svāmī pitā prasūḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*putrabuddhiṃ parityajya bhaja māṃ brahmarūpiṇam \|*  
*chittavā ca brahmanigaḍaṃ golokaṃ tadvraja svayam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kathayasva yaśodāṃ ca gopīṃ gopagaṇāṃ vraja \|*  
*taiśca sarvairjanaiḥ śokaṃ tyaja svamandiraṃ vraja \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ityevamuktvā bhagavānvirarāma ca saṃsadi \|*  
*papraccha punarevaṃ taṃ nandaścā''nandasaṃplutaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. Therefore my devotee is more powerful than myself, but still I remain anxious; for him being a lord, I don't have any lord, father or mother therefore instead of taking me as your son, you adore me as a complete Brahma as a result of which you will be relieved of the fetters of karmas and shall proceed to Goloka. О lord of Vraja, the cowherdess Yashoda, the group of cowherds should be told about the reality and leaving aside the grief, you go back to your house. After thus speaking in the assembly lord Krishna kept quiet; thereafter, Nanda getting overwhelmed with bliss asked him.

## \|\| 74.25-26 \|\|

*nanda uvāca vada sāṃsārikaṃ jñānaṃ yena yāsyāmi tvatpadam \|*  
*mūḍho'haṃ paramānanda śrutīnāṃ janako bhavān \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nandasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sarvajño bhagavānsvayam \|*  
*āhnikaṃ kathayāyāsa śrutibhirna śrutaṃ hi yat \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Nanda said – О blissful one, you bestow worldly knowledge on me by means of which I should be able to achieve your loka. Because I am quite devoid of wisdom and you happen to be the creator of the Vedas. On hearing the words of Nanda, the all-knowledgeable lord Krishna enlightened him on the daily routine as prescribed in the Vedas.

## Chapter 75

## \|\| 75.1 \|\|

*atha pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu nanda pravakṣyāmi jñānaṃ ca paramādbhutam \|*  
*sugopanīyaṃ vedeṣu purāṇeṣu ca durlabham \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The lord said – О Nanda, I am bestowing on you the astonishing knowledge which is quite secretive in the Vedas and the Puranas and is quite difficult to get. You listen to it quite attentively.

## \|\| 75.2 \|\|

*na viśvāso hi nārīṣu saṃtataṃ kulaṭāsu ca \|*  
*mokṣamārgārgalāsveva bhramamāyāsvamūṣu ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. One should not believe in the wicked women because they are the biggest obstruction in the path of achieving moksa; they are filled with illusion.

## \|\| 75.3-6 \|\|

*haribhakterasādhvīnāṃ viruddhāsu yutāsu ca \|*  
*bījarūpāsu nāśānāṃ pramadāsu vrajeśvara \|\| 3 \|\|*

*nityaṃ ca prātarutthāya rātrivāso vihāya ca \|*  
*abhīṣṭadevaṃ hṛtpadme brahmarandhre gṛruṃ param \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vicintya manasā prātaḥkṛtyaṃ kṛtvā suniścitam \|*  
*snānaṃ karoti suprājño nirmaleṣu jaleṣu ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*na saṃkalpaṃ ca kurute bhaktaḥ karmanikṛntanaḥ \|*  
*snātvā hariṃ smaretsaṃdhyāṃ kṛtvā yāti gṛhaṃ prati \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. О lord of Vraja, because of being characterless, they are always against the devotees of the lord and they serve as the seeds of destruction. A person should get up early in the morning and change the clothes worm by him during the night. He should meditate upon his sole lord in the lotus of his heart and should meditate upon his teacher in his mind and perform all the duties in the morning. Such a wise person should take a bath with clean water and while taking a bath, should not perform Samkalpa because the devotees are more interested in the destruction of the karmas and are not interested in enjoying their result. After taking a bath, he should recite the name of the lord and performing samthyd he should go back to his home.

## \|\| 75.7-10 \|\|

*prakṣālya pādau praviśennidhāya dhautavāsasī \|*  
*pūjayotparamātmānaṃ māmeva muktikāraṇam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śālagrāme maṇau yantre pratimāyāṃ jale'pi ca \|*  
*tathā ca vipre gavi ca guruṣvevaṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ghaṭi'ṣṭadalapadme ca pātre candananirmite \|*  
*āvāhanaṃ ca sarvatra śālagrāme jalena ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

*mantrānurūpadhyānena dhyātvā māṃ pūjayedvratī \|*  
*ṣoḍaśopacāradravyāṇi dadyānmūlena bhaktitaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Reaching there he should wash his feet and then enter the house and clad himself in sanctified garments. He should then perform puja for the lord. He should perform puja for Shalagrama, gems, yantras, images, water, Brahmana and cow and more specially for the teacher, then kalasha, the lotus with eight petals, ? vase with sandal-paste but I should be invoked only in Shalagrama stone and the water. Such a devotee should meditate upon me by reciting the appropriate mantra and then adore me. He should with great devotion recite the mula-mantra and make the offering of sixteen types.

## \|\| 75.11-14 \|\|

*śrīdāmānaṃ mudāmānaṃ vasudāmānameva ca \|*  
*vīrabhānuṃ śūrabhānuṃ gopānpañca prapūjayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sunandanandakumudaṃ pārṣadaṃ me sudarśanam \|*  
*lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ durgāṃ rādhāṃ gaṅgāṃ vasuṃdharām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*guruṃ ca tulasīṃ śaṃbhuṃ kārtikeyaṃ vināyakam \|*  
*navagrahāṃśca dikpālānparitaḥ pūjayetsudhīḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*devaṣaṭkaṃ ca saṃpūjya sarvādau vighnavighnataḥ \|*  
*gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivam \|\| 14 \|\|*

11-14. He should also adore Sridama, Sudama, Vasudama, Virabhanu and Surabhanu, the five cowherds and then should adore my courtiers named, Nanda, Sunanda, Kumuda and Sudarsana besides Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Durga, Radha, Ganga, Vasundhara, the teacher, Tulasi, Shiva, Karttikeya, Ganesha, the nine planets, Dikpalas, in a proper manner. It would be appropriate for an intellectual to adore first of all, Ganesha, Stirya, Agni, Shiva and Parvati.

## \|\| 75.15-20 \|\|

*śrutau vinirmitāndevānmokṣadānkarmakṛntanān \|*  
*gaṇeśaṃ vighnanāśāya sūryaṃ vyādhivināśine \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vahniṃ prāptinimittena śāntau śuddhau bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*viṣṇuṃ mokṣanimittena jñānadānāya śaṃkaram \|\| 16 \|\|*

*buddhimuktinimittena pārvatīṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ dattvā svastotraṃ kavacaṃ paṭhet \|\| 17 \|\|*

*guruṃ praṇamya saṃpūjya tatpaścātpraṇametsuram \|*  
*kṛtvā''hrikaṃ ca saṃpūjya yathāsukhamudīritam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*samācaretsvakarmaitadvedoktaṃ svātmaśuddhaye \|*  
*viṣṭhāṃ na paśyetprājñaśca vyādhibījasvarūpiṇīm \|\| 19 \|\|*

*mūtraṃ ca vyādhibījaṃ ca paraṃ narakakāraṇam \|*  
*liṅgaṃyoniṃ pāpaduḥkhavyādhidāridryadāyinīm \|\| 20 \|\|*

15-20. In the Vedas these gods have been described as the destroyer of the deeds and bestower of moksa. For the removal of obstruction, Ganesha should be adored; for the removal of the ailments the sun and Agni; for achieving peace and purity, Vishnu; Shiva for achieving moksa, knowledge and wisdom and Parvati for achieving wisdom. After adoring them, one should offer three hand cups full of flowers and should recite the relevant stotra and kavacha. Bowing in reverence to the teacher and adoring him, one should offer his salutation to the gods. Thus after performing the daily routine, one should adore the gods according to one's convenience. For self-purification, one should perform the adoration as prescribed in the Vedas. Similarly one should pay attention to the words which are forbidden, should not look at refuse which could be the cause of ailments. Looking at urine also one attracts ailment and one has to fall into the hell.

## \|\| 75.21-24 \|\|

*uruṃ mukhaṃ stanaṃ strīṇāṃ kaṭākṣaṃ hāsyameva ca \|*  
*vināśabījaṃ rūpaṃ ca vipadāṃ kāraṇaṃ sadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*divābhogaṃ ca svastrīṇāṃ svālāpaṃ parivarjayet \|*  
*rogāṇo kāraṇaṃ caiva cakṣuṣoḥ karṇayostathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*ekatāraṃ ca gaganaṃ na paśyettu rujāṃ bhayāt \|*  
*daivāddṛṣṭvā hariṃ smṛtvā saptadhā nāradaṃ japet \|\| 23 \|\|*

*astakāle raviṃ candraṃ na paśyed vyādhikāraṇam \|*  
*khaṇḍaṃ masuditaṃ candraṃ na paśyed vyādhikāraṇam \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. One should not look at the thighs, heart, breasts, side-glances and smiles of the other women because indulging in such an action attracts misfortune. One should not cohabit with his own wife during the day time because it is harmful and one attracts the ailment of eyes and ears. Similarly a star should not be looked at in the sky which could result in ailment and fear. It per chance one has a look at the stars he should recite the name of Hari and also the name of Narada seven times. In the evening the sun and the moon should not be seen because by doing so one attracts ailment and fear. At the time of the rising of the moon if one looks at it, one attracts ailments.

## \|\| 75.25-28 \|\|

*jalasthaṃ ca raviṃ candraṃ dṛṣṭvā śokaṃ labhennaraḥ \|*  
*bandhuvicchedahetuṃ ca na paśyetparamaithunam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ekatra śayanaṃ sthānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca gatiṃ tathā \|*  
*na kuryātpāpinā sārdhaṃ sarvaṃ nāśasya lakṣaṇam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ālāpādgātrasaṃsparśācchayanāśrayabhojanāt \|*  
*saṃcaranti dhruvaṃ pāpāstailavindurivāmbhasā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*hiṃsrajantusamīpaṃ ca na gacchedduḥkhakāraṇam \|*  
*khalena sārdha milanaṃ na kuryācchokakāraṇam \|\| 28 \|\|*

25-28. Similarly if one looks at the reflection of the sun and moon in the water, he meets with grief. By looking at the conjugal pleasures of others one gets separated from his relatives; by sleeping, eating and travelling with a wicked person, one attracts complete destruction. By talking to him, touching his body, sleeping with him or eating with him, all his sins are transferred to the noble person. One should not approach the terrific animal for fear of injury. And one should not keep company with a wicked person which could attract grief and fear.

## \|\| 75.29-42 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*na kuryāddhiṃsanaṃ hāniṃ sarvanāśasya kāraṇam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*devadevalaviprāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*vittaṃ dhanaṃ ca naharetsarvanāśasya kāraṇam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*svadattaṃ paradattaṃ vā brahmavittaṃ harettu yaḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ \|*  
*śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni gaṇḍakaḥ saptajanmani \|\| 32 \|\|*

*ghoṭakaḥ saptajanmāni kumbhīraḥ pañcajanmasu \|*  
*puṃścalīnāṃ yonikīṭaṃ śatajanmasu niścitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*vraṇakīṭaṃ ca teṣāṃ śatajanmasu nārada \|*  
*godhikā saptajanmāni gardabhaḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 34 \|\|*

*saptajanmāni mārjāro nakulaśtreṣu janmasu \|*  
*uccaiḥśravā janmaśataṃ kharaścāpi tathaiva ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*krūrasarpaśca śārdūlo mahiṣaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*bhekaśca śatajanmāni cchāgalaḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 36 \|\|*

*bhallūkaḥ śatajanmāni śṛgālo lakṣajanmasu \|*  
*tato jalaukā bhavati brahmasvaharaṇāddhruvam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kumbhīpāke ca pacyante pāpino brahmaṇaḥ śatam \|*  
*dakṣiṇāṃ vipramuddiśya tatkālaṃ cainna dīyate \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ekarātre vyatīte tu taddānaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*māse śataguṇaṃ proktaṃ dvimāse tu sahasrakam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*saṃvatsare vyatīte tu sa dātā narakaṃ vrajet \|*  
*dātrā na dīyate mūrkho grahītā ca na yācate \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ubhau tau narakaṃ yāto dātā vyādhiyuto bhavet \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ hisanaṃ kṛtvā vaṃśahāniṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*dhanaṃ lakṣmīṃ parityajya bhikṣukaśca bhavedvrajan \|*  
*devaṃ ca brahmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā na namedyo labhecchucam \|\| 42 \|\|*

29-42. One should not indulge in the killing of a cow, a Brahmana and especially a Brahmana which attracts total destruction. One should not steal the riches of the gods, the temples, Brahmanas and the Vaishnavas. By doing so, one attracts total destruction. The one who snatches away the livelihood given by himself or others and one who does so, has to be born as the insect of refuse for sixty thousand years. Thereafter for a hundred crores of births, he has to born as a pig; for a hundred years, he has to be born as a wild animal; for seven births, he has to be born as a Rhinoceros and horse; for seven births, he is to be born as a deformed person, for births the insect of the pelvic region of the wicked woman for a hundred births and for another hundred births he has to be born as an insect of a boil. О Narada, for seven births he has to be born as a lizard, a donkey for seven births, a cat for seven births, a monkey for three births, a horse for a hundred years, a terrific serpent for seven births, a tiger and buffalo for seven births, a frog for a hundred births, a he-goat for seven births, a bear for seven births, a jackal for a lakh of births. Thereafter because of the stealing of those riches he becomes a leech. For a hundred lives of Brahma he has to fall into the kumbhipaka hell where the sinners are boiled. The one who refuses to give immediately the daksind to a Brahmana after pronouncing the same, the charity after the lapse of a night is doubled and after the expiry of a month it multiplies to a hundred times after a lapse of two months, it multiplies to a thousand times and after the expiry of a year, the donor has to fall into the hell. In case the donor is unable to pay and the receiver is unable to demand the same, both of them fall into hell. By killing a Brahmana, the race of the killer is destroyed and after getting deprived of the wealth and riches he becomes a pauper or a beggar. He feels grief-stricken when no one offers salutation to him in spite of his being a Brahmana or a god.

## \|\| 75.43-50 \|\|

*na kuryādgurubhaktiṃ yo labhate rauravaṃ śucam \|*  
*ya strī mūḍhā durācārā svapatiṃ harirūpiṇam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*na paśyettarjanaṃ kṛtvā kumbhīpāke vrajeddhruvam \|*  
*vāktarjanādbhavetkāko hiṃsanātsūkaro bhavet \|\| 44 \|\|*

*sarpo bhavati kopaina darpeṇa gardabho bhavet \|*  
*kukkurī ca kuvākyenāpyandhaśca viṣadarśanāt \|\| 45 \|\|*

*pativratā ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ patyā saha vrajeddhruvam \|*  
*śivaṃ durgāṃ gaṇapatiṃ sūrya vipraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*viṣṇuṃ nindati yo mūḍhaḥ sa mahārauravaṃ vrajet \|*  
*pitaraṃ mātaraṃ putraṃ satīṃ bhāryāṃ guruṃ tathā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*anāthāṃ bhaginīṃ kanyāṃ vinindya narakaṃ vrajet \|*  
*viprabhaktivihīnāśca kṣatraviṭśūdrayonijā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*haribhaktivihīnāśca pacyante narame dhruvam \|*  
*patibhaktivihīnāśca yuvatyaśca narādhamāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*śālagrāmajalaṃ viṣṇuprasādaṃ ye ca bhuñjate \|*  
*tīrya punanti te viprāḥ śataṃ puṃsāṃ vasuṃdharām \|\| 50 \|\|*

43-50. The one who does not adore the teacher, has to fall into the terrific hell, the wicked woman or a foolish woman who disregarding her husband resembling Hari and neglects him besides denouncing him, she has to fall into the kumbhipaka hell. If one denounces her husband by evil words she has to be born a crow and if one resorts to physical violence against her husband, she has to be born as a pig by becoming angry, she has to be born as a snake. The one who becomes arrogant has to be born as a donkey and the one who speaks evil words has to be born as a bitch. If one makes others to consume poison he has to be born as a blind person. The chaste woman surely accompanies her husband to Vaikuntha. Such of the foolish people as denounce Shiva, Durga, Ganesha, Surya, Brahmana, Vaishnava and Vishnu have to fall into a terrific hell. Similarly, he who disowns his parents, the son, the chaste wife, the teacher, shelterless sister and daughter, surely falls into the hell. The Kshatriya who is not devoted to the Brahmana or lord Hari besides Vaishya and Shudras, surely proceed to the hell. Such of the damsels, as are not devoted to their husband are considered to be extremely degraded. Such of the Brahmana as consume the water of Shalagrama and the prasada of lord Vishnu, even the holy places get purified with their arrival and they also purify hundred future and previous generations besides the earth.

## \|\| 75.51-54 \|\|

*pitṛndevānsamamyarcya khādanmāsaṃ dvijaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*yo bhakṣati vṛthā māṃsaṃ sa mahārauravaṃ vrajet \|\| 51 \|\|*

*matsyāṃśca kāmato jagdhvā copavāsaṃ vaseddvijaḥ \|*  
*prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuryādvrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret \|\| 52 \|\|*

*kāmato brāhmaṇo matsyaṃ bhuṅkte yo jñānadurbalaḥ \|*  
*so'śuciḥ satataṃ nanda hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*viṣṇorucciṣṭabhojī yo matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ na khādati \|*  
*pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate niścitaṃ phalam \|\| 54 \|\|*

51-54. After adoring the gods and the manes, if a Brahmana eats meat once, he is till considered to be pure, but the one who always consumes meat he falls into the terrific hell. If a Brahmana fries a fish for selfish purposes be has to observe fast and thereafter perform repentance by observing Chandrayana-vrata. О Nanda, such of the Brahmana who observing fish, having been deprived of the knowledge, he also becomes impure and destroys his merit. Such of the Brahmana who consumes the left over of Vishnu and does not consume fish or meat, he is surely achieves the merit of Asvamedha sacrifice for every step he walk on earth.

## \|\| 75.55-58 \|\|

*ekādaśīṃ ye kurvanti kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvratam \|*  
*śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*yadbālaye yacca kaumāre vārdhake yacca yauvane \|*  
*bhasmībhūtāni kurvanti pātakāni kṛtāni ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

*ekādaśīdine bhuṅkte kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvrate \|*  
*trailokyajanitaṃ pāpaṃ so'pi bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*āture niyamo na syādapi vṛddhe ca bālake \|*  
*bhaktasya dviguṇaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya śucirbhavet \|\| 58 \|\|*

55-58. Such of the people who perform vrata on Ekadasi day and on the day of the birth of lord Krishna they are relieved of the sins committed by them for hundred years. There is no doubt about it. All the sins committed by them during childhood, boyhood, old age and when young, are destroyed. The one who takes food on the Ekadasi day and on the birthday of lord Krishna consumes the sins of the three worlds. There is no doubt about it. This rule is not applicable to the infirm, old and children. They can be purified after giving double the food they consume.

## \|\| 75.59-70 \|\|

*yo bhuṅkte śivarātrau ca śrīrāmanavamīdine \|*  
*upavāse samarthaśca sa mahārauravaṃ vrajet \|\| 59 \|\|*

*kuhūpūrṇendusaṃkrānticaturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca \|*  
*naraścāṇḍālayoniḥ syātstrītailamāṃsasevanāt \|\| 60 \|\|*

*matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūraṃ ca kāṃsyapātre ca bhojanam \|*  
*ārdrakaṃ raktaśākaṃ ca ravau ca parivarjayet \|\| 61 \|\|*

*anyathā narakaṃ yāti kumbhīpākaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*rajasvarānnaṃ veśyānnaṃ madirānnaṃ vrajeśvara \|\| 62 \|\|*

*yo bhuṅkte brāṅmaṇo daivādviḍbhojī sa bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet \|\| 63 \|\|*

*sa bhavedaśucirnityaṃ bhasmāntaṃ tasya sūtakam \|*  
*nārī veśyā pratijñeyā catuṣpuruṣagāminī \|\| 64 \|\|*

*pāke ca pitṛdevānāmadhikāro na tadbhavet \|*  
*yadgrāmayājināmannaṃ śūdraśrāddhānnabhojanam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*bhuktvā ca narakaṃ yāti yāvaccandradivākarau \|*  
*śūdrāṇāṃ śrāddhadivase tadannaṃ bhuñjate ddhijāḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*kumbhīpāke ca pacyante yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam \|*  
*yaḥ śūdreṇābhyanujñāto bhuṅkte śrāddhadine'nyataḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*surāpīti sa vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ \|*  
*asijīvī maṣījīvī devalo vṛṣavāhakaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca yo hi śūdrāpatiddhijaḥ \|*  
*sa śūdravadvahiṣkāryastadannaṃ viṭsamaṃ satām \|\| 69 \|\|*

*nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yastu paścimām \|*  
*sa śūdravadbahiṣkāryaḥ savaṃsmāddvijakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

59-70. In case someone who is competent to observe a fast on Shivaratri and Ramanavami day, but takes his food, he falls into the terrific hell. The one who cohabits with his wife on a moonless night or on a full moon night, first day of the month, on the fourteenth and eighth day of the moon and also consumes oil and meat, he is surely born as a Chandala. One should not eat the fish, meat, small grained pulse in a vase of bronze; ginger and the red vegetables should not be taken on Sundays otherwise one has to fall in the kumbhlpaka hell. There is no doubt about it. О lord of Vraja, the food served by a woman in period, the food of a loose woman and the food mixed with wine, in case it is consumed by a Brahmana, he surely consumes refuse. Whatever deeds are performed by him during the day, he is deprived of the reward for 'the same and he always remains impure. He is deprived of the impurity only when his body is burnt in fire. Such of woman who enjoys the company of four men has to be treated as a whore; she is not entitled to receive any share cooked for gods and the manes. The one who performs yajna from village to village and food during the sraddha performed by Shudras have to fall in the hell till the life of the sun and the moon. Such of the Brahamans who take srdddha food with the Shudras they have to fall in the kumbhlpaka hell up to the life of with some one else at the instance of a Shudra, he should be considered as a drunkard and should be excommunicated from performing seven religious deeds. Similarly the soldiers, the writers, those performing puja in the temples, earning their livelihood from the bullocks, burning the dead bodies of the Shudras, the Brahmana who is the husband of a Shudra woman should also be excommunicated because the food of such a person is like refuse for the noble people. Similarly the one who does not perform sandhya during the morning or the evening and neglects all the Brahmana practices should be excommunicated like a Shudra.

## \|\| 75.71-74 \|\|

*saṃdhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*yadahnākurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet \|\| 71 \|\|*

*vāmamantropāsakaśca brāhmāṇo narakaṃ vrajet \|*  
*nadīgarbhe ca garte ca dṛkṣamūle jalāntike \|\| 72 \|\|*

*devāntike sasyabhūmau purīṣaṃ notsṛjedbudhaḥ \|*  
*valmīkamūṣakotkhātāṃ mṛdamantarjalāṃ tathā \|\| 73 \|\|*

*śaucāvaśiṣṭāṃ gehācca nā''dadyāllepasaṃbhavām \|*  
*antaḥprāṇipipīlyāṃ ca halotkhātāṃ vrajeśvara \|\| 74 \|\|*

71-74. The one who does not perform sandhya such a Brahmana is always considered to be impure and unfit for all the religious performances. Because of this, whatever actions are performed by him, he is deprived of the reward. The Vamamargt Brahmana falling into hell surely has to face pain. The Intellectuals could not drop refuse at the places like the starting point of a river, the pits at the root of trees, near water, near god and green crops. О lord of Vraja, one should not rub his hand for purification with the dust from a heap of white ants, the earth dug by rats, the earth inside water and the earth with remnant from the one already used for washing the hands, the earth from the mud meant for plastering the walls of the houses. The earth from the place of white ants, the plough land is not fit for use in purifying the hands because by rubbing the hands with dust, the hands cannot be purified.

## \|\| 75.75-84 \|\|

*ālavālotthitāṃ caiva sasyakṣetrotthitāṃ tathā \|*  
*vṛkṣamūlotthitāṃ nanda nadīgarbhotthitāṃ tathā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*parityajenmṛdastvetāḥ sakalāḥ śaucasādhane \|*  
*kūṣmāṇḍaghātikā yā strī dīvanirvāṇakaḥ pumān \|\| 76 \|\|*

*saptajanma bhavedrogī daridro janmajanmani \|*  
*pradīpaṃ śivaliṅgaṃca śālagrāmaṃ maṇiṃtathā \|\| 77 \|\|*

*pratimāṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca suvarṇa śaṅkhameva ca \|*  
*hīrakaṃ ca tathā muktāṃ gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ ghṛtam \|\| 78 \|\|*

*śālagrāmaśilātoyaṃ bhūmau tyaktvā vrajedadhaḥ \|*  
*daridraḥ kṛpaṇaḥ kuṣṭhī vaṃśahīno'pyabhāryakaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*bhūmihīnaḥ prajāhīno bandhuhīnaśca kutsitaḥ \|*  
*andhaḥ paṅgurvā kharvaśca khañjaścaivāṅgahīnakaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*bhavetkameṇa pāpī sa hyetānbhūmau tyajetu yaḥ \|*  
*divase saṃdhyayornidrāṃ strīsaṃbhogaṃ karoti yaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*saptajanma bhavedrogī daridraḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*udite jagatīnāthe yaḥ kuryāddantadhāvanam \|\| 82 \|\|*

*sa pāpiṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ brūte pūjayāmi janārdanam \|*  
*mṛdbhasmagosakṛtviṇḍaistathā bālukayā'pi vā \|\| 83 \|\|*

*kṛtvā liṅkaṃ sakṛtpūjaya vasetkalpaśataṃ divi \|*  
*sahasrapūjanātso'pi labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam \|\| 84 \|\|*

75-84. О Nanda, similarly the earth from around the trees, green crops, the earth dug from under the tree or taken out of the water of the river are unfit for purification. Similarly the one who cuts the melon and the orie who extinguishes the lamp, has to be born with ailment and is always born a pauper. The one who places a lamp, Shivalinga, Shalagrama, gems, image of the gods, yajnopavita, the gold, samkha jewels, diamonds, urine of the cow, cowdung, ghee, the water of the Shalagrama, on the ground has to fall in the hell. Ultimately he is born as a pauper, miser, suffering from leprosy, having no issues, without land, without a wife, without the people, without relatives, a degraded one, blind, hunchback, lame, without feet and is born as deformed. The one who sleeps during the time of performing sandhya, thrice a day and cohabits with his wife, has to face the ailment for seven births together with poverty. When someone brushes his teeth, sunrise who is the lord of the universe, such a sinner can say that I am performing the adoration of lord Janardana. In case one adores Shiva by making a Shivalinga in earth, ashes, cowdung or sand, even once he resides in the heaven for a hundred kalpas. In case, one adores a thousand Shivalingas, all his desires are fulfilled.

## \|\| 75.85-98 \|\|

*lakṣaṃ ca pūjayedyastu śivatvaṃ labhate dhruvam \|*  
*jīvanmukto bhavedvipro liṅgamabhyarcayetu yaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*śivapūjāvihīnaśca brāhmaṇo narakaṃ vrajet \|*  
*matpūjitaṃ priyatamaṃ śivaṃ nindanti ye narāḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*pacyante niraye tāvadyāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam \|*  
*pūjite śivaliṅge ca yadi syātkeśavālukā \|\| 87 \|\|*

*sa mahāndho vālukayā keśena yavano bhavet \|*  
*kṣudro daridraḥ kṛpaṇo vyādhiḥ syātkutsite yathā \|\| 88 \|\|*

*sarvebhyo mānahāniḥ syājjāyate nīcayoniṣu \|*  
*sarveṣu priyapātreṣu brahmaṇaśca mama priyaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*brahmaṇācca priyā lakṣmīḥ satataṃ vakṣasi sthitā \|*  
*tato'dhikā priyā rādhā priyā bhaktāstato'dhikāḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*tato'dhikaḥ śaṃkaro me nāsti me śaṃkarātpriyaḥ \|*  
*mahādeva mahādeva mahādeveti vādiraḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

*paścādyāmi ca saṃtṛpto nāmaśravaṇalobhataḥ \|*  
*mano me bhaktamūle ca prāṇā rādhātmakā dhruvam \|\| 92 \|\|*

*ātmā me śaṃkarasthānaṃ śivaḥ prāṇādhikaśca yaḥ \|*  
*ādyā nārāyaṇī śaktiḥ sṛṣṭisthityantakāniṇī \|\| 93 \|\|*

*kanomi ca yathā sṛṣṭiṃ yayā brahmādidevatāḥ \|*  
*yayā jayati viśvaṃ ca yayā sṛṣṭiḥprajāyate \|\| 94 \|\|*

*yayā vinā jagannāśti mayā dattā śivāya sā \|*  
*dayā nidrā ca kṣuttṛptistṛṣṇa śraddhā kṣamā dhṛtiḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭistathā śāntirlajjādhidevatā hi sā \|*  
*vaisuṇṭhe sā mahālakṣmīrgoloke rādhikā satī \|\| 96 \|\|*

*martye lakṣmīśca kṣīrode dakṣakanyā satī ya sā \|*  
*sā durgā menakākanyā daityadurgatināśinī \|\| 97 \|\|*

*svargalakṣmīśca durgā sā śakrādīnāṃ gṛhe gṛhe \|*  
*sā vāṇī sā ca sāvitrī vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|\| 98 \|\|*

85-98. By adoring a lakh of Shivalingas one achieves the position of Shiva. Thus a Brahmana who adores Shivalinga, is deprived of the future birth. A Brahmana who does not adore Shiva, he is sure to fall in the hell. Such of the people who denounce me for adoring Shiva, they fall in the hell and remain there up to the life of a hundred Brahmas. In case at the time of adoration, sand is found with the Shivalinga in that case the devotee becomes blind and in case of any hair having been found there with the Shivalinga, the devotee is born as Yavana besides being degraded, as a pauper, miser and suffering from horrible ailment. He has to face great losses and is reborn in degraded yonis. Of all the people in the universe, Brahmanas are dear to me. Lakshmi is dearer to me than the Brahmanas who always reside in my heart. Radha is dearer to me than Lakshmi and my devotees are dearer to me than Radha and Shiva happens to be the dearest of all. No one else is dearer to me than Shiva because whosoever recites the name of Mahadeva, while walking I at once follow him. My mind is always devoted towards the devotees. Radha happens to be my life while Shiva happens to be my soul, who is dearer to me than my life. I create the universe through NarayanI, the eternal force, who preserves the universe as well and is also responsible for its destruction. The gods like Brahma and others are born out of her. With her influence the entire universe is victorious, she starts creation and without her the universe cannot survive. She is the form of mercy, sleep, nectar, satisfaction, lust, faith, forgiveness, patience, maintenance, peace and shyness. She happens to be Maha-Lakshmi in Vaikuntha, the chaste Radhika in Goloka, Lakshmi in the ocean of milk and Sati, the daughter of Daksha, she is also known as Durga who destroys misfortune, Parvati the daughter of Menaka, SvaragLakshmi in the house of Indra beside Sarasvati, Savitri and the great goddess of knowledge with Brahma.

## \|\| 75.99-100 \|\|

*vahnau sa dāhikāśaktiḥ prabhāśaktiśca bhāskare \|*  
*śobhāśaktiḥ pūrṇacandre jale śaktiśca śītatā \|\| 99 \|\|*

*sasyaprasūtā śaktiśca dhāraṇā ca dharāsu sā \|*  
*brāhmaṇyaśaktirvipreṣu devaśaktiḥsureṣu sā \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. She happens to be the power of burning with Agni, the lustre of Surya, the rays of the moon, the coolness of water, the producer of greenery and cereals and the divine sakti of the gods.

## \|\| 75.101-104 \|\|

*tapasvināṃ tapasyā kā gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhadevatā \|*  
*muktiśaktiśca muktānāmāśā sāṃsārikasya sā \|\| 101 \|\|*

*madbhaktānāṃ bhaktiśaktirmayi bhaktipradā sadā \|*  
*nṛpāṇāṃ rājyalakṣmīśca vaṇijāṃ labhyarūpiṇī \|\| 102 \|\|*

*pari saṃsārasindhūnāṃ trayītattvā tu tāriṇī \|*  
*satsu sadbuddhirūpā sā medhāśaktisvarūpiṇī \|\| 103 \|\|*

*vyākhyāśaktiḥ śrutau śāstre dātṛśaktiśca dātṛṣu \|*  
*kṣattrādīnāṃ viprabhaktiḥ patibhaktiḥ satīsu ca \|\| 104 \|\|*

101-104. She is the tapas of the mendicant, the family deity of the house-holders, the salvation for those seeking salvation, the hope for the worldly people, the devotion for my devotees and she always remains alive and devoted to me. She happens to be the RajyaLakshmi of the kings, the income of the Vaisyas and the three-fold force which enables the people to cross over the ocean of the universe. She is the intelligence of the wise people, the commentary on the Vedas and other scriptures, the power of giving charity with the donors for Brahmanas with the Kshatriyas and with the chaste woman she is the form of devotion for husband. I have handed over this type of NarayanI to Shiva. I have thus explained to you everything; what more do you want to listen to from me? You tell me. I will surely reveal the truth to you.

## Chapter 76

## \|\| 76.1 \|\|

*atha ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca yeṣāṃ ca darśane puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ yasya ca darśane \|*  
*tatsarva vada sarveśa śrotuṃ kautūharaṃ mama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Nanda said – О supreme lord you tell me the things by looking at which one earns merits and those by looking at which one earns sins. I am quite anxious to know about them.

## \|\| 76.2 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca subrāhmaṇānāṃ tīrthānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca darśane \|*  
*devatāpratimādarśī tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Krishna said – The best of Brahmanas, the holy places, the images of Vishnu and other gods are quite appropriate for looking at and by doing so one earns the merit of taking a bath at a holy place.

## \|\| 76.3-10 \|\|

*sūryasya darśane bhaktyā matīnāṃ darśane tathāḥ \|*  
*saṃnyāsināṃ yatīnāṃ ca tathaiva brahmacāriṇām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhaktyā gavāṃ ca vahnīnāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*gajendrāṇāṃ ca siṃhānāṃ śvetāśvānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śukānāṃ ca pikānāṃ ca khañjanānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*haṃsānāṃ ca mayūrāṇāṃ cāṣāṇāṃ śaṅkhapakṣiṇām \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vatsaprayuktadhenūnāsaśvatthānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*patiputravatīnāṃ ca narāṇāṃ tīnthayāyinām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pradīpānāṃ suvarṇānāṃ maṇīnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*ṇuktānāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ ca māṇikyānāṃ mahāśaya \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tulasīśuklapuṣpāṇāṃ darśanaṃ pāpanāśam \|*  
*phalāni śukladhānyāni ghṛtaṃ dadhi madhūni ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca lājāṃśca rājendraṃ darpaṇaṃ jalam \|*  
*mālāṃ ca śuklapuṣpāṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*gorocanaṃ ca karpūraṃ rajataṃ ca sarovaram \|*  
*puṣpodyānaṃ puṣpitāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā puṣyaṃo \|\| 10 \|\|*

3-10. Similarly, the sight of Surya with devotion, chaste woman, a mendicant, a yogi, a Brahmacari, a cow, a fire, a teacher, an elephant, a lion, a white horse, a parrot, a cuckoo, a wagtail bird, a goose, a peacock, a Nllkantha, a Sankha bird, a cow with a calf, a plpala tree, a woman whose son and husband are alive, a traveller going to the holy places, a lamp, a gold, a gem, a jewel, a diamond, a ruby, a Tulasi and a white flower remove the sins. О great king, one earns merit by looking at a flute, white paddy, ghee, curd, honey, a pitcher filled with water, paddy, a mirror, water, a garland and white flowers. A person also earns merit by looking at gorocana, camphor, silver, pools and an orchard with blossoming flowers.

## \|\| 76.11-12 \|\|

*śuklapakṣasya candraṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ candanaṃ tathā \|*  
*kastūrīṃ kuṅkumaṃ dṛṣṭvā nanda puṇyaṃ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*patākāmakṣayavaṭaṃ taruṃ devotthitaṃ śubham \|*  
*devālayaṃ devakhātaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃo \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. О Nanda, a person also attains merit by looking at the moon of the bright fortnight, nectar sandal-paste, kasturi and saffron beside the banner, the banyan tree, auspicious abode of the gods, temple of the gods and the caves.

## \|\| 76.13-14 \|\|

*devākṣitāṃ devadyaṭaṃ sugandhipavanaṃ tathā \|*  
*śaṅkhaṃ ca duṃdubhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ puṇyaṃo \|\| 13 \|\|*

*śukiṃta pravālaṃ rajataṃ sphaṭikaṃ kuśamūlakam \|*  
*gaṅgāmṛdaṃ kuśaṃ tāmraṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃo \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. And the sight of the divine kalasa in a temple, inhaling fragrant breeze, blowing of the shamkha and the beating of drums also bestow merit on the people. In case one looks at sakti, gem, silver, crystal, kushamUla, earth of Ganga, kusha grass and copper, he surely achieves merit.

## \|\| 76.15-16 \|\|

*purāṇapustakaṃ śuddhaṃ sabījaṃ viṣṇuyantrakam \|*  
*snigdhadūrvākṣate ratnaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃo \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tapasvināṃ siddhamantraṃ masudraṃ kṛṣṇasārakam \|*  
*yajñaṃ mahotsavaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa puṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. One earns great merit by looking at the spotless book of the PUranas, Vishnu-mantra with seed, dUrva-grass and an unbroken gem. One earns merit also with the reciting of siddha-mantra of the tapasvis, the buck and the festivities ofyajna.

## \|\| 76.17-20 \|\|

*gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ dugdhaṃ godhūliṃ goṣṭhagoṣpadam \|*  
*pakvasasyānvitaṃ kṣetraṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*rucirāṃ padminīṃ śyāmāṃ nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalām \|*  
*suveṣakāṃ suvasanāṃ divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*veśyāṃ kṣemakarīṃ gandhaṃ sudūrvākṣatataṇḍulam \|*  
*siddhānnaṃ paramānnaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kāntikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca rādhikāpratimāṃ śubhām \|*  
*saṃpūjya dṛṣṭvā natvā ca karoti janmakhaṇḍanam \|\| 20 \|\|*

17-20. In case one looks at the urine of a cow, the cowdung, the milk, cowdust, the abode of a cow, a place having the foot prints of a cow and ripe crop, he surely achieves merit. Looking at a beautiful damsel, a girl of sixteen years clad in beautiful costumes and adorned with divine ornaments, chaste woman, the best of diirva-grass, unbroken rice and the best of food also provides one the merits. The one who performs the adoration of the image of Radha on the full moon day in the Kartika month and offers her his adoration, he is relieved of the bondages of birth and death.

## \|\| 76.21-22 \|\|

*hiṅgulāyāṃ tathā'ṣṭamyāmiṣe māsi site śubhe \|*  
*śrīdurgāpratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā karoti janmo \|\| 21 \|\|*

*śivarātrau ca kāśyāṃ ca viśvanāthasya darśanam \|*  
*kṛtvopavāsaṃ pūjāṃ ca karoti janmo \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. A person is relieved of the bondages of birth and death if one looks at the image of Durga on the eight day of the bright fortnight in the month of Ashvin. The one who looks at Kasivishvanatha on the day of Shivaratri observing the fast is also relieved of the bondage of birth and death.

## \|\| 76.23-24 \|\|

*janmāṣṭamīdine bhakto dṛṣṭvā māṃ bindumādhavam \|*  
*praṇamya pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca karoti janmo \|\| 23 \|\|*

*pauṣe māsi śuklarātrau yatra yatra sthale naraḥ \|*  
*padmāyāḥ pratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā karoti janmo \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Looking at Bindumadhava on the JanmastamI day the one who performs puja with devotion, is also relieved of the cycle of birth or death. In the bright fortnight of the month of Pausa, one who witnesses the image of Lakshmi, is relieved of all the sins and future births.

## \|\| 76.25-28 \|\|

*saptajanma bhavettasya putraḥ pautro dhaneśvaraḥ \|*  
*upoṣyaikādaśīṃ snātvā prabhāte dvādaśīdine \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā kāśyāmannapūrṇāṃ karoti janmakhaṇḍanam \|*  
*caitrai māsi caturdaśyāṃ kāmarūpeṣu puṇyade \|\| 26 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā natvā bhadrakālīṃ karoti janmo \|*  
*ayodhyāyāṃ ca rāmaṃ ca śrīrāmanavamīdine \|\| 27 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya natvā dṛṣṭvā ca karoti janmo \|*  
*upoṣya puṣkare snātvā kiṃvā badarikāśrame \|\| 28 \|\|*

25-28. He enjoys all the riches like Kubera for seven births enjoying the company of his sons and grandsons. The one who observes fast on Ekadasi day and breaks the fast on Dvadasi day, after getting up early in the morning taking a bath and visiting the image of Annapurna on KasI he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. On the fourteenth day of bright fortnight of the month of Caitra, the one who visits the temple of Bhadrakall at Kamarupa and offers his salutation to her, is also relieved of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 76.29-30 \|\|

*maṃpūjya dṛṣṭvā māmekaṃ karoti janmo \|*  
*dattavā tiṣṇupade piṇḍaṃ viṣṇuṃ yaśca prapūjyet \|\| 29 \|\|*

*pitaṇāṃ svātmanaścaiva karoti janmo \|*  
*prayāge muṇḍanaṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ ca kurute yadi \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. On the day of RamanavamI one who performs the adoration of Rama and worships him bowing in reverence he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. The one who worships the lord in the Puskara-ksetra or Badrikairama and worships the god after taking a bath and observing fast he is surely relieved of the cycle of birth death. The one who performs the pindadana at Vishnupada and adores lord Vishnu, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death together with his ancestors; the one who shaving his head in Prayaga and goes to Naimisaranya observing fast, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 76.31-32 \|\|

*upoṣya naimiṣāraṇye karoti janmo \|*  
*siddhiṃ kṛtvā ca vadarīṃbhuṅkte badarikāśrame \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭavā matpratimāṃ nanda karoti janmo \|*  
*delāyamānaṃ govindaṃ puṇye vṛndāvane ca mām \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. О Nanda, after achieving success in Bctdrikasrama, one who consumes the jujubi fruit and worships my image, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. The one who worships me seated in the auspicious Vmdavana and adoring me offers his salutation to me, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 76.33-34 \|\|

*dṛṣṭavā saṃpūjya natvā ca karoti janmo \|*  
*bhādre dṛṣṭvā ca mañcasthaṃ māmeva madhusūdanam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya natvā bhaktaśca karoti janmo \|*  
*rathasthaṃ ca jagannāthaṃ yo drakṣyati kalau naraḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya natvā bhaktyā ca karoti janmo \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. The one who adores MadhusQdana placing him on the auspicious pedestal and offers his salutation with devotion, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. In the age of Kaliyuga the one who adores lord Jagannatha seated on the chariot and who perfonns his рщй with devotion, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 76.35-36 \|\|

*uttarāyaṇasaṃkrāntyāṃ prayāge snānamācaret \|*  
*saṃpūjya natvā māmeva karoti janmo \|\| 35 \|\|*

*kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā matpratimāṃ śubhām \|*  
*upoṣya pūjaraṃ kṛtvā karoti janmo \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. On the first day of the month when the sun is in northward movement, if one takes a bath at Prayaga and adores me, offering salutation, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. On the full moon day of Kartika one who adores my image observing fast, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 76.37-38 \|\|

*candrabhāgāsamīpe ca mādhyāṃ ca māṃ nametsudhīḥ \|*  
*rādhayā saha māṃ dṛṣṭvā karoti janmanaḥ kṣayam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*rāmeśvaraṃ setubandha aṣāṇīpūrṇimādine \|*  
*upeṣya dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya karoti janmo \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. On the full moon day of the month of Magha, the one who adores me with Radha on the bank of Chandrabhaga river, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. On the full moon day of Asadha, whosoever takes a bath at Rameshvara and obst:ving the fast, adores me, is relieved of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 76.39-42 \|\|

*svarge vidyādharā rātrau nṛtyanti ca suhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*praṇāmaṃ kartumīśaṃ taṃ samāyāti vibhīṣaṇaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*gāyanti kiṃnarā rātrau gandharvāśca manoharam \|*  
*praṇāmaṃ kartumīśaṃ ta samāyāti ya mādhavaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā sākṣādvasantaṃ ca sarveśaṃ candraśekharam \|*  
*jīvanmukto bhavedante prayāti harimandiram \|\| 41 \|\|*

*dīnanāthaṃ dinakaraṃ koṇārke cottarāyaṇe \|*  
*upoṣya dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya karoti janmo \|\| 42 \|\|*

39-42. The Vidyadharas adore me perfoiTning divine dance in heaven and at the same time Vibhlsana arrived there for bowing in reverence to Shiva. The Gandharvas and Kinnaras beautifully sing at night and at the same time Madhava also arrived for adoring Shiva. Adoring Shiva having the crescent on his head, being lord of all, the god dwells there. A person is relieved of birth and death after adoring him there and ultimately arrives in the abode of Shiva. When the sun is on the southward movement the one who adored Surya at Konarka, after observing fast, he is relieved of birth and death.

## \|\| 76.43-46 \|\|

*kṛṣikoṣṭhe suvasane kalarvike vasuṃdhare \|*  
*vispandake rājakoṣṭhe nandake puṣpabhadrake \|\| 43 \|\|*

*pārvatīpratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā kārtikeyaṃ gaṇeśvaram \|*  
*nandinaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā karoti janmanaḥ kṣayam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*upoṣya prātaḥ saṃpūjya dṛṣṭvā stutvā stutau nataḥ \|*  
*pāraṇaṃ ca dadhi prāśya karoti janmo \|\| 45 \|\|*

*trikūṭe maṇibhadre ca paścimodadhisaṃnidhau \|*  
*samupoṣya dadhi praśya māṃ dṛṣṭvā muktimāpnuyāt \|\| 46 \|\|*

43-46. The one who adores the images of Parvati, Karttikeya, Ganesha, Nandi and Shiva in the holy place of Krsikostha, Suvasana, Kalavinka, Vasundhara, Vispandaka, Rajakostha, Nandaka, Puspabhadrka, he is surely relieved of the cycle of birth and death. By fasting there one has to adore the gods offering prayers and one has to break the fast by consuming curd, only then the fast is considered to be successful. At Chitrakuta mountain close to the western ocean, there is a mountain known as Manibhadra, the one who adores the lord thereafter observing fast which has to be broken after consuming curd, one achieves salvation.

## \|\| 76.47-48 \|\|

*pratimāsu madīyāsu pārvatīpratimāsu ca \|*  
*jīvaṃ saṃnyasya saṃpūjya karoti janmo \|\| 47 \|\|*

*śivadurgālayaṃ kṛtvā madīyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*śivasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā karoti janmo \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. The one who consecrates my image and also of Parvati, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. The one who builds temples for Shiva, Durga, my temples and the place of Shiva, he achieves salvation from the universe.

## \|\| 76.49-54 \|\|

*puṣpodyānaṃ ca śaṃkuṃ ca setuṃ khātaṃ sarovaram \|*  
*viprasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā karoti janmo \|\| 49 \|\|*

*na ca vedāḥ purāṇāni brahmasaṃsthāpanaṃ phalam \|*  
*jānanti santo munayaḥ surā viprādayaḥ pitaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*gaṇyante pāṃsavo bhūmergaṇyante vṛṣṭibindavaḥ \|*  
*na gaṇyate vidhātrā'pi viprasaṃsthāpane phalam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*kṛtvopajīṃyaṃ viprasya jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*acalāṃ śrīyamāpnoti pare sukticatuṣṭayam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*maddāsyabhaktiṃ sa labhedvaikuṇṭhe modake ciram \|*  
*na hi pāto bhavettasya yathā me paramātmanaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*kumārīmaṣṭavarṣoyāṃ suvipraya dadāti yaḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya sarvābharaṇāṃ durgādānaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 54 \|\|*

49-54. The one who builds a flower orchard, a bridge, a wdl, a pool and the abodes of Brahmanas his life meets with success. О father, no one knows about the merit one earns by constructing the abodes of the sages, the mendicant, the gods and the Brahmanas because the particles of the dust on the earth can be counted as also the drops of rains but in case an abode is provided for a Brahmana its merit is beyond description. The one who provides livelihood to a Brahmana, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death and achieves the eternal Lakshmi. Thereafter, by achieving salvation he achieves my slavehood and devotion and then proceeds to Vaikuntha and he never falls from Vaikuntha like me. The one who gives away a girl of eight years adorned with ornaments to a Brahmana, he achieves the merit of donation to goddess Durga.

## \|\| 76.55-56 \|\|

*sarva svargya samālokya brahmalokeṣu pūjitaḥ \|*  
*labhate mama dāsyaṃ ca vaisuṇṭhe modate ciram \|\| 55 \|\|*

*vivāhadarśane koṭisvarṇadānaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*ante svarge prayātyevamihaiva niścalāṃ śriyam \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. He witnesses all the divine articles, is adored in Brahmaloka, achieves my slavehood and enjoys all the pleasures of Vaikuntha. Anyone who witnesses the marriage, he earns the merit of donating crores of gold coins. Ultimately he achieves heaven and the indestructible Lakshmi.

## \|\| 76.57-62 \|\|

*yaḥ suvipramanāthaṃ ca daridraṃ ca supaṇ̈ḍitam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā kuryāttadvivāhaṃ sa mokṣaṃ labhate dhruvam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yacchatrapādukādānaṃ śālagrāmasya yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*karoti bhaktyā puṇyāhe pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 58 \|\|*

*gajacadāne ca tallomamānavarṣa śrutau śrutam \|*  
*caturguṇaṃ gajendraṃ ca modate mama mandire \|\| 59 \|\|*

*gajardha śvetaturage tadardha cetane pitaḥ \|*  
*gajatulyaṃ kṛṣṇagavāṃ dāne ca tatphalaṃ labhet \|\| 60 \|\|*

*tattulyaṃ dhenudāne ca hyardhaṃ sāmānyagostathā \|*  
*labhedvatsaprasūtānāṃ dāne dāne phalaṃ bhuvaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*bhūmidāne reṇumānavarṣa sthānaṃ ca matpade \|*  
*jñānadāne mahatpuṇyaṃ vaikuṇṭhe modate ciram \|\| 62 \|\|*

57-62. The one who looking at a helpless pauper Brahmana of high family and marries him, he achieves moksa definitely The one who on an auspicious day, donates with devotion a chatra or sandals to Tulasi, the beloved of the lord Shalagmma, he earns the merit of donating land. If one gives away in charity an elephant, he enjoys the dwelling in heaven up to the number of years equivalent to the hair on his body and the one who donates a great elephant, he earns four times the merit described earlier. He enjoys all the pleasures in my abode. This has been described in the Vedas. Similarly by giving away a white horse in charity, one earns half the merit of donating an elephant and by donating several types of horses, one earns one-fourth of the merit. О father, by donating a black cow one earns the merit equivalent to the donating of an elephant. He does not get the same merit by donating another cow and by giving away in charity an ordinary cow one earns half the merit. О virtuous one, he who donates a cow with a calf earns the merit of donating land. He who donates land, has to remain in my abode till the number of years equivalent to the particles of dust of that land. One earns great merit by donating knowledge and he enjoys pleasure in Vaikuntha for a long time.

## \|\| 76.63-70 \|\|

*śriyaṃ labhetsvarṇadāne rājatvaṃ rajatena ca \|*  
*annadāne phalaṃ gahaṃ kathaṃ jānāmi pai śutam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*labhate sarvadānasya phalaṃ brahmaṇabhojane \|*  
*annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati \|\| 64 \|\|*

*nātra pātraparīkṣā'sti na kālaniyamaḥ kvacit \|*  
*annadāne śubhaṃ puṇyaṃ dātuḥ pātraṃ tvapātakī \|\| 65 \|\|*

*annadānaṃ ca dhanyaṃ syādbhūmau vaikuṇṭhahetukam \|*  
*vastraṃ dadāti vipraya daridrāya kuṭumbine \|\| 66 \|\|*

*vastraṃsūtramānavarṣa vaikuṇṭhe modate ciram \|*  
*suramye candraloke ca vāruṇe ca tathaiva ca \|\| 67 \|\|*

*kṛtvā lohapradīpaṃ ca svarṇavartisamanvitam \|*  
*dattavā ghṛtapradīpaṃ ca haraye paramātmane \|\| 68 \|\|*

*andhakāraṃ ca na gṛhaṃ yamadūtaṃ yamaṃ tathā \|*  
*na hi paśyati dātā ca prayāti mama mandiram \|\| 69 \|\|*

*brahmaṇāya ca dattavaiva na yāti yamayātanām \|*  
*divyavarṣasahaśraṃ ca modate śakramandire \|\| 70 \|\|*

63-70. Similarly by donating gold one gets riches and by donating silver one achieves kingship. The merit one earns by donating food is beyond description. By serving food to a Brahmana one earns great merit. This is the reason why no charity is considered to be bigger than of serving the food to the needy persons. While giving away food in charity, one remains unmindful of the receiver and there is no other rule specially applicable to this purpose. Thus the one, who serves food in charity, he earns the merit and the person who receives the food also does not earn sin. This is the reason why the giving away of food in charity has been considered to be quite graceful and leads one to Vaikuntha. In case a cloth is given to a poor Brahmana, the donor earns to stay in Vaikuntha delightfully till the number of years equivalent to the number of threads of the cloth. Thereafter he stays in Chandraloka and Vamnaloka with great pleasure. By placing a wick in an iron lamp, whosoever offers it to lord Vishnu, his house always remains lighted and even Yama, the god of death, cannot create darkness in his house. He ultimately achieves my abode. In case a similar type of lamp is given away in charity to a Brahmana, the donor does not have to face the torture of Yama and ultimately he achieves great pleasure up to a divine thousand years in the abode of Indra.

## \|\| 76.71-78 \|\|

*āsanaṃ labhate svarge vastumātrānurūpataḥ \|*  
*uttame lakṣavarṣe ca tadardha cetare vrajet \|\| 71 \|\|*

*tāmpūlena labhedbhogaṃ svarge varṣaśataṃ vrajet \|*  
*mālyadāne priyaṃ svarga vastumātrānurūpataḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*phaladānaphalaṃ svarga labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*sāmānyaśayyādānena svarga varṣaśataṃ vrajet \|\| 73 \|\|*

*caturguṇaṃ prakṛṣṭāyāṃ guṇalakṣaṃ dilakṣaṇe \|*  
*anāthāya suviprāya yadi gehaṃ pradīyate \|\| 74 \|\|*

*atraiva mānavarṣa ca śakraloke mahīyate \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā bubhukṣitaṃ vipramannaṃ tasmai pradīyate \|\| 75 \|\|*

*ayalāṃ śriyamāpnoti putrapautravivardhinīm \|*  
*vrajanātha vrajaṃ gatvā vrajabhūmau vrajādhunā \|\| 76 \|\|*

*vraja bhojaya vipāṃśca vraja sarva vraje vraje \|*  
*gokule gokule vatsa vatsa vatsa nirākule \|\| 77 \|\|*

*vyākulānāṃ gokulānāṃ saṃkule ca vraje vraje \|*  
*etatte kathitaṃ nanda sānandaṃ puṇyavardhanam \|*  
*susvapnadarśanaṃ puṇyaṃ yadi nīcaṃ na vakti ca \|\| 78 \|\|*

71-78. Thus one gets a seat in heaven according to the number and quantity of things donated by him. By donating the best of things one enjoys his stay in heaven for a lakh of years' and by donating medium type of things his stay is reduced to half and by donating a betel one enjoys the best of pleasure in heaven for a hundred years and by donating a garland one achieves whatever he desires; thus one achieves a place in heaven according the things donated by him and the person who receives such a donation. The one who donates an ordinary bed, he resides in heaven for a hundred years. By donating an excellent bed he enjoys his stay in heaven for four times more the number of years and by donating and extraordinary bed one enjoys his stay in heaven for three lakhs of years. Similarly, by donating a house to a helpless Brahmana one enjoys his stay in heaven up to the life of Indra. By serving food to a hungry Brahmana one achieves imperishable wealth and an increase of his sons and grandsons. Therefore, О lord of Vraja, you proceed to Vraja at the moment and after reaching there you advise all the people of Vraja to behave accordingly. О lord in the Gokula, the cows and the cowherds are getting upset because of my absence; you reassure them all and remain gracefully. О Nanda, I have made you aware of the merit one earns by giving away in charities. This should not be discussed among the degraded people; only then one earns the result of having good dreams.

## \|\| 76.79-80 \|\|

*kāśyapaṃ durbhagaṃ nīcaṃ śatrumajñāninaṃ streyam \|*  
*tyaktvā rātriṃ ca divase vakti vipraṃ mupaṇḍitam \|\| 79 \|\|*

*devālaye ca devaṃ vā'pyaśvatthatulaśīvaṭam \|*  
*uktvā taddviguṇaṃ puṇyamaprakāśya caturguṇam \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. The unfortunate person of Kashyapa gotra, a degraded person, an enemy, a foolish person and woman should not be told about this and the same should be told to an intelligent Brahmana. By speaking the same in the temple of the god, a pipala tree or Tulasi plant or a banyan tree, one gets double the merit. In case it is not revealed to any person, one gets four times the merit.

## \|\| 76.81-82 \|\|

*susvapnadarśane prājño gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*arthaṃ vittaṃ ca bhāryā ca bhūmiṃ putraṃ labhetprajām \|\| 81 \|\|*

*mokṣaṃ ca paramaiśvaryaṃ labhate sarvavāñchitam \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tāta kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. By witnessing a good dream an intellectual gets the merit of taking a bath in the Ganga, besides riches, wealth, wife, land, sons and people besides salvation. He achieves all types of pleasures and his desires are fulfilled. Thus, О lord, I have spoken to you whatever I had heard earlier.

## Chapter 77

## \|\| 77.1 \|\|

*atha saptaspatatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca kena spapnena kiṃ puṇyaṃ kena mokṣo bhavetsukham \|*  
*ko'pi ko'pi ca susvapnastatsarvaṃ kathaya prabho \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Nanda said – О lord, which one of the dreams bestows merit and by witnessing which dream one achieves moksa, which one of the dream bestowed pleasure and which ones of them are considered to be good dreams.

## \|\| 77.2-3 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca vedeṣu sāmavedaśca praśastaḥ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*tathaiva kaṇvaśākhāyāṃ puṇyakāṇḍe manohare \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sa vyavato yaśca duḥsvapnaḥ śaśvatapuṇyaphalapradaḥ \|*  
*tatsarva nikhilaṃ tāta kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Shri Krishna said – Of all the Vedas, Samaveda is considered to be the best for performing all types of deeds. In the Manohar-punya-kanda of the Kanvashakha, the bad dreams and the good dreams which bestow merit have been described. О father, I am highlighting all of them, you kindly listen to me attentively. I am narrating to you the chapter on good dreams which bestows immense merit. By listening to the chapter on great dreams one earns the merit of taking a bath in Ganga.

## \|\| 77.4-8 \|\|

*svapnādhyāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi bahupuṇyaphalapradam \|*  
*svapnādhyāyaṃ naraḥ śrutvā gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 4 \|\|*

*svapnaktu prathame yāme saṃvatsaraphalapradaḥ \|*  
*dvitīye cāṣṭabhirmāsaistribhirmāsaistṛtīyare \|\| 5 \|\|*

*caturthe cārdhamāsena svapnaḥ svātmaphalapradaḥ \|*  
*daśāhe phaladaḥ svapno'pyaruṇodayadarṇane \|\| 6 \|\|*

*prātaḥsvapnaśca phaladastatkṣaṇaṃ yadi bodhitaḥ \|*  
*dine manasi yaddṛṣṭaṃ tatsarva ca labheddhruvam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*cintāvyādhisamāyukto naraḥ svapnaṃ ca paśyati \|*  
*tatsarva niṣphalaṃ tāta prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

4-8. The dream is witnessed during the first Prahara of the night bestows the reward in a year; the dream witnessed in the second Prahara produces the result in eight months and the one witnessed in the third Prahara bestows the result in three months and the dream witnessed in the fourth Prahara of the night can produce the result in fifteen days. The dream which is witnessed during the dawn produces the result in ten days. And in case a dream is witnessed in the early morning it gives the result instantaneously. Whatever is seen is thought during the day and is reflected in the dream. О father, when a person who is infatuated with worry and disease, witnesses a dream it becomes of no consequence.

## \|\| 77.9-10 \|\|

*jacaḍo mūtrapurīṣeṇa pīḍitaśca bhayākulaḥ \|*  
*digambaro muktakeśo na labhetsvapnajaṃ phalam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ ca nidrāluryadi nidrāṃ prayati ca \|*  
*vimūḍho vakti cedrātrau na labhetsvapnajaṃ phalam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The one who is lying motionless and is suffering from the force of urine and refuse or is infatuated with fear, is naked or with dishevelled hair, the witnessing of a dream by such a person is of no consequence. In case a sleeping person after witnessing a dream or narrates it to someone in the night itself, he does not have to get a reward for it.

## \|\| 77.11-12 \|\|

*uktavā kāśyapagotre ca vipartti labhate dhruvam \|*  
*durgate durgatiṃ yāti nīce vyādhiṃprayāti ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

*śatrau bhayaṃ ca labhate mūrkhe ca kalahaṃ labhet \|*  
*kāminyāṃ dhanahāniḥ syādrātrau jorabhayaṃ bhavet \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. If a person of Kashyapa gotra witnesses a dream, he surely invites misfortune. In case the dream is told to an unfortunate person, one has to face misfortune; by speaking the same to a degraded person one invites ailment; by speaking out the same to an enemy, one invites fear; by narrating it to a foolish person, one invites quarrel; by speaking to a damsel one is deprived of the riches and when one narrates it during the night, one has to face the danger of theft.

## \|\| 77.13 \|\|

*nidrāyāṃ labhate śokaṃ paṇ̈ḍite vāñchitaṃ phalam \|*  
*na prakāśyaśca susvapnaḥ paṇḍitaiḥ kāśyape vraja \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. If one, after witnessing a dream, again goes to sleep he meets with grief and if the dream is retold to an intellectual, the desire is fulfilled. Therefore, О lord of Vraja, the intellectuals should not discuss about the dream with persons of Kashyapa gotra.

## \|\| 77.14-16 \|\|

*gavāṃ ca kuñjarāṇāṃ ca hayānāṃ ca vrajeśvara \|*  
*prāsādānāṃ ca śailānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ārohaṇaṃ ca dhanadaṃ bhojanaṃ rodanaṃ tathā \|*  
*pratigṛhyatathā vīṇāṃ sasyāḍhyāṃ bhūmimālabhet \|\| 15 \|\|*

*śastrāstreṇa yadā viddho vraṇena kṛmiṇā tathā \|*  
*viṣṭhayā rudhireṇaiva saṃyukto'pyarthavānbhavet \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. О lord of Vraja, one gets food and cries (weeping), if one witnesses in the dream a cow, an elephant, a horse, palaces, climbing on the mountains. By receiving vlna one gets enough of paddy and land. If the limbs are out with the attack of weapons or one gets wounded or having been bitten by insects or touching the refuse and blood, one gets wealth.

## \|\| 77.17-18 \|\|

*svapne'pyagamyāgamato bhāryālābhaṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*mūtrasiktaḥ pibecchukaṃ narakaṃ ca viśatyapi \|\| 17 \|\|*

*nagaraṃ praviśedraktaṃ samudraṃ vā sudhāṃ pibet \|*  
*śubhavārtāmavāpnoti vipulaṃ cārthamālabhet \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The one who enjoys the pleasure of the company of an unchaste woman, he achieves a good wife. By getting soaked in urine, drinking semen, entering a city or the hell, drinking of blood, water of the ocean or the nectar, one gets good news besides enormous riches.

## \|\| 77.19-22 \|\|

*gajaṃ nṛpaṃ suvarṇa ca vṛṣabhaṃ ghenumeva ca \|*  
*dīpamannaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ kanyāṃ chatraṃ rathaṃ dhvajam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kuṭumbaṃ labhate dṛṣṭvā kīrtiṃ ca vipulāṃ śriyam \|*  
*pūrṇakumbhaṃdvijaṃ vahniṃ puṣpatāmbūlamandiram \|\| 20 \|\|*

*śukladhānyaṃ nadaṃ veśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā śriyamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*gokṣīraṃ ca ghṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā cārtha puṇyadhanaṃ labhet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pāyasaṃ padmapatre ca dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu \|*  
*miṣṭānnaṃ svastikaṃ bhuktvā dhruvaṃ rājā bhaviṣyati \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. By witnessing in a dream an elephant, gold, bull, cow, lamp, cereal, fruit, flower, girl, umbrella, the glory is increase besides getting immense riches. One achieves immense riches by witnessing in a dream a pitcher full of water, a Brahmana, flower, fire, betel, temple, white paddy and actor and a whore. By witnessing in the dream a cow, milk and ghee, one achieves merit besides riches. In case one witnesses in the dream rice with milk on the leaf of the lotus flowers, the curd, milk, ghee, honey, Svastika-sweet he surely becomes a king in the near future.

## \|\| 77.23-24 \|\|

*pakṣiṇāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca bhuṅkte māṃsaṃ naro yadi \|*  
*bahvarthaṃ śubhavārtāṃ ca labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*chatraṃ vā pādukāṃ vā'pi labdhvā dhānyaṃ ca gacchati \|*  
*asiṃ ca nirmaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ tattathaiva bhaviṣyati \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The one who consumes the meat of the birds and the human flesh in a dream he earns enough of riches, good news and his desire is fulfilled. If one who gets a chatra or a sandal, he achieves enough of cereals and by getting a spotless and sharp sword, he gets the appropriate reward.

## \|\| 77.25-26 \|\|

*helayā saṃtaredyo hi sa pradhāno bhaviṣyati \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā ca phalitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ dhanamāpnoti niścitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sarpeṇa bhakṣito yo hi ṇarthalātraśca tadbhavet \|*  
*svapne sūrya vidhuṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate vyādhibandhanāt \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. The one who swims over the water play-fully, such a person becomes a minister, If one witnesses a tree laiden with fruits, the person surely gets enough of riches; he who is bitten by snakes, earns enough of fortune. The one who witnesses in a dream, the sun or the moon he is relieved of all the ailments.

## \|\| 77.27-28 \|\|

*vaḍavāṃ kukkuṭīṃ dṛṣṭvā kauñcīṃ bhāryaṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*svapneyo nigaḍairbaddhaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ putramālabhet \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ bhuṅkate padmapatre nadītaṭe \|*  
*viśīrṇapadmapatre ca so'pi rājā maviṣyati \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The one who witnesses a mare, a hen and a female crane bird, he obtains a beautiful wife. The one who is bound in fetters in a dream he achieves enough of glory and a son. If anyone consumes rice with milk on a lotus leaf seated on the bank of a river, he surely becomes a king.

## \|\| 77.29-30 \|\|

*jalaukasaṃ vṛścikaṃ ca sarpa ca yadi paśyati \|*  
*dhanaṃ putraṃ ca vijayaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vā labhediti \|\| 29 \|\|*

*śṛṅgibhirdaṃṣṭribhiḥ kolairvānaraiḥ pīḍito yadi \|*  
*niścitaṃ ca bhavedrājā dhanaṃ ca vipulaṃ labhet \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. By witnessing a leech, a scorpion and a snake one achieves enough of riches, son, victory and glory. If one witnesses animals with long horns and big teeth or tusks like those of pigs and getting troubled by monkeys, one becomes a king and achieves enormous riches.

## \|\| 77.31-32 \|\|

*matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ mauktikaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ candanahīrakam \|*  
*yastu paśyati svapnānte vipulaṃ dhanamālabhet \|\| 31 \|\|*

*surāṃ ca rudhiraṃ svarṇa bhuktvā viṣṭhāṃdhanaṃ labhet \|*  
*pratimāṃ śivaliṅgaṃca labheddṛṣṭvā jayaṃ dhanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. The one who witnesses fish, meat, ornaments with Jewels, samkha, sandal-paste and diamond, one achieves enough of riches. If one witnesses wine, blood and gold, one gets food and treasures. By looking at the image of a god or goddess or Shivalinga, one achieves enough of riches.

## \|\| 77.33-36 \|\|

*phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ bilvamāmraṃ dṛṣṭvā labheddhanam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā ca jvaladagniṃ ca dhanaṃ buddhiṃ śriyaṃ labhet \|\| 33 \|\|*

*āmalakaṃ dhātrauphalamutpalaṃ ca dhanāgamam \|*  
*devatāśca dvijā gāvaḥ pitaro liṅginastathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yaddadāti mithaḥsvapne tattathaiva bhaviṣyati \|*  
*śuklāmbaradharā nāryaḥ śuklamālyānulepanā \|*  
*samāśliṣyanti yaṃ svapne tasya śrīḥ sarvataḥ sukham \|\| 35 \|\|*

*pītāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ pītamālyānulepanām \|*  
*avagūhati yaḥ svapne kalyāṇaṃ tasya jāyate \|\| 36 \|\|*

33-36. If one witnesses a creeper laden with flowers and fruits beside the mangoes and burning fire, one achieves enough of riches, intelligence, wealth. By witnessing the myrobalan fruit, mango fruits and lotus, one achieves enough of profits. If one witnesses god, a Brahmana, ancestors and a Brahmacarf, whatever is seen in the dream becomes true. Clad in white garment, plastered with white sandal-paste, holding a white rosary if a damsel embraces a person, he enjoys the pleasures which always surround hipi. If a damsel clad in yellow garments, holding a yellow rosary and sandal-paste embraces a person, he meets with much welfare.

## \|\| 77.37-40 \|\|

*sarvāṇi śuklāni praśaṃsitāni bhasmāsthikārpāsavivarjitāni \|*  
*sarvāṇi kṛṣṇanyatininditāni gohastivājidvijadevavarjyam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*divya strī sasmitā viprā natnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|*  
*yasya mandiramāyāti sa priyaṃ labhate dhruvam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*svapne ca brahmaṇo devo brāhmaṇī devakanyakā \|*  
*brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇī vā'pi saṃtuṣṭā sasmitā satī \|\| 39 \|\|*

*phalaṃ dadāti yasmai ca tasya putro bhaviṣyati \|*  
*yaṃ svapne brāhmaṇā nanda kurvanti ca śubhāśiṣam \|\| 40 \|\|*

37-40. Except ashes, bones and cotton if anything else which is white is seen in a dream it is considered to be quite fortunate. Similarly except the cow, the elephant, the horse, a Brahmana and the god, all the black things witnessed in the dream are denounced; the one who meets a divine woman, wearing a smile on her face adorned with all the gem-studded ornament, belonging to the Brahmana caste or arrives in the house of anyone, he surely achieves great profits. A Brahmana, a god, a Brahman!, the daughter of the god or a Brahmana couple when seen in a happy mood as in dream they bestow the reward on anyone who surely gets a son. О Nanda, the one who is bestowed with the blessing of a Brahmana in the dream and whatever he speaks, it comes out to be true and his riches and horses go on increasing.

## \|\| 77.41-42 \|\|

*yadvadanti bhavettasya tasyaiśvarya bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*parituṣṭo dvijaśreṣṭhaśṭā''yāti yasya mandiram \|\| 41 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇaḥ śivo brahmā praviśettu tadāśramam \|*  
*saṃpattisvasya bhavati yaśaśca vipulaṃ śubham \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. In case a Brahmana getting immensely pleased visits the house of a person in a dream, in such a house Narayana, Shiva and Brahma enter, as a result of which there is an increase in his fortune, glory and lustre.

## \|\| 77.43-44 \|\|

*pade pade sukhaṃ tasya samānaṃ gauravaṃ labhet \|*  
*akasmādapi svapne tu labhate surabhiṃ yadi \|\| 43 \|\|*

*bhūmilābho bhavettasya bhāryā cāpi pativratā \|*  
*kareṇa kṛtvā hastī yaṃ mastake sthāpayedyadi \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. In a dream if someone suddenly gets a cow then he gets land and a chaste wife. The one who is lifted up by an elephant with his trunk over its head, he surely becomes a king. This has been ordained in the Vedas.

## \|\| 77.45-46 \|\|

*rājyalābhobhavettasya niścitaṃ ca śrutau matam \|*  
*svapne tu brāhmaṇastuṣṭaḥ samāśliṣyatiyaṃ vraja \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tīrthasnāyī bhavetso'pi niścitaṃ ca śriyā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*svapne dadāti puṣpaṃ ca yasmai puṇyavate dvijaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. О lord of Vraja, in a dream if a Brahmana embraces a person, he surely achieves riches beside having a bath in the holy place. In case a Brahmana in a dream offers some flowers to an auspicious person, be becomes victorious besides achieving enough of riches, animals and pleasures.

## \|\| 77.47-48 \|\|

*jayayukto bhavetso'pi yaśasvī ca dharī sukhī \|*  
*svapne dṛṣṭavā ca tīrthāni saudharatnagṛhāṇi ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

*jayayuktaśca dhanavāṃstīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*svapne tu pūṇaṃkalaśaṃ kaścitkasmai dadāti ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. By visiting the sacred places besides palaces, the gems and the house, in a dream, one gets enough of riches. The one who takes a bath in the holy places in a dream or if someone presents him with a pitcher filled with water, such a person surely obtains a son and enough of riches.

## \|\| 77.49-50 \|\|

*putralābho bhavettasya maṃpattiṃ vā samālabhet \|*  
*haste kṛtvā tu kuḍavamāḍhakaṃ vārasundarī \|\| 49 \|\|*

*yasya mandiramāyāti sa lakṣmīṃ labhate dhruvam \|*  
*divyā strī yadgṛhaṃ gatvā purīṣaṃ visṛjeddvija \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. In case a person arrives in the house of a person carrying wine, he surely achieves enormous riches. In case a divine woman arrives in the house of someone and drops refuse, he surely achieves riches and his poverty disappears.

## \|\| 77.51-52 \|\|

*arthalābho bhavettasya dāridryaṃ ca prayāti ca \|*  
*yasya gehaṃ samāyāti brāhmaṇo bhāryayā saha \|\| 51 \|\|*

*pārvatyā saha śaṃbhurvā lakṣmyā nārāyaṇo'thavā \|*  
*brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇī vā'pi svapne tasmai pradīyate \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. In case, in a dream, a Brahmana couple arrives in the house of someone in that case Shiva and Parvati or Lakshminarayana arrive in that house. In case a Brahmana couple offers some paddy or a bunch of flowers, he achieves all-round riches.

## \|\| 77.53-54 \|\|

*dhānyaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ vā'pi tasya śrīḥ sardatomukhī \|*  
*muktāhāraṃ puṣpamālyaṃ candanaṃ ca labhedvraja \|\| 53 \|\|*

*svāpne dadāti vipraśca tasya śrīḥ sarvo \|*  
*gorocanaṃ patākāṃ vā haridrāmikṣudaṇḍakam \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. О lord of Vraja, in case a Brahmana offers a garland of gems to a person besides a garland of flowers or sandal-paste, he meets with all-round glory. By receiving gorocana, a flag, turmeric, sugar-cane and food, in the dream one receives success all round.

## \|\| 77.55-56 \|\|

*siddhānnaṃ ca labhetsvapne tasya śrīḥ sarvo \|*  
*brāhmaṇo brahmāṇī vā'pi dadāti yasya mastake \|\| 55 \|\|*

*chatraṃ vā śuklavānyaṃ va sa carājā bhaviṣyati \|*  
*svapne lathasthaḥ puruṣaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. In case a Brahmana couple places a chatra or some white paddy on the head of someone, he surely becomes a king. The one who wears a white garland of flowers in the dream and the body is plastered with sandal-paste and is then seated on the chariot or when he consumes curd or rice with milk, he surely becomes a king.

## \|\| 77.57-58 \|\|

*tatrasthodadhi bhuṅkte ca pāyasaṃ vā lṛpo bhavet \|*  
*svapne dadāti vipraśca brāhmaṇī ca sudhāṃdadhi \|\| 57 \|\|*

*praśastapātraṃ yasmai vā so'pi rājā bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*kumārī cāṣṭavarṣīyā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. In a dream, when a Brahmana or a Brahman! placing nectar or curd in a vase, offers to a person, such a person surely becomes a king. The maid of eight years adorned with all the ornaments when appears in the dream before someone, she becomes a poet or an intellectual.

## \|\| 77.59-60 \|\|

*yasya tuṣṭā bhavetsvapne sa bhavetkavipaṇ̈ḍitaḥ \|*  
*dadāti pustakaṃ svapne yasmai puṇyavate ca sā \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sa bhavedviśvavikhyātaḥ kavīndraḥ paṇ̈ḍiteśvaraḥ \|*  
*yaṃ pāṭhayati svapne vā māteva ca sutaṃ yathā \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. In case in the dream she offers a book to someone, he becomes a world renowned poet and the best of intellectuals. In case in the dream, Sarasvati teaches a son like the mother, be becomes the son of Sarasvati and no one can compete with him in wisdom.

## \|\| 77.61-62 \|\|
