*sarasvatīsutaḥ so'pi tatparo nāsti paṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇaḥ pāṭhayedyaṃ ca piteva yatnapūrvakam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*dadāti pustakaṃ prītyā sa ca satsadṛśo bhavet \|*  
*prāpnoti pustakaṃ svapne pathi vā yatra tatra vā \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. In case a Brahmana teaches someone in the dream with much effort or offer him a book lovingly, he also is turned as a great intellectual. In the dream, if someone meets with a book while walking on the way, he also becomes a great writer well known in the universe.

## \|\| 77.63-64 \|\|

*sa paṇḍito yaśasvī ca vikhyātaśca mahītale \|*  
*svapne yasmai mahāmantraṃ vipro vipre dadāti cet \|\| 63 \|\|*

*sa bhavetpuruṣaḥ prājño dhanavānguṇavānsudhīḥ \|*  
*svapne dadāti mantraṃ vā pratimāṃ vā śilāmayīm \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. In case a Brahmana bestows a Mahdmantra to a Brahmana, such a person achieves great wisdom, wealth, qualities and becomes an intellectual. In case a Brahmana presents another Brahmana with an image or of a mantra, he achieves success in the mantra.

## \|\| 77.65-66 \|\|

*yasmai dadāti vipraśca mant siddhiśca tadbhavet \|*  
*vipraṃ viprasamūhaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā natvā''śiṣaṃ labhet \|\| 65 \|\|*

*rājendraḥ sa bhavedvā'pi kiṃvā ca kavipaṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*śukladhānyayutāṃ bhūmīṃ yasmai vipra samutsṛjet \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. In case someone in the dream goes before a Brahmana or a group of Brahmanas and receives their blessings, such a person surely becomes a great king or a great poet. Getting immensely pleased in a dream, if a Brahmana gives away land to someone, he surely becomes a lord on earth.

## \|\| 77.67-68 \|\|

*svapne'pi parituṣṭaśca sa bhavetpṛthivīpatiḥ \|*  
*svapna vipro rathe kṛtvā nānāsvargaṃ pradarśayet \|\| 67 \|\|*

*ciraṃjīvī bhavedāyurdhanavṛddhirbhaveddhruvam \|*  
*viprāya vipraḥ saṃtuṣṭo yasmai kanyāṃ dadāti ca \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. In case a Brahmana getting someone mounted on the chariot, shows round various heavens, he becomes immensely rich and enjoys a long life. In case, in a dream, a Brahmana gives away his daughter to another Brahmana, such a person becomes immensely rich and a king.

## \|\| 77.69-70 \|\|

*svapne ca sa bhavennityaṃ dhanāḍhyo bhūvatiḥ svayam \|*  
*svapne sarovaraṃ dṛṣṭavā samudraṃ vā nadīṃ nadam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*śuklāhiṃ śuklaśailaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śriyamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*yaṃ paśyanti mṛtaṃ svapne sa bhaveccirajīvanaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. In the dream, if one witnesses a pool and a ocean, a river, rivulet, a white snake and a white mountain, he surely achieves wealth. The one who witnesses a dead body, gains long life, he feels painful while coming across a sick person and feels delighted when he comes across a healthy person.

## \|\| 77.71-76 \|\|

*arogī rogiṇaṃ du khī suśinaṃ ca sukhaṃ bhavet \|*  
*divyā strī yaṃ pravadati mama svāmī bhavāniti \|\| 71 \|\|*

*svapne dṛṣṭvā ca cāgatiṃ sa ca rājā bhaveddṛḍham \|*  
*svapne vā kālikāṃ dṛṣṭvā labdhavā sphaṭikamālikām \|\| 72 \|\|*

*indracāpaṃ śakravajraṃ sa pratiṣṭhāṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*svapne vadati yaṃ vipro mama dāso bhaveti ca \|\| 73 \|\|*

*haridāsyaṃ ca madbhaktiṃ sa labdhvā vaiṣṇavo bhavet \|*  
*svapne vipro harīḥ śaṃbhurbrāhmaṇī kamalā śivā \|\| 74 \|\|*

*śaklā strī devamātā vā jāhnavī vā sarasvatī \|*  
*gopālikāveṣadharī bālikā rādhikā mama \|\| 75 \|\|*

*bālaśca bālagopālaḥ svapnavidbhiḥ prakāśitaḥ \|*  
*eṣa te kathito nanda susvapnaḥ puṇyahetukaḥ \|*  
*śrotumicchasi kiṃ vā tvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te \|\| 76 \|\|*

71-76. In case, in the dream, if a divine damsel comes and speaks to a person, "You are my lord". And he wakes up at the same time then he surely becomes a king. In the dream in case, the goddess Kalika" appears and offers a rosary of crystal beads or the vajra of Indra or the bow, such a person surely achieves great glory. In case a Brahmana tells somebody, "You are my slave," he becomes devoted to lord Hari and achieving my slavehood he is called a Vaishnava. In the dream a Brahmana is represented in the form of Vishnu and Shiva. The Brahman! represents Laks ml and Parvati, the white complexioned woman represents the mother of the gods, Ganga or Sarasvati, the one who takes to the form of the cowherdess, surely stands for Radhika my beloved and the cowherds are the form of the cowherds of Goloka. This has been ordained by those well-versed in the dreams. О Nanda, I have thus narrated to you everything about dreams; what else do you want to listen to from me? What more should I speak.

## Chapter 78

## \|\| 78.1 \|\|

*athāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca śrīqaṣṇa jagatāṃ nātha susvapnaśca śruto mayā \|*  
*vedasāro nītisāro laukiko vaidikastathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Nanda said – О Krishna, О lord of the universe, I have listened to your discourse on good dreams quite carefully which is the gist of the Vedas and is a part of worldly practices.

## \|\| 78.2 \|\|

*adhunā śrotumicchāmi pāpaṃ yeṣāṃ ca darśane \|*  
*yasminkarmaṇi vā vatsa tanmāṃ kathitumarhasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O son, by witnessing dreams and by performing deeds one earns sins. I would like to listen to them from you at present; you kindly tell me about the same.

## \|\| 78.3-4 \|\|

*vacanaṃ vedaśāśroktaṃ tathā vedānuyāyinaḥ \|*  
*śrotumicchanti saṃtaptā lokāstvanmukhatastathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vedānāṃ janakastvaṃ ca vaidikānāṃ satāmapi \|*  
*prahmādīnāṃ surāṇāṃ ca munīnāṃ jagatāmapi \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Thus, the followers of the Vedas listen to the provisions of the Vedas and other scriptures, with devotion. Similarly the people of the world remain anxious to listen to your nectar-like words because you happen to be the creator of the Vedas. The Vedic people, the intellectuals, Brahma and other gods besides the sages also preserve them.

## \|\| 78.5-6 \|\|

*śrutaṃ yattvanmukhāmbhojātpramāṇaṃ vacanāmṛtam \|*  
*tena deho'bhiṣikto me vatsavicchedadāhanaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*svapne yaccharaṇāmbhojaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam \|*  
*brahmādayo na paśyanti tadadya dṛṣṭigocaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Therefore, О son, whatever nectar-like words I have listened to from your lotus-like mouth, have made my body burning with the fire of separation, quite cool and calm, your lotus-like feet fulfil all the desires and even Brahma and other gods are unable to have a look at your lotus-like feet even in dream. Fortunately I am looking at them with my own eyes.

## \|\| 78.7-8 \|\|

*ataḥ paraṃ tvatpadābjaṃ kva paśyāmi ca pātakī \|*  
*viṇmūtradhārī deho me nibaddhaśca svakarmaṇā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*īdṛśaṃ ca dinaṃ vatsa kadā mama bhaviṣyati \|*  
*tvayā brahmādināthena saṃvādo mama pāpinaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. After this where can sinners like me have a glance at your lotus-like feet? My body is filled with refuse and urine and is entangled and is bound with the fetters of my deeds. О son, when shall the day come when I would be able to talk again to a person like you, who are the lord of the Brahma and other gods.

## \|\| 78.9-10 \|\|

*kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānātha mama doṣaṃ kṣamasva ca \|*  
*vatsabuddhyā ca durnītaṃ yatkṛtaṃ ca maheśvara \|\| 9 \|\|*

*brahmeśaśeṣamunayo dhyāyante tvatpadāmbujam \|*  
*sarasvatī śrutiryasya stavane jaḍatāṃ vrajet \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Therefore, О merciful one, О son, you kindly forgive me for the same. The gods Brahma, Shiva, Shesha, the sages, always meditate upon your lotus-like feet and Sarasvati and Shruti are unable to recite your glory becoming dumb before you.

## \|\| 78.11-12 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā nandaśca nirānandaḥ śucā''kulaḥ \|*  
*mūrcchāmāpa ruditvā ca putravicchedavihvalaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*saṃtrasto bhagavānkṛṣṇo bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ \|*  
*paramādhyātmikaṃ jñānaṃ dadau tasmai jagatpatiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Thus speaking Nanda who was deprived of pleasure and filled with grief, because of the separation from his son fainted while crying. Finding him in such a condition Vishnu felt panicky and started convincing him variously, bestowing the extremely spiritual knowledge on him.

## \|\| 78.13-14 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca he nanda janakaśreṣṭha sarvaśreṣṭha vrajeśvara \|*  
*cetanaṃ kuru kalyāma jñānaṃ ca paramaṃ śrṛṇu \|\| 13 \|\|*

*paramādhyātmikaṃ jñānaṃ jñānināṃ ca sudulrabham \|*  
*vedaśāstre gopanīyaṃ tubhyameva dadāmyaham \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Shri Krishna said – О Nanda, О best of the kings, best of the lord of Vraja, you regain consciousness and listen to my words which are beneficial and spiritual. This spiritual knowledge is even beyond the reach of the great yogis, quite secretive in the Vedas and other scriptures, which is being bestowed by me on you.

## \|\| 78.15-16 \|\|

*nibodha śrūyatāṃ nanda sānandaḥ susamāhitaḥ \|*  
*janmamṛtyucarāvyādhiryadabhyāsānna jāyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sthiro bhava mahārāja vrajanātha vrajaṃ vraja \|*  
*jñānaṃ labdhvā sadānandaḥ śokamohavivarjitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. О Nanda, you delightfully listen to it with apt attention and follow it, because by doing so one is relieved of birth, death, old age and ailments. Therefore, О lord of Vraja, О great king, be composed and receiving the divine knowledge^ relieved of grief and illusion and blissfully move to Vraja.

## \|\| 78.17-24 \|\|

*jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ sacarācaram \|*  
*prabhāte svapnavanmithyā mohakāraṇameva ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*mithyākṛtrimanirmāṇahetuśca pāñcabhautikaḥ \|*  
*māyayā satyabuddhyā ca pratītiṃ jāyate naraḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*kāmakrodharobhamohairveṣṭitaḥ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*māyayā mohitaḥ śaśvajjñānahīnaśca durbalaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*nidrātandrākṣutpipāsākṣamāśraddhādayādibhiḥ \|*  
*lajjā śāntirdhṛtiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭiścā''bhiśca veṣṭitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*manobuddhicetanābhiḥ prāṇajñānātmabhiḥ saha \|*  
*saṃsaktaḥ sarvadevaiśca yathā vṛkṣaśca vāyasaiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ahamātmā ca sarveśaḥ sarvajñānātmakaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*mano brahmā ca prakṛtirbuddhirupā sanātanī \|\| 22 \|\|*

*prāṇā viṣṇuścetanā sā padmā tu cādhidevatā \|*  
*mayi sthite sthitāḥ sarve gatāste'pigate mayi \|\| 23 \|\|*

*asmābhiśca vinā dehaḥ sadyaḥ patati niścitam \|*  
*pāñcabhūto vilīnaśca pañcabhūteṣu tatkṣaṇam \|\| 24 \|\|*

17-24. This entire movable and immovable universe is of no consequence like a water bubble, it is like a morning dream and leads only to illusion. The human body of five elements which is the cause of the building of the universe, also falls and is perishable. A human considers the illusion as truthful and in all his actions he is overpowered by desire anger, greed and illusion. He is over-powered by sleep, drowsiness, hunger, thirst, forgiveness, devotion, mercy, shyness, peace, belief, support, satisfaction and other elements. He 's involved in the worldly affairs with his mind, intelligence, consciousness, breathing, knowledge, soul, the lord of all and the supreme knowledge. Brahma is my mind, the eternal Prakriti is the wisdom, Vishnu is the breathing and consciousness is the great goddess Lakshmi. Till such time as I remain in the body everything moves. When I leave the body, the same is deserted by everyone; without me the body falls in no time. All the five elements of the body that is earth, water, fire, wind and sky are merged in the five elements.

## \|\| 78.25-26 \|\|

*nāmasaṃketarūpaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ mohakāraṇam \|*  
*śokaścājñānināṃ tāta jñānitāṃ nāsti kiṃcana \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nidrādayaḥ śaktayaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛte kalāḥ \|*  
*lobhādayo hyadharmāśāstathā'haṃkārapañcamaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. О father, that is why the whole universe is the cause of illusion alone, in which the wise people do not attract grief and the intellectuals never indulge in the same. All the saktis like sleep, etc., are the rays of Prakriti. Desire, anger, greed, illusion and arrogance are the amsa of adharma or sin.

## \|\| 78.27-30 \|\|

*te brahmaviṣṇurudrāśā guṇāḥ sattvādayastrayaḥ \|*  
*jñānātmakaḥ śivo jyotirahamātmā ca nirguṇaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yadā viśāmi prakṛtau tadā'haṃ saguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*saguṇā viṣayā viṣṇuprahmarudrādayastathā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dharmo madaṃśo viṣayī śoṣaḥ sūryaḥ kalānidhiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ sarve satkalāṃśā munimanvādayaḥsurāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sarvadehe praviṣṭo'haṃ na liptaḥ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*jīvanmuktaśca madbhakto janmamṛtyujarāharaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

27-30. The athsas of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are reflected with sattva, tamas and rajas. The all knowledgeable Shiva and myself whom the form of the soul, when I enter into the Prakriti then I become saguna. Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are all saguna, in other words in these forms, I take up the task of reconstruction. Dharma, Shesha, Surya, the moon are all my amsas\\ similarly all the sages, the ascetics are also part of my amshas. I pervade in all the bodies in the worlds but I never get involved in anyone of them. My devotee always gets relieved of birth, death and old age.

## \|\| 78.31-32 \|\|

*sarvasiddheśvaraḥ śrīmānkīrtimānpaṇ̈ḍitaḥ kaviḥ \|*  
*caturstriśadvidhaḥ siddhaḥ sarvakarmopahārakaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tamupaimi svayaṃ siddhaṃ bhaktastvanyanna vāñchati \|*  
*dvāviṃśatividhaṃ siddhaṃ siddhisādhanakāraṇam \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. He becomes the great Siddha, virtuous, glorious, intellectual, poetic, achieves such four types of siddhis and can destroy the deeds. I always remain present in my devotees, my devotees do not want anything else. He is engaged in achieving siddhis which are known to have twenty two types.

## \|\| 78.33-37 \|\|

*manmukhācchūyatāṃ nanda siddhamantraṃ gṛhāṇa ca \|*  
*aṇimā laghimā prāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ mahimā tathā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca tathā kāmāvasāyitā \|*  
*dūraśravaṇameveti parakāyapraveśanam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*manoyāyitvameveti sarvajñatvamabhīpsitam \|*  
*vahnistambhaṃ jalastambhaṃ ciraṃjīvitvameva ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vāyustambhaṃ kṣutpipāsānidrāstambhanameva ca \|*  
*kāyavyūhaṃ ca vāksiddhiṃ mṛtānayanamaupsitam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sṛṣṭīnāṃ karaṇaṃ caiva prāṇākarṣaṇameva ca \|*  
*oṃ sarveśvareśvarāya sarvadighnavināśine madhusūdanāya svāheti \|\| 37 \|\|*

33-37. О Nanda, you listen to me about them from my mouth and receive the siddhamantra. The names of the siddhis are anima, Laghima, Prapti, Prakamya, Mahima, Isitva, Vasitva, Kamavasayita, Dura-sravana, Parakaya-pravesha, Manoyayitva, Sarvajnatva, Agnistambhana, Jalastambhana, Ciranjlvitva, Vayustambha, controlling of hunger, thirst and sleep, a Vaksiddhi, bringing up the dead body, the creation, pranayama. The relevant siddha mantra is …

## \|\| 78.38 \|\|

*ayaṃ santro mahāgūḍhaḥ sarveṣāṃ kalpapādapaḥ \|*  
*sāmavede ca kathitaḥ middhānāṃ sarvamiddhidaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. This mantra is quite secretive and is like kalpavrksa which has been prescribed in the Sdmaveda and provides all success to the siddhas.

## \|\| 78.39-40 \|\|

*anena yoginaḥ siddhā munīndrāśca surāstathā \|*  
*śatalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavetsatām \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yadi nārāyaṇakṣetre haviṣyānnarato japet \|*  
*gatvā kuru japaṃ tātakāśikāṃ maṇikarṇikām \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. All these yogis, the ascetics and the gods achieve success by reciting the mantras, by consuming the havisya food in the Narayana-ks etra; by reciting this mantra for a hundred lakhs of times, the intellectuals meet with success. О father, you go to Kas'I and recite this mantra over the Manikamika ghata.

## \|\| 78.41 \|\|

*śrṛśu nārāyaṇakṣetrai jalādhastaccatuṣṭayam \|*  
*atra nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī nānyaḥ svāmī kadācana \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. I am now talking to you about Narayana-ks etra which you may please listen to. Up to the width of four hands of the flowing water in the river, the place has been described as Narayana-ksetra, only Narayana happens to be the lord of this place and none else.

## \|\| 78.42 \|\|

*jñānaṃ cātra mṛte loke mūrtirbhavati tasya vai \|*  
*vrataṃ vinā'pi mantreṇa jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. A person who dies at that place, achieves salvation and divine knowledge. If anyone recites the mantras even without performing vrata, he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death; there is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 78.43-51 \|\|

*vrajaṃ kuru pavitraṃ ca vrajanātha vrajaṃ vraja \|*  
*pāpaṃ yaddarśane tāta kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 43 \|\|*

*duḥsvapnaṃ pāpabaujaṃ ca kevalaṃ vighnakāraṇam \|*  
*goghnaṃ ca brāhmaṇaghnaṃ vā kṛtaghnaṃ kṛṭilaṃ tathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*devaghnaṃ pitṛmātṛghnaṃ pāpaṃ viśvavāsaghātinam \|*  
*mithyāsākṣipradātāraṃ yaṃ cā''tithyavivañcanam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*grāmayājinameveti devaviprasvahāriṇam \|*  
*aśvatthaghātinaṃ duṣṭaṃ śivaviṣṇuvinindakam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*adīkṣitamanācāraṃ saṃdhyāhīnaṃ dvijaṃ tathā \|*  
*devalaṃ vṛṣavāhaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārakam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*śavadāhaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ śūdraśrāddhānnabhojinam \|*  
*avīrāṃ chinnanāsāṃ ca devabrāhmaṇanindakām \|\| 48 \|\|*

*padibhaktiviṅīnāṃ ca viṣṇubhaktivihīnakām \|*  
*śūdrāṇāṃ vidhavāṃ caiva cāṇḍālīṃ vyabhicāriṇīm \|\| 49 \|\|*

*śaśvatkopayutaṃ duṣṭamṛṇagrastaṃ ca jārajam \|*  
*cauraṃ mithyāvādinaṃ ca śaraṇāgatayāyinam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*māṃsāpahāriṇaṃ caiva brahmaṇaṃ vṛṣalīpatim \|*  
*brāhmaṇīgāmiraṃ śūdra dvijaṃ vādhurṣikaṃ tathā \|\| 51 \|\|*

43-51. О lord of Vraja, you go to Vraja and purify the place. О father, now I am telling you about the person by looking at whom one earns a sin. You please listen to me. The bad dream is the result of sinful ways and is the result of many of our actions. One earns sins by looking at the killer of a cow, the killer of a Brahmana, an ungrateful person, a wicked person, a destroyer of the images of the gods, the killer of the parents, a betrayer of the faith, a giver of false witness, those who extend ill treatment to beggars, those who performed yajnas in villages, the one who snatches away the livelihood of the gods and the Brahmanas, the one who cuts the plpala tree, the one who denounces Shiva and Vishnu, a person without Diksa, the Brahmana who falls in evil ways and those who are deprived of the sandhyas thrice a day. By looking at the pujari of a temple, the driver of the bulls, the store-keeper of the Siidras, the one who bums the dead bodies of the Siidras and takes the food of sraddha with them, a woman having no son or a husband, women with severed nose, those who denounce Brahmanas and the gods, a lady who is not devoted to Vishnu or her husband, a widow Shudra woman, a Chandala woman, a loose-woman and those who always remain in anger, the wicked person, the indebtors, varnasankaras, the thieves, those who always speak untruth, these who come to take refuge, the thieves of meat, a Brahmana having a Shudra as his wife, a Shudra cohabiting with a Brahmana woman, the money lender, the wicked person who cohabits with a Brahmana woman and a person who is denounced by all the varnas.

## \|\| 78.52-55 \|\|

*agamyāmāminaṃ duṣṭaṃ caturvaṇaṃ narādhamam \|*  
*mātā sapatnīmātā ca śvaśrūśca bhaginī sutā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*gurupatnī putrapatnī sodarasya priyā satī \|*  
*mātṛṣvasā pitṛṣvasā bhāmineyapriyā tathā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*mātulānī navoḍhā ya pitṛvyastrī rajasvalā \|*  
*pitṛmātṛprasūścaiva cāgamyāṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*kīrtitāḥ sāmavede ca paripālyāḥ satāṃ vraja \|*  
*etā dṛṣṭvā ca spṛṣṭvā ca brahmahatyāṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

52-55. The eighteen types of women have been described as inaccessible. They include the mother, the step-mother, the mother-in-law, wife of the teacher, wife of son, wife of the brother, sister of the mother, sister of the father, wife of the nephew, brother's wife, newly wedded wife of others, aunt, the women in period, mother of the father and the mother of the mother. О lord of Vraja, the list of these has been provided in the Samaveda which is fully supported by the people of wisdom. If anyone looks at them with side glances or touches them with evil intentions he earns the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 78.56 \|\|

*tasmāddaivena tā dṛṣṭvā sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ smaret \|*  
*kāmato yadi paśyanti vinindyāste bhavanti vai \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. In case one accidentally looks at them with an evil eye, he should at once worship Hari. Whosoever looks at them with passionate intentions, always earns denouncement.

## \|\| 78.57 \|\|

*tasmātsanto na paśyanti śāpabhītā vrajeśvara \|*  
*rāhugrastaṃ raviṃ sobhaṃ na paśyanti vipaścitaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. О lord of Vraja, therefore, the wise people never cast an evil eye on them. The intellectuals never look at the sun and the moon when they are eclipsed by Rahu.

## \|\| 78.58-59 \|\|

*janmāṣṭasaptariḥ phāṅkadaśamasthe divākare \|*  
*janmarkṣe nidhane cāpi caturthe'pi kalānidhau \|\| 58 \|\|*

*sarvairaṃśairna paśyanti kampitaṃ candrabhāskaram \|*  
*neṣṭacandro na dṛśyaśya bhādre māsi sitāsite \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. In case the son is in the house of the birth, the eighth house, the seventh house, the twelfth house, ninth house and tenth house and in that case one should not look at the sun. In case the moon is in the constellation of birth and the fourth and eighth house, then one should not look at the moon. The moon rising in the bright fort-night in the month of Bhadrapada is known as Nashtachandra. The intellectuals should not look at it.

## \|\| 78.60-61 \|\|

*caturthyāmuditaścandraḥ parityakto manīṣimiḥ \|*  
*candrastārāpaharaṇaṃ kalaṅgamatiduṣkaram \|\| 60 \|\|*

*tasmai dadāti he nanda kāmato di paśyati \|*  
*akāmato naro dṛṣṭvā mantrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. О Nanda, in case someone intentionally looks at the moon, he earns a blemish like the kidnapping of Tara by moon; in case anyone looks at it, unconsciously then one should drink the sanctified water.

## \|\| 78.62-63 \|\|

*tadā śuddho bhavetsadyo niṣkalaṅkī mahītale \|*  
*siṃhaḥ prasenamavadhītsiṃho jāmbavatā hataḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*sukumāraka mā rodīstava hyeṣa syamantakaḥ \|*  
*iti mantreṇa pūtaṃ ca jalaṃ sādhuḥ pibeddhruvam \|*  
*iti te kathitaṃ sarvamaparaṃ kathayāmi te \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. By doing so, a person is purified and is relieved of all sins on earth. The mantra which purifies the water is like this: О prince, don't cry, you take this Syamantaka gem because of which a lion had killed Prasena and the lion was killed by Jambavan. The water sanctified by this mantra should always be consumed. I have thus spoken all the essential things to you. What more shall I speak.

## Chapter 79

## \|\| 79.1 \|\|

*athaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca rāhugrastaḥ kathaṃ sūryaścandro vā'pi jagatprabho \|*  
*neṣṭaścandraḥ kathaṃ bhādre caturthyāṃ cāsite site \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Nanda said – О lord of the universe, why is the viewing of the sun and moon eclipsed by Rahu and the moon on the fourth day of the bright fortnight is prohibited?

## \|\| 79.2 \|\|

*vedānāṃ janakastvaṃ ca kaṃ pṛcchāmitvayā vinā \|*  
*vede purāṇe gopyaṃ yanna jānanti vipaśyitaḥ \|*  
*iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā cedaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. You are the creator of the Vedas, therefore who else could be consulted on the subject? This is a secret topic in the Vedas as well as in the Puranas. Because of this, even the people with wisdom are not aware of the same. On hearing this, the lord said to him.

## \|\| 79.3-4 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca atathyaṃ vacanaṃ cedaṃ niṣiddhaṃ vaidikairapi \|*  
*kṣamasva nanda bhadraṃ te praśnamanyaṃ kuruṣva mām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*biśvastaṃ vacanaṃ tāta na prakāśyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ \|*  
*vighnaḥ prakāśe bhavati satāṃ chidraṃ ca daivataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The lord said – The revealing of this secret is prohibited in the Vedas; therefore you please forgive me and you ask for something else. О father, the secret things are not revealed by the learned people, because by doing so some obstructions or dissension's are created among the intellectuals.

## \|\| 79.5 \|\|

*nanda uvāca kathayasva jagannātha na bhakte v̈añcanaṃ kuru \|*  
*adṛśyau cāpi deveśau rāhugrastau ca puṣyadau \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Nanda said – О lord of the universe, you kindly tell me. Do not deprive a devotee of the knowledge; why are the sun and the moon getting eclipsed considered as auspicious?

## \|\| 79.6-7 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu nanda pravakṣayāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm \|*  
*yāṃ śrutvā niṣkalaṅkaśca tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sarvapātakinaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatpāpaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*ākhyānaśravaṇonaiva bhasmībhūtaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Lord Krishna said – О Nanda, I an going to narrate to you an old story by listening to which, a man is freed from blemish and earns the merit of having a bath in a holy place. I am going to tell you the same. You please listen. The sin one earns after looking at a most sinful person-all such sins are washed out by listening to the story.

## \|\| 79.8-11 \|\|

*ekadā jamadagniśca mahākautūhalānvitaḥ \|*  
*reṇukāsahitastuṣṭo jagāma narmadātaṭam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nirjane narmadātīre vijahāra tayā saha \|*  
*navoḍhayā ca sundaryā navayauvanayuktayā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*suveṣayā susmitayā ratnabhūṣaṇayuktayā \|*  
*natayā stanabhāreṇa śroṇībhāreṇa mandayā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sundarīṇāmatulayā śvetacampakavarṇayā \|*  
*supūrṇacandrānanayā kaṭākṣayutayā tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. Once, Jamadagni delightfully went to the bank of Narmada together with his wife Renuka. He enjoyed the water-sport with her on the bank of the river; she was newly wedded, beautiful, quite youthful, clad in beautiful garments, wearing a serene smile on the face, adorned with the best of ornaments studded with gems, heaving with the weight of her breasts, having a developed pelvic region, moving slowly, the best of the beauties, having the complexion of white campaka flowers and the face like the full moon and the sharp side-glances.

## \|\| 79.12-16 \|\|

*atīvasūkṣmāmbarayā kāmabāṇārtayā vraja \|*  
*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgasaṃbhogenāpi mūrcchayā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*puṃskokilayute ramye śabdite sumadhuvrate \|*  
*sugandhivāyusaṃyukte puṣpatalpānvite śubhe \|\| 13 \|\|*

*candanokṣitasarpāṅgaṃ vastramālyadharaṃ munim \|*  
*mahārāsarasāḍhyaṃ tamuvāca bhāskaraḥ svayam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vedakartuḥ prapautrastavaṃ brahmaṇaśca jagatvateḥ \|*  
*caturvedavidheyeṣu suniṣṇātaḥ sadā śuciḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vedāṅgakartā dharmajñaḥ śreṣṭho vedavidāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*mahātapasvī tejasvī brahmacārī ca suvratī \|\| 16 \|\|*

12-16. О lord of Vraja, she was clad in extremely fine garments and was filled with passion; she was feeling emotional and had fainted after the union. The sweet notes of the cuckoos, the hissing sound of the black wasps, the fragrant breeze, the flower beds arranged on the bank of the river looked quite fine. The sage had his body plastered with sandal-paste and having the rosary on the clothes, was engaged in the love-sport with the damsel. At that point of time the sun spoke to him, "You are the great grandson of Brahma the lord of the universe, who happens to be the creator of the Vedas. You are yourself quite well-versed in the Vedas and the post-Vedic literature, well-versed in the dharma, the best of those well-versed in the Vedas, a great ascetic, illustrious, a Brahmacarl and performer of the best of vratas.".

## \|\| 79.17-18 \|\|

*yuṣmadvidhoktaṃ śāstraṃ ca paṭhitvā'nyaśca paṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*vedapraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dharma tyajati dharmajño hyadharmeṇa rataḥ katham \|*  
*divāmaithunadoṣaṃ ca vakti vedo viśeṣataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The people attain wisdom with the study of the scriptures composed by you. It is quite religious to act according to the provision of the Vedas and to act against them is quite sinful. Therefore, being well-versed in the dharma, why are you acting in an opposite manner? How have you been indulging in the sinful ways when the Vedas prohibit union between a man and woman during the day time?

## \|\| 79.19-20 \|\|

*ahaṃ ca dharmiṇāṃ sākṣī tena tvāṃ kathayāmi te \|*  
*sūryasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tatyāja maithunaṃ dvijaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā puro viprarūpaṃ sūrya tejasvinaṃ suram \|*  
*uvāca sūrya raktāsyaḥ kopalajjāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*reṇukā lajjitā tatra vidhārya vāsasī satī \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. I am the witness of all the religious people; that is why I am speaking to you like this. On hearing the words of the sun the sage stopped enjoying the conjugal pleasures and finding Surya having been turned into the form of a Brahmana, the sage was over-powered with shame and anger. His mouth became red in anger. Renuka also hurriedly clad herself in the garments.

## \|\| 79.21-28 \|\|

*jamadagniruvāca ko bhavānpaṇ̈ḍitaṃmanyo na tvadanyo'sti paṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ bhṛgorbhagavataḥ śiṣyastvaṃ kaśyapasya ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

*caturvedāṃśca jānāmi dharmādharmanirūpaṇo \|*  
*vedapraṇihito dharme hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*ajñānī puruṣaḥ śaśvajjaḍitaśca svakarmaṇā \|*  
*tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vaṅneḥ sarvabhujo yathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*anye bhavāṃśca dharmaśca sākṣī sarve ca karmaṇām \|*  
*phaladātā ca śāstrajño yatastvattanayaḥ sadā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*na vaiṣṇavānāṃ śāstāro yūyamasmākameva ca \|*  
*na vāsudevabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit \|\| 25 \|\|*

*hareḥ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ śaśvadrakṣati vaiṣṇavān \|*  
*nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānsvayaṃ brahmā ca śaṃkaraḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*śāstā yamaśca nāsmākaṃ tvaṃ vai nāpi divākara \|*  
*rājaputro yathā sthāne vayaṃ svacchandagāminaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*śakto'haṃ bhasmasātkartuṃ yamaṃ sarvasurāṃstathā \|*  
*mahendraprabhṛtīnsūrya kṣaṇenaivāvalīlayā \|\| 28 \|\|*

21-28. Jamadagni said – How do you consider yourself a great intellectual; is there no other intellectual on earth beside you? I am a pupil of sage Bhrigu and you happen to be a pupil of sage Kashyapa. I am quite well-versed in all the four Vedas and the provisions of dharma and the sins prescribed there in. The actions according to the Vedas are considered to be dharma and the opposite of the same is called sinful. Whatever you have spoken now is meant for the people without wisdom and those who are inactive having been surrounded with their own deeds. But the illustrious person while moving in an opposite direction does not earn and sin like the fire flames which consumes everything. The people, yourself and all others are witnesses of dharma and your son named dharma also bestows the reward for the deeds, still you do not happen to be the rulers of the Vaishnavas like us. The devotees of lord Vasudeva never meet with any evil because the Sudarsana-cakra of the lord always protects them. Therefore, О son, none of the gods like Narayana, lord Brahma, Shiva, Yama and you yourself can control us. We people always move at will like the princes. I can reduce all the people including Yama and the gods to ashes. О son, I can make Mahendra and others lifeless just in a moment.

## \|\| 79.29-30 \|\|

*kastvaṃ dharmapravaktā me yāhi svasthānameva ca \|*  
*mama śāstā tu bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*adya me nirjane sthāne rasabhaṅgastvayā kṛtaḥ \|*  
*mama śāṇatpāpa dṛśyo rāhugrasto bhaviṣyasi \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. How could you be the spokesperson for me? You go to your abode, Shri Krishna happens to be my only lord who is beyond Prakriti. Arriving in this lonely place, you have destroyed my conjugal pleasures. Because of this, you would disappear due to your being eclipsed by Rahu.

## \|\| 79.31-33 \|\|

*draṣṭuṃ tvāṃ ye ghanāḥ sarve dūrībhūtā bhavanti te \|*  
*tvāmācchannaṃ kariṣyanti vāyunā preritāstathā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*svatejasā bhavāngarvāddhatatejā bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*meghācchannaḥ svalpatejā rāhugrasto bhavānbhava \|\| 32 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānbhāskaraḥ svayam \|*  
*tataḥ puṭāñjalirbhūtvā tuṣṭāva munipuṃgavam \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. The clouds who used to arrive to have a look at you always remained at a distance from you but with the blowing of the wind they would cover you and your arrogance and lustre would disappear with then. Getting covered by the clouds, you would lose your lustre and you would be eclipsed by Rahu. Listening to the words of Brahmana, the sun offered prayers to Jamadagni with folded hands

## \|\| 79.34-41 \|\|

*bhāskara uvāca avadhyāḥ sarve dharmajña dhanyā mānyāḥ puraskṛtāḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇaśca bhagavāñchaṃbhurbrahmā svayaṃ prabhuḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*gaṇeśāścāpi śeṣaśca dharmaścāpi sanātanaḥ \|*  
*stuvānti brahmaṇaṃ sarve viprarūpī janārdanaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vipradattaśca yo brahmanvayamasmanmukho dvijaḥ \|*  
*hutāśanaśca dvimukhāḥ surāḥ sarve dvijo varaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*kṣamasva vaiṣṇavaḥ śuddhaḥ svadharma sa samācara \|*  
*vaiṣṇavānāṃ kṛtaḥ kopo hṛdi yeṣāṃ janārdanaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*asmābhiḥ pūjitā viprā yuṣamābhiḥ pūjitāḥ surāḥ \|*  
*parasparaṃ snehapātraṃ cedamācaraṇaṃ dvija \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ahamevaṃ tvayā śapto mayā śapto bhavānbhava \|*  
*anyathā māṃ vadantyevaṃ sūrya nistejasaṃ janāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*parābhūtaḥ kṣatriyeṇa bhaviṣyasi dvijeśvara \|*  
*maraṇaṃ kṣatriyāstreṇa bhavataśca bhaviṣyati \|\| 40 \|\|*

*sūryasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa brāhmaṇaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*taṃ śaśāpātiraktāsyaḥ śaṃbhunā nirjito bhavān \|\| 41 \|\|*

34-41. The sun said – О well-versed in dharma, all the Brahmanas are adorable, graceful and respected, even lord Narayana, Shiva, Brahma, Ganesha, Shesha, eternal dharma and even Janardana in the form of a Brahmana, adore the Brahmanas. О Brahmana, we are receiving everything that is given by the Brahmanas. The Brahmanas as well as the god of fire are extremely important for us, they happen to be the mouths for all the gods. The Brahmanas are the best and you happen to be the pure Vaishnava. You perform your dharma. The Vaishnavas are devoid of anger, in whose mind the lord Janardana always resides. The Brahmanas are adorable by us and you adore all the gods. Therefore, О Brahmana, this type of conduct begets mutual love. If you have pronounced a curse on me, I am also going to pronounce a curse on you, because otherwise you would feel that the sun has no lustre. Therefore, О Brahmana, you would he defeated by a Kshatriya and you would meet your end with the weapon of a Kshatriya. On hearing the words of the sun, the Brahmana was again enraged as a result of which his face became extremely red, he pronounced another curse on the sun saying, You would be defeated by Shiva.

## \|\| 79.42-43 \|\|

*ubhayoḥ kalahaṃ jñātvā kaśyapena saha vraja \|*  
*ājagāma svayaṃ brahmā vidhātā jagatāmapi \|\| 42 \|\|*

*āgatya brahmā saṃtrastaṃ bodhayāmāsa bhāskaram \|*  
*muniśreṣṭhaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ dharmajñānāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. О lord of Vraja, knowing about the dispute of both of them, Brahma and Kashyapa arrived there. On their arrival Brahma, the teacher of all, the well-known persons spoke to the panic-stricken Surya and the extremely religious sage Jamadagni.

## \|\| 79.44-47 \|\|

*brahmovāca kṣamasva bhāskara tvaṃ ca sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavān \|*  
*yuṣmākaṃ paripālyaścāpyavadhyo brāhmaṇāḥ sadā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ahaṃ karomi bhavato vipraśāpāntamulbaṇam \|*  
*atrāhamāgatastrasto bhṛguṇā preritastataḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sphuṭo'haṃ preritaścāpi kaśyapena marīcinā \|*  
*śānto bhava surakṣeṣṭha sākṣītvaṃ sarvakarmaṇām \|\| 46 \|\|*

*kutraciddivase brahmaṃstvaṃ tatra kutracitkṣaṇam \|*  
*bhaviṣyasi ghanācchannaḥ sadyo mukto bhaviṣyasi \|\| 47 \|\|*

44-47. Brahma said – О sun, you are the form of Narayana, therefore you forgive the Brahmana who is to be maintained by you and is not to be killed. I would reveal to you the result of the curse pronounced by you because I have arrived here getting terrified at the instance of Bhrigu, Kashyapa and Marichi. Therefore I am going to speak out plainly. О best of the gods, you be peaceful, you are the witness of all the people, sometime you would be covered by the clouds but then again you would be freed from the same.

## \|\| 79.48-49 \|\|

*nyūnātirakte varṣe ca rāhugrasto bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*tatrādṛśyaśca keṣāṃcitpuṇyadṛśyo hi kasyacit \|\| 48 \|\|*

*anyathā sarvakālena puṇyadṛśyo bhavānbhuvi \|*  
*tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca namaskṛtya sarve niṣpāpino janāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. You would be eclipsed by Rahu when the year has a short or the access of a month. At that point of time you would not be looked at by the people but for some people looking at you would be quite meritorious. Besides this a look at you at all the times would bestow merit. People would be relieved of their sins by going before you.

## \|\| 79.50-51 \|\|

*janmasaptāṣṭariḥ phāṅkacaturthe daśame tathā \|*  
*janmarkṣe nidhanai naṇāmadṛśyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi \|\| 50 \|\|*

*astakāle ghanācchanne madhyāhanasthe jale'pi vā \|*  
*ardhodite ca kāne ca pāpadṛśyo bhaviṣyasi \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. By remaining in the house of birth, the seventh, eighth, tenth, ninth, fourth and tenth house, you would be invisible for the people and similarly at the time of sunset, with the sky over-cast with clouds, at noon, in the water and when half risen, your viewing would earn sin for the people.

## \|\| 79.52-53 \|\|

*bhāryāduḥkhanimittena bhāryayā hetubhūtayā \|*  
*śvaśureṇa śālakena hatatejā bhaviṣyasi \|\| 52 \|\|*

*anyathā tava tejaśca saṃjñā sahitumakṣamā \|*  
*mālīsumāliyuddhe ca śaṃbhunā tvaṃ parācitaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Because of the grief of the wife, moving in the forest or the abode of father-in-law and wives' brothers your lustre would be reduced. Otherwise your wife Sanjna would be unable to bear your heat. You would be defeated by Shiva while engaged in the battle with the demons named Mall and Sumali.

## \|\| 79.54-57 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sūrya ca bodhayāmāsa brāhmaṇam \|*  
*namraṃ śāpaparābhūtaṃ lajjitaṃ kopitaṃ vraja \|\| 54 \|\|*

*he vipra śvagṛhaṃ gaccha gaccha vatsa yathāsukham \|*  
*tvattejasā kṣaṇenaiva bhasmībhūtaṃ bhavejjagat \|\| 55 \|\|*

*sūryastvatparipālyaśca bhavānsūryasya nityaśaḥ \|*  
*parasparaṃ ca pūjyaśca saṃbandhaḥ poṣyapoṣkaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*haryaśena kṣatriyeṇa kārtavīryārjunena ca \|*  
*bhaviṣyasi na saṃdehaḥ parābhūto dvijo mṛtaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

54-57. О lord of Vraja, thus speaking to Surya, Brahma further said to the Brahmana who was quite humble, defeated by the curse, feeling shameful and enraged. He said, "O Brahmana, now you go to your abode." О son, you can reduce the entire universe to ashes in a moment. Instead of behaving like that you comfortably go to your abode because you have to serve the sun always and the sun to you. Thus the relation between both of you is adorable and stands and stands for survival of both of you. A king named Kartavirya Arjuna would be born in the race of Kshatriya and you would be defeated at his hand and meet with your end.

## \|\| 79.58-59 \|\|

*purā te prāktanaṃ sarva kadācinna hi khaṇḍitam \|*  
*nārāyaṇāśca svāṃśona tava putro bhaviṣyati \|\| 58 \|\|*

*triḥ saptakṛtvo jagatīṃ niḥkṣatrāṃ ca kariṣyati \|*  
*mṛtyuste yaśaso bījaṃ bhadiṣyati mahītale \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Your path of the birth and death has not been destroyed so far but Narayana would be your son from his arhsha who would relieve the earth of Ks aU'iyas, twenty one times and your death at the hands of a Kshatriya would earn glory in the universe.

## \|\| 79.60-63 \|\|

*ityevamukttā brahmā ca yayau gehaṃ vrajeśvara \|*  
*prayayau jamadagniśca bhāskaraśca svamandiram \|\| 60 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tāta ākhyānaṃ puṇyakārakam \|*  
*rāhugrasto bhāskaraścāpyadṛśyo yena hetunā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*caturthyāmuditaścandro bhādre māsi sitāsite \|*  
*adṛśyo naṣṭarūpaśca śrūyatāṃ yena heturā \|\| 62 \|\|*

*rāhugrastaḥ kalaṅkī vā purāśapto mayā pitaḥ \|*  
*sarva tvāṃ kathayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm \|\| 63 \|\|*

60-63. О lord of Vraja, after thus speaking Brahma went to the Brahmaloka. Thereafter Bhaskara and Jamadagni also reverted to their respective places. О father, the reason for which the sun is eclipsed and is not to be viewed during that time, the same reason has been highlighted by me. О father, I shall now narrate to you the old story relating to the prohibiting of the viewing of the moon during the fourth day of the black fortnight of the month of Bhadrapada and the reason for the sun getting eclipsed with the curse of the sage are related to the old story which I am going to tell you now.

## Chapter 80

## \|\| 80.1-10 \|\|

*athāśotitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca purā tārā guroḥ patnī navayauvanasaṃyutā \|*  
*ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyā varasūkṣmāmbarā satī \|\| 1 \|\|*

*suśroṇī sasmitā ramya sundarī sumanoharā \|*  
*atīva kabarīramyā mālatīmālyabhūṣitā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*mindūrabindunā sākaṃ cārucaṃdanabindubhi \|*  
*kastūrībindunā'dhaśca bhālamadhyasthalojjvalā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ratnendrasāranirmāṇakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitā \|*  
*suvakralocanā śyāmā sucārukajjalojjvalā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*sucārusāramuktābhadantapaṅktimanoharā \|*  
*ratnakuṇḍalayugmena cārugaṇḍasthalojjvalā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kāminīṣvatulā bālā gajendramandagāminī \|*  
*sukomalā candramukhī kāmādhārā ca kāmukī \|\| 6 \|\|*

*svargamandākinītīre snātā snigdhāmbarā varā \|*  
*dhyāyantī gurupādaṃ sā svagṛhaṃ gamanonmukhī \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā tasyāśca sarvāṅgamanaṅgabāṇapīḍitaḥ \|*  
*bhādre caturthyāṃ candraśca jahāra cetanāṃ vraja \|\| 8 \|\|*

*jñānaṃ kṣaṇena saṃprāpya rathastho ramiko balī \|*  
*rathamārohayāmāsa kare dhṛtvā ca tārakam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kāmonmattaḥ kāminīṃ tāṃ samāśliṣya cucumba ca \|*  
*śṛṅgāraṃ kartumudyuktaṃ tamuvāca gurupriyā \|\| 10 \|\|*

1-10. Shri Krishna said – In earlier times, Tara, the wife of teacher Brihaspati was quite youthful, adorned with gem-studded ornaments, clad in extremely fine garments, was quite chaste, having a developed pelvic region, wearing a serene smile on her face, quite charming, beautiful and good looking, her hair was adorned with the garland of jasmine flowers, she had a developed forehead with sandal-paste and a spot of vermilion and kastUrl. She wore anklets which were made of the best of gems, she had beautiful side-glances and collyrium was applied over her eyes, she had beautiful teeth like jewels. She had a pair of ear ornaments which adorned her temples. Thus the beautiful damsel walked like an elephant, quite slowly, having tender limbs, a moon like face and was quite passionate. She after taking a bath in the river Mandakini was adorned with wet garment. With her mind devoted to the feet of her husband, as soon as she was about to leave for her home, the moon was infatuated with passion at the sight of her beautiful figure and fainted. О lord of Vraja, this moon fainted on the fourth day of the bright fortnight and he retained consciousness. Mounted on the chariot he forcibly carried Tara holding her with her hand and mounted her on the chariot. Getting passionate, he carried her on the chariot and embraced her. Then the moon was found getting ready for a union with her, Tara spoke to him.

## \|\| 80.11-12 \|\|

*tārakovāca tyaja māṃ tyaja māṃ candra sureṣu kulapāṃsana \|*  
*gurupatnīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ ca pātivratyaparāyaṇām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*gurupatnīsaṃgamane brahmahatyāśataṃ bhavet \|*  
*gurupatnī viprapatnī yadi sā ca pativratā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Tara said – О moon you leave me, О blemish for the gods, leave me alone. I happen to be the wife of your teacher and also the daughter of a Brahmana, I have always been chaste and virtuous. One has to earn the sin of hundred Brahmahatyas by cohabiting with the wife of a teacher. If the wife of a teacher happens to be the daughter of a Brahmana and a chaste one, cohabiting with her earns the sins of a thousand Brahmahatyas.

## \|\| 80.13-17 \|\|

*brahmahatyāsahasraṃ ca tasyāḥ saṃgamane labhet \|*  
*putrastvaṃ tava mātā'haṃ dhairya kuru sureśvāra \|\| 13 \|\|*

*dhiktvāṃ śrutvā suragururbhasmībhūtaṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*putrādhikaśca śiṣyaśca priyo matsvāmino bhavān \|\| 14 \|\|*

*svadharma rakṣa pāpiṣṭha māmevaṃ mātaraṃ tyaja \|*  
*dāsyāmi strīvadhaṃ tumyaṃ yadimāṃ saṃgrahīṣyasi \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vilaṅdhya tārāvacanaṃ tāṃ ca saṃbhoktumudyatam \|*  
*śaśāpa tārā kopena niṣkāmā sā pativratā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*rāhugrasto ghanagrastaḥ pāpadṛśyo bhavānbhava \|*  
*kalaṅkī yakṣmaṇā grasto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

13-17. Therefore, lord of gods, you be patient, look I happen to be your mother and you happen to be my son. In case you indulge in such a type of deplorable action, you will earn disgrace and on hearing this Brihaspati, the teacher of the gods would reduce you to ashes. You happen to be the pupil of my husband and are dear to him like his own son. Therefore, sinful one, don't indulge in this. You leave the mother like me free and protect the dharma and in case you would touch me again I shall shower on you the sin of the killing of a woman. The moon a on the other hand, did not listen to the words of Tara and got ready to cohabit with her. At this Tarn who was free from passion and was quite chaste, became enraged and pronounced a curse on him, "You would be eclipsed by Rahu, covered with the clouds and would be quite sinful to look at. You would be filled with blemish and suffer from the disease of consumption. There is no doubt about it.".

## \|\| 80.18-19 \|\|

*candraṃ śaptvā tadā tūrṇa kāmadevaṃ śaśāpa sā \|*  
*tejasvinā kenacittvaṃ bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyasi \|\| 18 \|\|*

*candrastārāṃ gṛhītvā ca kṛtvā'pi ramaṇaṃ vraja \|*  
*kroḍenidhāya prayayau rudatīṃ tā śucā'nvitām \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Thus pronouncing a curse on the moon she also pronounced a curse on the god of love, "You would be reduced to ashes by an illustrious person. О lord of Vraja, thereafter the moon caught hold of Tara and enjoyed her company who was crying and sobbing. He took her in his lap and moved from that place.

## \|\| 80.20-22 \|\|

*nirjane nirjane ramye śaile śaile manohare \|*  
*saronadanadīnāṃ ca tīre tīre manohare \|\| 20 \|\|*

*madhuvratapikokte ca puṣpodyāne supuṣpite \|*  
*ramyāyāṃ puṣpaśathyāyāṃ sa reme rāmayā saha \|\| 21 \|\|*

*cadanokṣitasarvāṅgo madhupānarataḥ suraḥ \|*  
*sukhasaṃbhogasaṃsakto bubudhe na divāniśam \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Thereafter he took her to secluded places, the charming and beautiful mountains pools, rivers and rivulets, the beautiful valleys, the flower orchards which were surrounded by the black wasps and the cuckoos issuing sweet notes. He also took her to the flower orchards and enjoyed her company on a bed of flowers. Thus the moon having his body plastered with the sandal-paste, consuming beverages and was so immensely absorbed in the company of Tara that he lost track of day and night.".

## \|\| 80.23-30 \|\|

*malaye malayāraṇye malayānilasaṃyute \|*  
*syandane candanavane paścimodadhisaṃnidhau \|\| 23 \|\|*

*trikūṭe vaṭamūle ca tatra candrasarovare \|*  
*sucāruśatapatrāṇāṃ patre candanacarcite \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sucārucampakodyāne campakānilapūjite \|*  
*kṣīrodakāñcanībhūmau krauñcakāñcanaparvate \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ratnaśaile maṇimaye maṇimandirasundare \|*  
*māṇikyamuktāsāreṇa hīrahāreṇa śobhite \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sucāruvastracitrāḍhye śvetacāmāradarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*bhūṣite ratnadīpaiśca devakrīḍe priyasthale \|\| 27 \|\|*

*vāruṇīṃ madirāṃ pītvā varuṇānīsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*baruṇo ramate yatra tatra reme tayā saha \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pāvane pavanodyāne parijātānilena ca \|*  
*sugandhimohite ratnamālātīre ca nirmale \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ṛkṣaśaile kalpavṛkṣavane vahnipriyāśrame \|*  
*papau ca kāmadhenūnāṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīrodadhestaṭe \|\| 30 \|\|*

23-30. He moved on the chariot to the Malaya mountain and Malaya forest with the fragrant breeze blowing in the forest of sandal-wood, the shores of the western ocean peaks of the Trikuta mountain, under the shed of the banyan tree, in the pool, over the lotus leaves plastered with sandal-paste, in the charming orchard, of the campaka flowers, on the land of sea-shore of the ocean of milk, over the Kraunca mountain, mountain of gold, mountain of gems, mountain of rubies, sapphire and diamond which looked quite beautiful. They were decorated with different types of costumes, white fly-whisks, the mirrors, lamps of gems. They visited places of love sports, loving places and consumed the intoxicated beverages at the places were Varuna cohabits with Varunanl. The same places were used by the moon to enjoy the company of Tara. Thereafter they went to the sacred orchard on the bank of the river Ratnamala, the Rksa mountain, the forest of kalpavrksa and the abode of Svaha, the beloved of Agni. The moon enjoyed the company of Tara. Then they reached the shore of the ocean of milk and consumed the milk of Kamadhenu.

## \|\| 80.31-32 \|\|

*vahniśuddhāṃśukayugaṃ vahnistasmai dadau mudā \|*  
*varuṇo ratnamālāṃ ca natnacchatraṃ samīraṇaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tatra dṛṣṭvā'suraguraṃ baligehātsamāgatam \|*  
*praṇamya sarvamuktvā ca candrastaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. He presented her with a pair of garments sanctified by fire. Varuna gave the garland of gems and the wind god presented a gem-studded chatra.

## \|\| 80.33 \|\|

*śukrastaṃ bodhayāmāsa vacanaṃ nītiyuktitaḥ \|*  
*nirapekṣo suniśreṣṭho vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. In the meantime, he spotted the sage SukrScarya who had returned from the abode of Bali. The moon bowed before him and narrated to him the entire story, taking refuge with him. Sukracarya, the best of the sages who was well-versed in the Vedas and post-Vedic literature, tried to convince him with appropriate words.

## \|\| 80.34-35 \|\|

*śukra uvāca śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi gurave dehi tārakām \|*  
*śaṃbhośca suruputrāya pautrāya brahmaṇaśca vai \|\| 34 \|\|*

*pūjitāya surārṇā ca deyā tasmai niśāpate \|*  
*priyāya tatpriryāṃ dattavā śīghraṃ tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Sukra said – О son listen to me, whatever I tell you, you hand over Tara to Brihaspati, who is the pupil of Shiva, since you are the son of his teacher and the great grandson of Brahma. You hand over the beloved of your teacher, who is adored by the gods and at once take refuse with him.

## \|\| 80.36-37 \|\|

*gurupatnīṃ mātṛtulyāṃ tyaja sadvacanādvidho \|*  
*kuru pāpakṣayaṃ pāpanivṛttistu mahāphalā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*satīnāṃ gurupatnīrnāṃ grahaṇe ca balena ca \|*  
*brahmahatyāsahasrārṇāṃ pātakaṃ labhate janaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. О virtuous one, at my command you release the wife of your teacher because she happens to be like your mother and perform repentance for your sin, because it is quite virtuous to get relieved of the ill effects of the sin. By forcibly cohabiting with the chaste wife of the teacher was to earn the sins of a thousand Brahmahatyas.

## \|\| 80.38-39 \|\|

*kumbhīpāke ca pacyante yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam \|*  
*sāmyaṃ nārāyaṇasthāne tṛṇaparvatayoḥ sura \|\| 38 \|\|*

*kastvaṃ vatsa hareḥ sthāne karmabhogo'sti brahmaṇaḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇāśrītāḥ sarve jīvinastrividhā bhave \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. He also falls in the kumbhlpaka hell and has to live there up to the life of a hundred Brahma's. The lord Narayana treats equally all from a blade of grass to Brahma. Therefore, О son, in case even Brahma has to face the result of his deeds, then you are of no consequence, all the gods, the demons and all the three types of creatures are depending on Narayana alone.

## Chapter 81

## \|\| 81.1 \|\|

*athaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa uvāya etasminnantare śukraḥ surakṣeṇīṃ dadarśa saḥ \|*  
*ākāśamārgādāyāntīṃ raṇaśastrāstradhāriṇīm \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shri Krishna said – In the meantime Sukra witnessed Devasena (army of gods) who was moving through the sky, wearing a coat of arms.

## \|\| 81.2-3 \|\|

*patākārnāṃ trikoṭiśca śatakoṭirmahārathāḥ \|*  
*śatakoṭirgajendrārṇāṃ rathārnāṃ taccaturguṇam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*aśvārnāṃ tatchataguṇaṃ samūhaṃ ca sudāruṇam \|*  
*padātīrnāṃ samūhaṃ ca turaṅgebhyaśca ṣaḍguṇam \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. In the army there were three crores of flags, hundred crores of great chariots, hundred crores of elephants and four times more chariots, four times the terrific horses and six times more of the number of horses were the foot soldiers.

## \|\| 81.4 \|\|

*duṃdūbhīvādyabhāṇḍānāṃ pañcalakṣaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*paṭahānāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca ḍiṇḍimānāṃ dvilakṣakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. There were five lakhs of trumpets besides other musical instruments, three lakhs of drums and two lakhs of small drums.

## \|\| 81.5-7 \|\|

*airāvate mahendraṃ ca śvetāśve dharmameva ca \|*  
*kuberaṃ varuṇaṃ vahniṃ rathasthaṃ pavanaṃ tathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*mahiṣasthaṃ yamaṃ caiva syandanasthaṃ divākaram \|*  
*īśānaṃ ca vṛṣendrasthamanantaṃ nāgavāham \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ādityāṃśca vasūnrudrānsiddhagandharvākinnarān \|*  
*jīvanmuktamunīnāṃ ca samīhaṃ sūryavarcasam \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Mahendra mounted on the Airavata, Dharma on the white horse. Kubera, Varuna, Agni and the wind god mounted on chariots. The god of death mounted on a buffalo, Surya mounted on a chariot, Shiva mounted on a bull and Ananta mounted on a serpent. The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Siddhas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras and the sages having the lustre of the sun were also moving.

## \|\| 81.8-9 \|\|

*tāndṛṣṭvā nirbhayaḥ śukraḥ samāśvāsya niśākaram \|*  
*surāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ sainyamājuhāva vrajeśvara \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ratnamālānadītīre hutāśanapriyāśrame \|*  
*tatra tasthau daityasainyaṃ puṇyakṣīrodadhestaṭe \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. О lord of Vraja, looking at the army of gods, Sukra remained unmoved and assuring the moon, he summoned double the army. The army of the demons was lodged on the shore of the ocean of milk, the banks of Ratnamala river and the asrama of Agnipriya.

## \|\| 81.10-14 \|\|

*etasminnantare śukaḥ samīpe sarasastaṭe \|*  
*puṇyāśrame'kṣayavaṭe surasainyātsamāgatam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*dadarśa vṛṣabhasthaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ sarvaṃśaṃkaram \|*  
*triśalapaṭṭīśadharaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ varam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tejaḥsvarūpaṃ paramaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|*  
*sardasaṃpatpradātāraṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sarveśvaraṃ sarvapūjyaṃ sarvahūpaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃparitrāṇaparāyaṇam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sasmitaṃ paramātmānaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|*  
*saṃtrastaḥ sahasotthāya praṇanāma padāmbuje \|\| 14 \|\|*

10-14. In the meantime Sukra the spotted Shiva who had arrived there with the army of gods, camping near the bank of the pool under the eternal banyan tree. He mounted on a bull, bestowed welfare and was holding the trident and pattisha as weapons. He was clad in tiger skin, possessed great lustre and had taken to human form to grace his devotees. He was bestower of all the riches, all knowledgeable, the cause of all, the lord of all adorable by all, the eternal one, always anxious to help the grief-stricken people who come to take refuge with him, wearing a serene smile on the face and was illumining with the eternal lustre. Sukra became upset, got up at once, went to him and bowed at his feet.

## \|\| 81.15-18 \|\|

*dadau śubhāśiṣaṃ tasmai suprasannaḥ parātparaḥ \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsane taṃ ca vāsayāmāsa sādaram \|\| 15 \|\|*

*atha tatrāntare vipraṃ puratastaṃ dadarśa saḥ \|*  
*śāntaṃ svayaṃ vidhātāraṃ ratnasyandanamundaram \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānaṃ ratnamālāvibhūṣitam \|*  
*prasannaṃ susmitaṃ śuddhaṃ jagatāmīśvaraṃ param \|\| 17 \|\|*

*karmaṇāṃ phaladātāraṃ taporūpaṃ tapaśvinām \|*  
*vedānāṃ janakaṃ vedaprasūṃ kāntaṃ manoharam \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. Getting extremely pleased lord Shiva who is beyond everything pronounced a blessing on him. Thereafter, Sukra made him sit on the gem-studded lion throne. О Brahmana, in the meantime Sukra spotted Brahma also who was peaceful, the creator of the universe and was mounted on a beautiful chariot of gems, clad in divine garments sanctified by fire, adorned with the rosary of crystal beads, having a delightful face, wearing a smile on the face. He was the supreme lord of the spotless universe, granter of boons, tapas for the ascetics, the creator of the Vedas, the source of the Vedas and was quite charming to look at.

## \|\| 81.19-21 \|\|

*puṭāñjalistadā trastaḥ praṇanāma sureśvaram \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*pūjāṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca tayoścaraṇapaṅkaje \|*  
*nocitaṃ kuśalapraśnaṃ tayoḥ kalyāṇameva ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

*vidhātā jagatāṃ nanda śakācāryaṃ purasthitam \|*  
*sunītiṃ kathayāmāsa yatnataḥ śaṃmusaṃmataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. In the meantime Sukra who was panic-stricken offered his salutation to him with folded hands and offered him a gem-studded lion throne as a seat with great devotion. Sukra adored both the gods, devoting the mind at the lotus-like feet. Being the form of welfare he did not think it proper to enquire about their welfare. Thereafter Brahma, the creator of the universe, with the permission of Shiva spoke to Sukracarya the words which were quite appropriate.

## \|\| 81.22-24 \|\|

*śrṛṇu śukra pravakṣyāmi turnītiṃ śaśinaḥ suta \|*  
*lajjākāraṃ trijagatāṃ karma vedavahiṣkṛtam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*snātvā gṛhonmukhīṃ tārrāṃ gurupatnīṃ pativratām \|*  
*gṛhītvā śaraṇāpannastvayi pāpaśca saṃpratam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*prastutaṃ devasainyaṃ ca paśya vatsa raṇodyatam \|*  
*ahaṃ śaṃbhustvatsamīpaṃ tadarthaṃ ca samāgatau \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. Brahma said – О son Sukra, listen to me, I am going to tell you the misdeed of the moon which is disgraceful in all the three worlds and is against the Vedas. Chaste Tara, the wife of his teacher, was about to go back to her home when the moon forcibly took her and has now taken refuge with you. О son, you look here the army of the gods which has arrived here for the same purpose. Myself and Shiva have arrived here before you for the same purpose.

## \|\| 81.25-30 \|\|

*śaṃbhuruvāca candramānaya he vipra yadyātmaśivamicchasi \|*  
*saṃhariṣye sirastasya triśūrena ca pāpinaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*anyathā saṃhariṣyāmi sarvadaityānkṣaṇena ca \|*  
*mayi ruṣṭe rakṣitā ko daityārnāṃ ca bhaveddvija \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sadyaḥ pāśupatenaiva vāyvastreṇa ca rsāṃpratam \|*  
*surārṇāṃ ripuvargaṃ ca hariṣyāmi ca līlayā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*durvāsaso madaṃśasya gurustasyāṅgirā suniḥ \|*  
*parasparācca saṃbandhādguruputro gururmama \|\| 28 \|\|*

*bṛhaspatiśca tejasvī taṃ bhasmīkartumīśvaraḥ \|*  
*na cakāra kṛpāluścetpriyaśiṣyeṇa hetunā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*utathyapatnīṃ dṛṣṭvā sa purā reme svakāmataḥ \|*  
*tatpateḥ śāpato'syaiva paragrastā priyā satī \|\| 30 \|\|*

25-30. Shiva said – О Brahmana, is case you are desirous of your welfare, you produce the moon here. I shall remove the head of that sinful person with the striking of this trident, otherwise in a moment I shall reduce the entire demon race to ashes. Because, О Brahmana, if I am enraged who can protect the demons, by using the Pasupata weapon and the weapon of wind, I shall playfully destroy all the enemies of gods. The sage Angira is born in my race and is the teacher of Durvasa. Because of the eternal relationship Brihaspati happens to be the son of my teacher. The illustrious teacher can reduce the moon to ashes but since he happens to be quite a dear pupil of the teacher, the compassionate teacher has not done so. In the earlier times Brihaspati had raped the wife of his elder brother Utathya getting infatuated with passion. Because of the curse of his brother his beloved also has been abducted.

## \|\| 81.31 \|\|

*patnīṃ madguruputrasya dehi tārrāṃ manoharām \|*  
*madvairiṇaṃ ca candraṃ ca bhrādṛbhāryāpahāriṇam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. You hand over to the son of my teacher, his wife Tara and the one who has abducted her who is none else than the moon himself.

## \|\| 81.32-33 \|\|

*śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃ na hi rakṣedyadīśvaraḥ \|*  
*pacyate niraye tāvadyāvadindāścatudarśa \|\| 32 \|\|*

*atra nāsti vicāro me pāpiṣṭhe śaraṇāgate \|*  
*pāpī yaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāti sa pāpī ca na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. If a competent person does not protect the person who comes to take refuge with him then he has to fall in the hell for a period of the life of the fourteen Indras. Here, since the sinful person comes to take refuge with you, I don't have to think of anything else because if a sinner takes refuge with someone, the person who protects him also becomes a sinner. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 81.34 \|\|

*dehi taṃ vipraśārdūla pāpinaṃ mātṛgāminam \|*  
*bahiṣkṛtya svāśramācca tārāsādhvīsamanvitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O Brahmana, you take out the chaste Tara and the sinful moon who has cohabited with his own mother and hand over both of them to us.

## \|\| 81.35-36 \|\|

*śukra uvāca surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ jagatāmapi \|*  
*tvameva śāstā bhagavānko vā śāsti sure'sure \|\| 35 \|\|*

*kṛtvā surāṇāṃ sāhāyyaṃ kathaṃ daityānhaniṣyasi \|*  
*saṃhartuḥ sarvajagatāṃ daityaudhe kiṃ ca pauruṣam \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. Sukra said – You are the lord of the gods, the demons and the entire universe and you rule over the same. Who else can rule over the gods and the demons. Therefore by helping the gods why should you destroy the demons. You are the destroyer of the universe, then why should you display your prowess over the demons alone.

## \|\| 81.37-38 \|\|

*tvaṃ jayotiḥ paramaṃ brahma saguṇo nirguṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*guṇabhedānmūrtibhedo brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*balidvāre gadāpāṇiḥ svayameva bhavānprabho \|*  
*svayaṃ pradattā śakrāya tasmai śrīrapi līlayā \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. You are the form of flames, with qualities, without qualities and the eternal Brahma. Because of the difference in gunas, you appear as Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva in three separate forms. О Lord, it is you alone who remain present at the gate of the king Bali, holding a gada in your hand. Both Indras and Bali have been bestowed with Raja-Lakshmi by you.

## \|\| 81.39-42 \|\|

*kṣamasva bhagañchaṃbho hara krodhaṃ ca saṃhara \|*  
*kiṃ pauruṣaṃ ca bhavato brahmaṇasyāpi hiṃsayā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*ahaṃ jīvañcharīreṇa na dāsyāmi niśākaram \|*  
*śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃ lajjirvaṃ pāpasaṃyutam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ahaṃ ca tvatpadāmbhoje śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaṃkara \|*  
*yathocitaṃ kuru vibho jagatsarvaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

*śukrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prasanno bhagavāñchivaḥ \|*  
*ityuvāca niśānāthaṃ samānaya śubhaṃ bhavet \|\| 42 \|\|*

39-42. О lord, О Shiva, О Tara, you shed away the anger; what type of glory are you going to achieve by killing a Brahmana? I cannot hand over the moon to you till I am alive since he had taken refuge with me, becoming grief-stricken, shameful, down-trodden and sinful. Therefore, О Shiva, I take refuge under your lotus-like feet. О virtuous one, you now do whatever you think best. Not only I myself but the entire universe is ruled by you. On hearing the words of Sukra, Shiva felt delighted and said, "Bring the moon, the lord of night here at once". On his arrival here, he would meet with welfare.

## \|\| 81.43-44 \|\|

*etasminnantare brahmā bodhayitvā kaviṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*samānīya niśānāthaṃ tārakāsahitaṃ vraja \|\| 43 \|\|*

*śaṃbhośca caraṇāmbhoje cakāra ca samarpaṇam \|*  
*śaṃbhustaṃ prītiyuktaśca vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. O lord of Vraja, in the meantime, the lord Brahma made the poet Sukra to understand the reality. He brought Tara and the moon there and presented them at the lotus-like feet of Shiva. Shiva embraced lovingly the moon.

## \|\| 81.45-48 \|\|

*dattavā tasmai pādareṇuṃ niṣpāpaṃ ca cakāra saḥ \|*  
*dattavā tanmastake hastaṃ kṛpālurabhayaṃ dadau \|\| 45 \|\|*

*kṣīrode snāpayitvā ca prāyaścittena śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*cakāra candraṃ niṣpāpaṃ brahmaṇā sahitaḥ śucim \|\| 46 \|\|*

*yogena candraṃ yogīndro dvikhaṇḍaṃ taṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*rarakṣārdhaṃ lalāṭe ca so'pyardhaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puraḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*ata eva mahādevo babhūva candraśekharaḥ \|*  
*mṛgāṅko lajjitastatra kalaṅkīṃ devasaṃsadi \|\| 48 \|\|*

45-48. Then dropping the dust of his feet over the moon, he purified him completely. Thereafter the compassionate Shiva placed his hand on the head of the moon and freed him from danger. Thereafter, both Shiva and Brahma made the moon to have a bath in the ocean of milk, in repentance and made him sinless and pure. Thereafter Shiva the lord of the yogis, divided the moon into two parts. One part of the moon was placed by Shiva on his head. Therefore since that time Shiva is known also by the name of Chandras'ekhara and the part having the sign of the deer earned the blemish and started feeling shameful among the gods.

## \|\| 81.49-50 \|\|

*lajjayā ca svayogena dehatyāgaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*taccharīraṃ ca kṣīrode brahmaṇā ca samarpitam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*rurodātriśca kṛbayā śucā kṣīrodadhestaṭe \|*  
*atreścakṣurjalaṃ tasya papāta ca jale vraja \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Thereafter by yogic practices he ended his body which was thrown away by Brahma in the ocean of milk. Finding this, the sage Atri feeling compassionate started crying at the shore of the ocean of milk. О lord of Vraja, as soon as the tears of the sage Atri were dropped into the ocean of milk, the moon was relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 81.51 \|\|

*tasmādbabhūva candraśca niṣpāpo devasaṃsadi \|*  
*brahmā ca bhagavāñchaṃbhurabhiṣekaṃ cakāra tam \|*  
*uvāca taṃ mahādevo nirbhayaṃ devasaṃsadi \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Thereafter both'Shiva and Brahma crowned the moon and in the assembly of gods, lord Shiva spoke to the moon.

## \|\| 81.52 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca svasthānaṃ gaccha putra tvaṃ kuruṣva viṣayaṃ mudā \|*  
*paścāttasyāśca śāpenayakṣmagrastobhaviṣyasi \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Mahadeva said – О son, you go back to your home and enjoy all the worldly pleasures. Thereafter because of the curse of Tara you will have to suffer from the disease of consumption.

## \|\| 81.53-54 \|\|

*vyarthaṃ pativratāśāpaṃ kartumīśaścako bhuvi \|*  
*madāśiṣā yakṣmaṇaśca pratīkāro bhaviṣyati \|\| 53 \|\|*

*yasmādbhādracaturthyāṃ tu gurupatnīkṣatiḥ kṛtā \|*  
*tasmāttasmindine vatsa pāpadṛśyo yuge yuge \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. Who is competent enough to neutralise the curse of a chaste woman on earth? But because of my blessing the disease of consumption will also be removed. You have caused harm to the wife of your teacher on the fourth day of a Bhadrapada, therefore, with each yoga your sight would earn sin to the viewers.

## \|\| 81.55-56 \|\|

*nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi \|*  
*avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham \|\| 55 \|\|*

*dehatyāgena he vatsa karmabhogo na naśyati \|*  
*prāyaścittānna saṃdeho ṅyastameva bhaviṣyati \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. Because an evil deed cannot be destroyed even after the lapses of crores of kalpas without facing the reward for it. Therefore the result of the good or evil deeds performed by anyone has to be faced. О son, even after the death, the deeds never vanish but after performing repentance, they surely get destroyed.

## \|\| 81.57-59 \|\|

*tārābaharaṇāvatsa kalaṅkaścandramaṇḍale \|*  
*mṛgākṛtirvilagnaśca bhaviṣyati yuge yuge \|\| 57 \|\|*

*śṛṇu vākyamihā''gaccha tārake ca pativrate \|*  
*satyaṃ brūhi kasya garbhaṃtyaktvā śuddhābhava priye \|\| 58 \|\|*

*akāmato balātsādhvī na strī jāreṇa duṣyati \|*  
*kāmato narakaṃ yāti yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 59 \|\|*

57-59. О son, because of the abduction of Tara by the moon, the blemish in the form of the deer would always remain present in the body of the moon. О chaste lady, you come here and listen to me. You tell me plainly by whom have you conceived. О dear one, get yourself relieved of it and purify yourself. In case an unwilling and chaste lady is forcibly raped by someone she never gets impure but in case she enjoys the company of others willingly, she has to fall in the hell and remain there till the life of the sun end the moon.

## \|\| 81.60 \|\|

*uvāca tārā brahmāṇaṃ garbhaṃ candrasya sasmitam \|*  
*jahasurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ śaṃbhuśca munisaṃghakāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Thereafter, Tara smilingly spoke to Brahma, I have conceived from the moon. On hearing this the gods, Shiva and sages started laughing.

## \|\| 81.61-67 \|\|

*dadau tārāṃ ca gurave lajjitāya vrajeśvara \|*  
*bṛhaspatiryayau gehaṃ gṛhītvā ca pativratām \|\| 61 \|\|*

*tayā prasūtaṃ putraṃ ca sundaraṃ kanakaprabham \|*  
*gṛhītvāprayayau candaunamaskṛtya vidhiṃ śivām \|\| 62 \|\|*

*yayurdevāśca munayaḥ śaṃbhuśca kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*prayayau svagṛhaṃ śukrau daityayuktau mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*etatte kathitaṃ nanda hyākhyānaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham \|*  
*etacchru tvā tu niṣpāpo niṣkalaṅkī naro bhavet \|\| 64 \|\|*

*dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ param \|*  
*śokāpanodanaṃ harṣakaraṃ marvatra maṅgalam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*tyaja śokaṃ sadā nanda gṛhaṃ vraja vrajeśvara \|*  
*brūhi sarvaṃ yaśodāṃ ca matprasūṃ gopikāgaṇam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*bodhayiṣyasi sarvāṃ tāṃ strījātiṃ śokasaṃyutām \|*  
*sadīyajñānadattena harṣayuktaḥ sadā bhava \|\| 67 \|\|*

61-67. О lord of Vraja, Brihaspati was filled with shame and Brahma handed over Tara to him. The sage Brihaspati took the chaste lady with him and went to his abode. Tara gave birth to a son at that very place who was quite beautiful, having the lustre of gold and quite illustrious. The moon owned him. Thereafter bowing in reverence to Shiva and Brahma, both of them went back to their respective places. Sukra also was delighted with ail the demons and went back to his abode. О Nanda, thus I have narrated to you this auspicious and pleasant story, which is quite graceful, bestows glory, increases age, bestowing all the riches, removes grief, increases pleasures and bestows all the welfare. Therefore, О lord of Vraja, disown all the grief and go back to your house and narrate all this that I have told you, to my mother Yashoda and all other cowherdesses. In spite of that you try to console all the cowherdesses who are plunged in grief and extend to them the divine knowledge which has been imparted by me to you.

## Chapter 82

## \|\| 82.1 \|\|

*atha dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mahābhāga duḥsvapnaṃ kathaya prabho \|*  
*uvāca taṃ vai bhagavāñchrūyatāmiti tadvacaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Nanda said – О virtuous one, О lord, I have heard everything, now you tell me about the evil dreams. "On hearing his words the lord said, you listen."

## \|\| 82.2 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca svapne hasati yo harṣādvivāhaṃ yadi paśyati \|*  
*nartanaṃ gītamiṣṭaṃ ca vipattistasya niścitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Shri Krishna said – The one who laughs heartily in his dream, enjoys songs and dances according to his liking; besides he surely falls into danger.

## \|\| 82.3 \|\|

*dantā yasya vibīḍyante vicarantaṃ ca paśyati \|*  
*dhanahānirbhavettasya pīḍā cāpi śarīrajā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The one whose teeth are broken or fallen, meets with the loss of wealth besides suffering bodily disease.

## \|\| 82.4 \|\|

*amyaṅgitastu tailena yo gaccheddakṣiṇāṃ diśam \|*  
*kharoṣṭramahiṣārūḍho mṛtyustasya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The one who applies oil on the body or is seated on a donkey, camel or a he-buffalo, moving towards the south, is sure to meet with his death.

## \|\| 82.5-6 \|\|

*svapane karṇe japāpuṣpamaśokaṃ karavīrakam \|*  
*vipattistasya tailaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ yadi paśyati \|\| 5 \|\|*

*nagnāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ chinnanāsāṃ śūdrasya vidhavāṃ tathā \|*  
*kapardakaṃ tālaphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā śokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. The one who gives away in dream a y'ayw puspa (Shoe flower)1 an Asoka 2 flower or karavira-puspa 3 besides oil and salt, is sure to face misfortune. The one who meets in a dream a black unrobed Shudra widow with a severed nose or comes across a small shell or the fruit of a tala tree, he meets with grief.

## \|\| 82.7-8 \|\|

*svapne ruṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca brāhmaṇīṃ kopasaṃyutām \|*  
*vipattiśca bhavettasya lakṣmīryāti gṛhāddhruvam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vanapuṣpaṃ raktapuṣpaṃ palāśaṃ ca supuṣpitam \|*  
*kārpāsaṃ śuklavastraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The one who witnesses in a dream in a Brahmana and his wife in anger he surely meets misfortune and his wealth departs from his home, by looking in a dream at the forest flowers, red flowers, a pal as a flower, cotton and white garments, one meets with grief.

## \|\| 82.9-14 \|\|

*gāyantīṃ ca hasantīṃ ca kṛṣṇāmbaradharāṃ striyam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃ ca vidhavāṃ naro mṛtyumavāpnuyāt \|\| 9 \|\|*

*devatā yatra nṛtyanti gāyanti ca hasanti ca \|*  
*āsphoṭayanti dhāvanti tasya deho mariṣyati \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vāntaṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca vaidyaṃ raupyaṃ suvarṇakam \|*  
*pratyakṣamathavā svapne jīvitaṃ daśamāvadhi \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ kṛṣṇamālyānulepanām \|*  
*upagūhati yaḥ svapne tasya mṛtyurbhaviṣyati \|\| 12 \|\|*

*mṛtavatsaṃ ca muṇḍaṃ ca mṛgasya ca narasya ca \|*  
*yaḥ prāptotyasthimālāṃ ca vipattistasya niścitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*rathaṃ kharoṣṭrasaṃyuktamekākī yo'dhirohayet \|*  
*tatrastho'pi ca jāgarti mṛtyureva na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

9-14. The one who witnesses in his dream a lady clad in black garments who is smiling or a widow with black complexion, one surely meets with death. If the gods dance in the dream of anyone, laugh or pat the thighs or are shown running, he surely meets with his end. If someone vomits, eases, drops refuse or witnesses a physician, silver and gold, he surely meets with a calamity within ten days. If a person witnesses in a dream a black cloth, black colour and a woman with black colours and embraces her, he surely meets with his death. The one who meets with a dead calf, deer or a human with a shaven head or bones, he surely meets with some misfortune. The one who rides on a chariot driven by a donkey or a camel and after being seated in the chariot, he wakes up, he surely meets with his death.

## \|\| 82.15-16 \|\|

*amyaṅgistu haviṣā kṣīreṇa madhunā'pi ca \|*  
*takreṇāpi guḍenaiva pīḍā tasya viniścitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*raktāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ raktamālyānuleparām \|*  
*upagūhati yaḥ svapne tasya vyādhirviniścitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. The one who finds himself soaked in ghee, milk, honey, butter milk or guda, he surely has to feel pain. The one who witnesses a woman in a dream clad in red costumes, wearing garlands of red flowers and with other means of decoration, he is surely over-powered with diseases.

## \|\| 82.17-18 \|\|

*patitānnakhareśāṃśca nirvāṇāṅgārameva ca \|*  
*bhasmabūrṇāṃ citāṃ dṛṣṭvā labhate mṛtyumeva ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*śmaśānaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ ca tṛṇāni lohameva ca \|*  
*śamīṃ ca kiṃ citkṛṣṇāśvaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. One meets with death in case he witnesses in his dream fallen nails, hair, coal, a heap of ashes and a burning fire. By witnessing the cremation ground, dry-wood, grass, iron, teakwood trees, a black horse in a dream he surely achieves grief.

## \|\| 82.19-20 \|\|

*pādukāṃ phalakaṃ raktaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ bhayānakam \|*  
*māṣaṃ masūraṃ mudgaṃ vā dṛṣṭvā sadyo vraṇaṃ labhet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kaṭakaṃ saraṭhaṃ kākaṃ bhallūkaṃ vānaraṃ gavam \|*  
*pūyaṃ gātramalaṃ svapne kevalaṃ vyādhikāraṇam \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. By looking at sandal, a bone of forehead, a terrific garland of red flowers, black gram, green gram, small grained pulse, he develops a terrific boil in his body. In case someone witnesses in his dream, an anny, a chameleon, a crow, a bear, a monkey, a nilagaya and puss, he surely develops ailment in his body.

## \|\| 82.21-24 \|\|

*bhagnabhāṇḍaṃ kṣataṃ śūdraṃ galatkuṣṭhaṃ ca rogiṇam \|*  
*raktāmbaraṃ ca jaṭilaṃ sūkaraṃ mahiṣaṃ kharam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*andhakāraṃ mahāghoraṃ mṛtajīvaṃ bhayaṃkaram \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā svapne yoniliṅga vipattiṃ labhatedhruvam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kuveṣarupaṃ malecchaṃ ca yamadūtaṃ bhayaṃkaram \|*  
*pāśahastaṃ pāśaśastraṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*brahmaṇo brāhmaṇī bālā bālako vā sutaḥ sutā \|*  
*vilāpaṃ kurute kopāddṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. If someone witnesses a broken vase, a wound, leprosy, a red garment, natted locks of hair, a pig, a he-buffalo, a donkey, thick darkness, a terrific dead body, male and female organs, he surely meets with misfortune. If anyone meets with a denounced rnleccha holding a noose and a weapon in his hand beside the terrific messengers of Yama, holding a noose, one surely meets with death. One has to face grief in case one witnesses in a dream a Brahmana and his wife, a child, a son or a daughter crying and lamenting in anger.

## \|\| 82.25-26 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaṃ puṣpaṃ ca tanmālyaṃ sasyaṃ śastrāstradhāriṇam \|*  
*mlecchāṃ ca vikṛtākāraṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃlabheddhruvam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tyaktaprāṇaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ ca labhate dhruvam \|*  
*matsyādi dhārayedyo hi tadbhrāturmaraṇaṃ dhruvam \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. By looking in a dream at a black flower, a garland with black flowers, crops, warriors with a coat of arms and a deformed rnleccha woman, one surely meets with death. In the dream, if one consumes fish his brother surely meets with his end.

## \|\| 82.27-28 \|\|

*vādyaṃ ca nartanaṃ gītaṃ gāyanaṃ raktavāsasam \|*  
*mṛdaṅgavādyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*chinnaṃ vā'pi kabandhaṃ vā vikṛtaṃ muktakeśinam \|*  
*kṣipaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca kurvantaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. By witnessing a musical instrument, a dance, a song and music besides red costumes, one surely has to face grief. If one comes across in a dream an injured person, a body without the head or the one with dishevelled hair, dancing rapidly and a deformed person, he surely meets with his death.

## \|\| 82.29-30 \|\|

*mṛto vā'pi mṛtā vā'pi kṛṣṇā mlecchā bhayānakā \|*  
*upagūhati yaṃ svapne tasya mṛtyurviniścitam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*yeṣāṃ dantāśca bhagnāśca keśāścāpi patanti hi \|*  
*dhanahānirbhavettasya pīḍā vā taccharīrajā \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. If one witnesses a rnleccha of black colour, a black dead body and a rnleccha-woman embracing a person, he surely meets with his end. The one whose teeth are broken or hair is fallen, he surely meets with losses besides pain in the body.

## \|\| 82.31-32 \|\|

*upadravanti yaṃ svapne śrṛṅgiṇo daṃṣṭriṇo'pi vā \|*  
*bālakā mānavāścaiva tasya rājakulādbhayam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*chinnavṛṅaṃ patantaṃ ca śilāvṛṣṭiṃ tuṣaṃkṣuram \|*  
*raktāṅgāraṃ bhasmavṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamāvāpnuyāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. The person who comes across in a dream, the creatures with horns or protruding teeth or children and the grown-up people become hostile to him, he meets with danger in the royal court. If someone witnesses a falling tree, a rain of stones, straw, a beggar, a red fire flame and a rain of ashes, he meets with grief.

## \|\| 82.33-34 \|\|

*gṛhaṃ patantaṃ śailaṃ vā dhūmaketuṃ bhayānakam \|*  
*bhagnaskandhaṃ tarorvā'pi dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt \|\| 33 \|\|*

*rathagehaśailavṛkṣagohastituragāmbarāt \|*  
*bhūmau patati yaḥ svapne vipattistasya niścitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. If one witnesses falling houses or a mountain, terrific comets or the broken branches of the trees, he meets with grief. The one who falls in a dream from a chariot, from a horse, from a mountain, from a tree, from a cow, from an elephant or from the sky on the earth, he surely meets with misfortune.

## \|\| 82.35-40 \|\|

*uccaiḥ patanti garteṣu bhasmāṅgārayuteṣu ca \|*  
*kṣārakuṇḍeṣu cūrṇeṣu mṛtyusteṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*balādgṛhṇāti duṣṭaścacchatraṃ ca yasya mastakāt \|*  
*piturnāśo bhavettasya gurorvā'pi nṛpasya vā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*surabhiryasya gehācca yāti trastā savatmikā \|*  
*prayāti pāpinastasya lakṣmīrapi vasuṃdharā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*pāśena kṛtvā badvaṃ ca yaṃ gṛhītvā prayānti ca \|*  
*yamadūtāśca ye mlecchāstasya mṛtyurviniścitam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*gaṇako brāhmaṇo vā'pi brāhmaṇī vā gurustathā \|*  
*pariruṣṭaḥ śapati yaṃ vipattistasya niścitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*virodhinaśya kākāśca kukkuṭā bhallukāstathā \|*  
*patantyāgatya yadgātre tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

35-40. The one who falls from heights into ashes, into pits filled with fire-flames, into pits with salt or lime, he surely meets with his death. The one from whose head some wicked person forcibly snatches away the chatra, his father, teacher or the king he surely meets with his end; the one from whose house the terrified cows with calves run away, the fortunes from such a sinful person surely disappear. The one who is bound in a dream with the messengers of Yama or a mleccha with the noose and is driven away, he surely meets with his death. In case an astrologer, a Brahmana or his wife or a teacher pronounces a curse getting-enraged, he surely meets with misfortune. In case an enemy, crows, cocks, deer, pounce upon someone in a dream, he surely meet with his end.

## \|\| 82.41-51 \|\|

*mahiṣā bhallukā uṣṭrā sūkarā gardabhāstathā \|*  
*ruṣṭā dhāvanti yaṃ svapne sa rogī niścitaṃ bhavet \|\| 41 \|\|*

*raktacandanakāṣṭhāni ghṛtāktāni juhoti yaḥ \|*  
*gāyatryāśca mahasreṇa tena śāntirvidhīyate \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sahasradhā capedyo hi bhaktyainaṃ madhusūdanam \|*  
*niṣpāṇo hi bhavetso'pi duḥsvapnaḥ susvapno bhavet \|\| 43 \|\|*

*acyutaṃ keśavaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ satyaṃ janārdanam \|*  
*haṃsaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ caiva hyetannāmāṣṭakaṃ śubham \|\| 44 \|\|*

*śuciḥ pūrvamukhaḥ prājño daśakṛtvaśca yo japet \|*  
*niṣpāpo'pi bhavetso'pi duḥsvapnaḥ śubhavānbhavet \|\| 45 \|\|*
