*viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mādhavaṃ madhumūdanam \|*  
*hariṃ narahariṃ rāmaṃ govindaṃ dadhivāmanam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*bhaktyā cemāni nāmāni daśa bhadrāṇiyo japet \|*  
*śatakṛtyo bhaktiyukto japtvā nīrogatāṃ vrajet \|\| 47 \|\|*

*lakṣadhā hi japedyo hi bandhanānmucyate dhruvam \|*  
*japtvā ca daśalakṣaṃ ca mahāvandhyā prasūyate \|\| 48 \|\|*

*haviṣyāśī yataḥ śuddho daridro dhanavānbhavet \|*  
*śatalakṣaṃ ca japtvā ca jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*oṃ namaḥ śivaṃ durgāṃ gaṇapatiṃ kārtikeyaṃ dineśvanam \|*  
*dharmaṃ gaṅgāṃ ca tulasīṃ rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm \|\| 50 \|\|*

*nāmānyetāni bhadrāṇi jale snātvā ca yo japet \|*  
*vāñchitaṃ ca labhetso'pi duḥsvapnaḥ śubhavānbhavet \|\| 51 \|\|*

41-51. In a dream, in case a he-buffalo, a bear, a camel, a pig or a donkey runs away in anger, he surely meets with ailment; by soaking the red sandal-wood in ghee, reciting the Gayatri mantra in case one makes a thousand offerings, the effect of a bad dream is wiped out. In case one recites the name of Madhusudana in devotion a thousand times, such a person is relieved of all the sins and his bad dreams are turned into good dreams. In case an intelligent person recites the name of Acyuta, Kesava, Vishnu, Hari, Satyaka, Janardana, Hamsa and Narayana with utmost devotion, one is relieved of the sin and his bad dreams turn into good dreams. By reciting the name of Vishnu, Narayana, Krishna, Madhava, Madhusudana, Hari, Narahari, Rama, Govinda, Dadhivamana, the ten names which bestow welfare a hundred times, such a person is relieved of all ailments. The one who recites the name of god a lakh of times, he is surely relieved of all the bondage's and by reciting the name ten lakhs of times, he is relieved of all the bondages. Consuming havisya food and reciting the name purifies a pauper who becomes rich and by reciting the name a hundred lakhs of times, one is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. The one who recites the mantra in ЧЧ: fefFt reciting the name of Durga, Ganapati, Karttikeya, Surya, Ganga, Dharma, Tulasi, Radha, Laksnu and Sarasvatr standing in the water he gets his desires fulfilled and all his evil dreams turn into good dreams.

## \|\| 82.52 \|\|

*oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ pūrvadūrgatināśinyai mahāmāyāyai svāhā \|*  
*kalpavṛkṣo hi lokānāṃ santraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. the one who recites this mantra of seventeen letters, it serves him like a kalpavrksa.

## \|\| 82.53-54 \|\|

*śuciśca daśadhā japtvā duḥsvapnaḥ sukhavānbhavet \|*  
*śatalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām \|\| 53 \|\|*

*siddhamantrastu labhate sarvasiddhiṃ ca vāñchitam \|*  
*oṃ namo mṛtyuṃjayāyeti svāhāntaṃ lakṣadhā japet \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. By reciting this mantra ten times after purifying oneself, the evil dreams are turned into good dreams. By reciting this mantra a hundred lakhs of times, one achieves success in this mantra and by achieving this success, he obtains all the siddhis.

## \|\| 82.55-56 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā ca maraṇaṃ svapne śatāyuśca bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*pūrvottaramukho bhūtvā svapnaṃ prājñe prakāśayet \|\| 55 \|\|*

*kāśyape durgate nīce devabrāhmaṇanindake \|*  
*mūrkhe caivānabhijñe ca na ca svapnaṃ prakāśayet \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. After facing death in a dream one should recite this mantra a lakh of times and by doing so one achieves one's age up to a hundred years. An intelligent person should reveal his dream facing the east or the north but those belonging to the Kashyapa-gotra, the pauper, the degraded people, the denouncer of Brahmanas and the gods, the foolish and ignorant should not be told about the dream.

## \|\| 82.57-58 \|\|

*aśvatthe gaṇake vipre pitṛdevāsaneṣu ca \|*  
*ārye ca vaiṣṇave mitre divā svapnaṃ prakāśayet \|\| 57 \|\|*

*iti te puṇyamākhyātaṃ kathitaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. One should speak out the dream before a plpala tree, an astrologer, a Brahmana, the manes, seats of the gods, Arya and Vaishnava people besides friends. Thus I have narrated to you the story which relieves one of all the sins, is graceful, increases glory and age. What else do you want to listen to from me?

## Chapter 83

## \|\| 83.1 \|\|

*atha tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca vedānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca brahmādīnāṃ ca putraka \|*  
*sarvaṃ kathaya bhadraṃ te kaṃ pṛcchāmi tvayā vinā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Nanda said – О son, you are the cause of the Vedas and Brahma. Therefore, you tell us everything. You will meet with welfare. To whom shall I asked except you?

## \|\| 83.2-3 \|\|

*viprāṇāṃ yo hi dharmaśca kṣatravidśūdrakarmaṇām \|*  
*saṃnyāsināṃ ca yo dharmo yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām \|\| 2 \|\|*

*viprāṇāṃ vidhavāstrīṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāmapi \|*  
*pativratānāṃ strīṇāṃ ca tatsarva vaktumarhasi \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. What is the dharma of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, Shudras, mendicants, yogis, Brahmacarls, learned persons, widows, the noble people and those of the chaste woman? You kindly tell me in detail everything.

## \|\| 83.4-5 \|\|

*gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhiṇīnāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*putrāṇāṃ cāpi kanyānāṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ prati \|\| 4 \|\|*

*strījātiśca katividhā bhaktaḥ katividhaḥ prabho \|*  
*brahmāṇḍaṃ ca katividhaṃ vadanaṃ ca kimātmakam \|*  
*kiṃ nityaṃ kṛtrimaṃ kiṃ ca brūhi sarvaṃ krameṇa ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. О lord, you tell me in detail the duties of the householder, the wives of the house-holder, the pupils and the duties of the sons towards their parents and the duties of the daughters. You kindly speak them out in detail. О lord, what is the number of castes of the women, the number of the types of devotees, the number of the globes? You kindly tell me in detail everything.

## \|\| 83.6 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca saṃdhyāpūtaḥ sadā vipraḥ kurute mama sevanam \|*  
*nityaṃ bhuṅkate matprasādamanivedya kadā ca na \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Shri Krishna said – A Brahmana gets himself purified after performing sandhya, always serves me. He always take food with my left-over and he does not take food without offering me the same first.

## \|\| 83.7 \|\|

*annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam \|*  
*viṣṇuprasādabhojī ca jīvanmuktaśca brāhmaṇaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The one who does not offer to Vishnu the food, it becomes like refuse and the water like urine. Therefore, a Brahmana who consumes the left-over of Vishnu is relieved of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 83.8-10 \|\|

*nityaṃ tapasyānirataḥ śuciḥ śāntaśca śāstravit \|*  
*vratatīrthāśrito dharmī nānādhyāpanasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*viṣṇumantraṃ gṛhītvā ca kṛtvā ca gurusevanam \|*  
*guhītvā tadanujñāṃ ca paścādbhavati sa gṛhī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ nityabūjānāṃ gurave ca nivedayet \|*  
*gurūṇāṃ poṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ kartavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. The one who remains engrossed in tapas, pure, peaceful, well-versed in the scriptures, the one who performs vrata and visits holy places, the one who engages himself in the study of many subjects and an extremely religious Brahmana getting sanctified with the Vishnu-mantra serves his teacher. Thereafter, accepting his command he becomes a house-holder. Such a Brahmana always adores his teacher daily and offers daksina to him. He should always maintain his teachers daily. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 83.11-13 \|\|

*sarveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ pitā caiva mahān guruḥ \|*  
*pituḥ śataguṇairmātā mātuḥ śataguṇaiḥ suraḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*mantradastantradaścaiva sṛrāṇāṃ ca caturguṇaḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇāśca bhagavānguruḥ pratyakṣa īśvaraḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*uddeśe dīyate tasmai surāyeti śrutau śrutam \|*  
*pratyakṣabhoktā svaguruḥ svayaṃ dehī janārdanaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Of all the adorable persons, the guru happens to be the best. Indeed he is to be treated like Narayana the lord of Lakshmi. For that purpose alone everything is offered to the gods. This has been prescribed in the Vedas, one's own teacher is the consumer and has to be treated like Janardana.

## \|\| 83.14-24 \|\|

*gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgurureva svayaṃ śivaḥ \|*  
*gurau ca sarvadevāśca tiṣṭhanti satataṃ mudā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*gurau tuṣṭe haristuṣṭo yasmiṃstuṣṭe ca devatā \|*  
*guruḥ putrasamaṃ snehaṃ śiṣyeṣu na kariṣyati \|\| 15 \|\|*

*labhate brahmahatyāṃ ca bhuṅkte kṛtvā ca nā''śiṣam \|*  
*svadharmanirato vipro brāhmaṇaśca sadā śuciḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*viṣṇusevī sadā viprastadanyo'pyaśuciḥ sadā \|*  
*brāhmaṇo vṛṣavāhaśca śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārakaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇo devalaścaiva saṃdhyāhīnaśca durbalaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇaśca divāśāyī śūdraśrāddhānnabhojanaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca te ca śūdrasamā dvijāḥ \|*  
*śālagrāmamahāmantraṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bhuṅkte naṃvedyaśeṣaṃ ca tatpādodakameva ca \|*  
*hareḥ pādodakaṃ pītvā tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*mucyate sarvapāpemyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*śālagrāmaśilātoyairyo'bhiṣekaṃ samācaret \|*  
*gaṅgājalāddaśaguṇaṃ śālagrāmajalaṃ vraja \|\| 22 \|\|*

*nityaṃ bhuṅkte ca yo vipro jīvanmuktaḥ suraiḥ samaḥ \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ nityakṛtyaṃ ca viṣṇornaivedyabhojanam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yatnena pūjanaṃ tasya tatpājodakamevanam \|*  
*nityaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ kurute bhaktyā ca mama pūjanam \|\| 24 \|\|*

14-24. The teacher is Brahma, the teacher is Vishnu, the teacher is Shiva himself. All the gods reside in the teacher delight-fully. Therefore the lord becomes happy, all the gods always reside in the body of the teacher. Therefore, when the teacher is pleased, the lord himself is pleased and with his pleasure all the gods feel pleased. In case the teacher does not love his pupil like his own sons and does, not bless them when they adore him then he also earns the sin of Brahmahatyd. There is no doubt about it. The one who is devoted to his dharma and the one who serves Vishnu always, is considered to be quite an auspicious one. The rest are considered to be impure. Such of the Brahmana as make his livelihood by driving bullocks, cooking food for the Stidras, serves as a temple priest or does not perform sandhya, the one who sleeps during the day time or the one who consumes the food of sraddha of the Sfldras and bums the dead bodies of the Stidras, such a Brahmana could be equated with a Stidra. The Brahmana, who, adoring Sdlagrama, sips the water of washing the same, takes food after offering him and also consumes the caranodaka of the same, he is relieved of all the sins and achieves Vishnuloka because by consuming the caranodaka of lord Hari, one earns the merit of having a bath in the holy places. The one who has the Sdlagrama stone, should take it for granted that such a person has earned the merit of taking a bath in the holy places besides earning the merit of performing the yajna. О lord of Vraja, the water with which Sdlagrama is washed, is considered to be ten times more auspicious than the sacred water of the Ganga. Therefore the Brahmana always consumes the same. Such a Brahmana is relieved of the cycle of birth and death and becomes like gods. Therefore it is incumbent on the Brahmanas that they should consume food only after offering naivedya to Vishnu.

## \|\| 83.25-26 \|\|

*ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṅkte ca mama vai janmavāsare \|*  
*śivarātrau ca he tāta śrīrāmanavamīdine \|\| 25 \|\|*

*na ca bhuṅkte vratī yo hi jīvanmukto hi sa dvijaḥ \|*  
*pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tasya pāde ca tāni ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. They adore Vishnu with devotion and consume his caranodaka as a part of daily routine. О father the one who performs sandhya thrice a day and adores me with devotion performing vratas on Ekadashi, Janmastml, Shivaratri and Ramanavami day and does not take food, such a Brahmana is freed from the cycle of birth and death. All the holy places on earth reside on his feet.

## \|\| 83.27-29 \|\|

*viprapādodakaṃ pītvā tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*viprapādodakaklinnā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tāvatpuṣkarapātreṣu pivanti pitaro jalam \|*  
*viṣṇuprasādabhojī ca pavitrāṃ kurute mahīm \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tīrthāni ca narāṃścaiva jīvanmukto hi sa dvijaḥ \|*  
*sarvatīrtheṣu sa snāto vratānāṃ ca phalaṃ labhet \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. By consuming the water, washing the feet of a Brahmana, one earns the merit of having a bath in a holy place. Till such time the earth remains wet with the caranodaka of Brahmana, his ancestors consume the water in the lotus leaves. The one who consumes the left-over of Vishnu, such a Brahmana is purifies the earth, the holy places and all the people. And thereafter he is relieved of the cycle of birth and death, he achieves the merit of having bath in all the sacred places and for performing all the vratas.

## \|\| 83.30-31 \|\|

*pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate niścitaṃ phalam \|*  
*vahnivāyusamaḥ pūtastejasā bhāskaropamaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*yamadūtaṃ yamaṃ caiva sa ca svapne na paśyati \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi pārṣado hariṇā saha \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. He achieves the merit of performing Asvamedha sacrifice at every step, he becomes purified like fire and the air, beside being illustrious like the sun. He does not witness Yama or his messengers even in dream and ultimately he becomes the courtier of the lord and move on to Vaikuntha enjoying all the pleasures there.

## \|\| 83.32 \|\|

*na bhavettasya pāto hi viprasya harisevinaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇumantropāsakaśya sa eva vaiṣṇavo dvijaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. A Brahmana who serves the lord, never meets with a fall, the one who adores the lord, never meets with a fall, the one who adores the lord reciting the Vishnu-mantra is known as Vaishnava.

## \|\| 83.33 \|\|

*brāhmaṇo vaiṣṇavaḥ prājño na hi tasmātparaḥ pumāt \|*  
*vedokto vā purāṇokstantrokto vā \|*  
*manuḥ śuciḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. A Vaishnava-Brahmana is always well-read and no one could be compared with him. A mantra prescribed in the Vedas, Puranas or the tantras is considered to be quite auspicious,

## \|\| 83.34-35 \|\|

*vicārato gṛhītvā taṃ śaivaḥ śāktaśca vaiṣṇavaḥ \|*  
*guruvaktrādviṣṇumantroyasya karṇe viśatyayam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. The one who receives the mantra after fully thinking about it, such a person is known as Saiva, Sakta or Vaishnava. The Vishnu mantra getting out of the mouth of the teacher, enters the ear of a devotee and such a person is considered to be an auspicious Vaishnava. By receiving the mantra alone one is relieved of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 83.36-38 \|\|

*bhīttavā brahmaṇḍamakhilaṃ yāsyatyeva hareḥ padam \|*  
*pūrvānsapta parānsapta sapta mātāmahādikān \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sodarānṛddharedbhaktastatprasūṃ tatprasūṃ tathā \|*  
*japennārāyaṇakṣetre puraścaraṇapūrvakam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca līlayā' \|tmānamudvaret \|*  
*mantragrahaṇamātreṇa phalametadvrajeśvara \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. He pierces through the globe and moves on to the abode of the lord. A true devotee of Vishnu redeems the seven past and seven future generations including his brothers, parents and the mother of the mother. О lord of Vraja, one receives this reward soon after getting the mantra. '

## \|\| 83.39-40 \|\|

*puraścaraṇasaṃparkātpuruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam \|*  
*aikāntiko vaiṣṇavaścapuṃsāṃ lakṣaṃ samuddharet \|\| 39 \|\|*

*kriyā viṣṇupade yasya saṃkalpāśca bahiḥkṛtā \|*  
*dvijāḥ surā mama prāṇā bhaktaḥ prāṇatparaḥ priyaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. A person who performs the recitation of the mantra with Purascarana, he redeems his hundred past and hundred future generations. Those of the Vaishnavas who are immensely devoted to the lord are beyond the Samkalpa but all the details are performed within Vishnupada. They redeem a lakh of their ancestors. The Brahmanas and the gods are my witnesses but my devotees are the dearest among all.

## \|\| 83.41-42 \|\|

*viśveṣu priyapātreṣu na me bhaktātparaḥ priyaḥ \|*  
*tejīyāṃsaṃ guruṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvatra rakṣituṃ kṣamam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*kanoti mantragrahaṇaṃ tasmādbhūyādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*vayohīnājjñānahīnādvidyāhīnāttathaiva ca \|*  
*jātihīnādgurormantraṃ gṛhṇīyānna kadācana \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Of all the people in all the lokas my devotees are the dearest to me and there is none else equal to them. The one who receives the mantra from a teacher, who is illustrious and can protect at every step, he is bestowed with all the wisdom. The one who is younger in age, having little knowledge or learnings and belongs to a lower caste, the mantra should not be received from such a teacher.

## \|\| 83.43-45 \|\|

*aśāstrārtha kṣataṃ mantraṃ na guhṇīyātkadācana \|*  
*mūrkhādāśramahīnācca pituḥ saṃnyāsinastathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*rogiṇo vaṃśahīnācca bhāryāhīnāttathaiva ca \|*  
*mantrakṣiptāttathā mantraṃ na gṛhṇīyātkadācana \|\| 44 \|\|*

*viṣṇumantraṃ na gṛhṇīyādviṣṇubhakti vihīnataḥ \|*  
*na ca śaivānna śāktācca gṛhṇīyādvaiṣṇavāddvijāt \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. The mantra which is against the meaning of the scriptures and is incomplete should not be received by anyone. Similarly one should not receive the mantra from a foolish person, the one having no asrama, the father, the recluse, the ailing person and the person having no progeny or a wife. The one who is devoid of devotion to Vishnu, Shiva or Sakti, the Vismi-mantra should not be received from him. The Vismi-mantra should be received from a Vaishnava Brahmana alone.

## \|\| 83.46-48 \|\|

*vayohīnāttathā'lpāyurjñānahīnādapaṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*vidyāhīnādbhavenmūḍho jātihīnātkṣayo bhavet \|\| 46 \|\|*

*mūrkhānmūrkho bhavetsadyo duḥkhī svāśramahīnataḥ \|*  
*yaśohāniḥ pituścaiva mṛtyuḥ saṃnyāsinastathā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*rogiṇo vyādhiyuktaśca nirvaṃśo vaṃśahīnataḥ \|*  
*bhāryāhīno'pi strīhīnānmantrakṣiptādguro samaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

46-48. The one who receives the mantra from a person who is a physician his life span in shortened. The one who receives the mantra from a person without intelligence, he becomes a foolish fellow. The one who receives the mantra from a person without learnings, a fool or the one who belongs to a degraded caste, one meets with the fall of his position. By receiving mantra from a foolish fellow, one becomes a fool, the one who receives from a mendicant, having no asrama, meets with grief the one who receives the mantra from his father, has to face losses. The one who receives the mantra from a recluse, has to meet with death and in case of receiving the same from a person with disease, he invites ailment and when receiving the same from a person having no sons, his progeny is destroyed. In case the mantra is received from a person having no wife, the receiver has to lose his wife. In case one receives a mantra, who forgets the same, the person who receives it also becomes forgetful.

## \|\| 83.49 \|\|

*viṣṇubhaktivihīnācca bhaktihīno bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*śaivācchāktādgṛhītvā ca harau bhaktirna vardhate \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The one who receives the mantra from a person undevoted to Vishnu, such a person is deprived of the devotion and in case the mantra is received from a Saiva or a Sakta, the devotion towards the lord never increases.

## \|\| 83.50-51 \|\|

*brāhmaṇo vaiṣṇavaḥ śuddhaḥ pakvānnaṃ dātumīśvaraḥ \|*  
*pakvānnaṃ haraye dātumakṣamaścetaro janaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*oṃkāroccāraṇāddhomācchālagrāmaśilārcanāt \|*  
*mahyaṃ pakvānnadānācca viprādanyo vrajedadhaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. Only a pure Vaishnava Brahmana can serve the fried food and none else. Because in case any other person except the Brahmana recites откат or performs the homa adoring Shalagrama and offers fried food to the lord, such a person is surely degraded.

## \|\| 83.52 \|\|

*udāsīnāddūrācārānna gṛṅṇīyānmanuṃ sudhīḥ \|*  
*daivādyadi ca gṛhṇīyāddhanahīno bhaveddhruvam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The intellectuals should not receive the mantra from a sad or a wicked person. In case it so happens accidentally, such a person is relieved of all his fortunes.

## \|\| 83.53-55 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānāṃ sadā bhakṣyaṃ haviṣyaṃ ca nirāmiṣam \|*  
*āmiṣasya parityāgātsūryaṃvattejasā bhavet \|\| 53 \|\|*

*nityaṃ nūtanabhāṇḍena kartavyaḥ pāka eva ca \|*  
*athavā pakṣaparyantaṃ tatastyājyaṃ manīthibhi \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sthānaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ kṛtvā pākaṃ nirvṛ tya pūjakaḥ \|*  
*sthāne pariṣkṛte vipro dattvā mahyaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

53-55. The Brahmanas should always take the havis ya and vegetarian food. Discarding meat a Brahmana shines like the sun. The intellectual Brahmanas should use new ways for cooking daily or otherwise the food should be cooked for fifteen days and thereafter, the same should be discarded. My devotees should cook the food in a neat and clean place and should offer the same to me with devotion.

## \|\| 83.56-57 \|\|

*tadā nivedya bhuṅkte ca dattvā viprāya sādaram \|*  
*anivedya ca bhukttvā ca surāpītirbhaveddvijaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*candrasūryeparāge vai cā''śauce mṛtajātayoḥ \|*  
*spṛṣṭenāśucinā sadyāḥ pākabhāṇ̈ḍaṃ parityajet \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. After offering me and to the Brahmanas, he should himself consume the food. Without offering the food to me if any Brahmana consumes the food, he becomes impure like the wine. After the solar or lunar eclipse, after the removal of the impurity of birth and death or after the touch of a vase by an unclean person, the vase for cooking should me immediately changed.

## \|\| 83.58-59 \|\|

*bhṛṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ tathā'nnaṃ ca dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|*  
*pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā bhuṅkate sthāno pariṣkṛte \|\| 58 \|\|*

*dvirbhojanaṃ na kartavyaṃ sthite sūrye dvijātibhiḥ \|*  
*niṣphalaṃ tadbhavetkarma bhuktvā ca narakaṃ vrajet \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. The fried cereals and the food should be taken getting clad in two garments, washing the feet at a neat and clean place. The people of high castes should not take food twice during the day because by doing so all the actions becomes infructuous and the consumer is driven to hell.

## \|\| 83.60-64 \|\|

*yātrāṃ yudvaṃ nadītīraṃ punarbhojanamaithune \|*  
*varjaṃyecchrāddhadivase haviṣyāśī ca saṃyamī \|\| 60 \|\|*

*dvijāya viṣṇubhaktāya pātraṃ dadyādvudhāya ca \|*  
*vṛṣalīpataye caiva na dadyāychūdrayājine \|\| 61 \|\|*

*saṃdhyāhīnāya duṣṭāya vṛṣavāhāya yatnataḥ \|*  
*śukravikrayiṇe caiva devalāya kadācana \|\| 62 \|\|*

*pradattaṃ pātrametebhyo brāhmaṇaṃ narakaṃ nayet \|*  
*pātre bhuktavā taddivase maithunānnarakaṃ vrajetu \|\| 63 \|\|*

*sarvebhyaḥ pātakī tāta kanyāvikrayakārakaḥ \|*  
*mūnyaṃ gṛhītvā yo dadyātsa mahārauravaṃ vrajet \|\| 64 \|\|*

60-64. The one who consumes havisya food, controlling his senses, is prohibited from starting on a journey during the day of sraddha, for a war, crossing a river, eating again and cohabiting. The intelligent people and the Vais nava should be given the vases, the one who is the husband of a Shudra woman, the one who performs yajnas with the Shudras, the one who is deprived of sandhya, the wicked person, those earning a living by driving bullocks, the sellers of parrots, the temple priest, should never be offered the charities, because by offering these to such persons, the donor surely reaches hell. In case someone, after performing s'mddha and eating food, cohabits with his wife, he surely falls in to hell. О father, the one who sells away the daughter is considered to be the biggest sinner. The one who sells away the daughter after accepting a price, such a sinner has to fall into the terrible hell.

## \|\| 83.65 \|\|

*kanyālomapramāṇāntaṃ varṣaṃ ca pitṛbhiḥ saha \|*  
*kumbhīpāke pacyate ca putraścāpi purohitaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Then he has to fall in to the kumbhlpaka hell together with his ancestors, sons and the priest up to the number of hair on the body of the girl.

## \|\| 83.66 \|\|

*tasmātkanyāṃ supātrāya dānaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*śūdravadbrāhmaṇebhyaśca naiva tadvaṃśacāya ca \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Therefore an intelligent person should give away the daughter to a competent person. Such of the Brahmanas as behaves like Stidras, the daughter should not the married in his family.

## \|\| 83.67 \|\|

*vipravaiṣṇavayordharmaḥ kathitaśca vrajeśvaraḥ \|*  
*yaduktaṃ ca purāṇaiśca caturbhiḥ śrutibhistathā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. О lord of Vraja, I have thus highlighted to you the duties of the Brahmanas and the Vaishnavas as prescribed in the Vedas and the Puranas.

## \|\| 83.68-70 \|\|

*dvijārcanaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathā nārāyaṇārcanam \|*  
*rājyānāṃ pālanaṃ caiva raṇe nirbhayatā tathā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*nityaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam \|*  
*putratulyaṃ prajānāṃ ca duḥkhināṃ paripālanam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*śastrāstrāṇāṃ ca naipuṇyaṃ raṇe śauṇḍīryameva ca \|*  
*tapaśca dharmakṛtyaṃ ca yatnataḥ kurute mudā \|\| 70 \|\|*

68-70. Now you listen to the dharma of Kshatriyas. All the Kshatriyas should always adore the Brahmanas, Narayana, rule the countries, should become fearless in the battle-field, give away charity to the Brahmanas, protect those who take refuge with them, protect the people who are suffering, like their own sons, should achieve mastery in archery and the scriptures and display prowess in the battle-field and should continue to perform tapas and other religious duties.

## \|\| 83.71-73 \|\|

*paṇḍitaṃ nītijñāstrajñaṃ nityaṃ ca paripālayet \|*  
*niyojayetsabhāmadhye nityaṃ sadbhiśca saṃyute \|\| 71 \|\|*

*hastyaśvarathapādātaṃ senāṅgaṃ ca catuṣṭayam \|*  
*pālayedyatnato nityaṃ yaśasvī ca pratāpavān \|\| 72 \|\|*

*raṇe nimantritaścaiva dāne na vimukho bhavet \|*  
*raṇe vā yastyajetprāṇāṃstasya svargo yaśaskaraḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

71-73. They should always maintain a well-read Brahmana, well-versed in the scriptures and such a person should be entrusted with the court with due responsibility. The glorious Kshatriyas should always maintain the elephants, horses, chariots, foot-soldiers and the four-fold army. When challenged for a war they should not run away from it, because if a Kshatriya is killed in a battle-field, he surely enjoys heaven and its glory.

## \|\| 83.74-75 \|\|

*vaiśyānāmapi vāṇijyamīśvaraḥ kṛṣipālane \|*  
*vipradevārcanaṃ dānaṃ tapasyā vratasevanam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*viprāṇāmarcanaṃ nityaṃ śūdradharmo vidhīyate \|*  
*tatkṛṣī taddhanagrāhī śūdraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. The duty of the Vaisyas is to engage himself in business, besides adoring the Brahmanas and the gods, performing the vrata. Similarly the adoration of Brahmanas is also prescribed for the Shudras. In case a Shudra troubles the Brahmana or steals away his riches, such a Shudra achieves Chandala-hood.

## \|\| 83.76-81 \|\|

*gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ \|*  
*śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni śūdo vipradhanāpahaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*yaḥ śūdro brāhmaṇīgāmī mātṛgāmī sa pātakī \|*  
*kṛmbhīpāke pacyate sa yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śātam \|\| 77 \|\|*

*kumbhīpāke taprataile bhuktaḥ sarpairaharniśam \|*  
*śabdaṃ ca vikṛtākāraṃ kurute yamatāḍanāt \|\| 78 \|\|*

*tataścāṇḍālayoniḥ syātsaptajanmasu pātakī \|*  
*saptajanmasu sarpaśca jalaukāḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 79 \|\|*

*janmakoṭisahatraṃ ca viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ \|*  
*puṃścalīnāṃ yonikṛmiḥ sa bhavetsaptajanmasu \|\| 80 \|\|*

*garvā vraṇakṛmiḥ syācca pātakī saptajanmasu \|*  
*yonau yonau bhramatyevaṃ na punarjāyate naraḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

76-81. In case a Shudra steals the riches of a Brahmana, he has to become a vulture for a thousand crores of births, a pig for a hundred births and a wild animal. In case a Shudra cohabits with a Brahmana woman, he earns the sin of cohabiting with his mother. Because of this he has to fall into the kumbhlpaka hell. He is thrown into boiling oil and is bitten by snakes. The messengers of Yama further torture him. Thereafter the great sinner is born as a cdndala for seven births, a snake for seven births, leech for seven births and an insect of refuse for a hundred crores of births. Thereafter, such a sinner for seven births becomes an insect of the pelvic region of a loose woman and for seven births he has to become an insect of the boil of cows. Thus by travelling through many births, he is never born as a human being.

## \|\| 83.82-83 \|\|

*saṃnyāsināṃ ca yo dharmo manmukhācca niśāmaya \|*  
*daṇḍagrahaṇamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet \|\| 82 \|\|*

*iti śrībrahmo mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakho uttaṃo nāradānāo bhagavannandasaṃo tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. Now you listen to me about the duties of a samnyas! or a recluse by holding a danda a person becomes the form of Narayana. The recluse, who always meditates upon me, he, destroying his earlier karmas, also destroys the deeds of the present birth. Ultimately he achieves my abode.

## \|\| 83.84 \|\|

*saṃnyāsināṃ padasparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā \|*  
*sadyaḥ punanti tīrthāni vaiṣṇavasya yathā vraja \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. О lord of Vraja, as a holy place gets purified with the touch of the feet of a Vaishnava, similarly the earth also gets purified with the touch of the feet of a recluse.

## \|\| 83.85 \|\|

*saṃnyāsinaśca sparśena niṣpāpo jāyate naraḥ \|*  
*saṃnyāsinaṃ bhojayitvā cāśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. A person gets purified and is relieved of his sins with the very touch of the recluse. In case food is served to a recluse, the giver of the food achieves the merit of performing the Asvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 83.86-87 \|\|

*natvā ca kāmato dṛṣṭvā rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*phalaṃ saṃnyāsināṃ tunyaṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām \|\| 86 \|\|*

*saṃnyācī yāti sāyāhne kṣudhito gṛhiṇāṃ gṛham \|*  
*sadannaṃ vā kadannaṃ vā taddattaṃ naiva varjayet \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. The one who offers his salutation to a recluse after suddenly meeting him, achieves the merit of performing the Rajasuya sacrifice. One gets the same type of merit by meeting a recluse, a Yati and a Brahmaccln. In case a recluse suffering from hunger goes to a house-holder in the evening, whatever type of food is served to him should be taken by him.

## \|\| 83.88-89 \|\|

*na yācate ca miṣṭānnaṃ na kuryātkopameva ca \|*  
*na dhanagrahaṇaṃ kuryādekavāsā nirīhataḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

*śītagrīṣmasamānaśca lobhamohavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*tatra sthitvaikarātraṃ ca prātaranyatsthalaṃ vrajet \|\| 89 \|\|*

88-89. Ke should not demand for sweet dishes nor should he display his anger nor should he accept riches. He should be unattached and should remain, alike in the winter or the summer seasons, rising above greed and illusion. Thus spending the night at one place he should move on to the other, the next day.

## \|\| 83.90 \|\|

*yānamānohaṇaṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā gṛhiṇo dhanam \|*  
*gṛhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhī ramyātsvadharmātpatito bhavet \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. In case a recluse enjoys a ride, receives riches from a house-holder or resides in a beautiful house after constructing it, such a recluse is considered to be a fallen one.

## \|\| 83.91 \|\|

*kṛtvā cakṛṣivāṇijyaṃ kuvṛttiṃ kurute ca yaḥ \|*  
*sa saṃnyāsī hṛtācāraḥ svadharmātvatito bhavet \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. In case a recluse ploughs the field or enters into some business, he falls from his discipline and the dharma.

## \|\| 83.92 \|\|

*aśubhaṃ ca śubhaṃ vā'pi svakarma kurute yadi \|*  
*bahiṣkṛtaḥ svadharmo vā'pyupahāsyaśca vai bhavet \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. In case he performs good or bad deeds relating to his caste, then he is to be excommunicated from the ashrama and becomes a laughing stock.

## \|\| 83.93 \|\|

*brāhmaṇī patihīnā yā bhavenniṣkāminī sadā \|*  
*ekabhuktā dinānte sā haviṣyānnaratā sadā \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. Similarly, a widow Brahmana woman should always be beyond desire, she should take havisya food once a day.

## \|\| 83.94-101 \|\|

*na dhatte divyavastraṃ ca gandhadravyaṃ sutailakam \|*  
*srajaṃ ca candanaṃ caiva śaṅkhasindūrabhūṣaṇam \|\| 94 \|\|*

*tyaktvā malinavastrā syānnityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ smaret \|*  
*nārāyaṇasya sevāṃ ca kurute nityameva ca \|\| 95 \|\|*

*tannāmoccāraṇaṃ śaśvatkurute nānyabhaktitaḥ \|*  
*putratulyaṃ ca puruṣaṃ sadā paśyati dharmataḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

*miṣṭānnaṃ na ca bhuṅkte sā na kuryādvibhavaṃ vraja \|*  
*ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīdine \|\| 97 \|\|*

*śrīrāmasya navamyāṃ tu śivarātrau pavitrayā \|*  
*aghorāyāṃ ca pretāyāṃ candrasūryoparāgayoḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

*bhṛṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ parityajya bhujyate parameva ca \|*  
*tāmbūlaṃ vidhavāstrīṇāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāniṇām \|\| 99 \|\|*

*saṃnyāsināṃ ca saumāṃsasurātulyaṃ śrutau śrutam \|*  
*raktaśākaṃ masūraṃ ca jambīraṃ parṇameva ca \|\| 100 \|\|*

*alāburvartulākārā varjanīyā ca tairavi \|*  
*paryaṅkaśāyinī nārī vidhavā pātayetpatim \|\| 101 \|\|*

94-101. She should not be dad in divine garments or apply fragrant material, scented oil, garland, sandal-paste, vermilion and ornaments. She should be clad in unclean garments and remain devoted to Narayana. She should devotee herself to Narayana and with great devotion, should always consider the other men as her own sons. О lord of Vraja, she should not take sweet food and should not enjoy fortunes. She should not take food on the birthday of Krishna, Rama, Shivaratri, Narkacaturdasi, eclipse of the sun or moon. She should discard fried things and should take simple food alone. The use of betel by a widow a Yati, a BrahmacarJ or a recluse is like the eating of cow meat and the consuming of wine is also prohibited. This has been prescribed in the Vedas. They are prohibited from consuming red vegetables, small grained pulse, sour lime, betel and round gourd. A widow who sleeps on a comfortable bed makes her husband fall.

## \|\| 83.102-104 \|\|

*yānamārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā vidhavā narakaṃ vrajet \|*  
*na kuryātkeśasaṃskāraṃ gātrasaṃskārameva ca \|\| 102 \|\|*

*keśaveṇī jaṭārūpe tatkṣauraṃ tīrthakaṃ vinā \|*  
*tailābhyaṅgaṃna kurvīta nahi paśyati darpaṇam \|\| 103 \|\|*

*mukhaṃ ca parapuṃsāṃ ca yātrāṃ nṛtyaṃ mahotsavam \|*  
*nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ caiva suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ śubham \|\| 104 \|\|*

102-104. In case a widow enjoys the ride of a vehicle, she has to fall into hell. Oil should not be applied to her hair and her body should not be decorated. The hair which is turned into the form of looks of hair should be cut off only at a sacred place. She should not apply oil over the body, should not look at a mirror, should not look at the face of other men. She should not participate in a yalra, a dance and other festivities and should not look at a beautiful person clad in the best of gannents.

## \|\| 83.105 \|\|

*śṛṇuyācca satāṃ dharma sāmavedanirūpitam \|*  
*paramārtha paraṃ caiva nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. Now you listen to the duties of the noble people as prescribed in the Samavecla. Now I narrate to you the best of the duties to be performed by a noble person. You listen to me.

## \|\| 83.106-109 \|\|

*adhyāpanamadhyānaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ paripālanam \|*  
*guruṇāṃ sevanaṃ nityaṃ dvicadevārcanaṃ tathā \|\| 106 \|\|*

*siddhāntaśāstranaipuṇyaṃ bhāvanaṃ svātmatoṣaṇam \|*  
*vyākhyānaṃ pariśuddhaṃ ca granthābhyastaṃ ca saṃtatam \|\| 107 \|\|*

*pyavasthāpariśuddhyartha vicāro vedasaṃmataḥ \|*  
*śāstrārthācaraṇaṃ caiva katadhyaṃ svayameva ca \|\| 108 \|\|*

*devāhnikeṣu naipuṇyaṃ vedācaraṇamīpsitam \|*  
*vedoktabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva pavitrācaraṇaṃ sadā \|\| 109 \|\|*

106-109. The noble people should engage themselves in teaching, studies, maintaining pupils, serving teachers, Brahmanas and the gods daily, attaining proficiency in different theories, maintaining a high standard of intellect, self satisfaction pure discourses, continuos study of the scriptures, to mould the thinking of the people according to the Vedas and act according to the scriptures. They should be well-versed in the performing of the duties of the gods, the Vedas and should consume things which are prescribed in the Vedas. They should conduct themselves in a pure and simple way.

## \|\| 83.110-114 \|\|

*pativratānāṃ yaṃ dharma taṃ nibodha vrajeśvara \|*  
*nityaṃtu bhartaryautsukyāttatpādodakamīpsitam \|\| 110 \|\|*

*bhaktibhāvena satataṃ bhoktavyaṃ tadanujñayā \|*  
*vrataṃ tapasyāṃ devārcāṃ parityajya prayatnataḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

*kuryāccaraṇasevāṃ ca stavanaṃ paritoṣaṇam \|*  
*tadājñārahitaṃ karma na kuyadviraitaḥ satī \|\| 112 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇātparaṃ kāntaṃ dhyāyate satataṃ satī \|*  
*parapuṃsāṃ mukhaṃ caiva suveṣapuruṣaṃ param \|\| 113 \|\|*

*yātrāmahotsavaṃ nṛtyaṃ nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ vraja \|*  
*parakrīḍāṃ ca satataṃ na hi paśyati suvratā \|\| 114 \|\|*

110-114. О lord of Vraja, now you listen to me about the duties of the chaste woman. A chaste woman remains anxious about her husband and always sips his caranodaka daily. She takes food devotedly with the permission of her husband. Discarding the vratas, tapas and adoration of the gods, she spends her time by devoting herself at the feet of her husband and offers prayer to him satisfying him in all respects. A chaste woman should not act without the command of her husband and should not act with enmity. A chaste woman considers her husband more important than Narayana and remains always devoted to him. О lord of Vraja, a chaste woman is never attracted towards the best faces of other man, clad in beautiful garments and does not join them in journey, festivities, dance, song and other types of sports.

## \|\| 83.115 \|\|

*yadbhakṣyaṃ svāmino nityaṃ tadevamapi yoṣitām \|*  
*nahi tyajettu tatsaṅgaṃ kṣaṇameva ca suvratā \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Whatever is eaten by her husband daily is always acceptable to her. A chaste lady never separates herself from her husband even for a moment.

## \|\| 83.116 \|\|

*uttare nottaraṃ dadyātsvāminaśya pativratā \|*  
*na kopaṃ kurute śudvā tāḍitā cāpi kopataḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. A chaste woman never enters into controversies with her husband. Evan if she is scolded by her husband, she never gets enraged.

## \|\| 83.117-118 \|\|

*kṣudhitaṃ bhojayetkāntaṃ dadyātpānaṃ ca bhojanam \|*  
*na bodhayettaṃ nidrāluṃ prareyennaiva karmasu \|\| 117 \|\|*

*putrāṇāṃ ca śataguṇaṃ snehaṃ kuryātpatīṃ satī \|*  
*patirbandhurgatirbhartā daivataṃ kulayoṣitaḥ \|\| 118 \|\|*

117-118. The chaste woman should serve food to her hungry husband and serve him water. When asleep, he should not be disturbed and she should not demand conjugal pleasure when he is asleep. A chaste lady has to love her husband, a hundred times more than his sons because for a bride only the husband is the true relative and not the gods or others.

## \|\| 83.119 \|\|

*śubhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sudhātulyaṃ kāntaṃ paśyati sundarī \|*  
*sasmitaṃ vadanaṃ kṛtvā bhaktibhāvena yatnataḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. She looks at her husband quite devotedly who happens to be nectar-like towards her.

## \|\| 83.120 \|\|

*puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca satī strī ca samuddharet \|*  
*patiḥ pativratānāṃ ca mucyate sarvapātakāt \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. A chaste woman redeems thousands of her generations. The husband of the chaste woman is relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 83.121 \|\|

*nāsti teṣāṃ karmabhogaḥ satīnāṃ vratatejasā \|*  
*tayā sārdhaṃ ca niṣkarmī modate harimandire \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. Because of the performance of the chaste woman, the sins of the husband are washed away. As by getting relieved of all the desires, he together with his chaste wife enjoys her company in the abode of lord.

## \|\| 83.122 \|\|

*pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni satīpādeṣu tānyapi \|*  
*tejaśca sarvadevānāṃ munīnāṃ ca satīṣu ca \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. All the holy places on earth dwell in the feet of a chaste lady. The glory of all the gods and the sages always remain pleasant in the chaste woman.

## \|\| 83.123 \|\|

*tapasvināṃ tapaḥ sarvaṃ vratināṃ yatphalaṃ vraja \|*  
*dāne phalaṃ yaddātaṇāṃ tatsarva tāsu saṃtatam \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. О lord of Vraja, the merit a mendicant achieves by performing tapas, performing vratas, fasting by the ascetics and the giving away of charities by the donors, the same merit is always achieved by the chaste woman.

## \|\| 83.124 \|\|

*svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śaṃbhurvidhātā jagatāmapi \|*  
*surāḥ sarve ca munayo bhītāstābhyāṃ ca saṃtatam \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. That is why even lord Narayana, Shiva, Brahma, the creator of the universe, all the gods and the sages get afraid of the chaste woman.

## \|\| 83.125 \|\|

*satīnāṃ pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā \|*  
*pativratāṃ namaskṛtvā mucyate pātakānnaraḥ \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. With the dust of the feet of the chaste woman, the earth gets purified and by offering salutation to the chaste woman, one is relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 83.126 \|\|

*trailokyaṃ bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣaṇenaiva pativratā \|*  
*svatejasā samarthā sā mahāpuṇyavatī sadā \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. A chaste woman is always considered to be highly meritorious and she is competent enough to reduce the three worlds to ashes with her curse.

## \|\| 83.127 \|\|

*satīnāṃ ca patiḥ sādhuḥ putro niḥśaṃka eva ca \|*  
*na hi tasya bhayaṃ kiṃciddevebhyaśca yamādapi \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. The husband of the chaste women is always noble and her sons develop no doubt and she never gets afraid of the gods and Yama.

## \|\| 83.128-133 \|\|

*śatajanmapuṇyavatāṃ gehe jātā pativratā \|*  
*pativratāprasūḥ pūtā jīvanmuktaḥ pitā tathā \|\| 128 \|\|*

*satī strī prātarutthāya tyaktvā ca rātrivāsasam \|*  
*bhartāraṃ ca namaskṛtya karoti stavanaṃ mudā \|\| 129 \|\|*

*gṛhakāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snātvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|*  
*gṛhītvā śuklapuṣpaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ pūjayetpatim \|\| 130 \|\|*

*snāpayitvā supūtena jalena nirmalena ca \|*  
*tasmai dattvā dhautavastraṃ tatpādau kṣālayenmudā \|\| 131 \|\|*

*āsane vāsayitvā ca dattvā bhāle ca candanam \|*  
*sarvāṅgalepanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā mālyaṃ gale'pi ca \|\| 132 \|\|*

*sāmavedoktamantreṇa bhogadravyaiḥ sudhopamaiḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ kāntaṃ stutvā ca praṇamenmudā \|\| 133 \|\|*

128-133. Therefore only after a person performs good deeds for a hundred births only then is a chaste woman born in that race. The mother of the chaste woman is purified and the father is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. The chaste woman should get up early in the morning, change the clothes worn by her during the night and should clad herself in new clothes. Then she should adore her husband offering white flowers and she should make her husband take his bath with spotless clean water and offer him two clean garments and then wash her feet. Thereafter making him sit on a pedestal, apply sandal-paste on his forehead and all the limbs, place a garland around his neck and then should adore her husband with great devotion, reciting the hymns from the Samaveda.

## \|\| 83.134-137 \|\|

*oṃ namaḥ kāntāya śāntāya sarvadevāśrayāya svāhā \|*  
*ityanenaiva mantreṇa dattvā puṣpaṃ ca candanam \|\| 134 \|\|*

*pādyārdhyaṃ dhūpadīpau ca vastraṃ naivedyamuttamam \|*  
*jalaṃ suvāsitaṃ śuddhaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam \|\| 135 \|\|*

*dattvā stotraṃ paṭhedyadyatkṛtaṃ vai pāṭhyameva ca \|*  
*oṃ namaḥ kāntāya bhartre ca śiraścandrasvarūpiṇe \|\| 136 \|\|*

*namaḥ śāntāya dāntāya sarvadevāśrayāya ca \|*  
*namo brahmasvarūpāya satīprāṇaparāya ca \|\| 137 \|\|*

134-137. By reciting the mantra she should offer the sandal-paste and flowers, padya, arghya, incense, lamp and the best of garments beside the naivedya, in addition to the spotless clean water, fragrant betel and should recite, "O my beloved husband, the form of Chandrasekhara, I bow in reverence to you. You are peaceful and the form of Brahmana and the life of Sati, I adore you.".

## \|\| 83.138-140 \|\|

*namasyāya ca pūjyāya hṛdādhārāya te namaḥ \|*  
*pañcaprāṇādhidevāya cakṣuṣastārakāya ca \|\| 138 \|\|*

*jñānādhārāya patnīnāṃ paramānandarūpiṇe \|*  
*patirbrahmā patirviṣṇuḥ patireva maheśvaraḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

*patiśca nirguṇādhāro brahmarūpa namo'stu te \|*  
*kṣamasva bhagavan doṣaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ ca yat \|\| 140 \|\|*

138-140. You are adorable and are the base of my heart, I offer my salutation to you. You are the lord of my body, the star of my eyes, the base of the knowledge of the wives, you are all blissful, I offer my salutation to you. The husband is like Brahma, Vishnu and Maheshvara. The husband is like Brahman, I bow in reverence to you. О lord you forgive me for all the sins committed by me knowingly or unknowingly.

## \|\| 83.141-147 \|\|

*patnībandho dayāsindho dāsīdoṣaṃ kṣamasva me \|*  
*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sṛṣṭyādau padmayā kṛtam \|\| 141 \|\|*

*sarasvatyā ca dharayā gaṅgayā ca purā vraja \|*  
*sāvitryā ca kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇe cāpi nityaśaḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

*pārvatyā ca kṛtaṃ bhaktyā kailāse śaṃkarāya ca \|*  
*munīnāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca patnībhiśca kṛtaṃ purā \|\| 143 \|\|*

*pativratānāṃ sarvāsāṃ stotrametacchubhāvaham \|*  
*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yā śrṛṇoti pativratā \|\| 144 \|\|*

*naro'nyo vā'pi nārī vā labhate sarvavāñchitam \|*  
*aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhano labhate dhanam \|\| 145 \|\|*

*raugī ca mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt \|*  
*pativratā ca stutvā ca tīrthasnānaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 146 \|\|*

*phalaṃ ca sarvaṃ tapasāṃ vratānāṃ ca vrajeśvara \|*  
*idaṃ stutvā namaskṛtvā bhuṅkte sā tadanujñayā \|*  
*uktaḥ pativratādharmo gṛhiṇāṃ śruyatāṃ vraja \|\| 147 \|\|*

141-147. O lord of the wife, "you are the ocean of mercy, you forgive the sins of a slave like me.” О lord of Vraja, in earlier times at the beginning of the creation, Lakshmi, Sarasvati, PrthvI and Ganga had recited this meritorious stotra. Savitri had adored Brahma in earlier times by reciting this stotra, Parvati had adored Shiva by reciting this stotra in the ancient times. The gods and the sages were also adored by their spouses reciting this stotra which bestows welfare to all the chaste woman. In case a chaste lady recites this auspicious stotra or those of the people who listen to it, all their desires are fulfilled. The one without a son gets a son, a pauper gets riches and an ailing person is relieved of his ailment and a person is relieved of the fetters. О lord of Vraja, in case a chaste woman recites this stotra, she earns the merit of visiting a holy place, besides the merit of performing all the vratas and tapas. After adoring the husband offering the prayers, she should take food with the permission of her husband. О lord of Vraja, I have now narrated to you the duties of a chaste woman.

## Chapter 84

## \|\| 84.1-2 \|\|

*atha caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrībhagavānuvāca dvijadevārcanaṃ caiva karoti satataṃ gṛhī \|*  
*svadharmācaraṇaṃ caiva cāturvarṇyaṃ ca nityaṇaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kurvanti gṛhiṇāmāśāṃ sarve devādayastathā \|*  
*akṛtvā'tithipūjāṃ ca gṛhasthaśca sadā'śuciḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Shri Krishna said – The house-holders should daily adore Brahmanas and the gods. The people of all the four varnas should engage themselves in performing the dharmas of their respective varnas. All the gods repose their hopes in the house-holders. Therefore, a house-holder who does not welcome a guest or a beggar, is considered to be unclean.

## \|\| 84.3 \|\|

*pitaraḥ karmakāle cātithikāle ca devatāḥ \|*  
*sarve gṛhasthamāyānti nipānamiva dhenavaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. At the time of performing the pindas the ancestors and the guests arrive at the time of performing puja by a house-holder as the cows rush towards the tank filled with water.

## \|\| 84.4 \|\|

*samāyāti prayatnena sayāhne kṣudhito'tithiḥ \|*  
*pūjāṃ labdhvā''śiṣaṃ kṛtvā prayāti gṛhiṇo gṛhāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. In the evening if a hungry ascetic arrives at the door of a house-holder and getting honoured there, he leaves the place showering blessings on him.

## \|\| 84.5 \|\|

*akṛtvā'tithipūjāṃ ca gṛhī bhavati pātakī \|*  
*trailokyajanitaṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The one who does not welcome the guest becomes a sinner and attracts all the sins of the three worlds. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 84.6 \|\|

*atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinirvate \|*  
*pitarastasya devāśca vahnayaśca tathaiva ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The one from whose house a guest returns disappointed, from the same house the ancestors, the gods and the god of fire also go away disappointed.

## \|\| 84.7-8 \|\|

*nirāśāḥ pratigacchanti gṛhiṇo'tithayo gṛhāt \|*  
*strīdhnairgoghnaiḥ kṛtaghnaiśca brāhmaṇairgurutalpagaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tulyadoṣo bhavatyeva yenātithiranarcitaḥ \|*  
*svātmanaḥ pātakaṃ dattvā puṇyamādāya gacchati \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The one who does not adore a guest, he earns the sin of killing of a wife, the killing of a cow, becomes ungraceful and the one enjoying the company of the wife of his own teacher. The same guest gives away all his sins to the house-holder and moves out carrying all his merits.

## \|\| 84.9 \|\|

*tasmātkṛtvā sarvasevāṃ devādīṃśca śubhāśayaḥ \|*  
*poṣyāṇāṃ bharaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścādbhuṅkte sa dharmavit \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Therefore those well-versed in dharma, the large hearted house-holder serve the gods and others, feeling them to be like their own sons, then take their own food.

## \|\| 84.10 \|\|

*yasya mātā gṛhe nāsti bhāryā ca puṃścalī tathā \|*  
*araṇyaṃ tena gantavyamaraṇyādduḥkhadaṃ gṛham \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The household in which there is no mother and the wife becomes an evil place such a person should desert the home and retire to the forest because for him the house is as troublesome as the forest.

## \|\| 84.11 \|\|

*patīṃ dveṣṭi sadā duṣṭā viṣatunyaṃ ca paśyati \|*  
*dadāti tasmai nā''hāraṃ bhartsanaṃ kurute sadā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A wicked woman always becomes envious of her husband and looks at him like poison; she does not provide food to him and always denounces him.

## \|\| 84.12 \|\|

*pūjitaṃ munitulyaṃ ca sā ca pāpīyasī param \|*  
*saṃtataṃ tṛṇavanmatvā nyakkāraṃ kurute sadā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The wicked woman always treats her husband like a straw even if he is an adorable person like a sage and she always denounces him.

## \|\| 84.13 \|\|

*durvākyāvahninā dagdho mṛtatulyaśca jīvati \|*  
*yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ saṃprāpya duṣṭavaṃśajām \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus by accepting a girl of a wicked race, a person has to face the evil ways of the wife which bum him like a fire and he lives like a dead man throughout his life.

## \|\| 84.14-15 \|\|

*gṛhiṇīnāṃ sadācāraṃ śrūyatāṃ tacchru tau śrutam \|*  
*gṛhiṇī patibhaktā ca devabrāhmaṇabūjitā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sā śuddhā prātarutthāya namaskṛtya patiṃ suram \|*  
*prāṅgaṇe maṅgalaṃ dadyādgomayena jalena ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Now I repeat to you the noble conduct of the good nature woman, you please listen. The chaste woman is always adored by the gods and the Brahmanas. Such a spotless woman gets up early in the morning and offers her salutation to the family gods and then plasters the court-yard with cowdung and performs other welfare deeds.

## \|\| 84.16 \|\|

*gṛhakṛtyaṃ ca kṛtvā ca snātvā''gatya gṛhaṃ satī \|*  
*suraṃ vipraṃ patiṃ natvā pūjayedgṛhadevatām \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thereafter, performing the household jobs, the chaste lady takes her bath and returning to the home, she bows in reverence to the Brahmana, her husband and the family gods.

## \|\| 84.17 \|\|

*gṛhakṛtyaṃ sunirvṛtya bhojayitvā patiṃ satī \|*  
*atithiṃ pūjayitvā ca svayaṃ bhuṅkate sukhaṃsatī \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The chaste house wife performs the household duties pretty well and getting free from the same, she serves her husband and adores the guest. Thereafter she takes her food.

## \|\| 84.18 \|\|

*putraiśca pūjitastātaḥ śiṣyaiśca pūjito guruḥ \|*  
*ājñayā kurute karma putraḥ śiṣyaśca bhṛtyavat \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The father is adored by the sons and the teacher is adored by the pupils thus both the sons and the pupils serve like servants accepting the command.

## \|\| 84.19-22 \|\|

*na prerayedguruṃ tātaṃ putraḥ śiṣyaśca karmasu \|*  
*pitre ca gurave nityaṃ sarvasvaṃ ca samarpayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*na kuryānnarabuddhiṃ ca gurau pitari saṃtatam \|*  
*kṛtvā ca narabuddhiṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*mātaraṃ pūjayedbhaktyā pituścāpyadhikāṃ tathā \|*  
*mātuḥ paraṃ guruṃ caiva pūjayedbhaktiyogataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pitā mātā gururbhāryā śiṣyaḥ putraḥ sadā'kṣamaḥ \|*  
*anāthā bhaginī kanyā nityaṃ poṣyā gurupriyā \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. The son and the pupil should not force the father or the teacher to work. The father and the teacher should always be offered all the service, because by not doing so, one attracts the sin of Brahmahatya. A son should respect the mother more than his father and more than her he should adore the teacher. Thus the son who is unable to serve the parents, the teacher, the wife, the pupil and himself as a dependent son, the helpless sister, the daughter and the wife of the teacher he earns sins because it is the duty of a person to maintain all of them.

## \|\| 84.23-24 \|\|

*evaṃ ca kathitaṃ tāta sarveṣāṃ dharmamuttamam \|*  
*śtrījātirvāstapīśuddhā tāśca sarvāḥ pativratāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sarvā jātirekavidhā cā''dau sṛṣṭā ca brahmaṇā \|*  
*tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteraṃśāḥ pavitrāḥ paṇḍitādhikāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. О father, I have thus spelt out the best of the duties of them all and the chaste ladies who are spotless and clean. At the beginning of the universe Brahma had created all the types of creatures in a similar way. All the intelligent and pure damsels were born out of the amsa of Prakriti.

## \|\| 84.25-27 \|\|

*kedārakanyāśāpena sa hi dharmaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*tadā kopena dhātrā ca kṛtyā strī ca vinirmitā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kṛtyā strī trividhā jātirbrahmaṇā nirmitā purā \|*  
*uttamā prathamā sā ca madhyamā cādhamā vraja \|\| 26 \|\|*

*uttamā patibhaktā sā kiṃciddharmasamanvitā \|*  
*prāṇānte'pi na kurute taṃ jāramayaśakaram \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. When Dharma was reduced in body because of the curse of the daughter of Kedara, then Brahma in anger created krtya woman. О lord of Vraja, in earlier times Brahma divided the race of krtya woman into three parts; the first among them was known as uttama, the second one madhyama and the third one was adhama. The extremely religious uttama woman is always devoted to her husband. She does not accept the company of any other man even at the caste of her life.

## \|\| 84.28-30 \|\|

*pūjayetsā yathā kāntaṃ tathā devadvijātithīn \|*  
*vratāni copavāsāṃśca kurute sarvapūjanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*guruṇā rakṣitā yatnājjāraṃ ca na bhajedbhayāt \|*  
*sa kṛtrimā madhyamā ca yathākiṃcitpatiṃ bhajet \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sthānaṃ nāstikṣaṇaṃ nāsti nāsti prārthayitā naraḥ \|*  
*tena he nanda tāsāṃ ca satītvamupajāyate \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. She adores the Brahmanas and the guests like her own husband, performs fasting and vratas and adores everyone. The madhyama type of krtyd woman is such who does not fall into the company of other men because of the protection of the teachers and considers her husband as something. О Nanda, because of the non-availability of men, their desire, their chastity remains intact.

## \|\| 84.31 \|\|

*adhamā paramā duṣṭā'tyantāsadvaṃśajā tathā \|*  
*adharmaśīlā duḥśīlā durmukhā kalahānvitā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The woman who are born in degraded families are known as degraded woman who are extremely wicked. Such woman are devoid of dharma, have a wicked nature, are ill-spoken of and quarrelsome.

## \|\| 84.32-34 \|\|

*patiṃ bhartsayate nityaṃ jāraṃ ca sevate sadā \|*  
*duḥśaṃ dadāti kāntāya viṣatulyaṃ ca paśyati \|\| 32 \|\|*

*jāradvāramupāyena hanti kāntaṃ manoharam \|*  
*dharmiṣṭhaṃ ca variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca mahītale \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kāmadevasamaṃ cāpi jāraṃ paśyati kāmataḥ \|*  
*śubhadṛṣṭyā kaṭākṣeṇa śaravatpāpīyasī mudā \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. The wicked woman denounces her husband daily and serves the other men daily; she always tortures her husband and considers him like poison. Not only this, with the help of the other men, she even tries to kill her husband who is quite religious, glorious and beautiful. Such a degraded woman looks at other men with a passionate eye who see her as quite beautiful and he enjoys her voluptuous advances.

## \|\| 84.35 \|\|

*suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ draṣṭvā yuvānaṃ ratiśūkaram \|*  
*yoniḥ klidyati nārīṇāṃ kāminīnāṃ nirantaram \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Finding the youthful and wicked person well-versed in the love-sport and the one who is wicked like a pig, the pelvic region of the passionate woman always remains wet with fluid.

## \|\| 84.36 \|\|

*dadāti bhartre nā''hāraṃ viṣoktiṃ vakti saṃtatam \|*  
*adharmaṃ cintayecchaśvajjāraṃ ca paramaṃ mudā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The degraded woman does not serve food to her husband. She always speaks in a foul tongue but she thinks of her friend quite lovingly.

## \|\| 84.37-38 \|\|

*gurubhirbhartsitā sā ca rakṣitā ca śatena ca \|*  
*tathā'pi jāraṃ kurute nāpi sādhyā nṛperapi \|\| 37 \|\|*

*nāsti tasyāḥ priyaṃ kiṃcitsarvaṃ kāryavaśena ca \|*  
*gāvastṛṇamivāraṇye prārthayantī navaṃ navam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Getting denounced by the teachers and having been observed by hundreds of persons, she still moves on the wrong path and makes illegal friends. Even the kings are unable to set her right. There is no one dear to her and she moves just according to the available opportunity. She is always desirous of new faces like the cows grazing in the forest are always desirous of fresh pasture.

## \|\| 84.39-40 \|\|

*vidyudābhā jale rekhā tasyā prītistathaiva ca \|*  
*adharmayuktā satataṃ kapaṭaṃ vakti niścitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vrate tapasi dharme ca na mano gṛhakarmaṇi \|*  
*na gurau na ca deveṣu jāre snigdhaṃ ca cañcalam \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Her attachment is short lived like a line drawn on water or like a lightning. Infatuated with evil ways, she always talks deceitfully. She never feels interested in performing the vratas, tapas, religious functions, household jobs, the teachers or the gods. Her mind is always wavering for her friends towards whom she is always found attached.

## \|\| 84.41-42 \|\|

*strījātitrividhānāṃ ca kathā ca kathitā mayā \|*  
*bhaktānāṃ trividhānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ śrūyatāmiti \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tṛṇaśayyārato bhakto mannāmaguṇakīrtiṣu \|*  
*mano niveśayettyaktvā saṃsārasukhakāraṇam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Thus I have spoken about the three types of woman; now you listen to me about the three types of devotees. My devotees resting on a bed of grass, getting deprived of all comforts always remain engrossed in reciting my name, my qualities and glory.

## \|\| 84.43-46 \|\|

*vyāyate matpadābjaṃ ca pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ \|*  
*ahaitukīṃ tasya devāḥ saṃkalparahitasya ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*sarvasiddhiṃna vāñchanti te'ṇimādikamīpsitam \|*  
*brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā suratvaṃ sukhakāraṇam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*dāsyaṃ vinā nahīcchanti sālokyādicatuṣṭayam \|*  
*naiva nirvāṇamuktiṃ ca sudhāpānamabhīpsitam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*vāñchanti niścilāṃ bhaktiṃ madīyāmatulāmapi \|*  
*strīpuṃvibhedo nāstyeva sarvajīveṣu bhinnatā \|\| 46 \|\|*

43-46. Feeling devoted to my lotus-like feet, they adore me. My devotee is devoid of all desires and such a devotee achieves the Ahaitukl form of devotion. Such a devotee is not interested in the siddhis like anima and others, the Brahmanhood who is the cause of all the siddhis or etemalship. Not only this, except serving at my feet, they considers the four types of salvation including Salokya to be of no consequence. My devotee is not desirous of salvation and the consuming of nectar; he/she is always desirous of my everlasting and eternal devotion. He/she is disinterested in all other creatures and the difference between men and women disappears from his or her mind.

## \|\| 84.47-50 \|\|

*teṣāṃ siddheśvarāṇāṃ ca pravarāṇāṃ vrajeśvara \|*  
*kṣutpipāsādikaṃ nidrālobhamohādikaṃ ripum \|\| 47 \|\|*

*tpaktvā divāniśaṃ māṃ ca dhyāyante ca digambarāḥ \|*  
*samadbhaktottamo nanda śrūyatāṃ madhyamādikam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*nā''saktaḥ karmasu gṛhī pūrvaprāktanataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*karoti satataṃ caiva pūrvakarmanikṛntanam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*na karotyaparaṃ vatnātsaṃkalparahitaḥ sa ca \|*  
*sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasya yatkiṃcinnāhaṃ kartā ca karmaṇaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

47-50. О lord of Vraja, such a devotee of high order remains unmoved with hunger, thirst, sleep, greed, illusion and enemies. Such types of devotees are unmindful of the clothes they wear but they continue reciting my name throughout day and night. О Nanda, such a type of person is the best of my devotees. Now I speak about the medium type of the devotee who is a house-holder and getting purified because of his good deeds of earlier births, never gets involved in worldly deeds. On the other hand, he tries his best to destroy the earlier deeds and making all efforts and remaining unmindful, he performs no deeds. He is well aware of the fact that everything belongs to lord Krishna and he does not happen to be the performer of any deeds.

## \|\| 84.51-54 \|\|

*karmaṇā manasā vācā satataṃ cintayediti \|*  
*nyūnabhaktaśca tannyūnaḥ sa ca prākṛtikaḥ śrutau \|\| 51 \|\|*

*yamaṃ vā yamadūtaṃ vā svapne'pi na ca paśyati \|*  
*puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca pūrvabhaktaḥ suddharet \|\| 52 \|\|*

*puṃsāṃ śataṃ madhyamaśca taccaturthaṃ ca prākṛtaḥ \|*  
*bhaktaśca trividhastāta kathitaśca tavā''jñayā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍaracanākhyānaṃ śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ \|*  
*brahmāṇḍaracanārthaṃ ca bhaktā jānanti yatnataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

51-54. He thinks in this way, mentally with speech and with actions, such a type of devotee is called NyUnabhakta. The devotee who is still lesser in grade is known as Prakritika. This has been mentioned in the Vedas, my devotee does not have to come across Yama or the messengers of Yama even in a dream. The best of my devotees redeems thousands of his generations, the medium type of devotees redeems hundred of his generations and the Pr,' biika devotee redeems twenty five generations. О father, at your command I have narrated to you the qualities of the three types of my devotees; now you listen to the topic of the creation of the globe quite carefully. The cause of the creation of the globe is known to my devotees with great difficulty,

## \|\| 84.55-58 \|\|

*munayaśca surāḥ santaḥ kiṃcijjānanti duḥkhataḥ \|*  
*jānāmi viśvaṃ sarvārtha brahmā''nanto \|*  
*maheśvaraḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*dharmaḥ sanatkumāraśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|*  
*kapilaśca gaṇeśaśca durgā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī \|\| 56 \|\|*

*vedāśca vedamātā ca sarvajñā rādhikā svayam \|*  
*ete jānanti viśvārtha nānyo jānāti kaścana \|\| 57 \|\|*

*vaiṣamyārtha ca sudhiyaḥ sarve vijñātumakṣamāḥ \|*  
*nityākāśo yathā''tmā ca tathā nityā diśo daśa \|\| 58 \|\|*

55-58. The sages, the gods and the noble people know about the same with great difficulty, but I am quite well aware of the course of the universe about which I am going to tell you. The cause of universe is quite well-known to Brahma, Maheshvara, Dharma, Sanatkumara, the sage Naranarayana, Kapila, Ganesha, Durga, Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Vedas, Savitrf, the mother of the Vedas and Radhika. No one else knows about the same; all the intellectuals are unable to know its cause, as the soul is eternal, similarly the sky is eternal beside all the ten directions.

## \|\| 84.59-64 \|\|

*yathā nityā ca prakṛtistathaiva viśvagolakaḥ \|*  
*golokaśca yathā nityastathā vaikuṇṭha eva ca \|\| 59 \|\|*

*ekadā mayi goloke rāse nityaṃ prakurvati \|*  
*āvirbhūtā ca vāmāṅgādbālā ṣoḍhaśavārṣikī \|\| 60 \|\|*

*śvetacampakavarṇābhā śaraccandrasamaprabhā \|*  
*atīva sundarī rāmā ramaṇīnāṃ parāvarā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā kaumalāṅgī manoharā \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 62 \|\|*

*yathā jaladapaṅktiśca balākābhirtibhūṣitā \|*  
*sindūrabindūnā cārucandracandanabindubhiḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*kastūrībindubhiḥ sārdhaṃ sīmantāndhaḥsyalojjvalā \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇasusnigdhakiraṇojjvalā \|\| 64 \|\|*

59-64. As Prakriti is eternal, so the globe is also eternal and also Vaikuntha. Once while performing the divine dance in Goloka, a beautiful damsel of sixteen years appeared from my left half, having the complexion of white campaka flowers and the lustre of the full moon of the winter season. She was extremely beautiful and was the best of all the ladies on earth. She wore a serene smile on her face, was delightful in her mind, had soft limbs and was quite charming to look at. She was clad in the garments sanctified by fire and was adorned with ornaments studded with gems, which looked like a line of cranes in the clouds. Her forehead was adorned with a spot of vermilion, besides other spots of kusturl which looked like the moon surrounded by the stars, the line of parting of the hair was quite bright, she was adorned with the invaluable ornament of gems which were shining emitting rays like the sun.

## \|\| 84.65-66 \|\|

*ratarakuṇḍalabugmena gaṇḍasthalasamujjvalā \|*  
*kuṅakumālaktakasatūrīcārucandanapatrakeḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*vicitraiśca sucitraiśca sukapolasthalojjvalā \|*  
*khamendracañcuvijitanāsāmauktikaśobhitā \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. The pair of ear ornaments were adorning her temples and her feet were plastered with the red paste of saffron and kastiirl. Her cheeks painted looked like different types of leaves, her nose resembled the beak of Garuda which was adorned with jewels.

## \|\| 84.67-70 \|\|

*gajendragaṇ̈ḍanirmuktamuktābhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|*  
*śuktyā vimuktamuktābhadantapaṅktimanoharā \|\| 67 \|\|*

*valitākalitā'tīva pakvabimbādharā varā \|*  
*śaśvatpūrṇendunindāsyā padmaninditalocanā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇasāranibhodbhinnasucārukajjalojjvalā \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇakeyūrakaṅkaṇojjvalā \|\| 69 \|\|*

*maṇīndrarājarājībhiḥ śaṅkhayugmakarojjavalā \|*  
*ratnāṅgulīyakairebhiramṛtāṅgulibhūṣitā \|\| 70 \|\|*

67-70. She was. wearing the Gajamukta which is recovered from the temples of the elephant. The line of her teeth resembled gems. Her lips resembled the ripe wood-apple fruit, her face resembled the full moon of the winter season, her eyes resembled the lotus flower which were quite white like the eyes of a doe and the collyrium applied in the eyes looked quite charming. She was wearing beautiful armlets and wristlets which were shining. She had beautiful hands which looked like shining gems. The finger rings studded with gems adorned the fingers.

## \|\| 84.71-74 \|\|

*ratnendrarājarājena kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitā \|*  
*ratnapāśakarājībhiḥ pādāṅgulivirājitā \|\| 71 \|\|*

*sundarālaktarāgeṇa caraṇādhaḥsthalojjvalā \|*  
*gajendragāminī rāmā kāminī vāmalocanā \|\| 72 \|\|*

*māṃ dadarśa kaṭākṣeṇa ramaṇī ramaṇotsukā \|*  
*rāse saṃbhūya rāmā sā dadhāra purato mama \|\| 73 \|\|*

*tena rādhā samākhyātā burāvidbhiḥ prapūjitā \|*  
*prahṛṣṭā prakṛtiścāsyāstena prakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 74 \|\|*

71-74. The anklets were made of the best of gems and the rings on the toes were also studded with gems. The soles of the feet looked quite beautiful, having been painted with red colours. She walked slowly like an elephant. She looked charming having beautiful eyes. Becoming passionate, she looked with side-glances. Joining the divine dance, the damsel took me from the fore-front and that is why she was given the name of Radha by the intellectuals gracing her. She was quite pleasant in nature and as such she was known as Ishvari.

## \|\| 84.75-77 \|\|

*śaktā syātsarvakāryeṣu tena śaktiḥ prakīrtitā \|*  
*sarvādhārā sarvarūpā maṅgalārhā ca sarvataḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

*sarvamaṅgaladakṣā sā tena syātsarvamaṅgalā \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe sā mahālakṣmīrmūrtibhede sarasvatī \|\| 76 \|\|*

*prasūya vedānviditā vedamātā ca sā sadā \|*  
*sāvitrī sa ca gāyatrī dhātrī trijagatāmapi \|\| 77 \|\|*

75-77. Since she was competent to perform apy deeds, she was given the name of sakti. Since she happened to be the base of everything from all sides, the form of everything and bestowed welfare, she was given the name of Sarvamangala. She came to be known as Maha-Lakshmi in Vaikuntha and Sarasvati in the other form. After the creation of the Vedas she was known as the mother of the Vedas. She was also known as Savitrf, Gayatri and the one who bears the three worlds.

## \|\| 84.78 \|\|

*purā saṃhṛtya durgaṃ ca sā durgā ca prakīrtitā \|*  
*tejasaḥ sarvadevānāmāvirbhūtā purā satī \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. In the earlier times because of the killing of a demon named Durga she came to be known as Durga. In earlier times she also appeared as Sati from the tejas of all the gods.

## \|\| 84.79-80 \|\|

*tenā''dyā prakṛtirjñeyā sarvāsuravimarditī \|*  
*sarvānandā ca sānandā duḥkhadāridrayanāśinī \|\| 79 \|\|*

*śatruṇāṃ bhayadātrau ca bhaktānāṃ bhayahāriṇau \|*  
*dakṣakanyā satī kā ca śailajāteti pārvatī \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. That is why she came to be known as the eternal sakti for the destruction of all the demons. She is blissful to all, filled with all the pleasures, is the destroyer of all misfortune, frightens the enemies and removes the danger of the devotees. She appeared as Sati and was known as the daughter of Daksha, thereafter she was known as Parvati having been born as the daughter of Himalaya.

## \|\| 84.81-83 \|\|

*sarvādhārasvarūpā sā kalayā sā vasuṃdharā \|*  
*kalayā tulasī gaṅgā kalayā sarvayoṣitaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*sṛṣṭiṃ karomi ca yayā tāta śaktyā punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ rāsamadhyasthāṃ mama krīḍā \|*  
*tayā saha \|\| 82 \|\|*

*babhūva suciraṃ tāta yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam \|*  
*atyadbhutaṃ kautukaṃ ca mahāśrṛṅgāramīpsitam \|\| 83 \|\|*

81-83. She is the base of everything. She is the earth with one of her rays, with one of her rays she is Tulasi, with another ray she is Ganga and the form of all the women on earth. О father, I create the same sakti again and again. Finding the same sakti present in the Rasamandala, I enjoyed her company and the conjugal pleasures with her up to the life of hundred Brahma's. I also enjoyed her astonishing types of plays and the love-sports.

## \|\| 84.84 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmo mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakho utto nāradanāo bhagavannandasaṃo caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Thereafter both of our bodies were sweating profusely creating a charming pool there.

## \|\| 84.85-86 \|\|

*papāta dharmadhārā'dho vegena viśvagolake \|*  
*babhūva jalabūrṇaṃ ca brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca golakam \|\| 85 \|\|*

*jalapūrṇa purā sarva śṛṣṭiśūnyaṃ vrajeśvara \|*  
*śruṅgārānte ca tasyāṃ ca vīryādhānaṃ mayā kṛtam \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. The flow of the sweat moved with such force and reached the Goloka as a result of which all the lokas were filled with water. О lord of Vraja, in the earlier stage there was water everywhere and there was no earth. By enjoying the love-sport I implanted my semen in the womb of the damsels.

## \|\| 84.87-92 \|\|

*dadhāra garbha sā rādhā yāvadvai brahmaṇāḥ śatam \|*  
*susrāva sā tadante ca ḍimbhaṃ ca paramādbhutam \|\| 87 \|\|*

*cukopa devī taṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda viṣasāda sā \|*  
*pādena prerayāmāsa tamadho viśvagolake \|\| 88 \|\|*

*sa papāta jale tāta sarvādhāro mahānvirāṭ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā'patyaṃ jalasthaṃ ca mayā śaptā ca sā purā \|\| 89 \|\|*

*anapatyā ca sā rāthā macchāpena purā vibho \|*  
*tena prasūtāḥ kramato durgā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī \|\| 90 \|\|*

*catasraḥ paribūrṇāstāḥ prasūtāśca suniścitam \|*  
*devyo'nyāścāpi kāminyastāḥ prasūtā vrajeśvara \|\| 91 \|\|*

*kalayā prabhavo yāsāṃ kalāṃśāṃśena vā vraja \|*  
*jajñe mahānvirāḍyena ḍimbhena kalayā''śrayaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

87-92. Radha carried this pregnancy up to the life of a hundred Brahma's and then gave birth to a beautiful child. Finding the child Radha was enraged and started lamenting feeling disgusted. Thereafter, the child was driven out and he fell down as the Mahavirat, who was the base of everything. He fell into the water; finding the son floating in the water, I pronounced a curse on Radha. О virtuous one, she became issueless because of my earlier curse pronounced on her. Similarly Durga, Lakshmi and Sarasvati emerged. Together with Radha all the four of them conceived. О lord of Vraja, thereafter all the damsels gave birth to children because of the rays of which an egg emerged who was based on my rays.

## \|\| 84.93-99 \|\|

*amṛtāṅguṣṭhapīyūṣaṃ mayā dattaṃ papau ca saḥ \|*  
*jale sthāvararūpaśca śete ca nijakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*upadhānaṃ jalaṃ talpaṃ tasya yogabalena ca \|*  
*tasya lomnāṃ ca kūpāni jalapūrṇāni saṃtatam \|\| 94 \|\|*

*pratyekaṃ kramatasteṣu śete kṣudravirāṭ punaḥ \|*  
*sahasrapatraṃ kamalaṃ jajñe kṣudrasya nābhitaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*tatra jajñe varo brahmā tenāyaṃ kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*tatrā''virbhūya sa vidhiścintāgrasto babhūva saḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

*kasmāddehaḥkvā mātā me pitā vā kva ca bāndhavaḥ \|*  
*divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣañca babhrāma kamalāntare \|\| 97 \|\|*

*tato divyaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ sasmāra tapasā ca mām \|*  
*tadā mayā dattamantraṃ jajāpa kamalāntare \|\| 98 \|\|*

*divyavarṣasaptalakṣaṃ niyataṃ saṃyataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*tadā matto varaṃ labdhvā sraṣṭā sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

93-99. I made the child to suck my thumb which became an immovable tree because of his deeds and started floating in water. With the use of yogic practices, the water became his bed and pillow, all the hair pits on his body remained filled with water. In each hair-pit the Kshudra-virat resided. From the navel of the Kshudra-virat, a thousand petalled lotus emerged. From the same lotus, Brahma was created, that is why he is known by the name of the one born out of the lotus. After having been born of the lotus Brahma started thinking, "How has my body been born, who are my parents and brothers"? Thus thinking he spent three lakhs of years. Thereafter for divine five lakhs of years he performed my tapas, then I bestowed a mantra on him which purified him as a result of which he methodically performed tapas seated on the lotus for divine seven lakh of years. Thereafter, he received a boon from me and by becoming the creator, he started the creation.

## \|\| 84.100-108 \|\|

*māyayā prati brahmāṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ \|*  
*dikpālā dvādaśādityā rudrāścaikādaśāpi ca \|\| 100 \|\|*

*navagrahāṣṭau vasavo devāḥ koṭitrayaṃ tathā \|*  
*brāhmaṇākṣatraviṭśūdrā yakṣagandharvakinnarāḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*bhūtādayo rāṅasāścāpyevaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram \|*  
*viśve viśve vinirmāṇāḥ svargāḥ sapta krameṇa ca \|\| 102 \|\|*

*saptasāgarasaṃyuktā saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā \|*  
*kāñcanībhūmisaṃyuktā tamoyuktaṃ sthalaṃ tathā \|\| 103 \|\|*

*pātālāśca tathā sapta brahmāṇḍamebhireva ca \|*  
*viśve viśve candrasūyo puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam \|\| 104 \|\|*

*tīrthānyetāni sarvatra gaṅgādīti vrajeśvara \|*  
*yāvanti lomakūpāni mahāviṣṇoḥ krameṇa ca \|\| 105 \|\|*

*viśvānyeva hī tāvanti hyamaṃkhyātāni ca dhruvam \|*  
*viśveṣāsūrdhvābhāme ca vaikuṇṭhaśca nirāśrayaḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

*madicchayā vinirmāṇā vedāḥ kathitumakṣamāḥ \|*  
*kuyogināma dṛṣṭaścāmabhaktānāṃ viniścitam \|\| 107 \|\|*

*tasmādupari golokaḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanaḥ \|*  
*vāyunā dhāryamāṇaśca vicitraḥ paramāśramaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

100-108. Thus with the influence of illusion in every globe one finds Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, Dikpalas, eleven Rudras, seven planets, eight Vasus, three crores of gods, Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Viasyas, Siidras, Yaksas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, goblins, Raksasas besides movable and immovable. Besides every globe, there are seven heavens, seven oceans, seven continents, Svarnabhumi and darkness, land and earth, the nether-world and seven Brahmandas are there. О lord of Vraja, in each globe, the moon, the sun, the sacred land of Bharata, Ganga and other holy places are present, the number of the globes is equivalent to the number of the hair pits on the body of Maha-Vishnu and over the globes. Vaikunt ha is lodged, having no support; it was created as per my desire. Even the Vedas are unable to speak about the same. For the degraded yogis and the non-believer, Vaikuntha is invisible. The Goloka is located at a distance of fifty crores of yojanas from Vaikuntha; it is floating in the air which is quite astonishing and quite beautiful.

## \|\| 84.109-112 \|\|

*atīva ramyanirmāṇo nityarūpo madicchayā \|*  
*śataśrṛṅgeṇa śailena puṇyavṛndāvanena ca \|\| 109 \|\|*

*surāsamaṇḍalenāpi nadyā virajayā yutaḥ \|*  
*koṭiyojanavistīrṇā prasthena virajā vraja \|\| 110 \|\|*

*dairdhyaṃ tasyāḥ śataguṇaṃ paritaḥ paramā śubhā \|*  
*amūlyaratnanikarairhīramāṇikyayostathā \|\| 111 \|\|*

*maṇīnāṃ kaustubhādīnāmasaṃkhyānāṃ manoharā \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ tatrāvi pratimandiram \|\| 112 \|\|*

109-112. It has been built in a beautiful way which is according to my wishes; it has a mountain range with a hundred peaks, auspicious Vrindavana, the best of Rasamandala and the river named Viraja. О lord of Vraja, the river Viraja is a hundred crores yojanas in width and a hundred times more in length and looks charming from all sides. It has the invaluable gems besides diamonds, rubies and innumerable kaustubha gems. It is quite pleasant. Each and every house of Goloka has been made with gems.

## \|\| 84.113-114 \|\|

*manoharaṃ ca prākāramadṛṣṭaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*gopībhirgopanikarairvaiṣṭitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

*kalpavṛkṣaiḥ pārijātairasaṃkhyaiśca sarovaraiḥ \|*  
*puṣpodyānaiḥkoṭibhiśca saṃvṛtaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|\| 114 \|\|*

113-114. The. boundary wall is quite beautiful which could not be viewed by Vishvakarma even. The Rasamandala of Goloka, the groups of the cowherds and cowherdesses, the Kamadhenu, innumerable lotus flowers, kalpavrksas, pools and crores of flower orchards surround Goloka.

## \|\| 84.115-118 \|\|

*veṣṭitaṃ veṣṭitairgopairmandiraiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*ratnapradīpayuktaiśca puṣpatalpasamanvitaiḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

*sugandhicandanāmodaiḥ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitaiḥ \|*  
*krīḍopayuktairbhogeśca tāmbūlairvāsitairjalaiḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

*dhūpaiḥ surabhiramyaiśca mālyaiśca ratnadarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*rakṣakai rakṣitaṃ śaśvadrādhādāsītrikoṭibhiḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

*amūlyaratnābharaṇairvahniśuddhāṃśukairapi \|*  
*lakṣaṇattagajendrāṇāṃ veṣṭitaṃ ca balaiḥ kramāt \|\| 118 \|\|*

115-118. The Rasamandala is surrounded by the cowherds and has a hundred crores of buildings in which there are lamps of gems, beds of roses, fragrant sandal-paste, kastiiri, kumkum, besides incense, garlands of gems, mirrors of gems, guards and three crores of slave-girls of Radha also who reside there are adorned with the best of gem-studded ornaments and clad in garments sanctified by fire. The Rasamandala is surrounded by a lakh of intoxicated elephants.

## \|\| 84.119-125 \|\|

*navayauvanasaṃpannai rūpairnirupamairapi \|*  
*ramyaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ candrabimbaṃ yathā vraja \|\| 119 \|\|*

*amūlyaratnaracitaṃ daśayojanavistṛtam \|*  
*kastūrīkuṅkumai rabhyaiḥ sugandhicandanārcitam \|\| 120 \|\|*

*āvṛtaṃ maṅgalaghaṭaiḥ phalapallavasaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*dadhilājaiśca parṇaiśca snigdhadūrvāṅkuraiḥ phalaiḥ \|\| 121 \|\|*

*śrīrāmakadalīstambhairasaṃkhyaiśca manoharaiḥ \|*  
*paṭṭasūtranibaddhaiśca snigdhaiścandanapallavaiḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

*candanāsaktamālyaiśca bhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitam \|*  
*amūlyaratnaracitaṃ śataśṛṅgamanoharam \|\| 123 \|\|*

*koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca dairdhyaṃ śataguṇottaram \|*  
*śailaprasthaparimitaṃ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam \|\| 124 \|\|*

*atīva kamanīyaṃ ya vedānirvacanīyakam \|*  
*prākāramiva tasyāpi golalokasya manoharam \|\| 125 \|\|*

119-125. Its soldiers are quite young and quite beautiful. О lord of Vraja, the Rasamandala is circular in shape like the moon and is studded with gems like the stars. It is spread over an area of ten yojanas. It is quite charming and is filled with kasturl, saffron, fragrant sandal-paste, welfare pitchers, fruits and fresh tree leaves, curd, fried paddy, leaves, tender Dfirva-grass, fruits and innumerable trunks of banana trees adorned with tree leaves entwined with silken cord, garlands and ornaments. It has been built with valuable gems and has a hundred peaks. Its height is a hundred yojanas and is hundred times more in length. It is visible from a distance of fifty crores of yojanas and is beyond description even in the Vedas. It is like the boundary wall of Goloka.

## \|\| 84.126-128 \|\|

*parito veṣṭitaṃ ramyaṃ hīrahārasamanvitam \|*  
*tatra vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ yuktaṃ candanapādapaiḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

*kalpavṛkṣaiśca namyaiśca mandāraiḥ kāmadhenubhiḥ \|*  
*śobhitaṃ śobhanāḍhyaiśca puṣpodyānairmanoharaiḥ \|\| 127 \|\|*

*krīḍāsarovarai ramyaiḥ suramyai ratimandiraiḥ \|*  
*atīva ramyaṃ rahasi rāsayogyasthalānvitam \|\| 128 \|\|*

126-128. Since the garlands of gems decorate it from all sides it looks quite charming. There is charming Vmdavana having trees of sandal-wood, charming kalpavrksas, mandara trees, kamadhenus and immensely beautiful flower orchards, beautiful swimming pools and excellent places for love-sport. It is quite excellent and is the best for performing the divine dance in seclusion.

## \|\| 84.129-131 \|\|

*rakṣitaṃ rakṣakai ramyairasaṃkhyairgopikāgaṇaiḥ \|*  
*parito vartulākāraṃ trilakṣayojanaṃ vanam \|\| 129 \|\|*

*ṣaṭpadadhvanisaṃyuktaṃ puṃskokilarutānvitam \|*
