*tatrākṣayo vaṭo ramyo rahasye bahṛvistṛtaḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

*sahasrayojanordhvaśca paritaśca caturguṇaḥ \|*  
*gopīnāṃ kalpavṛkṣaśca sarvavāñchāphalapradaḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

129-131. The innumerable cowherdesses guard the place. The forest which is three lakh yojanas in area is circular in shape; one gets the hissing sound of the black wasps and the sweet notes of the cuckoos can also be heard. There is an A fa ayavata which is quite charming. It is quite widespread and its height is a thousand yojanas and it is spread over an area of four thousand yojanas. The kalpavrksa which fulfils all the desires of the cowherdesses is also available there.

## \|\| 84.132-134 \|\|

*krīḍānvitairāvṛtaśca rādhādāsītrilakṣakaiḥ \|*  
*virajātīranirāṇāṃ vāyunā śītalena ca \|\| 132 \|\|*

*puṣpānvitena mandena pavitraśca sugandhinā \|*  
*dāsīgaṇairasaṃkhyaiśca vṛndāvanavinodinī \|\| 133 \|\|*

*tatra krīḍati rādhā sā mama prāṇādhidevatā \|*  
*seyaṃ śrīdāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā \|\| 134 \|\|*

132-134. The slave-girls of Radha spend their time playfully there; the cool breeze scented with the water of Viraja river and the flowers blow there. The Vmdavana which is served by innumerable slave-girls is the dwelling place for me and Radha. The same Radha because of the curse of a Brahmana named Shridama has been born as the daughter of Vrsabhanu.

## \|\| 84.135-136 \|\|

*brahmādidevaiḥ siddhendrairmunīndraiḥ pūjitā vraja \|*  
*siddhairguṇairbalairbuddhyā jñānayogaiśca vidyayā \|\| 135 \|\|*

*tāta sarvaprakāreṇa vandyā satsadṛśī priyā \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ nanda brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca varṇanam \|*  
*yathocitaṃ parimitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 136 \|\|*

135-136. О lord of Vraja, she is adored by Brahma, the gods and siddhas and other ascetics. She happens to be my beloved, possesses all the virtues besides the prowess, intelligence, learning and is adorable like me, by all. О Nanda, I have thus described everything about the globes. What else do you want to listen to from me.

## Chapter 85

## \|\| 85.1-2 \|\|

*atha pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca varṇānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca sāṃpratam \|*  
*vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kathayasva mahābhāga kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam \|*  
*tvatto'nyaṃ kaṃ ca pṛcchāmi nitāntaṃ santamīśvaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Nanda said – О virtuous one, you kindly let me know what are the eatables and non-eatables for the four varnas of Brahmana, Kshatriyas, Shudra and Vaisya and what are the results of their deeds? Because you happen to be the cause of all the causes, the great sage and the lord on to yourself. I cannot ask this, question from anybody else.

## \|\| 85.3-5 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ caturṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ ca yathocitam \|*  
*vedoktaṃ śrūyatā tāta sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ayaḥpātre payaḥpānaṃ gavyaṃ siddhānnameva ca \|*  
*bhṛṣṭādikaṃ padhu guḍaṃ nālikerodakaṃ tathā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*phalaṃ mūlaṃ ca yatkiṃcidabhakṣayaṃ manurabravīt \|*  
*dagdhānnaṃ taptasauvīramabhakṣyaṃ vrahmanirmitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Shri Krishna said – I am now narrating to you about the eatables and non-eatables by the four varnas as prescribed in the Vedic literature. You listen to me attentively. Manu has prescribed that the water, the milk, curd and ghee, the food, fried materials, honey, guda, coconut water, fruit and the roots, kept in iron vases become unfit for consumption. The burnt food and the beverage, vinegar prepared by a Brahmana becomes unfit for consumption.

## \|\| 85.6 \|\|

*nālikerodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmrapātre sthitaṃ madhu \|*  
*gavyaṃ ca tāmrapātrasthaṃ sarvaṃ madyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vinā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The water of the coconut placed in a bronze vase, the honey and milk preparations kept in copper vases besides all other beverages become unfit for consumption except the ghee.

## \|\| 85.7 \|\|

*tāmrapātre payaḥpānamucchiṣṭe ghṛtabhojanam \|*  
*dugdhaṃ salavaṇaṃ caiva sadyo gomāṃsabhakṣaṇam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The consumption of milk in a copper vase, the ghee in a used vase, the milk, the food and salt is prohibited because for the one who consumes it, it becomes like consuming a cow’s flesh.

## \|\| 85.8 \|\|

*abhakṣyaṃ madhumikṣaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ guḍaṃ tathā \|*  
*ārdrakaṃ guḍasaṃyuktamabhakṣyaṃ śrutisaṃmatam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The ghee mixed with honey, oil and the guda mixed with ginger become unfit for consumption. This has been prescribed in the shrutis.

## \|\| 85.9-10 \|\|

*pītaśeṣajalaṃ caiva māghe ca mūlakaṃ tathā \|*  
*japādikaṃ ca śayane sadā prājñaḥ parityajet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dvirbhojanaṃ ca divase saṃdhyayohbhojanaṃ tathā \|*  
*bhakṣyaṃ ca rātriśeṣe ca dhruvaṃ prājñaḥ parityajet \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The left-over water, the eating of radish in the month of Magha, the recitation of mantras seated on a bed are all prohibited and the intellectuals should not indulge in the same. The intellectuals should not take food twice a day or eat food at the time of both the sandhyas and taking the food in the last quarter of the night is prohibited for the intellectuals.

## \|\| 85.11-12 \|\|

*pānīyaṃ pāyasaṃ cūrṇaṃ ghutaṃ lavaṇameva ca \|*  
*svastikaṃ guḍakaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ takraṃ tathā madhu \|\| 11 \|\|*

*hastāddhastagṛhītaṃ ca sadyo gomāṃsameva ca \|*  
*karpūraṃ raupyapātrasthamabhakṣyaṃ śrutisaṃmatam \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The water, payasam, flour, ghee, salt, svastika, guda, milk, butter-milk and honey should not be received in the palm of the hand from anyone which happens to be like cow's flesh. The camphor placed in the vase of silver becomes unfit for consumption according to the Vedas.

## \|\| 85.13 \|\|

*pariveṣaṇakārī cedbhoktāraṃ spṛśate yadi \|*  
*mabhakṣyaṃ ca tadannaṃ ca sarveṣāmeva saṃmatam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. In case the person who serves the food touches the person who is eating food, then the food becomes unfit for consumption. This is the opinion of all.

## \|\| 85.14-15 \|\|

*nakulānāṃ gaṇḍakānāṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ ca pakṣiṇām \|*  
*sarpāṇāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ ca gardabhānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*marjārāṇāṃ sṛgālānāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ vrajeśvara \|*  
*vyāghrāṇāmapi siṃhānāṃ tyājyaṃ māṃsaṃ nṛṇāṃ sadā \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. О lord of Vraja, the meat of the mangoos, rhinoceros, the birds, the snakes, fish, the donkeys, the cats, the jackals, the tiger, lion and of human being is prohibited from consumption.

## \|\| 85.16-18 \|\|

*jalaukasāṃ ca nakrāṇāṃ gedhikānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*maṇḍūkānāṃ karkaṭānāṃ cuñcukānāṃ ca niścitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*gavāṃ ca camarīṇāṃ ca na kalau māṃsabhakṣaṇam \|*  
*hastināṃ ghoṭakānāṃ ca nṛṇāmeva ca rakṣasām \|\| 17 \|\|*

*daṃśaśca maśakaścaiva makṣikā ca pipīnikā \|*  
*anyedhāṃ ca niṣiddhānāṃ loke vede vrajeśvara \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. Similarly the aquatic animals like crocodile, lizard, frogs, crabs, porcupines and the spotted cow's flesh should not be taken. О lord of Vraja, one should not take the meat of the elephant, horses, human flesh, demons, mosquitoes, flies, ants which is prohibited in the Vedas and the common human tradition.

## \|\| 85.19-21 \|\|

*vānarāṇāṃ bhallukānāṃ śarabhāṇāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*niṣiddhaṃ mṛganābhīnāṃ gardabhānāṃ ca māṃsakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*abhakṣyaṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ ca dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā \|*  
*svastikaṃ ca tathā tatra viprāṇāṃ navanītakam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*māṃsamucchaiḥśravasakaṃ tasya dugdhādikaṃ tathā \|*  
*varṇānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ cāpyabhakṣyaṃ ca śrutau śrutam \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. Similarly the meat of the monkeys, the bears, the camel, Astapada, a deer with kasturi and the meat of the donkey should not be consumed. The milk of a buffalo and the preparation of her milk like curd, ghee and butter besides the svastika prepared from the same is prohibited. The meat of the horse or the mare's milk is prohibited from consumption by all the four varnas. This has been prescribed in the Vedas.

## \|\| 85.22-23 \|\|

*abhakṣyamārdrakaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ ca raverdine \|*  
*paryuṣitaṃ calaṃ cānnaṃ viprāṇāṃ dugdhameva ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*varṇānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ cāpyavīrānnasya bhakṣaṇam \|*  
*tadannaṃ ca surātulyaṃ gomāṃsādhikameva ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Ginger should not be consumed on Sundays by all and for the Brahmanas, the left-over water, food and milk is considered to be unfit for consumption. The food cooked by a widow having no son or husband should not be taken because such a food is like the cow's flesh or even worse than that.

## \|\| 85.24-25 \|\|

*avīrānnaṃ ca yobhuṅkte brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ \|*  
*pitṛdevārcanaṃ tasya niṣphalaṃ manurabravīt \|\| 24 \|\|*

*brahmāṇānāṃ va2ṣṇavānāmabhakṣyaṃ matsyameva ca \|*  
*itareṣāmabhakṣyaṃ ca pañcaparvasu niścitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. If a Brahmana takes such a food from a widow due to ignorance, all the adoration's of the manes and the gods become infructuous. This has been prescribed by Manu. The fish is unfit for consumption of the Brahmanas, the Vaishnavas and people of other castes should not take the same on the eighth and fourth day of the fortnight, the moonless-night, full-moon night and the first day of the month.

## \|\| 85.26-33 \|\|

*pitṛdevāvaśeṣe ca bhakṣyaṃ māṃsaṃ na dūthitam \|*  
*pañcaparvasu tyājyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ manurabravīt \|\| 26 \|\|*

*asaṃskṛtaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ tailaṃ cābhakṣyameva ca \|*  
*bhakṣyaṃ pavitraṃ sarveṣāṃ vyañjanaṃ vahnisaṃskṛtam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*ekahaste ghṛtaṃ toyamabhakṣyaṃ sarvamaṃmatam \|*  
*āvilaṃ kṛmiyuktaṃ ca pariśuddhaṃ ca nirmalam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*abhakṣyaṃ brahmāṇānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*anivedyaṃ harereva yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām \|\| 29 \|\|*

*pipīlikāmiśritaṃ ca madhu gavyaṃ guḍaṃ tathā \|*  
*yatkiṃcidvastu vā tāta na bhakṣyaṃ ca śrutau śrutam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*pakṣibhakṣyaṃ kīṭabhakṣyaṃ śṛddhaṃ pakvaphalaṃ tathā \|*  
*kākabhakṣyamabhakṣyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dravyameva ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ghṛtapakvaṃ tailapakvaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ śūdrasaṃskṛtam \|*  
*abhakṣyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śūdrabhakṣyaṃ ca pīṭhakam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*sarveṣāmaśucīnāṃ ca jalamannaṃ parityajet \|*  
*āśaucāntātparadine śuddhameva na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

26-33. For the performing of the sraddhas and the adoration of the gods, the offering of the permissible meat is not prohibited. In the above five days, the consumption of meat is prohibited, this has been prescribed by Manu. The salt and the oil which is not well sanctified is not unfit for consumption but the food stuffs sanctified by the fire can be consumed by everyone. The consumption of the ghee or the water placed over the palm becomes unfit for consumption. The dirty water and the water with insets is also unfit for consumption even the visible clean water if it is not fully cleaned is unfit for consumption. The Brahmanas, especially the Vaishnavas, the recluses, the Brahmacans should not take anything without first offering it to lord Vishnu. О father, the honey, the milk, curd, ghee and other things when filled with the ants should not be taken. This has been prescribed in the Vedas. In case a fruit is eaten by an insect or the bird, it remains pure but if something is eaten by a cow it becomes unfit for consumption. The sweets fried in ghee and oil beside other sweets prepared by Sfidras are fit for their consumption but not by the Brahmanas. The food and water of all the unclean persons should be discarded. After removal of the impurity, everything becomes impure. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 85.34 \|\|

*vipākaṃ karmaṇāmeva duṣkaraṃ śrutisaṃmatam \|*  
*bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca kathitaṃ yathājñānaṃ vraceśvara \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. It is difficult to face the reward of the deeds. This has been prescribed in the shrutis. О lord of Vraja, I have spelt out to you, the eatables and non-eatables by all, according to my knowledge.

## \|\| 85.35 \|\|

*kramāccaturṣu vedeṣu cauktaṃ matacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca kathayāmi pitaḥ śṛṇu \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О father, there is a difference of opinion because of the four Vedas but in spite of that, I have told you the gist of everything.

## \|\| 85.36 \|\|

*nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi \|*  
*avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. After the expiry of hundred crores of kalpas, the deed is never destroyed.

## \|\| 85.37-38 \|\|

*tīrthānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca sahāyena nṛṇāmapi \|*  
*kiṃcidbhavati sāhāyyaṃ kāyavyūhena sarvataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*prāyaścitāni cīrṇāni niścitamamatparāṅamukham \|*  
*na niṣpunanti he tāta surākumbhamivā''pagāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. With the adoration of the gods and visiting the holy places in different types of bodies, the human bodies also receive some merit. О father, the one who remains inimical to me cannot be purified by performing any amount of repentance, as the vase of wine cannot be purified by any number of rivers.

## \|\| 85.39-44 \|\|

*prāyaścittena puṇyena na hi śudhyanti mānavā \|*  
*sarvārambheṇa vaiśyendra dānena yogato'pi vā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma vinā bhogānna ca kṣayaḥ \|*  
*bhogena śuddhimāpnoti tato muktirbhavennṛṇām \|\| 40 \|\|*

*na naṣṭaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ karma sukṛtena ca karmaṇā \|*  
*na naṣṭaṃ sukṛtaṃ karma kṛtena duṣkṛtena ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

*yajñena tapasā vā'pi vratenānaśanena ca \|*  
*tīrthasnānena dānena japena niyamena ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

*bhuvaḥ pradakṣiṇenaiva purāṇaśravaṇena ca \|*  
*upadeṇena puṇyena pūjayā gurudevayoḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*svadharmācaraṇenaivātithīnāṃ pūjanena ca \|*  
*brahmaṇāṃ pūjanenaiva bhojanena viśeṣataḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

39-44. О lord of the Vaisyas, a person cannot be purified by performing any type of auspicious deeds or repentance, performing of charities and the yogic practices because the good and bad deeds never get destroyed unless one faces them. By facing them, one gets purified and only then does he achieve redemption. The bad deed cannot be destroyed wjth the performing of the good deeds. The bad deeds cannot be destroyed by performing yajnas, tapas, vratas, fasting bathing in holy places, performing charities, recitations, strict observance of the rules, going round the globe, listening to the Puranas, auspicious discourses, adoring the teacher and the gods, by following one's own dharma, adoring the guest and the Brahmanas and serving them with food.

## \|\| 85.45-46 \|\|

*yaddhattamapi viprāya tatprāptaṃ pūrṇarūpataḥ \|*  
*bījarūpaṃ ca taddānaṃ kṣetrarūpaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*ekena karmaṇā tāta svargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|*  
*karmaṇā na hi mokṣaṃ ca tadeva mama sevayā \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. Whatever is given to the Brahmana one gets back the whole of it because a Brahmana happens to be the field and the charities given to him are like the seed. О father, a person can achieve heaven by performing a deed, but the moksa cannot be achieved by performing the deeds. It can be achieved by serving me.

## \|\| 85.47 \|\|

*svargaṃ ca sukṛtenaiva narakaṃ duṣkṛtena ca \|*  
*vyādhirjanma ca yonau ca kutsite ca tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. One achieves heaven by performing noble deeds and by performing evil and deplorable deeds, one is thrown into hell and then is reborn, suffering from ailment in degraded yonis. He then gets purified.

## \|\| 85.48 \|\|

*goghno yo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmataścopapātakī \|*  
*dandaśūkatvamāpnoti golomasamavarṣakam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The Brahmana who resorts to the killing of cows and the one who commits big or small crimes, falls into the dandasuka hell up to the number of years equivalent to the number of the hair on the body of the cow.

## \|\| 85.49-50 \|\|

*sarpeṇa bhakṣitastena cvālayā garalasya ca \|*  
*tṛṣito vyathitaścaiva nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tataḥ kuṇḍātsamutthāya gaurbhavellomavarṣakam \|*  
*tataḥ kuṣṭhī ca cāṇḍālo varṣalakṣaṃtato naraḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. He is bitten there by the snakes who emit flames of poison. He feels tortured, remains without food and his belly shrinks. He is then taken out of the same and is placed in the yoni of the cow for the number of years equivalent to the number of hair on the cow's body. Thereafter he becomes a patient of leprosy for a lakh of years and then becomes a chanddla. Thereafter he is born as a human being.

## \|\| 85.51 \|\|

*tadā bhavedbrāhmaṇaśca kuṣṭhayukto hi karmaṇā \|*  
*bhojayitvā vipralakṣaṃ nirvyādhiśca bhavecchuciḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Because of his deeds, he is reborn as a Brahmana suffering from leprosy. He is relieved of the ailment by serving food to a lakh of Brahmanas and then gets purified.

## \|\| 85.52-54 \|\|

*akāmatastadardhaṃ ca kṣatriyasyāpi kāmataḥ \|*  
*akāmatastadardhaṃ ca tadardhaṃ ca viśastathā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tadardha śūdragoghnaśca bhuṅkte pāpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*prāyaścittena śuddhaśca bhuṅkte śeṣaṃ ca karmaṇaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*anukalpe caturthaṃ ca pāpaṃ bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*caturguṇaṃ ca goghnānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pātakam \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. If one performs the deeds unmindfully, he has to face half the reward for the same. Similarly a Kastriya also by performing a degraded act has to suffer fully and if he does something unmindfully he has to suffer half the result of the same. Half of his sin has to be borne by the Vaisya and half of it by the Shudra who kills the cow. There is no doubt about it. After performing repentance he is purified and has to face the rest of the reward. In the Anukalpa one fourth of the result of the misdeeds has to be faced by a person, there is no doubt about it. But a Brahmana who becomes a killer of cow's has to suffer four times for the sin.

## \|\| 85.55-56 \|\|

*bhuṅkte pāpaṃ ca brahmanno brāhmaṇāścetaro'pi vā \|*  
*krameṇānena bodhyaṃ ca kāmato'kāmato'pi vā \|\| 55 \|\|*

*prāyaścittaṃ janma karma vyādhireva pa saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*goghno bhavati gauścāpi yāvadvarṣa ca niścitam \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. Similarly a Brahmana or a person of any other caste if he does so unwillingly, he has to face the reward accordingly for the sin. Repentance is the only remedy for the same. There is no doubt about it. The killer of the cows has to be born as a cow for an equal number of years as the number of hair on the cow's body.

## \|\| 85.57-58 \|\|

*caturguṇaṃ ca teṣāṃ ca brahmaghno viṭkṛmirbhavet \|*  
*tato bhavati mlecchaśca tāvadvarṣacaturguṇam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*tataścāndho bhavedvipraḥ pūrveṣāṃ ca caturguṇam \|*  
*brahmaṇānāṃ caturlakṣaṃ bhojayitvā śucirbhavet \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. A killer of the Brahmana becomes an insect of refuge for four times the number of years and of four times more the number of years, he becomes a mleccha. Thereafter for four times more the number of years he becomes a blind Brahmana who is purified after serving food to four lakh Brahmanas.

## \|\| 85.59-60 \|\|

*cakṣuṣmāṃśca yaśasvī ca bhavetso'pyatipātakāt \|*  
*strīghnacaturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ vede so'pyatipātakī \|\| 59 \|\|*

*kālasūtraṃ ca prāpnoti strīlomasamavarṣakam \|*  
*bhakṣitaḥ kṛmiṇā tatra nirāhāro vyathāyutaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. After getting relieved of the terrible impurity, he regains his eyesight and becomes glorious. In all the four varnas, the killer of a woman has been treated as a great sinner; he falls in the kalasutra hell for the number of years equivalent to the number of hair on the body of the woman and is eaten away by the insects where he remains without food, suffering immensely.

## \|\| 85.61-64 \|\|

*tato bhavati loke ca tāvadvarṣa ca pātakī \|*  
*tataḥ pāpī bhavetso'pi yakṣmagrastaśca karmaṇā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva vipralakṣaṃ ca bhojayet \|*  
*tataḥ śuddho brāhmaṇaśca vidvāṃstapasi saṃyataḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*kiṃcidbhuṅakte pāpaśeṣaṃ svarṇadānācchucirbhavet \|*  
*garbhaghnaśca mahāpāpī saṃprāpnoti śunīmukham \|\| 63 \|\|*

*varṣāṇāṃ satakaṃ caiva ghoṭakaśca bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva sūkṣmaśastreṇa pīḍītaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

61-64. Thereafter, the great sinner is born on earth as a person suffering from the ailment of consumption. Thereafter for hundred years he has to serve food to the Brahmanas for getting purified. He then becomes a Brahmana of a suitable form for performing tapas. Thereafter, he also has to suffer for his sins and with the giving away of gold in charity, he is purified. The one who terminates pregnancy, is treated to be a great sinner and is driven in the Sunlmukha hell where he has to spend a hundred years and is tortured there with sharp weapons. Thereafter, he has to be born for a hundred years as a horse.

## \|\| 85.65 \|\|

*tataḥ pāpī bhavedvaiśyo dravyayukto hi kamaṃṇā \|*  
*pañcāśadvarṣaparyantaṃ svarṇadānādbhavecchuciḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. He is then born a wealthy Vaisya and he gets purified after giving away gold in charity for fifty years.

## \|\| 85.66-68 \|\|

*tataḥ svakulajāto'pi nirvyādhirbrāhmaṇaḥśuciḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyaghnaśca kṣatriyo vā vinā raṇāt \|\| 66 \|\|*

*taptaśūlaṃ ca prāpnoti varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam \|*  
*kvathitaṃ taptalohena cā''rtanādaṃ karoti ca \|\| 67 \|\|*

*tato bhavenmattagajo varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā \|*  
*tato raktavikārī ca śūdro varṣaśataṃ tathā \|\| 68 \|\|*

66-68. He is then reborn in his own race and is freed from the ailment and is then born as a Brahmana again. If a Brahmana or a Kshatriya kills a Ks atriya except in battle, he falls into TaptasQla hell where he has to suffer for a thousand years; he cries aloud there when he is tortured with burning iron rods. Thereafter for a hundred years he becomes an intoxicated elephant and then for a hundred years he is reborn as a Shudra suffering from blood ailment.

## \|\| 85.69-71 \|\|

*gajadānena muktaśca vyādhitaśca tato dvijaḥ \|*  
*vaiśyaghnaścāpi vaiśyaśca śūdraghno vaiśya eva ca \|\| 69 \|\|*

*vaiśyaghnaścāpi śūdraśca samaṃ pāpaṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*kṛmikuṇḍaṃ ca prāpnoti varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā \|\| 70 \|\|*

*kṛmibhirbhakṣito duḥśī kirātaśca bhavettataḥ \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva kṛmivyādhisamanvitaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

69-71. Thereafter, he is relieved of the ailment by donating an elephant. He then becomes a pure Brahmana. Similarly a Vaisya who kills a Vaisya or a Shudra or a Shudra who kills a Vaisya, all are treated to be similar types of killers and they have to fall in the Krmikunda for a hundred years where they suffer with the biting of insects. He then becomes a hunter and suffer from the ailment. О lord of Vraja, thereafter for fifty years, he becomes a person with a krsodara belly and by giving away a horse in charity at a holy place, he is relieved of the sin.

## \|\| 85.72-76 \|\|

*tato mandāgniyuktaśca brāhmaṇo dainyavānvraja \|*  
*pañcāśadvarṣaparyantaṃ durbalaśca kṛśodaraḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*muktirbhavati yuktena tīrthecāśvapradānataḥ \|*  
*śūdraghno brahmaṇaścaiva kāmato'kāmato'pi vā \|\| 73 \|\|*

*sāvitrī lakṣayāpyena tadardhena śucirbhavet \|*  
*caturvarṇaḥ kukkuraghno hyabhiśaptaśca śaṃbhunā \|\| 74 \|\|*

*varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva prāpnoti rauravaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*tato bhavetkukkulaśca varṣāṇāmapi ṣoḍaśa \|\| 75 \|\|*

*tataḥ śuddho bhavedvipro bhakṣitaḥ kukkureṇai ca \|*  
*gaṅgāsnānena dānena svarṇasyāpi bhavecchuciḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

72-76. If a Brahmana kills willingly or unwillingly a Siidra he gets purified by reciting the Gayatri mantra a lakh of times or half the number of the same. The one who kills a dog because of the curse of Shiva has to fall in the terrific hell for a hundred years; thereafter he is born as a dog for sixteen years. He is then eaten away and gets purified as a Brahmana. After taking a bath in the Ganga and giving away gold in charity, he is purified for all times to come.

## \|\| 85.77-80 \|\|

*mārjāraghnaścaturvarṇo gaṅgāsnānādbhavecchuciḥ \|*  
*viprāya lavaṇaṃ dattvā ṣaṭpalaṃ ca pramucyate \|\| 77 \|\|*

*hatvā sarpāṃścaturvarṇo mama pādena cihnitān \|*  
*brahmahatyācaturthaṃ ca pātakaṃ ca labheddhruvam \|\| 78 \|\|*

*asipatraṃ ca narakaṃ varṣāṃṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā \|*  
*prāpnoti yātanāyukto vicchinnastīkṣṇadhārayā \|\| 79 \|\|*

*tato bhavati sarpaśca ḍuṇḍubho varṣapañcakam \|*  
*nareṇa tāḍito duḥkhī mṛtyorbhavati pīḍitaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

77-80. The one who kills a cat is purified by taking a bath in the Ganga and by giving away a measure of salt to a Brahmana. The one who kills snakes with his feet implanted on its hood, the people of all the four varnas earn the sin of one fourth of the Brahmahatya. Thereafter for a hundred years they fall into the Asipatra hell and have to suffer there getting eroded by sharp-edged weapons. Thereafter they are born as aquatic snakes for five years and they meet with their end after having been tortured by human beings.

## \|\| 85.81-82 \|\|

*tato bhavennaraḥ pāpī jvarayukto hi durbalaḥ \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ pañcakenaiva mṛto bhavati karmaṇā \|\| 81 \|\|*

*aśvaghnaśca gajaghnaśca caturvarṇaśca pātakī \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ pañcakenaiva mṛto bhavati karmaṇā \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. He is then born as a sinful human being suffering from fever, with lean and thin body and meets with his end at the age of five years. О lord of Vraja, he is then born as a horse for twenty years and becomes a Shudra again but remains quite proud and suffers from ailments. By giving away silver in charity and feeding a hundred Brahmanas, he is purified.

## \|\| 85.83 \|\|

*tato bhavati hastī ca ghoṭako vā vrajeśvara \|*  
*yāvadviṃśativarṣāṇi tataḥ śūdro bhaveddhruvam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. By killing the wretched creatures, one himself becomes wretched. He suffers from small ailments for a hundred years and is then purified.

## \|\| 85.84-88 \|\|

*ahaṃkṛtī vyādhiyukto raupyadānena mucyate \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śatakaṃ bhojayitvā śucirbhavet \|\| 84 \|\|*

*iti śrībrahmo mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakho utto nāradanāo bhagavannandasaṃo- pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*kṛpā kāryā satā śaśvatahiṃsreṣu ca jantuṣu \|*  
*hiṃsāyāṃ na hi doṣaśca hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca vrajeśvara \|\| 86 \|\|*

*aśvatthaghnaścatuvaṃrṇo brahmahatyācaturthakam \|*  
*pāpaṃ ca labhate tāta cāsipatraṃ vrajeddhruvam \|\| 87 \|\|*

*sa tīkṣṇenāpi śastreṇa vicchinnaśca divāniśam \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva bhuṅkte paramayātanām \|\| 88 \|\|*

84-88. О lord of Vraja, therefore one should always be compassionate towards the non-ferocious animals but it is not a crime to kill the wild animals. О father, such of the people of the four varnas who cut the plpala tree, attract the sin of Brahmahatya and fall into the Asipatra hell and are tortured by sharp-edged weapons daily throughout the day and night. They then suffer from torture for a hundred years and become the semara tree for a lakh of years. Then they are born as deformed Shudra persons suffering from ailment.

## \|\| 85.89 \|\|

*tato bhavati vṛkṣaśca śālamalirahvarṣalakṣakam \|*  
*tato bhavati śūdraśca cchinnāṅgo vyādhisaṃyutaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. They have to suffer for the whole life, and are reborn as Brahmanas, suffering from boils. A person is relieved of the ailment by giving away gold in charity.

## \|\| 85.90-93 \|\|

*yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ tato vipro bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*vraṇavyādhisamāyukto mucyate svarṇadānataḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*mithyāsākṣyapradātā ca kṛtaghno'tikṛtaghnakaḥ \|*  
*viśvāsaghātī mitraghno viprāṇāṃ dhanahārakaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

*śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakaḥ \|*  
*śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca vṛṣavāhakapātakī \|\| 92 \|\|*

*dhāvako devalaścāpi caite'tipāpinastathā \|*  
*kumbhīpākaṃ prayāntayeva varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam \|\| 93 \|\|*

90-93. The one who gives false evidence and is an extremely ungrateful person, a betrayer of the faith, a killer of the friend, a usurper of the riches of the Brahmanas, the one who takes the food of the sraddha with the Shudras, the one who bums the dead bodies of the Shudras, the cook of the Shudras, the driver of the bulls or the one who earns his livelihood with the driving of the bullocks, the messengers and the temple priest have been treated to be great sinners who have to remain in the kumbhlpaka hell for a thousand years.

## \|\| 85.94 \|\|

*tatraiva taptatailena saṃtaptaśca divāniśam \|*  
*ṇakṣito vyathitaścaiva sarvākāreṇa jantunā \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. They are tortured throughout day and night in the boiling oil, they suffer from ailments and are eaten away by serpent like creatures.

## \|\| 85.95-96 \|\|

*gṛdhraḥ koṭisamasrāṇi śatajanmāni śūkaraḥ \|*  
*śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni śūdro rogī bhavettataḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*mandāgnijvarasaṃyuktaḥ pañcāśadvarṣakaṃ tathā \|*  
*suvarṇānāṃ śatapalaṃ dattavā śuddho bhaveddhruvam \|\| 96 \|\|*

95-96. They are then born in this world as vultures for a thousand years, a pig for a hundred births, a dog for a hundred births and then they become Shudras, suffering from diseases and live for fifty years suffering from indigestion and fever. They are relived of the ailment after giving away in charity a hundred pieces of gold.

## \|\| 85.97-98 \|\|

*caturvarṇo vastrahārī gavyahārī ca mānavaḥ \|*  
*raupyamuktāpahārī ca śūdradravyāpahārakaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca bakajātirbhaveddhruvam \|*  
*mutrakuṇḍaṃ ca vai bhuktvā varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā \|\| 98 \|\|*

97-98. Of all the four varnas, whosoever costumes, milk, curd and ghee besides steals the silver and jewels or the riches of Shudras, falls into the tank of urine for a thousand years. He is then reborn as a sky-lark. This is certain.

## \|\| 85.99-100 \|\|

*tato bhavecchūdrajātirvarṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ vraja \|*  
*kuṣṭhavyādhisamāyukto galitaścaiva pātakī \|\| 99 \|\|*

*tato bhavedbrāhmaṇaśca kuṣṭhāvaśeṣasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*svarṇaṣaṭpaladānena vyādhito mucyate śuciḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. He is then born as a Shudra for a hundred years, where he leads a miserable life suffering from leprosy. He is then reborn as a Brahmana suffering from leprosy. He is then purified after giving away six pieces of gold.

## \|\| 85.101 \|\|

*śākāpahārakaścaiva phalāpahārakastathā \|*  
*yakṣaḥ pṛthivyāṃ saṃbhūto līlādravyāpahārakaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. The one who loots away the treasure steals fruits and vegetables and playfully steals the riches, becomes a Yaksa on earth.

## \|\| 85.102 \|\|

*varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva cāṣapakṣī bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*tato bhavetkṛṣṇavarṇaḥ śūdraśca bhārate bhuvi \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Не then becomes Nllakantha for a hundred years and then is reborn as a-black complexioned Shudra.

## \|\| 85.103-106 \|\|

*tato bhavedbrāhmaṇaścāpyadhikāṅgo'pi janmani \|*  
*punarjanmadvijo bhūtvā sucyate viprabhojanāt \|\| 103 \|\|*

*pakvadravyāpahārī ca paśuyonirbhavedradhruvam \|*  
*yasyāṇḍakośo gandhāktaḥ kastūrī yasya nāma ca \|\| 104 \|\|*

*saptajanmamṛgo bhūtvā tato bhavati gandhakaḥ \|*  
*janmaikaṃ ca tataḥ śūdro galatkuṣṭhī ca janmani \|\| 105 \|\|*

*tato rogāvaśeṣeṇa saṃyuto brahmaṇaḥ kṛśaḥ \|*  
*svarṇaṣaṭpaladānena mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

103-106. He then is born as a Brahmana with excess limbs and then again he is born as a Brahmana. He is relieved of all the sins by serving food to the Brahmanas. The one who steals the ripe fruits is born as an animal having fragrant andakosas. It is called kastUrl. Similarly by remaining as a deer for seven births, he is then born as sulphur. In one of his births, he is born as a Siidra suffering from leprosy and then he is born as a Brahmana with an insignificant ailment and remains quite lean and thin. Here he gets purified by giving away six pieces of gold in charity. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 85.107 \|\|

*dhānyāpahārī duḥkhī ca kṛpaṇaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*viṣṭhākuṇḍaṃ varṣaśataṃ saṃprāpya mucyate bhiyā \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. The one who steals away the paddy, is born as a miser for seven births and remains filled with grief. He is then thrown into the pit of refuse from where he is freed ultimately.

## \|\| 85.108-110 \|\|

*svarṇāpahārī kuṣṭhī ca mānava patito bhavet \|*  
*svarṇadānapratigrāhī viṭkuṇḍaṃ ca prayāti ya \|\| 108 \|\|*

*tato varṣaśataṃ bhuktvā purīṣaṃ ca divāniśam \|*  
*tato vyāgho bhavecchūdro raktadoṣeṇa saṃyutaḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

*tajjanmapātakaṃ bhuktvā brāhmaṇaśca punarbhavet \|*  
*vyādhiroṣāvayuktaśca mucyate svarṇadānataḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

108-110. The one who steals away the gold is born as a degraded person, suffering from leprosy and the one who receives gold in charity also has to fall into the pit of refuse for a hundred years. Then suffering for the reward of all his misdeeds he again becomes a Brahmana with minor ailments. He is relieved of the remaining part of the sin by giving away gold in charity.

## \|\| 85.111-115 \|\|

*agamyānāṃ ca gāmī ca pūrvoktaṃ rauravaṃ vrajet \|*  
*kumbhīpākaṃ mahāghoraṃ varṣāṇāṃ cāpyasaṃkhyakam \|\| 111 \|\|*

*tato bhavetpuṃścalīnāṃ yonīnāṃ ca kṛmistathā \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca viṭkṛmirvarṣalakṣakam \|\| 112 \|\|*

*paśuyonirbhavettasmāttasmācca kṣudrajantavaḥ \|*  
*tato bhavenmlecchajātistataḥ śūdrādhamastadā \|\| 113 \|\|*

*tato bhavati vipraśca vyādhiyukto napuṃsakaḥ \|*  
*punaśca brāhmaṇo bhūtvā tīrthaparyaṭanena ca \|\| 114 \|\|*

*krameṇa śuddho bhavati vaṃśahīnaśca pātakāt \|*  
*bhojayitvā vipralakṣaṃ putraṃ ca labhate śuciḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

111-115. The one who enjoys the company of an inaccessible woman, falls into the terrific hell. He then is thrown into the terrific kumbhlpaka hell for a hundred thousand years and becomes an insect of the pelvic region of loose woman. He has then to be born as an insect of refuse and he remains there for a lakh of years. He is then born as an animal and thereafter as a petty creature. He is then born a mleccha and thereafter he becomes a degraded Siidra. He is then born as a eunuch and after, becoming a Brahmana suffering from ailment, he is reborn as a Brahmana who gets purified after visiting holy places but because of the impurity he remains issueless. He is relieved of the impurity by serving food to a lakh of Brahmanas and then obtains a son.

## \|\| 85.116-117 \|\|

*mānavaḥ krodhayuktaśca gardabhaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*mānavaḥ kalahāviṣṭaḥ saptajanmasu vāyasaḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

*śālagrāmapratigrāhī kālasūtraṃ vrajeddhruvam \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva śañjarīṭo bhavettataḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

116-117. The enraged person is born as a donkey for seven births, a quarrel-some person is born as a crow for seven births, a person who gives away in charity, Shalagrama, he falls into the kalasutra hell for a hundred years where he has to suffer. He is then born as a wagtail bird on earth.

## \|\| 85.118 \|\|

*lohacoraśca nirvaśo maṣīcoraśca kokilaḥ \|*  
*śuko'pyañjanaconaśca miṣṭacoraḥ kṛmirbhavet \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. The one who steals away iron, is deprived of progeny. The one who steals away ink, is born as a parrot and the one who steals away sweets becomes an insect.

## \|\| 85.119-125 \|\|

*vipradveṣī gurudveṣī śirasāṃ ca kṛmirbhavet \|*  
*puṃścalīṃ kāminīṃ tāta bhuktvā ca rauravaṃ vrajet \|\| 119 \|\|*

*tato vṛthā kṛmiścaiva varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā \|*  
*tato'pi vidhavā caiva vandhyā ca saptajanmasu \|\| 120 \|\|*

*aspṛśyā jātihīnā ca ccinnanāsā bhavetkramāt \|*  
*raktadravyāpahānī ca raktadoṣānvito bhavet \|\| 121 \|\|*

*ācārahīno yavanaḥ khañjo bhavati hiṃsakaḥ \|*  
*adīkṣito vaṅkharaśca duṣṭadarśo ca kāṇakaḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

*ahaṃkārī karṇahīno badhiro vedanindakaḥ \|*  
*vākyahartā ca mūkaśca hiṃsakaḥ keśahīnakaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

*mithyāvādī śmaśruhīno durvākyo dantahīnakaḥ \|*  
*cihvāhīnaḥ satyahārī duṣṭo'pyaṅgulihīnakaḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

*granthāpahārī mūrkhaśca vyādhiyukto bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*aśvagrāhī ca taccauro lālāmūtraṃ vrajediti \|\| 125 \|\|*

119-125. Those who are envious of Brahmanas and teachers are born as insects of the head. О father, the one who enjoys the company of loose woman has to suffer in the terrific hell for a hundred years and is then reborn as a useless insect, thereafter for seven births he is born as a widow, a childless woman, untouchable and a woman with a severed nose. The one who steals away red articles, suffers from a blood ailment he also becomes Yavana having no character, is cruel and lame. He becomes a dwarf, devoid of dlksa, having an evil eye or becomes a one-eyed person. He then becomes arrogant, deaf, a denouncer of the Vedas, ill spoken and dumb, indulging in violence, devoid of hair, devoid of truth, beard and moustaches, ill spoken, deprived of teeth, untruthful, devoid of tongue, engaged in evil deeds and devoid of fingers. The one who steals books, he becomes a foolish person with disease. The one who receives a horse in charity has to fall into the red urine hell for a hundred years and thereafter he is born as a horse.

## \|\| 85.126-128 \|\|

*varṣāṇāṃ ca śataṃ schitvā ghoṭakaśca bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*gajacoro gacagrāhī viṭkuṇḍe ca sahasrakam \|\| 126 \|\|*

*sthitvā varṣa bhaveddhastī tatpaścādvṛṣalo bhavet \|*  
*ayajñe chāgahantā ca cchāgacorapratigrahī \|\| 127 \|\|*

*pūyakuṇḍe varṣaśataṃ sthitavā cāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet \|*  
*chāgaśca varṣaparyantaṃ tadā bhavati mānavaḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

126-128. The one who steals away an elephant or receives the same in charity, has to remain as an elephant for a long period before he becomes a Shudra. The one who kills a he-goat without the yajna, the one who steals it or receives the goat in charity, has to fall in the kunda of puss for a hundred years and after that he is born as a cdnddla. He is then reborn as a goat for one year and thereafter the person is purified.

## \|\| 85.129-131 \|\|

*śatruśastreṇā cchinnaśca tadā mukto bhaveddvijaḥ \|*  
*dattāpahārī vāgdānaṃ kṛtvā'paharate punaḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

*sa bhavenmalecchayonau ca bhuktvā ca narakaṃ vrajet \|*  
*ekākī miṣṭamaśnāti kālamūtraṃ vrajeddhruvam \|\| 130 \|\|*

*tatra varṣaśataṃ sthitvā predo varṣasahasrakam \|*  
*tadā bhavati janmaikaṃ makṣikā ca pipīlikā \|\| 131 \|\|*

129-131. He is relieved of the curse after meeting his death with the weapon of the enemy. The one who takes back the things given in charity or the one who takes back his words, is born as a mleccha and falls into the hell, the one who consumes alone sweets in the company of others, he surely falls into the kalasiitra hell, he remain there for a hundred years and is reborn as a goblin for a thousand years. He is then reborn as a filly or as an ant.

## \|\| 85.132-137 \|\|

*janmaikaṃ bhramaraśyaiva janmaikaṃ madhumakṣikā \|*  
*janmaikaṃ varalaścaiva janmaikaṃ daṃśa eva ca \|\| 132 \|\|*

*janmaikaṃ maśakaścaiva janmaikaṃ pūtikaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*janmaikaṃ talpakīṭaśca tadā śūdro bhaveddhruvam \|\| 133 \|\|*

*asadbuddhirvyādhiyuktastadā mukto bhaveddvijaḥ \|*  
*tailacorastailakāro mūrdhina kīṭastrijanmakam \|\| 134 \|\|*

*tadā bhavetsvarṇakāro janmaikaṃ duṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*viśvaikanipikartā ca bhakṣmadādurdhanaṃ haret \|\| 135 \|\|*

*tamaḥkuṇḍe varṣaśataṃ sthitvā svarṇavaṇigbhavet \|*  
*janmaikaṃ ca darācāro janmaikaṃ karaṇo bhavet \|\| 136 \|\|*

*kāyasthenodarasthena māturmāsaṃ na khāditam \|*  
*tatra nāsti kṛpā tasya dantābhāvena kevalam \|\| 137 \|\|*

132-137. He is born as a black wasp and during one birth he is born as a bee, then a wasp for one birth, a large mosquito for one birth and ill-smelling insect for one birth, a bug for one birth and thereafter is born as a foolish Shudra suffering from ailment. Getting free from the sin, he becomes a Brahmana again in due course of time. The one who steals away oil and the one who cmshes oil, becomes a louse for one birth and a wicked gold smith for one birth. Even the Brahmana the creator of the letters, if he steals away the riches of the giver of food, he has also to be thrown in the kunda of darkness and then has to be born as a gold-smith. He has then to be born as a widow and a kayastha in one birth. In case a kayastha has not eaten the flesh of his mother while remaining in the womb of the mother, it is not because of his grace but is due to his having no teeth.

## \|\| 85.138 \|\|

*svarṇakāraḥ svarṇavaṇik kāyasthaśca vrajeśvara \|*  
*nareṣu madhye te dhūrtāḥ kṛpāhīnā mahītale \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. О lord of Vraja, the gold smith, the trader in gold and a kayastha are all very clever and there is no one else more cruel than them on earth.

## \|\| 85.139 \|\|

*hṛdayaṃ kṣuradhārābhaṃ teṣāṃ nāsti ca sādaram \|*  
*śateṣu sajjanaḥ ko'pi kāyastho netarau ca tau \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. The heart of these people is always like the sharp edged dagger. In hundreds of the kayastha people only one could be found as a noble one but the goldsmith and the trader in gold can never be a noble person.

## \|\| 85.140-143 \|\|

*subuddhiḥ śivayuktaśca śāstrajño dharmamānasaḥ \|*  
*na viśvasetteṣu tāta svātmakalyāṇahetave \|\| 140 \|\|*

*sīmāpahārī duṣṭaśca bhūmicoraśca hiṃsakaḥ \|*  
*bhūmidānāpahārī ca kālasūtraṃ vrajeddhruvam \|\| 141 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāmi kṣaṭatvivāsārditaḥ sthitaḥ tato'pitāni nāmāni viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

*tato bhavedasacchūdro janmaikaṃ ca tataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*tasmājjñānaiḥ sāvadhānaṃ bhavetprājñaśca yatnataḥ \|\| 143 \|\|*

140-143. О father, therefore, people with great wisdom filled with welfare, well-versed in the scriptures and the religious people should not believe in them, keeping in view their own welfare. The one who usurps the boundary, thief of the land, the terrorist and the one who usurps the land surely falls into the kalastitra hell. He has to suffer there with hunger and thirst for sixty thousand years and then is thrown as the insect of refuse. He then is born as an untouchable Shudra before he is relieved of the impurity. Therefore the intellectuals should always be careful in using their intelligence.

## \|\| 85.144 \|\|

*raktavastrāpahārī ca janmaikaṃ raktakīṭa kaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ śūdraśca janmaikaṃ tato vipro bhavecchuci \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. The one who steals the red garment becomes an insect for one birth of red colour, he then is reborn as a Shudra and is then reborn as a sinless Brahmana.

## \|\| 85.145-146 \|\|

*trisaṃdhyahīno vibraśca prātaḥśāyī ca yo naraḥ \|*  
*saṃdhyāśāyī divāśāyī yajñasūtrāpahārakaḥ \|\| 145 \|\|*

*aśuddhaḥ saṃdhyākārī ca vedavedāṅganindakaḥ \|*  
*tadviruddhaḥ svargamārgastrijanmapatito dvijaḥ \|\| 146 \|\|*

145-146. The one who is devoid of performing the sandhya thrice a day an the one who sleeps early in the morning at the time of performing sandhya, the thief of yajnopavita, the one who performs sandhya in spite of being impure, the denouncer of the Vedic and post-Vedic literature is impure and falls for three births and instead of going to the heaven he falls in the hell.

## \|\| 85.147-151 \|\|

*yaḥ śūdro brāhmaṇīgāmī kumbhīpāke vrajeddhruvam \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ ca trilakṣaṃ ca pacyate tatra pīḍitaḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

*divāniśaṃ pradagdhaśca taptataile ca dāruṇe \|*  
*tatau bhavedyonikīṭaḥ puṃścalīnāṃ ca pātakī \|\| 148 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi cā''hāraṃ tasya tanmalam \|*  
*tato bhavati cāṇḍālo janmalakṣaṃ krameṇa ca \|\| 149 \|\|*

*tataḥ śūdro galatkuṣṭhī janmaikaṃ ca tataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*so'pi vipro vyādhiśeṣastīrthaparyaṭanācchuciḥ \|\| 150 \|\|*

*asacchūdraśca bhavati so'sthāne'sūrapūjite \|*  
*dattavā devāya naivedyamapavitraṃ ca mānavaḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

147-151. The Shudra who cohabits with a Brahmana woman surely falls into the hxmbhlpaka hell where he has to stay for three lakh of years, suffering all the times. He is then throwned in the kunda of boiling oil where he has to be born through out the day and night and then he is born as the insect of the pelvic region of the loose woman. For sixty thousand years he has to consume the filth of the pelvic region and for a lakh of births, he has to be born as a Chandala. He is born as a Shudra with a wound. He is then purified and is born as a Brahmana with ailment who gets purified after visiting the holy places. A person who adores a god placing him in an unclean environment, surely becomes a Shudra.

## \|\| 85.152-153 \|\|

*sakeśaṃ pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃpūjya yavano bhavet \|*  
*durbalena bhavedandhaḥ kutsitena ca kutsatiḥ \|\| 152 \|\|*

*aṅgahīno daridraśca vyādhiyuktaśca mānavaḥ \|*  
*aśraddhayā ca nirmāṇe nirmāṇasadṛśaṃ phalam \|\| 153 \|\|*

152-153. The one who adores the stone Shivalinga with matted locks of hair, surely becomes a Yavana. If one prepares a weak Shivalinga, he becomes blind and in case a degraded linga is made, the one who makes it earns disgrace and the one who makes it without devotion, is born as a pauper and deformed and a person with ailment because the result of the preparation of the linga is bestowed according to the making of the linga.

## \|\| 85.154 \|\|

*mṛdbhasmagośakṛtviṇḍaistathā vālukayā'pi vā \|*  
*kṛtvā liṅgaṃ sakṛtpūjya vasetkalpāyuṣaṃ divi \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. The one who makes a linga in clay, in ashes, cowdung, pindas or sand and adores it once he stays in heaven for a kalpa.

## \|\| 85.155 \|\|

*tato bhavati vipraśca mahābrajñaśca bhūmimān \|*  
*rājā bhavedbhārate ca liṅgānāṃ śatapūjanāt \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. Thereafter, he becomes an intelligent Brahmana possessing vast land. By adoring a hundred lingas of Shiva, one becomes a king in the land of Bharata.

## \|\| 85.156-157 \|\|

*sahasrapūjanātso'pi labhate niścitaṃ phalam \|*  
*sthitvā ca suciraṃ svarge rājendro bhārate bhavet \|\| 156 \|\|*

*ayute ca tadīśaśca lakṣe ca pṛthivīśvaraḥ \|*  
*pūjane cātibhaktyā cāpyatiristaṃ phalaṃ labhet \|\| 157 \|\|*

156-157. By adoring a thousand Shivalingas one surely gets the merit, he remains in heaven for a long time and remain a great king in the land of Bharata. By adoring ten thousand lingas, one becomes the lord of Bharata and by adoring a lakh of lingas one becomes the lord of the universe and if these lingas are adored with great devotion, one achieves extra merit.

## \|\| 85.158 \|\|

*tīrthasnānena dānena viprāṇāṃ bhojanena ca \|*  
*nārāyaṇārcayā caiva viprajātiśca karmaṇā \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. One achieves birth in the race of Brahmana by taking a bath at holy places, performing charities, serving food to the Brahmanas and by adoring Narayana.

## \|\| 85.159-161 \|\|

*atiriktena tapasā paṇḍito brāhmaṇo bhavet \|*  
*paṇḍito brāhmaṇaścaiva vaiṣṇavaśca jitendriyaḥ \|\| 159 \|\|*

*anekajanmapuṇyena jāyate bhārate bhuvi \|*  
*tasyāṅdhrisparśanenaiva sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā \|\| 160 \|\|*

*tīrthāḥ kurvanti tīrthāni jīvanamuktāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*svapuṃsāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca punantīti śrutau śrutam \|\| 161 \|\|*

159-161. By performing additional tapas one becomes an intellectual Brahmana and a Vaishnava who has controlled all his senses. One is born on the land of Bharata after performing deeds of great merit or with the touching of his feet, the earth gets purified. The pious and Vaishnava Brahmana bestows suspiciousness to the holy places and redeems thousands of his generations. This has been ordained in the Vedas.

## \|\| 85.162-163 \|\|

*pāpena vaidyajanmaiva duścikitso'pi brāhmaṇaḥ \|*  
*duścikitsastathā vaidyo vyālagrāhī trijanmasu \|\| 162 \|\|*

*atikrūro durācāro dveṣṭā ca suraviprayoḥ \|*  
*sa bhavetkuṭilavyālo varṣāṇāṃ ca mahasrakam \|\| 163 \|\|*

162-163. A Brahmana becomes a physician because of his ill deeds and then a wicked surgeon, he is then born for three births, as a wicked surgeon, a physician and a snake charmer, who is always wicked and is envious of the Brahmanas and the gods. For a thousand years he remains as a terrific serpent.

## \|\| 85.164-169 \|\|

*puṃścalīlampaṭānāṃ ca dūtī yā kāminī vraja \|*  
*kālamūtre varṣaśataṃ sthitvā ca godhikā bhavet \|\| 164 \|\|*

*janmaikaṃ godhikā bhūtvā hariṇaśca trijanmasu \|*  
*janmaikaṃ mahiṣacaiva janmaikaṃ bhalluko bhavet \|\| 165 \|\|*

*janmaikaṃ gaṇḍakaścaiva sṛgālaśca trijanmasu \|*  
*parakīyataḍāgaṃ ca luptvā sasyaṃ dadāti ca \|\| 166 \|\|*

*sa bhavennakrajātiśca kacchapaśca trijanmasu \|*  
*vṛthā māṃsaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte matsyalubdhaśca brāhmaṇaḥ \|\| 167 \|\|*

*bhuṅkte māṃsamadattaṃ ca sa mīnaśca mṛgo bhavet \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca tāta bhuktvā ca kilbiṣam \|\| 168 \|\|*

*karmabhogācchucirbhūtvā sa punarbrāhmaṇo bhavet \|*  
*ekādaśīvihīnaśca brāhmaṇaḥ patitobhavet \|\| 169 \|\|*

164-169. О lord of Vraja, the female messengers of the loose woman fall into the kalasiitra hell for a number of years and then become lizards. After becoming a lizard for a birth, he ’becomes a deer for three births, he-buffalo for a birth, a bear for a birth, a rhinoceros for a birth and for three births he is born as a jackal. The one who cuts off the water from the tank of someone else and cuts the standing crop denoting the same, he becomes a crocodile during one birth and a tortoise for three births. A Brahmana greedy of fish and also consumes meat and also the meat which is not given to him is born a fish and a deer. О father, he has to bear the ill-effects of his misdeeds for a thousand years and by getting purified with his deeds, he becomes a Brahmana. He who does not perform Ekadashi vrata, becomes degraded.

## \|\| 85.170-171 \|\|

*bhakṣyasya dviguṇaṃ dattvā tena pāpena mucyate \|*  
*mama janmadine caiva yo bhuṅkte mānavo'dhamaḥ \|\| 170 \|\|*

*trailokyajanitaṃ pāpaṃ so'pi bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*bhuktvā ca narakaṃ sarvaṃ paścāccaṇḍālatāṃ vrajet \|\| 171 \|\|*

170-171. But he is relieved of the sin if he offers double the weight of the food he consumed, in charity. The one who consumed food on my birthday, consumes the sin of the three worlds; there is no doubt about it. After eating the food, he falls into the hell and then he becomes a Chandala.

## \|\| 85.172-173 \|\|

*evaṃ ca śivarātau ca śrīrāmanavamīdine \|*  
*upavāsāsamarthaśca haviṣyānnaṃ samācaret \|\| 172 \|\|*

*tato'śakto durbalaśca bhojayedbrāhmaṇānapi \|*  
*kṛtvā mahotsavaṃ puṇyaṃ madīyaṃ pātakācchuciḥ \|\| 173 \|\|*

172-173. Similarly the one who takes food on Shivaratri and RamanavamI days meets with the same fate. If one is unable to observe fast then he should consume the havisya food and should perform auspicious festivities serving food to the Brahmanas. He is then purified and is relieved of the sin.

## \|\| 85.174-175 \|\|

*tasmādyatnena kartavyaṃ nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ mama \|*  
*gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ \|\| 174 \|\|*

*śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni kuhvāṃ ca niśi bhojanāt \|*  
*adīkṣito dvijaścaiva śaṅkhaścillaḥ \|*  
*śuko bhavet \|\| 175 \|\|*

174-175. Therefore, on that day one should recite my name delightfully. In case someone eats food on the night of a moonless day, he has to become a vulture for a crore of births, a pig for a hundred births and a wild animal for a hundred births. Thereafter he becomes an impure Brahmana, a white kite and a parrot.

## \|\| 85.176 \|\|

*anudvāhī dvijaścaiva rājahaṃso bhavaddhruvam \|*  
*citravastrāpahārī ca mayūraśca trijanmasu \|\| 176 \|\|*

176\. An unmarried Brahmana and a goose. He who steals away the divine garments, he is born a peacock for three births.

## \|\| 85.177-180 \|\|

*tejaḥpatrāpahārī ca bhavetkāraṇḍavaściram \|*  
*surāṇāṃ pratimācoro'pyandhaśca saptacanmasu \|\| 177 \|\|*

*daridro vyādhiyuktaśca badhiraścāpi kubjakaḥ \|*  
*strītailamadhumāṃsāni ravau vā pañcaparvasu \|\| 178 \|\|*

*sevate yo mahāmūḍho vajradaṃṣṭraṃ vrajeddhruvam \|*  
*pātakī duḥkhitastatra varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam \|\| 179 \|\|*

*tato bhavati mlecchaśca cāṇḍālaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*vyāviyuktastataḥ śūdro brāhmaṇaśca tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 180 \|\|*

177-180. The one who steals away a bay-leaf becomes a duck for long time. He who steals away the images of gods, is born as person with disease, a deaf and the hunch back. He who enjoys the company of his wife on Sunday and the five auspicious days besides using oil, honey and meat, surely falls into the hell named Vajradariist ra where the sinner has to face grief for a thousand years. Thereafter he is born as a mleccha for seven births, besides being a Chandala or an ailing Shudra. Thereafter he is purified by becoming a Brahmana.

## \|\| 85.181-183 \|\|

*tasmādyatnānna bhoktavyaṃ bhārate dharmabhīruṇā \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ ca suraṃ dṛṣṭvā na namedyo narādhamaḥ \|\| 181 \|\|*

*yāvajjīvanaparyantamaśuciryavano bhavet \|*  
*abhyutthānaṃ na kurute dṛṣṭvā cā''gatabrāhmaṇam \|\| 182 \|\|*

*sa bhavedbrahmaghātī ca saptajanmasu niścitam \|*  
*śivadveṣī kukkuṭaśca devalaḥ saptajanmamu \|\| 183 \|\|*

181-183. Therefore a religious minded person in the land of Bharata should make an effort not to take food on that particular day. The degraded person who does not bow in reverence while looking at a Brahmana or a god, becomes impure for the whole life and becomes a Yavana. He who does not welcome a Brahmana by getting up, surely earns the sin of killing a Brahmana for seven births. He who is envious of Shiva becomes a temple priest or a cock for seven births.

## \|\| 85.184-189 \|\|

*pitṛdevāncanaṃ hanti vedoktaṃ jñānadurbalaḥ \|*  
*sa yāti naramaṃ pāpī varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam \|\| 184 \|\|*

*tataśca rauravaṃ bhuktvā tīrthakākastricanmasu \|*  
*trijanmasu śṛgālaśca tīrthe bhuṅkte śavaṃ vraja \|\| 185 \|\|*

*trijanmasu bhavetso'pi tīrtheṣu śavarakṣakaḥ \|*  
*śavānāṃ karamādatte karmaṇā kṛtapātakī \|\| 186 \|\|*

*nityaṃ surārcanaṃ kṛtvā dāmbhiko jñānadurbalaḥ \|*  
*guruṃ ca nārcayedbhaktyā tasmai nānnaṃ dadāti yaḥ \|\| 187 \|\|*

*sa bhaveddelo duḥkhī devaśāpena pātakī \|*  
*nityaṃ surārcanaṃ kṛtvā dāmbhiko jñānadurbalaḥ \|\| 188 \|\|*

*pūcāphalaṃ na labhate devadrohī sa dārupāḥ \|*  
*dīpanirvāṇakartā ca khadyola saptacanmasu \|\| 189 \|\|*

184-189. A person who unknowingly destroys adoration of the gods and ancestors, falls into the terrific hell. He has to remain there for a thousand years and is reborn for three births as a crow. He is then reborn as a jackal at a holy place for three births and consumes dead bodies. О lord of Vraja, thereafter the sinner during the three births, protects dead bodies in holy places and snatches coffins. Such of the foolish people as neither adored the gods nor the teacher with devotion or provide them with good food surely get cursed and become temple priests. He becomes hostile to gods and he does not earn merit by performing puja. The one who extinguishes the lamps with his hand is born as a fire-fly for seven births.

## \|\| 85.190 \|\|

*atīva matsyalabdhaścāpyanaivedyaṃ ca khādati \|*  
*sa bhavenmatsyaraṅgaśca mārjariḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 190 \|\|*

190\. The one who eats without offering food to his family gods or the one who is quite greedy for fish, becomes a fish-eating-bird and then is born as a cat for seven births.

## \|\| 85.191 \|\|

*goṇīhartā kapotaśca mālāhartā vihaṃgamaḥ \|*  
*caṭako dhānyacoraśca māṃsacoraśca kuṃjaraḥ \|\| 191 \|\|*

191\. He who steals away the begs becomes a pigeon, he who steals a garland becomes a bird; the one who steals away paddy, becomes a sparrow and a thief of meat becomes an elephant.

## \|\| 85.192-195 \|\|

*kaviḥ prahartā viduṣāṃ māṇḍrakaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*asatkavirgrāmavipro nakulaḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 192 \|\|*

*kuṣṭhī bhavecca janmaikaṃ kṛkalāsastrijanmasu \|*  
*janmaikaṃ varalaścaiva tato vṛkṣapipīlikā \|\| 193 \|\|*

*tataḥ śūdraśca vaiśyaśca kṣatriyo brāhmaṇastathā \|*  
*kanyāvikrayakārī ca caturvarṇo hi mānavaḥ \|\| 194 \|\|*

*sadyaḥ prayāti tāmisraṃ yāvaccandradivākarau \|*  
*tatau bhavati vyādhaśca māṃsavikrayakārakaḥ \|\| 195 \|\|*

192-195. A poet who attacks intellectuals becomes a frog for seven births. Such of the petty intellectuals as poses himself as a Brahmana, becomes a mangoose for seven births, a person suffering from leprosy during one birth and a chameleon for three births. He then becomes a wasp during one birth and then becomes an ant of the trees. He then is reborn as a Stidra, Vaisya, Kshatriya and a Brahmana, he who sells away girls of all the four varnas, surely falls in the hell and remains there till the time of the sun and the moon. Thereafter he becomes a hunter selling meat. He suffers from some aliment according to his earlier evil deeds.

## \|\| 85.196-200 \|\|

*tato vyādhi(dho)rbhavetpaścādyo yathā pūrvacanmani \|*  
*mannāmavikrayī viprona hi mukto \|*  
*bhaveddhruvam \|\| 196 \|\|*

*mṛtyuloke ca mannāmasmṛtimātraṃ na vidyateḥ \|*  
*paścādbhavetsa goyonau janmaikaṃ jñānadurbalaḥ \|\| 197 \|\|*

*tataścāgastato meṣo mahiṣaḥ sptacanmasu \|*  
*mahācakrī ca kuṭilo dharmahīnastu mānavaḥ \|\| 198 \|\|*

*janmaikaṃ tailakāraśca kumbhakālastathaiva ca \|*  
*mithyākalaṅkavaktā ca devabrāhmaṇa nindakaḥ \|\| 199 \|\|*

*sa bhavetsvarṇakāraśca rajakaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*brāhmaṇakṣatraviṭśūdrāḥ kutsitāḥ śaucavarjitāḥ \|\| 200 \|\|*

196-200. A Brahmana who sells away my name can never be freed and can never achieve salvation. This is certain. The one who remaining on earth does not recite my name, such an ignorant person becomes a cow during one birth, a goat and a ram and then for seven births he is to be born as a he-buffalo. A person who is a great conspirator, wicked and is devoid of dharma, becomes an oil-man and a potter. The one who paints false blemishes and denounces the gods as well as the Brahmanas, becomes a black-smith during one birth and for seven births he has to be born as a washerman. Such of the Brahmana, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras are denounced and are unclean as they are born as mlecchas for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 85.201 \|\|

*janma teṣāṃ malecchayonau varṣāṇāmayutaṃ tathā \|*  
*atīva kāminīlubdhaḥ kāmukaḥ strīrataḥ sadā \|\| 201 \|\|*

201\. The one who is lustful of woman, passionate and always thinks of them, suffers from the disease of consumption and in the next birth he is born as a eilnuch.

## \|\| 85.202-204 \|\|

*yakṣmagrasto bhavetsadyaḥ paratrāpi napuṃsakaḥ \|*  
*kāmato yoṣitāṃ śroṇīstanāsye yaśca paśyati \|\| 202 \|\|*

*sa bhaveddṛṣṭihīnaśca paratrāpi napuṃsakaḥ \|*  
*vipro'bhicārakartā ca hiṃsako jñānadurbalaḥ \|\| 203 \|\|*

*yātyevamandhatāmisraṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ tathā \|*  
*tadā bhavati daivajño'pyagradānī ca durmatiḥ \|\| 204 \|\|*

202-204. The one who looks with passionate eyes, at the pelvic region of the wives of others, the breasts and the faces of woman becomes blind and in his next birth he becomes a eunuch. A Brahmana who being ignorant performs evil deeds and indulges himself in killing, falls into the Andhatamisra hell for ten thousand years. Thereafter he is born as an astrologer, receiver of charities and remains devoid of wisdom. He is then born as a Shudra and then a Brahmana according to his deeds.

## \|\| 85.205-210 \|\|

*tataḥ śūdro bhavedvipro bhogena karmaṇastathā \|*  
*śāstrajñātā ca daivajño mithyā vadati lobhataḥ \|\| 205 \|\|*

*sa bhavecca dhruvaṃ jyeṣṭhī vānaraḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*anekajanmatapasā bhārate brāhmaṇo bhavet \|\| 206 \|\|*

*subuddhiratidharmiṣṭho dharmahīnaśca pātakī \|*  
*svadharmanirato vipraḥ paramācca hutāśanāt \|\| 207 \|\|*

*pavitraścātitejasvī tasmadbhītāḥ surāḥ sadā \|*  
*nadīṣu ca yathā gaṅgā tīrtheṣu puṣkaraṃ yathā \|\| 208 \|\|*

*purīṣu ca yathā kāśī yathā jñāniṣu śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*śāstreṣu ca yathā vedā yathā'śvatthaśca pādape \|\| 209 \|\|*

*mama pūjā tapasyāsu vrateṣvanaśanaṃ yathā \|*  
*tathā jātiṣu sarvāsu brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭha eva ca \|\| 210 \|\|*

205-210. An astrologer who is well-versed in the scriptures if speaks falsehood, he surely becomes the chief of the monkeys for seven births. Thereafter, as a result of the reward of the tapas for several births, he is born in the land of Bharata and becomes a virtuous Brahmana. The person devoid of dharma becomes sinful. The one who performs his dharma is considered to be extremely purified like fire and illustrious and even the gods are afraid of him. As the Ganga is the most sacred of all the rivers, Puskara is sacred among the holy places, Kashipuri among the cities, Shiva among the intellectual, the Vedas among the scriptures, the plpala tree among the trees, my adoration among the tapas, various types of tapas and fasting among performing of vratas, similarly the Brahmanas are adorable among all the people.

## \|\| 85.211-214 \|\|

*vipraṇadeṣu tīrthāni puṇyāni ca vratāni ca \|*  
*viprapādarajaḥ śuddhaṃ pāpavyādhivimardanam \|\| 211 \|\|*

*śubhāśīrvacanaṃ teṣāṃ sarvakalyāṇakāraṇam \|*  
*etatte kathitaṃ tāta vipākaḥ karmaṇāmaho \|\| 212 \|\|*

*yathāśrutaṃ yathājñātaṃ tadaśeṣaṃ niṇāmaya \|*  
*śutvā dharmavipākaṃ ca vācakāya suvarṇakam \|\| 213 \|\|*

*dadyāttasmai ca raupyaṃ ca vastraṃ tāmbūlameva ca \|*  
*suvarṇaśatakaṃ dadyātsadyo dehī ca gokulam \|*  
*raupyaṃ vastraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ matprītyā brāhmaṇāya ca \|\| 214 \|\|*

211-214. All the tlrthas reside in the feet of Brahmanas and the dust of the Brahmana's feet is considered to be quite auspicious and destroys sins and ailments; their blessing bestows welfare. О father, thus I have narrated to you the effects of the evil and good deeds as heard by me. Now you listen to the rest. After listening to the scriptures, one should offer gold, silver, clothes and betel to the Brahmanas. For my pleasure the reciter should be given a hundred gold coins, a cow, silver, costumes and betels.

## Chapter 86

## \|\| 86.1-2 \|\|

*atha ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca kedārakanyāprastāvātkathitaṃ karmakīrtanam \|*  
*kṛtyāstrīṇāṃ prasaṅgena tadvyāsena vada prabho \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kedārakanyā sā kā vā ko vā kedārabhūpatiḥ \|*  
*kasya vaṃśecatajjanma tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Nanda said – О lord with the resolve of the daughter of Kedara you have spelt out the result of the deed. I halve also learnt about the conduct of loose woman. Now you tell me in detail the story about Kedarakanya who was king Kedara and in which race was he born.

## \|\| 86.3-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca purātu brahmaṇāḥ putro manuḥ svāṃyabhuvastathā \|*  
*tasya strī śatarūpā ca dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*priyavratottānapādau tayoḥ putrau babhūvatuḥ \|*  
*uttānapādaputraśca dhruva eva mahāyaśāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tatputro nandasāvarṇiḥ kedāraśca tadātmajaḥ \|*  
*saptadvīpapatiḥ śrīmānkedāro vaiṣṇavaḥ svayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Shri Krishna said – In the earlier times Svayambhuvamanu was the son of Brahma who was married to Satarupa who was quite graceful among the ladies. They had two sons named Priyavrata and Uttanapada. Out of them Uttanapada happened to be quite glorious and he had a son named Dhruva. Dhruva had a son named Nandasavarni and Kedara was the son of Nandasavarni. He happened to be the lord of all the seven continents and was a great Vaishnava.

## \|\| 86.6-11 \|\|

*tasya rakṣānimittena satsabhāyāṃ sudarśanam \|*  
*gavāṃ lakṣaṃ śuddhaṃ svarṇaśṛṅgaṃ ca bhūṣitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vahniśuddhāni vastrāṇi dattāni varuṇena ca \|*  
*suvarṇānāṃ tathā lakṣaṃ sarvasasyāṃ vasuṃdharām \|\| 7 \|\|*

*maṇiratnaṃ ca muktāśca hīrakaṃ paramaṃ tathā \|*  
*māṇikyāmaśvaratnānāṃ lakṣaṃ lakṣaṃ cahastinām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*raupyaṃ pravālaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ śatadhānyācalaṃ varam \|*  
*nityaṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇemyo dadau ca ratnabhūṣaṇām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śatalakṣaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ \|*  
*jalabhojanapātrāṇi suvarṇānāṃ dadau nṛpaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*suvarṇānāṃ yajñasūtramaṅgulīyakamuttamam \|*  
*āsanaṃ svarṇaratnānāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā \|\| 11 \|\|*

6-11. The Sudarsana-cakra always remained present in his court. He used to give away in charity a lakh of cows of high breed whose horns were covered with gold plates, which were given to him by Varuna and covered with the best of garments purified fire, a lakh of gold coins and land with growing crops. The best of the gems, jewels, diamonds, a lakh of horses, a lakh of elephants, silver, rubies, sweet dishes and a hundred mountain-like heaps of paddy, besides gem-studded ornaments. He used to serve food to a hundred lakhs of Brahmanas daily. The king had all the vases made of gold. The gold vases for eating and the yajnopavlta were of gold and had beautiful finger rings. He also gave away in charity the gem-studded seats delightfully to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 86.12 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānāṃ ca lakṣaṃ ca sūpakāraṃ nṛpasya ca \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ dvilakṣaṃ ca pariveṣaṇakārakam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. A lakh of Brahmanas were engaged by the king to serve in the kitchen for cooking food and serving it to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 86.13-15 \|\|

*ghṛtakulyā madhukulyā dadhikulyā manoharāḥ \|*  
*guḍakulyā dugdhakulyā nityaṃ prārthanamīpsitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*prātarārabhya saṃdhyāntaṃ viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ tathā \|*  
*duḥśināṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ ca dhanadānaṃ yathocitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*phalamūlāśano rājā vaiṣṇavaśca jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*sarva madarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā'japanmāṃ ca divāniśam \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. He always had a huge stock of honey, curd, guda and milk. The king right from the morning till evening engaged himself in serving the fruits, roots and other eatables to the Brahmanas. He was a great Vaishnava who had controlled all the senses. He offered everything of his own to me and always recited my name throughout the day and night.

## \|\| 86.16-17 \|\|

*ekadā sūpakāraśca tamuvāca nṛpeśvaram \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ bhojanāyaiva daśalakṣamupasthitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*bhuñjate brāhmaṇāścādya rūkṣamannaṃ vada prabho \|*  
*kurvantu bhakṣaṇaṃ te vai viprāḥ sūpādinā nṛpa \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Once the cook came to him and told the king, "O king, ten lakhs of Brahmanas have, arrived to take food; Today the Brahmana are taking quite simple food. О lord you tell me kindly as to what should be done. О king the Brahmanas should take their food with pulses and other eatables.".

## \|\| 86.18-20 \|\|

*caturyojanaparyantamadhikāro nṛpasya ca \|*  
*yo rājā tacchatasuṇaḥ sa eva maṇḍaleśvaraḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tattaddaśaguṇo rājā rājendraḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|*  
*rājendrāṇāṃ pañcalakṣaṃ nityaṃ kedārasaṃsadi \|\| 19 \|\|*

*amūlyaratnamāṇikyaṃ muktāhīraṃ maṇīśvaram \|*  
*gajaratnamaśvaratnaṃ kedārāya karaṃ dadau \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. The authority of the king spread up to the four yojanas and the one whose authority extended to hundred times more the area, he is considered to be a mandaleshvara. The one whose command is extended to ten times more than mandaleshvara is called Rajendra. In the court of Kedara five lakhs of kings always remained present who were adorned with gem-studded ornaments, the jewels and the diamonds and presented to the king the best of gems, horses and elephants.

## \|\| 86.21-25 \|\|

*kamalākalayā jātā yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavāḥ \|*  
*vahriśuddhāṃsukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kāmukī kāminīśreṣṭhā kanyā kamalalocanā \|*  
*kanyā'smi te mahārājetyuvāca nṛpatiṃ ca sā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*rājā saṃpūjya tāṃ bhaktyā tasthau patnīṃsarpya ca \|*  
*sā vijñāya prasūṃ tātaṃ kṛtvā ca vinayaṃ sudā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yayau puṇyavanaṃ ramyaṃ tapase yamṛnāntikam \|*  
*tattapasyāvanaṃ yasmāttasmāddṛndāvanaṃ smṛtam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tapasā varayāmāsa māṃ varaṃ ca varaṃ varam \|*  
*brahmā dadau varaṃ tasyai paśyātkṛṣṇaṃ labheṣyasi \|\| 25 \|\|*

21-25. From the fire altar of the same king Lakshmi had appeared as a damsel, having lotus-like eyes, she was clad in the garments sanctified by fire and was adorned with gem-studded ornaments, she said to the king, О lord I am your daughter". On hearing this the king handed over the girl with devotion to his wife and stood there. Thereafter the girl humbly spoke to her parents and went for performing tapas at the bank of the Yamuna in an auspicious forest. Because of her performing the tapas there, the place was known as Vrindavana. After performing tapas she desired to have me as her husband as a boon. Brahma then bestowed a boon to her, "You would achieve lord Krishna as the husband later."

## \|\| 86.26-30 \|\|

*sa caikadā nadītīne vasante sasmitā satī \|*  
*śayānā puṣpaśayyāyāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*brahmā parīkṣituṃ yātaḥsādhvīṃ ca sumanoharām \|*  
*dadarśa kanyā rahasi yuvānaṃ puruṣaṃ param \|\| 27 \|\|*

*candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|*  
*sasmītaṃ kāmukaṃ ramyaṃ ramaṇīnāṃ ca vāñchitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*yathā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyaṃ kumāraṃ kanakaprabham \|*  
*koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ vītāmbaradharaṃ varam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*śaratpārvaṇācandrāsyaṃ śaratpadmasulocanam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā taṃ ca samutthāya vāsayāmāsa saṃnidhau \|\| 30 \|\|*

26-30. Once she was lying down in the spring season over the bank of the river in the flower bed, adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments, she wore a serene smile on her face while sleeping there. At the same time a Brahmana in order to test the chastity of the damsel arrived there. The girl also saw a beautiful young men having arrived there whose body was plastered with sandal-paste. He was adorned with gem-studded ornaments and was quite desirable by the damsels. He was quite young, beautiful and quite pleasant to look at. He appeared like a boy of sixteen, having the lustre of the molten gold, looking more beautiful then the crores of the gods of love, wearing pltambara, a face like the moon and the eyes like the lotus of the winter season. On finding the Brahmana boy there, the girl got up from her bed and made him sit besides her.

## \|\| 86.31-32 \|\|

*pūjāṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca phalaṃ mūlaṃ dadau mudā \|*  
*suvā sitaṃ jalaṃ dattvā praṇanāma mudā'nvitā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*pūjāṃ gṛhītvā muditaḥ sādaraṃ tāmuvāca ha \|*  
*viprarūpī ca bhagavānprajvalanbrahmātejasā \|*  
*kāmukīnāṃ ca kāmyaṃ ca satīnāṃ duṣkaraṃ vraja \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. She adorned him with devotion and offered fruits and roots to him besides the fragrant water and then bowed in reverence to him О lord of Vraja, Dharma in the form of a Brahmana boy was shining with his eternal lustre. He delightfully accepted the adoration of the princess and spoke the words which were quite appropriate for the passionate women but were difficult for the chaste woman.

## \|\| 86.33-34 \|\|

*dharma uvāca bhavatī kasya kanyā vā kiṃ te nāma manohare \|*  
*kiṃ karoṣi rahasyeva tanme kathitumarhasi \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kasya hetostapasyā te kiṃ vā vāñchasi sundari \|*  
*varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vāñchitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. Dharma said – О beautiful one, who is your father? What is your name? Why are you staying here in the lonely place? You tell me. О beautiful one, what for are you performing tapasl What is your desire? You will meet with welfare. You ask for a boon.

## \|\| 86.35-36 \|\|

*vṛndovāca vipra kedārakanyā'haṃ vṛndā vṛndāvane sthitā \|*  
*tapaḥ karomi rahasi cintayāmi hariṃ patim \|\| 35 \|\|*

*yadi dātuṃ samartho'si dehi me vāñchitaṃ varam \|*  
*asamartho'si cedgaccha kiṃ te praśnena brāhmaṇa \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. Vmda said – О Brahmana, I am the daughter of Kedara and my name is Vmda. Residing in Vrindavana, I performed tapas in a secluded place in order to get lord Hari as my husband. О Brahmana, if you can bestow a boon on me then give the same to me. And if you are not competent enough to do so what is the use of putting a question to me?

## \|\| 86.37-42 \|\|

*dharma uvāca nirīhamaditarkyaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*nirguṇaṃ ca nirākāraṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kā kṣamā taṃ patiṃ kartuṃ vinā lakṣamīṃ sarasvatīm \|*  
*caturbhujasya dve bhārye harervaikuṇṭhaśāthinaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*goloke dvibhujasyāpi śrīvaṃśīvadanasya ca \|*  
*kiśoragopaveṣasya paripūrṇatamasya ca \|\| 39 \|\|*

*tasya bhāryā svayaṃ rādhā mahālakṣmīḥ parātparā \|*  
*brahmasvarūpā paramā paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 40 \|\|*

*bhajate satataṃ śāntaṃ suramyaṃ śyāmasundaram \|*  
*koṭikandarpasaundaryaninditaṃ sukalevaram \|\| 41 \|\|*

*amūlyaratnābharaṇaṃ satyaṃ ca nityavigraham \|*  
*pītāmbaradharaṃ ramyaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām \|\| 42 \|\|*

37-42. Dharma said – The lord is devoid of desires, beyond comprehension, the soul of all, the lord of all, without qualities, invisible, who becomes visible to shower his grace on his devotees; therefore who else would be able to achieve him as her husband, except Sarasvati and Lakshmi? The four-armed lord Hari who sleeps in the Vaikuntha with two spouses and the two-armed lord who dwells in the Goloka holding a flute, appearing in the form of a cowherd, is lord Krishna and he has Radha as his spouse. The same Radha who is the form of eternal Brahmana, serves the dark-complexioned Krishna always, who possesses considerable mental prowess and fortunes, is peaceful and extremely beautiful. Her beautiful body puts to shame the bodies of crores of gods of love. He is adorned with invaluable gem-studded ornaments, is the form of truth, imperishable, clad in pltambara and happens to be the bestower of all riches.

## \|\| 86.43 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇaśca dvidhārūpo dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ \|*  
*caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The same Krishna who is two-armed in Goloka, resides in the Vaikuntha, having four arms.

## \|\| 86.44-45 \|\|

*yannimeṣo bhavedvṛnde brahmaṇaḥ patatena ca \|*  
*pañcaviṃśatsahasreṇā yugenendrasya pātanam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*caturdaśendrāvacchinnakālena brahmaṇo dinam \|*  
*tāvatīti niśā tasya vidhāturjagatāmapi \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. O Vrinda, with the fall of Brahma, lord Krishna winks his eye. After a lapse of twenty five yugas. Indra comes to an end and after the fall of fourteen such Indras, a day of Brahma is counted, his life similarly is in lengthy.

## \|\| 86.46 \|\|

*evaṃ triṃśaddinairmāsaṃ dviṣaṭke māsi varṣakam \|*  
*evaṃ śatāyustasyaiva nibodha bodhatatparam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Thirty such days make a month and twelve such months make a year. Brahma has the life of hundred such years.

## \|\| 86.47-51 \|\|

*yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ sevante sanakādayaḥ \|*  
*kalpānāṃ koṭikoṭiṃ ca tanna sādhyāścayo vibhuḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sahasravaktraḥ śeṣaśca sevate ca japansadā \|*  
*divāniśaṃ ca yaṃ bhaktyā kalpakoṭiśataṃ śatam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tanna sādhyo hitakaro durārādhyaḥ parātparaḥ \|*  
*brahmā brahmāsvarūpaṃ taṃ bhajejjanmani janmani \|\| 49 \|\|*

*vaktraiścaturbhiḥ satataṃ stauti nityaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*vede'nirvacanīyaśca vedānāṃ janako vidhiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*vidhātā phaladātā ca dātā ca sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*tanna sādhyo hi bhagavānkālakālāntakaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

47-51. With the end of the life of Brahma, a second of lord Vishnu is counted, the sages like Sanaka and others serve him throughout life but even after performing tapas, for crores of kalpas, they never achieve his glance. The serpent Shesha having a thousand serpent-hoods adore him with devotion for an innumerable number of years but he is not able to get him. Brahma, the creator of the Vedas, who is the creator of the universe, bestows reward for all the deeds; bestower of all the fortunes, he always adores the lord who is eternal, the form of Brahmana, imperishable, with all the four mouths but the lord is beyond the description of the Vedas, is the death for the time and is the Yama for Yama, is not able to achieve him.

## \|\| 86.52-60 \|\|

*saṃhārakartā jagatāṃ kalayā rudrarūpataḥ \|*  
*sa stauti pañcavaktreṇa ko'nyo'nyasyāpi kā kathā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tatparaśca priyo nāsti vṛnde bhagavātaḥ śṛṇu \|*  
*sarvaśaktisvarūpā sā durgā durgatināśinī \|\| 53 \|\|*

*brahmasvarūpā paramā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*nārāyaṇī viṣṇumāyā vaiṣṇavī sā sanātanī \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yanmāyayā jagadbhrāntamanitye bhramate sadā \|*  
*sā stauti bhaktyāyaṃ devaṃ vṛnde'yaṅge.divāniśam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*stauti bhaktyā svaśaktyā ca gajavaktraḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ \|*  
*dhyāyate yaṃ gaṇeśaśca sarvādau yasya pūjanam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*bhagavānsarvadeveśo jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ \|*  
*sidvendreṣu ca devendre yomīndre jñānināṃ gurau \|\| 57 \|\|*

*na gaṇeśātparo vidvāngaṇeśaśca surādhipaḥ \|*  
*sarasvatī ca yaṃ stotumaśaktā parameśvarī \|\| 58 \|\|*

*divāniśaṃ pādapadmaṃ bhaktyā padmā niṣevate \|*  
*yatkaṭākṣājjagatsarva paripūrṇatamaṃ śivam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*yadbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ sūryastapati yadbhayāt \|*  
*varṣatīndro dahatyagnirmṛtyuścarati jantuṣu \|\| 60 \|\|*

52-60. The one who taking the form of Rudra destroys the universe, offers prayer with all his five faces. No one else is dearer to the lord than him but still he cannot be achieved even by such people; then what to speak of others. О Vrinda, Durga who is the form of all the prowess, destroys misfortune, the form of eternal Brahmana, MdlaPrakriti, Isvari, Narayani, Vis numaya, Vaishnavl and the eternal force is influenced by the illusion of the lord always roamed about in the perishable universe. She has also been adoring the lord with great devotion; the elephant-faced Ganesha and six face Karttikeya always adore him according to their prowess. Lord Ganesha who is adored first of all, happens to be the lord of the gods and the teacher of the intellectuals. There is no one greater than Ganesha who could achieve the siddhis nor is there any other lord of the gods or a yogi or an intellectual comparable to Ganesha and who happens to be the lord of the gods, the same lord Ganesha adores him. Sarasvati the great goddess also adores him, Lakshmi serves at his lotus-like feet throughout the day and night with devotion. With the frowning of whom the whole universe is complete and meets with welfare, with the fear of whom, the wind blows, the sun bums, Indra pours the rain, the fire bums and the death roams about in the universe,

## \|\| 86.61 \|\|

*pṛthivī sevayā yasya sarvādhārā vasaṃdharā \|*  
*samṛdrā niścalāḥ śailā yasya bhītāśca sundari \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. By serving him the earth has become the base of all and the store of all the riches, terrified from whom the ocean and the mountains remain within their limit.

## \|\| 86.62 \|\|

*tīrthasārā ca sā gaṅgā pavitrā muktidāyinī \|*  
*jagatāṃ pāvanī devī yasya pādābjasevayā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. By serving whose lotus-like feet, Ganga becomes the essence of all the holy places and redeems everyone.

## \|\| 86.63-66 \|\|

*pavitrā tulasī devī smaraṇādyasya sevanāt \|*  
*navagrahāśca dikpālā bhītā yasya pratāpataḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*brahmaṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ \|*  
*anye ye ye sureśāśca śeṣādyā munayastathā \|\| 64 \|\|*

*kecitkalāsvarūpāścāpyaṃśarūpāśca kecana \|*  
*kecitkalāṃśāḥ kṛṣṇasya kecicca paramātmanaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*patimicchasi kalyāṇi prakṛteḥ paramīśvaram \|*  
*goloke rādhikā sādhyo nānyeṣāṃ ca kadācana \|\| 66 \|\|*

63-66. With the reciting of whose name, Tulasi gets purified and by whose glory, the nine planets and Dikpalas get frightened. Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are present in all the globes besides the Shesha, other gods and sages. Some of them have the amsas of lord Krishna while others are the amsas of his amsas. О virtuous one, you intend to achieve the same lord as your husband who is beyond Prakriti but he could be achieved by Radha only in Goloka. No one wise can achieve her.

## \|\| 86.67-68 \|\|

*māṃ bhajasva mahābhāge nṛpāṇāmīśvaraṃ patim \|*  
*balavantaṃ ca devebhyo daityebhyaśca varānane \|\| 67 \|\|*

*sukhāni yāni kalyāṇi triṣu lokeṣu santi vai \|*  
*bhuṅkṣva tānyeva sarvāṇi matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. Therefore, О virtuous one, О damsel, you accept me as your husband and enjoy all the pleasures. I happen to be the lord of all the gods and possess more prowess than the gods and the demons. О virtuous one, you can enjoy with me all the pleasures of the three worlds with my grace. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 86.69 \|\|

*saptasāgalapāre ca kāñcanī rucirā vare \|*  
*devānāṃ krīḍanārthāya vidhātrā nirmitā purī \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Beyond the seven oceans, Brahma has built up a sporting place for the gods which is quite charming and known as the city of Kanchani.

## \|\| 86.70 \|\|

*tatraiva gacchabhadraṃ te rama rāme mayā saha \|*  
*mahendrasya priyavanaṃ puṣpodyānasamanvitam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. О Rama, you will meet with welfare, let us go and enjoy the pleasure there. There is an orchard which is quite dear to Indra.

## \|\| 86.71 \|\|

*gaccha svarṇamayīṃ laṅkāṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitām \|*  
*tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te ramo \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The golden Lanka is adorned with the ornaments of gold. О beautiful one, you would meet with welfare; you get along with me there and let us enjoy the pleasure.

## \|\| 86.72 \|\|

*vispandakaṃ suvasanaṃ nandakaṃ puṣpabhadrakam \|*  
*tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te ramo \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. There are the gardens named Vispandaka, Suvasana, Nandaka and Puspabhadraka. О beautiful one, you go there and enjoy my company.

## \|\| 86.73 \|\|

*sumerugahvaraṃ vā'pi kṣīrorda vā manoharam \|*  
*tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te ramo \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. О beautiful damsel, let us go to the beautiful caves of the Sumeru mountain and the bed of ocean of milk and enjoy my company there.

## \|\| 86.74 \|\|

*satyalokaṃ brahmalokaṃ ramyaṃ sadma rahaḥsthalam \|*  
*tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te ramo \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Visiting Satyaloka, Brahmaloka and the charming lonely places enjoy my company there.

## \|\| 86.75-77 \|\|
