*malaye nilayaṃ ramyaṃ ratnendrasāranirmitam \|*  
*sugandhiyuktaṃ satataṃ śuddhaṃ candanavāyunā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*mālatī yūthikā ramyā ketakī mādhavī tathā \|*  
*cārucampakapuṣpāṇāṃ gandhena sumanoharam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*pikānāṃ bhramarāṇāṃ ca madhuradhvanisaṃyutam \|*  
*tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te ramo \|\| 77 \|\|*

75-77. There is a beautiful place on the Malaya mountain built with the best of gems where the fragrant cool breeze blows, the jasmine flower and the flower of RetakI, Madhavi and Campa creepers are also tyere. The place is filled with the sweet notes of the cuckoos and the hissing sound of the biack-wasps. О beautiful one, you get along with me and enjoy my company there.

## \|\| 86.78-80 \|\|

*indrasya varuṇāsyaiva vāyorapi yamasya ca \|*  
*dhaneśvarasya bahreśca dharmasya śaśinastathā \|\| 78 \|\|*

*suramyaṃ lokameteṣāṃ madhye tevi yathecchasi \|*  
*tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te ramo \|\| 79 \|\|*

*ratnadvīpaṃ maṇidvīpaṃ ramyaṃ candrasarovaram \|*  
*tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te ramo \|\| 80 \|\|*

78-80. О goddess, the places of Indra, Varuna, Vayu, Yama, Kubera, Agni, Dharma and the moon are quite pleasant; you can enjoy my company at whichever place you like. We can visit Ratnadvipa, Manidvipa, Chandrasarovara which are quite beautiful. О beautiful one, you get along with me and enjoy my company.

## \|\| 86.81 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā saṃbhoktuṃ gacchantaṃ taṃ chalena ca \|*  
*na vāstavaparīkṣārthaṃ satītvaṃ bodhituṃ vraja \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. О lord of Vraja, thus speaking Dharma in order to test the chastity of the daughter of Kedara advanced towards her deceitfully.

## \|\| 86.82 \|\|

*uvāca sā nṛpasutā kopavaktrāsyalocanā \|*  
*hitaṃ satyaṃ yogayuktaṃ dharmārthaṃ ca yaśaskaram \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The eyes of the damsels became red with anger and the princess spoke to him the words which were quite beneficial, truthful, appropriate and glorious.

## \|\| 86.83-84 \|\|

*vṛndovāca dhairya kuru mahābhāga śreṣṭho jātiṣu brahmaṇaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇānāṃ tapo mūlaṃ satyaṃ vedavrataṃ dhṛtiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*parastrīsahasaṃbhogaḥ svabhāvaścāpyadharmiṇām \|*  
*adharmeṇaiva he vipra duṣṭo'bhadrāṇi paśyati \|\| 84 \|\|*

83-84. Vrinda said – О lord, be patient with all the castes, Brahmana is believed to be the supreme. The base of a Brahmana is tapas, truthfulness, the performing of vratas and patience. О Brahmana, it is not proper for noble people to cohabit with the wives of others. Because of sin, the wicked people have to face misfortune.

## \|\| 86.85-88 \|\|

*tataḥ sapatne jayati samūlastho vinaśyati \|*  
*pativratānāṃ gamane balātkāreṇa niścitam \|\| 85 \|\|*

*iti śrībrahmo mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakho utto nāradanāo bhagavannandasaṃo ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*pradagdhastailatapteṣu na mṛtaḥ sūkṣmadehataḥ \|*  
*tāḍito yamadūtaiśca lohadaṇ̈ḍena mūrdhani \|\| 87 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ ciraṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvanāśasya kāraṇam \|*  
*agamyāgamanaṃ duḥkhaṃ dharmiṣṭho naiva vāñchati \|\| 88 \|\|*

85-88. Thereafter he is vanquished by the enemies and then is completely destroyed. The one who rapes chaste woman forcibly, is surely described as the one cohabiting with his mother and earns the sin of a hundred Brahmahatyas. He stays in the kumbhlpaka hell for the life of the sun an the moon. He is thrown into the pan of boiling oil but because of his having an ethereal form he does not die; the Messengers of Yama strike on his head with iron rods. For a short-lived pleasure, he has to suffer pain for a long time. This happens to be the cause of total destruction. Therefore the intellectuals never invite such a type of misfortune.

## \|\| 86.89-90 \|\|

*kṣamasvagaccha bhadraṃ te brāhmaṇa jñānadurbala \|*  
*yathā dīpaśikhāṃ dṛṣṭvā kīṭaḥ patati niścitam \|\| 89 \|\|*

*miṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā baḍīśāgre lubdhamīno mṛgo yathā \|*  
*yathā viṣāktaṃ bhakṣyaṃ ca bhuṅkte bhoktā bubhukṣitaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

89-90. О Brahmana, your knowledge is weak. Let you meet with welfare and you kindly excuse me. As a fire-fly hovers round the burning wick of a lamp, similarly fish and deer finding the sweet places at the mouth of a thorn swallow it, the hungry person consumes poisoned food.

## \|\| 86.91-98 \|\|

*gṛhṇāti duṣṭo duṣṭaṃ ca viṣakumbhaṃ payomukham \|*  
*tathā dṛṣṭvā parastrīṇāṃ mukhapadmaṃ manoharam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*vināśabījaṃ mohena bhrānto bhavati lampaṭaḥ \|*  
*mukhaṃ ca ruciraṃ strīṇāṃ śroṇiyugmaṃ manoharam \|\| 92 \|\|*

*kāmādhāraṃ nāśabījamadharmasthalameva ca \|*  
*bhagaṃ narakakuṇḍaṃ ca lālāmūtrasamanvitam \|\| 93 \|\|*

*durgandhiyuktaṃ pāpaṃ ca yamadaṇḍasya kāraṇam \|*  
*yathā liṅgaṃ viśatyeva pāpayonau ca yoṣitām \|\| 94 \|\|*

*tathā pumānviśatyeva raurave ca yuge yuge \|*  
*rahasyaṃ cā''padaṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃ tavaṃ dharṣitumicchasi \|\| 95 \|\|*

*atraiva sarvadevāśca lokapālāśca brāhmaṇā \|*  
*jājvalyamāno dharmaśca sākṣī śāstā ca karmaṇām \|\| 96 \|\|*

*yamaśca daṇ̈ḍakartā ca sthāpito hariṇā svayam \|*  
*svayaṃ kuṣṇaśca dharmātmā jñānarupo maheśvaraḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*durgā buddhirmano brahma cendriyāṇi surāstathā \|*  
*sarvaprāṇiṣu tiṣṭhanti sākṣiṇāḥ karmaṇāṃ dvija \|\| 98 \|\|*

91-98. A wicked person accepts milk filled with poison with pleasure; similarly a wicked person turns round others' wives, having a pleasant face which results in total destruction. By looking at the face of a beautiful woman, a wicked person is filled with fallacy. The beautiful face of the damsels, the breasts and the pelvic region are the seeds for destruction. Filled with fluid and urine, the pelvic region is like an altar of hell. It is filled with bad smell, sinful and entitles one to receive punishment at the hands of Yama after men and women are united. Similarly the men have to fall into the terrific hell for yugas. О Brahmana, finding me alone if you intend to rape me, then all the gods, the lokapalas, dharma who is the witness to all the deeds, lord Hari and the lord of Yama, lord Krishna, Maheshvara the abode of all intelligence, Durga, wisdom, mind, Brahma and all other gods would arrive.

## \|\| 86.99-101 \|\|

*kva guptaṃ kva rahasyaṃ vā brahmaṇa jñānadurbala \|*  
*kṣamasva gaccha bhadraṃ te avadhyāśca dvijātayaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*śaktā'haṃ bhamasātkartuṃ gaccha vatsa yathāsukham \|*  
*tapasyāsu mama gatamaṣṭottaraśataṃ yugam \|\| 100 \|\|*

*nāsti gortra matpituśca na mātā na pitā mama \|*  
*sarvāntarātmā bhagavānkṛṣṇo rakṣati māṃ dvija \|\| 101 \|\|*

99-101. All these gods remaining witness to all the people remain present at all times in all the places. Therefore, О foolish Brahmana, which is the secret place and what is secretive? О Brahmana, therefore you excuse me; you leave the place and meet with your welfare. О son, the Brahmanas are not to be killed, therefore, you leave the place with pleasure; otherwise, I am competent enough to reduce you to ashes. I have been performing tapas for a hundred and eight yugas; therefore, there is no name or gotra for my father nor are my parents alive.

## \|\| 86.102-103 \|\|

*kṛṣṇena sthāpito dharmo māṃ ca rakṣati nityaśaḥ \|*  
*ādityaśca tathā candraḥ pavanaśca hutāśanaḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

*brahmā śaṃbhurbhagavatī durgā rakṣati māṃ sadā \|*  
*yena śuklīkṛtā haṃsāḥ śukāśca haritāḥ kṛtāḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. О Brahmana, lord Krishna who is the soul of all always protects me and. the cakra of lord Krishna always protects me besides the sun, the moon, the wind, Agni, Brahma, Shiva and the goddess Durga always protects me.

## \|\| 86.104-105 \|\|

*mayūrāścitritā yena sa me rakṣāṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*anāthabālavṛddhānāṃ rakṣakāḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

*nārībudvyā na māṃ dharmastyaktvā gaccheddhi sarvadā \|*  
*māṃ mātaraṃ parityajya gaccha vatsa yathāsukham \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. The one who has bestowed whiteness to the goose, greenness to the parrot, different colours to the peacock, the same lord will surely protect me, he is the lord of the orphans boys, as well as the old people. Therefore taking me to be a women, dharma cannot disown me.

## \|\| 86.106 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā devī sā tasthau tatra dharā yathā \|*  
*āgacchantaṃ ca saṃbhoktuṃ mā yāntaṃ bodhanena ca \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. О son, you leave me alone and go to your place comfortably. Thus the lady remained unmoved like the earth.

## \|\| 86.107-111 \|\|

*śaśāpeti ca sā kopādbrahmapandho kṣayo bhava \|*  
*kṣayo bhava durācāra he pāpiṣṭha kṣayo bhava \|\| 107 \|\|*

*punaḥ śaptaṃ svayaṃ sūryo vārayāmāsa yatnataḥ \|*  
*etasimannantare tāta tatrava jagadīśvarāḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

*ājagmuratisaṃtrastā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*

By your grace, I shall surely bring him back to life". О lord of Vraja, thus speaking Vrinda said – In case my tapas is truthful, my devotion towards lord Vishnu is truthful then with the influence of that tapas the Brahmana should be relived of all the miseries. In case, I am truthful, my vrata is truthful, because of the influence of the same and with the influence of my tapas, this Brahmana should be freed from the misery. In case the eternal Narayana who happens to be the soul of all and Shiva the all knowledgeable one is also truthful, in that case the Brahmana should be relieved of the entire miseries. In case Brahmana is truthful beside the gods and the Prakriti, the yajna and the tapas then this Brahmana should be freed from all the sufferings. Thus speaking Vrinda picked up Dharma and took him in her lap. Finding him reduced to the form of a mere ray, she started crying.

*tvāṃ dattvā vāstavī rādhā sā'ntardhānā bhaviṣyati \|*

138-142. When Radha would be born as the daughter of Vrsabhanu due to the curse of Shridama, at that very moment, Radha would appear together with you as her reflection. At the time of the marriage Rayana would accept you because after entrusting the real Radha to you, he would disappear. Therefore, all the people of Gokula would treat you, as the real Radha but the cowherds would not be able to witness the lotus-like feel of Radha in dream. Because Radha herself resides in my heart and her reflection would be the wife of Rayana. On hearing these words of Vishnu, the damsel gave away his life to Dharma. Thereafter Dharma got up in his full form with the complexion of molten gold and looked more illustrious than before; he then bowed in reverence to lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 86.143-147 \|\|

*vṛndovāca devāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṃ durlaṅghyaṃ sāvadhānataḥ \|*

*kṣayo bhaveti vākyaṃ ca mayoktaṃ kopabhītayā \|*

*satye ca paripūrṇo'yaṃ yathāpūrvo yathā'dhunā \|*

*ekapādaśca darmo'yaṃ kaleśca prathame hare \|*

*trirnirgataṃ mama mukhātkṣayastena tataḥ kramāt \|*  
*punarukte ca manasi vārayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

143-147. Vmda said – О gods you listen to my words carefully which cannot be overlooked and can never untme or false. In anger I pronounced the word ksyobhava thrice but when I was about to pronounce the same the fourth time, Stirya prevented me from doing so. The same total effect of my curse would be that in Satyayuga, Dharma would be complete in all respects but in Tretayuga, he would have only three feet; in Dvapara only in two and in Kaliyuga only one; in the later part of Kaliyuga, only a small reflection of dharma would be visible thereafter in Satyayuga he would again appear in his full form. The words of destruction were spoken by me thrice and as such the effect of the same has also been pronounced by me. I was going to repeat the same the fourth time when Surya prevented me from doing so, therefore, I could not speak it out. Therefore Dharma would remain in the last part of the Kaliyuga only in negligible form.

148-152. O Nanda, in the meantime the gods witnessed the arrival of a chariot moving with great force which was quite beautiful to look at and was built with the best of gems, it had the doors of gems and was decorated with diamonds, rubies, precious gems, costumes, white fly-whisk, ornaments and beautiful mirrors. Vmda after bowing in reverence to Vishnu, Shiva and Brahma beside other gods, mounted over to chariot and proceeded to Goloka. Thereafter the gods also went to their respective places. Now what else do you want to listen from me.

## \|\| 87.1-2 \|\|

## \|\| 87.12-14 \|\|

*tāndṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya namaskṛtya puṭāñjaliḥ \|*  
*siṃhāsaneṣu ramyeṣu vāsayāmāsa sādaram \|\| 12 \|\|*

Thereafter, all of them were made to sit over the charming lion thrones; Shri Krishna then asked about their welfare and adored them all. After mutual consultations Shri Krishna took his seat among them. In the meantime Krishna spotted a fall of lustre in the sky which was also witnessed by the sages.

## \|\| 87.15-18 \|\|

*tejaso'bhyantare vatsa kumāraṃ kanakaprabhām \|*  
*yathaiva pañcavarṣīyaṃ nagnaṃ bālakamīpsitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*āvirbabhūva sahasā samāmadhye ca nārada \|*  
*uttiṣṭamānaṃ sahasā taṃ dṛṣṭvā munapuṃgavāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*praṇemurmunayaḥ sarve śauriśca praṇanāma tam \|*  
*sasmitaṃ snigdhanetraṃ cakṛtvā yuktiṃ ca sādaram \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sa sarvānāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā samuvāsa ca saṃsadi \|*

15-18. Inside the lustre there was Sanatkumara in the form of a nude child having the lustre like gold. О Narada he appeared among the assembly suddenly. Finding him having arrived suddenly, all the ascetics bowed in reverence to him and Shri Krishna also with a smiling face and the love reflecting in his eyes, bowed his head to him in reverence. The child than bestowed his blessing on all those present there taking his seat among the assembly of ascetics. Thereafter he spoke to lord Krishna who happens to be eternal.

## \|\| 87.19-21 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca bhadraṃ vo munayaḥ śaśvattapasāṃ phalamīpsitam \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya kuśalapraśnaṃ sivabījasya niṣphalam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bhaktānurodhāddehasya parasya prakṛterapi \|\| 20 \|\|*

*nirguṇāsya nirīhasya sarvabījasya teyasā \|*  
*bhārāvataraṇāyaiva cā''virbhūtasya sāṃpratam \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. Sanatkumara said – О ascetics, you may meet with welfare always and you may also get the fruit all the tapas performed by you, but it is of no use to question-about the true form of lord Krishna who bestows his grace on all. Presently all of you meet with welfare because you are having an audience with the great soul at present. He has taken to the human form at the instance of his devotees. He is beyond Prakriti beyond qualities, unattached the seed of all and has incarnated on earth to relieve her of her burden.

## \|\| 87.22 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śarīradhāriṇaścāpi kuśalapraśnamīpsitam \|*  
*tatkathaṃ kuśalapraśnaṃ mayi vipra na vidyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Shri Krishna said – О Brahmana, if it is desirable to enquire about the welfare from all who possess the human bodies than why are you not interested in such question about me?

## \|\| 87.23 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca śarīre prākṛte nātha saṃtataṃ ca śubhāśubham \|*  
*nityadehe kṣemabīje śivapraśnamanarthakam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Sanatkumara said – О lord the worldly body is always surrounded with the good or bad deeds, but the one who himself is the seed of welfare, it is no used asking question about his welfare.

## \|\| 87.24 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca yo yo vigrahadhārī ca sa ca prākṛtikaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*deho na vidyate vipra tāṃ nityāṃ prākṛtiṃ vinā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Shri Krishna said – О Brahmana, of the people having human form or the other are termed as Prakritika and without Prakriti they cannot survive.

## \|\| 87.25-26 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca raktabindūdbhavā dehāste ca prākṛtikā smṛtāḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ prakṛtināthasya bījasya prākṛtaṃ vapuḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sarvabījasya sarvādirbhavāṃśca bhagavānsvayam \|*  
*sarveṣāmavatāraṇāṃ pradhānaṃ bījamavyayam \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Sanatkumara said – The bodies which are born with the application of semen, they are known as Prdkrtika but the one who is the lord of Prakriti and the cause of his body cannot be Prakritika. You happen to be the cause of all the causes, the one beginning of all, the lord himself, the foremost of all the incarnation, the seed of all as well as indestructible.

## \|\| 87.27 \|\|

*kṛtvā vadanti vedāśca nityaṃ satyaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*jyotiḥsvarūpaṃ pradhānaṃ bījamavyayam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The Vedas always define you as eternal, form of flame, the excellent, the supreme soul and the lord.

## \|\| 87.28 \|\|

*māyayā saguṇaṃ caiva māyeśaṃ nirguṇaṃ param \|*  
*pravadanti ca vedāṅgāstathā vedavidaḥ prabho \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О lord, the Vedas and post-Vedic literature also define you as the lord of illusion, without qualities, beyond the illusion and also possessing the form.

## \|\| 87.29 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca saṃprataṃ vāsudevo'haṃ raktapīryāśritaṃ vapuḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ na prakṛto vipra śivapraśnamabhīpsitam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Shri Krishna said – О Brahmana, presently I am the son of Vasudeva and my body has the semen and blood as usual. Then how can it not be called as Pmkrta and why is it not proper to enquire about the welfare of the same body.

## \|\| 87.30-33 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvāni yasya lomasu \|*  
*tasya devaḥ paraṃ brahma vāsudeva itīritaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*vāsudeveti tannāma vedeṣu ca caturṣu ca \|*  
*purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu yātrādiṣu ca dṛśyate \|\| 31 \|\|*

*raktavīryāśrito dehaḥ kva te vede nirūpitaḥ \|*  
*sākṣiṇo munayaścaiva dharmaḥ sarvatra eva ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

*sākṣiṇo mama vedāśca ravicandau ca saṃpratam \|\| 33 \|\|*

30-33. Sanatkumara said – you are the one in whose hair pits, innumerable globes are enshrined and happen to be the abode of all. That is why you are called Vasu and because of the god-hood inherent in how you are called Vasudeva. The word Vasudeva has also been repeated in the Puranas, the history books and the treatises on journeys or pilgrimages. His body comprising of the semen and blood has not been defined in the Vedas. The ascetics and the Dharma stand witnessed for the same. Presently the Vedas, the sun and the moon are my witness.

## \|\| 87.34 \|\|

*bhṛguruvāca satyaṃ vadasi tvameva vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ \|*  
*svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ śaśvatkiṃnimittamihā''gataḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Bhrigu said – О Brahmana, you have spoken truthfully, you are the fore-most of the Vaishnavas and therefore we welcome you. Are you perfectly all right, you tell us the reason for your arrival here.

## \|\| 87.35 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca śrūyatāṃ munayaḥ sarve śrūyatāṃ kṛṣṇa sāṃpratam \|*  
*aho yena nimittena cātiśīghramihā''gataḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Sanatkumara said – О sages and lord Krishna, you please listen to me about the purpose for which I have arrived here.

## \|\| 87.36 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca bhagavanmarvadharmajña kiṃnimittamihā''gataḥ \|*  
*sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña tvameva viduṣāṃ varaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Shri Krishna said – О religious one, tell me the purpose for your arrival here. You are foremost among, the intellectuals and possessed all the knowledge, you know everything and therefore you kindly speak out the purpose for your arrival here.

## \|\| 87.37 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca dhanyo'si bhagavañchaśvanmānyo'si jagatāmapi \|*  
*sarveśvareśvaro'si tvaṃ tatparo nāsti viśvataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Sanatkumara said – О lord, you are quite graceful and you are adored throughout the universe; you happen to be the lord of all and no one is superior than you.

## \|\| 87.38-39 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca yajñānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasyānāṃ dvijeśvara \|*  
*satataṃ phaladātā'haṃ dakṣiṇābhiḥ saheti ya \|\| 38 \|\|*

*iti śrutvā kumāraśca javena prayayau vane \|*  
*matvā''ścarya ca vacanaṃ vārayāmāsa te'pitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Shri Krishna said – О lord of the Brahmanas, I bestow the fruit of the yajnas and daksinas, for performing yajnas, vratas and tapas. On hearing this Kumara was about to leave the place in a hurry in the forest but the sages prevented him from going finding his words to Ъе quite astonishing.

## \|\| 87.40-41 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ he siddhendra mahābhāga kumāra karuṇāmaya \|*  
*kā śaṅkitakathā proktā bhagavatkṛṣṇasaṃnidhau \|\| 40 \|\|*

*kiṃ putra dṛṣṭamāścarya śrutaṃ kimapi kutracit \|*  
*atīva kṛtvā vistīrṇamasmākaṃ vaktumarhasi \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. The sages said – О great sage, О virtuous one, О ocean of mercy, О Kumara, what are the doubtful words spoken by you in the presence of lord Krishna. О son, have you witnessed or met with any surprise? You please speak out the same in detail.

## \|\| 87.42-45 \|\|

*eta sminnnatare brahmā pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*anantaścāpi dharmaśca śrīsūryaśca niśākaraḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*ādityā vasavo rudrā dikpālādyāśca devatāḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sahasotthāya saṃbhādhya capṛthakpṛthaku \|\| 43 \|\|*

*madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*praṇesurṛṣayaḥ sarve śeṣaṃ śaṃbhuṃ vidhiṃ śivām \|\| 44 \|\|*

*parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣā babhūva dvijadevayoḥ \|*  
*samuvāsā''sane madhye kumāraḥ kanakaprabhaḥ \|*  
*kayāṃ kathitumārebhe saṃsadi dvijadevayoḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

42-45. In the meantime Brahma, Shiva with Parvati, Ananta. Dharma, Surya, the moon, Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Dikpalas and all the gods arrived there. Finding them having arrived there, Shri Krishna got up from his seat and welcomed them individually offering madhuparka and adoring them with devotion. All the sages adored Shesha, Shiva, Brahma and Parvati. The Brahmanas and the gods conversed with one another; thereafter, Sanatkumara having the lustre of gold addressed the assembly while seated on the gem-studded lion-throne.

## \|\| 87.46-50 \|\|

*mayā gataśca goloko na dṛṣṭo rādhikāpatiḥ \|*  
*tato gataṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatra nāsti caturbhujaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tato gataśca kṣīrodastatra nāsti hariḥ svayam \|*  
*pariśrānto viṣaṇṇaśca snātaṃ kṣīrodadhestaṭe \|\| 47 \|\|*

*vistīrṇavālukāmadhye kacchapaḥ śatayojanaḥ \|*  
*bhītaśca kampitastatra dṛṣṭo duḥkhī ca śuṣkitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*niḥsārito rāghaveṇa mīnena ca mahātmanā \|*  
*dhanyo'sīti mayoktaśca nāhaṃ dhanya uvāca saḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kṣīrodaḥ sāgaro dhanyo jantavo yatra madvidhāḥ \|*  
*matto mahattarāścāpi hyasaṃkhyāśca mahāmune \|\| 50 \|\|*

46-50. Sanatkumara said – 1 had gone to Goloka but I could not find there Krishna the lord of RSdha. Thereafter I went to Vaikuntha and could not find the four-farmed Vishnu there. I then went to the ocean of milk but lord Hari was no where to be found there; thereafter feeling fatigued, I found that a vast tortoise of the size of a hundred yojanas was lying there. He looked terrified, shaking, grief, stricken and dry. It was driven out from the water by a fish named Raghava. I told him that you are quite graceful. He said, "O great sage I am not graceful but the ocean of milk is graceful which is filled with innumerable creatures of my size and even bigger than me.

## \|\| 87.51 \|\|

*bhavāndhanyo'sti kṣīroda tenokto nāhameva ca \|*  
*dhanyā vasuṃdharā devī yatraiva saptasāgarāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. I than told the ocean of milk, "O ocean of milk you are graceful. He said, "I am not graceful, this earth is graceful which has accommodated seven oceans like me.

## \|\| 87.52-60 \|\|

*dhanyā'si vasudhetyuktā nāhamevetyuvāca sā \|*  
*dhanyo'nanto mamā''dhāraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo nāgarāḍvibhuḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*mahasramūrdhnā madhye'haṃ mūrdhni śūrpe ca sarṣapaḥ \|*  
*dhanyo'si śeṣetyukto'yaṃ dhanyo nāhamuvāca vai \|\| 53 \|\|*

*dhanyaḥ kūrmo mamā''dhāro gaccha tatraiva vai mune \|*  
*dhanyo'si kūrmetyukto'yaṃ nāraṃ dhanyo'smi vai mune \|\| 54 \|\|*

*vāyunā dhāryamāṇo'haṃ matto dhanyatamaśca saḥ \|*  
*dhanyo'sītyuktaḥ pavano dhanyo nāhamuvāca saḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*dhanyaśca bhagavānbrahmā vidhātā jagatāmapi \|*  
*dhanyo'si tatra dhātā ca dhanyo nāhamuvācasaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*dhanyo maheśvaro devo yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|*  
*sarvārādhyaḥ sarvapūjyo dharmarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*kālakālaśca saṃhartā svayaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*dhanyo'si tatra śaṃbhuśca dhanyo nāhamuvāca saḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*sarvādau pūjanaṃ yasya jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ \|*  
*dhanyo gaṇeśvaro devo devānāṃ pravaraḥ paraḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*siddhendreṣu munīndreṣu devendreṣu śrutau śrutam \|*  
*yogīndreṣu ca prājñeṣu na gaṇeśātparaḥ pumān \|\| 60 \|\|*

52-60. I then said, "O earth you are graceful but she said, "I am not graceful but Ananta the lord of the serpents is graceful who supports me and is born from the arhsa of Krishna and pervades everywhere. He has a thousand hoods over one of which I have been lodges like a sheshamum seed in the winnowing basket. Then I said, Shesha is quite graceful". He said, no I am not graceful, О sage, the tortoise who happens to be my base is graceful, you go to him. Then I spoke to tortoise, you are graceful, but he replied О sage I am not graceful. The wind carries me; therefore he is more graceful than myself, Then I spoke to the wind god, "You are graceful" he replied "lord Brahma is graceful who had created the three worlds, then I spoke to Brahma, "O Brahma you are graceful, he said", I am not graceful. Lord Maha-Vishnu is graceful who happens to be the teacher of the yogis and is adored by all, is the form of Dharma, is eternal, is death for the death, the destroyer of all, having over-come the death and the lord of all. when I told him, You are graceful," he said, "No I am not graceful lord Ganesha is graceful who is adored first of all everywhere, who is the intellectuals, the best among the gods, because I have heard in the Vedas that there is no one else more graceful than Ganesha among that siddhas, ascetic, the gods, the yogis.

## \|\| 87.61-65 \|\|

*nimnagāsu yathā gaṅagā tīrtheṣu puṣkaraṃ yathā \|*  
*vedapraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*vedo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādvayaṃ pūjyā vyavasthayā \|*  
*tasmācchāstrāṇi sarvāṇi purāṇāni ca santi vai \|\| 62 \|\|*

*yasmānnirūpito dharmaścetihāsaśca saṃhitā \|*  
*tasmāddhanyāśca te vedā vadantyatra manīṣiṇāḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*yūyaṃ dhanyāśca mānyāścetyuktā vedā mayā tataḥ \|*  
*ūyuste na vayaṃ dhanyā yajñasaṃghaśya sāṃpratam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*vayaṃ vyavasthākartāro yajñaughaḥ phaladaḥ svayam \|*  
*tasmāddhanyaḥ sa evāpi gaccha gaccha mahāmune \|\| 65 \|\|*

61-65. As the Ganga is the best of all the rivers, Pushkara is the best of all the holy places, similarly he happens to be the best of all. I therefore told Ganesha that he was graceful who said, "All whatever has been prescribed in the Vedas is dharma and whatever is done against the same is sinful. Vedas are treated as the form of Narayana himself, we are adored because of the provisions of the Vedas. All the scriptures and the Puranas have emerged from the Vedas. The source of dharma history, Samhitas also vests in the Vedas. Therefore, according to the opinion of the intellectual, Vedas are graceful. Then I spoke to the Vedas saying, "You are graceful". Then they said, "We are not graceful the people who perform yajnas are graceful; we people only prescribe the path but the yajha provides the fruit. О sage, therefore only such people are graceful and you go to them.

## \|\| 87.66 \|\|

*dhanyo'si yajñasaṃgho'sītyuktastatra mayā vibho \|*  
*ūcuste na vayaṃ dhanyā dhanyaṃ karma śubhaṃ mune \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. O virtuous one, I went to the people who performed the yajna and said to them. "You people are graceful" they said, "We are not graceful only the good deeds are graceful".

## \|\| 87.67-68 \|\|

*śubhakarmāsi dhanyaṃ tvaṃ nāhaṃ dhanyamuvāca tat \|*  
*karmaṇāṃ phaladātā yaḥ karmahetuśca sāṃpratam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*dhāturvidhātā bhagavānsarvādiḥ sarvakārakaḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā ca dhanyo mānyaścaniścitam \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. I than spoke to the noble deeds and said, you are graceful. They said, "we are not graceful, lord Krishna alone is graceful who bestows the fruit for the good deeds and who happens to be the eternal Brahmana and the creator of the universe.

## \|\| 87.69-73 \|\|

*dharmālayaṃ tato gatvā na duṣṭvā jagadīśvaram \|*  
*mathurāmāgato draṣṭuṃ paripūrṇatam prabhum \|\| 69 \|\|*

*yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva vratānāṃ śubhakarmaṇām \|*  
*īśvaraṃ phaladātāraṃ paramātmānameva ca \|\| 70 \|\|*

*kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca brahmādīnāṃ puraḥsaram \|*  
*dhanyo'sīti mayoktaśca dakṣiṇābhiḥ saheti ca \|\| 71 \|\|*

*ityuktena bhagavatā kathitaṃ sarvakāraṇam \|*  
*dakṣiṇābhiśca phalado hatayajño ṅyadakṣiṇāḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇā vipramuddiśya tatkāle tu na dīyate \|*  
*ekarātre vyatīte tu taddānaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 73 \|\|*

69-73. Then I went to the abode of Dharma but I could not find him there and ultimately I arrived at Mathura in order to meet him. He is the one who bestows fruit for all the yajnas, tapas, vratas and he is the lord on to himself, the supreme soul, cause of all the causes besides being Brahma and the fore-most of the gods. I told him, "You are gracefhl with daksina." At these words of mine, the lord spoke to him about the causes of everything and said that a yajna performed, by giving away the daksina, is quite successful and the yajna performed without daks ina is unsuccessful. In case the Brahmana is not provided daksina immediately after the completion of the yajna than it is doubled after the lapse of one night.

## \|\| 87.74 \|\|

*māse śataguṇaṃ proktaṃ dvimāse tu sahasrakam \|*  
*saṃvatsare vyatīte tu sa dātā narakaṃ vrajet \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. On the expiry of one month, it is multiplied to hundred times and after the completion of two months it is multiplied to a thousand times. After completion of one year the performer of the yajna has to fall in the hell,

## \|\| 87.75 \|\|

*varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca mūtrakuṇḍe nipatya ca \|*  
*tataścāṇ̈ḍālatāṃ yāti vyādhiyuktaśca pātakī \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. He has to remain there in the tank of urine for a thousand years and is then reborn as a Chandala and a sinner.

## \|\| 87.76-77 \|\|

*dātrā na dīyate dānaṃ grahītrā cenna gṛhyate \|*  
*ubhau tau narakaṃ prāptau varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*yajamānaśca cāṇḍālo brahmaṇastatpurohitaḥ \|*  
*vyādhiyuktāvubhau tau ca pāpinau karmaṇaḥ phalāt \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. In case the performer does not give and the receiving does not receive daksina then both of them are thrown in the hell for thousand years. Thereafter, the performer and his priest Brahmana become Chandala, both of them suffer from ailment because of the same sin".

## \|\| 87.78-79 \|\|

*sarve devāśca munayo jahasurvismayaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*vismayaṃ ca yayau nandastatyāja putrabhāvakam \|\| 78 \|\|*

*ruroda ca sabhāmadhye lajjāhīnaḥ śucā''kulaḥ \|*  
*tyaja mauhamitītyuktvā bodhayāmāsa pārvatī \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. On hearing this all the gods and the sages laughed aloud getting surprised, Nanda also getting surprised shed away from his mind, attraction towards Krishna, of his being a son to him. He started crying in grief among the assembly. At that point of time Parvati consoled him and said, "You shed away the illusion, you free yourself from ignorance.

## \|\| 87.80 \|\|

*nanda uvāca amūlyaratnaṃ māṇikyaṃ yathā kujanmano gṛhe \|*  
*sthitaṃ tena ca deveśa tathā'haṃ vañcitaḥ prabho \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Nanda said – О lord I feel deprived like the one in whose house an invaluable gem is born but he remains ignorant about the same.

## \|\| 87.81-82 \|\|

*mamāparādhaṃ bhagavān kṣamasva prakṛteḥ para \|*  
*yāsyāmi na punargehaṃ gokulaṃ yamunātaṭam \|\| 81 \|\|*

*vṛndāvanaṃ tathā''vāsaṃ krīḍāvāsaṃ gadāgraja \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ ca yaśodāyā gopikāntikameva ca \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. O lord, you are beyond Prakriti and you forgive me for my sin. О wielder of the gada I will not go to Gokula, the bank of Yamuna, Vmdavana, my abode, the place of Yashoda and the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 87.83-84 \|\|

*kiṃ bravīmi yaśodāṃ ya preyasīṃ rādhikāmapi \|*  
*premapātraṃ ca bālaughaṃ vada bhoḥ kathayāmi kim \|\| 83 \|\|*

*ityuktvā ca sabhāmadhye marcchāṃ saṃprāpa nārada \|*  
*kroḍe kṛtvā jagannātho bodhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam \|\| 84 \|\|*

83-84. You kindly tell me what reply shall I give to Yashoda and Radha who is your beloved, besides the cowherds? О Narada, thus speaking Nanda fainted in the assembly. Thereafter Krishna took him in his lap and started consoling him.

## Chapter 88

## \|\| 88.1 \|\|

*athāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇā uvāca cetanaṃ kuru he tāta he tāta cetanaṃ kuru \|*  
*jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ sacarācaram \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shri Krishna said – О father be conscious. The entire universe comprising of moveable and immovable creatures is like the water bubble.

## \|\| 88.2-4 \|\|

*tyāja mohaṃ mahābhāga māyāṃ stauhi paratparāmā \|*  
*brahmasvarūpāṃ paramāṃ sarvamohanikṛntanīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

*muktipradāṃ mahābhāgāṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ sanātanīm \|*  
*tripurasya vadhe ghore mahāyuddhe bhayākule \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yena stotreṇa saṃbhuśca tayā daityaṃ jaghāna saḥ \|*  
*stotrarājaṃ pradāsyāmi sarvamohanikṛntanam \|*  
*sarvavāñchāpradaṃ nanda śrūyatāmatra saṃsadi \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. О virtuous one, discarding attraction you adore the eternal goddess Maya who is beyond everything, the fomt of Brahma, eternal, destroyer of all the attractions, bestowers of salvation, extremely virtuous and is the eternal illusion of Vishnu. In the terrific battle of Tripurasura, Shiva had recited this stotra in adoration to the goddess and killed the demon. О Nanda, shall bestow that stotra to you in the present assembly. The stotra destroys all the attractions and fulfills all the desires. You please listen to it.

## \|\| 88.5-7 \|\|

*nanda uvāca sarvavighnavināśāya duḥkhapraśamanāya ca \|*  
*vibhūtaye ca yaśase nṛṇāṃ vāñchitasiddhaye \|\| 5 \|\|*

*stotramekaṃ mahādevyā jaganmāturjagatprabho \|*  
*paraṃ durgatināśinyā gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dehi marhya vinītāya bhaktāya bhaktavatsala \|*  
*vedānāṃ janakastvaṃ ca nirguṇāśca parātparaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Nanda said – О lord you are graceful to the devotees, you kindly bestow the knowledge of the best of stotras of Durga which removes all the obstructions, removes the grief, bestows fortune, popularity and fulfils all the desires, destroying the evil times, which is quite secretive and the best of all the stotras. You are graceful to the devotees, creator of the Vedas, without qualities and beyond everything.

## \|\| 88.8-9 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca śruṇu vakṣyāmi daiśyendra stotraṃ yatparamādbhutam \|*  
*sarvavighnavināśārthaṃ mohapāśanikṛntanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*raṇatrastena vibhunā śaṃkareṇa purā kṛtam \|*  
*nārāyaṇopadeśena preritena ca brahmaṇā \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Shri Krishna said – О lord of the Vaisyas, In the earlier times, Shiva got terrified from the battle and at the advice of Narayana and the inspiration of Brahma he had recited the stotra. The same stotra removes all the obstructions and noose of attachment, is being narrated by me which you please listen.

## \|\| 88.10-11 \|\|

*śatrugrastaṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa brahmāṇamuvāca ha \|*  
*uvāca śaṃkaraṃ brahmā rathasthaṃ patitaṃ raṇe \|\| 10 \|\|*

*surasaṃkaṭaśāntyarthaṃ durgā durgatināśinīm \|*  
*mūlaprakṛtimādyāṃ tāṃ stau(stu) hi brahmasvarūpiṇīm \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Finding that Shiva was surrounded by the enemies, Narayana, spoke to Brahma. Then Brahma went to Shiva in the battle-field and spoke to him, "For the destruction of the danger on the gods you recite the stotra of Durga who removes the misfortune, is Mula-Prakriti, eternal prowess and is the form of Brahma.

## \|\| 88.12-14 \|\|

*hariṇā prerito'haṃ ca tvāṃ vadāmi sureśvara \|*  
*vinā śaktisahāyena ko vā kaṃ jetumīśvaraḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā durgāṃ sasmāra śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*puṭāñjaliparo bhūtvā bhaktinamratmakaṃdharaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*snātaḥpādau ca prakṣālya dhṛtvā dhaute vāsasī \|*

О father, in the meantime the Stavaraja also appeared in person who could remove the obstructions, the persons creating the obstructions, the killer of the enemies, was bestower of all riches, bestowed pleasure, quite auspicious, bestower of salvation and the devotion of lord Hari beside the dwelling in Goloka and the success. By reciting this Stotraraja, Parvati also gets pleased. This stotra relieves one of the greed, passion, anger, the cause of deeds beside bestowing the prowess, intelligence making one free from the cycle of birth and death. This stotra bestows the people with riches, sons, wife, land and all the riches, removing all his ailments and grief. All the success is achieves by him. By reciting this stotra even the immensely barren woman gets a child, a grief stricken person is freed from fetters.

О best of the Vaisyas, with the influence of this stotra, a person meets with welfare even when surrounded by the robbers, enemies and wild animals.

Similarly this stotra happens to be the best of all and no other stotra can equated with it.

## \|\| 88.65-68 \|\|

*yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ pāpine gopanaṃ kuru \|*

65-68. The knowledge of this stotra cannot be imparted to anyone else nor would it be proper to bestow its knowledge to a sinner; it. can be bestow to a devotee of Narayana, a peaceful intellectual and all knowing Brahmana. This stotra should never be given to the driver of the bulls, a Brahmana who happens to be the husband of a loose women, the Brahmana serving as a cook with the Shudras and the Brahmanas consuming the food with the Shudras at the time of sraddhas. It should also not be given to a Brahmana \\vho sells away his daughter. With the achieving of the success by this stotra, one gets all the siddhis and by reciting this stotra ten thousand times, one meets with success.

It is the best of the stotra and bestows the merit of performing and a thousand Asvamedha sacrifices, going round the earth and taking bath at all the holy places. О father, I have bestowed the knowledge of the stotra. to you since you happen to be dearer to me than my life. Now you adore goddess Parvati in my assembly. О best of the Brahmanas, on hearing the words of Shri Krishna, Nanda adored goddess Durga who bestows all the riches. Thereafter getting pleased the goddess bestowed him the boon of his stay in the Goloka.

## Chapter 89

## \|\| 89.1-2 \|\|

## \|\| 89.8-12 \|\|

*maṇimāṇikyamuktānāṃ mālājālavibhūṣitam \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukai ramyairācchannaṃ pītavarṇakaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pārṣadapravarai ramyairveṣṭitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*sadratnadarpaṇai ramyairgopikābhiśca gopakaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*veṣṭitaṃ ca tadāruhya kautukādyāsyasi dhruvam \|*  
*tyaktvā ca pārthivaṃ dehaṃ divyadehaṃ vidhāya ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

8-12. О father, after enjoying all the pleasures in this world, Yashoda, Rohini, the cowherdesses, the cowherds, Vrsabhanu, Kalavati, the mother of Radha and Radha also leaving the human body would go to the Goloka. О father, at that that point of time, a hundred lakhs of chariots would arrive in Gokula from Goloka which will be decorated with innumerable ornaments of gems, the garland of gems, the sapphire, rubies and jewel, garlands, flags of yellow fine garments with white fly-whisks held by the divine attendants. The chariot would also have the mirrors of gems and would have a number of cowherds and cowherdesses aboard the same, you would proceed to Goloka mounted on the chariot.

## \|\| 89.13-15 \|\|

*ayonisaṃbhavā rādhā rādhāmātā kalāvatī \|*  
*yāsyatyeva hi tenaiva nityadehena niścitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*pitṛṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā mānyā kalāvatī \|*  
*dhanyā ca sītāmātā ca durgāmātā ca menakā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ayonisaṃbhavā durgā tārā sītā ca sundarī \|*  
*ayonisaṃbhavāstāśca dhanyā menā kalāvatī \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. Since Radha and her mother Kalavati were not born of any human contact, they would go to the Goloka with their human bodies because Kalavati happens to be the mind born daughter of the manes. The mother of Sita, the mother of Parvati named Mena, Durga, Tara and beautiful Sita are all born without any human contact; all of them including Kalavati and Mena are quite graceful.

## \|\| 89.16-17 \|\|

*ityeva kathitaṃ tāta gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*varo'yaṃ tattastubhyaṃ ca mayā ca durgayā tathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca vrajeśvaraḥ \|*  
*punareva jagannāthaṃ ta dbhakto bhaktavātsalam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. О father, thus I have spoken to you the extremely secret story which is inaccessible to others. Both Durga and myself have bestowed our blessing to you". On hearing the words of Krishna, Nanda the lord of Vraja spoke to Krishna the lord of the universe and who is graceful to the devotees thus.

## \|\| 89.18 \|\|

*nanda uvāca yugānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca yaṃ yaṃ dharma sanātanam \|*  
*krameṇa kṛṣṇa vistīrṇaṃ kṛtvā māṃ kathaya prabho \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Nanda said – О lord Krishna what are the eternal dharma of the four yugas, you kindly tell me in detail.

## \|\| 89.19 \|\|

*kaliśeṣe bhavedyadyadguṇadoṣaṃ kalestathā \|*  
*kā gatirvā pṛthivyāśca dharmasya praṇināṃ tathā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. You kindly tell me the merits and demerits of Kali age, beside the position of dharma, artha and the people.

## \|\| 89.20 \|\|

*nandasya vacanaṃ śrutvā hṛṣṭaḥ kamalalocanaḥ \|*  
*kathāṃ kathitumārebhe vicitrāṃ madhurānvitām \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. On hearing the words of Nanda, lord Krishna delightfully spoke to him the sweet story.

## Chapter 90

## \|\| 90.1-2 \|\|

*atha navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu nanda pravakṣyami sānandaṃ mānasaṃ yathā \|*  
*kathāṃ ramyāṃ sumadhurāṃ purāṇeṣu pariṣkṛtām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*paripūrṇatamo dharmo dhārmikāśca kṛte yuge \|*  
*paripūrṇatamaṃ satyaṃ paripūrṇatamā dayā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Shri Krishna said – О Nanda, you listen to me delightfully. I am going to tell you an extremely charming story which has been described beautifully in the Puranas. In the Krtayuga, all the people are religious minded and the religion is fully established during that period. The people are truthful and are full of mercy and compassion.

## \|\| 90.3-4 \|\|

*atīva prajvaladrūpā vedāścatvāra eva ca \|*  
*vedāṅgāścāpi pipidhāsāścetihāsāca saṃhitāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*purāṇāni suramyāṇi pañcarātrāṇi pañca ca \|*  
*rucirāṇi subhadrāṇi dharmaśāstrāṇi yāni ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. All the four Vedas, the post-Vedic literature, various types of historical treatises and the Samhitas predominate the society. All the charming Puranas, the five Pancaratras and all the religious scriptures which bestow welfare, remain quite popular.

## \|\| 90.5 \|\|

*viprā vedavidaḥ sarve puṇyavantastapasvinaḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ te dhyāyanti tanmantraṃ ca japanti ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. All the Brahmanas are well-versed in the Vedas, quite meritorious and tapasvls. They always remain devoted to Narayana and recite his mantras.

## \|\| 90.6 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāḥkṣatriyā vaiśyāśyaturvarṇāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*śūdrā brāhmaṇabhṛtyāśca satyadharmaparāyaṇācha \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. All the four varnas including Brahmanas, Ks atriyas, Shudras Vaisyas perform their duty religiously. Out of them Shudras serve the Brahmanas and perform their dharma.

## \|\| 90.7 \|\|

*rājāno dhārmikāścaiva prajāpālanatatparāḥ \|*  
*gṛhṇāntyeva prajānāṃ ca ṣoḍaśāṃśakarāṣṛpāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The Kings have a religious bent of mind and maintain the people always and receive the taxes equivalent to the sixteen part of their earnings.

## \|\| 90.8 \|\|

*karaśūnyāśca viprāśca pūjyāḥ svacchandagāminaḥ \|*  
*tataṃ sarvasasyāḍhyā ratnādhārā vasuṃdharā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The Brahmanas remain free from taxes and they roam about it will, the earth always produces various types of cereals and crops remaining filled with gems.

## \|\| 90.9-10 \|\|

*gurubhaktāśca śiṣyāśca pitṛbhaktāḥ sutāstathā \|*  
*yoṣitaḥ patibhaktāśca pativrataparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ṛtau saṃbhoginaḥ sarve na strīlubdhā na lammapaṭāḥ \|*  
*na bhayaṃ dasyucauryāṇāṃ na tatra pāradārikāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The pupil are devoted to the teacher, the son remain devoted to the father and the wives remain to their husbands maintaining to their chastity. All the people enjoy the conjugal pleasure of their wives at the appropriate time; no one is greedy of the women and or is wicked. During this yuga there are no thieves or robbers and no one owns the wives of others.

## \|\| 90.11-12 \|\|

*taravaḥ pūrṇaphalinaḥ pūrṇakṣīrāśca dhenavaḥ \|*  
*balavanto janāḥ sarve dīrghāḥ saundaryasaṃyutāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*lakṣavarṣāyuṣaḥ kecitpuṇyavanto kṣyarogiṇaḥ \|*  
*yathā viprā viṣṇubhaktā strivarṇāṃ viṣṇusevinaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The trees remain laiden with fruit and the cows yield the maximum of milk. All the people are healthy, with long and well-built body besides being beautiful; some of the auspicious people remain alive up to a lakh of years and are never attracted by ailments. As the Brahmana are devoted to Vishnu similarly, the remaining three varnas of the people are also devoted to Vishnu.

## \|\| 90.13-14 \|\|

*jalapūrṇā nadā nadyaḥ saṃtataṃ kaṃdarāstathā \|*  
*tīrthapūtāścaturvarṇāstapaḥ pūtā dvijātayaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*manaḥpūtāśca nikhilāḥ khalahīnaṃ jagattrayam \|*  
*satkīrtiparibūrṇaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ maṅgalānvitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. All the rivers and rivulets are filled with water and the mountain caves look quite charming. The people of all the four varnas purify themselves by taking bath in the holy places. The Brahmanas purify themselves by performing tapas. Thus all the people of the earth have noble souls. One cannot hear the name of a wicked person in the three worlds during Satyayuga. All the varnas are filled with welfare.

## \|\| 90.15-16 \|\|

*pitaraḥ sarvakāleṣu tithikāleṣu devatāḥ \|*  
*sarvakāleṣvatithayaḥ pūjitāśca gṛhe gṛhe \|\| 15 \|\|*

*trivarṇā viprabhaktāśca viprabhojatatparāḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇasya mukhaṃ kṣetramanūṣaramakaṇṭakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. The ancestors arrive at the appropriate time, the gods also arrive at the appropriate time. The guests are adored in all the household; the people of all the three varnas respect the Brahmana and provide them with food regularly because the mouth of a Brahmana, as never barren and is free from the thorns.

## \|\| 90.17-20 \|\|

*nārāyaṇotkīrtanena harṣayuktāstadutsave \|*  
*na śatravo janānāṃ ca sarve sarvaṃhitaiṣiṇaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*nā''tmapraśaṃsakāḥ kecitsarve paraguṇotsukāḥ \|*  
*na devānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca viduṣāṃ tatra nindakāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*puruṣā yoṣitaścāpi na hi sūrkhāśca paṇḍitāḥ \|*  
*na duḥkhino janāḥsatye sarveṣāṃ ratnamandiram \|\| 19 \|\|*

*maṇimāṇikyaratnaugharatnasvarṇasamanvitam \|*  
*na bhikṣukā na rogārtāḥ śokahīnāścaharṣitāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

17-20. The people remain extremely happy by reciting the name of Narayana in the festivities. During this yuga no one denounces the gods, the Brahmanas and the intellectuals. No one praises himself. All the people remain engaged in praising others. No Person remains inimical to others. All the people think of the welfare of others; all the men and women are quite well-read and there is no one devoid of wisdom. There is no one filled with greed and all the people reside in the palaces of gems which are studded with to sapphire and rubies beside the gold. At that point of time there are no beggars; no one suffers from ailment and all the people are free from grief and other ailments. They remain delightful all the times.

## \|\| 90.21-22 \|\|

*na hi bhūṣaṇahīrāśca narā nāryaśca kecana \|*  
*na pāpino na dhūrtāśca na kṣudhārtā na kutsitāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*jarāhīnāḥ prāṇinaśca śaśvadyauvanasaṃsthitāḥ \|*  
*ādhivyādhivihīnāśca nirvikārāśca dehinaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. No man or woman is seen without ornaments. There are no sinners, nor wicked. No one remains hungry or denounces. All the people are free from old age and remain always young; they are free from the ailment and other deformities,

## \|\| 90.23 \|\|

*yadukto vai satyayuge dharmaḥ satyaṃ dayādikam \|*  
*pādahīnaśca tretāyāṃ satyārdha dvāpare'pi ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thus in the Satyayuga the people are truthful, compassionate and extremely religious. Dharma in Tretdyuga remains present with three feet only and in Dvapara, it has only two.

## \|\| 90.24 \|\|

*dharmai kapācca prathame kaleścātikṛśo'balaḥ \|*  
*duṣṭānāṃ dasyucauryāṇāmaṅkuraḥ prabhavedvraja \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. At the beginning of the age of Kali, the same. Dharma becomes quite lean and thin and stands on earth on one leg. О lord of Vraja, at that point of time, the sprouting of the wicked people, the robbers and the thieves starts.

## \|\| 90.25-26 \|\|

*adharmaniratāḥ kecidbhītāḥ saṃgopinastathā \|*  
*bhītā guptāśca puṃścalyau bhītāśca pāradārikāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dharmiṣṭhānāṃ bhayaṃ śaśvadadharmiṣṭhāśca kampitāḥ \|*  
*svalpadharmaratā bhūpāḥ svalpavedaratā dvijāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Some people engage themselves in performing evil deeds throughout the day and night but some of the people feel afraid of doing anything evil. Therefore they start concealing their evil deeds. The loose women feel panicky and indulge into sinful ways secretly. The men also become panicky and they enjoy secretly the company of other women. Similarly the religious minded people are also shaken, the kings would perform only pretty religious deeds and the Brahmanas would devote themselves to the study of Vedas only nominally.

## \|\| 90.27-28 \|\|

*vratadharmaratāḥ kecitsarve svacchandagāminaḥ \|*  
*yāvattiṣṭhanti tīrthāni yāvattiṣṭhanti sādhavaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yāvattiṣṭhanti grāmāṇāṃ devāḥ śāstrāṇi pūjanam \|*  
*tāvatkiṃcittapaḥ satyaṃ svargadharmāśa eva ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Only a few people would get themselves devoted to their dharma and all the people would bp free to move anywhere alike. Till such time the holy places, the ascetics, noble people, the village deities and the scriptures besides the method of adoration would remain on earth, the truthfulness, the athsha of dharma and the tapas would remain on earth.

## \|\| 90.29-30 \|\|

*kalerdoṣanidhestāta guṇa eko mahānapi \|*  
*mānasaṃ saṃbhavetpuṇyaṃ sukṛtaṃ na hi dṛṣkṛtam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tīrthādike gate tāta naṣṭo dharmāśa eva ca \|*  
*kalārūpaśca dharmaśca yathā kuhvāṃ niśākaraḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. О father, though the Kaliyuga is filled with all the evils but still there are great virtues in the same. There will be a performing of mental merit but not the sin. О father, after the sanctity of thS holy places is lost, the dharma, also looses itf importance. The dharma would becomes'black form like the moonless night.

## \|\| 90.31 \|\|

*nanda uvāca tīrthānyetāni sarvāṇi tiṣṭhantyeva kiyaddinam \|*  
*sādhavo grāmyadevāśca śāstrāṇyetāni vatsaka \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Nanda said – О son for how long the holy places, the ascetic, the village deities and the scriptures would remain on earth during Kaliyuga.

## \|\| 90.32 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca kalau daśasahasrāṇi haristiṣṭhati medinīm \|*  
*devānāṃ pratimā būjyā śāstrāṇi ca purāṇakam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Shri Krishna said – During Kaliyuga the lord remains on earth for ten thousand years. Till that time the images of the gods and the scriptures beside the Puranas are also adored.

## \|\| 90.33 \|\|

*tadardhamapi tīrthāni gaṅgādīni suniścitam \|*  
*tadardha grāmadevāśca vedāśca viduṣāmapi \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. For half that period (five thousand years), tile Ganga and all other holy places would enjoy their sanctity and for half of that period, the village deities would be adored besides the intellectual and the Vedas.

## \|\| 90.34-36 \|\|

*adharmaḥ paribūrṇaśca tadante ca kalau pitaḥ \|*  
*ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti varṇāścatvāra eva ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

*na mantrapūtodvāhaśca na hi satyaṃ na ya kṣamā \|*  
*strīsvīkārarato nityaṃ grāmyadharmapradhānataḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*na yajñasūtraṃ tilakaṃ brāhmaṇanāṃ ca nityaśaḥ \|*  
*saṃdhyāśāstravihīnāśca vipravaṃśāḥśrutā api \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. О father at the end of Kaliyuga, wickedness would establish itself completely. At that point of time, the people of all the four varnas would become like Shudras. At that point of time no marriage would be performed with the reciting of the mantras. The people will be deprived of truthfulness and forgiveness. Because of the importance of the conjugal pleasures, the marriage would be performed only with the consent of the women. The Brahmanas would not wear the yajnopavltas would not apply tilakam on the forehead nor would the Brahmanas perform the sandhyas thrice a day.

## \|\| 90.37-38 \|\|

*sarvaiḥ sārdha ca sarveṣāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ niyamacyutam \|*  
*abhakṣyabhakṣā lokāśca caturvarṇāśca lampaṭāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*nārīṣu na satī kācitpuṃścalī ca gṛhe gṛhe \|*  
*karoti tarjanaṃ kāntaṃ bhṛtyatulyaṃ ca kampitam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. All the people discarding all the vows would eat whatever they liked. Thus all the people of the four varnas would consume things irrespective of those which have been prescribed as eatables and non-eatables. All would be wicked. There will be dearth of chaste women on earth and in every house-hold, the loose women would be available, who would always denounced their husbands, such a person would always feel panicky and shaky like a servant.

## \|\| 90.39-40 \|\|

*jārāya dattvā miṣṭānnaṃ tāmbūlaṃ vastracandanam \|*  
*na dadātyeva cā''hāraṃ svāmine duḥkhine pitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*putreṇa bhartsitastātaḥ śiṣyeṇa bhartsito guruḥ \|*  
*prajābhistāḍito bhūpo bhūpena pīḍitāḥ prajāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. О father, the loose woman would serve the best of the sweets to her lower beside the food, betel, the fragrance, sandal-paste and the costumes, but would never care for the food of her husband. The son would always denounce the father and the pupil their teacher. The king would always be terrified by the public while the king would torture by the people.

## \|\| 90.41-42 \|\|

*dasyucoreśca duṣṭaiśca śiṣṭāśca paripīḍitāḥ \|*  
*sasyahīnā ca vasudhā kṣīrahīnāśca dhanevaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*svalpakṣīre ghṛtaṃ nāsti navanītaṃ ca nityaśaḥ \|*  
*satyahīnā janāḥ sarve nityaṃ mithyā vadanti ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. The noble people would suffer at the hands of the robbers, the thieves and the wicked people. The yielding of crop would be destroyed on earth and the cows would stop yielding enough of milk. The milk, butter and ghee would be in short supply. All the people would be devoid of truthfulness and always speak falsehood.

## \|\| 90.43-46 \|\|

*śaucasaṃdhyāśāstrahīnā brāhmaṇā vṛṣavāhakāḥ \|*  
*sūpakārāśca śūdrāṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*śūdrastrīniratāḥ śaśvacchūdrā vipravadhūratāḥ \|*  
*khādanti yasya viprasya bhakṣyaṃ ca paripācakāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*mātuḥ parāṃ tasya patnīṃ śūdrā gṛhṇanti lampaṭāḥ \|*  
*bhṛtyaśca hatvā rājānaṃ svayaṃ rājā bhaviṣyati \|\| 45 \|\|*

*nārī hatvā patiṃ kāmādbhajejjāraṃ ca kautukāt \|*  
*putraśca pitaraṃ hatvā svayaṃ bhūpo bhaviṣyati \|\| 46 \|\|*

43-46. The Brahmana would be deprived of purity, performing of sandhya, study of scriptures and become the drivers of bulls, cooks in the kitchen of Shudras, resorting to the burning of the dead bodies of the Shudras, getting entangled with Stidra women. The Shudras on the other hand would be attracted towards the Brahmana ladies, consuming the food of a Brahmana the wicked Shudra would abducts the wife of the Brahmana who could be equated with his own mother and quite adorable. The servants would conspire to kill the king and occupy the throne. The women would kill the husband and would enjoy the company of the lover. The son would kill the father and himself become the king.

## \|\| 90.47-48 \|\|

*sarve svacchandaniratāḥ śiśnodaraparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*vaṅkharā vyādhiyuktāśca kutsitāśca kucailakāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*vikṣuṇṇamantraliptāśca mithyāmantrapracārakāḥ \|*  
*jātihīnāśca guravo vayohīnāśca nindakāḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Thus all the people would become independent, moving at will, lustful, gluttons, suffering from ailment, dirty, the reciter of broken mantras and would propagate false mantras. The teachers would be casteless, devoid of age would be and denounced.

## \|\| 90.49 \|\|

*rājānaścāpi malecchāśca yavanā dharmanindakāḥ \|*  
*satkīrtimapi sādhūnāṃ kurvantyunmūlanaṃ mudā \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The mlecchas would become the king and the Yavana would denounce the dharma destroying the spotless glory of the ascetics.

## \|\| 90.50-52 \|\|

*pitṛdevadvijātīnāmatithīnāṃ ca nityaśaḥ \|*  
*pūjā nāsti gurūṇāṃ ca pitrośca pūjanaṃ striyāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*strībandhūnāṃ gauravaṃ ca strīṇāṃ ca satataṃ pitaḥ \|*  
*coraḥ satkulajātiśca brahmadevasvahārakaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*mānaṃ vahanti lobhena yugadharmeṇa kautukāt \|*  
*devāyatanahīnaṃ ca jagatsarva bhayākulam \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. The adoration of ancestors gods and Brahmanas, the guests, the teachers and the parents would not be respected; they would remain welcoming their own wives. О father the relatives of the wife would be preferred and the influence of the ladies would go on increasing, the people of high castes would become their and would steal the riches of the gods and the Brahmanas. in Kaliyuga the people would respect the religion only playfully or with the intention of causing grief;; the entire universe would be deprived of the abodes of gods and would become terrific.

## \|\| 90.53-54 \|\|

*arājakaṃ ca durnītaṃ saṃtataṃ kalidoṣataḥ \|*  
*bubhṛkṣitāḥ kucailāśca daridrā vyādhino narāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*kapardakaghaṭādhyakṣo rājendro hi ghaṭeśvaraḥ \|*  
*vṛddhāṅguṣṭasamā lokā vṛkṣāḥśākasamāstathā \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. Because of the evils of the age of Kali, there would be indiscipline everywhere and disturbance would increase. All the people would face hunger, wear dirty clothes and would become pauper. The one whose house is filled with pitchers of small shells would be treated as the king and the one having innumerable pitchers like the same would be known as the great king. The people would be of the size of the thumb and the trees would be of the size of vegetables.

## \|\| 90.55-56 \|\|

*tālānāṃ nārikelāṇāṃ panasānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*phalāni sarṣapāṇyeva tatkṣudraṃ ca tataḥ param \|\| 55 \|\|*

*jalabhājanapātreṇa sasyena vāsasā tathā \|*  
*vihīnaṃ mandiraṃ sarvaṃ gṛhāṇāmapariṣkṛtam \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. The fruits of tala, coconut, jack fruit would be of the size of sheshamum seeds and other fruits would be of still smaller in size, there will be general shortage of the vases for waters cereals and cloth in the households the houses would be quite broken and deserted.

## \|\| 90.57-58 \|\|

*gandhakena parivṛtaṃ dīpahīnaṃ tameyutam \|*  
*hiṃsrajantubhayādbhītā janāḥ sarve ca pāpinaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sarve ca kalahāviṣṭā puṃścalyaḥ kalahapriyāḥ \|*  
*rūpavatyo na kāminyo narāścāpi na rūpiṇaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. They would be filled with bad smells; having no lamps and filled with bad smells, having no lamps and filled with darkness; all the humans would be sinful and would feel panicky of the wild animal. At that point of time the people would be greedy for fruits and the women would be quarrel some. The women would be deprived of deities beside the men.

## \|\| 90.59-63 \|\|

*nadyo nadāḥ kaṃdarāśca taḍāgāśca sarovarāḥ \|*  
*jalapadmavihīnāśca jalahīnā dhanāstathā \|\| 59 \|\|*

*apatyahīnā nāryaśca kāmukyo jārasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*aśvatthacchedinaḥ sarve vṛkṣahīnā vasuṃdharā \|\| 60 \|\|*

*phalahīnāśca taravaḥ śākhāḥ skandhavihīnakāḥ \|*  
*phalāni svāduhīnāni cānnāni ca jalāni ca \|\| 61 \|\|*

*mānavāḥ kaṭuvaktāro nirdayā dharmavarjitāḥ \|*  
*tadante dvādāśādityāḥ saṃhariṣyanti mānavān \|\| 62 \|\|*

*sarvāñjantuṃśca tāpena bahuvṛṣṭyā vrajeśvara \|*  
*avaśiṣṭā ca pṛthivī kathāmātrāvaśeṣitā \|\| 63 \|\|*

59-63. All the rivers, rivulets, the caves, the lakes and pools beside the tanks would be deprived of the water. The women would be barren, passionate and would always like the company of lovers; all the people would cut the plpala tree and the land would be deprived of the trees. The trees would be without the branches fruit and trunks; the fruit would not be delicious. The water and the food would have no taste. The human beings would speak untruth, would be heartless and devoid of dharma. Thereafter the twelve Adityas would bum all the creatures of the universe with their heat. О lord of Vraja, at that point of time only the story of the earth would remain.

## \|\| 90.64 \|\|

*kalau gate ca pṛthivī kṣetraṃ varṣāgate tathā \|*  
*punaḥ satyapravṛttiśca bhaviṣyati krameṇa vai \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. As the land dries up at the end of the rainy season, similarly after the expiry of Kaliyuga, the land would be free from all the creatures. Thereafter again the Satyayuga would start.

## \|\| 90.65-68 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaccha tāta vrajaṃ sukham \|*  
*ahaṃ dugdhamukho bālaḥputraste kathayāmi kim \|\| 65 \|\|*

*navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi takraṃ pariṣkṛtam \|*  
*svastikaṃ śubhakarmārhaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*miṣṭadravyaṃ ca yatkiṃcitpitṛdevanimittakam \|*  
*bhuktaṃ balācca tatsarva bālānāṃ rodanaṃ balam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*tatkṣamasvāparādhaṃ me bāladoṣaḥ pade pade \|*  
*tvaṃ pitā tava putro'haṃ yaśodā jananī mama \|\| 68 \|\|*

65-68. О father, I have thus narrated to you everything; now you comfortably go back to Vraja; I am indeed like an infant before you and what could I speak about dharma before you. Remaining in Vraja, I consumed butter, ghee, milk, curd, butter-milk, svastika and the sweet dishes and several other sweet dishes which were prepared for the gods and the ancestors; I consumed them forcibly because he crying of a child has his own strength. Therefore all the short-comings committed by me at every step should be forgiven by you since you are my father and I am your son beside Yashoda is my mother.

## \|\| 90.69-70 \|\|

*madīyaṃ parihāsaṃ ca yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ vada \|*  
*kumārāsyācchrutaṃ sarva so'hamityevamīpsitam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*kīrtayiṣyasi tatsarva sarva gokulavāsinam \|*  
*kālaḥ karoti sasairga bandhūnāṃ bandhubhiḥ saha \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. You narrate this joke of mine to Yashoda and Rohini and tell them that you had heard all this from an infant like me. Thereafter you can narrate the same to all the dwellers of Gokula because the meeting between the relatives is arranged by destiny.

## \|\| 90.71-76 \|\|

*kālaḥ karoti vicchedaṃ virodhaṃ prītimeva ca \|*  
*kālaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ ca kurute kālaśca paripālanam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*kālaḥ karoti sānandaṃ kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ \|*  
*sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ ca janma ca \|\| 72 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ karmānurodhena kāla eva karoti ca \|*  
*sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ tāta vismayaṃ na vrajaṃ vraja \|\| 73 \|\|*

*kutastvaṃ gokule vaiśyo nando vaiśyādhipo nṛpaḥ \|*  
*vasudevasuto'cahaṃ ca mathurāyāmaho kutaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*pitā me kaṃsabhītena tvadgṛhe ca samapritaḥ \|*  
*pitu paraḥ pitā tvaṃ ca mātā mātuḥ parā'pivā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*mayā dattena jñānena pārvatyā ca vrajeśvara \|*  
*tyaja mohaṃ mahābhāga gaccha tāta sukhaṃ gṛham \|\| 76 \|\|*

71-76. It is the destiny which is responsible for the separation from them, their opposition and the period of love. The destiny creates the universe and the destiny preserves the same. The destiny, provides bliss and the destiny gets responsible of the destruction of the universe. Thus the destiny arranges for the pleasure, the pain, fear, the grief, old age, death, birth and all other things according to the deeds of a person. О father, therefore everything should be considered as having been arranged by destiny. There is no doubt about it. You are indeed the Vaisya of-Gokula, known as the king Nanda and I am the son of Vasudeva from Mathura; my father getting terrified from Kariisa, left me in your house, therefore, you enjoy the greater respect from me than my own father and Yashoda enjoys greater respect for me than my mother. Therefore О lord of Vraja, you relieve yourself from the illusion and attachment because of my discourse and that of Parvati you go back to your abode delightfully.

## \|\| 90.77-81 \|\|

*nanda uvāca smara vṛndāvanaṃ tāta ramyaṃ puṇyaṃ mahotsavam \|*  
*gokulaṃ gokulaṃ ramyaṃ sundaraṃ yamunātaṭam \|\| 77 \|\|*

*ramaṇīnāṃ suramyaṃ ca tvatpriyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*gopālikā gopabālānyaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ priyām \|\| 78 \|\|*

*prāṇādhikāṃ rādhikāṃ na kathaṃ smarasi putraka \|*  
*vāramekaṃ svalpadinaṃ gokulaṃ gaccha vatsaka \|\| 79 \|\|*

*ityevamuktavā nandaśca kroḍe kṛṣṇaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*netrāśruṇā ca pūrṇena taṃ siṣeca śucā'nvitaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*cucumba tadgaṇḍayugaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi mohataḥ \|*  
*sānandaḥ paramānado bhagavāṃstamuvāca saḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

77-81. Nanda said – О son, you remember the charming and auspicious place of Vrindavana. Why are you not reminded of the festivities of Gokula, the cows, the beautifiil bank of Yamuna river, the Rasamandala, your divine dance with cowherdesses in Rasamandala, the cowherdesses, the cowherds, Yashoda, Rohini and Radhika who is dearer to you than your live? О son for the sake of these people you must go to Gokula for sometime. Thus speaking, Nanda took Krishna in his lap and started dropping tears over him. He embraced him and kissed his temples. Thereafter the blissful Krishna spoke to him.

## Chapter 91

## \|\| 91.1-4 \|\|

*athaikanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrībhagavānuvāca niṣekena pariṣvaṅgo vibhedastena vā bhavet \|*  
*kṣaṇena darśanaṃ tena niṣekaḥ kena vāryate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gamanāgamanārtha cāpyuddhavaḥ kathayiṣyati \|*  
*prasthāpayāmi taṃ śīghraṃ vijñāsyasi tataḥ pitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ caiva gopikāṃ gopabālakān \|*  
*prāṇādhikāṃ rādhikāṃ tāṃ gatvā saṃbodhayiṣyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tatra vasudevaśca devakī \|*  
*baladevaścoddhavaśca tathā'krūraśca satvaram \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Shri Krishna said – One meets with someone and faces separation from him and because of the deeds he meets with him again. Therefore, who can oppose it, О father, I am shortly sending Uddhava to Mathura and you would come to know about everything. He would speak there about my arrival of otherwise. He, after arriving there would meet Yashoda, Rohini, cowherdesses, the cow and Radha who is dearer to me than my life. In the meantime Vasudeva, Devaki, Baladeva, Akrura and Uddhava arrived there.

## \|\| 91.5-6 \|\|

*vasudeva uvāca nanda tvaṃ balavāñjñānī sadbandhuśca sakhā mama \|*  
*tyaja mohaṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha vatsaste'yaṃ yathā mama \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dūrībhūtā gokulācca mathurā nāsti bāndhava \|*  
*mahotsave sadānande nanda drakṣyasi putrakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Vasudeva said – О Nanda, you are great intellectual, you are my intimate friend and brother. Shedding away the attachment, you go back to your house, this boy belongs to you as much as he belong to us. О brother, this city of Mathura is the gate of Gokula, whenever there are any festivities you would surely arrive and meet your sons.

## \|\| 91.7-8 \|\|

*devakyuvāca yathā'yamāvayoḥ putrastathaiva bhavato dhruvam \|*  
*sālasaḥ kena he nanda śucā deho hi lakṣyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ekādaśābdaṃ sabalaḥ sthitvā te mandire sukham \|*  
*kathaṃ svalpadinenaiva śokagrasto bhaviṣyasi \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Devaki said – О Nanda, this Krishna is as much your son as he is of both of us; then why your face is getting faded? He remained in your house for eleven years and was brought up here. If he is here for sometimes then why do you get worried.

## \|\| 91.9 \|\|

*tiṣṭha putreṇa sārdhaṃ ca mathurāyāṃ kiyaddinam \|*  
*pūrṇacandrānanaṃ paśya janma tvaṃ saphalaṃ kuru \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. It would be better if you stay here with the boy for sometime in Mathura and looking at his moon like face, make your birth quite graceful and successful.

## \|\| 91.10-11 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca ghacchoddhava sukhaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati tava priyam \|*  
*praharṣa gokulaṃ gatvā yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ prasūm \|\| 10 \|\|*

*gopavālasamūhaṃ ca rādhikāṃ gopikāgaṇam \|*  
*prabodhayā''dhyātmikena maddattena śucaśchidā \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Shri Krishna said – О Uddhava, you go to Gokula with pleasure and your desire would be fulfilled there. Reaching there, you meet mother Yashoda, Rohini, the cowherds, Radhika, cowherdesses and enlighten them with the divine knowledge I have imparted here.

## \|\| 91.12 \|\|

*nandastiṣṭhatu sānandaṃ manmāturājñayā śucā \|*  
*nandasthitiṃ sadvinayaṃ yaśodāṃ kathayiṣyasi \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Since my mother has ordained Nanda would stay here with pleasure for sometimes. You inform mother Yashoda about my stay here.

## \|\| 91.13 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pitrā mātrā balena ca \|*  
*akrūreṇa samaṃ tūrṇa yayāvabhyantaraṃ gṛham \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus speaking lord Krishna accompanied by his parents, Balabhadra and Akrura entered into the palace.

## \|\| 91.14 \|\|

*uddhavo rajanīṃ sthitvā mathurāyāṃ ca nārada \|*  
*prabhāte prayayau śīghraṃ ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О Nanda, thereafter Uddhava spending the night in Mathura, departed in the early morning for the charming Yrndavana.

## Chapter 92

## \|\| 92.1-2 \|\|

*atha dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇaprerito hṛṣṭaḥ praṇamya ca gaṇeśvaram \|*  
*smarannārāyaṇaṃ śaṃbhuṃ durgā lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gaṅgāṃ ca manasi dhyātvā dimīśaṃ taṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*prajagāmoddhavaścaiva dṛṣṭvā maṅgalamūcakam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Uddhava who was inspired by Shri Krishna, delightfully bowed in reverence to Ganesha, Narayana, Shiva, Durga, Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Ganga and Dikpalas and witnessing the auspicious symbols proceeded towards Gokula.

## \|\| 92.3-9 \|\|

*śuśrāva duṃdubhiṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ śaṅkhadhvaniṃ tathā \|*  
*hariśabdaṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śuśrāva maṅgaladhvanim \|\| 3 \|\|*

*patiputravatīṃ sādhvīṃ pradīpaṃ mālyadarpaṇam \|*  
*paribūrṇatamaṃ kumbhaṃ dadhilājaphalāni ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dūrvāṅkuraṃ śukladhānyaṃ rajataṃ kāñcanaṃ madhu \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ samūhaṃ ca kṛṣṇasāraṃ vṛṣaṃ ghṛtam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sadyomāṃsaṃ gajendraṃ ca nṛpendraṃ śvetaghoṭakam \|*  
*patākāṃ nakulaṃ cāṣaṃ śuklaṃ puṣpaṃ ca candanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvaivaṃ pathi kalyāṇaṃ prāpa vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|*  
*dadarśa purato vṛkṣaṃ bhāṇḍīre vaṭamakṣayam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*snigdhaparṇa raktavarṇa puṇyadaṃ tīrthamīpsitam \|*  
*suveṣānbālakāṃścaiva ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitān \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vadato balakṛṣṇeti rudataśca śucā'nvitān \|*  
*tānāśvāsya yayau dūraṃ praviśya nagaraṃ mudā \|\| 9 \|\|*

3-9. He heard on the way beating the of big drums, the bells, the blowing of conches, reciting of the name of the lord, accompanied with music and the sound of welfare. He also came across on the way, chaste women whose husband and son was alike, the burning lamp, the garland, mirror, the pitcher filled with water, the curd, fried paddy, the fruit, tender durva grass, white paddy, silver, gold, honey, group of Brahmanas, the buck, the bull, ghee, fresh meat, the elephant, the king, white horse, banners, mangoose, Nllakantha, white flowers and sandal-paste. He than reached Vrindavana first of all he came across the Aks ayavata tree in the Bhandlra forest, it was in red colour, with glassy leaves; it was quite meritorious and auspicious. Thereafter he met with the boys clad in beautiful garments, who were adorned with gem-studded ornaments and were crying reciting the name of Krishna as a boy. Assuring them variously, Uddhava entered the city delightfully and walked up to a long distance.

## \|\| 92.10-12 \|\|

*dadarśa nandaśibiraṃ racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*maṇiratnavinirmāṇaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*paricchannaṃ manoramyaṃ sadratnakalaśānvitam \|*  
*dvāraṃ citraṃ vicitrāḍhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca praviveśa saḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*avaruhya rathāttūrṇa tasthau tatprāṅgaṇe mudā \|*  
*yaśodā rohiṇī śīghraṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ param \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. He spotted the palace of Nanda which was built by Vishvakarma inlaid with several gems and diamonds besides pearls and other precious gems on all the sides; it had the pitchers of gems decorating the same. It had astonishing type of gates and Uddhava entered the same, reaching before the court-yard he descended from the chariot and stood over the ground. Finding him there, Yashoda and Rohini at once came out and enquired about his welfare.

## \|\| 92.13-18 \|\|

*āsanaṃ ca jalaṃ gāṃ ca madhuparkaṃ dadau mudā \|*  
*kva nandaḥ kva balaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ satyaṃ tatkathayoddhava \|\| 13 \|\|*

*uddhavaḥ kathayāmāsa sarva bhadraṃ krameṇa ca \|*  
*sārdhaṃ ca balakṛṣṇābhyāṃ nandaḥ sānandapūrvakam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*āyāsyati vilambena kṛṣṇopanayanāvadhi \|*  
*yuṣmākaṃ kuśalaṃ tatvaṃ vijñāya vidhipūrvakam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*ahaṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ yaśode śṛṇu sāṃpratam \|*  
*śrṛtvā maṅgalavārtā ca yaśodā rohiṇī mudā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇāya dadau ratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vastramīpsitam \|*  
*uddhavaṃ bhojayāmāsa miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ ca ratnaṃ ca dadau tasmai ca hīrakam \|*  
*vādyaṃ ca vādayāmāsa bhadraṃ nānāvidhaṃ tathā \|\| 18 \|\|*

13-18. He was seated delightfully over a seat and offered water, arghya and madhuparka; then they asked him, "O Uddhava, where are Nanda, Balarama and Krishna. You tell us truthfully." Thereafter Uddhava spoke to them all, the words of welfare and said, "O Yashoda, Balarama, Krishna and Nanda are quite comfortable; Krishna would return to Gokula only after performing of the thread ceremony; therefore his arrival here would be delayed. I have arrived here only to convey the news to you. After informing you suitably I shall go back to Mathura; on coming to know about the welfare of all of them, Yashoda and Rohini were filled with delight and they distributed gems, gold and beautiful costumes to the Brahmanas; thereafter they served Uddhava the sweet dishes which were as tasty as the neater; he was presented with the best of gems, diamonds and other precious stones. The musical instrument were played upon in welfare tunes.

## \|\| 92.19-24 \|\|

*brahmaṇānbhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam \|*  
*vedāśca pāṭhayāmāsa paramānandapūrvakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śaṃkaraṃ pūjayāmāsa vipradvārā paraṃ vibhūm \|*  
*nānopahārairnaivedyaiḥ puṣpadhūpapradīpakaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*candanairvastratāmbūlairmadhugavyaghṛtādibhiḥ \|*  
*bhavānīṃ pūjayāmāsa śrīvṛndāraṇyadevatām \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ṣoḍaśopacārairdravyairbalibhirvividhairmune \|*  
*mahiṣāṇāṃ śate śuddhaṃ chāgālānāṃ sahasrakam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*meṣāṇāmayutaṃ śuddhaṃ yuktamādāya pañcakam \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyaḥ svarṇaśataṃ dhenunāṃ ca śataṃ tathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*pradadau dakṣiṇāṃ tūrṇa kṛṣṇakalyāṇahetave \|*  
*uddhavaṃ pūjayāmāsa sādaraṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

19-24. The Brahmanas were served with food the festivities of the welfare were arranged and the recitation of the Vedas was made delightfully presenting various types of gifts to the Brahmanas. The naivedya, flowers, incense, the lamp, were offered to lord Shiva. The goddess Bhavan! of VmdUvana was adored with sandal-paste, costumes, betel, honey, milk, preparations, offering sixteen types of adoration's to her. Several types of sacrifices were also made which included a hundred he-buffaloes, a hundred he-goats and ten thousand sheep, for the welfare of lord Krishna, the Brahmanas were given in charity, a hundred cows together with a hundred gold coins. They were adored with great devotion.

## \|\| 92.25-30 \|\|

*samāśvāsya yaśodāṃ ca rohiṇīṃ gopabālakān \|*  
*vṛddhāngopālikāḥ sarvāḥ prayayū rāsamaṇḍalam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dadarśa rāsaṃ ruciraṃ candramaṇḍalavartulam \|*  
*śrīrāmakadalīstambhaśatakairupaśobhitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yuktaiśca snigdhavasanaiścandanānāṃ ca pallavaiḥ \|*  
*paṭṭasūtranibaddhaiśca śrīyuktamālyajālakaiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dadhilājaphalaiḥ paṭṭaiḥ puṣpairdūrvāṅkurairapi \|*  
*candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiḥ parisaṃskṛtam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*veṣṭitaṃ sakṣitaṃ yatnādgopikānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*trilakṣaiḥ sundarai ramyaiḥ saṃsaktaṃ ratimandiraiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*lakṣagopaiḥ parivṛtaṃ kṛṣṇāgamanaśaṅkitaiḥ \|*  
*yamunāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā prayayau mālatīvanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

25-30. Then Uddhava assured Yashoda, Rohinl, cowherds, old people and cowherdesses variously and moved towards Rdsamandala. Reaching there he found a circular building like the globe. Which was known as Rasamandala', it had hundreds of the pillars of the banana trunks; it was decorated with the best of costumes and the tree leaves bound in the cord of silk. It had a number of beautiful garland with a huge stock of curd, paddy, fruit, silken cloth, flowers, tender Durva-grass, sandal-paste, aguru, kasturl and saffron. It was protected by three crores of cowherdesses, it bad three lakhs of pleasure houses which were quite charming and beautiful. Waiting for the arrival of Krishna, a lakh of cowherds always remained there, looking at the Rasamandala and living Yamuna to the right, Uddhava moved on to the forest of jasmine flowers.

## \|\| 92.31-36 \|\|

*candanānāṃ campakānāṃ yūthikānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*ketakīmādhavīnāṃ ca vanaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*bakulānāṃ vañjulānāmaśokānāṃ ca kānanam \|*  
*mallikānāṃ palāśānāṃ śirīṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dhātrīṇāṃ kāñcanānāṃ ca karṇikānāṃ vanaṃ tathā \|*  
*nāgeśvarāṇāṃ vipinaṃ lavaṅgānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

*vanaṃ ca śālatālānāṃ hintālānāṃ vanaṃ tathā \|*  
*panasānāṃ rasālānāṃ lāṅgalīnāṃ manoharam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*mandārakānanaṃ ramyaṃ vāmaṃ kṛtvā ca satvaram \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā kundavanaṃ ramyaṃ saṃprāpya madhukānanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*puṃskokilānāṃ śabdena madhureṇa samanvitam \|*  
*madhuvratasamūhānāṃ madhuradhvanibūritam \|\| 36 \|\|*

31-36. From there he moved on to the forest of sandal-wood, campaka-vana Mhi-vana, Ketaki-vana and Madhavi-vana. From there he moved on to the Bakula-vana, Vanjula-vana, Yashodd-vana, Mallika-vana, Palasa-vana, Sirlsa-vana, Dhatrl-vana, Kancan-vana, Nageshvara-vana, Karnika-vana Lavanga-vana, forest of teak wood, forest of tala trees, Hintala-vana, forest of jack-fruits, mango groves, the pleasant Langall-vana and the forest of Mandara trees. Leaving this forest to the left Uddhava reached Kunda-vana and thereafter he reached Madhuvana in which the sweet voice of the cuckoos was echoing and the black wasps were creating the hissing sound. It had enough of the wild growth and was the base of wine. It was fragrant with forest flowers and the fragrant cool breeze was blowing. Thereafter, he moved over to the royal path built by Vishvakarma and reached the secret forest of Jujubi trees, thin crossing over to shrlphala forest, lemon forest, orange forest, forest of lotus flower, fragrant oleander forest and Tulasi-vana, he found there enough of fruit of red colour and other delicious fruits. Leaving it, Uddhava moved to the forest of banana trees.

## \|\| 92.37-40 \|\|

*vanyavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ mādhvīkādhāramīpsitam \|*  
*vātena vanyabuṣpāṇāṃ varitaḥ surabhīkṛtam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*taddṛṣṭvā rājamārgeṇa yaśodoktena sāṃpratam \|*  
*yayau śīghraṃ nirudvigniṃ rahasyaṃ badarīvanam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*śrīphalānāṃ ca nimbārnāṃ nāriṅgāṇāṃ vanaṃ tathā \|*  
*padmānāṃ karavīrāṇāṃ tulasīnāṃ ca kānanam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭavā raktimavarṇaṃ ca supakvaphalamīpsitam \|*  
*tadeva vāmataḥ kṛtvā viveśa kadalīvanam \|\| 40 \|\|*

37-40. It was quite a secluded place and was located pleasantly. He then spotted the extremely charming abode of Radhika, having the boundary wall studded with gems and surrounded by moat and the forts, being inaccessible by the enemies. It was easily accessible for the friends and had quite secretive and indicative paths; it was surrounded by the moats from all the four sides; it was painted with various types of paintings and was built by Vishvakarma, using the precious stones and gems beside the garland of gems, it had the pillars which were made of the best of the gems. The steps were made of gems and the pitchers were also decorated with gems; it had a number of banners of fine cloth sanctified by fire. It had beautiful mirrors made of gems as well as the white fly-whisks. He then came across the main gate which had the doors of gems. Above the gate, Vishvakarma had painted beautifully scene from Vrindavana, kadamba-vana, stealing of the cloth, extremely beautiful Rasamandala, several types of orchards of gems were depicted which was filled with cowherds and cowherdesses.

## \|\| 92.41-48 \|\|

*atīva nirjane ramye dadarśa rādhikāśramam \|*  
*maṇīndrāṇāṃ ca prākāraṃ parikhādurgaveṣṭitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*atyagamyaṃ ripūṇāṃ ca mitrāṇāṃ sugamaṃ sukham \|*  
*gopyaṃ saṃketamārgaṃ ca rakṣakaiḥ parirakṣitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*nānācitravicitrāḍhyaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahārojjvalaṃ param \|\| 43 \|\|*

*ratnendrasāraracitaṃ ratnastambhaiḥ suśobhitam \|*  
*ratnasopānasaṃsaktamandireṇa manoharam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*amūlyaratnakhacitaṃ kalaśaiḥ pariśobhitam \|*  
*vāhniśuddhāṃśukābhiśca patākābhiḥ pariṣkṛtam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sadratnadarpaṇotkṛṣṭaṃ carcitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*
