*dadarśa siṃhadvāraṃ ca yuktaṃ ratnakapāṭakaiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*dvāropari vicitraṃ ca ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|*  
*kadambakānanaṃ ramyaṃ tadvāstraharaṇādikam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*viśvakarmaviracitaṃ suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*nānāratnakuṭīraṃ ca gopagopīsamanvitam \|\| 48 \|\|*

41-48. A lakh of cowherdesses were guarding the gate, holding the staff in their hands. All of them could move at will and they carried various types of presents in their hands. Finding the gate there, Uddhava crossed, it then crossing the second and the third gates he reached the fourth gate which was quite surprising. Thereafter he crossed the fifth gate and found beautiful paintings there; he than reached the sixth gate which was quite beautiful from all sides, the walls of the place were painted by Vishvakarma with the scenes from Ramayana including the battle scenes the ten incarnations of lord Vishnu, Rasamandala and the water sport at the bank of Yamuna river. The sixth gate was guarded by a thousand cowherdesses. All of them were adorned with the best of ornaments studded with gems and held in their hands the staff decorated with gems and other precious stones.

## \|\| 92.49-55 \|\|

*rakṣitaṃ gopikālakṣairvetrahastairmanoharaiḥ \|*  
*svacchandācaraṇaiḥ śaśvadamitairbalibhirmudā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*taddvāraṃ purato dṛṣṭvā vilaṅkya ca jagām saḥ \|*  
*dvitīyaṃ dvāramullaṅghya tasmāduttamamīpsitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*dvāraṃ caturthaṃ saṃprāpya sarvasmācca vilakṣaṇam \|*  
*tatpaścātpañcamaṃ dvāraṃ dadarśa citramuttamam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*dvāraṣaṭkaṃ ca prayayau sarvatra ruciraṃ param \|*  
*rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ bhitticitraṃ manoharam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*daśāvatāraṃ viṣṇośca kṛtrimaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*yamunājalakeliṃ ca racitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*gopikānāṃ sahasreṇā ṣaṣṭhaṃ dvāraṃ ca rakṣitam \|*  
*ratnendrasāranirmāṇabhūṣaṇairbhūṣitena ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sadratnadaṇ̈ḍahastena hīrakairbhūṣitena ca \|*  
*maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahārānvitena ca \|\| 55 \|\|*

49-55. Out of them the female friend of Radha named Madhavi put a meaningful question to Uddhava besides asking about his welfare. Uddhava on his part gave the appropriate reply. Thereafter the cowherdesses left Uddhava at that place, went to Radhika and spoke to her dearest friend. Listening to the goodness, the cowherdesses, started blowing conches, ringing bells, playing on small drums and big drums welcoming Uddhava's arrival there. They carried him to the inner apartment of Radhika.

## \|\| 92.56-59 \|\|

*mādhavī tatpradhānā sā papraccha sāṃprataṃ śivam \|*  
*dadau pratyuttaraṃ sarvaṃ krameṇa ca sa uddhavaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*gatvā vijñāpayāmāsa rādhāpriyasakhīgaṇam \|*  
*sā mādhavī mahāhṛṣṭā tatra saṃsthāpya taṃ mudā \|\| 57 \|\|*

*śrutvā maṅgalavārtāṃ ca rādhāpriyasakhīgaṇaiḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā śaṅkhadhvaniṃ ghaṇṭāmṛdaṅgapaṭahasvanam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*kṛtvā nirmañchanaṃ śīghramuddhavaṃ priyamāgatam \|*  
*hṛṣṭā praveśayāmāsa rādhābhyantaramuttamam \|\| 59 \|\|*

56-59. Arriving in the place which was built with the best of gems, Uddhava met with Radhika; she was beautiful like the moon rays. Her eyes were like full blown lotus flowers, she had discarded all the ornaments, except the pairs of ear ornaments which were hanging issuing the lustre. Because of the separation from Krishna, her mouth had become red; she was lying over the ground getting fainted and was crying at the same time; she was motionless and peaceful. She was without food; her lips, throat had dried up; she was breathing some-how; finding her in that condition, Uddhava the great devotee of Krishna was filled with emotions. He bowed his head in reverence to Radhika.

## \|\| 92.60-63 \|\|

*amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ gatvā mandiramuttamam \|*  
*dadarśa purato rādhāṃ kuhvā candrakalopamām \|\| 60 \|\|*

*supakvapadmanetrāṃ ca śayānāṃ śokamūrcchitām \|*  
*rudatīṃ raktavadanāṃ vilṣṭāṃ ca tyaktabhūṣaṇām \|\| 61 \|\|*

*niśceṣṭāṃ ca nirāhārāṃ suvarṇavarṇakuṇḍalām \|*  
*śuṣkitādharakaṇṭhāṃ ca kiṃcinniḥ śvāsasaṃyutām \|\| 62 \|\|*

*praṇanāma ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ \|*  
*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo bhaktyā bhaktaḥ sa uddhavaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

60-63. Uddhava said – I bow in reverence at the lotus-like feet of Radha who is adored by Brahma and other gods and by whose virtues all the three lokas gets purified; I bow in reverence to the dweller of Gokula. I bow in reverence to Radhika. The one who resides over the mountain of hundred peaks and is known as Chandravati, I offer my salutation to her; she is the dweller of the Tulasi forest and the Vrindavana; I adore her again and again. She is the dweller of the Rasamandala, the goddess of divine dance, I offer my salutation to her a gain and again.

## \|\| 92.64-66 \|\|

*uddhava uvāca vande rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ brahmādisuravindatam \|*  
*yatkīrtiḥ kīrtanenaiva punāti bhuvanatrayam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*namo gokulavāsinyai rādhikāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*śataśṛṅganivāsinyai candrāvatyai no \|\| 65 \|\|*

*tulasīvanavāsinya vṛndāraṇyai no \|*  
*rāsamaṇḍalavāsinyai rāseśvaryai no \|\| 66 \|\|*

64-66. I offer my salutation to Vrinda, the dweller on the bank of Viraja river. I offer my salutation to the passionate Krishna of Vrindavana, I offer my salutation again and again. I offer my salutation to the beloved of Krishna who is quite peaceful, I offer my salutation to her again aiid again. The one who reside is in the heart of Krishna and is his beloved, I offer my salutation to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.67-68 \|\|

*virajātīravāsinyai vṛndāyai ca no \|*  
*vṛndāvanavilāsinyai kṛṣṇāyai ca no \|\| 67 \|\|*

*namaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca śāntāyai ca no \|*  
*kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthitāyai ca tatpiyāyai no \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. I offer my salutation to the one who resides in Vaikuntha as Maha-Lakshmi. I offer her salutation again and again. The one who is the great goddess of all the knowledge and also appeared in the form of Sarasvati, I adore her again and again. She is the lady of all the fortunes, in the form of Kamala I offer my salutation to her again and again. She is the beloved of lord Padmanabha, I offer my salutation to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.69-70 \|\|

*namo vaikuṇṭhavāsinyai mahālakṣmyai no \|*  
*vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca sarasvatyai no \|\| 69 \|\|*

*sarvaśvaryādhidevyai ca kamalāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*padnābhapriyāyai ca padyāyai ca namo namaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. She is the one who happens to be the mother of Maha-Vishnu, is quite eternal and the eternal force. I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.71 \|\|

*mahāviṣṇośca mātre ca parādyāyai no \|*  
*namaḥ sindhusutāyai ca martyalakṣmayai no \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. I bow in reverence to the daughter of Sindhu and the goddess Lakshmi of the universe, I offer my salutation to her again and again. She happens to be Narayan! the beloved of Narayana, I offer her salutation again and again. I bow in reverence to Vishnumaya; she is also called Vaishnavl, I offer my salutation to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.72-74 \|\|

*nārāyaṇapriyāyai ca nārāyaṇyai no \|*  
*namo'stu viṣṇumāyāyai vaiṣṇavyai ca no \|\| 72 \|\|*

*mahāmāyāsvarūpāyai saṃpadāyai no \|*  
*namaḥ kalyāṇarūpiṇyai śubhāyai ca no \|\| 73 \|\|*

*mātre caturṇā vedānāṃ sāvitryai ca no \|*  
*namo'stu buddhirūpāyai jñānadāyai no \|\| 74 \|\|*

72-74. I adore the treasure known in the form of Mahamaya. She is the fonn of all the welfare, I bow in reverence to her. She is the form of welfare, I bow in reverence to her. The one who happens to be the mother of all the four Vedas and is also known as Savitri, I bow in reverence to her. The one who removes all the misfortune, I bow in reverence to Durga again and again.

## \|\| 92.75-76 \|\|

*namo durgavināśinyai durgādevyai no \|*  
*tejaḥsu sarvadevānāṃ purā kṛtayuge mudā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*adhiṣṭānakṛtāyai ca prakṛtyai ca no \|*  
*namastripurahāriṇyai tripurāyai no \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. The one who was born in Krtayuga out of the tejas of all the gods, I bow in reverence to the same goddess again and again. I bow in reverence to the goddess who destroyed the demon Tripurasura. Because of that she was known as Tripurasundarl. I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.77 \|\|

*sundarīṣu ca ramyāyai nirguṇāyai no \|*  
*mamo nidrāsvarūpāyai nirguṇāyai no \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. The one who happens to be the most beautiful of all the beautiful goddesses on earth who is without qualities, I bow in reverence to her again and again. The one who has the fonn of sleep, I bow in reverence to her. The one who is without qualities I bow in reverence to her.

## \|\| 92.78-79 \|\|

*namo dakṣasutāyai ca namaḥ satyai no \|*  
*namaḥ śailasutāyai ca pārvatyai ca no \|\| 78 \|\|*

*namo namastapasvinyai hyu māyai ca no \|*  
*nirāhārasvarūpāyai hyaparṇāyai no \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. I bow in reverence to the daughter of Daksha, who came to be known as Sati, I bow in reverence to her again and again. I offer my salutation to the daughter of the mountain who was known as Parvati, I bow in reverence to the ascetic goddess again and again. I bow in reverence to Uma again and again. The one who remained without food and without clothes, I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.80 \|\|

*gaurīlaukavilāsinyai namo gauryai no \|*  
*namaḥ kailāsavāsinyai māheśvaryaiḥ no \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. The one who is known as Gauri, I bow in reverence to her; the one who dwells in Gauri-loka, I bow in reverence to her. I bow in reverence to the dweller of Kailasa. The one who is known as Maheshvari, I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.81-82 \|\|

*nidrāyai ca dayāyai ca śraddhāyai ca no \|*  
*namo dhṛtyai kṣamāryai ca lajjāyai ca no \|\| 81 \|\|*

*tṛṣṇāyai kṣutsvarūpāyai sthitikartryai no \|*  
*namaḥ saṃhārarūpiṇyai mahāmāryai no \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. The one who is of the form of sleep, compassion, reverence, I bow in reverence to her again and again. The one who is patient and forgive and everyone. I bow in reverence to her again and again. The one who is the fonn of shyness, I bow in reverence to her again and again. The one who has the form of lust, hunger and the one who establishes everyone, I bow in reverence to her again and again. The one who is the form of destruction I offer my salutation to her. I offer my salutation to the great epidemic again and again.

## \|\| 92.83 \|\|

*bhayāyaiṃ cābhayāyaiṃ ca muktidāyai no \|*  
*namaḥ svadhāyaiṃ svāhāyai śāntayai kāntyai no \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. The one who is the form of fear as well as fearlessness and the granter of salvation, I offer my salutation to her again and again. I offer my salutation to Svadha and Svaha, the form of lustre as well as peace, I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.84 \|\|

*namastuṣṭyaiṃ ca puṣṭyai ca dayāyai ca no \|*  
*namo nidrāsvarūpāyai śraddhāyai ca no \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. The one who is the form of satisfaction, protection and compassion, I bow in reverence to her again and again. The one who is the fonn of sleep and devotion, I offer my salutation to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.85 \|\|

*kṣutpipāsāsvarūpāyai lajjāyaiṃ ca no \|*  
*namo dhṛtyaiṃ kṣamāyaiṃ ca cetanāyaiṃ no \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. The one who has the form of hunger, thirst and shyness, I offer my salutation to her again and again. The one who has the form of patience and forgiveness beside consciousness, I bow in, reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.86 \|\|

*sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇyai sarvamātre no \|*  
*agnau dāhasvarūpāyai bhadrāyai ca no \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. The one who represents the eternal strength and is the mother of all, I bow in reverence to her again and again, the one who is the burning sensation in the fire and who happens to be Bhadra, I offer my salutation to her again and again. The one who has the lustre of the hill moon as well as the lotus flower of the winter season, I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 92.87-91 \|\|

*śobhāyai pūrṇacandre ca śaratpadma no \|*  
*nāsti bhedo yathā devi dugdhadhāvalyayoḥsadā \|\| 87 \|\|*

*yathaiva gandhabhūmyośca yathaiva jalaśaityayauḥ \|*  
*yathaiva śabdanbhasorjyotiḥ sūryakayoryathā \|\| 88 \|\|*

*loke vede purāṇe ca rādhāmādhavayostathā \|*  
*cetanaṃ kuru kalyāṇi dehi māmuttaraṃ sati \|\| 89 \|\|*

*ityuktvā coddhavastatra praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*ityudvavakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhedbhaktipūrvakam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante harimandiram \|na bhavedbandhuvicchedo rogaḥ śokaḥ sudāruṇaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

87-91. О goddess as the whiteness cannot be separated from the milk, fragrance cannot be separated from the earth, coolness cannot be separated from water the sound can not be separated from the sky. The lustre cannot be separated from the sun, similarly the Vedic and Pauranic literature define Radha as inseparable from Madhava. О goddess of welfare, "O chaste goddess regain consciousness and give me the reply". Thus speaking Uddhava bowed in reverence to Radha again and again. Thus the one who recites the stotra composed by Uddhava with devotion, after enjoying all the pleasures in this world, lived in the abode of lord. He does not suffer from the separation from the relatives or ailment and the grief.

## \|\| 92.92-94 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmo mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakho utto nāradanāo rādhāstotraṃ nāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*nirbhūmirlabhate bhūmiṃ prajāhīno labhetprajām \|*  
*rogādvimucyate rogī baddhī mucyate bandhanāt \|\| 93 \|\|*

*bhayānmucyeta bhītastu mucyetā''pannaāpadaḥ \|*  
*aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

92-94. By reciting this stotra a lady whose husband has gone to some other place gets back the husband and the one who is separated from the wife gets back the wife, a person without a son gets a son, a pauper gets the riches, a person without land gets the land, a person who is issueless gets the progeny, the ailing person would be freed from the ailment and person in fetter would be freed from the fetters, the person in panic would he freed from the same and the one who is over-powered with misfortune would be relieved of the same. A person with no reputation achieves immense reputation and a foolish person becomes wise.

## Chapter 93

## \|\| 93.1 \|\|

*atha trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca uddhavastavanaṃ śrutvā cetanāṃ prāpya rādhikā \|*  
*vilokya kṛṣṇākāraṃ ca tamuvāca śucā'nvitā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – On listening to the stotra of Uddhava, Radha regained consciousness, then convincing Uddhava as Krishna she spoke to him.

## \|\| 93.2 \|\|

*rādhikovāca kinnāma bhavato vatsa kena vā prerito bhavān \|*  
*āgato vā kuta iti brūha māṃ kena hetunā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Radhika said – О son, who are you? What is your name? Who has sent you, where from have you arrived? And what is the purpose of your arrival here? You tell me.

## \|\| 93.3-6 \|\|

*kṛṣṇākṛtistvaṃ sarvāṅgairmanye tvāṃ kṛṣṇapārṣadam \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya suśalaṃ brūhi baradevasya sāṃpratam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*nandastiṣṭhati tatraiva hetunā kena tadvada \|*  
*samāyāsyati sovindo ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*punardrakṣyāmi tasyaiva pūrṇacandramukhaṃ śubham \|*  
*punaḥ krīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi tenāhaṃ rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 5 \|\|*

*jale ca vihariṣyāmi punarvā sakhibhiḥ saha \|*  
*śrīnandanandanāṅge ca punardāsyāmi candanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. All of your limbs resemble those of Krishna. I therefore, believe what you happen to be the courtier of Krishna, therefore you let me know about the welfare of Krishna and Baladeva. You also tell me as to how is Nanda staying there? Would Krishna ever come to this charming Vmdavana, when I would be able to have a look at his moon like face? Shall be able to enjoys the divine dance with him in the Rasamandala, shall I again have the chance of enjoy the water-sport with my friends? Would I be able to plaster the sandal-paste on the body of Krishna?

## \|\| 93.7-8 \|\|

*uddhava uvāca uddavetyabhidhānaṃ me kṣatriyo'haṃ varānane \|*  
*preṣitaḥ śubhavārtārthaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tavāntikaṃ samāyātaḥ pārṣado'haṃ harerapi \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya baladevasya śivaṃ nandasya sāṃpratam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Uddhava said – О beautiful faced one, I am a Kshatriya and my name is Uddhava. Krishna the supreme soul has deputed me to convey the news about his welfare.. I happen to be the courtier of the lord, that is why I have arrived here. Currently Krishna, Baladeva and Nanda are quite well in Mathura.

## \|\| 93.9-18 \|\|

*rādhikovāca asti tadyamunākūlaṃ sugandhipavano'sti saḥ \|*  
*tasya kelikadambānāṃ mūlamastayeva sāṃpratam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ tadvidyamānamīpsitam \|*  
*puṃskokilānāṃ virutaṃ talpaṃ candanacarcitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*caturvidhaṃ ca bhojyaṃ ca madhupānaṃ ca sundaram \|*  
*duranto duḥkhado'pyasti pāpiṣṭho manmathastathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*te ca ratnapradīpāśca jvalanti rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*maṇīndrasāranirmāṇamastyeva ratimandiram \|\| 12 \|\|*

*gopāṅganāgaṇo'styeva pūrṇacandro'sti śobhitaḥ \|*  
*sugandhipuṣparacitaṃ talpaṃ candanacarcitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tāmbūlaṃ ratibhogārhaṃ karpūrādisusaṃskṛtam \|sugandhimālatīmālyaṃ śvetacāmaradarpaṇam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*muktāmāṇikyasaṃsaktahīrahāramanoharam \|*  
*kastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ ca pātrapūrṇaṃ ca candanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*nānopakānanaṃ ramyaṃ ramyakrīḍāsarovaram \|*  
*sugandhipuṣpodyānaṃ ca padmaśreṇīmanoharam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*astyevaṃ sarvavibhavaḥ prāṇanāthaḥ kuto mama \|*  
*hā kṛṣṇa hā rāmānātha kvāsi me prāṇavallabha \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kva vā'parādho dāsyāśca dāsīdoṣaḥ pade pade \|*  
*ityevamuktvā sā devī punarmūrcchāmavāpa sā \|\| 18 \|\|*

9-18. Radhika said – The bank of Yamuna is present here, the fragrant wind is blowing, the kadamba tree is also available for his sports. The beautiful and auspicious Vmdavana is also there, the cuckoos are issuing sweet notes, the bed with sandal-paste is also there, all the, four types of eatables and the honey is also there. That wicked god of love, who always causes pain is also there. The lamps of gems are burning in the Rasamandala, the pleasure house is also there which has been built with the best of gems. The cowherdesses are there, the full moon is there, the flower bed painted with sandal-paste is also there issuing fragrance. The betel with camphor is also there which is consumed after performing the love-sport, the fragrant garland of jasmine flower is also there, the white fly-whisks is there, beside, the mirror made of gems, the garland of gems, the pool for with the water sport surrounded by charming gardens is also there, the garden with fragrant flower is also there, the lines of beautiful lotus flowers are there. Thus all the pleasures are available but where is the lord of my life? О Krishna, О Saranatha, О lord of my life, where are you? what is the fault of the slave girl like me or otherwise the fault of the slave girl is visible at every step. Thus speaking she again fainted.

## \|\| 93.19-21 \|\|

*cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa punareva sa uddhavaḥ \|*  
*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paramāścarya mene kṣatriyapuṃgavaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sakhībhiḥ saptabhiḥ śaśvatsevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*gopīnāṃ ca trilakṣaiśca supriyaiḥ priyasevitām \|\| 20 \|\|*

*divāniśaṃ veṣṭitāṃ ca gopīnāṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*kācitkajjalahastā ca kācinmālyavarā'parā \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. Thereafter, Uddhava somehow brought her to senses again and he was immensely surprised. At that point of time the seven female friends of Radha where moving white fly-whisks on her. Three lakhs of cowherdesses remained in attention, always to serve Radha. She was surrounded by a hundred crores of cowherdesses through out the day and night. Some of them carried the collyrium in their hands, some of them carried the garland of flowers.

## \|\| 93.22-23 \|\|

*kācitsindūrahastā ca kācidgorocanākarā \|*  
*kāciccandanapātraṃ ca haste kṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kāciddarpaṇahastā ca kācitkuṅkumāvahikā \|*  
*kastūrīpātramiṣṭaṃ ca kācidvahati tatra vai \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Some carried vermilion in their hands, while others carried gorocana, while still others carried the vases of sandal-wood in their hands, some of them carried the mirrors, some of them carried kumkum and others carried vases of kasturl.

## \|\| 93.24-26 \|\|

*kāciccampakapātraṃ ca kare dhṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati \|*  
*madhubhirmadhuraiḥ pūrṇaṃ pātraṃ dhṛtvā śucā'nvitā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kācitsugandhitailaṃ ca gṛhītvā paritiṣṭhati \|*  
*kācidvahati tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kācidvāsitamacchaṃ ca jalaṃ dhṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati \|*  
*krīḍāputtalikāṃ kāciccitrāḍhyāṃ parirakṣati \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. Someone carried the vase of campaka flowers while others carried the vases of honey filled with gems. Some of them carried the fragrant oil, some of them carried fragrant oil, some of them carried the betels with the fragrance of camphor, while others carried the scented water. Some of them were attending to the dancing puppets.

## \|\| 93.27-32 \|\|

*kācidvahati kandūkaṃ kācicca ratnabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ kācidamūlyaṃ parirakṣati \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kācidbhakṣayopahāraṃ ca gṛhītvā parivartate \|*  
*kācicca keśaveśārthakaroti mālyamīpsitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*kācitkaṅkatikāṃ dhṛtvā purataḥ paritiṣṭhati \|*  
*kācidyāvakahastā ca kāciddhātrīrasaṃ mudā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*dūrato'pi vahatyevaṃ bhītā ca paritiṣṭhati \|*  
*kācidbhītā bhiyā stautikācidroditi śokataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kācittāṃ baudhayetyerva vidagdhā virahāturām \|*  
*kāciduttāpataptā ca snigdhatalpe manohare \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sthāpayeddāhadūrārthaṃ snigdhapadmadale śubhe \|*  
*evaṃbhūtāṃ catāṃ dṛṣṭavā covāca punaruddhavaḥ \|*  
*supriyaṃ karṇapīyūṣaṃ vinayena ca bhītivat \|\| 32 \|\|*

27-32. Some of them carried the balls, some of them carried the gem-studded ornaments while others carried invaluable garments sanctified by fire, some of them carried the eatables. Some of them were inserting the flowers in the hair of Radha, while others were carrying the combs. Some of them carried the red paint for the feet and some of them carried the essence of myrobalan and were standing in panic at a distance, someone feeling panicky was praying while someone was grief-stricken and crying, some of the intelligent cowherdesses were addressihg sweet words to Radha, who was burning with separation. Someone was looking at Radha, who was lying at the beautiful bed and was trying to remove the grief of separation. Someone of them was trying to lay Radha on the bed of lotus leaves. Finding Radha in such a condition Uddhava felt panicky and he.spoke words which were sweet like nectar to Radha.

## \|\| 93.33-34 \|\|

*uddhava uvāca jāne tvāṃ devadevīśāṃ susnigdhāṃ siddhayoginīm \|*  
*sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca sūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm \|\| 33 \|\|*

*śrīdāmaśāpāddharaṇīṃ prāptāṃ golokakāminīm \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ devīṃ tadvakṣaḥsthalavāsinīm \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. Uddhava said – I know you fully well, you happen to be the foremost of all the gods and goddesses or affectionate, Siddhayoginl, the form of the entire prowess, MiilaPrakriti, Isvari and the damsel of Goloka, you have incarnated on the earth because of the curse of Sridama, О goddess, you happen to be the beloved of Shri Krishna and always reside in his heart.

## \|\| 93.35-36 \|\|

*śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi śubhavārtāmabhīpsitām \|*  
*susthiraṃ sakhibhiḥ sārdhaṃ hṛdayasnagdhikāriṇīm \|\| 35 \|\|*

*duḥkhadāvāgnidagdhāyāḥ sudhāvarṣaṇarūpiṇīm \|*  
*virahavyādhiyuktāyā rasāyanasamāṃ śubhām \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. O goddess, you be attentive and listen to me with your cowherdesses, I have come here to convey a good news to you which is desired by you and pleases the heart and would be serve as the rain to extinguished the fire of separation or serves the medicine for the person ailing from separation.

## \|\| 93.37-38 \|\|

*tatra tiṣṭhati nando'yaṃ sānando suditaḥ sadā \|*  
*nimantritaśca vasunā kṛṣṇopanayanāvadhi \|\| 37 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā sabalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sāṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi \|*  
*sa nandaḥ paramānando sudā''yāsyati gokulam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. О mother, you composer yourself and clad yourself in the divine garment sanctified by fire you adorn yourself with gem-studded ornaments and apply the paste of kastiirl, kumkum and sandal-paste over your body. Decorate your hair with the garland of jasmine flowers, О virtuous one, now you adorn yourself with the best of costumes and have your cheeks suitably painted and the pasting of hair would be adorned with kastiirl and sandal-paste, applying the spot of vermilion over your forehead and the red paste over the soles of your feet. You now get up and occupy the gem-studded lion-throne, you discard the dirty bed of the lotus leaves. '

## \|\| 93.39 \|\|

*āgatya kṛṣṇo muditaḥ praṇamya mātaraṃ punaḥ \|*  
*naktamāyāsyati mudā puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Vasudeva has invited Nanda to remain in Mathura till the performing of the thread ceremony of Krishna. Therefore Nanda is quite happy thereafter the completion of those festivities, Nanda accompanied by Krishna. and Baladeva would delightful return to Gokula.

## \|\| 93.40 \|\|

*acirāddrakṣyasi sati śrīkṛṣṇamukhapaṅkajam \|*  
*sarvaṃ virahaduḥkhaṃ ca saṃtyakṣyasi ca sāṃpratam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. At that time Shri Krishna would be delightful, bow in reverence to the mother and would return to Vrindavana in the night.

## \|\| 93.41-45 \|\|

*susthirā bhava mātastvaṃ tyaja śokaṃ sudāruṇam \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ ramyaṃ paridhāya praharṣitā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ kuru \|*  
*gṛhāṇacandanaṃ snigdhaṃ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*kuruṣva keśasaṃskāraṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam \|*  
*suveṣaṃ kuru kalyāṇi gaṇḍe ca citrapatrakam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*sindūrabinduṃ sīmante kastūrīcandanānvitam \|*  
*alaktakāktaṃ caraṇaṃ yuktaṃ yāvakabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*kuruṣva tiṣṭhacotiṣṭha ratnasiṃhāsane vare \|*  
*sapaṅkapaṅkajaṃ talpaṃ tyaja sārdhaṃ śucā sati \|\| 45 \|\|*

41-45. О chaste lady you would surely have a look at the lotus-like face of Shri Krishna and would be relieved of the pain of separation.

## \|\| 93.46-52 \|\|

*bhuṅkṣva kṛṣṇena manasā viśuddhaṃ madhuraṃ madhu \|*  
*saṃskṛtaṃ bhāsitaṃ toyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*ratnendrasāranirmāṇaparyaṅke mumanohare \|*  
*vahnisaddhāṃśukākte ca mālatīmālyabhūṣite \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sugandhiyukte kastūrījātīcampakacandanaiḥ \|*  
*parito mālatīmālyahīrahāravibhūṣite \|\| 48 \|\|*

*maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyasundaraiśca pariṣkṛte \|*  
*puṣpamālyopadhāne ca maṅgalārhe mudā'nvitā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*śayanaṃ kuru deveśi gopībhiḥ sevitā sadā \|*  
*karotu sevanaṃ śaśvatpriyāliḥ śvetayāmaraiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*padāravindasevāṃ ca gopībhaktā manohare \|*  
*sadratnasāranirmāṇaparyaṅke sumanohare \|\| 51 \|\|*

*tyevamuktvā sa mune punastūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha \|*  
*praṇamya pādapadmaṃ ca brahmādisuravanditam \|\| 52 \|\|*

46-52. You consume the sweet beverages, devoting your mind towards Krishna. You consume the fragrant betel and water, enjoy the channing bed delightfully which is having a bed sheet of fine cloth sanctified by fire and is also decorated with the garlands of jasmine flowers kastiirl, lilies, campaka flowers and sandal-paste. Issuing divine fragrance, it is decorated with the garland of jasmine flowers from all sides, is decorated by several precious gems and the jewels and the pillow is made of the best of auspicious flowers. О goddess, all the cowherdesses serve you some of your dear friends are moving the white fly-whisks uninterruptedly, but I want that you should be lodged over the lion throne which is built of the best of the gems and all the cowherdesses should serve at your feet. О sage, thus speaking Uddhava adored the lotus-like feet of Radha which are adored by Brahma and all other gods daily with reverence. After thus speaking, Uddhava kept quiet.

## \|\| 93.53-58 \|\|

*uddhavasya vacaḥśrutvā sasmitā rādhikā satī \|*  
*yautukaṃ ca dadau tasmai ratnasārāṅgulīyakam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*amūlyaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ viśvakarmavinirmitam \|*  
*mukhadṛśyaṃ pītavarṇa sudīptaṃ supradīpavat \|\| 54 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇaya vahninā dattamapūrvaṃ rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*maṇikuṇḍalayugmaṃ cāmūlyaratnavinirmitam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ sarvabhūṣaṇamīpsitam \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukayugaṃ ratnanirmāṇanāyakam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*hīrahāravinirmāṇaṃ hāraṃ ca sumanoharam \|*  
*purā dattaṃ ca suprityā kṛṣṇāya varuṇena ca \|\| 57 \|\|*

*śrīsūryeṇa ca yaddattaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya syamantakam \|*  
*pradattaṃ kau(yau) tukaṃ tasmai yaddattaṃ hariṇā purā \|\| 58 \|\|*

53-58. On hearing the words of Uddhava, the smiling and chaste Radha offered to him a ring which was invaluable, beautiful and studded with gems and was made by Vishvakarma. She then offered him the two ear ornaments in which one could look his own reflection. They were yellow in colour, were unprecedented and were shining like the lamp. These kundalas were handed over by lord Agni to Krishna in the Rasamandala. Thereafter she also gave him several gem-studded ornaments and the costumes sanctified by fire, the garland of gems which had been handed over by Varuna to Krishna in the earlier times, she also handed over the Syamantaka gem to Uddhava which was handed over by Surya to Krishna. The same gem was presented by Krishna to Radha.

## \|\| 93.59-62 \|\|

*yaddattaṃ ca mahendreṇa ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ varam \|*  
*tatpradattaṃ mudā debyā tasmai prītyā ca rādhāyā \|\| 59 \|\|*

*maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ chatraratnaṃ manoharam \|*  
*muktāmāṇikyasāreṇa hīrahārasamanvitam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*vicitraratnapadmena vicitraṃ vāruṇaṃ sadā \|*  
*śobhitaṃ paritaścānyai ratnanirmāṇadarpaṇaiḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*yaddattaṃ brahmaṇa prītyā haraye rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*suprītyā rādhayā tatra pradattamuddhavāya ca \|\| 62 \|\|*

59-62. Thereafter the goddess Radha handed over the lion-throne studded with best of gems which was presented to Shri Krishna by Mahendra quite delightfully. She also gave him the chatra which was made of the best of gems and diamonds. A garland of diamonds decorated it and several lotus flowers of gems were engraved over it-She also gave the mirror of gems which was handed over to Krishna by Brahma in the Rasamandala. This was also handed over to Uddhava by Radha.

## \|\| 93.63-65 \|\|

*maṇikāravinirmāṇaṃ maṇirājavirājitam \|*  
*japāmālyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ca yaddattaṃ śaṃbhunā purā \|\| 63 \|\|*

*tadeva dattaṃ tasmai cāpyamūlyaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ cātimanoharam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*candrakāntamaṇiṃ ramyaṃ candradattaṃ pariṣkṛtam \|*  
*candrāvalīṃ dadau tasmai sudīptaṃ pūrṇacandravat \|\| 65 \|\|*

63-65. Thereafter she also gave him a garland of china-rose flower in which the best of gems were studded and which was given in earlier times by Shiva to Krishna and was invaluable, auspicious, remover of deaths birth and old age, beside the ailment. She also handed over the Chandrakanta gem which was given to Krishna by the moon was an excellent gem and had the lustre of the full moon.

## \|\| 93.66 \|\|

*viśuddhaṃ madhupūrṇaṃ ca madhupātraṃ yadakṣayam \|*  
*dharmeṇa yatpradattaṃ ca taddattaṃ priyayā hareḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. She also handed over the pure imperishable vase of honey which was handed over to Krishna by Dharmaraja.

## \|\| 93.67-68 \|\|

*jalabhojanapātraṃ ca śṛdraṃ svarṇavinirmitam \|*  
*miṣṭānnaṃ paramānnaṃ cadadau susvādumiṣṭakam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*bhojataṃ kārayitvā ca karpūrādisuvāsitam \|*  
*tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau śīghraṃ mālyaṃ susnigdhacandanam \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. She also gave Uddhava, the gold vase which were quite auspicious and were used for taking food and water, she also served the sweet and delicious dishes to him including payasam. She than offered him the betel sanctified by camphor beside the garland of flowers beside, the garland of flowers with soaked in sandal-paste.

## \|\| 93.69-74 \|\|

*śubhāśiṣaṃ ca pradadau vāñchitaṃ pravaraṃ varam \|*  
*jñānaṃ kṛṣṇena yaddattaṃ goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 69 \|\|*

*puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ yāvanniścalāṃ kamalāṃ dadau \|*  
*vidyāṃ yaśaskarīṃ śuddhāṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ sunirmalām \|\| 70 \|\|*

*sarvasiddhiṃ harerdāsyaṃ haribhaktiṃ ca niścalām \|*  
*pārṣadapravaratvaṃ ca pārṣadaṃ ca hareriti \|\| 71 \|\|*

*varaṃ prasādaṃ dattvā ca samutthāya mudā'nvitam \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśuke dhṛtvā cāmūlyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam \|\| 72 \|\|*

*hīrahāraṃ ratnamālāṃ parighāya manoharām \|*  
*sindūraṃ kajjalaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ sustigdhacandanam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ taṃ pūjitā pūjitaṃ mudā \|*  
*veṣṭitā harṣanirataṃ gaupīnāṃ śātakoṭi bhiḥ \|*  
*taptakāñcanavarṇābhā śatacandrasamaprabhā \|\| 74 \|\|*

69-74. She than blessed him variously and bestowed him with the divine knowledge which was imparted by lord Krishna himself to Radha in Rasamandala of the Goloka, she than blessed him that the Lakshmi would not depart from his house up to a hundred generations, beside bestowing the knowledge of Yasaskarl, wide spread popularity, spotless, glory, all the siddhis, the slavehood of the lord, the infallible devotion to the lord, beside becoming the best of the courtier of the lord. This delightfully handing over all these things and pronouncing the blessing on him, Radhika got up and she clad herself in the divine costumes sanctified by fire adorned herself with the best of gem-studded ornaments, garland of diamonds and also applied the spot of vermilion over her forehead besides the collyrium in the eyes. She wore long garland of flowers. She applied sandal-paste on her body and than adored Uddhava who was seated on the gem-studded lion throne. At that point of time the complexion of the body of Radha resembled that of. the molten gold and her lustre exceeded hundreds of moons. She was surrounded by a hundred crores of cowherdesses, thereafter, she delightfully adored Uddhava who was seated on the gem-studded lion-throne.

## \|\| 93.75-78 \|\|

*rādhikovāca satyamāyāsyati hariḥ satyaṃ niṣkapaṭaṃ vada \|*  
*vada tathyaṃ bhayaṃ tyaktvā satyaṃ brūhi susaṃsadi \|\| 75 \|\|*

*varaṃ kūpaśatādvāpī varaṃ vāpīśatātkratuḥ \|*  
*varaṃ kratuśatātputraḥ satyaṃ putraśatātkila \|\| 76 \|\|*

*na hi satyātparo dharmo nānṛtātpātakaṃ param \|\| 77 \|\|*

*uddhava uvāca satyamāyāsyati hariḥ satyaṃ drakṣyasi sundari \|*  
*dhruvaṃ tyakṣyasi saṃtāpaṃ dṛṣṭvā candramukhaṃ hareḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

75-78. Radhika said – Will Krishna really come back you tell me truthfully, he is deprived of deceit-fullness, you speak out the truth in this vast assembly because the step-well is better than a hundred wells and a yajna is better than a hundred step wells, a son is better than a hundred yajnas and truthfulness is better than a hundred sons. There is no sin greater than the falsehood. Uddhava said – О beautiful one, the lord would surely come and you would truthfully meet him and your suffering would come to an end at the sight of the lotus-like face of lord.

## \|\| 93.79 \|\|

*maddarśanānmahābhāge gataste virahajvaraḥ \|*  
*nānābhogasukhaṃ bhuktvā tyaja cintāṃ duratyayām \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. O virtuous one, the pain of separation from which you had been suffering has disappeared with my meeting you, you shed away all the worries which are always troublesome and enjoy all the pleasures of life.

## \|\| 93.80-81 \|\|

*ahaṃ prasthāpayāsyāmi gatvā madhupurīṃ harim \|*  
*vidhāya tatprabodhaṃ ca kāryamanyatkariṣyati \|\| 80 \|\|*

*vidāyaṃ kuru me mātaryāsyāmi harisaṃnidhim \|*  
*sarvaṃ taṃ kathayiṣyāmi tvadvṛttāntaṃ yathocitam \|\| 81 \|\|*

80-81. I am returning to Mathura and shall surely send the lord back to Gokula. He would complete all the unfinished tasks. О mother, let me take leave of I shall go to the lord and reaching there, I shall to him convey news about you.

## \|\| 93.82-83 \|\|

*rādhikovāca gamiṣyasi yadā vatsa mathurāṃ sumanoharām \|*  
*śrṛṇu duḥkhakathāṃ kāṃcittiṣṭha vatsa sthirobhava \|\| 82 \|\|*

*māṃ vismṛto na bhavasi virahajvarakātarām \|*  
*kathayiṣya si matkāntaṃ dhruvaṃ prasthāpayiṣyasi \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. Radhika said – О son, in case you have to go to the pleasant city of Mathura, then you stay here for some more time and listen to my painful story. I am badly suffering from the pain of separation. Therefore, you do not forget me reaching there. You tell my beloved everything and send him here without fail.

## \|\| 93.84-85 \|\|

*nārīṇāṃ manaso vārtāṃ ko vā jānāti paṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*kiṃcicchāstrānusāreṇa prakaroti nirūpaṇam \|\| 84 \|\|*

*vedā vaktuṃ na śaktāśca śāstrāṇi kiṃ vadanti ca \|*  
*katha yiṣyāmi tvāṃ sarvaṃ putra kṛṣṇaṃ ca vakṣyasi \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. Otherwise, who can reach the mind of a damsel, a learned person can create anything according to the scriptures but when even the Vedas are unable to recite his glory then what could the scriptures do. Therefore, О son, I shall speak everything to you which you should convey to lord Krishna.

## \|\| 93.86-93 \|\|

*gehe vane na bhedo me paśvādiṣu tathā nṛṣu \|*  
*kiṃ vā jalaṃ kimu svapnamajñānaṃ ca divāniśam \|\| 86 \|\|*

*ātmānaṃ ca na jānāmi caudayaṃ candrasūryayoḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ prāpya harervārtāṃ cetanaṃ me babhūva ha \|\| 87 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇākṛtiṃ ca paśyāmi śrṛṇomi muralīdhvanim \|*  
*kulaṃ lajjāṃ bhayaṃ tyaktvā cintayāmihareḥ padam \|\| 88 \|\|*

*saṃprāpya sarvajagatāmīśvaraṃ prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*na jñānaṃ māyayā tasya jñātvā gopapatermaṃma \|\| 89 \|\|*

*dhyāyante yatpadāmbhojaṃ vedā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ \|*  
*sa bhartsito mayā kīpāddhdi śatyamidaṃ mama \|\| 90 \|\|*

*tatpadāmbhojasevābhirguṇaprastāvato'pi vā \|*  
*tadbhaktyā yatkṣaṇo nīto dhyāto dhyānena pūjayā \|\| 91 \|\|*

*tatrāpi maṅgalaṃ sarvaṃ harṣamāyurvyaṃvasthitam \|*  
*vighnaṃ ca hṛdi saṃtāpastadvicchede sadoddhava \|\| 92 \|\|*

*iti śrībrahmo mahāo nāradanāo śrīkṛṣmajanmakho uttaro rādhoddhavasaṃo trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

86-93. Because of the pain of separation I am unable to distinguish between the human being and an animal between the water and the earth or the day or night, I have indeed forgotten myself and am unmindful of the rising of the sun and the moon or their setting. I have regained consciousness simply in order to receive the news about the welfare of the lord, during all the time 1 only visualise the form of the lord or to listen to the sweet notes of his flute. Discarding the traditional shame and fear, I always get engrossed at the lotus-like feet of the lord. No doubt I achieved the lord of universe who is beyond Prakriti but I could not achieve the true knowledge because of his illusion. I understood him only as the lord of cowherdesses whose feet are adored by Brahma and all other gods beside the Vedas. I denounced him in anger. This fact is paining my heart like a thorn. О Uddhava, the time I spent while serving at his lotus-like feet, reciting his glory and adoring him is considered to be quite auspicious and delightful moment and my entire life is dedicated to him, now in separation from him my heart always remains painful. Because of this, I shall not have the fortune to enjoy his love sport-in the secluded place like this.

## \|\| 93.94-100 \|\|

*vṛndāvanaṃ na yāsyāmi tatsaṅge punaruddhava \|*  
*candanaṃ vā na dāsyāmi nandanandanavakṣasi \|\| 94 \|\|*

*mālāṃ tasmai na dāsyāmi na drakṣyāmi mukhāmbujam \|*  
*mālatīnāṃ ketakīnāṃ campakānāṃ ca kānanam \|\| 95 \|\|*

*punareva na yāsyāmi sundaraṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*harisaṅge na yāsyāmi ramyaṃ candranakānanam \|\| 96 \|\|*

*punareva na yāsyāmi malayaṃ ratnamandiram \|*  
*mādhavīnāṃ vanaṃ ramyaṃ rahasyaṃ madhukānanam \|\| 97 \|\|*

*śrīkhaṇḍakānanaṃ ramyaṃ svacchaṃ candrasarovaram \|*  
*vispandakaṃ suravanaṃ nandanaṃ puṣpabhadrakam \|\| 98 \|\|*

*bhadrakaṃ hariṇāṃ sārdhaṃ na yāsyāmi punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*kva sā ramyā vikasitā mādhave mādhavīlatā \|\| 99 \|\|*

*kva gatā mādhavī rātriḥ kva madhuḥ kvāpi mādhavaḥ \|*  
*isyevamuktvā sā rādhā dhyātvā kṛṣṇapadāmbujam \|*  
*punarmurcchāṃ ca saṃprapya rūdatī pulakānvitā \|\| 100 \|\|*

94-100. I shall not be able to go to the Vrindavana any more. I would not be able to plaster his body with sandal-paste nor would I be able to adorn his neck with garland of flowers nor would I be able to have a look at his lotus-like face. I would not be able to visit the jasmine, the lilly and campaka flowers forests or the Rasamandala any further. The visit of the charming sandal-wood forest with Hari, the peaks of gems of the Malaya mountain, the Madhavf forest, the Madhuvana which is quite secretive and charming, the Khanda-vana, the beautiful and charming Chandrasarovara, the Nandana-vana of the gods, the forest of Puspabhadraka and Bhadraka cannot be visited by me any further with out company of the lord. Where is the beautiful Madhavi creepers laiden with flowers in the spring season? Where is the night of the spring season. Where is the spring season? And Alas, where has Madhava gone? Thus speaking Radha started devoting her mind at the lotus-like feet of the lord, she felt emotional and fainted while crying.

4-6. This entire universe has been purified with you, this earth has been sanctified with the dust of your feet, your face is quite auspicious, adorable in the holy places, spotless, bestows the devotion of the lord, the form of welfare and removes all the obstructions.

## \|\| 94.7-8 \|\|

*tvameva rādhā tvaṃ kṛṣṇastvaṃ pumānprakṛtiḥ parā \|*

7-8. You are Radha, you are Krishna, you are Purusa and you are Prakriti. The Vedas or the Puranas do not differentiate between Radha and Madhava. Thereafter finding Radha in an unconscious condition, the cowherdesses Madhavi spoke to Radha pushing aside Uddhava and standing before Radha.

## \|\| 94.9-12 \|\|

*mādhavyuvāca kiṃ vā corasya kṛṣṇasya rūpaṃ vā veṣamuttamam \|*

9-12. Madhavi said – what is the virtue of lord Krishna, who is the form of a thief, clad in the best of garments, enjoys the best of pleasures, glory, prowess, fortunes and strength, beside the siddhis and the glory what more virtues does he have as compared to you? He a somehow arrived here from somewhere and again disappeared but the cowherds shall still remain there. There is no prince here therefore, О virtuous one, why are you dyeing for the son of Nanda, you protect yourself making all the efforts because there is no one else greater than ones own soul,

## \|\| 94.13-15 \|\|

*dhiktvāṃ rādhe'tinirlajjāṃ tavaiva jīvanaṃ vṛthā \|*

*yatnena cakṣuṣo vā'rhaṃ sakhi saṃcaraṇaṃ kṛru \|\| 14 \|\|*

*antare patibhāvaṃ ca saṃgopya bhāvanaṃ kuru \|*

13-15. Malati said – О Radha, disgrace to your shamelessness and your life has become useless. Presently you are destroying the good name of all the damsels of the universe. All the ladies should keep their moves a secret, because by revealing the same, there is the loss of reputation. Therefore О friend, open your eyes and carefully look with your own eyes, you love anyone keeping the love of the husband as a secret in your heart. О goddess there is no caste between a friend and foe. In the deeds, one becomes a friend.

## \|\| 94.16 \|\|

*śatruḥ kāryavaśenaiva mitraṃ ca karmaṇā bhavet \|*

16\. The intelligent person performs his own deeds because it is of no use spoiling the work of anyone.

## \|\| 94.17 \|\|

*kaḥ kasya vallabho rādhe kaḥ kasyāpriya eva ca \|*

17\. О Radha, who is beloved of whom and who is inimical to whom, people conduct themselves taking both the things into consideration.

## \|\| 94.19-20 \|\|

19-20. Getting you excommunicated from your caste, throwing you in the ocean of grief, stealing away your consciousness, the heartless Krishna has disappeared. О foolish one, then why do you remember him? you shed away this terrific grief and preserve yourself making efforts, because who could be more important than self.

## \|\| 94.21-24 \|\|

*padmāvatyuvāca bhavatā kathitaṃ pūrṇaṃ yamunājalasaṃnidhau \|*

*yadā tvaṃ yamunākūle mukhaṃ vīkṣya hareraho \|*

*punaḥ punastvaṃ saṃvīkṣya tvayā tyaktaṃ ca cetanam \|*

21-24. Padmavati said – О dear, you had yourself spoken on the bank of the river Yamuna that the love of a dull person carries a person too far and with that the women have to suffer a lot. Because no line can be drawn in the lightening and the water, similarly the love of a wicked person is only short lived. Therefore the people who are well-versed in polity have pronounced that the wicked person should never be believed at any time, whenever you looked with a side glance towards Krishna on the bank of Yamuna, you had kept it a secret, because of your consciousness. This is the result of the same and you have disowned your teachers and your relatives discarding their words. Now you always think of Krishna alone. You are unmindful about your food and life.

## \|\| 94.25-26 \|\|

*saṃtataṃ dhyāyase kṛṣṇaṃ nā''hāraṃ jīvanaṃ tathā \|*  
*kva kṛṣṇo mathurāyāṃ ca kvāpi tvaṃ kadalīvane \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tvaṃ yadi tyajasi prāṇānnā''virbhavati so'dhunā \|*  
*kāle drakṣyasi svātmānaṃ yadi rakṣasi sundari \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Lord Krishna is comfortably lodged in Mathura, while you are rotting here in the forest of banana trees. Even if you lay down your life for his sake, he is not going to appear before you. О beautiful one, you save yourself and you will surely meet him in due course of time.

## \|\| 94.27-28 \|\|

*candramukhyuvāca prāktanena śubhaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaṃ ca vibhavaściram \|duḥkhaṃ śoko prāktanena vipatsaṃpacca sāṃpratam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27-28. ChandramukhI said – One achieves pleasure and pain according to one's earlier deeds including the everlasting fortune, the pain, grief, misfortune and the riches, in the land of Bharata which is sought for by all. You would achieve lord. Hari, your beloved as your husband by performing tapas.

## \|\| 94.29-32 \|\|

*tathā'pi pradahedgātraṃ kāmabāṇena sāṃpratam \|*

*śaṃkareṇa pradagdho'bhūtpunareva sa manmathaḥ \|*

*madhuśca mitraśokena prāṇāṃstyaktvā yayauyamam \|*  
*sudhāsindhuśca cenduryo viṣasindhuśca māṃ prati \|\| 31 \|\|*

*suveṣaḥ syājjvaladvahniścandanaṃ tad ghṛtāhutiḥ \|*

29-32. Why are you burning your body with the arrows of passion? How are the moon, the god of love and the spring season, the enemies of the passion? Shiva had burnt the god of love to ashes, Rahu had swallowed the moon and vomited it back and the spring season died with the separation from his friend and arrived in the abode of Yama. The moon who was considered to be the ocean of nectar has turned as the ocean of poison for my friend Radha. The shining garments are like the fire, the sandal-paste serve as the offering in the fire and the fragrant breeze bums the body.

## \|\| 94.33-34 \|\|

*tyaktāhārā mama sakhī paśya śvasiti jīvati \|*

*tannāmasmṛtimātreṇa tadguṇaśravaṇena ca \|*

33-34. Look this friend of mine is lying motionless discarding food and is alive only by breathing, therefore, О son of the Kuru race, you praise your friend Krishna with your mouth again and again. Because the reciting of his name and his virtues are the good news about him and she would be brought back the life.

## \|\| 94.35-43 \|\|

*śaśikalovāca tvaṃ kiṃ mādhavi jānāsi kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram \|*

*dhyāyanti saṃtasaṃ santaḥ pādapadmaṃ surepsitam \|*  
*padmā sarasvatī durgā so'nanto'pi maheśvaraḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*yaṃ na jānanti siddhendra munīndrāṃ manavastathā \|*  
*sarvātmanaḥ kuto rūpaṃ nirguṇasya kuto guṇāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*satya muktaṃ ca satyasya yattadeva yathocitam \|*  
*dhatte bhārāvataraṇe pṛthivyāśca manoharam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sukhamāhlādakaṃ ramyaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|*  
*kimanirvacanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ janamanoharam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāma śubhākṣayam \|*  
*yatpādapadmamadhuraṃ madhu mandākinījalam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*dadhre śirasi bhaktyā ca sarveśaḥ śaṃkaraḥ paraḥ \|*  
*śaśvatkaroti vairāgī tīrthakīrteśca kīrtanam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ nṛtyati bhaktyā ca pañcavaktreṇa gāyati \|*  
*āhāraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ vastraṃ parityajya digambaraḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*brahma jyotiḥ svarūpaṃ ca dhyātvā śubhraṃ sunirmalam \|*
