*śeṣaḥ sanatkumāraśca siddhasaṃghaśya yogavit \|\| 43 \|\|*

35-43. Shashikala said – О Madhavi, the one, whose glory is recited by Brahma and other gods beside the four Vedas, whose lotus-like feet are adored by the gods and the sages and whose glory is beyond the recitation of Kamala, Sarasvati, Durga, Ananta, Maheshvara, the siddhas, the ascetics, Manus; therefore, what do you know about Krishna who is the supreme soul? He is the soul of all, is formless, is without qualities, is form of truth, The form of the lord which has been described is truthful, bestows pleasure, blissful, charming, bestower of grace over the devotees, the abode of divine play, the welfare of all the welfare's, whose beauty excels crores of the gods of love, whose beauty is beyond comparison. The same lord Krishna having the said form has incarnated on earth in order to rid of her of the burden. The water of Mandakini has emerged from the sweat lotus-like feet of the lord, who was accommodated by lord Shiva several in his head and getting detached always devotes his mind reciting his name. He discarding his food, costumes and ornaments remaining unrobed, starts dancing in a movement with devotion and recited the qualities of the lord from all his five faces. Brahma, Shesha, Sanatkumara and the siddhas in groups always meditate upon the divine lustre of the lord and engage themselves tapas for him and spend their lives, who could know about the glory of the same Krishna.

## \|\| 94.44-48 \|\|

*suśīlovāca nirmañchanārhaṃ na bhavettasya kāmaśataṃ śatam \|*  
*candro'śivanīkumāro vā rupeṣu kena gaṇyate \|\| 44 \|\|*

*asaṃkhyeṣu ca viśveṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*  
*munayo manavaḥ siddhā bhaktāḥ santaśca saṃtatam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*dhyāyante yatpadāmbhojaṃ nirguṇasyā''tmanaśca vai \|*  
*vedāḥ stotuṃ na śaktāśca yamīśaṃ ca sarasvatī \|\| 46 \|\|*

*jaḍībhūtā ca bhītā ca stavanena kṣamāṇyetu \|*  
*sahasravaktraḥ stavane kampitaśca nirantaram \|\| 47 \|\|*

*vedānāṃ janako brahmā stotreṇa tasya hīśvaraḥ \|*  
*taṃ satyaṃ nityamīśaṃ ca mādhavī parinindati \|\| 48 \|\|*

44-48. Sushila said – Hundreds of the gods of love cannot be compared with the beauty of Shri Krishna and the moon, Asvinikumaras are of no consequence before his beauty. Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, the gods, the sages, Manus, siddhas and devotees besides the ascetic always adore and meditate upon the feet of the lord Krishna in the innumerable globes. All the four Vedas are unable to recite his glory. The goddess Sarasvati becomes dumb before him and getting nervous she seeks apology from him, the serpent Shesha with a thousand hoods always shakes while offering prayers to him, Brahma the creator of the Vedas is known as a lord because of him. The same lord is being denounced by Madhavi.

## \|\| 94.49-50 \|\|

*apavitrā sabhā bhūtā gopīnāṃ jīvanaṃ vṛthā \|*  
*tāsu puṇyavatī śokaḥ praṇaśyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*yannāmaspṛtimatreṇa koṭijammārjitaṃ sakhi \|*  
*kṛtapāpabhayaṃ śokaḥ praṇaśyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Therefore this assembly has become in auspicious and the life of a cowherdess is of no consequence now. Only Radha is the most virtuous of all who always remains engaged in the love of lord Krishna, with the reciting of whose name the sin of crores of birth gets destroyed, there is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 94.51-52 \|\|

*ratnamālovaca dadhāra vāmahastena śailaṃ govardhanaṃ hariḥ) \|*  
*tataḥ kiṃ taddaśaḥ śaurya jagatāṃ janakasya ca \|\| 51 \|\|*

*śailānāṃ ca sahasraṃ yo bhetuṃ śaktaśca daityarāṭ \|*  
*līlāmātreṇa teṣāṃ ca lakṣaṃ hantu kṣamo hariḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Ratnamala said – Krishna had lifted Govardhana with his left hand but he could add to the glory of the kings because the one who could reduce to pieces thousand of mountains, the same Krishna kills lakhs of demons at a time.

## \|\| 94.53-54 \|\|

*yadaṃśakalayā jātaḥ sūkaro viṣṇurīśvaraḥ \|*  
*vasudhāṃ daśanāgreṇa coddadhāra ca līlayā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*śailānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi yatra santi mahītale \|*  
*daityāśca vā'pyasaṃkhyāśca vīrāḥ śūrāstathaiva ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. Vishnu in the form of a boar incarnated on earth from his amsa and lifted the goddess earth over the tip of his tusks quite playfully, redeeming the earth from the vast ocean, with thousands of mountains and trees, in which innumerable demons dwelt.

## \|\| 94.55 \|\|

*tenaiva karmaṇā tasya na śauryaṃ na ca pauruṣam \|*  
*na yaśāśca praśaṃsā vā sakhi sarvātmanā''tmanā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. О friend, by that deed alone one could asses his prowess, strength, reputation and praise. He happens to be the soul of ail.

## \|\| 94.56-58 \|\|

*pārijātovāca saptadvīpā ca vasudhā saśailavanasāgarā \|*  
*kāñcanībhūmisahitā sarvādhārā manoharā \|\| 56 \|\|*

*sapta svargāśca vividhā brahmalokāvadhi priye \|*  
*vicitrāḥ sundarāścaiva pātālānāṃ ca sapta ca \|\| 57 \|\|*

*etaiḥ parimitaṃ viśvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam \|*  
*mahadviṣṇorlomakūpe tadevaṃ cāṇuvatsthitam \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. Pdrijata said – О dear, the earth is the base of all the seven continents, the forest, the mountains, the oceans, Meru mountain, seven heavens and up to Brahmaloka. Below the earth there are seven nether worlds. The globe comprises of all of them which is created by Brahma. The same Brahma resides in the hair-pits of Maha-Vishnu in a tiny form.

## \|\| 94.59 \|\|

*tasya yāvanti lomāni tāni viśvāni santi ca \|*  
*sa eva ṣoḍaśāṃśaśca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Because the number of globes is equivalent to the number of the hair-pits on the body of Maha-Vishnu. The same Maha-Vishnu is the sixteenth part of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 94.60 \|\|

*tasyaiva kiṃ yaśaḥ śaurcaṃ mahimānamanūpamam \|ghasmarī gopakanyā ca kiṃ vā jānāti mādhavī \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Therefore how could the reputation, the strength and the glory of lord Hari be described? Therefore, cowherdess Madhavi who is a glutton, can never know about him.

## \|\| 94.61 \|\|

*mādhavyuvāca mayā yaduktaṃ na jñātvā mūḍhā jalpanti gopikāḥ \|*  
*uddhava śuṇu me vākyaṃ yanmayā kathitaṃ śubham \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Madhavi said – О Uddhava, these cowherdesses are uselessly speaking without understanding my words. Therefore, you please listen to me whatever I have to say.

## \|\| 94.62 \|\|

*svecchayā saguṇo viṣṇuḥ svecchayā nirguṇobhavet \|*  
*bhuvo bhārāvataraṇe gopaveṣaḥ śiśurvibhuḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Lord Vishnu becomes Saguna according to his own sweet will and with his own sweet will he becomes Nirguna. The same lord, in order to rid the earth of her burden incarnate on the earth in the form of a cowherd.

## \|\| 94.63-66 \|\|

*yadi vedāḥ purāṇāni siddhāḥ santaśca saṃtatam \|*  
*brahmeśaśeṣabhaktāśca na jānanti yamīśvaram \|\| 63 \|\|*

*taṃ kiṃ jānāmi mūḍhā'haṃ ghasmarī gopakanyakā \|*  
*tathā'pi madvacaḥ satyaṃ śrūyatāṃ vatsa tatkṣaṇam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*kimanirvacanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ śauryaṃ yaśo balam \|*  
*vīryaṃ veṣaṃ ca siddhiṃ cāpyanyo vā yo guṇo hareḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*svecchāmayasya tasyaiva saguṇasya ca sāṃpratam \|*  
*kimanirvacanīyaṃ ca vartate tadviśeṣaṇam \|\| 66 \|\|*

63-66. In case the Vedas, the Puranas, the siddhas, the ascetics, the noble souls, Brahma, Shiva, Shesha and his devotees are not aware of his true identity, then how could a foolish cowherdesses like me, who is a glutton, know about him? Still О son, you listen to my truthful words just now. Are all the virtues of the lord including his duties, his strength, reputation, strength ,prowess, costumes, siddhis and all other virtues are beyond description. Lord Krishna who move at will in definite form, can be beyond description? What is the name of the Nirguna supreme soul? What is his form.

## \|\| 94.67-69 \|\|

*nirguṇasya ca viṣṇośca vehahīnasya svātmanaḥ \|*  
*vartate ca kimākhyeyaṃ tasya rūpādikaṃ ca kim \|\| 67 \|\|*

*māṃ nindati mahāmūḍhā na buddhā vacanaṃ mama \|*  
*eṣā jānāti kiṃ mūḍhā taṃ satyaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|\| 68 \|\|*

*jyotiḥ svarūpaṃ paramaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham \|\| 69 \|\|*

67-69. All the foolish cowherdesses are denouncing me without understanding my words. How could this foolish cowherdess know about the lord who is beyond nature, truthful, the form of eternal flame, the supreme soul, the inexplicable lord and the one who takes to a human form in order to grace his devotees.

## \|\| 94.70-72 \|\|

*yatpādapadbhaṃ padmā sā trailokyajananī parā \|*  
*sevate kampitā bhītā dāsīvatsatataṃ bhiyā \|\| 70 \|\|*

*viṣṇumāyā ca prakṛtirmūlarūpā sanātanī \|*  
*brahmasvarūpā paramā bhītā dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

*sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā bhītā ca parameśvarī \|*  
*stotuṃ na śaktā vedāḥ kiṃ stuvanti parameśvaram \|\| 72 \|\|*

70-72. Kamala the spouse of Vishnu who happens to be the mother of the three worlds serves at his feet like a slave getting panicky. He happens to be Vishnumaya, MiilaPrakriti, eternal and the form of Brahma. Still she remains panicky remaining on his right side, Similarly the goddess Sarasvati getting terrified becomes non-pulsed and is unable to recite his glory, then how could the Vedas recite the glory of the lord.

## \|\| 94.73-74 \|\|

*tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā coddhavo bhaktivihvalaḥ \|*  
*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo ruroda ca papāta ca \|\| 73 \|\|*

*mūrcchaṃ saṃprāpya bhakttyā ca dhyātvā taṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*tucchaṃ mene sa cā''tmānaṃ gopīṃ bhaktyā'pyuvāca saḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. On hearing the words of cowherdess, Uddhava was flooded with devotion and he felt emotional in his body. He then started crying and getting fainted, he fell down on the ground. On regaining consciousness he devoted his mind at the lotus-like feet of the lord and considered himself to be of no consequence before the cowherdesses and he spoke to them with devotion.

## \|\| 94.75-76 \|\|

*uddhava uvāca dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ dvīpānāṃ jambudvīpaṃ manauharam \|*  
*yatra bhāratavarṣaṃ ca puṇyadaṃ śubhadaṃ tathā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*vaṇijāṃ ca puśyakṛtaṃ vāṇijyasthalamīpsitam \|*  
*atra kṛtvā supuṇyaṃ ca bhuṅkte'nyatra śubhaṃ phalam \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. Uddhava said – Of all the continents Jambudvipa is quite graceful glorious and pleasant, on which the auspicious land of Bharata is lodged. This is the auspicious place for the traders and is the best place for their auspicious commercial activities, because the merit earned by performing good deeds by anyone in the land of Bharata is enjoyed at another places.

## \|\| 94.77-78 \|\|

*dhanyaṃ bhāratavarṣaṃ tu puṇyadaṃ śubhadaṃ varam \|*  
*gopīpādābjarajasā pūtaṃ paramanirmalam \|\| 77 \|\|*

*tato'pi gopikā dhanyā sānyā yoṣitsu bhārate \|*  
*nityaṃ paśyanti rādhāyāḥ pādapadmaṃ supuṇyadam \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. This land of Bharata has been purified with the dust from the feet of Radha which is quite spotless, graceful, meritorious and auspicious. Even more than that, of all the ladies in the land of Bharata, the cowherdesses are considered quite graceful, who always have the privilege of having an audience with Radha, looking at her lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 94.79-81 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ ca brahmaṇā \|*  
*rādhikāpādapadmasya reṇūnāmupalabdhaye \|\| 79 \|\|*

*golokavāsinī rādhā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā parā \|*  
*tatra śrīdāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā \|\| 80 \|\|*

*ye ye bhaktāśca kṛṣṇasya devā brahmādayastathā \|*  
*rādhāyāścāpi gopīnāṃkarāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 81 \|\|*

79-81. Brahma had performed tapas for sixty thousand years in order to achieve dust of the lotus-like feet of Radha but was unsuccessful. Radha the dweller of a Goloka is dearer to Krishna more than his own life. She had to be born as the daughter of Vrsabhana due to the curse of Shridama, such of the people who are devoted to lord Krishna, are also devoted to Radha, Brahma and other gods do not compare to the sixteen part of cowherdesses.

## \|\| 94.82 \|\|

*kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ vijānāti yogīndraśca maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*rādhā gopyaśca gopāśca golokavāsinaśca ye \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The devotion of lord Krishna is well know to Shiva the lord of the yogis, Radha, cowherdesses, the cowherds and the dwellers of Goloka.

## \|\| 94.83-86 \|\|

*kiṃcitsanatkumāraśca brahmā cedviṣayī tathā \|*  
*kiṃcideva vijānanti siddhā bhaktāśca niścitam \|\| 83 \|\|*

*dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'hamāgato gokulaṃ yataḥ \|*  
*gopikābhayo gurubhyaśca haribhaktiṃ labhe'calām \|\| 84 \|\|*

*mathurāṃ ca na yāsyāmi tīrthakīrteśca kīrtanam \|*  
*śroṣyāmi kiṃkaro bhūtvā gopīnāṃ janmajanmani \|\| 85 \|\|*

*na gopībhyaḥ paro bhakto hareśca paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*yādṛśīṃ lebhiregopyo bhaktiṃ nānye ca tādṛśīm \|\| 86 \|\|*

83-86. Sanatkumara and Brahma also know a little about him. The siddhas and the devotees also known about him. I have been graceful by coming to Gokula. The cowherdesses have served as the teacher to me, as a result of which I have achieved the infallible devotion of lord. I shall not go back to Mathura now. For all future births I shall serve the cowherds and cowherdesses and spend my life reciting the name of Krishna because out of the devotees of lord Krishna, no one could be superior to the cowherdesses. The type of devotion which has been achieved by the cowherdesses has not been achieved by anyone else.

## \|\| 94.87-89 \|\|

*kalāvatyuvāca pitaṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā menā kalāvatī \|*  
*vayaṃ tisro bhaginyaśca bhramāmaḥ pṛthivītale \|\| 87 \|\|*

*dhanyā janakapatnī naḥ sītāmātā pativratā \|*  
*ayonisaṃbhavā rādhā ahaṃ cāyonisaṃbhavā \|\| 88 \|\|*

*rādhā śrīdāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā bhuvi \|*  
*sanatkumāraśāpena vayameva mahītale \|\| 89 \|\|*

87-89. Kalavati said – The manes had three daughters named Dhanya, Mena and Kalavati and all the three of us roam abate on earth according to our sweet will. Out of these three, the chaste Dhanya became the wife of Janaka and the mother of Sita, both myself and Radhika are born without any human contact. Because of the curse of ShridaMa, Radha had to be born as the daughter of Vrsabhana on earth and because of the curse of Sanatkumara,' the three sisters had to be born on earth.

## \|\| 94.90 \|\|

*kṣīrodasāgaraṃ ramyaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ manoharam \|*  
*tisro bhaginyo bhaktyā ca viṣṇuṃdraṣṭuṃ gatā vayam \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Once all the three of us went to Shveta-dvipa located on the ocean of milk with the mind filled with devotion, in order to have an audience with lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 94.91 \|\|

*amyutthānādi na kṛtaṃ kopādasmāñchaśāpa ha \|*  
*sanatkumāro bhagavānyogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. At that point of time Sanatkumara the lord of the yogis also arrived there but all the three of us did not welcome him by standing, which enraged him and he pronounced a curse on us.

## \|\| 94.92 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca mūḍhāstiṣṭhata bhūmau ca punaḥ svargaṃ na yāsyatha \|*  
*martyaprāṇipriyā bhūtvā cāhaṃkāraiṇa haitunā \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Sanatkumara said – О foolish girls, you would be reborn on earth and become the wives of human beings, because of the arrogance displayed by you. You would not be able to go back to the heaven again.

## \|\| 94.93-97 \|\|

*punarvaraṃ ca pratyekaṃ dadau tuṣṭo dviceśvaraḥ \|*  
*viṣṇorvaśasya śailasya himādhārasya kāminī \|\| 93 \|\|*

*iti śrībrahmo mahāo śrīkṛṣmajanmakho utto nāradanāo rādhoddhavasaṃo caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*tasya kanyā mahālakṣmīḥ sītādevī bhaviṣyati \|*  
*vṛṣabhānasya vaiśyasya yogināṃ pravarasya ca \|\| 95 \|\|*

*durvāsasaśca śiṣyasya kaniṣṭhā ca kalāvatī \|*  
*bhaviṣyati priyā sādhvīdvāparānte ca gokule \|\| 96 \|\|*

*kalāvatīsutā rādhā devī golokavāsinī \|*  
*śrīdāmagopaśāpena bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

93-97. Thereafter the sage was somehow pleases and granted boon to all the three of us. He said to Mena you would be born and become the wife of Himalaya from the amsa of Vishnu and you would have a daughter named Parvati. Dhanya would be the wife of Janaka the great ascetic in whose house Lakshmi in the form of Sita would incarnate. At the end of the Dvapara you would be born as Kalavati and become the wife of Vrs abhana, Vaisya and would be known as chaste Kalavati. Radha the dweller of Goloka would be the daughter of Kalavati who would incarnate on earth because of the curse of Shridama. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 94.98 \|\|

*īśo brahmeśaśeṣāṇāṃ bhārāvataraṇena ca \|*  
*āgamiṣyati pṛthavīṃ ca puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Shri Krishna, the lord of Maheshvara, Brahma and Shesha would also incarnate on the land of Bharata in order to rid the earth of her burden.

## \|\| 94.99 \|\|

*kalāvatī vṛṣbhānaḥ kautukāt kanyayā saha \|*  
*jīvanmuktaśca golokaṃ gamiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Thereafter accompanied by her daughter Radha, Vrsabhana and Kalavati would be relieved of the cycle of the birth and death and arrived in Goloka. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 94.100-105 \|\|

*dhanyā ca sītyā sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gamiṣyati \|*  
*menakā yoginī siddhā pārvatyāśca vareṇa ca \|\| 100 \|\|*

*kalpānte viṣṇuloke ca lakṣmīvanmodate ciram \|*  
*vinā vipattyā mahimā keṣāṃ kutra bhaviṣyati \|\| 101 \|\|*

*karmaṇā ca gate duḥkhe prabhaveddurlabhaṃ sukham \|*  
*purā pitaṇāṃ kanyāśca svarmabhogavilāsikāḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

*lakṣmīsamā vareṇāpi viprasya viṣṇudarśanāt \|*  
*karmakṣayaṃ cāpyasmākaṃ babhūva viṣṇudarśanāt \|\| 103 \|\|*

*puṇye tena tīvreṇa kumārasyāpi darśanam \|*  
*śrutaṃ tatra kumārāsyājjñānaṃ paramadurlabham \|\| 104 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ siddhānāṃ jagatāmapi \|*  
*īśvaraḥ paramātmā ca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ nirguṇaśca nirīhaśca paraḥ svecchāmayo varaḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

100-105. Dhanya too would go to Vaikuntha together with Sita. Menaka with the boon of Parvati would be turned into a Siddhayoginl and at the end of kalpa she would proceed to Vishnuloka and reside there delightfully like Lakshmi. Who can achieve glory without facing the painful situation. After facing the difficult situation according to ones own deeds, one achieves the inaccessible pleasures. In earlier times the daughters of the manes enjoyed all the pleasures in the heaven. Because of the boon from Brahma and by at the adoring the feet of lord Vishnu they were treated like Lakshmi. Thereafter having an audience with lord Vishnu or their deeds were destroyed. Because of the grace of same lord, we met Kumara and we achieved the divine knowledge from his mouth. Shri Krishna happens to be the lord of Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, gods, siddhas and the entire universe. He is beyond Prakriti, Nirguna, unattached, of all the best and moves at will.

## \|\| 94.106-110 \|\|

*tulasyuvāca sarvaprāṇiṣu devāśca tiṣṭhantyeva pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*prāṇo viṣṇuśca viṣayī mano brahmā ca cetanā \|\| 106 \|\|*

*prakṛtirbuddhirūpā ca sarvaśaktyadhidevatā \|*  
*jñānasvarūpaḥ śaṃbhuśca svayaṃ dharmaśca pūruṣaḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

*nirguṇaḥ paramātmā ca tadbrahma prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*sa eva kṛṣṇaḥ sākṣī ca karmaṇāṃ jīvināmapi \|\| 108 \|\|*

*bhoktā ca sukhaduḥkhānāṃ jīvastatpratibimbakaḥ \|*  
*cakṣuṣoścandrasūryau ca jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatī \|\| 109 \|\|*

*vasuṃdharā tvaci sadā bāhvoste lokapālakāḥ \|*  
*ātmanaścāpi te sarpe paricārakarūpiṇaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

106-110. Tulasi said – In all the creatures the gods are variously lodged, Vishnu happens to be the life (breathing), Brahma, lord of consciousness and the mind, the goddess Prakriti, control all the strength and intelligence, Shiva controls the eternal knowledge, Dharma himself appears in the form of nobility, lord Krishna who is Nirguna, the supreme soul, eternal Brahman and beyond Prakriti, remains as the witness of all the deeds which are performed by all the people. The jiva happens to be the recitation of the same, the sun and the moon reflect the eyes, Sarasvati resides in the tongue, the earth dwells in the skin and the Lokapalas in the arms.

## \|\| 94.111-113 \|\|

*ātmanyeva priyāste ca sarve gacchanti jīvinaḥ \|*  
*yathā saṃsadi saṃsāre naradeha(va) mivānugāḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

*tasmātsarvātmanā''tmānaṃ bhajanti saṃtataṃ sadā \|*  
*santaśca parayā bhaktyā dhyāyante yogino mudā \|\| 112 \|\|*

*karmiṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣī kutaḥ karma ca gopanam \|*  
*antaryāmī ca kṛṣṇaśca pracāraṃ kurute mudā \|\| 113 \|\|*

111-113. All of them serve the soul in one way or the other. The soul loves them all. As in the assembly of the human beings, the people go to the king, similarly all the Jivas, go to the supreme soul. The yogis meditate upon he lord with great devotion. Krishna happens to be the witness of the deeds of all the people, therefore, who can keep a secret of any deed from him? Lord Krishna who pervades all the people propagates for them.

## \|\| 94.114-115 \|\|

*kālikovāca narā bālāśca vṛddhāśca yuvānastrividhāstathā \|*  
*devādayaśca ce siddhāḥ sarve jānanti taṃ param \|\| 114 \|\|*

*uddhava uvāca sāṃprataṃ mūrcchitāṃ rādhāṃ yukto bodhayituṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*atra yuktiḥ pradhānā tvaṃ tāṃ prabodhaya coddhava \|\| 115 \|\|*

114-115. Kalika said – All the children, the old and young and three types of human beings including the gods and the siddhas know Krishna pretty well. At the present movement, it would be only wise to bring Radhika back to consciousness who is lying fainted. О Uddhava, you therefore do something for that. Bring her back the consciousness.

## \|\| 94.116-118 \|\|

*cetanaṃ kuru kalyāṇi jaganmātarnibodha mām \|*  
*udbhavaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktasya kiṃkarasyāpi kiṃkaram \|\| 116 \|\|*

*prasādaṃ kuru mātarmāṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ punaḥ \|*  
*na svatantraḥ parādhīno yoṣā dārumayī yathā \|\| 117 \|\|*

*yathā vṛṣo vaśībhūto vṛṣavāhasya saṃtatam \|*  
*tathā mātarjagatsarvaṃ jagannāthasya niścitam \|\| 118 \|\|*

116-118. Uddhava said – О virtuous one, О mother of the universe, you regain your consciousness, I happen to be the servant of the devotees of Krishna. Therefore О mother be compassionate on me. I intend to return Mathura. I am controlled by somebody else like the puppet as the bull is controlled by the person who yokes him, similarly I am also controlled by the lord of the universe.

## Chapter 95

## \|\| 95.1-2 \|\|

*atha pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca uddhavasya vacaḥ śrutvā cetanaṃ prāpya rādhikā \|*  
*sā covāca samutthāya ratnasiṃhāsane vare \|\| 1 \|\|*

*uvāca madhuraṃ devī hṛdayena vidūyatā \|*  
*gopībhiḥ saptabhirbhakatyā sevitā śvetacāmaraiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – On hearing the words of Uddhava, Radhika, regained her consciousness, she than occupied the gem-studded lion throne and expressed the pain of her heart with very sweet words. At that point of time, the cowherdesses were serving her moving the white fly-whisks.

## \|\| 95.3-4 \|\|

*rādhikovāca mathurāṃ gacchavatsa tvaṃ māṃca (na) vismara saṃvadā \|*  
*ato'pyadharmo nāstyeva bhavato bhavasāgare \|\| 3 \|\|*

*madīyaṃ vacanaṃ sarvaṃ gatvā kathaya sāṃpratam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramānandaṃ śīghramānaya matprabhum \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Radhika said – О son you go back to Mathura, but don't forget me while enjoying the comforts there, because if you do so there would be no other sin greater than, that in the universe. You go to Mathura and narrate my words to lord Krishna who is all blissful and try to bring him to me.

## \|\| 95.5-8 \|\|

*yoṣijjanmani yoṣitsu saṃprāpya tādṛśaṃ patim \|*  
*bhedo babhūva kasyā vā madanyā kā'pi duḥkhinī \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kiṃ dadāsi prabodhaṃ me nāsti me bodhanocitam \|*  
*niṣphalo dehināṃ deho vinā''tmānaṃ sahoddhava \|\| 6 \|\|*

*saṃprītyā saha saubhāgyaṃ gauravaṃ nityanūtanam \|*  
*atīva durlabhaṃ prema rahasyaṃ navasaṃgamam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*smarāmi manasā śaśvannānyo manasi vartate \|*  
*rātrau nidrāṃ parityajya smaraṇaṃ śokavardhanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. Which one of the woman has faced the separation of such a type of husband in her life? Is there anyone else more grief-stricken than myself? What type of consolation are you providing me? It is no more proper to console me. О Uddhava, without the soul one remains of no consequence. The love with Hari, the fortune, offering of new respect every day, inaccessible love, speaking in seclusion and new physical union are always remembered by me. There is nothing else in my mind. Waking up during the night from sleep, my suffering is increased.

## \|\| 95.9-12 \|\|

*māmuddhara dhruvaṃ vatsa nimagnāṃ śokasāgare \|*  
*jīvābhavapradānena tīrthe snānaphalaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*prabodhituṃ na śaknomi durnivāraṃ ca mānasam \|*  
*cintaye caraṇāmbhojaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tadguṇaṃ mahimānaṃ ca prītiṃ ca premasāgaram \|*  
*smāraṃ smāraṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ mano me na sthiraṃ calam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*jagatāṃ yuvatīnāṃ ca kāsāṃ vā duḥkhamīdṛśam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇabhedaduḥkha ca kā vā jānāti māṃ vinā \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. О son, you will surely redeem me since I am drowning in the ocean of grief. There is no merit greater for a person in the universe than to provide protection to someone. It is greater than the merit of visiting the holy places. My mind is quite difficult to console and I am unable to console it. I always devote my mind at the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna, his virtues reputation, love. Drowning in the ocean of love again and again, my mind does not remain stable and therefore it remains always unstable. But you tell me how many of the damsels had to face this type of grief, without me which one of the damsel could realise the grief of my separation from Krishna.

## \|\| 95.13-14 \|\|

*kiṃ cijjānāti sītā sā'pyahaṃ ca vidhibodhitam \|*  
*matparā duḥkhinī nāsti kāminīṣu jagattraye \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kāvāyāti pratītiṃ me śrutvā ca mānasīṃ vyathām \|*  
*kāsāṃ vā matsamaṃ duḥkhaṃ yuvatīnāṃ sutoddhava \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. This type of grief was known either to Sita or to myself. There is no one else in the three worlds whose mind is so painful as compared to me. Can any woman believe in my pain after looking at me. О son Uddhava, which one of the ladies has faced such a type of grief.

## \|\| 95.15 \|\|

*rādhikāsadṛśī strīṣu na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati \|*  
*duḥkhinī virahātaptā sukhasaubhāgyavarcitā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. There is no one else among the woman who is so badly suffering like Radha, who is suffering from separation from his lord and is devoid of fortune and is completely grief-stricken. There is no one else among the damsels feeling more painful at heart than Radhika.

## \|\| 95.16 \|\|

*saṃprāpya kalpavṛkṣaṃ ca patiṃ ca jagatāṃ patim \|*  
*vañcitā'haṃ vidhātrā ca nirdayena ca pāpinā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. In the universe the husband happens to be kalpavrksa who was achieved by me, but have been deprived of the same because of the cruel destiny.

## \|\| 95.17 \|\|

*jīvanaṃ saphala janma susnigdhaṃ cakṣuṣī manaḥ \|*  
*tatpādapadmavaktrendurūpaveṣapradarśanāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. With the look at his lotus-like feet as well as the face like the moon and his costumes, my life, my birth and my love has been successful.

## \|\| 95.18-19 \|\|

*yannāmaśrutimātreṇa pañca prāṇāḥ praharṣitāḥ \|*  
*smṛtimātrātpraphullyanta ātmā susnigdha eva ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yaśca pasparśa suratau yaśastribhuvanaṣvapi \|*  
*kathā vā saṃpadā vatsa vismarāmi tamīśvaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. With the hearing of whose name all the five pranas become activated and sprout like flowers and the soul is filled with affection, the one who touched me at the time of conjugal pleasure and with that I enjoyed the glory the three worlds. How can I forget such a lord by getting any amount of riches.

## \|\| 95.20-24 \|\|

*trailokyavijayaṃ rūpaṃ guṇameva bibharti yaḥ \|*  
*na nirmito yo vidhinā tenaiva nirmito vidhiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*taṃ vidheśca vidhātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*kalpavṛkṣātparaṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ manoharam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sarveśaṃ sarvabījaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*kayā vā saṃpadā tāta vismarāmi cataṃ patim \|\| 22 \|\|*

*yasya nirmañchanārhaśca na candro na ca manmathaḥ \|*  
*naivāśvinīkumāraśca guṇasābhyaṃ na diśvataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dhyāyante yatpadāmbhojaṃ brahayaśaśeṣasaṃnñakāḥ \|*  
*kayā vā saṃpadā tāta vismarāmi ca taṃ prabhum \|\| 24 \|\|*

20-24. The one who is victorious over the three worlds; is quite virtuous and has been created by Brahma or who happens to be the creator of the Brahma, who is the bestower of all the riches, is more peaceful than kalpavrksa, is the lord of Lakshmi, quite charming the lord of the universe, the seed of all besides bring the supreme soul and the lord. He happens to be my husband. How can 1 forget him by receiving any amount of riches? The one whose beauty cannot be compared with the moon, the god of love and Asvinlkumara or in other worlds, who else is incomparable in the three worlds in so far as this qualities are concerned and whose lotus-like feet are adored by Brahma, Shiva and Shesha, how can I forget such a lord by getting any amount of riches.

## \|\| 95.25-33 \|\|

*svapne paśyanti ye rūpamatulaṃ ca manoharam \|*  
*te'pi sarvaṃ parityajya dhyāyānte tamarniśam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*guṇena śailaḥ salilaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ dravediti \|*  
*mṛtavṛkṣo mukulitaḥ stambhitaśca samīraṇaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sūryaśca jaladhiścaiva sthagito bhaktibhāvataḥ \|*  
*kayā vā saṃpadā putra vismarāmi cataṃ priyam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yadbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ sūryastapati yadbhayāt \|*  
*varṣatīndro dahatyagnirmṛtyuścarati jantuṣu \|\| 28 \|\|*

*yadbhayātphalino vṛkṣāḥ puṣpitāḥ samaye'pi ca \|*  
*samudrāḥ svātmaviṣaye grahāśca munayaḥ surāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*kālasya kālaḥ saṃhartuḥ saṃhartā sraṣṭurīśvaraḥ \|*  
*svādhīnaśca svatantraśca svayamevā''tmasaṃjñakaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kayā vā saṃpadā bhakta vismarāmi ca taṃ prabhum \|*  
*prabodho nāsti tadbhede yena māṃ bodhayedbudhaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*māṃ ca bodhayituṃ śaktā na sāvitrī sarasvatī \|*  
*na vedā na ca vedāṅgāḥ ke vā santaśca ke surāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*sahasravaktro'nantaśca vedānāṃ janako vidhiḥ \|*  
*na śaṃbhunaṃ gaṇeśāśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

25-33. Those who visualise his pleasant form even in dream, they start meditating upon him throughout the day and night continuously disowning everything. By the virtue of whom, the mountains are turned into water and the dry wood becomes fluid, the dried trees, start sprouting and are laiden with flowers, the wind stops and the sun, moon and ocean stand in devotion. О son, how can I forget such a type of husband by getting any amount of riches, Feeling panicky of whom, the wind blows, the sun bums, the clouds, pour rains, the fire bums, the death roams about among the creatures, with the fear of whom the trees sprout timely and the ocean, the planet, the sages and the gods engaged themselves in their respective duties, the one who is the death for time, appears as the destroyer in the form of Shiva and happens to be the lord of Brahma. The one who is independent and himself is the form of the soul, how can I forget such a type of lord by getting any amount of riches. О devotee of the lord, I don't have the knowledge to turn my face from him. No intellectual can console me, Savitri, Sarasvati, Vedas, post-Vedic literature, the ascetics the noble people the gods, the serpent Ananta having a thousand hoods, Brahma the creator of the Vedas, Shiva the teacher of the yogis and Ganesha are unable to console me.

## \|\| 95.34-36 \|\|

*sthitergatiścintanīyā mārgaśūnye kuto gatiḥ \|*  
*kālasādhyaṃ ca sarva ca sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ śubhāśubham \|\| 34 \|\|*

*durnivāraḥ sa kālaśca kālasādhyaṃ jagatsu ca \|*  
*uttiṣṭha mathurāṃ gaccha sukhaṃ vatsa manoharam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vrajavākaṃ parityajya bhavāṃśca gamanotsukaḥ \|*  
*suciraṃ kṛṣṇavicchedo duḥkhāya na sukhāya ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. The one who is visible, his movement could attract some one but the one who is invisible and without any path who can visualise his movement. The good or bad or pleasure or pain are over with the passage of time, all. the elements are controlled by the time, which cannot averted. О son, you get up and go to the city of the Mathura, since you are anxious to go to Mathura. I understand that it is difficult to remain without Krishna, which is always painful. The one who is separated from him, has always to suffer from pain.

## \|\| 95.37 \|\|

*paśya candramukhaṃ tasya janmamṛtyujarāpaham \|*  
*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā ruroda bhṛśamuddhavaḥ rudatīṃ rādhikāṃ dṛṣṭvā bandhuvicchedakātarām \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Reaching there you will meet the moon-faced Krishna whose sight removes birth, death and old age. At these words of Radhika and finding her suffering from the pain of the separation from Kysna, Uddhava cried aloud.

## Chapter 96

## \|\| 96.1-2 \|\|

*atha ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gamanonmukhamuddhavam \|*  
*nataṃ rādhāpadāmbhoje śirasā pulakāñcitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*uvāca mādhavī gopī rudatī premavihvalā \|*  
*bhaktaṃ rudantamucchaiśca rādhāvicchedakātaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Uddhava was ready to proceed to Mathura but was feeling upset and had fallen on the lotus-like feet of Radha. He was filled with emotion and overwhelmed with the separation from Radha and was crying aloud. At that movement the cowherdesses Madhavi, with her mind filled with love spoke to him while weeping.

## \|\| 96.3-5 \|\|

*mādhavyuvāca uddhava śṛṇu vakṣyāmi kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha yathocitam \|*  
*nigūḍhaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ yatte manasi vāñchitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sudurlabhaṃ purāṇeṣu vedeṣu gopanīyakam \|*  
*praśnaṃ kuru mahābhāga rādhikāṃ trijagatprasūm \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ityuktvā sā ca gopīśā samuvāsa musaṃsadi \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ śāntāmuddhavaścāpi rādhikām \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Madhavi said – О Uddhava, in case you think it proper you wait for while, I shall extend to you the deep knowledge which is occupying your mind. О virtuous one, you put a question to Radha who happens to be the mother of the three worlds. The same is inaccessible in the Vedas and the Puranas besides being secretive. Thus speaking the foremost of the cowherdesses took her seat in the assembly. Thereafter Radhika with a peaceful mind spoke sweet words to Uddhava.

## \|\| 96.6 \|\|

*uddhava\_uvāca ekākī bhavamāyāti yātyekākī punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*prāṇī karmānurodhena svakarmaphalabhukpumān \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Uddhava said – A person arrives in the universe alone and departs alone from the universe, A creature or a person has to face the reward of his deeds performed by him earlier.

## \|\| 96.7 \|\|

*karmaṇā jāyate jantuḥ karmaṇauva pralīyate \|*  
*sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ karmaṇaivābhipadyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. A person takes his birth because of his deeds and disappears from the universe because of his deeds. He achieves the pleasure, pain, fear, grief and everything else because of his deeds.

## \|\| 96.8-11 \|\|

*janturbhogāvaśeṣeṇa bhogaṃ bhuṅkte bhaveṣu ca \|*  
*punaśca karmaṇo bhogātsamāyāti ca yāti ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ratnādikaṃ ca yatkicinmahyaṃ dattaṃ tvayā sati \|*  
*mayā sārdha na yātyeva tena me kiṃ prayojanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*bhavābthitāraṇe devi bhavatī taraṇirvarā \|*  
*karṇadhāraḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ pārakārakaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kiṃcidyānaṃ dehi mahyaṃ bhavābdhipārakāraṇam \|*  
*prāpya prasātaṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ kṛṣmamūlakam \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. When the enjoyments are left out a person is born again in the universe and faces all the enjoyment. He arrives in the universe because of his deeds and goes back because of his deeds, therefore О chaste lady, whatever gems you have given to me cannot accompany me to the heaven. Therefore they are of no used to me. О goddess you are like the beautiful boat to cross the ocean of the universe. Lord Krishna also makes other to cross over the ocean of universe. He himself the sailor. Therefore, you bestow me the gift by which I should be able to cross the ocean of the universe. After receiving the gratification I shall go to Mathura to meet Krishna.

## \|\| 96.12 \|\|

*yāṃ yāṃ kālagatiṃ mātaḥ surāṇāṃ ca nṛṇāmapi \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ brahmalokasya tadūrdhvasya ca tāṃ vada \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О mother, you kindly let me know the movement of time for the gods, the human beings, ancestors and the Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 96.13 \|\|

*tāmeva dustarāṃ ghorāṃ tīrtvā yāmi hareḥ padam \|*  
*evaṃbhūtamupāyaṃ ca dehi me kamalālaye \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Lotus faced one you spell out a remedy for me by which I should be able to cross the movement of the time and achieve the abode of the lord.

## \|\| 96.14 \|\|

*dūrato yatpadāmbhojaṃ dhyāyante ca divāniśam \|*  
*devā brahmeśaśeṣādyāstvaṃ tadvakṣaḥ sthalasthitā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Because you reside in the heart of the one whose lotus-like feet are adored by Brahma, Shiva, Shesha and gods from a distance and meditate upon him through out the day and night.

## \|\| 96.15 \|\|

*uddhavasya vacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa kamalālayā \|*  
*vāsasā netranīraṃ ca saṃbhārjya tamuvāca sā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. On hearing the words of Uddhava, lotus face Radhika smiled, wiping out her tears with a cloth, she started speaking.

## \|\| 96.16 \|\|

*rādhovāca mādhavīvacanenaiva karoṣi praśnamuddhava \|*  
*strījātirabalā loke kiṃ vā jñānaṃ dadāmi te \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Radhika said – О Uddhava, you have put up this question at the instance of MadhavL First of all you tell me that the ladies are considered to be quite delicate, ones therefore what type of knowledge can I impart to you?

## \|\| 96.17 \|\|

*śuddhāṃ kālagatiṃ vatsa jānāti bhagavānhariḥ \|*  
*brahma maheśaḥ śeṣaśca vedāścatvāra eva ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. О son, the spotless movement of the time is known only to lord Krishna, besides Brahma, Shiva, Shesha and the Vedas.

## \|\| 96.18-19 \|\|

*kiṃcidvedānusāreṇa santo jānanti putraka \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ kuṣṇavaktreṇa goloke rāsamaṇ̈ḍale \|\| 18 \|\|*

*goloke cāpi vaikuṇṭhe brahmaloke ca sāṃpratam \|*  
*yā ca dṛṣṭā kālagatistāmeva kathayāmi te \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. О son, according to the Vedas, the noble people also are aware of the same to some extent. Now I am going to tell you something which I had heard from the mouth of lord Krishna in the Rasamandala of the Goloka. I have also witnessed the same in the Goloka, Vaikuntha and Brahmaloka, the same Kdla-cakra (movement of lime), is being spelt out by me, you listen to it.

## \|\| 96.20-23 \|\|

*nṛṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ devānāṃ brahmalokādikasya ca \|*  
*bahilrokasya brahmāṇḍātpātālānāṃ ca niścitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*duratyayāṃ kālagatiṃ yenopāyena paṇḍitāḥ \|*  
*nistaranti budhaśreṣṭha kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 21 \|\|*

*bhajanti jagatāṃ nāthaṃ kālakālaṃ jagadgurum \|*  
*nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sadyaḥ patati deho'yaṃ vinā yena sadātmanā \|*  
*taṃ niṣevya kālagatiṃ talatyeva hi kevalam \|\| 23 \|\|*

20-23. О best of the friend, I am going to narrate to you the movement of time which influences the humans, ancestors, Brahmaloka, nether worlds, the globe and the people who live beyond them. You listen to me. The great lord who is meditated upon by the intellectuals who happen to be the lord of the universe, who happens to be the killer of the time, the teacher of the universe, devoid of gunas unattached and who happens to be the soul of all, without whom the bodies are destroyed, one can cross the movement of the time only be serving the great lord.

## \|\| 96.24 \|\|

*āyurharati sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ ravireva ca \|*  
*śrīhareḥ śuddhabhaktānāṃ satāṃ puṇyavatāṃ vinā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Except the people with great merit and the spotless devotees of lord Krishna, the life of all the creatures, is shortened by Surya.

## \|\| 96.25-27 \|\|

*vidhermānasikānputrāṃścaturaḥ paśya putraka \|*  
*sanakādīnbhāgavatānyeṣāṃ ca susthiraṃ vamaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*rudrādyānvayasā nityāñjñātināṃ ca gurorgurūn \|*  
*bālānanupanītāṃśca pañcavarṣaśiśūnyathā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*amyantare mahāsphītānsasmitāṃśca digambarān \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇadhyānapūtāśca tīrthapūtāṃśca vaiṣṇavān \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. As for example you look at the four mind-bom sons of Brahma named Sanaka and others. Their age remains stable, they always remains of five years' old, without yajnopavita like the children and in the same form they happen to be the teachers of eleven Rudras, twelve Adityas and the great intellectuals. They are spotless from inside and their faces always wear the serene smile, they remain without garments and are sanctified with the reciting of the name of Krishna, They are devoted to Vishnu and purify even the holy places.

## \|\| 96.28 \|\|

*vedavedāṅgaśāstrāṇāṃ cintāhīnānpraphullitān \|*  
*bhaktyā divāniśaṃ śaśvaddharibhāvena tatparān \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. They are free from the worries of, Vedas, post-Vedic literature and scriptures. Their faces are always shining and they recite the name of Hari through out the day and night.

## \|\| 96.29-31 \|\|

*bāhyapūjāvihīnāṃśca pūtānmānasikāṃstathā \|*  
*mṛtyuñjayānmahābhāgānkālavyālajitastathā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sanakaṃ ca sanandaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca sanātanam \|*  
*paraṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca ye smaranti ca sarvaśaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tīrthasnānaphalaṃ labdhvā mucyate kṛtapātakāt \|*  
*haribhaktirbhavetteṣāṃ haridāsyaṃ labhanti ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. They are unconcerned with the adoration of Brahman. They are purified at heart. They have over-come, the death. They are immensely virtuous and over-powered Stirya, who is the cause of death. They are known by the names of Sanaka, Sanandana and Sanatkumara, those who recite their names regularly, all their sins are removed and they achieve the merit of having the bath at the holy places. They ultimately achieved the devotion of lord Hari and slavehood of the lord.

## \|\| 96.32-34 \|\|

*mṛkaṇḍubālakaṃ paśya karmaṇā ca dvijottamam \|*  
*daśavarṣāyuṣaṃ tīvraṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*harisevanataḥ paścātsaptakalpāntajīvinam \|*  
*voḍhuṃ pañcaśikhaṃ paśya lomaśaṃ cā''suriṃ tathā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sarvakarmavihīnaṃ ca harisevanatatparam \|*  
*śatakalpāyuṣaṃ caiva dhyāyamānaṃ hareḥ padam \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. You look at Markandeya the son of sage Mrkandu who has achieved the Brahmanhood by means of his good deeds and being illustrious and having divine lustre, he at the age of ten years, by adoring the lord achieved the life of seven kalpas. Than look at Vodhu, Pancasikha, Lomasa and Asuri. All of them having been freed from the deeds, they devote them-selves exclusively. They enjoy the age of a hundred kalpas, they always remain devoted at the feet of lord Hari.

## \|\| 96.35-36 \|\|

*jamadagneḥ sutaṃ paśya rāmaṃ taṃ cirajīvinam \|*  
*hanumantaṃ baliṃ vyāsamaśvatthāmānameva ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vibhīṣaṇaṃ kṛpaṃ vipraṃ jāmbavantaṃ ca bhallukam \|*  
*haribhāvanayā caite śuddhāḥ sucirajīvinaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. Now you look at Parashurama the son of Jamadagni, Hanuman, Bali, Vyasa, Ashvatthama, Vibhlsana, Krpacarya and Jambavan. They were sanctified because of their devotion at the feet of Hari.

## \|\| 96.37-42 \|\|

*siddhendreṣu munīndreṣu nareṣvanyeṣu coddhava \|*  
*haribhāvanaśuddhāśca sarve te cirajīvinaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*prahlādaṃ paśya daityeṣu hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutam \|*  
*haridviṣo durantasya haribhāvanatatparam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*cirāyuṣaṃ kālajitaṃ paśyānyaṃ cāpyasaṃkhyakam \|*  
*anekajanmatapasā labdhvā janma ca bhārate \|\| 39 \|\|*

*ye hariṃ taṃ na sevante te mūḍhāḥ kṛtapāpinaḥ \|*  
*vāsudevaṃ parityajya viṣaye nirato janaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tyaktvā'mṛtaṃ mahāmūḍho viṣaṃ bhuṅkte nijecchayā \|*  
*kasya strī kasya vā putraḥ kasya vā bāndhavāstathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*kaḥ kasya bandhurvipadi śrīkṛṣṇena vinā bhuvi \|*  
*tasmātsantaḥ sadā kṛṣṇaṃ bhajantyeva divāniśam \|\| 42 \|\|*

37-42. О Uddhava, you have a look at siddhas the sages and the devotees of Hari among the humans who always remain devoted at the feet of the lord with spotless mind and enjoy the long life. You look at Prahlada the son of Hiranyakasipu who was always inimical to the gods. He also remained devoted to lord Hari and achieved long life and conquered the movement of time. There are innumerable other such people also. Therefore as a result of performing great tapas for several births, one is born on the auspicious land of Bharata. Those who don’t serve the lord they are foolish and sinners. Leaving Vasudeva, whosoever involves himself in the worldly pleasures and is considered to be a great fool. He willingly leaving aside the nectar, consumes the poison. In the universe who is the wife of whom, who is the son of whom and who is the brother of whom? In the universe when one is over-powered with misfortune who help him except lord Krishna? This is the reason while why the noble people recite the name of Krishna throughout the day and night.

## \|\| 96.43-45 \|\|

*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ sarvaharaṃ param \|*  
*kālasya taraṇopāyaṃ bhajanaṃ paramātmanaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*ānandanandanasyaiva paripūrṇatamasya ca \|*  
*śṛṇu kālagatiṃ vatsa madīyajñānagocarām \|\| 44 \|\|*

*narāṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ cāpi brahmaṇaḥ \|*  
*nāgānāṃ rākṣasādīnāṃ tatpareṣāṃ ca putraka \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. Lord Krishna is the destroyer of the birth, death, old age and ailment, beside removing all the griefs. Only by reciting the name of Shri Krishna, the supreme soul who is blissful, one can over-come the time or death. О son, you listen to me I am going to tell you about the life of the humans, the ancestors, the gods, Brahma, Nagas, Raks asas and others.

## \|\| 96.46-54 \|\|

*kathayāmi nigūḍhārthaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya \|*  
*sarvasmācca paraṃ sthānaṃ sarvādhāro mahānvirāṭ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*yasya lomasu viśvāni cāsaṃkhyāni ca tāni ca \|*  
*sarvasmācca paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ paramāṇuṃ niśāmaya \|\| 47 \|\|*

*kālārambhātmakaṃ sarvamanūraṃ paramīpsitam \|*  
*caramaḥ sadviśeṣāṇāmaneko'saṃyutaḥ sadā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*paramāṇuḥ sa vijñeyo nṛpāmaikyabhramo yataḥ \|*  
*paramāṇudvayenāṇustrasareṇustu te trayaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*trasareṇutrikeṇāpi truṭiruktā manīṣibhiḥ \|*

46-54. I am revealing to you a deep secret, you listen to me attentively. The great Virat is the best abode and base of everyone. Innumerable globes are enshrined in his hair-pits, you listen to me about the smallest of the things called atom. The time starts from the atom alone, the same atom takes the form of all, is beyond discussion, desired the most with distinction multiplies variously and also gets because of separated because of which people it to be one. It is known as the atom or paramdnu with the combination of three anus is produced trasarenu. Three trasarenus make a truti. This has been ordained by the intellectuals. Thereafter a hundred trutis makes a vedha and three vedhas make a lava, three lavas make a nimesa and three nimesa make a ksana, the five ksanas make a kastha, the ten kasthas make a laghu and fifteen laghus make a danda. You listen to its measure. A sear of water should be placed in a vase equal of six palas with the hole made by four fingers with the wire of gold. Till such time it remains submerged in the water, the same is called danda. Similarly two dandas make a mahiirta and sixty danda make a tithi. Its eighth part has been described as a prahara. Similarly, four praharas make a day and four praharas make a night.

57-67. The intellectuals have described five types of years known as Samvatsara, Pravatsara, Ilavatsara, Anuvatsara and Vatsara. The people who are well-versed in the signs of time or well-aware about the same. О Uddhava, the twelve months make a year known as Vaisakha, Jyestha, Asadha, Sravana, Bhadrapada, Asvina, Kartika, Margas'Trsa, Pausa, Magha, Phalguna and Caitra. Caitra happens to be the last month of the year, the Caitra and Vaisakha months represent the spring season, the Jyestha and Asadha represent the summer season, Havana and Bhadrapada represents the rainy search, Ashvina and Kartika represent the winter season, Margaslrsa and Paus a represent the autumn and Magha and Phalguna represent the cold season. There are two half years known as Uttarayana and Daksinayana. Both of them combined comprise of a year. The period from the month of Magha to Asadha are treated to be Uttarйуana while the period from Sravana to Pausa month is treated as Daks inayana. The span of night increase from the mouth Sravana up to the month of Pausa, the people well-versed in the Vedas have described the bright fortnight from Pratipada to the full moon day as the bright fortnight and from the first day after the full moon to the moonless night as the dark fortnight. The days are counted from Pratipada, Dvitlya, Trtlya, Caturthi, Pancaml, Sasthi, Saptami, Astami, Navaml, Dasaml, EMdasl, Dvadasi, Trayodasl, Caturdasi and Amavasya (moonless day).

68-73. There are twenty eight Naksatras, including Ashvini, Bharani, KrttiM, Rohini, Mrgasira, Ardra, Punarvasu, Pusya, As'lesa, Magha, Purvdphalguni, Uttaraphalgunl, Hasta, Chitra, Svati, Visakha, Anuradha, Jyestha, Mula, Piirvas adha, Uttarasadha, Sravana, Abhijit, Dhanistha, Satabhisd, Purvabhadrapada, Uttara-bhadrapada and Revati. These twenty eight constellation are believed to the wives of the moon and the moon spent the time with them one by one. Though the Vedas only twenty seven constellations as the spouses of the moon, but still the shadow of Sravana constellation is called Abhijit which makes the total as twenty eight.

74-82. Once in the month of Caitra, the moon spent 'his time enjoying the conjugal pleasure with his beautiful spouse Rohini, at this Sravana was enraged and entrusting the care of the moon to her shadow, she left for the house of her parents. Thereafter at the instance of her father the time was distributed. Thereafter the constellation Abhijit was introduced. О son, I have heard about these constellation from the mouth of Krishna tit the mountain of hundred peaks, who always used to move around along with the tithis. Now you listen from me the names of the yogas which are Viskambha, Prlti, Ayusman, Saubhagya, Shobana, Atiganda, Sukarma, Dhrti, Siila, Ganda, Vrddhi, Dhruva, Vyaghata, Hars ana, Vajra, Siddhis, Vyatlpata, Variyan, Parigha, Shiva, Sadhya, Subha, Sukra, Brahmandra and Vaidhrti. The names of the karanas are Bava, Valava, Kaulava, Taitila, Gara, Vanija, Visti, Sakuni, Catuspada, Naga and Kimstughna.

83-84. The months of the ancestors are strictly like those of the humans. The bright fortnight is the day of the ancestors, while the dark fortnight is considered to be their nights. Similarly, the years of the gods as expectedly like those of the humans. The period of Uttarayana is considered to be their day and the period of Daksinayana is considered to be their night. Seventy one divine yugas make a manvantara.

85-86. The age of Indra is exactly like that of Manu which has been described as twenty five thousand and five hundred years. The sun rays do not reach Brahmaloka. The people of Brahmaloka do not know about the day and night after the fall of Indra.

## \|\| 96.87-92 \|\|

*dinaṃ ca tejasā dīptaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*naktaṃ tejovihīnaṃ ca harau ca mandiraṃ gate \|\| 92 \|\|*

87-92. Like the movement of the human Brahma too has the movement, who falls. Two palas make a danda and two dandas make a muhurta and with the fall of Indra, his one day is counted. Thirty such days make a month and twelve months make a year. Thus Brahma enjoys the age of a hundred years. After the fall of Brahma, Nimesa a movement of Krishna is counted, there are no days and nights in the Vaikuntha, because it is beyond the reach of the sun. The dwellers of Vaikuntha remain unaware about the day and night. The place is also beyond the reach of the moon and the planets, with the will of the lord, the sighs of zodiac do not move there, the place is illumined with the lustre of lord Krishna and while moving into his palace, one comes across the night.

93-107. The same movement of time always prevails in Vishnuloka, the lord is the form of the time, the supreme soul and is invisible, the seven neither worlds are also beyond the reach of the sun and the moon, the dwellers of that place are well aware of the same and they developed know how doubt about the same. The gems studded in the hoods of the serpents illumine the place and the fire is lighted in the evening and the night is covered with darkness, the dwellers of that place know about the time with the ringing of the bells. They have similar arrangement as we have on the earth. There are four yugas known as Satyayuga, Treta, Dvapara and Kali. The life of each one of these extepds to twelve thousand divine years. Out of these, Krtayuga has a span of four thousand and eight hundred years. This has been spelt out by the people well-versed in the signs of time. The Satyayuga. has the span of seventeen lakhs and twenty eight thousands years of the humans. О son, the Tretayuga has the span of lakh and six hundred divine years. This has been told by those well-versed in time. This time is equivalent to twelve lakhs, ninety six thousand years all the humans. According to those who are well-versed in the signs of time, Dvapara has the span of too thousand and four hundred divine years which period is equivalent to eight lakhs and sixty four thousand years of humans, this has been ordained by those well-versed in the signs of time. О son, the span of Kaliyuga extends to a thousand and two hundred divine years which is equivalent to four lakhs, thirty two thousand years of human beings, this has been told by those well-versed in the signs of the time. Thereafter, the astrologer have described the period of Caturyugas eighty lakhs and twenty thousand years. О son, I have narrated to you whatever I had heard earlier about the time. Now you move on to Mathura, the place of Hari.

## \|\| 97.8-9 \|\|

Of all the five types of salvation, the devotion of lord Hari happens to be the best. The Brahmanhood, the god-hood of Indra, becoming eternal, the nectar and gaining of siddhis can be achieved but the slavehood of lord Hari is inaccessible.

## \|\| 97.11-15 \|\|

11-15. By reducing the earlier deeds performed during the present birth, ones life becomes successful, Not only he alone, but the lives of thousands of ancestors, the mother, the grandmother, hundreds of ancestors, real brothers relatives, wife, teachers, pupils with the servants surely becomes successful. О son, the deed which is presented to lord Krishna is known to be the best deed. The deed which could please Krishna that is considered to be quite meritorious, whatever deeds are performed with devotion, for the achievement of something, it bestows welfare, becomes graceful and results in pleasure. The vrata, fasting, tapas, speaking of the truth, the devotion and the performing of puja, which is performed for the sake of Krishna, results in the achieving of the slavehood of the lord.

## \|\| 97.16-20 \|\|

*samastapṛthivīdānaṃ pradakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā \|*  
*samastatīrthasnānaṃ ca samastaṃ ca vrataṃ tapaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*samastayajñakaraṇaṃ sarvadānaphalaṃ tathā \|*  
*samastavedavedāṅgapaṭhanaṃ pāṭhanaṃ tathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*bhītasthaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caiva jñānadānaṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*atithīnāṃ pūjanaṃ ca śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*sarvadevārcanaṃ caiva vandanaṃ japanaṃ manoḥ \|*  
*bhojanaṃ vipradevānāṃ puraścaraṇapūrvakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ caiva pitrorbhaktiśca poṣaṇam \|*  
*sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadāsyasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 20 \|\|*

16-20. The giving away of the entire earth in charity, going round the. entire earth in pilgrimage, bathing in all the holy places, performing of all the vratas and tapas, performing of all the yajnas, performing of all the charities, recitation of all the Vedas and the post Vedic literature, providing protection fo the terror-stricken person, imparting of the inaccessible knowledge, adoration of the guests, protection of those who takes shelter, adoration of all the gods, performing of puja and recitation of mantras, offering of food to the Brahmanas and gods with Purascarana the adoration of the teacher and the parents and their maintenance do not weight even one-sixteenth part of the merit one achieves by attaining the slavehood of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 97.21-25 \|\|

*tasmāduddhava yatnena bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam \|*  
*nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 21 \|\|*

*nityaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma prakṛteḥ paramīśvaram \|*  
*paribūrṇatamaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|\| 22 \|\|*

*karmiṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣyapradaṃ nirliptameva ca \|*  
*jyotiḥ svarūpaṃ paramaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvasaṃpatpradaṃ śubham \|*  
*bhaktidaṃ dāsyadaṃ svasya nijasaṃpatpadapradam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*visṛjya jñātibuddhiṃ ca mātsaryamaśubhapradam \|*  
*bhaja taṃ paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ nandanandanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

21-25. Therefore, О Uddhava, you recite the name of Krishna, who is beyond the qualities, free from desire, the supreme soul, the lord, eternal, truthful, eternal Brahman, beyond Prakriti, complete in all respect, spotless, graceful to the devotees, the witness of the deeds, uninvolved, the form of flame, the cause of all the causes, the form of everything, the lord of everything, bestower of all the fortunes, welfare and devotion, besides the slavehood to his feet. Therefore discarding the evil arrogance and all other knowledge one should adore with devotion, the name of son of Nanda who is always blissful.

## \|\| 97.26-27 \|\|

*vede kauthumiśākhāyāṃ tasya nāmnāṃ sahasrakam \|*  
*nandanandananāmoktaṃ kṛtau vighnaṃ sudurlabham \|\| 26 \|\|*

*uddhavaḥ sarvamākarṇya paramaṃ vismayaṃ yayau \|*  
*jñānaṃ saṃprāpya saṃpūrṇa paribūrṇe bhabhūva ha \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. A thousand of his names have been mentioned in the Kauthumi-shakha of the Vedas. By reciting the same, all the obstructions are removed. On hearing all these words Uddhava was immensely surprised and he was filled with all the knowledge.

## \|\| 97.28 \|\|

*svavastraṃ ca gale baddhvā daṇḍavatpraṇanām tām \|*  
*murdhnaḥ keśaiśca tatpādaṃ nibadhya ca punāḥ punaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thereafter Uddhava keeping a cloth round his neck, placed his head over the feet of Radhika and prostrated before her again and again.

## \|\| 97.29 \|\|

*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetraśca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*tadvicchedaśucā premṇa rurodoccaiśca nārada \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О Narada, his entire body was feeling emotions, his eyes were filled with tears because of the devotion. With his mind filled with love and at the very thought of separation from Radha, he started crying aloud.

## \|\| 97.30-32 \|\|

*ruroda rādhā tatpremṇā ruroda ballavīgaṇaḥ \|*  
*uddhavasya galaṃ dhṛtvā sathāpayāmāsa lobhataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*udvavaṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā jṛmbhitaṃ tyaktacetanam \|*  
*śīghrasutthāpayāmāsa rādhikā kṛṣṇamānasam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*cetanaṃ kārayāmāsa jalaṃ dattvā mukhāmbuje \|*  
*śubhāśiṣaṃ ca pradadau vatsa jīveti nārada \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. Than Radha also getting filled with emotions started crying together with all the cowherdesses. Thereafter, Radhika lifted up Uddhava and made him sit. But took Uddhava a deep sigh and became senseless. Finding him so fainted Radhika lifted up Uddhava whose mind was full of devoted to lord Krishna and sprinkling water on his face, he was brought back to senses. О Narada, Radhika then addressed him saying, "O son, you enjoy long life". Thus speaking she bestowed her blessing on him.

## \|\| 97.33 \|\|

*uddhavaścetanāṃ prāpya tamuvāca susaṃsadi \|*  
*rudatīnāṃ ca gopīnāṃ purataḥ paramārthadam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. On regaining consciousness Uddhava spoke the spiritual words to Radhika as well as the cowherdesses who were crying.

## \|\| 97.34 \|\|

*uddhava uvāca dhanyo yaśasyo dvīpānāṃ jambudvīpaḥ sudurlabhaḥ \|*  
*yatra bhāratavarṣa tu sarvaiṣāmīpsitaṃ varam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Uddhava said – Of all the continents Jambudvipa happens to be quite graceful glorious and inaccessible. The auspicious land of Bharata is located there, which is desired by all.

## \|\| 97.35 \|\|

*aho bhāratavarṣe tu puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|*  
*rādhāpādābjasaṃsparśarajaḥ pūtaṃ surepsitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. There is an auspicious Vrindavana, the same Bharatavarsa has been purified with the dust of the feet of Radha, which is desired by all the gods.

## \|\| 97.36 \|\|

*dhanyā mānyā ca pṛthivī treṣu lokeṣu pūjitā \|*  
*rādhāyāstīrthapūtāyāḥ pādābjarajasā varā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Thought the land is quite graceful in the three worlds and also auspicious but in spite of that it has become more sanctified with the dust of the feet of Radha which purify all the holy places.

## \|\| 97.37-40 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi divyāni puṣkare purā \|*  
*brahmaṇā ca tapastaptaṃ vedoktaṃ bhaktipūrvakam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*goloke rādhikākṛṣṇadarśanārthaṃ manorathāt \|*  
*goloke rādhikākṛṣṇo na dṛṣṭaḥ svapnatastadā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*śrutā tenā''kāśavāṇī satyarūpā ca līlayā \|*  
*vārāhe bhārate varṣe puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|\| 39 \|\|*

*rāsotsave mahārāmye tatraiva rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*drakṣyasīti ca devānāṃ madhye sustho na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

37-40. In the earlier times Brahma had performed tapas at Puskara for sixty thousand years according to the Vedas in order to have a look at the lotus-like feet of Radha. But he could not have an audience with Radhika and Krishna, even in dream. Thereafter, he heard of a divine voice from the sky saying. In the Varaha-kalpa, in the land of Bharata, in the forest of Vrindavana, you would have a glance of them in the Rdsamandala. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 97.41 \|\|

*śrutvā ca virato brahmā tapasaḥ svagṛhaṃ gataḥ \|kṛṣṇo dṛṣṭaśca hṛṣṭaśca paripūrṇamanorathaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. On hearing this, Brahma left for his abode getting free from tapas, thereafter in due course of time he had an audience with lord Krishna and he felt delighted with the fulfilment of his desire.

## \|\| 97.42 \|\|

*gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca saphalaṃ janma jīvanam \|*  
*nityaṃ paśyanti te pādapadmaṃ brahmādidurlabham \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The lives of the cowherds and cowherdesses are quite graceful, because they always have a look at the lotus-like feet of Radha.

## \|\| 97.43-44 \|\|

*māninīṃ rādhikāṃ santaḥ sadā sevanti nityaśaḥ \|*  
*yogīndrāśca munīndrāśca siddhendrā vaiṣṇavāstathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*satīṃ puṇyāṃ tīrthapūtāṃ svataḥ śuddhāṃ sudurlabhām \|*  
*sulabhaṃ yatvadāmbhojaṃ brahmādīnāṃ sudurlabham \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. All the ascetics, the noble people, the yogis, the sages, the siddhas and Vaishnavas, serve at the feet of Radha who is quite proud, auspicious, purifies the holy places, is spotless and difficult to access, as a result of their devotion it becomes easy for them to have a look at the lotus-like feet of Radha which is difficult for Brahma and the gods to achieve.

## \|\| 97.45-51 \|\|

*yatpādapadmanakharaṃ kṛtaṃ yāvakacihnitam \|*  
*sarveśvareśvareṇaiva kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|\| 45 \|\|*

*cakāra yasyāḥ pūjāṃ ca stotrarājaṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*śataśṛṅge svayaṃ kṛṣṇo goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 46 \|\|*

*pārijātaprasūnānāmañjaliṃ gandhayandanam \|*  
*dadau dūrvākṣataṃ snigdhaṃ yasyāḥ pādāravindayoḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*triṃśatsahasrakoṭīnāṃ gopīnāmīśvarī ca yā \|*  
*tatṣaṭtriṃśatsakhīnāṃ ca īśvarī rādhikābhidhā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*ye vā dviṣanti nindanti pāpinaśca hasanti ca \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikādevadevīṃ ca rādhikāṃ varām \|\| 49 \|\|*

*brahmahatyāśataṃ te ca labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*tatpāpena ca pacyante kumbhīpāke ca raurave \|\| 50 \|\|*

*taptataile mahāghore dhvānte kīṭe ca yantrake \|*  
*caturdaśendrāvacchinnaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saptabhiḥ saha \|\| 51 \|\|*

45-51. Krishna the supreme soul and the lord of all had painted the nails of her feet and had adored her in Goloka on the mountain of hundred peaks with inaccessibles stotra. He also offered the tender Dnrvd-grass, unbroken rice, fragrance, sandal-paste and bunch of Parijata flowers to her. She happens to be the friend of thirty six cowherdesses and the mistress of thirty thousand cowherdesses. She is known as Radhika who is dearer to Krishna than his life and is adored by the gods, whosoever feel envious of the same Radha or denounce her or finds faults with her, he earns hundreds of Brahmahatyas. There is no doubt about it. Because of that sin such sinners fall into the kumbhlpaka hell where they are thrown in the boiling oil, in pitch darkness and they are crushed like sugar cane up to the seven generations till the time of fourteen Indras.

## \|\| 97.52-53 \|\|

*tataḥ paraṃ ca jāyante janmaikaṃ lokajanmataḥ \|*  
*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca viṣṭhākīṭāśca pāpataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*puṃścalīnāṃ yonikīṭāstadraktamalabhakṣakāḥ \|*  
*malakīṭāśca tanmānavarṣaṃ ca pūyabhakṣakāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Thereafter they are born on earth as the insects of refuse for a thousand divine years. Then they become the germs of the pelvic region of the loose women always consuming refuse, licking puss.

## \|\| 97.54 \|\|

*vede ca kāṇvaśākhāyāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*ityuktavantaṃ taṃ yāntamuvāca rādhikā punaḥ rudantaṃ ca rudantī sā kṛṣṇavicchedakātarā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. This has been ordained by Brahma in the kanvashakha. Thus speaking Uddhava again got ready to depart. At that point of time Radhika who was suffering because of the separation of Krishna spoke to Uddhava who was crying at the same time.

## \|\| 97.55-56 \|\|

*rādhikovāca gaccha vatsa madhupurīṃ sarvaṃ bodhaya mādhavam \|*  
*yathā paśyāmi govindaṃ prayatnena tathā kuru \|\| 55 \|\|*

*niṣphalaṃ ca gataṃ janma gaccha mithyādurāśayā \|*  
*āśā hi paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ nairāśyaṃ paramaṃ sukham \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. Radhika said – О son, you go to Mathura and apprise Krishna about the situation here and you move in such a way that I should be able to meet Govinda, my life would be unsuccessful.

## \|\| 97.57-58 \|\|

*paścādvicintya govindaṃ jīvanmuktā babhūva sā \|*  
*ityuktvā rādhikā tatra ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ punaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*praṇamya tāṃ rudantīṃ ca yaśodābhavanaṃ yayau \|*  
*athoddhave gate rādhā mūrcchāṃ maṃprāpa nārada \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. In the universe the hope is always troublesome and getting detached, from getting all the pleasures of the worlds it bestows the real pleasure. Thereafter he is absorbed in meditation of lord Krishna". Thus speaking Radhika also started sobbing. Uddhava on his part bowed in reverence to the sobbing Radha and left for the place of Yashoda.

## \|\| 97.59-60 \|\|

*tatyāja cetanāṃ śaśvadbabhūva dhyānatatparā \|*  
*paṅkasthe paṅkajadake sajale śayane mune \|\| 59 \|\|*

*gopyastāṃ sthāpayāmāsuḥ sāśrunetrotpalā varāḥ \|*  
*tatsparśamātrācchayanaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ babhūva ha \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. O Narada, after departure of Uddhava, Radha was fainted she was so deeply absorbed in the meditation of Krishna that she lost consciousness. О sage, the cowherdesses then finding her in such a position filled the lotus petals their own tears and placed with them on the bed, on which Radha was made to sleep, but with the very touch of her body, the bed was burnt out.

## \|\| 97.61-62 \|\|

*punaḥ snigdhasthale sthigdhanicole candanāṅkite \|*  
*punastāṃ sthāpayāmāsurvirahajvarakātarām \|\| 61 \|\|*

*sahasā śuṣkatāṃ prāpa sugandhi candanodakam \|*  
*nimeṣeṇa śatayugaṃ tadbabhūvoddhavaṃ vinā \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. Thereafter, the cowherdesses made Radha to sleep on a bed which was covered by a bed-cover and was very soft. They then sprinkled the water mixed with sandal-paste on her but the water with sandal-paste with the touch of the body of Radha, also dried up. Without Uddhava, Radha felt a moment as long as the yugas.

## \|\| 97.63-64 \|\|

*hā hoddhavoddhava hariṃ śīghraṃ gatvā vadeti ca \|*  
*samānaya hariṃ śīghraṃ matprāṇeśvaramityapi \|\| 63 \|\|*

*ityuktavacanāṃ dīnāṃ saṃtāpahṛtacetanām \|*  
*rurudurgopikāḥ sarvā rādhāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi cetanāṃ kārayāmāsurbodhayāmāsuraupsitam \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. She cried O Uddhava, "You speak to Krishna at once and send here the lord of life at once". She thus spoke filled with mental agony, loosing consciousness and a miserable condition. The cowherdesses embraced Radha in such a condition and they also started crying. Thereafter they brought her back to consciousness and consoling her.

## Chapter 98

## \|\| 98.1-3 \|\|

*athāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca athoddhavo yaśodāṃ ca praṇamya tvarayā mudā \|*  
*kharjūrakānanaṃ vāme kṛtvā ca yamunāṃ yayau \|\| 1 \|\|*

*snātvā bhuktvā ca tatraiva jagām mathurāṃ punaḥ \|dadarśa vaṭamūle ca govindaṃ rahasi sthitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*praphullo'pyuddhavaṃ dṛṣṭavā sasmitaṃ tamuvāca saḥ \|*  
*rudantaṃ śokadagdhaṃ ca sāśrunetraṃ ca kātaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narayana said – Uddhava then went to the abode of Yashoda where he bowed in reverence to her delightfully. Thereafter getting leave from her, he moved on. Leaving the palm grove to the left, he reached the bank of Yamuna. He took his bath and food there and than left for Mathura. He found Krishna seated under the shade of the banyan tree. The lord also delightfully looked at Uddhava and smilingly spoke. At that point of time feeling grieved, Uddhava was sobbing and the tears were flowing from his eyes. He felt panicky.

## \|\| 98.4-5 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca āgacchoddhava kalyāṇaṃ rādhā jīvati jīvati \|*  
*kalyāṇayuktā gopyaśca jīvanti virahajvarāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śubhaṃ gopaśiśūnāṃ ca vatsānāṃ ca gavāmapi \|*  
*mātā me putravirahādyaśodā kīdṛśī ca sā \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Shri Krishna said – О Uddhava, come on, is everything all right? "Is Radha alive?" The cowherdesses who are suffering from the pain of separation are still alive? Are the cowherds, the calves and the cows getting on well? What is the condition of my mother Yashoda with the separation from her son.

## \|\| 98.6-9 \|\|

*vada bandho yathārthaṃ tattvāṃ dṛṣṭvā kimuvāca sā \|*  
*tvayoktā jananī kiṃ vā punaḥ sā kimuvāca mām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭaṃ tadyamunākūlaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|*  
*nirjanopavanoghaiśca suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ramyaṃ kuñjakuṭīraudhai ramyaṃ krīḍāsarovaram \|*  
*puṣpodyānaṃ vikasitaṃ saṃkulaṃ ca madhuvrataiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*bhāṇḍīre ca vaṭo dṛṣṭaḥ susnigdho bālakānvitaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭo goṣṭho gavāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ gokulaṃ gokulavrajam \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. О brother, what did they speak on meeting you? You tell me truthfully the words of my mother. And what was the message conveyed by her me. Did you visit the bank of Yamuna, the auspicious Vrindavana the Rasamandala with deserted orchards, the pleasant Kunja cottage and pool of water sport, the flower, orchards surrounded by the black-wasps, the cool shadow of the Bhandlra-vana and the banyan tree surrounded by the cowherd boy, the abode of cows and the cows of Gokula.

## \|\| 98.10 \|\|

*yadi jīvati rādhā sā dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ kimuvāca mām \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ vada he bandhī cā''ndolayati me manaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In case Radha is alive, then what did she speak about me on finding you there? О brother, you tell me all this because my mind is getting anxious.

## \|\| 98.11 \|\|

*kimūcurgopikāḥ sarvāḥ kimucurgopabālakāḥ \|*  
*gopāśca vṛddhāḥ kiṃvocurvayasyā janakasya me \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. What did all the cowherdesses speak? What did the cowherd boys speak? What did the grown up cowherds, my father and friends speak to you.

## \|\| 98.12 \|\|

*balavevasya jananī kimūce rohiṇī satī \|*  
*kimucūraparāstāta bandhuvallabhavallavāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О brother, what did Rohini the mother of Baladeva spoke to you and what did the wives of my other relatives speak to you.

## \|\| 98.13 \|\|

*kiṃ bhuktaṃ kimapūrvaṃ vā dattaṃ mātrā ca rādhayā \|*  
*kīdṛgvākyaṃ sumadhuraṃ saṃbhāṣā kīdṛśīti ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. What food did you take there? what was the astonishing gifts given to you by my mother Yashoda and Radha? How did they talk to you and were their words quite sweet.

## \|\| 98.14 \|\|

*gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca śiśūnāṃ mātureva ca \|*  
*rādhāyāścāpi kīdṛgvā mayi premoddhavādhikam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О Uddhava, how are the cowherdesses, the cowherds, the children, the mother and Radhika, disposed towards me, do they have same old affection for me or not.

## \|\| 98.15-16 \|\|

*māṃ ca smarati mātā me māṃ ca smarati rohiṇī \|*  
*māṃ ca smarati sā rādhā matpremavirahākulā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*māṃ ca smaranti gopyaśca gopāśca gopabālakāḥ \|*  
*bhāṇḍīre vaṭamūle ca bālāḥ krīḍanti māṃ vinā \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Does my mother ever remember me? Does Rohini remember me? Does Radhika remember me? Getting infested with the pain of separation from my love, do the cowherdesses, the cowherd boy remember me? Do the cowherd boys engage themselves in sport in my absence in the Bhandira forest.

## \|\| 98.17 \|\|

*dattamannaṃ brāhmaṇībhiryatra bhuktaṃ sudhopamam \|*  
*pramadābālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ taddṛṣṭaṃ padamīpsitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Did you visit the place where I consumed the nectar-like food offered to me by the Brahmana damsels, with the boys.

## \|\| 98.18 \|\|

*indrayāgasthalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭo govardhano varaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇā ca hṛtā gāvo yatra taddṛṣṭamuttamam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Did you visit the place of yajna of Indra, Govardhana, the best of the mountains and the place where Brahma had stolen away the cows?

## \|\| 98.19 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā śokoktaṃ madhurānvitam \|*  
*uddhavaḥ samuvācedaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On listening to the grief-stricken and-sweet words of Krishna, Uddhava spoke to the eternal lord.

## \|\| 98.20-22 \|\|

*uddhava uvāca yadyadukataṃ tvayā nātha sarvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathepsitam \|*  
*saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ janma kṛtamatraiva bhārate \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭaṃ bhāratasāraṃ ca puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|*  
*tatsāraṃ vrajabhūmau ca suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tatsārabhūtā golokavāsinyo gopikāḥ varāḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭā tatmārabhūtā ca rādhā rāseśvarī parā \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Uddhava said – О lord, whatever have you spoken, I have visited all these places and I have made my life in the land pf Bharata as success. I have visited the auspicious Vrindavana which is the best place in the land of Bharata besides the land of Vraja which is the essence of the same and the charming Rasamandala. The cowherdesses happens to be the essence of the Rasamandala and Radha the foremost of the performers of the divine dance was also seen by me.

## \|\| 98.23-24 \|\|

*kadalīvanamadhye ca nirjane suhṛdasthale \|*  
*paṅkasthe paṅkajadale sajale candanārcite \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śayane'tiviṣaṇṇā sā ratnabhūṣaṇavarjitā \|*  
*atīva malinā kṣīṇā''cchāditā śuklavāsasā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. She was lying in the forest of banana trees on the bed of lotus petals which was soaked with the sandal-paste. She had discarded all the gem-studded ornaments and was lying there in gloom. She looked quite dirty, lean and thin and was clad in the white garments.

## \|\| 98.25 \|\|

*sevitā sakhibhistatra satataṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*kṛśodarī nirāhārā kṣaṇaṃ śvasiti ca kṣaṇam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. fowm fflii уиГцН h fflpiRmi The female friends of Radha were serving her continuously moving the white fly-whisks, she had discarded taking food and her belly had shrunk, she used to breath moment after moment.

## \|\| 98.26-27 \|\|

*kṣaṇaṃ jīvati kiṃ vā sā virahajvarapīḍitā \|*  
*kiṃ vā jalaṃ sthalaṃ kiṃ dā naktaṃ kiṃ vā dinaṃ hare \|\| 26 \|\|*

*naraṃ paśuṃ na jānāti kiṃ paraṃ kimu vānvam \|*  
*bāhajñānavirahitā dhyāyamānā padaṃ tava \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Thus would it be possible for Radha to survive from the fever of separation even for a moment? О lord Hari, she has lost consciousness about the water or the earth, the day or the night, the human or the animals and the relatives and stranger. She is devoid of all the outward knowledge and is solely devoted at your feet.

## \|\| 98.28-30 \|\|

*trelokye yaśasā bhāti tanmṛtyuryaśasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*strīhatyāṃ naiva vāñchanti jñānahīnāśca dasyavaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*gaccha śīghraṃ jagannātha kadalīvanamīpsitam \|*  
*bahirbhūtā na jagatāṃ sā rādhā tvatparāyaṇā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*atīva bhaktā na tyājyā prabhuṇā rakṣitā sadā \|*  
*na hi rādhāparā bhaktā na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Her glory is spread in the universe and as such her death also would be glorious. Even the robbers who are devoid of knowledge do not intend to kill a women then why would you so desire? Therefore, О lord of the universe, you visit the desired forest of banana trees at once. Radha who is extremely devoted to you is not out of the universe. О lord, Radha is protected by you who is a great devotee of yours. There is no devotee comparable to her in the world nor would one ever be.

## \|\| 98.31 \|\|

*manmathaḥ śaṃkarādbhīto bhavāṃśca tatpuraḥsuraḥ \|*  
*bhavadvidhaṃ patiṃ prāpya kāmadagdhā ca rādhikā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The god of love is afraid of Shiva and you happen to be the foremost of Shiva, after achieving a husband like you, Radhika is still burning with passion.

## \|\| 98.32-33 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaparaṃ karma tanna kenāpi vāryate \|*  
*madhurdahati candraśca satataṃ kiraṇena ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

*śaśvatsugandhivāyuścāpyanāthā sarvabīḍitā \|*  
*taptakāñcanavarṇabhā sā'dhunā kajjalopamā \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. Therefore the deeds are the foremost and no one can stop the same. The spring season and the moon with its rays are actually burning her. The blowing of cool breeze is regularly burning her, therefore she is lying there suffering from pain like an orphan. She is having the complexion of the lustre of molten gold but presently the same has turned black.

## \|\| 98.34 \|\|

*suvarṇavarṇakeśī ca vāsoveṣavivarcitā \|*  
*svayaṃ vidhātā tvadbhaktaḥ surāṇāṃ pravaro vibhuḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The complexion of the hair of her head has become golden and she is lying without garments in spite of the face that she is adored like you and Brahma.

## \|\| 98.35 \|\|

*tvadbhaktaḥ śaṃkaro devo yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|*  
*sanatkumārastva dbhakto gaṇeśo jñānitāṃ varaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Shiva the teacher of the yogis also adores here Sanatkumara, Ganesha and the best of intellectuals are also her devotees.

## \|\| 98.36 \|\|

*munīndrāśca katividhāstvadbhaktā dharaṇītale \|*  
*tvadbhaktā yādṛśī rādhā na bhaktādṛśo'paraḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Various types of ascetics and sages are also devoted to her but the type of devotion displayed by Radha is difficult to get anywhere.

## \|\| 98.37-38 \|\|

*dhyāyate yādṛśī rādhā svayaṃ lakṣmīrna tādṛśī \|*  
*harirāyāti cetyevaṃ rādhāgre svīkṛtaṃ mayā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*uddhavasya vacaḥ śrutvā jahāsovāca mādhavaḥ \|*  
*vedoktaṃ kathayāmāsa sahitaṃ satyamuvratam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. The way in which Radhika adored you even Lakshmi can not do so. I have admitted before her that you would reach her. Therefore, О virtuous one, "You move immediately and display the truthfulness of my words." On hearing the words of Uddhava, Madhava smiled and he started speaking words according to the Vedas which were quite truthful.

## \|\| 98.39 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca strīṣu dharmavivāheṣu vṛttyarthe prāṇasaṃkaṭe \|*  
*gavāmarthe brāhmaṇārthe nānṛtaṃ syājjugupsitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Shri Krishna said – It is not a sin to resort to falsehood while cutting jokes with the damsels, in the marriages, for the sake of livelihood, when life is in danger and for the sake of the cows and the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 98.40 \|\|

*tatsvīkāravihīnena kutastvaṃ narakaḥ kutaḥ \|*  
*golokaṃ yāti madbhakto narakaṃ na hi paśyati \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Therefore even if you don’t make your words truthful, there is no harm in the same nor would you have to face the hell. My devotee actually goes to the Goloka and not to the hell.

## \|\| 98.41 \|\|

*tvadaṅgīkārasāphalyaṃ kariṣyāmi tathā'pi ca \|*  
*yāsyāmi svapne ca gokulaṃ virahākulam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. In spite of that I shall honour your words, I shall go to Radhika, the cowherdesses and my mother Yashoda in dream.

## \|\| 98.42-44 \|\|

*ityākaṇarya yayau gehamuddhavaśca mahāyaśāḥ \|*  
*harirjagāma svapne ca gokulaṃ virhākulam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*svapne rādhāṃ samāśvāsya dattvā jñānaṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*saṃtoṣya krīḍayā tāṃ ca gopikāśca yathocitam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*bodhayitvā yaśodāṃ ca stanaṃ pītvā ca nidritām \|*  
*gopāngopaśiśūṃścaiva bodhayitvā yayau punaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. On hearing this the glorious Uddhava went back to his abode. Then lord Krishna reached Gokula which was suffering from separation. In the dream he assured Radhika and bestowed the divine knowledge on her and satisfied the cowherdesses with various types of sports.
