He sucked the breast of Yashoda who was enjoying the deep sleep and assuring the cowherds and the cowherd boys variously, he returned to Mathura,

## Chapter 99

## \|\| 99.1-2 \|\|

*atha navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca etasminnantare gargo vasudevāśramaṃ yayau \|*  
*daṇḍī chatrī ca jaṭilo dīptaśca brahmatejasā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śuklayajñopavītī ca tapasvī saṃyataḥ sadā \|*  
*śukladantaḥ śuklavāsā yadoḥ kulapurohitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – In the meantime, Acarya Garga came to Vasudeva holding a danda and chatra, wearing the matted locks of hair on the head, illumining with lustre, adorned with white yajnopavlta, looking like a mendicant and a disciplined person, having white teeth and clad in white garments, being the family priest of Yadus.

## \|\| 99.3-4 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya devakī praṇanāma ca \|*  
*vasudevaśca bhaktyā ca ratnasihāsanaṃ dadau \|\| 3 \|\|*

*madhuparkaṃ kāmadhenuṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ tathā \|*  
*dattvā gandhaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Finding him there Devaki, Vasudeva suddenly got up and bowed in reverence to him offering him the gem-studded lion throne. Thereafter, they offered madhupurka, Kamadhenu (wish fulfilling cow), the garments, sanctified by fire, fragrance and garland of flowers. They adored him with devotion.

## \|\| 99.5 \|\|

*miṣṭānnaṃ paramānnaṃ ca piṇṭakaṃ madhuraṃ madhu \|*  
*bhojayāmāsa yatnena tāmbūlaṃ vāsitaṃ dadau \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. They served him the sweets, payasam, fried food, the honey and the fragrant betel.

## \|\| 99.6 \|\|

*praṇamya kṛṣṇaṃ manasā sabalaṃ taṃ vilokya ca \|*  
*uvāca vasudevaṃ ca devakīṃ ca pativratām \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Не mentally bowed in reverence to Shri Krishna and Balarama looking at them and then he spoke to Vasudeva and Devaki.

## \|\| 99.7 \|\|

*garga uvāca vasudeva nibodhenaṃ savalaṃ paśya putrakam \|*  
*uvanītocitaṃ śuddhaṃ vayamā sāṃprataṃ varam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Garga said – О Vasudeva, you look at Balabhadra and your son Krishna and realise that the age for performing their yajnopavlta, has arrived.

## \|\| 99.8 \|\|

*vasudeva uvāca śubhakṣaṇaṃ kuru gṛro yadūnāṃ pūjyadaivata \|*  
*upanītocitaṃ śuddhaṃ praśaṃsyaṃ ca satāmapi \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Yashoda said – You are adorable for the race of Yadus, therefore you prescribed an auspicious time for performing the yajnopavlta which should be praised by the noble people.

## \|\| 99.9-10 \|\|

*garga uvāca sarvemyo bāndhavemyo'pi dehyāmantraṇapatrikām \|*  
*saṃbhāraṃ kuru yatnena vasudeva vasupama \|\| 9 \|\|*

*paraśvaḥ subhamevāsti copenatumihārhasi \|*  
*dinaṃ satāmapi mataṃ viśuddhaṃ candratārayoḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Garga said – О Vasudeva, comparable to the Vasus, you send invitation letters to all your relatives and with great effort collect the material required for the ceremony. Day after tomorrow is the auspicious time. On that day the moon and the planets are favourable. The day is adorable by the noble people therefore the yajnopavita can be performed on that day.

## \|\| 99.11-13 \|\|

*gargasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vasudevo vasūpamaḥ \|*  
*prasthāpayāmāsa sarvānbandhūnmaṅgalapatrikām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ghṛtakulyāṃ dugdhakulyāṃ dadhikulyāṃ manoharām \|*  
*madhukulyāṃ guḍakulyāṃ pracakāra samanvitaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*rāśiṃ nānopahārāṇāṃ maṇiratnaṃ suvarṇakam \|*  
*nānālaṃkāravastraṃ ca muktāmāṇikyahīrakam \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. On listening to the words of Acarya Garga, Vasudeva at once despatched the auspicious invitation letters to all his relatives. He than made canals of ghee, curd, milk, honey and guda and also collected several things for presents, including the gems, the jewels, gold, ornaments, different types of costumes, diamonds and heaps of jewels.

## \|\| 99.14 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇo devavargāśca munīndrasiddhapuṃgavān \|*  
*sasmāra manasā bhaktyā bhaktāśca bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. On the other hand, Krishna, who is graceful to the devotees also remembered in his heart with devotion the gods, sages and the siddhas.

## \|\| 99.15 \|\|

*śubhe dine ca saṃprāpte te ca sarve samāyayuḥ \|*  
*munīndrā bāndhavā devā rājāno bahuśastathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. At that point of time people from all the state of society arrived there including the sages, the brothers, the gods and several of the kings.

## \|\| 99.16-17 \|\|

*devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāśca sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*vidyādharyaśca gandharvāścā''yayurvādyabhāṇḍakāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇā bhikṣukā bhaṭṭā yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ \|*  
*saṃnyāsinaścāvadhūtā yoginaśca samāyayuḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. On the female side, the daughters of the gods, daughters of the Nagas, the princesses, the Vidyadharls and the Gandharvas who played on musical instrument also arrived. The Brahmana, the beggars, the bards, Yatis, Brahmacaris, mendicant, ascetics and yogis also arrived there.

## \|\| 99.18 \|\|

*strībāndhavāḥ svabandhūnāṃ vargā mātāmahasya ca \|*  
*bandhūnāṃ bāndhavāḥ sarve svāyayuḥ śubhakarmaṇi \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. At that auspicious time the relatives of all the ladies, the group of all the relatives, relatives from the mothers side also participated.

## \|\| 99.19 \|\|

*bhīṣmo droṇaśca karṇaścāpyaśvatthāmā kṛpo dvijaḥ \|*  
*suputro dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sabhāryaśca samāyayau \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Bhlsma, Drona, Kama, Ashvatthama, also arrived with their families and sons besides Dhrtarastra.

## \|\| 99.20 \|\|

*kuntī saputrā vidhavā harṣaśokasamāplutā \|*  
*nānādeśodbhavā yogyā rājāno rājaputrakāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Kunti also arrived there with her sons who was a widow and was filled with grief as well as delight. The competent kings of various countries and the princesses also arrived there.

## \|\| 99.21-32 \|\|

*atrirvasiṣṭhaścyavano bharadvājo mahātapāḥ \|*  
*yājñavalkyaśca bhīmaśca gārgyo gargo mahātapāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vatsaḥ saputraśca dharmo jaigīṣavyaḥ parāśaraḥ \|*  
*pulahaśca pulastyaścāpyagastyaśvāpi saubhariḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca manātanaḥ \|*  
*sanatkumāro bhagavānvoḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*turvāsāścāṅgirā vyāso vyāsaputraḥ śukastathā \|*  
*kuśikaḥ kauśiko rāma ṛṣyaśṛṅgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*śṛṅgī ca vāmadevaśca gautamaśca guṇārṇavaḥ \|*  
*kraturyatiścā''ruṇiśca śukrācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*aṣṭāvakro vāmanaśca vālmīkiḥ pāribhadrakaḥ \|*  
*pailo vaiśaṃpāyanaśca pracetāḥ purujittathā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*bhṛgurmarīcirmadhujitkaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*aditirdevamātā ca ditirdaityaprasūstathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sumantuśca subhānuśca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanastathā \|*  
*mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca kapilaśca parāśaraḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pāṇiniḥ pāriyātraśca pāribhadraśca puṃgavaḥ \|*  
*saṃvartaścāpyutathyaśca naro'haṃ cāpi nārada \|\| 29 \|\|*

*viśvāmitraḥ śatānando jābālistaitilastathā \|*  
*sāṃdīpaniśca brahmāṃśo yogināṃ jñānināṃ guruḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*upamanyurgauramukho maitreyaśca śrutaśravāḥ \|*  
*kaṭhaḥ kacaśca karakho bharadvājaśca dharmavit \|\| 31 \|\|*

*saśiṣyā munayaḥ sarve vasudevāśramaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*vasudevaśca tāndṛṣṭvā vavande daṇḍavadbhuvi \|\| 32 \|\|*

21-32. The sages like Atri, Vasistha, Cyavana, the Bharadvaja, the great tapasvl, Yajnavalkya, Bhlma, Gargya, Mahatapa, Gargacarya, Vatsa with his son, Dharma, Jaigisavya, Parasara, Pulaha, Pulastya, Agastya, Saubhari, Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatkumara, Sanatana, Vodhu, Paiicas'ikha, Durvasa, Angira, Vyasa, Suka the son of Vyasa, Kusika, Kausika, Parashurama, Srnglrsi, Vibhandaka, Srngl, Vamadeva, all virtuous Gautama, the Kratu, Yati, Aruni, Sukracarya, Brihaspati, Astavakra, Vamana, Valmlki, Paribhadraka, Paila, Vaishampayana, Praceta, Purujit, Bhrigu, Marlci, Madhujit, Prajapati, Kashyapa, Aditi the mother of the gods, Diti the mother of Daityas, Sumantu, Subhanu, Kanva, Katyayana, Markandeya, Lomasa, Kapila, Panini, Pariyatra, Paribhadra, Pungava, Samvarta, Utathya, Nara, Narayana, Vishvamitra, Satananda, Jabali, Taitila, Sandipani the teacher of yogis and intellectuals, Upamanyu, Gauramukha, Maitreya, Srutasrava, Katha, Kaca, Karakha, Bharadvaja, with all the pupils arrived at the place of Vasudeva. Vasudeva on his part welcomed them prostrating before each one of them.

## \|\| 99.33-38 \|\|

*athāsminnantare brahmā sasmito haṃsavāhanaḥ \|*  
*ratnanirmāṇayānena pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*nandī svayaṃ mahākālo vīrabhadraḥ subhadrakaḥ \|*  
*maṇibhadraḥ pāribhadraḥ kārtikeyo gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*gajendreṇa mahendraśca dharmaścandro ravistathā \|*  
*kubero varuṇaścaiva pavano vahnireva ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*yamaḥ saṃyaminīnātho jayanto nalakūbaraḥ \|*  
*sarve grahāśca vasavo rudrāśca sagaṇastathā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*ādityāśca tathā śeṇo nānādevāḥ samāyayuḥ \|*  
*vasudevaśca bhaktyā ca vavande śirasā bhuvi \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā devendrāṃśca tathā surān \|*  
*bhaktina mrātmamūrdhā ca pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

33-38. In the meantime Brahma wearing a smile on his face and mounted on the goose arrived there. Parvati arrived mounted over a gem-studded plane together with Shiva, NandT, Mahakala, Virabhadra, Subhadraka, Manibhadra, Paribhadra, Karttikeya, Ganesha, Indra mounted over Airavata, Dharma, the sun and moon, Kubera, Varuna, Pavana, Agni, Yama, Jayanta, Nalakflbara, all the planets, the Vasus, Rudra with all the ganas, Adityas, Shesha and several other gods also arrived there. Vasudeva on his part adored each one of them prostrating on the ground. He adored all the gods with great devotion. At that point of time his head bowed in reverence, feeling emotional

## \|\| 99.39-40 \|\|

*vasudeva uvāca paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma parameśaḥ parātparaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ vidhātā madgehe jagatāṃ paripālakaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vedānāṃ janakaḥ sraṣṭā sṛṣṭihetuḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*surāṇāṃ ca munīndrāṇāṃ siddhendrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Vasudeva said – Today Brahma himself has arrived in my abode who is the primeval Brahman, illustrious, the great lord, beyond all and maintains the universe, besides being the creator of the Vedas, the cause of the universe, eternal and the teacher of all the sages and siddhas.

## \|\| 99.41-43 \|\|

*svapne yatpādapadmaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*śivasmaraṇamotreṇa sarvāniṣṭāḥ palāyitāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*sarvasaṃkaṭamuttīrya kalyāṇaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*sarvāgre pūjanaṃ yasya devānāmagraṇīḥ paraḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*ghaṭeṣu maṅgalaṃ mantrairbhaktyā cā''vāhanena ca \|*  
*svayaṃ gaṇeśo bhagavān sākṣādvighnavināśakaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. His lotus-like feet are inaccessible even in dream and by reciting his name all the obstructions vanish in no time, the same Shiva has also arrived here. Lord Ganesha has also arrived here who frees people from all the miseries, bestows welfare on the people, who is adored first of all, the one who is the foremost of the gods and the one who is the form of welfare and is established first of all in the ceremonies with the reciting of the mantras invoking him.

## \|\| 99.44-50 \|\|

*kārtikeyaśca bhagavāndevādīnāṃ ca pūjitaḥ \|*  
*devānāṃ pravarā pūjyā mahālakṣmīḥ parātparā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*madgehe pārvatī mātā jagatāmādirūpiṇī \|*  
*sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 45 \|\|*

*parāparāṇāṃ paramā parabrahmasvarūpiṇī \|*  
*yasyāḥ pādau samārādhya vāñchitaṃ labhate naraḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*śaratkāre ca bhaktyā ca sā sākṣānmama mandire \|*  
*sarvadevaiśca sahitā sagaṇā bhaktavātsalā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*kṛpāmayī ca kṛpayā cā''virbhūtā ca bhārate \|*  
*dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama \|\| 48 \|\|*

*āgatā'si yato durge paramādyā ca madgṛhe \|*  
*evaṃ sarvāṃśca tuṣṭāva krameṇa ca parasparam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*sarvānmunīndrānviprāṃśca gale baddhvāṃ'śukaṃ mudā \|*  
*pratyekaṃ vāsayāmāsa ratnasihāsane vare \|\| 50 \|\|*

44-50. Lord Karttikeya has also arrived who is adored by all the Yadus. Maha-Lakshmi has also arrived here who is the best of the goddesses and is extremely adorable. The goddess Parvati has also arrived here who is the primeval form of the universe, the form of the entire universe, MiilaPrakriti, Isvarl, the best of all, the form of eternal Brahman, by adoring her during in the winter season, one gets his desire fulfilled, the one who is the eternal shakti, compassionate one and has incarnated on the land of Bharata out of compassion. The same goddess Parvati, who is graceful to her devotees has arrives in my abode with all her attendants and gods. О Durga, since you have arrived in my abode therefore I feel myself to be quite graceful, my life has met with success. Thus Vasudeva binding a cloth around his neck, bowed in reverence to all the gods, the sages and the Brahmanas offering prayers to them and made sit them on the gem-studded throne, individually.

## \|\| 99.51-56 \|\|

*pūjayāmāsa vidhivatkrameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*pratyekaṃ varayāmāsa brahmādīṃśca surānapi \|\| 51 \|\|*

*munivargānbrāhmaṇāṃśca bhaktyā gargaṃ purohitam \|*  
*ratnaiḥ pravālairmaṇibhirmuvatāmāṇikyahīrakaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*bhūṣaṇairvasanaiścaiva mālyaiśca gandhacandanaiḥ \|*  
*latnasihāsane ramye sarveṣāṃ madhyadeśataḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*gaṇeśaṃ vāsayāmāsa pūjārthaṃ śubhakarmaṇi \|*  
*saptatīrthodakenaiva suvarṇakalaśena ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

*puṣpajandranayuktena śītena vāsitena ca \|*  
*svargagaṅgājalenaiva puṣkarodakuṇyataḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*pañcāmṛtena śuddhena pañcagavyena bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*herambaṃ snāpayāmāsa samudrodena mantrataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

51-56. Thereafter, he properly adored them individually with his mind filled with devotion. He adored offering the gems, the diamonds, the jewels and the gem-studded ornaments, the garments, the flower garlands the fragrant sandal-paste to Brahma, the gods, the sages, Brahmana as and Garga, the family priest. At the auspicious time Ganesha was made to sit on the gem-studded there and he was adored first of all. The water of all the seven oceans was kept in pitchers which were decorated with flowers. The fragrant and cool water of Ganga was also brought together with the sacred water from Pus kara together with the pure milk preparations. Herambha Ganesha was adored with devotion, reciting the mantras, pouring the water over him.

## \|\| 99.57-58 \|\|

*varayāmāsa mālyena pārijātasya nārada \|*  
*ratnendrabhūṣaṇenaiva vahniśuddhena vāsasā \|\| 57 \|\|*

*gandhayandanapuṣpaiśca ratnamālyāṅgulīyakam \|*  
*tuṣṭāva pārvatīputraṃ sarvadevādhipaṃ śubham vighnanighnakaraṃ śāntaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. О Narada, Ganesha was also offered the garland of Parijata flower, the ornaments of gems, the garment sanctified by fire, fragrant and the Sandal paste, the garland of flowers and gems and the finger ring. Thereafter he offered his prayer to lord Ganesha who happens to be the foremost of all the gods, the form of welfare, remover of obstruction, peaceful and eternal.

## Chapter 100

## \|\| 100.1-4 \|\|

*atha śātatame'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca athāditirditiścaiva devakī rohiṇī ratiḥ \|*  
*sarasvatī ca sāvitrī yaśodā ca pativratā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*lobāmudrā'rundhatī ca ahalyā tārakā tathā \|*  
*yayustāḥ pārvatīṃ dṛṣṭavā vegena mandirādapi \|\| 2 \|\|*

*parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya samāśliṣya punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*praṇamya veśayāmāsurmandiraṃ ratnanirmitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ratnasihāsane ramye vāsayāmāsurīśvarīm \|*  
*varayāmāsurmālyena vāsasā ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Narayana said – Thereafter Aditi, Diti, Devaki, Rohini, Rati, Sarasvati, the chaste Yashoda, Lopamudra, Arundhatl, Ahalya, Tara proceeded to the temple of Parvati and bowing. In reverence to her again and again, they offered their salutation to her. Then after talking to her they made her enter into the gem-studded palace. There she was made to sit on the gem-studded lion throne and honoured offering the garland, the costumes, gems studded ornaments and was than established there.

## \|\| 100.5 \|\|

*pārijātasya puṣpaṃ ca śakrānītaṃ manoharam \|*  
*dadau tatpādapadme ca devakī bhaktipūrvakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The goddess Devaki offered her the Parijata flowers, which were brought by Indra with great effort, at the lotus-like feet of Parvati.

## \|\| 100.6 \|\|

*sindūrabinduṃ sīmante bhāle candanabindukam \|*  
*kastūrīkuṅkumādīṃśca pradadau paritastayoḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The parting of her hair was adorned with the spot of vermilion while the forehead was adorned with the spot of sandal-paste. She was also decorated with kastiiri and saffron on all sides.

## \|\| 100.7-8 \|\|

*miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa śītatoyaṃ suvāsitaṃ \|*  
*tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*alaktakaṃ ca pradadau nakheṣu pādapadmayoḥ \|*  
*kuṅkumasyāpi rāgaṃ ca siṣeve śvetacāmaraiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. She was served with sweet food, offering the cool fragrant water, the fragrant betel was also offered to her, the nails of her toes were painted with saffron and she was served by moving the white fly-whisks.

## \|\| 100.9-10 \|\|

*maṃpujya pārvatīṃ devīṃ munipatnīḥ krameṇa ca \|*  
*pūjayāmāsa vidhivatpatiputravatīḥ satīḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*rājakanyā devakanyā nāgakanyā manoharāḥ \|*  
*munikanyā bandhukanyāḥ pūjayāmāsa suvratā \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Devaki thus adored Parvati and thereafter she also adored the wives of the sages, the chaste woman whose son and husband were alive, the princesses, the daughter of all the gods, the beautiful daughters of the Nagas and the sages besides the daughters of all other relatives

## \|\| 100.11 \|\|

*vādya nānāvidhaṃ ramyaṃ vādayāmāsa kautukāt \|*  
*maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa brahmaṇān \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Several of the musical instrument were sounding delightfully and welfare mantras were recited serving food to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 100.12 \|\|

*bhairavīṃ pūjayāmāsa mathurāgrāmadevatām \|*  
*upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ maṅgalacaṇḍikām \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The village deities named Bhairavl and SasthI were adored, offering sixteen types of adoration's.

## \|\| 100.13 \|\|

*puṇyaṃ svastyayanaṃ śuddhaṃ vārayāmāsa maṅgalam \|*  
*vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa vasudevāsya vallabhā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Then Devaki the spouse of vasudeva had the recitations of the Vedas and welfare mantras, made by the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 100.14-15 \|\|

*svargaṅgāsujalenaiva suvarmakalaśena ca \|*  
*snāpayāmāsa sabalaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ putravatsalā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vastracandanamālyaiśca tayorveṣaṃ cakāra sā \|*  
*ratnendrasāranirmāṇabhūṣaṇaiśca manoharaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Devaki who was graceful to her son made Balabhadra and Krishna bathe with the best of the water of the Ganga from heaven brought in golden pitchers. She then offered the costumes, the sandal-paste, the flowers garland and the ornaments made with the best of gems. They were thus fully decorated.

## \|\| 100.16 \|\|

*mātṛbhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaḥ sabalaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca \|*  
*āyayau ca sabhāṃ devamunīndrāṇāṃ ca nārada \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О Narada, having been decorated with the ornament in the form of mother, Shri Krishna reached the assembly of great sages.

## \|\| 100.17-18 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā taṃ jagatāṃ rāthamuttasthau prajavena ca \|*  
*svayaṃ vidhātā śaṃbhuśca śeṣo dharmaśca bhāskaraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*devāśca munayaścaiva kārtikeyo gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*pṛthakpṛthak krameṇaiva tuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. On their arrival Brahma, Shiva, Shesha, Dharma and Surya got up to welcome them. Thereafter the gods, the sages, Karttikeya and Ganesha offered prayer to lord Krishna separately.

## \|\| 100.19 \|\|

*brahmovāca nāthānirvacanoyo'si bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ \|*  
*vedānirvacanīyaṃ ca kastvāṃ stotumiheśvaraḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Brahma said – О lord, you are inexplicable and you take to the human form for the only to grace your devotees. You are inexplicable by the Vedas, Therefore who could be competent enough to praise you.

## \|\| 100.20 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca deheṣu dehināṃ śaśvatsthitaṃ nirliptameva ca \|*  
*karmiṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ śuddhaṃ sākṣiṇāṃ sākṣataṃ vibhum \|*  
*kiṃ staumi rūpaśūnyaṃ ca guṇaśūnyaṃ ca nirguṇam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Mahadeva said – You always pervades all the creatures in the universe and still remain unattached, you are the witness of all the deeds of the people and are imperishable. Therefore what type of adoration can I offer to you because you are formless, devoid of gums and are also nirguna.

## \|\| 100.21-22 \|\|

*ananta uvāca kiṃvā jānāmyahaṃ nātha tvāmajño'nantamīśvaram \|*  
*anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍakāraṇaṃ duḥkhatāraṇam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*mahāviṣṇośca lomnāṃ ca vivareṣu jaleṣu ca \|*  
*santi viśvānyasaṃkhyāni citrāṇi kṛtrimāṇi ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Ananta said – О lord, I am devoid of knowledge, then how could I know about the endless lord, because you happen to be the cause of the creation of crores of globes and you redeem the people from the ocean of universe. Innumerable globes are lodged into the hair-pits of Maha-Vishnu which are astonishing as well as artificial.

## \|\| 100.23 \|\|

*santi santaśca devāśca brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ \|*  
*tvadaṃśāḥ pratibimbeṣu tīrthāni bhārataṃ tathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Out of them the noble people, the gods, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, represent your arhshas and all the holy places are located in the land of Bharata.

## \|\| 100.24 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍaikasthito'haṃ ca sūkṣmanāgasvarūpakaḥ \|*  
*sthāpitaśca tvayā kūrme gajendre maśako yathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. I pervade the universe in my tiny form of Naga. You have established myself on the back of tortoise live the mosquito sits on the huge elephant.

## \|\| 100.25-27 \|\|

*paramāṇuparaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśveṣu nāsti kutracit \|*  
*mahāviṣṇoḥ paraṃ sthūlaṃ samo nāsti ca kutracit \|\| 25 \|\|*

*mahāviṣṇoḥ parastvaṃ ca tvatparo nāsti kaścana \|*  
*sthūlātsthūlataro devaḥ mūkṣmātsūkṣmatamo mahān \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ādhāraśca mahāviṣṇo jalarūpo bhavānsvayam \|*  
*jalādhāro hi golokastvaṃ ca sthāvararūpadhṛk \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. There is nothing smaller in the world than the atom and there is nothing greater than Maha-Vishnu but you happen to be beyond Maha-Vishnu and no one else is beyond you, therefore you are greater than the greatest and smaller than the smallest. You happen to be the form of water which is the base of Maha-Vishnu. Water is the base of Goloka and you have taken to immovable form.

## \|\| 100.28 \|\|

*marvādhāro mahānvāyuḥ śvāsaniḥ śvāsarūpakaḥ \|*  
*bhaktānugrahadehasya nityasya bhavato dibho \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О virtuous one, you take to human form for the sake of your devotees. Your breathing is the base of all the creatures in the world.

## \|\| 100.29 \|\|

*vaktrairbahutarairvāṃ'tha tvayā dattaiḥ puraiva ca \|*  
*stotumicchāmi tvadyogaṃ na dattaṃ jñānamaiśvaram \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. You had provided me with several hoods in earlier times and therefore collectively with these hoods intend to recite your glory but you have not bestowed me with the divine knowledge.

## \|\| 100.30 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ tvāmanantaṃ yadi stotuṃ devo'nanto na hīśvaraḥ \|*  
*na hi svayaṃ vidhātā ca na hi jñānātmakaḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā kiṃ kurmaḥ stavanaṃ vayam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The gods said – О lord you are endless and in case Ananta is not able to recite your glory, Brahma himself and lord Shiva are unable to do so while Sarasvati becomes double before you then how can the weak people recite your glory.

## \|\| 100.31 \|\|

*munīndrā ūcuḥ vedā na śaktāḥ stotuṃ cettvāṃ caiva jñātumīśvaram \|*  
*vayaṃ vedavidaḥ santaḥ kiṃ kurmaḥ stavanaṃ tava \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The sages said – O Lord in case the Vedas are unable to recite your glory, then how could one in spite of our being well-versed in the Vedas, recite your glory.

## \|\| 100.32-33 \|\|

*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ devaiśca munimiḥ kṛtam \|*  
*yaḥ paṭhetsaṃyataḥ śuddhaḥ pūjākāle ca bhaktitaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā labdhvā jñānaṃ nirañjanam \|*  
*ratnāyānaṃ samāruhya golokaṃ sa ca gacchati \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. Thus one who recites the stotra composed by the sages and the gods, at the time of adoration, purifying himself and with the mind filled with devotion, he enjoying all the pleasures in this world achieves the divine knowledge and proceeds to Goloka ultimately.

## Chapter 101

## \|\| 101.1 \|\|

*athaikādhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca saṃstūya devā munayo viremurnahi mānase \|*  
*dadṛśuḥ prāṅgaṇe kṛṣṇaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – As soon as the gods and the sages completed the mental prayer of Krishna, they spotted Krishna clad in pltdmbara standing in the court-yard.

## \|\| 101.2 \|\|

*yathā saudāminīyuktaṃ navīnajaladaṃ mune \|*  
*bakapaṅ ktiyutaṃ caiva mālatīmālayā tathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О sage, as the fresh clouds appear with lightening and the line of sky-larks, similarly lord Krishna was standing there wearing the garland of jasmine flowers.

## \|\| 101.3 \|\|

*kapāle maṇḍalākārakastūrīyuktacandanam \|*  
*sakalaṅkaṃ mṛgāṅkaṃ ca śobhitaṃ jalade tathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. He had a circular spot of kastUrl painted on his forehead and it looked like the moon among the clouds.

## \|\| 101.4-5 \|\|

*dvibhujaṃ śyāmalaṃkāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitam \|*  
*rudantaṃ piturutsaṅge balena sahitaṃ param \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. He had two arms, beautiful dark complexion, was the beloved of Radha, quite charming, wearing a smile on his delightful face. Taking to human form, in order to grace his devotees, he was wearing armlets and wristlets of gems. He was sobbing in the lap of his father together with Balabhadra.

## \|\| 101.6-7 \|\|

*atha maṅgalakāle ca śubhalagne manorame \|*  
*saṃpīkṣite grahaiḥ saumyairjāṃgrallagnādhipe sthite \|\| 6 \|\|*

*asadgrahairadṛṣṭe ca sadgrahekṣita eva ca \|*  
*śubhakarmasamārambhaṃ svastivācanapūrvakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Thereafter at the arrival of the auspicious time when the lord of lagna was in the high position looked upon and favourable by the stars who were casting their glance. At the point of time, bowing to the command of the Brahmanas, he started, the ceremony by reciting the welfare mantras.

## \|\| 101.8-10 \|\|

*cakāra vasudevaścāpyājñayā suraviprayoḥ \|*  
*dattvā suvarṇaśatakaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca sādaram \|\| 8 \|\|*

*devendrāṃśca munīndrāśca namaskṛtya purohitam \|*  
*gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ śivām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca sākṣatairdevasaṃsadi \|*  
*upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ saṃyato bhaktipūrvakam \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. After offering a hundred gold coins to the Brahmanas, he bowed before Indra, the sages and the family priest, besides Ganesha, Surya, Agni, Shiva and Parvati with utmost devotion. He adored them with sixteen types of offerings together with all the gods.

## \|\| 101.11-12 \|\|

*putrādhivāsanaṃ cakrai vedamantreṇa saṃsadi \|*  
*saṃpūjya nānādevāṃśca dikpālāṃśca navagrahān \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dattvā pañcopacārāṃśca bhaktyā ṣoḍaśamātṛkāḥ \|*  
*dattvā ca vasudhārāṃ ca saptavārānghṛtena ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Then with the reciting of the Vedic hymns, the bodies of both the brothers were plastered with fragrant material. Thereafter the gods, the Dikpalas, nine planets were adored together with the sixteen mothers by making five-fold offerings, the ghee was poured on them, seven times.

## \|\| 101.13-18 \|\|

*cedirājaṃ vasuṃ natvā saṃpūjya prayayau punaḥ \|*  
*vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ sunirvāpya yatkiṃciddaivikaṃ tathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*yajñaṃ kṛtvā tu vedoktaṃ yajñasūtraṃ dadau mudā \|*  
*valadevāgracāyaiva kṛṣṇāya paramātmane \|\| 14 \|\|*

*gāyatrī ca dadau tābhyāṃ muniḥ sāṃdīpanistathā \|*  
*bhikṣāṃ dadau ca prathamaṃ pārvatī paramādarāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

*amūlyaratnapātrasthaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakam \|*  
*hīrasāravinirmāṇaṃ pitrā dattaṃ ca hārakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*śubhāśiṣaṃ ca pradadau śuklapuṣpeṇā dūrvayā \|*  
*tato'ditirditiścaiva munipatnyaśca devakī \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yaśodā rohiṇī hṛṣṭā sāvitrī ca sarasvatī \|*  
*pratyekaṃ pradadau bhikṣāṃ maṇikāñcanabhūṣitām \|\| 18 \|\|*

13-18. Thereafter adoring the king of Cedi, he moved forward and completed the Vrddhi-sraddha and adored some other gods also. Thereafter he performed the yajha has prescribed in the Vedas, after which both Krishna and Balarama were adorned with yajhopavlta. The sage Sandlpani bestowed the Gayatri hymn to both the boys. First of all Parvati gave the jewels. The father Vasudeva gave him a garland of gems together with the garland of white flowers and Durva-grass. Aditi, Diti, Devaki, Yashoda, Rohini, Savitri, Sarasvati and other goddesses also offered him the bhiksa in gems and pearls.

## \|\| 101.19 \|\|

*devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāḥ pativratāḥ \|*  
*kāminyo bāndhavānāṃ ca sasmitāḥ snigdhalocanāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The daughters of the gods, Nagas, the chaste woman, the princesses and the damsels of the relatives, offered the bhiksa, with their eyes filled with affection.

## \|\| 101.20-22 \|\|

*indrāṇī varuṇānī ca pavanānī ca rohiṇī \|*  
*kuberapatnīṃ svāhā ca ratiḥ kāmasya kāminī \|\| 20 \|\|*

*pratyekaṃ pradadau bhikṣāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*bhikṣāṃ gṛhītvā bhagavānsabalo bhaktipūrvakam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kiṃciddadau ca gargāya kicitsvagurave tathā \|*  
*vaidikaṃ karma nirvāpya gargāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadau \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Thereafter IndranI, VarunanI, the spouse of the wind god, Rohini, the spouse of Kubera, Svaha, Rati also gave him the gem-studded ornament as bhiksa. Both Balabhadra and Krishna accepted the offerings and distributed them among Garga and their teacher. After completion of the ceremonies according to the Vedic traditions, the teacher Garga was presented with the daksina.

## \|\| 101.23-25 \|\|

*devāṃśca bhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇāṃścāpi sādaram \|*  
*ye ye samāyayuryajñe teca dattvā śubhāśiṣam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kṛṇṇāya baladevāya prahṛṣṭāḥ prayayṛrguham \|*  
*nandaḥ sabhāryo nirvāpya śubhakarma sutasya vai \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kroḍe kṛtvā balaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cucumba vadanaṃ tayoḥ \|*  
*ucacai ruroda nandaśca yaśodā ca pativratā śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ samāśvāsya bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. The gods and the Brahmanas were respectfully offered the food. Then all the people who had arrived to participate in the yajha variously offered blessings to Shri Krishna and Baladeva and went back to their abodes. After completion of the auspicious ceremonies Nanda and Yashoda took the boys in their laps and started kissing their faces. At that point of time both Nanda and Yashoda became emotional and started sobbing. Shri Krishna then somehow reassured them and spoke to them.

## \|\| 101.26 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca sānandaṃ gaccha he mātaryaśode tātamatvaram \|*  
*tvameva mātā poṣṭrī tvaṃ pitā ca paramārthataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Shri Krishna said – "O mother Yashoda and О father, both of you reached here delightfully, you happen to be our mother who has brought us up and you happen to be our real father.

## \|\| 101.27 \|\|

*avantinagaraṃ tāta yāsyāmi sabalo'dhunā \|*  
*muneḥ sāṃdīpaneḥ sthānaṃ vedapāṭhārthamīpsitam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О father, we are moving to the abode of the sage Sandlpani in order to achieved learnings.

## \|\| 101.28-30 \|\|

*tata āgatya suciraṃ kāle bhavati darśanam \|*  
*kāmaḥ karoti kalanaṃ sa ca bhedaṃ karoti ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ mātarbhedaṃ saṃmīlanaṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca harṣaṃ ca śokaṃ ca maṅgalālayam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*mayā dattaṃ ca tattvaṃ ca yogināmapi durlabham \|*  
*sarvaṃ nandaśca sānandaṃ tvāmeva kathayiṣyati \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. After our return from that place, after a long time, we shall surely come to you. О mother, it is the time alone which accepts and also creates differences. So much so, the separation, meeting, the pleasure and pain and the welfare are all managed by the time itself. I have imparted the knowledge of tattvas to the respected father. He would surely narrate to you the secret of the same.

## \|\| 101.31-32 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho vasudevasabhāṃ yayau \|*  
*tadājñayā kṣaṇaṃ prāpya yayau saṃdīpanergūham \|\| 31 \|\|*

*vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca saṃbhāṣya vinayena ca \|*  
*nandaḥ sabhāryaḥ prayayau hṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Thus speaking Krishna the lord of the universe went to the court of Vasudeva. Remaining there for sometime, both of them went to the abode of the teacher Sandlpani, thereafter both Nanda and Yashoda humbly spoke to Vasudeva and Devaki and got ready to depart.

## \|\| 101.33-34 \|\|

*muktāmaṇiṃ suvarṇa ca māṇikyaṃ hīrakaṃ tathā \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ ratnaṃ nandāya devakī dadau \|\| 33 \|\|*

*śvetāśvaṃ ca gajendraṃ ca suvarṇarathamuttamam \|*  
*nandāya kṛṣṇaḥ pradadau vasudevaśca sādaram \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. At that point of time Devaki offered to Nanda several types of gems and jewels, gold, rubies, diamond, costumes, sanctified by fire. Vasudeva and Krishna presented Nanda with white horses, elephants and the chariot made of gold.

## \|\| 101.35 \|\|

*tayoranuvrajanviprā devakīpramukhāḥ striyaḥ \|*  
*vasudevastathā'krūro'pyuddhavaśca yayau mudā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. At the time of their departure all the Brahmanas, Devaki and other damsels, Vasudeva, Akrnra and Uddhava delightfully followed them.

## \|\| 101.36 \|\|

*kālindīnikaṭaṃ gatvā te sarve ruruduḥ śucā \|*  
*parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya te sarve svālayaṃ yayuḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Reaching the bank of river Yamuna, all of them started crying with grief, thus after talking with one and other they returned to their abodes.

## \|\| 101.37-39 \|\|

*kuntī saputrā vidhavā vasudevājñayā mune \|*  
*nānāratnamaṇiṃ prāpya prayayau svaralayaṃ mudā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*vasutevo devakī ca putrakalyāṇahetave \|*  
*nānāratnamaṇiṃ vastraṃ muvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*muktāmāṇikyacahāraṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam \|*  
*bhaṭṭemyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca pradadau sādaraṃ mudā \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. О sage, at the command of Vasudeva, the widow KuntI also returned to her abode with her sons and the gems given to her by Vasudeva. Vasudeva and Devaki also gave away enough of gems and jewels, costumes, gold, silver, rubies, sapphire and various types of sweets to the Brahman as and the bards for the welfare to their sons.

## \|\| 101.40-41 \|\|

*mahotsavaṃ vedapāṭhaṃ harernāmaikamaṅgalam \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ caiva kārayāmāsa yatnataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*jñātīnāṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca puraskāraṃ yathocitam \|*  
*cakāra maṇimāṇikyamuktāvastrairmanoharaiḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Thereafter the festivities were gracefully performed which included the recitation of the Vedas and the name of the lord, serving food to the Brahmanas. Thereafter the gems, jewels, sapphire and precious stones besides the costumes were distributed to the relatives as gifts.

## Chapter 102

## \|\| 102.1-2 \|\|

*dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca kṛṇṇaḥ sāṃdīpanergehaṃ gatvā ca sabalo mudā \|*  
*namaścakāra svaguruṃ gurupatnīṃ pativratām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śubhāśiṣaṃ gṛhītvā ca dattvā ratnamaṇiṃ hariḥ \|*  
*gurave tasya bhāryāyai tamuvāca yathocitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Both Krishna and Balabhadra reached the abode of sage Sandlpani and bowed in reverence to the chaste wife of the teacher. Earning blessing from her lord Hari presented the precious gems to the wife of the teacher and then spoke.

## \|\| 102.3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tvatto vidyāṃ labhiṣyāmi vāñchitāṃ vāñchitaṃ mama \|*  
*kṛtvā śubhakṣaṇaṃ vipra māṃ pāṭhaya yathocitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Shri Krishna said – О Brahman, I have a desire to complete all the learning, therefore you start the teaching at an auspicious time.

## \|\| 102.4-5 \|\|

*omityuktvā muniśreṣṭhaḥ pūjayāmāsa taṃ mudā \|*  
*madhuparkaprāśanena gavā vastreṇa candanaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitaṃ \|*  
*supriyaṃ kathayāmāsa tuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Thereafter with the reciting of the word от, the sage gave his consent, he then welcomed them offering madhuparka, eatables, the cow, the costumes and the sandal-paste. He also offered them the sweets and the fragrant betel, talking to them with sweet voice. He also offered prayer to the lord.

## \|\| 102.6-7 \|\|

*sāṃdīpaniruvāca paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paramīśa parātpara \|*  
*svecchāmayaṃ svayaṃjyotirniliptaiko niraṅkuśaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*bhaktaikanātha bhakteṣṭa bhaktānugrahavigraha \|*  
*bhaktavāñchākalpataro bhaktānāṃ prāṇavallabha \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Sandlpani said – You are the one beyond measure, the primeval Brahman, the sole abode of all the pleasures, the eternal lord who moves at will, self illumining, unattached, unpresented, unrestrained, the only lord of the devotees, the family god of the devotees, the one who takes to human form for the welfare of the devotees, kalpavrksa for the fulfilment of the desires of the devotees, who is adorable the devotees more than their lives.

## \|\| 102.8 \|\|

*māyayā bālarūpo'si brahmeśaśeṣavanditaḥ \|*  
*māyayā bhuvi bhūpāla bhuvo bhārakṣayāya ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. You take to the form of a boy with your illusion and are adored by Brahma, Shiva, Shesha and have incarnated on earth to rid her of her burden.

## \|\| 102.9-16 \|\|

*yogino yaṃ vidantyevaṃ brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam \|*  
*dhyāyante bhaktanivahā jyotirabhyantare mudā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sundaraṃ śyāmahupakam \|*  
*candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ sasmitaṃ bhaktavatsalam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ vanamālavibhūṣitam \|*  
*līlāpāṅgataraṅgaiśca ninditānaṅgamūrcchitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*alaktabhavanaṃ tadvatpādapadmaṃ suśobhanam \|*  
*kaustubhodbhāsitāṅgaṃ ca divyamūrtiṃ manoharam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannaṃ ca suveṣaṃ prastutaṃ suraiḥ \|*  
*devadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ trelokyamohanaṃ param \|\| 13 \|\|*

*koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ kamanīyamanīśvaram \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇaughena bhūṣitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*varaṃ varaṇyaṃ varadaṃ varadānāmabhīpsitam \|*  
*caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pāṭhārtha matpriyasthānamāgato'si ca māyayā \|*  
*pāṭhaṃ te lokaśikṣārthaṃ ramaṇaṃ gamanaṃ raṇam \|*  
*svātmārāmasya ca vibhoḥ paripūrṇatamasya ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

9-16. The yogis conceive you as the eternal flame and the devotees meditated upon the same flame delightfully with devotion. The one who had two forms and holds a flute in his hands, whose all the limbs are plastered with the sandal-paste, the one who has dark complexion and wears a serene smile on his face, the one who is graceful to his devotees, wears the yellow lower garment and long garland of forest flowers. You are the one who can put to shame the god of love with a single glance, the one whose lotus-like feet look beautiful with the application of the red paint and the kaustubha gem adores the chest, the one who possesses the beautiful figure, one who smiles gracefully with delight and is clad in beautiful garments, the one who is adored by the gods and happens to be the god of all the gods, lord of the universe and influences the three worlds with his illusion, who happer. to be the best of all possessing the lustre of crores of the gods of love, who is quite charming, the one who himself is the lord, adorned with all the invaluable gem-studded ornaments who is the best of all, bestower of the boons and happens to be the cause of all the four Vedas. The same lord has arrived here for learnings, playfully at my place, you happen to be the one who always remains engrossed in his own soul. You are virtuous and complete in all respects therefore all the people are desirous of seeking knowledge from you in various fields.

## \|\| 102.17-19 \|\|

*gurupatnyuvāca adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama \|*  
*pātivratyaṃ ca saphalaṃ saphalaṃ ca tapovanam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*maddakṣahastaḥ saphalo dattaṃ yenānnamīpsitam \|*  
*tadāśramaṃ tīrthaparaṃ tīrthapādapadāṅkitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tvatpādarajasā pūtā gṛhāḥ prāṅgaṇamuttamam \|*  
*tvatpādapadmaṃ dṛṣṭvā caivā''vayorjanmakhaṇḍanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. The wife of the teachers said – My life has success today, my birth has been successful, my chastefulness has been successful and our abode also has become successful, the hand with which I have offered the food to you, the same right hand of mine has become successful, your feet are like the holy places and with your arrival here, my abode has been sanctified with the dust of your feet, my house has been purified besides the court yard with the sight of both your feet, both of us have been relieved of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 102.20 \|\|

*tāvadduḥkhaṃ ca śokaśca tāvadbhogaśca rogakaḥ \|*  
*tāvajjanmāni karmāṇi kṣutpipāsādikāni ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Because the grief, the pain, the ailment, the deeds, the birth, hunger and thirst are painful to a person till such time they do not have a glance at your lotus-like feet. О lord, you happen to be the killer of the time, the creator and the destroyer also.

## \|\| 102.21-22 \|\|

*yāvattvatpādapadmasya bhajanaṃ nāsti darśanam \|*  
*he kālakāla bhagavansraṣṭuḥ saṃharturīśvara \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānātha māyāmohanikṛntana \|*  
*ityuktvā sāśrunetrā sā kroḍe kṛtvā hariṃ punaḥ svastanaṃ pāyayāmāsa premṇā ca devakī yathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. О compassionate one, you destroy the illusion, you be graceful on us. Thus speaking the eyes of the wife of the teacher were filled with tears, she took the lord in her lap and started suckling him from the breasts like Devaki.

## \|\| 102.23-24 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca mātastvaṃ māṃ kathaṃ stauṣi bālaṃ dugdhamukhaṃ sutam \|*  
*gaccha golokamiṣṭaṃ ca svāminā sahasāpratam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tyaktvā prākṛtikaṃ mithyā naśvaraṃ ca kalevaram \|*  
*vidhāya nirmalaṃ dehaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Shri Krishna said – О mother, why do you offer a prayer to an infant like me? This body is all falsehood and perishable, you take to divine form which is free from the birth, death, old age and. proceed to Goloka with your husband.

## \|\| 102.25-30 \|\|

*ityuktavā caturo vedānpaṭhitvā munipuṃgavāt \|*  
*māsena parayā bhaktyā dattvā putraṃ mṛtaṃ purā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ratnānāṃ ca trilakṣaṃ ca maṇīnāṃ pañcalakṣaṇam \|*  
*hīrakāṇāṃ caturlakṣaṃ muktānāṃ pañcalakṣakam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*māṇikyānāṃ dvilakṣaṃ ca vastraṃ trailokyadurlabham \|*  
*hāraṃ ca durgayā dataṃ hastaratnāṅgulīyakam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*daśakoṭiṃ suvarṇānāṃ gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadau \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ nārīsarvāṅgabhūṣaṇamā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*gurupriyāyai pradadau vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ varam \|*  
*munirdattvā ca putrāya taḥsarvaṃ priyayā saha \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sadratnarathamāruhya yayau golokamuttamam \|*  
*tamadbhūtaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayau svālayaṃ mudā \|\| 30 \|\|*

25-30. Thus Shri Krishna attained all the knowledge from Sandlpani including the four Vedas in a months time, restored his dead son to him. He then gave away three lakhs of gems, five lakhs of rubies, four lakhs of diamonds, five lakhs of jewels, two lakhs of rubies and three lakhs of inaccessible divine garments, the garland given to him by goddess Durga, the finger ring and ten crores of gold coins to the teacher. Thereafter, the best of the ornaments for all the limbs of the ladies and the costumes sanctified by fire were offered to the wife of the teacher, then Sandlpani handed over all the costumes and ornaments to his son and mounting on the divine chariot proceeded to Goloka. Witnessing this supreme lord Hari also reverted to his abode.

## \|\| 102.31-33 \|\|

*evaṃ brahmaṇyadevasya caritraṃ śṛṇu nārada \|*  
*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedbhaktipūrvakam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇe niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇ̈ḍitaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya yātyante śrīhareḥ padam \|*  
*tatra nityaṃ harerdāsyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. О Narada, you listen to the other stories of the lord, whosoever would recite this auspicious stotra would achieve the infallible devotion of lord Krishna. There is no doubt about it. With the influence of the same stotra a person without separation would achieve the best of reputation and a foolish would become a learned one. Enjoying all the pleasures he would achieve the abode of the lord where he would attain the slavehood of lord Hari. There is no doubt about it.

## Chapter 103

## \|\| 103.1-6 \|\|

*atha tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca athā''gatya madhupurīṃ praṇamya pitaraṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*sabalo vaṭamūle ca sasmāra garuḍaṃ hariḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sādaraṃ lavaṇodaṃ ca viśvakarmaṇamīpsitam \|*  
*tatyāja gopaveṣaṃ ca nṛpaveṣaṃ dadhāra saḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*etasminnantare cakramājagām hariṃ svayam \|*  
*paraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāma sūryakoṭisamaprabham \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tejasā hariṇā tulyaṃ paraṃ vairivimardanam \|*  
*avyarthamastramastrāṇāṃ pravaraṃ paramaṃ param \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ratnayānaṃ puraḥ kṛtvā garuḍo harisaṃnidhim \|viśvakarmā saśiṣyaśca jaladhiḥ kampitastathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*hariṃ praṇemuste sarve murdhnā ca bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*sasmitaḥ sādaraṃ yatnāttānuvāca kramādvibhuḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Narayana said – Krishna together with Balarama returned to Mathura and offered his salutation to his father and seated under the banyan tree he summoned gracefully, Garuda, ocean of milk and Vishvakarma. Thereafter discarding the costumes of cowherds, he clad himself in the royal garments. In the meantime the Sudarsana-cakra also arrived before the lord having the lustre of the crores of suns, it was illustrious like Hari himself, destroyer of the enemies, infallible and was the best of all the weapons. Mounting on the gem-studded chariot the lord, Vishvakarma, together with his pupils and the ocean feeling panicky, bowed before the lord in reverence. Thereafter the all-pervading lord spoke to them smilingly.

## \|\| 103.7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca he samudra mahābhāga sthalaṃ ca śātayojanam \|*  
*dehi me nagarārtha ca paścāddāsyāmi niścitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Shri Krishna said – О virtuous ocean, you give me a hundred yojanas of land for dwelling, which could be returned to you.

## \|\| 103.8-9 \|\|

*nagaraṃ kuru he kāro triṣu lokeṣu durlabham \|*  
*ramaṇīyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kamanīyaṃ ca yoṣitām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vāñcitaṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ vaikuṇṭhasadṛśaṃ param \|*  
*sarveṣāmapi svargāṇāṃ paraṃ pāramabhīpsitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. О architect, you build such a type of city here which should be become beyond comparison in the three worlds. It should be charming for all, beautiful for all the ladies, desirable by the devotees, the best like Vaikuntha and beyond even the heavens.

## \|\| 103.10 \|\|

*divāniśaṃ khagaśreṣṭha saṃnidhau viśvakarmaṇaḥ \|*  
*sthitiṃ kuru mahābhāga yāvannirmāti dvārakām \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О virtuous lord of the birds, till such time Vishvakarma builds up the new city, you accompany him throughout the day and night.

## \|\| 103.11 \|\|

*divāniśaṃ ca matpārśve cakraśreṣṭha sthitiṃ kuru \|*  
*omityukatvā tu prayayuḥ sarve cakaṃ vinā mune \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. О best of the Cakra, "You remain with me through out the day and night." О sage, thus speaking to everyone and receiving his approval, all others left the place accept the cakra.

## \|\| 103.12-13 \|\|

*kaṃsasya pitaraṃ bhadramugrasenaṃ mahābalam \|*  
*nṛpaṃ cakāra nagare kṣatriyāṇāṃ satāmapi \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vijitya ca jarāsaṃdhaṃ nihatya yavanaṃ tathā \|*  
*upāyena mahābhāga nirmāṇakramamīśvaraḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. О virtuous one, thereafter lord Krishna enthroned the father of Kaihsa known as Ugrasena as the king beside several other Ks atriyas. He defeated Jarasandha skilfully and also killed Kalayavana. Thereafter the process of building the city was started.

## \|\| 103.14-23 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca śatayojanaparyantaṃ nagaraṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*padmarāgairmarakatairindranīlairanuttamaiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*rucakaiḥ pāribhadraiśca palaṅkaiśca syamantakaiḥ \|*  
*gandhakairgālimaiścaiva candrakāntādibhistathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sūryakāntādibhiścaiva putraiśca sphaṭikākṛtaiḥ \|*  
*haridvarṇaiśca maṇibhiḥ śyāmairgoramukhaiścaṣaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*gorocanābhiḥ pītaiśca dāḍimībījarūpakaiḥ \|*  
*padmabījanibhaiścaiva nīlaiḥ kamalavarṇakaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*maṇibhiḥ kajjalākārairujjvalaiśca pariṣkṛtaiḥ \|*  
*śvetacampakavarṇābhaistaptakāñcanasaṃnibhaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*svarṇamūlyaśataguṇairīṣadraktaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ \|*  
*gariṣṭhaiśca variṣṭhaiścama ṇiśreṣṭhaiśca pūjitaiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*yathāvidhānaṃ yadyogaṃ yatra yanmuktamīpsitam \|*  
*maṇīnāṃ haraṇaṃ caiva yakṣasaṃghā himālayāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

*divāniśaṃ kariṣyanti yāvannirmāṇapūrvakam \|*  
*yakṣaiśca saptabhirlakṣaiḥ kuberapreritairapi \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vetālalakṣaiḥ kūṣmāṇḍalakṣaiḥ śaṃkarayojitaiḥ \|*  
*dānavairbrahmarakṣobhiḥ śailakanyāniyojitaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kuru divyaṃ ca patnīnāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*anyapatnījanasyāpi cāṣṭādhikaśatasya ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

14-23. Shri Krishna said – О Vishvakarma, you build a charming city spread over an area of a hundred yojanas, having the puppets made of rubies, emeralds, the best of sapphire, charming Paribhadra, Palanka, celebrated jewels, sulphur, gdlima, moon stone, sun-stone and crystal. They should have the shades like yellow, dark, white, blue like the seeds of pomegranate, yellow gorocana, like the seed as lotus flower, like blue lotuses, the collyrium, white campaka flower, shining like molten gold, hundred times more valuable than the gold, slightly red, most beautiful, heavy, the best of all and city should be built with the best of gems according to the signs of architecture, more or less, according to various designs. Till such time you build the city, the Yaksas will bring the gems from Himalaya throughout the day and night. The seven lakhs of Yaksas will be deputed by Kubera, a lakh of Vetalas and a lakh of kusmandas by Shiva, Danavas by Parvati the daughter of Himalaya beside the Brahmaraksasas would assist you in the construction work.

## \|\| 103.24 \|\|

*śibiraṃ parikhayuktamuccai prākāraveṣṭitam \|*  
*yuktadvādaśaśālaṃ ca siṃhadvārapariṣkṛtam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. You build beautiful houses for sixteen thousand and eight hundred of, my spouses which should be surrounded by the moats and high boundary walls, each one of these houses should have twelve rooms with the main entrance.

## \|\| 103.25-26 \|\|

*yuktaṃ citrairvicitraiśca kṛtrimaiśca kapāṭakaiḥ \|*  
*niṣiddhavṛkṣarahitaṃ prasiddhaiśca pariṣkṛtam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sulakṣaṇaṃ candravedhaṃ prāṅgaṇaṃ ca tathaiva ca \|*  
*yadūnāmāśramaṃ divyaṃ kiṃkarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. They should have the artificial doors, beautifully painted, the should be deprived of the evil trees and should have enough of the popular types of trees, in the court-yard should have auspicious symbols and Chandra-vedha. Similarly other houses should be built for the people of Yadu's race and the divine asramas for their attendants.

## \|\| 103.27 \|\|

*sarvatra siddhaṃ nilayamugrasenasya bhūbhṛtaḥ \|*  
*āśramaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ vasudevasya matpituḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The palace of king Ugrasena should be the best and the ashrama of Vasudeva should be Sarvatobhadra (open from all four sides).

## \|\| 103.28 \|\|

*viśvakarmovāca ke te vṛkṣāḥ praśastāśca niṣiddhāścāpi kecana \|*  
*bhadrābhadrapradāścāpi tānvadasva jagadguro \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Vishvakarma said – О lord of the universe, you tell me which one of the tree is praise-worthy and which one is a prohibited one. Which one of them produces good or bad results? You kindly tell me all.

## \|\| 103.29-33 \|\|

*keṣāmasthiniyuktaṃ ca śibiraṃ ca śubhāśubham \|*  
*diśi kutra jalaṃ bhadramabhadraṃ ca vada prabho \|\| 29 \|\|*

*bhadrapradaśca ko vṛkṣo diśi kṛtra pravartate \|*  
*kiṃ pramāṇaṃ gṛhāṇāṃ ca prāṅgaṇānāṃ sureśvara \|\| 30 \|\|*

*maṅgalaṃ kusumodyānaṃ diśi kutra tarostathā \|*  
*prākārāṇāṃ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ parikhāṇāṃ sureśvara \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dvārāṇāṃ ca gṛhāṇāṃ ca prākārāṇāṃ pramāṇakam \|*  
*kasya kasya taroḥ kāṣṭhaṃ praśastaṃ śibire prabho \|\| 32 \|\|*

*amaṅgalaṃ vā keṣāṃ ca sarva māṃ vaktumarhasi \|\| 33 \|\|*

29-33. О lord with the fall of whose bone the place become auspicious apd with the fall of whose bone it becomes inauspicious. Towards which side of the camp the water is auspicious and on which side it becomes inauspicious? О lord of the gods the boundary wall, moats, the gates, the houses and their enclosure walls should be of which sizes? О lord, the wood of which tree should be used in the building of a camp and the wood of which trees as inauspicious. You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 103.34 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca āśrame lārikelaśca gṛhiṇāṃ ca dhanapradaḥ \|*  
*śibirasya yadīśāne pūrve putrapradastaruḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Shri Krishna said – In case the coconut tree is planted in the ashrama, the householder achieve riches, these trees when planted towards the east or north-east bestows son to the householder.

## \|\| 103.35-37 \|\|

*sarvatra maṅgalārhaśca tarurājo manoharaḥ \|*  
*rasālavṛkṣaḥ pūrvasminnṛṇāṃ saṃpatpradastathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*śubhapradaśca sarvatra surakāro niśāmaya \|*  
*bilvaśca panasaścaivajambīro badarī tathā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*prajāpradaśca pūrvasmindakṣiṇe dhanadastathā \|*  
*saṃpatpradaśca sarvatra yato hi bardhate gṛhī \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. The tree bestows welfare all round. In case a mango tree is planted to the east of the house, the householder achieves enough of riches and it bestows welfare everywhere. О divine architect, the trees of wood-apple, jack-fruit, the lemon and jujubi, if planted on the eastern side, they bestow sons to the householder and in case they are planted on the southern side, the householder gets the riches all the times, The prosperity of householder increases with them.

## \|\| 103.38-40 \|\|

*jambūvṛkṣaśca dāḍimbaḥ kadalyāmrātakastathā \|*  
*bandhupradaśca pūrvasmindakṣiṇe mitradastathā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sarvatra śubhadaścaiva dhanaputraśubhapradaḥ \|*  
*harṣaprado guvākaśca dakṣiṇe paścime tathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*īśāne sukhadaścaiva sarvatraiva niśāmaya \|*  
*sarvatra campakaḥ śuddho bhuvi bhadrapradastathā \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. The trees of sala fruit, banana, myrobalan, when planted in the southern side they increase the friends. They are auspicious for all sides, the betel nut tree when planted on the southern side provides the householder with riches, sons and fortunes, in case they are planted in the west, they bestow pleasure and in case they are planted in the north-east, they bestow, welfare all round, the campa tree is auspicious wherever it is planted.

## \|\| 103.41-42 \|\|

*alābuścāpi kūṣmāṇḍamāyāmbuśca sakiṃśukaḥ \|*  
*kharjūrī karkaṭī cāpi śibire maṅgalapradā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*vāstūkakārabilvaśca vārtākaśca śubhapradaḥ \|*  
*latāphalaṃ ca śubhadaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatra niścitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. The white gourd, pumpkin, Ayambu, Palasa, date palm and cucumber are always auspicious in the royal camp. The purple goose foot, wood apple and bringle plants are quite auspicious. The creepers with fruits are always auspicious for all places.

## \|\| 103.43-44 \|\|

*praśastaṃ kathitaṃ kāro niṣiddhaṃ ca niśāmaya \|*  
*vanyavṛkṣo niṣiddhaśca śibire nagare'pi ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*vaṭo niṣiddhaḥ śibire nityaṃ corabhayaṃ yataḥ \|*  
*nagareṣu prasiddhaśca darśanātpuṇyadastathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. О architect, thus I have spoken to you about the auspicious trees now you listen to the inauspicious trees. The wild tree should neither be planted in a city nor in an asrama. The banyan tree should not be planted in a camp where the danger of thieves always remains. But in the big cities, the banyan tree is quite popular. The very sight of this tree showers merit on the people.

## \|\| 103.45 \|\|

*niṣiddhaḥ śālmariścaiva śibire nagare pure \|*  
*duḥkhapradaśca satataṃ bhūmipānāṃ sadā'pi ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. In the asrama cities and the villages, the plant of the cotton tree is totally prohibited. It causes misfortune to the king.

## \|\| 103.46-47 \|\|

*na niṣiddhaḥ prasiddhaśca grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca \|*  
*vidyāmatiniṣiddhastu satataṃ duḥkhadastadā \|\| 46 \|\|*

*he kāro tintiḍīvṛkṣo yatnāttaṃ parivarjayet \|*  
*śatena dhanahāniḥ syātprajāhānirbhaveddhruvam \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. О architect, the planting of tamarind tree should be planted in the villages but should never be planted in the camps. It destroys learnings and intelligence and creates pain, with the planting of this tree, the people have to loose the riches. Therefore one should carefully escape from the same.

## \|\| 103.48 \|\|

*śibire'tiniṣiddhaśca nagare kiṃcideva ca \|*  
*na niṣiddhaḥ prasiddhaśca grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The planting of the tamarind in an asrama is strictly prohibited and its plantation is restricted. In the towns and villages its plantation is not prohibited but it is quite popular.

## \|\| 103.49 \|\|

*vidyāmatiniṣiddhaśca prājñastaṃ parivarjayet \|*  
*kharjūraśca gahaścaiva niṣiddhaḥ śibire tathā \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The planting of palm tree and the tree with thorns are strictly prohibited in the camp because they destroy the learning and the intelligence, therefore they should be kept as a distance.

## \|\| 103.50 \|\|

*na niṣiddhaḥ prasiddhaśca grāmeṣu nagaleṣu ca \|*  
*vṛkṣaśca caṇakādīnāṃ dhānyaṃ ca maṅgalapradam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. In the cities as well as the villages the planting of cereals like grams is not prohibited but it is quite popular, the paddy is considered to be quite auspicious there.

## \|\| 103.51-54 \|\|

*grāmeṣu nagare cāpi śibire ca tathaiva ca \|*  
*ikṣuvṛkṣaśca śubhadaḥ saṃtataṃ śubhadastathā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*aśokaśca śirīṣaśca kadambaśca śubhapradaḥ \|*  
*kacciddharidrā śubhadā śubhadaścā''rdrakastathā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*harītakī ca śubhadā grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca \|*  
*na vādyā bhadradā nityaṃ cā''malakī ghruvam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*gajānāmasthi śubhadamaśvānāṃ ca tathaiva ca \|*  
*kalyāṇamuccaiḥśravasāṃ vāstau sthāpanakāriṇām \|\| 54 \|\|*

51-54. In the villages as well as in the cities, beside, dsramas, the planting of sugar-cane is considered to be quite auspicious together with ashoka tree, sirisa and kadamba tree. The planting of turmeric, ginger, black myrobalan, as well as green myrobalan are quite auspicious and bestow welfare in the land of construction, the bone of an elephant is considered to be quite auspicious together with the bone of the horse belonging to the breed of Uccaihshrava.

## \|\| 103.55-56 \|\|

*na śubhapradamanyeṣāmucchinnakāraṇaṃ param \|*  
*vānarāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca gardabhānāṃ gavāmapi \|\| 55 \|\|*

*kukkurāṇāṃ śṛgālānāṃ mārjārāṇāmabhadrakam \|*  
*bheṭakānāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ karveṣāṃ ca śubhapadam \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. The bones of others brings total destruction. The bones of monkeys, human beings, the donkeys, the crows, the gods, the jackal and the cats are considered to be quite inauspicious, the bones of the seep and the pigs are considered to quite auspicious.

## \|\| 103.57 \|\|

*īśāne cāpi pūrvasminpaścime ca tathottare \|*  
*śibirasya jalaṃ bhadramanyatrāśubhameva ca \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. It is quite beneficial, in case the water is available towards the north-east, west and the north of the camp.

## \|\| 103.58 \|\|

*dīrghe prasthe samānaṃ ca na kuryānmandire budhaḥ \|*  
*caturasre gṛhe kāro gṛhiṇāṃ dhananāśanam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. О architect the intellectual should keep the length and breadth of the house as equal. By constructing the house in a quadrangle, the house owner meets with his end.

## \|\| 103.59 \|\|

*dīrghaprasthaḥ parimito netrāṅkenāpi saṃhṛtam \|*  
*śūnyena rahitaṃ bhadraṃ śūnyaṃ śūnyapradaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The length and breadth of the house after dividing it by two if is nothing is left, it is considered to be quite auspicious for the people.

## \|\| 103.60 \|\|

*prasthe hastadvayātpūrvaṃ dīrghe hastatrayaṃ tathā \|*  
*gṛhāṇāṃ śubhadaṃ dvāraṃ prākārasya gṛhasya ca \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Two hands ahead of the width of the houses and three hands ahead and three hands beyond the length on the south, the door of the house as well as of the boundary walls is always considered to be auspicious.

## \|\| 103.61-62 \|\|

*na madhyadeśe kartavyaṃ kiṃcinnyūnādhike śubham \|*  
*caturasraṃ candravedhaṃ śibiraṃ maṅgalapradam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*abhadradaṃ sūryavedhaṃ śibiraṃ maṅgalapradam \|*  
*abhadradaṃ sūryavedhaṃ prāṅgaṇaṃ ca tathaiva ca \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. A door should not be provided in the middle of the house. It is always auspicious to be kept a little this way that way. The square house is considered to be auspicious when provided with a Chandra-vedha. But the auspicious house also becomes inauspicious when it has the Suryavedha. Similarly the Suryavedha court-yard is also inauspicious.

## \|\| 103.63 \|\|

*śibirāmyantare bhadrā sthāpitā tulasī nṛṇām \|*  
*dhanaputrapradātrī ca puṇyadā haribhaktidā \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The Tulasi plant which is planted by the householder is always considered to be auspicious which bestows riches and provides merit and the devotion of lord Hari.

## \|\| 103.64-75 \|\|

*prabhāte tulasīṃ dṛṣṭvā svarṇadānaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*mālatī yūthikā kundaṃ mādhavī ketakī tathā \|\| 64 \|\|*

*nāgeśvaraṃ mallikāṃ ca kāñcanaṃ bakulaṃ śubham \|*  
*aparājitā ca śubhadā teṣāmudyānamīpsitam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*pūrve ca dakṣiṇe caiva śubhadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*ūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśahastebhyo naiva kuryādgṛhaṃ gṛhī \|\| 66 \|\|*

*urdhvaṃ viṃśatihastebhyaḥ prākāraṃ na śubhapradam \|*  
*sūtradhāraṃ tailakāraṃ svarṇakāraṃ ca hīrakam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*vāṭīmūle grāmamadhye na kuryātsthāpanaṃ budha \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ kṣabhiyaṃ vaiśyaṃ sacchūdraṃ gaṇakaṃ śubham \|\| 68 \|\|*

*bhaṭṭaṃ vaidyaṃ puṣpakāraṃ sthāpayecchibirāntike \|*  
*prasthe ca parikhāmānaṃ śatahastaṃ praśastakam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*pārataḥ śibirāṇāṃ ca gambhīraṃ daśahastakam \|*  
*seketapūrvakaṃ caiva parikhādvāramīpsitam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*śatroragamyaṃ mitrasya gamyameva sukhena ca \|*  
*śālmalīnāṃ tintiḍīnāṃ hintālānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 71 \|\|*

*nimbāṇāṃ sindhuvārāṇāṃ badarīṇāmabhadrakam \|*  
*dhattūrāṇāṃ vaṭānāṃ cāpyeraṇḍānāmavāñchitam \|\| 72 \|\|*

*eteṣāmatiriktānāṃ śibire kāṣṭhamīpsitam \|*  
*vṛkṣaṃ ca vajrahastaṃ ca bhūdharo varjayedadhaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*putradāradhanaṃ hanyādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*kathitaṃ lokaśikṣārthaṃ kurukāṣṭhaṃ vinā purīm \|\| 74 \|\|*

*śubhakṣaṇaṃ cāpyadhunā gaccha vatsa yathāsukham \|*  
*viśvakarmā hariṃ natvā jagām pakṣiṇā saha \|\| 75 \|\|*

64-75. The one who sights the Tulasi plant in the morning, he earns the merit of giving away gold in charity. Towards the east and the south of the house, the plants of jasmine, madhavi, ketaki, nageshvara, wood apple, thorn-apple, maulasirl and aparajitd are always considered to be auspicious. The garden of these plants is always considered to be auspicious. There is no doubt about it. A house-holder should not build a house having a height of more than sixteen hands and the boundary walls should not be more than twenty hands in height. An intelligent person should not make the carpenter and oil-men and the goldsmith to live in the centre of the city but the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaisyas, Shudras, the astrologer, the bards, the physicians and the gardener should always the made to live close to one's house. The camp should be surrounded by a moat having a length of hundred hands and ten hands in depth. This type of moat has been praised by all. The entrance gate of the moat should be indicative which should be comfortable for the movement of the people but should be inaccessible for the enemies. Except the wood of cotton tree, tamarind wild-palm, neem, sindhuvdra, the wild fig tree, wood-apple, banyan, castor oil tree, the wood of all other trees could be used for the construction purpose. The king should not touch the wood vajra-hasta, otherwise one faces the destruction of the son, the wife and the riches. This has been ordained by Brahma, О son I have spoken all this for the information of the people, now you go with pleasure and construct the city without wood. This is the most auspicious time to start the construction work. Vishvakarma them bowed in reverence to the lord and left the place with Garuda.

## \|\| 103.76 \|\|

*samudrasya samīpaṃ ca vaṭamūlaṃ manoharam \|*  
*suṣvāpa tatra naktaṃ ca kāruśca pakṣiṇā saha \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. They reached the pleasant banyan tree standing on the shore of the ocean and spent the night there.

## \|\| 103.77-79 \|\|

*svapne dvāravatīṃ ramyāṃ dadarśa garuḍastathā \|*  
*yatkiṃcitkathitaṃ kāruṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|\| 77 \|\|*

*tadeva lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ dadarśa nagare mune \|*  
*kāruṃ hamanti svapne ca sarve te śilpakāriṇaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*garuḍaṃ garuḍāścānye baravantaśca pakṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*buddho dadarśa garuḍo viśvakarmā ca lajjitaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

77-79. In the dream Garuda witnesses the charming city of Dvaraka. О sage, he witnesses all the symptoms which lord Krishna had spoken to Vishvakarma in the city. In the dream also all the artisans were laughing at Vishvakarma and other were laughing at Garuda. After waking up, both Garuda and Vishvakarma felt ashamed.

## \|\| 103.80 \|\|

*atīva dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ śatayojanavistṛtām \|*  
*brahmādīnāṃ ca nagaraṃ vijitya ca virājitām \|*  
*tejasā''cchāditāṃ sūryaṃ ratnānāṃ ca pariṣkṛtām \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. The city of Dvaraka was quite beautiful and was spread over an area of hundred yojanas, it was established by conquering the cities of Brahma and others, there was enough of inlay work. The lustre issued from the gems studded in the houses covered the son.

## Chapter 104

## \|\| 104.1-5 \|\|

*atha caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca etasminnantare brahmā bhavānyā ca bhavaḥ svayam \|*  
*anantaścāpi dharmaśca bhāskaraśca hutāśanaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kubero varuṇaścaiva pavanaśca yamastathā \|*  
*mahendraścapi candraśca rudrāścaikādaśaiva te \|\| 2 \|\|*

*anye devāśca munayo vasavaḥ sapta eva ca \|*  
*ādityāścāpi daityāśca gandharvāḥ kinnarāstathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*āyayurdvārakāṃ draṣṭuṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca balaṃ tathā \|*  
*āgacchantaṃ ca sahasā vaṭamūlaṃ manoharam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā ca devatāḥ sarvāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam \|*  
*ākāśācca vimānaiśca saṃprāpya vaṭamūlakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Kubera, Vanina, Vayu, Yama, Mahendra, the moon, eleven Rudras, several gods and sages, seven Vasus, twelve Adityas, Daityas, Gandharvas and Kinnaras arrived in the city of Krishna and Balabhadra to have a view of the same passing by the charming banyan tree. They spotted lord Krishna there. The gods who were moving over their planes arrived there and started adoring the lord.

## \|\| 104.6-8 \|\|

*dadṛśurdvārakāṃ ramyāmatīva sumanoharam \|*  
*muktāmāṇikyahīreṇā ratnarājivirājitām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*paritaścaturasrāṃ ca śatayojanasaṃmitām \|*  
*saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca gambhīrābhiśca veṣṭitām \|\| 7 \|\|*

*prākārairnavabhiryuktāṃ lakṣaiḥ krīḍāsarovaraiḥ \|*  
*manoharaiḥ sapadmaiśca sahitaiśca madhuvrataiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Thereafter, they took round the city of Dvaraka which was quite beautiful, charming and was decorated with sapphires, emeralds, gems and several other precious stones studded in-lines and was surrounded with a moat of hundred yojanas. It had nine boundary walls, the swimming pools, with lotus flowers over which the black wasps were flying creating hissing sound.

## \|\| 104.9-16 \|\|

*śobhitāṃ sarvatobhadraiḥ puṣpodyānatrilakṣakaiḥ \|*  
*praphullapuṣpaiḥ pavanaiḥ sarvatra surabhīkṛtām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*āmoditāṃ ca śītena mandacandanavāyunā \|*  
*tarubhirnārikelāṇāṃ śobhitāṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*guvākānāṃ ca vṛkṣaiśca bhūṣitāṃ taccaturguṇaiḥ \|*  
*caturguṇairguvākānāṃ yuktāmāmramahīruhaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*parītāṃ panasānāṃ ca vṛkṣairāmrasamairmune \|*  
*suśobhitāṃ ca tālānāṃ drumairāmrasamairmune \|\| 12 \|\|*

*aśvatthairbadarībhiśca bilvairāmrātakairvaṭaiḥ \|*  
*śālmalībhiśca jambūbhiḥ kadambaiścāpi śobhitām \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vaṃśaiśca tintiḍībhiśca campakairbakulaistathā \|*  
*nāgeśvarairnāgaraṅgairjambīrairdāḍimairyutām \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kharjurairarjunaiḥ piṣṭairikṣubhiḥ kāñcanairapi \|*  
*harītakībhirdhātrībhirindubhiḥ paritaḥ plutām \|\| 15 \|\|*

*śālaiḥ priyālairhintālaiḥ śirīṣaiḥ saptaparṇakaiḥ \|*  
*anyairnānādrumairiṣṭairiṣṭāṃ yuktāṃ pariplutām \|\| 16 \|\|*

9-16. There were Sarvatobhadra style of structures and three lakhs of flower orchards, the fragrant cool breeze was blowing, the wind scented with the sandal-paste was blowing delightfully. There hundreds crores the coconut trees decorating the city. The number of betel-nut trees was four times the number of the coconut tree. The number of mango trees was four-times the number of betel-nut trees, the number of jack-fruit trees was equivalent to the number of mango trees and the city was decorated from all the sides, The number, of tala trees was the same as the number of mango trees. There were large number of pipala, jujubi, wood-apple, myrobalan, banyan, silk cotton, trees silk-fruit tree and kadamba trees in the city besides the trees of bamboo, tamarind, campa, maulasirl, nagakesara, lemon, orange, pomegranate, palm and Arjuna trees, beside pistaka, sugar-cane, deciduous tree, hantaki and myrobalan trees. Beside them, there were enough of sala, Buchanania latifolia, sirisa, saptaparna and several other trees in the city also there.

## \|\| 104.17-25 \|\|

*asaṃkhyairmandirai ramyairatyuccairapi saṃskṛtām \|*  
*ratnendrasāranirmāṇairmuktāmāṇikyabhūṣitaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*māṇikyahīrakaiścitraiḥ sadratnakalaśānvitaiḥ \|*  
*maṇibhirnirmitairiṣṭaiḥ sopānanikarairvaraiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*kapāṭaiḥ kaṭhinairdavyairargalākīlakairyutām \|*  
*harinmaṇīnāṃ stambhānāṃ kadambairapi saṃyutaiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*nānācitrairvicitraiśca sucitraiśca pariṣkṛtaiḥ \|*  
*darpaṇaiḥ sūkṣmavastraiśca śobhitaiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*prāṅgaṇaiḥ padmarāgādyarindranīlapariṣkṛtām \|*  
*vīthībhī ratnakhacitairājamārgaiḥ samanvitām \|\| 21 \|\|*

*grīṣmadhyāhnasūryābhāṃ jvalitāṃ ratnatejasā \|*  
*gavākṣalakṣaiḥ saṃyuktāṃ vājiśālāpariṣkṛtām \|\| 22 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā ca dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ te devā vismayaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*prasannavadano devo lāṅgalī bhagavānajaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sasmāra yaduvaṃśānāṃ samūhamugrasenakam \|*  
*vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca pāṇḍavāṃśca samātṛkān \|\| 24 \|\|*

*nandaṃ yaśodāṃ gopālānrājendramunipuṃgavām \|*  
*gandharvānkinnarāṃścaiva sahito yadupuṃgavaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

17-25. The city of Dvaraka had innumerable high palaces. All these were built with the best of gems in which the jewels, diamonds and other precious stones were studded. It had several vases made of gems. The steps also were made of gems, they had very strong doors with shutters. There were several pillars of rubies. The court-yards were decorated with sapphire and emeralds, the street were decorated with gems. The roads were quite white, the entire city of Dvaraka was shining like the mid-day sun of the summer season. There were lakhs of window and horse stables, all the gods felt surprised while looking at the city of Dvaraka. Shri Krishna with a delightful mind together with Balarama and other respectable persons of the race of Yadu including Ugrasena, Vasudeva, Devaki, mothers of Pandavas, Nanda, Yashoda, cowherds besides the kings and the sages, Gandharvas and Kinnaras entered the city.

## \|\| 104.26-30 \|\|

*nando yaśodā gopāśca jananyā saha pāṇḍavāḥ \|*  
*gandharvāḥ kinnarāścaiva vidyādharyaśca nārada \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kinnaryaścāpi nartakyo gāyakā vādyabhāṇḍakāḥ \|*  
*bhikṣukā bhāṇḍakāścaiva bhaṭṭāścagaṇakāstathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*nānādeśo dbhavā bhūpā vaidyāścānye ca mānavāḥ \|*  
*saṃnyāsinaśca yatayo'vadhūtā brahmacāriṇaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*āyayurmunayaḥ sarve saśiṣyāḥ siddhapuṃgavāḥ \|*  
*sanakaśca sanandaśca ttīyaśca sanātanaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sanatkumāro bhagavāñjñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ \|*  
*śiṣyaistrikoṭibhiḥ sārdha pañcavarṣā digambaraḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

26-30. О Narada, at that point of time several people arrived before Shri Krishna including Nanda, Yashoda, cowherds, Pandavas with mothers, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Vidyadharis, Kinnaris, the dancers, the singers, the players of musical instruments the beggars, the bards, astrologers kings of several countries, the physician, human beings, ascetics, Yatis, AvadMtas, Brahmacari, the sages with their pupils, siddhas in groups, Sanaka, Sananda Sanatana and Sanatkumara the teacher of the intellectuals, who always remained five year old and naked also arrived with three crores of his pupils.

## \|\| 104.31-36 \|\|

*śiṣyaistrilakṣaiḥ sahito durvāsā bhagavānajaḥ \|*  
*lakṣaśiṣyaiḥ kaśyapaśca vālmīkiśca trilakṣakaiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*lakṣaśiṣyairgau tamaśca kauṭibhiśca bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*śukrastrikoṭibhiḥ sārdha bharadvājaśca lakṣakaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*śiṣyaistrikoṭibhiḥ sārdhamaṅgirā bhagavānajaḥ \|*  
*vasiṣṭhaḥ koṭibhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ pracetāḥ koṭibhistathā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*trilakṣaiśca pulastyaścāpyagastyaḥ koṭibhiḥ saha \|*  
*pulaho lakṣaśiṣyaiśca kraturlakṣaisthaiva ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

*atristrikoṭibhiḥ śiṣyairbhṛguśca pañcakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*trikoṭibhirmarīciśca śatānandaḥ sahasrakaiḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sārdha trikoṭibhiḥ śiṣyairṛṣyaśṛṅgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ \|*  
*pāpiniḥ koṭibhiḥ śiṣyairlakṣaiḥ kātyāyanastathā \|\| 36 \|\|*

31-36. The sage Durvasa, arrived with three lakhs of his pupils, Kashyapa with a lakhs of his pupils, Valmlki with three lakhs of his pupils, Gautama with one lakh of pupils, Brihaspati with three crores of pupils, Sukracarya with three crores of pupils, Bharadvaja with a lakh of pupils, Angira with three crores' of pupils, Vasistha and Praceta with a crore of pupils each. Atri with three crore of people, Bhrigu with five crores of pupils, Marlci with three crores of people, Agastya with crores of pupils, Pulastya with three lakhs of pupils. Pulaha and Kratu with a lakh of pupils each, Satananda with thousand of pupils, Vibhandaka Rsyas'mga with three and a half crores of pupils, Panini with crores of pupils and Katyayana arrived with lakhs of pupils.

## \|\| 104.37-45 \|\|

*yājñavalkyaḥ sahasraiśca vyāsaḥ śiṣyatrikoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*śiṣyairlakṣaiśca sahito gargaḥ kulapulohitaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*gālavaśca sahasraiśca sahasaiḥ saubharistathā \|*  
*trikoṭibhirlomaśaśca mārkaṇḍeyastrikoṭibhiḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*koṭibhirvāmadevaśca jaigīṣavyastrikoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*sāṃdīpanirdevalaśca sacchiṣyaiśca trikoṭibhiḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*voḍhuḥ śiṣyaiḥ koṭibhiśca lakṣaiḥ pañcaśikhastathā \|*  
*ahaṃ nārāyaṇaścaiva naro mama sahodaraḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śiṣyaistrikoṭibhiḥ sārdhaṃ viśvāmitraśca koṭibhiḥ \|*  
*trikoṭibhirjaratkārurāstīkaśca trikoṭibhiḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*trikoṭibhiḥ parśurāmo vatso lakṣaiśca śiṣyakaiḥ \|*  
*dakṣastrilakṣaiḥ śiṣyaiśca kapilaḥ pañcakoṭibhiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*saṃvartaśca trilakṣaiścāpyutathyaśca tathaiva ca \|*  
*sahasrairjaiminiścaiva pailo lakṣaistathaiva ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*suvaṇaṃśca sahasraiśca vaiśampāyana eva ca \|*  
*śiṣyairlakṣaiḥ sametaśca vyāsaśiṣyaḥ purogamaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*lakṣaiḥ śiṣyaistathā śṛṅgī copamanyustathaiva ca \|*  
*sahasraiśca gauramukhaḥ kaco lakṣairguroḥ sutaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

37-45. Yajnavalkya arrived with thousand of his pupils, Vyasa arrived with three crores of pupils, the family priest Garga arrived with lakhs of pupils, Galava and Saubhari arrived with a thousand pupil each, Lomasha and Markandeya arrived with three crores of pupils, Vamadeva with crores of pupils, Jaiglsavya with three crores of pupils and thereafter pupils Sandlpani with three crores of pupils, while Devala arrived with crores of pupils, Vodhu arrived with the crores of pupils, Pancasikha arrived with the lakhs of pupils, Narayana arrived with three crores of pupils besides Nara, Vishvamitra arrived with crores of pupils, Jaratkaru, Parashurama and Astlka, arrived with three crores of pupils each. Vatsa arrived with lakhs of pupils, Daksha arrived with three lakhs of pupils, Kapila arrived with five crores of pupils, Samvarta and Utathya with three lakhs of pupils each, Jaimini arrived with thousand of pupils, Paila arrived with lakh of pupils, Suvarna arrived with thousand of pupils, Vyasa pupil Vaisampayana arrived with lakhs of pupils, Srngi and Upamanyu arrived with lakhs of pupils each. Gauramukha arrived with thousand of pupils, Kaca arrived with a lakh of pupils.

## \|\| 104.46 \|\|

*aśvatthāmā tathā droṇaḥ kṛpācāryaḥ saśiṣyakaḥ \|*  
*bhīṣmaḥ karṇaśca śakunī rājā duryodhanastathā \|*  
*nṛpasya bhrātaraḥ sarve cānye bhūpā jagadgurum \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Asvatthama and Dronacarya, Krpacarya with their pupils, Bhlsma, Karna, Sakuni, the king Duryodhana and his brother stayed with Jagadguru.

## \|\| 104.47-49 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca śubhakarmaṇi niṣpanne yāsyanti ye samāgatāḥ \|*  
*śivabrahmādayo devā munayaśca tathā'pare \|\| 47 \|\|*

*bhavāśca yādavaiḥ sārdhaṃ praviśa dvārakāṃ purīm \|*  
*matpitrā mātṛbhiḥ sārdha māhendre ca kṣaṇe nṛpa \|\| 48 \|\|*

*apare yadavo'nye ca yāsyanti mathurāṃ purīm \|*  
*śrutveti viraso rājā tamuvāca bhayākulaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

47-49. Shri Krishna said – All the people who have arrived here will return only after completion of the auspicious festivities. О king, you enter the city gate of Dvaraka in the Mahendra rnuMrta together with the mothers, fathers and Yadavas. All other people of the race of Yadu should go back to Mathura. At these Ugrasena felt terrified and said to him.

## \|\| 104.50-57 \|\|

*ugrasena uvāca vāsudeva na yāsyāmi bhūmiṃ tāṃ paitṛkīṃ punaḥ \|*  
*sarvatīrthaparāṃ śuddhāṃ daive karmaṇi paitṛke \|\| 50 \|\|*

*pāvake bhūmideśe ca pitṝṇāṃ nirvapettu yaḥ \|*  
*tadbhūmiḥ svāmipitṛbhiḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi hanyate \|\| 51 \|\|*

*pitṝṇāṃ niṣphalaṃ śrāddhaṃ devānāmapi pūjanam \|*  
*kiṃcitphalapradaṃ caiva saṃpūrṇe paitṛke sthale \|\| 52 \|\|*

*putrapautrakalatrebhyaḥ prāṇebhyaḥ preyasī sadā \|*  
*durlabhā paidṛkī bhūmiḥ piturmāturgarīṃyasī \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tatsatyaṃ ca pavitraṃ ca daive karmaṇi paitṛke \|*  
*krīḍāṃ ca datte dānaṃ ca paradattamaśuddhakam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*mriyate paitṛkībhūmyaṃ tīrthatulyaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*gaṅgājalasamaṃ pūtaṃ patṛkhātodakaṃ hare \|\| 55 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā jale pūte gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*pitaṇāṃ tarpaṇāṃ tatra pavitraṃ devapūjanam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*paitṛkī janmabhūmiśceddviguṇaṃ tatphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*paitṛkībhūmitulyāca dānabhūmiḥ satāmapi \|\| 57 \|\|*

50-57. О Vasudeva, I shall go back to my ancestral, land because it happens to be more auspicious that any other place for the performing of adoration of the gods and the manes. The one who does make the offering of the pindas to the ancestors on the land and the fire, the ancestors destroy the performers and the sraddha. The sraddhas performed by such a person for the ancestors become fruitless or bear little fruit but such a performance when made at the ancestral place bears much fruit. The ancestors land is considered to be dearer than the son, grandson and wife. The inaccessible ancestral land is dearer than the parents. Therefore for performing the adoration of the gods and the ancestors, it is considered to be quite auspicious, whatever is playfully given there is considered, to be. The charity, the charity given by someone at some other place is considered to be inauspicious, when one dies at the ancestral-land one achieves great merit like dyeing at a holy place. О Hari, the water of the pool of the ancestral and is considered to be quite auspicious like the water of the Ganga. By taking a bath there in that pool, one earns the merit of having a bath in the Ganga. The adoration of the gods and offering of water (tarpana) are considered to be quite auspicious. In case the birth place is an ancestral place the fruit of tarpana and other performance is doubled.

## \|\| 104.58-60 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca bhogāste vacanaṃ kiṃ vā niṣekaḥ kena vāryaṃte \|*  
*paitṛkī tīrthatulyā sā kiṃ tīrthaṃ dvārakāparam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*sarvatīrthaparā śreṣṭhā dvārakā bahapuṇyadā \|*  
*yasyāḥ praveśamātreṇa narāṇāṃ janmakhaṇḍanam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*dānaṃ ca dvārakāyāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ ca devapūjanam \|*  
*caturguṇaṃ ca tīrthānāṃ gaṅgādīnāṃ ca bhūmipa \|\| 60 \|\|*

58-60. Shri Krishna said – You have spoken the truth, who can stop the birth and the ancestors land is like a holy place but can that holy place be more important than the city of Dvaraka. The city of Dvaraka is the best of all and bestows great merit, with the entry of the people in Dvaraka they achiever moksa. О king, by giving away charities or by, performing sraddha or the adoration of gods in Dvaraka, one achieves four times more the merit than taking a bath in Ganga and other holy places.

## \|\| 104.61-68 \|\|

*gaccha brahmadibhiḥ sārdha munibhiryādavaiḥ saha \|*  
*rājendrabhavanaṃ tatra gṛhāṇāṃ sādaraṃ punaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*
