Devaki, charming Rohini, Yashoda, the wife of Nanda, Aditi, Diti and the best of damsels looked at the charming RukminT and Krishna again and again and then took them to their home, performing all the welfare ceremonies.

## \|\| 109.48 \|\|

*caturvidhaṃ bhojayitvā devāṃśca munipuṃgavān \|*  
*nṛpāṃśca bāndhavāṃścaiva parīhāraṃ cakāra ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Four types of dishes were served to the gods, the sages, the king, relatives and who begged forgiveness from them for anyshort coming.

## \|\| 109.49 \|\|

*bhaṭṭebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo'pi dadau ratnādikaṃ mudā \|*  
*tāṃścapi bhojayāmāsa parituṣṭāṃśca sasmitān \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The bards and the Brahmanas were served with gems delightfully and happily served the food.

## \|\| 109.50 \|\|

*evaṃ bhuktvā dhanaṃ labdhvā yayuḥ sarve gṛhaṃ mudā \|*  
*maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa vasudevasya vallabhā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Thus consuming the food all the people went back to their respective houses. Devaki the wife of Vasudeva then performed the welfare ceremony.

## Chapter 110

## \|\| 110.1 \|\|

*atha daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca āgateṣu gateṣvevaṃ sāṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi \|*  
*nando yaśodayā sārdha putrābhyāśaṃ samāyayau \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – with the departure of all the guests who had arrived to attend the marriage ceremony Nanda and Yashoda sat with their son.

## \|\| 110.2 \|\|

*yaśodovāca jñānaṃ ca bhavatā dattaṃ pitre nandāya mādhava \|*  
*māṃ cāpi mātaraṃ vatsa kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Yashoda said – О Madhava, you have bestowed the knowledge to your father Nanda, now, О ocean of mercy, you also be graceful to the mother like me.

## \|\| 110.3 \|\|

*māmuddhara mahābhāga dharoddhāraṇakāraṇa \|*  
*bhavābdhitaraṇe bhīmau bhītāṃ ca patitāmapi \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. I virtuous one, you redeem me also since you have arrived to rid the earth of her burden, you redeem a person like me who is terrified from the terrific ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 110.4 \|\|

*māyāmayī sā prakṛtirbhavābdhitaraṇe tariḥ \|*  
*tvameva karṇadhāraśca bhaktottīrṇe kṛpāmaya \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The illusory Prakriti serves as a boat to cross the ocean of the universe. О merciful one, you happen to be the boat-man or the sailor.

## \|\| 110.5 \|\|

*yaśodāvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa puruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*uvāca mātaraṃ bhaktyā jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. On hearing the words of Yashoda, Purusottama, the teacher of the great teachers and the intellectuals smiled and spoke to the mother with devotion.

## \|\| 110.6 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca jñānaṃ yogātmakaṃ mātarjñānaṃ ca viṣayātmakam \|*  
*jñānaṃ bhaktyātmakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ maddāsyakāraṇaṃ śubham \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Shri Krishna said – О mother knowledge is connected with yoga and knowledge is also connected with different subjects but the knowledge pertaining to devotion is considered to be the best. This is the auspicious cause of my slavehood.

## \|\| 110.7 \|\|

*jñānaṃ pañcavidhaṃ proktaṃ sarvavedeṣu saṃmatam \|*  
*bhaktyātmakaṃ sarvaparaṃ teṣāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The knowledge has been defined to be in Vedas of five types but the knowledge concerning the devotion is considered to be the best of all. You listen to some of the symptoms of the same.

## \|\| 110.8-9 \|\|

*kṣutpipāsādikānāṃ ca khaṇḍanaṃ svāntaśodhanam \|*  
*nāḍīnāṃ śodhanaṃ caiva cakrāṇāmapi bhedanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śaktikuṇḍalinīyuktamīśvaraṃ cintayettataḥ \|*  
*indriyāṇāṃ ca damanaṃ laubhādīnāṃ ca varjanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. By over-coming hunger and thirst, purifying inner-self, purification of the entrails, the shattering of the cakras and meditating upon the kundalini-sakti, the control of the organs of senses and discarding of the greed one achieves devotion.

## \|\| 110.10-11 \|\|

*mūlādhāraṃ svadhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūramanāhatam \|*  
*viśuddhaṃ ca tathā jñākhyaṃ cakraṣaṭkaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*nārīṇāmapi durbodhaṃ murkhāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*jñānaṃ yogātmakaṃ sādhvi siddhānāṃ sādhyamīpsitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Mulddhara, Adhisthana, Manipura, Anahata, Visuddha and Jna are the six cakras. These are inaccessible to the foolish and especially the woman. О chaste lady, the knowledge of yogic practices is meant for the siddhas.

## \|\| 110.12-13 \|\|

*jantūnāmapi sarveṣāṃ jñānaṃ svaviṣaye tathā \|*  
*santaḥ sarve vijānanti svecchayā ca madīyayā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*siddhyātmakaṃ ca siddhānāṃ niyuktaṃ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*catustriṃśatsu siddhānāṃ sādhanaṃ bodhanaṃ tathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. fingsrara xi fn^r xijjfravicy fnvgRi nm nraii^ii The knowledge about one's own self is desirable by all. The noble people know about themselves as per desire. The knowledge of siddhis is important in all the deeds of the siddhas.

## \|\| 110.14 \|\|

*jñānaṃ maukṣātmakaṃ siddhaṃ paraṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam \|*  
*nivṛttimārgamārūḍhaṃ bhaktastatraiva vāñchati \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The knowledge which bestows moksa is quite successful and redeems everyone. Such a type of knowledge makes one to follow the path of Nivrttimarga and the devotee is however never desirous of the same.

## \|\| 110.15 \|\|

*bhaktyātmakaṃ ca yajjñānaṃ tubhyaṃ rādhā pradāsyati \|*  
*tasyāṃ ca mānavaṃ bhāvaṃ tyaktvā jñānaṃ kariṣyati \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The knowledge about the devotion can be imparted to you by Radha. By shedding away the human approach, you can achieve the divine knowledge from her.

## \|\| 110.16 \|\|

*nandāya dattaṃ yajjñānaṃ tacca tubhyaṃ pradāsyati \|*  
*gaccha nandavrajaṃ mātarnandena saha sādaram \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The knowledge that I imparted to Nanda, the same will be imparted to you by her. О mother, you move on gracefully with Nanda to Vraja.

## \|\| 110.17-23 \|\|

*ityuktvā vinayaṃ kṛtvā jagāmābhyantaraṃ hariḥ \|*  
*nando yaśodayā sārdhaṃ prayayau kadalīvanam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dadarśa rādhāṃ tatraiva nidritāṃ tyaktabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*dadhānāṃ śuklavastraṃ ca nirāhārāṃ kṛśodarīm \|\| 18 \|\|*

*paṅkasthe paṅkajadale sajale candanārcite \|*  
*śayānāṃ śuṣkitauṣṭhīṃ ca sāśrunetrāṃ ca mūrcchitām \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dhyāyamānāṃ padāmbhojaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*bāhyajñānaparityaktāṃ tanni viṣṭaikamānasām \|\| 20 \|\|*

*paśyantīṃ sasmitaṃ kāntaṃ paśyantīṃ tanmukhāmbujam \|*  
*hasantīṃ ca rudantīṃ ca svapne kāntasamīpataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sakhībhiḥ paritaḥ śaśvatsevitāṃ ścetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*divāniśaṃ rakṣitāṃ ca gopībhiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sāvadhānaparābhiśca vetrahastābhirīśvarīm \|*  
*saptadvāreṣu yuktābhiḥ paritaḥ prāṅgaṇeṣu ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

17-23. Thus speaking displaying all his humility, Shri Krishna went to the inner apartment while Nanda accompanied by Yashoda went to the banana forest. Both of them found Radha there, who was lying unconscious on the bed of lotus leaves soaked with water and sandal-paste. Radha had discarded all the ornaments and was clad in bright costumes. By remaining without food her belly had shrunk the lips had dried up, the eyes were filled with tears. She was lying unconscious; she was meditating upon the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna remaining unconcerned from the outer world; she was totally engrossed in the meditation of lord Krishna. She was witnessing her smiling beloved in the dream and staring at his lotus-like face; she sometimes laughed before her beloved and same time wept before him. Her female friends were moving the white fly-whisks continuously. Hundreds and crores of the cowherdesses guarded the place, holding the canes in their hands. They were guarding the seven gates throughout the day and night protecting Radha.

## \|\| 110.24 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ prāpya sabhāryo nanda eva ca \|*  
*nanāma parayā bhaktyā daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Finding her there in that condition Nanda together with his wife was surprised and prostrated before her in reverence.

## \|\| 110.25-26 \|\|

*nidrāṃ tyāktvā ca sahasā bubudhe seśvarecchayā \|*  
*kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpa viṣayajñānavarcitām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*purato daṃpatī dṛṣṭvā papraccha sādaraṃ satī \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ caivaṃ tatraiva sakhisaṃsadi \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. With the will of the lord Radha at once got up from here sleep and she regained consciousness, unmindful of the subject to be discussed, finding the couple there, the chaste lady asked them, the reason for their arrival there. She than spoke sweet words in presence of her female friends.

## \|\| 110.27 \|\|

*rādhikovāca kastvaṃ cātra samāyāto brūhi vā kiṃ prayojanam \|*  
*na ca me viṣayajñānaṃ na jānāmi naraṃ paśum \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Radhika said – "Who are you?" What for have you arrived here? You tell me I am not aware of the subject to be talked I an unable to distinguish between a human and an animal.

## \|\| 110.28 \|\|

*kiṃ jalaṃ vā sthalaṃ kiṃvā naktaṃ tinaṃ śruṇu \|*  
*striyaṃ pumāṃsaṃ klībaṃ vā nāhaṃ jānāmi bhedākam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. I am unable to differentiate between the earth and the water, the day and night, the man and woman or the eunuch. I am unaware of any differentiation.

## \|\| 110.29-30 \|\|

*rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā nandaśca vismayaṃ yayau \|*  
*bhītā yaśodā nikaṭaṃ gopīsaṃbhāṣitā yayau \|\| 29 \|\|*

*uvāsa nikaṭe tasyāḥ samuvāca priyaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*uvāsa tatra nandaśca gopīdattāsanena ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. On hearing the words of Radhika, Nanda was extremely surprised. On hearing the words of cowherd Yashoda feeling panicky went closer to her and sitting besides here, she said. Nanda also took his seat offered by the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 110.31-32 \|\|

*yaśodovāca cetanaṃ kuru rādhe tvamātmānaṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ \|*  
*drakṣyasi prāṇanāthaṃ ca saṃprāpte maṅgale dine \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tvatto viśvaṃ pavitraṃ ca svakulaṃ ca sureśvari \|*  
*gopyaśca puṇyavatyaśca tvatpādāmbujasevayā \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Yashoda said – О Radha, be conscious. You save yourself making all the efforts because on the arrival of the days of welfare you will surely meet the lord of your life. О great goddess, you have purified not only your own race but also the universe as a whole. The cowherdesses have been purified by serving at your lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 110.33 \|\|

*lokā gāsyanti tvatkīrtitīrthapūtāṃ sumaṅgalām \|*  
*santo vedāśca catvāraḥ purāṇāni purātanīm \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The people, the sages, all the four Vedas and Puranas shall always recite your glory like other holy places.

## \|\| 110.34 \|\|

*ahaṃ yaśodā nando'yaṃ buddhirūpe nibodha mām \|*  
*vṛṣabhānasutā tvaṃ ca māṃ niśāmaya suvrate \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O form of intelligence, I am Yashoda and he is Nanda and you happen to be Radha the daughter of Vrsabhana. О performer of noble vratas, you listen to my words.

## \|\| 110.35 \|\|

*dvārakānagarādbhadre śrīkṛṣṇasaṃnidhānataḥ \|*  
*tavāntikamāgatā'haṃ preritā hariṇā sati \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О virtuous one, I have just returned from Dvaraka, the abode of Krishna. О chaste lady, lord Hari has directed me towards you.

## \|\| 110.36 \|\|

*śṛṇu maṅgalavārtāṃ ca maṅgalaṃ ca gadābhṛtaḥ \|*  
*ārāddrakṣyasi kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ he devi cetanaṃ kuru \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Now you listen to the welfare news of lord Gadadhara. You would shortly meet Shri Krishna O goddess regain your senses.

## \|\| 110.37 \|\|

*bhaktyā tmakaṃ parijñānaṃ dehi mahyaṃ ca sāṃpratam \|*  
*tvadbharturupadeśena tvatsamīpaṃ samāgatau \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. You bestow the knowledge of devotion to me, presently. Both of us have arrived here at the advice of your husband.

## \|\| 110.38 \|\|

*paścadāyāsyati haristvāṃ muhūrtaṃ varānane \|*  
*bhaviṣyatyacireṇaiva śrīdāmnaḥ śāpamocanam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. O beautiful faced one, "Lord Hari would arrive here before you after this and you would soon to be freed from the curse of Sridama".

## \|\| 110.39 \|\|

*yaśodāvacanaṃ śrutvā vārtāṃ prāpya gadābhṛtaḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇanāmasmaraṇāddūribhūtamamaṅgalam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. On hearing the words of Yashoda about the news of Gadadhara, all the miseries of Radha were removed.

## \|\| 110.40 \|\|

*saṃprāpa cetanaṃ rādhā saṃbhāvya kṛṣṇamātaram \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ śāntā laukikīṃ bhaktimuttamām \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Radha regained her consciousness becoming peaceful, honouring the mother of Krishna, she spoke to her sweet words concerning the devotion.

## Chapter 111

## \|\| 111.1-2 \|\|

*athaikādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ rādhikovāca jñānātmakaśca paramo brahmeśaśeṣapūjitaḥ \|*  
*jñānaṃ ca na dadau tubhyaṃ manmulaṃ preṣitā sati \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tenaiva cchadmanā tubhyaṃ bhāvārthaṃ bodhayāmi kim \|*  
*vedāḥ santaśca bhāvārthaṃ naiva jānanti tasya ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Radhika said – О chaste lady, lord Krishna is the form of knowledge and is adorable by Brahma, Shiva and Ananta; he instead of imparting the knowledge himself has directed you to me. By this, I am able to understand his feelings about me. Even the Vedas and the ascetics are unable to judge truly, his ideas.

## \|\| 111.3-4 \|\|

*strījātirabalā mūḍhā vaktuto'jñānatatparā \|*  
*tatastadviraheṇaiva saṃtataṃ hatacetanā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kiṃ vā'haṃ kathayiṣyāmi jñānaṃ pañcavidheṣu ca \|*  
*bhaktyātmakaṃ sarvaparaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. I belong to the class of woman who are considered to be weak, devoid of wisdom and deprived of knowledge. Because of the separation from him, my knowledge has faded out. In such a condition what could I speak about the five types of knowledge. Still the devotion happens to be the best of knowledge which is being narrated by me. You please listen to the same.

## \|\| 111.5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇasya vareṇāpi na sādho nirbhayo bhava \|*  
*goloke cāpi patanaṃ saṃbhavecca kuyoginaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О virtuous lady, don't become fearless because of the boon of Krishna because even an ascetic has to fall from Goloka.

## \|\| 111.6 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya bhajasva parameśvaram \|*  
*putrabuddhiṃ parityajya brahmarūpaṃ niśāmaya \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Therefore disowning everything, you recite the name of the lord. Discarding the feeling of his being the son you, take him to be the eternal Brahman.

## \|\| 111.7 \|\|

*yaśode bhavatī sarve parityajya ca naśvaram \|*  
*gatvā vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О Yashoda, you, after discarding all the perishable articles, go to Vrindavana situated on the auspicious land of Bharata.

## \|\| 111.8-9 \|\|

*kṛtvā trikālasnānaṃ ca nirmale yamunājale \|*  
*kṛtvā'ṣṭadalapadmaṃ ca snigdhena candanena ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dhyānena gargadattena śuddhena manasā sati \|*  
*saṃpūjya paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ vraja tatpadam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Taking bath in the spotless clean water of the Yamuna thrice a day, you prepare an eight pettaled lotus, with a devoted mind, adore blissful lord Krishna variously and get absorbed in the blissful stage ultimately.

## \|\| 111.10 \|\|

*kṛtvā nikṛntanaṃ karma pidṛbhiḥ śatakaiḥ saha \|*  
*vaiṣṇavena sahā''lāpaṃ kuruṣva satataṃ sati \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О chaste lady, you better uproot all the deeds performed earlier with hundred means and always converse with the Vaishnavas.

## \|\| 111.11-12 \|\|

*varaṃ hutavahajvālāṃ bhakto vāñchati pañjaram \|*  
*varaṃ ca kaṇṭake vāsaṃ varaṃ ca viṣbhakṣaṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*haribhaktivihīnānāṃ na saṅgaṃ nāśakāraṇam \|*  
*svayaṃ naṣṭo bhaktihīno bṛddhiṇedaṃ karoti ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. A devotee accepts the flames; of fire, captivity in a cage, leaving among the thorns end consuming the poison but he fails to keep company of the people devoid of the devotion of lord Hari because the same deeds to destruction. A person who is devoid of devotion, not only destroys himself but simultaneously create differentiation.

## \|\| 111.13-14 \|\|

*aṅkuro bhaktivṛkṣasya bhaktasaṅgena vardhate \|*  
*paraṃ harikathālāpapīyūṣāsecanena ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

*abhaktālāpadīpāgnijvālāyāḥ kalayāpi ca \|*  
*aṅkuraḥ śuṣkatāṃ yāti punaḥ sekena vardhate \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. By keeping the company of a devotee, with the reciting of the story of lord Hari, the tree of devotion sprouts with the nectar-like stories. But by conversing with the people devoid of devotion, serves as the burning flame, the sprouting tree is dried up. Only by the serving the lord or reciting of his stories lord, it develops and sprouts.

## \|\| 111.15 \|\|

*tasmādabhaktasaṅgaṃ ca sāvadhānaḥ parityaja \|*  
*yathā dṛṣṭvā kālasarpaṃ naro bhītvā palāyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The company of the non-believer should be left in the same way, as a person runs away in panic at the sight of a terrible snake.

## \|\| 111.16-18 \|\|

*yaśode ca prayatnena svātmanaḥ putramīśvaram \|*  
*rāma nārāyaṇananta mukunda madhusūdana \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇa keśava kaṃsāre hare vaikuṇṭha vāmana \|*  
*ityekādaśa nāmāni paṭhedvā pāṭhayediti \|\| 17 \|\|*

*janmakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ pātakādeva mucyate \|*  
*rāśabdo viśvavacano maścāpīśvaravācakaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. О Yashoda, you must adore your son with great efforts, like a lord. The one who recites the name of Rama, Narayana, Ananta, Mukunda, Madhusudana, Krishna, Keshava, Kamsari, Hari, Vaikuntha and Vamana or the one who reads these eight names daily, he is freed from the thousands and crores of sins of the previous births. Ra stands for globe and Ma stands for the lord. Thus the one who is the lord of the globe is called Rama. He enjoys the company of Rama, that is why he is also called Rama.

## \|\| 111.19-21 \|\|

*viśvānāmīśvaro yo hi tena rāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*ramate ramayā sārvaṃ tena rāmaṃ vidurbudhā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ramāyā ramaṇasthānaṃ rāmaṃ rāmavido viduḥ \|*  
*rāśceti lakṣmīvacano maścāpīśvaravācakaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*lakṣmīpatiṃ gatiṃ rāmaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānāṃ smaraṇe yatphalaṃ labhet \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. Since Rama happens to be the cause of the knowledge of Rdmatattva and the place of keeping company with Rama, he is also called Rama. Even otherwise Ra stands for Lakshmi and Ma stands for the lord. Therefore the intellectuals call the lord of Lakshmi as Rama; the merit one earns by reciting thousands of the divine names the same is achieved by reciting the name of Rama only once.

## \|\| 111.22-29 \|\|

*tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ rāmoccāraṇamātrataḥ \|*  
*sārūpyamuktivacano sāreti ca vidurbudhāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*yo devo'pyayanaṃ tasya sa ca nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*nārāśca kṛtapāpāścāpyayanaṃ gamanaṃ smṛtam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yato hi gamanaṃ teṣāṃ so'yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*sakṛnnārāyaṇetyuktvā pumānkalmaśatatrayam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*gaṅgādisarvatīrtheṣu snāto bhavati niścitam \|*  
*nāraṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ puṇyamayanaṃ jñānamīpsitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tayorjñānaṃ bhavedyasmātso'yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*nāstyanto yasya vedeṣu purāṇeṣu caturṣu ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*śāstreṣvanyeṣu yogeṣu tenānantaṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*mukumadhyayamānaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ mokṣavācakam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*taddadāti ca yo devo mṛkuṃdastena kīrtitaḥ \|*  
*mukuṃ bhaktirasapremavacanaṃ vedasaṃmatam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*yastaṃ dadāti bhaktebhyo mukaṃdastena kīrtitaḥ \|*  
*sūdanaṃ madhudaityasya yasmātsa madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

22-29. The intellectuals believes that Nara stands for Sarupya salvation. Therefore the one who happens to be the god of the same or the Ayana is called Narayana. The sins which are committed by some one are known as Nara and Ayana stands for disappearing. This with the reciting of the name of Narayana, all the sins disappear. With the reciting of the word Narayana once, a person achieves the merit of having a bath in all the sacred places for a hundred kalpas. According to another interpretation Nara stands for merit and moksa while the Ayana stands for the appropriate knowledge. The one who therefore, enshrines the knowledge of both, he is considered to be Narayana. The one who beyond the description of the four Vedas, Puranas, scriptures and others literature and is unlimited, he is called Ananta by the intellectuals. Мики stands for studies and salvation beside moksa and the one who provides the same, is known as Mukunda. Even otherwise, the word Мики stands for love and devotion as prescribed in the Vedas and the one who bestows the same to the devotees is called Mukunda. Because he happens to be the killer of the demon Madhu, he is therefore called Madhustidana.

## \|\| 111.30-36 \|\|

*iti santo vadantīśaṃ vede bhinnārthamīpsitam \|*  
*madhu klībaṃ ca mādhvīke kṛtakarmaśubhāśubhe \|\| 30 \|\|*

*bhaktānāṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva sūdanaṃ madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*pariṇāmāśubhaṃ karmaṃ bhrāntānāṃ madhuraṃ madhu \|\| 31 \|\|*

*karoti sūdanaṃ yo hi sa eva madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣirutkṛṣṭavacano ṇaśca sadbhaktivācakaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*aścāpi dātṛvacanaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tena vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*kṛṣiśca paramānande ṇaśca taddāsyakarmaṇi \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tayordātā ca yo devastena kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*koṭijanmārjite pāpe kṛṣiḥkleśe ca vartate \|\| 34 \|\|*

*bhaktānāṃ ṇaśca nirvāṇe tena kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānāṃ trirāvṛttyā cayatphalam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*ekāvṛttyā tu kṛṣṇasya tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇanāmnaḥ paraṃ nāma na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati \|\| 36 \|\|*

30-36. Even otherwise the people derive meaning from the word Madhu which is a neutral gender and is present in the good or bad deeds or a wine of intoxicated tree. Therefore the one who destroys the same together with the deeds of the devotees, he is called Madhusudana. Such of the deeds which results in evil reward and are sweet in fallacy, they are termed as Madhu. The one who destroys the same he is called Madhustidana. The word Krsi stands for excellence and … stands for the noble devotion and A stands for the container. That is why people call him by the name of Krishna. According to another interpretation Krsi stands for blissful and .. stands for the slavehood. The on who provides both of them is called Krishna. Even otherwise the word Krsi stands for the sin earned during the crores of the births and … stands for the reliever of the sins. This results in the making of the word Krishna. The merit one earns by reciting the thousand divine names of the lord thrice, the same merit is earned by him while reciting the name of Krishna. There has been no name better than Krishna in the past nor would it be in future.

## \|\| 111.37-42 \|\|

*sarvebhyaśca paraṃ nāma kṛṣṇeti vaidikā viduḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇoti he gopi yastaṃ smarati nityaśaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*jalaṃ bhittvā yathā padmaṃ narakāduddharecca saḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇeti maṅgalaṃ nāma yasya vāci pravartate \|\| 38 \|\|*

*bhasmībhavanti sadyastu mahāpātakakoṭayaḥ \|*  
*aśvamedhasahasrebhyaḥ phalaṃ kṛṣṇajapasya ca \|\| 39 \|\|*

*varaṃ tebhyaḥ punarjanma nāto bhaktapunarbhavaḥ \|*  
*sarveṣāmapi yajñānāṃ lakṣāṇi ca vratāni ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tīrthasnānāni sarvāṇi tapāṃsyanaśanāni ca \|*  
*vedapāṭhasahasrāṇi prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvaḥ śatam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇanāmajapasyāsya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|*  
*teṣāṃ lobhā dbhavetsvargaphalaṃ ca suciraṃ nṛṇām \|\| 42 \|\|*

37-42. The people well-versed in the Vedic knowledge, hold the view that the name Krishna is the best of all. О cowherdesses, the one who recites the name of Krishna again and again regularly, he is saved from falling into the hell in the same way as the lotus emerges out of the water. The one in whose tongue the word Krishna always remain, all his great sins are reduce to ashes. The reciting of the name Krishna is better than the performing of thousands of Asvamedha sacrifices, because by doing so, one is never reborn again. By reciting the same name, one is freed from the cycle of the birth and death. All the yajhas, lakhs of vratas, with bathing in the holy places, All types of tapas, performing of vratas, thousands of the reciting of the Vedas, going round the globe a hundred times, all these combined do not compare to the one sixteen the part of the merit one earns by reciting the name of Krishna, with the greed of performing the good deeds, a person enjoys his stay in the heaven and the fall from the heaven is a must. But the one who recites the name of Hari he achieves the eternal abode.

## \|\| 111.43-47 \|\|

*svarkādavaśyaṃ puṃsaśca japakarturhareḥ padam \|*  
*ke jale sarvadehe'pi śayanaṃ yasya cā''tmanaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*vadanti vaidikāḥ sarve taṃ devaṃ keśavaṃ param \|*  
*kaṃsaśca pātake vighne roge śoke ca dānave \|\| 44 \|\|*

*teṣāmarirnihantā ca sa kaṃsāriḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*rudrarūpeṇa saṃhartā viśvānāmapi nityaśaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*bhaktānāṃ pātakānāṃ ca haristena prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*mā ca brahmasvarūpā yā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 46 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇīti vikhyātā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī \|*  
*mahālakṣmīsvarūpā ca vedamātā sarasvatī rādhā vasuṃdharā gaṅgā tāsāṃ svāmī ca mādhavaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

43-47. The letter Ka stands for water. The one who pervades that water and the bodies of all the creatures, he is called Kesava by the Vedic people. The word Karhsa is used for obstruction, ailment greed and the Danavas. The one who is inimical to all of them is known by the name of Kamsari. The one who in the form of Rudra and destroy the universe always and the enemies of the devotees, is known by the name of Hari. Ma stands for the form of eternal Brahman and Mula-Prakriti besides being Isvarl, NarayanI, SanatanI, Vishnumaya, Maha-Lakshmi, Sarasvati the creator of the Vedas, Radha, Vasundhara and Ganga. Therefore, the lord is known as Madhava.

## \|\| 111.48-52 \|\|

*brahmeśaśeṣādibhavaiśca vandyaṃ dhyānairna kiṃcitsanakādibhiśca \|*  
*vedaiḥ purāṇairna nirūpitaṃ ca bhajasva bhaktyā navanītacoram \|\| 48 \|\|*

*kva cāpi dugdhaṃ kva daghi ghṛtaṃ vā navoddhṛtaṃ vā kva ca takramīpsitam \|*  
*teṣāṃ kva corobhavatiṃ kva cāpi kva bandhanaṃ te bhavamūlamadhye \|\| 49 \|\|*

*na yogibhiḥ siddhagaṇairmunīndrairna bhaktasaṃghairbhavapadmaśeṣaiḥ \|*  
*yogairna baddho na hi rakṣituṃ kṣamaiḥ kathaṃ sa vaddhastava mūlamadhyataḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*pramṇānu bhaktyā stavanena pūjayā bhajasva putraṃ tarasā ca bhārate \|*  
*hṛtpadmamadhye sthitamīśvaraṃ paraṃ dhyānena yatnena ca saṃtataṃ sati \|\| 51 \|\|*

*varaṃ vṛṇuṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vāñchitam \|*  
*sarvaṃ dāsyāmi jagati devānāmapi durlabham \|\| 52 \|\|*

48-52. О chaste lady, the one who is adored by Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and Shesha and the sage like Sanaka and others, who are unable to know about the secret of his existence by deep meditation, the one who is beyond the conception of all the Vedas and the Puranas, you should adore with devotion the one who stole away the butter from your house. Where is the milk, curd, butter-milk, ghee and other milk preparations? Where is the thief of these articles? Where is your link with the base of the universe? The one who could not be captured by the yogis, siddhas, ascetics, the devotees, Brahma, Shiva and Shesha, how could he be bound with the mortar by you? Therefore you adore your son who is lodged in the centre of the lotus flowers in the form of the lord and adore him with devotion, meditation, recitation, making all the efforts. You would meet with welfare. You ask for a boon, desired by you. The one which is beyond a reach of the gods his adoration would surely be bestowed by me to you.

## \|\| 111.53 \|\|

*yaśodovāca harau ca niścalā bhaktistaddāsyaṃ vāñchitaṃ mama \|*  
*tava nāmnaśca vyutpattiḥ kā vā tadvaktumarhasi \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Yashoda said – I desire a boon to achieve the infallible devotion at the feet of lord Hari and his slavehood. You also enlighten me about the root of your own name.

## \|\| 111.54 \|\|

*rādhikovāca bhavedbhaktirniścalā te harerdāsyaṃ ca durlabham \|*  
*labhasva madvareṇāpi kathayāmi sunirṇayam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Radhika said – with my boon you would surely achieve the devotion of the lord besides his slavehood. Now I tell you the best of the decision.

## \|\| 111.55-56 \|\|

*purā nandena dṛṣṭā'haṃ bhāṇḍīre vaṭamūlake \|*  
*mayā ca kathito nando niṣiddhaśca prajeśvaraḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*ahameva svayaṃ rādhā chāyā rāyaṇakāminī \|*  
*rāyaṇaḥ śrīhareraṃśaḥ pārṣadapravaro mahān \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. In the earlier times Nanda found me in the Bhandlra forest seated under the shed of a banyan tree, I stopped Prajapati Nanda and said to him, "I am Radha myself and by reflection the wife of Rayana. Rayana was born of the amsa of Hari and happens to be one of the important courtiers of lord Hari.

## \|\| 111.57 \|\|

*rāśabdaśca mahāviṣṇurviśvāni yasya lomasu \|*  
*viśvaprāṇiṣu viśveṣu dhā dhātrī mātṛvācakaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The word Ra stands for Maha-Vishnu in the hair-pits of whom several globes are lodged and dha stand for the motherhood among the creatures.

## \|\| 111.58 \|\|

*dhātrī mātā'hameteṣāṃ mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*tena rādhā samākhyātā hariṇā ca purā budhaiḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. I being the Mula-Prakriti and Ishvari, I am the mother of all of them. This is the reason why Hari and other people gave me the name of Radha in the earlier times.

## \|\| 111.59 \|\|

*ahaṃ sudāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā \|*  
*śatavarṣaṃ ca vicchedo hariṇā saha sāṃpratam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. I have become the daughter of Vrsabhana because of the curse of Shridama; now I shall be separated from lord Hari for a hundred years.

## \|\| 111.60 \|\|

*vṛṣabhānaśca kṛṣṇasya pārṣadapravaro mahān \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā mama mātā kalāvatī \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Vrsabhana happens to be the best of the courtiers of the Krishna and parson my mother named Kalavati is the mind born daughter of the ancestors.

## \|\| 111.61-62 \|\|

*ayonisaṃbhavā'haṃ ca mama mātā ca bhārate \|*  
*punaḥ sārthaṃ ca yuṣmābhiryāsyāmi śrīhareḥ padam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vrajaṃ vraja vrajeśvari \|*  
*vrajeśvareṇa sahitā svāminā jñāninā sati \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. In the land of Bharata, both myself and my mother are born without human contact I shall move to the abode of Hari together with you. О queen of Vraja, I have thus spoken out to you all the things. О chaste lady, now you move back to Vraja together with your husband who is the lord of Vraja.

## \|\| 111.63 \|\|

*mamādhunā ca bhavatī dhyānasya vyavadhānikā \|*  
*dhyānabhaṅge mahādoṣo narāṇāmapi sundari \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Currently you are obstructing my meditation. О beautiful one, a person earns sins by disturbing medication.

## Chapter 112

## \|\| 112.1-2 \|\|

*atha dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca vāsudevo dvārakāyāṃ vasudevājñayā mune \|*  
*prayayau ratnaruciraṃ rukmiṇīmandiraṃ varam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśamamūlyaratnanirmitam \|*  
*purataḥ parito ramyaṃ nānācitreṇa citritam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – О sage, at the command of Vasudeva, Krishna went in Dvaraka, in the palace of Rukmini, which was decorated with the best of gems. It was shining like the best of crystal gems and other invaluable diamonds, it had a number of paintings decorating all the sides.

## \|\| 112.3 \|\|

*amūlyaratnakalaśaṃ śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*vahaniśuddhāśukaiḥ śuddhaiḥ paritaḥ pariśobhitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. It was decorated with the invaluable pitchers of gems and a large number of white fly-whisks and the mirrors. The costumes sanctified by fire appeared on all the sides.

## \|\| 112.4-6 \|\|

*dadarśa rukmiṇīṃ devīmatīva navayauvanām \|*  
*ratnaparyaṅkamāruhya śayānāṃ sasmitāṃ mudā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*aprauḍhāṃ ca navoḍhāṃ tāṃ navasaṃgamalajjitām \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇena vibhūṣitām \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sucārukabarībhārāṃ mālatīmalyabhūṣitām \|*  
*dṛṣṭavā kṛṣṇāṃ bhīṣmakanyā sahasā praṇanāma sā \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Rukmini who was quite youthful was found there lying on the bed of gems and smiling delight-fully. She was adult, had been just wedded and was therefore feeling shy of the first union. She was adorned with the best of gem-studded ornaments and her hair do looked simply charming; which was decorated with the garlands of jasmine flowers. The daughter of Bhlsmaka suddenly fiddling Krishna before her offered her salutation to him.

## \|\| 112.7-8 \|\|

*tāṃ saṃprāpya jagannātho ratnatalpe uvāsa saḥ \|*  
*śubhakṣaṇe ca śubhayā sa reme rāmayā saha \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sukhasaṃbhogamātreṇa mūrcchāmāpa mudā satī \|*  
*tasyāṃ jajñe kāmadevo bhasmībhūtadaśca śaṃbhunā \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Finding her there, Krishna the lord of the universe, sat on the bed and started enjoying conjugal pleasures, the damsels was fainted; the god of love had been reduced to ashes by lord Shiva.

## \|\| 112.9 \|\|

*sa śambaraṃ nihatyaiva tatra prāpa ratiṃ satīm \|*  
*ratirmāyāvatīnāmnā saṃketena surasya ca \|*  
*chāyāṃ dattvā ca śayane gṛhiṇī śambarālaye \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. After killing the demon Sambara, he achieved the chaste Rati. At that point of time at the instance of the gods, Rati remained in the house of the demon as her shadow named Mayavati.

## \|\| 112.10 \|\|

*narada uvāca jahāra śambaraṃ kāmo daityaṃ kena prakārataḥ \|*  
*kathayasva māhābhāga vistareṇa śubhāṃ kathām \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Narada said – О virtuous one, you please tell me how was Sambara killed by Kamadeva? You please tell me the story in detail.

## \|\| 112.11-12 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca samatīte ca saptāhe rukmiṇīsūtikāgṛhāt \|*  
*gṛhītvā bālakaṃ daityo jagām svālayaṃ javāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

*aputrakaśca daityeśaḥ putraṃ prāpya praharṣitaḥ \|*  
*māyāvatyai dadau hṛṣṭo hṛṣṭā māyāvatī satī \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Narayana said – After the lapse of a week, the demon entered the labour room of Rukmini and carried away her son with great force. The demon who was without a son felt extremely delighted by getting that son. He entrusted his care too Mayavati, who felt delighted by receiving the child.

## \|\| 112.13 \|\|

*atīva pālanenaiva vardhayāmāsa bārakam \|*  
*sarasvatī tāṃ rahasi kathayāmāsa nirjane \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. She carefully brought up the child, Sarasvati then spoke to her in lonely place.

## \|\| 112.14 \|\|

*sarasvatyuvāca śivakopānale pūrva bhasmībhūtaḥ patistava \|*  
*sa cāyaṃ rukmiṇīputro daityenaiva samāhṛtaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Sarasvati said – In earlier times, your husband was reduced to ashes because of the anger of lord Shiva; the same Kamadeva has been born as the son of Rukmini who has been abducted by the demon.

## \|\| 112.15 \|\|

*māyayā'pi ca māyeśo rukmiṇīsūtikāgṛhāt \|*  
*samānīya dadau tubhyaṃ patiste'yaṃ na cā''tmajaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The one who is well-versed in the illusion has brought him from the labour room of Rukmini and given him to you. He happens to be your husband and not the son.

## \|\| 112.16 \|\|

*kāmaṃ ca kathayāmāsa jaganmātā ca sā satī \|*  
*tava patnī ratiśceyaṃ ramasva rāmayā saha \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Sarasvati who happened to be the mother of the universe also spoke to Kamadeva, "This is your wife named Rati and you enjoy her company"

## \|\| 112.17 \|\|

*tvameva rukmiṇīputro nānyadaityasya manmathaḥ \|*  
*kurarīva satī nityaṃ roditi sma tvayā vinā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. You are Kamadeva, the son of Rukmini and you are not the son of the demon. The chaste Rati had always been crying like the bird of prey.

## \|\| 112.18 \|\|

*ityuktvā ca yayau vāṇī brahmāṇī brahmaṇaḥ padam \|sa reme nirjane nityaṃ rāmayā saha sundaraḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Thus speaking Sarasvati the spouse of Brahma, Brahmaloka and the beautiful Kamadeva daily enjoyed the company of the beautiful Rati in the lonely places.

## \|\| 112.19 \|\|

*ekadā manmathaṃ daityau dadarśa rahasi śthitam \|*  
*śṛṅgāraṃ rāmayā sārdhaṃ kurvantaṃ kautukena ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Once the demon witnessed Kamadeva and Rati both engaged in the conjugal pleasure.

## \|\| 112.20-21 \|\|

*sasmitaṃ sasmitāyāśca madhyavakṣaḥsthalasthitam \|*  
*ratiṃ dadarśa kāmena mūrcchitāṃ suratotsukām \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā cukopa daityaśca jagrāha khaḍgamuttamam \|*  
*uvāca khaḍgahastaśca kāmadevaṃ ratiṃ satīm \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. The-smiling Kamadeva was found on the breast of Rati who was anxious to enjoy conjugal pleasures and got fainted in passion. Witnessing this the demon was enraged. He took out his sword. Holding the sword in his hand, he spoke to Kamadeva and Rati.

## \|\| 112.22 \|\|

*śamvara uvāca dhiktvāṃ mahākāmukaṃ ca mūrkhaṃ paṇḍitamāninam \|*  
*mahāpātakināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pramattaṃ mātṛgāminam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Sambara said – О foolish one, you consider yourself to be veiy wise, you are the most degraded of all the sinners and are intoxicated, you enjoy the company of your own mother. О passionate one, disgrace to you.

## \|\| 112.23 \|\|

*dhiktvāṃ ca puṃścalīṃ mattāṃ kāmukīṃ hatacetanām \|*  
*putraṃ gṛhītvā rahasi kaloṣi suratiṃ sati \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О loose women, an intoxicated the one, the passionate one and the senseless women, disgrace to you, a chaste lady is enjoying the company of her son in seclusion.

## \|\| 112.24 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā khaḍgaṃ ca tāmeva hantumṛdyataḥ \|*  
*jighāṃsantaṃ ratiṃ detyaṃ prerayāmāsa manmathaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Thus speaking he raised his sword to kill her. The demon who was about to kill Rati, was pushed aside by Kamadeva.

## \|\| 112.25-28 \|\|

*papāta dūrato brahmanmūrcchitaḥ svāṅgapīḍitaḥ \|*  
*punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya kopena prajvalanniva \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śivadattaṃ ca śūlaṃ ca jagrāha nirbhareṇa ca \|*  
*śatasūryaprabhaṃ śūlaṃ pralayāgnisamaṃ mune \|\| 26 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā''jagmuśca devāśca brahmeśaśeṣasaṃjñakāḥ \|*  
*pavanaḥ kathayāmāsa karṇe kāmasya yatnataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*smara smara mahāmāyāṃ durgāṃ turgatināśinīm \|*  
*pavanasya vacaḥ śrutvā durgāṃ sasmāra manmathaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

25-28. О Brahman, the demon felt pain in all his limbs and fainted falling at a distance. Regaining his consciousness he was burning with rage and held the trident of Shiva tightly in hand. О sage, the trident having the lustre of hundreds of suns. The demon was burning with rage. Brahma, Shiva felt terrified. Than the wind god whispered in the ears of Kamadeva, "You recite the name of Durga, the great illusion who removes all the misfortunes". On hearing the words of the wind god, the god of love recited the name of Durga.

## \|\| 112.29 \|\|

*śūlaṃ babhūva tasyāṅge ramyaṃ mālyaṃ manoharam \|*  
*brahmāstreṇa ca taṃ daityaṃ jaghāna manmatho mudā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. As a result of all this the trident and other weapons, were turned into the fragrant flowers with the touch of the body of Kamadeva. Thereafter the god of love killed the demon with the use of Brahmastra.

## \|\| 112.30 \|\|

*ratiṃ gṛhītvā yānena jagāma dvārakāṃ purīm \|*  
*prayayurdevatāḥ sarvā stutvā ca pārvatīṃ svayam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. He returned to his abode with Rati in Dvaraka. All the gods then adored goddess Parvati and left for their respective abodes.

## \|\| 112.31 \|\|

*rukmiṇī maṅgalaṃ kṛtvā prajagrāha ratiṃ sutam \|*  
*utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa paraṃ svastyayanaṃ hariḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. RukminT performing all the welfare, rites accepted his son and Rati. Krishna on the other hand performed great festivities.

## \|\| 112.32-36 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa pārvatīmra \|*  
*atha kṛṣṇaḥ krameṇaiva vedokte maṅgale dine \|\| 32 \|\|*

*saptānāṃ ramaṇīnāṃ ca pāṇigrāhaṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*kālindīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca satyā rāgnijitīṃ satīm \|\| 33 \|\|*

*jāmbavatīṃ lakṣmaṇāṃ ca samudvāhaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*tābhiḥ sārdha krameṇaiva putratpattiṃ cakāra ha \|\| 34 \|\|*

*ekasyāṃ daśaputrāśca kanyakaikā krameṇa ca \|*  
*nihatya narakaṃ daityaṃ saputraṃ ca nṛpeśvaram \|\| 35 \|\|*

*balavantaṃ muraṃ daityaṃ jaghāna raṇamūrdhani \|*  
*dadarśa kanyāstatrasthāḥ sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 36 \|\|*

32-36. The BrShmanas were served with food adoring Parvati at the same time. Thereafter in an auspicious time he married seven damsels named Kalindl, Satyabhama, Satya, Nagnijiti, Sati, Jambavati and Laksmana; several sons were born to them, ten sons and a daughter were born of each one of the queens. Than he killed a demon named Naraka and also the demon named Mura and found sixteen thousand damsels there.

## \|\| 112.37-38 \|\|

*śatādhikā vayasyāśca śaśvatsusthirayauvanāḥ \|*  
*praphullavadanāḥ sarvā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*śubhakṣaṇe ca tāsāṃ ca pāṇiṃ jagrāha mādhavaḥ \|*  
*tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ sa reme ca krameṇa ca śubhakṣaṇe \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Each one of the damsels had more than a hundred female friends each; all of them were quite, a youthful, jovial and adorned with the gem-studded ornaments. Lord Krishna accepted their hands in an auspicious time and enjoyed their company in the auspicious time.

## \|\| 112.39 \|\|

*ekasyāṃ daśaputrāśca kanyakaikā krameṇā ca \|*  
*hareretānyapatyāni babhūvuśca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Ten sons and the daughter were born to each one of the wives of Krishna. Thus he had different issues from all his wives.

## \|\| 112.40 \|\|

*ekadā dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ durvāsā munipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*śiṣyaistrikoṭibhiḥ sārdhamājagāmāvalīlayā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Once the sage Durvasa arrived in Dvaraka with three crores of his pupils.

## \|\| 112.41-42 \|\|

*rājā mahograsenaśca saputraḥ sapurohitaḥ \|*  
*vasudevo vāsudevo'pyakrūraścoddhavastathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*nītvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ praṇemurmunipuṃgavam \|*  
*śubhārśiṣaṃ ca pradadau tebhyo brahmanpṛthakpṛthak \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Brahmana, the king Ugrasena together with the son and priest, accompanied by Vasudeva, Krishna AkrQra and Uddhava besides the sages, adored Durvasa making sixteen types of offerings to him. The sage blessed them individually.

## \|\| 112.43 \|\|

*ekānaṃśāṃ ca kanyāṃ tāṃ dadau tasmai śubhakṣaṇe \|*  
*muktāmāṇikyaṅīrāṃśca ratnaṃ ca yautakaṃ dadau \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Vasudeva gave away in marriage his daughter named Ekanamsa to the sage together with many gems, jewels and diamonds in dowry.

## \|\| 112.44-48 \|\|

*sa reme rāmayā sārdha māhendre ratnamandire \|*  
*ratnendrasāranirmāṇaṃ dadau tasmai śubhāśramam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ekadā sa muniśreṣṭhaḥ samālocya svacetasā \|*  
*śayānaṃ kṛtracidramyaparyaṅke ratnanirmite \|\| 45 \|\|*

*śrutavantaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śraddhayā kutraciddhibhum \|*  
*mahotsave niyuktaṃ ca kutracitprāṅgaṇe śubhe \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tāmabūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca bhaktyā dattaṃ ca satyayā \|*  
*kutracitsevitaṃ talpe rukmiṇyā ścetacāmaraiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*kālindīsepitapadaṃ śayānaṃ kutracinmudā \|*  
*sarvatra samasaṃbhāṣāṃ cakāra bhagavānmunim \|\| 48 \|\|*

44-48. The sage enjoyed the company of the newly wedded wife in the palace of gems. Vasudeva also gave to Durvasa an asrama which was beautifully decorated with gems. Once Durvasa, the best of the sages thought in his mind that all-pervading Krishna sometimes sleeps on the gem-studded bed. Sometimes listens to the recitation of the Puranas, sometimes he keeps himself busy taking in the food in the court-yard, sometimes he chews the betel offered by Satya and sometimes he enjoys the company of Rukmini having been served with the moving of white fly-whisks, sometimes he is found sleeping delightfully. While Kalindl processed his feet. Shri Krishna always discussed with the sage, several things.

## \|\| 112.49 \|\|

*vismayaṃ prayayau viprau dṛṣṭvā tatparamādbhutam \|*  
*tuṣṭāva jagatīnāthaṃ rukmiṇīmandire punaḥ vasantaṃ ca sudharmāyāṃ satāṃ saṃsadi sundaram \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Finding him in astonishing form, Durvasa was surprised. Thereafter the sage offered prayer to lord Krishna in the abode of Rukmini and the assembly named Sudharma besides in the company of intellectuals.

## \|\| 112.50-52 \|\|

*durvāsā uvāca jaya jaya jagatāṃ nātha jitasarva janārdana sarvātmaka sarveśa sarvabīja purātana nirguṇa nirīha \|\| 50 \|\|*

*nirlipta nirañjana nirākāra bhaktānugrahavigraha satyamvarūpasanātana niḥsvarūpa nityanūtana \|\| 51 \|\|*

*brahmeśaśeṣadhaneśavandita padmayā sevitapādapadma brahmajyotiranirvacanīya vedāviditaguṇarūpa mahākāśasaṃmānanīya paramātmannamo'stu te \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. Durvasa said – О lord of the universe, victory to you, victory to you. You conquer everyone. О Janardana, you are the form of everyone, the lord of everyone or eternal without qualities, unattached, uninvolved, spotless, invisible, the one who takes to human form to grace his devotees, the form of truth, eternal, formless, always fresh, adored by Shiva, Shesha and Kubera. Lakshmi serves at your feet. You are the divine lustre of Brahman, inexplicable; your qualities are unknown to the Vedas, adorable like the sky and the supreme soul. I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 112.53 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā manasā hareranumatena ca \|*  
*praṇamya tasthau viprendrastatraiva purato hareḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Thus adoring the lord mentally and bowing before Krishna he stood before him with his permission.

## \|\| 112.54 \|\|

*tamuvāca jagannātho hitaṃ satyaṃ purātanam \|*  
*jñānaṃ ca vedavihitaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca satāṃ matam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Thereafter the lord of the universe bestow the divine knowledge to him which was beneficial, truthful, ancient, according to the Vedas and acceptable by the intellectuals.

## \|\| 112.55-61 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca mā bhervipra śivāṃśastvaṃ kiṃ na jānāsi jñānataḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate \|\| 55 \|\|*

*ahamātmā ca sarveṣāṃ śāvāḥ sarve mayā vinā \|*  
*prāṇidehānmayi gate yāntyeva sarvaśaktayaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*jātāvapyeka evāhaṃ vyaktāveva pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*yo bhuṅkte tasya tṛptiḥ syānnānyeṣāṃ ca kadācana \|\| 57 \|\|*

*pṛthagjīvādisarveṣāṃ pratimānaṃ ca prāṇinām \|*  
*paripūrṇatamo'haṃ ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 58 \|\|*

*śrīdāmaśāpādrādhā sā māṃ draṣṭumakṣamā'dhunā \|*  
*sarve caivāṃśarūpeṇā kalayā ca tadaṃśataḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*rukmiṇīmandire cāṃśo'pyanyāsāṃ mandire kalāḥ \|*  
*mamāpi kutraciccāṃśaṃ kutra cicca kalākalāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kalākalāṃśāḥ kutrāpi pratimāsu ca dehiṣu \|*  
*ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho gṛhasyābhyantaraṃ yayau durvāsāśca priyāṃ tyaktvā śrīharestapase gataḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

55-61. Lord Krishna said – О Brahmana, you are born of the arhsha of Shiva, don't get afraid, are you not aware of the fact with the divine knowledge possessed by you that I happen to be the creator of and all are born out of me. I happen to be the soul of all; without me every body is lifeless when I depart from the bodies of the creatures, all the strength disappears. I am myself the form of flame and represent each individual appearing separately in all the bodies. The one gets satisfied with the food, he takes and others cannot be satisfied with it. The figure of all the creatures are made separately. I appear in complete form in Goloka. Because of the curse of Shridama, Radha is unable to find me presently. All are born out of the amsa of Radha. The amsa of Radha is available in the palace of Rukmini and other goddesses happen to be the rays of the same. "My amsa is also available in the bodies of several creatures of earth." Thus speaking the lord of the universe went inside the house. Durvasa also leaving his beloved there, started performing tapas.

## Chapter 113

## \|\| 113.1-4 \|\|

*atha trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca saśiṣyaścāpi durvāsāstyaktvā ca dvārakāṃ purīm \|*  
*kailāsaṃ prayayau bhaktyā śaṃkaraṃ draṣṭumīśvaram \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gatvā muniśca kailāsaṃ praṇanāma śivaṃ śivām \|*  
*tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā saśiṣyaḥ praṇataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tatsarvaṃ kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ śrīharerapi \|*  
*ātmanastapasastattvaṃ svavairāgyaṃ ca cetamaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*muneśca vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya pārvatī satī \|*  
*tamuvāca hitaṃ satyaṃ sākṣācchaṃkaramaṃnidhau \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Narayana said – Durvasa accompanied with his pupils went to meet Shiva with his mind filled with devotion, leaving the city of Dvaraka. He proceeded towards Kailasa. On reaching Kailasa, the sage together with his pupils purified themselves and started adoring Shiva and Parvati. Thereafter he spoke all the details about Shri Krishna and the tattva of his tapas and the detachment of his mind from them. On hearing the words of the sage, the chaste Parvati smiled and in the presence of Shiva spoke truthful words which were quite beneficial.

## \|\| 113.5-7 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca dharmatattvaṃ na jānāsi dharmiṣṭhaṃ manyase svayam \|*  
*anapatyāṃ parityajya vava yāsi tapase mune \|\| 5 \|\|*

*anapatyāṃ ca yuvatīṃ kulajāṃ ca pativratām \|*  
*tyaktvā bhaveyuḥ saṃnyāsī brahmacārī yatīti vā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vāṇijye vā pravāse vā ciraṃ dūraṃ prayāti yaḥ \|*  
*tīrthe vā tapase vā'pi mokṣārthaṃ janma khaṇḍitum \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Parvati said – О sage, you are unaware of the tattva of dharma and still you consider yourself to be quite religious. Where are you moving leaving your childless wife. The one who disowns a youthful wife having no son who is quite chaste and devoted towards her husband becoming an ascetic, Brahmacarl or Yati or goes to a distant place for carrying out business or becomes a mendicant or a wandering ascetic in order to rid himself of the cycle of birth and death, he can never get redemption. He surely becomes responsible for the destruction of his dharma. Because with the curse of the wife, he has to fall in the hell after death his glory in this world is lost. This has been ordained by Brahma. О Brahmana, therefore you go back to Dvaraka and protect your dharma.

## \|\| 113.8-15 \|\|

*kva yāsi tapase vatsa sudhāṃ tyaktvā manoharām \|*

*kāmato'kāmato vā'pi bhasmībhūtaṃ ca pātakam \|*

*dṛṣṭvā sadyo bhavetpūjyo jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*koṭijanmārjitātsadyaḥ kṛtapāpādvimucyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

8-15. Ekanamsa was born out of my amsha and therefore maintain her with devotion. О son, the water of the feet of lord Krishna is blissful like kalpavrksa which is adored by Lakshmi and is inaccessible by all. The gods like Shiva, Sanaka and other sages recite the glory of lord Krishna whose name is like the charming nectar. Where are you going leaving him? О sage, the one who recites the name of the lord at his lotus-like feet, he is relieved of the sin committed by him up to a hundred births. There is no doubt about it. By reciting his name, all his sins committed during childhood, boyhood, in youthful age as well as in old age, knowingly or unknowingly, gets destroyed. The one who looks at the lotus-like feet of Shri Krishna. he becomes always adorable. This is the total truth, such a person is relieved of all the sins performed by him during the crores of births.

## \|\| 113.16-19 \|\|

*sarvāṇyeva hi tīrthāni yataḥpūtāni nityaśaḥ \|*

16-19. All the holy places get sanctified with such a type of devotee of lord Krishna. Those who are connected with lord Krishna only that vrata, tapas, truth, merit and -adoration become successful because by doing so one is relieved of the cycle of the birth. In case Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas is deprived of the devotion of lord Krishna even a devotee of the lord becomes degraded by talking to such a person. The Brahmana who consume the left-over or is devoted to him, such an auspicious soul, is competent enough to purify the fire and the wind besides the entire universe. О Brahmana, living lord Krishna where are you going to perform tapas.

20-23. The devotees achieve the fruit of their tapas by merely reciting the name of Shri Krishna. The sage Durvasa offering his salutation at the feet of Shiva and Parvati, devoting his mind at the lotus-like feet of Shri Krishna went back to Dvaraka. Reaching there he started offering prayer to lord Krishna.

*paripūṣṭaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ naivedyaṃ ca dadau mudā \|*  
*laḍḍukaṃ svastikānāṃ ca saptalakṣaṃ sudhopamam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*gaṇeśvarāya pradadau śarkarāśatarāśikam \|*  
*pakvarambhāphalānāṃ ca daśalakṣamapūpakam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*miṣṭānnaṃ pāyasaṃ ramyaṃ svādu svastikapiṣṭakam \|*  
*ghṛtaṃ ca navanītaṃ ca dadhi dugdhaṃ sudhopamam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ pārijātapuṣpamālyamabhīpsitam \|*

48-58. О sage, he promoted the popularity of Rukmini and other spouses among the Vais navas, the gods and the Brahmanas besides other religions. The lord then bestowed to Uddhava the divine knowledge. He imparted the knowledge of Gita to Arjuna in the fare-front of the battle-field. The merciful lord relieved the earth of her burden and bestowed the Raja-Lakshmi on earth to Yudhusthira. He made Durga to be adored as the village deity, eveiywhere to whom several types of naivedya and the pleasant incense, lamps etc. were offered performing the homas. The Brahmanas were served with the food and in order to please Parvati; he built a beautiful palace of Parvati and Ganesha studded with invaluable several gems on the Raivata mountain. For the pleasure of Parvati, he also built-a palace for Ganesha on the Raivata mountain. At that point of time five lakhs of sweet balls of sheshamum seeds were made and seven lakhs of modakas, hundreds of heaps of sugar, the ripe banana fruit, ten lakhs of sweet dishes, charming payasam, fried, ghee, butter, curd, milk, incense, lamps, garland of Parijata flowers, fragrant sandal-paste, fragrance and the costumes sanctified by fire were distributed.

## \|\| 113.59-61 \|\|

*yajñaṃ ca kārayāmāsa koṭihomānvitaṃ śubham \|*

*vādyaṃ daśavidhaṃ caiva vādayāmāsa tatra vai \|*  
*sūryaṃ ca pūjayāmāsa sāmbaḥ kuṣṭhakṣayāya ca \|\| 60 \|\|*

*haviṣyaṃ kārayāmāsa taṃ ca sāmbaṃsamātaram \|*  
*paribūrṇa vatsaraṃ cāpyupahārairanuttmaiḥ varaṃ dadau ca sāmbāya stotraṃ ca bhāskaraḥ svayam \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. Не performed a yajna comprising of crores of homas, served the Brahmanas the food and offer prayer to Ganapati. At that point of time, ten types of musical instruments were sounded Samba then adored Stirya to get rid of the leprosy, he had attracted for a year. Samba continue to consume the havisya food together with his mother. He adored Stirya with several types of offerings. Stirya then himself appeared before Samba and bestowed to him several blessing and his stotra.

## Chapter 114

## \|\| 114.1-2 \|\|

*atha caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca kṛṣṇaputraśca pradyumno mahābalaparākramaḥ \|*  
*tatputro'pyaniruddhaśca vidhāturaṃśa eva ca \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ekadā'sāvaniruddho navayauvanasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*supto rahasi paryaṅke puṣpacandanacarcite \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Pradyumna was the son of Krishna who was immensely valorous and strong. He had a son named Aniruddha who was born out of the arhsa of Brahma. Once the youthful Animddha was sleeping on the bed in a secluded place which was having the flowers and the scented sandal-paste over it.

## \|\| 114.3-14 \|\|

*svapne dadarśa yuvatīṃ puṣṇodyāne supuṣpite \|*  
*sugandhipuṣpatalpe ca snigdhacandanacarcite \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śayānāṃ susmitāṃ ramyāṃ navayauvanasaṃyutām \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇena vibhūṣitām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*cārukeyūravalayaśaṅkhakaṅkaṇaśobhitām \|*  
*maṇikuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitām \|\| 5 \|\|*

*atīva sūkṣmavasanāṃ kvaṇanmañajīrarañjitām \|*  
*pakvabimbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca śaratkamalalocanām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*śaratpadmaprabhāmuṣṭakoṭīnduninditānanām \|*  
*muktāpaṅktisamāsādyadantapaṅktimanoharām \|\| 7 \|\|*

*trivakrakabarībhārāṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitām \|*  
*kastūrīkuṅkumālaktasnigdhacandanakajjalaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*patrāvalīviracitasukapolasthalojjvalām \|*  
*dāḍimīkusumākārasindūrabindubhūṣitām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śrīrāmakadalīstambhaninditorusthalojjvalām \|*  
*atyuccairvartulākārastanayugmavibhūṣitām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*nitambabhārana mrāṃ ca kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām \|*  
*kāmukīṃ kamanīyāṃ ca paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kuṅkumālaktaraktāktapādapadmavirājitām \|*  
*vāyupreraṇavastreṇa vyaktaguvtasthalojjvalām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmaputraśca kāmonmathitamānasaḥ \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ ramyaṃ kāmamattāṃ sukomalām \|\| 13 \|\|*

*cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ kāmena pulakānvitām \|*  
*atiprauḍhāṃ navoḍhāṃ ca śṛṅgānecchāsucañcalām \|\| 14 \|\|*

3-14. In the dream he found a beautiful damsel lying on the bed of flowers and whose limbs were painted with fragrant sandal-paste. She was smiling. The damsel was quite beautiful and youthful and was adorned with several types of ornaments, she wore beautiful armlets, wristlets and the bangles of conch-shells. Her temples were decorated with the ear ornament. She was clad in an extremely fine garment the anklets worn by her which issued dangling sound. She had the lips resembling the ripe wood apples; the eyes were resembling the lotus flower of the winter season. Her face resembled the lotus flower of the winter season and was bestowed with the grace of crores of the moons. The lines of her teeth were quite charming and looked like the garland of jewels; she had the hair-do which was curved at three places and adorned with the garland of jasmine flowers. The kastiiri, saffron, red paint and sandal-paste besides the collyrium were applied on her body and the eyes. Her cheeks were decorated with several types of tree-leaves; she was having the vermilion spot resembling the flower of pomegranate; her thighs resembled the trunk of banana tree. Both her breasts were quite, hard thick and well-developed; she was bending because of the weight of her breasts and was suffering from passion. The beautiful damsel was looking with side-glances; both her feet which were painted with red paint and the saffron, looked like the red lotus flowers. Her costume was removed with the blowing of the wind, revealing her private parts, as a result of which she was filled with passion. She had an extremely charming complexion of the campaka flower. Finding her there, the unstable son of the god of love was infested with passion and spoke to her quite sweet words.

## \|\| 114.15 \|\|

*aniruddha uvāca kiṃ devī kiṃ ca gāndharvokā tvaṃ kāminikānane \|*  
*kasya satrī kasya kanyā vā kaṃ vā vāñchasi sundari \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Aniruddha said – О beautiful one, are you a forest goddess or the daughter of Gandharvas; are you the daughter of a woman? О beautiful one, whom do you love?

## \|\| 114.16 \|\|

*trailokyātulasaundaryā munimānasamohinī \|*  
*na bibheṣi kathaṃ brūhi svayamekākinī ca mām \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. You happen to be most beautiful of the three worlds and also make the minds of sages get attracted towards you. You tell me, are you alone here? Why are you not afraid of me?

## \|\| 114.17-18 \|\|

*ahaṃ trailokyanāthasya pautraḥ kāmātmajo'dhunā \|*  
*kānte'hamaniruddhaśca navīnayauvanāhataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kamanīyaśca kāmī ca kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ \|*  
*kāmukīkāmanāṃ pūrṇāṃ kartumeveśvaraḥ svayam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Presently, I am the grandson the lord of the three worlds and the son of the god of love. О damsel, my name is Aniruddha. I am quite youthful, beautiful, passionate, well-versed in the scriptures of love and can fulfil the desire of the passionate woman.

## \|\| 114.19-20 \|\|

*māṃ bhajasva suśīre tvaṃ suveṣaṃ ca suśīlakam \|*  
*ratiśūraṃ ratirasaprājñaṃ ratirasapriyam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ratiputraṃ ratirasaṃ pramattaṃ rasikaṃ priye \|*  
*yuvānaṃ vyādhihīnaṃ ca kāmukaṃ kāmukīcchati \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. О well disciplined, one you are clad in beautiful garments and therefore you love me since I have a good nature, I am well-versed in the art of making love, desirous of making love and the son of Rati. О beloved, the passionate woman is always desirous of a passionate and a healthy person.

## \|\| 114.21 \|\|

*vidagdhāmu vidagdhaṃ ca kāntamāyāti kāmataḥ \|*  
*vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Only competent damsel seeks a competent and passionate person. Because the union of a competent damsels with the competent man is always desirable.

## \|\| 114.22 \|\|

*pracchādya lojanāsyaṃ ca navasaṃgamalajjitā \|*  
*vilokayantī vakrākṣikoṇena tamuvāca sā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thereafter feeling shy of the new union, she covered her eyes and the face and spoke to him.

## \|\| 114.23 \|\|

*kāminyuvāca kāmukaḥ kāmaputro'si kāmena vyākulo'dhunā \|*  
*bhavāṃścetkāmukīyogyo na kāmaścintitaḥ katham \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The damsel said – You are quite passionate and the son of the god of love and are getting anxious because of the passions. If you are suitable for a passionate damsel, than why did you think about the passion.

## \|\| 114.24 \|\|

*pautrastrailokyanāthasya svataḥ saṃbhāvitasya ca \|*  
*svayaṃ yogyo yogyaputro vivāhaṃ na kathaṃ (vyadhāḥ) cana \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. You yourself happen to be the grandson of the lord of the three worlds and the son of quite a competent person and are yourself also quite competent; then why don't you marry?

## \|\| 114.25 \|\|

*vivāhītā yajñapatnī sā ca puṇyavratā satī \|*  
*niścalā satataṃ sādhyā vardhinī saṅginī sadā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The married wife is always auspicious, chaste, virtuous, always remains with the husband, dwells in the race, develops the race and is the life partner.

## \|\| 114.26 \|\|

*bhayaprītidānasādhyā guptapatnī tvaniścalā \|*  
*naimittikā na nītyā sā sā ca vedavivarjitā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The secret wife is always fearful, could be won over by love and charities and is always unstable; such a wife remains only per chance and not the life partner. The keeping of such a wife is prohibited in the Vedas and other scriptures.

## \|\| 114.27 \|\|

*paraṃ narakasopānā paratrehāyaśaskarā \|*  
*sādhustatra na hi rato vaṃśajo vaiṣṇavo yadi \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The improper wife is the step for moving towards the hell and earns disgrace in this as well as the future world. A person of high caste besides being a Vaishnavas or a noble person, never gets interested in the improper wife.

## \|\| 114.28 \|\|

*yadi pūrva bhavedbhrānto nivṛttaḥ sādhusaṅgataḥ \|*  
*pravṛttireṣā bhūtānāṃ nivṛttistu mahāphalā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. In case someone gets attracted towards such a woman in fallacy and when he was not following the company of noble people, only in that case one could get attracted towards the improper wife because it is the nature of the people, but getting detached from such women is always beneficial.

## \|\| 114.29 \|\|

*prāyaścittī punarlipto nivṛttaḥ pātakī yadi \|*  
*uvahāsyo bhuvi bhavetsarvaṃ kuñjaraśaucavat \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. In case a detached person gets himself involved again in the worldly pleasure, such a person become a sinner and has to repent while being jeered upon on earth. All his actions become like the bathing of an elephant.

## \|\| 114.30-32 \|\|

*suśīlā sundarī śāntā dharmapatnī praśaṃsitā \|*  
*pativratā susādhyā sā śaśvatsupriyavādinī \|\| 30 \|\|*

*komalāṅgī vidagdhā ca śyāmā ratisukhapradā \|*  
*evaṃbhūtāṃ parityajya vaiṣṇavastapase vrajet \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sā jetpariṇatā sādhvī śāntā putravatī yadā \|*  
*anyathā ca vṛthā sarvaṃ tapasaḥ skhalanaṃ bhavet \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. A Vaishnava having a chaste disciplined, beautiful, peaceful, glorious, graceful, obedient, soft spoken, having soft limbs, quite competents, youthful and the one who pleases during the conjugal pleasure, such a wife and disowning her, proceeds for performing tapas. When such a lady begets a son, becomes peaceful in her mind, otherwise his entire tapas, would be destroyed.

## \|\| 114.33 \|\|

*asādhuśca kuvaṃśaścetparanārīṃ prayāti cet \|*  
*sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ pituśiḥ saptabhiḥsaha \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. In case a person of a degraded family goes to a graded woman he fall into the terrific hell for seven generations.

## \|\| 114.34 \|\|

*ahamūṣā bāṇakanyā bāṇaḥ śaṃkarakiṃkaraḥ \|*  
*bāṇastrailokyavijayī śaṃkaro jagatāṃ patiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. I am Usha the daughter of Bana, who happens to be the devotee of Shiva and is the conquered of the three worlds, while Shiva happens to be lord of the tree worlds.

## \|\| 114.35 \|\|

*na svatantrā parādhīnā triṣu kāleṣu kāminī \|*  
*puṃścalī yā svatantrā sā'pyasadvaṃśaprasūtikā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. A woman of high race can never be independent under any circumstances but she remains in bondage. The loose woman is always independent and born in the degraded family.

## \|\| 114.36 \|\|

*pitā dadāti kanyāṃ tāṃ suyogyāya varāya ca \|*  
*kanyā varaṃ na yāceta dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The father gives away in marriage his daughter to a competent person.-The daughter does not desire for a husband. This is the eternal dharma.

## \|\| 114.37 \|\|

*tvaṃ ca yogyo'si yogyā'haṃ māmicchasi yadi prabho \|*  
*bāṇaṃ prārthaya śaṃbhuṃ vā''pyathavā pārvatīṃ satīm \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. You are quite competent and so am I. О lord, in case you are desirous of me, you go to Bana, Shiva or the chaste Parvati with a request to seek my hand.

## \|\| 114.38 \|\|

*ityuktvā sundarī sādhvī sāntardhānā babhūva ha \|*  
*nidrāṃ tatyāja sahasā kāmī kāmātmajo mune \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Thus speaking that beautiful and chaste damsel disappeared. О sage, thereafter suddenly the sleep of Aniruddha, the son of the god of love was disturbed.

## \|\| 114.39 \|\|

*buddhavā svapnaṃ sa vijñāya kāmena vyathitāntaraḥ \|*  
*babhūva vyākulo'śānto na dṛṣṭvā prāṇavallabhām \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Witnessing the dream, he was filled with passion and finding his beloved no were there, he become upset.

## \|\| 114.40 \|\|

*tyaktvā''hāramanidraśca pramattaśca kṛśodaraḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhati śete ca kṣaṇaṃ rahasi roditi \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thereafter he discarded taking food, spent sleepless nights, got intoxicated and became quite lean and thin; sometimes he stood erect, sometimes he slept, while sometimes he wept in a lonely place.

## \|\| 114.41 \|\|

*putraṃ dṛṣṭvā tu krandantaṃ devakī rukmiṇī ratiḥ \|*  
*anyāśca yoṣitaḥ sarvāḥ kathayāmāsurīśvaram \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Finding the son so weeping, Devaki, Rukmini, Rati and other damsels spoke to lord Krishna.

## \|\| 114.42 \|\|

*tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya mavusūdanaḥ \|*  
*uvāca sarvatattvajñaḥ kṛṣṇaśca pūrṇamānasaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. On hearing their words, the lord who was well-versed in all the tattvas, smilingly spoke to them.

## \|\| 114.43 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca kāmāturā bāṇakanyā ratiṃ dṛṣṭvā śiveśayoḥ \|*  
*varaṃ saṃprāpa durgāyā vyākulā madanāstrataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Shri Krishna said – Finding Shiva and Parvati engaged in the conjugal pleasure, the daughter of Bana became passionate. She then achieved the boon getting influenced with the passion.

## \|\| 114.44-45 \|\|

*svapnaṃ ca darśayāmāsa sā'niruddhaṃ ca pārvatī \|*  
*mama pautraṃ pramattaṃ ca cakāra kautukena ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tatputrīṃ ca pramatāṃ tā karomi svapnatā'dhunā \|*  
*svacchandaṃ tiṣṭha na ciraṃ nāsti cintā manovyathā \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Parvati made Aniruddha to witness a dream and he has thus intoxicated the mind of my grandson. Now I shall intoxicate the daughter of Bana in the dream. All of you should remain carefree; this mental agony would not lost for long.

## \|\| 114.46 \|\|

*iti kṛṣṇaḥ samāśvāsyasarvātamāsarvasiddhivit \|*  
*svapnaṃ ca darśayāmāsa bāṇaputrīṃ ca kāmukīm \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Thus assuring them lord Krishna who is the bestower of all the siddhis made with this illusion, the daughter of Bana, to witness the dream.

## \|\| 114.47-52 \|\|

*suptā sutalpe bālā sā puṣpacandanacarcite \|*  
*navayauvanasaṃyuktā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*śayānā ratnaparyaṅke dadarśa svapnamīpsitam \|*  
*atīva nirjane deśe ratnanirmāṇamandire \|\| 48 \|\|*

*navīnanīradaśyāmamatīva navayauvanam \|*  
*koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*ratnakeyuravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitam \|*  
*ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bhūṣitaṃ pītavāsasā \|*  
*sucārumālatīmālyavakṣaḥ sthalasamujjvalam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*śayānaṃ ratnaparyaṅke puṣpacandanacarcite \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā sādhvī tanmūlaṃ prayayau mudā \|\| 52 \|\|*

47-52. The damsel was quite youthful adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments besides the garland of flowers and was lying on the bed, witnessing a dream. She witnessed in dream a youthful person sleeping in a lonely place, in the palace of gems. He had the dark complexion, resembling the fresh cloud. He was extremely youthful, having the beauty resembling the crores of gods of love, had a smiling face, quite pleasant, clad with the ornament of gems like armlets, wristlets and anklets, besides two gem-studded ear ornament illumining the temples. The sandal-paste was plastered on his entire body. He was clad in yellow garment and adorned with the garland of jasmine flowers hanging on his chest. Finding him lying on the bed of roses, made of gems, the chaste girl went to him suddenly.

## \|\| 114.53 \|\|

*uvāca madhuraṃ sādhvī hṛdayena vidūyatā \|*  
*kāmātmajapriyā kāntā kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. With her heart infested with love, the damsels spoke to Aniruddha the son of the god of love.

## \|\| 114.54-55 \|\|

*ūṣovāca kastvaṃ kāmuka bhadraṃ te māṃ bhajasva smarāturām \|*  
*atiprauḍhāṃ navoḍhāṃ ca navasaṃgamalālasām \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tavānuraktāṃ bhaktāṃ ca gāndharveṇa samudvaha \|*  
*vivāhāṣṭaprakāreṣu gāndharvaḥ sulabho nṛṇām \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Usha said – О passionate one who are you? you enjoy the company of a passionate damsel like me, I am quite youthful, fresh and desirous of the fresh union. I feel, attracted towards you and you perform the Gandharva type of marriage. The Gandharva type of marriage is permissible for the human beings.

## \|\| 114.56 \|\|

*anuraktāṃ priyāṃ prāpya tyajedyaḥ kapaṭī pumān \|*  
*tasmādyāti mahālakṣmīḥ śāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. If a deceitful person neglects a passionate damsels, Maha-Lakshmi pronounces a terrific curse on him and leaves the place.

## \|\| 114.57 \|\|

*pumānuvāca ahaṃ kṛṣṇasya pautraśca kāmadevātmajaḥ svayam \|*  
*kathaṃ gṛhṇāmi tvāṃ kānte tayoranumatiṃ vinā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The man said – I am myself the grandson of Krishna and the son of the god of love, therefore, О beautiful one, how can I accept you without their permission?

## \|\| 114.58-59 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sa pumānantardhānaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*kāmena vyākulā kāntā na dṛṣṭvā kāntamīpsitam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*nidrāṃ tyaktvā samutthāya talpādeva manoharāt \|*  
*viṣasāda sakhīmadhye pramattā rudatī bhṛśam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Thus speaking the person disappeared. The damsel on the other hand finding her beloved having disappeared, was completely upset; instead of sleeping, she got up from the bed and getting intoxicated she started speaking to her female friends.

## \|\| 114.60 \|\|

*papraccha tāṃ varā''līnāṃ kiṃ kimityeva niścitam \|*  
*uvāca baudhayāmāsa citralekhā suyoginī \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. With the mere reciting of the name of Shiva, all the evils disappear and welfare prevails everywhere. Welfare is the abode of Shiva.

## \|\| 114.61 \|\|

*cetanaṃ kuru kalyāṇi kasmāte bhītirulbaṇā \|*  
*svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ śivā sākṣāddurlaṅdhye nagare sati \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. By devoting the mind to Durga, the destroyer of the misfortune, all the ailments disappear. Parvati the bestower of the welfare always provides welfare to all.

## \|\| 114.62 \|\|

*śivasmaraṇamātreṇa sarvāriṣṭaṃ palāyate \|*  
*śivaṃ bhavati sarvatra śiva eva śivālayaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. On hearing the words of Chitralekha, beautiful Usha did not speak out anything. On the other hand, discarding her food and sleep, she started thinking about the same person. Chitralekha then went to her parents, Durga, Shiva, as well as Ganesha.

## \|\| 114.63 \|\|

*dhyānāddurgatināśinyāḥ sarvaṃ durgaṃ vinaśyati \|*  
*dadāti maṅgalaṃ tasmai sarvamaṅgalamahgalā \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Learning about the mental condition of Usha, the wife of Bana started crying aloud. Bana who was seated besides Shiva was also grieved and he fainted. At the sight of the condition of the parents of Shiva, Parvati and Ganesha started smiling.

## \|\| 114.64-65 \|\|

*citralekhāvacaḥ śrutvā kiṃcinnovāca sundarī \|*  
*tyaktvā''hāraṃ ca nidrāṃ ca puruṣaṃ cintayetsadā \|\| 64 \|\|*

*citralekhā sakhī gatvā bāṇamāha ca tatpriyām \|*  
*durgāṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ skandaṃ gaṇeśaṃ yogināṃ gurum \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. Chitralekha who happened to be the best of the yoginls asked her, What has happened; then she tried to convince her.

## \|\| 114.66 \|\|

*citralekhāvacaḥ śrutvā rurodoccairbhṛśaṃ satī \|*  
*bāṇaśya śaṃkarābhyāśe viṣasāda pramūrcchitaḥ jahāsa śaṃkaro durgā kārtikeyo gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Chitralekha said – О auspicious one, be conscious. From whom, have you felt so panicky? Both Shiva and Parvati are here and the place is inaccessible to anyone.

## \|\| 114.67 \|\|

*gaṇeśvara uvāca yo dadāti dhruvaṃ duḥkhamanyasmai damabhamohitaḥ \|*  
*sakṣmadharmavicāreṇa sa vindati caturguṇam \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Ganesha said – The one who in arrogance, makes other to suffer from mental torture, he himself suffers four times more the torture Inflicted on others.

## \|\| 114.68 \|\|

*śiveśayośca krīḍāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yā kāmamohitā \|*  
*varaṃ tasyai dadau durgā varameva sudurlabham \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Usha became passionate, witnessing the conjugal pleasure of Shiva and Parvati. Durga had blessed her with a boon of getting a unique husband.

## \|\| 114.69 \|\|

*svapne gatvā svayaṃ devī mattaṃ kṛtvā samarātmajam \|*  
*adhunā vāmapārśce ca śaṃbhostiṣṭhati mūkvat \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Parvati herself had infested the love for the son of the god of love with pass on in Usha and now she is quietly siting the left of Shiva.

## \|\| 114.70 \|\|

*sarvaṃ jñātvā ca sarvajño bhagavānharirīśvaraḥ \|*  
*svapne suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ darśayāmāsa kanyākām \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. The omnipresent lord Krishna had realised the same and have arranged Usha to witness a dream in which the beautiful person was displayed.

## \|\| 114.71-75 \|\|

*suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuvānaṃ yuvātī satī \|*  
*paramecchā bhavettasyā dharmabhītyā nivartate \|\| 71 \|\|*

*suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṃścalī pāpavaṃśajā \|*  
*tyejennidrāṃ ca svāhāraṃ patiṃ putraṃ dhanaṃ gṛham \|\| 72 \|\|*

*cetanaṃ gṛhakārya ca kulalajjāṃ kuladvayam \|*  
*yuvānaṃ ratiśūraṃ cāpyatinīca na hi tyajet \|\| 73 \|\|*

*tyajejjātiṃ ca dharmaṃ ca prāṇāṃśca pariṇāmataḥ \|*  
*tasmātprājñaḥ prayatnena prāṇebhyo yuvatīṃ sadā \|\| 74 \|\|*

*parirakṣecca satataṃ māyāyuktāṃ na viśvaset \|*  
*hṛdayaṃ kṣuradhārābhaṃ nārīṇāṃ madhuraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

71-75. At the sight of a competent person damsel always becomes desirous of him but is contained because of the fear of dharma. Finding a beautiful person, woman born in a degraded family or a loose woman is relieved of her sleep, food, husband, son, riches, house, intelligence, household, household affairs, shame of the family, the caste and dharma and ultimately she sacrifices her life also, but the degraded woman could never disown a youthful person who is well-versed in the art of making love. Therefore the intelligent person should protect the youthful ladies even after putting his life in danger. He should never believe a woman who is infested with illusion because the damsels speak sweet words but their hearts are quite sharp like a blade.

## \|\| 114.76-78 \|\|

*tāsāṃ mano na jānanti santo vedāśca vaidikā \|*  
*prayātu dvārakāṃ sadyāścitralekhā suyoginīṃ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*aniruddhaṃ samāhartuṃ pramāttamavalīlayā \|*  
*iti śrutvā mahādevo gaṇeśaṃ tamuvāca ha \|\| 77 \|\|*

*na śruṇoti yathā bāṇaḥ śubhakāryaṃ tathā kuru \|*  
*citralekhā yayau turṇaṃ dvārakābhavanaṃ hareḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

76-78. The bent of their mind is unknown to the Vedas and the people who are well-versed in the Vedas. Chitralekha who happened to be the best of the yoginls, should playfully move to Dvaraka for bringing Aniruddha after abducting him. On hearing the worlds whiskered by Ganesha, which could not be heard by Вana. She was permitted to perform this job. Chitralekha at once reached Dvaraka and then the abode of Hari.

## \|\| 114.79-84 \|\|

*sarveṣāmapi durlaṅdhyaṃ līlayā praviveśa sā \|*  
*nidritaṃ cāniruddhaṃ ca samāhṛtya ca yogataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*rathamārohayāmāsa nidvitaṃ bālakaṃ mudā \|*  
*sā manoyāyinī bhadrā gṛhītvā bālakaṃ mune \|\| 80 \|\|*

*muhūrtācchoṇitapuraṃ kṛtvā śaṅkhadhvaniṃ yayau \|*  
*athā''śramābhyantare ca ruruduḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*aho bāṇaharo vatsaḥ kvagataḥ prāṇavallabhaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇastāśca samāśvāsya sarvajñaḥ sarvatattvavit \|\| 82 \|\|*

*sāmbakāmabalaiḥ sārdha kṛṣṇāḥ sātyakinā tathā \|*  
*gṛhītvā gānuḍaṃ vīraṃ rathamāruhya satvaraḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*sudarśanaṃ pāñcajanyaṃ padmaṃ kaumodakīṃ gadām \|*  
*paścādyāsyatideveśo nagaraṃ śoṇitaṃ tathā \|\| 84 \|\|*

79-84. The place was inaccessible to all but still Chitralekha entered expeditiously and abducted Aniruddha and placed him on the chariot, with the influence of her yogic practices. О sage, the chaste Chitralekha could move with the speed of the mind. Blowing the conch, she in a moment reached Sonitpura. On the other hand finding Aniruddha missing from his chamber, all the ladies started crying, lamenting for the boy who was dearer to them than their lives. The all-knowledgeable Krishna who was well-versed in all the tattvas, assured them variously. He at once accompanied with, Samba, Kamadeva, Satyaki and the army moved on with Garuda mounted on the chariot holding samkha, cakra, gada and padma. They moved on towards Sonitpura, the city was protected by the ganas of Shiva and Parvati.

## \|\| 114.85-92 \|\|

*sagaṇaiḥśaṃkeraṇaiva pārvatyā parirakṣitam \|*  
*atha sā yoginī dhanyā puṇyā mānyā ca yoṣitām \|\| 85 \|\|*

*śiṣyā durvāsasaḥ śāntā siddhayogena siddhidā \|*  
*bārakaṃ bodhayāmāsa rudantaṃ mātaraṃ smaran \|\| 86 \|\|*

*snāpayitvā dadau tasmai mālyacandanabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*kṛtvā suveṣaṃ bālasya kanyāntaḥ puramīpsitam \|\| 87 \|\|*

*cakre praveśaṃ yogena rakṣakaiścāpi rakṣitam \|*  
*tāmūṣāṃ nidritāṃ dṛṣṭvā nirāhārāṃ kṛśodarīm \|\| 88 \|\|*

*śīghraṃ ca bodhayāmāsa sakhībhiḥ parirakṣitām \|*  
*ūṣāṃ kṛtvā ca susnātāṃ vastrabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 89 \|\|*

*vastrairmālyaiścandanaiśca sindūrapatrakaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*dvayoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tatra māhendre ca śubhakṣaṇe \|\| 90 \|\|*

*kārayāmāsa guptyā ca sakhīnāṃ saṃmatena ca \|*  
*pativratā patiṃ dṛṣṭvā sā reme vigatajvarā \|\| 91 \|\|*

*gāndharveṇa vivāhena tāmuvāha smarātmajaḥ \|*  
*ratirbabhūva suciramubhayoḥ sukhakāraṇam \|\| 92 \|\|*

85-92. On the other hand Chitralekha was a great yoginl quite graceful among the ladies, quite auspicious, peaceful and was well-known as siddhayoginl and as the granter of success, She than consoled the boy who was crying getting separated from his mother. Thereafter, she made him take his bath and the sandal-paste was applied on his body decorating him with the garland of flowers. Thus the boy having been beautifully decorated, was made to enter the inner apartment which was protected by the gods, through yogic practices. Usha was without food for long, thin waisted and protected by her female friends, was woken up. She was also made to take bath and adorned with all the ornaments, garlands, applying the sandal-paste on the body in addition to the auspicious vermilion. Thereafter, in the auspicious time of Mahendra, both of them were made to talk with each other secretly. On finding her beloved there, the mental agony of Usha was removed. She married Aniruddha the son of the god of love in a Gandharva style and enjoyed the conjugal pleasure. Both of them enjoyed the conjugal pleasure for a long time.

## \|\| 114.93-94 \|\|

*divāniśaṃ na bubudhe smaraputraḥ smarāturaḥ \|*  
*ūṣā kāmāturā prauḍhā navoḍhā navasaṃgamāt \|\| 93 \|\|*

*mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa puṃsaśca sparśamātreṇa kāmukī \|*  
*evaṃ nityaṃ ca rahasi saṃgamaḥ sumanoharaḥ babhūva suciraṃ vipra rājā śuśrāva rakṣakāt \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. The passionate Aniruddha did not care for the day and night. On the other hand the passionate Usha was fainted while enjoying the conjugal pleasures for the first time. Thus both of them were united and they enjoyed all the conjugal pleasures in lonely place, thereafter, О Brahmana, the king came to know about the reality from his guards.

## Chapter 115

## \|\| 115.1 \|\|

*atha pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha bhītā rakṣakāste samūturbāṇamīśvaram \|*  
*skandaṃ gaṇeśaṃ durgāṃ ca daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – Thereafter, the guards feeling panicky prostrating before Karttikeya, Ganesha and Durga spoke to the king Bana.

## \|\| 115.2 \|\|

*rakṣakā ūcuḥ aho duṣṭaśca kālo'yamatīva duratikramaḥ \|*  
*svatantrā bālikā prauḍhā patimicchati sāṃpratam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The gods said – The time is quite wicked and unsurpassable. Presently the adult daughter becoming independent is desirous of a husband.

## \|\| 115.3 \|\|

*asaṅgasaṃgamaṃ nātha sādhūnāṃ duḥkhakāraṇam \|*  
*saṃsargajā guṇā doṣā bhavanti satataṃ nṛṇām \|\| 3 \|\|*
