3\. O lord it is always painful if the noble people keep the company of the wicked, the good and bad are the products of the continuos company of the people.

## \|\| 115.4-9 \|\|

*citralekhā svayaṃ dūtī samānīya paraṃ varam \|*  
*raṇaśūraṃ mahāvīraṃ nṛpendraṃ ca mahāratham \|\| 4 \|\|*

*yuvānaṃ vyādhihīnaṃ ca kandarpādapi sundaram \|*  
*saṃbhogaṃ kārayāmāsa bubudhe na divāniśam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sāṃprataṃ tava kanyā sā'pyūṣāgarbhavatī satī \|*  
*kulajā kulayoścaiva taptāṅgārasvarūpiṇī \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dauhitro vā'pi dauhitrī babhuva sāṃprataṃ tava \|*  
*kanyāṃ paśya mahāprauḍhāṃ nagarīṃ nāgarānvitām \|\| 7 \|\|*

*nakhavikṣatasarvāṅgīṃ varādhīnāṃ ca cañcalām \|*  
*puṃsaśca saṅgirīṃ śaśvadrahasye ratisaṅginīm \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sasmitāṃ sakaṭākṣāṃ ca c̈añcalekṣaṇavīkṣatām \|*  
*evaṃ śrutvā lajjitaśca bāṇastatra cukopa ha \|\| 9 \|\|*

4-9. Chitralekha, herself becoming a messenger, brought a competent groom for the girl who is quite strong, valorous, resembling Indra, a great charioteer, youthful, healthy and is more beautiful than the god of love. She made both of them to enjoy each other company through out the day and night. Now chaste Usha, your daughter has conceived. In spite of her having been born in noble race, she has become like the burning fire for both the races. Now you have to, become a grandfather of a male of a female child. You meet an extremely youthful and clever person besides the clever daughter in whose body there are signs of enjoying conjugal pleasures and who is completely under the command of her husband, is quite unstable remaining in the company of a male, enjoying conjugal pleasures in seclusion, always smiling, looking with side-glances and unstable eyes. On hearing this, В ana was ashamed as well as enraged.

## \|\| 115.10-13 \|\|

*yuddhāya ca matiṃ cakre vāritaḥ śabhunā bhṛśam \|*  
*vāritaśca gaṇeśena skandena śivayā tathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*bhairavyā bhadrakālyā ca yoginībhiśca saṃtatam \|*  
*aṣṭabhirbhairavaiścaiva rudrairekādaśātmakaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*bhūtaiḥ pretaiśca kūṣmāṇḍairvetālairbrahmarākṣasaiḥ \|*  
*yosīndrairapi siddhendrai rudraiścaṇḍādibhistathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*koṭaryā prāmadevyā ca yathā mātrā hitāya ca \|*  
*uvāca śaṃkaro bāṇaṃ mūḍhaṃ paṇḍitamāninam hitaṃ satyaṃ nītiśāstraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. Не resolved for waging a war but Shiva stopped him from doing so. He spoke to Ganesha, Karttikeya, Parvati, Bhairavl, Bhadrakall, Yogini, eight Bhairavas, eleven Rudras, Goblins, Pretas, Kusmandas, Vetalas, Brahmaraksasas, Yogindras, the Siddhas, Chanda and other Rudras, Kotarl the village deity, spoke to Shiva the words which were considered to be beneficial for Bana. These words truthful according to polity and were beneficial in the long run.

## \|\| 115.14-18 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca śṛṇu bāṇa pravakṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm \|*  
*bhuvo bhārāvataraṇe bhārate svayamīśvaraḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*nihatya sarvānrājendrāndvārakāyāṃ virājate \|*  
*yasya lomasu viśvāni tasya vāsaḥ sadīśvaraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vāsudeva iti khyātaḥ kathyate tena kovidaiḥ \|*  
*dhāturvidhātā bhagavāṃścakrapāṇiḥ svayaṃ bhuvi \|\| 16 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmīśvaraḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*nirguṇaśca nirīhaśca bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paramātmā ca dehinaḥ \|*  
*yasmingate śavo jīvo saṃgrāmastena saṃbhavet \|\| 18 \|\|*

14-18. Shiva said – I am narrating to you an ancient story you please listen to it. In order to rid the earth of her burden, the lord himself has incarnated on earth in the land of Bharata and has killed many kings; all the globes are enshrined in his hair-pits; his abode is the eternal Brahman that is why people call him with the name of Vasudeva. Lord Krishna happens to be on earth as Brahma for Brahma. He is beyond Prakriti, devoid of gunas, unattracted, always graceful to his devotees and takes to human form for their sake, is eternal Brahman is the abode of the supreme soul. He is the one with the departure of whom, a human becomes a dead body. How can a war be possible with him.

## \|\| 115.19 \|\|

*śastraviddho mahākāśo yathā mūḍha diśastathā \|*  
*tathā''tmā ca nirākāro dehī ca dhyānahetunā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. As one is unable to visualise the sky having been covered with the weapons. Similarly a person is unable to visualise the invisible soul even by meditation.

## \|\| 115.20 \|\|

*tasya putro'niruddhaśca mahābalaparākramaḥ \|*  
*trailokyamapi saṃhartuṃ kṣaṇena ca kṣamaḥ svayam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. His son named Aniruddha can destroy the three worlds in no.time.

## \|\| 115.21 \|\|

*sarve vevāśca daityāśca balavanto mahārathāḥ \|*  
*te sarve cāniruddhasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. All the gods, the demons and all the valorous people do not compare to the one-sixteenth part of Aniruddha.

## \|\| 115.22 \|\|

*yayoreva samaṃ vittaṃ yayoreva samaṃ balam \|*  
*tayorvivāho maitrī ca na tu puṣṭavipuṣṭayoḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Such of the people who have comparable strength and the riches, the marriage should be performed only between them; it would not be proper to engage a weak person with a valorous one.

## \|\| 115.23-24 \|\|

*baliḥ pitā te daityānāṃ sārabhūto mahārathaḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇena yena nītaśca sutalaṃ sa hareḥ kalā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sarve cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥ paripūrṇatamasya ca \|*  
*vṛndāvaneśvarasyāpi kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. He is the one who drove Bali your father, who was immensely valorous and was born out the athsha of Hari to the neither world in a movement. He is the one who is the lord of Vrindavana, the supreme soul and all other creatures are only his rays.

## \|\| 115.25 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca dhyāyate dhyānaniṣṭhaśca hṛtpadme ca divāniśm \|*  
*brahmā maheśaḥ meṣaśca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Parvati said – Brahma, Shiva, Shesha always meditate upon him in their hearts through out the day and night.

## \|\| 115.26 \|\|

*dineśaśca gaṇeśaśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|*  
*dhyāyate paramātmānaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Surya, Ganesha, Shiva the teacher of the yogis, always meditate upon the eternal lord.

## \|\| 115.27 \|\|

*sanatkumāraḥ kapilo naro nārāyaṇastathā \|*  
*dhyāyate hṛdayāmbhoje bhagavantaṃ so \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Sanatkumara, Kapia, Nara and Narayana always meditate upon the eternal lord.

## \|\| 115.28 \|\|

*manavaśca munīndrāśca siddhendrā yogināṃ varāḥ \|*  
*dhyānāsādhyaṃ ca dhyāyante bhagavantaṃ so \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Manu, the sages, siddhas, the yogis always meditate upon the eternal lord.

## \|\| 115.29 \|\|

*sarvādiṃ sarvabījaṃ ca sarveśaṃ ca parātparam \|*  
*dhyāyante jñāninaḥ sarve bhagavantaṃ so \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. All the intellectuals, who are the foremost of all, adore the lord of all, who is eternal.

## \|\| 115.30 \|\|

*gaṇeśa uvāca abhāgyaṃ ca baleścāpi vaiṣṇavasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*mūḍho'yamīdṛśaḥ putraḥ prahlādasya ca dhīmataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Ganesha said – It is misfortune of Prahlada and Bali a great devotee of Vishnu who has given birth to such a foolish son.

## \|\| 115.31-32 \|\|

*skanda uvāca aye bhrātarna śrutā ca hiraṇyakaśipoḥ kathā \|*  
*hiraṇyākṣasya ca madhoḥ kaiṭabhasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*pūrvajāste'pi te daityā mahābalaparākramāḥ \|*  
*krameṇa viṣṇunā nītā līlayā yamasādanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Karttikeya said – О brother, have you heard the stories of Hiranyakasipu, Hiranyaksa, Madhu and Kaitabha. All of them were quite valorous demons and were your ancestors. All of them were dispatched to the abode of Yama playfully by Vishnu.

## \|\| 115.33 \|\|

*bhagavānyasya saṃhartā svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*tasya ko rakṣitā bhrātarnivartasva śubhāyaca \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О brother, who can save the one who is to be killed by none else them Narayana himself. Therefore keeping in view your own welfare, you leave the idea of a war.

## \|\| 115.34 \|\|

*teṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā tānuvācāsureśvaraḥ \|*  
*koparaktāsyanayano dhanuṣpāṇiryathā'ntakaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. On hearing his words, В ana was enraged. His face and eyes became red with anger. He held a bow in his hand and started thundering like the god of death.

## \|\| 115.35-36 \|\|

*bāṇa uvāca śṛṇu mātaḥ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tāta maheśvara \|*  
*śṛṇu bhrātargaṇapate śṛṇu bhrātaśca kārtika \|\| 35 \|\|*

*śubhaśubhaṃ prāktanena prāṇināṃ karmiṇāṃ tathā \|*  
*kṛtakarmātiriktaṃ ca kārya keṣāṃ ca vartate \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. Bana said – О mother, О father Shiva, О brother Ganesha, О brother Karttikeya, listen to what I speak. The people performing deeds have to face the good or bad results according to the deeds performed by them. Who can get the reward of any type without performing a deed.

## \|\| 115.37 \|\|

*nāprāptakālo mriyate viddhaḥ śaraśatairapi \|*  
*tṛṇāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. A person cannot die, ahead of times even when wounded with hundreds of arrows and when the time comes even with the touch of the blade of grass one cannot survive.

## \|\| 115.38 \|\|

*yasmācca yasya nirvāṇaṃ vidhātrā likhitaṃ purā \|*  
*tadeva nityaṃ satyaṃ ca niṣekaḥ kena vāryate \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. In which ever way the destiny has ordained the person has to meet with the death in the same way, who can avert the result of an action which one has to face definitely.

## \|\| 115.39 \|\|

*saṃgrāme kātaro yo hi niṣphalaṃ tasya jīvanam \|*  
*jayī yaśasca labhate mṛtaḥ svargaṃ ca gacchati \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The one who becomes a coward in the battle-field, his life becomes useless, the person who is victories in the battle-field, he earns the glory and after the death he achieves the heaven.

## \|\| 115.40-42 \|\|

*praviśya kanyāṃ gṛhṇāti nagaraṃ śivarakṣitam \|*  
*pārvatyā ca gaṇeśena yuddhena balinā tathā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ko vā gṛhṇāti kanyāṃ ca kasya vā jīvitasya ca \|*  
*sagarbhā tava kanyeti sabhāyāṃ rakṣako vadet \|\| 41 \|\|*

*iti me vajratulyaṃ ca śrutikauṭaṃ paraṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*ato'nirudvaṃ hatvā ca ghātayiṣyāmi kanyakām anyathā jvaladagnau ca tyakṣyāmi ca kalevaram \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. Не entered the city which was protected by Shiva, Parvati and Ganesha and accepted the daughter, in the same way as a valorous person does in the battle-field. Who can abduct anyone's daughter like this, who is still, alike. In the court, the'guard has spoken that the girl has conceived. These words entered my ears like vajra. Therefore, after killing Aniruddha, I shall also kill the girl, otherwise I shall jump into the burning fire.

## \|\| 115.43-45 \|\|

*koṭaryuvāca śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi mātā'haṃ te'pi dharmataḥ \|*  
*turantenāpi pṛtreṇa pitrorduḥrkha pade pade \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kanyā paragṛhītā sā'pyanyasmai dātumakṣamā \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇasyāpi pautrāya pradyumnasya sutāya ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*aniruddhāya mahate svecchayā dehi kanyakām \|*  
*pūto'si bhārate varṣe saptabhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. Kotarl said – О son, you listen, since I happen to be your mother according to dharma. The parents have to suffer from, mental agony at every step, because of the conduct of the wicked son. Since Usha had been accepted by somebody, therefore she cannot be given by you to anyone else. You give away your daughter to Aniruddha, the grandson of Krishna and the son of Pradyumna. By doing so your seven generations in the land of Bharata would be purified.

## \|\| 115.46-51 \|\|

*yautukaṃ dehi sarvasvaṃ yaśase mahase bhuvi \|*  
*anyathā raṇamadhye ca tvāṃ haniṣyati mādhavaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*sudaśaṃnena cakeṇa ko vā tvāṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*koṭarīvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa daityapuṃgavaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*prayayau rathamāruhya yatra pautro harermune \|*  
*skandaḥ senāpatirbhūtvā prayayau śaṃkarājñayā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*bāṇaḥ svastyayanaṃ cakre gaṇeśaśca śivaḥ svayam \|*  
*bāṇaṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ cakre pārvatī koṭarī tathā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*aṣṭau ca bhairavāścaiva rudrāścaikādaśaiva te \|*  
*sarve yuddhāya hantāro babhūvuḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*etasminnantare dūto'pyaniruddhamuvāca ha \|*  
*pārvatyā preritaścaiva bāṇapatnyā ca satvaram \|\| 51 \|\|*

46-51. In order to achieve the glory and lustre on the land of Bharata, you give away everything in dowry otherwise lord Hari would surely kill you with the use of the Sudarsana-cakra in the battle-field. "Who would be able to save you?" On hearing the words of Kotari the demon was further enraged. О sage, mounted on chariot he went to the place where the grandson of Krishna was lodged. Thereafter with the permission of ava, Karttikeya took the command of army and marched on. Bana then performed the welfare ceremony. Ganesha, Shiva, Parvati and Kotari blessed Bana variously. All the eight Bhairavas, eleven Rudras, holding the weapons in their hands started for a war. In the meantime under the influence of Parvati and the wife of Bana, messenger carried the words, to Aniruddha and spoke to him.

## \|\| 115.52 \|\|

*dūta uvāca aniruddhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ pārvatīvacanaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*bhava sāṃnāhiko vatsa kuru yuddhaṃ bahirbhava \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The messenger said – О Aniruddha, get up and listen to the welfare words of Parvati. О son, you wear the kavacha and coming out you start the war.

## \|\| 115.53-54 \|\|

*bhītoṣā rudatī trastā sasmāra pārvatīṃ satīm \|*  
*rakṣa rakṣa mahāmāye matpraṇeśvaramīpsitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*abheye'pyabhayaṃ dehi saṃgrāme ghoradāruṇe \|*  
*tvameva jagatāṃ mātā snehaste sarvataḥ samaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. The terrified Usha remembered the chaste goddess Parvati saying, "O Mahamaya, you protect the one who is the lord of my life; you extend him all protection in the terrific battle-field. You are the mother of the universe and your love extends to all equally".

## \|\| 115.55 \|\|

*athāniruddhaḥ saṃnāhī śastrapāṇirbabhūva ha \|*  
*ūṣādattaṃ rathaṃ prāpya cakārā''rohaṇaṃ mudā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Thereafter, Aniruddha wearing the coat of arms and holding the weapons in his hand, mounted the chariot, given to him by Usha.

## \|\| 115.56 \|\|

*bahiḥ saṃbhūya śibirāddadarśa bāṇamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*sāṃnāhikaṃ śastrapāṇiṃ raktāsyalocanaṃ param \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Getting out of the camp he spotted Bana who was wearing the coat of arms and holding weapons in his hands. His eyes were burning in anger.

## \|\| 115.57 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā'niruddhaṃ bāṇaśca tamuvāca ruṣā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*ghorasaṃgrāmamadhye ca viṣoktiṃ prajvalanniva \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. At the sight of Aniruddha, Bana was enraged and in the terrific battle-field he started emitting venom.

## \|\| 115.58-59 \|\|

*bāṇa uvāca aye vīra mahāduṣṭa nītiśāstravivarjita \|*  
*candra vaṃśakulāṅgāra puṇyakṣetre'yaśaskara \|\| 58 \|\|*

*pitā te śambaraṃ hatvā jagrāha tasya kāminīm \|*  
*tato jāto bhavaneva nirodhaṃ svakulakṣamam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Bana said – О valorous one, you are extremely wicked, devoid of the knowledge of polity; you are the-form of fire flame for the solar race, you are acting disgracefully in the auspicious land, your father owned the wife of Sambrasura after killing him. You were born out of her. You are a blot on your race.

## \|\| 115.60 \|\|

*pitāmaho vāsudevo mathurāyāṃ ca kṣatriyaḥ \|*  
*gokule vaiśyaputraśca nāmnā ca nandanandanaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Your grandfather known as Krishna is the Kshatriya of Mathura. He is the son of a Vaisya in Gokula known by the name of Nanda.

## \|\| 115.61 \|\|

*vṛndāvane ca gopasya nandasya paśurakṣakaḥ \|*  
*sākṣājjāraśca gopīnāṃ duṣṭaḥ paramalampaṭaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. In Vrindavana he happens to be a cowherds of Nanda who grazed the cows; he is the lover of the cowherdesses and is an extremely wicked person.

## \|\| 115.62 \|\|

*jaghāna pūtanāṃ sadyo nārīghātī hyadhārmikaḥ \|*  
*āgatya mathurāṃ kubjāṃ jaghāna maithunena ca \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. He killed during his childhood, POtana and is therefore the killer of the woman. Reaching Mathura he killed Kubja after enjoying conjugal pleasures with her.

## \|\| 115.63 \|\|

*durbalaṃ narakaṃ hatvā strīsamūhaṃ manoharam \|*  
*jagrāha yonilubdhaśca svaputramatiniṣṭhuraḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Thereafter the heartless Krishna who is greedy for passion killed Naraka and took away the group of ladies of his palace.

## \|\| 115.64 \|\|

*bhīṣmakaṃ mānavaṃ jitvā tatputraṃ cāpi durbalam \|*  
*jagrāha kanyakāṃ tasya devayogyāṃ ca rukmiṇīm \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. He also over-powered Bhlsmaka and his weak son; and married princess Rukmini.

## \|\| 115.65 \|\|

*satrājitaḥ sūryabhṛtyo devātprāpa maṇīśvaram \|*  
*ghātayitvā hyupāyena jagrāha maṇikanyakām \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Satrajita achieved a gem from Surya which was taken away by Krishna killing him together with his daughter.

## \|\| 115.66-68 \|\|

*kurupāṇḍavayuddhaṃ ca kārayitvā ca dāruṇam \|*  
*yudhiṣṭhirasya yajñe ca śiśupālaṃ jaghāna saḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*dantavaktraṃ ca śālbaṃ ca jarāsaṃdhaṃ ca dāruṇaḥ \|*  
*saṃjahāra bhuvo bhūpasamūhamatidāruṇam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*upāyānnarakaṃ hatvā sarvasvaṃ tajjahāra saḥ \|*  
*durbalo rājabhītaścasamudraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

66-68. He managed a terrific war between Kauravas and Pandavas. Thereafter, in the yajna of Yudhis thira he heartlessly killed Sis'upala, Dantavaktra, Salva and Jarasandha. He therefore relieved the earth of very competent kings. He deceitfully killed Naraka and usurped his gold; getting terrified from the king he went to the ocean and took refuge there.

## \|\| 115.69 \|\|

*jitvā ca bhrātaraṃ śakraṃ bhāryāyā vacanena ca \|*  
*jagrāha pārijātaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca svargadurlabham \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. At the sight of his wife he attacked Indra his brother and forcibly took away the Parijata flowers.

## \|\| 115.70-71 \|\|

*kaṃsaṃ nihatyādharmiṣṭho bhrātaraṃ mātureva ca \|*  
*jagrāha tasya sarvasvaṃ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi te \|\| 70 \|\|*

*jatvā ca bhallukaṃ yuddhe jagrāha tasya kanyakām \|*  
*tatpiturbhaginī kuntī caturṇāṃ kāminī bhuvi \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. The great sinner killing the brother of his own mother, he usurped all his riches, what shall I speak to you; he also forcibly married the daughter of Jambavan the great beer after killing him in the battle-field. His fathers sister became the beloved of four people.

## \|\| 115.72-75 \|\|

*draupadī bhrātṛpatnī ca p̈añcānāṃ kāminī tathā \|*  
*goṣṭhīno yonilubdhaśca śaśvatparamalampaṭaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*tajjyeṣṭho baradevaśca śaśvatpibati vāruṇīm \|*  
*yamunāṃ bhrātṛpatnīṃ ca karotyāhvānamīpsitam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*jahāra bhaginīṃ tasya kauḥteyaḥ śakranandanaḥ \|*  
*subhadrāṃ mātulasutāṃ saṃnibodha kulakramam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*bāṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa kāmanandanaḥ \|*  
*uvāca paramārthaṃ ca yogyaṃ pratyuttaraṃ mune \|\| 75 \|\|*

72-75. The wife of his brother named Draupad! was married to five persons. He is the dweller of the cowsheds; is voluptuous and is quite wicked. His elder brother known as Baladeva remains drunk, consuming wine and summons Yamuna the wife of his brother according to his sweet will. That is why Arjuna the son of KuntI abducted his sister Subhadra, who was the daughter of his metemal uncle. You should know about your family traditions. О sages, listening to the words of Bana Aniruddha was enraged and he gave a suitable reply.

## \|\| 115.76 \|\|

*aniruddha uvāca pitā me kāmadevaśca brahmaputraḥ purā śuciḥ \|*  
*yasyāstreṇa vaśībhūtaṃ trailokyaṃ satataṃ śṛṇu \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Aniruddha said – My father named Kamadeva was the auspicious son of Brahma in earlier times, with the weapons of whom all the three worlds were over-powered.

## \|\| 115.77-79 \|\|

*śivakopānalenaiva bhasmībhūtaḥ svakarmataḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya putro'pyadhunā sarveṣāṃ paramātmanaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

*pativratā ratirmātā patiśokena sāṃpratam \|*  
*śambarasya gṛhe tasthau hṛtā tena balena ca \|\| 78 \|\|*

*chāyāṃ māyāvatīṃ dattvā māyayā śayanena ca \|*  
*ratiṃ svadharma saṃrakṣya dharmasākṣī ca tadgṛhe \|\| 79 \|\|*

77-79. Because of his misdeed he was bum to ashes because of the anger of Shiva. Currently he happens to be the son of lord Krishna, my mother named Rati is quite a chaste lady. She had to stay in the house of Sambara because of the desire for her husband, who had abducted her forcibly. She gave away her shadow to the demon and saved her chastity. Dharma stands witness to the same.

## \|\| 115.80-81 \|\|

*nihatya śambaraṃ śatruṃ gṛhītvā svapriyāṃ satīm \|*  
*ājagāma dvārakāṃ ca candrasuryau ca sākṣiṇau \|\| 80 \|\|*

*pitāmahaṃ vāsudevaṃ tvaṃ kiṃ jānāmi mūḍhavat \|*  
*yaṃ ca santona jānanti vedāścatvāra eva ca \|\| 81 \|\|*

80-81. My father killing the demon Sambara took his chaste wife with him and went to Dvaraka. Both the sun and moon are witness to the same; how can you like a fool understand my grandfather Vasudeva who is unknown even to the Vedas.

## \|\| 115.82 \|\|

*vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvāni yasya lomasu \|*  
*tasya devaḥ paraṃ brahma vāsudeva iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Vasu is the place which happens to be the abode of all, one in whose hair-pits, the globe are lodged, he lord came to be known as Vasudeva.

## \|\| 115.83 \|\|

*śaṃkaraṃ pṛccha sākṣācca yasya bhṛtyo'dhunā bhavān \|*  
*kṛṣṇabhṛtyasya ca baleḥ putro'si kiṃkarātmajaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. You better ask about him from Shiva to whom you are serving. You happen to be the son of Bali who is the servant of Krishna and as such you happen to be his slave.

## \|\| 115.84 \|\|

*gokule vaiśyaputratvaṃ brūhi tvaṃ jñānadurbala \|*  
*bhojanaṃ vedavihitaṃ śaśvatkṣattriyavaiśyayoḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. You are devoid of wisdom and as such you call him as the son of Vaishya of Gokula. The Vedas permit the taking of food with Kshatriyas and the Vaisyas.

## \|\| 115.85 \|\|

*droṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ śreṣṭhā dharā tasya priyā satī \|*  
*putraṃ ca tapasā lebhe paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. The same Drona was born as Nanda and the chaste Dhara was born as Yashoda. Radha on the other hand was born as the daughter of Vrs abhana due to the curse of Sudarr.a; she at the command of her lord accompanied with thirty crores of cowherdesses arrived in the land of Bharata from the Goloka.

## \|\| 115.86-87 \|\|

*droṇo nando vaiśyarājo yaśodā sā dharā satī \|*  
*vṛṣabhānasutā rādhā sudāmnaḥ śāpakāraṇāt \|\| 86 \|\|*

*triṃśatkoṭiṃ ca gopīnāṃ gṛhītvā bharturājñayā \|*  
*puṇyaṃ ca bhārataṃ kṣetraṃ golokādājagāmasā \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. Because of this, the lord kept the company of those damsels. He married Radha and Brahma performed himself as the priest of the marriage.

## \|\| 115.88 \|\|

*tābhiḥ sārdha sa reme ca svapatnībhirmudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*pāṇiṃ jagrāha rādhāyāḥ svayaṃ brahmā purohitaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. A crore of cowherd boys arrived from the Goloka on earth. All of them were the best of the attendants of Hari and were illustrious like him.

## \|\| 115.89 \|\|

*gopakoṭiśca golokādājagām mṛdā'nvitā \|*  
*tejasā haritulyāste pārṣadapravarā hareḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. The lord with his illusion turning to the form of the cowherds is protecting the cows with his illusion.

## \|\| 115.90 \|\|

*gorakṣaṇaṃ harereva gopaveṣasya cā''tmanaḥ \|*  
*gopānāṃ śiśurakṣārthaṃ māyeśasyāpi māyayā \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. О demon, Putana was the daughter of Bali and your sister; she was childless in earlier birth and looking at the lord as the incarnation of Vamana had desired to achieve a son like him and could feed the child with her breasts.

## \|\| 115.91-92 \|\|

*pūtanā balikanyā ca bhaginī ca tavāsura \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā ca vāmanaṃ vindhyā cakāra putramānasam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*evaṃbhūto yadi mama putro bhavati sāṃpratam \|*  
*stanaṃ dadāmi tanayaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi sundaram \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. Drona was Prajapati and his wife Dhara was quite chaste; both of them performed tapas and achieved the lord as their son.

## \|\| 115.93-96 \|\|

*tasyāḥpūrṇaṃ mānasaṃ ca cakāra bhagavānprabhuḥ \|*  
*stanaṃ dattvā ca golokaṃ yayau sā ratnayānataḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*kubjā sā bhaginī pūrvaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ \|*  
*śrīrāmaṃ cakame kāmānnāmnā śūrpaṇakhā satī \|\| 94 \|\|*

*nāsāṃ ciccheda tasyāśca lakṣmaṇo dhārmikeśvaraḥ \|*  
*tapasā ca varaṃ lebhe brahmaṇaḥ priyamīśvaram \|\| 95 \|\|*

*tena puṇyena taṃlabdhvā golokaṃ sā jagāma ha \|*  
*gopī babhūva goloke kṛṣṇasyā''liṅganena ca \|\| 96 \|\|*

93-96. The lord fulfilled her desire; after feeding the child with her breasts she left the earth mounted over a gem-studded plane to Goloka. Kubja on the other hand was the sister of Ravana known as Surpanakha in her earlier birth, who passionately desired Rama as her husband but the extremely religious Laksmana severed her nose. Thereafter she performed tapas and achieved a boon from Brahma, as a result of which he achieved the lord as her husband and then proceeded to Goloka as a result of her embrace by lord Krishna, she went to Goloka as a cowherdesses.

## \|\| 115.97 \|\|

*narako harivadhyaśca svapūrvaprāktanena ca \|*  
*pāṇiṃ jagrāha kanyānāṃ sākṣiṇau śaśibhāskarau \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. Narakasura was killed because of his earlier misdeeds and Hari married the damsels. The sun and the moon stand witness to the same.

## \|\| 115.98-100 \|\|

*bhīṣmakanyā mahālakṣmīḥ śīkṛṣṇasya priyā satī \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhādāgatā sādhvī brahmaṇo'nṛmatena ca \|\| 98 \|\|*

*satrājitasya kanyā sā satyabhāmā vasuṃdhara \|*  
*dadau kṛṣṇāya rājā sa taṃ maṇiṃ yautukena ca \|\| 99 \|\|*

*bhuvo bhārāvataraṇahetunā gamanaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*saṃjahāra bhuvo bhāraṃ kurupāṇḍavayuddhataḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

98-100. Maha-Lakshmi the daughter of Bhlsma became the chaste wife of Krishna who arrived on earth at the command of Brahma from Vaikuntha. She was born as Satyabhama the wife of Satrajita; the king gave away the daughter in marriage to Krishna together with and auspicious gem. Lord Hari incarnated on earth in order to rid her from the burden. That is why engaging the Kauravas and the Pandavas in the battle-field, he relieved the earth of her burden.

## \|\| 115.101-103 \|\|

*śiśupālo dantavaktro jayo vijaya eva ca \|*  
*dvāriṇau dvāraṣaṭke ca vaikuṇṭhe śrīharerapi \|\| 101 \|\|*

*kumāraśāpātpatitau prāpya janmatrayaṃ dhruvam \|*  
*hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva tavaiva pūrvapūruṣaḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

*tasya bhrātā hiraṇyākṣastenaiva varuṇo jitaḥ \|*  
*harirnṛsiṃharūpeṇa taṃ jaghānāvalīlayā \|\| 103 \|\|*

101-103. Sisupala and Dantavakra happened to be the two guards of the lord in Vaikuntha, known by the name of Jaya and Vijaya. Both of them had fallen from Vaikuntha because of the curse from Sanaka and were born on earth thrice; in one birth they were born as Hiranyakasipu and Hiranyaksa, he had conquered Vamna. Lord Vishnu taking to the form of Nrsimha killed him playfully.

## \|\| 115.104-107 \|\|

*sūkareṇa hato'nyaśca pūrvajanmakathāṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*dvitīye janmani purā rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇakaḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

*śrīrāmeṇa hatau tau dvau śeṣajanma kalau tayoḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇena hatau tau dvau dharmaputrāvubhau tathā \|\| 105 \|\|*

*jarāsaṃdhaśca śālvaśca durātmā kaṃsa eva ca \|*  
*prāktanāttasya vadhyāste bhuvo bhārajihīrṣayā \|\| 106 \|\|*

*māṃdhātuḥ sutamadhye ca yavanaścāpi prāktanāt \|*  
*lakṣmīśvarasya kṛṣṇasya dhanena kiṃ prayojanamā \|\| 107 \|\|*

104-107. The other one Hiranyaksa was killed by the lord incarnating himself as Varaha; now you listen to the story of his second births, In the second birth they were born as Ravana and Kumbhakama who were killed by Rama; thereafter both of them were born as the sons of Dharma and were killed by Krishna. Jarasandha, Salva and the wicked Kariisa had also to reap the results of their misdeeds and had to be killed at the hands of Krishna. Yavana who was among the sons of Mandhata was also killed because of his earlier misdeeds. How is Krishna lord of Lakshmi concerned with the riches.

## \|\| 115.108-109 \|\|

*pratijñayā ca satyāyāḥ puṇyakavratakāraṇāt \|*  
*pārijātaṃ samanīya cakāra svātmano vratam \|\| 108 \|\|*

*svayaṃ jāmbavatī devī durgāṃśā bhallukātmajā \|*  
*pāṇiṃ jagrāha tasyāśca tapasā bhārate hariḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. Because of the Рщуака-wata performed by Satya the lord had to bring the Parijata tree for her. Jambavati the daughter of Bhalluka was herself born as amsha of Durga. Lord Hari accepted her as his spouse because of the tapas performed by her.

## \|\| 115.110 \|\|

*kuntyāśca kṣetrajāḥ putrāḥ kevalaṃ bharturājñayā \|*  
*kalau niṣiddhaṃ triyuge prasiddhaṃ palapaitṛkam \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. The ksetraja sons were born to Kunti at the command of her lord. This practise is prohibited in the Kaliyuga but was well-known in all the other three yugas.

## \|\| 115.111-113 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhiro dharmaputro bhīmaśca pavanātmajaḥ \|*  
*mahendraputro dharmiṣṭhaḥ phālguno vijayī bhuvi \|\| 111 \|\|*

*yasmai pāśupataṃ śaṃbhuḥ pradadau ca svayaṃ purā \|*  
*aśvamedhaṃ gavālambhaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ parapaitṛkam \|\| 112 \|\|*

*devareṇa sutotpatiṃ kalau pañca nityaśaḥ \|*  
*draupadyāḥ pañca bhartāraḥ śaṃkarasya vareṇa ca \|\| 113 \|\|*

111-113. Yudhisthira had been the son of Dharma, Bhima was the son of the wind god, Arjuna was the son of Indra who achieved victory on the earth and in earlier times Shiva bestowed him the Pasupata weapon. In Kaliyuga the practice of five things are prohibited which include, Asvamedha sacrifice, Gomedha sacrifice, samnyasa, conception through artificial insemination and conception from Devara. Draupadi was bestowed with five spouses because of the boon of Shiva.

## \|\| 115.114 \|\|

*baladevaḥ puṣpamadhu pūtaṃ pibati nityaśaḥ \|*  
*cakāra yamunāhvānaṃ snānārthaṃ dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. Balarama always consumed the auspicious nectar of the flowers which is always religious and pious. He had summoned Yamuna for taking bath.

## \|\| 115.115-116 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmo mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakho utto nāradanāo vāṇāniruddhasaṃo pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

*deśeṣvanyeṣu doṣo'yamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

115-116. Krishna had given away his sister Subhadra to Arjuna, the marriage with the daughter of maternal uncle is not prohibited in the south. But in other countries it is considered to be sinful.

## Chapter 116

## \|\| 116.1 \|\|

*atha ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ bāṇa uvāca aniruddha budho'si tvaṃ tvayoktaṃ satyameva ca \|*  
*śaṃbhunā caivamuktaṃ ca sarvaṃ buddhaṃ svacetasā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Bana said – О Aniruddha, you are quite an intelligent person. You have spoken the truth. Shiva also told me like that. I have well understood in my mind everything.

## \|\| 116.2 \|\|

*tvayoktaṃ śaṃkaravarātpañcānāṃ svāmināṃ priyā \|*  
*draupadī ca mahābhāgā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. You have told me that the virtuous Draupadi could have five spouses because of the boon of Shiva, you narrate the same episode to me in detail.

## \|\| 116.3 \|\|

*śambareṇa hṛtā pūrva tava mātā kathaṃ ratiḥ \|*  
*devairapi kathaṃ dattā devāstena jitā katham \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Why did Sambara abduct Rati your mother and why did the gods hand her over to him. How could the gods over-power him.

## \|\| 116.4-9 \|\|

*aniruddha uvāca ekadā raghunāthaśca sītayā lakṣmaṇo ca \|*  
*snātaḥ sarasi tatrastho ramye pañcavaṭītaṭe \|\| 4 \|\|*

*uvāca sītā hemante jalaṃ susvādu nirmalam \|*  
*tathā'nnaṃ vyañjanaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaṃ vastu suśītalam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*phalāvabacayanaṃ cakre sītāyai pradadau mudā \|*  
*tato dadau lakṣmaṇāya paścādbhaṅkte svayaṃ prabhuḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*lakṣmaṇastadgṛhītvā ca naiva bhuṅkte phalaṃ jalam \|*  
*meghanādavadhārthaṃ ca sītoddhāraṇakāraṇāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

*nidrāṃ na yāti no bhuṅkte varṣāṇāṃ ca caturdaśa \|*  
*ya evaṃ puruṣo yogī tadvadhyo rāvaṇatmajaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*etasminnantare rāmaṃ draṣṭuṃ kamalalocanam \|*  
*vahanistatra samāyāto dvijarūpī kṛpānidhiḥ bhaviṣyatkathayāmāma śrutikauṭaparaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

4-9. Aniruddha said – Once Rama and Sita having bath in Pancavati were seated on the bank of the river. At that point of time Sita said, "In the autumn season the water becomes spotless and tasteful; the food and other dishes become cool." Rama collected some fruits and handed them over to Sita. Then handing over some fruits to Laksmana, he ate himself; Laksmana received the fruits, the water but did not consume the same, because in order to redeem Sita, he intended to kill Meghanada. Only such a person could kill Meghanada who could never have slept for fourteen years nor had he eaten anything. In order to have an audience with the lotus eyed lord, the merciful Agni taking to the form of a Brahmana arrived there and started speaking harsh words.

## \|\| 116.10-12 \|\|

*vahniruvāca śṛṇu rāma mahābhāga sītāsaṃgopanaṃ kuru \|*  
*saptāhābhyantare caiva rāvaṇo duṣṭarākṣasaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*durnivāryaḥ prāktanena jānakīṃ ca hariṣyati \|*  
*vidhātrā likhitaṃ karma prāktaṃnaṃ kena vāryate \|\| 11 \|\|*

*vedaiścaturbhiḥ kathitaṃ na ca daivātparaṃ varam \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. Agni said – О virtuous Rama, you hide Sita somewhere, because Ravana influenced with the evil deeds of his earlier births, would arrive here and abduct Sita. This cannot be prevented. This has been ordained by destiny. Who can escape from the same? It has been ordained, in the Vedas that destiny is most powerful.

## \|\| 116.13 \|\|

*rāma uvāca sītāṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ gaccha cchāyā'traiva tu tiṣṭhatu \|*  
*kalatravarjanaṃ karma sarveṣāṃ ca jugupsitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Rama said – You carry Sita with you and her shadow he should remain here because it is difficult to perform any deed without a woman.

## \|\| 116.14 \|\|

*sītāṃ gṛhītvā prayayau rudatīṃ ca hutāśanaḥ \|*  
*sītayā sadṛśī chāyā tasthau śrīrāmasaṃnidhau \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The god of fire then took away Sita who was feeling gloomy and crying. Since then the shadow of Sita remained with Rama.

## \|\| 116.15 \|\|

*sā ca cchāyā hṛtā pūrva rāvaṇenāvalīlayā \|*  
*samuddadhāra tāṃ rāmo nihatya taṃ sabāndhavam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The same shadow Sita was carried by Ravana playfully in earlier times. Thereafter Rama after killing Ravana with all his relatives, redeemed Sita.

## \|\| 116.16 \|\|

*vahnau parīkṣākāle ca cchāyā vahnau viveśa sā \|*  
*agniśchāyāṃ ca saṃrakṣya dadau rāmāya jānakīm \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. At the time of fire ordeal, the shadow Sita entered the fire. The god of fire protected the shadow Sita and handed her over to him Sita in two forms.

## \|\| 116.17 \|\|

*rāmastāṃ ca gṛhītvā ca prayayau svāśramaṃ mudā \|*  
*chāyā tasthau vahnipārśve hṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Rama delightfully went back to his ashrama. The shadow Sita on the other hand started living with Agni with a very heavy heart.

## \|\| 116.18 \|\|

*sā ca cchāyā tapaścakre nārāyaṇasarovare \|*  
*tapaścakāra divyaṃ ca śātavarṣaṃ ca śūlinaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The shadow Sita then performed severe tapas at a pool named NSrayana. For a hundred divine years she adored Shiva.

## \|\| 116.19-20 \|\|

*varaṃ vṛṇuṣva bhadre tvamuvāca śaṃkaraśca tām \|*  
*uvāca śivaṃ vyagrā bharturduḥkhena duḥkhitā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*patiṃ dehi pañcadhā sā varaṃ vavre trilocanam \|*  
*sarvasaṃpatpradastuṣṭastasyai śarvo varaṃ dadau \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Thereafter, Shiva appeared before her and said, О virtuous lady, ask for a born, suffering from the pain from the separation of her husband and getting upset, she spoke to Shiva, "Give me my husband back." These words were repeated by her five times. Lord Shiva getting pleased with her tapas granted her the boon.

## \|\| 116.21 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca sādhvi tvaṃ pañcadhā brūhi patiṃ dehīti vyākulā \|*  
*pañcendrāśca hareraṃśā bhaviṣyanti priyāstava \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Mahadeva said – О chaste lady, getting upset you had desired for the husband uttering five times therefore five Indras would become your spouses from the arhsha of Vishnu.

## \|\| 116.22-23 \|\|

*te ca sarve ca pañcendrāścādhunā pañca pāṇḍavāḥ \|*  
*sā ca cchāyā draupadī ca yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kṛtayuge vedavatī tretāyāṃ janakātmajā \|*  
*dvāpare draupadī chāyā tena kṛṣṇā trihāyaṇī \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Those five Indras have currently appeared on earth in the form of five Pandavas and Draupadi is the shadow Sita who appeared from the sacrificial alter. The same shadow was known as Vedavati in Satyayuga. In Tretayuga she was known as JanakI and in Dvapara she is born as Draupadi. Because of this, Draupadi is known of having been born thrice.

## \|\| 116.24 \|\|

*vaiṣṇapī kṛṣṇabhaktā ca tena kṛṣṇā prakīrtitā \|*  
*svargalakṣmīrmahendrāṇāṃ sā ca paścādbhaviṣyati \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Draupadi is an extremely chaste and Vaishnava woman, a devotee of Krishna and because of the same she is also called Krishna. In future she would be born as SvargaLakshmi of Indra.

## \|\| 116.25 \|\|

*rājā dadau phālgunāya kanyāyāśca svayaṃvare \|*  
*papraccha mātaraṃ vīro vastu prāptaṃ mayā'dhunā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The king in the Svayamvara of Draupadi gave her to Arjuna. The valorous Arjuna spoke to the mother I have brought a unique thing with me.

## \|\| 116.26-27 \|\|

*tamuvāca svayaṃ mātā gṛhāṇa bhrātṛbhiḥ saha \|*  
*śaṃbhorvareṇa pūrva ca paratra māturājñayā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*draupadyāḥ svāminastena hetunā pañca pāṇḍavāḥ \|*  
*caturdaśānāmindrāṇāṃ pañcendrāḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. But the mother spoke out, "You enjoy the same with your brothers." Therefore because of the earlier boon of Shiva and because of command of the mother later on, Draupadi had five spouses. These five Pandavas happen to be five Indras out of the fourteen Indras.

## \|\| 116.28-29 \|\|

*śaṃkareṇābhisaṃśaptā sā mātrā bhartsitena ca \|*  
*bhartāte bhasmasādbhūto harakopānalena ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*he rati tvaṃ mayā śaptā daityagrastā bhavādhunā \|*  
*vijityadevānsendrāśca śambarastvā hariṣyati \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Shiva had pronounced a curse on my mother what her husband would be burnt to ashes because of his anger. At this she denounced Shiva thereafter Shiva again who said to her, "O Rati, because of my curse you would be over-powered by a demon." Sambara after conquering the gods would abduct you.

## \|\| 116.30 \|\|

*punaruvataṃ varaṃ prādātsatītvāṃ te na yāsyati \|*  
*chāyāṃ dattvā tiṣṭha gehe yāvajjīvati te patiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Thus speaking, he again pronounced a boon on her, "Your chastity would not be lost. You entrusting your shadow to the demon, would live in your own abode, till such time your husband is brought back to life".

## \|\| 116.31-32 \|\|

*iti te kathitaṃ sarvamitihāsaṃ purātanam \|*  
*devānāṃ guptacaritaṃ śrṛṇu daityendra sāṃpratam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tatra subhadraśca mahābalaḥ \|*  
*kumbhāṇḍabhrātā balavānbāṇasenāpatīśvaraḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Thus I have narrated to you the ancient story, now О demon, listen to the secret story of the gods. At the same time the valorous Subhadra arrived there, who happened to be the brother of Kumbhanda and was more valorous warrior of Bana.

## \|\| 116.33 \|\|

*nirbhatsarya bāṇaṃ samare śastrapāṇirmahārathaḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇapautraṃ śūlaṃ ca cikṣepa pralayāgnivat \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The great warrior denounced Bana and getting equipped with all the weapons, he threw a trident at Animddha, the grandson of Krishna.

## \|\| 116.34-35 \|\|

*ardhayandreṇa tacchūlaṃ ciccheda kāmaputrakaḥ \|*  
*śaktiṃ cikṣepa bhadraśca śatasūryasamaprabhām \|\| 34 \|\|*

*vaiṣṇavāstreṇa ciccheda tāṃ śaktiṃ kāmaputrakaḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇāstraṃ cikṣepa subhadro raṇamūrdhani \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. But the son of the god of love neutralised it with the use of the crescent arrow. Bhadra then shot a shakti which was illumining like hundreds of suns. Aniruddha on his part destroyed the same with the use of Vaishnavastra. Subhadra then used Narayandstra in the battle-field.

## \|\| 116.36 \|\|

*praṇamya śete nirbhīto madanasya suto balī \|*  
*ūrdhvamastraṃ ca babhrāma śatasūryasamaprabham \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. But Aniruddha the son of the god of love bowed before Narayandstra and fearlessly slept there. The weapon issuing the lustre of the hundred suns started moving round and round above Aniruddha.

## \|\| 116.37-38 \|\|

*pralīnamastramākāśe viśvasaṃhārakāraṇam \|*  
*astre gate so'niruddho gṛhītvā ca mahānasim \|\| 37 \|\|*

*prababhañjabhadrarathaṃ jaghānāśvāṃśca sārathim \|*  
*jaghāna taṃ subhadraṃ ca līlayā raṇamūrdhani \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. After sometime the weapon which could be cause of the destruction of the universe disappeared. After the disappearing of the weapon, Aniruddha held a sword in his hand and broke the chariot of Bhadra, killing, horses as well as the charioteer. Moving forward then he killed Subhadra play fully.

## \|\| 116.39-41 \|\|

*hate subhadre bāṇaśca mahābalaparākramaḥ \|*  
*vāṇānāṃ śatakaṃ cāpi cakṣepa raṇamūrdhani \|\| 39 \|\|*

*kāmātmajo'gnibāṇena bāṇodhaṃ pradadāha saḥ \|*  
*bāṇaścikṣepa brahmāstraṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā kāmātmajaḥ śīghraṃ sabījaṃ mantrapūrvakam \|*  
*brahmastreṇaiva sahasā saṃjahārāvalīlayā \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. After the killing of Subhadra, Bana shot a hundred arrows which were burnt out by the son of Kamadeva with the shooting of an arrow. Thereafter Bana shot Brahmastra which could destroy the entire universe. Aniruddha on the other hand shot another Brahmdstra reciting the mantras and destroyed the one shot by Bana.

## \|\| 116.42 \|\|

*bāṇaḥ pāśupataṃ kṣeptuṃ samārebhe ca kopataḥ \|*  
*niṣiddhaśca gaṇeśena skandena śaṃbhunā tathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Bana getting enraged, was about to shoot Pasupata, weapon but was presented from doing so by Ganesha, Karttikeya and Shiva.

## \|\| 116.43 \|\|

*taddṛṣṭvā so'niruddhastaṃ dhanurbāṇaugha saṃyutam \|*  
*mumoca jṛmbhaṇe yuddhe śīghraṃ taṃ ca mahāratham \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Finding Bana attempting to use Brahmdstra, Aniruddha shot a number of arrows as a result of which the valorous Bana started yawning in the battle-field.

## \|\| 116.44-45 \|\|

*jaḍo babhūva bāṇaśca niśceṣṭo raṇamūrdhani \|*  
*punaścikṣepa nidrāsyaṃ nidritaṃ taṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*bāṇaṃ taṃ nidritaṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhītvā khaḍgamuttamam \|*  
*bāṇaṃ hantuṃ samudyantaṃ vārayāmāsa kārtikaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Thereafter Bana became motionless in the battle-field. Thereafter Aniruddha shot a sleeping arrow, as a result of which Bana was over-powered by sleep. Finding Bana over-powered with sleep in the battle-field, he took out his sword and was about to kill the demon king when Karttikeya prevented him from doing so.

## \|\| 116.46 \|\|

*skandaśca śatabāṇauśca vārayāmāsa līlayā \|*  
*aniruddhaṃ mahābhāgaṃ balavāntaṃ dhanurdharam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Karttikeya prevented Aniruddha from attacking Bana with the shooting of a hundred arrows.

## \|\| 116.47 \|\|

*aniruddhaśca sahasā tathā śaktyā duratyayā \|*  
*babhañja kārtikarathaṃ ratnendrasāranirmitam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Aniruddha then shot Sakti-astra which was indestructible and broke into pieces the chariot of Karttikeya which was built with the best of gems.

## \|\| 116.48 \|\|

*gadayā kārtikaḥ kruddho'pyaniruddharayaṃ mudā \|*  
*babhañja līlayā tatra kṣaṇena raṇamūrdhani \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Karttikeya on the other hand getting enraged broke the chariot of Aniruddha into pieces.

## \|\| 116.49 \|\|

*aniruddho'rdhacandreṇa kṣuradhāreṇa līlayā \|*  
*ciccheda kārtikadhanurbhallāstreṇa niyojitam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Aniruddha then shot a crescent arrow at Karttikeya which broke his bow and thereafter the Bhalldstra was used by Aniruddha.

## \|\| 116.50-52 \|\|

*jadhāna kārtikastaṃ ca gadayā ca durantayā \|*  
*gadāṃ jagrāha taddhastājjavena madanātmajaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*śūlaṃ gṛhītvā skandaṃ ca tameva hantumu dyatam \|*  
*aniruddhaśca kopena prerayāmāsa dūrataḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*kārtikaḥ punarāgatya gṛhītvā kāmaputrakam \|*  
*gṛhītvā ca kareṇaiva pātayāmāsa bhūtale \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. Karttikeya then attacked Aniruddha with a massive club but Aniruddha the son of the god of love, held the club in his hands forcefully and shot it back to Karttikeya who was about to throw a trident at Aniruddha. In the meantime Karttikeya moved forward and holding Aniruddha with his hands threw him on the ground.

## \|\| 116.53 \|\|

*aniruddho gṛhītvā'siṃ prabhustasthau mahābalaḥ \|*  
*tayorvirodhaṃ dūraṃ ca pracakāra gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Most powerful lord Aniruddha took a sword in his hand. At this, Ganesha the great, intervened and pacified born of them,

## \|\| 116.54 \|\|

*kārtikaḥ prayayau gehamūṣāgehaṃ smarātmajaḥ \|*  
*sarva nivedituṃ śaṃbhuṃ prayayau sa gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Karttikeya then left for his home and Aniruddha went back to the abode of Osa. Ganesha left the place for the abode of Shiva in order to narrate to him the entire story.

## Chapter 117

## \|\| 117.1-2 \|\|

*atha saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca gaṇeśastu śivasthānaṃ gatvā natvā maheśvaram \|*  
*sarva vijñāpayāmāsa krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 1 \|\|*

*bāṇāniruddhayoryuddhaṃ subhadranidhanaṃ tathā \|*  
*skandāniruddhayoryuddhamaniruddhasya vikramam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Ganesha after reaching the abode of Shiva bowed in reverence to him and narrated to him separately all the happenings of the battle-field, which included the battle between Bana and Aniruddha, killing of Subhadra, battle between Karttikeya and Aniruddha and the prowess of Aniruddha.

## \|\| 117.3 \|\|

*gaṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya bhagavānbhavaḥ \|*  
*uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā suguptaṃ vedasaṃmatam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. On hearing the words of Ganesha, Shiva spoke beautiful and secret words which were according to the Vedas.

## \|\| 117.4 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca gaṇeśvara mahābhāga śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama \|*  
*hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Mahadeva said – О Ganesha, you listen to my words which are truthful, the gist or polity and result in, pleasantness.

## \|\| 117.5 \|\|

*asaṃkhyaviśvasaṃghaṃ ca sarva kṛṣṇātmajaṃ sutam \|*  
*kṛṣṇaṃ jānīhi yatkāryaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. You consider Krishna to be the combination of all including Pradyumna, the son of Krishna and Aniruddha.

## \|\| 117.6 \|\|

*brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ jagatmarva gaṇeśvara \|*  
*nibodha satyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О lord of the ganas, everything right from Brahma to the blade of grass is treated to be a like by Krishna.

## \|\| 117.7 \|\|

*goloke dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam \|*  
*śiśurūpaṃ gopaveṣaṃ gopaveṣaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ prabhum \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He is two-armed in Goloka, quite peaceful, beloved of Radha, beautiful, the form of a child, appearing as a cowherd and the complete lord.

## \|\| 117.8-12 \|\|

*gopībhirgopanikaraiḥ sahitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ \|*  
*puṇye vṛndāvane ramye sundare rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 8 \|\|*

*carantaṃ muralīhastaṃ brahmeśaśeṣavanditam \|*  
*śataśṛṅgai ca śaileśe vaṭamūle nirākule \|\| 9 \|\|*

*goṣṭhe bhāṇḍīranikaṭe nirmale virajātaṭe \|*  
*navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yathā navaṃ ghanaughaṃ ca saudāminthā virājitam \|*  
*āvirbhāvaśca teṣāṃ vai goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tāvanto gokule ramye puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*sarve cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥkṛṣṇastu bhagavānsvayam \|\| 12 \|\|*

8-12. He is surrounded by the cowherdesses, cowherdes and the cows. He is the one who remains present in the charming and auspicious Vrindavana and the Rasamandala, holding a flute in his hand. He is the one who is adored by Brahma, Shiva and Shesha, who resides under the shade of a banyan tree, on the mountain of hundred peaks and also roams about in the Bhandlra forest on the bank of Viraja river which is spotless. He has the dark complexion of new clouds and is clad in yellow garment and looks like lightening in the new clouds. He always appears in the Rasamandala of Goloka, all the creatures in the charming Goloka and the auspicious v'rndavana, represent his aritsa but Krishna himself is the lord.

## \|\| 117.13 \|\|

*paripūrṇatamaḥ kāmo brahmaśāpātsvavismṛtaḥ \|*  
*tasya putro'niruddhaśca mahābalaparākramaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Lord Krishna would arrive soon holding his Sudarsana-cakra which is infallible and possesses the lustre of the crores of suns.

## \|\| 117.14 \|\|

*mayā prasthāpitaḥ skando mahāyuddhe sudāruṇe \|*  
*mṛto bāṇaśca saṃgrāme tena skandena rakṣitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The complete Brahman has forgotten himself because of the curse of Brahma His son named Aniruddha, possesses all the prowess and strength.

## \|\| 117.15-17 \|\|

*skandāniruddhayoryuddhe samatvaṃ tu gaṇeśvara \|*  
*aṣṭau ca bhairavāḥ sarve rudrāścaikādaśaiva te \|\| 15 \|\|*

*aṣṭau ca vasavaścaite devāḥ śakrādayastathā \|*  
*tathaiva dvādaśādityāḥ sarve daityeśvarāstathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*devānāmagraṇīḥ skando bāṇaśca sagaṇastathā \|*  
*sarve te cāniruddhaṃ ca saṃgrāme jetumakṣamāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. I have deputed Karttikeya for the terrific battle. Bana had almost been killed in the battle-field who has been saved by Skanda.

## \|\| 117.18 \|\|

*aniruddhaḥ svayaṃ brahmā pradyumnaḥ kāma eva ca \|*  
*baladevaḥ svayaṃ śeṣaḥ kṛṣṇaśca prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О Ganesha, though both Skanda and Aniruddha are equals in the battle-field but the eight Bhairavas all the eleven Rudras, eight Vasus and Indras the gods, twelve Adityas, all the demons beside Skanda the foremost of the god as well as all my ganas including Bana would be unable to defeat Aniruddha in the battle-field.

## \|\| 117.19 \|\|

*etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bāṇaṃ rakṣa gaṇeśvara \|*  
*bhavāñśubhasvarūpaśca vighnakhaṇḍanakārakaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Aniruddha himself is beyond Brahma, Pradyumna, Kamadeva, Baladeva, Shesha and Krishna.

## \|\| 117.20 \|\|

*ārādāyāsyati harirgṛhītvā ca sudarśanam \|*  
*avyarthamastrapravaraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О lord of the ganas, I have spoken all this to you, you protect Bana; you are the form of welfare and remove all the obstructions.

## Chapter 118

## \|\| 118.1-2 \|\|

*athāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca gaṇeśaṃ bodhayitvā tu śaṃbhuramyantaraṃ yayau \|*  
*tatra siṃhāsane ramye durgā durgatināśinī \|\| 1 \|\|*

*bhairavī bhadrakālī ca ugracaṇḍā ca koṭarī \|*  
*tāḥ samutthāya sahasā praṇemurjagadīśvam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – After thus speaking to Ganesha, Shiva retired to his inner apartment, he found there Durga the destroyer of the misfortune, Bhairavl, Bhadrakali, Ugrachanda and Kotarl seated on the beautiful lion thrones, all of them got up at once and bowed in reverence to the lord.

## \|\| 118.3-5 \|\|

*tatrā''yayau gaṇeśaśca kārtikeyaśca vīryavān \|*  
*bāṇaśca vīrabhadraśca svayaṃ nandī sunandakaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*mahākālo mahāmantrī hyathāṣṭauṃ bhairavāstathā \|*  
*siddhendrāścāpi yogīndrā rudrāścaikādaśaiva te \|\| 4 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tatra maṇibhadraḥ samāyayau \|*  
*sihadvāre svayaṃ dvārī tabhīśvaramuvāca saḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Thereafter, Ganesha when valorous Karttikeya, Nandi, Sunanda, the minister Mahakala, eight Bhairavas, the siddhas, the yogis and eleven Rudras also arrived there. In the meantime Manibhadra who guarded the main gate arrived there and spoke to Shiva.

## \|\| 118.6-13 \|\|

*maṇibhadra uvāca asaṃkhyāni ca sainyāni yādavānāṃ maheśvara \|*  
*baladevaśca pradyumnaḥ sāmbaśca sātyakistathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*rājā mahograsenaśca bhīmaśca svayamarjunaḥ \|*  
*akrūnaścodyavaścaiva jayantaḥ śakranandanaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ratnenadrasāranirmāṇarathendre sumanohare \|*  
*vidhervidhātā bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*saptabhiḥ pārṣadaigoṃpaiḥ sevitaḥ śvetayāmaraiḥ \|*  
*kandarpakoṭilīlābho vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dadhāra cakramatulaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham \|*  
*gadāṃ kaumodakīṃ śūlamavyarthaṃ saṃnidhāya ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

*rathamadhye mahāśaṅkhaṃ viśvasaṃhārakāraṇam \|*  
*mahārathānāṃ lakṣaiśca rathānāṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*trikoṭibhirgajendrāṇāṃ mallānāṃ ca trikoṭimiḥ \|*  
*śatakoṭibhiraśvānāṃ carmiṇāṃ taccaturguṇaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*khaḍgināṃ tatsaptaguṇairdviguṇaistaddhanuṣmatām \|*  
*ebhiḥ sārdha ca tvaritamāyayau śoṇitaṃ puram \|\| 13 \|\|*

6-13. Manibhadra said – The anny of Yadavas is innumerable and comprises of Baladeva, Pradyumna, Samba Satyaki, Ugrachanda, Bhima, Arjuna, Akrnra, Uddhava, Jayanta, the son of Indra and are seated on the chariot built with the best of gems. Shri Krishna the creator of the creator is also there, seven cowherds are moving the white fly-whisks. He possesses the lustre of cores of gods of love and is adorned with long garland of forest flowers. He is shining like crores of suns and is holding an astonishing cakra. The kaumodaM-gada is placed in the chariot; beside the indestructible trident and Pancajanya conch are also seem there. There are three crores of the wild elephants, three crores of terrific warriors, hundred crores of horses besides four times more the foot soldiers adorned with kavachas seven times more that number or the wielders of the swords and the number of archers as double its number.

## \|\| 118.14-16 \|\|

*parito veṣṭayāmāsa laṅkāṃ dāśarathiryathā \|*  
*sahasratālamānāṃ ca jvaladagniśikhojjvalām \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ūrdhve ca parikhāyuktāṃ durlaṅdhyāmasuraiḥ suraiḥ \|*  
*svargagaṅgāmburāśīnāṃ samūhairvṛṣṭibhistathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pakṣīndro garuḍaḥ sākṣānnirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ \|*  
*maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ prākārābhraṃlihaṃ puram \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. All of them have surrounded Sonitpura in the same way as the army of Rama had surrounded Lanka which was thousand talas in height, illumining with the fire flames and had a number of moats and was inaccessible from the demons and the gods. Garuda with the waters of the Svargaganga had destroyed the boundary wall of the city, which was built with the best of gems and was quite high.

## \|\| 118.17 \|\|

*babhañja lakṣaṃ mallānāṃ baladevaśca lāṅgalaiḥ \|*  
*udyānānāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca cakārotpāṭanaṃ prabho \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Baladeva have destroyed lakhs of the soldiers with his plough and three lakhs of gardens have been uprooted.

## \|\| 118.18-19 \|\|

*praviveśa mahādvāraṃ dvārapālānnipatya ca \|*  
*evaṃ śrutvā mahādevaścovāca surasaṃsadi \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pārvatī bhadrakālī ca skandaṃ gaṇapatiṃ tathā \|*  
*aṣṭau ca bhairavāṃścaiva rudrāśca vīrabhadrakam mahākālaṃ nandinaṃ ca sarvānsenāpatīnnava \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Killing the gate-keepers they have entered the main-gate. On hearing this, lord Shiva in the assembly of the gods spoke to Parvati, Bhadrakali, Skanda, Ganapati, eight Bhairavas, Rudras, Virabhadra, Mahakala, Nandi and all the army commanders.

## \|\| 118.20 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca golokanātho bhagavāṃścakrapāṇiḥ samāgataḥ \|*  
*viśvaughaṃ bhaṅktumīśo yaḥ kṣaṇena nagaraṃ ca kim \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Mahadeva said – Shri Krishna, the lord of Goloka, has arrived who can destroy the entire universe in a moment then what to speak all this land.

## \|\| 118.21 \|\|

*sarvopāyaiśca sarve te bāṇaṃ rakṣantu yatnataḥ \|*  
*bāṇo gacchatu saṃgrāmaṃ smṛtvā lambodaraṃ param \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. All of you should protect Bana with all the means. Bana should move out to the battle-field reciting the name of Ganesha.

## \|\| 118.22-23 \|\|

*bāṇasya dakṣiṇo skandaḥ purataśca gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*vāme ca bhairavā rudrāḥ svayaṃ nandī sahārathaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*mahākālo vīrabhadro ye cānyo sainikāstathā \|*  
*ūrdhve durgā bhadrakālī hyagraṇḍā ca koṭarī \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Skanda should be on the left of Bana, while Ganesha should move forward and Bhairava should be on right his together with Indra, Nandi, Mahakala and Virabhadra. All other warriors should protect him, the goddess Durga should move in the upper region together with Kotarl, Kali and Ugrachanda.

## \|\| 118.24 \|\|

*bāṇaṃ rakṣa mahābhāge durge durgatināśini \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya bhavatī śaktistena nārāyaṇī smṛtā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Durga, the destroyer of misfortune should protect Bana. О virtuous one, you happen to be the strength of lord Krishna, that is why you are known as Narayani.

## \|\| 118.25 \|\|

*viṣṇumāye jaganmātaḥ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgale \|*  
*avyarthāccakrasāracca rakṣa bāṇaṃ sudarśanāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. You are illusion of Vishnu, the mother of the universe, bestower of all the welfare's and therefore you protect Bana with the use of Sudarsana-cakra.

## \|\| 118.26 \|\|

*bāṇaḥ priyo me sarvemyo gaṇeśātkārtikādapi \|*  
*bāṇamūrdhni karaṃ dhehi pādābjarajasā saha \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. I love Bana the most, much more than Ganesha and Karttikeya, you place your hand on the head of Bana together with the dust from your feet.

## \|\| 118.27 \|\|

*śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā durgā durgatināśinī \|*  
*prahasyovāca madhuraṃ yāthārthyaṃ samayocitam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. On hearing the words of Shiva, Durga, the destroyer of misfortune spoke sweet, meaningful and truthful words which were appropriate to the time.

## \|\| 118.28-29 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca maṇiratnādikaṃ yadyanmuktāmāṇikyahīrakam \|*  
*sarvasvaṃ kanyakāmūṣāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 28 \|\|*

*ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyamaniruddhaṃ paraṃ varam \|*  
*puraskṛtya dehi bāṇa kṛṣṇāya paramātmane \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Parvati said – О Bana, you hand over your daughter Usha to lord Krishna together with Aniruddha and giving in dowry the gems, diamonds, jewels, rubies, sapphire, emeralds and all the ornaments studded with precious gems. Thereafter you rule the country fearlessly, what type of war can you wage against the one ho happens to be the soul of all.

## \|\| 118.30 \|\|

*rājyaṃ kuruṣva nirvighnaṃ kiṃ yuddhamātmanā saha \|*  
*yasmingate gatāḥ prāṇāḥ ka jīvaścaindriyaiḥ saha \|*  
*śaktiścāhaṃ mano brahmā svayaṃ jñānātmakaṃ śivaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. With the departure of whom the body becomes lifeless together with all the organs of senses. I happen to be the strength, Brahma is the mind while Shiva is the store of all the knowledge.

## \|\| 118.31-33 \|\|

*sadyaḥ patati dehaśca śivaṃ tyaktvā śavo bhavet \|*  
*ko vā tiṣṭhati saṃgrāme cakrasya tejasā śiva \|\| 31 \|\|*

*nā''tmā''kāśo bāṇaviddho yuddhaṃ kiṃ svātmanā saha \|*  
*paramātmā ca sarveṣāṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*nityaḥ satyo hi kṛṣṇaśca paribūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*gaṇeśaḥ kārtikeyaśca bhavānapi tayoḥ paraḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. With the departure of the soul from the body, it falls and becomes like a dead body. О Bana, who can stand the lustre of Sudarsana-cakra in the battle-field. Shri Krishna happens to be the supreme soul, the one who takes to human form in order to oblige his devotees who is eternal, truthful and complete Brahman. The soul cannot be wounded with the shooting of an arrow like the sky, then what type of fight could be there with the soul? You are dearer to me much more than Ganesha and Karttikeya.

## \|\| 118.34-39 \|\|

*kiṃkareṣu priyo bāṇo na hi kṛṣṇātparaḥ priyaḥ \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe'haṃ mahālakṣmīrgoloke rādhikā svayam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*śivā'haṃ śivaloke'pi brahmaloke sarasvatī \|*  
*ahaṃ nihatya daityāṃśca dakṣakanyā satī purā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tvannindayā tyaktadehā sā cāhaṃ śailakanyakā \|*  
*raktabījasya yuddhe ca kānī ca mūrtibhedataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sāvitrī vedamātā'haṃ sītā janakakanyakā \|*  
*rukmiṇī dvāravatyāṃ ca bhārate bhīṣmakanyakā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*sudāmnaḥ śāpato daivādvṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā \|*  
*dharmapatnī ca kṛṣṇasya puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|\| 38 \|\|*

*bhagavantaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ tvāṃ śivaṃ ca sanātam \|*  
*kiṃ vā'haṃ kathayāmīti kartavyaṃ samayocitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

34-39. I like Bana much more than all of my attendants but no one else is dearer to me than Krishna. I happen to be Maha-Lakshmi in Vaikuntha, Radha in Goloka, Shiva in Shivaloka and Sarasvati in Brahmaloka, In incarnated as Sati in earlier times, the daughter of Daksha for the killing of the demons. Thereafter I ended my life because of your denouncement and was born as the daughter of the mountain. In the battle-field with Raktablja, I came to known as Kali. I happen to be Savitri, the mother of the Vedas, Sita the daughter of Janaka and Rukmini in Dvaraka. Presently I have been born on earth as the daughter of Vrsabhana and the spouse of Krishna in Vrindavana. You happen to be the all knowledgeable and eternal Shiva, what should I speak to you about the appropriate action to be taken at the moment.

## Chapter 119

## \|\| 119.1-2 \|\|

*athaikonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā gameśaśca śivaḥ svayam \|*  
*kārtikeyaśca kālī ca tāṃ praśaṃsāṃ cakāra ha \|\| 1 \|\|*

*uvāca bhagavāñśaṃbhurjagatāṃ mātaraṃ parām \|*  
*jyotiḥ svarūpāṃ paramāṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – On hearing the words of Parvati, Shiva, Karttikeya and Kali started praising her.. Lord Shiva addressed to the mother of the universe, who is beyond everything, the form of eternal flame and happens to be Mula-Prakriti besides being Isvari.

## \|\| 119.3-4 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca tvayā yadhaktaṃ deveśi sarva vedoktamīpsitam \|*  
*ayuktamupahāsyaṃ va samaraṃ paramātmanā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bāṇo dadātu kanyāṃ dāṃ svarṇabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*sāmañjasyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca śubhadaṃ sarvakarmasu \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Mahadeva said – О great goddess, whatever has been spoken by you is strictly according to the Vedas and is desirable. It is quite improper and laughable to fight with the eternal soul. Bana should adorn is daughter with all the ornaments and hand her over to the lord. This is the most appropriate action besides being glorious and pleasant.

## \|\| 119.5-6 \|\|

*na dadāti yadā bāṇo hiraṇyakaśipoḥ prajā \|*  
*yuddhe parāṅmukho bhīto bhagavatyayaśaskaraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bāṇo gacchatu saṃnāhī raṇaśāsraviśāradaḥ \|*  
*paścāccā ''gamanaṃ kurmo vayaṃ sāṃnāhikāḥ śive \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. О goddess, if Bana does not do so being the descendants of Hiranyakasipu and feels that getting panicky, to run away from the battle-field, would be disgraceful and in that case Bana is well-versed in the warfare, should proceed to the battle filed wearing the kavacha. О Shiva, we shall also follow him, wearing the kavachas.

## \|\| 119.7-8 \|\|

*uvāca bāṇaṃ tāṃ dātuṃ sa ca na svīcakāra ha \|*  
*durgā taṃ bodhayāmāsa na bubodha ca sadvacaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tāṃ ca sabhāmeva mahoramām \|*  
*ājagāma mahādharmo baliśca vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Bana was advised to give away his daughter but he refused to do so. Durga tried to convince him but he did not agree to her words. In the meantime Bali, the foremost of the Vaishnavas and was the immensely religious person, arrived there in the assembly.

## \|\| 119.9-12 \|\|

*rathaṃ latnendranirmāṇaṃ samāruhya mahābalaḥ \|*  
*prataptaiḥ saptabhirdaityaiḥ sevitaḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*daityendrāṇāṃ saptalakṣairāvṛtaḥ paramāstravit \|*  
*avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca śivāṃ śivām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tamuvāca mahādevaḥ saṃbhāṣya priyabhāṣaṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*mahādeva uvāca bhagavaṃścaturastvaṃ ca pradātā sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*ayaṃ hi paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. The great warrior had arrived mounted on the chariot inlaid with the best of gems. At that point of time the seven Daityas were moving the white fly-whisks serving him and he was surrounded by seven lakhs of demons. He was a great archer and descending from the chariot, he bowed in reverence to Ganesha, Parvati, Shiva and Karttikeya and than took his seat in the assembly. Finding him arriving there, from a distance, all the people except, Shiva got up to welcome him. Thereafter Shiva enquired of him about his welfare.

## \|\| 119.12 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca bhagavaṃścaturastvaṃ ca pradātā sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*ayaṃ hi paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Mahadeva said – О great king, you are quite clever and always give away riches in charity, it is a matter of great pride for the Vaishnavas to assemble at a place.

## \|\| 119.13-16 \|\|

*tīrthānyapi ca pūtāni vaiṣṇavasparśamātrataḥ \|*  
*sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ ca pūjito brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tato'dhikaḥ pūjito'pi brāhmaṇo yadi vaiṣṇavaḥ \|*  
*na hi pūtaṃ ca paśyami vaiṣṇavabrāhmaṇātparam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sa pūtaḥ pavanādeva sa pūtaśca hutāśānāt \|*  
*tīrthemyo'pi ca sarvebhyo bibheti ca tataḥ suraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*na hi pāpāni taddehe vahnau śuṣkatṛṇādivat \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. With the very touch of the Vaishnavas, all the holy places get sanctified. The Brahmanas are considered to be most adorable of all the castes. In case the Brahmanas is a Vaishnava, he becomes more adorable. No god is more auspicious than the Vaishnava Brahmana. He is pure than the wind, the fire and all the holy places. Even the gods are afraid of him, the sins cannot remain in his body in the same way as the hay cannot remain in the fire.

## \|\| 119.17 \|\|

*baliruvāca kathaṃ stauṣi jagannātha bhṛtyamastavyamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*pradattaṃ parameśvarya tvayā nātha sudulrabham \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Bali said – О lord of the universe, why are you praising a slave who is not suitable for the place. О lord you have bestowed upon me, The inaccessible fortune.

## \|\| 119.18-22 \|\|

*adhunā sthāpito daivātsarvādhaḥ sutale'pi ca \|*  
*indrāya dattamaiśvarya matto bhaktātsureśvara \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tvayā vāmanarūpeṇa sarvarūpo'si sarvataḥ \|*  
*bāṇaṃ bodhaya bhadraṃ ca mama prāṇātmajaṃ param \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ātmanā saha yuddhaṃ ca deveṣvapi vigarhitam \|*  
*ityuktvā ca śivaṃ natvā śirasā praṇanāma tam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sāmavedoktastotreṇa tuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|*  
*pulakāñcitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro'tivihvalaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*dhyāyamānaśca nityaṃ yo hṛtpadme sumanohare \|*  
*śukreṇa dattaṃ mantraṃ ca japtvā caikādaśākṣaram \|\| 22 \|\|*

18-22. О lord of the gods, though you pervade everywhere, still taking to the dwarfish form because of the destiny you have established me in the nether-world, taking away all my riches from me. You bestowed them upon Indra. you kindly make Bana my dearest son to understand the situation. It is not proper to fight with the soul even by the gods. Thus speaking, he bowed his head saluting Shiva. Thereafter, he praised lord Shiva with the stotra prescribed in the Samaveda. At that point of time he was overwhelmed with devotion and tears started flowing from his eyes. Getting extremely emotional, he started reciting the mantra given to him by Sukra.

## \|\| 119.23-24 \|\|

*baliruvāca adityāḥ prārthanenaiva māturdevyā vratena ca \|*  
*purā vāmanarūpeṇa tvayā'haṃ vañcitaḥ prabho \|\| 23 \|\|*

*saṃpadrūpā mahālakṣmīrdattā bhaktāya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*śakrāya matto bhaktāya bhrātre puṇyavate dhruvam \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Bali said – О lord, in the earlier times because of the vrala and the prayer of Aditi you took to the dwarfish from and cheated me. Snatching away all my riches, you gave them to your devotee. The same devotee is non else than the meritorious Indra.

## \|\| 119.25 \|\|

*adhunā mama putro'yaṃ bāṇaḥ śaṃkarakiṃkaraḥ \|*  
*ārācca rakṣitaḥ so'pi tenaiva bhaktabandhunā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Presently my son Bana happens to be the slave of Shiva. He has been protected by Shiva who is always graceful to his devotees.

## \|\| 119.26-27 \|\|

*paripuṣṭaśca pārvatyā yathā mātrā sutastathā \|*  
*gṛhītavāṃśca tatkanyāṃ balena yuvatīṃ satīm \|\| 26 \|\|*

*samudyataśca taṃ hantuṃ kārtikenāpi vāritaḥ \|*  
*āgato'si punarhantuṃ pautrasya damane kṣamaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Parvati brought him up like a mother, brings up his son. Your grandson has forcibly taken away his daughter who was about to kill him but was prevented by Karttikeya. Though you are competent enough to control your grandson still you have arrived here to kill Bana.

## \|\| 119.28 \|\|

*sarvātmanaśca sarvatra samabhāvaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ \|*  
*karoṣi jagatāṃ nātha kathamevaṃ vyatikramaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The great soul treats all equally. This has been ordained in the Vedas. О lord of the universe, why are you moving in the opposite direction.

## \|\| 119.29 \|\|

*tvayā ca nihato yo hi tasya ko rakṣitā bhuvi \|*  
*sudarśanasya tejo hi sūryakoṭinibhaṃ param \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Intelligent is the best of all the shaktis. The life elements in all the creatures of the world is only the reflection of your soul.

## \|\| 119.30-31 \|\|

*keṣāṃ surāṇāmastreṇa tadeva ca nivāritam \|*  
*yathā sudarśanaṃ caivamastrāṇāṃ pravaraṃ varam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tathā bhavāṃśca devānāṃ sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ paraḥ \|*  
*yathā bhavāṃstathā kṛṣṇo vidhātā vedhasāmapi \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. In case, you intend to kill someone, who can save him on earth. The lustre of Sudarsana-cakra is like the crores o f suns.

## \|\| 119.32 \|\|

*viṣṇuḥ sattvaguṇādhāraḥ śivaḥ sattvāśrayastathā \|*  
*svayaṃ vidhātā rajasaḥ sṛṣṭikartā pitāmahaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Which of the weapons of the gods could stand before the same? Sudarsana-cakra is the best of all the gods. As are you so is Krishna who happens to be the creator of the creators.

## \|\| 119.33-35 \|\|

*kālāgnirudro bhagavānviśvacasaṃhārakārakaḥ \|*  
*tamasaścā''śrayaḥ so'pi rudrāṇāṃ pravaro mahān \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sa eva śaṃkarāṃśaścāpyanye rudrāśca tatkalāḥ \|*  
*bhavāṃśca nirguṇasteṣāṃ prakṛteśca parastathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*sarveṣāṃ paramātmā vai praṇā viṣṇusvarūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*mānasaṃ ca svayaṃ brahmā svayaṃ jñānātmakaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. Vishnu happens to be the base of sattvika elements, Shiva happens to be the base of tamas while Brahma is the base of rajas.

## \|\| 119.36 \|\|

*pravarā sarvaśaktīnāṃ buddhiḥ prakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*svātmanaḥ pratibibhbaste jīvaḥ sarveṣu dehiṣu \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The one who is the base of tamas, foremost of the eleven Rudras and the destroyer of the universe, the same lord happens to be the Goloka of Shiva, known as Kalagni-Rudra. Besides him all the Rudras are merely the rays of Shiva. Out of all of them you happen to be devoid of gunas and beyond Prakriti. You happen to be the supreme soul and also the form of Vishnu, who is the life of all the creatures. Brahma himself is the form of meanwhile Shiva is the form of knowledge.

## \|\| 119.37-38 \|\|

*jīvaḥ svakarmaṇāṃ bhogī svayaṃ sākṣī bhavāṃstathā \|*  
*sarve yānti tvayi gate naradeve yathā'nugāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*sadyaḥ patati dehaśca śavo'spṛśyastvayā vinā \|*  
*buddhāḥ santo na jānanti vañcitāstava māyayā \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. A person has to face the reward of his deeds and you yourself remain the witness to him. After your departure all the people follow you as the followers follow the king. After you leave the bodies, a person becomes dead and the body becomes untouchable but influence, with you illusion, even the people with intelligence become aware of the same.

## \|\| 119.39-41 \|\|

*tvāṃ bhajantyeva ye santo māyāmetāṃ taranti te \|*  
*triguṇā prakṛtirdurgā vaiṣṇavī ca sanātanī \|\| 39 \|\|*

*parā nārāyaṇīśānī tava māyā duratyayā \|*  
*tvadaṃśāḥ prativiśveṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*sarveṣāmapi viśveṣāmāśrayo yo mahānvirāṭ \|*  
*sa sete ca jale yogādviśveśo gokule yathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. Such of the people who adore you can only be freed from this illusion; the three fold Prakriti includes Durga, Vaishnavl, SanatanI, NarayanI and IsanI which represent your form, which is difficult to over-comes Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva who are present in all the globes, represent your amsas only as Shri Krishna resides in Gokula, similarly the great Virat who is the base of all dwells in the water.

## \|\| 119.42 \|\|

*sa eva vāsurbhagavāṃstasya devo bhavānparaḥ \|*  
*vāsudeva iti khyātaḥ purāvidbhiḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. He happens to be the lord Vasu and you happen to be his lord. The name Vasudeva has been derived from the same. This has been told by those who are well-versed in the ancient scriptures.

## \|\| 119.43-46 \|\|

*tvameva kalayā sūryastvameva kalayā śaśī \|*  
*kalayā ca hutāśaśca kalayā pavanaḥ svayam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kalayā varuṇaścaiva kuberaśca yamastathā \|*  
*kalayā tvaṃ mahendraśca kalayā dharma eva ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tvameva kalayā śeṣa īśāno naiṛṃtistathā \|*  
*munayo manavaścaiva grahāśca phaladāyakaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*kalākalāyāścāṃśena sarve jīvāścarācarāḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ jyotirdhyāyante yoginaḥ sadā \|\| 46 \|\|*

43-46. You happen to be the sun from one of your rays and also the moon. You also happen to be the fire from your race and also Vayu from you rays besides being Varena, Kubera, Yama, Indra, Dharma, Shesha, Isana, Nairriti, Manu and the beneficial planets. All the moveable and immovable creatures are born out of your rays. You are the eternal, illustrious Brahman. The yogis always meditate upon you.

## \|\| 119.47-60 \|\|

*taṃ tcā''driyante bhaktāste dhyāyante ya tadantare \|*  
*navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhakteśaṃ bhaktavatsalam \|*  
*candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ dvibhujaṃ muralīdharam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyabhūṣitam \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇakeyūravalayāvintam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*maṇikuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitam \|*  
*ratnasārāṅgalīyaṃ ca kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ śaratkamalalocanam \|*  
*śaratpūrṇaindunindāsyaṃ candrakoṭisamaprabham \|\| 51 \|\|*

*vīkṣitaṃ sasmitābhiśca gopīnāṃ koṭikoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*vayasyaiḥ pārṣadairgopaiḥ sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*gopabālakaveṣaṃ ca rādhāvakṣaḥ sthalasthitam \|*  
*dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ brahmeśaśeṣavanditam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*sinddhendraiśca munīndraiśca yogīndraiḥ praṇataṃ stutam \|*  
*vedānirvacanīyaṃ ca paraṃ svecchāmayaṃ vibhum \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sthūlasthūlatamaṃ rūpaṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatamaṃ param \|*  
*satyaṃ nityaṃ praśastaṃ ca prakṛteḥ paramīśvaram \|\| 55 \|\|*

*nirliptaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*evaṃ dhyātvā ca te pūtāḥ snigdhadūrvākṣatā jalam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*padmāpadmārcite pādapadme ca dātumutsukāḥ \|*  
*vedāḥstotumaśaktāstvāmaśaktā sā sarasvatī \|\| 57 \|\|*

*śeṣaḥ stotumaśaktaśca svayaṃbhūḥ śaṃbhurīśvaraḥ \|*  
*gaṇeśaśca dineśaśca mahendraścandra eva ca \|\| 58 \|\|*

*stotuṃ nālaṃ dhaneśaśca kimanye jaḍbuddhayaḥ \|*  
*guṇātītamanīhaṃ ca kiṃ staumi nirguṇaṃ param \|\| 59 \|\|*

*apaṇḍito'yamasuro na suraḥ kṣantumarhasi \|*  
*balestadvacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmānbhaktaṃ ca bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

47-60. The devotees respect you and meditate upon you in their heart. The one whose body has the complexion of new clouds, is clad in pitambara wears smile on his delightful face, the one who is graceful to the devotees, the one on whose body the sandal-paste is plastered the one who is having two arms, he holds a flute in his hand, the one whose head is adorned with peacock feather, the one who wears the garland of jasmine flowers, invaluable armlets and wristlets, the ear ornament made of gems decorate the temples, the one who wears the rings studded with gems and whose waist-band issued dangling sound, whose lustre jeers at crores of the gods of love, whose eyes defeat the glory of the lotus flowers of the winter season, the lustre of whose face resembles the lustre of the full moon of the winter season, who is stared by crores of cowherdesses smilingly, who is served by the cowherds moving the white-fly whisks who appears in the form of a boy, the one who always remains in the heart of Radha and is difficult to be achieved by deep meditation and is inaccessible, the one who is adored by Brahma, Shiva and Shesha, the one who is praised by the siddhas, the ascetics and the yogis the one who is inexplicable in the Vedas, the one who moves at will and is all-pervading who is the smaller than the smallest and greater than the greatest, the one who is eternal, truthful and the lord beyond Prakriti, uninvolved and unattached, the people get purified by devoting their minds at the eternal lord and always get anxious to offer at his lotus-like feet, the tender Dfirva-grass, unbroken rice and the water, the one whose glory cannot recited by the Vedas, Sarasvati. Shesha, Brahma, Ganesha, Surya, Indra, the moon and Kubera, that to speak of the people having little wisdom. It is beyond me to praise him. This Bana is a foolish demon and is not a god. Therefore, you kindly forgive him. On hearing the words of Bali, Shri Krishna who happen to be the lord of the universe and the one who is graceful to his devotees spoke.

## \|\| 119.61-63 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca mā bhairvatsa gṛhaṃ gaccha sutalaṃ rakṣitaṃ mayā \|*  
*madvareṇa prasādena tvatputro'pyajarāmaraḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*darpahāniṃ kariṣyāmi tasya mūrkhasya darpiṇaḥ \|*  
*prahlādāya varo datto bhaktāya ca tapasvine \|\| 62 \|\|*

*mamāvadhyaśca tvadvaṃśaśceti prītena cetasā \|*  
*tava putrāya dāsyāmi jñānaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ param \|\| 63 \|\|*

61-63. Shri Krishna said – О son, don't be afraid, you are completely saved and you go back to your abode, your son is eternal because of my boon or grace, I shall rid him of the arrogance who is just foolish. I have granted a boon delightfully to Prahlada that his descendants would not be killed. I shall bestow your son, the knowledge of over-powering the death.

## \|\| 119.64-67 \|\|

*tvayā kṛtimidaṃ stotraṃ sāmavedoktamīpsitam \|*  
*purā sanatkumārārāya pradattaṃ brahmaṇā tathā \|\| 64 \|\|*

*siddhāśrame puṇyatame praśaste sūryaparvaṇi \|*  
*gautamāya pradattaṃ ca gauryā mandākinītaṭe \|\| 65 \|\|*

*śaṃkareṇa ca śiṣyāya bhaktāya ca dayālunā \|*  
*brahmaṇe ca mayā dattaṃ śivāya virajātaṭe \|\| 66 \|\|*

*bhṛgave ca purā dattaṃ kumāreṇa ca dhīmatā \|*  
*tvaṃ ca dāsyasi bāṇāya bāṇaḥ stoṣyatyanena mām \|\| 67 \|\|*

64-67. The stotra with which you had adored me and is included in Samaveda, was bestowed by me to Brahma in earlier times at the time of solar eclipse, in the siddMsrama who bestowed the same to Sanatkumara. The knowledge of the same was bestowed by Gauri at the bank of Mandakini to Gautama. The merciful Shiva bestowed is knowledge to his devoted people, Brahma and I bestowed it knowledge to Shiva on the bank of the Viraja river. In earlier times Sanatkumara imparted the knowledge of the same to Bhrigu. Currently I will bestow this knowledge to Bana who would recite the same.

## \|\| 119.68-69 \|\|

*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyamubadiśya gurormukhāt \|*  
*vṛtasya pūjitasyāpi vastrabhūṣaṇacandanaiḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*susnāto yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ pūjākāle ca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. This is an immensely meritorious stotra when heard from the mouth of the teacher, having been served with the ornaments, costumes and sandal-paste and while so listening whosoever would recite the same with devotion daily, he would be relieved of the sins committed by him during crores of his births.

## \|\| 119.70-71 \|\|

*vipadāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ stotraṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*vāraṇaṃ duḥkhaśokānāṃ bhavābdhidhoratāraṇam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*khaṇḍanaṃ garbhavāsānāṃ jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param \|*  
*bandhanānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ bhaktamaṇḍanam \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. This stotra relieves one of all the misfortunes and bestows all the riches. It removes all the ailments and grief and serves as a boat to cross the terrific ocean of the universe. It removes the cycle of birth, death and old age and shatters all the bondages. This happens to be the ornament of the devotees.

## \|\| 119.72-74 \|\|

*sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ \|*  
*vratī vrateṣu sarveṣu tapasvī ca tapaḥsu ca \|\| 72 \|\|*

*sa stayaṃ sarvadānānāṃ phalaṃ ca labhate dhruvam \|*  
*lakṣadhā stotrapāṭhena stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām \|\| 73 \|\|*

*sarvasiddhiṃ ca labhate siddhistotro bhavedyadi \|*  
*ihaloke devatulyo'pyante yāti hareḥ padam \|\| 74 \|\|*

72-74. Whosoever recites the same, he earns the merit of taking bath at all the holy places, performing all the yajnas, vratas and tapas. a person surely meets with the success by reciting this stotra. Thereafter he leads the life like a god on the earth and ultimately reaches the abode of Vishnu.

## Chapter 120

## \|\| 120.1 \|\|

*viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha kṛṣṇaśca bhagavānuddhaveta balena ca \|*  
*dūtaṃ praśthāpayāmāsa vidhāya mantraṇaṃ śubham \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – Shri Krishna after consulting Balarama and Uddhava dispatched a messenger to Bana.

## \|\| 120.2-3 \|\|

*śivo gaṇapatiryatra durgāṃ durgatināśinī \|*  
*kārtikeyo bhadrakālī cogracaṇḍā ca koṭarī \|\| 2 \|\|*

*āgatya natvā dūtaśca gaṇeśaṃ ca śivaṃ śivām \|*  
*mānavāṃścāpi pūcyāṃśca samuvāca yathocitam \|\| 3 \|\|*
