2-3. He went to the place where Shiva, Ganesha, Parvati, the destroyer of misfortunes, Karttikeya, Bhadrakall, Ugrachanda and Kotarl were seated. The messenger bowed in reverence to Ganesha, Shiva, Parvati and all other respectable people there.

## \|\| 120.4-5 \|\|

*dūta uvāca bāṇamāhvayate kṛṣṇaḥ saṃgrāmārtha maheśvara \|*  
*kiṃ vā'niruddhamūṣāṃ ca gṛhītvā śaraṇaṃ vraja \|\| 4 \|\|*

*raṇe nimantrito yo hi na yāti bhayakātaraḥ \|*  
*paratra narakaṃ yāti saptabhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. The messengers said – "O Shiva, Krishna is inviting Bana for a battle-field or otherwise he should go and take refuge with Krishna together with Aniruddha and Usha. The one who does not face the war when he is invited for the same, he drives his seven generations after death to the hell"

## \|\| 120.6 \|\|

*dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sabhāmadhye yathocitam \|*  
*uvāca pārvatī devī svayaṃ śaṃkarasaṃnidhau \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. On hearing the words of messengers, Parvati who was seated beside Shiva spoke the appropriate words.

## \|\| 120.7-8 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca gaccha bāṇa mahābhāga gṛhītvā tava kanyakām \|*  
*sarvasvaṃ yautakaṃ dattvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sarveṣāmīśvaraṃ bījaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadam \|*  
*varaṃ varepyaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛpāluṃ bhaktavatsalam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Parvati said – О virtuous Bana, you give away everything in dowry and take refuge with Shri Krishna together with your son. He happens to be the lord of all, bestower of all the riches, the best of all the protector of all, is all merciful and is graceful on the devotees.

## \|\| 120.9-12 \|\|

*pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā tamūcuste sureśvarāḥ \|*  
*praśasaṃsuḥsabhāmadhye dhanyadhanyeti sarvadā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kopāviṣṭaśca bāṇo'yamuttasthau sahasā'suraḥ \|*  
*sāṃnāhiko dhanuṣpāṇiḥ praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ yayau \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sarvairniṣidhyamānaśca kampito raktalocanaḥ \|*  
*sāṃnāhikaśca daityānāṃ trikoṭyā ca mahābalaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kumbhāṇḍaḥ kūpakarṇaśca nikumbhaḥ kumbha eva ca \|*  
*senāpatīśvaraścaite yayuḥ sāṃnāhikāstathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. On hearing the words of Parvati, all the gods and the sages present in the assembly termed her words graceful and praised her. They also advised Bana to act accordingly but Bana started burning in anger and he was trembling with his eyes burning red. The demon then suddenly got up and in spite of the objection by all, he adorned himself, with the kavacha, holding a bow in his hand and bowing in reverence to Shiva, the valorous demon moved on with three crores of soldiers of the army. He was followed by Kumbhanda, Kupakama, Nikumbha, Kumbha and the commander Isvara wearing the kavachas.

## \|\| 120.13-15 \|\|

*unmattabhairavaścaiva saṃhārabhairavastathā \|*  
*asitāṅgo bhairavaśca rurubhairava eva ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

*mahābhairavasaṃjñaśca kālabhairava eva ca \|*  
*pracaṇḍabhairavaścaiva krodhabhairava eva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*prayayuḥ śaktibhiḥ sārdha sarve sāṃnāhikāśca te \|*  
*kālāggirudro bhagavānrudraiḥ sāṃnāhiko yayau \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. Thereafter Unmattabhairava, Samhara-bhairava, Asitaiigabhairava, Rurubhairava, Mahabhairava, Kalabhairava, Prachandabhairava and Krodhabhairava also followed him carrying all the weapons, the lord Kalagnirudra also followed him with all the Rudras.

## \|\| 120.16-21 \|\|

*ugracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍikā caṇḍināyikā \|*  
*caṇḍeśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā caṇḍī caṇḍakapālikā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*aṣṭau ca nāyikāḥ sarvāḥ prayayuḥ kharparāvintāḥ \|*  
*koṭarī ratnayānasthā śoṇitagrāmadevatā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*prayayau sā praphullāsyā khaḍgakharparadhāriṇī \|*  
*indrāṇī vaiṣṇavī śāntā brahmāṇī brahmavādinī \|\| 18 \|\|*

*kaumārī nārasiṃhī ca vārāhī vikaṭākṛtiḥ \|*  
*māheśvarī mahāmāyā bhairavī bhīmarūpiṇī \|\| 19 \|\|*

*aṣṭau ca śaktayaḥ sarvā rathasthāḥ prayayurmudā \|*  
*ratnendrasārayānasthā prayayau bhadrakālikā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*raktavarṇā trinayanā jihvālalanabhīṣaṇā \|*  
*śūlaśaktigadāhastā khaḍgakharparadhāriṇī \|\| 21 \|\|*

16-21. Ugrachanda, Prachanda, Chandika, Chandinayika, Chandeshvari, Camunda, Chandi, Chandakapalika, all the eight of them marched forward holding the skull-cups in their hands. The village deity of Sonitpura named Kotarl also moved on mounted on the gem-studded chariot. She had a smiling face and held and skull-cup and a sword in her hand; all the eight goddesses named IndranI, peaceful Vaishnavl, BrahmanI, Kaumari, Narasimhi, Varahl, of terrible form, Mahamaya, Maheshvari and Bhairavl of terrific form also followed the army mounted over a chariot delightfully. Bhadrakalika was mounted over a gem-studded chariot, offered her salutation to the lord. She had a red complexion, three eyes and looked terrific because of her protruding tongue. All of them carried the trident, sakti, gada, sword and the skull-cup in their hands.

## \|\| 120.22-27 \|\|

*prayayau śūlahastaśca vṛṣabhastho maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*skandaśca śikhiyānasthaḥ śastrapāṇirdhanurdharaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*evaṃ ca prayayuḥ sarve gaṇeśaṃ pārvatīṃ vinā \|*  
*ebhiryuktaṃ mahādevaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca bhadrakālikām \|\| 23 \|\|*

*pracakre cakrapāṇiśca saṃbhāṣāṃ ca yathocitām \|*  
*bāṇaḥ śaṅkadhvaniṃ kṛtvā praṇamya pārvatīśvaram \|\| 24 \|\|*

*dhanurdathāra saguṇaṃ divyāstreṇa niyojitam \|*  
*bāṇaṃ samudyataṃ dṛṣṭvā sātyakiḥ paravīrahā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*niṣidhyamānastaiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃnāhī prayayau mudā \|*  
*bāṇaścikṣepa divyāstramañjanaṃ nāma nārada \|\| 26 \|\|*

*avyarthaṃ grīṣmamadhyāhanamārtaṇḍābhaṃ sutīkṣṇakam \|*  
*dṛṣṭāvā'straṃ sātyakiḥ sākṣātkiṃcinnamro babhūva saḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

22-27. Thereafter Mahadeva holding a trident in his hand was mounted on Nandi and marched on. Karttikeya holding a terrific weapon in his hand moved on mounted on the peacock. Thus all the gods and goddesses except Ganesha and Parvati marched on to the battle-field. Finding Mahadeva and Bhadrakall there, Krishna spoke to them. Bana then blew the conch and bowing at the feet of Shiva, strung his bow and aimed the divine arrow from the bow. Finding Bana getting ready for the war, Satyaki the killer of the enemy moved forward in spite of being dissuaded by other people. О Narada, Bana shot a divine weapon named Aiijana on him. The weapon was infallible, issued the lustre like the mid-day sun of the Summer season and was quite sharp. Finding the weapon Satyaki himself became quite humble.

## \|\| 120.28-30 \|\|

*kiṃ vā na dagdhaḥ prayayau nabhomadhyaṃ sudāruṇam \|*  
*vahniṃ cikṣepa bāṇaśca sātyakirvāruṇena ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*prajvalantaṃ tālamānaṃ nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ \|*  
*ciccheda vāruṇaṃ ghoraṃ prajaṇḍaṃ bhīmamulbaṇam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ciccheda sātyakiścaiva pārjanyenāvalīlayā \|*  
*cikṣepa pavanaṃ bāṇaḥ pracaṇḍaṃ bhīmamulbaṇam \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. As a result of this, he could not be burnt and was flown to the sky. Thereafter Bana shot a fire arrow which was neutralised by Satyaki with Varunastra, extinguishing the flames of the fire which, were rising to the height of a tala tree. Thereafter Bana shot the terrific arrow of the wind.

## \|\| 120.31 \|\|

*ciccheda sātyakiścaiva parvatāśtreṇa līlayā \|*  
*nārāyaṇastraṃ cikṣepa bāṇaśca raṇamūrdhani \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. But Satyaki neutralised the same with the shooting of a Parvatastra. Bana then used Narayanastra in the battle-field.

## \|\| 120.32 \|\|

*sātyakirdaṇḍavadbhūmau papātārjunaśikṣayā \|*  
*māheśvaraṃ pracikṣepa bāṇaḥ śastravidāṃ varaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. But Satyaki because of the training he received for Arjuna prostrated before it on the ground. Thereafter Bana who was well-known in the warfare shot the Maheshvara arrow.

## \|\| 120.33 \|\|

*sātyakirvaiṣṇavāstreṇa pravicchedāvalīlayā \|*  
*brahmāstraṃ cāpi cikṣepa bāṇaśca raṇamūrdhani \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Satyaki destroyed it with the use of Vaishnava-astra. Thereafter Bana shot Brahmastra.

## \|\| 120.34 \|\|

*kṣaṇaṃ cakāra nirvāṇaṃ brahmāstreṇa ca sātyakiḥ \|*  
*nāgāstraṃ cāpi cikṣepa bāṇo raṇaviśāradaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Satyaki on the other hand destroyed the same with the use of Brahmastra. Bana, who was well-versed in the warfare shot the Ndgdstra.

## \|\| 120.35 \|\|

*sātyakirgāruḍenaiva saṃjahāra kṣaṇena ca \|*  
*jagrāha śūlamavyarthaṃ śaṃkarasya sudāruṇam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. But Satyaki destroyed the same with the shooting of Garudastra in a moment. Thereafter Bana took up the infallible trident of Shiva.

## \|\| 120.36 \|\|

*tuṣṭāva sātyakirdurgā gale mālyaṃ babhūva ha \|*  
*jagrāha dhanuṣā bāṇo bāṇaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Satyaki than offered prayer to Durga. as a result of this, the trident was turned into the garland of flowers adorning his neck. Bana then placed the Pds'upata on the bow.

## \|\| 120.37-38 \|\|

*bāṇaṃ sabāṇaṃ jṛmbhaṃ ca sātyakiśca cakāra ha \|*  
*bāṇaṃ taṃ jṛmbhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kārtikeyo mahābalaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*ardhacandraṃ ca cikṣepa kāmaściccheda līlayā \|*  
*gadāṃ cakṣepa ca skandaḥ prātaḥ sūryasamaprabhām \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. But Satyaki shot an arrow which plunged Bana into a swoon. Finding Bana getting into sleep, the valorous Karttikeya shot the crescent arrow. But Kamadeva destroyed it playfully. After this, Karttikeya shot a gada having the lustre of the rising sun.

## \|\| 120.39-40 \|\|

*vaiṣṇavāstreṇa kāmaśca nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇastraṃ skandaśca prākṣipacca tvarānvitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇaśikṣayā \|*  
*skandaḥ śaktiṃ ca cikṣepa pralayagnisamaprabhām \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. The god of love neutralised it also, Skanda then shot Nardyandstra but Pradyumna because of the training he had received from Krishna, prostrated on the ground like a rod. Skanda then shot an another arrow named shakti, having the lustre of the fire of dissolution. Kamadeva on his part neutralised the same by issuing the Nardyandstra-, then Karttikeya took up in anger the Pasupata weapon.

## \|\| 120.41-45 \|\|

*kāmo nārāyaṇāstreṇa nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra tām \|*  
*brahmāstraṃ ca pracikṣepa kārtiko raṇamūrdhani \|\| 41 \|\|*

*brahmāstreṇāpi kāmaśca nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ \|*  
*jagrāha kārtikaṃ kopāddivyaṃ pāśupataṃ tadā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*nidrāstreṇāpi madano nidritaṃ ca cakāra tam \|*  
*kārtikaṃ nidritaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇaṃ ca jṛmbhitaṃ tathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kopātkāmaṃ ca sarathaṃ jagrāha bhadrakālikā \|*  
*kroḍe kṛtvā ca bāṇaṃ ca skandaṃ ca jagatāṃ prasūḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*raṇasthalācca prayayau yatraiva pārvatī satī \|*  
*kārtikaṃ bodhayāmāsa bāṇaṃ susthaṃ cakāra sā \|\| 45 \|\|*

41-45. But Kamadeva with the use of Nidrastra made him unconscious who went to sleep. Finding Karttikeya having been over-powered by sleep and yawning, Banasura and Bhadrakall in anger caught hold of Kamadeva. She then carried Kamadeva and Bana in her lap and went to the place where the chaste Parvati was seated. She woke up Karttikeya and Bana also regained consciousness.

## \|\| 120.46 \|\|

*sahasāsarathaḥ kāmo nāsārandhreṇa vartmanā \|*  
*bahirbabhūva saṃtrastaḥ prayayau ca raṇasthalam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. In the meantime ката left the place from the hole of the nose suddenly and somehow terrorising all, reached the battle-field.

## \|\| 120.47 \|\|

*dṛṣṭkā kāmaṃ ca sarathaṃ jahasuryādavāstadā \|*  
*sarve śaivāśca tatrasthāḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhā bhayakulāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. At that point of time all the Yadavas finding Kamadeva there, started laughing. The throat of all the ganas of Shiva dried up and they ware upset with fear.

## \|\| 120.48 \|\|

*atha bāṇaḥ punaḥ kruddho rathamāruhya kopataḥ \|*  
*kārtikeyaśca bhagavānyuddhāya punarāgataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Thereafter Bana again mounted on the chariot and started fighting with Karttikeya.

## \|\| 120.49 \|\|

*bāṇaḥ pañca śarāṃścaiva cikṣepa raṇamūrdhani \|*  
*ardhacandreṇa ciccheda baladevo mahābalaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Bana used five arrows in the battle-field which were neutralised by Baladeva with the use of crescent arrow.

## \|\| 120.50 \|\|

*rathaṃ babhañja bāṇasya lāṅgalena ca lāṅgalī \|*  
*jaghana sūtamaśvāṃśca musalenāvalīlayā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Haladhara Balarama then broke the chariot with the use of the plough and with the use of the mortar, he killed the chariot as well as charioteer.

## \|\| 120.51 \|\|

*kurvantamudyamaṃ chettuṃ halinaṃ ca mahābalaḥ \|*  
*kālāgnirudro bhagavānvārayāmāsa līlayā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. At the time when Bana was about to be killed by Balabhadra, Kalagnirudra prevented him from doing so.

## \|\| 120.52-53 \|\|

*rathaṃ kālāgnirudrasya babhañja lāṅgalī ruṣā \|*  
*halena sūtamaśvāśca jadhāna raṇamūrdhani \|\| 52 \|\|*

*kālāgnirudraḥ kopena cikṣepa javaramulvaṇam \|*  
*babhūvuryādavāḥ sarve jvarākrāntā hariṃ vinā \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Thereafter Balabhadra broke into pieces the chariot of Kalagnirudra and killed with the use of the plough the horses and broke the chariot. Kalagnirudra then issued the terrific fever, as a result of which all the Yadavas were over-powered with fever except Krishna.

## \|\| 120.54-55 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ sasarja vaiṣṇavaṃ jvaram \|*  
*taṃ cikṣepa jvaraṃ hantuṃ māheśaṃ raṇamūrdhani \|\| 54 \|\|*

*babhūva jvarayoryuddhaṃ muhūrtamatidāruṇam \|*  
*vaiṣṇavajvaraniṣkānto raṇamīrdhni papāta saḥ \|*  
*paraṃ babhūva niśceṣṭastuṣṭāva mādhavaṃ punaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. At that point of time Shri Krishna created the Vaishnava fever and made it spread on the army and neutralised the fever of Kalagnirudra. Both the fevers were engaged in the battle-filed for sometime. Ultimately the fever of Rudra was over-powered by Vaishnava fever restless. At regaining consciousness he prayed to Shri Krishna.

## \|\| 120.56 \|\|

*jvara uvāca praṇānrakṣa jagannātha bhaktānugrahavigraha \|*  
*tvamātmā puruṣaḥ purṇaḥ sarvatra samatā tava \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The fever said – О lord of the universe you are the one who takes to the human form to grace your devotees, you are a soul of all and are the complete Purusa, you are adored everywhere.

## \|\| 120.57 \|\|

*jvarasya vacanaṃ śrutvā saṃjahāra svakaṃ jvaram \|*  
*māheśvaro jvaro bhīto raṇādeva hi niryayau \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. On hearing the words of the fever, Shri Krishna wound up his fever; thereafter the Maheshvara fever getting terrified fled away from the battle-field.

## \|\| 120.58-60 \|\|

*bāṇaśca punarāgatya bāṇānāṃ ca sahasrakam \|*  
*cikṣepa mantrapūtaṃ ca pralayāgniśikhopamam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*phālgunaḥ śarajālena vārayāmāsa līlayā \|*  
*cikṣepa śaktiṃ bāṇaśca grīṣmasūryasamaprabhām \|\| 59 \|\|*

*ciccheda līlayā tāṃ ca savyasācī mahābalaḥ \|*  
*sa jagrāha pāśupataṃ śatasūryasamaprabham \|\| 60 \|\|*

58-60. Bana than again shot thousands of arrows issuing the lustre of the fire of dissolution and were sanctified with the reciting of the mantras. Arjuna on the other hand stopped the flow of all the arrows with his own arrow. Bana then shot the terrific shakti having the lustre of the mid-day sun of the summer season, which was neutralised by Arjuna quite playfully.

## \|\| 120.61 \|\|

*atyarthamatighoraṃ ca viśvasaṃhārakārakam \|*  
*taddṛṣṭā cakrapāṇiśca cakraṃ cikṣepa dāruṇam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Bana then shot a hundred Pasupata arrow having the lustre of hundred of suns and was quite terrific. It could destroy the entire universe. Finding him so doing Shri Krishna lifted up the Sudarshana-cakra.

## \|\| 120.62 \|\|

*hastānāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca sapāśupatamulbaṇam \|*  
*ciccheda raṇamadhye ca papātācalasiṃhavat \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The Sudarshana-cakra cut off thousand of heads of Bana who he fell down on the ground like a wild lion.

## \|\| 120.63 \|\|

*śastraṃ pāśupataṃ caiva yayau paśupateḥ karam \|*  
*avyartha dāruṇaṃ loke pralayāgniśikhopamam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Thereafter the Pasupata weapon which was infallible and quite terrific like the fire of dissolution, reverted in the hands of Shiva.

## \|\| 120.64 \|\|

*bāṇaraktasamūhena babhūva ca mahānadaḥ \|*  
*bāṇaḥ papāta niśceṣṭī vyathito hatacetanaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. A great river was created with the flow of the blood of Bana. He became unconscious and fell on the ground and he lost his senses because of the pain.

## \|\| 120.65 \|\|

*tatrā''jagāma bhagavānmahadevo jagadguruḥ \|*  
*rurodā''gatya mohena bāṇaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. In the meantime Shiva, the teacher of the universe arrived there and holding Bana in his arms, he was infested with illusion. He than started ciying.

## \|\| 120.66-67 \|\|

*śivāśrupatanenaiva saṃbabhūva sarovaram \|*  
*cetanaṃ kārayāmāsa karumāsāgaraḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*bāṇāṃ gṛhītvā prayayau yatra devo janārdanaḥ \|*  
*cakre padmārcite pādapadme bāṇasamarpaṇam \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. With the fall of the tears from the eyes of Shiva a lake was created. The all merciful lord then brought him to senses. He then carried Bana in his arm and went to the place of Krishna. He than placed Bana at the lotus-like feet of Krishna, which were always adored by Lakshmi.

## \|\| 120.68 \|\|

*tuṣṭāva jagatāṃ nāthaṃ bhakteśaṃ candraśekhalaḥ \|*  
*balinā ca stataṃ yena vedoktena ca tena ca \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Shiva then started praising Krishna who happens to be the lord of the universe according to the Vedic hymns, in the same way as he was adored by Bali.

## \|\| 120.69 \|\|

*harirmṛtyuṃjayaṃ jñānaṃ dadau bāṇāya dhīmate \|*  
*karapadmaṃ dadau gātre taṃ cakārājarāmaram \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Shri Krishna then bestowed on intelligent Be, the sacred knowledge of over-coming the death and placing his hand on his body made him eternal and indestructible.

## \|\| 120.70-74 \|\|

*bāṇaḥ stotreṇa tuṣṭāva bhaktyā balikṛtena ca \|*  
*varāṃ kanyāṃ samānīya ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 70 \|\|*

*bradadau haraye bhaktyā tatraiva devasaṃsadi \|*  
*gajendrāṇāṃ pañcalakṣmaśvānāṃ taccaturguṇam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*dāsīnāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|*  
*sahasraṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ vatsayuktaṃ ca sarvadam \|\| 72 \|\|*

*māṇikyānāṃ ca muktānāṃ ratnānāṃ śatalakṣakam \|*  
*maṇīndrāṇāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ śatalakṣaṃ manoharam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*jalabhājanapātrāṇi suvarṇanirmitāni ca \|*  
*mahasrāṇi dadau tasmai bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

70-74. Thereafter, Bana adored the lord with the stotra recited by Bali with devotion and offered his daughter adorned with all the ornaments to Shri Krishna with devotion. Thereafter, he, bowing in reverence gave away five lakhs of elephants, twenty lakh horses, a thousand slave-girls adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments, a thousand lakh of emeralds, sapphire, gems and the best of diamonds beside thousand of water vases made of gold.

## \|\| 120.75 \|\|

*varāṇi sūkṣmavastrāṇi vahniśuddhāṃśukāni ca \|*  
*dadau bāṇaśca marvāṇi svabhaktyā śaṃkarājñayā \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. At the command of Shiva, Bana presented to Krishna the fine costumes which were sanctified by fire.

## \|\| 120.76 \|\|

*tāmbūlānāṃ madhanāṃ ca pūrṇapātrāṇi nārada \|*  
*sahasrāṇi dadau bhaktyā varāṇi vividhāni ca \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. О Narada, he also gave away to Krishna thousands of vases filled with betels and honey.

## \|\| 120.77 \|\|

*kanyāṃ samarpayāmāsa pādapadme harerapi \|*  
*rurodoccaiḥ svabhaktyā ca parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Placing his daughter at the lotus-like feet of Hari, he started crying in land voice. Lord Kari consoled him.

## \|\| 120.78 \|\|

*kṛṣṇastasmai varaṃ dattvā vedoktaṃ ca śubhāśiṣm \|*  
*śaṃkarānumatenaiva prayayau dvārakāṃ purīm \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Thereafter bestowing his blessing according to the Vedas and taking permission from Shiva, he left for Dvaraka.

## \|\| 120.79 \|\|

*gatvā kanyāṃ navoḍhāṃ tāṃ bāṇasyāpi mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*rukmiṇyai pradadau śīghraṃ devakyai ca hariḥ svayam \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Reaching Dvaraka lord Krishna presented the newly wedded daughter of Bana to Rukmini and Devaki.

## \|\| 120.80 \|\|

*mahotsavaṃ maṅgalaṃ ca kārayāmāsa yatnataḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. After that, the welfare festivities were performed with great enthusiasm and the Brahman as were served with-food and given riches in charity.

## Chapter 121

## \|\| 121.1-2 \|\|

*athaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha kṛṣṇaḥ sudharmāyāṃ nivasansagaṇastathā \|*  
*tatrā''jagām vipraśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*āgatya dṛṣṭāva tuṣṭāva bhaktyā ca puruṣottamam \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ śānto bhīto vinayapūrvakam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Thereafter, Shri Krishna was seated in the assembly called Sudharma with his courtiers. In that assembly a Brahmana possessing the divine lustre arrived there. Reaching there the Brahmana started offering prayer to Shri Krishna quite humbly with devotion.

## \|\| 121.3 \|\|

*brāhmaṇa uvāca śrṛgālo vāsudevaśca rājeśo maṇḍaleśvaraḥ \|*  
*tvāmuvāca sa yadvākyaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Brahmana said – There is a Vasudeva named Shrigala (jackal) who considers himself to be Shri Krishna and the king of kings; he always speaks ill of you, you kindly listen to the same.

## \|\| 121.4 \|\|

*śrṛgāla uvāca vaikuṇṭhe vāsudevo'haṃ deveśaśca caturbhujaḥ \|*  
*lakṣmīpatiśca jagatāṃ dhātā dhātuśca pālakaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Shrigala said – I am Vaikuntha and the god of gods having four arms, lord of Lakshmi, maintain the universe and preserve the same being Brahma and Vasudeva.

## \|\| 121.5 \|\|

*brahmaṇā prārthito'haṃ ca bhārāvataraṇāya ca \|*  
*bhuvo bhāratavarṣa ca tadartha gamanaṃ mama \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Brahma had prayed to me to incarnate in order to rid the earth of her burden. That is why I arrived in the land of Bharata.

## \|\| 121.6 \|\|

*vasudevasuto vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyaścāpyahaṃkṛtaḥ \|*  
*ātmānaṃ bhaktaviṣṇuśca māyāvī ca pratārakaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The son of Vasudeva is a Vaisya and is quite arrogant and Kshatriya as well. He is filled with illusion and is a cheat.

## \|\| 121.7 \|\|

*janaṃ janena nirjitya durbalaṃ balinā saha \|*  
*jodhayitvā mahādhūrto ghātayāmāsa bhūpatīn \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He makes the people to fight with each other and making the valorous to fight with the weak people, he has destroyed the kings, he is extremely deceitful.

## \|\| 121.8-10 \|\|

*duryodhanaṃ jarāsaṃdhaṃ bhūpamanyaṃ ca durbalam \|*  
*bhīmena ghātayāmāsa balinā'lpena bhūtale \|\| 8 \|\|*

*droṇaṃ bhīṣmaṃ ca karṇa ca yaṃ yamanyaṃ ca bhūtale \|*  
*balīyasā'rjunenaiva ghātayāmāsa māyayā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*yaṃ yamanyaṃ durbalaṃ ca prasiddhamaprasiddhakam \|*  
*prasiddhena balavatā ghātayāmāsa māyayā \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Krishna who is devoid of valour, had Duryodhana, Jarasandha and a weak king named Bhlma, Drona, Bhlsma, Kama and other warriors on earth killed from Arjuna. He therefore has the weak warriors killed with the valorous warriors, sometimes deceitfully.

## \|\| 121.11-14 \|\|

*śiśupālaṃ dantavaktraṃ kaṃsaṃ ca cirarogiṇam \|*  
*matputraṃ narakaṃ caiva durbalaṃ keśinaṃ muram \|\| 11 \|\|*

*svayaṃ jaghāna saṃketācchalena sahasā bata \|*  
*na dharmayuddhe kapaṭī sa ca bālo hyadhārmikaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*jaghāna pūtanāṃ kubjāṃ strīghātī vastrahetunā \|*  
*jaghāna rajakaṃ śiṣṭamaśiṣṭaśca pratārakaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*hiraṇyakaśipuṃ daityaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahābalam \|*  
*madhuṃ ca kaiṭabhaṃ caiva hatvā'haṃ suṣṭirakṣakaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

11-14. He killed Sisupala, Dantavaktra, Kamsa who was ailing since long, Narakasura my son and the weak Kes'I besides the demon named Mura quite deceitfully. One should not be deceitful in the battle of dharma. That irreligious boy killed Putana and Kubja. Thus he is the killer of a woman. In the greed for costumes that deceitful and uncultured person killed the washerman. I have saved the earth by killing the great demon like Hiranyakas'ipu. Hiranyaksa, Madhu and Kait abha.

## \|\| 121.15 \|\|

*ahameva svayaṃ brahmā hyahameva svayaṃ śivaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ viṣṇuśca jagatāṃ pātā duṣṭāpahārakaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. I am myself Shiva and the preserver of the universe and Vishnu the destroyer of the wicked persons.

## \|\| 121.16 \|\|

*aṃśena kalayā sarve manavo munayastathā \|*  
*svayaṃ nārāyaṇo'haṃ ca mirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. All the sages and the ascetics were born of my athsas. I am myself Narayana without qualities and beyond Prakriti.

## \|\| 121.17 \|\|

*lajjayā kṛpayā caiva mitrabuddhyā ṅamā kṛtā \|*  
*yadgataṃ tadgataṃ bhadra yuddhaṃ kuru mayā saha \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. O virtuous one, till now because of shyness and mercy beside having a friendly attitude towards you I have been forgiving you. Whatever has happened, has happened, now you fight with me.

## \|\| 121.18-20 \|\|

*śrṛṇomi dūtadvāreṇa hyatīvoccairahaṃkṛtam \|*  
*ucitaṃ damanaṃ tasyāpyunnatānāṃ nipātanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*rājñaśca paramo dharmo'pyahaṃ śāstā bhuvo'dhunā \|*  
*śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ gṛhītvā'haṃ caturbhujaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dvārakāṃ tā gamiṣyāmi yuddhāya sagaṇaḥ svayaṃ \|*  
*yuddhaṃ kuru yadīcchā'sti mā māṃ ca śaraṇaṃ vraja \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. I have leamt through messenger that you have become more and more arrogant therefore it is proper for me to subjugate you. It is the duty of the king to trample upon the people who raise their heads quite high and presently I happen to be the ruler of the univers. I shall myself arrive in Dvaraka taking to the four armed form holding samkha, gada, cakra and padma together with the army. In case you are desirous of a fight then fight with me, otherwise you take refuge under my feet.

## \|\| 121.21 \|\|

*yadi mā yāsyati mama śaraṇaṃ śaraṇāgataḥ \|*  
*bhasmībhūtāṃ kariṣyāmi dvārakāṃ ca kṣaṇena ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In case you do not take refuse with me then I shall destroy the entire city of Dvaraka in a moment.

## \|\| 121.22 \|\|

*sabalaṃ ca saputraṃ tvāṃ sagaṇaṃ ca sabāndhavam \|*  
*kṣaṇena dagdhuṃ śakto'hamasahāyena līlayā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. I myself alone will destroy playfully your army, sons, attendants, relatives and brothers burning them in fire flames.

## \|\| 121.23-24 \|\|

*tapasvinaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ ca jitvā yuddhe ca śaṃkaram \|*  
*śakraṃ bhagāṅgaṃ jitvā ca rogiṇaṃ brahmaśāpataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*matto'si vīramātmānaṃ manyamānastvameva ca \|*  
*strījito hi vṛthārtha ca pārijātasya hetunā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. You consider, yourself to be quite valorous by conquering Shiva, who is an ascetic and pretty old and Indra who suffers from Brahmasapa and having vaginas on his body, you consider yourself to be quite valorous and have become arrogant. You had been over-powered by your wife just for the sake of Parijata flower.

## \|\| 121.25 \|\|

*lamapaṭo yonilubdhaśca rādhādīnaśca gokule \|*  
*adhunā kiṃkarasamaḥ satyādīnāṃ ca yoṣitām \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. You are the debauch and are ruled by Radha in Gokula. Presently you are like the slave of Satyabhama and other ladies.

## \|\| 121.26 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vipraśca tūṣṇīṃbhūya sthito mune \|*  
*śīkuṣṇaḥ sagaṇaḥ śrutvā bhṛśasucchairjahāsa saḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Thus speaking О sage, the Brahmana kept quiet and hearing him the lord laughed aloud with all his courtiers.

## \|\| 121.27 \|\|

*bhojayitvā ca saṃpūjya brāhmaṇaṃ ca caturvidham \|*  
*nināya rajanīṃ duḥkhādvākśalyamāna jvarāt \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The Brahmana was then adored variously serving four types of food to him, he felt pained with the words of Shrigala which pierced like the thorns and he spent the night with great difficulty.

## \|\| 121.28 \|\|

*prabhāte rathamāruhya sagaṇaḥ satvaraṃ mudā \|*  
*līlāmātreṇa prayayau śrṛgālo nṛpatiryataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. In the early morning he got up anxiously and accompanied with his people, he mounted over a chariot and at once reached the city of Shrigala.

## \|\| 121.29 \|\|

*śrutvā śrṛgālo vārtāṃ tāṃ kṛtrimaśca caturbhujaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma hareḥ sthānaṃ yuddhāya sagaṇaḥ svayam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. He had four artificial arms and he himself reached before Krishna.

## \|\| 121.30 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaścakre ca saṃbhāṣāṃ mitrabuddhyā ca laukikīm \|*  
*āśleṣaṃ madhurālāpaṃ snigdhanetraśca sasmitaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Krishna talked to him like a friend; he looked at him with loving eyes and smilingly embraced him.

## \|\| 121.31 \|\|

*rājā nimantraṇaṃ cakre kṛṣṇo na svīcakāra tat \|*  
*uvāca kṛṣṇabhītaścatyaktvā dambhaṃ ca darśanāt \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The king invited him but Shri Krishna did not accept finding Krishna discarding his arrogance, he felt frightful and said.

## \|\| 121.32 \|\|

*śrṛgāla uvāca cakreṇa macchiraśchittvā suśīghraṃ dvārakāṃ vraja \|*  
*pāpaḥ patatu deho'yamanityo naśvarastathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Shrigala said – You cut-off my head with your calcra and go back, let the sinner having the perishable body fall on earth.

## \|\| 121.33 \|\|

*ahaṃ subhadraste dvāri jayaśca vijayo yathā \|*  
*sarva jānāsi sarvajña mā vilambaṃ kuru prabho \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. I happen to be Subhadra who always remained guarding your doors like Jaya and Vijaya. О lord, you are all knowledgeable and are therefore well-aware of everything. Do not delay.

## \|\| 121.34 \|\|

*lakṣmīśāpena bhraṣṭo'haṃ kālaḥ pūrṇo babhūva me \|*  
*śatavarṣeṇa śāpānte yāsyami bhavanaṃ tava \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. I had fallen because of the curse of Laksmr, the period of my curse is over. I shall now proceed to your abode after lapse of hundred years of curse.

## \|\| 121.35 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca pūrva māṃ mitra prahara paścādyuddhaṃ karobhyaham \|*  
*sarva jānāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ gaccha vatsa yathāsukham \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Shri Krishna said – О friend, you first attack me and thereafter I shall fight. О son, I am quite well-aware of everything. You go back to Vaikuntha with pleasure.

## \|\| 121.36 \|\|

*śrṛgālo daśabāṇāṃśca cikṣepa mādhavaṃ prati \|*  
*te praṇabhya yayuḥ śīghramākāśaṃ kālarūpimaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Thereafter Shrigala shot ten arrows towards Shri Krishna. All of these arrows bowing in reverence at the feet of Krishna disappeared in the sky.

## \|\| 121.37 \|\|

*gadāṃ cikṣepa rājā sa pralayāgniśikhopamām \|*  
*kṛṣṇāṅgasparśamātreṇa babhañja ca kṣaṇena ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The king then threw gada which issued fire-flames but the same was shattered into pieces with the touch of the body of Shri Krishna.

## \|\| 121.38-39 \|\|

*śūlaṃ cikṣepa musalaṃ ca paraśuṃ tathā \|*  
*kṛṣṇāṅgasparśamātreṇa babhañja ca kṣaṇena ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*dhanuścikṣepa khaṅgaṃ ca kālarūpaṃ sudārupām \|*  
*kṛṣṇāṅgasparśamātreṇa babhañja ca kṣaṇena ca \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. The king then shot the trident, mortar and sakti which were destroyed and broken into pieces with the touch of the body of Shri Krishna. He then shot the terrific sword and the arrows, but with the touching of the body of Sri. Krishna, they were all reduced to pieces.

## \|\| 121.40 \|\|

*dṛpṭvā nirastraṃ rājanamityuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*gṛhaṃ gatvā sutīkṣṇaṃ ca mitrāstramānayeti ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. When the king was without any weapon, the merciful Krishna said to him, "O friend you go and bring some more sharp edged weapon.

## \|\| 121.41 \|\|

*śrṛgāla uvāca nā''tmā''kāśo'straviddhaśca kiṃ yuddhamātmanā saha \|*  
*māmuddhara bhavābdheśca dharoddhāraṇakāraṇa \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Shrigala said – The soul and the sky cannot be wounded with the use of arrows, therefore, how can I have a fight with the soul? You are the one who relieves the earth of her burden. You redeem me from the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 121.42-43 \|\|

*bhavārbdhi viṣamaṃ nātha viṣayaṃ ca viṣādhikam \|*  
*chindhi me nigaḍaṃ māyāṃ mohajālaṃ svakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*karmaṇāmīśvarastvaṃ ca vidhātā ghātureva ca \|*  
*dātā śubhaphalānāṃ ca pradātā sarvasaṃpadām \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. О lord, the terrific ocean of the universe is.filled with poison; therefore you remove all my bondage's of illusion, you are the lord of all the deeds, creator of Brahma, bestower of the fruits and all the noble deeds, bestowed all the riches, the cause of all the deeds and are competent enough to shatter the deeds.

## \|\| 121.44-47 \|\|

*kāraṇaṃ prāktanānāṃ ca teṣāṃ ca khaṇḍane kṣamaḥ \|*  
*yāmi gehaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tavaiva dvārasaptamam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tyaktvā ca naśavaraṃ dehaṃ prākṛtaṃ pāñcabhautikam \|*  
*mitrasya stavanaṃ śrutvā vacanaṃ ca sudhopamam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*ruroda samare tatra kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*babhūva tatra sahasā kṛṣṇanetrāśrubindunā \|\| 46 \|\|*

*divyaṃ bindusaro nām tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ param \|*  
*tattoyasparśamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*saptajanmarjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

44-47. After ending this body of five elements, I shall reach the gate of Vaikuntha. On listening to the prayer of a friend, the words of which were spoken like nectar, the lord who happened to be the ocean of mercy, started crying filled with emotion and compassion. With the tears fallen from the eyes of lord Krishna, a pool was created which was known by the name of Bindusara. It was a divine pool and became the best of the pool, person with a dip in the pool is relieved of the cycle of birth and death and the sins committed by him in earlier birth also disappear. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 121.48 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca kathametādṛśī buddhirmitra te nirmalaṃ manaḥ \|*  
*dūtadvārā kathaṃ cauktaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Shri Krishna said – О friend, you have a spotless mind, then how were you so misguided? Why did you make the messenger to speak such harsh words?

## \|\| 121.49 \|\|

*śṛgāla uvāca evamukto mayā tvaṃ ca tena krodhādihā''gataḥ \|*  
*anyathā durlabhaṃ nātha svapne'pi tava darśanam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Shrigala said – Since I made the messenger speak in harsh tone you have arrived here, otherwise О lord, it is difficult to have an audience with you even in dream.

## \|\| 121.50-51 \|\|

*etasminnantare yogāddehaṃ tyaktvā ca prākṛtam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca yānena vaikuṣṭhaṃ prayayau mudā \|\| 50 \|\|*

*saptatālapramāṇaṃ ca jyotistatra maholbaṇam \|*  
*padmaiḥ padmārcitaṃ pādapadmaṃ natvā jagāma ha \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. In the meantime he ended his life with yogic practices and looking at Krishna he delightfully proceeded to Vaikuntha. At that point of time a divine lustre as high as seven tala trees appeared there and merged into the lotus-like feet of Shri Krishna.

## \|\| 121.52-54 \|\|

*gatvā ca dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇo natvā ca pitaraṃ prasūm \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sagaṇaḥ śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā ca paramādbhutam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*praphullavadanaḥ śrīmāndvārakābhimukhaṃ yayau \|*  
*jagāma rukmaṇīgehaṃ puṣpajandanavāsitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*puṣpacandanatalpe ca naktaṃ reme tayā saha \|*  
*mūrcchaṃ saṃprāpa sa bhaiṣmī kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. Shri Krishna felt delighted. At the sight of this he felt delightful and went back to Dvaraka; reaching there, he bowed in reverence to his parents and then reached the abode of Rukmini, which was issuing the fragrance of flowers and sandal-paste. He spent the night on the bed of flowers and, sandal-paste. Rukmini was fainted placing her head on the chest of her lord.

## Chapter 122

## \|\| 122.1-2 \|\|

*atha dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca sarvāsāṃ ramaṇīnāṃ ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|*  
*samudvāhaśca kathitastvayā bhagavatā mudā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*syamantakasya ca maṇerupākhyānamabhīpsitam \|*  
*tanna śrutaṃ mahābhāga tanmāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narada said – You have narrated about the marriage of several damsels with Krishna but the mystery about the Syamantaka remain unfolded. О virtuous, one I have not heard about it. You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 122.3-4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca bhādraśuklacaturthyāṃ ca tārakāṃ hṛtvāñchaśī \|*  
*tāṃ tatyāja sa kṛṣṇāyāṃ gurustāṃ ca gṛhītavān \|\| 3 \|\|*

*guruṇā bhartsitā tārā magarbhā lajjitā satī \|*  
*śaśāpa lajjayā kopāccandraṃ kāmāturaṃ purā \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Narayana said – In the earlier times on the fourth moon day of the Bhadrapada, the moon abducted Tara and freed her on the fourth moon day of Ashvina. Brihaspati then accepted her. The chaste lady felt shameful because of her conception Brihaspati denounced her and Tara in anger pronounced a curse on the moon getting filled with shame and anger.

## \|\| 122.5 \|\|

*tārovāca bhava śāpakalaṃkī tvaṃ yastvāṃ paśyati dehabhṛt \|*  
*pāpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa pāpī ca kalaṃkī ca bhaviṣyati \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Tara said – You would earn the blemish because of my curse. Whosoever you looks at you on the fourth moon day of Bhadrapada, he would also earn blemish.

## \|\| 122.6 \|\|

*iti śrutvā sa candraśca nārāyaṇasarovare \|*  
*nārāyaṇatapastaptvā mumoca kṛtapātakāt \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Vishnu said – О moon you will be freed from the blemish for all the times. Only such a person would earn a blemish, who would look at you on the fourth moon day of Bhadrapada quite willingly. The blemish of moon would be transferred to such a person and he would earn a blemish.

## \|\| 122.7 \|\|

*tapaḥkliṣṭaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*tamuvāca mahābhītaṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Lord Hari announced with the clapping of the hands that on the fourth day of the moon either in the bright or dark fortnight, the moon should not be witnessed.

## \|\| 122.8 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca mukto bhava kalaṃkī tvaṃ sarvakālaṃ kalānidhe \|*  
*śāpasthānaṃ tārakāyā bhādre māsi sitāsite \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. He also followed, the declaration about the moon for himself and because of that he earned a blemish on the fourth day of the night in Bhadrapada. Now I shall narrate to you way in which he earned the blemish. The lord was freed from the blemish to educate the people.

## \|\| 122.9-10 \|\|

*caturthyāmuditaṃ candraṃ yastu paśyati kāmataḥ \|*  
*taṃ yāti tatkalaṅkaśca sa kalaṃkī bhaviṣyati \|\| 9 \|\|*

*hariṇā dīyate tāle bhādre māsi sitāsite \|*  
*caturthyāmuditaścandro nekṣitavyaḥ kadācana \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. On hearing this, the moon went to the Narayana-sarovara and performing tapas there he was free from the sin.

## \|\| 122.11-12 \|\|

*svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā svavākyaṃ ca pālanaṃ kartumarhati \|*  
*bhādre candraṃ caturthyāṃ tu sa kalaṃkī babhūva ha \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kalaṃkī yena rūpeṇa tadvakṣyāmi niśāmaya \|*  
*sa mumoca kalaṃkācca lokaśikṣārthamīśvaraḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Finding the moon having become so lean and thin, the compassionate Narayana mercifully told him.

## \|\| 122.13 \|\|

*satrājitaḥ sūryabhaktastapastabtvā ca puṣkare \|*  
*syamantakaṃ maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ saṃprāpa bhāskarādapi \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Satrajita a devotee of Surya performed tapas at Puskara-tirtha and achieved Syamantaka gem from Sitrya.

## \|\| 122.14 \|\|

*aṣṭau bhārānsuvarṇānāṃ prasūte nityameva ca \|*  
*viṣgormaṇāvadhiṣṭhānaṃ mahāpūte ca puṇyade \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The Syamantaka gem produce eight bharas of gold daily. Lord Vishnu was established in that gem.

## \|\| 122.15-16 \|\|

*satrājitaḥ satyabhāmāṃ dattvā kṛṣṇāya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*yautukārthe maṇiṃ dātumudyato mahate mahān \|\| 15 \|\|*

*taṃ niṣidhya prasenaśca durmatiḥ kālapīḍitaḥ \|*  
*maṇiṃ gṛhītvā prayayau puṇyāṃ vārāṇasīṃ purīm \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Satrajita got ready to present the said gem with devotion to Satyabhama as a dowry. Moved with the evil time the wicked Prasena stopped him from doing so and stealing the gem he went to the auspicious place of Varanasi.

## \|\| 122.17-19 \|\|

*nihatya taṃ pathi balātsiṃhaḥ sabala eva ca \|*  
*maṇiṃ jagrāha ruciraṃ sūtrabaddhaṃ gale dadhau \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kaliṅgarājaputraśca brahmaśāpātsudāruṇāt \|*  
*vipreṇāmyuditastena paśuyoniṃ jagām saḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*nihatya siṃhaṃ gahane bhallūko jāmbavānbalī \|*  
*maṇiṃ gṛhītvā prayayau svapuraṃ ratnanirmitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. But on the way a very strong lion killed him and took away the gem with the cord and wore it round his neck. The lion was none else than then the son of the king of Kalinga, who had been facing the curse of that Brahmana and had taken to the form of an animal. The same lion was killed by a very strong beer named Jambavan and carrying the gem with him, he reverted to his abode.

## \|\| 122.20 \|\|

*ūcuḥ sarve dvārakāyāṃ maṇiṃ jagāha mādhavaḥ \|*  
*tasya buddhiṃ na jānīmaḥ kenopāyena veti ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. On the other hand people in Dvaraka started saying that the gem had been stolen by Krishna and it was difficult to find out the way by which he stole away the gem.

## \|\| 122.21 \|\|

*iti śrutvā tu bhagavānkalaṃkakṛntanāya ca \|*  
*prayayau kānanaṃ ghoraṃ cauracihnena vartmanā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. On hearing this in order to wash out the blemish, lord Krishna moved in the forest on the path bearing the foot-prints of the thief.

## \|\| 122.22 \|\|

*mṛtaṃ prasenaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca duḥkhī sihaṃ dadarśa saḥ \|*  
*maṇiśūnyaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣasāda ca mādhavaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Finding Prasena having been dead, he was grieved. Then he found the lion but finding, him without the gem, Madhava felt disinterested.

## \|\| 122.23 \|\|

*sarvaṃjñātvā ca sarvajño bhallūkabhavanaṃ yayau \|*  
*rudantaṃ bālakaṃ tatra dhātrīkroḍe dadarśa saḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thereafter, the all knowledgeable Krishna, because of his divine power came to know of everything and went to the abode of the beer, he found a child sleeping in the lap of the mid-wife.

## \|\| 122.24 \|\|

*bālakaṃ bodhayāmāsa sā dhātrī karuṇānvitā \|*  
*maṇiṃ gṛhāṇa bāleti tava hyeṣa syamantakaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The mid-wife getting filled with compassion was talking to the child, "you have this gem known by the name of Syamantaka which belongs to you.".

## \|\| 122.25 \|\|

*siṃhaḥ prasenamavadhītsiṃho jāmbavatā hataḥ \|*  
*sukumāraka mā rodīstava hyeṣa syamantakaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The lion killed Prasena and Jambavan killed the lion. О prince don't cry, this gem belongs to you.

## \|\| 122.26 \|\|

*iti dhātryuktasuślokaṃ yaśca smṛtvā jalaṃ pibet \|*  
*daivadṛṣṭanaṣṭacandradroṣādeva pramṛcyate \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The one who recites this stotra, composed by the mid-wife and then drinks the water, he is relieved of the blemish of witnessing the moon on the prohibited day.

## \|\| 122.27 \|\|

*kāmato yadi paśyanti dāmbhikā vedanindakāḥ \|*  
*kalaṅkino bhavantyevamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Such of the wicked person who denounces the Vedas and willingly witnesses the moon on the prohibited day, he surely earns the blemish.

## \|\| 122.28 \|\|

*kṛṣṇo dhātrīvacaḥ śrutvā maṇiṃ jagrāha bālakāt \|*  
*dhātrī gatvā ca bhallūkaṃ kathayāmāsa kopataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. On hearing the words of the midwife Krishna took away the gem from the child. The enraged midwife went to the beer and spoke to him.

## \|\| 122.29 \|\|

*jāmbavāṃśca samāgatya tuṣṭāva praṇipatya saḥ \|*  
*kanyāṃ jāmbavatīṃ tasmai yautukārthaṃ maṇiṃ dadau \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Jambavan than come there and started eulogising Krishna. Thereafter, he gave away his daughter Jambavati to him together with the divine gem in dowry.

## \|\| 122.30 \|\|

*dvārakāṃ maṇimānīya darśayāmāsa yādavān \|*  
*prabhuśca sarvataḥ śuddho niṣkalaṅko babhūva saḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Lord Krishna went to Dvaraka and showed the gem to Yadavas and was freed from the blemish.

## \|\| 122.31 \|\|

*etatte kathitaṃ vatsa maṇerākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*adhyāyaśravaṇādeva niṣkalaṃko bhavennaraḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. O son, I have narrated to you the story of the Syamantaka gem with the hearing of which one is relieved of all the blemish.

## \|\| 122.32 \|\|

*yacchru taṃ dharmavaktreṇa taduktaṃ ca yathāgamam \|*  
*sudurlabhamupākhyānaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. I have narrated to you the beautiful story which I had heard from the mouth of Dharmaraja in earlier times, what else do you want to listen from me now.

## Chapter 123

## \|\| 123.1-2 \|\|

*atha trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca gaṇeśapūjanākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu ca durlabham \|*  
*śrutaṃ tadbrahmaṇo vaktrātsāmānyaṃ ca samāsataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*mahimānaṃ gaṇapateḥ sarvabūjyeśvarasya ca \|*  
*vyāsena śrotumicchāmi yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguroḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narada said – I have listened to the inaccessible method of adoration of Ganesha quite briefly from the mouth of Brahma; now you tell me about the glory of Ganapati, who is the teacher of the yogis, in considerable detail.

## \|\| 123.3-4 \|\|

*siddhāśrame mahāpūja trailokyasthaiḥ kṛtā purā \|*  
*rādhāmādhavayostatra punaḥ saṃmīlaraṃ purā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*atīte varṣaśatake śrīdāmnaḥ śāpamokṣaṇe \|*  
*ādau cakāra pūjāṃ ca sā ca rādhā kathaṃ mune \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. In the earlier times the people of the three worlds performed a great рщй in Siddhasrama, where Radha and Krishna had met again after the expiry of the curse or hundred years separation pronounced by Shridama. Then О sage, how could Radha adored Ganesha first?

## \|\| 123.5-7 \|\|

*sthiteṣu ca surendreṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivādiṣu \|*  
*nāgendre ca sthite śeṣe nāgeṣu ca mahatsu ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*rājendreṣu ca bhūmau ca baliṣṭheṣvasureṣu ca \|*  
*gandharveṣu ca rakṣaḥsu cānyeṣu balavatsu ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vistareṇa mahābhāga tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. How could the Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and other gods, the king of Nagas known as Shesha, the great serpents, the great king on earth, powerful demons, Gandharvas and other rulers adore Ganesha on earth. You kindly tell me in detail.

## \|\| 123.8-9 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca trelokye pṛthivī dhanyā mānyā puṇyavatī satī \|*  
*tatra bhāratavarṣaṃ ca karmaṇāṃ phaladaṃ śubham \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ pūjyaṃ ca puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|*  
*siddhāśramaṃ mahāpuṇyakṣetraṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Narayana said – Since the earth happens to be quite auspicious in three worlds it is adorable by all. The land of Bharata only bestows the reward of the good deeds. In the land of Bharata there is an auspicious region in which Siddhasrama is located which bestows grace, reputation and moksa.

## \|\| 123.10-11 \|\|

*sanatkumāro bhagavāṃstatra siddho babhūva ha \|*  
*svayaṃ vidhātā tatraiva taptvā siddho babhūva ha \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yogīndrāśca munīndrāśca siddhendrāḥ kapilādayaḥ \|*  
*śatakrantūnmahendraśca tatra kṛtvā babhūva ha \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. The great yogis, the ascetic, sage Kapila and others achieved excellence there, performing a hundred yajhas there, the god of gods achieved the position of Mahendra.

## \|\| 123.12 \|\|

*tena siddhāśramaṃ nāma sarveṣāmapi durlabham \|*  
*adhiṣṭhānaṃ gaṇeśasya tatreva satataṃ mune \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Because of this, the place is given the name of Siddhasrama. It is beyond the reach of all. О sage, Ganesha resides there always.

## \|\| 123.13-14 \|\|

*amūlyaratnanirmāṇagaṇeśapratimāṃ śubhām \|*  
*vaiśākhyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca pūjāṃ kurvanti devatāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*nāgāśca mānavāścaiva daityā gandharvarākṣasāḥ \|*  
*siddhendrāśca munīndrāśca yogīndrāḥ sanakādayāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. There is a beautiful image of Ganesha studded with gems, which is adored on the full moon day of Vaisakha by the gods and the Nagas, humans, demons, Gandharvas, the siddhas the Raksasas, the sages and the yogis.

## \|\| 123.15 \|\|

*tatrā''jagāma śaṃbhuśca pārvatvā saha śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*sagaṇaḥ kārtikeyaśca svayaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. At that point of time Shiva also accompanied by Parvati, Karttikeya and other ganas arrived there together with Brahma.

## \|\| 123.16-17 \|\|

*tatrā''jagāma śeṣaśca nāgendraiḥ saha satvaram \|*  
*tajñā''jagmuḥ surāḥ sarve manavo mṛnayastathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*ājagmuste nṛpāḥ sarve pūjārthaṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ \|*  
*āyayau bhagavānkṛṣṇo dvārakāvāsibhiḥ saha \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Shesha also arrived there with all the serpents. After that, all the gods, Manus and the sages also arrived there; all the gods and the kings arrived there in order to adore Ganesha. Lord Krishna also reached there together with the people of Dvaraka.

## \|\| 123.18-20 \|\|

*ājagāma tathā nandaḥ sārdhaṃ gokulavāsibhiḥ \|*  
*gopītriśatakoṭībhirgolokavāsibhiḥ saha \|\| 18 \|\|*

*gacendrakoṭitulyābhirbaliṣṭhābhiḥ sahā''libhiḥ \|*  
*āyayau sundarī rādhā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevatā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*rāseśvarī surasikā śatavarṣe gate sati \|*  
*susnātā mudatī śuddhā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. Similarly Nanda together with the people of Gokula also reached there; the beautiful Radha, the beloved of Shri Krishna also reached there. After the expiry of a hundred years of separation together with three crores of cowherdesses of Gokula, who were quite strong like the elephant. Radha having the beautiful teeth took her bath and was clad in the beautiful and fine garment.

## \|\| 123.21 \|\|

*saṃyatā sā nirāhārā gatvā ca maṇimaṇḍapam \|*  
*suprakṣālitapādābjā kāntā bhuvanapāvanī \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Thereafter the chaste Radha washed her feet pretty well and observing fast, controlling her senses reached the mandapa of gems.

## \|\| 123.22 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇaprītikāmā'tha susaṃkalpaṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*gaṅgodakena herambaṃ snāpayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. She with the intention of achieving Krishna performed the puja of Ganesha bathing his image with water of the Ganga.

## \|\| 123.23-24 \|\|

*dhyārna ca sāmavedoktaṃ cakāra śuklapuṣpataḥ \|*  
*mātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vasośca jagatāmapi \|\| 23 \|\|*

*buddhirūpā bhagavatī jñānināṃ jananī parā \|*  
*dhyānātmakaṃ svapusraṃ taṃ paraṃ dhyānaṃ cakāra sā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Thereafter Radha who happens to be the mother of the Vedas, the Vasus, the universe, the mother of intellectuals and filled with wisdom, offered white flowers to the gods and adored Ganesha like her son according to the method prescribed in the Samaveda.

## \|\| 123.25-29 \|\|

*śarvaṃ lambodaraṃ sthūlaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|*  
*gajavaktraṃ vahnivarṇamekadantamanantakam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*siddhānāṃ yogināmeva jñānināṃ ca gurorgurum \|*  
*dhyātaṃ munīndrairdevendrairbrahmeśaśeṣasaṃjñakaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*siddhendrairmunibhiḥ sadbhirbhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*brahmasvarūpaṃ paramaṃ maṅgalaṃ maṅgalālayam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sarvavighnaharaṃ śāntaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*bhavābdhimāyāpotena karṇadhāraṃ ca karmiṇām \|\| 28 \|\|*

*śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇam \|*  
*dhyāyeddhyānātmakaṃ sādhyaṃ bhakteśaṃ bhaktavatsalam \|\| 29 \|\|*

25-29. The dwarfs, the pot-bellied person, the fat people, the people possessing divine lustre, those having the faces of elephants, those having the lustre of fire, the one having the single tusk, the one who happens to be the teacher of all the intellectuals and people of wisdom, the one who is adored by Brahma, Shiva, Shesha sages, siddhas, ascetics and noble people, who is all virtuous, is eternal, is form of Brahman, the form of welfare, the place of welfare, the one who removes all the obstructions, is peaceful, bestower of all the riches, the one who can make the people to cross the ocean of the universe, the one who always provides protection to those who take refuge in him, is the form of meditation, is quite adorable and graceful to the devotees, the same Ganesha had to be adored.

## \|\| 123.30 \|\|

*iti dhyātvā svaśirasi dattvā puṣpaṃ punaḥ satī \|*  
*sarvāṅgaśodhanaṃ nyāsaṃ vedoktaṃ ca cakāra sā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. After thus meditation, Radha, placed the flower on his head and performed all the rights prescribed in the Vedas.

## \|\| 123.31 \|\|

*punaśca dhyātvā dhyānena tenaiva śubhadāyinā \|*  
*dadau puṣpaṃ pādapadme rādhā lambodarasya ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Thereafter with the performing of dhyanam she offered a bunch flowers at the lotus-like feet of Ganesha, having a protruding belly.

## \|\| 123.32-33 \|\|

*saptatīrthodakenaiva śītena vāsitena ca \|*  
*dadau pādyaṃ pādapadme taiḥ padmādibhirarcite \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dūrvākṣataiḥ śuklapuṣpaiḥ sugandhicandanodakaiḥ \|*  
*arghyaṃ dadau tacchirasi svayaṃ golokavāsinī \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. Thereafter, Radha, the dweller of Goloka herself offered the fragrant water of the holy places, Diirva-grass, unbroken rice, white flowers, fragrant sandal-paste and arghya to Ganesha.

## \|\| 123.34-35 \|\|

*sacandanaṃ sgdhimālyaṃ pārijātasya sundaram \|*  
*dadau gale gaṇeśasya svayaṃ rāsaṃśvarī mudā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ ca sugandhi snigdhacandanam \|*  
*sarvāṅge pradadau tasya vṛndāvanavinodinī \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Then she offered a beautiful garland of Parijcita flowers soaked in sandal-paste. Thereafter Radha the dweller of Vmdavana pasted the body of Ganesha with kasturl, saffron and fragrant sandal-paste.

## \|\| 123.36-37 \|\|

*sugandhi śuklaṃ puṣpaṃ ca sugandha candanārcitam \|*  
*dadau tasya padāmbhoje mahāpadmalayā satī \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sugandhiyuktaṃ dhūpaṃ ca pūtairvastubhiranvitam \|*  
*dadau kṛṣṇapriyā tasmai jagatāmīśvarāya ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Then Radha the dweller of the great lotus, took up the fragrant white flowers and soaking them with fragrant sandal-paste, offered them at the lotus-like feet of Ganesha. Thereafter the beloved of Krishna of feed the fragrant material together with incense to lord Ganesha.

## \|\| 123.38 \|\|

*dīpaṃ ghṛtapradīptaṃ ca dhvāntavidhvaṃsakāraṇam \|*  
*dadau tasmai sureśāya paramādyā sanātanī \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The primeval and eternal Radha then offered a lamp to Ganesha which removed the complete darkness.

## \|\| 123.39-58 \|\|

*naivedya vividhaṃ ramyaṃ susvādu sumanoharam \|*  
*coṣyaṃ carvyaṃ lehyapeye sudhātulyaṃ caturvidham \|\| 39 \|\|*

*phalāni ca supakvāni trailokye durlabhāni ca \|*  
*madhurāṇi ca mūlāni grāmyāraṇyāni nārada \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tāni tvanyānyasaṃkhyāni tilānāṃ laḍḍukāni ca \|*  
*laḍḍukāni supakvāni svādūni surasāni ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

*yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ pakvāni piṣṭakāni ca \|*  
*ghṛtāktāni ca ramyāṇi śarkarāsahitāni ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

*svāstikānāṃ laḍḍukāni sthūlāni sundarāṇi ca \|*  
*bhṛṣṭadravyaṃ ca vividhamakṣataṃ śarkarānvitam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*ghṛtakulyāṃ dugdhakulayāṃ madhukulyaṃ manoharām \|*  
*guḍasya dadhnaḥ kulyāṃ ca pāyasānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*piṣṭakānāṃ svastikānāṃ rambhāṇāṃ rāśireva ca \|*  
*miṣṭavyañjanayuktāni śālyannāni śubhāni ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

*dadau tasmai sureśāya kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevatā \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ ramyaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ varam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*dadau vighnapināśāya virājataṭavāsinī \|*  
*sūkṣmavastrayugaṃ ramyamamūlyaṃ vahniśuddhakam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*dadau śailātmajāyaiva śataśṛṅganivāsinī \|*  
*viśuddhasarpiṣā yuktaṃ nirmalaṃ madhuraṃ madhu \|\| 48 \|\|*

*madhuparkaṃ dadau tasmai vṛndāvananivāsinī \|*  
*tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*sarvasaṃpatpradātre ca vṛṣabhānasutā dadau \|*  
*saptatīrthodakaṃ śuddhaṃ susitaṃ suvāsitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*pānārtha ca jalaṃ tasmai dadau gaupośvarī mudā \|*  
*amūlyaṃ durlabhaṃ caiva viśuddhaṃ śvetacāmaram \|\| 51 \|\|*

*dadau tasmai pareśāya mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*pariṣkṛtaṃ sutalpaṃ ca puṣpacandanacarcitam \|*  
*sitasūkṣmāśukenaiva paritaśca pariṣkṛtam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*dadau śivātmajāyaiva kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthalasthitā \|*  
*dattvā ca kāmadhenuṃ ca savatsāṃ vāñchitapradām \|\| 54 \|\|*

*kṛtvā'tīva parīhāraṃ vṛndā puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau \|*  
*divyena mūlmanunā sabījenojjvalena ca \|\| 55 \|\|*

*dadau ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ kālindīkulavāsinī \|*  
*oṃ gaṃ gauṃ gaṇapataye vighnavināśine svāhā \|\| 56 \|\|*

*ityevameva mantraṃ ca gāṇeśaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram \|*  
*sā jajāpa sahasraṃ ca paraṃ salpataruṃ varam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharā \|*  
*sāśrunetrā pulakitā stotreṇa kauthumena ca \|\| 58 \|\|*

39-58. Then the tasteful food and others eatables and beverages which we difficult to get in the three worlds. She also offered the ripe fruits, the roots from the villages and the forest, the sweet balls of sheshamum and several other types of sweet balls of barley and flour besides other sweet times including svastikas. Several types of friends articles besides sugar, ghee, milk, honey, guda, curd, payasam and heaps of banana fruits besides other sweet and vegetables with food including rice were offered to Ganapati by Radha the beloved of Krishna. She also offered the gem-studded lion-throne. The five garments sanctified by fire were given by Radha, the dweller of the mountain of hundred peaks to Ganesha. She also offered to Ganesha the betel with camphor. Thereafter, the mistress of the cowherdesses, offered from water seven holy places to Ganesha for drinking which was quite auspicious and cool. Thereafter Radha offered to Ganesha an invaluable white fly-whisks. Radha who always dwells in the heart of Krishna also gave away in charity, Kamadhenu cows with calves and performing repentance, she offered a bunch of flowers and recited the mUlamantra making sixteen type of offerings. Thereafter Radha the dweller of Kalindl recited the mantra 4 nt Г^и(сн\|^н of sixteen letters which was like the best of kalpatarus and recited it a thousand time. Radhas then filled with devotion became overwhelmed and tears started flowing from her eyes and she started adoring Ganesha.

## \|\| 123.59-61 \|\|

*rādhikovāca paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahma pareśaṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*vighnanighnakaraṃ śāntaṃ puṣṭaṃ kāntamanantakam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*surāsurendraiḥ siddhendraiḥ stutaṃ staumi parātparam \|*  
*surapadmadineśaṃ ca gaṇeśaṃ maṅgalāyanam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ vighnaśokaharaṃ param \|*  
*yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya sarvavighnātpramucyate \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. Radha said – You happen to be eternal abode, eternal Brahman, the lord of all, remover of the obstructions peaceful, well-built, pleasant and beyond measure; you are adores by the fore-most of the gods and the demons. You are the one who serves as a sun for the lotus-like gods and happen to be the resting place for the welfare. I offer my prayer to the same type of Ganesha. The stotra is quite auspicious and removes the terrific obstructions, whosoever recites it in the early morning, he is freed from all the obstructions.

## Chapter 124

## \|\| 124.1-2 \|\|

*atha caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyoyaḥ nālāyaṇa uvāca rādhā saṃpūjya vidhinā stutvā lambodaraṃ satī \|*  
*amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ sarvāṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ dadau \|\| 1 \|\|*

*rādhāyāḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā pūjāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca vastu ca \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaḥ śāntāṃ trailokyamātaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – The chaste Radha adored Ganesha appropriately and offering prayer to him, presented to him the gem-studded ornaments for all the limbs. On hearing the prayer of Radha and finding her adoration and the articles given by her in charity, Ganesha spoke to Radha who happened to be the mother of the universe and having the peaceful nature.

## \|\| 124.3-6 \|\|

*gaṇeśa uvāca tava pūjā jaganmātarlokaśikṣākarī śubhe \|*  
*brahmasvarūpā bhavatī kṛṣṇavakṣaḥ sthalasthitā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yatpādapadmatulaṃ dhyāyante te sudurlabham \|*  
*surā brahmeśaśeṣādyā munīndrāḥ sanakādayaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*jīvanmuktāśca bhaktāśca siddhendrāḥ kapilādayaḥ \|*  
*tasya prāṇādhidevī tvaṃ priyā prāṇādhikā parā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vāmāṅganirmitā rādhā dakṣiṇāṅgaśca mādhavaḥ \|*  
*mahālakṣmīrjaganmātā tava vāmāṅganirmitā \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. Ganesha said – О mother of the universe, the adoration provided by you, is educative for others. О auspicious one, you are the form of Brahman and reside always in the heart of Krishna; he is the one whose lotus-like feet are meditated upon by Brahma, Shiva, Shesha and other gods, Sanaka and sages, Kapila and others, devotees and siddhas, you happen to be the beloved of the same Krishna. Shri Krishna happens to be Madhava from the right side and Radha emerged from his left side. Lakshmi the mother of the universe appeared from his left side.

## \|\| 124.7-8 \|\|

*vasoḥ sarvanivāsasya prasūstvaṃ parameśvarī \|*  
*vedānāṃ jagatāmeva mūlprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sarvāḥ prākṛtikā mātaḥ sṛṣṭyāṃ ca tvadvibhūtayaḥ \|*  
*viśvāni kāryarūpāṇi tvaṃ ca kāraṇarūpiṇī \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. You happen to be. the mother of Vasus, Parameshvari, MiilaPrakriti and the mother of the Vedas. О mother, all the humans of the universe represent your form, the entire universe represent the deeds and you happen to be the cause of the same.

## \|\| 124.9-10 \|\|

*pralaye brahmaṇaḥ pāte tannimeṣo harerapi \|*  
*ādau rādhāṃ samuccārya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ parātparam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sa eva paṇḍito yogī golokaṃ yāti līlayā \|*  
*ādau rādhāṃ samuccārya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ parātparam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. When Brahma falls at the time of the dissolution of the universe, a moment of Vishnu is counted. The one who recites the name of Radha and then of Krishna he surely goes to the Goloka if the order is reversed, one earns the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 124.11-13 \|\|

*jagatāṃ bhavatī mātā paramātmā pitā hariḥ \|*  
*pitureva gururmātā pūjyā vandyā parātparā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*bhajate devamanyaṃ vā kṛṣṇaṃ vā sarvakāraṇam \|*  
*puṇyakṣetre mahāmūḍho yadi nindati rādhikām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vaṃśahānirbhavettasya duḥkhaśokamihaiva ca \|*  
*pacyate niraye ghore yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. You are the mother of the universe and Hari happens to be the father but the one who is beyond everything is more adorable than the parents. Such of the people who in the land of Bharata recite the name of Krishna only and denounce Radha, their race gets destroyed and have to suffer mental agony for long. They are then fallen in the terrific hell and have to remain there till the sun and the moon.

## \|\| 124.14-15 \|\|

*guruścajñānodgiraṇājjñānaṃ syānmantratantrayoḥ \|*  
*sa ca mantraśca tattantraṃ bhaktiḥ syāddhruvayoryataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*niṣevya mantraṃ devānāṃ jīvā janmani janmani \|*  
*bhaktā bhavanti durgāyāḥ pādapadme sudurlabhe \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The one who bestows the knowledge is known as the teacher besides the mantras and the tantras. The same mantras and tantras represent your devotion. By reciting the mantras of the gods, the people achieved the extremely inaccessible devotion of goddess Durga.

## \|\| 124.16 \|\|

*niṣevya mantre śaṃbhośca jagatāṃ kāraṇasya ca \|*  
*tadā prāpnoti yuvayoḥ pādapadmaṃ sudurlabham \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. By reciting the mantra of Shiva who is the cause of the universe, one achieves the inaccessible lotus-like feet of the lord.

## \|\| 124.17 \|\|

*yukyoḥ pādapadmaṃ ca durlabhaṃ prāpya puṇyavān \|*  
*kṣaṇārdhaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ ca nahi muñcati daivataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. By achieving the inaccessible lotus-like feet of the lord, the virtuous person never disowns them even for the fraction of a moment in future.

## \|\| 124.18-19 \|\|

*bhaktyā ca yuvacormantraṃ gṛhītvā vaiṣmapādapi \|*  
*stavaṃ vā kavacaṃ vā'pi karmamūlanikṛntanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yojayetparayā bhaktyā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|*  
*puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca tvātmanā sārdhamuddharet \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. In the sacred land of Bharata, such of the Vais nava person who recites your mantra with devotion or received the kavacha which shatter the base of the deeds and recites it with great devotion, he redeems with himself, thousands of his generations.

## \|\| 124.20 \|\|

*gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ \|*  
*kavacaṃ dhārayedyo hi viṣṇutulyo bhaveddhruvam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Such of the persons who adore her daily appropriately and wears the kavacha offering the costumes, ornaments, sandal-paste to the teacher, he surely becomes equal to Vishnu.

## \|\| 124.21-22 \|\|

*yaddattaṃ vastu me mātastatsarvaṃ sārthakaṃ kuru \|*  
*dehi viprāya matprītyā tadā bhokṣyāmi sāṃpratam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*deve deyāni dānāni deve deyā ca dakṣiṇā \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyāttadānantyāya kalpate \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. О mother whatever has been given by you to me, make them purposeful. Presently for my pleasure you distribute all these things to the Brahmana. Only than I shall take my food. The things which are fit for giving away in charity besides the daksina should be given to the Brahmanas which best-owed the merit beyond measure.

## \|\| 124.23 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānāṃ mukhaṃ rādhe devānāṃ mukhamukhyakam \|*  
*viprabhuktaṃ ca yaddravyaṃ prāpnuvantyeva devatāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The valorous Radha is accompanied by three crores of cowherdesses. The strong cowherdesses had driven me out. I also advise all of you to adore Ganesha first of all, because he bestows the merit beyond measure. In case the adoration is performed in the middle, one gets the medium type of merit and when his adoration is performed last of all, one gets very little merit.

## \|\| 124.24 \|\|

*viprāṃśca bhojayāmāsa tatsarva rādhikā satī \|*  
*babhūva tatkṣaṇādeva prīto lambodaro mune \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О Radha, the mouth of the Brahmanas, is equal to the mouth of god. Therefore whatever is eaten by the Brahmanas, it surely reaches the gods.

## \|\| 124.25 \|\|

*etasminnantare devā brahmeśaśeṣasaṃjñakāḥ \|*  
*āyayurvaṭamūlaṃ ca devapūjārthameva ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О sage, thereafter all those articles were distributed by Radha to the Brahmanas which pleased the Ganesha immensely.

## \|\| 124.26 \|\|

*tatra gatvā śivacaro devāndevīruvāca saḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhaśca bhayabhītaśca rakṣakaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. In the meantime Brahma, Shiva, Shesha and other gods also arrived under the banyan tree for performing adoration.

## \|\| 124.27 \|\|

*rakṣaka uvāca gaṇeśaṃ pūjayāmāsa sarvādau ca śubhakṣaṇe \|*  
*vṛṣabhānasutā rādhā prakṛtya svastivācanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. At that point of time a messenger of Shiva whose throat has been dried up spoke to the gods, goddess and Shri Krishna.

## \|\| 124.28-29 \|\|

*sahitā sā balavatī gopītriśatakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*vārito'haṃ valiṣṭhābhiryuṣmāṃśca kathayāmi tat \|\| 28 \|\|*

*marvādau pūjayedyo hi so'nantaṃ phalamālabhet \|*  
*madhye madhyavidhaṃ puṇyaṃ śeṣe svalpamiti smṛtam \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. The messenger said – Radha the daughter of Vrsabhana reciting Svastivacana adored Ganesha first of all.

## \|\| 124.30 \|\|

*devendreṣu munīndreṣu devastrīṣu sthitāsu ca \|*  
*gopībhiśca saha tayā rādhayā pūjitaḥ paraḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Radha adored Ganesha in the presence of the gods, the sages and the goddesses.

## \|\| 124.31 \|\|

*dūtavākyaṃ samākarṇya jahasuḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|*  
*munayo manavaścaiva rājāno devayoṣitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. On hearing the words of the messenger all the men the sages, Manu, kings, gods and goddesses started laughing.

## \|\| 124.32-34 \|\|

*rukmiṇyādyā ramaṇyaśca yā devyo vismayaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*sarasvatī ca sāvitrī pārvatī parameśvarī \|\| 32 \|\|*

*rohiṇī ca satī saṃjñā svāhādyā devayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*muditāḥ prayayuḥ sarvā munipatnyaḥ pativratāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*munayo manavaḥ sarve devāścāpi narāstathā \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sa gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ ye cānye prayayurmudā \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. Rukmini and other damsels beside the goddess however felt surprised at the same time Sarasvati, Savitri, Parvati, the great goddess, Sati, Rohini, Sanjna, Svaha and other goddesses delightfully arrived here. All the chaste wives of the sages also arrived the. The ascetics. Manu, all the gods, the humans, also arrived there together with Krishna.

## \|\| 124.35 \|\|

*te sarve vividhairdravyaiḥ pūjāṃ cakruḥ śubhakṣaṇe \|*  
*baliṣṭhā durbalāścaiva krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. All of them performed the adoration in the auspicious time. All the strong as well as the weak people adored separately.

## \|\| 124.36 \|\|

*laḍḍukānāṃ ca rāśīnāṃ śatakoṭirbabhūva ha \|*  
*śarkarāṇāṃ tadardhaṃ ca svastikānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. A hundred crores of heaps of the sweets balls were heaped up, the number such heaps was half of those comprising of the balls of sugar and svastikas.

## \|\| 124.37 \|\|

*annānāṃ bhavyavastūnāṃ śatakoṭirbabhūva ha \|*  
*asaṃkhyāni phalānyeva svādūni madhurāṇi ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. There were hundred crores of heaps of the cereals and other delicious items. The delicious and sweet fruits were available in large number.

## \|\| 124.38 \|\|

*madhukulyā dugdhakulyā dadhikulyā ghṛtasya ca \|*  
*babhūvuḥ śatasaṃkhyāśca trailokyānāṃ ca pūjane \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The adoration could be performed with honey, milk, curd and ghee which were flowing in hundreds of canals and could be used for performing pftja in all the three worlds.

## \|\| 124.39 \|\|

*pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu te sarve samūṣuśca sukhāsane \|*  
*pārvatī paramaprītyā rādhāsthānaṃ samāyayau \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. After performing puja, all of them took their seats. Thereafter Parvati getting filled with affection went to Radha.

## \|\| 124.40-41 \|\|

*sā rādhā pārvatīṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya javena ca \|*  
*yathāyogyāṃ ca saṃbhāṣāṃ cakāra sādaraṃ mudā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*āśleṣaṇaṃ cumbanaṃ ca babhūva ca parasparam \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ durgā rādhāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Finding Parvati with her, Radha got up at once and started tailing to her in a sweet manner. Both of them embraced each other, kissing each other at the same time, thereafter, Parvati embracing Radha spoke to her the sweet words.

## \|\| 124.42 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca kiṃvā praśnaṃ kariṣyāmi tvāṃ rādhā maṅgalālayām \|*  
*gatā te virahajvālā śrīdāmnaḥ śāpamokṣaṇe \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Parvati said – О Radha, you are the abode of welfare and as such what should I ask you. Getting freed from the curse of Srfdama, the agony of your flames of separation has been subsided.

## \|\| 124.43 \|\|

*satataṃ manmanaḥ prāṇāstvayyeva mayi te tathā \|*  
*na hyevamāvayorbhedaḥ śaktipūruṣayostathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. I had always been thinking about you, similarly your mind also remains devoted to me. Therefore there is no difference between the two of us. In the same way as there is no difference between Purusa and shakti.

## \|\| 124.44 \|\|

77-96. The lustre of her body resembled the white campaka flower which was quite pleasing and channing and could attract the minds of the sages. Her face could put to shame crores of the moons. She always remained smiling and had the beautiful teeth. Her eyes resembled the lotus flower of the winter season. She was the form of Maha-Lakshmi, the form of seed, primeval, eternal and the form of eternal Brahman, besides being the goddess of the life of lord Krishna. She is the one who is adored for achieving the supreme soul; she is beyond everything, the form of Brahman, uninvolved, everlasting devoid of qualities, Prakriti, the one who bestows grace on her devotees, the form of truth, spotless, auspicious, purifier of the down-trodden, the one who sanctifies even the auspicious holy places, possessing the divine glory, the creative instinct of Brahma, the beloved of lord, the great goddess, the mother of Maha-Vishnu the goddess of the divine dance, adorable, passionate, goddess of the divine dance, clad in the garment sanctified by fire, the one who moves at her own will, the abode of welfare, the one who is served by the seven cowherdesses moving white fly-whisks over her, the one who is adored by the four female friends at her feet, the one who is adorned with the gem-studded ornaments, the one whose temples are shining with the ear ornament worn by her, the one who wears an elephant gem in her nose which keeps on hanging, the one who had the nose like the curved beak of Garuda, the one whose body is plastered with saffron, kasturi end sandal-paste, the one who is quite passionate and walks like the elephant, she is quite attractive having a beautiful nose, to becomes victorious with the god of love she is always passionate and the best, she is the one having a blossomed flower in her hand, she is the one holding Parijata flower and the gem-studded mirror in her hand, she is the one who is seated on the lion-throne Studded with various types of gems, she is the one who always adored the lotus-like feet of Krishna; adored by padma which are the form of welfare and those lotus-like feet are always placed by her in her heart, she is immensely emotional a spotless devotee, a chaste woman, a graceful one, quite proud, having fair-complexion, the one who always resides in he heart of Krishna, the one who is dearer to Krishna than all his beloved, the one who is sweet-spoken, the one who emerged from the left side of Krishna, the one who is unprecedented in the qualities and the beauty. The one who resides in Goloka, the one who is the goddess of all the goddesses, the supreme goddess, the mistress of the cowherdesses, quite secretive, the one who provides all the success is the form of success could be achieved by deep devotion, the one who is difficult to be achieved the one who is adored by her devotees and the one who appeared in the land of Bharata as the daughter of Vrsabhana. I adore such a type of Radha.
