The holy places, the ocean as well as the mountains also get purified.

## \|\| 125.9-11 \|\|

*surā darśanamicchanti pātakendhanapāpakam \|*  
*so'jñāni naiva bubudhe jñānaṃ ca jñāninā saha \|\| 9 \|\|*

*paramaṃ svādurūpaṃ ca dadhidugdharasaṃ yathā \|*  
*yathā kṛṇasya tāto'haṃ saṅgī sucirameva ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tathaiva devakī mātā jñānināṃ ca gurorguroḥ \|*  
*vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā prahasya śaṃkaraḥ svayam caturṇāmapi vedānāmuvāca janako guruḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. The gods also get desirous of meeting of a Vaishnava for the destruction of their sins like the fire burning the wood. Such of the person who is unable to achieve the knowledge by keeping the company of the Vaishnavas, indeed is a fool. The knowledge otherwise is tasteful like the milk and the curd. Therefore, О teacher of the great intellectuals, I happen to be the father of Krishna and have kept his company for long. Similarly Devaki too happens to be his mother. Listening to the words of Vasudeva, Shiva himself who happens to be well-versed in all the Vedas laughed aloud and said.

## \|\| 125.12-13 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca saṃnikarṣo jñānināṃ cāpyanādaraṇakāraṇam \|*  
*yānti gaṅgāmbhasā pūtāstīrthānyanyāni siddhaye \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vāsudevāsya tāto'yaṃ vasudevaśca paṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*jñāninaḥ kaśyapasyāśo vasostātasya cā''tmanaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Mahadeva said – To live with the intellectuals sometimes becomes disgraceful to them, as the people who get purified with the water of Ganga still go to the other holy places. The father of Krishna is quite a well-read person and his father was the form of Vasu and was descendants of the race of Kashyapa.

## \|\| 125.14-16 \|\|

*pṛcchati jñānamasmāṃśca kṛṣṇājñānputrabuddhitaḥ \|*  
*aho durgā mahāmāyā jñānināmapi mohinī \|\| 14 \|\|*

*viṣṇumāyā durārādhyā na sādhyā jāgatāmapi \|*  
*vayaṃ ca mohitāḥ śaśvadvedānāṃ janakastathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*brahmā kṛṣṇaṃ parīkṣeta mohitastasya māyayā \|*  
*dhyāyate yatpadāmbhojaṃ tapasā jīvanāvadhi \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. They have a clear and auspicious approach towards Krishna and they seek knowledge from us, who are unaware of the personality of Krishna. The illusion of Vishnu is Durga. Mahamaya and overpowers even the intellectuals. The illusion of Vishnu is beyond the reach of all the people in the three worlds. We people always get influenced with the same, influences with the same illusion, Brahma the creator of the Vedas, performed tapas for his whole life at his lotus-like feet and wanted to taste such a type of Krishna.

## \|\| 125.17 \|\|

*indreṣu daśalakṣeṣvapyadhikāṣṭaśateṣu ca \|*  
*pāteṣu brahmaṇaḥ pāte nimeṣo mādhavasya ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. With the fall of ten lakh and eight hundred Indras, Brahma has to fall; after that a movement of Madhava is counted.

## \|\| 125.18 \|\|

*saha tenendrayuddhaṃ ca pārijātasya hetunā \|*  
*pārijātataruṃ dattvā mayā śakraśca rakṣitaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. There was a fight between Krishna and Indra for the sake of Parijdta tree, I saved Indra by returning the Par ij at a tree to him.

## \|\| 125.19 \|\|

*yajjñānaṃ na girāmeva tatvaṃ vā viṣayātmakam \|*  
*nahi kiṃ cittadajñānāṃ tasmāddhyānaṃ sadaiva hi \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The knowledge which is beyond description and the people with little wisdom hardly know about the same. Therefore it is always proper to adore the lord.

## \|\| 125.20 \|\|

*prāṇināmātmano jñānamasmākaṃ jñānamasti ca \|*  
*tadūdharvaṃ tatsamaṃ naiva kṛṣṇaṃ pṛccha śubhāśumam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. I am aware of the soul of the creatures but I am unaware about the knowledge above them who are equals, therefore you better ask about the auspicious things from Krishna alone.

## \|\| 125.21-22 \|\|

*brahmaṇaśca caturyāmaṃ kalpaṃ kalpavido viduḥ \|*  
*saptakalpāntajīvī ca mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*aṣṭānavatiśakreṣu pāteṣu patanaṃ muneḥ \|*  
*tataḥ prāptaṃ harerdāsyaṃ muninā tapasaḥ phalāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The four praharas of Brahma have been equated with a kalpa by the knowledgeable people. The same Markandeya remained alive for seven kalpas, after the fell of nineteen eight Indras. The same sage Markandeya had them to fall. Thereafter the sage as the result of the tapas performed by him, achieved the slavehood of Krishna.

## \|\| 125.23-24 \|\|

*pralaye brahmaṇaḥ pāte patanaṃ lomaśasya ca \|*  
*dikpālānāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca tadāyuścirajīvinām \|\| 23 \|\|*

*anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ munīnāmūrdhvaretasām \|*  
*tadevā''yuśca rudrāṇāṃ māṃ ca mṛtyuṃjayaṃ vinā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. At the time of dissolution, with the fall of Brahma, the sage Lomasa also had to fall. Thereafter, the Dikpalas and nine planets also have been to fall. Thus those with long life have to live only for this duration.

## \|\| 125.25 \|\|

*pralaye ca vidheḥ pāte śivaloke'pyahaṃ śivaḥ \|*  
*brahmabhālodbhavaḥ śaṃbhūḥ sarvādiḥ sargabhāṣaṇaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. At the time of dissolution Brahma falls; he remerge from the forehead of Shiva. Shiva happens to be the beginning of all. This has been ordained by Ganga.

## \|\| 125.26 \|\|

*kṛṣṇavāmāṅgasaṃbhūtā yathā rādhā tathaiva ca \|*  
*tathaiva durgā lakṣmīśca sāvitrī ca sarasvatī \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The way in which Radha emerged from the left side of Krishna, Durga, Lakshmi, Sarasvati and Savitri also emerged from his body in the same way.

## \|\| 125.27 \|\|

*ādityo''yaditeḥ putraḥ kāyavyūhena dvādaśa \|*  
*tathaiva ca mahendraśca kāyavyūhāccartudaśa \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The twelve Adityas were born out of the body of Aditi. Similarly there were fourteen Indras on earth.

## \|\| 125.28 \|\|

*tathaiva vasavaścāṣṭau rudrāścaikāvaśaiva te \|*  
*manupāte cendrapāto viṣayātpatanaṃ bhavet \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Similarly there were eight Vasus, eleven Rudras after the fall of Manu, Indra also falls.

## \|\| 125.29-30 \|\|

*samāyayau ca sarveṣāṃ nidhanaṃ pralaye'pi ca \|*  
*pralayo darśayāmāsa brahmāṇḍaṃ ca jalaplutam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*brahmāṇaṃ ca svalokaṃ ca svātmānaṃ śaktibhiśca mām \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ mūlarūpaśca sarveśaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. After dissolution the entire universe, Brahma with Brahmaloka and together with his shaktis, are all submerged in water. Krishna himself is the root of all and the lord of all.

## \|\| 125.31-32 \|\|

*bhaja putraṃ rājasūye yajñeśaṃ yajñakāraṇam \|*  
*vidhivaddakṣiṇāṃ dattvāṃ bhavābdhiṃ tara yādava \|\| 31 \|\|*

*muktiste nāsti nirvāṇā viṣayī kaśyapo bhavāna \|*  
*na te dāsyaṃ ktadhanamaditirdevakī tathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Therefore Vasudeva should organise a Rajashuya-yajna and should adore his son Krishna with the performing of the уajna. Thereafter giving away daksina appropriately, you cross over the ocean of the universe. Without that, you cannot achieve moksa, you are a Kashyapa; the riches of the devotees cannot be held by you. Devaki is the form of Aditi.

## \|\| 125.33-35 \|\|

*vraja svargaṃ bhogabījaṃ svasthānamamarālayam \|*  
*śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā saṃyata ścaśubhakṣaṇe \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tatra saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro rājasūyaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*vasudevasya havyaṃ ca sākṣācca jagṛhaḥ surāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yatra sākṣācca yajñeśo yajño'yaṃ dakṣiṇā saha \|*  
*būrṇāhutiṃ dattavantaṃ vasudevamuvāca saḥ \|*  
*sanatkumāro bhagavānvāsudevājñayā mune \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. You should therefore go to the heaven together with Devaki which happen to be your own abode and your own temple. On hearing the words of Shiva, Vasudeva who had over-powered all tire organ of his senses collected the material perfonned the Rajashuya-yajna in the auspicious time. Yajnesa, the lord of yajna himself was resent thereat he re fore the gods appeared themselves and accepted the offerings. О sage, thereafter at the instance, of Krishna, Sanatkumara the lord of the gods.

## \|\| 125.36-38 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dehi turṇaṃ lakṣmīpateḥ pitaḥ \|*  
*sārthakaṃ kuru karmedaṃ vedoktaṃ vacanaṃ śruṇu \|\| 36 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ vipramuddiśya tatkālaṃ cenna dīyate \|*  
*muhūrte tu vyatīte sā dakṣiṇā dviguṇā bhavet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*vāsare ca bahirbhūte bhavetsā'pi caturguṇā \|*  
*trirātre samatīte ṣaḍguṇā dakṣiṇā bhavet \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. Sanatkumara said – О lord, the husband of Lakshmi, you give me all your belongings in daks ina immediately and make the yajha successful, now you listen to the words which are according to the Vedas. In case the Brahmana is not given daksina at once, with the passage of a ghadi, the amount of daksina is doubled. After the lapse of the day it multiplies to four times and after the lapse of three nights it multiplies to six times.

## \|\| 125.39-41 \|\|

*pakṣānte tu śataguṇā māsānte tu caturguṇā \|*  
*ṣaṇmāse'pyadhike nyūne ca sāhastraguṇā tathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*varṣānte sā lakṣaguṇā brahmaṇoktaṃ ca yāṭava \|*  
*ubhau ca narakaṃ yāṃtaḥ karmakartṛpurohitau \|\| 40 \|\|*

*vāsudaivaśca tacchutvā sarvasvamutsasarjaṃ saḥ \|*  
*adhikārāṃśca sāh lādo vāsudevājñayā tathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. After the lapse of the fortnight it multiplies to hundred times and after the lapse of a month, it further multiplies to four hundred times; after the lapse of six months, it multiplies to a thousand times. О lord of the Yadus, after lapse of one years, it multiplies to a lakh of times after which both the performer and the priest fall into the hell. This has been ordained by Brahma. On hearing this Vasudeva at the instance of Krishna delightfully gave away everything to the sage.

## \|\| 125.42 \|\|

*amūlyānāṃ ca ratnānāṃ daśakoṭimanuttamamā \|*  
*dadau gargāya sarvādau svayaṃ lakṣmaupateḥ pitā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. At very first, Vasudeva, the father of the lord of Lakshmi then gave away ten crores of very precious gems to Garga.

## \|\| 125.43-52 \|\|

*śatakoṭiṃ maṇīndrāṇāṃ svarṇānāṃ taccartuguṇam \|*  
*māṇikyānāṃ ca muktānāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*raupyaṃ pravālaṃ paramaṃ svarṇapātrāṇi yāni ca \|*  
*svastrīṇāṃ svavadhūnāṃ cāpyamūlyaratnabhūṣaṇam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*śvetacāmaralakṣaṃ ca lakṣaṃ ca ratnadarpaṇam \|*  
*kāmadhenugaṇaṃ sarvaṃ śatakoṭiṃ gajānapi \|\| 45 \|\|*

*śatakauṭiṃ gajendrāṇāmaśvānāṃ taccaturguṇam \|*  
*yaddhanaṃ yādavānāṃ ca rājño rājanumodanāt \|\| 46 \|\|*

*grāmāṇāṃ śatalakṣaṃ ca sasasyaṃ phalitaṃ tarum \|*  
*dhānyācalānāṃ lakṣaṃ ca śālyannānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

*pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ caiva miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam \|*  
*svastikānāṃ tilānāṃ ca ramyaṇi l̈aḍḍukāni ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

*dadhnāṃ madhūnāṃ dugdhānāṃ guḍānāṃ haviṣāmapi \|*  
*kulyānāṃ śatakaṃ dattvā parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*sakarpūraṃ ca tāmdūlaṃ suśītaṃ vāsitaṃ jalam \|*  
*sugandhi candanaṃ caiva pārijātasya mālikām \|\| 50 \|\|*

*āsanāni ca ramyāṇivahniśuddhāśukāni ca \|*  
*ratnanirmāṇatalpāni puṣṇāṇi ca phalāni ca \|\| 51 \|\|*

*pradadau brāhmaṇebhyaśca praphullavadanekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*devāṃśca bhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇānāṃ mukhaiḥ subhaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

43-52. Ten crores of the best of gems and four times more the gold, emeralds, diamond, silver, gold, vases, all the ornaments of his wife and the daughter-in-law, a lakh of white fly-whisks an equal number of gem-studded mirrors, herds of Kamadhenu cows, a hundred crores of elephants, a hundred crores of huge elephants, four hundred crores of horses, all the riches of the Yadavas, all the riches of Ugrasena with his consent, the paddy with a hundred lakh of villages, the blossoming trees, a lakh of mountains like heaps of cereals and an equal number of the heaps of paddy, beside payasam, nectar-like sweets, svastika sweet, sweet balls of sheshamum, curd, honey, milk, guda and ghee were given filled in canals. Thereafter he gave away the betel with camphor, the fragrant and cool water, fragrant sandal-paste, garland of Parijata flowers, the beautiful seeds, spotless costumes, the flowers made of gems, beside the fruit were delight fully given to the Brahmanas, He also served the gods by feeding the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 125.53 \|\|

*devāśca munayo rātrau svarāmābhiścaremire \|*  
*prabhāte prayayuḥ sarve śrīkṛṣṇānumatena ca \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. During the night, the sages and gods enjoyed the company of their wives and in the early morning all of them left the place with the permission of Krishna.

## \|\| 125.54 \|\|

*vādavāḥ prayayuḥ sarvedvārakāṃ kṛṣṇapālitām \|*  
*amūlyarātnabūrṇāṃ ca rukmiṇīdarśanena ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Thereafter, all the people of the race of Yadus and adored with innumerable gems and other, valuables proceeded to Dvaraka which was protected by Krishna.

## Chapter 126

## \|\| 126.1 \|\|

*atha ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca gaṇeśapūjanaṃ kṛtvā mādhavo yādavaiḥ saha \|*  
*devairmunibhiranyaiśca devībhiḥ saha nārada \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – O Narada, Krishna thus heard the adoration of Ganesha in the company of Yadavas, the gods, the sages, the goddesses and other people (1).

## \|\| 126.2 \|\|

*aṃśena devo devībhī rukmiṇyādyābhireva ca \|*  
*prayayau dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ tasthau siddhāśrame svayam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Thereafter from his amsa, he proceeded to Dvaraka in the company of Rukmini and other goddesses and in one form he stayed in Siddhasrama.

## \|\| 126.3-4 \|\|

*kṛtvā suprītisaṃbhāṣāṃ sārdhagolokavāsibhiḥ \|*  
*gopaiḥ suhṛdbhirnandena mātrā gopyā yaśodayā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*uvāca mātaraṃ tātaṃ sunītaṃ ca cathocitam \|*  
*gopāṃśca gokulasthāṃśca bandhuvargāśca sāṃpratam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. From there, he keeping the company of cowherds and cowherdesses, Nanda, mother Yashoda and cowherdesses continued conversation with them. Thereafter, he spoke to his parents, the cowherds and cowherdesses of the Goloka.

## \|\| 126.5-6 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca gaccha nandavrajaṃ nanda he tāta prāṇavallbha \|*  
*mātaryaśode tvamapi paramārthe yaśasvini \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhuktvā kālāvaśeṣaṃ ca gaccha golokamuttamam \|*  
*sālokyamuktiṃ dāsyāmi sārtha gokulavāsibhiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Shri Krishna said – ”O mother, О Nanda, you are dear to me then my life now you return to Vraja. О glorious and the best mother Yashoda, you also return to Gokula and spend the rest of the life there. Enjoying all the pleasures in Gokula, you would achieve the salvation together with the people of Gokula".

## \|\| 126.7 \|\|

*ityuktvā bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ pitroranumatena ca \|*  
*jagāma rādhikāsthānaṃ nandaśca gokulaṃ tathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Thus speaking with the permission of his parents, he went to his place of Radhika and Nanda proceeded towards Gokula.

## \|\| 126.8 \|\|

*dadarśa rādhā rucirāṃ muktāhārāṃ ca sasmitām \|*  
*yathā dvādaśavarṣīyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Reaching there, he met Radha who was adorned with the garland of gems and was smiling, she was ever youthful and looked like a damsel of twelve years.

## \|\| 126.9 \|\|

*ratnoccairāsanasthā ca gopītriśatakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*āvṛtā vetrahastābhiḥ sasmitābhiśca sāṃpratam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. She was seated on the gem-studded seats, she was smiling and was surrounded by innumerable cowherdesses, each holding a staff in her hand.

## \|\| 126.10-14 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā ca dūrato rādhā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prāṇavallabham \|*  
*śiśuveṣaṃ suveṣaṃ ca sundareśaṃ ca sasmitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*navīṃnajaladaśyāmaṃ pīṃtakauśeyavāsasam \|*  
*candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyaśobhitam \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānuprahavigraham \|\| 12 \|\|*

*krīḍākamalamamlānaṃ dhṛtavantaṃ manoharam \|*  
*muralīhastavinyastaṃ supraśastaṃ ca darpaṇam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*javena ca samutthāya gopībhiḥ saha sādaram \|*  
*praṇamya parayā bhaktyā tuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|\| 14 \|\|*

10-14. Radha looked at Krishna who was dearer to her than her life and was coming towards her; he was clad in beautiful costumes like a boy and he was wearing a serene smile on his face. He had a lustre of the new cloud and had a dark complexion. He was clad in beautiful silken yellow lower garment and the entire body was plastered with the sandal-paste. His body was adorned with the best of gem-studded ornaments and a peacock feather was adorning his head. He was wearing garland of jasmine flowers, his delightful face wore a smile. He was holding the blossomed lotus flowers. He was carrying a flute in his one hand and in the other he carried a mirror. Finding him there, Radha got up at once from her seat and started praying him with devotion.

## \|\| 126.15 \|\|

*rādhikovāca adya me saphalaṃ janmajīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam \|*  
*yaddṛṣṭvā mukhacandraṃ te susnigdhaṃ locanaṃ manaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Radha said – My life has met with success today by looking at your moon like face; my eyes and my mind are now delighted.

## \|\| 126.16 \|\|

*pañca prāṇāśca snigdhāśca paramātmā ca supriyaḥ \|*  
*ubhayorharṣabījaṃ ca durlabhaṃ bandhudarśanam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. All the five prcinas of mine have been filled with delight; the sight of a dear relative is cause of delight always.

## \|\| 126.17 \|\|

*śokārṇave nimagnā'haṃ pradagdhā virahānalaiḥ \|*  
*tvaddṛṣṭyā'mṛtavṛṣṭyā ca susiktā'dya suśītalā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. I had been drowned in the ocean of grief and was burning with the fire of separation but today the same has been completely subsided.

## \|\| 126.18 \|\|

*śivā śivapradā'haṃ ca śivabījā tvayā saha \|*  
*śi (śa) va svarūpā niśceṣṭā'pyadṛśyā ca tvayā vinā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. With you, I am always the from of welfare, bestower of welfare and the cause of welfare. But without you I am like a dead body, getting motionless and become invisible.

## \|\| 126.19-20 \|\|

*tvayi tiṣṭhati dehe ca dehī śrīmāñchuciḥ svayam \|*  
*sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca śivarūpā gate tvayi \|\| 19 \|\|*

*strīpuṃso viṃraho nāthasāmānyaśca sudāruṇaḥ \|*  
*yāntyeva śaktibhiḥ prāṇā vicchedātparamātmanaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. When you stay in this body the soul become a beautiful and pure. I feel myself all powerful, but without you I look like a dead body. О lord, the separation between the man and woman is always painful but with the separation of the lord, all the shaktis and the five pranas also disappear.

## \|\| 126.21 \|\|

*ityuktvā rādhikā vevī paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*svāsane vāsayāsāsa kṛtvā pādārcanaṃ mudā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Thus speaking the goddess Radha made Shri Krishna to sit on the seat and the herself adored his feet.

## \|\| 126.22 \|\|

*ratnasiṃhāsane śrīmānuvāsa rādhayā saha \|*  
*gopībhiḥ saptabhiḥ śaśvatsevitaḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thereafter, Shri Krishna occupied the gem-studded lion-throne together with Radha, seven cowherdesses served them by moving white fly-whisks.

## \|\| 126.23 \|\|

*candanā sā dadau gātre sugandhi candanaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*sasmitā ratnamālā sā ratnamālāṃ gale dadau \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The cowherdesses named Chandana applied the fragrant sandal-paste on the body of the lord, the smiling Ratnamala placed the garland of gems around his neck.

## \|\| 126.24 \|\|

*padmaiḥ padmārcite pādapadme padmāvatī satī \|*  
*ardhyā dadau sā sajalaṃ dūrvā puṣpaṃ ca candanam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The chaste Padmavati adored the lotus-like feet of the lord with lotus flowers, she also offered the arghya together with Durva-grass, flowers and sandal-paste.

## \|\| 126.25 \|\|

*mālato mālatīmālyaṃ cūḍāyāṃ ca harerdadau \|*  
*campāpuṣpasya puṭakaṃ dadau campāvatī satī \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Malatl on the other hand placed the garland of jasmine flower around the neck of Malatl, the chaste Campavati offered him the bunch of jasmine flowers.

## \|\| 126.26 \|\|

*pārijātā ca haraye pārijātaṃ dadau mudā \|*  
*sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ vāsitaṃ śītalaṃ jalam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Parijcita on her part, offered the lord, the Parijdta flowers, betel with camphor, besides the cool fragrant water.

## \|\| 126.27-28 \|\|

*dadau kadambamālā sā kadambamālikāṃ śubhām \|*  
*krīḍākamalamamlānamamūlyaṃ rtanadarpaṇam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dadau haste harereva kamalā sā sukomalā \|*  
*varuṇena purā dattaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca sundaram \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Kadambamala presented the garland of kadamba flowers, the fresh lotus flowers and valuable mirrors of gems. The tender limbed Kamala gave the two costumes given by Varuna.

## \|\| 126.29 \|\|

*sākṣādgorocanābhaṃ ca sundarī haraye dadau \|*  
*madhupātraṃ madhustasmai madhuraṃ madhupūrṇakam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The beautiful Madhu presented to the lord the sweet honey having the colour of gorocana in a vase.

## \|\| 126.30 \|\|

*sudhāpūrgaṃ sudhāpātraṃ dadau bhaktyā sudhāmukhī \|*  
*cakāra puṣpaśayyāṃ ca gopī candanacarcitām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Sudhamukhi presented to the lord, a vase of nectar with devotion, a cowherdesses prepared a bed of flowers.

## \|\| 126.31 \|\|

*amlānamālatīpuṣpamālājālavibhūṣitām \|*  
*ratnendrasāranirmāṇamandire sumanohare \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The bed was decorated with the garland of jasmine flowers. It was placed in such a charming place which was built with the best of gems.

## \|\| 126.32 \|\|

*maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahāravibhūṣite \|*  
*kastūrīkuṅkumāktena vāyunā surabhīkṛte \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. It was decorated with the best of gems, jewels, emeralds and other precious gems and had the fragrance of kasturl, the saffron and several scented material.

## \|\| 126.33 \|\|

*ratnapradīpaśatakairjvaladbhiśca sudīpite \|*  
*dhūpite satataṃ dhūpairnānāvastusamanvitaiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. It was illumined with hundreds of the gem-studded lamps. It bore the fragrance of several of the scented incense and other materials.

## \|\| 126.34-39 \|\|

*kṛtvā śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ yayurgopyaśca sasmitāḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā rahasi talpaṃ ca suramyaṃ sumanoharam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*mādhavo rāghayā sārdha viveśa ratimandiram \|*  
*nānāprakārahāsyaṃ ca parihāsaṃ smarocitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*dvayorbabhūva talpe ca madanāturayostathā \|*  
*mālyaṃ dadau ca kṛṣṇāya tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*kastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ ca candanaṃ śyāmavakṣasi \|*  
*cārucampakapuṣpaṃ ca cūḍāyāṃ pradadau satī \|\| 37 \|\|*

*sahasradalasasaṃktakrīḍāpadmaṃ kare dadau \|*  
*prakṣipya muralīṃ hastātpradadau ratnadarpaṇam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*pārijātasya kusumamamlānaṃ purato dadau \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ rādhā rahasye madhuraṃ vacaḥ sasmitā sasmitaṃ śāntaṃ kāntaṃ kāntā manoharam \|\| 39 \|\|*

34-39. By making a bed for comfortable sleeps, the cowherdesses left the place smilingly. Thereafter, finding the bed in a lonely place which attracted the mind, Madhava entered the place of pleasure. Both of them were engaged in conjugal pleasures. The chaste Radha then adorned the neck of Madhava with the garland of fragrant flowers and also gave him the fragrant betel. After that she pasted the kasturl and saffron paste on his body and adorned his hair with the beautiful jasmine flower. She handed over a fully blossomed lotus flower with thousand petals, in his hand and snatching away the flute from his hand she gave him the mirror of gems; thereafter she placed the blossomed flower of Parijata before him. Thereafter Radha in a peaceful form spoke quite sweet words to her beloved.

## \|\| 126.40-41 \|\|

*rādhikovāca niṣphalaṃ maṅgalapraśtaṃ maṅgale maṅgalālaye \|*  
*sarvamaṅgalabīje ca māṅgalye maṅgalaprade \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tathā'pi kuśalapraśne sāṃprataṃ samayocitam \|*  
*laukiko vyavahāro'pi vedebhyo balavāṃstathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Radhika said – О lord, the one who is the store of the welfare, the cause of welfare, the form of welfare and the bestower of prosperity. To ask the question about your welfare is of no consequence. In spite of that, it is proper to enquire about the welfare because the traditions are more forceful than the Vedic hymns.

## \|\| 126.42-44 \|\|

*kuśalaṃ rukmiṇīkānta satyabhāmeśa sāṃpratam \|*  
*mahandreṇa samaṃ yuddhaṃ līlayā ca yadājñayā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*pārijātataruṃ svargādutpāṭya cāmarāvatīm \|*  
*gatvā vijitya devāṃśca tasyai dasamiti śrutam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*puṇyakaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tena pārijātena suvratam \|*  
*tvāmeva sādhyaṃ kāntaṃ ca saṃpūrṇe dakṣiṇāṃ dadau \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. O lord of Rukmini, О lord of Satyabhama, are you all right. At the instance of Satyabhama, you playfully engage yourself in conflict with Indra and uprooting the Parijata tree from Amaravati in the heaven, conquered the gods and handed it over to Satyabhama. This is what has been heard by me. With the use of the Parijdta flower, she performed the Punyaka-vrata. After completing it, She gave yourself as daksina to the priest.

## \|\| 126.45 \|\|

*brahmeśaśeṣāsādhyastvaṃ tayā sādhyaḥ kṛtaḥ katham \|*  
*sarvabhyaḥ kāminībhyaśca satyabhāmāṃ bibheṣi ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. You are beyond the reach of Brahma, Shiva and Shesha then how could she over-power you? You are afraid of Satyabhama in comparison to all other damsels.

## \|\| 126.46 \|\|

*rukmiṇyāṃ premasaubhāgyamatiriktaṃ ca gauravam \|*  
*bhayaṃ mālyaṃ ca dhanyāyāṃ satyāyāṃ satataṃ śrutam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Your love for Rukmini is the matter of great glory of her it is heard that you are afraid of Satyabhama and you offer her the flower garland.

## \|\| 126.47 \|\|

*satyaṃ jāmbavatīkānta vada māṃ ca suniścitam \|*  
*tāsu sarvāsu kāntāsu kasyāste prema cādhikam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О beloved of Jambavati, you tell me truthfully which one of the damsels is more attached to you.

## \|\| 126.48 \|\|

*śṛṅgāre sarvabhāve vā tāsu kā rasikā parā \|*  
*tvayi snigdhā vidagdhā kā tāmu dhanyā'tisuvratā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Which one of them is more lovable to you? Which one of them, performing the best of vratas is loved by you the most?

## \|\| 126.49 \|\|

*sā strī bhāvānuraktā yā bhāryāṃ pāti patiśca saḥ \|*  
*premātiriktaṃ strīpuṃsostrailokyeṣu sudurlabham \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Only that damsel could be called virtuous who conducts herself according the desires of the husband. The complete harmony in the conducting of love between the man and a woman is difficult to get in the three worlds.

## \|\| 126.50 \|\|

*rasikā strī vijānāti satī guṇavatī patim \|*  
*guṇajñaṃ rasikaṃ śūraṃ suśīlaṃ suratau sadā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The passionate, chaste and virtuous damsel is fully attracted towards the one who possesses all the qualities is quite passionate, valorous and noble.

## \|\| 126.51 \|\|

*dūrāddhāvati padmārtha madhulobhānmadhruvrataḥ \|*  
*bhekastanna hi jānāti tanmūrdhni pādamutsṛjet \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The black-wasps feeling greedy for the nectar, rush toward the lotus flower but the frog is completely unaware about it and therefore places its feet over its head.

## \|\| 126.52 \|\|

*yantrī jānāti saṃgītarasaṃ yantraṃ ca naiva ca \|*  
*dugdhāsvādaṃ vidagdhaśca na darvī naiva bhājanam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The one who plays upon the musical instruments enjoys the sweet news of the tune but instruments itself unaware of it. A clever person very well knows the taste of the milk but not the vase in which the milk is contained.

## \|\| 126.53 \|\|

*paripakvaphalāsvādaṃ jānanti bhoginaḥ sukham \|*  
*ekatrāvasthitāḥ śaśvannakiṃcitphalino yathā \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The consumers are well-aware of the taste of the ripe fruit but the tree over which the fruits is ripened remains unaware of the same.

## \|\| 126.54 \|\|

*suśīlajalāsvādaṃ vijānanti tṛṣālvaḥ \|*  
*na ca vāpī na ghaṭaścaikatrāvasthito yathā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The thirsty person knows the taste of the cold water but the tank or the pitchers in which the water is contained remains unaware of the same.

## \|\| 126.55 \|\|

*bhokino hi vijānanti śālisvādurasaṃ param \|*  
*ekatrāvasthitaṃ cetu na kṣetraṃ bhājanaṃ yathā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The consumer enjoys the tasteful the rice but the paddy field or the vase in which the rice is cooked remains unaware of the same. The user of the sandal-paste remains quite well-aware of its fragrance but the donkey who carries the sandal-wood remains unaware of the same.

## \|\| 126.56 \|\|

*bubudhe candanāghraṇaṃ candanārthī ca bhogavit \|*  
*na gardabho bhāravāhī na tasya pātrikā yathā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The user of the sandal-paste remains quite well-aware of its fragrance but the donkey who carries the sandal-wood remains unaware of the same.

## \|\| 126.57 \|\|

*yaṃ na yānanti vedāśca brahmeśānādayastathā \|*  
*yogino munayaḥ siddhāstaṃ kiṃ jānanti yoṣitaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The one who in beyond the reach of the Vedas, Brahma, Shiva, Yogis, ascetics and siddhas, how could he be known by the woman.

## \|\| 126.58 \|\|

*saubhāgyaṃ gauravaṃ prema durlabhaṃ nityanūtam \|*  
*yauṣitāṃ ca paraṃ naiva cūrṇībhūtaṃ kṣaṇena ca \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Even the fortune, glory and love are difficult to achiever but the ladies snatch them in a moment.

## \|\| 126.59 \|\|

*atyucchrito nipatanaṃ prāpnotyeva dhruvaṃ prabho \|*  
*ārādvipattibījaṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ vihiṃsanam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. О lord, after reaching the extreme height, one has to fall. The violence of the Vaishnavas results in misfortune.

## \|\| 126.60 \|\|

*śrīdāmā ca mayā śaptastvadbhakto bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*etādṛśī vipattirme putraśrīdāmaśāpataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Your devotee named Shridama was cursed by me and because of the same I had to face the misfortune as a result of the curse of Shridama.

## \|\| 126.61 \|\|

*īśvaraḥ kasya vā bandhuḥ priyo vā vipriyastathā \|*  
*satataṃ bhaktisādhyaśca yo bhaktaśca tadīśvaraḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. To whom the lord is dearer; he is always achieved with devotion and for him the devotee is the lord.

## \|\| 126.62 \|\|

*vedāśca vaidikāḥ santaḥ purāṇāni vadanti ca \|*  
*rādhāyā mādhavaḥ sādhyo bhagavāniti niṣphalam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The Vedas, the Vedic literature, the ascetic and the Puranas pronounce repeatedly that lord Krishna is over-powered by Radha. This is useless.

## \|\| 126.63 \|\|

*jitvā ca sagaṇaṃ śaṃbhuṃ bāṇasya bhujakṛntanam \|*  
*kṛtvā ca rukmiṇīpautraḥ samānītaḥ sabhāryakaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Over-powering Shiva together with his ganas, cutting of the arms of Bana you brought back Aniruddha, the grandson of Rukmini together with his wife.

## \|\| 126.64 \|\|

*aho tvayi samāyāte rukmiṇī kimuvāca ha \|*  
*prema sthitaṃ samānaṃ te kiṃ vivṛddhaṃ ca gauravam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. What did Rukmini speak after your return? You love all equally, was there any increase from prestige with the same.

## \|\| 126.65 \|\|

*kurupāṇḍavayuddhena kuravo nihatāstvayā \|*  
*pāṇḍavārthe tathā bhūpāḥ kva sāmyaṃ paramātmanaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. In the battle between the Kauravas and the Pandavas, you made the kings of the Kaurava side to be killed. You tell me where is your vision for equality to all?

## \|\| 126.66-67 \|\|

*sākṣānmahendrajātasya kaunteyasyārjunasya ca \|*  
*rājamaṇḍalamdhyastho bhavāneva hi sārathiḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*tena bhaktena śuddhena bhīṣmeṇa ca mahātmanā \|*  
*lajjitena kimuktaṃ te mahatīṣu mabhāsu ca \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. You became the charioteer of Arjuna, the son of Indra. What did noble Bhlsma speak to you getting ashamed in the assembly?

## \|\| 126.68-71 \|\|

*devairapi kathaṃ dṛṣṭo brahmeśaśesaṃṣajñakaiḥ \|*  
*bhaktasihairbhṛttaiḥ sarvairna coktaṃ kiṃcideva saḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*yaścānirvacanīyaśca vedeṣu ca caturṣu ca \|*  
*purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu prakṛteḥ para īśvaraḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*nirguṇaca nīrīhaśca nirliptaḥ sarvakarmaṇām \|*  
*karmaṇāṃ sākṣirūpaśca bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*paraṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ parameśaḥ parātparaḥ \|*  
*paramātmā ca sarveṣāṃ sūto nararathasthitaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

68-71. What did Brahma, Shiva, Shesha and other gods speak to you? All your devotees kept quiet and spoke nothing. You are the same who is inexplicable in the Vedas, Puranas and the historical treatises, beyond Prakriti, the great lord, devoid of gums, unattached, uninvolved, the witness of all the deeds, the one who takes to human form for the sake of the devotees, the eternal Brahman^ the divine light, beyond everything and became the charioteer of a human being in spite of your being the supreme soul.

## \|\| 126.72 \|\|

*tvayā kubjā ca saṃbhuktā vṛddhā kṣatriyakāminī \|*  
*aputriṇī cādhikāṅgī yūnā'spṛśyā ca praktanāt \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Initially you kept company of the old Kubja who was untouchable by the youth,

## \|\| 126.73 \|\|

*tvayā ca nihataḥ kaṃso mātulaḥ kena hetunā \|*  
*āyāsyatīti kṛtvā ca gattaṃ na punarāgatam \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. What for did you kill Kamsa your maternal uncle? You said that 'you will come’ but after departure you did not come again?

## \|\| 126.74 \|\|

*nihatya yādavānsarvānvibhajya dvārakāṃ purīm \|*  
*tvāṃ nibadhya samānetumīśvarī vāritā janaiḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Killing Yadavas, dividing the city of Dvaraka, the people had prevented the goddess, who ordained to capture you.

## \|\| 126.75 \|\|

*ityuktvā rādhikā devī bhṛśamuccai ruroda sā \|*  
*mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa sahasā niniḥśvāsā babhūva ha \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Thus speaking Radhika started crying aloud and fainted stopping breathing.

## \|\| 126.76 \|\|

*gopyo gavākṣajālasthāḥ śuśruvurdadṛśustathā \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tamāyayuḥ sarvā ūcū rādhā mṛteti ca \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The cowherdesses who were peeping through the windows witnessed the sight. All of them rushed towards her and all of them declared that Radha was dead.

## \|\| 126.77 \|\|

*uccaistā ruruduḥ sarvāḥ kroḍe kṛtvā ca rādhikām \|*  
*ūcustā rakṣarakṣeti hare narahare prabho \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. All of them lifted up Radha and started crying. О lord, О Hari, "Save us ".

## \|\| 126.78 \|\|

*gopya ūcuḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇa tvayā rādhā mṛtā ca naḥ \|*  
*rādhāṃ jīvaya bhadraṃ te yāsyāmaḥ kānanaṃ vayam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. The cowherdesses said – О Krishna what have you done? Our Radha is dead. You bring her back to life. You will be prosperous. All of us shall retired to the forest.

## \|\| 126.79-81 \|\|

*anyathā strīvadhaṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmaḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*gopīnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā rādhikāyāśca mādhavaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*uvāca jīvayāmāsa mudhādṛṣṭyā ca nārada \|*  
*uttasthau rādhikā devī rudatī māninī satī \|\| 80 \|\|*

*gopyastāṃ bodhayāmāsuḥkroḍe kṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

79-81. Otherwise all of us shall give you the blemish of killing a woman. О Narada, on hearing the words of the cowherdesses, the lord of Radhika, Madhava spoke the words which were like nectar and with his lovable glance at her brought her back to life. The proud Radha got up while sobbing. Thereafter all the cowherdesses took Radha in their lap and started talking to her.

## \|\| 126.82 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrṛṇu rādhe pravakṣyāmi jñānamādhyātmikaṃ param \|*  
*yacchrutvā hāliko mūrkhaḥ sadyo bhavati paṇḍitaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Shri Krishna said – О Radha, I shall impart the divine knowledge to you hearing which even a ploughman becomes immensely intelligent.

## \|\| 126.83 \|\|

*jātyā'haṃ cagatāṃ svāmī kiṃ rukmiṇyādiyoṣitām \|*  
*kāryakāraṇarūpo'haṃ vyakto rādhe pṛthak pṛthak \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. I am the lord of the universe since birth then what to speak of the woman like Rukmini and others, I possess the personality because of my being the cause of the deeds as well as the deeds themselves.

## \|\| 126.84 \|\|

*ekātmā'haṃ ca viśveṣāṃ jātyā jyotirmayaḥ svayam \|*  
*sarvaprāṇiṣu vyaktyā cāpyābrahmāditṛṇādiṣu \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. I myself represent divine lustre, I happen to be the soul of the entire universe and pervade all the creatures right from the blade of grass to Brahma.

## \|\| 126.85 \|\|

*ekasmiṃśca bhuktavati na tuṣṭo'nyo janastathā \|*  
*mayyātmani gate'pyeko mṛto'pyanyaḥ sujīvati \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Since, with the taking of food by one, others are not satisfied, similarly with my departure from the body one dies but the others remain alive.

## \|\| 126.86-87 \|\|

*jātyā'haṃ kṛṣṇarūpaśca paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam \|*  
*goloke gokule puṇye kṣetre vṛndāvane vane \|\| 86 \|\|*

*dvibhujo gopaveṣaśca svayaṃ rādhāpatiḥ śiśuḥ \|*  
*gopālairgopikābhiśca sahitaḥ kāmadhenubhiḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. I am complete in all respect in the form of Krishna. Since my birth I remain present with two arms in Goloka, Gokula and Vrindavana being the lord of Radha and also play as a child with Yashoda in the form of a cowherd; all the cowherds, the cowherdesses, are associated with me.

## \|\| 126.88 \|\|

*caturbhujo'haṃ vaikuṇṭhe dvidhārūpaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*lakṣmīsarasvatīkāntaḥ satataṃ śāntavigrahaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. I remain in Vaikuntha with four arms and appear as the beloved of Lakshmi and Sarasvati there in peaceful form.

## \|\| 126.89 \|\|

*yanmānasī sindhukanyā martyalakṣmīpatirbhuvi \|*  
*śvetadvīpe ca śrīrīde tatrāpi ca caturbhujaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. I also appear over the earth in Shveta-dvipa in the ocean of milk as the husband of ManasI, Sindhukanya and Martya-Lakshmi. There also I appear in four armed form.

## \|\| 126.90 \|\|

*ahaṃ nārāyaṇarṣiśca naro dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*dharmavaktā ca dharmiṣṭho dharmavartmapravartakaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. I happen to be the sage Narayana, the profounder of Dharma. I am devoted to Dharma and those who follow the path of Dharma are attached to me.

## \|\| 126.91 \|\|

*śāntirlakṣmīsvarūpā ca dharmiṣṭhā ca pativratā \|*  
*atra tasyāḥ patirahaṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. The extremely religious and chaste Lakshmi happens to be my spouse and I happen to be her lord in the sacred land of Bharata.

## \|\| 126.92 \|\|

*siddheśaḥ siddhidaḥ sākṣātkapilo'haṃ satīpatiḥ \|*  
*nānārūpadharo'haṃ ca vyaktibhedena sundari \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. I am the lord of siddhas and bestower of siddhis and also appear in the form of Kapila. О beautiful one, thus I take to several forms according to the exigencies of the situation.

## \|\| 126.93-95 \|\|

*ahaṃ caturbhujaḥ śaśvaddvārvatyāṃ rukmiṇīvatiḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ kṣīrodaśāyī ca satyabhāmāgṛhe śubhe \|\| 93 \|\|*

*anyāsāṃ mandire'haṃ ca kāyavyūhātpṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*ahaṃ nārāyaṇarṣiśca phālgunasyāsya sārathiḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*sa nararṣirdharmaputro madaṃśo balavānbhuvi \|*  
*tapasā''rādhitastena sārathye'haṃ ca puṣkare \|\| 95 \|\|*

93-95. In the two-armed form, I always remain in Dvaraka as the, lord of Rukmini. I sleep in the ocean of milk and also dwell in the abode of Satyabhama and other queens taking to different forms. I functioned as the charioteer of Arjuna. Arjuna happens to be a human sage, the son of Dharma, is quite valorous and was born on the earth from my urns a. He had performed great tapas in the Puskara-ksetra for myself performing as his charioteer.

## \|\| 126.96-97 \|\|

*yathā tvaṃ rādhikā devī goleke gokule tathā \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīrbhavatī ca sarasvatī \|\| 96 \|\|*

*bhavatī martyalakṣmīśca kṣīrodaśāyinaḥ priyā \|*  
*dharmaputravadhūstvaṃ ca śāntirlakṣmīsvarūpiṇī \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. О dear, you are Radhika in the Goloka, you are the same in Gokula. You happen to be Maha-Lakshmi and Sarasvati of the Vaikuntha. You happen to be the Martya-Lakshmi in the ocean of milk. You are the daughter-in-law of Dharma and appear in the form of Lakshmi with peaceful form

## \|\| 126.98-99 \|\|

*kapilasya priyā kāntābhārate bhavatī satī \|*  
*tvaṃ sītā mithilāyāṃ ca tvacchāyā draupadī satī \|\| 98 \|\|*

*dvāravatyāṃ mahālkṣmīrbhavatī rukmiṇī satī \|*

98-99. You happen to be the chaste Bharati, the dearest wife of the sage Kapila in the land of Bharata. You are the one known as Sita in Mithila. you happen to be shadow of the chaste Draupadi, you also appear in the form of Maha-Lakshmi in Dvaraka and Rukmini as well. Draupadi who was born of your ray became the spouse of the Pandavas

## \|\| 126.100-101 \|\|

*rāvaṇena hṛtā tvaṃ ca svaṃ ca rāmasya kāminī \|*

*paripūrṇatamo'haṃ ca paramātmā parātparaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

100-101. You are Sita of Rama and was abducted by Ravana. О chaste one, you appear in different forms in the universe and similarly I also appear in different forms in the universe. I happen to be the complete supreme soul and beyond everybody

## \|\| 126.102 \|\|

*iti te kathitaṃ sarvamādhyātmikamidaṃ sati \|*

102\. O chaste one, I have therefore imparted to you the entire divine knowledge. О Radha, supreme goddess, you forgive me for all the sins.

## \|\| 126.103 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā parituṣṭā ca rādhikā \|*

103\. On hearing the words of Krishna, Radha as well as the cowherdesses felt satisfied and started offering their salutation to Krishna.

## Chapter 127

## \|\| 127.1 \|\|

*atha saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā prahṛṣṭā gopikā mudā \|*

*yojanāyatavistīrṇa gṛhestriśatakoṭibhiḥ \|*

18-22. The chariot was a yojana in length and width and had a hundred crores of chambers studded with gems and other precious ones. It moved with the speed of wind and had arrived from Goloka having thousands of wheels and the horses. It was decorated with the crores of gem-studded pillars and the small fringes. The gems, sapphire, emeralds and other precious stones studded in the pillar looked quite charming. It contained several types of paintings, white fly-whisks, the mirrors and the divines clothes besides several garlands, It had innumerable beds made of gems and decorated with flowers and sandal-paste. It had lakhs of cowherdesses having the similar type of bodies and costumes.

Thereafter he took round Radha to Vispandaka, Surasana, Mahendra, Nandanavana and the peaks of Sumeru mountain, the charming Gandhamadana mountain, beautiful hills, caves in the forest, extremely secret flower orchard, the waters of the rivers and rivulets, the sea-shore, the forest of Parijata flowers, the pools of Subhadra, Puspabhadra and Narayana, the abode of wind god, the Malaya mountain which is the abode of the gods, Chitrakuta, Bhadrakuta, Pancakuta and Sukuta on the golden land of the gods, on the islands in the oceans the heaven, the beautiful Chandrasarovar and the asramas of the sages. *āśliśya bhṛśamuccaiśca siṣeca netrajairjalaiḥ \|*

He was holding a flute in his hand and was adorned with the gem-studded ornaments; he appeared of the age of eleven years and was clad in yellow lower garment and the locks of hair were decorated with the feather of peacock and the garland of jasmine flowers.

Thereafter, Yashoda took Radha and Madhava in the palace, where she performed all the welfare ceremonies and served food to the Brahmanas, the cowherdesses were also adored in the same way as the people adore the sages. Thereafter delightfully the Brahmanas were given the gems, the precious stones, gold, jewels, emeralds, Gajaratna, Goratna, Asvaratna, paddy and the land with standing crops, beside the costumes.

## Chapter 128

## \|\| 128.1-2 \|\|

*athāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇaśca samāhvānaṃ gopāṃścāpi cakāra saḥ \|*  
*bhāṇḍīre vaṭamūle ca tatra svayamuvāsa ha \|\| 1 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said – Shri Krishna was surrounded by the cowherds and he himself was seated under the banyan tree in the Bhandira forest. It was the same place where the Brahmana women had served him the food. Radha took her seat to the left of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 128.3 \|\|

*dakṣiṇe nandagopaśca yaśodāsahitastathā \|*

## \|\| 128.4 \|\|

4\. AH the cowherdesses, cowherds, relatives and the friends also took their seat. The lord then spoke to Nanda the appropriate words.

## \|\| 128.5 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu nanda pravakṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ samayocitam \|*

## \|\| 128.6 \|\|

6\. All the creatures right from the blade of grass to Brahma are perishable like the lightening in the cloud or the line drawn on the water or the water bubbles. You take it from me.

## \|\| 128.7-8 \|\|

*mathurāyāṃ sarvamuktaṃ nāvaśeṣaṃ ca kiṃcana \|*

7-8. I have already spoken this in Mathura and nothing is left out. In the forest of banana trees Radha had spoken of this to Yashoda. It is completely truthful and removes the darkness of illusion, serving as a lamp. Therefore disowning all the false illusion get yourself devoted towards the eternal-abode.

## \|\| 128.9 \|\|

*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ harṣakaraṃ param \|*

10\. Taking to me to be the eternal Brahman, you should devote your mind towards the same, removing the feeling my being son and achieve the eternal abode.

## \|\| 128.11 \|\|

*golokaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ sārdhaṃ gokulavāsibhiḥ \|*  
*ārātkalerāgamanaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Now the time for the arrival of Kaliyuga is meaning which destroys the root of the deeds. Therefore all of you together with the residents of Gokula should go to Goloka.

## \|\| 128.12 \|\|

*strīpuṃsorniyamo nāsti jātīnāṃ ca tathaiva ca \|*

12\. In the Kaliyuga there are no rules for the man and woman nor are there any rule for the castes. The Brahmanas would never perform sandhya and would not wear yajnopavita.

## \|\| 128.13 \|\|

*yajñasūtraṃ ca tilakaṃ śeṣaṃ luptaṃ suniścitam \|*

13\. Or sometimes they would wear the Yajnasutra and tilakam and would be deprived of other religions duties, they would cohabited during the day time and would indulge in irreligious ways.

## \|\| 128.14 \|\|

*yajñānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasāṃ luptameva ca \|*  
*kedārakanyāśāpena dharmo nāstyeva kevalam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The yajna, vratas and performing of tapas would disappear, the dharma would disappear totally from the earth, because of the curse of the daughter of Kedara.

## \|\| 128.15 \|\|

*svacchandagāminīstrīrṇā patiśca satataṃ vaśe \|*

15\. The husband would be ruled by the woman who could move independently. Such woman would denounce her husband always throughout the day and night.

## \|\| 128.16-17 \|\|

*prādhānyaṃ strīkuṭumbānāṃ strīṇāṃ ca satataṃ vraja \|*

*kalau ca yoṣitaḥ sarvā jārasevāsu tatparāḥ \|*  
*śataputrasamaḥ snehastāsāṃ jāre bhaviṣyati \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The woman would always head the families and they would have more importance. All the men would be under the influence of the women and would face defeat everywhere. All the women in the age of Kali would always serve their lovers. They would love the lovers much more.

## \|\| 128.18-19 \|\|

*dadāti tasmai bhakṣyaṃ ca yathā bhṛtyāya kopataḥ \|*  
*sasmitā sakaṭākṣā sā'mṛtadṛṣṭyā nirantaram \|\| 18 \|\|*

*jāraṃ paśyati kāmena viṣadṛṣṭyā patiṃ sadā \|*  
*satataṃ gauravaṃ tāsāṃ snehaṃ ca jārabāndhave \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. A women would serve food to her husband with anger in the same day as the food served to a servant. But she would look at the lover with the side-glance and her sight could be filled with nectar. She would look at her husband like poison. Such woman would always feel attracted towards her lover.

## \|\| 128.20 \|\|

*patyau karaprahāraṃ ca nityaṃ nityaṃ karoti ca \|*  
*miṣṭānnaṃ śraddhayā bhaktyā jārāya pradadāti ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. They would man-handle the husbands always but will show enough of grace to the lovers.

## \|\| 128.21 \|\|

*veṣayuktā ca satataṃ jārasevanatatparā \|*  
*prāṇā bandhurgatiścā''tmā kalau jāraśca yauṣitām \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. They would always remain ready to serve the lovers decorating themselves. In the age of Kali the lovers would be the life of the ladies and would be like brothers, the movement and the soul.

## \|\| 128.22 \|\|

*luptā cātithisevā ca praluptaṃ viṣṇusevanam \|*  
*pitṛṇāmarcanaṃ caiva devānāṃ ca tathaiva ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In the age of Kali, the adoration of the guests, Vishnu, manes and the gods would disappear.

## \|\| 128.23 \|\|

*viṣṇuvaiṣṇavayordveṣī satataṃ ca naro bhavet \|*  
*vāmamantropāsakāśca caturvarṇāśca tatparāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The people would always be envious of Vishnu and the Vaishnavas, all the people of the four varnas would get attracted towards Vamacara.

## \|\| 128.24-26 \|\|

*śālagrāmaṃ ca tulasīṃ kuśaṃ gaṅgodakaṃ tathā \|*  
*na spṛśenmānavo dhūrto mlecchācārarataḥ sadā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvabījakam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ śaśvaddātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tyaktvā māṃ parayā bhaktyā kṣudrasaṃpatpradāyinam \|*  
*vedanighnaṃ vāmamantraṃ japedvipraśca māyayā \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. The people would remain under the influence of mlecchas and would never touch Shalagrama, Tulasi, kusa or the water of the Ganga. The Brahmanas also influenced with illusion disown the cause of all the causes, the seed of all, bestower or pleasure and moksa and all the riches would follow the vama-mantra which is the killer of the Vedas.

## \|\| 128.27 \|\|

*sanātanī viṣṇumāyā vañcitaṃ taṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*mamā''jñayā bhagavatī jagatāṃ ca duratyayā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The eternal goddess Bhagavati, who is also called Vishnumaya, would deprived such Brahmanas of my devotion at my command.

## \|\| 128.28 \|\|

*kalerdaśasahasrāṇi madarcā bhuvi tiṣṭhati \|*  
*tadardhāni ca varṣāṇi gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. In the age of Kaliyuga I would continue to be adored on earth for ten thousand years and Ganga would flow on earth for five thousand years in Kaliyuga.

## \|\| 128.29 \|\|

*tulasī viṣṇubhaktāśca yāvadgaṅgā ca kīrtanam \|*  
*purāṇāni ca svalpāni tāvadeva mahītale \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Till such time the Ganga flows on the earth, the Tulasi plant, devotion of Vishnu and reciting of the Puranas continue you would also continue.

## \|\| 128.30 \|\|

*mama cotkīrtanaṃ nāsti etadante kalau vraja \|*  
*ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti kirātā balinaḥ śaṭhāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О lord of Vraja, no one would recite my name in Kaliyuga. The Bhllas, the wicked people would become of the same types.

## \|\| 128.31 \|\|

*pitroḥ sevā guroḥ sevā sevā ca devaviprayoḥ \|*  
*vivarjitā narāḥ sarve cātithīnāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. A person should be deprived of the adoration of his parents, the teacher, the gods, Brahmanas and the guest.

## \|\| 128.32 \|\|

*sasyahīnā bhavetpṛthvī sā'nāvṛṣṭyā nirantaram \|*  
*phalahīno'pi vṛkṣaśca jalahīnā sarittathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The land would be deprived of truthfulness, the trees could be deprived of the fruit and the rivers would be deprived of the water.

## \|\| 128.33 \|\|

*vedahīno brāhmaṇaśca balahīnaśca bhūpatiḥ \|*  
*jātihīnā janāḥ sarve mleccho bhūpo bhaviṣyati \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The Brahman as would be deprived of the knowledge of the Vedas, the king would become weak. There would be classless society and the king would turn as mlecchas.

## \|\| 128.34 \|\|

*bhṛtyavattāḍayettātaṃ putraḥ śiṣyastathā gurum \|*  
*kāntaṃ ca tāḍayetkāntā lubdhakukkuṭavadgṛhī \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The son would torture the father and similarly the pupil would behave with the teacher like a servant. In the house wife would pounce upon the husband like a greedy cock.

## \|\| 128.35 \|\|

*naśyanti sakalā lokāḥ kalau śeṣe ca pāpinaḥ \|*  
*sūryāṇāmātapātkecijjalaughenāpi kecana \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. In the last phase of Kali all the sinners would get destroyed. Some of them would be destroyed with the scorching heat of sun while others would be destroyed with the over flowing waters.

## \|\| 128.36 \|\|

*he vaiśyendra pratikalau na naśyati vasuṃdharā \|*  
*punaḥ sṛṣṭau bhavetsatyaṃ satyabījaṃ nirantaram \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The lord of the Vaishyas, the earth would be destroyed in the Kaliyuga. At the time of creation, the seed of truthfulness women again start sprouting.

## \|\| 128.37-41 \|\|

*etasminnantare vipra rathameva manoharam \|*  
*caturyojanavistīrṇamūrdhve ca pañcayojanam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ ratnendrasāranirmitam \|*  
*amlānapārijātānāṃ mālājālavirājitam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*maṇīnāṃ kaustubhānāṃ ca bhūṣaṇena vibhūṣitam \|*  
*amūlyaratnakalaśaṃ hīrahāravilambitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*manoharaiḥ pariṣvaktaṃ sahasrakoṭimandiraiḥ \|*  
*sahasradvayacakraṃ ca sahasradvayaghoṭakam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*sūkṣmavastrācchāditaṃ ca gopīkoṭībhirāvṛtam \|*  
*golokādāgataṃ tūrṇaṃ dadṛśuḥ sahasā vraje \|\| 41 \|\|*

37-41. О Brahmana, in the meantime a divine chariot arrived there, which was five yojanas in length and four yojanas in width. It had the lustre of the fine crystal gem. It was built with the best of gems and was decorated with the garland of Parijdta flowers. It had a number of ornaments made of kaustubha gem. It had the pitchers of valuable gems and the garland of rubies were hanging; it had a crore of chambers in it. It was yoked with a two thousand of chandras and two thousand horses, it had a large number of fine silken garments and was surrounded with crores of cowherdesses. The chariot which had arrived from Goloka was witnessed by all the people.

## \|\| 128.42-44 \|\|

*kṛṣṇājñayā tamāruhya yayurgolokamuttamam \|*  
*rādhā kalāvatī devī dhanyā cāyonisaṃbhavā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*golokāda gatā gopyaścāyonisaṃbhavāśca tāḥ \|*  
*śrutipatnyaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ svaśarīreṇa nārada \|\| 43 \|\|*

*sarve tyaktvā śarīrāṇi naśvarāṇi suniścitam \|*  
*golokaṃ ca yayau rādhā sārghaṃ gokulavāsibhiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. At the command of Shri Krishna, all the people mounted on the chariot and then went to Goloka. О Narada, Radha and Kalavati who deserves to be thanked, were never born from any human womb. Both of them were born without any human contact. The spouses of s rut is had appeared in their forms. They also shedding their human bodies went to Goloka. Thereafter Radha also went to Goloka together with the people of Gokula,

## \|\| 128.45 \|\|

*dadarśa virajātīrra nānāratnavibhūṣitam \|*  
*taduttīrya yayau vipra śataśṛṅgaṃ ca parvatam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О Brahman, on the way they came across the banks of the Viraja river, which were adorned with several types of gems, crossings the Viraja river, they reached the mountains of hundred peaks.

## \|\| 128.46 \|\|

*nānāmaṇigaṇākīrṇaṃ rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam \|*  
*tato yayau kiyaddūraṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. There, they found the Rasamandala, which was decorated with the best of gems. The charming Vmdavana filled with flowers, was located at some distance from that place.

## \|\| 128.47 \|\|

*sā dadarśākṣayavaṭamūrdhve triśatayojanam \|*  
*śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ śākhākoṭisamāvṛtam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The eternal banyan was also seen by them which was three hundred yojana in height and hundred yojana in width and had crores of branches.

## \|\| 128.48 \|\|

*raktavarṇaiḥ phalaughaiśca sthūlairapi vibhūṣitam \|*  
*gopīkoṭisahasraiśca sārdhaṃ vṛndā manoharā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The fruits of red colour were decorating the tree. The charming Vmda was present under the tree with thousands of cowherdesses.

## \|\| 128.49 \|\|

*anuvrajaṃ sādaraṃ ca sasmitā sā samāyayau \|*  
*avaruṅya rathāttūrṇaṃ rādhāṃ sā praṇanāma ca \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Finding her there Radha at one, descended from the chariot and went to her gracefully. Vmda on her, part bowed in reverence to Radha.

## \|\| 128.50 \|\|

*rāseśvarīṃ tāṃ saṃbhāṣya praviveśa svamālayam \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsane ramye hīrahārasamanvite \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Then talking to her she took her to her abode. Vmda then made Radha to sit on the gem-studded lion throne and she herself started serving at her feet. The seven female friends started moving the white fly-whisks.

## \|\| 128.51 \|\|

*vṛndā tāṃ vāsayāmāsa pādasevanatatparā \|*  
*saptabhiśca sakhībhiśca sevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The cowherdesses arrived there to have an audience with Radha the great goddess. Thereafter Radha arranged for separate dwelling places for Nanda and others. Thereafter the blissful Radha accompanied by the cowherdesses moved towards her abode.

## \|\| 128.52-53 \|\|

*āyayurgopikāḥ sarvā draṣṭuṃ tāṃ parameśvarīm \|*  
*nandādikaṃ prakalpyaitadrādhā vāsaṃ pṛthakapṛthak \|\| 52 \|\|*

*paramānandarūpā sā paramānandapūrvakam \|*  
*svaveśmani mahāramye pratasthe gopikā saha \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. The people of Gokula were assured by Krishna, who spoke to them the sweet and beneficial words.

## Chapter 129

## \|\| 129.1-4 \|\|

*athaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavāṃstatra paripūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā sārokyamokṣaṃ ca sadyo gokulavāsinām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*uvāsa pañcabhirgopairbhāṇḍīre vaṭamūlake \|*  
*dadarśa gokulaṃ sarva gokulaṃ vyākulaṃ tathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*arakṣakaṃ ca vyastaṃ ca śūnyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam \|*  
*yogenāmṛtavṛṣṭyā ca kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*gopībhiśca tathā gopaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*tathā vṛndāvanaṃ caiva suramyaṃ ca manoharam \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Narayana said – The complete lord Krishna, together with the people of Gokula finding the Salokya type of salvation there, sat under the banyan tree in the Bhandira-vana accompanied by five cowherds. He had a glance on the entire Gokula. At that point of time, Gokula seemed upset, without a protector and extremely busy. Vmdavana too looked deserted. At that point of time the merciful lord Krishna filled Gokula with cowherds and cowherdesses sprinkling the nectar there. He made Vmdavana quite charming and beautiful.

## \|\| 129.5 \|\|

*gokulasthāśca gopāśca samāśvāsaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ hitaṃ nītaṃ ca durlabham \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The people of Gokula were assured by Krsna, who spoke to them the sweet and beneficial words.

## \|\| 129.6-7 \|\|

*śrī bhagavānuvāca he gopagaṇa he bandho sukhaṃ tiṣṭha sthiro bhava \|*  
*ramaṇaṃ priyayā sārdhaṃ suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tāvatprabhṛti kṛṣṇasya puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*adhiṣṭhānaṃ ca satataṃ yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Shri Krishna said – "O cowherd, О brothers, you remain happy and be stable, you enjoy your spouses in the beautiful Rasamandala, Krishna would remain present in Vmdavana till the time of sun and moon".

## \|\| 129.8-11 \|\|

*tathā jagāma bhāṇḍīraṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi \|*  
*svayaṃ śeṣaśca dharmaśca bhavānyā ca bhavaḥsvayam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sūryaścāpi mahendraśca candraścāpi hunāśanaḥ \|*  
*kubero varuṇaścaiva pavanaśca yamastathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*īśānaścāpi devāśca vasavo'ṣṭau tathaiva ca \|*  
*sarve grahāśca rudrāśca munayo manavastathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tvaritāścā''yayuḥ sarve yatrā''ste bhagavānprabhuḥ \|*  
*praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūbhau tamuvāca vidhiḥ svayam \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. Thus speaking, the lord of the universe went to the Bhandira-vana. Thereafter Shesha, Dharma, Gauri and Shiva, Surya, Indra, moon, Agni, Kubera, Varuna, the wind god, Yama, Tsana the gods, eight Vasus, all the planets, the sages and Manus reached the place where lord Krishna was seated. Brahma reaching there prostrated before the lord and said:

## \|\| 129.12 \|\|

*brahmavāca paribūrṇatam brahmasvarūpa nityavigraha \|*  
*jyotiḥsvarūpa parama namo'stu prakṛteḥ para \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Brahma said – О eternal form of Brahman and complete lord, the form of flame, eternal, beyond Prakriti, I bow in, reverence to you.

## \|\| 129.13 \|\|

*sunirlipta nirākāra sākāra dhyānahetunā \|*  
*svecchāmaya paraṃ dhāma paramātmannamo'stu te \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You are completely unattached, invisible and visible only to the devotees, you are the one who moves at will, the eternal abode, the supreme soul, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 129.14 \|\|

*sarvakāryasvarūpeśa kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇa \|*  
*brahmeśaśeṣadeveśa sarveśa te no \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. You are the lord and the form of all the deeds, cause of all the causes, you are Brahma, Shiva and Shesha, the lord of the gods, the lord of all, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 129.15 \|\|

*sarasvatīśa padmeśa pārvatīśa parātpara \|*  
*he sāvitrīśa rādheśa rāseśvara no \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Of all the three worlds, earth is quite graceful over which you have placed your feet purifying the same by witnessing your lotus-like feet, all the gods and the sages, have been feeling graceful.

## \|\| 129.16 \|\|

*sarveṣāmādibhūtarstvaṃ sarvaḥ sarveśvarastathā \|*  
*sarvapātā ca saṃhartā sṛṣṭirūpa no \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The one who is beyond the comprehension of the great sages who is difficult to be adored the same lord has appeared before us.

## \|\| 129.17 \|\|

*tvatpādapadmarajasā dhanyā pūtā vasuṃdharā \|*  
*śūnyarūpā tvayi gate he nātha paramaṃ padam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. You are the lord of Sarasvati, Lakshmi, Parvati and are the lord of Savitri, Radha and divine dance, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 129.18 \|\|

*yatpañcaviṃśatyadhikaṃ varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ gatam \|*  
*tyaktvemāṃ svapadaṃ yāsi rudatīṃ virahāturām \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. You are the beginning of all, the lord of all, the protector of all, destroyer of all and creator of all, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 129.19 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca brahmaṇā prārthitastvaṃ ca samāgatya vasuṃdharām \|*  
*bhūbhāraharaṇaṃ kṛtvā prayāsi svapadaṃ vibho \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. With the touch of the dust from your lotus-like feet, the earth has been purified, becoming graceful, but О lord, with your departure for your eternal abode, it will get deserted.

## \|\| 129.20 \|\|

*trailokye pṛthivī dhanyā sadyaḥ pūtā padāṅkitā \|*  
*vayaṃ ca munayo dhanyāḥ sākṣāddṛṣṭvā padāmbujam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. A hundred and twenty five years have passed and now you are proceeding to your divine abode deserting the earth.

## \|\| 129.21 \|\|

*dhyānāsādhyo durārādhyo munīnāmūrdhvaretasām \|*  
*asmākamapi yaśceśaḥ so'dhunā cākṣuṣo bhuvi \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Mahadeva said – О virtues one, you had incarnated on earth at the request of Brahma and relieved the earth of her burden; now you are going back to your abode.

## \|\| 129.22 \|\|

*vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvani yasya lomasu \|*  
*devastasya mahāviṣṇurvāsudevo mahītale \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Vishnu happens to be the abode of all, in the hair-pits of whom innumerable globes reside. The same lord Maha-Vishnu incarnated on earth in the form of Krishna.

## \|\| 129.23 \|\|

*suciraṃ tapasā labdhaṃ siddhendrāṇāṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*yatpādapadmamatulaṃ cākṣuṣaṃ sarvajīvinām \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Whose lotus-like feet are beyond the reach of the siddhas and would be achieved only by performing tapas for prolonged periods, the same lord has become visible to us.

## \|\| 129.24-25 \|\|

*ananta uvāca tvamananto hi bhagavannāhameva kalāṃśakaḥ \|*  
*viśvaikasthe kṣudrakūrme maśako'haṃ gaje yathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*asaṃkhyaśeṣāḥ kūrmāśca brahmaviṣaṇuśivātmakāḥ \|*  
*asaṃkhyāni ca viśvāni teṣāmīśaḥ svayaṃ bhavān \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Ananta said – You are the lord without limitations and I happen to be and arhsa of your ray. Lodged in a secluded place in the universe remain on the head of the tortoise like a small mosquito on the elephant head. There are innumerable Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and the serpents Shesha beside tortoise. There are innumerable globe's but you happen to be the lord of all.

## \|\| 129.26-27 \|\|

*asmākamīdṛśaṃ nātha sudinaṃ kva bhaviṣyati \|*  
*svapnādṛṣṭaścayaśceśaḥ sa dṛṣṭaḥ sarvajīvinām \|\| 26 \|\|*

*nātha prayāsi golokaṃ pūtāṃ kṛtvā vasuṃdharām \|*  
*tāmanāthāṃ rudantīṃ ca nimagnāṃ śokasāgare \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. О lord when shall the auspicious day arrive? The lord who is. invisible even in dream, the same lord appeared before all the creatures. О lord, you are leaving for Goloka purifying the earth and the same earth who has been plunged in grief is now crying.

## \|\| 129.28 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ vedāḥstotuṃ na śaktā yaṃ brahmeśānādayastathā \|*  
*tameva stavanaṃ kiṃ vā vayaṃ kurmo namo'stu te \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The gods said – The one who is beyond the comprehension of the Vedas, Brahma, Shiva and all the gods, who are unable to offer prayer to him, what type of prayer can be offered to him. We offer our salutation to you.

## \|\| 129.29 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā devāste prayayurdvārakāṃ purīm \|*  
*tatrasthaṃ bhagavantaṃ ca draṣṭuṃ śīghraṃ mudā'nvitāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Thus speaking all the gods getting filled with delight, hurriedly left the place and reached the city of Dvaraka to have an audience with the lord.

## \|\| 129.30 \|\|

*atha teṣāṃ ca gopālā yayurgolokamuttamam \|*  
*pṛthivī kampitā bhītā calantaḥ saptasāgarāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Thereafter Gopala left for the blissful Goloka. The earth started shaking together with the seven oceans.

## \|\| 129.31 \|\|

*hataśriyaṃ dvārakāṃ ca tyaktvā ca brahmaśāpataḥ \|*  
*mūrtiṃ kadambamūlasthāṃ viveśa rādhikeśvaraḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Dvaraka was deserted because of the curse of Brahma and Shri Krishna the lord of Radha left the city and entered the image that was lying under the foot of kadamba tree.

## \|\| 129.32 \|\|

*te sarve cairakāyuddhe nipeturyādavāstathā \|*  
*citāmāruhya devyaśca prayayuḥ svāmibhiḥ saha \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thereafter all the Yadavas were destroyed fighting among themselves, using the red-grass as the weapon. Their spouses also met with their end jumping in the burning flames together with their husbands.

## \|\| 129.33 \|\|

*arjunaḥ svapuraṃ gatvā samuvāca yudhiṣṭhiram \|*  
*sa rājā bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ yayau svargaṃ ca bhāryayā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Thereafter, Arjuna went to Hastinapur and communicated the news to Yudhisthira who also together with his wife and brothers went to the heaven.

## \|\| 129.34 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā kadambamūlasthaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*devā brahmādayaste ca praṇemurbhaktipūrvakam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Finding lord Krishna lodged in the form of an image in the root of the kadamba tree, all the gods including Brahma went there and bowed to him with devotion.

## \|\| 129.35-37 \|\|

*tuṣṭuvuḥ paramātmānaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum \|*  
*śyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ bhūṣitaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānaṃ śobhitaṃ vanamālayā \|*  
*atīva sundaraṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ manoharam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*vyādhāstrasaṃyutaṃ pādapadmaṃ padmādivanditam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā brahmādidevāṃstānabhayaṃ sasmitaṃ dadau \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. Не was having the dark complexion, of the tender age of a boy and his body was adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments. He was clad in the divine garments, having the lustre of the fire. He was wearing the long garland of forest flowers, was extremely beautiful, peaceful, lord of Lakshmi, holding divine weapon in the hand, served by Lakshmi and other goddesses at his feet. All the gods then offered their prayer to Narayana the supreme soul and pervading god. Lord Krishna also looking at the gods provided protection to them smilingly.

## \|\| 129.38 \|\|

*pṛthivīṃ tāṃ samāśvāsya rudatīṃ premavihvalām \|*  
*vyādhaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa paraṃ svapadamuttamam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The lord assured the earth who was upset and was crying and gave the hunter his eternal abode.

## \|\| 129.39-40 \|\|

*balasya tejaḥ śeṣe ca viveśa paramādbhutam \|*  
*pradyumnasya ca kāme vai vā'niruddhasya brahmaṇi \|\| 39 \|\|*

*ayonisaṃbhavā devī mahālakṣmīśca rukmiṇī \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau sākṣātsvaśarīreṇa nārada \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. O Narada, the illumining lustre of Balarama enter Sheshanaga, the lustre of Pradyumna entered Kamadeva and that of Aniruddha in Brahma. The eternal goddess Rukminl in the form of Maha-Lakshmi proceeded on to Vaikuntha with her human body.

## \|\| 129.41 \|\|

*satyabhāmā pṛthivyāṃ ca viveśa kamalālayā \|*  
*svayaṃ jāmbavatī devī pārvatyāṃ viśvamātari \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Satyabhama who happened to be the amsha of Lakshmi, entered into the earth. Thereafter Jambavati entered the body of Parvati, the mother of the universe.

## \|\| 129.42 \|\|

*yā yā devyaśca yāsāṃ cāpyaṃśarupāśca bhūtale \|*  
*tasyāṃ tasyāṃ praviviśustā eva ca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. All the goddesses who happened to be the athshas of whichever goddess entered their bodies separately.

## \|\| 129.43 \|\|

*sāmbasya tejaḥ skande ca viveśa paramādbhutam \|*  
*kaśyape vasudevaścāpyadivyāṃ devakī tathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The unique tejas of Samba entered the body of Skanda. The tejas of Vasudeva entered Kashyapa while that of Devaki entered Aditi.

## \|\| 129.44 \|\|

*rukmiṇīmandiraṃ tyakatvā samastāṃ dvārakāṃ purīm \|*  
*sa jagrāha samudraśca praphullavadanekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The ocean having a delightful face and the eyes submerged the entire city of Dvaraka under water leaving aside the abode of Rukmini.

## \|\| 129.45 \|\|

*lapaṇodaḥ samāgatya tuṣṭāva puruṣottamam \|*  
*ruroda tadviyogena sāśrunetraśca vihvalaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Thereafter the ocean of saline water arrived and offered prayer to Purusottama and started crying, filling his eyes with tears, as a result of the separation from the lord.

## \|\| 129.46-47 \|\|

*gaṅgā sarasvatī padmāvatī ca yamunā tathā \|*  
*godāvarī svarṇarekhā kāverī narmadā mune \|\| 46 \|\|*

*śarāvatī bāhṛdā ca kṛtamālā ca puṇyadā \|*  
*samāyayuśca tāḥ sarvāḥ praṇemuḥ parameśvaram \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. О sage, all the rivers like Ganga, Sarasvati, Padma, Yamuna, Godavari, Svarnarekha, Kaveri, Narmada, Sarasvati, Bahuda and the auspicious Krtamala arrived there and started offering their salutation to the lord.

## \|\| 129.48 \|\|

*uvāca jāhnavī devī rudatī parameśvaram \|*  
*sāśrunetrā'tidīnā sā virahajvarakātarā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Getting upset with the fever of separation her eyes filled with tears, the Ganga spoke to lord Krishna while crying.

## \|\| 129.49 \|\|

*bhāgīrathayuvāca he nātha ramaṇaśreṣṭha yāsi golokamuttamam \|*  
*asmākaṃ kā gatiścātra bhaviṣyati kalau yuge \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Bhaglrathi said – О lovable lord, you are now proceeding to GoJoka. What shall be our position during the age of Kali?

## \|\| 129.50-51 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca kaleḥ pañcasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi tiṣṭha bhūtale \|*  
*pāpāni pāpino yāni tubhyaṃ dāsyanti snānata \|\| 50 \|\|*

*manmantropāsakasparśādbhasmībhūtāni tatkṣaṇāt \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti darśanācca snānādeva hi jāhnavi \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. Shri Krishna said – О Ganga, You remain on earth for five thousand years during Kaliyuga. All the sins that are washed in your water would disappear with the reciting of the mantras by the devotees and by the people who earn merit by having a look at you.

## \|\| 129.52 \|\|

*harernāmāni yatraiva purāṇāni bhavanti hi \|*  
*tatra gatvā sāvadhānamābhiḥ sārdhaṃ ca śroṣyasi \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. You. would also listen to the reciting of the name of Hari and the reciting of the Puranas.

## \|\| 129.53 \|\|

*purāṇaśravaṇāccaiva harernāmānukīrtanāt \|*  
*bhasmībhūtāni pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. With the reciting of the Puranas and the name of Hari, the sins like Brahmahatya get destroyed in no time.

## \|\| 129.54-56 \|\|

*bhasmībhūtāni tānyeva vaiṣṇavāliṅganena ca \|*  
*tṛṇāni śuṣkakāṣṭhāni dahanti pāvakā yathā \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tathā'pi vaiṣṇavā loke pāpāni pāpināmapi \|*  
*pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyānyapi ca jāhnavi \|\| 55 \|\|*

*madbhaktānāṃ śarīreṣu santi pūteṣu saṃtatam \|*  
*madbhaktapādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā \|\| 56 \|\|*

54-56. These sins are reduced to ashes with the touch of a Vaishnavas in the same way as the strew is bum it out in the fire flames or the dry-wood is also burnt out in fire. О Ganga, all the holy places which are located on earth, are all enshrined in the bodies of my devotees. The earth gets purified with the dust from the feet of my devotees.

## \|\| 129.57-58 \|\|

*sadyaḥ pūtāni tīrthāni sadyāḥ pūtaṃ jagattathā \|*  
*manmantropāsakā viprā ye maducchiṣṭabhojinaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*māmeva nityaṃ dhyāyante te matprāṇādhikāḥ priyāḥ \|*  
*tadupasparśamātreṇa pūto vāyuśca pāvakaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. All the holy places get purified at once with the fall of the dust from the feet of my devotee. A Brahmana who is devoted to me and recites my mantras also consumes the naivedya and always remains devoted to me, he becomes dearer to me than my life. With the very touch of his body, the wind as well as the fire get purified.

## \|\| 129.59-61 \|\|

*kalerdaśasahasrāṇi madbhaktāḥ santi bhūtale \|*  
*ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti madbhakteṣu gateṣu ca \|\| 59 \|\|*

*madbhaktaśūnyā pṛthivī kaligrastā bhaviṣyati \|*  
*etasminnantare tatra kṛṣṇadehādvinirgataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*caturbhujaśca puruṣaḥ śatacandrasamaprabhaḥ \|*  
*śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrīvatsalāñchanaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. During Kaliyuga my devotees would remain on earth for ten thousand years. In the meantime the four-armed from, having the lustre of hundred of moons, illumining all the directions, holding shamkha, cakra, gada and padma, with Srivatsa mark on his chest, emerged from the body of Krishna.

## \|\| 129.62 \|\|

*sundaraṃ rathamāruhya śrīrodaṃ sa jagāma ha \|*  
*sindhukanyā ca prayayau svayaṃ mūrtimatī satī \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. He at once mounted on the beautiful chariot and proceeded towards the ocean of milk. Lakshmi, the daughter of the ocean also transformed herself into a goddess and left the place.

## \|\| 129.63-64 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇamanasā jātā martyalakṣmīrmanoharā \|*  
*śvetadvīpaṃ gate viṣṇau jagatpālanakartari \|\| 63 \|\|*

*śuddhasattvasvarūpe ca dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ \|*  
*dakṣiṇāṃśaśca dvibhujo gopabārakarūpakaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. With the departure of lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, to Shveta-dvipa, Martya-Lakshmi was born from the mind of Shri Krishna. In his pure and spotless form, Shri Krishna was divided into two forms, his right hand side was having two arms and appeared in the form of a cowherd boy.

## \|\| 129.65-68 \|\|

*napīnajaladaśyāmaḥ śobhitaḥ pītavāsasā \|*  
*śrīvaṃśavadanaḥ śrīmānsasmitaḥ padmalocanaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*śatakoṭīndusaundaryaṃ śatakoṭismaraprabhām \|*  
*dadhānaḥ paramānandaḥ paribūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahmasvarūpo nirguṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*paramātmā ca sarveṣāṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*nityadehaśca bhagavānīśvaraḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*yogino yaṃ vadantyevaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam \|\| 68 \|\|*

65-68. That form had the dark-complexioned of a new cloud, wore pltambara, placing a flute on his mouth, filled with glory, having smiling face, the eyes like the lotus flowers and possessed the lustre of a hundred crores of the moons. He was blissful, having the glory of crores of gods of love, complete lord, like the eternal abode, eternal Brahman, devoid of gunas, the supreme soul, the one who was always graceful to his devotees and takes to human form for their benefit only, having eternal body and was beyond Prakriti. The yogis always adored him as the everlasting flame.

## \|\| 129.69-70 \|\|

*jyotiramyantare nityarūpaṃ bhaktā vidanti yam \|*  
*vedā vadanti satyaṃ yaṃ nityamādyaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*yaṃ vadanti surāḥ sarve paraṃ svecchāmayaṃ prabhūm \|*  
*siddhendrā munayaḥ sarve sarvarūpaṃ vadanti yam \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. The devotees consider him to be the eternal flame of their minds and the Vedas described him as the eternal truth. The great intellectuals conceived him as eternal and everlasting. All the gods describe him as the lord who moved at will. The siddhas and the ascetics conceived him to be omnipresent.

## \|\| 129.71 \|\|

*yamanirvacanīyaṃ ca yogīndraḥ śaṃkaro vadet \|*  
*svayaṃ vidhātā pravadetkāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Shiva, the lord of yogis describes him as inexplicable. The creator of the universe describes him to be the cause of all the causes.

## \|\| 129.72 \|\|

*śeṣo vadedanantaṃ yaṃ navadhārūpamīśvaram \|*  
*tarkāṇāmeva ṣaṇṇāṃ ca ṣaḍvidhaṃ rūpamīpsitam \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The serpent Shesha conceives him to be the lord who could be achieved by nine types of devotion and beyond measure, the divine six types of philosophies project him in six different form.

## \|\| 129.73 \|\|

*vaiṣṇavānāmekarūpaṃ vedānāmekameva ca \|*  
*purāṇānāmekarūpaṃ tasmānnavavidhaṃ smṛtam \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. He has been described to possess the nine forms including one of the Vaishnavas, one of the Vedas, one of the Puranas.

## \|\| 129.74 \|\|

*nyāyo'nirvacanīyaṃ ca yaṃ mataṃ śaṃkaro vadet \|*  
*nityaṃ vaiśeṣikāścā''dyaṃ taṃ vadanti vicakṣaṇāḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. The jurisprudence define him as the one who is beyond conception and this theory is also accepted by Sankara. The Vaisesika doctrine escribes him as eternal and primeval.

## \|\| 129.75 \|\|

*sāṃkhya vadanti taṃ devaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*mīmāṃsā sarvarūpaṃ ca vedāntaḥ sarvakāraṇam \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The Samkhya people, the Sdmkhya Philosophers described him as the fonn of v crlasting flame. The Mlmansd philosophers call him as the form of everything and the Yedanla philosophy describes him to be the cause of all.

## \|\| 129.76 \|\|

*pātañjalo'pyanantaṃ ca vedāḥ satyasvarūpakam \|*  
*svecchāmayaṃ purāṇaṃ ca bhaktāśca nityavigraham \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The Yogashastra of Patanjali described him to be beyond measure and the Vedas take him to be the form of truth. The Puranas described him as the one who moves at will and the devotees always take him to be the one having the eternal form.

## \|\| 129.77 \|\|

*so'yaṃ golokanāthaśca rādheśo nandanandanaḥ \|*  
*gokule gopaveṣaśca puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. The same supreme soul happens to be the lord of Goloka and the beloved of Radha. besides being the son of Nanda. He remains in Gokula and Vrindavana in the form of a cowherd.

## \|\| 129.78 \|\|

*caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe mahālakṣmīpatiḥ svayam \|*  
*nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānyannāma muktikāraṇam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. In Vaikuntha he appears as the four armed lord of Maha-Lakshmi. He happens to be the form of Narayana, the reciting of whose name bestows salvation.

## \|\| 129.79 \|\|

*sakṛnnārāyaṇetyuktvā pumānkalpaśatatrayam \|*  
*gaṅgādisarvatīrtheṣu snāto bhavati nārada \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. О Narada, by reciting the name of Narayana once, a person earns the merit of having a bath in the Ganga for a hundred kalpas.

## \|\| 129.80-81 \|\|

*sunandanandakumudaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ parivāritaḥ \|*  
*śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrīvatsalāñchanaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa bhūṣito vanamālayā \|*  
*devaiḥ stutaśca yānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ svapadaṃ yayau \|\| 81 \|\|*

80-81. Thereafter lord Vishnu went to Vaikuntha surrounded by Sunanda, Nanda and Kumuda, holding samkha, gada, cakra and padma in the hands beside displaying the SrJvatsa mark on the chest, adorned with the kaustubha gem wearing the long garland of forest flowers, mounted on a plane and adored by the gods.

## \|\| 129.82 \|\|

*gate vaikuṇṭhanāthe ca rādheśaśca svayaṃ prabhuḥ \|*  
*cakāra vaṃśīśabdaṃ ca trailokyamohanaṃ param \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. After the departure of the lord of Vaikuntha, Shri Krishna the lord gf Radha played on the flute which attracted the three worlds.

## \|\| 129.83 \|\|

*mūrcchāṃprāpurdevagaṇā munayaścāpi nārada \|*  
*acetanā babhūvuśca māyayā pārvatīṃ vinā \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. О Narada, on hearing the voice of the flute, all the gods and the sages fainted or all those present there were fainted with the illusion of the lord, except Parvati.

## \|\| 129.84-85 \|\|

*uvāca pārvatī devī bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*viṣṇumāyā bhagavatī sarvarūpā sanātanī \|\| 84 \|\|*

*parabrahmasvarūpā yā paramātmasvarūpiṇī \|*  
*saguṇā nirguṇā sā ca parā svecchāmayī satī \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. Thereafter, Parvati who happened to be the illusion of Vishnu, the form of all, eternal Brahman, the form of the supreme soul, possessing qualities as well as without them, the one who moved at will and was the chaste goddess, spoke to the lord.

## \|\| 129.86 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca ekā'haṃ rādhikārūpā goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*rāsaśūnyaṃ ca golokaṃ paripūrṇa kuru prabho \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Parvati said – О lord, I was always in the form of Radhika in the Rasamandala of Goloka. You fill the void in the Goloka by performing the divine dance.

## \|\| 129.87 \|\|

*gaccha tvaṃ rathamāruhya muktāmāṇikyabhūṣitam \|*  
*paribūrṇatamā'haṃ ca tava vaṅaḥ sthalasthitā \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. You proceed mounted on the gem-studded chariot. By residing in your heart I felt myself complete.

## \|\| 129.88-89 \|\|

*tavā''jñayā mahālakṣmīrahaṃ vaikuṇṭhagāminī \|*  
*sarasvatī ca tatraiva vāme pārśve harerapi \|\| 88 \|\|*

*tavāhaṃ manasā jātā sindhukanyā tavā''jñayā \|*  
*sāvitrī vedamātā'haṃ kalayā vidhisaṃnidhau \|\| 89 \|\|*

88-89. At your command I became Maha-Lakshmi the dweller of Vaikuntha. I also functioned there as Sarasvati appearing to the left of lord Hari. I have been born out of your mind and appeared as the daughter of the ocean at your command. I had appeared as Savitri the mother of the Vedas and stayed with Brahma with my athsa.

## \|\| 129.90 \|\|

*taijaḥsu sarvadevānāṃ purā satye tavā''jñayā \|*  
*adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṛta tatra dhṛtaṃ devyā śarīrakam \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Earlier, during the time of Satyayuga, I appeared from the tejas of all the gods at your command and took to the form of a goddess.

## \|\| 129.91 \|\|

*śumbhādayaśca daityāśca nihatāścāvalīlayā \|*  
*durga nihatya turgā'haṃ tripurā tripure vadhe \|\| 91 \|\|*
