91\. I then killed playfully the demons named Sumbha and Nis'umbha beside Durga after which I was given the name of Tripura.

## \|\| 129.92 \|\|

*nihatya raktabījaṃ ca raktabījavināśinī \|*  
*tavā''jñayā dakṣakanyā satī satyasvarūpiṇī \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. By killing the demon named Raktabrja, I came to be known as the destroyer of Raktablja. At your command I became Safi, the daughter of Daksha in the truthful form.

## \|\| 129.93 \|\|

*yogena tyaktvā dehaṃ ca śailajā'haṃ tavā''jñayā \|*  
*tvayā dattavā (ttāḥ śaṃkarāya goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. At you command I discarded that body and then came to be known as the daughter of Himalaya. You had handed me over to Shiva in Rasamandala.

## \|\| 129.94-95 \|\|

*viṣṇubhaktirahaṃ tena viṣṇumāyā ca vaiṣṇavī \|*  
*nārāyaṇasya māyā'haṃ tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā \|\| 94 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā'haṃ ca prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|*  
*mahāviṣṇośca vāsośca jananī rādhikā svayam \|\| 95 \|\|*

94-95. I had been the devotion of Vishnu and as such I came to be known as Vishnumaya or Vaishnavl, I was the illusion of lord Narayana and as such I came to be known as Narayani. I was the beloved of Krishna and was the mother of Maha-Vishnu also known as Radha.

## \|\| 129.96 \|\|

*tavā''jñayā pañcadhā'haṃ pañcaprakṛtirūpiṇī \|*  
*kalākalāṃśayā'haṃ ca devapatnayo gṛhe gṛhe \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. At your command I took to five forms and was known as PancaPrakriti. With my rays or the amsha of my rays, I became the spouses of the gods.

## \|\| 129.97 \|\|

*śīghraṃ gaccha mahābhāga tatrā'haṃ virahāturā \|*  
*govībhiḥ sahitā rāsaṃ bhramantī paritaḥ sadā \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. О virtuous one, you move on at once because I am suffering badly from your separation there, I always roam about in the Rasamandala together with the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 129.98 \|\|

*pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya rasikeśvaraḥ \|*  
*ratnayānaṃ samāruhya yayau golokamuttamam \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Listening to the words of Parvati, Krishna the lord of the divine dance, smiled and mounted on the chariot studded with gems then proceeded to Goloka.

## \|\| 129.99-100 \|\|

*pārvatī bodhayāmāsa svayaṃ devagaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*māyāvaṃśīravācchannaṃ viṣṇumāyā sanātanī \|\| 99 \|\|*

*kṛtvā te hariśabdaṃ ca svagṛhaṃ vismayaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*śivena sārdhaṃ durgā sā prahṛṣṭā svapuraṃ yayau \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. Thereafter Parvati who happened, to be the eternal Vishnumaya, brought the gods back to senses who had been fainted because of the sound of the flute of lord Krishna. Reciting the name of Hari, all the gods then retied astonishingly to their respective abodes, Durga also delightfully want along with Shiva to her abode.

## \|\| 129.101 \|\|

*atha kṛṣṇaṃ samāyāntaṃ rādhā gopīgaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*anuvrajaṃ yayau hṛṣṭā sarvajñā prāṇavallabham \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. Radha then finding Krishna arriving in Vraja, left the place and followed the lord together with all the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 129.102 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā samīpamāyāntamavaruhya rathātsatī \|*  
*praṇanāma jagannāthaṃ sirasā sakhibhiḥ saha \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Reaching close to him, the chaste Radha bowed in reverence to the lord after his descending from the chariot.

## \|\| 129.103 \|\|

*gopā gopyaśca muditāḥ praphullavadanekṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*duṃdubhiṃ vādayāmāsurīśvarāgamanotsukāḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. All the cowherds and cowherdesses having the delightful face and eyes welcomed the lord and played upon the big drums.

## \|\| 129.104-105 \|\|

*virajāṃ ca samuttīrya dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā rādhikākaram \|\| 104 \|\|*

*śataśṛṅgaṃ ca babhrāma suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā'kṣayavaṭaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. Krishna finding. Radha standing on the river Viraja, at once got down from the chariot and held her hand taking her to the mountain of hundred peaks in the Rasamaiydala, where he started roaming about with her. Thereafter they went to the auspicious banyan tree and having a sight of it, they went to Vmdavana.

## \|\| 129.106 \|\|

*tulasīkānanaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayau mālatīvanam \|*  
*vāme kṛtvā kundavanaṃ mādhavīkānanaṃ tathā \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. There he found the Tulasi-vana, Kunda-vana and Madhavi-vana, leaving them to the left they moved towards the Malatl-vana.

## \|\| 129.107-108 \|\|

*cakāra dakṣiṇe kṛṣṇaścampakāraṇyamīpsinam \|*  
*cakāra paścāttūrṇaṃ ca cārucandanakānanam \|\| 107 \|\|*

*dadarśa purato ramyaṃ rādhikābhavanaṃ param \|*  
*uvāsa rādhayā sārdhaṃ ratnasiṃhāsane vare \|\| 108 \|\|*

107-108. The campaka-vana was to the right and a forest of sandal-wood was at the back. Then he found the place of RSdhika who was lodged in her abode occupying a gem-studded lion throne.

## \|\| 129.109 \|\|

*sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bubhuje vāsitaṃ jalam \|*  
*suṣvāpa puṣpatalpe ca sugandhicandanārcite \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. He consumed there the fragrant water, the betel with camphor and slept on the bed of flowers over which the sandal-paste had been spread.

## \|\| 129.110-111 \|\|

*sa reme rāmayā sārdhaṃ nimagno rasasāgare \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dharmavaktrācca yacchrutam \|\| 110 \|\|*

*golokārohaṇaṃ ramyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 111 \|\|*

110-111. He was filled with ocean of pleasure and started enjoying the company of his beloved. Thus I have narrated everything to you, whatever I had heard from the mouth of Dharma.

## Chapter 130

## \|\| 130.1 \|\|

*atha triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mahābhāga nāraśeṣamabhīpsitam \|*  
*kimapūrva purāṇaṃ ca brahmavaivartamiṣṭadam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – О virtuous one, I have listened, to everything and nothing has been left out. This Brahmavaivarta Ригйпа is unprecedented and fulfils all the wishes.

## \|\| 130.2 \|\|

*adhunā kiṃ kariṣyāmi tanmāṃ brūhi jagadguro \|*  
*ājñāṃ kuru tapasyāṃ ca kartu yāmi himālayam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О teacher of the universe, you tell me as to what should be done by me. You give me a command I shall go to Himalaya for performing tapas.

## \|\| 130.3 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca uvabarhaṇagandhardaḥ pañcaśatkāminīpatiḥ \|*  
*janmāntare bhavānāsīdadhunā brahmaputrakaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Narayana said – In one of your earlier births, you were the husband of fifty damsels, known as a Gandharva named Upabarhana. Currently you are the son of Brahma.

## \|\| 130.4 \|\|

*tāsvekā ca satī ramyā tapasā śaṃkaraṃ param \|*  
*ārādhya ca varaṃ lebhe vāñchitaṃ nāradaṃ patim \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. One of the damsels was quite beautiful and chaste, she performed great tapas for Shiva in order to get Narada as her husband.

## \|\| 130.5 \|\|

*sā ca sṛñjayakanyā ca svarṇaṣṭhīvīsahodarā \|*  
*tāṃ vivāhaṃ kuruṣveti śaṃkarājñā kathaṃ vṛthā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Shaunaka said – О virtuous one, we have listened to quite attractive, astonishing and unprecedented ancient secret, I would like to listen about the marriage of Narada, the son of Brahma and the one who had controlled all his senses.

## \|\| 130.6-7 \|\|

*sundarī sundarīṣvevaṃ komalāṃ kamalākalām \|*  
*pativratāṃ mahābhagāṃ ramyāṃ supriyavādinīm \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kāmukīṃ kamanīyāṃ ca śaśvatsusthirayauvanām \|*  
*vidhātrā likhitaṃ karma prāktanaṃ kena vāryate \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. She was the daughter of Srnjaya and the real sister of SvarnasthivI. You batter marry him. No one could venture to go against the wished of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 130.8 \|\|

*nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi \|*  
*avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ śubhāśubham \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. She happened to be the ray of Lakshmi with tender limbs, besides being quite chaste, virtuous, attractive and Soft spoken. She is quite passionate, beautiful and possessed the ever lasting youthfulness therefore you surely marry her, who can erase the reward of the earlier deeds.

## \|\| 130.9 \|\|

*sūta uvāca nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hṛdayena vidūyatā \|*  
*praṇamya prayayau śīghraṃ nāradaḥ sṛñjayālayam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The deeds do not vanish even after the lapse of hundred crores of kalpas one has to face the reward of the good and had deeds without fail.

## \|\| 130.10-11 \|\|

*śaunaka uvāca aho sūta mahābhāga śrutaṃ kiṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*kimapūrvaṃ rahasyaṃ ca sarasaṃ ca purātanam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*adhunā śrotumicchāmi vivāhaṃ nāradasya ca \|*  
*atīndriyasya ca munerbrahmaputrasya sāṃpratam \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Suta said – On hearing the words of Narayana, Narada bowed before him with a painful heart and at once moved to the abode of Srnjaya.

## \|\| 130.12-13 \|\|

*sūta uvāca nārado mū(gu)ḍharupaśca dṛṣṭāvā sṛñjayakanyakām \|*  
*tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yayau brahmasabhāṃ ramyāṃ sarvadevaiḥ samāvṛtām \|*  
*praṇamya pitaraṃ śāntaḥ sarvaṃ tattvamuvāca tam \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Suta said – Narada secretly looked at the virtuous daughter of Srnjaya and went to the court of Brahma which was surrounded by all the gods. Bowing in reverence to Brahma he spoke to him quite humbly.

## \|\| 130.14-15 \|\|

*brahmā prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ śrutvā vārtāṃ śubhāvahām \|*  
*tapasvinaṃ ca putraṃ ca saṃprāpya jagatāṃ patiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ratnanirmāṇayānena sārdhaṃ devaiḥ śubhe kṣaṇe \|*  
*putraṃ kṛtvā ca purato yayau sṛñjayamandiram \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Brahma the lord of the universe, after meeting his son and learning about the proposed marriage delightfully proceeded with other gods, mounted on the gem-studded plane, accompanied with his son, to the place of Srnjaya.

## \|\| 130.16-18 \|\|

*tacchrutvā sṛñjayo rājā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*gṛhītvā kanyakāṃ ramyāṃ nāradāya dadau mudā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā maṇimuktādikaṃ tathā \|*  
*puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā parihāre cakāra saḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kanyāṃ samarpya brahmāṇaṃ rājā ca yogināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*ruroda bhṛśamuccaiśca vatse vatsa itīritam \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. On hearing about the news, the king Srnjaya adorning his charming daughter with gem-studded ornaments gave her away in marriage to Narada delightfully' He offered several of the precious gems and the riches in daksina the king then prayed to them with folded hands. The king Srnjaya who was the best of the yogis, after offering his daughter to Brahma, started crying uttering the name of his daughter.

## \|\| 130.19 \|\|

*kva yāsi tyaktvā madgehaṃ śūnyaṃ ka malalocane \|*  
*ahaṃ yāmi vanaṃ ghoraṃ tvāṃ tyaktvā jīvito mṛtaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He said, "O daughter having the eyes resembling the lotus flowers where are you going deserting my house. Getting separated from your company I shall go to the terrific forest because without you I am feeling like dead."

## \|\| 130.20 \|\|

*praṇamya pitaraṃ kanyā rudantaṃ mātaraṃ tathā \|*  
*rudatīṃ tāṃ rudantī sā'pyāruroha rathaṃ vidheḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The girl while sobbing left her weeping parents behind offering her salutation to them and mounted on the chariot of Brahma.

## \|\| 130.21 \|\|

*gṛhītvā ca sabhāryaṃ ca putraṃ dhātā mudā'nvitaḥ \|*  
*prayayau brahmalokaṃ ca devandrairmunibhiḥ saha \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Brahma on his part delightfully accompanied with the bride and the groom together with the gods and the sages went to Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 130.22 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbojayāmāsa sāṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi \|*  
*devānapi ca siddhāṃśca vādayāmāsa duṃdubhim \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He performed all the welfare ceremonies there, serving food to the Brahmanas and the gods, beating the big drums.

## \|\| 130.23 \|\|

*nāradastu muniśreṣṭho bādhitaḥ pūrvakarmaṇā \|*  
*yasya yatprāktanaṃ vipra durlaṅdhya kena vāryate \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The sage Narada was deprived of his earlier deeds. О dear one, the one who is habitual to performing particular type of deed, who could prevent him from doing so.

## \|\| 130.24-30 \|\|

*suramye puṣpatalpe ca sugandhicandanārcite \|*  
*sa reme rāmayā sārdha bubudhe na divāniśam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*evaṃ kṛtvā vivāhaṃ ca virato munisattamaḥ \|*  
*uvāsa brahmalokeṣu vaṭamūle manohare \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tatrā''jagāma nagnaśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā \|*  
*sanatkumāro bhagavānsākṣācca bālako yathā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvaśca vayasā yathaiva pañcahāyanaḥ \|*  
*ayūḍo'nupanītaśca vedasaṃdhyāvihīnakaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇeti mantraṃ japati yasya nārāyaṇo guruḥ \|*  
*anantakālakalpaṃ ca bhrātṛbhiśca tribhiḥ saha \|\| 28 \|\|*

*vaiṣṇavānāmagraṇīśo jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ \|*  
*ārāddṛṣṭvā nārādastaṃ bhrātaraṃ ca satāṃ varam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sahasā śirasā bhūmau daṇḍavatpraṇanāma tam \|*  
*uvāca nāradaṃ bālaḥ prahasya paramārthakam \|\| 30 \|\|*

24-30. He then started enjoying the company of his spouse on the bed of flowers and became unconcerned with the passing of the day and night. Thus Narada the best of the sages was involved in the conjugal pleasures. He Started residing under the charming banyan tree. At that point of time, Sanatkumara, the three brothers arrived there who always remained nude, illumining with the divine lustre. They appeared like the Supreme lord in the form of children, appearing in the age of five years, who were devoid of the first shaving of their heads, the thread ceremonies and the performing of sandhya. They were always reciting the mantra of Krishna, whose teacher was Narayana himself, who remained roaming about all the times, was the foremost of the intellectual Vaishnavas, the best of the devotees of the lord and who were the teachers of the teachers, arrived there. Finding those brothers who are the best among the noble people. Narada prostrated before them. The sage then smiled and spoke to Narada, the words which were quite auspicious.

## \|\| 130.31-32 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca aye bhrātaḥ kiṃ karoṣi kuśalaṃ yuvatīpateḥ \|*  
*strīpuṃsorvardhate prema nityaṃ tannityanūtanam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*argalaṃ jñānamārgasya bhaktidvārakapāṭakam \|*  
*mokṣamārgavyavahitaṃ ciraṃ bandhanakāraṇam \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Sanatkumara said – О brother, what are you doing? О husband of damsel, are you keeping on well, is the love of the couple going on increasing? This love obstructs the divine path of knowledge. It serves as the door leaf for the door of devotion. It obstructs the path of salvation and m to the wordily the bondage for a long time.

## \|\| 130.33 \|\|

*garbhavāsasya bījaṃ ca paraṃ narakakāraṇam \|*  
*pīyūṣabuddhyā garalaṃ bhuṅkte pāpī narādhamaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. This is the seed for entering in the womb and results into the fall in the hell. A degraded and sinful person enjoys it like the nectar.

## \|\| 130.34 \|\|

*paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tyaktvā yasyā''ste viṣaye manaḥ \|*  
*sa vañcito māyayā cāmṛtaṃ tyaktvā viṣaṃ bhajet \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The one who discarding the name of Narayana involves himself into such worldly pleasures, he under the influence of the illusion owns the poison discarding nectar.

## \|\| 130.35 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ karmabhoge'sti karmiṇāmīśvaraṃ vinā \|*  
*vayaṃ vidhātuḥ putrāśca sā buddhiriti dehinām \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Except the lord all the people, have to face the fruit of their deeds, we people are the sons of Brahma, this type of behaviour is to be indulged into by the human beings.

## \|\| 130.36 \|\|

*yadi te nāsti bhogaśca kathaṃ gandharvajanma ca \|*  
*kathaṃ dāsīsutastvaṃ ca muktaśca bhaktasaṅgataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. If you have not to face the result of your deed then how could you be born as the son of female servant getting detached from the company of devotees of the lord?

## \|\| 130.37 \|\|

*nirgaccha tapase bhrātastyaja mayāmayīṃ priyām \|*  
*supuṇye bhārate varṣe tapasā bhaja mādhavam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. O brother, discarding this beautiful damsel, who is the form of illusion, you proceed on for performing tapas. In the sacred land of Bharata, you must recite the name of Madhava, performing tapas.

## \|\| 130.38 \|\|

*sthite nārāyaṇe sveśe pare svapadadātari \|*  
*viṣayī viṣayāndhaśca vañcito māyayā dhruvam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. By devoting your mind to lord Narayana who bestows salvation on the people, the one who remains engrossed in the worldly pleasures, he is surely over-powered with the illusion or the pleasures, he surely over-powered with the illusion of the lord.

## \|\| 130.39 \|\|

*gṛhāṇa mama mantraṃ ca kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva santrāṇāṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The essence of all the mantras and the best of all happens to be the mantras called Krishna. You receive it.

## \|\| 130.40 \|\|

*sarveṣu ca purāṇeṣu vedeṣu ca caturṣu ca \|*  
*dharmaśāstraiṣu tantraiṣu nāstyevāsmātparo manuḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. There is no mantra better than the same in all the Puranas, the four Vedas, the religious treatises and all the tantras.

## \|\| 130.41 \|\|

*nārāyaṇena datto me puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi \|*  
*asaṃkhyakalpa japtvā'haṃ bhramāmi sarvapūjitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. This mantra, was given to me by Narayana nimself at Puskara-ksetra on the occasion of the solar eclipse. I reciting the same for innumerable kalpas, became adorable by all and I moved at will.

## \|\| 130.42 \|\|

*ityuktvā snāpayitvā taṃ dadau dasmai paraṃ manum \|*  
*divāniśaṃ sa japati pūtayā maṇimālayā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Thus speaking he bestowed the mantra to Narada. Holding a rosary in his hand, he started reciting the same through out the day and night.

## \|\| 130.43 \|\|

*tasmai śubhāśiṣaṃ dattvā mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ \|*  
*golokaṃ prayayau draṣṭuṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Sanatkumaras who happened to be the foremost of the Vaishnavas pronouncing their blessing for Narada and bestowing the mantra on him went to Goloka to have an audience with the eternal Brahman.

## \|\| 130.44 \|\|

*nāradastu manu prāpya sarvasiddhipradaṃ varam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇe niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ pūrvakarmanikṛntanīm \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Narada on the other hand receiving the mantra which bestowed all the success, destroying all his previous deeds achieved the infallible devotion of Lord Krishna.

## \|\| 130.45 \|\|

*tyaktvā māyāmayīṃ bhāryāṃ bhārataṃ tapase yayau \|*  
*kṛtamālānadītīre dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ param \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Disowning his wife he went to the land of Bharata for performing tapas. Reaching the bank of Krtamala river, he hod an audience with lord Shiva.

## \|\| 130.46 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā ca sahasā mūrdhnā praṇanāma śivaṃ muniḥ \|*  
*tamuvāca jagannātho bhaktaṃ ca bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Finding Shiva there, the sage Narada suddenly prostrated before him. Lord Shiva who bestows his grace on his devotees spoke to Narada.

## \|\| 130.47 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca aho nārada dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ prasanno'haṃ svatejasā \|*  
*bhaktānāṃ darśanaṃ yatra sudinaṃ taccharīriṇām \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Shiva said – О Narada, I have been delimited to meet you with the glory, the day on which meet our devotees, it becomes an suspicious days for the human beings.

## \|\| 130.48 \|\|

*ayaṃ hi paramo lābho dehināṃ baktasaṃgamaḥ \|*  
*sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yo dadarśa ca vaiṣṇavām \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. For the human beings it is quite beneficial to have an audience with the devotees of the lord. The one who has an audience with the Vais navas, he earns the merit of having bath at all the holy places.

## \|\| 130.49 \|\|

*api prāpto mahāmantraḥ sarvatantrasudurlabhaḥ \|*  
*mayā datto gaṇeśāya skandāya svātmajāya ca \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Have you achieved the inaccessible Mahamantra which is difficult of all the tantras which I had bestowed upon Ganesha and my son Skanda.

## \|\| 130.50 \|\|

*mahyaṃ dattaśca kṛṣṇena goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*brahmaṇe cāpi dharmāya dharmo nārāyaṇāya ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The knowledge of this mantra was bestowed by lord Krishna on me in Rasamandala of the Goloka besides Brahma and Dharma. Dharma bestowed the knowledge to Narayana.

## \|\| 130.51 \|\|

*brahmā sanatkumārāya tumyaṃ dattaśca tena vai \|*  
*mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jano nārāyaṇo bhavet \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Brahma bestowed the knowledge to Sanatkumara, who has bestowed the same to you, by receiving this mantra, one becomes Narayana himself.

## \|\| 130.52 \|\|

*vicāraṇaṃ ca nāstyatra kālākālaṃ śubhāśubham \|*  
*pañcalakṣajapenaiva puraścaraṇamasya ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. By reciting this mantra, the good or bad time, become of no consequence; by reciting this mantra five lakhs of time, one meets with success.

## \|\| 130.53-59 \|\|

*dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ tena dhyāyecca vaiṣṇavaḥ \|*  
*dhyānaṃ ca pāpadahanaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇaṃ navaghanaśyāmaṃ kiśoraṃ pītavāsasam \|*  
*śatakoṭīndusaundaryaṃ dadhānamatulaṃ param \|\| 54 \|\|*

*bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇaughaistairamūlyaratnanirmitaiḥ \|*  
*candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ kaustubhena virājitam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ nityopāsyaṃ śivādibhiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|\| 57 \|\|*

*vedānirvacanīyaṃ ta varaṃ sarveśvaraṃ bhaje \|*  
*dhyānenānena taṃ dhyātvā bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*bhaja taṃ paramānandaṃ satyaṃ nityaṃ parātparam \|*  
*ityuktvā svapadaṃ śaṃbhūrjagām parameśvaraḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

53-59. One should adore Krishna according to the dhyanam prescribed in the Samaveda which destroyed the sin and cuts at the root of the deeds. He has dark complexion of the new clouds is of quite a tender age, wearing pltambara, illumining with the lustre of hundred crores of the moons, adorned with best of the gem-studded ornaments. His body is plastered with sandal-paste. The kaustubha gem adorns his chest, the peacock feather appears on the head. He wears the garland and of jasmine flowers, wears a serene smile on the face. He is adored by Shiva and others gods daily, He is difficult to be achieved even with meditation, is devoid of all the gunas, beyond Prakriti, the supreme soul of all, the one who takes to human form for the sake of his devotees, the on who is inexplicable by the Vedas and is the lord of all. I adore lord Krishna who is the best or all. One should meditate upon the eternal lord with this dhyanam. Who is blissful, truthful eternal, beyond everything and is known by the name of lord Krishna. Thus speaking lord Shiva retired to his abode.

## \|\| 130.60 \|\|

*taṃ praṇamya jagannāthaṃ nāradastapase yayau \|*  
*nāradaḥ śrīhariṃ smṛtvā yogāttyaktvā kalevaram nilīnaḥ pādapadme ca pāda (padmā) padmārcite hareḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Bowing at the feet of lord Shiva, Narada went for performing tapas. Narada discarded his human body by yogic practices and devoting his mind at the feet of lord Hari he entered the lotus-like feet of lord Hari which are adored always by Kamala.

## Chapter 131

## \|\| 131.1 \|\|

*adhai katriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ śaunaka uvāca atyapūrvamupākhyānaṃ śrutaṃ paramamādbhutam \|*  
*sugopyaṃ ca sugopyaṃ ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃ navam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shaunaka said – I have listened, to the extremely astonishing, secret, charming and completely new story from you.

## \|\| 131.2 \|\|

*kimanirvacanīyaṃ ca kamanīyaṃ manoharam \|*  
*sudurlabhā kathā proktā purāṇeṣu purātanī \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. But it is inexplicable in the Puranas, charming, beautiful, ancient and the inaccessible story.

## \|\| 131.3-4 \|\|

*evaṃbhūtaṃ ca sudinaṃ kadā'smākaṃ phaviṣyati \|*  
*tajjanma saphalaṃ dhanyaṃ yatra vaiṣṇavasaṃgamaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*garbhavāsocchedanaṃ ca karmamūlanikṛntanam \|*  
*haridāsyapradaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktivardhanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. When shall I meet with such a type of auspicious deeds, in which my life would become successful, keeping the company of the Vaishnavas. This company of the Vaishnavas is destroyer of the life in the womb, cuts at the root of the deeds, bestows toe slavehood of lord Hari and increases his devotion.

## \|\| 131.5-7 \|\|

*asādhusaṅgadurbuddhipāponmūlanakāraṇam \|*  
*gaṇeśajanmopakhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sudurlabham \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tulasīrādhikākhyānaṃ kimapūrva śrutaṃ param \|*  
*anyadyadyadgopanīyaṃ vyaktamavyaktamīpsitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mahābhāga paribūrṇaṃ manoharam \|*  
*adhunā śrotumicchāmi vahnerutpattimīpsitām svarṇasya ca mahābhāga tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. The story about the birth of Ganesha is difficult to get in the Puranas which relieves one from the company of the wicked and evil minded people and uproots the cause of the deeds. I have listened to the story about Tulasi and Radhika. Beside this, I have listened, to several other secret known and unknown stories which fulfil the desires. О lord, I have listened to everything; now I intend to listen to the story about the birth of Agni as well as the gold. О virtuous one, you kindly tell me the story about both of them.

## \|\| 131.8-9 \|\|

*sūta uvāca sāmagrīkaraṇaṃ sṛṣṭerjalameva hutāśanaḥ \|*  
*tathaiva prakṛtirnityā mahāneva tathaiva ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yathā diśo mahākāśo yayaiva sṛṣṭigolakam \|*  
*prakṛtermahataśca syādya thā'haṃkāra eva ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Stita said – Of all the material of the universe water, fire and the eternal Prakriti have their own entity, similarly the Mahatattva has its own entity. As the sky and the direction are there or the universe is there, the arrogance is born out of Prakriti and Mahat.

## \|\| 131.10 \|\|

*yathaiva śabdastanmātraṃ tathaiva ca hutāśanaḥ \|*  
*tathā'pi tatsamutpattiṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Agni also exists like Sabda and Tanmatras. In spite of that I would narrate to you the story about its emergence.

## \|\| 131.11-13 \|\|

*ekadā sṛṣṭikāle ca brahmānantamaheśvarāḥ \|*  
*śvetadvīpaṃ yayuḥ sarve draṣṭuṃ viṣṇuṃ jagatpatim \|\| 11 \|\|*

*parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣāṃ kṛtvā siṃhāsaneṣu ca \|*  
*ūcuḥ sarve sabhāmadhye suramye purato vibhoḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*viṣṇugātrodbhavāstatra kāminyaḥ kamalākalāḥ \|*  
*tatra nṛtyanti gāyanti viṣṇugāthāśca susvaram \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Once during the time of creation Ananta, Brahma and Shiva went to have an audience with Vishnu on the Shveta-dvipa, after mutual discussion. They took their seats on the lion thrones, in the court of lord Vishnu. In the court, the damsels who had emerged out of the body of Lakshmi continued dancing there, reciting the glory of the lord with their sweet voice.

## \|\| 131.14 \|\|

*tāsāṃ ca kaṭhināṃ śroṇiṃ kaṭhinaṃ stanamaṇḍalam \|*  
*sasmitaṃ mukhapadmaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā brahmā sukāmukaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Looking at their well built body, the flesh, smiling faces and the pelvic region, Brahma was infested with passion.

## \|\| 131.15-16 \|\|

*manonivāraṇaṃ kartuṃ na śaśāka pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*vīryaṃ papāta cacchāda lajjayā vāsasā vibhuḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tadvīryaṃ vastrasahitaṃ prataptaṃ kāmatāpataḥ \|*  
*kṣīrode prerayāmāsa saṃgīte virate dvija \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. О Brahmana, Brahma could not control himself and his semen fell. Brahma feeling ashamed hid it in a cloth and after the music was over, Brahma getting infatuated with passion took out the cloth and threw it out in the ocean.

## \|\| 131.17 \|\|

*jalādutthāya puruṣaḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā \|*  
*uvāsa brahmaṇaḥ kroḍe lajjitasya ca saṃsadi \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thereafter, a divine immense lustre, emerged out of the water and sat in the lap of Brahma, who was feeling ashamed seated in the court of Vishnu.

## \|\| 131.18 \|\|

*etasminnantare ruṣṭo jalādutthāya satvaraḥ \|*  
*praṇamya varuṇo devānbālaṃ netuṃ samudyataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. In the meantime, getting angry Varuna came out of the water and bowing in reverence to the gods he tried to take away the boy with him.

## \|\| 131.19 \|\|

*bālo dadhāra brahmāṇaṃ bāhumyāṃ ca bhayādrudan \|*  
*kiṃ cinnovāca jagatāṃ vidhātā lajjayā dvija \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The boy on the other hand started crying and caught hold of Brahma. But Brahma could not speak anything getting ashamed.

## \|\| 131.20 \|\|

*bālakasya kare dhṛtvā cakāra''karṣaṇaṃ ruṣā \|*  
*varuṇaśca sabhāmadhye taṃ cikṣepa prajāpatiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Getting enraged Varuna caught hold of the hand of the boy and dragged him. Brahma, the Prajapati, threw him away in the court.

## \|\| 131.21 \|\|

*papāta dūrato devo varuṇo durbalastataḥ \|*  
*mūrchāṃ saṃprāpa mṛtavatkopadṛṣṭyā vidheraho \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Thereafter, the weak Varuna fell at a distance and with the anger of Brahma, he lay there like a dead person at a distance.

## \|\| 131.22 \|\|

*cetanaṃ kārayāmāsāmṛtadṛṣṭyā ca śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*saṃprāpya cetanaṃ tatra tamuvāca jaleśvaraḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Lord Shiva brought him back to life with his merciful glance. After regaining consciousness, Varuna said –

## \|\| 131.23 \|\|

*varuṇa uvāca bālo jale samudbhūto mama putro'yamīpsitaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ gṛhītvā yāsyāmi brahmā māṃ tāḍayetkatham \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Varuna said – The boy has been born in the water and therefore he is my son. I shall carry him with me, how could Brahma beat me?

## \|\| 131.24 \|\|

*brahmovāca vālakaḥ śaraṇāpanno mayi viṣṇo maheśvara \|*  
*kathaṃ dāsyāmi bhītaṃ ca rudantaṃ śaraṇāgatam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Brahma said – О lord Vishnu, О Maheshvara, this boy has come to take refuge with me. Therefore how can I give away a crying child who has come to take refuge with me.

## \|\| 131.25 \|\|

*śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃ yo na rakṣedapaṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*pacyate niraye tāvadyāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The fool who is unable to protect the humble person who comes to take refuge with him, he has to fall in the hell till the time of the sun and the moon.

## \|\| 131.26 \|\|

*ubhayorvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdhanaḥ \|*  
*uvāca tatra sarvajñaḥ sarveśaśca yathocitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Listening to the words of both of them, the all knowledgeable Madhusfldana spoke the appropriate words.

## \|\| 131.27-28 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca dṛṣṭvā tu kāminīśroṇiṃ vīryaṃ dhātuḥ papāta tat \|*  
*lajjayā prerayāmāsa kṣīrode nirmale jale \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tatau babhūva bālaśca dharmato vidhiputrakaḥ \|*  
*kṣetrajñaśca sutaḥ śāstre varuṇasyāpi gauṇataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The lord said – Looking at the body of the damsels the semen of Brahma had fallen. Feeling ashamed, he threw it out in the spotless water of the ocean. The son born because of that is appropriately the son of Brahma, but he has also to be the son of Varuna according to the provisions of the scriptures.

## \|\| 131.29-30 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca yo vidyāyonisaṃbandho vedeṣu ca nirūpitaḥ \|*  
*śiṣye putre ca samatā ceti vedavido viduḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*mantraṃ dadātu varuṇo vidyāṃca bārakāya ca \|*  
*putro vidhāturvaṅniśca śiṣyaśya varuṇasya ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Mahadeva said – Like the relationship between the knowledge and the yoni, there is no difference between a pupil and the son. This fact is quite well-known to those who are well-versed in the Vedas, in other words, as on is born with the use of yoni and the knowledge is connected with a pupil. Therefore both of them are equals. Therefore Varuna should provide the knowledge and mantras to this boy. This boy named Agni is the son of Brahma and would be the pupil of Varuna.

## \|\| 131.31 \|\|

*viṣṇurdadātu bālāya dāhikāṃ saktimujjvalām \|*  
*sarvadagdho hutāśaśca nirvāṇo varuṇena ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. But the lord Vishnu should provide him the power of burning and becoming illustrious. This Agni would be competent enough to born everybody and Varuna should make the fire to extinguish.

## \|\| 131.32 \|\|

*viṣṇuśca dāhikāṃ śaktiṃ dadau tasmai śivājñayā \|*  
*mantraṃ vidyāṃ ca varuṇo ratnamālāṃ manoharām \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. At the command of Shiva, Vishnu gave him the power of burning and Varuna imparted him the knowledge of mantras and also gave him the charming garland of gems.

## \|\| 131.33 \|\|

*kroḍe kṛtvā ca taṃ bālaṃ cucumba māyayā suraḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇe ca dadau sākṣādviṣṇuśaṃkarayorapi \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Vanina than took the child in his lap and then gave him to Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

## \|\| 131.34 \|\|

*praṇamya viṣṇuṃ brahmā ca yayau śaṃbhuḥ svamandiram \|*  
*agnyutpattiśca kathitā svarṇotpattiṃ niśāmaya \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. All the people then left for their respective abodes, bowing in reverence to Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. Thus I have narrated to you the story of the birth of Agni.

## \|\| 131.35 \|\|

*vilokya rambhāṃ suśroṇiṃ sakāmo vahnireva ca \|*  
*papāta vīryaṃ cacchāda lajjayā vāsasā tathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Once all the gods were seated in the assembly, in the heaven, where the apsaras were dancing.

## \|\| 131.36 \|\|

*vilokya rambhāṃ suśroṇiṃ sakāmo vahnireva ca \|*  
*papāta vīrya cacchāda lajjayā vāsasā tathā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Finding Rambha having beautiful figure, the god Agni became passionate and his semen fell which was covered by him in shame in the cloth.

## \|\| 131.37-38 \|\|

*uttasthau svarṇapuñjaśca vastraṃ kṣiptvā jvalatprabhaḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇena vardhayāmāsa sa sumerurbabhūva ha \|\| 37 \|\|*

*hiraṇyaretasaṃ vahniṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. When the cloth was thrown away by him, it turned into the shining gold and in a moment it was raised to the height of the Sumeru mountain. Thereafter the intellectuals started calling him as Agni having the lustre of gold. Thus I a have narrated to you about the birth of gold what else do you want to listen from me.

## Chapter 132

## \|\| 132.1 \|\|

*atha dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ śaunaka uvāca śrutaṃ sarvaṃ nāvaśeṣaṃ dharmeśa vrahmaṇaṃ ca mām \|*  
*kathayasva mahābhāga purāṇaṃ punareva hi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shaunaka said – О lord of Dharma, I have listened to everything and nothing has been left out. О virtuous one, you kindly narrate the entire Purana to me in brief.

## \|\| 132.2 \|\|

*evaṃvidhaṃ purāṇaṃ ca janmanaiva na hi śrutam \|*  
*nadhṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ tāta tā (tvā) dṛśaṃ vājakaṃ tathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. I have never heard about this Purana, since my birth, О adorable one, I have never come across and orator like you nor have I heard about him.

## \|\| 132.3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca śrūyatāṃ bho mahābhāga sāvadhānaṃ ca saṃyatam \|*  
*adhyāyaśravaṇenaiva purāṇaphalamālabhet \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Stita said – О virtuous one, you listen me attentively the entire Pritna.

## \|\| 132.4 \|\|

*brahmakhaṇḍaṃ ca kathitaṃ paraṃ brahmanirūpaṇam \|*  
*tadanirvacanīyaṃ ca yeṣāmapi yathāgamam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Brahma-khanda consists of the form of Brahman which I have recited. This is beyond description and no one could know about the same through the agamas.

## \|\| 132.5-11 \|\|

*sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ pṛthak \|*  
*yeṣāmapi yathā śaktistathaiva dhyānameva ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*golokādervarṇanaṃ ca krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*tatropayuktopākhyānaṃ yadyatprāsaṅgikaṃ dvija \|\| 6 \|\|*

*jātīnāṃ nīrṇayaścaiva saṃkarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*yadyadviśiṣṭopākhyānaṃ tattatpraśanānurodhataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*rādhāmādhavayoḥ krīḍā mahāviṣṇoḥ samudbhavaḥ \|*  
*nirūpaṇaṃ ca viśveṣāṃ samāsena dvijottama \|\| 8 \|\|*

*brahmanāradayoścaiva saṃvādaḥ paramārthataḥ \|*  
*vipeko nāradasyaiva munīndrasya tathaiva ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ājñayā brahmaṇaścaiva naranārāyaṇāśramam \|*  
*gamanaṃ nāradasyaiva tena sārthaṃ ca darśanam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tayoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ caiva nāradādya(ya) nivedanam \|*  
*tatra deva brahmakhaṇḍaṃ krameṇoktaṃ dvijottama \|\| 11 \|\|*

5-11. He is visible, invisible, with qualities and without qualities separately, one adores him accordingly to his own competence. О best of Brahmana, I have described separately about Goloka and others regions according to Brahma-khanda supported by different stories. I described the various castes and the divine sport of Radha and Madhava besides the emergence of Maha-Vishnu in brief. The talk between Brahma and Narada, the intelligence of sage Narada, his proceeding to the abode of Nara-Narayana, discussion with them and the prayer to Narada have been described.

## \|\| 132.12 \|\|

*śrūyatāṃ prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ sudhākhaṇḍasamaṃ mune \|*  
*prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca varṇanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О sage, now you listen about Prakriti-khanda which is like the peace of nectar, the symptoms of Prakfti and its forms have been described.

## \|\| 132.13-14 \|\|

*upāśyānaṃ ca tāsāṃ ca varṇanaṃ būjanādikam \|*  
*lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rādhikā tathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*etāsāṃ caritaṃ caivamanyāsāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*upākhyānaṃ mahālakṣmyāḥ sarasvatyāstathaiva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Their stories, their destruction and the mode of their adoration have been described. The different forms of Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Durga, Savitri, Radha and other forms of Prakriti were discussed separately in addition to the story of Maha-Lakshmi and MahaSarasvati were also narrated.

## \|\| 132.15-16 \|\|

*apūrvaṃ rādhikākhyānaṃ sāvitryāśca tathaiva ca \|*  
*saṃvādo yamasāvitryoḥ satyavajjīvadānakam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kṛṇḍānāṃ varṇanaṃ proktaṃ teṣāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*jīvitarmavipākaśca bhoganirṇaya eva ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. The story of Radhika and Savitri is unique. The conversation between Yama and Sarasvati besides Satyavan remaining life, the description of kundas and their qualities, the relationship between the human being and the deeds besides, the facing of the results of the deeds have been described.

## \|\| 132.17 \|\|

*apūrva rādhikākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sugopyakam \|*  
*suyajñasca nṛpendrasya caritaṃ paramādbhutam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The story of Radhika, is quite secretive in the Puranas. The story of king Suyajna is quite unique.

## \|\| 132.18 \|\|

*proktaṃ tulasyupākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sugopyakam \|*  
*mahāyuddhaṃ ca saṃvāde maheśaśaṅkhacūḍayoḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The story of Tulsi is quite astonishing and unique. The battle between Shiva and Samkhacuda together with the dialogue has been narrated.

## \|\| 132.19 \|\|

*tulasīkṛṣṇasaṃvādastayoḥ saṃbhoga eva ca \|*  
*nidhanaṃ śaṅkhacūḍasya śrīdāmnaḥ śāpamokṣaṇam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The conversation between Tulasi and Krishna has been narrated, their conjugal pleasures, the killing of Samkhacuda and freeing Radha of the curse of Sridama have been narrated.

## \|\| 132.20 \|\|

*padaprāptiḥ surāṇāṃ ca vipadāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ tathā \|*  
*jīvināṃ mokṣabījaṃ ca gaṅgopākhyānamīpsitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The misfortune of the gods was removed and their regaining the lost glory, the salvation of the creatures and the story of the Ganga have been narrated.

## \|\| 132.21-22 \|\|

*tathaiva manasākhyānaṃ paraṃ harṣavivardhanam \|*  
*svāhāsvadhākhyānamevamanyāsāṃ ca nirūpaṇam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*yadyataprāsaṅgikākhyānaṃ vaktuḥ praśnānurodhataḥ \|*  
*proktaṃ tatprakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ gaṇapateḥ śrṛṇu \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The story of Manasa which increases the pleasure besides the stories of Svaha and Svadha beside over goddesses have been narrated. In the Prakriti-khanda in the series of the question, various other stories have been included, Now I speak about the Ganapati Khanda.

## \|\| 132.23 \|\|

*atīva madhuraṃ ramyaṃ svādu svādu pade pade \|*  
*sugopyaṃ tatpurāṇeṣu ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃ navam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. This Ganapati Khanda is quite sweet and is tasteful at over step. This is quite charming and new and is considered to be most secretive of all the Puranas.

## \|\| 132.24-25 \|\|

*sudurlabhamupākhyānaṃ śrotṛprītikaraṃ param \|*  
*proktā krīḍā ca paramā pārvatīparameśayoḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*skandotpattiḥ prathamataḥ krīḍābhaṅgastayostathā \|*  
*pārvatītoṣaṇaṃ caivamabhimānavimokṣaṇam \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. The stories contained there in, are quite attractive for the listeners, the story of the, sports of Shiva and Parvati are included there in. Initially it relates to the disturbing of the love sport of Shiva and Parvati and then the birth of Skanda. The pride of Parvati and subsiding of the same have been described.

## \|\| 132.26-27 \|\|

*puṇyakaṃ ca vrataṃ viṣṇordevyāścaritamuttamam \|*  
*varadānaṃ harereva suvratāṃ pārvatīṃ prati \|\| 26 \|\|*

*hareśca darśanaṃ caiva brāhmaṇātithirūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*āvirbhāvo gaṇeśasya kṛpayā śivamandire \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. The detail about Puiyyaka-vrata of Vishnu, the story of the goddess, the grant of boon by Vishnu to Parvati have been described. This Khanda also contained details about the meeting with Hari in the form of a Brahmana a guest and the birth of Ganesha in the temple of Shiva, have been mentioned.

## \|\| 132.28 \|\|

*darśanaṃ putravaktrasya pārvatīparameśayoḥ \|*  
*paramānandarūpaṃ ca śivagehe mahotsavam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Looking at the face of their son by Shiva and Parvati and the performing of the festivities in the abode of Shiva have been mentioned.

## \|\| 132.29-32 \|\|

*devādyā dadṛśuḥ sarve bālaṃ nityamajaṃ vibhum \|*  
*satyasvarūpaṃ paramaṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sarvavighnaharaṃ śāntaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*tapasāṃ japayajñānāṃ vratānāṃ phaladaṃ vibhum \|\| 30 \|\|*

*atīva kamanīyaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ ca yoṣitām \|*  
*prāṇādhikaṃ priyatam pārvatīparameśayoḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*paramātmasvarūpaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*sarveśaṃ sarvabījaṃ ca sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakam \|\| 32 \|\|*

29-32. The meeting of the gods and all the ganas with child Ganesha, who has been eternal, virtuous, the form of truth and eternal Brahman has been described. The child happens to be the remover of all the construction, bestower of all the riches, tapas, recitation, performing ofyajna, vratas and the bestower of their fruits, quite virtuous, charming, adored by the ladies, the beloved of Parvati and Shiva, the form of eternal soul, the eternal lord, the lord of all the gods, the seed of all and was the form of Narayana.

## \|\| 132.33 \|\|

*yaddarśanācca stavanātpraṇāmātpūjanāttathā \|*  
*dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ janmakoṭyaghanāśanam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. With the audience of whom, by reciting whose name, by adoring whom, all the crores of the sins committed during the earlier births are destroyed.

## \|\| 132.34 \|\|

*kārtikoddharaṇaṃ proktaṃ tasyābhiṣeka eva ca \|*  
*gaṇeśapūjanaṃ caiva sarvavighnavināśanam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The Khanda also contains the account of the redemption of Karttikeya and his crowding; the method of adoration of Ganesha has also been described.

## \|\| 132.35 \|\|

*jamadagneśca yuddhaṃ ca kārtavīryārjunena ca \|*  
*surabhīharaṇaṃ caiva nidhanaṃ ca munestathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The battle between Jamadagni and Karttavirya-Arjuna, the abduction of Surabhl and the killing of the sage have been described.

## \|\| 132.36 \|\|

*pativratāreśukāyāścitārohaṇameva ca \|*  
*pratijñātaṃ bhṛgoścaiva dāruṇaṃ ca sudāruṇam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The self burning by the chaste Renuka, the terrific vow taken by Bhrigu, have also been described.

## \|\| 132.37 \|\|

*niḥkṣatrīkaraṇaṃ caivamekaviṃśatikaṃ dvija \|*  
*saṃvādo jñānalābhaśca gaṇeśaparśurāmayoḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. О Brahmana, the dialogue between Ganesha and Para.shurama, who rid the earth of the Ks atriyas twenty one times, has been narrated.

## \|\| 132.38 \|\|

*tayoryuddhaṃ dārumaṃ ca herambadantabhañjanam \|*  
*durgāyāśca vilāpaścābhiśāpo bhārgavaṃ prati \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The battle between both of them besides the breaking of the tusk of Ganesha, the lamenting of Durga and the curse of Bhargava, have been described.

## \|\| 132.39 \|\|

*smaraṇe parśurāmasyāpyāvirbhāvo harerapi \|*  
*pārvatīṃ bodhayāmāsa svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The appearing of Hari at the reciting of his name by Paras'urama, convincing of Parvati by lord Narayana.

## \|\| 132.40-41 \|\|

*varṇanaṃ śivalokasya paramāścaryamīpsitam \|*  
*pradattaṃ parśurāmāya mahāstraṃ śaṃkareṇa ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

*mantraṃ ca kavacaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*varadānaṃ cābhayaṃ ca pradānaṃ sarvasaṃpadām \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. The description of astonishing and desirable Shivaloka and bestowing of the greet weapon by Shiva to Paras'urama, the giving away of the mantra-kavacha of Shri Krishna beside the protection and all the riches have been mentioned.

## \|\| 132.42 \|\|

*triḥsaptakṛtvo bhūpānāṃ nidhanaṃ ca cakāra saḥ \|*  
*babhūva bhṛguṇā vipra bhuvaśca bhāramīkṣaṇam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The killing of Kshatriyas by Parashurama twenty one times ridding the earth of her burden has been discussed.

## \|\| 132.43 \|\|

*praśnānurodhakramataḥ pūrvāpākhyānameva ca \|*  
*proktaṃ gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ samāsena dvijottama \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О best of the sage, in the series of the questions, the stories of Ganapati-khands have been described.

## \|\| 132.44 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ mokṣakaraṃ param \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Now you listen to the Krishna Janma Khanda which removed the birth, death, old age and ailment. You listen to it quite carefully.

## \|\| 132.45 \|\|

*haridāsyapradaṃ śuddhaṃ suśrāvyaṃ ca sudhopamam \|*  
*atyabūrvamuṇākhyānaṃ ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃ navam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The story is unprecedented, quite charming, always fresh and bestows the slavehood of lord Hari, besides being auspicious, nectar, like and fit for hearing.

## \|\| 132.46 \|\|

*na śrutaṃ canmanā yadyatsvadu svādu pade pade \|*  
*pradīpaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ bhavābdhitāraṇaṃ param \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. It is tasteful at every stop, in case of achieving a human birth, one does net listen to it, his birth would be of no consequence. This Khanda illumines all the tattvas and happens to be the means of crossing on the ocean of universe.

## \|\| 132.47 \|\|

*karmepabhogarogāṇāṃ mardanaṃ ca rasāyanam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojaprāptisopānakāraṇam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. This is such a type of alchemistry which destroys all the deeds and the ailment and serves as a step towards salvation.

## \|\| 132.48 \|\|

*śrīdāmarādhākalahavarṇanaṃ dāruṇaṃ dvija \|*  
*tayoḥ śāpaprakathanaṃ tatasteṣāṃ visarjanam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О Brahmana, there is a mention of the great quarrel between Radha and Sridama. The curses of both of them have been highlighted beside their departure from Goloka.

## \|\| 132.49 \|\|

90\. This Brahmavaivarta has been divided into four parts. О best of the sages, what more do you want to listen from me.

## Chapter 133

## \|\| 133.1-2 \|\|

*atha trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ śaunaka uvāca adhya me saphalaṃ janma cīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam \|*  
*yatphalaṃ brahmavaivarte nirvighnaṃ mokṣakāraṇam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*abhayaṃ dehi he vatsa he tāta mahyameva ca \|*  
*tadā nivedanaṃ kiṃcidastīti ca karomyaham \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Shaunaka said – My life has been successful today my birth has been beautified, because the Brahmavaivarta removes all the obstruction and provides salvation. О son, you first assure protection to me and only then I shall put any further question

## \|\| 133.3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca tyaja bhītiṃ mahābhāga praśnaṃ kuru yadicchasi \|*  
*sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi yadyadgopyaṃ manoharam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Suta said – O virtuous one, shed away the rear and ask me any question of you liking. I shall speak out to you whatever is secret and pleasant.

## \|\| 133.4 \|\|

*śaunaka uvāca adhunā śrotumicchāmi purāṇānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam \|*  
*saṃkhyānamapi teṣāṃ ca phalamasyaiva putraka \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Shaunaka said – Presently I intend to listen to the distinguishing features of the Puranas, their number and the fruits for the listening, to the same.

## \|\| 133.5 \|\|

*sūta uvāca vistarāṇi purāṇāni cetihāsaśca śaunaka \|*  
*saṃhitāṃ pañcarātrāṇi kathayāmi yathāgatam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Suta said – О Shaunaka, the Puranas are quite comprehensive which include history, collection of hymns and Pancardtra. I speak them to you according to the scriptures.

## \|\| 133.6 \|\|

*sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca \|*  
*vaṃśānucaritaṃ vipra purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. A Purana has five characteristics which include sarga (creation of the universe), pratisarga (dissolution and recreation of the universe), Varhsha (genealogies of gods, the patriarchs, the sun, the moon etc.) than manvantaras (aeons presided over by Manus) and vamsanucarita (accounts of dynasties of the different ruling families).

## \|\| 133.7 \|\|

*etadupapurāṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*mahatāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kathayāmi te \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The intellectuals should know this characteristics of the Upapuranas. Now I am explaining about the Mahapuranas.

## \|\| 133.8-10 \|\|

*sṛṣṭiścāpi visṛṣṭiśca sthitisteṣāṃ ca pālanam \|*  
*karmaṇāṃ vāsanā vārtāmanūnāṃ cākrameṇa ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*varṇanaṃ pralayānāṃ ca maukṣasya ca nirūpaṇam \|*  
*utkīrtanaṃ harereva vedānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 9 \|\|*

*daśādhikaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca mahatāṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*saṃkhyānaṃ ca purāṇānāṃ nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. The creation, preservation, maintenance, lust for performing deeds, the story of Manus the description of dissolution, the mode of salvation, the reciting of hymns of Hari, reciting of the Vedas separately are the ten additional, characteristics of Mahapurana. Now I speak to you about the number of the Puranas. You try to understand me.

## \|\| 133.11 \|\|

*paraṃ brahmapurāṇaṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ daśaiva tu \|*  
*pañconaṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ pādmameva prakīrtitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Brahma-purana happens to be the best of all containing ten thousand verses followed by Padma-purana containing fifty five thousand verses.

## \|\| 133.12 \|\|

*trayoviṃśatisāhasraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ śaivaṃ caiva nirūpitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The intellectuals believe, Vishnu-purana to contain twenty-three thousand verses. Shiva-purana consists of twenty four thousand verses.

## \|\| 133.13 \|\|

*grantho'ṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ śrīmadbhāgavataṃ viduḥ \|*  
*pañcaviṃśatisāhasraṃ nāradīyaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Shrimadbhdgvata-purana comprises of eighteen thousand verses while Naradiya-purana has twenty five thousand verses.

## \|\| 133.14-16 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍaṃ navasāhasraṃ purāṇaṃ paṇḍitā viduḥ \|*  
*catuḥśatādhikaṃ pañcadaśasāhasrameva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*paramagnipurāṇaṃ ca ruciraṃ parisīrtitam \|*  
*caturdaśasahasrāṇi paraṃ pañcaśatādhikam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*purāṇapravaraṃ caiva bhaviṣyaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*aṣṭādaśasahasraṃ ca brahmavaivartamīpsitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. The Markandeya-purana consists of nine thousand verses, while Agni-purana comprises of fifteen thousand and four hundred verses, the Bhavisya-purana has fourteen thousand and five hundred verses while Brahmavaivarta-purana comprises of eighteen thousand verses.

## \|\| 133.17 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ sārameva vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*ekādaśasahasraṃ tu paraṃ liṅgapurāṇakam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The Brahmavaivarta-purana is considered to be essence of all the Puranas. The Linga-purdna has eleven thousand verses.

## \|\| 133.18-19 \|\|

*caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ vārāhaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*ekāśītisahasraṃ ca parameva śatādhikam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*varaṃ skandapurāṇaṃ ca sadbhirevaṃ nirūpitam \|*  
*vāmanaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kaurma saptadaśaiva tu \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. The Varaha-purana has twenty four thousand verges. The Skanda-purana has been conceived to contain eighty one thousand and one hundred verses. Vamana-purana comprises of ten thousand verses and Kurma-purana contains seventeen thousand verses.

## \|\| 133.20 \|\|

*mātsyaṃ caturdaśa proktaṃ purāṇaṃ paṇḍitaistathā \|*  
*ūnaviśatisāhasraṃ gāruḍaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The intellectuals belief that a Matsya-purdna has fourteen thousand verses and Garuda-purana comprises of nineteen thousand verses.

## \|\| 133.21 \|\|

*paraṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ brahmāḍhaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*evaṃ purāṇasaṃkhyānaṃ caturlakṣamudāhṛtam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Brahmdnda-purana has twelve thousand verses; thus the total number or the verses of all the Puranas comes to two lakhs.

## \|\| 133.22 \|\|

*aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāmevameva vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*evaṃ copapurāṇānāmaṣṭādaśa prakīrtitā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. This is the number of verses described by the intellectuals in the Puranas; similarly there are eighteen Upa-puranas.

## \|\| 133.23 \|\|

*itihāso bhārataṃ ca vānmīkaṃ kāvyameva ca \|*  
*pañcakaṃ pañcarātrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇamāhātmyapūrvakam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Mahabharata is a book of history. The Valmlki Ramayana happens to be an epic. There are five Pancaratras including the Krishna-mahatmya.

## \|\| 133.24-26 \|\|

*vasiṣṭhaṃ nāradīyaṃ ca kāpilaṃ gautamīyakam \|*  
*paraṃ sanatkumārīyaṃ pañcarātraṃ ca pañcakam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*pañcakaṃ sahitānāṃ ca kṛṣṇabhaktisamanvitam \|*  
*brahmaṇāśca śivasyāpi prahlādasya tathaiva ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

*gautamasya kumārasya saṃhitāḥ parikīrtitāḥ \|*  
*iti te kathitaṃ sarva krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. The five Pancaratras are the Vasistha-ratra, Naradiya-ratra, Kapila-rdtra, Gautamiya-ratra and Sanatkumariya-ratra. There are five collections of hymns known Samhitas relating to the adoration of Krishna. These are Brahma-samhita, Shiva-samhitd, Prahlada-samhita, Gautama-samhita and Kumara-samhita; thus I have explained to you everything separately.

## \|\| 133.27-28 \|\|

*astyevaṃ vipulaṃ śāstraṃ mamāpi ca yathāgamam \|*  
*uvācedaṃ purāṇaṃ ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 27 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsākṣādbrahmāṇaṃ ca svabhaktakam \|*  
*brahmā dharma ca dharmiṣṭhaṃ dharmo nārāyaṇaṃ munim \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. This is a vast book. In the Rasamandala of the Goloka, according the agamas this Purana was narrated by Shri Krishna to me as well as to Brahma who happens to be his devotee. Brahma then narrated the same to Dharma and Dharma narrated the same to Narayana.

## \|\| 133.29-32 \|\|

*nārāyaṇo nāradaṃ ca nārado māṃ ca bhaktakam \|*  
*ahaṃ tvāṃ ca muniśreṣṭha variṣṭhaṃ kathayāmi tat \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sudarlabhaṃ purāṇaṃ ca brahmavaivartamīpsitam \|*  
*yadvṛṇotyeva viśvaughaṃ jīvināṃ paramātmakam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tadbrahma sākṣirūpaṃ ca karmaṇāmeva karmiṇām \|*  
*tadbrahma vivṛtaṃ yatra tadvibhūtimanuttamām \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tenedaṃ brahmavaivartamityevaṃ ca bidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*puṇyapradaṃ purāṇaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ maṅgalapradam \|\| 32 \|\|*

29-32. Narayana narrated it to Narada and Narada narrated the same to me. О best of the sages, I have spoken out to you all this, taking you to be a senior sage. It is difficult to get the Brahmavaivarta Purdna which influences the universe. It is the form of eternal Brahman for the people of the universe and it happens to be the witness for all those, performing the deeds. The people call it by the title of Brahmavaivarta Purdna because of the glory of Brahman is contained in it. This Purana bestows prosperity, merit and all the welfare.

## \|\| 133.33 \|\|

*sugopyaṃ ca rahasyaṃ ca yatra ramyaṃ navaṃ navam \|*  
*haribhaktipradaṃ caiva durlabhaṃ haridāsyadam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. It is quite secretive, pleasant and is filled with many secrets, it bestows the devotion of lord Hari besides the inaccessible slavehood of the lord.

## \|\| 133.34 \|\|

*sukhadaṃ brahmadaṃ sāraṃ śokasaṃtāpanāśanam \|*  
*saritāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā sadyo muktipradā śubhā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. It is quite pleasant, bestower of the Brahman, is the form of gist, destroyer of grief and mental agony; as the Ganga is considered to be the sacred most of all the rivers and bestower of salvation, this Purana also is believed to be like the same.

## \|\| 133.35 \|\|

*tirthātāṃ puṣkaraṃ śuddhaṃ yathā kāśī purīṣu ca \|*  
*sarveṣu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ sadyo muktipradaṃ śubham \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. As Puskara is considered to be the holiest of all the holy places, Kasi of all the cities, Bharatavarsa of all the contents which bestows salvation. Similarly this Purana also happens to be like that.

## \|\| 133.36 \|\|

*yathā sumeruḥ śaileṣu pārijātaṃ ca puṣpataḥ \|*  
*patreṣu tulasīpatraṃ vrateṣvekādaśīvratam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. As the Sumeru is among the mountains, Tulasi leaf among all the leaves, Ekadashi among the vratas, at the best, similarly this Purana happens to be the best.

## \|\| 133.37 \|\|

*vṛkṣeṣu kalpavṛkṣaśca śrīkṛṣṇaśca sureṣu ca \|*  
*jñānīndreṣu mahādevo yogīndreṣu gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. As kalpavrksa is considered to be the best of the trees, Shri Krishna is the best among the gods, Shiva among the intellectuals, Ganesha among the yogis is considered to be the best, similarly this Purana happens to be the best.

## \|\| 133.38 \|\|

*siddhendreṣveva kapilaḥ sūryastejasvināṃ yathā \|*  
*sanatkumāro bhagavānvaiṣṇaveṣu yathā'graṇīḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. As Kapila happens to be the best of siddhas, the sun among those containing luster, Sanatkumara among the Vaishnavas, similarly this Purana happens to be the best of all.

## \|\| 133.39 \|\|

*bhūpeṣu ca yathā rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca dhanuṣmatām \|*  
*devīṣu ca yathā durgā mahāpuṇyavatī satī \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. As Rama is considered to be the best of the kings, Laksmana among the archers, chaste Durga among the goddesses, similar is the case with this Purana.

## \|\| 133.40-41 \|\|

*prāṇādhikā yathā rādhā kṛṣṇasya preyasīṣu ca \|*  
*īśvarīṣu yathā lakṣmīḥ paṇḍiteṣu sarasvatī \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tathā sarvapurāṇeṣu brahmavaivartameva ca \|*  
*nāto diśiṣṭaṃ sukhadaṃ madhuraṃ ca supuṇyadam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. As Radha happens to be the best of the beloved's of Krishna, Lakshmi among the goddesses, Sarasvati among the goddesses of learning, similar is the case with this Purana which is quite pleasant, sweet, bestower of merit. No other Purana is comparable to it.

## \|\| 133.42 \|\|

*saṃdehabhañjanaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*iha loke ca sukhadaṃ supradaṃ sarvasaṃpadām \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Now the fruit of listening of the Purana is defined. This Purana has been defined to be the one which shatters all the doubts. This is the one, which provides all the pleasures and1 riches in this world.

## \|\| 133.43 \|\|

*śubhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva vighnanighnakaraṃ param \|*  
*haridāsyapradaṃ caiva paraloke praharṣadam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. It bestows pleasure, merit and is the remover of obstructions, bestower of the slavehood of lord Hari and provides pleasure in the other worlds as well.

## \|\| 133.44 \|\|

*yajñānāmapi tīrthānāṃ vratānāṃ tapasāṃ tathā \|*  
*bhuvaḥ pradakṣiṇasyāpi phalaṃ nāsya samānakam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The merit of performing yajna visiting holy places, vratas, tapas, going round the globe cannot be compared with, the merit of listening to his Purana.

## \|\| 133.45 \|\|

*caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ pāṭhādapi varaṃ phalam \|*  
*śrṛṇotīdaṃ purāṇaṃ ca saṃyataśceha putraka \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О son, in case anyone listens to it attentively, he achieves a merit greater than the reciting of the Vedas.

## \|\| 133.46 \|\|

*guṇavantaṃ ca vidvāṃsaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ putramālabhet \|*  
*śrṛṇoti durbhagā cettu saubhāgyaṃ svāmino labhet \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. In case an issueless person listens to the recitation of this Purana, he achieves a virtuous son. In case an unfortunate woman listens to it, she becomes quite fortunate and enjoys the company of her husband.

## \|\| 133.47 \|\|

*mṛtavatsā kākavandhyā mahāvandhyā ca pāpinī \|*  
*purāṇaśravaṇāllebhe putraṃ ca ciracīvinam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The one who always delivers dead Children or the one who is extremely barred or even a wicked woman achieves a virtuous son by listening to this Purana.

## \|\| 133.48-49 \|\|

*aputro labhate putramabhāryo labhate priyām \|*  
*aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt \|*  
*bhayānmucyeta bhītastu mucyetāpanna āpadaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. A person without a child, gets a child. A person without a wife gets a wife, the one who has lost his glory gets back the glory and the foolish becomes an intellectual. And ailing person is relieved of the ailment, a person in bondages is relieved of them. A terrified person is freed from the fear and the unfortunate person is relieved of the misfortune.

## \|\| 133.50-58 \|\|

*araṇye brāntare bhīto dāvāgno mucyate dhruvam \|*  
*aghaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca dāridryaṃ rogaṃ śokaṃ ca dāruṇam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*puṇyavānśravaṇādeva naiva jānātyapuṇyavān \|*  
*ślokārdha ślokapādaṃ vā yaḥ śṛṇoti susaṃyataḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*golakṣadānapuṇyaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*yutuḥkhaḍaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śuddhakāle jitendriyaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*saṃkalpato yaḥ śṛṇoti bhaktyā dattvā ca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*yadbālye yaccakaumāre vārdhake yacca yauvane \|\| 53 \|\|*

*koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*ratnanirmāṇayānena dhṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇarūpakam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*nityaṃ gatvā ca golokaṃ kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ labhedbhūvam \|*  
*asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pāte na bhavettasya pātanam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*samīpe pārṣado bhūtvā sevāṃ ca kurute ciram \|*  
*śrutvā ca brahmakhaṇḍaṃ ca susnātaḥ saṃyataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ caiva phalaṃ tāmbūlameva ca \|*  
*bhojayitvā vācakaṃ ca tasmai dadyātsuvarṇakam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*candanaṃ śuklamālyaṃ ca sūkṣmavastraṃ manoharam \|*  
*nivedya vāsudevaṃ ca vācakāya pradīyate \|\| 58 \|\|*

50-58. In the secluded forest or in the forest fire, a person is freed from all the danger. A virtuous person by listening to this Purana a is relieved of all the sins, leprosy, poverty, ailment and terrific grief. The sinful person cannot know about it but he achieves the merit or giving a lakh of cows in charity. There is no doubt about it. The one who has controlled all his senses listens to all the four-khanda of the Purana in auspicious time, with devotion and gives away daksina thereafter, he is relieved of all the sins accumulated during his childhood boyhood, youthful age or the old age. There is no doubt about it. He, mounting on the gem-studded chariot, taking to the form or Krishna proceeds to Goloka and accepts the slavehood of Krishna. lie never gets destroyed even after the destruction of innumerable Brahmas and he remains with the lord as his attendants for a long time. Taking a proper bath controlling his senses and with an auspicious mind, after listening to Brahma-khanda, one should series the fried food, the payasam, the fruit, the betel and gold to a beggar as daksina. Thereafter, he should offer the sandal-paste, white garland, fine cloth and the naivedya of the lord to the reciter of the Puranas.

## \|\| 133.59 \|\|

*śrutvā ca prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ suśrāvyaṃ ca sudhopamam \|*  
*bhojayitvā ca dadhyannaṃ tasmai dadyācca \|*  
*kāñcanam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. By listening to the beautiful Prakriti Khanda, the reciter of the Purana should be served with curd and the food besides, gnda.

## \|\| 133.60 \|\|

*savatsāṃ surabhiṃ ramyāṃ dadyādvai bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*śrutvā gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ vighnanāśāya saṃyataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Thereafter he should give away in charity, a cow with calf. For the removal of obstruction one should listen to the Ganapati Khanda with a devoted mind.

## \|\| 133.61-64 \|\|

*svarṇayajñopavītaṃ ca śvetāśvacchatramālyakam \|*  
*pradīyate vāyakāya svastikaṃ tilalaḍḍukam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*paripakvaphalānyeva kāladeśodbhavāni ca \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaṃ ca śrutvā bhaktaśca bhaktitaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*vācakāya pradadyācca paraṃ ratnāṅgulīyakam \|*  
*sūkṣmavastraṃ ca mālyaṃ ca svarṇakuṇḍalamuttamam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*mālyaṃ ca varadolāṃ ca supakvaṃ kṣīrameva ca \|*  
*sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātstavanaṃ kurute dhruvam \|\| 64 \|\|*

61-64. The reciter of the Purana should be given the yajnopavlta of gold, a white horse a garland, svastika, sheshamum sweet balls and the ripe seasonal fruits and flowers. The devotees after listening to the Krishna Janma Khanda with devotion should offer a gem-studded ring to the reciter of the Purana, the fine cloth, a garland, gold ear-rings, beautiful palanquin, boiled milk and everything else should be given to him in daksina offering him the prayer.

## \|\| 133.65-67 \|\|

*śatakaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojayetparamādarāt \|*  
*brahmaṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śāstraniṣṇātaṃ paṇḍitaṃ varam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*kurute vācakaṃ śuddhamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇa vimukhādduṣṭānnopadiṣṭācca brāhmaṇāt \|\| 66 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇabhaktiyuktaṃ ca purāṇaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti ca \|*  
*bhaktiṃ puṇyaṃ na labhate hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam \|\| 67 \|\|*

65-67. He should then serve find to a hundred Brahmanas, besides the devotees of Vishnu, the person well-versed in the scriptures otherwise the entire exercise would be fruitless, The one who listen to the recitation of the Krishna Janma Khanda from the one who does not believe in Krishna and is devoid of his devotion, he cannot earn the devotion of lord; all the merits or; the other hand get destroyed.

## \|\| 133.68 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇabhaktiyuktācca purāṇaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti ca \|*  
*bhaktiṃ puṇyaṃ ca labhate yātyante śrohareḥ padam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The one who listens to the Purana from a Brahmana who is devoted to Shri Krishna, he earns the devotion of the lord as well as the merit and ultimately he achieves lord Hari.

## \|\| 133.69 \|\|

*etatte kathitaṃ sarva yacchru taṃ guruvaktrataḥ \|*  
*bidāyaṃ dehi viprendra yāmi nārāyaṇāśramam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Whatever I had heard from the mouth of my teacher I have narrated the same to you. Therefore О best of the Brahmanas, you bid me farewell. I am going to the abode of Shri Narayana.

## \|\| 133.70 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā viprasamūhaṃ ca namaskartuṃ samāgataḥ \|*  
*kathitaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ bhavatāmājñayā param \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. I had arrived here to offer my salutation finding a group of Brahmanas here. At your command I have recited the Brahmavaivarta Purana.

## \|\| 133.71 \|\|

*namo'stu brāhmaṇebhyaśca kṛṣṇāya paramātmane \|*  
*śivāya brahmaṇe nityaṃ gaṇeśāya namo namaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. I bow in reverence to the Brahmanas, lord Krishna, Shiva, Brahma and Ganesha.

## \|\| 133.72 \|\|

*kāyena manasā vācā paraṃ bhaktyā divāniśam \|*  
*bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma rādheśaṃ triguṇātparam \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The lord of Radha who is beyond the three gunas, is truthful, should be adored through-out day and night physically, mentally as well as with speech.

## \|\| 133.73-74 \|\|

*namo devyai sarasvatyai purāṇagurave namaḥ \|*  
*sarvavighnavināśinyai durgādevyai namo namaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*yuṣmākaṃ pādadmāni dṛṣṭvā puṇyāni śaunaka \|*  
*adya siddhāśramaṃ yāmi yatra devo gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. The goddess Sarasvati, Vyasa, the teacher of the Puranas and Durga the destroyer of the misfortune are adored by me again and again offering salutation to than. О Shaunaka, after looking at your auspicious lotus-like feat, I am now proceeding to Siddhasrama where Ganapati is lodged.
